data.description:
Description

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale. 

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them. 

About The Mansort Team

The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers. 

We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises. 

Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs. 

Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation. 

As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations. 

Key job responsibilities

Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments. 

Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements. 

Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation. 

Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies. 

Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions. 

Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience. 

Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization. 

Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability. 

Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
data.description:
Description

Do you want to shape how people stay connected across calls, text, and email? Alexa Connections is building a trusted communication agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, then acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel natural. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you'll design and deliver the software systems behind a context-aware assistant that grows more helpful over time. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle - from understanding customer problems, through system design and implementation, to deployment and operations - building privacy-first solutions that serve tens of millions of daily communication events. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement software services that model each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of relationships and communication patterns used to power context-aware assistance. 
 - Build and operate scalable backend systems that integrate large language models and agentic reasoning to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect across calls, text, and email. 
 - Collaborate with scientists, product managers, and peer engineering teams to translate research advances in personalization and memory into reliable, production-grade features. 
 - Contribute to the full software development lifecycle - scoping, design, code review, testing, deployment, and operational support - while coaching teammates through constructive code reviews and documentation. 
 - Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, and continuously improve system reliability, maintainability, and performance. 

A day in the life

Your morning might start with a design review for a new personalization feature, working through tradeoffs in scalability and data privacy with senior engineers and applied scientists. After lunch you could be writing and testing code for a service that ranks a customer's most relevant contacts, then pairing with a teammate on a code review. You'll regularly join standups with product managers and scientists to align on priorities, and you'll rotate through on-call responsibilities to keep the systems you build running smoothly. 

About The Team

The Alexa Connections team is growing, so you'll join early and help shape its engineering culture from the ground up. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and scientists who are invested in your growth, with mentorship and the chance to own meaningful problems. Our mission is to make communication effortless and trustworthy for customers worldwide, and we're focused on building intelligent, privacy-first systems that redefine how people stay in touch. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Lead Solution Architect - ADMS Presales | Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization
data.description:
Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Bangalore

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 12807

Posting Start Date: 10/13/26

At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130, 000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future. 

Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization

Role family: Business Consulting / Solution Architecture

Technology focus: Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration

Ideal Candidate

A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome. 

Role Purpose

Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization. 

Role Summary

The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility. 

Application Solution Architect

- Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery. 
 - Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management. 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts. 
 - Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach. 
 - Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context. 
 - Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications. 
 - Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks. 
 - Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable. 
 - Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery. 
 - Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets. 

Core Technical Capabilities

- Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design. 
 - Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development. 
 - Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions. 
 - Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls. 
 - Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node. js. 
 - Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance. 
 - Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria. 

Leadership and Consulting Skills

- Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms. 
 - Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs. 
 - Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning. 
 - Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities. 
 - Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers. 

Experience And Qualifications

- Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms. 
 - Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation. 
 - Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable. 

Technology and Platform Exposure

Front end and mobile: Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility. 

Back end and APIs: Spring Boot, Node. js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management. 

Cloud and containers: Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance. 

Integration and Middleware: API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security. 

Engineering and delivery: Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy. 

Operations: Monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, resilience, backup/recovery, service readiness and support transition. 

Relocation Supported: Yes

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

data.title: Sr. Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Join Us as a Sr. Manager, Engineering!

Are you ready to make a significant impact in an innovative environment? At ORBCOMM, we're looking for an experienced and technically strong Sr. Manager, Engineering to lead high-performing software engineering teams responsible for building and operating our cloud-based IoT and asset intelligence solutions. 

If you're passionate about developing engineering talent, building scalable cloud platforms, and translating complex business requirements into reliable technology solutions that create meaningful customer value, we'd love to hear from you. 

Why You'll Love Working Here

As a Sr. Manager, Engineering, you'll lead software engineering teams responsible for the design, development, delivery, and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based products and platforms. 

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, Quality Assurance, DevOps, and Customer Success to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support ORBCOMM's global customers. 

This role combines technical leadership, people leadership, and delivery execution. You'll help establish engineering standards, guide technical decision-making, develop engineering talent, and ensure teams have the structure, priorities, and resources needed to deliver high-quality products. You'll also collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams, helping create consistent engineering practices and a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer focus. 

This role is based out of our Hyderabad office. We operate in an onsite work environment. 

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

- Lead software engineering teams responsible for the development and operation of ORBCOMM's cloud-based IoT, asset intelligence solutions and AI First offerings. 
 - Drive execution of cloud platform initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable software. 
 - Manage engineering capacity, prioritization, and resource allocation across multiple projects and initiatives. 
 - Partner with Product Management to translate business requirements into technical solutions and executable delivery plans. 
 - Drive Agile development practices, including sprint planning, release management, and continuous delivery. 
 - Monitor engineering productivity, software quality, system reliability, and customer satisfaction to identify opportunities for improvement. 

Technical & Operational Excellence

- Establish and champion engineering best practices across software development, architecture, code quality, testing, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Guide teams in the development and operation of cloud-native applications, microservices, APIs, and distributed systems. 
 - Promote effective CI/CD, DevOps, automation, monitoring, and production support practices. 
 - Drive improvements in application scalability, performance, reliability, and security. 
 - Support customer escalations and critical production issues when required, ensuring appropriate technical resources and stakeholders are engaged. 

People & Organizational Leadership

- Lead, coach, and mentor engineering teams while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop engineering talent through ongoing coaching, feedback, career development, and succession planning. 
 - Build and scale high-performing engineering teams capable of supporting evolving product and business priorities. 
 - Create an environment that encourages technical excellence, ownership, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing. 

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Customer Success, and other business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate effectively with engineering teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
 - Communicate engineering priorities, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Apply data-driven decision-making to engineering priorities, resource planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Who You Are

You're an experienced engineering leader who combines strong technical knowledge with exceptional people leadership and execution capabilities. You understand how to build high-performing teams while maintaining a strong focus on software quality, operational reliability, and customer outcomes. 

If You Have

- 15+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed software engineering teams. 
 - Strong experience building and operating cloud-native applications and enterprise software platforms. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Hands on experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, API development, and system integrations. 
 - Experience with cloud security, scalability, performance optimization, monitoring, and system reliability. 
 - Familiarity with databases, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience managing cloud-based enterprise software products and platforms. 
 - Experience within IoT, transportation, logistics, telematics, supply chain, industrial automation, connected products, or a related technology environment. 
 - Knowledge of IoT platforms, connected devices, telemetry, and asset tracking solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership. 
 - A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering measurable business outcomes. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy. 

Then we want to meet you!

The Benefits Of Working Here

A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts-helping you thrive both professionally and personally. 

How We Hire

ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture. 

About Us

At ORBCOMM, we're pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www. orbcomm. com !

data.title: Sr Systems Engineer
data.description:
Senior Systems Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, scalability, and reliability of our internal healthcare application platform. This role owns Kubernetes platform standards, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, operational excellence, and cost optimization. The role also mentors engineers and partners with development and leadership teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, own, and evolve the Kubernetes platform architecture for healthcare applications, including cluster strategy, upgrades, and multi-environment standards. 
 - Define and enforce standardized deployment patterns using Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps (e. g. , Argo CD or Flux). 
 - Architect enterprise CI/CD pipelines with built-in security scanning, quality gates, and release governance. 
 - Lead IaC strategy with reusable Terraform modules, configuration management, and policy-as-code. 
 - Establish observability standards, SLOs/SLIs, and alerting. Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive platform security and compliance (HIPAA, audit readiness, secrets management, RBAC, network policies, image hardening). 
 - Own cloud cost governance (FinOps): rightsizing, autoscaling, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, with measurable savings. 
 - Plan and test disaster recovery, backup, and high availability. 
 - Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and author technical documentation and runbooks. 
 - Partner with development, security, and leadership teams on the platform roadmap and technical decisions. 

Required Skills

- 5+ years in Systems Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years running Kubernetes in production. 
 - Expert-level Kubernetes administration (AKS, EKS, or OpenShift), Docker, Kustomize and Helm. 
 - Proven experience designing CI/CD at scale with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins. 
 - Advanced Terraform skills (module design, state management) plus Ansible or similar tools. 
 - Strong scripting and automation in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. 
 - Deep Azure experience (networking, identity, security, cost management); multi-cloud is a plus. 
 - Hands-on observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK. 
 - Track record of leading production incidents and delivering reliability improvements. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2). 
 - GitOps, service mesh (Istio or Linkerd), and policy engines (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno). 
 - FinOps practices and cloud cost tooling (Kubecost, Azure Cost Management). 
 - Relevant certifications: CKA/CKS, Azure Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, Terraform Associate. 

What Success Looks Like

- A standardized, self-service Kubernetes platform adopted across application teams. 
 - Defined SLOs met consistently, with reduced incident frequency and faster recovery (MTTR). 
 - Majority of infrastructure and deployments fully automated through IaC and GitOps. 
 - Audit-ready platform security and compliance posture. 
 - Documented, measurable infrastructure cost savings. 
 - Stronger team capability through mentoring, standards, and documentation.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer – Full Stack | Node.js, TypeScript, React | Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS
data.description:
📍 Remote - India

💰 ₹25-50 LPA total CTC, depending on experience and scope

🕒 Full-time

Staff Engineer | Node. js | TypeScript | React | Multi-Tenant SaaS | Software Architecture | Technical Leadership

Shape the architecture. Control the quality. Stay hands-on. Script Assist is looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer with deep production experience in Node. js, TypeScript and React to help shape the architecture and technical direction of a complex multi-tenant healthcare SaaS platform. 

We are looking for someone who has already worked on a substantial enterprise B2B SaaS product and understands what happens as that product becomes large: 

- More modules
 - More integrations
 - More customer configuration
 - More workflow variation
 - More roles and permissions
 - More historical data
 - More dependencies
 - More engineers
 - More opportunities for seemingly small changes to have unexpected consequencesYou may currently be a: 

- Staff Software Engineer
 - Staff Engineer
 - Staff Full Stack Engineer
 - Lead Software Engineer
 - Principal-level IC
 - Senior Technical Lead
 - Experienced Senior Software Engineer already operating beyond your formal titleThis is not an Engineering Manager position. 

It is also not an architect role where you stop working in production code. 

You will remain technically hands-on while influencing the quality and direction of engineering well beyond your own implementation work. 

About Script AssistScript Assist is a UK healthcare technology company providing the technology and operating infrastructure behind complex private clinical and pharmacy services. 

Our platform connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams. 

It supports substantial functionality across: 

- Clinical workflows
 - Prescribing
 - Medication management
 - Pharmacy workflows
 - Inventory
 - Dispensing
 - Payments
 - Subscriptions
 - Fulfilment
 - Communications
 - Reporting
 - Permissions
 - Customer configuration
 - Third-party integrationsThe difficult engineering problem is not any one of these features. 

It is how they interact. 

A workflow may behave differently depending on: 

- Customer
 - Clinical service
 - User role
 - Pharmacy
 - Medication
 - Configuration
 - Integration
 - Payment status
 - Previous actions
 - Operational exceptionsThe product therefore needs engineers who can understand local implementation details while simultaneously protecting the coherence of the wider platform. 

🧭 Your roleYou will take deep technical ownership of a substantial part of Script Assist while helping establish engineering patterns that scale beyond it. 

You will move comfortably between: 

- Architecture
 - Product behaviour
 - Node. js services
 - React applications
 - Databases
 - Integrations
 - Code review
 - Production incidents
 - Mentoring
 - Technical strategyYou should be able to understand the hardest parts of the codebase without becoming the only person capable of changing them. 

Architecture and system designYou will: 

- Define domain and module boundaries
 - Design backend services and APIs
 - Define data ownership
 - Review database models
 - Design integration patterns
 - Establish appropriate shared abstractions
 - Improve configuration architecture
 - Challenge unnecessary coupling
 - Reduce fragile customer-specific behaviour
 - Lead important technical migrations
 - Help simplify accumulated complexityYou should understand when to introduce: 

- Configuration
 - Shared services
 - Events
 - Queues
 - Transactions
 - APIs
 - Feature flags
 - Migration layersand equally importantly, when not to introduce them. 

Hands-on engineeringYou will remain capable of personally implementing difficult production changes. 

That includes: 

- Node. js / TypeScript backend development
 - React / TypeScript frontend development
 - API design
 - Database work
 - Integration development
 - Debugging
 - Performance investigation
 - Refactoring
 - Testing
 - Production incident investigationYou should still enjoy working directly with code. 

Multi-tenant SaaS complexityThe strongest candidates will have experience with products where many customers share the same platform while behaving differently. 

Relevant problems include: 

Tenant architecture
 - Tenant isolation
 - Tenant-aware data models
 - Customer-specific configuration
 - Organisations and sub-organisations
 - Entitlements
 - Feature flagsWorkflow complexity
 - Workflow engines
 - State machines
 - Rules engines
 - Configurable business logic
 - Approval flows
 - Long-running workflows
 - Versioned workflows
 - Exception handlingPermissions
 - RBAC
 - User roles
 - Organisation-level access
 - Fine-grained permissions
 - AuditabilityIntegrations
 - REST APIs
 - GraphQL
 - Webhooks
 - Public APIs
 - External systems
 - Background jobs
 - Asynchronous processing
 - Event-driven architectureDistributed-system behaviour
 - Idempotency
 - Retries
 - Partial failures
 - Transactions
 - Outbox patterns
 - Queues
 - Dead-letter handling
 - Concurrency
 - Reconciliation
 - Correlation IDsProduct evolution
 - Schema changes
 - Data migrations
 - Backward compatibility
 - Safe rollouts
 - Feature flags
 - Progressive migrations
 - Production monitoring
 - Incident recoveryYou do not need to have implemented every specific pattern. 

We care about whether you have actually solved these kinds of problems. 

Technical leadershipA Staff Engineer at Script Assist should improve the work of other engineers. 

You will: 

- Lead important design reviews
 - Review difficult code
 - Challenge poor technical decisions
 - Establish engineering patterns
 - Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers
 - Help engineers decompose complex problems
 - Document major technical decisions
 - Improve testing strategy
 - Improve observability
 - Help identify technical debt worth solving
 - Resolve architectural disagreements
 - Work with Product on technical trade-offs
 - Raise the quality of engineering across your areaWe do not want someone who responds to every difficult problem by saying: 

"I'll just build it myself. "You should be capable of solving the hardest problems while making the people around you increasingly capable of solving them too. 

Production ownershipYou will take responsibility beyond merge and deployment. 

You should care about: 

- What happened in production
 - Whether customers are seeing unexpected behaviour
 - Performance
 - Errors
 - Failed integrations
 - Operational recovery
 - Logging
 - Monitoring
 - Reconciliation
 - Incident preventionA major production incident should result not merely in a patch, but in a better system afterwards. 

Essential technical backgroundWe need substantial recent production experience with: 

- Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - React / React. js
 - Backend systems
 - API design
 - Databases
 - Distributed applications
 - Automated testing
 - Git
 - Docker
 - CI/CD
 - Cloud environments
 - Production observabilityParticularly relevant: 

- NestJS
 - Express
 - Fastify
 - PostgreSQL
 - MongoDB
 - Redis
 - GraphQL
 - Kafka
 - RabbitMQ
 - SQS
 - Kubernetes
 - AWS / Azure / GCP
 - Integration testing
 - Event-driven systemsOne particular database, message broker or cloud provider is not mandatory. 

Node. js requirementWe need genuine backend Node. js ownership. 

Experience limited to: 

- Front-end build tooling
 - Server-side rendering
 - Simple proxy services
 - Thin BFF layersis insufficient unless you also have substantial Node. js backend experience elsewhere. 

Relevant product backgroundsThe most interesting candidates will often come from mature enterprise SaaS products involving: 

- Workflow management
 - Automation
 - CRM
 - Identity
 - Permissions
 - Governance
 - APIs
 - Developer platforms
 - Operational systems
 - Enterprise configurationPotentially relevant engineering environments include: 

- Okta / Auth0
 - Blue Yonder / JDA Software
 - Freshworks
 - Diligent
 - Postman
 - LeadSquared
 - Comparable enterprise SaaS businessesThese are examples only. 

We assess your actual product ownership, not your employer's brand. 

How you should thinkWe are interested in engineers who ask questions such as: 

- What is the real domain boundary here?
 - Is this customer-specific or product behaviour?
 - Should this become configuration?
 - What happens to existing tenants?
 - What happens to workflows already underway?
 - What happens if the event arrives twice?
 - How do we recover from partial failure?
 - How do we prove this migration is safe?
 - How will another engineer understand this in two years?
 - How do we make this simpler rather than merely making it work?That style of reasoning matters enormously. 

Communication and judgementYou will work directly with senior Product and Engineering colleagues across the UK and India. 

You should be able to: 

- Explain difficult technical concepts clearly
 - Challenge assumptions constructively
 - Defend technical decisions with evidence
 - Understand commercial/product constraints
 - Avoid overengineering
 - Make pragmatic trade-offs
 - Communicate clearly in written English
 - Mentor without patronising or micromanaging
ExperienceWe expect strong candidates will typically have approximately 8-14+ years of software engineering experience. 

However, Staff-level scope matters more than calendar years. 

You do not necessarily need to hold a Staff title today. 

A Lead or exceptional Senior engineer who is already: 

- Leading architecture
 - Influencing several engineers
 - Reviewing critical work
 - Owning production behaviour
 - Taking responsibility beyond individual featurescan absolutely be relevant. 

📈 Why join Script Assist?At a very large organisation, a Staff Engineer may own one layer or one subsystem of a much bigger machine. 

At Script Assist, you can have meaningful influence across a significant part of the product. 

You will help determine: 

- How major areas are designed
 - How the platform handles customer variation
 - How engineers structure new functionality
 - How code quality is maintained
 - How technical debt is reduced
 - How production issues are prevented
 - How engineering scales as the company growsYou will remain hands-on. 

But the objective is not simply to become the person who can write the most difficult code. 

- The objective is to make a substantial part of the platform - and the engineers responsible for it - better because of your technical leadership.

data.title: Engineering Manager – Firmware Engineering
data.description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS

The Engineering Manager - Firmware Engineering will lead a team delivering firmware across sustaining engineering, product enhancements, production support, qualification, and new product development. 

This hands-on leader will own technical execution, delivery, quality, and team development for an assigned portfolio while increasing team accountability from individual tasks toward complete deliverables and workstreams. 

You Will Make an Impact By

- Lead firmware execution across sustaining, enhancements, qualification, production support, and product development. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership in embedded firmware, real-time systems, controls, communications, and diagnostics. 
 - Own team priorities, resources, commitments, risks, and delivery. 
 - Drive architecture, design and code reviews, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and technical decisions. 
 - Strengthen requirements, code quality, verification, configuration, release, and defect-prevention practices. 
 - Expand CI/CD, test automation, regression automation, and approved AI-assisted development. 
 - Partner with global teams on execution, qualification, production issues, and product delivery. 
 - Coach engineers, develop technical leads, and build capability, ownership, and succession. 

Key Result Areas

Delivery: On-time delivery, commitment reliability, backlog health, and responsiveness. 

Quality: Defect leakage, repeat defects, verification effectiveness, and corrective-action closure. 

Productivity and Automation: Development cycle time, automated test coverage, CI/CD maturity, and measurable benefits from automation and approved AI tools. 

Talent and Ownership: Skill growth, time to productivity, retention, technical-lead development, and progression toward deliverable and workstream ownership. 

Skills You Bring: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of firmware or embedded-systems experience, including 3+ years of engineering leadership. 
 - Strong technical depth in embedded C/C++, real-time systems, processors, communications, diagnostics, and embedded architecture. 
 - Experience delivering firmware through design, integration, verification, release, sustaining, and production support. 
 - Hands-on experience with design and code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and technical problem solving. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and modern firmware-development practices. 
 - Strong execution, people leadership, global collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Skills: 

- Experience in semiconductor equipment, instrumentation, controls, power systems, industrial automation, or similar complex products. 
 - Experience with RTOS-based systems, embedded Linux, industrial communications, high-reliability products, or hardware-in-the-loop testing. 
 - Experience using automation and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development productivity and quality.

data.description:
The P&SE Post Trade NCCP engineering organization is expanding technology center in Bengaluru (Bangalore). We are looking for a Senior Specialist with Manual/Functional testing to join our Clearing Counter Party (CCP) system QA team. 

This is an opportunity to join the world's leading exchange technology company and work with innovative technologies in an international environment where our clients include high profile organizations like Hong Kong Exchange, Singapore Exchange, Swiss Exchange and Saudi Stock Exchange. With this position we offer: 

In this role, you will join the P&SE Post Trade NCCP QA team in Bangalore, part of Nasdaq Marketplace Technology. As this is a growing team in Bangalore, you will play a key role in helping build and shape our local QA function from the ground up.  - Hands on experience in API testing. 
 - Strong experience in Clearing and Trading domains (Financial Markets).

 - Good understand of DB concepts and hands on experience with SQL. 
 - Experience working in agile teams either using Scrum or Kanban.

You can expect a collaborative, fast-paced, and constantly evolving work environment where you are recognized for your results and ability to drive things forward proactively & persistently. Every day brings many opportunities to learn & grow and rewards with a global impact we build. 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 

A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent work experience

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Moveworks
data.description:
Company Description

Moveworks is the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce. 

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt. 

Moveworks is trusted by over 5. 5 million employees at more than 350 of the world's largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company's 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc's Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft's 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award. 

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow's leading workflow automation with Moveworks' Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work. 

By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. 

Come join us!

ServiceNow

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today - ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8, 100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone. 

Job Description

What you'll do: 

- Technical Architecture & Strategy Define and own the long-term technical architecture, making critical build vs. buy decisions to ensure systems remain resilient as the platform scales 10x
 - Platform & Infrastructure Design and build core infrastructure services and microservices that serve machine learning, frontend, and platform teams
 - Business Alignment Align technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, system reliability, and infrastructure costs directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market
 - Hands-on Engineering Write high-performance, clean, and maintainable production-grade code across the stack (K8s, Python, Golang, Postgres etc. )
 - Cross-functional Execution Drive and deliver business-critical engineering outcomes in close collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - Experience 15+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated progression into Principal or Sr. Staff Engineer capacity at a high-growth tech company or top-tier AI lab
 - Technical Proficiency Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking, capable of driving both code-level execution and system-level architecture decisions. Proficiency in any programming language with ability to adapt - K8s, Python, Golang, Postgres and data lakes preferred
 - Distributed Systems Proven experience in distributed systems - performance, scalability, latency, optimization, and monitoring
 - Commercial Mindset Demonstrated ability to connect engineering decisions to business outcomes such as latency improvements, driving margin efficiency, and enabling rapid product feature launches
 - High Agency Self-driven with strong ownership, ability to identify system and business gaps, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and execute at startup pace
 - Product & AI Mindset Experience integrating or evaluating AI tools and workflows in engineering processes and decision-making

Good to Have

- Open Source Contributions to major open-source AI or infrastructure projects
 - Startup Experience Prior experience working closely with Product and Growth teams in an early-stage startup environment

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

data.description:
Required Qualifications

- 10+ years in software QA/testing with at least 5 years focused exclusively on Non-Functional Testing (performance, load, stress, security) for enterprise-grade web applications.

 - Hands-on proficiency with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or k6, and security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Nessus, or Qualys. 
 - Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure (App Services, Azure Load Testing, Azure Monitor, Application Insights) and its impact on application performance and security posture. 
 - Experience with APM and observability platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, or New Relic) for performance profiling, bottleneck isolation, and capacity planning. 
 - Strong communication and consulting skills - ability to run NFR definition sessions with customers, present risk-rated findings to non-technical stakeholders, and align cross-functional teams on quality gates. 

Tech Stack

- JMeterLocustGatlingk6OWASP ZAPBurp SuiteNessus / QualysAzure DevOpsAzure Load TestingApplication InsightsDatadogDynatracePlaywrightPythonDocker / Kubernetes

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in performance testing (ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or security testing (CEH, OSCP, or relevant Azure security certifications). 
 - Experience with UI/UX performance measurement tools (Google Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Core Web Vitals) for page responsiveness and load-time optimization on B2B portals. 
 - Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment - managing NFT deliverables, customer expectations, and multi-stakeholder engagements simultaneously. 
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and shift-left security integration within Azure-based CI/CD workflows. 
 - Exposure to accessibility testing standards (WCAG 2. 1) relevant to enterprise B2B web applications. 

Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end-to-end Non-Functional Testing strategy and framework covering performance, load, stress, UI/UX responsiveness, and security vulnerability testing for an Azure-hosted B2B web application. 
 - Lead customer-facing NFR requirement workshops - translate business expectations into measurable test criteria, SLA thresholds, and acceptance gates in collaboration with product and engineering stakeholders. 
 - Evaluate, select, and onboard the NFT tooling stack; establish standards for load simulation, vulnerability scanning, and frontend performance profiling suited to the Azure platform. 
 - Design realistic workload models, test scenarios, and data strategies for load and stress testing that reflect B2B usage patterns, peak traffic, and failure conditions. 
 - Plan and execute security vulnerability assessments (VAPT) aligned to OWASP Top 10; coordinate with DevSecOps teams to log, prioritize, and track remediation of findings. 
 - Integrate NFT suites into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, establishing automated performance gates and regression baselines that block releases when thresholds are breached. 
 - Monitor application performance using APM tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, or Application Insights); analyse bottlenecks and provide root-cause analysis with actionable optimization recommendations.

data.title: Senior Test Developer – Automotive Simulation Testing & Failure-Triage Lead
data.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex automotive software failures and leading high-impact validation activities in a fast-paced engineering environment? We are looking for an experienced SWQA Lead with strong automotive domain knowledge, hands-on simulation testing expertise, advanced Python skills, and a proven ability to identify regression-causing changelists (CL's) through systematic bisection. This role is central to Integration testing quality and simulation failure triage. You will lead daily testing activities, analyze various failures and artifacts, identify root causes, isolate culprit changelists (CLs), and coordinate resolution across software, simulation, validation, and infrastructure teams. As the Person in Charge (PIC), you will manage priorities, assign work, remove blockers, improve triage efficiency, and ensure release-impacting issues are driven to closure. You will also apply Agentic AI workflows to accelerate failure investigation, evidence correlation, classification, and reporting. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead daily pre-merge testing, simulation failure triage, task prioritization, team execution, and timely closure of critical issues. 
 - Perform root-cause and signal-level analysis using logs, traces, metrics, videos, and state transitions to isolate software, simulation, configuration, infrastructure, analyzer, or evaluator failures. 
 - Lead the bisections using source-control history, failure patterns, signal evidence, and code-impact analysis to identify culprit CLs and complex multi-change regressions. 
 - Develop Python-based tools and automation for log analysis, failure classification, regression isolation, automated bisection, and reporting. 
 - Apply Agentic AI workflows to correlate diagnostic evidence, identify patterns, summarize failures, recommend investigation paths, and improve triage efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with development, systems, simulation, validation, tools, and infrastructure teams; track quality metrics, communicate risks, mentor engineers, and establish consistent triage practices. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in CS, CE, ECE, EEE, Automotive Engineering, or a related field, with 8-12 years of relevant automotive software testing and validation experience. 
 - Strong expertise in HIL/SIL, simulation testing, automotive verification workflows, and root-cause analysis using signals, logs, traces, and system-level evidence. 
 - Hands-on validation experience with ADAS and automated-driving functions, including L2, L2PP, and L3/L4 features across perception, localization, prediction, planning, control, and vehicle interfaces. 
 - Advanced Python skills for automation, signal processing, data analysis, visualization, debugging, and validation-tool development. 
 - Proven expertise in bisection using Git, CI/CD pipelines, build artifacts, and change history to identify and validate culprit CLs. 
 - Demonstrated ability to apply Agentic AI workflows. 
 - Proven ability to lead small to mid-sized teams, work with diverse stakeholders, and drive process alignment and continuous improvement. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to break down complex process topics into actionable steps. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience applying AI agents or LLM-based workflows to log analysis, evidence correlation, failure classification, automated bisection, or root-cause investigation. 
 - Familiarity with GitLab CI, Jenkins, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and large-scale simulation infrastructure. . 
 - Working knowledge of Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) processes and Functional Safety (ISO 26262) requirements, with their application in ADAS software verification and validation. 
 - Good understanding of ADAS regulatory standards and consumer safety assessment protocols, including Euro NCAP, UNECE DCAS, GSR, and applicable UNECE homologation regulations. 
 - Prior experience owning a validation, failure-triage, bisection, or pre-merge quality program and delivering continuous improvements end-to-end.

Content Automation Architect role for a global organization responsible for designing optimizing and maintaining scalable automation solutions using Ansible for hybrid work model operations. About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the continuous availability, reliability, and functionality of DCS and PLC systems. This includes scheduling and performing regular system backups, maintenance, and troubleshooting, as well as coordinating with OEMs for system upgrades. The role also involves managing hardware and software resources, network integrity, and cybersecurity measures to prevent data loss and system vulnerabilities. 

Responsibilities

Lead - DCS_PLC (Distributed Control System_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability And Maintenance

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG. 

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss. 

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime. 

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems. 

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades. 

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS). 

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery. 

Hardware And Software Management

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements. 

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions. 

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance. 

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies. 

Network And Cybersecurity

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies. 

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure. 

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication. 

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols. 

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity. 

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives. 

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

You will have an ASIC design verification background with hands-on experience in System Verilog and UVM methodology with in-depth knowledge of C++, scripting as well as ASIC/SoC development cycle, the best industry practices, from specification through tape-out and lab validation, and a proven track record of success in high-performance/high-volume products. 

- Leads ASIC engineering teams to deliver high-performance, high quality and reliable ASICs for Cisco's diverse product platforms. 
 - Leads teams in defining and verifying ASICs and ASIC subsystems to ensure alignment with stringent quality requirements for deployment across Cisco's platforms. 
 - Drives collaboration cross-functionally to achieve high-volume production with uncompromised quality. 
 - Collaborate closely with the design team and the hardware team to verify the ASIC in simulation, in emulation and during ASIC bring up. 
 - Defining and Building UVM/System Verilog testbenches from scratch or enhancing existing testbenches with focus on reuse
 - Defining new DV methodologies or enhancing the existing methodologies
 - In-depth understanding of the architecture, and identification of problems and solutions. 
 - End-to-end verification of one or more design blocks simultaneously while helping full chip team with integration and support. 
 - Test plan generation, review, planning and execution, meeting all criteria of ASIC group. 
 - Help in developing Emulation infrastructure using C/C++, that has to work with UVM based verification environment. 
 - Gate level simulation and SDF back annotation for blocks as part of pre-silicon verification. 
 - Code and Functional coverage-based simulation run, coverage collection, merging and working with designers to fill coverage holes. 
 - Participating in all phases during ASIC development - RTL Verification, Emulation and post-silicon validation
 - Recommending best practice, identifying and suggesting innovative solutions to improve efficiency and quality
 - Leading and mentoring team of junior engineers in addition to the assigned task. 
 - Strong focus on efficiency, quality, reusability. 
 - Drives design verification solutions across the business. Ensure culture of code reviews and postmortems. 
 - Act as the design verification leader, owning and leading all the above aspects, including driving the technical decisions made at the program level with rest of the dv teams, conducting weekly dv meetings, sync-ups with stake holders and cross functional teams like Architecture, Design, Emulation, SW, PSV. 

Minimum Qualifications

- BS/MS and 15+/13+ years respectively of hands-on experience in large-scale, high-performance ASIC. 
 - Have led a design team for a minimum of 5+ years
 - Must have prior experience of developing UVM based infrastructure from scratch in more than one projects. 
 - Ability to handle complex features/parts of chip independently. 
 - Quick learner must be able to work in a fast pace dynamic environment and must be able to deliver quality even in aggressive schedule. 
 - Strong teamwork quality - must be able to work in a highly collaborative team. 
 - Overseeing reusability, comes up reusable solution to improve efficiency. Must always focus on efficiency and quality. 
 - Ability to build, lead and mentor a team of engineers and ensuring quality delivery as a team. 
 - Proficient in merging and analyzing code coverage data generated functional simulation
 - Good working knowledge in C, C++ programming and debugging skills
 - Experienced in system debug and SW/HW bring-up, system validation of silicon towards FCS. 
 - Hardware Emulation Platforms and tools (such as EVE, Veloce)
 - Good written/verbal interpersonal skills and leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Worked in DV methodology and definition of high-scale, high-performance ASICs. 
 - Planning overall DV architecture strategy and defining the requirements. 
 - Conducting & leading various test plan reviews. 
 - Driving complex debugs and system level integration aspects
 - Valid experience in flow automation (scripting, Makefiles, etc), and establishing guidelines for the team. 
 - Mentoring the senior resources in the team on DV and DV methodologies. 
 - Good interpersonal skills, and validated leadership to accurately describe issues/improvements and lead team for on-time completion. 
 - Excellent communication skills both verbal and written

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

data.title: Senior Developer, Agentic AI
data.description:
Overview

ABOUT JAGGAER

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries. 

Our 1, 300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses. 

For more information, visit www. jaggaer. com

JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education. 

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of our enterprise agentic AI platform. 

You will work across AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, workflows, tools, enterprise integrations, retrieval, model providers, micro-frontends, observability, security, and governance. Your responsibility will be to create a coherent, reusable platform that enables multiple product teams to build and operate secure, reliable AI capabilities at scale. 

This is not a documentation-only architecture role. You will be expected to design systems, review and write production code, resolve complex technical issues, guide platform migrations, and mentor senior engineers. 

Principal Responsibilities

- Define the target architecture for enterprise AI agents, workflows, orchestration runtimes, tools, retrieval, model integrations, and embedded user experiences. 
 - Establish clear platform contracts for agent definitions, versions, advertised capabilities, tools, workflows, sessions, memory, and runtime execution. 
 - Design and evolve multi-agent and Supervisor Agent architectures that can safely coordinate worker agents, child supervisors, tools, and long-running workflows. 
 - Define shared runtime operations such as invoke, stream, resume, approve, cancel, status, events, and trace. 
 - Ensure secure propagation of tenant, user, authorization, run, and delegation context across distributed agent and workflow calls. 
 - Build deterministic security, policy, approval, budget, retry, and lifecycle controls around probabilistic model decisions. 
 - Guide micro-frontend and embedded AI architecture, including streaming, orchestration progress, tool activity, evidence, approvals, and error handling. 
 - Define provider-independent model integrations and model-selection strategies based on quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Establish agent evaluation systems covering capability selection, plan quality, grounding, hallucination, safety, latency, cost, and user experience. 
 - Drive observability across model calls, agents, tools, workflows, retrieval, evaluation, and final synthesis. 
 - Design for retries, idempotency, partial failures, cancellation, long-running execution, human pauses, and process recovery. 
 - Lead technical reviews, critical refactors, production debugging, and platform-hardening initiatives. 
 - Mentor engineers and influence architecture across multiple product and platform teams. 

Position Requirements

- 7+ years of software engineering experience, with experience operating at Principal Engineer, Architect, Staff+ Engineer, or equivalent scope. 
 - Strong hands-on programming and production-debugging ability. 
 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed, multi-tenant enterprise platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in several of the following: 
 - Python 
 - TypeScript and React 
 - API and event-driven architectures 
 - PostgreSQL and Redis 
 - Workflow or queue-based systems 
 - Containers and Kubernetes 
 - Public cloud platforms 
 - Production experience with LLM applications, AI agents, or enterprise AI platforms. 
 - Understanding of tool calling, structured model output, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, API versioning, observability, reliability, and data governance. 
 - Ability to distinguish model-driven decisions from deterministic security, policy, and transactional controls. 
 - Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to influence technical direction across teams. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing multi-agent, Supervisor Agent, or research-oriented AI systems. 
 - Experience with graph-based orchestration frameworks and cloud-hosted generative AI services. 
 - Experience with multiple commercial LLM providers. 
 - Experience building shared platforms used by several product teams. 
 - Experience with micro-frontends and AI functionality embedded across a product portfolio. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance, model risk management, audit, safety controls, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Experience with distributed tracing and AI observability platforms. 
 - Experience defining internal developer platforms, reference architectures, and migration programs. 

Ideal Leadership Profile

You Are

- Hands-on and comfortable moving from architecture to implementation 
 - Opinionated but evidence-driven 
 - Focused on simplifying complex systems without forcing unnecessary rewrites 
 - Experienced in balancing delivery speed with security and platform quality 
 - Comfortable making trade-offs across model quality, latency, cost, and reliability 
 - Able to communicate effectively with engineers, product leaders, security teams, and executives 
 - Passionate about mentoring engineers and building strong technical leadership across the organization

What We Offer

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family's well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. 

Our Values - T. E. A. M

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them-the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies. 

- Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together-with customers, teammates, and partners. 
 - Entrepreneurial Spirit - Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth 
 - Accountability - Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere 
 - Metrics-Driven Results - Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we're delivering real impact. 

Eeo

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

Great Place to Work® Certified 2026 - JAGGAER

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first. 

We are proud to announce that JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high-performing culture.

Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust. com" email address.
