At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185, 000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world's most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense. 

About RTX

RTX is a global aerospace and defense company with more than 185, 000 employees worldwide. We push the boundaries of technology and innovation to help create a safer, more connected world. Through our industry-leading businesses-Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon-we deliver advanced solutions for commercial aviation, defense, and connected technologies. 

About Collins Aerospace

Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is a leader in aerospace and defense technologies, delivering intelligent solutions that redefine the future of aviation. Our Digital Technology (DT) organization enables business transformation by providing secure, scalable, and innovative digital solutions that support our global operations, customers, and suppliers. 

Join our Digital Technology team and play a key role in driving digital transformation across our global Supply Chain organization while collaborating with talented professionals around the world. 

Job Overview

As a Senior Associate Manager - Quality for Lighting Value stream at Collins Aerospace, you are responsible for leading incoming inspection of buy parts, assemblies, and COTS parts to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and quality requirements. 

Manage and develop the inspection team, including workload allocation, competency development, and daily Tier 1/2 meetings. Drive quality performance through QN management, block stock disposition, QIP updates, supplier corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Ensure documentation, traceability, and compliance with AS9100 and Collins ASQR requirements while coordinating with Supplier Quality, SCM, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Warehouse teams. 

What You Will Do: 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Incoming Buy Parts Inspection
 - Supervise inspection of Buy parts, assemblies, COTs parts and other supplier-delivered products. 
 - Verify suppliers' parts against engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, and other applicable quality requirements. 
 - Ensure proper sampling plans and inspection methods are followed at inspection process. 
 - Review inspection records on regular basis for effectiveness. 
 - QN creation and communication to SQE focal with 5 working days from NC identified. 
 - Monitor the block stock for SLT1 and MRB1 & MRB3 disposition in same month or 30 days. 
 - Team Leadership
 - Lead, train, coach, and evaluate receiving inspection personnel. 
 - Assign daily workloads and prioritize inspection activities. 
 - Ensure adherence to quality procedures and safety requirements. 
 - Support employee development and competency assessments. 
 - Tier 1 meeting board should be maintain and updation on daily basis. 
 - Conduct tier1 meeting on daily basis. 
 - Quality Management
 - Develop and maintain receiving inspection procedures and work instructions . 
 - Monitor inspection cycle times, and incoming quality levels. Ammendment QIP as applicable. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and improve efficiency at inspection process and block stock. 
 - Participate in audits and support compliance with quality management systems. 
 - Supplier Quality Coordination
 - Investigate incoming material nonconformances. 
 - Coordinate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with suppliers. 
 - Work with Supplier Quality focal and SCM Focal to resolve recurring quality issues. 
 - Review supplier performance data and support supplier qualification activities. 
 - Documentation & Compliance
 - Maintain inspection reports, nonconformance reports (NCRs), and quality records. 
 - Ensure compliance with standards such as: 
 - AS9100 (Aerospace)
 - COL-ASQR-PRO-0003 COLLINS follow down requirements. 
 - Regulatory requirements applicable to the industry. 
 - Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits. 
 - All inspection records /documents scanned copy shall be maintain on weekly basis. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Warehouse teams. 
 - Participate in Material Review Board (MRB) activities. 
 - Assist in root cause analysis and problem-solving efforts

What You Will Learn

- Gain hands-on experience in Incoming inspection , nonconformance management, QN creation, block stock monitoring, and MRB disposition processes. 
 - Strengthen team leadership, workload planning, daily Tier 1 management, employee coaching, and competency development skills. 
 - Learn to monitor inspection performance metrics, improve cycle times, update QIPs, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop knowledge of supplier quality management, CAPA coordination, root cause analysis, and supplier performance improvement. 
 - Gain expertise in aerospace quality standards, including AS9100 and Collins ASQR requirements, documentation control, and audit compliance. 
 - Enhance cross-functional collaboration with Supplier Quality, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Warehouse teams. 
 - Strengthen problem-solving, decision-making, stakeholder management, and quality process improvement skills. 
 - Strengthen your leadership, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. 

Qualifications You Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering -Mechanical / Electronics, or a related field with 7-10 years of experience. 

Working knowledge of: 

- Quality Function - Aerospace / Automotive

Experience in: 

- Six sigma
 - SAP - Quality Function T-Codes
 - FAI as per AS9102
 - Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a global team environment. 

Qualifications We Prefer

- B. E (Mechanical / Electronics) with 7-10 years of experience. 
 - Strong on GD&T Measurements
 - CMM operation Skill benefit - Additional advantage

WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE. 

- Please consider the following role type definitions as you apply for this role. 

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products. 

Benefits package includes: 

- Meal coupons
 - Group Term Life Insurance. 
 - Group Health Insurance.

Nothing matters more to Collins Aerospace than our strong ethical and safety commitments. As such, all India positions require a background check, which may include a drug screen.

data.description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. 

Must have skills : Embedded Product Verification & Validation

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : Bachelor or Master of Engineering in Electronics or Electrical or Instrumentation

Summary: 

As a test lead you will act as an interface in the areas of testing, validation, integration, and requirements management. You will coordinate with team members across global locations. You will actively participate in building and developing the testing team in the areas of test development, test execution, test environment development and maintenance, guidance and technical mentorship. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

You will be responsible for developing test strategies, specifying new test cases and implementing automated test suites. 

You will analyze and interpret the obtained test results, discuss them with technical experts, and support in optimizing the testing processes. 

You will be responsible for testing the infotainment systems Features such as Media, BT, Wi-Fi, Navigation etc. , in close cooperation with our customers and process partners. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

Overall, 9 years of experience in testing and Validation in the automotive domain. 

You have gained practical experience on test automation with programming language such as Python or C#. 

You have hands-on experience in assembling a test bench (HIL) and are comfortable working with hardware and electrical components. 

Very good knowledge in Vector tools like CANoe, CANape. 

Experience with Confluence, Jira, DOORs

Good experience of Ethernet, CAN and LIN protocols. 

System and Sub system Knowledge of Automotive ECUs. 

Experience on Requirement Understanding, Configuration Management, Bug Tracking Tool, Change management Tool

You have experience in test strategy creation, test planning, and tooling enablement. 

You offer guidance and mentoring to teams in regard to technology usage

You are an excellent team player with very good communication skills. 

You have a strong ability to think analytically you have a well-established professional network and have an independent and structured way of working. 

You are excellent at solving problems and debugging. 

You are a confident communicator and have highly developed interpersonal skills

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 9 years of experience in Embedded Product Verification & Validation. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A Bachelor or Master of Engineering in Electronics or Electrical or Instrumentation is required.

data.title: MCCB Product Engineer
data.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. 

Job Description

MCCB Product Engineering Lead

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 13+ Years

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced MCCB Product Engineering Lead with expertise in product development, industrialization, manufacturing processes, validation, and quality engineering for low-voltage switchgear products. The role requires strong technical leadership to drive new product introduction, supplier development, testing, and manufacturing excellence. 

Your Role

As an MCCB Product Engineering Lead, you will be responsible for leading product engineering and industrialization activities for MCCB products, ensuring successful product launches, quality compliance, and continuous improvement across the product lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead MCCB product engineering activities from design support through industrialization and production ramp-up. 
 - Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) programs including pilot builds, process qualification, and manufacturing readiness. 
 - Provide technical expertise on MCCB architecture, protection systems, operating mechanisms, and critical components. 
 - Collaborate with design, manufacturing, quality, testing, and supplier teams to ensure robust product performance. 
 - Support manufacturing processes including moulding, stamping, forming, plating, joining, assembly, calibration, and testing. 
 - Review and validate plastic, rubber, and sheet-metal components for manufacturability, quality, and reliability. 
 - Execute APQP activities including PFMEA, Process Flow, Control Plan, MSA, Cp/Cpk studies, and PPAP deliverables. 
 - Lead validation and compliance testing as per IEC 60947-2 standards. 
 - Perform root cause analysis for product, process, supplier, and field failures and drive corrective actions. 
 - Support supplier qualification, component development, process audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 13+ years of experience in MCCB product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or industrialization. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of MCCB architecture, protection mechanisms, and components. 
 - Proven experience executing NPI, pilot production, process release, and ramp-up activities. 
 - Extensive knowledge of manufacturing processes including injection moulding, stamping, sheet-metal fabrication, assembly, and testing. 
 - Strong understanding of engineering plastics, copper alloys, steels, contact materials, bimetals, elastomers, and coatings. 
 - Hands-on experience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, Control Plans, and process capability analysis. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 60947-2 testing including temperature rise, dielectric, overload, endurance, and trip testing. 
 - Expertise in failure analysis, problem-solving methodologies, and corrective/preventive actions. 
 - Experience in supplier development, supplier qualification, and technical leadership. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills. 

What You'll Love About Working Here

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence. 

You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI. 

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

data.title: Principal Software Developer (software installation and deployment solutions)
data.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways - from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. 

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Installation Developer with 7-12 years of software development experience and strong expertise in Windows and/or Linux environments to design, develop, and maintain reliable software installation and deployment solutions. 

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of installation technologies, demonstrated programming and scripting skills, and experience working collaboratively in an Agile development environment. The candidate should also be able to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, accelerate troubleshooting and development, enhance testing and documentation, and deliver high-quality software solutions while applying appropriate engineering judgment to validate AI-generated code and recommendations. 

Your Impact

- Design, develop, test, and maintain installation packages and deployment solutions for Windows and Linux platforms. 
 - Utilize Windows Installer and other installation technologies to deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable installation solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain installation tools, automation, and scripts using C#, PowerShell, Bash, and C++. 
 - Leverage InstallShield for advanced installation packaging, configuration, and deployment requirements. 
 - Effectively utilize AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, scripting, debugging, troubleshooting, testing, code review, and technical documentation. 
 - Apply engineering judgment to review and validate AI-generated code and recommendations, ensuring solutions meet established standards for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define installation requirements, deployment strategies, and technical solutions. 
 - Work with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern deployment environments. 
 - Integrate installation and deployment processes with version control systems such as Git and Perforce and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support database configuration and connectivity requirements for SQL and NoSQL database systems as part of installation and deployment workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot, debug, perform root-cause analysis, and resolve complex installation and deployment issues. 
 - Develop automated tests and validation processes to improve the quality and reliability of installation solutions. 
 - Follow Agile development practices and established software engineering standards to deliver high-quality solutions in a timely manner. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve installation processes through automation, AI-assisted development, and adoption of modern engineering practices. 

What You'll Need

- 7-12 years of software development experience, preferably involving software installation, deployment, build, release, or related technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux operating systems, including software installation, configuration, and deployment concepts. 
 - Strong experience with Windows Installer technology and InstallShield, or comparable enterprise installation technologies. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more relevant programming and scripting languages, including C#, C++, PowerShell, and Bash. 
 - Experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, and an understanding of containerized software deployment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to effectively use or rapidly adopt AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall engineering productivity. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations, applying sound software engineering principles and appropriate human oversight. 
 - Solid understanding of software installation and deployment processes, CI/CD, automation, and software engineering best practices. 
 - Experience working in an Agile software development environment. 
 - Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL database technologies and their installation and configuration requirements. 
 - Experience with version control systems such as Git and Perforce. 
 - Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues and develop sustainable solutions.

data.title: Advanced Project Engr
data.description:
Job Description

This role will support the lead to implement Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects and assist in onsite user training as necessary. The candidate should have a very strong career interest in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer work. 

Responsibilities

The role will have a broad set of responsibilities encompassing the following: 

- Execute Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects including assessment, kick-off, pre-test, plant test, design, modeling, configuration, installation, commissioning, and post-audit. 
 - Implement RMPCT Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer/Control Performance Monitor technologies as Lead Consultant/Engineer 
 - Perform/Participate in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer studies, proof of concepts/trial evaluation and provide user training. 
 - Review the economic targets for the Advanced Process Controllers, suggest and incorporate necessary changes, to provide the right direction to the controllers. This may be required to incorporate the new economic indicators, if any, and make the controller to constantly work towards the current economic objectives. 
 - Identify, advise, and incorporate modifications to the controller configuration, in terms of proposing addition of new variables/ constraints, deletion of the redundant variables, wherever found necessary. 
 - Identify faulty regulatory control loops in the system (DCS level) and carryout tuning of existing regulatory controller at Distributed control systems. 
 - Lead cross function teams such as the Customer Support and R&D to resolve Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer issues. 
 - Support Sales and Marketing to grow Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer licenses and services business. 
 - Support and train junior personnel

Qualifications

- Has a at least 10+ years of experience in refining/petrochemical, MMM industry. 
 - Has a background in Chemical Engineering principles and operations. 
 - Knowledge of regulatory control and advanced control. 
 - Understands optimization principles. Experience in implementing global optimization programs is advantages. 
 - Good communication and writing skills. 
 - Knowledge of Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer, DCS and real-time database technologies. 
 - Good team player. Strong ability to maintain good working relationship with customers. 

WE VALUE

- Demonstrated project experience implementing commercial off-the-shelf software for APC such as DMC3/DMC Plus, SMOC, PACE, ROMeo. 
 - Experience in deploying APC or maintenance management strategies in an operating company. 
 - Candidates having experience in plant operations. 
 - Experience in plant startup & commissioning 
 - Configuration experience working on control systems, DCS / PLC / Safety Systems. 
 - Advanced post graduate degree in a technical discipline. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Staff DFT Solutions Engineer – Chip Methodology & Automation (CMA)
data.description:
About The Team

The Chip Methodology & Automation (CMA) team within Arm's Solutions Engineering organization develops scalable methodologies, flows, and automation that enable efficient deployment of Arm-based SoCs across internal teams, customers, and ecosystem partners. 

The Role

You will drive alignment across engineering teams, integrate DFT into broader implementation flows, and lead the adoption of scalable, reusable, and automated solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain DFT methodologies, flows, automation, and reference solutions for Arm-based SoCs. 
 - Drive alignment and integration of DFT flows within end-to-end RTL-to-GDS and silicon enablement methodologies. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, implementation, CAD, product engineering, customers, and ecosystem partners to ensure successful deployment. 
 - Evaluate and enable new capabilities with EDA vendors and technology partners. 
 - Lead technical reviews, resolve complex integration challenges, and drive methodology improvements. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to the DFT and automation roadmap within CMA. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong industry experience in DFT implementation, methodology development, and flow integration for complex SoCs.

 - Strong automation and scripting skills (Python, Tcl, Shell, or similar). 
 - Excellent debugging, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with advanced-node SoC development. 
 - Familiarity with chiplet or multi-die architectures. 
 - Experience developing CAD, methodology, or automation infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of automotive, safety, or production test requirements. 

Education

BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 

This version is closer to the style Arm typically uses internally: concise, outcome-focused, and avoiding detailed technical lists in both responsibilities and skills. The responsibilities describe what the person owns, while the skills describe what they need to know.

Job Title: Lead - Performance Tester

Work Type: Hybrid

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent

Role Summary & Context: The Lead Performance Engineer / Performance Tester will design, script, execute, and analyze high volume load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing across the entire unified experience stack. You will partner with Frontend, Integration, and Core ERP Engineering teams to define nonfunctional requirements (NFRs), map user journeys to realistic volumetric load models, configure specialized performance testing tools, and diagnose critical bottlenecks in multi tier, distributed cloud environments. 

This role requires a proactive professional who does not simply report metrics but actively isolates performance failures (such as memory leaks, thread contention, and slow database queries) and collaborates with development teams to implement architectural, code, and database optimizations. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Performance Strategy & Volumetric Modeling: 

- Define, document, and refine Non Functional Requirements (NFRs) (e. g. , Response Time, Throughput, Concurrent Users, Resource Utilization) for the unified digital front door. 
 - Formulate robust, data driven Performance Test Plans based on production telemetry and realistic regional workload patterns across distributors and workshop centers. 
 - Model comprehensive test scenarios encompassing Load, Stress, Endurance/Soak, Spike, and Failover/Resilience testing. 

Test Automation, Scripting & Execution

- Develop, maintain, and execute highly parameterized performance test scripts utilizing industry standard tools (e. g. , JMeter, Gatling, or HP LoadRunner/Performance Center). 
 - Simulate complex multi step APIs, event driven integrations (Kafka/Azure Event Grid), and distributed state machine operations (Camunda workflows) under varying load conditions. 
 - Design and execute performance testing pipelines integrated seamlessly with CI/CD practices (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) for automated regression level performance checks. 

Deep Dive Bottleneck Analysis & Profiling

- Utilize modern Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and observability tools (e. g. , Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, or Datadog) to gain end to end transaction visibility. 
 - Investigate latency across the entire user journey: from React/Next. js frontend rendering, API Gateway forwarding (Azure APIM/Kong), BFF processing, Java Spring Boot microservices execution, and Camunda state engine hops, down to target SAP ERP connector calls. 
 - Perform log analysis, database query profiling, JVM heap dump analysis, and thread contention investigations to isolate the root cause of high response times and error rates. 

Collaboration, Reporting & Optimization

- Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Database Administration, and Cloud Operations teams to tune systems (e. g. , JVM sizing, database connection pools, Kubernetes container scaling parameters, Redis caching strategies). 
 - Publish detailed performance execution reports with actionable recommendations for senior engineering leadership and program stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Stack

- Professional Experience: 8+ years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering, with a proven track record of testing high scale, distributed B2B or B2B2C cloud applications. 
 - Testing Toolsets: Mastery of Apache JMeter or Gatling (Scala/Java based writing) is required. Experience with commercial suites (LoadRunner/NeoLoad) is a strong plus. 
 - Observability & APM: Hands on experience using modern APM platforms (specifically Dynatrace, Datadog, or AppDynamics) to analyze transaction traces and isolate resource bottlenecks. 
 - API & Integration Testing: Deep expertise in load testing REST/SOAP APIs, microservices architectures, and asynchronous event brokers (specifically Apache Kafka). 
 - Environment & Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud native infrastructure concepts (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure configurations, and container scaling policies). 

Database & Caching Profiling: Experience identifying slow SQL/NoSQL queries and evaluating the effectiveness of caching layers (such as Redis).

data.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 4-8 years
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments. 

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution. 

- You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane, subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements. 
 - Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load. 
 - Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios. 
 - Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution. 
 - Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles. 
 - Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity. 
 - Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis. 
 - Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions. 
 - Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads. 
 - Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions. 
 - Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments. 
 - Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics. 
 - Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components. 
 - Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure. 
 - Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results. 
 - Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, 
 - Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
 - protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis. 
 - Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
 - Genie or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP. 
 - Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Ability to design and implement large-scale network topologies and systematically characterize capacity, throughput, latency, convergence, resource utilization, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of high availability, duplication, subscriber-state management, and fault- recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong Linux skills and experience with Git, debugging tools, packet collections, logs, telemetry, and defect-management systems. 
 - Strong solving and analytical skills with the ability to isolate sophisticated issues across traffic generators, network protocols, software, hardware, and forwarding layers. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output, including AI-assisted log and defect analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience validating cnBNG, BNG, or broadband subscriber solutions. 
 - Experience with CUPS / Control Plane-User Plane separation and large-scale distributed User
 - Plane deployments. 
 - Sophisticated experience with IXIA BreakingPoint/IxNetwork and/or Spirent Test Center, including automation APIs and large-scale subscriber/traffic emulation. 
 - Experience with Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700, Silicon One, or comparable carrier-grade routing platforms and NPUs. Experience validating subscriber scale, session churn, traffic performance, convergence, and long-duration stability. 
 - Experience with SRG geo/warm excess, ISSU, NSR/NSF, and service continuity testing. 
 - Knowledge of SRv6/Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN/VPLS, TE/GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, and ACLs. Experience with YANG, gRPC, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and telemetry. Experience building automated performance dashboards, test-result analytics, failure classification, and regression trend analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Aha/Jira APIs engineering and defect-management integrations. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport. 

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Description

Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient - increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate. 

We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI-first engineering organization operates - where large language models, agents, and AI-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day-to-day engineering. 

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross-functional environment. 

Key job responsibilities

- Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives - whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both. 
 - As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams. 
 - Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India-based charters - accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale. 
 - Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org - in the products you ship (LLM-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) - while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it. 
 - Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - 8+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers. 
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team. 
 - Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes. 
 - Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions. 
 - Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or related field. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user-facing technologies. 
 - Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market. 
 - Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production-ready solutions.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems (IN)
data.description:
About Onehouse

Onehouse is a mission-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock-in. We deliver the industry's most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real-time AI / ML). 

We are a team of self-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self-optimizing data lake platform!

The Community You Will Join

When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category - the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems. 

The Impact You Will Drive: 

- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest. Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads. 
 - Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing. 

A Typical Day: 

- Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers. 
 - Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance. 
 - Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines. 
 - Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster. 
 - Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Strong, object-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C++ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform). 
 - 5+ Years experience with inner workings of distributed (multi-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases. 
 - You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions. 
 - An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed. 
 - An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems. 
 - An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data. 
 - Robust and clear communication skills. 
 - Nice to haves (but not required): 
 - Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases. 
 - Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization). 
 - Existing publications of optimizing large-scale data systems in top-tier distributed system conferences. 
 - PhD degree with 2+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high-impact optimization projects. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

- Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
 - Health & Well-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well-being by reimbursing up to 20, 000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
 - Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
 - Location; we are a remote-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America + India), though some roles will be subject to in-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
 - Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
 - Food & Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in-office snacks/drinks
 - Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
 - Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents - fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition

House Values

One Team

Optimize for the company, your team, self - in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of. 

Tough & Persevering

We are building our company in a very large, fast-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!

Keep Making It Better Always

Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward. 

Think Big, Act Fast

We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns. 

Be Customer Obsessed

Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company. 

Pay Range Transparency

Onehouse is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Our job titles may span more than one career level. The pay range(s) for this role is listed above and represents the base salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are dependent upon several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: job-related skills, depth of transferable experience, relevant certifications and training, business needs, market demands and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Onehouse utilizes the full width of the range; the base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. The total compensation package for this position will also include eligibility for equity options and the benefits listed above. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next-generation, highly scalable, low-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) - operating at a scale of 1 trillion+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team's roadmap, in one of the fastest-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we'd love to talk to you. 

What You'll Do

- Product & Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion-scale. 
 - Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization. 
 - Standards & Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams. 
 - Own end-to-end technical direction for the AdServer platform - partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi-quarter technical roadmap. 
 - Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on. 
 - Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof-of-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point across teams - auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross-cutting problems. 
 - Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long-range technical planning - new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform. 
 - Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar. 
 - Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, and documentation - and help set the standard for AI-enabled engineering across the org. 

We'd Love for You to Have

- 14+ years of hands-on development experience in C/C++ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team. 
 - Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles. 
 - Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low-latency, high-throughput systems. 
 - A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly. 
 - Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open-ended technical problems. 
 - Strong working knowledge of generative AI-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level. 
 - Deep knowledge of OS internals and systems programming - multi-threading, multi-processing, and memory management - and the ability to troubleshoot the hardest production issues. 
 - Ability to write clean, modular, loosely coupled code, and to hold others to that same bar through review. 
 - Strong end-to-end understanding of product functionality across the platform, not just an individual component. 
 - Working knowledge of scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) and databases (preferably MySQL). 
 - Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority. 

Good To Have - CTV Domain Experience

- Prior hands-on experience building or scaling ad serving, ad decisioning, or real-time bidding systems specifically for Connected TV (CTV) / OTT. 
 - Working knowledge of CTV-specific technical protocols and standards - e. g. VAST/VPAID/VMAP, SSAI (server-side ad insertion) and CSAI, HLS/DASH manifest manipulation, and IAB CTV/OTT specifications. 
 - Understanding of the CTV supply chain and its unique constraints - device- and app-level identifiers (e. g. IFA, RIDA), frequency capping and pod/ad-break management, content-level targeting, and the latency/quality bar required for a living-room viewing experience. 
 - Familiarity with SSAI stitching architectures and the trade-offs between client-side and server-side ad insertion at scale. 
 - Exposure to OTT/streaming platforms, smart TV operating systems (e. g. Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), or set-top box environments, and the constraints they place on ad delivery. 
 - Understanding of CTV measurement, viewability, and completion-rate reporting requirements, and how they differ from traditional display/video. 
 - Awareness of the evolving CTV privacy and identity landscape (e. g. data clean rooms, alternative identifiers, cross-device graphs) and its implications for ad server architecture. 

AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset

We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e. g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc. ) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. 

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

data.title: Principal/Senior/Software Engineer (AI-Powered Advertising Agents - AgenticOS)
data.description:
About The Role

PubMatic is looking for engineers with expertise in Generative AI and AI agent development. You will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced AI agents that leverage the latest technologies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and large language models (LLMs). You will work on developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance Generative AI capabilities and enable our platform to handle complex information retrieval, contextual generation, and adaptive interactions. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven features. Drive end-to-end ownership-from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release-while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast-paced Agile environment. 
 - Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures. 
 - Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long-term product strategy and technical roadmaps. 
 - Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine-tuning models, deploying pre-trained models, and evaluating their performance. 
 - Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content. 
 - Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms. 
 - Create sophisticated prompts and fine-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses. 
 - Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e. g. , Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems. 
 - Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI-driven capabilities into customer-facing products and internal tools. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company's offerings. 
 - Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

We'd Love For You To Have

- 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles - transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning. 
 - Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, multi-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short-term and long-term). 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs). 
 - In-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus. 
 - Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails - tools like Langfuse or equivalent - to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems. 
 - Proficiency in prompt engineering - crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context-sensitive, domain-specific LLM outputs. 
 - Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers. 
 - Experience with data preprocessing, vectorization, and handling large-scale datasets. 
 - Ability to present complex technical ideas and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice-to-Have

- Experience in building AI agents using graph-based architectures, including knowledge graph embeddings and graph neural networks (GNNs). 
 - Experience with training small base models using custom data, including data collection, pre-processing, and fine-tuning models to specific domains or tasks. 
 - Familiarity with deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, or ad auction mechanics. 
 - Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-integration standards
 - Publication or contributions to research in AI, LLMs, or related fields. 

Qualification

Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute/university. 

Additional Information

Return to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. 

Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!. 

Diversity and Inclusion: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

About PubMatic

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. 

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. 

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we're just getting started. 

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Core Infrastructure team at Harvey, you'll play a critical role in designing and building new infrastructure systems while equally scaling and strengthening our existing infrastructure. Our infrastructure is the foundation that powers every user interaction with Harvey - processing billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests across our global legal AI platform. 

You'll work in an environment balanced between innovation - building new systems - and operational excellence, ensuring that Harvey remains resilient and efficient as it scales products, regions, customers, and usage. Nice to Have

data.description:
About The Team

The Systems Engineering team in Rubrik's Developer Platform organization owns the reliability of Rubrik Cloud Data Management (CDM) and RSC-P products. Our customers trust Rubrik to recover their data on the worst day of their year. We make sure the software holds up under that pressure, at scale, over months of continuous operation, and in the face of failure. 

We build the infrastructure and pipelines that let product teams validate stress, scale, longevity and resilience, and we own the call on whether a release is reliable enough to ship. We work with component teams, product management and release managers to build reliability early, rather than inspect for it at the end. 

What We Own

- Release reliability certification. We own the reliability decision behind every CDM and RSC-P release, based on evidence from the platforms and pipelines we build. 
 - Stress, scale and chaos platforms. We build the infrastructure and pipelines for these validations, and give product teams self-service tools so they can validate their own work without waiting on us. 
 - Extreme-scale simulation. We build simulators that reproduce very large customer environments cost-efficiently. 
 - Long-running, customer-like environments. We operate and evolve clusters that run for months and mirror real customer deployments, so we find longevity problems before customers do. 
 - AI-driven triage and reliability. We build triage agents that investigate bugs, incidents and alerts, and we apply AI across our own workflows to speed up detection, diagnosis and certification. 

What You'll Do

As Senior Manager of Systems Engineering, you will own how Rubrik proves its products are reliable before customers depend on them. 

- Own release reliability. Be accountable for the reliability call behind every CDM release, and make ship-or-hold decisions with release managers and component leaders. 
 - Drive the qualification roadmap. Set one roadmap for release workflows and fast build qualification, improving both quality and speed. 
 - Build self-service platforms. Lead the engineers building our stress, scale, chaos and longevity infrastructure, simulators and long-running environments, so component teams can validate their own work. 
 - Lead and grow a high-performing team. Build a culture of transparency, innovation and security-first thinking in a fast-paced environment. Hire, coach and retain engineers across geographies. 
 - Run the team with operational rigor. Set a clear operating rhythm (sprint planning, stand-ups, regular reviews), keep the bar high, give direct feedback and hold the team accountable for delivery. 
 - Run on metrics. Track certification cycle time, customer-found escapes, triage time and infrastructure cost, and act on them. 
 - Reimagine reliability in the AI era. Use and promote AI and emerging technologies in the team, in line with the Company and Engineering vision, including AI-driven triage and automation, and measure the results. 
 - Partner broadly. Align priorities with component leaders, product managers and program managers, and communicate with stakeholders at every level. 

About You

You are a results-oriented leader who cares about enterprise software quality and about building strong teams. 

- 12+ years in the software industry, with hands-on experience building and delivering enterprise-grade products as both an individual contributor and a manager. 
 - 3+ years leading teams of software or systems engineers, with a track record of delivering high-quality enterprise releases. 
 - Technical depth in distributed systems, test infrastructure, or release and reliability engineering. 
 - Experience hiring and building top-tier teams, including teams spread across geographies. 
 - Experience building engineering practices, processes and operational rigor. 
 - Track record of communicating clearly and influencing across engineering, product and executive leadership. 
 - Ability to execute in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. 
 - AI-forward leadership: proven use of AI to improve your own work and your team's, for example by building or adopting AI agents and tooling that measurably cut triage time, speed up infrastructure and pipeline delivery, or automate release workflows.

We are seeking a high-achieving developer to join our Offensive Security Operations team (OSO). This role will focus on automating processes and building tools to drive down cyber security risk. You will have the opportunity to innovate, build for the future, and make a direct impact on our security landscape!

OSO conducts internal security testing exercises and leads key initiatives to identify and mitigate cyber security risks. However, to improve our business-as-usual activities, we require additional automation and custom tooling. Your contributions will be critical in streamlining operations, automating high impact security checks, and supporting the team's long-term success. 

Our environment is cloud-native, primarily AWS based with a mature development ecosystem and well-established standards. 

Responsibilities

- Gather user requirements, decipher the needs and expectations of internal and external customers, and translate them into effective solution designs. 
 - Maintain regular communication with partners, providing updates and collecting feedback for continuous improvement. 
 - Implement and deliver solutions within agreed timeframes. 
 - Fully test services including unit tests and user acceptance tests. 
 - Provide full documentation ensuring there are appropriate artefacts for maintaining, extending and using your work in your absence. 
 - Ensure all services align with LSEG security standards, team quality controls, and validated approaches. 
 - Collaborate with partner teams to integrate security measures into all stages of the development lifecycle and existing tooling. 
 - Continuously evaluate and improve quality and security processes, policies and documentation based on lessons learned and industry developments where possible through automation. 
 - Communicate sophisticated technology concepts and solutions clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences through reports, presentations, and documentation. 
 - Demonstrate strong active listening skills and provide constructive feedback to colleagues and partners

Required Experience & Skills

Required Qualification: 

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems / Technology, Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent field of study. 

Core Technical Skills

- Proven experience in crafting design documents 
 - Proven experience with Python 3. 7+ and VueJS 2 or 3 
 - Proven experience with API Development (Flask API or any) 
 - Proven experience with CLI tool development (Cleo or any) 
 - Proven experience with Unit testing / Integration / Behavioral testing 
 - Proven experience in maintaining complete software development lifecycle 
 - Proven experience with IaC technology to maintain cloud infrastructure 
 - Proven experience with setting up and managing resources in cloud hosting solutions (AWS preferred) 
 - Proven experience with PowerShell and/or Bash Scripting 
 - Proven experience with containerisation 
 - Solid exposure to different software architectures 
 - Proven experience with RDBMS databases or NoSQL, preferably with MySQL/PostgreSQL or similar 
 - Proven experience with Git repository management - we use Gitlab / Git 
 - Proven experience with Static analysis tooling 
 - Proven experience with CI / CD 
 - Any knowledge of Azure / Graph API Is a bonus 
 - Good understanding of UI/UX

Required Professional Attributes And Demeanour

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail (comfortable investigating issues on production) 
 - Strong understanding of security vulnerabilities and common software engineering flaws. 
 - Comfortable with Agile practices (Daily standups, retros, demoes) 
 - A disliking for silo operations 
 - Comfortable with demoes showcasing progression of work. 
 - Evidence driven, methodical and incremental approach over future proofing approach 
 - Proficiency with designing software and discussing with collaborators over contributing a solution to code 
 - Great teammate and able to self-organise is vital 
 - Proactive over reactive 
 - Estimation, Planning and maintenance of the backlog 
 - Comfortable exploring and adopting out of the box solutions including outside of immediate expertise. 
 - Taking challenge as an opportunity 
 - Able to push back over overcommitting and underdeliver 
 - A kind, collaborative personality while being firm on delivering work and driving progress. 

This is a great opportunity for an experienced software engineer looking to work in a highly dynamic security-focused team. If you have a passion for automation, security, and innovative problem-solving, we would love to hear from you!

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions. 

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25, 000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. 

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. 

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
