data.title: Cloud Automation
data.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. 

Job Description

Cloud Automation Engineer

Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai

Experience: 6+ Years

About The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization. 

Your Role

As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments. 
 - Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning. 
 - Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions. 
 - Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations. 
 - Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles. 
 - Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines. 
 - Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions. 
 - Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities. 
 - Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management. 
 - Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability. 
 - Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design. 
 - Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). 
 - Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services. 
 - Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning. 

Mandatory Skills

- Microsoft Azure
 - Terraform
 - Azure Bicep
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
 - Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
 - Azure Virtual Machines
 - Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
 - CI/CD & Deployment Automation
 - Cloud Cost Optimization
 - Monitoring & Operations

What You'll Love About Working Here

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence. 

You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in emerging technologies like cloud and AI. 

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

‒ Design and build AI solutions across a range of business problems, choosing the right approach for each: document and image extraction or classification, predictive models, workflow automation, LLM-based agents and more.

‒ Set and enforce model governance standards: approval workflows, risk and bias assessment, and documentation for every model promoted to production. 

‒ Build observability into every AI system: logging, tracing and monitoring for inputs, outputs, latency and failure modes, so issues surface before they reach the business. 

‒ Own token economics and compute cost across LLM-based and other AI systems: track cost per request, choose the right model size for each task, and balance accuracy against spend. 

‒ Build and maintain a dashboard that tracks the metrics that matter, such as accuracy, latency, cost, throughput, drift and error rate, across every AI system in production. 

‒ Evaluate and select the right AI approach for each problem, whether that is an LLM, a classical machine learning model, computer vision or a mix, based on what the problem actually needs rather than what is fashionable. 

‒ Mentor engineers on AI engineering practices, and build a shared standard for how the team designs, tests and ships AI systems. 

‒ Explain what an AI system can and cannot do, in plain terms, to non-technical stakeholders and leadership, so expectations stay realistic. 

‒ Track new AI and machine learning techniques, and test them against real business needs rather than adopting them for their own sake. 

What You Bring

‒ 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years focused on applied AI or machine learning in production. 

‒ Hands-on experience building and deploying a range of AI solutions, such as document or image extraction and classification, predictive models, recommendation systems, or LLM-based agents and assistants.

‒ Experience building dashboards or metrics systems that track model and system performance over time.

Scopely is looking for an Engineering Manager, Backend (Gaming) to join the WWE Champions team in Bangalore!

We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

WWE Champions is our ultimate and unique RPG puzzle match game featuring WWE superstars and legends across mobile and PC platforms. WWE Champions is the most downloaded WWE game to date, with a highly engaged and passionate community. 

What You'll Do

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead the teams overseeing the systems that power live game configuration, blueprint and content delivery, feature controls, and the backend runtime that serves core gameplay and live operations at scale. You will be accountable for team health, technical execution, operational excellence, and cross-functional delivery across a complex live-service ecosystem, ensuring that tools used by designers and live-ops teams translate safely and reliably into production game behavior. 

- Lead and grow an engineering team responsible for both Game Backend and Live Tools, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and career development
 - Own delivery across two tightly connected domains: the internal content/configuration platform and the live backend services that power player-facing gameplay systems
 - Drive execution for systems that manage blueprints, game configuration, live-ops content, server controls, A/B testing, segmentation, and feature rollout workflows
 - Partner closely with product, design, analytics, QA, and operations to plan and deliver live-service features, events, and tooling improvements

 - Help the team balance short-term live-ops responsiveness with long-term platform investments, code health, and system maintainability
 - Establish clear engineering processes for planning, prioritization, estimation, quality, release management, and cross-team coordination
 - Partner with senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, technical risk management, and modernization opportunities across legacy and live production systems
 - Create strong feedback loops with stakeholders who depend on internal tools, ensuring design, content, and live-ops workflows are efficient, safe, and scalable
 - Support live-service excellence by leading incident reviews, improving operational playbooks, and hardening systems that directly affect player experience

What We're Looking For

- Experience Technical Skills
 - 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 1+ years of people management or technical team leadership experience
 - Proven experience managing backend or platform teams supporting live-service products, game services, or other high-availability systems
 - Demonstrated success leading through ambiguity, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and delivering across multiple parallel workstreams
 - Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and building healthy, accountable engineering culture
 - Experience balancing execution, technical quality, and long-term platform evolutionin a fast-moving product environment
 - Strong backend engineering foundation, ideally in Python and Django or similarly large service-oriented web platforms
 - Solid understanding of live backend systems, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, caching, asynchronous processing, and operational tooling
 - Hands-on familiarity with Redis, DynamoDB, and data models used in performance-sensitive, high-throughput applications
 - Experience with systems that manage configuration, feature flags, experiments, content pipelines, or blueprint/data-driven runtime behavior
 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and service operations, especially AWS-based environments and supporting developer workflows
 - Ability to partner credibly in architecture and debugging discussions involving reliability, scale, release safety, and production incidents
 - Experience improving engineering practices around testing, deployment, observability, code review, and maintainability in large shared codebases
 - Cross-Functional and Domain Knowledge
 - Experience supporting internal tools used by non-engineering teams such as game design, live-ops, economy design, QA, or analytics
 - Strong understanding of how backend systems, admin tools, and content pipelines work together to power live events, gameplay tuning, and player-facing experiences
 - Experience with A/B testing, segmentation, rollout controls, or live configuration systems is strongly preferred
 - Comfortable partnering across technical and non-technical functions to translate product and operational needs into durable engineering solutions
 - Experience in mobile games, live-service games, or game-adjacent backend/platform environments is highly preferred
 - Soft Skills & Education
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to align engineers, stakeholders, and leadership around priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes
 - Pragmatic, organized, and highly accountable, with a strong sense of ownership for both team effectiveness and production quality
 - Passion for games, live operations, and building systems that help teams ship better player experiences safely and efficiently

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world's most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time "MONOPOLY GO!" and "Pokémon GO, " along with "Stumble Guys, " "Star TrekTM Fleet Command, " "MARVEL Strike Force, " "WWE Champions, " the Scrabble® franchise, "Yahtzee® With Buddies, " and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry - bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Whether building global sensations like "MONOPOLY GO!" from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses - Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
data.description:
Who We Are

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves. 

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on. 

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on. 

The Opportunity

AI applications are moving from prototypes to production, and the infrastructure underneath them is becoming increasingly complex. 

We build and run the infrastructure behind our AI products: the cloud and Kubernetes platform they run on, the pipelines that ship code to production, and the observability that tells us when something breaks. We're also building AI agents that can operate that infrastructure themselves

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can work across these areas, build systems from the ground up, and think ahead about how they will behave at scale. 

A key part of this role is building AI agents for infrastructure and engineering workflows. We're looking for someone who has actually built and shipped agents or agentic systems that perform real work, not just used AI coding assistants or experimented with prompts. 

What You Will Do?

- Build reliable infrastructure at scale. Design and improve cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, compute, storage, and distributed systems. 
 - Design for failure. Identify bottlenecks, failure modes, and operational risks before they become production issues. 
 - Build safer deployments. Improve CI/CD, testing, rollout strategies, and deployment controls. 
 - Build strong observability. Develop monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational tooling that makes systems easier to understand and operate. 
 - Improve infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and cloud cost. 
 - Build AI agents for infrastructure and engineering. Design and ship agents that can use tools and APIs, execute multi-step workflows, troubleshoot issues, or automate operational work. 
 - Make agents safe to operate. Build the right evaluation, permissions, guardrails, observability, and failure handling around agents taking real actions. 
 - Raise the engineering bar. Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and postmortems. 
 - Share on-call ownership. Join the team's on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and turn what you learn into fixes, runbooks, and automation that reduce future pages. 

What Makes You a Match?

- You've built AI agents, not just used AI tools. You have shipped agentic systems that perform meaningful work and understand tools, state, workflows, evaluation, and guardrails. 
 - You have strong infrastructure fundamentals. You understand distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, and production operations. 
 - You've built systems through scale. You have taken infrastructure from relatively early stages to meaningful production scale and can talk about the trade-offs along the way. 
 - You think about reliability by default. Failure modes, blast radius, operational complexity, and recovery are part of how you approach architecture. 
 - You can debug across layers. You're comfortable moving from application behaviour to Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure to find root causes. 
 - You build rather than operate manually. Your instinct is to automate repetitive work and build tools that make engineering teams more effective. 
 - You've built platforms other engineers build on. Package registries, artifact stores, CI systems or internal developer platforms all count. 
 - You write things down. At staff level most of your influence comes through design docs and reviews. 

Strong signals: Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or production-grade AI agents. Experience with agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, memory/state, or agent reliability is particularly valuable. 

Our stack: AWS/EKS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu, FluxCD, Temporal, VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, Grafana, Go, and Rust. You don't need experience with all of these. Strong engineers from other backgrounds can pick them up quickly. 

Why Atlan?

Joining Atlan Means Being Part Of a Global Movement To Help Data Teams Do Their Life's Best Work. Here's What You Can Expect

- Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‐based variable pay, and impact‐driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time. 
 - AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn't an add-on, it's woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact. 
 - Health & Wellness: From Day‐1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in. 
 - Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact. 
 - Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery. 
 - Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work. 

More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: "Can we trust the data in our stack?" to businesses asking: "Can we trust AI inside the business?"

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents. 

To learn more, visit www. atlan. com and follow us on LinkedIn. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Recruitment Fraud Alert

Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan. com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links - visit atlan. com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. 

Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan. com.

data.title: Medical Visualization Engineer – 3D Rendering
data.description:
Key Responsibilities 
 - Develop interactive medical visualization applications for 2D images, multiplanar reconstruction, 3D surfaces, and volumetric datasets derived from CT, MR, ultrasound, or fluoroscopy workflows. 
 - Implement volume rendering, surface rendering, transfer functions, lighting, clipping, cropping, transparency, camera controls, and anatomical exploration features. 
 - Convert medical image volumes, segmentation masks, landmarks, centerlines, meshes, and quantitative results into accurate and intuitive 3D visual representations. 
 - Develop visualization features for segmentation overlays, measurements, annotations, registration results, treatment or intervention planning, and image-guided navigation. 
 - Implement geometry-processing workflows including isosurface extraction, mesh generation, smoothing, decimation, repair, normal computation, and model export. 
 - Optimize rendering pipelines for responsiveness, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and real-time interaction with large medical datasets. 
 - Work with DICOM datasets and support image loading, orientation handling, voxel spacing, coordinate transformations, metadata interpretation, and de-identification-aware workflows. 
 - Collaborate with AI and medical imaging teams to visualize model outputs, uncertainty, anatomical structures, and quantitative biomarkers for validation and demonstration. 
 - Conduct visual and functional testing to verify anatomical correctness, coordinate consistency, rendering quality, usability, and performance across representative datasets. 
 - Document visualization architecture, rendering methods, design assumptions, performance findings, and user-interface behavior. Required Qualifications 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Game Technology, or a related field. 
 - Less than 3 years of professional, research, internship, or project experience in computer graphics, scientific visualization, medical imaging, game-engine development, or 3D application development. 
 - Strong understanding of 3D graphics concepts including coordinate systems, transformations, cameras, lighting, textures, meshes, shaders, depth, transparency, and rendering pipelines. 
 - Hands-on programming experience in C++ and/or Python, with exposure to graphics or visualization frameworks. 
 - Experience with one or more tools or libraries such as VTK, OpenGL, WebGL, Three. js, Unity, Unreal Engine, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience working with 3D geometry, point clouds, surface meshes, volumetric data, or image stacks. 
 - Familiarity with image-processing and medical-imaging tools such as OpenCV, SimpleITK, ITK, pydicom, NiBabel, MONAI, or 3D Slicer. 
 - Understanding of DICOM image orientation, voxel spacing, patient coordinate systems, resampling, and the relationship between image space and world space. 
 - Ability to profile and troubleshoot rendering performance, memory use, visual artifacts, and cross-platform behavior. 
 - Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with imaging scientists, AI engineers, clinicians, UX designers, and software developers. Preferred Skills 
 - Experience with direct volume rendering, ray casting, transfer-function design, GPU shaders, CUDA, compute shaders, or GPU-accelerated image processing. 
 - Exposure to medical visualization workflows such as MPR, MIP, MinIP, curved planar reformation, cinematic rendering, segmentation review, surgical planning, or navigation. 
 - Familiarity with mesh-processing libraries such as Open3D, PCL, CGAL, trimesh, MeshLab, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience creating interactive desktop, web, AR, VR, or mixed-reality applications for scientific or medical use cases. 
 - Basic understanding of human factors, visual perception, color mapping, accessibility, and clinical usability considerations. Good to have 
 - Exposure to front-end development frameworks such as React, Angular, Qt, Flutter, or similar technologies for building visualization interfaces and proof-of-concept demos. 
 - Experience with DICOMweb, PACS integration concepts, image streaming, cloud-based rendering, or remote visualization. 
 - Awareness of regulatory, privacy, cybersecurity, and software-quality considerations for medical visualization applications, including traceability and reproducible validation.

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing QA team, including hiring, mentoring, and driving performance excellence
 - Demonstrate excellence in team management, task management, and cross-pod coordination, ensuring optimal planning, prioritization, and execution across multiple workstreams
 - Define and drive test strategy, coverage, and risk-based validation approaches across features, content, and technical initiatives
 - Champion a shift-left approach, actively contributing during design and early development phases to identify risks, gaps, and quality concerns

 - Maintenance: PM activity execution, spare parts planning, and equipment reliability enhancement

- Willing to work in rotational shifts.

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Overview

The Engineering team is looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer to help drive quality engineering excellence through automation, continuous testing, and performance validation. The ideal candidate is passionate about software quality, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

This role will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable automation frameworks, validating complex enterprise applications, APIs, microservices, and batch processes, and ensuring high-quality releases through robust test automation and performance engineering practices. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Software Engineers, Architects, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable solutions that enhance the customer experience. 

Role

In this role, you will: 

Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for UI, API, microservices, and batch processing applications. 

Create and execute automated test suites for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. 

Develop automation solutions using BDD, Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Page Object Model frameworks. 

Perform API, UI, microservices, batch, and performance testing to ensure application quality and reliability. 

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing initiatives. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define test strategies, identify quality risks, troubleshoot defects, and drive resolution. 

Analyze test results, quality metrics, and performance bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for continuous improvement. 

All About You

The ideal candidate for this position should: 

Have advanced expertise in Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and HTML, with strong software development and automation engineering skills. 

Possess hands-on experience designing and implementing automation frameworks using BDD (Cucumber/JBehave), Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Page Object Model approaches. 

Demonstrate strong experience in API, UI, microservices, batch, and integration testing using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Rest Assured, Postman, Insomnia, TestNG, and JUnit. 

Have advanced knowledge of CI/CD and software development tools including Maven, Node. js, Spring Framework, Git, Jenkins DSL, Swagger, Splunk, Apache NiFi, Unix/Linux, and JPA. 

Be proficient in backend testing and data validation using Oracle and PostgreSQL databases. 

Have practical experience conducting performance, load, and scalability testing using JMeter, BlazeMeter, or LoadRunner. 

Be skilled at root cause analysis, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and improving overall test effectiveness and automation coverage. 

Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and business teams. 

Possess a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 

Thrive in Agile environments and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, frameworks, and engineering practices. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Director, Technology (Data Engineering)
data.description:
The Technical Director, Data Engineering will own the vision, architecture, and delivery of our data platform and the engineering organization behind it. You will set the technical direction for how Code and Theory collects, models, and activates data, powering analytics, predictive models, and generative AI across the agency and its clients. You will work closely with agency leadership, client stakeholders, Engineering, Strategy, and the Machine Learning team to translate business strategy into data and platform development. 

You will have broad authority over technical strategy, standards, and staffing, and input into budget and roadmap decisions. You will anchor the architecture of major platform initiatives, define how we prioritize and fund competing investments, and build the team as deliberately as the systems. You will collaborate with some of the best talent globally and define the culture and craft of a world-class data organization. 

Our engineers are AI native and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development with AI. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the vision, architecture, and delivery of the Code and Theory data platform and the engineering organization behind it
 - Set technical strategy and tie it to measurable business outcomes, prioritizing and funding competing initiatives
 - Design and scale data platforms from the ground up, covering how data is collected, modeled, and activated
 - Activate latent company and client data lakes into data-driven product backends
 - Evaluate and select cloud data platforms, making and defending architectural trade-offs
 - Write and review Python and SQL, staying hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and critical builds
 - Partner with the Machine Learning team to power analytics, predictive models, and generative AI across the agency and its clients
 - Use AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor in daily engineering, and build agentic tools and AI-enabled workflows that automate and optimize quality, processes, and delivery
 - Lead adoption of AI-powered coding and agentic engineering across the team, establishing best practices for AI-enhanced processes
 - Hire, mentor, and develop engineers and leads, and establish engineering standards, best practices, and team culture
 - Have input into budget and roadmap decisions and represent the data organization to senior leadership and clients
 - Recommend data governance, privacy, and security policies that fit client and regulatory constraints
 - Communicate effectively across the full range of technical levels in an organization that is 50/50 Tech/Creative
 - Create internal and external knowledge sharing in the form of blog posts, whitepapers, best practices, and methodologies

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 10+ years in data engineering or adjacent disciplines
 - 3+ years leading teams or technical organizations
 - Record of designing and scaling data platforms from the ground up
 - Demonstrated ability to set technical strategy and tie it to measurable business outcomes, including prioritizing and funding competing initiatives
 - Substantial work experience activating latent company data lakes into data-driven product backends
 - Deep expertise in cloud data platforms and the judgment to choose among them. Bring your opinions on which you love and which you hate!
 - Strong technical fluency in Python and SQL
 - Substantial experience with AI-powered coding, agentic engineering, and AI-enabled workflows, ideally having led their adoption across a team
 - Proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and growing engineers and leads, and of establishing standards and best practices
 - Exceptional communication and influence across the full range of technical levels
 - Ability to represent the data organization to senior leadership and clients

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience owning data governance, privacy compliance, and security programs
 - Working knowledge of marketing data ecosystems (GA4, advertising platforms, CRMs, CDPs)
 - Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into data pipelines and shipping GenAI applications to production
 - Experience in an agency or consultancy environment, balancing client-facing delivery with internal platform investment

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic. 

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J. P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok. 

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2, 000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

data.description:
The Lead Data Engineer will own the design, build, and delivery of core components of our data platform and lead a pod of engineers working on them. You will help shape how Code and Theory collects, models, and activates data, powering analytics, predictive models, and generative AI across the agency and its clients. You will work closely with the Technical Director, Data Engineering, the Machine Learning team, Strategy, and client-facing teams to turn business needs into reliable, well-modeled data products. 

You will be a hands-on technical leader with authority over design decisions, code quality, and delivery within your area, and input into estimates and roadmap planning. You will anchor the architecture of the pipelines and services your pod owns, set day-to-day engineering standards, and mentor the engineers around you. You will collaborate with some of the best talent globally and contribute to the culture and craft of a world-class data organization. 

Our engineers are AI native and advance the state of the art in the practice of software development with AI. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the design, build, and delivery of core data platform components and the pod of engineers behind them
 - Translate roadmap priorities from the Technical Director into technical plans, estimates, and timelines
 - Design and build scalable data pipelines, covering how data is collected, modeled, and activated
 - Turn latent company and client data lakes into data-driven product backends, APIs, and reusable data products
 - Evaluate tools and cloud data services, and recommend fit-for-purpose approaches with clear trade-offs
 - Write and review production-grade Python and SQL, staying hands-on in design reviews and critical builds
 - Partner with the Machine Learning team to deliver reliable feature pipelines and data foundations for predictive models and generative AI
 - Use AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor in daily engineering, and build agents and AI-enabled workflows that improve quality, testing, and delivery speed
 - Coach the team on AI-assisted development and agentic engineering, and help establish best practices for AI-enhanced processes
 - Mentor engineers, support hiring and interviews, and help raise the engineering bar through standards, code review, and team culture
 - Implement testing, monitoring, data quality, and observability practices to keep pipelines trustworthy
 - Apply data governance, privacy, and security standards that fit client and regulatory constraints
 - Communicate effectively with technical and creative colleagues in an organization that is 50/50 Tech/Creative, and with client stakeholders when needed
 - Contribute to internal and external knowledge sharing in the form of blog posts, best practices, and methodologies

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 8+ years in data engineering or adjacent disciplines
 - 3+ years leading engineers, a pod, or a workstream
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and delivering data pipelines and platforms in production
 - Ability to translate technical work into clear plans, estimates, and business outcomes
 - Experience making data lake or warehouse data available to applications and products
 - Working experience with at least one major cloud data platform (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, or similar) and sound judgment on when to use it
 - Strong technical fluency in Python and SQL
 - Experience with orchestration and batch or streaming tools (Airflow, Spark, Kafka, dbt, or similar)
 - Hands-on experience with AI-powered coding, agentic engineering, and AI-enabled workflows, ideally having helped teammates adopt them
 - Track record of mentoring engineers and enforcing standards and best practices through code review, documentation, and testing
 - Solid communication skills across the full range of technical levels, including creative partners

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with data governance, privacy compliance, and security practices
 - Working knowledge of marketing data ecosystems (GA4, advertising platforms, CRMs, CDPs)
 - Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into data pipelines and shipping GenAI applications to production
 - Experience in an agency or consultancy environment, balancing client-facing delivery with internal platform investment
 - Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and FinOps basics

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic. 

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J. P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok. 

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2, 000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We're always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

data.title: Senior Integration Solutions Engineer
data.description:
Function

Product

Our Company

We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. 

If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data. 

Job Description

Role Overview

The Senior Integration Solutions Engineer is responsible for architecting, validating, and documenting enterprise solutions leveraging S3-compatible object storage. This role works across data protection, analytics, AI/ML, search, and modern data lakehouse platforms to ensure solution interoperability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. The engineer functions as a technical authority, designing validation strategies, developing performance benchmarks, troubleshooting complex environments, and publishing best-practice guidance for customers and partners. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Validation

- Validate partner solutions including data protection, analytics, observability, search, and data lake platforms. 
 - Design and validate end-to-end reference architectures leveraging S3-compatible object storage for data protection, analytics, search, AI/ML, and data lake workloads. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and identify strategic integration opportunities for object storage platforms. 
 - Define validation methodologies that accurately reflect real-world customer deployment scenarios. 
 - Work directly with engineering, product management, partners, and field teams to ensure successful solution integration and deployment. 
 - Serve as a subject matter expert for object storage integration patterns, performance characteristics, and best practices. 

Integration & Performance Testing

- Develop and execute comprehensive integration, interoperability, scalability, and performance test plans. 
 - Design benchmark tests that characterize throughput, latency, concurrency, and scalability under production-scale workloads. 
 - Build automated validation frameworks and test environments that improve testing efficiency and coverage. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks across storage, network, compute, application, and infrastructure layers. 

Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

- Investigate complex issues spanning distributed applications, object storage systems, networking, operating systems, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and telemetry data to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Reproduce field and customer-reported issues and work with development teams to validate resolutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership during escalations involving partner integrations and strategic customer environments. 
 - Publish validated reference architectures, deployment guides, solution briefs, and technical whitepapers. 
 - Develop sizing guidance, architecture recommendations, and performance tuning documentation. 
 - Present technical findings to customers, partners, sales engineers, and executive stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience designing, validating, or supporting enterprise-scale data platform, storage, or cloud infrastructure solutions. 
 - Strong background in integration testing, performance testing, or solution validation. 
 - Proven troubleshooting experience with distributed applications and multi-tier architectures. 
 - Experience with object storage technologies and S3-compatible APIs. 
 - Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate complex technical challenges independently. 
 - Excellent written communication skills with experience creating technical documentation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or other data protection platforms. 
 - Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk, or large-scale search and observability platforms. 
 - Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Starburst, Databricks, or similar data analytics technologies. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML data pipelines and data lake architectures. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native environments. 
 - Experience authoring technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and reference architectures. 
 - Experience presenting technical findings to customers and executive audiences. 
 - Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and system administration concepts. 
 - Proficiency in Python, scripting, or test automation development. 

About Us

We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can a make positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential. 

Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives

Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. 

We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. 

How We Look After You

We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.

Job Title: Staff Software Engineer, Database Engineering

Location: India, Hybrid

ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue - one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. 

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won - the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. 

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue - and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. 

THE OPPORTUNITY: 

At Salesloft, our Staff Software Engineer, DBE will be pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing team in India. We are looking for an experienced technical leader who can help realize the Salesloft vision of a "Data Platform as a Service. - Design, build, and scale our RDBMS (Postgres, MySQL, Amazon Aurora) and NoSQL systems (Cassandra, MongoDB) to meet massive ingestion and analytical demands.

This role is ideal for an experienced infrastructure-focused engineer who is proficient with open-source platform technologies such as Kubernetes, Conductor, Istio, Kong, and related cloud-native tools. You will have the opportunity to leverage software development methodologies to deliver value to BCG's Consulting & X (case) teams, X Product teams and Practice Areas (domain) through providing software developer subject matter expertise, and accelerated execution support. 

You will collaborate with teams to gather requirements, specify, design, develop, deliver and support software solutions serving client needs. You will provide technical support through deeper understanding of relevant software solutions and processes to build high quality and efficient technology solutions. data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture 
 - Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents 
 - Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor 
 - Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service 
 - Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features 
 - Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load 
 - Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe 
 - Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt 
 - Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience 
 - Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture 
 - Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up 
 - Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them 
 - Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline 
 - AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside - review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
 - End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment 
 - A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved 
 - Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling

Why You'll Love Us

- We've evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
 - Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
 - We celebrate one another's differences: We're proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally. 
 - We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time. 
 - Where can we take you? We're fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

We are seeking a high-achieving developer to join our Offensive Security Operations team (OSO). This role will focus on automating processes and building tools to drive down cyber security risk. You will have the opportunity to innovate, build for the future, and make a direct impact on our security landscape!

OSO conducts internal security testing exercises and leads key initiatives to identify and mitigate cyber security risks. However, to improve our business-as-usual activities, we require additional automation and custom tooling. Your contributions will be critical in streamlining operations, automating high impact security checks, and supporting the team's long-term success. 

Our environment is cloud-native, primarily AWS based with a mature development ecosystem and well-established standards. 

Responsibilities

- Gather user requirements, decipher the needs and expectations of internal and external customers, and translate them into effective solution designs.

data.title: Software Engineer, Production
data.description:
Constantinople delivers a new era of AI-native banking. Constantinople provides banks with a fully-managed software and AI operational platform, which brings together customer experience, product, data, operations, compliance and infrastructure in a single platform. 

Constantinople's AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking. 

The Role

You will own production issues on a live banking platform, end to end. When an incident lands with you, you find the root cause in the code, the data, or the infrastructure. Then you fix it, or you work with our senior engineers to ship the fix. 

You will work across the full platform: payments, lending, deposits, the core ledger, and the services that connect them. Few roles give you this breadth this early in your career. 

You will also use AI tools every day to diagnose issues, trace problems across services, and draft fixes. Over time, you will help us build the automation that takes over routine work. The goal is a support function that runs itself, and you will help design it. 

What You Will Do

- Own Medium and Low impact incidents from assignment through to resolution, within agreed SLAs. 
 - Investigate issues across services, logs, databases, and code to find the true root cause. 
 - Write fixes where you can. Work with the Change team when a significant hotfix is required. 
 - Raise problem records for residual impact and recurring incidents. Drive the investigation through to a permanent fix. 
 - Coordinate Post Incident Reviews for Critical and High priority incidents, with the Engineering Managers who author them. 
 - Convert PIR and investigation actions into tracked problem tickets in Helix, and follow them through to closure. 
 - Use AI coding and analysis tools to diagnose and resolve issues faster. 
 - Turn manual runbooks into scripts, tools, and automated workflows. 
 - Help design and build the systems that automate triage, diagnosis, and resolution of routine incidents. 
 - Work closely with our Operations team to give our clients and their customers consistent coverage, care, and support. 
 - Find and fix issues in production before they become incidents. 

Who You Are

- You have 2-4 years of experience as a software engineer, ideally with some time in production support or on-call. 
 - You are strong in at least one language, such as TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, or Python. 
 - You read and debug code that you did not write, and you are comfortable in a large codebase. 
 - You know SQL well enough to investigate data issues directly. 
 - You understand how distributed systems fail, for example timeouts, retries, race conditions, and partial failures. 
 - You already use AI tools in your work, and you want to push them further. 
 - You want to understand how the whole platform works, not just one service. 
 - You stay calm under pressure and communicate clearly with engineers, operations, and stakeholders during incidents. 
 - You fix root causes, not symptoms. 

Application Process

If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been looking for, select the 'Apply Now' button below to submit your cover letter and resume. data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer -  Caretech (m/f/d)
data.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you'll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading. 

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care. 

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need. 

About The Role

As a product development company with a multi-year history of building robust platform and clinical products, we are shaping the future of European healthcare using healthcare open standards. To support this vision, we are engineering a strictly cloud-agnostic web application and require a Lead DevOps Engineer having 7-9 years of hands-on experience in the field of DevOps to define and drive our infrastructure, deployment, and automation strategies. 

Our engineering culture emphasizes high autonomy, flat team alignment, and pragmatic problem-solving principles inspired by Nordic corporate standards. You will join at a critical transition period to lead our repository migration from Azure DevOps (ADO) to GitHub and architect an AI-native development environment. Your strategic decisions regarding Kubernetes and Terraform will ensure our product deploys seamlessly across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments. 

Technology Stack

- Infrastructure & Provisioning: Kubernetes (K8s), Terraform, networking, capacity planning, load balancing, high availability (HA), and disaster recovery (DR). 
 - CI/CD & Source Control: ArgoCD, Azure DevOps (ADO), GitHub (Transitioning), GitHub Actions
 - AI Tooling: GitHub Copilot, Claude (for AI-native/agentic development workflows)
 - Application Development Technologies: Fundamental knowledge of . NET 10, C#, Angular, and TypeScript is nice to have. 

Responsibilities

- Design CI/CD solutions to enable continuous and seamless application delivery. 
 - Infrastructure Strategy: Define the Infrastructure as Code (IaC) governance using Terraform and Kubernetes, strictly maintaining a cloud-agnostic posture that fully supports self-hosted deployments and Mult cluster environment management. 
 - Release on Demand Architecture: Architect and govern Release on Demand capabilities, decoupling continuous deployment from business releases. Design feature toggle strategies, blue/green deployments, and canary rollouts that align with healthcare compliance and SAFe delivery cadence. 
 - DevSecOps & Compliance: Architect compliance-as-code, integrating automated security gating (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) directly into GitHub workflows to meet strict European healthcare regulations (e. g. , GDPR, NIS2). 
 - Unified Observability: Define a vendor-neutral telemetry and monitoring strategy (utilizing standards like OpenTelemetry) to ensure consistent logging, metrics, and tracing across both cloud and self-hosted deployments. 
 - Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose and resolve deployment issues by analyzing application and system logs. 
 - Workflow Architecture: Design and implement robust GitHub Copilot workflows and automated pipeline architectures that support our shift toward agentic and AI-native development. 
 - Strategic Migration: Architect and lead the end-to-end repository migration strategy from Azure DevOps to GitHub without disrupting active development cycles. 
 - Disaster Recovery (DR) Architecture: Design and govern multi-region failover strategies, automated backup architectures, and RTO/RPO standards to ensure the continuous availability of critical clinical systems. 
 - Technical Leadership: Act as the primary DevOps authority within our SAFe/Agile Scrum framework, providing fact-based, pragmatic guidance and mentoring to the broader engineering team. 

Technical Qualifications: 

- Extensive Containerization & IaC: Proven architectural experience designing and managing production workloads using Kubernetes and Terraform. Demonstrated ability to decouple infrastructure from specific cloud vendors. 
 - Advanced Deployment Strategies: Deep architectural knowledge of zero-downtime deployment patterns and feature flag management systems tailored for enterprise platform rollouts. 
 - CI/CD Mastery: Deep structural understanding of Azure DevOps pipelines combined with a strong capability to design, build, and automate sophisticated workflows in GitHub. 
 - Ecosystem Familiarity: Understanding of how . NET (C#) and Angular/TypeScript applications compile, build, and deploy at an enterprise scale. 
 - Security & Telemetry Architecture: Deep understanding of healthcare compliance frameworks, secrets management, and designing vendor-neutral observability stacks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 
 - AI-Forward Mindset: Practical experience implementing and optimizing AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude) within CI/CD pipelines and developer environments. 

Professional Attributes: 

- Pragmatic & Fact-Driven: You make architectural decisions based on objective metrics, scalability requirements, and logic. 
 - Self-Starter: You thrive in a high-trust environment, driving alignment and managing complex deliverables independently. 
 - Agile Collaborator: Comfortable operating as a leader within a SAFe/Agile Scrum model, prioritizing clear communication with product owners and development teams. 

What's in it for you?

In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. 

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you're interested in. 

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. 

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity. 

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay alert to recruitment scams: 

- Tieto only communicates via @tieto. com email addresses. 
 - We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond - verify it via our official careers site. 
 - For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

 - Balance operational responsibilities, project work, automation, technical debt, and reliability improvements. 
 - Identify recurring operational challenges and drive lasting improvements with the team and partner technical leads. 

Cross-Team Partnership

- Serve as the primary infrastructure engineering representative within the India office. 
 - Build working relationships with software engineering, data science, program management, release teams, and other partner organizations, and resolve priorities and dependencies across teams. 
 - Represent the team in planning, release, and operational discussions, making sure reliability, supportability, and operational concerns are raised early and addressed. 
 - Keep the India team aligned with the broader global Platform Engineering organization. 

About You

- 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering or a related discipline (Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Operations), including 3+ years of direct management of engineering or technical teams. 
 - Prior or current hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized environments. 
 - Experience with public cloud platforms; Azure and AWS experience preferred. 
 - Familiarity with production systems, monitoring and observability, incident management, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automation. 
 - Experience supporting teams that operate business-critical production systems. 
 - Enough technical depth to understand infrastructure and reliability issues, communicate effectively with engineers, and make informed management decisions. 
 - People-management skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development. 
 - Organizational and prioritization skills, with sound judgment around operational risk, escalation, and resource allocation. 
 - Experience coordinating work across multiple teams and stakeholder groups, including software development, data science, release engineering, and program management. 
 - Experience working in a geographically distributed, global engineering organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

If you share our passion for building a sustainable, intelligent, and efficient world, you're in the right place. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, we're a series D start-up, with teams in Mountain View, San Francisco (California), Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca (Romania), Paris (France), Munich (Germany), London (UK), Pune (India), and Sydney (Australia). So join us, and let's build this!

Aera Technology is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

At Aera Technology, we strive to support our Aeranauts and their loved ones through different stages of life with a variety of attractive benefits, and great perks. You'll find comprehensive medical, Group Medical Insurance, Term Insurance, Accidental Insurance, paid time off, Maternity leave, and much more. We offer limited access to online professional courses for both professional and personal development, coupled with people manager development programs. We believe in a flexible working environment, to allow our Aeranauts to perform at their best, ensuring a healthy work-life balance. When you're working from the office, you'll also have access to a fully-stocked kitchen with a selection of snacks and beverages.

Details: 

INSEAD is seeking an experienced Accessibility QA Engineer (Accessibility) to establish and drive accessibility testing practices across Learning Technology, Student Services, and Enterprise Applications. 

This role will lead the adoption of accessibility testing standards aligned with WCAG 2. 2 AA, implement an accessibility testing framework, integrate accessibility validation into CI/CD pipelines, and support compliance initiatives across INSEAD's digital services. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining accessibility testing standards, implementing both manual and automated accessibility testing, establishing governance and reporting, and supporting product teams in remediating accessibility issues. 

In addition, this role will support the broader Quality Engineering strategy by expanding test automation coverage and automated regression testing across INSEAD's critical applications. 

Accessibility expertise, including designing accessibility frameworks, governance, standards, and compliance processes, is the primary requirement for this role. Knowledge of Tosca and Java-based automation is preferred and will be considered a secondary requirement to support accessibility test automation initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

Accessibility Strategy & Governance

- Define and implement INSEAD's Accessibility Testing Framework. 
 - Establish accessibility testing standards aligned with WCAG 2. 2 AA and accessibility compliance requirements & s hould be able to implement Accessibility automated tests in Tosca. 
 - Define accessibility testing processes, methodologies, templates, governance, and reporting standards. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, UX Designers, and QA teams to embed accessibility into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Lead accessibility awareness sessions, workshops, and coaching programs. 
 - Provide expert guidance and recommendations on accessibility best practices and remediation strategies. 

Accessibility Testing & Compliance

- Design and execute accessibility testing across web and digital platforms. 
 - Build accessibility test scenarios, use cases, and reusable test assets. 
 - Conduct accessibility assessments and audits. 
 - Perform: 
 - Keyboard navigation testing
 - Screen reader testing
 - Color contrast validation
 - Focus management testing
 - ARIA validation
 - Workflow accessibility testing
 - Evaluate compliance against WCAG requirements. 
 - Provide accessibility gap analysis and remediation recommendations. 
 - Work closely with development teams to validate fixes and improvements. 

Accessibility Automation & CI/CD

- Implement automated accessibility testing using Tricentis Tosca Accessibility capabilities. 
 - Evaluate and recommend complementary accessibility tools and technologies. 
 - Integrate accessibility testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build automated accessibility regression test suites. 
 - Establish accessibility quality gates as part of the delivery process. 
 - Develop accessibility dashboards, compliance reports, and metrics. 
 - Promote continuous accessibility testing within Agile and DevOps teams. 

Accessibility Tools & Innovation

Recognizing that no single tool provides complete accessibility coverage, the Accessibility QA Engineer will: 

- Evaluate and recommend accessibility testing solutions beyond Tosca (depends if Tosca is enough)
 - Research and recommend open-source and commercial accessibility tools. 
 - Establish a best-practice accessibility testing toolchain combining automated and manual techniques. 
 - Benchmark industry practices and continuously improves INSEAD accessibility testing capabilities. 
 - Support proof-of-concepts and pilot implementations of emerging accessibility technologies. 

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

- Expand automated testing coverage across critical applications. 
 - Design and maintain automated regression test suites. 
 - Improve test automation execution efficiency and reporting. 
 - Support Quality Engineering initiatives across Digital Delivery. 
 - Reduce manual testing effort through automation and reusable testing frameworks. 
 - Drive best practices for automated testing within Agile delivery teams. 

Applications in Scope

The Accessibility QA Engineer Will Initially Focus On: 

Learning Technology Platforms

- Canvas LMS
 - Study
 - Intrepid
 - Bidding

Required Experience Essential

- 10+ years of experience in Accessibility Testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of: 
 - WCAG 2. 1 / WCAG 2. 2
 - WAI-ARIA standards
 - Accessible User Interface design principles
 - Accessibility compliance practices
 - Experience implementing accessibility programs and frameworks. 
 - Experience with automated test frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience developing accessibility test strategies and testing frameworks. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery environments. 

Open-Source Accessibility Tools (if Tosca is not sufficient)

- axe DevTools / axe-core
 - Pa11y
 - Lighthouse Accessibility
 - WAVE
 - Accessibility Insights
 - ARC Toolkit

Certifications (Preferred)

- CPACC (Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies)
 - WAS (Web Accessibility Specialist)
 - IAAP Certifications
 - ISTQB Testing Certifications
 - ISTQB Test Automation Engineer
 - Agile Testing Certifications
