data.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Lead Control Automation System Engineer, you will be responsible to lead the requirement, design, implementation, and development of digital control system of the HVDC Control & Protection system. As part of this role, you will be working closely across various engineering disciplines within HVDC business. Solution and engineering centre (NPI, ITO, OTR and Product Care) in all aspects of HVDC Control & Protection system, this includes developing organizational talent and Engineering process management, provide technical guidance, mentoring, drive consistent design practices, common global processes for projects implementation and also provide technical solution that meets the NPI, project delivery and Tender objectives. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Overseeing the overall technical solution that meets customer Requirement based on reference Solution. 

This Includes The Following Actives

- Responsible for leading overall requirement, design, implementation, and testing of digital control system of the HVDC Control & Protection system this includes network & Cybersecurity design
 - Lead the configuration of IEC61850 IED's via vendor specific tools and System Configuration Tools for complete system integration. 
 - Lead the generation of Substation Configuration description Language (SCL) files for system integration. 
 - Knowledge of Sequencing & interlocking principles used in substation automation systems and their implementation on IEC61850 IED's. 
 - Lead the design, configuration and testing required to deliver on time and within defined budgets the HVDC Control System hardware. 
 - Lead the testing and debugging of complex IEC61850 communication systems using industry standard tools such as IEDSCout, Wireshark etc. 
 - Good experience with HMI/SCADA technologies, implementation, testing and installation. 
 - Coordinate and interface the HVDC Control System with Balance of Plant equipment and SCADA systems. 
 - Define the main IO Lists of the control system. 
 - Analyze signal interfaces and ensure compatibility with the control system. 
 - Lead in collaboration with NPI teams, the configuration of Remote Terminal Units (RTU), Bay Controllers (BCU) and Merging Units for signal acquisition in digital substation environments. 
 - Lead the design of LAN networks/Communication Architectures and configuration of industrial ethernet switches/routers and satellite clocks
 - Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines. 
 - Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks under the guidance of lead engineers. 
 - Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
 - Wire/Cable Schedules
 - Routine Test specification
 - General Assembly drawings
 - Bill of Materials
 - Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System. 
 - Prepare and present technical information for Substation Control Systems to internal and external customers. 
 - Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system. 
 - Share engineering information and promote open dialogue. 
 - Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures. 
 - Responsible for coaching and developing department talent. 
 - Continuously improving the product in terms of delivery speed, stability and reliability
 - Review and approve design documents, implement, and ensures quality deliverables on time and within targeted cost

Required Qualifications

- Degree in Electronics/Electrical engineering or related field. 
 - Strong background in configuring Substation Bay Controllers/Merging Units/ IEC61850 IED's/HMI/SCADA technologies. 
 - Minimum of 8 -10 years' experience in control and protection system design
 - Knowledge of industrial communication networks such as IEC61850 and Ethernet based protocols. 
 - Control & Protection Relay logics Design techniques
 - Experienced in developing electrical designs for industrial control systems
 - Knowledge of communication networks Security/Hardening and Cybersecurity best practices
 - Excellent knowledge of commonly used Layer2&3 protocols such as Ipv4, OSPF, LACP, DMZ, VPN/ DMS/ADMS/ DNP, IEC, Modbus
 - Experience relevant to electrical power systems and Substation automation engineering
 - Working knowledge of industrial and utility electrical control and protection systems and Digital Control Systems, Substation Automation and SCADA

Desired Characteristics

- Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. 
 - Proven technical leadership in a complex system engineering development environment

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer, Automation & API Testing
data.description:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It's how we've contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services - and our open-access model - we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. 

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25, 000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG's ticker symbol is LSEG. 

OUR PEOPLE: 

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. 

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder - which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. 

Position Overview

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality across the software development lifecycle through a strong focus on test automation, API validation, quality engineering practices, and continuous delivery. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to establish testing strategies, improve automation coverage, identify quality risks early, and enable rapid, reliable releases. 

The Senior QE serves as a quality advocate and technical leader, helping teams adopt scalable automation frameworks, shift-left testing practices, and data-driven quality standards. The role is expected to operate independently, influence engineering decisions, and mentor team members on quality engineering best practices. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Test Leadership

- Define and execute comprehensive quality strategies aligned with product and engineering objectives. 
 - Lead test planning activities and establish risk-based testing approaches across initiatives. 
 - Review requirements, architectures, and designs to identify quality risks and testability concerns early. 
 - Establish quality gates, standards, and automation objectives for development teams. 
 - Provide technical leadership on quality engineering practices across multiple products or services. 
 - Mentor Quality Engineers and development teams on automation, testing methodologies, and quality best practices. 

API & Service-Level Testing

- Design, develop, and maintain robust API and service-level automation frameworks. 
 - Validate REST, GraphQL, and microservice-based architectures through automated testing. 
 - Create automated tests covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing scenarios. 
 - Validate authentication, authorization, data integrity, error handling, and security controls across services. 
 - Perform data validation through API responses, databases, queues, and downstream integrations. 
 - Collaborate with developers to improve API testability and observability. 

Test Automation Engineering

- Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, and test data management solutions. 
 - Drive automation-first testing approaches, minimizing reliance on manual regression testing. 
 - Continuously improve automation reliability, execution speed, and maintainability. 
 - Measure automation effectiveness using coverage, execution, defect detection, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous delivery goals. 

System Integration & End-to-End Testing

- Validate complex workflows across distributed systems, microservices, and third-party integrations. 
 - Design test strategies for highly integrated cloud-based applications. 
 - Conduct integration and system testing to ensure end-to-end business process validation. 
 - Identify risks associated with cross-system dependencies and recommend mitigation strategies. 

Performance, Reliability & Security Testing

- Define and execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing approaches. 
 - Analyze application behaviour under load and identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Support security testing initiatives by validating authentication, authorization, and API security controls. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application resilience and production readiness. 

DevOps & Continuous Quality

- Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. 
 - Ensure quality gates are embedded within deployment pipelines. 
 - Leverage test execution analytics and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve environment stability, test data availability, and deployment validation. 
 - Support quality practices within cloud-native and containerized environments. 

Release Quality & Production Support

- Evaluate release readiness using risk assessments, automation results, and quality metrics. 
 - Participate in production incident investigations and root cause analysis. 
 - Develop monitoring and validation strategies to ensure quality after deployment. 
 - Analyze defect trends and recommend preventative quality improvements. 

Required

Skills & Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Test Automation. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks. 
 - Advanced experience in API testing and automation using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, Karate, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong programming/scripting experience with languages such as Java, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python. 
 - Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates. 
 - Experience with SQL and database validation techniques. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Ability to independently drive quality initiatives and influence engineering teams. 

Preferred

- Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments. 
 - Experience with containerized platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience implementing contract testing and service virtualization. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana). 
 - Experience in regulated, enterprise, or high-availability environments. 
 - ISTQB Advanced, CSTE, or equivalent certification. 

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions. 

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25, 000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. 

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone's race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. 

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering. 

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

As part of the GE India Multi-modal Manufacturing team, the Deputy Engineer- Quality inspector is responsible for establishing an efficient and continually improving DSQR process as per Spec 1182 and AS 9100 / ISO 9001 and internal GE QMS norms. Own & drive key Quality deliverables in the projects including analysis & certifying aviation hardware per internal quality inspection requirements . 

Job Description

Site Overview: 

Our Multi-modal Manufacturing Facility (MMF) in Pune plays a crucial role in manufacturing key aerospace components, supporting not only India's defence and commercial sectors but also global aviation supply chains. Our relationships with Indian suppliers, combined with our world-class local facilities and global reach, continue to shape India's aerospace ecosystem. 

Role Overview

- The position will report to the Quality Engineer / Manager. 
 - Responsible to carry out inspections in quality in DSQR for various customer GE, MRAS, collins. 
 - Work closely with manufacturing / production & Quality system teams to develop and implement AS 9100 procedures & systems & support driving end to end production quality flow downs.

The Ideal Candidate

Candidate would be responsible for Final inspection of the aerospace hardware. Aware about AS9100, FAI, NC, RCCA and QMS requirement

Required Qualification

- First Class Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
 - 5+ Years of Experience in Production quality . 
 - DPRV Certification and DSQR for at least one prime (GE Preferred)

We believe in fostering an environment where there is a diversity of perspectives, in hopes that we can all thrive. 

Job Summary

You will join a cross-functional team building our Next-Generation of digital signage tooling from a world class CMS that integrates design and event systems, through a multitude of signage presentation platforms, into high volume reporting, and analytics systems. 

We work in an agile, DevOps-oriented environment with an emphasis on quality engineering, sustainable delivery, and continuous improvement. You'll help ensure our systems are reliable, observable, secure, and capable of handling data at large scale. 

This role will help DS strengthen today's quality engineering foundation while evolving toward a more automated, telemetry-driven, and AI-enabled delivery model. We do not expect every future capability to exist on day one; we are looking for someone who can improve the current system while helping define and pilot the next generation of quality practices. 

You will collaborate with Product, UX, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver high-quality features in an agile, flow-oriented delivery environment using Jira, GitLab pipelines, and AWS SaaS architecture. 

The Person

You are a team player who cares about the customer and business outcomes. You enjoy working closely with teammates to build relationships while finding and fixing important problems. You often experiment with the latest technology and methods to logically and efficiently improve process. You prioritize prevention of risk over late detection of defects, and you are comfortable coaching teammates, improving quality practices, and helping teams build quality into the platform from the start. You are also comfortable operating in a transition state: strong in today's quality engineering practices, while curious and pragmatic about how AI, automation, and telemetry will change quality over the next several years. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate quality across signage components such as content repository, design, scheduling, integration, deployment, player performance, reporting and analytics. 
 - Troubleshoot in AWS including CloudWatch, DynamoDB, MySQL, IoT Core, S3, and CloudFront to find problem sources and contribute to resolutions. 
 - Flag testing, risk, and observability considerations early in design and planning including writing lightweight test strategy and plans. 
 - Ensure effective automation at the appropriate layers (API/service, data validation, and UI as needed). 
 - Explore and responsibly introduce AI-assisted quality practices where they create measurable improvements in speed, coverage, reliability, or insight, while preserving human judgment and appropriate review gates. 
 - Champion a whole-team quality approach. 
 - Contribute to non-functional testing (performance, scalability, resilience, security). 
 - Facilitate collaborative quality activities (exploratory testing, risk workshops, bug bashes). 
 - Help define and mature automated quality gates, regression suites, and evaluation-style checks that can support both today's delivery process and future AI-assisted development workflows. 
 - Partner with Product, UX, and Engineering to translate product intent into clear, testable acceptance criteria and risk-based test strategies. 
 - Use production telemetry, customer workflow data, observability signals, and CI/CD feedback to prioritize testing and identify quality risks earlier. 
 - Partner with Engineering and Product as we pilot AI-assisted delivery workflows, helping assess where AI can safely support test generation, defect triage, documentation, MR review, and delivery reporting. 

Technical Skills / Experience

- 7+ years in Software Testing/Quality Engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience validating complex SaaS platforms, distributed systems, APIs, data workflows, and user-facing product experiences. 
 - Experience with AWS services (e. g. , CloudWatch, DynamoDB, MySQL, IoT Core, S3, and CloudFront). 
 - Experience with GitLab (or equivalent CI/CD platform) for automated testing and delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and API/service testing. 
 - Proficient in at least one programming language (preferably in Java and TypeScript). 
 - Experience building or contributing to automated testing frameworks (API/service and data validation). 
 - Automation experience with Playwright for API and UI testing; familiarity with Selenium-based frameworks is helpful. 
 - Experience with load/performance testing. 
 - Strong grounding in agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience establishing a whole-team quality strategy and coaching teammates. 
 - Ability to build a strong understanding of customer workflows and use production telemetry to guide testing. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, CodeRabbit, GitLab Duo, or equivalent. 
 - Ability to review AI-generated tests, code, documentation, or analysis for correctness, maintainability, security, and fit to customer intent. 
 - Experience collaborating across distributed teams, using clear written context, async-friendly documentation, and structured handoffs to maintain quality across time zones. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with observability tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 
 - Familiarity with testing containerised workloads (ECS/EKS), serverless patterns, or IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform). 
 - Experience with analytics and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Looker, or Tableau*. 
 - Experience with test data generation techniques and tools, including synthetic data creation, data masking. 
 - Experience driving quality improvements at a team level. 
 - Community involvement (Meetups/Conferences, blogs, Open-Source contributions). 
 - Experience using AI/GenAI tools for synthetic test data generation, test design, log analysis, defect triage, documentation, or automation support. 

Who We Are

We are a values-driven organisation that encourages our employees to bring their authentic selves to work every day and empowers everyone to make a tangible impact on our products, clients, and culture. We offer a dynamic environment with driven, fun, and flexible individuals who thrive on challenge and responsibility. This is an opportunity to contribute to our culture and join a company that's on the move. 

We live the Poppulo values each day, as they are key to everything we do. 

- Bring Your Best Self We show up authentically, are self-aware and always strive to be better. 
 - See it. Own it. Solve it. We proactively innovate and solve for our customers and each other. We set an example with high standards for our work. We foster a culture of learning, acknowledging our successes and our failures. 
 - Together We're Better We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respecting their expertise, and focus on building trust. That's what makes us a team. 

Named a Great Place to Work in 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, we are a fast-growing global technology company, with offices in Ireland, the US, and the UK. 

Poppulo is an equal opportunity employer. 

We are committed to protecting your privacy. For details on how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

Job Description: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location: Bengaluru, India

About Us

Dymon Asia Capital ("Dymon Asia"), founded in 2008, is a leading alternative investment firm with assets across public and private markets. The firm's flagship hedge fund product is the Multi-Strategy Investment Fund (MSIF), an Asia-focused multi-manager multi-strategy fund that seeks to generate absolute consistent uncorrelated returns from emerging and developed markets. 

Headquartered in Singapore, Dymon Asia operates from nine offices across the Middle East and Asia, including Hong Kong, Tokyo, Dubai, Shanghai, Mumbai, and Kuala Lumpur. Our platform is built on our people. We bring together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experience across our multi-strategy and private markets businesses. Maintaining a collaborative culture where our people are set up to do their best work is central to how we operate. 

Our Bengaluru Quality Engineering team partners with Singapore-based trading, risk, and technology teams to support mission-critical platforms, including our multi-asset trading (DART) and execution/liquidity systems (ELS), through a legacy-to-Agile QA transformation. We are looking for an SDET to join a distributed Singapore/Bengaluru QA organization, working closely with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, DevOps, and Production Support teams across the full software development lifecycle of enterprise financial applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform comprehensive manual, API, functional, integration, regression, and automation testing for enterprise financial applications. 
 - Validate complex financial workflows across trading, risk management, portfolio management, and capital markets systems, including FIX Protocol validation. 
 - Design test strategies and manage test execution across multiple releases using Jira, Confluence, and Tricentis qTest. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and rapid delivery. 
 - Debug application issues, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve defects. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) across the testing lifecycle, including test case generation, code review, root cause analysis, defect summarization, and documentation. 
 - Identify automation opportunities and continuously improve testing efficiency and product quality. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 6-10 years of hands-on experience in software testing / test automation. 
 - Test automation expertise in Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript), including scalable framework design using POM, modular structure, reusable utilities, and reporting. 
 - Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, and Java, with solid OOP fundamentals and hands-on REST API testing and automation using Postman and/or Playwright, including auth, headers, payloads, and response schema validation. 
 - Financial domain expertise, with proven experience testing trading platforms, risk management, capital markets, or investment management workflows, including FIX Protocol / FIX Message and trading lifecycle validation. 
 - Git-based version control and CI/CD integration experience (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI). 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across distributed, cross-functional teams. 
 - Proven ability to work in Agile/Scrum environments, with a quality-and-automation-first engineering mindset and strong sense of ownership. 
 - Domain exposure to Capital Markets, Hedge Funds, Asset Management, or Investment Banking highly desirable, along with knowledge of GraphQL APIs, SQL/database testing, and AWS and/or Azure cloud-native application testing. 
 - Curiosity to explore emerging technologies, particularly AI in Quality Engineering-and exposure to reviewing automation code and establishing coding standards.

data.title: Software Development Manager, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
data.description:
Description

Role Overview

As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions. 

Strategic Ownership

Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle - from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment. 

Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower. 

Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability. 

Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making. 

Technical Domain

Your team will work on one or more of the following areas: 

Real-time observability platforms - powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones. 

AI/ML-driven forecasting - demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1, 400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs). 

Optimization engines - capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels. 

Multi-agent orchestration systems - coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML). 

Data pipelines - processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff. 

People Leadership

Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals. 

Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns. 

Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team. 

Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption. 

Customer & Operational Excellence

Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns. 

Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers - service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators. 

Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations. 

Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders. 

Deliver Results

Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption. 

Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership. 

Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences - from engineering peers to senior leadership. 

A day in the life

Strategic Vision & Roadmap

Define the strategic vision for your team within the supply chain domain - whether that's demand planning, fulfillment optimization, manufacturing observability, or capacity planning

Establish and execute a roadmap that aligns with the end-to-end supply chain lifecycle, translating business needs into engineering deliverables

Make crisp, independent decisions about project prioritization, balancing competing demands across systems like RP3, Fulfillment Planner, Build Planner, and Control Tower

Author narratives, PR/FAQs, and strategic documents to drive alignment with leadership and stakeholders

Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence

Deliver high-quality software consistently with minimal defects and system disruption across large-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily

Manage software operations effectively - ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K+ active demands

Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e. g. , stage dwell times, on-track/off-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends)

Drive continuous improvement - improve software quality and operational performance metrics under your leadership

People Management & Development

Independently manage a team of SDEs - hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals

Assess SDE performance and manage both high and low performers with effective action

Hire, develop, and promote SDEs - build a talent pipeline and export talent across the organization

Delegate appropriately - assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, and real-time observability

Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Partner effectively with customers and stakeholders - internal service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, GSMs, manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and logistics operators

Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to evolving supply chain needs

Define metrics to measure customer experience across the fulfillment pipeline - from Purchase Request through Handoff

Risk Management & Escalation

Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks

Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders - especially critical in a domain where delays in manufacturing, material shortages, or DC readiness issues can cascade across the global fleet

Ensure your team adheres to SLAs across all systems and operational commitments

Culture & Process

Build an effective development process that enables sustainable, high-quality delivery

Use mechanisms, not good intentions - establish trust-and-verify systems for operational excellence, code quality, and team health

Drive root cause analysis - instill a culture of asking "5 whys, " fixing to root cause, and adding missing metrics after incidents

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Job Title: Engineering Manager - HV Substations (EPC)

Job Location: Chennai, India

Join Us!

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations - we are Linxon!

The Engineering Manager leads the multidisciplinary engineering team assigned to one major project, or to several projects in parallel, within the High Voltage (HV) substation EPC business. The role owns technical delivery end-to-end - from design coordination through to as-built handover - while acting as the primary technical interface toward vendors, subcontractors, and internal/external stakeholders. This is a senior, hands-on leadership position requiring both deep electrical engineering credibility and strong people-management skills. 

What will you do?

Team Leadership

- Manage, coordinate, and develop the project engineering team, covering primary (substation layout, electrical calculations, studies), secondary (protection, control, automation, SCADA), BIM/3D modelling, and civil/structural engineering disciplines. 
 - Allocate engineering resources and Distribute workload across the allocated resources of the project team based on project phase, milestones, and priorities; scale the team up or down as projects move through ECI, detailed engineering, and site support phases. 
 - Set individual and team objectives, mentor engineers, and support technical skill development within the discipline groups. 
 - When responsible for multiple projects simultaneously, arbitrate priorities and resource allocation across projects in line with overall business objectives. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact for Principal Design Engineer in UK and guarantee the delivery of the design by GETS as per project plan. 
 - Attend weekly internal design review and monthly project plan review meetings. 

Engineering Delivery & Technical Ownership

- Own the overall technical quality, consistency, and interdisciplinary coordination of the engineering deliverables (single line diagrams, layouts, protection & control schemes, civil/structural drawings, 3D BIM models, technical specifications). 
 - Ensure engineering outputs comply with applicable codes, standards, client technical specifications, and internal engineering standards. 
 - Resolve interdisciplinary technical conflicts (e. g. , primary/civil layout clashes, secondary/primary interface issues) and ensure design freeze milestones are met. 
 - Review and approve Guarantee the review and the approval of the key technical documents and design packages before issue to client or procurement according to project delivery plan. 

Vendor & Supplier Interface

- Act as the senior technical point of contact toward equipment vendors and subcontractors. 
 - Support technical clarification meetings, technical bid evaluations, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and design review meetings with suppliers. 
 - Ensure vendor technical documentation (drawings, datasheets, calculations) is reviewed, commented, and approved in line with project schedule. 

Internal Coordination & Stakeholder Management

- Interface with the wider project engineering organization (project management, procurement, construction, commissioning, QA/QC) to align engineering priorities with overall project schedule and deliverables. 
 - Represent the engineering function in internal project review meetings, steering committees, and client-facing technical discussions. 
 - Communicate risks, technical constraints, and schedule impacts clearly and proactively to project leadership and internal stakeholders. 
 - Act as a credible, senior technical voice able to defend engineering positions and priorities in front of internal stakeholders and management. 

Experience, Education And Other Required

- Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor'S or Master's level). 
 - Minimum 18+ years of experience required, with a solid background in the HV EPC substation business (design, engineering, and/or execution of AIS/GIS substations, HV equipment, protection & control systems). 
 - Proven experience managing or leading a multidisciplinary engineering team (primary, secondary, civil, and/or BIM disciplines). 
 - Track record of managing engineering scope on EPC substation projects, ideally with exposure to both single-project and multi-project engineering management. 
 - Direct experience interfacing with equipment vendors and subcontractors on technical matters (technical clarifications, bid evaluation, design reviews, FAT). 
 - Experience working within a structured project engineering environment, coordinating with project management, procurement, and construction functions. 
 - Strong technical grounding across HV substation engineering disciplines, sufficient to arbitrate between primary, secondary, civil, and BIM inputs. 
 - Solid understanding of project engineering processes: design freeze, document control, interdisciplinary coordination, schedule-driven deliverables. 
 - Strong leadership and people-management skills, with the ability to organize, motivate, and hold a technical team accountable. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable presenting and defending positions to senior internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Strong personality and presence, with the seniority and confidence to front demanding internal stakeholders and represent engineering interests at project level. 
 - Fluent in English (additional languages an advantage depending on project geography). 

What We Offer

In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits, 

- 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year 
 - Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression 
 - When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too. 

About Linxon

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity. 

We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations - we are Linxon. 

Linxon's vision is to deliver the best market offering for turnkey substation projects through world-class power technologies and delivering the highest level of competence in managing infrastructure projects. 

As a leading engineering company, we help our customers with turnkey substation solutions in the field of power transmission, renewable energy, and transportation. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a new company as it evolves and help shape it for the future. If you like new challenges, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and are interested in working with other motivated professionals with expertise in the Substations EPC business, then this is the new opportunity for you. 

To know more about the Linxon please click on the link below. 

Building the infrastructure to power the world - we are Linxon! - YouTube

data.description:
Job Description

Remarkable people, trusted by clients to design and advance the world. 

Wood India Consulting division is currently recruiting for a Lead flow assurance engineer for our Chennai office. This is a management role, providing technical leadership to our 25-member flow assurance team, collaborating to win new business, and leading project execution. 

Due to the nature of the role, it must be based in our Chennai office on a full-time basis. 

The Role

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced technical professional within Flow Assurance to utilise their knowledge and experience to develop the technical capability of the Flow assurance team in our engineering centre in Chennai. 

The successful candidate will train and mentor the team, and lead projects on the assessment of fluid flow within oil and gas production systems, ensuring reliable and uninterrupted transport from the reservoir to processing facilities. Additionally, the principal engineer will contribute to best practices and plays a key role in technical decision making and innovation. 

The ideal candidate will have significant proven working knowledge and expertise in flow assurance projects across the Energy sector within a global fast-paced consulting environment and be passionate about developing people. 

Our Clients and Projects

Designing the future. Transforming the world. 

Our Production Optimisation team are part of our Digital consulting business unit. We support our clients to secure economic recovery from existing infrastructure, optimising assets and enabling extension of productive field life whilst accelerating the move towards net Zero. The work we do predominately enables Energy security whilst we transition. However, we are also growing our services across Carbon Capture Utilisation and storage and transportation of Hydrogen and Ammonia. 

With Wood's ambitious growth within energy transition related business, you will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to our global pool of knowledge experts in a range of topics, including traditional oil and gas, CO 2 and H 2 transport. 

Wood is an inclusive and diverse global community of inquisitive minds and recognised industry innovators, partnering to create new possibilities.

data.title: Team Lead, Field Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions. 

You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward-deployed delivery model with hands-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high-performing engineering team. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i. e. 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST. (hybrid role)

What You'll Do

- Serve as a player-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
 - Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 - Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross-functional partners
 - Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
 - Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 - Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 - Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 - Write and review production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 - Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 - Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
 - Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
 - Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

Who You Are

- Experience: Minimum 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
 - Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
 - Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
 - Pipelines & Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
 - Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
 - Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
 - Leadership: A solutions-driven, player-coach mindset - able to balance hands-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people-management skills
 - Communication: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to conduct technical presentations and translate complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
 - Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager, Search
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e. g. , C, C++, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript). 
 - 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. 
 - 3 years of experience in a people management and 2 years of experience in a technical leadership role. 
 - Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields. 
 - 5 years of experience working in a complex organization. 
 - Experience leading through technical and organizational complexity. 
 - Experience with Java, C++, or both. 
 - Passion for technology, collaboration, and solving challenging problems. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information - any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds.

data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Team

The Semantic Layer team owns the systems that turn dbt models into trusted, reusable business metrics. At the heart of this is MetricFlow - the open-source semantic engine that powers the dbt Semantic Layer. MetricFlow lets data teams define metrics once in code and consume them consistently across BI tools, notebooks, AI agents, and downstream applications. 

This team is the steward of MetricFlow as an open-source project: shipping releases, reviewing community contributions, evolving the query compiler, and ensuring it integrates cleanly with the broader dbt ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of language design, query compilation, and distributed data execution - solving problems that directly shape how thousands of organizations measure their business. 

About The Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Semantic Layer team in Bangalore. You'll be a core contributor to MetricFlow - designing features, optimizing query generation, hardening the open-source codebase, and partnering with the community of contributors and adopters around it. This is a high-ownership role: you'll write production code, drive technical decisions, and help shape the long-term architecture of one of the most important projects in the modern data stack. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain core features of MetricFlow, including metric definitions, query compilation, dimensional modeling, and SQL generation across multiple data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and others). 
 - Own MetricFlow as an open-source project - triage issues, review external pull requests, manage releases, and engage the community on GitHub and in Slack. 
 - Collaborate with engineers across dbt Cloud, dbt Core, and the Semantic Layer service to ensure MetricFlow integrates seamlessly with the rest of the dbt ecosystem. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, and observability of metric query execution at scale. 
 - Partner with product, design, and developer-relations teammates to translate customer and community feedback into shipped improvements. 
 - Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, and design docs that raise the bar for how the team thinks and ships. 
 - Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance. 

Skills We're Looking For

- Strong professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of shipping production systems. 
 - Deep proficiency in Python, including modern typing, testing practices, and packaging. 
 - Strong SQL fundamentals and a working understanding of how analytical query engines and data warehouses execute queries. 
 - Experience designing systems that involve parsing, compilation, or transformation - for example: query planners, DSL compilers, type systems, or rule-based engines. 
 - Solid grasp of software design principles: clean APIs, modularity, testability, and backwards compatibility. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, PMs, and external community members. 
 - Experience collaborating in a distributed, asynchronous team environment. 

Bonus Skills (Optional)

- Prior experience contributing to or maintaining a popular open-source project. 
 - Familiarity with dbt, MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or other semantic-layer technologies. 
 - Background in data warehousing internals, query optimization, or analytical SQL dialects. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and release engineering for Python libraries. 
 - Exposure to building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or CLIs. 

Why Join Us

- Impact at scale: Your code will run inside the data platforms of tens of thousands of companies, including some of the world's largest enterprises. 
 - Open-source ownership: You'll be a public, named maintainer of a foundational project - your work is visible, reviewed, and used by the global data community. 
 - A team that values craft: We invest in design docs, code review, and durable engineering. We ship fast, but we don't ship sloppy. 
 - Competitive compensation: Market-leading salary, equity, comprehensive health insurance, generous time off, learning & wellness stipends, and home-office support. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*
 - Professional development and training opportunities
 - Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
 - Monthly cell phone stipend
 - Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 

We're honored to be valued at over $5. 6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. 

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. 

To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. 

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. About The Role

You will work on platform-level feature development, data integrations, and end-to-end observability - building the cloud platform and frameworks that AI product teams across Cornerstone depend on every day. You will write real code in Java, Python, and Node. js, ship production infrastructure on AWS (EKS/ECS), and own the developer experience for the systems you build. 

This is a builder role on a small, high-trust platform team. You will ship production code and infrastructure, debug production issues with rigor, and be the kind of teammate others reach out to first. 

In this role you will. . . 

- Drive platform-level feature development for Workforce AI - design and ship shared services, frameworks, and SDKs that AI product teams build on top of.

 - Stand up, scale, and harden containerized workloads on Amazon EKS and ECS, including networking, autoscaling, secrets, and zero-downtime deploys.

 - Design and tune persistence layers on native databases (RDS / Aurora, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) - schema design, indexing, query and cost optimization. 
 - Write production code in Java, Python, and Node. js - clean, tested, well-documented modules that other engineers can build on. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code in CloudFormation, Terraform, and Helm charts - repeatable, peer-reviewed, environment-parameterized. 
 - Partner with security, SRE, and Workforce AI product teams to set platform standards, document runbooks, and continuously improve developer experience. 
 - Triage and resolve incidents with rigor - reproduce, isolate, fix, and write blameless postmortems to prevent recurrence. 

You've got what it takes if you have. . . 

- 3-5 years of relevant software / platform / infrastructure engineering experience.

 - Proficiency in at least two of: Java, Python, Node. js - comfortable contributing real code, not just glue scripts.

 - Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code - CloudFormation, Terraform, and Helm charts in a production repo. 
 - Operational experience with ELK and/or Splunk - building dashboards, writing alert rules, debugging from logs. 
 - Solid grasp of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL/Aurora, DynamoDB) - schema, indexes, query plans.

 - Excellent problem-solving and communication - clear writing, calm under incident, generous with help to teammates. 

Nice to have

 - Experience operating Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar streaming/messaging systems. 
 - Service-mesh (Istio/Linkerd), API gateway, or platform-engineering exposure (Backstage, internal developer platforms).

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now - is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone - anywhere - to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

About Company
At Finantic AI India, we sit at the intersection of finance and technology, helping US Commercial real estate companies run their finance and accounting smarter. We work on real-world areas you study - lease accounting, asset and portfolio reporting, record-to-report, order-to-cash, and procure-to-pay and use AI automation tools to make these processes faster, more accurate, and fully audit-ready. 

Based in Chennai and serving US clients, we offer commerce graduates with good analytical mindset, a launchpad to apply core accounting concepts, build strong MSExcel and ERP skills, learn how AI is transforming finance operations, and grow into future-ready finance professionals in a high-learning startup environment. 

The US Commercial real estate market is entering a renewed growth phase, with major firms projecting steady recovery in leasing and investment activity across sectors like industrial, multifamily, data centers, and high-quality office assets. This growth is driving intense focus on robust finance and accounting operations. 

US CFOs are tightening month-end close, lender reporting, lease accounting, and portfolio-level consolidation, and increasingly rely on specialized offshore teams to handle this work at scale. For commerce graduates, this creates a strong learning runway: you get hands-on exposure to real estate leases, property-level P&L, cash-flow and refinancing metrics, consolidations across large portfolios, and the use of AI in F&A, building a profile that is both technically strong and globally relevant in a high-demand niche market

About Job

What you will own

- Architect and build scalable, high-performance front-end applications from the ground up for an AI-native finance and accounting automation platform
 - Design a reusable component library and design system (atomic/composable components, theming, design tokens) that keeps the product consistent as it scales
 - Build data-dense, intuitive interfaces for complex CRE finance workflows (invoice review, payment matching, reconciliation, lease management dashboards)
 - Integrate front-end applications with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, handling authentication, caching, pagination, error states, and real-time updates (WebSockets/SSE)
 - Define front-end architecture: state management, data-fetching patterns, routing, code-splitting, and module boundaries for a growing multi-tenant B2B SaaS product
 - Build interfaces for AI-driven workflows: human-in-the-loop review screens, confidence indicators, exception queues, and streaming LLM responses
 - Own front-end performance, accessibility (WCAG), security, and cross-browser quality, with strong testing practices (unit, integration, E2E)
 - Collaborate with backend and AI engineers on API contracts, and contribute to backend/BFF endpoints where it speeds up delivery
 - Set engineering standards for the front-end codebase: code reviews, CI/CD, linting, documentation, and mentoring other engineers

What makes you a great fit

- 5+ years of front-end engineering experience building production web applications at scale
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from any university, or equivalent practical experience
 - Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with deep experience in React (Next. js) or a comparable modern framework
 - Strong grasp of front-end engineering principles: component-driven architecture, separation of concerns, rendering performance, accessibility, and maintainable code
 - Proven experience designing reusable, composable component systems and design systems (Storybook, Tailwind, CSS-in-JS, or similar)
 - Hands-on experience with state management and data-fetching libraries (Redux, Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query, Apollo, or similar)
 - Strong API integration skills: consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs, managing async data flows, error handling, auth (OAuth/JWT), and real-time data
 - Experience building scalable front-end architectures: monorepos, micro-frontends or modular codebases, build tooling (Vite/Webpack), and CI/CD pipelines
 - Solid testing discipline with Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress
 - Self-motivated and autonomous - high ownership, product thinking, strong eye for UX, clear communicator
 - Fast learner with startup DNA - thrive in ambiguity, move fast, iterate based on feedback
 - Good to have exposure to writing APIs and backend services (Node. js, Python, or Go) or building BFF layers
 - Good to have experience building interfaces for AI/LLM products, data-heavy dashboards, or financial/B2B SaaS platforms

data.description:
Description

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon's Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Picture working on technologies, where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process. Envision being able to leverage the resources of a Fortune-500 company within the atmosphere of a start-up. 

AWS OpenSearch team is looking for Software Development Engineers for its Bangalore team who can help build search technologies for customers of all sizes. If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you. 

You are highly-motivated and thrive in an environment where problems are open-ended. You enjoy engaging in passionate discussions with smart people and letting the best ideas rise to the top. You see your mistakes as learning opportunities and continually look for ways to improve yourself, your team and your products. You understand that not all solutions come easily and don't shy away from hard work to reach your goals. 

We are looking for smart, motivated Software Development Engineers who can help take the service to new heights. If you have the skills to building large-scale and high-performance services, this is the job for you. 

As An Amazon OpenSearch Service Engineer, You Will

- Design, develop, and support a world-class OpenSearch Service that manages thousands of search domains. 
 - Focus on scalability, performance, service robustness, and cost trade-offs. (Especially as they pertain to a highly-virtualized, elastic, cloud-based environment)
 - Apply scientific analysis and mathematical modeling techniques to predict, measure, and evaluate the consequences of designs and the ongoing success of our platform
 - Continuously drive to explore, improve, enhance, automate, and optimize distributed systems and tools to best meet evolving business and market needs
 - Work alongside a dedicated operations team to develop and support the smooth 24x7 operation of our worldwide service
 - Participate in setting a vision and objectives for Amazon OpenSearch Service in alignment with business and market needs
 - Invent the future of search instead of just being a bystander
 - Mentor other SDEs and advise the leadership team on the technical vision. 

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. data.description:
Job Description

1 BASIC FUNCTION

Is the 'Voice of the Guest' within the hotel. Cooperates closely with the hotels' management board and works

cross-departmentally with all departments to improve reputation performance and guest satisfaction. 

Is the 'Brand Ambassador' within the hotels. Has a perfect understanding and clear vision of the brands'

promise to the guests and, monitors, plans and ensures brand compliance in hotel operations. 

Is the 'Sustainability Leader' within the hotels. Cooperates closely with the hotels' management board and

works cross-departmentally with all departments to meet both the hotels' and the company's environmental and sustainability targets. 

2 SCOPE

Is responsible for implementing and driving the Guest Experience, Brand Compliance, Sustainability programs

throughout the hotels with the support of the management board. Coordinates and manages the programs in terms of the continuous improvement process. 

3 RESPONSIBILITY

Reputation Performance Management: Ensures the reputation management of the hotel is fully functional

on all levels including analyzing of RPS results, monitoring competitors and operational efficiency, initiating operational improvement efforts and tracking results. Is responsible for achieving or exceeding the hotel's RPS score. 

Brand Compliance: Ensures all brand markers and programs are implement throughout the hotel, audits

compliance monthly and drives improvement plans with the relevant departments. Prepares departments for LQA. 

Sustainability: Ensures the action plans for both environmental and sustainability programs are in place and followed by supporting Departments. Is responsible for achieving eco-certification and other related targets. 

Coordinates that all actions & targets are clearly and regularly communicated to the guests and on Social Media to create awareness. 

4 CLUSTER SUSTAINABILITY MANAGER - WORK PERFORMED: 

4. 1 REPUTATION PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

- Chairs a monthly Quality meeting, reviewing RPS scores and sentiments, following-up actions plans and submits a monthly VOG report before the 5th of each new month. 
 - Identifies sentiments with a consistent downward trend and / or score below 80% and drives improvement plans in cooperation with the relevant HOD. Actively drives improvement. 
 - Manages the process of setting and amending Local Standard Operating Procedures when required. 

4. 2 BRAND COMPLIANCE

- Conducts a minimum of one Brand Compliance Audit per area / per month and more if required. 

Sets corrective plans, target dates and assigns responsibilities. 

- Chairs brand meetings as needed to ensure team communication and results. 
 - Manages the preparation, coordination, debriefing, and follow-up of all LQA audits. 
 - To actively monitor spelling and brand compliance for all inhouse guest communications, printed and digital. 
 - Is actively involved in the Product Modernity replacement cycle management, the design stage of refurbishments in terms of brand compliance. 

4. 3 SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM

- Manages the preparation, coordination, debriefing, and follow-up of annual eco-certification audits with the highest possible certification. 
 - Analyzes all CSR data versus targets, identifies improvement areas, defines actions in cooperation with the area leader(s) and sets target dates and responsibilities for continuous improvement. 
 - Coordinates clear internal & external communications on targets, achievements, activities, and projects to all stakeholders.
