Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We're a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other. 

About The Role

As a Quality Engineering Manager, you will own the quality strategy for a significant product domain while leading a talented team of Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams. Through your partnership with other Quality Engineering (QE) leaders, you'll help shape and evolve our quality tooling and practices and continue to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility. 

Our teams support quality efforts across multiple product domains, invest heavily in automation, and embrace AI-assisted development. This role requires technical judgement, strong people leadership, and the ability to build trust across teams. 

Success in this role is measured by the quality of the software your team helps deliver, the growth of the quality engineers you lead, and your ability to influence how quality is built into the software development lifecycle. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6-10 Quality Engineers supporting multiple engineering teams and product initiatives. 
 - Own the quality strategy for a product domain by partnering closely with other leaders, tech leads, and product managers to improve software quality, delivery predictability, and customer outcomes. 
 - Provides technical and architectural leadership in test automation, frameworks, CI/CD, and testing standards. 
 - Partner with QE leadership to define and evolve scalable quality practices and AI-assisted testing solutions, translate those into clear team priorities and goals, and drive consistent adoption to improve quality outcomes
 - Balance competing priorities across multiple engineering teams, helping stakeholders understand tradeoffs while ensuring the highest-value work receives appropriate quality investment. 
 - Coach and mentor through clear, actionable feedback -- developing technical and leadership capabilities, clarifying promotion expectations, and supporting career growth. 
 - Lead teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while maintaining focus, engagement, and delivery excellence. 
 - Influence engineering teams to build quality earlier in the software development lifecycle through collaboration, data, and thoughtful decision-making. 

About You

You believe quality engineering is much more than finding defects - it's a shared engineering responsibility woven into how software gets built. You also lead by helping others do their best work, and you measure your own success by theirs. 

You Will Be Successful In This Role If You

- Build trust quickly with your team and other leaders and teams in the organization. 
 - Lead with curiosity, active listening, empathy, and thoughtful communication. 
 - Make informed decisions in an environment where priorities can change or information is incomplete. 
 - Balance customer needs, quality, delivery timelines, and business priorities when making tradeoffs
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where individuals feel empowered to learn, experiment, and continuously improve. 
 - Believe your success is a reflection of the success, engagement, and growth of your team. 

Experience We Think You'll Need

- Demonstrated success managing and developing a high-performing Quality Engineering team. 
 - Experience with or working knowledge of AI-assisted software development; including AI assisted test generation, model evaluation, and skills/playbooks. 
 - Experience developing and scaling quality processes that drive greater efficiency and support organizational growth. 
 - Experience leading and working with distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
 - Understanding of fundamental quality engineering strategies and practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence decisions on teams without direct authority. 
 -

Why Quickbase?

At Quickbase, Quality Engineering is a strategic partner in how software is built and this role carries real scope: you'll help shape and evolve our quality strategy not just execute someone else's plan. 

Quality Engineering is also at an inflection point. We're actively building what AI-assisted quality engineering looks like in practice, and this role has direct influence over how that evolves - not adopting a playbook someone else already wrote. 

You'll do this alongside the rest of the QE leadership team -- sharing practices, tackling problems together, and growing together. You won't be leading in isolation. 

If you want a role where your decisions shape how quality is built across a growing organization, and you want to help define what quality engineering looks like in an AI-driven future, we'd love to talk. 

Important Notices

Recorded Interviews. Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription. 

Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Quickbase - we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles. 

How We Review Applications We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person. 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply - even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 

Benefits

- Modern Health
 - Group Medical Insurance
 - Night Shift Allowance
 - Hybrid Work Allowance
 - Mobile and Internet Allowance
 - Meal Benefit
 - Office Transportation
 - On-Call Weekend Allowance
 - Weekend Working Allowance
 - Employee Referral Bonus

That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. 

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. 

What You'll Be Doing: 

Job Summary

This role designs, architects and improves all Microsoft 365 technologies, Intune Suite, Purview, Copilot and integrations with adjacent technologies. The lead seeks to improve digital employee experience, across all digital touch points and proactively addresses security gaps. The engineer also collaborates with technology vendors, product managers, IT security and legal or compliance teams to ensure alignment with company policy and applicable legislation. 

This role also leads the development and governance of agentic AI solutions-building autonomous agents and AI-driven automation that eliminate manual, repeatable work across the digital workplace-and sets the engineering standards other engineers follow when building with AI. 

Essential Functions

- Implement, monitor and operate digital workplace technologies (endpoint hardware, software, services and SaaS tools)
 - Integrate digital workplace technologies with adjacent technologies (identity, security, vulnerability management, IT service and asset management, remote access, backup, directory services, etc. )

 - Work on various digital workplace technology projects
 - Create, publish and communicate knowledgebase articles
 - Monitor technology trends and seek ways to enhance continuous improvement initiatives

 - Act as mentor for the IT support and operations teams, forming a tight partnership for mutual success. Ensure information is flowing freely to minimize siloed operations and engineering
 - Build and deploy agentic AI solutions that autonomously execute multi-step digital workplace workflows

 - Define engineering standards, guardrails and governance for the secure, responsible design and deployment of AI agents, including least-privilege permissions, human-in-the-loop controls, evaluation and observability

Required Qualifications

 - Digital workplace tool management expertise: tools, techniques, monitoring and integration
 - Experience with configuration management, identity and access management, active directory, desktop virtualization, collaboration platforms and other cloud-based services

 - Experience with continuous engineering or other agile methods to keep pace with frequent changes and to reduce complexity
 - Ability to write technical documentation
 - Demonstrated coding/scripting ability (Python, PowerShell, C#, or similar) with a track record of building and maintaining automation, integrations or tools in a production environment
 - Hands-on experience building or deploying agentic AI solutions

 - Understanding of responsible AI, security and governance practices for autonomous systems, including least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop review and monitoring/evaluation of agent outputs

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Education

Preferred Certifications

General Performance Criteria

As the Lead Digital Workplace Engineer, you will be required to fulfill your responsibilities while meeting the following general performance criteria for this position at this level: 

Expertise: You have very deep knowledge of the skills necessary to perform your role, and the structure of the technology for which you are responsible. 

Communication: You guide others through problem solving whether it is a technical issue, project impediment, or conflict.

Process: You question the status quo in a constructive manner to find areas for the team to improve. 

Influence: You regularly make an impact to your entire team.

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business. 

Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent. com for further assistance.

data.title: Senior Manager WOP
data.description:
Who are Inchcape

At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3, 000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. 

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. 

Main Purpose of Job : 

- Lead the World of Ports (WOP) marine data and operational delivery function, acting as the senior maritime subject-matter expert between global Inchcape teams, product, technology and customers. 
 - Own delivery against KPIs for collection, verification, validation and publication of port, terminal, berth, vessel and marine-operational datasets and APIs, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and operational relevance. 
 - Translate practical seagoing and port-operational expertise into product requirements, customer use cases and continuous improvements that support safe, efficient and commercially sound maritime decision-making. 

Key Accountabilities : 

- Lead, coach and develop the WOP marine/data operations team, setting clear standards for performance, quality and professional growth. 
 - Act as the senior marine subject-matter expert for port, terminal, berth, vessel and cargo operations across WOP products and services. 
 - Own marine-data governance, validation standards and quality controls to ensure data is operationally credible, consistent and fit for customer use. 
 - Engage directly with shipowners, operators, charterers, terminals, ports and other customers to understand operational needs and convert feedback into actionable requirements. 
 - Build strong working relationships across the Inchcape global network to improve source coverage, verification discipline and timeliness of marine information. 
 - Partner with Product, Technology and Data teams to define specifications, acceptance criteria and priorities for maritime data and digital solutions. 
 - Provide marine-operational oversight for new datasets, APIs and product features, ensuring outputs reflect real-world shipping and port workflows. 
 - Use data and domain insight to identify gaps, trends and opportunities, providing clear recommendations that support the WOP product roadmap. 
 - Manage multiple workstreams and improvement initiatives, balancing operational delivery, customer priorities, risk and strategic objectives. 
 - Establish and maintain SOPs, controls, documentation and audit trails that strengthen operational resilience and data quality. 
 - Represent WOP in customer and stakeholder forums, communicate progress to senior management, and support sprint/release readiness from a marine-business perspective. 

Key Deliverables

- Demonstrable senior-level maritime experience with strong practical knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo operations and port agency workflows. 
 - Strong marine assurance and operational risk mindset, with the ability to assess the reliability and operational relevance of maritime information. 
 - Consistently high data quality, verification and service performance against agreed KPIs and customer expectations. 
 - Successful conversion of marine-domain knowledge and customer feedback into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Effective leadership of a geographically dispersed team, with measurable improvements in capability, accountability, quality and productivity. 
 - Trusted engagement with senior internal stakeholders and external maritime customers, supported by clear, credible and concise communication. 
 - Successful delivery of marine-data, API and digital initiatives in partnership with Product, Technology and Data teams. 
 - Well-governed processes, SOPs and controls that support traceability, continuous improvement and operational resilience. 
 - Proactive identification of data gaps, customer pain points and maritime-market opportunities that inform the WOP roadmap and priorities. 

Skills and Experience required : 

- Marine Operations Expertise: In-depth knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo handling, port agency processes and ship/shore interfaces. 
 - Seagoing / Marine Background: Senior officer-level seagoing or equivalent shore-based marine operations experience, with strong practical understanding of shipboard and port operations. 
 - Marine Assurance & Risk: Sound knowledge of marine assurance, operational risk, HSSE principles and safe operating practices relevant to vessels and terminals. 
 - Data Governance: Ability to define verification rules, quality controls and governance standards for critical maritime operational data. 
 - Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Credible communication with shipowners, operators, charterers, ports, terminals, agents and senior internal stakeholders. 
 - Product & Business Translation: Ability to convert marine workflows, operational pain points and customer needs into product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Digital Maritime Transformation: Strong understanding of maritime digitalisation, data platforms, APIs, vessel/port intelligence and technology-enabled operational decision support. 
 - Team Leadership: Proven ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams while setting clear performance standards. 
 - Project & Delivery Management: Ability to manage concurrent workstreams, priorities, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Commercial Awareness: Understanding of how reliable port and vessel intelligence supports voyage planning, chartering, operations, demurrage, risk and customer value. 
 - Analytical Capability: Ability to interpret complex maritime datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate practical insights to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Change & Continuous Improvement: Ability to improve processes, introduce new standards and guide teams through operational and technology change. 
 - Communication & Reporting: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including senior-management reporting and customer-facing presentations. 
 - Problem Solving & Judgement: Sound operational judgement with a structured approach to resolving data, process, customer and delivery issues. 

Experience : 

- Maritime Experience: Typically 10+ years in shipping, marine operations, ports, terminals, vessel operations or closely related maritime roles. 
 - Senior Marine Responsibility: Experience at senior officer level at sea (preferably Master Mariner / Chief Engineer / Chief Officer / Second Engineer) or equivalent senior shore-based marine responsibility. 
 - Port & Terminal Operations: Hands-on exposure to port calls, berth/terminal operations, cargo operations, marine services and ship/shore coordination. 
 - Marine Assurance: Experience applying marine assurance, HSSE, operational risk or compliance principles in vessel, port or terminal environments. 
 - Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading teams, setting standards, managing performance and developing capability. 
 - Maritime Data / Digital Solutions: Experience using or delivering maritime data, port intelligence, vessel-tracking, API, analytics or other digital shipping solutions. 
 - Customer Relations: Experience engaging maritime customers and stakeholders, gathering requirements and resolving operational or service issues. 
 - Product / Project Delivery: Experience contributing to or leading product, data or technology initiatives from requirement definition through implementation. 
 - Data Quality & Governance: Experience establishing validation processes, quality controls, SOPs and traceable governance for operational information. 
 - Cross-functional Working: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across marine operations, commercial, product, technology and data teams. 
 - Global / Distributed Operations: Experience working across different geographies, cultures and time zones in a global maritime environment. 
 - Change Management: Track record of implementing process or technology change while maintaining operational delivery. 
 - Executive Communication: Experience providing concise progress, risk and recommendation updates to senior management and external stakeholders. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated record of improving operational quality, efficiency, customer outcomes or data reliability

Education and Professional Qualification : 

Essential: Recognised marine qualification and substantial maritime operating experience. 

Preferred: Master Mariner (STCW II/2), Chief Engineer (STCW III/2), or equivalent senior deck/engine certification. Alternatively, a degree in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies or Marine Operations supported by significant vessel, port or terminal experience. A relevant management, project-management or digital/data qualification is advantageous. 

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. 

Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: 

Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture. 

The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships. 

Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry. 

In return, we will offer you: 

A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive: 

- A retirement savings plan
 - Holiday
 - Competitive salary
 - Employee Assistance Programme
 - Career development and progression opportunities
 - Values Award celebration events

Plus, much more!

If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!

#ISSthebiggerpicture

Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location. 

Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

data.title: Quality Manager (QA)
data.description:
QA-Manager Criteria

B Tech (Chemical, Food, Cosmetics) with minimum 3 to 7 years of experience as QA head in cosmetics/ FMCG industry

- Quality System Oversight
 - Develop, implement, and maintain GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and ISO standards for cosmetics production. 
 - Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EU Cosmetics Regulation, BIS in India, etc. ). 
 - Raw Material & Supplier Quality Control
 - Establish and monitor quality standards for incoming raw materials, packaging, and ingredients. 
 - Conduct supplier audits and approve vendors based on quality performance. 
 - Production Process Monitoring
 - Supervise in-process quality checks during mixing, filling, and packaging stages. 
 - Identify deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Finished Product Testing & Release
 - Oversee microbiological, stability, and performance testing of finished products. 
 - Approve batch release only after meeting defined quality specifications. 
 - Documentation & Reporting
 - Maintain accurate records of quality inspections, audits, and test results. 
 - Prepare monthly quality reports and present findings to senior management. 
 - Training & Team Development
 - Train production and QA staff on hygiene, safety, and quality protocols. 
 - Build a culture of continuous improvement and quality awareness across departments. 
 - Customer Complaint & Recall Management
 - Investigate product complaints and implement root cause analysis. 
 - Lead recall procedures if necessary, ensuring consumer safety and regulatory compliance. 

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India's premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1, 000+ brands, 60, 000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences. 

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6, 000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses-FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae-offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials. 

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach. 

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India's 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures. 

With a 3, 000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India's booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

data.title: Staff Embedded SW/FW Engineer (Bringup) - Bengaluru
data.description:
Staff Embedded SW/FW Engineer (Bringup)

Graphcore is a globally recognised leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialised processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. We are opening a new AI Engineering Campus in Bengaluru which will play a central role in Graphcore's work building the future of AI computing. 

Job Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, cross-functional development team developing C code used to validate cutting-edge, high-performance AI chips and platforms. You will play a critical role in supporting new product introductions and post-silicon validation. 

Working within the Post-Silicon Bringup team, you will be involved with bringing first silicon to life, developing code primarily in C to configure and exercise systems and sub-systems on new silicon devices, and working closely with many other teams to help it become a fully characterised and working product, reporting project status/progress to program management on a regular basis. You will have the opportunity to, and be responsible for, leading, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to other engineering team members. In this role, you can leverage your experience and industry knowledge to architect and drive implementation of continuous improvements to test infrastructure and processes. 

The Team

The Post-Silicon Bringup team sits within the Architecture and Validation team, we are responsible for bringup and validation of new silicon when it returns from manufacture, enabling and supporting the production SW and FW teams to bring up their software and supporting the Silicon Characterisation team. 

Responsibilities And Duties

- Plan, design, develop and debug silicon bringup sequences and test in bare metal C/C++ on FPGA/Emulator prior to first silicon
 - Deploy configuration sequences and validation tests on first silicon and debug them
 - Develop automated test framework and regression test suites in Python to optimize validation efficiency
 - Collaborate closely with engineers from many other disciplines on a variety of topics
 - Work with Validation and Production Test engineering peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to test methodologies
 - Analyse test results, identify and debug failures/defects
 - Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure
 - Provide feedback to architects

Candidate Profile

Essential

- Strong experience in Bare metal / embedded C/C++
 - Good knowledge of digital ASICs. 
 - Be highly motivated, a self starter, and a team player 
 - Ability to work across teams and programming languages to find root causes of deep and complex issues
 - Experience of the post-silicon validation process applied in digital ASIC environments
 - Python, Linux
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with others to solve problems. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical & diagnostic skills

Desirable

- Driver level experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: 
 - PCIe
 - Ethernet
 - Memory technologies (LPDDR, DDR, HBM, . . . )
 - Other peripherals such as I2C, I3C, SPI, . . . 
 - Good knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks such as PLLs, high speed PHYs and IC control/communication protocols is highly desirable. 
 - Experience of Arm CPUs, System IP and debug tools. 
 - Experience of AMBA protocols. 
 - Understanding of ML applications and their workloads. 
 - Experience in Characterization, Failure Analysis, Test Development, Statistical analysis, and Customer Support

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers a competitive benefits package. We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. About The Role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join the Platform Ops team (Platform Engineering) and lead initiatives that enable developer productivity by building and improving developer tooling and environments, and by improving other productivity tools around observability. Our team builds the shared systems and workflows engineers rely on every day-internal developer environments and self-serve tooling that makes the recommended way to ship changes the easiest way. 

This is a platform tooling role with a focus is on reusable capabilities and self-service workflows adopted across teams. You'll also help develop AI-based workflows for productivity and efficiency, including automation that improves infrastructure operations (for example, faster triage, automated runbook steps, and better self-service for common issues). You'll prioritize the highest-impact problems by looking at where time is being lost today (slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, repetitive operational work) and turning that into concrete projects. You'll set clear success metrics up front and use them to guide design decisions and rollouts. Expect to partner closely with engineering teams to drive adoption, document changes, and iterate based on feedback. You'll drive cross-team work across internal tooling, developer environments, observability, and reliability, focusing on measurable improvements (for example: shorter lead time, fewer incidents, and faster recovery). You'll add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP). 

As a staff engineer on the team, you'll lead medium-to-large initiatives end-to-end: define the problem with stakeholders, write a design and rollout plan, build and operate the solution in Python/Go, and measure results. You'll work across Platform Engineering, Release Engineering, Security, and product engineering teams to make improvements that are adopted broadly and remain reliable over time. 

What You'll Do

- Lead end-to-end projects that improve developer tooling, environments, and operational workflows (speed, reliability, and safety)
 - Design and operate internal tooling/services in Python and/or Go
 - Build tooling for our internal developer platform (self-service workflows, shared patterns, developer-facing interfaces)
 - Add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP)
 - Develop AI-based workflows that improve developer experience and reduce repetitive manual work, including efficiency gains in infrastructure operations
 - Improve developer feedback loops through better observability (metrics/logs/traces), making failures easier to diagnose
 - Design/build and document "paved paths" and self-service capabilities so teams can ship without extensive platform expertise
 - Improve reliability through automation and observability (metrics/logs/traces), and drive incident follow-ups to reduce recurrence
 - Set technical direction (design docs, tradeoffs, sequencing) and drive delivery across stakeholders
 - Mentor engineers through design and code reviews

Skills We're Looking For: 

- Strong experience building and operating production services in Python and/or Go
 - Experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core primitives (IAM, networking, compute)

 - Track record leading ambiguous, cross-team technical projects to completion
 - Strong communication and engineering judgment

You'll have an edge if you have: 

- Kubernetes/platform abstractions experience
 - Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including reusable modules, safe state practices, and modernization of shared platform foundations

Perks And Benefits

data.title: Complaint Analyst
data.description:
Overview

The Complaint Analyst is responsible for the evaluation, investigation, documentation, and regulatory assessment of product complaints associated with medical devices. This role supports compliance with applicable global regulations and quality system requirements through complaint investigations, adverse event reportability assessments, complaint trending, risk escalation, and cross-functional collaboration to identify and mitigate patient safety and product quality risks. 

Responsibilities

- Independently conduct and document complaint investigations of moderate to high complexity by evaluating product performance concerns, gathering information from customers, users, field representatives, and internal stakeholders, reviewing service records and product analysis findings, and exercising sound judgment to determine complaint conclusions and appropriate escalation activities. 
 - Coordinate and review product analysis, service evaluations, engineering assessments, and event coding activities to support complaint investigations, facilitate product performance monitoring, and ensure consistent event categorization. 
 - Ensure complaint records are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable procedures, regulatory requirements, and record retention requirements. 
 - Assess complaint events for regulatory reportability using established decision models and investigation findings, and support the preparation, review, and documentation of MDR, Vigilance, and other applicable adverse event reports. 
 - Review service records, service reports, and other post-market information to assess whether events meet complaint criteria and verify appropriate complaint classification in accordance with applicable procedures and regulatory requirements. 
 - Analyze complaint, service, and performance data to identify emerging quality, safety, reliability, or compliance trends and appropriately escalate issues requiring CAPA, risk management review, regulatory assessment, or other corrective actions. 
 - Participate in the review, validation, and continuous improvement of regulatory decision trees, complaint evaluation processes, and related complaint handling procedures. 
 - Compose clear and concise written communications detailing complaint events, investigation activities, product analysis findings, conclusions, and corrective actions, as applicable, for both internal and external use. 
 - Uphold the company's core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork. 
 - Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company's Code of Ethics and Conduct. 
 - Report quality problems, product defects, or compliance concerns to management to support appropriate corrective action and prevent recurrence. 
 - Perform other duties as assigned to meet business needs. 
 - It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or related discipline preferred. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. 
 - Demonstrated experience conducting complaint investigations, evaluating product performance issues, and documenting investigation conclusions in accordance with regulatory requirements. 
 - Fluency in English, with demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate verbally at a professional level. 
 - Couple of hours of overlap with the snoqualmieteam who usually work between 7: 30AM-5: 30PM PDT. 
 - Experience evaluating adverse events and determining regulatory reportability using established decision trees and applicable regulatory requirements preferred. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of ISO 13485, FDA medical device regulations, and ISO 14971 risk management principles. 
 - Knowledge of global medical device regulations and reporting requirements (e. g. , EU MDR, UK MDR, Health Canada, TGA). 
 - Experience working within electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) and complaint management databases preferred. 
 - Must be able to perform critical thinking to identify and synthesize patterns from emerging trends and translate into actionable recommendations 
 - Strong technical written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively across all levels of a global organization and remain composed in urgent circumstances 
 - Must have ability to work in collaborative and independent work situations and environments with minimal supervision. 
 - Proficiency in multi-tasking and working in a high-paced, matrixed environment with an awareness of continued impact on compliance and operational performance 
 - Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Service, Quality, and Supply Chain to support complaint investigations and risk mitigation activities. 
 - Ability to learn how to use the Spacelabs Healthcare products that are supported (training provided) 
 - Organized and resourceful with excellent attention to detail and ability to execute on assigned project plans. 

Physical Requirements

- Standing: 5% Bending: 
 - Sitting: 80% Stooping: Reaching: 
 - Walking: 10% 
 - Lifting: (0 - 25lbs)

data.title: Data Engineering Lead
data.description:
About Us: 

At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. We empower companies to harness the full potential of AI, unlocking opportunities they never imagined possible before the AI era. Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. Our ERP solution teams have successfully implemented cloud solutions and developed tools that seamlessly integrate with ERP systems, reducing manual work so teams can focus on high-impact tasks. 

None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we're actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications. 

As one of the fastest-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed-without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high-energy, driven individuals. 

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey!

About the Role

We're looking for a Data Engineering Lead to architect and own enterprise-scale data platforms end to end - Databricks, cloud-native Lakehouse architecture, and modern orchestration - empowering the organization to make reliable, governed, data-driven decisions. You'll be the senior technical voice on the team, with BI and reporting as a downstream output of the platform you build, not the platform itself. 

What You'll Do

- Data Platform Architecture: Design and own end-to-end data pipeline architecture - ETL/ELT, orchestration, and data modeling - across cloud-native platforms (Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and/or Snowflake). 
 - Lakehouse Engineering: Architect Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) or equivalent layered data platform designs using Delta Lake; own Unity Catalog governance, access control, and data lineage. 
 - Data Integration: Oversee ETL/ELT pipeline development and orchestration (Apache Airflow, ADF), including legacy migration support (e. g. , SSIS, Informatica, SAS) where applicable. 
 - Data Modelling: Own dimensional modeling and SCD (Type 1/2) implementation for accurate historical and current-state reporting. 
 - Database Management: Utilize SQL to write complex queries, stored procedures, and manage large-scale data transformations. 
 - Reporting Enablement: Ensure the platform reliably feeds downstream BI tools (Power BI or similar) with clean, curated, analytics-ready data. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications and architecture designs. 
 - Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize Spark/pipeline workloads for performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Data Governance: Implement RBAC, data classification, and lineage tracking to ensure compliance and audit readiness. 
 - Team Leadership: Mentor and guide data engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and architectural rigor. 

On your first day, we'll expect you to have: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with demonstrated Lead-level ownership. 
 - Deep, hands-on expertise in Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and/or Snowflake, plus ADF or equivalent orchestration. 
 - Strong data modeling experience - dimensional modeling, SCD, Medallion or equivalent layered architecture. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL, including advanced query writing and database management. 
 - Strong programming foundation in Python: 
 - Data manipulation and analysis using Pandas, NumPy, and PySpark. 
 - Data serialization and formats - JSON, CSV, Parquet. 
 - Database interaction to query cloud-based data warehouses. 
 - Pipeline orchestration using Airflow - scripting and automation. 
 - Cloud services such as S3 and AWS Lambda for infrastructure management. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native databases such as Snowflake, Postgres, Redshift. 
 - Code quality and management using version control and collaborative workflows. 
 - Full lifecycle experience - you've taken a design from blueprint through production support. 

We'd be super excited if you have: 

- Relevant cloud/platform certifications (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure). 
 - BI/reporting tool exposure (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). 
 - Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Plotly, or Dash. 
 - Ability to interact with REST APIs and perform web scraping tasks. 
 - Azure SDK familiarity. 

Benefits: 

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit. 

Calfus Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

We believe diversity drives innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone-regardless of background, identity, or experience-has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome all applicants!

data.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2, 800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. 

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. 

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. 

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. 

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. 

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. 

Role Details

📍 Job location: Pune (Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office)

🕒 Contract type: Employee

🗓 Target start date: ASAP

⏰ Working hours: Full-time (40h/week), 1: 00 PM to 10: 00 PM IST

💵 Compensation: ₹35, 00, 000 - ₹50, 00, 000 per year

📋 What You'll Architect

At Keyrus, we transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence and human decision-making. 

We're looking for an experienced Technical Delivery Lead to contribute to a strategic enterprise modernisation programme for a global financial services client. This is a highly hands-on role, with approximately 80% focused on coding and technical implementation and 20% on technical leadership. 

You will combine hands-on technical expertise with team leadership, guiding a Pune-based development team while working closely with stakeholders and distributed teams across APAC, EMEA and the US. 

What You'll Do

 - Promote strong engineering practices across CI/CD, DevOps and infrastructure automation. 
 - Contribute to the design and optimisation of ETL/data pipelines, Snowflake solutions and Kafka-based messaging. 
 - Support team development, performance and alignment across international time zones. 

👤 Who You Are

- You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving meaningful business challenges. 
 - You enjoy turning complexity into clarity and action. 
 - You balance technical thinking with business understanding. 
 - You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments. 
 - You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. 
 - You value continuous learning and are motivated by long-term professional growth. 
 - You communicate clearly and effectively with a variety of stakeholders. 

🛠️ What You Bring

Qualifications & Experience

- 15+ years of software development experience, including at least 5 years in a technical leadership role. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Core Java, Java 8+, Spring Boot and microservices architecture. 
 - Proven experience with REST APIs and enterprise application development. 
 - Strong cloud experience with Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes/AKS. 
 - Experience with Docker and cloud-native application deployment. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical teams and deliver enterprise-scale initiatives in an Agile environment. 
 - Excellent communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively across distributed international teams. 

Strongly Preferred

- Experience with Snowflake and ETL/data pipelines, including technologies such as Airflow, Spring Batch or Apache Camel. 
 - Experience with Kafka or other enterprise messaging platforms. 
 - Experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure-as-Code. 
 - Financial Services / Banking experience. 
 - Knowledge of SQL, NoSQL/Cosmos DB, Unix scripting or monitoring tools. 
 - GitHub Copilot or other AI-powered development tools, Terraform/IaC, and Financial Services experience. 

⭐ What Makes You Successful

- You focus on outcomes rather than activity. 
 - You approach challenges with curiosity and pragmatism. 
 - You communicate complex concepts in a clear and accessible way. 
 - You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions. 
 - You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others. 
 - You combine autonomy with collaboration. 
 - You continuously look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and results. 

🎁 What We Offer at Keyrus UK

- Hybrid work model (3 days/week in the office)
 - 18 paid leaves + 9 public holidays
 - ₹5L medical insurance + ₹10L accident insurance
 - Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits
 - International consulting exposure with Keyrus clients
 - Discretionary Bonus Scheme
 - Referral Bonus Scheme
 - Training & Development via KLX (Keyrus Learning Experience)

💰 How Our Salary Ranges Work

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role - not different job titles. 

- Bottom of the range You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support. 
 - Middle of the range You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently. 
 - Top of the range You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team. Final offers are based on experience, autonomy, scope, and market context, and are discussed transparently during the process. 

🔒 Responsible AI & Recruitment

At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers. 

To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for note-taking purposes during interviews. AI is never used to make decisions. 

To ensure fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is strictly prohibited. 

Our commitment to responsible AI practices ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate's own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise. 

⚠️ Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process. 

♿ Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. 

At Keyrus, we help organisations move from experimental AI to industrialised AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. 

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated ModelTM (HOM), we architect reliable: 

- Intelligence Foundations,

With 30+ years of expertise and 2, 800 employees across 28 countries, we help organisations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organisations.

data.title: Senior Principal Engineer – Wireless AP Software Development
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Senior Principal Engineer  to lead the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation Enterprise Wireless Access Point (AP) solutions. In this role, you will define the software architecture for state-of-the-art Wi-Fi 6, 6E, and Wi-Fi 7 access points. 

You will bridge the gap between low-level silicon firmware and high-level cloud management platforms, ensuring our APs deliver enterprise-grade performance, seamless roaming, high security, and cloud-driven scalability. If you have deep expertise in embedded Linux, 802. 11 protocols, and cloud-managed networking, we want you on our team. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- End-to-End Architecture: Own the software architecture, design, and delivery of advanced Wi-Fi features from silicon SDK integration up to cloud-managed provisioning systems. 
 - Enterprise Wi-Fi Evolution: Design and develop advanced features utilizing Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E, and Wi-Fi 7  standards to deliver enterprise-grade performance. 
 - Advanced Wireless Feature Design: Architect and implement high-value wireless application features including Wi-Fi Mesh,   Neighbor  Awareness Networking (NAN), Fine Timing Measurement/Locationing  (IEEE 802. 11mc/az), and advanced enterprise roaming (802. 11k/v/r). 
 - Ecosystem Collaboration: Partner closely with leading Wi-Fi chipset vendors for SDK integration, firmware customization, performance tuning, and hardware platform enablement. Edge-to-Cloud Integration

- Cloud-Managed Infrastructure: Design, optimize, and deliver cloud-managed and firewall-managed capabilities including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, real-time monitoring, and centralized control. 
 - Network & Security Orchestration: Ensure seamless data path orchestration between the AP firmware, local security firewalls, and cloud management dashboards.   

Qualifications & Skills

Must-Have Technical Expertise

- Wireless Domain Mastery: Strong Wi-Fi Access Point product development experience with a deep understanding of IEEE 802. 11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be) and wireless security protocols (WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise). 
 - Advanced Protocol Experience: Hands-on experience developing core firmware/wireless applications for Wi-Fi Mesh, NAN, 802. 11mc, 802. 11az, and seamless roaming (802. 11k, 802. 11v, 802. 11r). 
 - Embedded Software Engineering: Expert knowledge of Embedded Linux, Linux kernel internals, device drivers,   hostapd,   wpa_supplicant, and system-level debugging. 
 - Language Proficiency: Strong proficiency in C/C++  development for resource-constrained embedded networking platforms. 
 - Networking Core: Strong networking background including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, QoS, and enterprise network protocols. 
 - Network Security: Practical knowledge of network security integrations such as firewall systems, IDS/IPS, threat detection, and policy enforcement at the AP level. Good-to-Have (Preferred) Qualifications

- Advanced Security & Data Path: Knowledge of Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), malware detection, sandboxing, and Software-Defined Networking (SDN) in large-scale wireless deployments. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Direct experience with cloud-managed networking platforms, telemetry/analytics collection, and DevOps/automation frameworks. 
 - RF Engineering & Optimization: Solid understanding of RF concepts including DFS, dynamic channel planning, interference mitigation, and automated performance optimization. 
 - Next-Gen Tech: Exposure to AI/ML applications  in wireless networking for predictive performance optimization, Wi-Fi analytics, or anomaly detection. 
 - Experience: Prior technical leadership or architecture ownership experience shipping commercial carrier-grade or enterprise-grade networking products.   

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries. 

Applicant Privacy Notice

data.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
data.description:
Software Development

Join Royal York Property Management as a Senior Full-Stack Developer to lead the architecture and maintenance of our key web portals and client applications. Work with cutting-edge AI tools in a remote, dynamic environment. 

About Royal York Property Management

At Royal York Property Management, we take pride in managing our clients' investment properties with the same dedication and care as we would our own. Our approach to property management is meticulous, whether it involves addressing maintenance emergencies or conducting tenant showings. In every task, we consider whether the standards we apply are equivalent to those we would expect for our properties. Prioritizing the needs of our clients and tenants is at the forefront of our mission, ensuring we deliver exceptional service every day. 

About The Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Developer at Royal York Property Management, you will be responsible for architecting, scaling, and maintaining our core web platforms. You will play a vital role in managing complex backend ecosystems using Laravel and dynamic frontends with Vue. js, ensuring seamless integration with third-party APIs like Google Ads and Zoho. Your expertise will guide the development of secure, scalable, and fast-delivery features using AI-assisted coding workflows. 

In your day-to-day, you'll write clean and maintainable backend code, develop reactive UI components, and manage API endpoints and webhooks. You will leverage AI tools to enhance development speed and maintain a robust architectural structure across projects. You will work closely with our technical leads, operating with high autonomy to design and execute high-level project requirements into functional systems. 

Success in this role means delivering modular, scalable features rapidly, achieving zero critical downtime, and ensuring robust security implementations. You'll excel if you take a proactive approach to security, love clean architecture, and possess a flair for integrating AI workflows into traditional coding practices. 

What you will do

- Architect and maintain core web portals and client applications using Laravel and Vue. js. 
 - Write clean, maintainable backend business logic in Laravel and develop reactive UI components in Vue. js. 
 - Design, test, and monitor external API endpoints, handle incoming and outgoing webhook payloads, and trace debug logs. 
 - Utilize AI coding assistants to rapidly prototype and refactor code, and write comprehensive test suites. 
 - Review code architecture, optimize database queries, and ensure security compliance across active projects. 
 - Deliver major feature sprints, verify webhook reliability, and perform code reviews. 
 - Conduct security audits, optimize API rate-usage tracking, and update technical documentation. 
 - Architect new multi-tenant modules, refactor legacy architecture, and troubleshoot complex production scaling bottlenecks. 
 - Achieve zero critical downtime in production and implement clean API error handling and robust security measures. 
 - Build and document robust, fault-tolerant API integrations with error recovery and rate-limit handling. 
 - Deliver scalable, secure, and modular features rapidly using modern AI-assisted development workflows. 
 - Difficulties arise when handling asynchronous event/APIs, ignoring security fundamentals, or relying on outdated development methods. 
 - Debug broken or delayed webhook payloads, manage API quota suspensions, and resolve security vulnerabilities under tight deadlines. 

What we are looking for

- Minimum of 6 years of hands-on software development experience building production-grade web applications. 
 - Deep expertise in PHP and Laravel for backend development. Proficiency in frontend development with a strong grasp of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as Tailwind CSS and Vue. js. 
 - Extensive experience in REST APIs, OAuth protocols, and Webhooks. Knowledge of various third-party platforms like Payment Gateways, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Zoho for integrations. 
 - Strong knowledge of comprehensive web security best practices, including CSRF, XSS protection, secure authentication methods, data encryption, and safe payload validation. 
 - Proficiency in Git for version control, and experience with deployment on cloud platforms such as AWS and Cloudways. 
 - Familiarity with SSH and command-line tools for efficient server management and deployment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - English - fluent, spoken and written. 

Nice to have

- Python proficiency is an advantage, especially for potential integration or data-driven tasks. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools to enhance coding speed and quality is preferred. 

What we offer

CAD $24, 000 to $40, 000 per year. 

Schedule

Full-Time, Mon-Fri, 9: 00 AM-5: 00 PM. 

What happens next

Join Revun as a Full-Stack Developer to scale web applications using cutting-edge technology. Build robust API integrations and enhance coding with AI tools, working in a fast-paced environment. 

About Revun

Revun is the software platform and infrastructure layer behind modern property operations. Where other tools solve one piece of the puzzle, Revun unifies leasing, payments, maintenance, communications, compliance, reporting, and brokerage workflows into a single operating system. Owners, property managers, brokerages, leasing teams, maintenance companies, and REITs all operate from the same connected platform, with role-based experiences that adapt to each stakeholder. As a Full-Stack Developer at Revun, you'll be at the forefront of scaling our web applications. Your day-to-day tasks include reviewing sprint tasks, refactoring backend logic in Laravel, and designing responsive frontends using Tailwind CSS. You will engage with third-party API integration and leverage AI coding assistants to enhance your workflows. 

Working closely with the Lead Developer and reporting to the Technical Lead/Founder, your responsibilities include delivering clean, modular code, ensuring zero-downtime deployments, and accelerating development velocity through AI tools. Your success will be assessed by your ability to meet sprint deadlines and ship functional code features consistently.

What you will do

- Deliver clean, modular, and scalable code using Laravel and Tailwind CSS or any other modern frontend framework to enhance web application performance and client project outcomes. 
 - Review sprint tasks, manage pull requests, and refactor backend logic in collaboration with the team, ensuring consistency and quality. 
 - Write and refactor both backend logic in Laravel and design responsive frontend layouts using Tailwind CSS and Blade components. 
 - Test and debug third-party API connections, handle complex payloads, and manage error logs effectively.

 - Strong proficiency in full-stack Laravel development, including backend services and frontend frameworks such as Vue. js or any similar JavaScript framework. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, payment gateways, and CRM systems like Zoho. 
 - Solid understanding of MySQL, database schema design, and Git version control workflows. 
 - Fluent in English, with excellent spoken and written communication skills. 
 - Clear communication skills in providing progress updates and resolving development issues. 

Nice to have

- Experience in software development within the IT sector. 
 - Proficiency in AI-assisted development tools like Cursor, Claude, and OpenAI APIs to enhance coding speed and quality. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

data.description:
About T-Mobile: 

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America's supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience. 

About TMUS Global Solutions: 

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company's global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking. 

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions. 

Job Profile: 

- Engineer, SoftwareJob Overview: 

The T-Mobile FinTech Platform team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and highly reliable backend services powering digital banking, payments, card services, customer account management, and financial transaction processing. This hands-on role owns complex services and integrations across internal T-Mobile platforms and external banking and financial technology partners. 

The Senior Engineer contributes to architecture and design, delivers cloud-native Java/Spring Boot applications, and owns software across development, deployment, monitoring, and production support. Success requires sound technical judgment, reliable transaction processing, secure handling of sensitive information, and collaboration with product, architecture, QA, operations, security, and partner teams. 

Candidates should have 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience. Prior banking or FinTech experience is preferred, not required.

- Design, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable Java/Spring Boot backend services, REST APIs, and microservices for FinTech products. 
 - Own complex services end to end, including technical design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support. 
 - Design secure integrations with internal T-Mobile platforms, external banking partners, payment processors, and other financial service providers. 
 - Implement reliable transaction workflows with appropriate validation, retries, idempotency, error recovery, data integrity, and reconciliation. 
 - Contribute to distributed system design, event-driven integration, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant application patterns. 
 - Design and optimize relational and NoSQL data access, including PostgreSQL or comparable databases; build scheduled jobs or ETL pipelines when needed. 
 - Primary Location Hyderabad, India
 - Build and operate cloud-native applications on AWS or equivalent cloud platforms, using CI/CD and containerized deployment practices. 
 - Apply secure coding, authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and applicable financial data security controls. 
 - Improve observability with logs, metrics, tracing, and alerting; investigate complex production issues and lead technical root cause analysis for owned services. 
 - Participate in architectural and design decisions, assess trade-offs, conduct code reviews, and mentor other engineers. 
 - Collaborate with product owners, architecture, QA, security, operations, and partner teams to define solutions and deliver reliable capabilities. 
 - Maintain API specifications, integration designs, runbooks, and operational documentation; reduce technical debt and improve reliability. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pragmatic improvements aligned with platform strategy.

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent education and experience consistent with company policy (Required). 
 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting backend applications, APIs, microservices, or distributed systems (Required). 
 - Demonstrated ownership of production software, technical design decisions, and complex troubleshooting (Required). 

Required Qualifications: 

- Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot experience building production REST APIs and microservices. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, resiliency, asynchronous processing, and API integration. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and supporting services on AWS or a comparable cloud platform. 
 - Experience with SQL databases (such as PostgreSQL or Oracle), plus familiarity with NoSQL technologies. 
 - Experience with automated testing, Git, CI/CD, code reviews, and secure software delivery.

Preferred Skills: 

- FinTech, digital banking, card services, payment processing, transaction reconciliation, or other regulated systems.

Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS, event-driven architecture, and distributed transaction patterns.
