Job Description

Senior Mechanical Design Engineering Manager - Pune Team Lead

Location: Pune, India

Who Are We?

At Vertiv, we're on a mission to empower the people who power the future. From life-saving healthcare systems to high-performance computing, we design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With over $8 billion in annual sales and operations in more than 130 countries, Vertiv is uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people. 

We are currently seeking a Senior Mechanical Design Engineering Manager - Pune Team Lead to establish, grow, and lead a Pune-based mechanical engineering team supporting data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines across both released-product sustaining work and new product development activities. This role will serve as a critical extension of the US-based engineering organization, partnering closely with stateside engineering leadership to build local capability, strengthen execution, and drive product quality, reliability, cost optimization, and continuous improvement. 

Position Summary

As the Senior Mechanical Design Engineering Manager - Pune Team Lead at Vertiv, you will be a highly experienced people manager with a strong mechanical design background. You will lead a growing, multi-disciplinary engineering team in Pune while maintaining enough technical depth to guide design decisions, challenge assumptions, remove roadblocks, and ensure engineering output meets Vertiv standards. 

This is both a challenge and an opportunity: the successful candidate will help build a new engineering capability in Pune, shape the operating model, recruit and develop talent, and create a high-performing team that can support both rapid response sustaining needs and disciplined new product development execution. You will be expected to translate priorities from US-based leadership into clear local direction while creating a team culture built on ownership, accountability, practical problem-solving, and continuous improvement. 

Reporting to US-based engineering leadership, you will collaborate closely with stateside sustaining, NPDI, product, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and operations teams. You will operate as a strong local leader and trusted extension of the Edinboro, Pennsylvania engineering team, ensuring seamless coordination across time zones while progressively building Pune-based technical capability and capacity. 

Responsibilities People Leadership & Team Building

- Establish, grow, and lead a Pune-based engineering team supporting sustaining engineering, new product development, and engineering change management activities. 
 - Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, mentor, and develop engineers and technical support roles needed to build a scalable Pune engineering capability. 
 - Provide day-to-day people management, technical guidance, coaching, and career development for direct reports. 
 - Create a strong team culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, customer focus, engineering discipline, and continuous improvement. 
 - Manage workload, priorities, resource allocation, and execution commitments in coordination with stateside engineering leadership. 
 - Drive performance management, skills development, succession planning, and team capability growth as the Pune organization expands. 
 - Help define practical processes, communication rhythms, and handoff mechanisms that allow Pune and US-based teams to operate as one integrated engineering organization. 

Technical Leadership & Mechanical Design Oversight

- Provide experienced mechanical design leadership for data center rack, enclosure, and infrastructure product lines, including both released-product support and new design development. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of sheet metal enclosure design, manufacturing processes, tolerancing, component selection, and configuration control. 
 - Guide engineers through complex design decisions involving manufacturability, fit/function, structural integrity, serviceability, cost, quality, and compliance impact. 
 - Review and approve technical work products including 3D models, drawings, BOM updates, engineering changes, and supporting documentation. 
 - Support development and release of mechanical designs using Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo, while ensuring consistent use of engineering standards, templates, and best practices. 
 - Ensure lessons learned from manufacturing issues, quality feedback, field concerns, and customer requirements are captured and applied to future product improvements. 

Sustaining Engineering, NPDI & Change Management Execution

- Lead and coordinate sustaining engineering activities including issue resolution, design updates, product improvements, cost reductions, component substitutions, and lifecycle support for released products. 
 - Support new product development execution by helping the Pune team contribute to design documentation, drawing release, design updates, prototype support, and transition-to-production readiness. 
 - Oversee effective execution of engineering change orders, documentation updates, BOM maintenance, part-number/revision control, and product data accuracy within ERP and PLM systems. 
 - Partner with engineering change analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure changes are properly reviewed, approved, released, tracked, and implemented with minimal disruption. 
 - Investigate and resolve manufacturing, quality, supplier, and field-reported issues using structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action methodologies. 
 - Balance fast response to production and customer needs with disciplined engineering change control and long-term product robustness. 

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Partner closely with US-based engineering leadership and technical leads, taking direction on priorities while providing clear local execution ownership in Pune. 
 - Maintain a few hours of daily working overlap with US Eastern Time to support standups, design reviews, issue escalation, handoffs, and real-time collaboration. 
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Management, Compliance, and other engineering teams to implement changes and product improvements effectively. 
 - Support smooth transitions between new product development, production launch, and ongoing sustaining ownership. 
 - Communicate clearly across geographies, functions, and levels of the organization, escalating risks and resource needs early with proposed solutions. 

Qualifications Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical experience. 
 - 12+ years of mechanical engineering experience with strong exposure to product development, sustaining engineering, lifecycle support, manufacturing support, or related design leadership responsibilities. 
 - Demonstrated people-management experience, including hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance management, workload planning, and career development for engineering teams. 
 - Strong mechanical design background with the ability to review, guide, and challenge detailed engineering work while also leading through others. 
 - Experience leading engineering work across cross-functional teams and globally distributed organizations. 
 - Proficiency in 3D CAD modeling and drawing release processes; Autodesk Inventor and PTC Creo experience strongly preferred. 
 - Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems such as Autodesk Vault, Windchill, or Agile. 
 - Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle PD Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar business systems. 
 - Strong understanding of engineering change management, BOM/documentation control, root-cause analysis, corrective action processes, and disciplined product data management. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate effectively across geographies and time zones. 
 - Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions with limited supervision while keeping leadership informed of risks, tradeoffs, and resource constraints. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, or related field. 
 - Experience building, scaling, or transforming engineering teams in a global or multi-site environment. 
 - Experience designing and supporting sheet metal enclosures and assemblies for data center, ICT, or technology infrastructure applications. 
 - Working knowledge of manufacturing processes including laser cutting, punch press, press brake, welding, assembly, and powder coating. 
 - Experience supporting high-volume, configurable, or engineered-to-order products in production. 
 - Familiarity with mechanical compliance standards relevant to data center and infrastructure products, including UL, IEC, CB schemes, seismic qualification, and environmental standards such as RoHS and REACH. 
 - Experience coordinating engineering change analysts, configuration management resources, or documentation-control activities. 
 - Experience with automation or scripting tools such as iLogic, VB. NET, Python, C#, or C++. 

What Will Make You Successful?

- Proven ability to lead people while remaining grounded in practical mechanical engineering and design fundamentals. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for team performance, engineering output, product quality, and execution commitments. 
 - Comfort building structure in a growing team environment where processes, responsibilities, and capabilities are still being established. 
 - Ability to create clarity from broad priorities and translate stateside direction into executable plans for the Pune team. 
 - Bias toward action, with disciplined follow-through and the judgment to balance urgency with engineering rigor. 
 - Collaborative mindset across time zones, cultures, functions, and levels of the organization. 
 - Continuous improvement mindset focused on reliability, cost, manufacturability, documentation accuracy, and engineering excellence. 
 - Ability to mentor engineers, develop future leaders, and build a team that earns trust through consistent execution. 

Travel Requirements

Periodic international travel to Edinboro, PA, USA and other Vertiv locations as needed to support team integration, training, hiring alignment, and cross-site collaboration. Domestic travel within India may also be required.

data.title: Principal Emulation IP Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. Sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe does not faze you. You walk out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. Ask the right questions, push back when something does not make sense, and move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high-speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best-in-class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work. You read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - Mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification comes naturally to you, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Quality Manager
data.description:
About The Role

As Quality Manager, you lead the plant quality function to deliver zero-defect manufacturing, exceed customer expectations, and ensure compliance with OEM, IATF, and regulatory standards. You drive a culture of continuous improvement by leveraging robust quality systems, data-driven decision-making, and disciplined problem-solving. Through strong leadership and collaboration across manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and customer teams, you enable operational excellence in quality performance and customer satisfaction while developing a high-performing quality organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the site quality function to consistently achieve world-class quality performance, customer satisfaction, and compliance with OEM and industry standards. 
 - Champion zero-defect manufacturing by driving proactive quality planning, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives across welding and assembly operations. 
 - Lead customer quality management activities, including customer complaints, audits, issue resolution, and timely closure of corrective actions. 
 - Ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO standards, and customer-specific requirements. 
 - Drive defect reduction initiatives through structured problem-solving methodologies and implementation of Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction strategies. 
 - Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Control Plans, and implementation of 7QC tools. 
 - Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and systematic containment activities for internal and external quality concerns. 
 - Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, supplier quality, and customer teams to resolve quality issues and improve process capability. 
 - Establish and monitor quality KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and visibility across the organization. 
 - Develop and coach a high-performing quality team, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, regulatory, and customer requirements while promoting operational discipline and best practices. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Minimum 15+ years of experience in Quality Management within a Tier-1 automotive manufacturing environment. 
 - Strong expertise in welding and assembly manufacturing processes and quality management systems. 
 - Proven experience in customer quality management, audit management, complaint handling, and corrective action implementation. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans, and core quality tools. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience driving defect reductionand continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders to achieve quality and business objectives. 
 - Proficiency in interpreting customer requirements, regulatory standards, and quality system expectations. 
 - Effective communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a strong ownership mindset and customer focus. 
 - Relevant quality certifications and automotive quality credentials are preferred.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 - DPP
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

QA Engineer - DPP

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Engineer to support the quality, reliability, and integrity of DPP deliverables across data ingestion, transformation, APIs, and downstream reporting. The successful candidate will review requirements and acceptance criteria, design and execute manual and automated tests, validate end-to-end data flows and business rules, and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify defects early, reduce delivery risk, and support high-quality releases. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Design

Review requirements, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation to create clear, traceable test scenarios and test cases for each User Story. 

Review test coverage with relevant stakeholders and maintain the regression suite to ensure ongoing support for business-critical DPP functionality. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

Execute manual and automated tests to validate new features, regression scenarios, and data transformations across the DPP platform. 

Record defects and data issues with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and impact assessment to enable efficient triage and resolution. 

Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to support root-cause analysis, validate fixes, and confirm production readiness. 

Validation & Closure

Retest resolved defects and confirm that acceptance criteria, business rules, and quality expectations have been met before closure. 

Maintain accurate defect reporting, status tracking, and quality documentation to support transparent delivery decisions. 

Data Integrity & ETL Validation

Validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of extracted, transformed, and loaded data across the DPP platform. 

Confirm that processed data aligns with business rules, acceptance criteria, and reporting expectations. 

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, tooling, and automation to increase efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the wider QA and delivery teams. 

Technical Skills & Tools

Mandatory Tools: 

Azure DevOps (Test Management & Release Support): Plan and execute DPP test cycles, manage test evidence and defects, support release readiness, and contribute to quality sign-off across delivery pipelines. 

Azure DevOps (Defect Tracking & Traceability): Log, triage, and track defects and data issues, maintain traceability to User Stories, data changes, and releases, and work with Engineering and Data teams on root-cause analysis and fix validation. 

SQL (Data Validation): Write and execute queries to validate data transformations, reconciliations, referential integrity, and data quality rules across staging and curated layers. 

Postman & Swagger (API Testing): Validate API contracts, schemas, authentication and authorization, error handling, and payload accuracy using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications; create and maintain collections for smoke and regression testing. 

Databricks & Azure Data Factory: Support validation of transformation logic, pipeline outcomes, and orchestration processes. Databricks is the primary platform used in DPP, while Azure Data Factory knowledge remains valuable as an additional skill aligned to broader ETL requirements. 

Programming & Frameworks: 

Python or Java: Experience using one or both languages for test automation, API checks, and data validation scripting. 

PyTest / Robot Framework / Contract Testing / Automated Data Checks: Familiarity with test frameworks and data-quality tooling to support DPP regression coverage and ongoing monitoring. 

KPIs & Success Metrics

Test Execution Delivery: Complete planned DPP test execution within agreed sprint timelines, with clear evidence and status visibility. 

Defect Detection Rate: Identify and log at least 90% of critical defects (data quality issues, pipeline failures, and API contract breaks) before release. 

Defect Turnaround Time: All defects are triaged, prioritized, and assigned within 24 hours of discovery. 

Coverage & Traceability: Maintain end-to-end coverage of User Stories, acceptance criteria, core business rules, and key data scenarios, with clear traceability across testing and release activity. 

Data Quality & Integrity: Ensure validated datasets meet transformation rules, reconciliation checks, and agreed quality tolerances for the DPP platform. 

Status Reporting: Provide weekly QA status updates covering test progress, defect trends, data quality outcomes, pipeline/API risks, and release readiness. 

Continuous Improvement: Propose at least one process or tooling improvement per quarter (e. g. , automation, data-quality checks, or pipeline monitoring) to strengthen DPP quality. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Candidate Profile

- Proven experience in QA or software testing within data-driven platforms, ideally involving ETL processes, APIs, and reporting or analytics solutions. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across data, APIs, and application behavior. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge is essential, including the ability to write and execute queries for data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work effectively across Product, Engineering, and Data teams. 
 - High attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes. 

Nice-to-have Skills

- Experience testing modern data platforms, data pipelines, or cloud-based analytics solutions. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, or quality gates within engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of API standards, data contracts, and integration testing practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional product and engineering teams.

 - Own: Own it end to end with Speed, quality, depth and long term vision. 

What You Must Bring

- You have led engineers. At least 2 years directly managing a team - hiring, feedback, 

performance conversations, growing people. 

- Tech-lead: A tech-lead role for at least 4 years. 
 - You are still hands-on. Y ou've designed and built production systems in the recent

past, and you can review a pull request or a design doc and find the real problem in it. 

- You've owned multiple systems in production end to end. A system or product where

you were accountable for it working for customers - releases, incidents, and the

follow-through after. 

- You've delivered under ambiguity. You've taken a problem nobody had fully defined - a new product, an inherited system, a team in transition - and turned it into something

shipped. 

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. 

Technical background

- You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: AWS - you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them. 
 - Languages: one or more modern languages such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node. js or equivalents. 
 - Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). Y ou can walk us through a data model you designed and a performance problem you fixed, with the before and after. 

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. 

What Sets Great Candidates Apart

- Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and how your team got there. You've also stopped or cut something that wasn't working. Teams you've grown. People you hired or coached who went on to bigger roles, and a team that got measurably better at shipping under you. 
 - Scale and complexity. Y ou've handled real load, real data volume or a genuinely hard domain - and can tell the story of one hard technical problem in detail. 
 - Inherited systems. You've taken over a codebase or product from another team or location and made it better without stopping delivery. 
 - Quality discipline. Y ou've raised a team's bar on testing, releases or incident response, and can show what changed. 
 - Cross-functional range. You've worked directly with product, support and business partners, and made scoping calls rather than just executing them. 
 - Framework mindset: You have a framework mindset and find opportunities to covert a custom implementation into a framework. 

What We Look For In Everyone We Hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things. For a manager, each one also shows up in the team you build. 

- Customer obsession. Y ou know who uses what your team builds and what changed for them. Y ou treat support escalations and on-call as signal, not chores. 
 - Impact over activity. Y ou measure success by outcomes, not sprints delivered or meetings run. Y ou'll choose the boring solution if it ships sooner. 
 - Honesty. You give credit to your team and are specific about your own part. You tell leadership bad news early, and you say what didn't work. 
 - Independence. Y ou don't need a roadmap handed to you. Y ou find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding - and you build a team that works the same way. Y ou will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. 
 - Passion. Not the word on a resume - the evidence: something you kept going back to, a craft you kept deepening, people you kept teaching. 
 - Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Y ears in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is.

data.title: AME-End of Line Deployment Engineer
data.description:
Position Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

Vertiv is seeking a AME Manufacturing Development & Deployment Engineer. This role is the critical architect of our "Connected Factory, " responsible for the physical and digital realization of manufacturing processes on the plant floor. You will lead the deployment of advanced production lines for Power and Thermal products, ensuring that Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and Yamazumi models are executed with precision. This role requires a leader who can manage the convergence of physical equipment-such as Automation cells and DC Torque tools-with our OT digital stack, including Inductive Automation's Ignition, Power Apps, and mobile tablet integration, to ensure a seamless "Vertical Startup" with real-time data visibility

Responsibilities

- On-Site Process & OT Deployment: Lead the physical installation of manufacturing lines, integrating OT devices and Automation into a unified factory ecosystem. Orchestrate the rollout of Ignition Perspective HMI and Microsoft Power Apps to provide shop-floor operators with real-time digital work instructions and performance dashboards. 
 - Smart Tooling & IoT Integration: Direct the deployment and calibration of DC Torque tools and smart sensors. Ensure these devices are networked to capture granular assembly data (e. g. , torque curves, cycle times) to feed directly into the Digital Twin and Quality Management Systems. 
 - Factory-Level Yamazumi Execution: Validate and refine Yamazumi modeling on the shop floor. Utilize Tablets and mobile devices to conduct live work content graphing, ensuring the synchronization of manual labor with automated machine cycles to meet Takt time targets. 
 - Digital-to-Physical Validation: Use Discrete Event Simulation (DES) data to guide the layout of automation cells and material handling. Verify that the physical throughput and data latency of networked OT devices match simulation predictions, neutralizing bottlenecks during the deployment phase. 
 - Full Line Balancing & Tablet-Based SOPs: Synchronize all factory processes, deploying Tablets at each workstation to replace paper-based systems. Ensure a seamless data flow between automated cells and manual enclosure integration through integrated Power Automate workflows. 
 - Equipment & Automation Commissioning: Oversee the validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of manufacturing equipment, including robotics, conveyors, and testing protocols. Ensure all OT infrastructure is robust, secure, and fully communicative with the broader MES/ERP environment. 
 - Digital Handoff & Hyper-care: Lead the creation of digital Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Act as the primary technical lead during the launch "hyper-care" period, troubleshooting both physical mechanical issues and digital logic gaps in the Ignition/Power App interface. 
 - Cross-Functional Factory Alignment: Collaborate with IT, Plant Managers, and Supply Chain to ensure the factory's network infrastructure supports high-density IoT and mobile tablet connectivity required for new deployments. 

Skills

- Deployment & Automation Expertise: Proven ability to manage large-scale equipment installations and PLC/Automation startups in an international environment. 
 - OT Stack Proficiency: Hands-on experience deploying Inductive Automation (Ignition), Microsoft Power Apps, and Power Automate within a manufacturing context. 
 - Smart Hardware Integration: Expert knowledge of integrating DC Torque tools, OT gateways, and Industrial Tablets into a production line. 
 - Operational Line Balancing: Advanced proficiency in Takt time optimization and Work Content Graphing using digital data collection tools. 
 - Simulation Application: Ability to use Discrete Event Simulation outputs to optimize the placement of automation and the configuration of digital workflows. 
 - Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish to facilitate communication with regional engineering teams and local factory staff

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Degrees: Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing deployment or plant engineering, specifically with power products or high-complexity electronics. 
 - Proven Launch Track Record: Demonstrated success in "Vertical Startups" and the physical implementation of DFM/DFA principles on the factory floor. 
 - Software Proficiency: Experience with Advanced Simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, Arena) and CAD (SolidWorks/AutoCAD) for factory footprint and layout design. 
 - Certification: Six Sigma Black Belt or Lean Certification is highly desirable. 

Physical Requirements

No Special Physical Requirements

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

No Special Requirements

Travel Time Required

- 25%

data.title: Software Design Assurance Engineer Advanced
data.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

The Software Design Assurance Team is responsible for ensuring our software products meet quality, reliability, and release-readiness standards throughout the development lifecycle. The design assurance team supports Zebra's promise of quality to our customers and is responsible for participating in design reviews, sprint refinement, build/release operations, and post-mortems, and process gap analysis to conduct release readiness assessment. This position works with a minimum level of supervision. 

This position is hybrid based in Bengaluru, India. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Perform an analysis of SW Design Assurance for cloud-native SaaS Technology products and provide feedback for all the key Quality Metrics and deliverables executed by the functional teams, including: 

- Responsible for SW Quality assessment of SWS & cloud solutions. Identify deviations from stated product goals, standards, and processes. 
 - Perform Software Quality Reviews, measure and monitor progress of programs under development. 
 - Lead and conduct Product Release readiness reviews ensuring release criteria for software & device solutions are met and communicate all quality issues, risks, requirements gap prior to product approval. 
 - Recommend latest technologies and new approaches to design and implementation of new technology
 - Should have strong knowledge of cause-and-effect relation between SW defects and potential customer impact use cases. 
 - Instrument the product CI/CD pipeline and surface build-stage quality signal - code coverage trends, flaky-test detection, build stability, deployment frequency, and rollback rate - as a living engineering dashboard rather than a downstream report. 
 - Experience with Software-as-a-Service development processes, release automation, observability tooling, and quality metrics for distributed cloud systems. 
 - Knowledge of the SDLC, testing concepts, methodologies, metrics, automated SW testing frameworks
 - Experience in delivery and manage multi release projects in AGILE (Scrum, Scaled Agile) and knowledge of SW tools like JIRA, Confluence and Power BI
 - Guidance of the process, test methodologies, test strategy used in production of Zebra's NSI SW products and solutions including Software Stability, Stress, and performance strategies
 - Experience communicating cross-functionally and across management levels in formal and informal settings
 - Actively participate in SW Product and applications Risk Assessment and mitigation activities

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related). 
 - Minimum of 10 years' experience in Software Engineering, with at least 5 years in site reliability, release engineering, or senior quality engineering roles on SaaS / cloud-native systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), observability stacks (e. g. , Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana), and release-automation tooling - able to instrument systems directly, not only interpret dashboards. 
 - Demonstrated experience with modern test architecture across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers; flaky-test triage; regression-suite design; and test-pyramid discipline applied to refactor-heavy codebases. 
 - Software QA automation experience with technologies such as Java, Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, or comparable. 
 - Knowledge of productivity and analytics tools such as issue trackers, knowledge-base / documentation systems, BI / dashboarding tools, and CRM platforms. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver an independent quality recommendation to an engineering team in which the engineer is embedded - without compromising the working relationship. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production-incident and release-health fluency - comfortable leading post-mortems, building escape-defect feedback loops, and translating field signal into engineering priorities; credibility built from on-call experience. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant enterprise SaaS domains and complex customer-facing platforms. 
 - Experience working as an embedded quality / SRE partner inside a product engineering team, with demonstrated ability to maintain independent judgment while operating inside the team's day-to-day rituals. 
 - Experience communicating cross-functionally and across management levels - including engineering leadership, customer success, and quality leadership - in formal and informal settings. 
 - Ability to actively engage business and technology partners; present, defend, and challenge technical recommendations. 
 - Ability to deal with ambiguity effectively and exercise sound judgment when evidence is incomplete. 
 - Advocate for the customer and drive the highest standard of quality at every stage of the product lifecycle. 
 - Instill best practices for software development, testing, and observability documentation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality work on tight schedules. 
 - Strong analytical skills and a methodical, objective approach to problem-solving. 

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

Job Title

Senior Automation Engineer

Division

Engineering

Location: 

Pune

Job Summary

The Lead Automation Engineer is responsible for delivery of engineering Automation design outputs for projects and, where requested, bid proposals. They will be responsible for the technical scope of the project/proposal (or, in some cases, a sub-area of the scope). For the scope area for which they are responsible, the Lead Automation Engineer must: 

- Provide leadership to engineers working on that area. 
 - Function as the interface point for customers and, also, the SPX internal organization. 
 - Propose / update the execution strategy within the project life to get the most relevant & efficient team. 
 - Ensure adherence with relevant SPX Flow procedures and practices (e. g. IDEFs)
 - Manage the engineering process to ensure outputs meet schedule, budgetary and quality requirements. 
 - Ensure that the scope delivered from engineering is aligned with contract or proposal requirements (KPIs)

Depending on the scope of the project, the Lead Automation Engineer may be required to undertake engineering design tasks corresponding to their own core discipline and, as such, reference should be made to relevant job descriptions such as Process Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, Automation Engineer, etc. 

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Lead Automation Engineers are expected to possess relevant experience of engineering design and execution from within the industries which we serve. Duties include, but are not limited to, the following: 

Lead Engineer

The primary role will be to perform the "lead engineer" tasks on projects and proposals: 

- Safety & Environment
 - Ensuring that plant designs are safe. 
 - Ensuring that environmental impacts of designs have been considered appropriately. 
 - Ensuring that relevant reviews, as defined in SPX Flow procedures and, additionally, customer contracts, have been undertaken fully and that resultant actions have been completed. (Example reviews include: Design Reviews, Risk Assessments)
 - Ensuring compliance with local legislation and regulations (for the locality of the plant/process) which apply to engineering design (e. g. EU Machinery Directive)
 - Promoting a safety culture amongst staff, particularly when operating outside of the known office environment (e. g. on customer and supplier sites)

data.title: Operations Team Lead (Night Shift)
data.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. 

What you'll do

You will manage a team of Seller Systems Operations Associates in a player-coach capacity. You'll be accountable for your team's operational performance, development, and engagement, while working closely with global operations specialists, business process owners, and cross-functional partners to improve workflows and user experiences. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the day-to-day operational performance of a team of Associates, including quality, productivity, service-level, and other team goals. 
 - Set clear expectations, priorities, and performance goals for individuals and the team. 
 - Manage team capacity, scheduling, and work allocation to ensure critical workflows are covered and work is completed accurately and on time. 
 - Coach Associates on troubleshooting, process knowledge, communication, and sound judgment in resolving user issues. 
 - Hold regular development conversations and provide timely, constructive feedback that supports growth and career progression. 
 - Complete performance reviews and address performance concerns in partnership with your manager and People team partners, as appropriate. 
 - Build a collaborative, inclusive team environment where Associates can raise risks, share ideas, and learn from one another. 
 - Serve as an escalation point for complex operational or user issues, using sound judgment to resolve issues or route them to the right partner. 
 - Partner with global operations specialists and business process owners to run critical Internal Systems workflows. 
 - Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and manual work. 
 - Lead or contribute to improvements that increase quality, reduce effort, and improve the user experience. 
 - Use operational data and team insights to surface trends, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve product offerings, processes, tools, and user-facing communications. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ramping of new team members. 
 - Help build the operating culture, team practices, and capabilities of Stripe Delivery Centers. 

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum Requirements

- 3+ years of experience leading, supervising, or formally mentoring an operations, support, or user-facing team. 
 - 9+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, operations, or another internal or external user-facing environment. 
 - Experience managing operational work against defined quality, productivity, or service-level goals. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback. 
 - Experience coaching others and supporting their professional development
 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with API integrations, including diagnosing implementation issues, interpreting technical documentation, and guiding teams through ambiguous customer or system problems. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and make practical improvements. 
 - The ability to prioritize effectively and make sound decisions in a fast-moving, structured environment. 
 - A process-oriented mindset and a track record of improving workflows, reducing manual effort, or improving user experiences. 
 - Experience working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - A user-first mindset and interest in learning technical products, systems, and processes. 
 - The ability to work from the Bengaluru office in night shift

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using operational data to manage performance, identify trends, and prioritize improvements. 
 - Experience supporting hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, or scheduling for an operations team. 
 - Experience working with global teams across time zones. 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. 

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. 

We look forward to hearing from you. 

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out-and set you apart-especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. 

Apply now

data.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies. 

We are looking for an experienced software developer to join the GAI Tech team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of GAI Tech will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting interdepartmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development. This includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY: 

You will be working as a part of a team that is focused on providing core AI infrastructure for the firm. You will be working on improving areas including developer productivity and process efficiency and making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption, etc. You will be expected to comprehend the technical requirements of diverse groups using AI, explore opensource tech options beneficial for us, and integrate the chosen tech within our teams to enhance efficiency and construct supportive systems. You will also be overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI tools and infrastructure. You will be expected to solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the team. You will be expected to mentor team members from day one, and over time take on people management responsibilities, including leading and managing a team to drive effective execution and delivery. 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field with 6 to 9 years of relevant experience
 - Exposure to GAI projects
 - Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
 - Excellent attention to details and learning agility
 - Excellent communication skills
 - At least 1 year of people and team management experience, leading a team of at least 2 members

Preferred qualification: 

- Experience in managing and working in a global and diverse team
 - GAI Academic qualifications/Certifications

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https: //www. deshawindia. com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadGAITechSept26

We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative. 

The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https: //www. deshawindia. com/careers

Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

data.title: Technical Architect – Application Design & AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 12-15 years

Primary Areas: Application Architecture, Enterprise & Cloud Architecture, AI-Assisted Software Engineering, Quality Engineering

Primary Stack: Python/Django, Go/Gin, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Playwright

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Architect to define and evolve the application architecture of Nextpower's engineering and business platforms. 

The role will focus on designing scalable, maintainable, and secure applications across the full technology stack, including domain models, APIs, services, user interfaces, data stores, integrations, and deployment environments. 

The architect will also establish practical guidelines for AI-assisted software development, helping teams use AI tools to improve productivity while maintaining strong standards for design quality, security, testing, maintainability, and responsible use. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role that works closely with product management, engineering, QA, DevOps, security, and subject-matter experts. The role remains hands-on in complex or high-risk areas through design reviews, prototypes, reference implementations, and critical code reviews. 

Key Responsibilities

Application Architecture and Design

- Define target application architectures, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns. 
 - Design end-to-end solutions covering domain models, business services, APIs, user interfaces, persistence, integrations, security, and deployment. 
 - Establish standards for modular application design, service boundaries, API contracts, error handling, configuration, and versioning. 
 - Review major application designs for functional suitability, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational supportability. 
 - Guide teams in selecting appropriate architectural styles, including modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven components, and workflow-based solutions. 
 - Identify architectural risks, design inconsistencies, and technical debt, and drive practical remediation plans. 
 - Remain hands-on through prototypes, proof-of-concepts, reference implementations, and targeted development in uncertain or high-risk areas. 

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

- Define guidelines for the responsible and effective use of AI coding assistants and generative AI tools across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Establish recommended practices for AI-assisted requirements analysis, architecture, coding, testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting. 
 - Define quality gates and review expectations for AI-generated or AI-assisted code. 
 - Develop reusable prompts, templates, coding patterns, architectural context, and development workflows that improve consistency and engineering productivity. 
 - Guide teams in using AI to generate and maintain unit tests, API tests, UI tests, documentation, migration scripts, and technical designs. 
 - Define guardrails for security, privacy, intellectual property, licensing, data handling, and human oversight when using AI tools. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend their adoption where they provide measurable engineering value. 
 - Measure the impact of AI-assisted development on delivery speed, quality, test coverage, maintainability, and developer experience. 

Engineering and Quality Standards

- Set standards for architecture, APIs, authentication and authorization, observability, testing, CI/CD, configuration, and deployment. 
 - Establish expectations for automated unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Partner with QA and engineering teams to improve testability, regression coverage, and production confidence. 
 - Promote design-for-quality practices, including validation, resilience, diagnosability, performance, and backward compatibility. 
 - Run architecture reviews, critical code reviews, and technical design discussions. 
 - Define and promote engineering practices that reduce defects and prevent the accumulation of technical debt. 

Technical Leadership

- Drive technical alignment across teams and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, constraints, and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads in application design, cloud architecture, software quality, and AI-assisted development. 
 - Collaborate with product management to assess technical feasibility, delivery risks, and sequencing of major initiatives. 
 - Escalate significant technical, security, reliability, and operational risks. 
 - Maintain practical architecture documentation, decision records, standards, and reference implementations. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 12-15 years of experience in enterprise software engineering, with significant experience in application architecture and technical leadership. 
 - Strong experience designing end-to-end business applications and platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of domain modeling, modular design, service boundaries, API-first development, integration patterns, and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on backend development experience with Python/Django/DRF and/or Go/Gin. 
 - Strong frontend architecture experience with Angular and TypeScript; working knowledge of React is a plus. 
 - Experience designing relational data models, indexes, queries, and persistence strategies using MySQL and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with Redis for caching, distributed coordination, or queue-based processing. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, API versioning, asynchronous processing, event-driven systems, and workflow orchestration. 
 - Experience with authentication and authorization standards, including OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC, and secure secret management. 
 - Strong Azure experience, including Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring. 
 - Experience with Docker, Terraform, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD automation. 
 - Experience with observability, logging, metrics, tracing, performance analysis, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated ability to use or establish AI-assisted software development practices, including code generation, test generation, design assistance, and documentation workflows. 
 - Ability to assess AI-generated output critically and apply appropriate human review and quality controls. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience building shared engineering platforms, frameworks, libraries, or developer-productivity tooling used by multiple teams. 
 - Experience defining engineering playbooks, architecture standards, coding guidelines, or development governance. 
 - Experience implementing AI-enabled developer workflows or internal engineering assistants. 
 - Experience with agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-calling agents, or enterprise AI application patterns. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture, message queues, and workflow orchestration. 
 - Experience with Playwright or other modern UI automation frameworks. 
 - Experience working closely with product, QA, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy applications incrementally while continuing feature delivery. 

Soft Skills

- Strong architectural thinking and practical application-design judgment. 
 - Ability to reason clearly about trade-offs, constraints, risks, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to influence and build alignment without direct reporting authority. 
 - Strong ownership mindset and willingness to work hands-on when necessary. 
 - Curiosity and adaptability in evaluating new technologies and AI development approaches. 
 - Commitment to engineering quality, security, responsible AI use, and continuous improvement. 

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Equivalent practical experience with a strong record of technical leadership may also be considered. 

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we're building the foundation for the world's next generation of clean energy infrastructure. 

We are Nextpower

data.title: Lead Mobile Engineer
data.description:
Job Location: Bengaluru, India

Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co. , you can be yourself - and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit - and your future. 

We are looking for a Lead Mobile Engineer to provide end-to-end development leadership for Levi's consumer mobile app. This role owns overall development execution for the mobile experience by solving problems with the right framework, architecture, and tools and partners closely with product, backend/platform engineering, architects, and design in a fast-paced agile environment. The Lead Mobile Engineer brings a DevOps mindset, owning the write, test, monitor, and maintain lifecycle of what the team builds end-to-end. The Lead Mobile Engineer guides technical direction, drives code quality, mentors junior and mid-level developers, and ensures secure, performant, production-ready delivery across the app, integrations, testing, and AI-assisted engineering practices. 

About The Job

- Lead technical planning, design decisions, and delivery for the mobile app from implementation approach through release readiness. 
 - Embrace a DevOps mindset - own the full lifecycle of what you build, including writing, testing, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining code in production, and fulfilling on-call duties for the app. 
 - Contribute to the technical vision for Levi's web & app platforms, defining patterns, architecture, and best practices for the team. 
 - Design, build, and maintain high-performance, accessible mobile experiences using React Native, integrated with backend/commerce APIs, with attention to state management, offline handling, and caching. 
 - Own app performance, stability, and platform health like startup time, responsiveness, crash rates, and app store ratings - and manage release processes (app store submission, versioning, phased rollouts). 
 - Champion telemetry and observability by instrumenting the app with crash reporting, logging, and monitoring to proactively detect issues and uplevel the team's operational maturity. 
 - Lead code reviews, architecture reviews, and technical standards; own test strategy (unit, integration, end-to-end) as a shared team responsibility to reduce production defects. 
 - Mentor developers, play an active role in hiring and growing the team, and lead by example on team agreements and best practices. 
 - Foster an open, collaborative culture with honest communication, peer support, continuous learning and stay connected across the broader platform team via stand-ups, brown bags, and demos. 
 - Partner with cross-functional stakeholders like product, design, and backend/platform engineering to align on requirements, API contracts, and integration points. 
 - Drive agile execution with sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation. 

About You

- 8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant depth in mobile app development. 
 - Proven experience leading the technical direction of a consumer-facing mobile app, ideally in e-commerce or retail. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and elevate the technical skills of other engineers. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and documentation, including writing effective prompts and critically validating AI-generated output for accuracy, security, and production quality. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy and safe handling of enterprise information. 
 - Mobile: React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) fundamentals for native module work 
 - Integration: RESTful/GraphQL APIs, headless/composable commerce platforms 
 - CI/CD: Git-based workflows, automated pipelines, mobile release tooling (Fastlane or similar), app store submission processes 
 - Performance & Quality: Crash monitoring, performance profiling, automated testing (unit/integration/e2e) with Appium, Selenium, and Java 
 - Observability: Experience with mobile telemetry, crash reporting, and monitoring tools (e. g. , Firebase Crashlytics, Datadog RUM, New Relic Mobile, Sentry) to drive proactive monitoring and operational maturity

Bengaluru, India

Full time

data.title: Lead Software Engineer - Financial Risk Integration
data.description:
Lead Software Engineer - Financial Risk Integration

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Software Engineers to drive the design, development, and evolution of our Risk Fusion platform, focused on integrating SimCorp Dimension and Axioma Risk solutions through robust model and position integration capabilities. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Lead architecture and development of Risk Fusion services. 
 - Design APIs and ETL pipelines to support seamless integration
 - Implement ETL flows to extract instrument T&Cs from SimCorp Dimension, map into Axioma Risk format, and import into Axioma Risk
 - Collaborate with Product, Consulting, and QA. 
 - Develop automated tests for new features. 

What We Value

- 7+ years software engineering experience. 
 - Experience with SQL and REST APIs. 
 - Experience building ETL pipelines / data integrations. 
 - Basic understanding of pricing methodologies for financial instruments, including equities, bonds, FX, futures, options, and OTC derivatives. 
 - Demonstrated problem solving skills. 

Preferred

- CFA, FRM or equivalent financial certification
 - Understanding of OTC instrument T&Cs (e. g. swaps, FX forwards, TRS). 
 - Understanding of VaR, Stress Testing, Factor Risk and other Risk Analytics. 
 - Axioma Risk workflows/integration. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application. 
 - Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work. 
 - Inclusive and diverse company culture
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

 - Coordinate implementation of Kafka based event streaming and messaging for payment authorization clearing and settlement processes to improve resilience observability and real time transaction tracking.

 - Guide teams in implementing observability monitoring and alerting for Java services Kubernetes workloads Kafka clusters and MSBI packages to proactively detect issues and minimize impact on payment processing. 
 - Ensure secure engineering practices for cardholder data and payment information by driving encryption secure configuration controlled access and adherence to relevant internal standards and industry regulations. 
 - Optimize hybrid work model collaboration by establishing clear communication routines documentation practices and engineering workflows that maintain productivity across onsite and remote team members.

 - Mentor senior engineers and architects in applying best practices for distributed systems container orchestration and data integration within the cards and payments domain to strengthen overall engineering capability. 
 - Align engineering outcomes with company purpose by enabling secure efficient and reliable payments experiences that support customers merchants and financial partners while contributing to broader economic activity. 
 - Evaluate new tools and patterns related to Kubernetes platforms event streaming and data integration that can enhance scalability resiliency and innovation in the cards and payments technology landscape. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate extensive experience of fifteen to eighteen years in engineering roles delivering complex enterprise systems with significant exposure to transaction intensive financial platforms. 
 - Possess strong hands on expertise using Helm for configuration management and release orchestration of containerized services deployed on Kubernetes based infrastructure. 
 - Apply deep practical skills in Docker for building packaging and running secure and efficient application images that support modular and repeatable deployments across environments.

Qualifications
