data.title: Senior Backend Engineer – API Design & Development
data.description:
About the job

We're hiring a Senior API Product Engineer in Pune!

Be part of our growing international tech team building innovative telecom platforms for European market. 

About Peoplefone: 

Founded in Zurich in 2005, peoplefone started as a bold idea to transform telecommunications - and we've been growing ever since. Now active in seven European countries and licensed telecom providers in five others, we're a dynamic and forward-thinking organization committed to innovation in VoIP and telecom services. 

🌐 Learn more: www. peoplefone. com

What We're Looking For: 

We are looking for a Senior API Product Engineer to design and develop customer-facing APIs as reliable, secure and easy-to-use products. This is not only a backend development position. You will work with product teams, internal developers, customers, and integration partners to understand their use cases, determine which capabilities and data should be exposed, and translate those requirements into clear and evolvable API contracts. 

You will own API design from the initial use case through contract definition, implementation, documentation, testing, publication and lifecycle management. 

Your impact: 

- Understand real usage - Gather and challenge API requirements together with customers, partners, product owners and internal teams, and understand how their developers will consume what we expose. 
 - Design contract-first - Design every API using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI: agree resources, operations, schemas, error models, pagination, filtering, idempotency and async patterns before implementation starts, and use the contract as the source of truth for docs, mocks and tests. 
 - Decide what's exposed - Work with product, architecture and security to decide what data and operations may be exposed, and translate business capabilities into intuitive, consistent API resources and workflows. 
 - Build production-grade APIs - Implement and maintain the REST APIs you design, with clean versioning, deprecation and backward-compatibility strategies so partner integrations never break unexpectedly. 
 - Secure by design - Define authentication and authorization, scopes and roles appropriate to customer- and partner-facing use cases. 
 - Enable integrators - Create accurate documentation, examples and reference integrations, and support customers and partners directly during their integration work. 
 - Close the loop - Establish automated contract, integration, security and performance testing, and feed real API-consumer feedback back into the design. 
 - Raise the bar platform-wide - Define API design guidelines and reusable standards that other development teams adopt. 
 - Work as one team - Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, with code reviews, pair programming and CI/CD as standard practice. 

What You Bring

The Must-Haves: 

- 8+ years of backend software engineering experience, including significant time designing and building APIs in production
 - Hands-on experience defining API contracts with OpenAPI/Swagger, and comfort treating the spec as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought
 - Proven ability to design resources, schemas, versioning and backward-compatibility strategies for APIs consumed by external customers or partners - not only internal services
 - Solid understanding of API security fundamentals: OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, scopes, roles and data-exposure controls
 - Confident handling of relational databases and writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code (automated unit/integration tests as standard practice)
 - Experience working directly with customers, partners or third-party integrators to gather requirements and support their integration work
 - Self-organized, a strong communicator, and comfortable owning a feature or capability from initial use case through go-live
 - Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear developer-facing documentation

Nice-to-Haves: 

- Telecom/VoIP domain experience. 
 - Experience with PHP 8. x, Laravel & OOP
 - Frontend experience (Vue 2/3, CSS, React)
 - Familiarity with contract/schema testing tools (e. g. OpenAPI diffing, Spectral, contract test frameworks)
 - Experience with containers and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI)
 - Monitoring stack exposure: Grafana, Prometheus, OpenSearch
 - Atlassian tooling: Jira, Confluence. 
 - Agile mindset and experience with Scrum methodologies

Why Join peoplefone?

- Young, international team - short communication paths, direct decisions
 - Daily challenges in an open, innovative environment with a team that supports and inspires each other
 - Training time and budget allocated for your growth
 - Career Growth opportunities into an evolving team

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager- NKP
data.description:
About The Team

The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi-cloud environment. 

NKP offers Container Attached Storage using Kubernetes pods to run AOS distributed storage fabric (Cloud Native AOS), enabling seamless integration with cloud native stateful workloads. The platform offers scale out, resilient and tiered storage. Supports storage features such as dynamic provisioning, thin provisioning, data efficiency, and application-centric snapshots. Cloud Native AOS can be used in both hyperconverged and disaggregated storage environments in a hybrid cloud environment. The stateful application Pods use the Nutanix CSI driver to consume storage entities that the AOS Pods present as Persistent Volumes. Much Like an on-premise HCI setup, Cloud Native AOS too provides all core Nutanix data management and copy data management functionalities. 

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager who is a "builder" at heart-someone who can architect complex storage software and, more importantly, architect the careers of the engineers who write it. 

In this role, you will lead a team of talented junior and mid-level engineers. You will serve as the technical anchor and mentor, guiding the team through the challenges of containerizing our services while ensuring our storage control path remains the gold standard for performance and reliability. 

You will design secure-by-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads. 

Key Responsibilities. 

- Cloud-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads
 - Architect, design and develop storage software for a computing+storage platform, Storage for AI - for cloud native environment. 
 - Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency. 
 - Improve data path performance, scale-out and resiliency of our distributed control plane. 
 - Work closely with other development teams, testers, documentation writers and product management to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues
 - Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier. 

What You Will Bring

- Experience: 12-18 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years of team management, with a proven track record of building large-scale distributed systems, cloud native platforms, or cloud infrastructure. 
 - Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability. Understanding of the storage access protocols and features viz. SCSI/iSCSI/NFS/CIFS/S3/Cloud. Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization and/or storage management.

data.title: Senior AI Product Tester
data.description:
About The Opportunity

Venxr is hiring a Senior AI Product Tester to ensure zero broken AI products reach clients, especially those managing real ad budgets for major Indian brands like Haier, Orient Electric, and Suzuki. The role centers on QA automation powered by Claude, testing products that act on data - launching campaigns, moving budgets, and conversing with customers via WhatsApp. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Own quality across AdsGPT, and the WhatsApp bot - not as a gate at sprint end, but as a daily habit starting at 10am and embedded in every story shipped. 
 - Write test cases for every user story from acceptance criteria, and review them with the PM before development finishes. 
 - Run a 30-minute morning sanity check daily across all products - logins, key flows, ad-platform syncs, bot replies - and flag red issues before stand-up. 
 - Build and own QA automation using Claude Code for UI, API, and conversational flows, wired into CI to run on every deploy. 
 - Log 5-10 actionable bugs daily: clear repro steps, expected vs actual, severity, and evidence - so developers can fix without follow-up. 
 - Build evaluation sets for AI features - golden prompts, edge cases, adversarial inputs - to measure if new prompts or models improve outcomes. 
 - Validate numbers against source systems - dashboards must match Google Ads and Meta down to the rupee. 
 - Maintain the regression suite: fix flaky tests, delete useless ones, and identify coverage gaps. 
 - Test non-deterministic AI outputs using structural/intent assertions, LLM-as-judge with rubrics, and human validation when needed. 
 - Ensure bulk uploads (e. g. , Excel-based ad campaigns) fail safely and report precise errors for malformed inputs. 
 - Verify automated rules (e. g. , spend alerts) fire correctly and stay silent when they shouldn't. 
 - Test WhatsApp bot conversations - Hinglish, one-word replies, angry customers, off-topic questions, prompt injection. 
 - Validate live, self-updating client reports to ensure data accuracy against ad platforms. 

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

- 3-5 years in software QA, with at least 2 years building CI-integrated automation. 
 - Hands-on experience using Claude Code (or similar coding agent) to write, debug, and maintain test suites - must show a working suite built this way. 
 - Proficient with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI testing, and Postman, pytest, or REST Assured for API testing. 
 - Comfortable reading and testing code in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Skilled at testing non-deterministic outputs - assertions on structure/intent, LLM-as-judge with rubrics, and knowing when human judgment is needed. 
 - Ability to write clear, concise, and actionable bug reports and test cases - no padding, just specifics. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL to validate data directly in the database, not just UI. 

Preferred

- Experience testing chatbots or WhatsApp Business API flows. 
 - Exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, or ad-tech platforms. 
 - Familiarity with MCP servers (e. g. , Playwright MCP), GitHub Actions, or Docker. 
 - Basic load testing experience with k6, Locust, or JMeter. 

Benefits & Culture Highlights

- Small, fast team - bugs you find get fixed in days, not quarters. 
 - Build QA automation from the ground up - you choose tools, structure, and what to automate first. 
 - Flat hierarchy - no layers between you and release decisions. 
 - Direct client exposure - see how brands use your work and learn the ad industry. 
 - Work at the edge of AI testing - help write the playbook as you go. 
 - Offsites, learning budget, and an open culture for asking questions. 

Skills: typescript, rest assured, k6, claude code, python, selenium, sql, github actions, pytest, javascript, cypress, playwright

data.title: Validation Engineer
data.description:
Posha builds cooking robots that live inside your kitchen and cook food for you completely autonomously. Posha robots use Artificial Intelligence enabled Computer Vision to consistently and reliably cook the best food for our users 🥘

See it in action: https: //bit. ly/howposhaworks

Posha is backed by Tier-1 VCs 💙. These include Accel Partners, Waterbridge Ventures and a clutch of ambitious founders including Binny Bansal (Flipkart), Samay Kohli (Grey Orange Robotics)

What can I expect from this role? 🤔

- You'll be Posha's first dedicated validation hire. Today, validation is performed informally by engineers and technicians alongside their regular design work - there is no independent validation function. You're being brought in to build that function from the ground up. 
 - This is an individual contributor role to start, working hands-on and coordinating technicians to execute tests. As you demonstrate ownership, judgement and results, there's a clear path to growing into a Validation Manager building out a team under you. 
 - Location is Bengaluru, and this is a work-from-office role - no remote or hybrid option. 

What will my work responsibilities look like if I join Posha?🔧

- Translate product and system requirements into a formal Design Validation Plan (DVP) and Product Validation Plan (PVP) spanning mechanical, electrical and firmware/system-level behavior. 
 - Define test requirements, test specifications and pass/fail criteria for each requirement. 
 - Write test procedures and execute verification and validation testing across the product. 
 - Direct technicians to build test setups and test rigs needed to run these tests. 
 - Where a test needs external lab support ; compliance, environmental, reliability chambers and the like - own that engagement end-to-end: scoping, scheduling and interpreting results. 
 - Build validation processes, documentation and tooling essentially from zero, replacing today's informal "kitchen validation" approach with something rigorous and repeatable. 
 - Own the product development lifecycle from a product quality perspective end-to-end, not just execute tests handed down to you. 
 - Identify and source product/system requirements proactively, including going and finding them when they aren't already handed to you. 
 - Participate in DFMEA activities and build test plans driven by the risks identified there, combined with available specification sheets. 
 - Where spec sheets or formal requirements don't exist, develop reasonable estimates and theoretical justification to back the validation and verification approach rather than stalling for a spec. 
 - Define acceptance test protocols for incoming components and subassemblies. 
 - Root-cause test failures and work closely with design engineers to close the loop. 
 - Maintain a requirements-to-test-case-to-results traceability matrix. 
 - Set up systematic data logging and reporting for test results. 
 - Good at instrumentation and equipment for measurement

What makes you a match for us? 😍

- Experience can range anywhere from about 3 to 6 years - what matters far more than years on paper is the right approach: rigour, coverage-mindedness and a genuine drive to protect product quality. 
 - Background in consumer hardware or appliances is useful but not required. We're equally open to adjacent domains ; automotive, industrial, medical devices, electronics manufacturing and similar. 
 - Comfortable defining test methodology from a blank page, not just executing an existing plan handed to you. 
 - Able to manage technicians and external lab or vendor relationships to get tests done on time. 
 - Good to have: familiarity with compliance and certification processes such as UL and FCC. 

Working at Posha🚀

- What users have to say about our Product
 - Twitter love from users
 - How does Posha cook
 - Our Website
 - Read Our Story 📕

Why Posha?

- Attractive Compensation, ESOPS, Personalized L&D budgets are some benefits that we offer - but these are par for the course. We go beyond this. 
 - We believe that Posha is a generational company with the opportunity to alter the trajectory of how food is cooked inside homes today. This opportunity is parallel to how autonomous cars have started making an impact. 
 - The Validation Engineer / Manager role will be at the forefront of this opportunity, standing up a function that doesn't exist yet and setting the bar for product quality as we scale toward production.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

 - Own complex implementations at component/module level. 
 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team's agreed standards and best practices
 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. Id: 20973

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead
data.description:
Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks. 

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails. 

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

- Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems. 
 - Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns. 
 - Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform. 

2. AI Application Development

- Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation. 
 - Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes. 
 - Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems. 
 - Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. 
 - Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components. 

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

- Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models. 
 - Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases. 
 - Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider. 

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

- Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs. 
 - Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules. 
 - Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP. 
 - Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance. 
 - Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership. 

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

- Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs. 
 - Design human-approval workflows where required. 
 - Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability. 
 - Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models. 
 - Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements. 

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs). 
 - Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI

- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability. 

Programming & Application Development

- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node. js/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration. 

AI Frameworks & SDKs

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology. 

LLM Integration

- Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs. 

Data Engineering & RAG

- Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies. 
 - Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG. 
 - Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture. 

Cloud Platforms

- Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 
 - Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools. 
 - Ollama and open-source LLMs. 
 - Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation. 
 - AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation. 
 - Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection. 
 - Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations. 
 - AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices. 
 - Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace. 
 - Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software. 
 - Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches. 

What We're Looking For

- A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions. 
 - Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking. 
 - A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions. 
 - Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills. 

Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!

data.description:
Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases (CE&IG) is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the LH2, LNG and industrial gases industries. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with over USD 1. 2B in annual revenue, 8, 000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. 

Job Overview

Summary/Objective: 

We are looking for an experienced engineer with 8-12 years of experience, who can work with supplier and ensure their deliverables and develop them to our expectation to meet the growing business volume and help to deliver good quality products withing stipulated delivery time. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing new suppliers, improving existing supplier capabilities, localizing components for group companies, ensuring supplier quality and delivery performance, and coordinating with global teams for technical and localization requirements. 

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of raw material, P&ID components, ASME code and have excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to independently drive supplier development projects from identification through successful production

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

- Identify, evaluate, and develop new suppliers based on technical, quality, capacity, cost, and delivery requirements. 
 - Conduct supplier capability assessments and evaluate manufacturing infrastructure, processes, quality systems, and capacity. 
 - Develop suppliers for P& ID parts, machined, cast, fabricated, forged, and other engineering components. 
 - Identify suitable local suppliers and develop them to meet global quality and technical standards. 
 - Drive improvement projects from supplier identification → feasibility → sample development → validation → PPAP/approval → production stabilization. 
 - Resolve technical and quality issues during development in coordination with global teams. 
 - Ensure consistent quality of components received from suppliers. 
 - Monitor supplier quality performance through PPM, rejection, rework, customer complaints, and other quality KPIs. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for supplier quality issues. 
 - Work closely with suppliers to implement CAPA, RCA, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Establish process controls and inspection standards at supplier locations. 
 - Conduct regular supplier visits and process audits. 
 - Development & qualification of supplier product / process of newly purchased parts through the process working with Sourcing, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing. 
 - Support to Supplier process to develop suppliers and products to the point of successful/on-time Production Part Approval Process and Customer needs. 
 - Coordinates with engineering, manufacturing engineering, procurement and supplier quality on component quality / delivery issues and supplier initiatives to minimize the waste and control the cost, prepare monthly reports (MER). 
 - Provide support role to Quality to ensure supplier on-time product part approval process, Run at Rate and Delivery. 
 - Interfaces with the suppliers' engineering, manufacturing and procurement departments the respective internal departments to drive cost effective manufacturing process improvements that optimize throughput and minimize waste. 
 - Perform in-depth quality system assessments across commodities to confirm supplier structure, level of lean implementation, and effectiveness of the quality management system. 
 - Perform annual supplier audits as required. 

Authorities

- Work with vendor and improve their performance, help in material clearance while working closely with internal quality team, periodic vendor audits

Supervisory Responsibility

- Establish and monitor supplier performance metrics covering Quality, Cost, Delivery, Development, and Service.

 - Coordinate effectively with procurement, quality, Manufacturing, logistics teams. 
 - Prepare and deliver professional management presentations, supplier review presentations, project updates, and performance reports. 
 - Responsibility of improving the performance and effectiveness of the IMS. 
 - Responsibility to Provide support of implementation of supplier related Engineering Changes involving major product design, process, supplier changes, as needed 
 - Assist company to perform cost reduction programs with suppliers, eliminate cost of rework

 - Facilitate supplier design reviews encompassing supplier design simulation, testing, and validation activities to ensure delivered quality at both the proto-type and product launch phase 
 - Project management, Review & reporting of pending RFQ, PO, Delivery

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers, and smartphones. 

Physical Demands

- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. 

Qualifications

Education, Experience and Skills: 

- 8-12 years of relevant experience in Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, Vendor Development, Sourcing, or Manufacturing Engineering. 
 - B. E. /B. Tech. - Mechanical Engineering, master's degree in management will be an added advantage 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of machining and casting processes. 
 - Proven experience in new supplier development and supplier qualification. 
 - Demonstrated experience in localization of components/parts, preferably for multinational or group companies. 
 - Experience in coordinating with global teams and international stakeholders. 
 - Strong knowledge of engineering drawings, GD&T, inspection methods, process capability, and manufacturing processes. 
 - Knowledge of PPAP, FMEA, RCA, and CAPA. 
 - Good understanding of supplier audits and quality management systems. 
 - Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to lead suppliers and cross-functional teams toward defined project objectives.

 - Good communication and interpersonal skills

Description

Do you thrive on solving complex problems? Do you enjoy diving under the surface to uncover how massively scalable systems with multiple dependencies work? Our preferred candidate possesses a high level of OO coding experience, combined with a demonstrated passion for software quality. As a QAE, you will work closely with product and engineering teams to create test strategies and drive initiatives that ultimately ensure our customers get what they want, when they want. You'll understand the big picture of how our features and products interact as you navigate through complex designs and code. You will work with software development engineers to ensure soundness of design, testability of their code, and determine the best testing and automation approaches. You will contribute to automation frameworks and automate test cases both at the API and UI levels, using Java and other languages. You'll be responsible for driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. 

- Demonstrated track record of delivering test automation, quality requirements, designing functional and performance test suites and producing deliverables that exceed commitments. 
 - Responsible for the creating test automation solutions, discovering current limitations and compatibilities between subsystems, the selection of new concepts and methodology, and the development of major routines and utilities. 
 - Generation of metrics and information that improve development practices on the team. 
 - Review and critique of technical requirements and software design specifications and software implementation. 
 - Instilling best practices for test suite automation and frameworks and documentation, making sure designs meet requirements, and delivering high quality software on tight schedules. 

Key job responsibilities

- Participate in the full development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and software quality needs. 
 - Writing and executing test plans, designing and developing test tools, automation, debugging and reporting code bugs and pushing quality upstream. 
 - Own the delivery of an entire software development test suites and frameworks. 
 - Work closely with the technical leaders to develop the best approach for testing our functionality at scale. You are capable of understanding the interaction between the components in a distributed system in order to ensure they are functioning properly. 
 - Create and execute appropriate test strategies and processes that align with business objectives and project timelines. 

About The Team

TAQ's diverse team of SDETs, QA Engineers, and Device Associates provides comprehensive testing support for customer-facing Relay products, including Carrier Products, Relay Mobile, and Relay Yard Automation, while also driving end-to-end testing between Relay Products.

 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience in UI and API automation testing (Selenium/SOAPUI)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in API & Mobile testing
 - Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control

▪ Experience working with trading, brokerage, financial services, or other complex business applications

▪ Familiarity with the thinkorswim platform or other desktop trading applications

▪ Experience partnering with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, security, performance engineering, and other technology organizations

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security. 

Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include

- Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions

You will provide strong operational and program leadership while working closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with the technical aspects of data product development, including architecture and cloud infrastructure, to effectively communicate with development teams.

 - Ability to identify and analyse complex business challenges (technical, operational, or client-related) and break them into smaller, manageable problems, support proposal creation and pre-sales activities. 
 - Experience in creating and maintaining data and product roadmaps, adjusting them based on changing priorities, feedback, and unforeseen challenges (risk and change management, risk mitigation). 
 - Ability to build strong relationships with multiple stakeholders, including developers, designers, marketing, sales, and leadership teams. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Operational leadership experience in overseeing the execution of operational processes and improving workflows for maximum efficiency.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote )
data.description:
Help build the open future of digital intelligence

At InnoCraft (trading as Matomo), we believe everyone has the right to data sovereignty, privacy and trusted analytics insights. 

Born from open source and backed by a global community, Matomo helps organisations understand their users and digital performance without surrendering ownership, privacy or control of their data. 

Today, Matomo is used on more than one million websites across 190 countries, supporting leading brands, national governments, universities and organisations in regulated industries. 

We are looking for a Product Engineer to help organisations make sense of their digital performance as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. You'll help decide which problems matter most, shape solutions and deliver software that gives customers clearer insights while protecting their privacy and ownership of their data. Working closely with Product and your engineering team, you'll have the trust and responsibility to take ideas through to measurable customer outcomes. 

This is an opportunity to take real ownership, solve challenging product and platform problems, and see your work make a difference in a widely used open-source product. 

Why this role matters

Customers need confidence in their data, a clear understanding of their users and tools that help them act on what they learn. As digital behaviour changes, Matomo needs to meet those needs while remaining accessible to smaller organisations and capable enough for demanding enterprise use. 

Our Product Engineering teams focus on five domains: Measurement Integrity, Human Analytics, AI Analytics & Digital Presence, Growth & Web, and Enterprise Platform. You'll work within one of these domains, collaborating across teams where customer problems and technical decisions overlap. 

You'll build new capabilities and improve a mature, widely used product. That means understanding existing systems, choosing practical solutions and evolving Matomo with care for the customers, open-source users, integrations and plugins that depend on it. ]

Your work will directly influence: 

- The accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers use to make decisions. 
 - How clearly customers understand human behaviour and their digital presence as AI changes how people discover and interact with them. 
 - How easily customers get started, find value and grow their use of Matomo. 
 - How effectively enterprise customers manage access, governance and integrations at scale. 

We make extensive use of approved AI tools throughout our engineering workflow, from exploring ideas and prototyping to building, reviewing and testing software. We expect you to use them to move faster and improve quality, while applying your own judgement and taking responsibility for the decisions you make and the software you ship. 

What you'll own

- Understand the problem. Work with Product, colleagues and customers to uncover needs, question assumptions and agree what a useful outcome looks like. 
 - Shape the solution. Explore options, test ideas through prototypes and make clear trade-offs about scope, complexity and what to deliver first. 
 - Build across the stack. Own the technical design and implementation, choosing practical solutions that fit the product and its existing systems. 
 - Build quality in from the start. Work with QA and Design as needed, considering privacy, security, accessibility, performance and compatibility throughout delivery. 
 - Deliver and learn. Ship in small increments, take responsibility for how your changes work in production, and use customer feedback and evidence to measure results and improve them. 
 - Use AI effectively throughout delivery. Give tools the context they need, challenge their suggestions and verify the results. Keep privacy, security and maintainability central to the work you ship. 

What you bring

- 5+ years experience delivering full-stack software, with the technical depth to investigate difficult problems and make sound design decisions. 
 - Product judgement and a drive to solve real customer problems. You can explain why a change is worth building and care whether people use and benefit from it. 
 - Confidence taking ownership of outcomes, clarifying problems and shaping solutions without needing every requirement spelled out in a ticket. 
 - Confidence working in mature systems, understanding existing behaviour and improving it without unnecessary rewrites. 
 - The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, privacy, security and backwards compatibility. 
 - Strong experience using AI throughout development: refining requirements, preparing clear context for prompts, building and testing solutions, and checking the results. You keep reusable AI skills and instructions up to date, follow developments in models and tools, and experiment with new ways to improve delivery and quality. 
 - Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly in a global, asynchronous environment 
 - A strong record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgement and delivering measurable outcomes

Helpful experience

- You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback. 
 - Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue. js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems. 
 - Experience in product management, UI/UX design or building your own product or business. 
 - Contributing to or maintaining open-source projects, or building plugins, APIs and integrations used across different environments. 
 - Analytics, data-intensive systems or enterprise software. 

You may not match every item, but you should bring strong capability in the core requirements and a clear record of creating meaningful impact. 

Why Matomo?

Matomo is for people who want their work to matter. 

You will help build technology that protects data privacy, strengthens digital sovereignty and gives organisations a genuine alternative to surveillance-based platforms. 

We are intentionally lean, globally distributed and backed by a worldwide open-source community. Important work is not buried under layers. You will have access to meaningful problems, the context behind decisions and the opportunity to influence what Matomo becomes next. 

We value people who take ownership, exercise strong judgement and turn complex problems into clear, valuable outcomes. People who raise standards, challenge assumptions and care about the complete result, not only their part of it. 

High performance at Matomo means choosing the work that matters most, moving it forward with urgency and leaving customers, colleagues and Matomo stronger because of your contribution. 

You will have freedom over where and, within the needs of your role, when you work. In return, we expect clear communication, dependable follow-through and accountability for outcomes. 

We also protect focused work through: 

- No-meeting Fridays 
 - No more than two days each week with late meetings 
 - No meetings after 10pm in any time zone

This is a place for people who want meaningful responsibility, visible impact and the opportunity to help build something globally significant. 

Benefits

- 100% remote working within your country of employment 
 - Flexible working hours, within the collaboration and coverage requirements of the role 
 - 25 days of paid annual leave 
 - Home-office equipment allowance 
 - Health insurance support, where applicable 
 - Mental-health and wellbeing support 
 - Paid volunteering day 
 - Pet bereavement leave

Benefits vary depending on the country of employment. 

Hiring Process

Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Hiring Manager/Behaviour interview→ Live Coding test (Final round)

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Matomo values what makes you unique. We're an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products. 

Fight for data privacy. Build the open future of digital intelligence. Create meaningful impact from anywhere. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust - Payments
data.description:
Role Overview

Join our Payments Engineering team and continue to build your expertise! We're looking for a collaborative Senior Software Engineer to help build and improve a world-class payment platform that impacts millions of users. 

This is your opportunity to take ownership of your work, support your team, and grow your skills in a supportive environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Collaboration : 

- Proactively collaborate with your team, communicating progress and helping to remove obstacles. 
 - Give and graciously receive direct, useful feedback to improve both your work and the team's processes. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help them grow their technical skills while contributing to a supportive team culture that adopts company values. 

Design & Development

- Design small systems or processes with collaborative support, making design choices that prioritize long-term maintainability and scalability. 
 - Actively participate in design reviews and improvement efforts, anticipating how your work affects upstream and downstream systems. 
 - Take ownership of the reliability of your deliverables and ensure quality and efficiency in your own work while supporting others to do the same. 

Quality & Operations

- Plan and execute validation for your systems, ensuring repeatable and traceable practices while understanding common failure points. 
 - Plan and execute validation for systems, utilizing repeatable and traceable practices to monitor performance and mitigate potential security or operational risks. 
 - Understand testing coverage and common failure points, contributing to documentation to ensure the team learns from every incident. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues (e. g. , latency, throughput bottlenecks) and propose improvements to our cloud-native environment. 

Tech Stack

- RUST, RESTful APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Cloud native. 

Required Skills

- Experience : 5 - 8 years of professional software development experience. 
 - Domain Knowledge : A deep understanding of the business, user needs, and the technical landscape. You can learn new business logic efficiently and mentor others on our systems and practices. 
 - Impact & Ownership : You take ownership of your projects, solve problems independently, and have a thorough understanding of the product. You actively participate in production, review others' contributions, and have informed opinions on strategic decisions. 
 - Strategic Mindset : You think beyond immediate tasks, using data and insights to weigh trade-offs and align decisions with long-term goals. 
 - Security Focus : You have a deep understanding of security, how it affects your domain, and experience with risk assessments and mitigations. 
 - Team Growth : A passion for growing your team and helping them contribute to their goals. 
 - Experience in designing and implementing "secure-by-design" systems that include robust monitoring, reporting, and root-cause analysis to handle the distributed nature of the cloud. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices : Continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (k8s). 
 - Rust Expertise : Deep professional experience building and scaling applications using Rust. 
 - Cloud Native Background : Proven track record migrating applications from on-prem to cloud (AWS, Kubernetes, or similar tools). 

Preferred Skills

- Previous experience with billing, financial systems, or high-volume payment gateways. 
 - Experience in a formal or informal technical leadership role (Team Lead or Lead Engineer). 

(ref: hirist. tech)
