data.title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Senior
data.description:
Your opportunity

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client's goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what's right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success - they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape. 

Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab's growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations - it's a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region. 

What you have

Key Responsibilities

At Schwab, you are empowered to make an impact on your career. Innovative thinking meets disciplined engineering as we challenge the status quo and strengthen the quality of digital experiences that serve our clients. 

This Senior Manager role will lead quality engineering and SDET practices for business-critical enterprise applications. The role combines hands-on automation architecture with technical leadership, partnering across product, development, architecture, operations, and risk teams to build quality into every stage of delivery. 

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic quality leader who can independently drive large-scale initiatives, modernize automation frameworks, coach engineers, and improve release confidence through measurable, risk-based testing. 

AI-enabled quality engineering is a core expectation of this position. The leader will establish practical, governed use of AI agents and coding assistants to accelerate test design, framework development, end-to-end regression automation, failure analysis, and continuous quality improvement while maintaining human review, security, privacy, traceability, and reliability controls. 

- Drive quality strategy and successful execution for complex, business-critical programs, aligning test coverage, automation, release readiness, and quality outcomes with organizational objectives. 
 - Architect, develop, and evolve scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript and Selenium with Java, applying reusable design patterns, reliable synchronization, test-data management, and actionable failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish an effective quality-engineering approach across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, API, database, accessibility, compatibility, and non-functional testing, with appropriate use of exploratory and risk-based testing. 
 - Validate data integrity and backend processing through advanced SQL across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including source-to-target reconciliation, stored procedure validation, and troubleshooting of complex application workflows. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub-based workflows; improve execution speed, stability, reporting, environment readiness, and defect traceability using modern test and quality-management tooling. 
 - Lead test planning, estimation, quality metrics, defect triage, root-cause analysis, release risk assessments, and production-quality reviews, distinguishing product defects from automation or environment instability. 
 - Guide and mentor SDETs and QA engineers, set coding and automation standards, conduct design and code reviews, and foster accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence. 
 - Partner with geographically distributed product, engineering, architecture, DevOps, operations, compliance, and vendor teams to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and deliver secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions. 

Required Qualifications

Preffered Qualification

- Contribute to long-term quality-engineering roadmaps, platform modernization, tooling decisions, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted testing while following data privacy and company-policy guardrails. 
 - Define and lead an AI-enabled quality-engineering strategy, including the creation and governed use of specialized testing agents for requirement analysis, test-case generation, automation development, test-data preparation, code review, regression-suite maintenance, defect reproduction, and failure triage. 
 - Build and maintain enterprise end-to-end regression suites and reusable test frameworks using Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Selenium, mabl, API automation, and AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude, with mandatory human validation of generated code, tests, assertions, and conclusions. 
 - Create agent instructions, reusable prompts, repository context, tool integrations, and evaluation criteria that enable AI agents to consistently follow application architecture, coding standards, testing patterns, security controls, and quality gates. 
 - Own GitHub engineering administration and governance for quality repositories, including repository structure, branching strategy, pull-request controls, access management, protected branches, secrets usage, dependency management, release tagging, reusable workflows, auditability, and quality dashboards. 
 - Design, manage, and continuously improve CI/CD and test-execution pipelines across GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Bamboo, including pipeline-as-code, parallel and distributed execution, environment orchestration, test selection, artifact retention, reporting, failure notifications, and release gates. 
 - Lead adoption and governance of mabl for agentic and low-code test automation, including browser and API coverage, reusable flows, test plans, environment configurations, CI/CD integration, intelligent test maintenance, and alignment with the broader Playwright and Selenium automation strategy. 
 - Establish controls for responsible AI use in quality engineering, including approved-tool usage, data classification and privacy protection, restricted handling of credentials and production data, prompt and output review, model-risk awareness, reproducibility, evidence retention, and monitoring for inaccurate or unsafe AI-generated results. 
 - Define measurable AI and automation outcomes such as regression coverage, execution duration, flaky-test rate, escaped defects, failure-triage time, maintainability, adoption, and productivity, using metrics to guide investment and continuous improvement. 
 - 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, QA automation, SET, or SDET roles, including 5+ years leading engineers or major quality-engineering initiatives for enterprise applications. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus strong experience with Java and Selenium WebDriver. 
 - Strong experience testing web applications, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using appropriate automation libraries and API tools such as REST Assured, Postman, or equivalent. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and database validation across Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including complex queries, data reconciliation, backend troubleshooting, and performance-aware test design. 
 - Experience integrating automated suites with CI/CD and source-control workflows using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS DevOps, or comparable platforms; practical knowledge of containers and cloud-based test execution. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of Page Object or Screenplay patterns, test pyramids, contract testing, mocking or service virtualization, TDD/BDD, parallel execution, cross-browser testing, and dependable test-data strategies. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence, Xray, Zephyr, TestRail, qTest, or equivalent, along with clear quality metrics and executive-ready reporting. 
 - Working knowledge of accessibility, security, performance, and observability testing, JMeter or k6, Splunk, and application-log analysis. 
 - Proven ability to work independently, lead multiple large-scale efforts, influence technical decisions, communicate risks clearly, and collaborate effectively in Agile environments. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience applying generative AI and agentic AI to software quality engineering, including the creation or configuration of testing agents and the use of AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or comparable enterprise-approved platforms to design tests, generate and review automation code, create end-to-end regression suites, maintain frameworks, and analyze failures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate AI-generated tests and code for functional correctness, determinism, security, privacy, maintainability, coverage, bias, hallucination risk, and compliance with enterprise engineering standards; candidates must be able to keep a human-in-the-loop for material quality and release decisions. 
 - Advanced ownership of GitHub repository management and governance, including permissions, branching, pull requests, protected branches, secrets, reusable workflows, dependency controls, release management, auditability, and integration with enterprise CI/CD and quality tooling. 
 - Strong experience designing and operating production-grade automation pipelines with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Bamboo, including pipeline-as-code, parallel execution, environment and test-data orchestration, reports and artifacts, notifications, quality gates, failure recovery, and troubleshooting. 
 - Hands-on experience with mabl or a comparable intelligent test-automation platform, including authoring and maintaining browser and API tests, reusable flows, execution plans, environment configuration, CI/CD integration, result analysis, and governed use of AI-assisted capabilities. 
 - Experience integrating AI agents with test-management, observability, source-control, CI/CD, and engineering workflows through APIs, webhooks, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Experience establishing reusable AI prompts, agent instructions, contextual grounding, evaluation datasets or benchmark scenarios, and acceptance criteria for AI-assisted testing workflows, with clear versioning and traceability in source control. 
 - Experience in financial services, brokerage, wealth management, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy Selenium suites to Playwright and improving flaky-test detection, execution time, coverage, and maintainability. 
 - Knowledge of AWS, GCP, or Azure; Kubernetes/Docker; mobile automation with Appium; event-driven systems; and data-pipeline testing. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, automation development, code review, and failure triage, with human validation and appropriate privacy controls. 
 - Relevant quality, Agile, cloud, security, or testing certifications. 
 - Experience defining an enterprise adoption roadmap for AI-enabled testing, including proof-of-value criteria, tool evaluation, licensing and usage controls, training, reusable assets, governance, and scaled rollout across multiple teams. 
 - Knowledge of testing AI-enabled application features, including validation of model responses, grounding, prompt behavior, safety controls, non-deterministic outcomes, latency, reliability, and regression evaluation. 

What's in it for you

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security. 

Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include

- Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
 - Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
 - Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
 - Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 - Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
 - Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work
 - Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a sharp, ownership-driven QA Manager who can run a team of 4-5 QA engineers while remaining hands-on as an individual contributor. 

This is a player-coach role: you will personally own test strategy and execution for critical modules, while also leading, mentoring, and unblocking a small QA team, and driving AI-first ways of working across the function. 

You Deeply Understand Systems, Identify Risks Early, And Hold Your Team To The Same Bar Of Quality And Curiosity That You Hold Yourself Team Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4-5 QA engineers, providing technical direction and career guidance. 
 - Plan and distribute work across the team; balance workload against sprint and release commitments. 
 - Review team members' test plans, test cases, and automation code; hold the line on quality standards. 
 - Run 1: 1s, contribute to performance reviews, and support hiring/interviewing for QA roles. 
 - Act as the QA point of contact for developers, product managers, and delivery stakeholders. 
 - Escalate and unblock issues for the team without slipping into micromanagement. 
 - Individual Contribution: 
 - Own end-to-end quality for at least one critical module or product as a hands-on tester. 
 - Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies (Functional, API, UI, Regression, E2E). 
 - Perform hands-on API testing using tools like Postman / Playwright / similar. 
 - Build and maintain automation frameworks (UI/API) that the rest of the team builds on. 
 - Identify edge cases, hidden risks, and potential production issues proactively. 
 - Process & Quality Ownership: 
 - Own the defect triage process and root cause analysis across the team's scope. 
 - Contribute to and oversee CI/CD pipeline integration of automated test suites. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in QA processes, test coverage, and release quality org-wide. 
 - Report on team quality metrics, release readiness, and risk to leadership. 
 - AI-First Quality Engineering: 
 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate test case creation, test data generation, and defect analysis - for yourself and the team. 
 - Use AI-assisted automation for smarter test coverage and faster feedback cycles. 
 - Explore and implement AI-driven testing approaches (self-healing locators, visual validation, anomaly detection). 
 - Utilize AI for root cause analysis, log analysis, and predictive risk identification. 
 - Continuously evaluate and roll out new AI tools across the team to improve QA efficiency. 
 - Own the team's adoption of AI-driven QA workflows and agentic testing Required Skills & Qualifications: 
 - 6+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance. 
 - 2+ years leading, mentoring, or informally guiding a QA team (formal title not required). 
 - Proven ability to balance hands-on IC delivery with people leadership. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation tools (e. g. , Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, etc. ). 
 - Solid experience in API testing and backend validation. 
 - Good understanding of databases and ability to write SQL queries. 
 - Experience with bug tracking and test management tools. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD tools and version control (Git). 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills. 
 - What We Value (Beyond Skills) : 
 - High ownership mindset - accountable for the team's quality output, not just your own. 
 - Servant leadership - ability to unblock and grow the team without micromanaging. 
 - Strong logical thinking and ability to break down complex problems. 
 - Curiosity to understand systems deeply, not just at surface level. 
 - Ability to ask the right questions and challenge assumptions. 
 - Openness to adopt AI-first ways of working and continuously evolve. 
 - Clear and professional communication with both the team and leadership. 
 - Good to Have : 
 - Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, k6, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of security testing basics (OWASP concepts). 
 - Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with visual testing or accessibility testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI tools or frameworks in testing. 
 - Prior experience hiring or interviewing QA candidates.

Job Description

Are you looking to apply your skills contributing to a next generation of Database cloud services? Are you calm and collected when others panic under pressure? Do you get a thrill from solving really tough problems? Do you light up in conversations about uptime, horizontal scalability, performance, security, and DevOps?

The Autonomous AI Database Team is responsible for building the cloud service framework powering various Oracle Autonomous AI Database cloud services, including Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP). The framework automates deployment, scaling and management of databases in the cloud. It is built on top of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Layer. 

The autonomous AI database cloud service framework features APIs to handle all lifecycle management operations of databases. It also performs operations autonomously based on internal and external events. The team has the unique opportunity to make significant contributions to the full stack of Oracle technology, from database kernel to cloud service platform and to customer-facing portals. 

As a Site reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and deploying autonomous database services with deep focus on architecture, production operations, capacity planning, performance management, deployment, and release engineering. You will work with multiple cross-functional teams helping deliver new and outstanding experiences to our stakeholders while ensuring reliability and performance. 

We are a dynamic and enthusiastic team with great emphasis on go-getters and proactive individuals. 

Overview from oracle. com with links to other collateral: 

https: //cloud. oracle. com/en_US/datawarehouse

https: //www. oracle. com/database/autonomous-database/feature. html

Career Level - IC3

Responsibilities

In this role you will need to: 

Take ownership of the implementation and production operations of a wide array of core system platform solutions

React to production deficiencies by continuously implementing automation, self-healing, and real-time monitoring to production systems

Be a strong contributor to development of platform services including architecture, provisioning, configuration, deployment, and support

Partner with the distributed team in prototyping new database platform services

Stay informed of cloud infrastructure stacks

Innovate

Preferred Qualifications: 

Degree level : BE/BS/MS

Programming languages like Python, Java

Expert knowledge and in-depth experience of the Oracle Engineered systems and subsystems. 

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware/software issues, restore environments to an operational state, perform root cause analysis and provide forward thinking mitigation strategies

Expert level understanding, implementation experience and troubleshooting of Oracle Database technology including RAC, Dataguard, ASM, RMAN etc

Demonstrated operations experience with Linux platform (i. e. RHEL, OEL) including administration, management, and troubleshooting

Strong communication and analytical skills

Familiarity with security practices in web application delivery and General knowledge of network topology

Experience with configuration management tools

*Core Competencies: *

- Extensive expertise in Oracle Engineered Systems and subsystems with hands-on experience in deployment, optimization, and maintenance. 
 - Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, restore system functionality, conduct root cause analysis, and implement proactive mitigation strategies. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Oracle Database technologies, including RAC, Data Guard, ASM, RMAN, and performance tuning, with a focus on implementation and troubleshooting. 
 - Operational mastery of Linux platforms (e. g. , RHEL, OEL), including system administration, maintenance, and issue resolution. 
 - Strong experience in automation using Python and shell scripting to develop custom solutions, streamline processes, and improve system efficiency. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (OCI, AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. 
 - Excellent communication skills paired with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Working knowledge of security best practices for web application delivery and familiarity with network infrastructure concepts. 
 - Proficiency in utilizing configuration management tools to streamline system operations.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. data.title: Senior Quality Tester
data.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

Job Description

Job Location: Bangalore

We are looking for an AI Quality Tester (Manual & Automation) to bridge the gap between traditional quality assurance and the future of AI-driven testing. In this role, you won't just write scripts; you will balance a strong foundation in manual exploratory testing with the adoption of cutting-edge AI automation tools. You will be responsible for designing thoughtful test strategies, manually validating complex user journeys, and leveraging low-code/AI tools (like UiPath, Gemini, or Claude) to scale our automation loops and ensure "zero critical bugs" reach production. 

We think you'll be a good fit if you have: 

- 4+ years of experience in test automation, with an openness or early experience in leveraging AI tools (like Claude, Gemini, or UiPath) to speed up test creation and manual test case generation. 
 - Low-Code & RPA Mastery: Proficiency in high-performance low-code platforms like UiPath, with a focus on integrating these with AI Agent Builders. 
 - Agentic Systems Knowledge: An understanding of how to test and govern AI agents, ensuring they operate predictably, ethically, and securely. 
 - Architectural Vision: Ability to translate complex business and technical realities into automated strategies that support Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) at scale. 
 - Leadership Approach: A highly collaborative approach, with a track record of building consensus and driving action. A high degree of leadership, initiative, responsibility, and assertiveness. 
 - Communication Leadership: Excellent skills in articulating complex AI and automation concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

In This Role, You Will

- Evolve the Automation Excellence Strategy: Design intricate, self-healing test scripts and frameworks that adapt to application and agent changes automatically using AI. 
 - End-to-End Business Validation: Manually map out complex business workflows and determine the optimal mix of manual and automated testing to validate them. 
 - Eliminate Technical Debt: Drive quality practices that use AI-powered reviews to proactively detect issues in architecture, maintainability, and performance every 12 hours. 
 - Liaise for Excellence: Collaborate with diverse teams - including R&D, Security, TechOps, Digital Transformation, Cloud, and Service Delivery - to build a foundation for AI-native software that meets the highest enterprise-grade standards

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform. 

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact. 

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration. 

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1, 700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees. 

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries- such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA-who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact. 

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports. 

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems. 

What do we have to offer you?

- A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don't just react to AI innovation-we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse. 
 - Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there. 
 - A global collective of world-class talent, where you'll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries-they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together. 

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. data.title: Quality and Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

The Quality Engineer designs, develops, and maintains automated quality solutions that provide fast, reliable feedback throughout the delivery lifecycle. Working as an embedded member of an Agile engineering team, this role combines exploratory testing with code-based automation across services, interfaces, data flows, and user experiences. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

- Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into maintainable automated tests and focused exploratory testing for functional and integration risks. 
 - Develop automation for APIs, services, web, interfaces, databases, events, and end-to-end business workflows using approved frameworks and coding standards. 
 - Apply the test pyramid and risk-based coverage principles, emphasizing stable unit-adjacent, component, API, contract, and integration checks over brittle end-to-end tests. 
 - Create reusable test utilities, fixtures, page or service objects, data builders, mocks, and service-virtualization assets that improve delivery speed and maintainability. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines; diagnose failures, remove flaky behavior, and keep execution time and feedback quality within team targets. 
 - Validate positive, negative, boundary, error-handling, authorization, compatibility, accessibility, and recovery scenarios appropriate to the product risk. 
 - Prepare and manage test data in accordance with privacy, security, masking, retention, and environment-control requirements. 
 - Review stories, designs, code changes, logs, and telemetry to identify testability gaps and defects before release. 
 - Document defects with clear evidence, business impact, and reproducible conditions; partner with developers on root-cause analysis and verification. 
 - Participate in refinement, planning, design discussions, code reviews, quality reviews, and release-readiness activities as a full engineering team member. 
 - Monitor automation results and quality signals; communicate coverage, failures, residual risk, and readiness without relying on pass-rate alone. 
 - Contribute improvements to team frameworks, standards, documentation, and engineering practices. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 3+ years in software quality engineering or software development with meaningful hands-on test automation experience. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language and experience with UI and API automation, SQL, Git, build tools, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of HTTP, REST or event-driven integrations, databases, application architecture, and common debugging techniques. 
 - Ability to design clear test scenarios, write maintainable code, analyze failures across system layers, and balance speed with coverage. 
 - Strong collaboration, ownership, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with cloud platforms, containers, contract testing, performance testing, accessibility testing, or observability tools. 
 - Exposure to healthcare systems, regulated data, interoperability, or privacy-conscious test-data management. |

Additional Information

ELLKAY is committed to fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment that supports innovation, teamwork, and professional growth. Most roles are designed to operate from our office locations to encourage effective collaboration and engagement across teams. 

Any alternative work arrangements may be considered at the company's discretion based on role requirements and business needs. 

For more information about our company, please visit www. ELLKAY. com . 

ELLKAY is a Smoke-Free Workplace. 

ELLKAY, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

data.title: Senior Manager, Application Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new application software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents that clarify application design and code. Leads application-focused code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project. Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix application issues across multiple components or functional areas. Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Leads teams to design and develop application software, systems, and services. Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding application-related issues. Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of the group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, application development best practices and processes, and coding standards. Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria. Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application Software Development: 

- Leads multiple teams or a small group owning a significant application surface area (e. g. , multiple services/features) with measurable reliability, security, and performance outcomes. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements. 
 - Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project. 
 - Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas. 
 - Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. 
 - Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services. 
 - Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards. 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus. 
 - Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. 
 - Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed. 
 - Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards. 
 - Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria. 
 - Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. 
 - Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. 
 - Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. 
 - Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. 
 - Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. 
 - Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. 
 - Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. 
 - Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. 
 - Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. 
 - Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

You will drive an automation-first operating model, turning recurring operational tasks into reliable, reusable software and workflows. You will use AI-assisted design, development, and automation to accelerate engineering work, improve troubleshooting, and reduce manual effort while maintaining production safety and engineering quality. 

This role combines independent technical ownership, production reliability, and collaboration across development, infrastructure, security, and cloud service teams. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Independently design, build, test, and operate tools and frameworks that improve the reliability and usability of NonProduction environments. 
 - Develop self-service capabilities for environment provisioning, service onboarding, deployment, configuration, health validation, and troubleshooting. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries, APIs, command-line tools, and workflow integrations with clear interfaces, documentation, and ownership. 
 - Engineer and improve development, integration, test, and release-validation pipelines, including build orchestration, artifact promotion, and failure diagnosis. 
 - Automate NonProduction environment lifecycle activities, including provisioning, upgrades, configuration synchronization, drift detection, and cleanup. 
 - Build observability capabilities using metrics, logs, traces, deployment events, and environment metadata to explain platform and application health. 
 - Develop dashboards and diagnostic tools that correlate service versions, configuration, feature flags, dependencies, and recent changes. 
 - Define and measure the reliability of DevEx services and NonProduction platforms, including availability, provisioning time, pipeline success, deployment duration, and recovery time. 
 - Build automated health checks and validation frameworks that detect environment issues and provide actionable diagnostic evidence. 
 - Develop AI-assisted tools, skills, or agents for pipeline failure analysis, log investigation, environment comparison, knowledge retrieval, and guided troubleshooting. 
 - Evaluate AI-assisted capabilities against representative scenarios for accuracy, usefulness, and safe failure handling; validate outcomes before adoption. 
 - Implement secure automation with appropriate permissions, secrets handling, auditability, recovery procedures, and approval boundaries. 
 - Improve NonProduction resource utilization through rightsizing, lifecycle policies, and automated identification of idle or orphaned resources. 
 - Support designated NonProduction platforms, investigate recurring issues, and turn support findings into durable tooling and framework improvements. 
 - Partner with developers, QA, release engineering, SRE, and security teams to identify friction and prioritize improvements. 
 - Evaluate echnical tradeoffs across reliability, performance, scalability, security, cost, and operational complexity; document design decisions and recommend solutions aligned with service objectives and delivery needs. 
 - Participate in the scheduled oncall rotation and support Production environments, including after-hours coverage; triage alerts, respond to incidents, coordinate escalations, restore service, and ensure clear handovers and follow-up actions. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, onboarding guides, runbooks, and examples; contribute to code reviews and engineering standards. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Professional experience in platform engineering, developer tooling, SRE, DevOps, infrastructure software, or backend software engineering, including ownership of production systems. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language, with experience building maintainable tools, services, or frameworks. 
 - Experience designing reusable interfaces, integrating APIs, and developing automated tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux, Git, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform(OCI, AWS, or Azure). 
 - Experience developing infrastructure-as-code modules using Terraform or an equivalent tool. 
 - Experience building, troubleshooting, or improving CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience implementing observability using metrics, logs, dashboards, or distributed tracing. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across application dependencies, Kubernetes, infrastructure, and networking fundamentals. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify developer friction or repetitive support work and address it through automation or self-service capabilities. 
 - Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, including reviewing generated code and validating results. 
 - Ability to independently deliver well-scoped projects and collaborate effectively with users of the platform. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with OCI, including OKE, IAM, networking, Object Storage, and DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, portals, command-line tools, or workflow frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, centralized logging, and telemetry correlation. 
 - Experience with environment metadata, configuration drift analysis, feature-flag tooling, artifact/BOM management, or deployment comparison. 
 - Experience building AI-assisted diagnostic tools, retrieval-based knowledge systems, or agents integrated with operational APIs. 
 - Familiarity with agent evaluation, permission boundaries, human approval workflows, and safe tool execution. 
 - Experience with event-driven automation, asynchronous workflows, idempotency, retries, and partial-failure recovery. 
 - Experience supporting shared development and test environments with multiple teams or tenants. 
 - Experience measuring developer productivity and using adoption, reliability, and support data to guide improvements. 
 - Familiarity with NonProduction cloud cost optimization and resource lifecycle management.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Are you looking to apply your skills contributing to a next generation of Database cloud services? Are you calm and collected when others panic under pressure? Do you get a thrill from solving really tough problems? Do you light up in conversations about uptime, horizontal scalability, performance, security, and DevOps?

The Autonomous AI Database Team is responsible for building the cloud service framework powering various Oracle Autonomous AI Database cloud services, including Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) and Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP). The framework automates deployment, scaling and management of databases in the cloud. It is built on top of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Layer. 

The autonomous AI database cloud service framework features APIs to handle all lifecycle management operations of databases. It also performs operations autonomously based on internal and external events. The team has the unique opportunity to make significant contributions to the full stack of Oracle technology, from database kernel to cloud service platform and to customer-facing portals. 

As a Site reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and deploying autonomous database services with deep focus on architecture, production operations, capacity planning, performance management, deployment, and release engineering. You will work with multiple cross-functional teams helping deliver new and outstanding experiences to our stakeholders while ensuring reliability and performance. 

We are a dynamic and enthusiastic team with great emphasis on go-getters and proactive individuals.

data.title: Software Engineer I -Data Infrastructure
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 8B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Role

The Data Infrastructure Team is a lean, high-impact group operating in a true founder mode. We are responsible for building and safeguarding all data systems, managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade resources across 10+ types of data stores. Our core mission is to build self-serve, automated platforms that ensure our systems are efficient, scalable, and continuously evolving. We don't just operate systems-we invent them. 

What You Will Do

We are looking for enthusiastic, innovative engineers to join our engineering team as Software Engineers (SDE-1). In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to real-world projects from day one, and gain exposure to cutting-edge tools and technologies. You'll play a key role in building and optimizing products that reach millions of users globally. you will join one of our many teams to develop robust, well-designed products, implement new updates and features, and solve complex problems that affect our business and our clients. 

- Invent, design, and build self-serve, automated platforms for managing the lifecycle of 500+ production-grade data resources across 10+ data store types. 
 - Drive innovation by engineering foundational tooling for all engineering teams, such as the Database Proxy and the database replication services. 
 - Pioneer and execute complex projects like large-scale, zero-downtime database migrations. 
 - Go deep into technical architecture, distributed systems, protocol-level debugging, and performance optimization to ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and efficient at petabyte scale. 
 - Build and maintain the core foundations for strategic initiatives, including multi-region architecture, sandbox environments, and a comprehensive, Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code platform. 
 - Focus intensely on performance, observability, cost and operability to maintain infrastructure that just works, even when handling ~100 billion queries/day and 10 PB of data transfer. 
 - Write core libraries like middlewares, ORMs, proxies, rate limiters, shard routers (in Python and Go) to support scalability and developer experience. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from initial design and planning to successful rollout and operation. 

What You Will Have

- 1-2 years experience working with fast growing, top tier product companies
 - Strong coding in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or Go. 
 - Expert understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design principles and low level design
 - Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively in a collaborative environment
 - Understanding of system design and complex distributed systems
 - Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply them to solve real-world problems. 
 - Bonus points for open source contributions, competitive coding experience, and a strong Computer Science background from a Tier 1 institution. 

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling. com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

data.title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
data.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems. 

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 
 - Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms. 
 - Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues. 
 - Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones. 

Essential Requirements

- Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience. 
 - Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory). 
 - HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent. 
 - Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP. 
 - Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives. 

Desirable Experience

- Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects. 
 - Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems. 
 - Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). 
 - OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443). 
 - Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.

Job Purpose

Supervise the production of New Products (Textura, Kool n Seal & other products) and testing of all raw materials, in process & finished product so as to achieve targeted production as per specified quality norms to fulfill market demands. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

Job Context

Birla White is White Cement division of UltraTech Cement Limited and is a P&L centre. In India, BW is leader in White Cement as well as main Value Added Product Wall Care Putty with WC installed capacity of 680, 000 MT per annum and Wall Care Putty capacity of 8, 50, 000 MT per annum. Business has plans to increase White Cement capacity by another 7, 20, 000 MT and Wall Care Putty capacity by another 4, 50, 000 MT per annum. Birla White plant is fully integrated and automated processing. The plant is accredited with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, SA 8000, and OHSAS 18001. BW sells WC & WCP in multipack variants of 1 KG, 5KG, 20 KG, 25 KG, 40 KG and 50 KG. 

In White Cement category, there is only one major competitor M/s JK White Cement with BW commanding a Market Share of 52. 3% whereas in cement based putty, there are multiple competitors across organized and unorganized sector with BW commanding a market share of over 45. 5%. Over the years, WCP has grown to become major contributor to White Cement Industry and is contributing 60%-65% of the total revenues. The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our Generative AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products by composing powerful, safe and explainable AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, and shared services such as guardrails, observability and evals coupled with foundational model power of open-weight and proprietary frontier models.  - Hands-on experience working with cloud-based systems (e. g. , AWS or equivalent).

data.title: Technology Consultant - Senior Automation & AI Engineer
data.description:
India T&M Special Bonus: 

Req ID: 396166

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Technology Consultant - Senior Automation & AI Engineer to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN). 

Job Title: Technology Consultant - Senior Automation & AI Engineer

Location: Noida/Bengaluru

Overall Experience: 7-12+ Years

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation & AI Engineer with strong expertise in Intelligent Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Process Automation, and Enterprise Solution Development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automation and AI-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency, productivity, and business outcomes. 

The candidate should possess hands-on experience with Python, AI/ML frameworks, Generative AI platforms, workflow automation, APIs, cloud services, and integration technologies. The role will work closely with Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, Developers, Data Engineers, and Operations teams to identify automation opportunities and deliver scalable AI-powered solutions. 

Day to Day Job Duties

- Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered automation solutions across business and technology functions. 
 - Identify business processes suitable for automation and recommend appropriate AI and automation approaches. 
 - Develop intelligent workflows using AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and automation platforms. 
 - Build and integrate AI services utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, and AI-driven decision-making capabilities. 
 - Develop Python-based automation frameworks, utilities, APIs, and reusable components. 
 - Integrate enterprise systems using REST APIs, web services, databases, and middleware technologies. 
 - Design and implement AI assistants, copilots, chatbots, and workflow automation solutions. 
 - Work with structured and unstructured data for AI model training, inference, and process automation. 
 - Collaborate with business teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize AI model responses for business use cases. 
 - Monitor AI solution performance, accuracy, reliability, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Implement security, governance, compliance, and responsible AI best practices. 
 - Conduct troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization activities. 
 - Support SIT, UAT, deployment, production rollout, and post-production support activities. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, design reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on AI and automation best practices. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7-12+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Automation Engineering, AI Engineering, or related fields. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Python development and automation frameworks. 
 - Experience delivering AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI solutions in enterprise environments. 
 - Experience integrating applications using APIs, databases, and cloud services. 
 - Strong understanding of automation architectures and workflow orchestration concepts. 
 - Experience working with cloud-native applications and modern development practices. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Core Technical Skills

- Programming: Python, SQL, JavaScript
 - Generative AI: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LLM Integration
 - AI/ML: Machine Learning, NLP, Model Evaluation, AI Workflows
 - Prompt Engineering: Prompt Design, Optimization, AI Response Tuning
 - Automation Development: Workflow Automation, Business Process Automation, Intelligent Automation
 - Frameworks & Libraries: LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Hugging Face, AI SDKs
 - Integration Technologies: REST APIs, Web Services, API Integrations
 - Data Technologies: SQL, Vector Databases, Data Processing, Data Validation
 - Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP
 - DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
 - Security & Governance: Responsible AI, Data Privacy, Access Controls
 - Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, SDLC

Nice to Have

- Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or Power Automate. 
 - Experience building AI Agents, AI Assistants, and Autonomous Workflows. 
 - Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. 
 - Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, or Azure AI Search. 
 - Experience with document intelligence, OCR, and intelligent document processing solutions. 
 - Exposure to Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science projects. 
 - Experience implementing AI governance and compliance frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps, model deployment, and monitoring frameworks. 
 - Experience working on enterprise digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills. 

Preferred Experience Profile

- 7-12+ years of Software Engineering, Automation, or AI Engineering experience. 
 - Strong expertise in Python, APIs, and enterprise automation development. 
 - Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-powered solution development. 
 - Experience designing and implementing intelligent automation frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI integration patterns. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms and scalable enterprise architectures. 
 - Experience collaborating with business and technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to drive AI and Automation initiatives from concept through production deployment. 
 - Strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Passion for innovation, automation, and AI-driven transformation. 

Preferred Certifications

- Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure OpenAI Service (preferred)
 - AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty
 - Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
 - Microsoft Power Platform Certifications
 - UiPath Advanced Developer Certification (if applicable)
 - Generative AI or LLM-related certifications from recognized platforms. 

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D. 

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client's needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata. com, @nttdatafed. com and @talent. nttdataservices. com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https: //us. nttdata. com/en/contact-us.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https: //us. nttdata. com/en/contact-us.
