data.title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
data.description:
Position: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA

Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)

Work Type: Full-Time/Onsite

Experience: 8+ Years

PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on-premise environments. 

Roles & Responsibilities Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting. 
 - Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data-correctness risks. 
 - Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision. 
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality-first engineering culture. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams. 

Test Automation

- Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions. 
 - Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence. 
 - Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation. 

Functional & Migration Testing

- Own end-to-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios. 
 - Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases. 
 - Design test scenarios based on real-world customer data migration use cases. 
 - Validate migration correctness from source to destination. 
 - Test multi-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation. 
 - Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring. 

Data Validation & Integrity

- Build automated source-to-target data validation frameworks. 
 - Validate: 
 - Record counts 
 - Field-level accuracy 
 - Data mappings 
 - Relationships and associations 
 - Transformations 
 - Deduplication 
 - Overall data integrity 
 - Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results. 
 - Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent. Performance Testing

- Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing. 
 - Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations. 
 - Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them. 
 - Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline. 

Security Testing

- Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform. 
 - Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross-tenant data access is possible. 
 - Validate authentication and authorization controls. 
 - Perform input validation and abuse-case testing. 
 - Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD. 
 - Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors. 
 - Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence. 

Technical Quality & Delivery

- Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready. 
 - Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers to identify defects early. 
 - Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality. 
 - Support both cloud and on-premise deployments. 
 - Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation. 

Note: Should be highly self-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones. 

Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones

Required Skills

- 8+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience. 
 - Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium. 
 - Strong API and REST testing experience. 
 - Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools. 
 - Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Strong SQL and data-validation experience. 
 - Experience validating source-to-target data integrity across multiple systems. 
 - Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with on-premise/customer-deployed software is preferred. 
 - Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, containers, and IaC is a plus. 
 - Exposure to chaos/resilience testing or contract testing is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or other compliance audits is preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria. 

Education

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

Candidates must attend phone/video calls and in-person interviews as required. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience. 

Please email your resume to divyam@petadata. ai

After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.

data.title: Senior Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AIcompute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About the role: 

The ideal candidate will work with multi-functional global teams to design, implement and verify Boundary Scan, ATPG (Stuck-AT/AT-Speed) SCAN, MBIST, IO BIST and JTAG/IJTAG DFT features on our next generation highly complex server class processor products. Will work in close collaboration with test engineering team to deliver ATE patterns and post silicon bring-up and debug. 

What you'll achieve: 

- DFT features like EDT, SSN, shared bus based MBIST insertion, ijtag, simulation and debug on RTL and gates netlist for automotive applications. 
 - Verification of jtag/ijtag, MBIST features in RTL and GLS. 
 - Boundary Scan insertion, simulation and verification. 
 - Hands on knowledge in state-of-the-art EDA tools for DFT, design and verification (Mentor, Cadence, Synopsys)
 - STA DFT Test mode timing constraint development and analysis
 - In-depth knowledge of Verilog HDL and experience with simulators and waveform debugging tools 
 - ATE silicon debug and utilize scripting with perl/Tcl for efficient handling of ATE data

About you: 

- M. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 8+ years of semiconductor experience or B. Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 12+ years of semiconductor experience
 - Expert with methods and techniques to design, implement and verify regular and shared bus based Memory BIST on repairable and non-repairable memories using Electrical fuses. 
 - Expert knowledge and practical work experience partnering with designers to implement highly customized and tools-driven MBIST solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of MBIST algorithms needed for 5nm and lower technology nodes and ability to code new algorithms, operation sets supporting tool driven solutions for functional safety applications. 
 - Experience in implementing EDT, SSN, IST, boundary scan, jtag/ijtag features. 
 - Work independently to generate test plans, run simulations and debug failures on RTL and Gate Level
 - Hands on experience in the usage of industry standard tools, like Siemens Tessent Shell flow, or Synopsys SMS/SHS flow
 - Experience in Multimedia subsystems DFT (Image, display, video etc. )
 - Expert understanding tradeoffs to optimize coverage and test time reduction with the ability to foresee physical implementation and timing challenges during early development. 
 - Experience in working with physical design teams to support STA constraints, reviewing timing reports. 
 - Expert in using silicon debug/diagnosis tools to root cause silicon bringup and production test issue. 
 - Experience in setting up and running Scan DRC flows in RTL. 
 - Experience with industry standard simulation tools, including Verilog, and scripting languages like Perl, Python, Shell or Tcl. 
 - Experience in revision control systems like GIT, perforce etc. . 
 - Needs in depth experience in stuck at, transition delay, path delay, etc. coverage loss analysis and identifying solutions to improve test coverage
 - Experience in leading the effort to derive cell aware fault models and develop necessary flows to generate ATPG and to support silicon debug. 
 - Good knowledge of functional safety, clock domain crossing analysis, logic synthesis and scan insertion

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation. 

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. 

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do-powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us. 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Software Engineer on the CX-E Voice engineering team, you will develop, maintain, and enhance enterprise voice and unified messaging software. You will focus on sustaining engineering, investigating complex customer-reported issues, identifying root causes, fixing defects, and delivering reliable patches for released product versions. You will use your expertise in C++, Python, advanced debugging, and test automation to improve product quality and reliability across Linux and Windows environments. You will also leverage GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional to accelerate development and testing while ensuring the quality and correctness of AI-generated code. 

What The Role Offers

- Investigate, debug, and resolve complex production defects in the CX-E Voice back end. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis using logs, traces, crash dumps, WinDbg, and other debugging tools. 
 - Identify and fix memory leaks, heap corruption, concurrency issues, and other memory-related defects. 
 - Design, develop, and enhance back-end features using modern C++ across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Deliver bug fixes, hotfixes, and release patches within agreed timelines while maintaining product quality. 
 - Conduct impact analysis and regression risk assessments for fixes across supported product versions. 
 - Develop automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end tests using Python and Playwright. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to improve test coverage and release confidence. 
 - Use GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional for debugging, feature development, test creation, and refactoring. 
 - Review and validate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and quality. 
 - Contribute to requirements analysis, technical design, effort estimation, and the end-to-end software development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with QA, Support, Release Management, and global engineering teams to resolve issues and deliver releases. 
 - Share engineering best practices, improve developer productivity, and mentor other engineers. 

What You Will Need To Succeed

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent discipline. 
 - 8+ years of software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in C++, including modern C++, multithreading, and memory management.

 - Hands-on experience with Playwright for automated UI and web testing. 
 - Experience with pytest or other Python testing frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with gdb, core dump analysis, Wireshark, UMDH, Valgrind, and sanitizers. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle databases. 
 - Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills, including resolving complex production defects. 
 - Hands-on experience with WinDbg, including crash dump analysis and heap/memory diagnostics. 
 - Proven experience identifying and resolving memory leaks, heap corruption, and concurrency-related defects. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining functional, regression, and integration test suites. 
 - Proven hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Professional for development, debugging, and automated test creation. 
 - Experience with Git or similar source control tools and sustaining engineering activities, including defect fixes, patches, hotfixes, and version management. 
 - Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, FTP, and REST protocols. 
 - Knowledge of SIP, RTP, unified messaging, voicemail, or enterprise voice products. 
 - Experience with SVN, TeamForge, XML, JSON, web servers, Perl, or PowerShell. 
 - Experience with release engineering and maintaining multiple supported product versions.

data.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Cloud and AI)
data.description:
About GenAirate

GenAirate builds SnapLine, a submission intelligence platform that converts unstructured broker submissions (emails, PDFs, Excel, images) into structured, decision-ready data for underwriters. SnapLine was built for Lloyd's and the London Market and is now expanding into US specialty insurance. We are SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified. 

The role

You will build and run the product end to end: the interfaces underwriters use, the services behind them, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. A large part of the work is the document processing pipeline that turns messy, inconsistent submissions into reliable structured data. We are looking for someone who cares about how systems are designed, takes responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks, and does not need to be chased. 

What you'll do

- Design, build and ship full-stack features, from API and data model through to a UI that works for underwriters under time pressure
 - Build and improve document processing pipelines: ingestion, classification, OCR and parsing, extraction, validation and traceability back to the source document
 - Design architectures that are clean, efficient and cost-aware, and that hold up as submission volumes and document variety grow
 - Build event-driven services on AWS and GCP, with sound choices on queues, storage, concurrency and failure handling
 - Integrate LLM-based components (RAG, retrieval, agentic workflows) with proper evaluation, fallbacks and monitoring
 - Take ownership of what you ship: deployment, observability, reliability and fixing problems at the root rather than patching symptoms
 - Raise issues early, make clear technical decisions, and write them down so the wider team can build on them
 - Work with product and design to turn real underwriter workflows into clear, accessible interfaces
 - Apply secure development practice as a normal part of the job, in line with our certifications

What we're looking for

- 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering, with production full-stack experience
 - Strong Python and TypeScript, with React or a comparable frontend framework
 - Experience building data or document processing pipelines that handle messy, real-world inputs
 - Good architectural judgement: you can explain trade-offs in performance, cost, maintainability and reliability, and you simplify rather than over-engineer
 - Hands-on cloud experience on AWS or GCP, including containers (ECS or Kubernetes), queues or messaging, and infrastructure as code
 - Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, and both SQL and NoSQL stores
 - A track record of owning services in production: debugging, observability, incident response
 - A self-starter mindset: you take a problem from vague to shipped without close supervision
 - Clear written communication; you will be working across time zones with a UK and US team

Useful, not required

- Experience with LLM applications, vector search or OpenSearch, OCR or document AI tooling
 - Exposure to Bedrock, Pub/Sub, Firestore or similar services
 - Insurance or related financial services background. Not needed; we will teach the domain. 

What we offer

- Direct work on a product with live London Market and US customers
 - A small team where engineers have real ownership and influence on design
 - Competitive Compensation

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on something you have built and run in production to shravan@genairate. io.

data.title: Operations Manager
data.description:
Company Description SisuCare is dedicated to making healthcare careers more accessible across the U. S. , especially for individuals who face barriers related to cost, location, or background. The organization offers flexible, affordable training programs that are closely connected to real job opportunities, including hybrid classes and options for employer-sponsored tuition. 

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Operations Manager to serve as the senior management presence during the IST shift, overseeing the effective functioning of approximately 20 employees across multiple teams. 

Team Leads will continue to manage their respective functions. This Manager will work across teams to ensure that work gets done on time, company standards and SOPs are followed, quality is maintained, and Team Leads and employees remain accountable. 

This is not an administrative office-management role. It is an execution, accountability, quality and operational leadership position with authority to independently audit work across the organization. 

Key responsibilites: 

- Maintain a visible, hands-on management presence throughout the IST shift. 
 - Oversee daily execution across teams and ensure priorities, deadlines and deliverables are achieved. 
 - Hold Team Leads accountable for their teams' performance, productivity, quality and follow-through. 
 - Identify delays, bottlenecks, recurring mistakes and operational issues before they escalate. 
 - Ensure every significant issue has clear ownership, corrective action and a deadline. 
 - Conduct random and scheduled audits across departments to verify quality, accuracy, documentation and adherence to company standards and SOPs. 
 - Identify root causes of recurring errors and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented. 
 - Monitor operational KPIs, productivity, outstanding tasks and quality indicators. 
 - Ensure company policies, processes and management instructions are consistently followed. 
 - Coordinate cross-functional issues and prevent work from falling between departments. 
 - Recommend improvements to processes, SOPs, controls and operational workflows. 
 - Escalate significant performance, conduct, quality or compliance concerns to Executive Management. 
 - Provide a concise daily management report covering exceptions, missed deliverables, audit findings, corrective actions, recurring issues and matters requiring executive attention. 

Ideal Candidate: 

- 7-12+ years of professional experience, with significant operations/management responsibility. 
 - Proven experience managing Team Leads, supervisors or multi-functional teams. 
 - Experience overseeing approximately 15-50+ employees preferred. 
 - Strong background in operations, quality assurance, process management, audits or compliance. 
 - Highly organized, analytical and comfortable holding people accountable. 
 - Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills. 
 - Confident working directly with founders and senior management. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English. 
 - Experience in healthcare, education, technology, BPO/KPO or another process-driven/regulated environment is advantageous. 

What success looks like: 

Success means stronger operational discipline, fewer recurring errors, higher SOP compliance, timely completion of deliverables, faster resolution of issues, stronger Team Lead accountability and consistently high-quality work across the organization. 

We are looking for someone who is visible, proactive and execution-focused-someone who does not wait for problems to reach them, but actively understands what is happening across teams, identifies gaps early and ensures that commitments are followed through to completion.

data.title: Senior SDET – Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)
data.description:
Senior SDET - Automation Framework Architect (Playwright, Selenium, API, CI/CD)THE ROLEOwn test strategy, quality architecture, and the automated regression infrastructure for Securly Flex - the flex period scheduling and attendance platform that 1, 000+ schools use every school day to place students into intervention, enrichment, and support sessions. 

Flex decides where students are supposed to be. A defect in Autoassign placement, capacity limits, separation rules, roster sync, or attendance recording does not just break a feature - it can put a student in the wrong room, leave a must-attend intervention empty, place students together who are required to be kept apart, or send inaccurate attendance into a district's student information system. The test infrastructure you build is the last line of defense before production. 

This is an engineering leadership role, not a QA role. You will define what "production-ready" means for Flex, build the automation platform that enforces it through CI/CD quality gates, and write production-quality code for that platform yourself. You will also serve as the team's expert on rules-engine correctness and edge-case testing - your understanding of how Flex's rules interact (priorities, capacity limits, restricted sessions, sign-up cutoffs, and check-in controls) directly shapes both the test suite and the implementation team's design decisions. 

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid - 2 days onsite)
Experience: 6-10+ years
Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Own the quality bar. Define what "passing" means for Flex: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases. 
 - Test the rules engine. Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic - student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten - plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries. 
 - Gate every release. Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory. 
 - Set performance baselines. Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each flex period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression. 
 - Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on Flex runs on with Securly Pass. 
 - Build the framework. Architect and build the Flex automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends - and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability. 
 - Mentor and scale. Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage. 
 - Shape architecture. Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad. 
 - Own incidents. Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective. 

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTSMust-Have
 - Test framework architecture - designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts. 
 - Test automation (SDET-level) - Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior - placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions - not just UI interaction tests. 
 - CI/CD quality gates - integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1, 000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it. 
 - Rules-engine and data-integrity testing - designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits. 
 - Strong programming - JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code. 
 - Technical communication - ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on. 
 - Education & experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience. Strongly Preferred
 - Performance & concurrency testing - k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs. 
 - AI-assisted test engineering - using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams. 
 - Security & access-control testing - role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations. Nice to Have
 - Mobile test automation - Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage. 
 - Integration testing - SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push). 
 - K-12 EdTech domain - understanding of bell schedules, flex and advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios. WHO YOU ARE
 - You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them. 
 - You have built automation frameworks from the ground up - not just inherited them - and other engineers have built on what you designed. 
 - You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline. A feature without a regression suite is not finished - and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments. 
 - You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release. 
 - You are hands-on at a senior level - you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you. Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement. 
 - Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions. Your influence extends past your own work. 
 - You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec. ABOUT SECURLYTech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact. 

Securly processes over 1. 1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20, 000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K-12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement. 

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support - driving measurable improvements in student safety and wellbeing at scale. 

We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills. 

BENEFITS
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance (employee, parents, spouse, children)
 - Accidental & Term Life Insurance
 - Learning & Development reimbursement
 - Paid Time Off
 - Public Holidays (10+ per year)
 - Retirement Benefits (EPF & gratuity)
 - Parental Leave (as per statutory norms)EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYERSecurly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion, fairness, and respect. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

data.title: SDE II - Java
data.description:
Job Summary

Auriga is looking for a Software Engineer who can develop and deploy APIs and Web applications using Java MVC Frameworks and power a variety of leading-edge digital products. You'll need to bring creative thinking and architectural problem solving to the table, to devise optimal technical solutions, along with highly performant user experiences. 

Responsibilities

- Work with business users to gather functional requirements 
 - Combine your technical expertise and problem-solving passion to turn complex problems into end-to-end solutions
 - Work with client architect/senior developers to do high level/low level design/architecture. 
 - Design and implement high-quality, test-driven BE code for various projects
 - Unit Testing/Integration Testing
 - Code Configuration and Release Management. 
 - Create and maintain documentation, implement and follow best practices for development workflow. 
 - Work collaboratively with team members to ensure deadlines are met. 
 - Stay current on changes in technology and keep adding to your skillset. 

Qualifications

- Minimum 3 Years of experience in Web Application and API development in Java 8 and above
 - Working experience with MVC frameworks like Spring, Play, etc. 
 - Experience with Multi-threading, Collections, and concurrent API
 - Working experience with web-services and APIs (REST, SOAP)
 - Working experience with data platforms (relational and/or NoSQL) and messaging technologies 
 - Excellent OOPs, data structure, and algorithm knowledge 
 - Understanding & experience in API management, Swagger
 - Working knowledge of API Testing Tools (e. g. Postman), Version control systems like GIT. 
 - Working experience with LINUX/UNIX environment and shell scripts
 - Proficiency in English 
 - Strong collaborator and comfortable to work in an agile, remote and distributed team environment
 - Follow secure coding practices and ensure data protection, authentication, and authorization mechanisms are implemented effectively (e. g. , OAuth2, JWT). 
 - Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and implementation of security controls in APIs. 

Nice to have

- Experience in one or more front-end development technologies
 - Experience in developing microservices in Spring Boot. 
 - Experience writing high-quality code with fully automated unit test coverage (Junit, Mockito, etc. ) 
 - Experience defining and applying design/coding standards, patterns, and quality metrics depending on the solution
 - Working experience with various CI/CD systems (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) and build tools (ant, maven, gradle, etc. ).

Position: Architect, IT Solutions - Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms

City: Pune

State: Maharashtra (Onsite)

Job Description

Innovation starts from the heart. At client, we're dedicated to developing ground-breaking technologies with a genuine impact on patients' lives. At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions. 

As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms - Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise. 

This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery - and want to shape how a global healthcare company adopts agentic AI at scale - this is the role for you. 

How You'll Make an Impact

Platform Architecture Leadership - Copilot & Moveworks

· Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks - serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices. 

· Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms. 

· Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks. 

Integration Architecture

· Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB. 

· Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms. 

· Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards. 

Lead Solution Architecture

· Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms. 

· Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards. 

· Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies. 

Governance, Mentorship & Innovation

· Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices. 

· Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture. 

· Survey emerging developments in agentic AI - including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents - and recommend approaches that extend platform value. 

· Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations. 

What You'll Need (Required)

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

· 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture. 

· 3+ years in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations. 

· Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation). 

· Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e. g. , Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate). 

· Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms. 

· Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale. 

· Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e. g. , Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification). 

· Expert-level documentation and communication skills - ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

· Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams. 

What Else We Look For (Preferred)

· Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio - building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration. 

· Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform - configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics. 

· Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models. 

· Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB. 

· Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer. 

· Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e. g. , medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices. 

· Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 

· Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks. 

· Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice. 

Why This Role Is Different

data.title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
data.description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software. 

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB. 

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner's product. 

This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements. 

Learn more about here!

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What you'll do at MongoDB

- Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
 - Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
 - Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
 - Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
 - Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
 - Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
 - Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have

- 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
 - Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
 - Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
 - Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
 - Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
 - The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
 - Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

- Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
 - Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
 - MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

What you will learn

- Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem

 - Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Senior AI Architect

Experience

- 15+ years overall; 8+ years in Java/J2EE; 2+ years in AI/GenAI delivery

Role focus

- AI-led modernization of enterprise Java platforms and creation of scalable, secure AI solutions

The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI Architect who combines deep Java/J2EE architecture expertise with hands-on AI and Generative AI delivery experience. The role will shape AI-first enterprise solutions, embed intelligent capabilities into existing Java estates, and guide clients from experimentation through secure, production-scale adoption. 

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product engineering, cloud-native modernization and applied AI. They will define target architectures, make technology decisions, lead engineering teams, and advise senior stakeholders on how AI can create measurable business and engineering outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

AI and solution architecture

- Define end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled enterprise applications, from data ingestion and retrieval through model orchestration, inference, APIs, user experience and production operations. 
 - Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge graph, multimodal and agentic AI solutions aligned to business workflows. 
 - Design multi-agent systems / skills, tool-use patterns and orchestration approaches, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) where relevant. 
 - Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption. 
 - Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost. 

Java/J2EE engineering and modernization

- Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs. 
 - Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns. 
 - Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity. 
 - Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management. 
 - Guide engineering teams on code quality, design patterns, performance, resilience, observability, security and maintainability. 

Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering

- Design and deploy AI solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP using appropriate managed AI services and cloud-native components. 
 - Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback. 
 - Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost. 
 - Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback. 
 - Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment. 

Governance, security and responsible AI

- Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design. 
 - Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk. 
 - Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations. 
 - Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads.

data.title: Lead AI Application Engineer-Business Technology
data.description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data & AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1, 000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo. 

About The Role

We're building an in-house engineering team to replace major enterprise SaaS platforms with custom internal tools, designed and delivered with AI-augmented development. We're looking for an architect-level Lead Engineer to own this initiative. You'll lead a lean, AI-augmented team, define the technical blueprints, host and scale applications from scratch, and grow new college graduates into productive engineers. This is greenfield, end-to-end ownership with direct business impact: every tool you ship replaces a vendor we no longer need to pay. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and design: Design scalable backend services, data models, and integrations for internal tools that replace complex SaaS platforms. Set and enforce architectural standards across the team. 
 - Understand the business: Work directly with stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs, and make pragmatic build-vs-buy and scope trade-offs. 
 - Host and scale from scratch: Own the full lifecycle of internal applications: provisioning infrastructure, deploying, scaling, monitoring, and operating them in production. 
 - Own CI/CD: Build and maintain end-to-end pipelines with automated testing, code scanning, and branch-protection guardrails, making them the definitive quality gate for all code, including AI-generated code. 
 - Build with AI: Use tools like Claude Code and Cursor to accelerate delivery, and establish team practices for reviewing, refactoring, and hardening AI-generated code. 
 - Collaborate across teams: Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Project Management, and other internal teams to prioritize work, gather feedback, and iterate quickly. 
 - Mentor: Guide new graduates and junior engineers on architectural first principles, code quality, security, and effective AI-assisted development. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years building production-grade, full-stack applications (e. g. , Python, Node. js, Go, React, relational and vector databases). 
 - Strong backend architecture and system design skills, with a proven ability to design distributed systems and to critically evaluate, refactor, and modularize sub-optimal code, including LLM-generated code. 
 - Core knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), and distributed systems, with experience running multi-service containerized environments in production. 
 - Demonstrated experience hosting and scaling internal applications from scratch, including building CI/CD pipelines end to end (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins). 
 - Hands-on experience with AI development tools and agentic coding workflows, and a record of using them to ship real products. 
 - Working knowledge of secure SDLC practices: automated static/dynamic code scanning, secret detection, and OWASP Top 10 awareness built into the pipeline. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work directly with non-engineering stakeholders and turn use cases into shipped software. 
 - A track record of mentoring junior engineers. 

In-Office at ThoughtSpot

Spotters are expected in-office 3+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed. 

About ThoughtSpot

The world's most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot's AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision-making into a truly data-driven culture. 

At ThoughtSpot, we're a curious, data-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That's why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation. 

Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles

Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to: 

- Comfortably and confidently integrate AI into their daily workflows to increase productivity and quality. 
 - Hands-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality. 
 - Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions. 
 - Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools. 

Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and possess an AI Mindset: 

- Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
 - Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
 - Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary

This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it's required for every role at ThoughtSpot. 

AI Mindset for All Spotters

At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work. 

All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot's AI tools (like AgentSpot, Spotter, and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. 

We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI. 

ThoughtSpot for All

At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you're a strong match, we encourage you to apply. 

What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?

ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world-class products. If you're excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that's right for you.

Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) - Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform

Experience: 6-9 years

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads. 

The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform. 
 - Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting. 
 - Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform - module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments. 
 - Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows. 
 - Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC - SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno). 
 - Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards. 
 - Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements. 
 - Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 6+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3+ years in a senior or lead capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform. 
 - Deep, production-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators). 
 - Strong expertise in Terraform - module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting. 
 - Solid grounding in cloud security - IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e. g. , Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud). 
 - Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls. 
 - Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks. 
 - Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills. 

Qualification and Certifications

- B. E. / B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred - Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+). 
 - Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Exposure to GCP and broader multi-cloud operating models. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel). 
 - Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace. 
 - Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices. 
 - Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices. 

Working Expectations

- Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies. 
 - Maintain clear, version-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts. 
 - Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms. 
 - Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure, automation, and security challenges.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. In the HPE Hybrid Cloud, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. Join us redefine what's next for you. 

What You'll Do

Senior individual-contributor technical leader responsible for end-to-end system and cloud architecture, providing organization-wide technical direction to Experts, senior engineers, and engineering teams. The role requires deep cloud/software expertise combined with broad system knowledge across compute, networking, storage, virtualization, security, operating systems, high availability, manageability, and cloud infrastructure. 

Responsibilities

- Own and drive end-to-end architecture for complex cloud and infrastructure solutions spanning software, compute, networking, storage, virtualization, security, and management layers.

 - Define reference architectures, interfaces, integration patterns, and engineering standards for scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable systems. 
 - Lead architecture/design reviews and drive critical decisions involving scalability, performance, availability, security, resiliency, and cost. 
 - Drive architecture for cloud-native, hybrid-cloud, distributed systems, APIs, Kubernetes, automation, observability, and infrastructure management. 
 - Identify cross-stack dependencies, failure modes, technology risks, and system bottlenecks and lead resolution of complex customer and production issues. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, drive proof-of-concepts and innovation, and influence multi-year technology and product roadmaps. 
 - Mentor and develop Experts and senior engineers, establish engineering best practices, and raise technical capability across the organization. 
 - Influence customers, product management, senior technologists, and leadership through clear articulation of architecture options, trade-offs, risks, and business value. 

What You Need To Bring

Education and Experience Required: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent. 
 - 12-15 years of experience in product engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems software, platform engineering, or related R&D. 
 - Proven experience architecting and delivering large-scale, production-grade systems across multiple technology domains. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership of senior engineers, Experts, architects, or multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience driving major capabilities through architecture, development, deployment, lifecycle management, and customer adoption. 

Knowledge And Skills

- Deep expertise in cloud, hybrid cloud, distributed systems, and enterprise infrastructure architecture.

 - Strong programming and design skills in one or more of Python, Java, Go, C/C++, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

 - Proven ability to remain technically hands-on through prototyping, architecture/design reviews, code reviews, and complex problem solving. The source Expert roles establish hands-on engineering and technical reviews as important expectations even at senior technical levels. 
 - Strong ability to lead through influence, mentor senior technical talent, resolve architectural disagreements, and drive cross-team technical decisions. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and negotiate architectural decisions with senior engineering, product, customer, and executive stakeholders. 

Principal-level differentiator

Operates beyond component or domain expertise, owns system-level architecture and technical direction, and leads Experts and engineering teams across organizational boundaries while remaining hands-on on critical technical problems.

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

The Content Technology division, as part of our Generate Segment, builds and supports the world's most advanced enterprise content platforms - including Tridion, a leading Component Content Management and Web CMS solution, and Fonto, a structured content authoring and collaboration suite.

Key Responsibilities

Job Overview

- Architect and build a comprehensive testing strategy that balances manual oversight of offshore teams with the development of scalable automation. 
 - Develop and maintain automated test suites XCUITest/Espresso for mobile apps. 
 - Partner early with Product, Design, and Engineering to identify potential issues during the requirements and design phases. 
 - Serve as the primary technical point of contact for our offshore QA team, providing technical guidance, reviewing test plans, and driving high-quality execution. 
 - Identify bottlenecks in the development lifecycle and implement process improvements to increase release velocity without compromising quality.

The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.

data.title: Senior Performance Test Specialist
data.description:
Esko | Veralto Corporation

Location: Bangalore, India | Hybrid

Reports To: Senior Team Leader

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Performance Test Specialist to independently design realistic workload simulations and own performance, scalability, stability, and capacity testing for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in JMeter and complementary performance-testing tools, test scripting, workload modelling, statistical analysis of results, and evidence-based root-cause analysis across application, JVM, database, search, and infrastructure layers. You will partner with development and infrastructure colleagues to translate findings into prioritized recommendations and verified improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design realistic load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, and capacity simulations based on user behaviour, transaction flows, concurrency, data volumes, pacing, and production-like workload distributions. 
 - Develop and maintain reusable JMeter frameworks and scripts for web applications and APIs, including correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, assertions, distributed execution, and automated result collection. Use LoadRunner, Gatling, k6, or other tools where appropriate. 
 - Define workload models, baselines, SLAs, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders. 
 - Analyze response-time distributions and percentiles, throughput, errors, variability, saturation points, and resource trends; distinguish repeatable patterns from noise, outliers, and environmental variation. 
 - Diagnose Java/JVM issues using JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, and related tools, including memory leaks, OOM errors, high CPU, thread contention, and connection-pool bottlenecks. 
 - Analyze and tune performance across JBoss/WildFly, Tomcat, SQL Server, REST APIs, and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch in collaboration with development and infrastructure teams. 
 - Correlate transaction timings, logs, traces, diagnostics, database behaviour, and cloud/infrastructure metrics to identify and quantify root causes. 
 - Form and test hypotheses, recommend prioritized improvements, and rerun controlled tests to verify benefits and prevent regressions. 
 - Integrate repeatable performance checks into CI/CD pipelines and maintain controlled environments, baselines, and versioned test assets. 
 - Plan investigations independently, estimate effort, manage dependencies and risks, validate test-environment and load-generator constraints, and document reproducible findings. 
 - Use approved AI tools where appropriate for scripting, diagnostics, and reporting; validate outputs and protect proprietary and customer data. 

Required Skills

- 8+ years of testing experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on performance testing and engineering, with independent delivery of complex investigations. 
 - Advanced JMeter experience designing, scripting, debugging, executing, and maintaining realistic simulations for enterprise web applications and APIs, including distributed load generation, correlation, parameterization, dynamic test data, workload modelling, and automated result collection. 
 - Demonstrated ability to interpret percentiles, distributions, throughput, errors, variability, saturation behaviour, and resource correlations; distinguish meaningful findings from noise; and communicate evidence-based root causes, capacity limits, and recommendations. 
 - Hands-on Java/JVM performance diagnosis using profiling data, JFR, heap and thread dumps, GC logs, Eclipse MAT, jcmd, or comparable tools. 
 - Performance-analysis experience across JBoss/WildFly or Tomcat, SQL Server, and REST APIs. 
 - Experience with monitoring and APM tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Datadog for cross-layer correlation and root-cause analysis. 
 - Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure, Linux and Windows, Git, and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable performance-test execution. 
 - Ability to use Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, or similar languages for test-data generation, execution automation, result processing, statistical analysis, and repeatable reporting. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch performance analysis. 
 - Experience with LoadRunner, Gatling, or k6 in addition to JMeter. 
 - Effective use of AI-assisted tools for performance scripting, analysis, or diagnostics, with critical validation of outputs.
