data.description:
Esko | Veralto Corporation

Location: Bangalore, India | On-site

Reports To: Senior Team Leader

About The Role

The Opportunity

We're seeking a self-driven Senior QA Specialist to strengthen quality engineering for WebCenter Enterprise, a Java/J2EE web application. In this hands-on role, you'll independently own quality for assigned features and product areas, combining thoughtful manual testing with the creation and maintenance of reliable automated test scripts. You'll work with the current SAHI-based automation suite and help evolve the framework, including evaluating Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. 

You'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and the Senior Team Leader to translate product and technical risks into an effective test approach. You'll execute tests, interpret results, distinguish product defects from automation or environment failures, and communicate evidence-based quality risks. Success means meaningful automation coverage, effective exploratory testing, earlier defect detection, and dependable test results for WebCenter Enterprise. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will: 

- Independently own the test approach for assigned features and product areas: assess customer and technical risk, clarify acceptance criteria, estimate effort, prioritize coverage, and raise dependencies or quality concerns early. 
 - Design and execute a balanced set of manual and automated tests, including exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing; select the test layer and technique that best addresses the risk. 
 - Create, maintain, and improve reliable SAHI-based automated test scripts using established design patterns and reusable code; contribute to framework design and evaluate Playwright or Selenium where appropriate. 
 - Interpret test and CI/CD results, investigate failures systematically, and distinguish product defects from automation, test-data, or environment issues using logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. 
 - Reduce flaky tests through root-cause analysis; maintain representative test data, repeatable setup and cleanup, dependable environments, and clear, actionable failure reporting. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to improve testability, find defects earlier, and align testing with delivery timelines and product quality goals. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve QA processes, tooling, and feedback loops while protecting the stability of existing coverage. 
 - Produce concise, accurate test cases, automation code, defect reports, traceability, and quality summaries; communicate coverage, evidence, blockers, and release risks clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Share domain knowledge and practical QA and automation techniques with colleagues, and use approved AI tools responsibly where useful while independently validating outputs and protecting proprietary and customer data. 

Minimum Qualifications

What We're Looking For

These are the must-have requirements for the role: 

- 8+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, test automation, software development, or a combination thereof, including ownership of quality for complex web-product features. 
 - Strong hands-on ability in automated and manual testing, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining reusable automation code with established design patterns; practical programming or scripting skills in JavaScript, Java, or a comparable language; proficiency with Git, code review, and maintainable coding practices; and sound judgment in applying exploratory, functional, regression, and automated testing. 
 - Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation with SAHI, Selenium, Playwright, or a comparable framework, together with the ability to become productive in SAHI. SAHI is the current automation tool; prior expertise in SAHI is not required. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, organizing, and implementing automated unit, integration, and API tests with Java frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent solutions, including parameterized or data-driven testing; API coverage should include HTTP/REST, authentication, response and schema validation, and negative scenarios using RestAssured or comparable code-based tools, with Postman or similar tools for exploratory testing. 
 - Experience integrating, maintaining, and diagnosing automated test execution in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, including analysis of failures and reliable reporting of results. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including interpreting test results and investigating failures with logs, browser developer tools, and reproducible evidence. 
 - Experience testing web and client/server products, preferably Java/J2EE enterprise applications, with a good understanding of browser behavior, sessions, authentication, authorization, and integrations. 
 - Strong risk-based test-design skills, including equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, and state-transition testing. 
 - Ability to design representative test data, maintain repeatable setup and cleanup, and validate results and data integrity, including practical use of basic SQL queries where appropriate. 
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and contributing quality engineering and automation activities throughout iterative, sprint-based delivery. 
 - Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative working style, with the ability to explain quality risks, ask relevant questions, build consensus, and support less-experienced colleagues. 

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications will help distinguish stronger candidates; relevant experience in one or more of these areas is valued: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - Relevant professional testing certification, such as ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL); advanced or specialist credentials-particularly ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE), Technical Test Analyst (CTAL-TTA), Quality in DevOps (CT-QDO), or an equivalent recognized certification are a differentiator for this senior automation-focused role. 
 - Practical experience using approved AI tools to accelerate test design, automation-code development, test-data generation, or failure analysis, with independent review and validation of outputs and appropriate protection of proprietary and customer data. 
 - Direct experience maintaining or evolving SAHI-based automation suites. 
 - Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices and experience using Cucumber to translate expected user behaviors and acceptance criteria into clear, executable test scenarios and maintainable automated test scripts. 
 - Experience with performance testing and tools such as JMeter. 
 - Experience testing AI-assisted features with non-deterministic outputs, including correctness, consistency, reliability, and safe fallback behavior.

Job Description Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of GE Vernova Grid Software solutions that support transmission, distribution, and energy management operations across utilities worldwide. Leveraging deep expertise in power systems, utility operations, EMS/SCADA applications, and Grid Engineering products, you will lead quality engineering initiatives across complex enterprise software platforms. 

The ideal candidate combines strong software testing and quality engineering capabilities with a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Power Systems preferred) and hands-on experience validating mission-critical grid applications. You will work closely with product management, development teams, system architects, and domain experts to develop comprehensive test strategies, drive automation adoption, identify product risks early, and ensure high-quality releases for customers operating critical grid infrastructure. 

This role requires strong domain expertise in power systems and utility operations, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for delivering world-class Grid Software products that are transforming the future of energy. 

Responsibilities

Job Description

- Lead quality assurance activities across Grid Software products, ensuring functional, integration, system, performance, and regression testing coverage. 
 - Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and validation approaches for complex EMS, SCADA, DMS, ADMS, GridOS, and power system applications. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, developers, solution architects, and power system engineers to understand business requirements and grid operational workflows. 
 - Apply strong power system domain expertise to validate network modeling, topology processing, state estimation, contingency analysis, outage management, interoperability, and other grid applications. 
 - Drive automation initiatives using modern test frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to improve test coverage, release quality, and execution efficiency. 
 - Design and implement automated functional, API, integration, and end-to-end test suites for enterprise-grade Grid Software products. 
 - Analyze customer-reported issues, reproduce field defects, perform root-cause analysis, and partner with engineering teams to drive resolution. 
 - Validate software performance, scalability, cybersecurity, reliability, and resiliency requirements for utility-grade deployments. 
 - Participate in architecture reviews, requirement reviews, and design discussions to ensure quality is built into products from inception. 
 - Champion quality engineering best practices, shift-left testing methodologies, risk-based testing, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to establishing testing standards, frameworks, and quality processes across teams. 
 - Support customer deployments, interoperability testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and system validation activities for utility customers globally. 

Desired Characteristics

- Strong understanding of Power Systems Engineering, utility operations, transmission systems, distribution systems, and control center applications. 
 - Proven experience working with Grid Engineering products, including EMS, DMS, ADMS, SCADA, GridOS, Network Applications, Market Systems, or related utility software platforms. 
 - Deep knowledge of software testing methodologies, validation processes, defect lifecycle management, and quality assurance best practices.

 - Experience with enterprise software products deployed in mission-critical environments.

 - Excellent root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Required Skills & Experience

- 3-4 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.

At Resillion, you'll have the opportunity to work on large-scale digital transformation programmes and enterprise SAP implementations. At Basware, we deliver mission-critical cloud solutions that empower organizations to unlock their full potential. Our products are designed to bring clear and compelling value to our customers, and we're looking for a talented and forward-thinking developer who can help us shape the future of our technology. 

We are seeking a Lead Cloud Developer - Country Compliance, an experienced software engineer, who will contribute to the solutions that keep our customers compliant with country e-invoicing and tax reporting mandates. Your role will be focused on building the country-specific capabilities that connect invoices, credit notes and purchase orders to government tax portals and clearance networks, using the latest technologies and AI-assisted ways of working to deliver large-scale, high-performance, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also provide technical leadership and mentoring to the team, helping to shape engineering practices and raise the bar on code quality and architectural decisions. 

This is a hands-on technology role, ideal for candidates seeking opportunities to both build on their existing experience and research new knowledge areas, with a significant share of design and exploratory elements to their day-to-day tasks. Every country mandate brings a different set of rules, formats and deadlines, so no two modules look the same. 

You will be working alongside engineers and developers from the Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM) Teams, assisted by our AI Engineering team, and in integration with other Basware solutions. The product you will be contributing to is targeted at large, well-known enterprises. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own system design and software architecture decisions for country compliance modules, from new mandate onboarding through to production. 
 - Drive non-functional requirements: throughput and latency under load, secure handling of certificates, tokens and secrets, fault tolerance and graceful degradation against unreliable third-party government APIs. 
 - Lead code and design reviews and set the architectural conventions the team builds against. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on design thinking, technical depth and code quality. 
 - Champion CI/CD, TDD and AI-assisted engineering practices across the team. 
 - Participate in incident response and drive root cause fixes for production issues. 

, 

- 10+ years of commercial software engineering experience, including prior technical leadership of a team or major module. 
 - Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot expertise, with deep understanding of REST API design and implementation. 
 - Proven hands-on experience in the application of AI-assisted coding techniques, including structuring context and prompts, and critically reviewing AI-generated code for correctness and security. 
 - Experience with XML and XSD processing at scale, including secure parsing and schema validation frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with MongoDB (document design, indexing, performance tuning) or comparable NoSQL databases. 
 - Solid grasp of authentication and authorization patterns: OAuth2, JWT, API security, secrets management. 
 - Practical AWS cloud architecture experience across compute, storage, networking, IAM and observability, and designing for cloud-native deployment. 
 - Demonstrated system design and software architecture skills, able to design for scale, extensibility, and multi-tenant and multi-region variation. 
 - Strong CI/CD pipeline experience and Test-Driven Development as a working practice. 
 - Proven ability to mentor engineers on both technical depth and non-functional thinking across performance, security and resilience. 
 - Excellent communication skills, able to explain architectural trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative mindset, strong sense of ownership, comfortable adapting to shifting regulatory and business requirements. 

Considered as a strong plus

- Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and networks such as Peppol and EN 16931, or with national clearance models such as Italy's SDI, Poland's KSeF or the French PPF and PDP model. 
 - Experience with digital signatures and certificates (X. 509, XAdES) or secure token and credential handling. 
 - Microservices architecture design experience: service decomposition, inter-service contracts, resilience patterns such as circuit breakers and bulkheads.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer-Golang-API Gateway
data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

FactSet's product suite of smart analytics and unique data empower the world's leading financial service professionals to make more informed decisions every day. At our heart is an inclusive community unified by the spirit of going above and beyond. Our philosophy is to embrace diversity, and that our best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time. We continuously look ahead to advance the future and technology of our industry, by rolling up our sleeves to solve tough problems together, and by learning from our successes, as well as our failures. 

In this role, you will work with team of engineers who are responsible for the design, development and maintenance of our API Gateway. This team powers centralized routing, service discovery, rate limiting, and policy enforcement for MCP traffic and other internal APIs. You will design, implement, and operate dual‐authentication and token‐exchange capabilities, evolve gateway policies, drive multi‐region reliability, and automate delivery on AWS. This role spans design through operations with a strong focus on performance, security, and developer experience. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree, or higher, in Computer Science or a related technical field 
 - 7+ years' experience of building backend/platform systems, with substantial experience in traffic management or API platforms. 
 - Strong GO development and Lua experience on NGINXX/OpenResty
 - Deep hands‐on experience with Docker/Kubernetes and AWS (EKS, EC2, ALB/NLB, Route 53, VPC/private networking; CloudWatch/CloudTrail). 
 - Infrastructure‐as‐code and CI/CD pipelines
 - Strong Linux fundamentals and scripting (Bash/Python); excellent debugging and performance tuning skills. 
 - Clear communication, ownership mindset, and a security‐first approach. 
 - Address production issues in a timely manner 
 -

What You'll Do

- Design, implement, and operate gateway capabilities: routing, service discovery, rate limiting/quotas, and policy enforcement. 
 - Build gateway extensions and filters in Lua (NGINX/OpenResty) and GO for authN/Z, token exchange, request shaping, and telemetry. 
 - Implement dual‐auth support and seamless token exchange (OAuth2/OIDC, RFC 8693), including validation, caching, replay protection, and robust trust store management. 
 - Establish mTLS to backends and standardize API registration and onboarding patterns; integrate with discovery (Kubernetes/EKS, Consul). 
 - Automate deployments with IaC and CI/CD (Terraform/CloudFormation, Helm, GitHub Actions/Jenkins); use blue/green and canary releases with signed artifacts. 
 - Plan and run hybrid/multi‐region topologies on AWS (active‐active or active‐standby), including global routing (Route 53/GLB), health checks, failover, and DR/chaos drills. 
 - Lead patching and upgrades with minimal downtime; define autoscaling policies, capacity plans, and incident response playbooks. 
 - Create onboarding guides, example configurations, and self‐service workflows to accelerate adoption by MCP servers/agents and other internal services. 
 - Participate in code-reviews and proactively take ownership of PR's and make sure to catch all security vulnerabilities
 - Proper collaboration and interaction with multiple teams across FactSet and respond to stakeholder queries in a timely manner

Nice To Have

- Kong Gateway experience (configuration, plugin development) - a strong plus. 
 - Envoy or NGINX expertise 
 - Multi‐region traffic management (Global Accelerator/CloudFront), resilience patterns, and DR playbooks. 
 - Data stores for counters and policies (Redis/KeyDB, DynamoDB including Global Tables). 
 - Observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK) and SLO/error budget practices. 

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. 

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

data.title: Senior Staff Emulation Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation

data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

AGNI (Arista Guardian for Network Identity) is Arista's cloud-native SaaS platform for network access control and zero-trust security. It is deployed by enterprises worldwide, both as a managed cloud service and on-premises. The platform handles authentication and authorization for every device that joins a network - using protocols like 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP-TLS, TACACS+, and PKI - and must work correctly under real network conditions, at scale, every time. 

The AGNI engineering team operates with a strong ownership culture: engineers define the feature, write the code, write the tests, and are accountable for what ships. The test automation team is a first-class engineering function - not a handoff at the end of development, but an integral part of how the team designs and validates the product. 

You will work alongside backend engineers, network protocol specialists, and CloudOps/SRE to build and maintain the automated test infrastructure that validates the entire AGNI platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build end-to-end automated test suites for AGNI features - authentication protocol flows, REST API correctness, network policy enforcement, and device onboarding - primarily in Go. 
 - Own test coverage for one or more product domains (e. g. , RADIUS/EAP, TACACS+, captive portal, PKI) end to-end: derive test plans from feature specs, implement the cases, triage failures, and maintain them as the product evolves. 
 - Build and extend internal test utility libraries - simulated RADIUS/EAPOL clients, browser automation, certificate helpers, and REST API wrappers - and know when a gap in the utility layer is the right fix rather than working around it in the test. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis on test failures - distinguish a flaky test from a real product bug, reproduce the bug in a lab environment, and work with backend engineers to resolve it. 
 - Review feature design specifications and write test plans that cover happy paths, boundary conditions, and failure modes before the feature is implemented - shifting quality left, not bolting it on at the end. 
 - Own and improve the Jenkins CI pipelines that run nightly e2e suites against cloud and on-prem deployments: reduce flakiness, improve signal-to-noise, and shorten the feedback loop for engineers. 
 - Contribute targeted fixes to the platform codebase (testability improvements, log clarity, small bug fixes) when the test reveals a clear, bounded issue. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and interns on test design principles, debugging methodology, and the team's test framework. 
 - Participate in incident post-mortems and customer issue reviews - identify gaps in test coverage that allowed a bug to reach production and close them. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related engineering field. 
 - 3-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a significant portion in test automation or quality engineering - not just manual testing. 
 - Proficiency in Go or Python for writing production-grade automation code. Experience with Go is strongly preferred. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux from both an administration and debugging perspective: process management, networking tools (tcpdump, openssl, curl), and log analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols - 802. 1X, RADIUS, EAP variants (EAP-TLS, PEAP, TEAP), TACACS+, or PKI/certificate management. You need to be able to read a packet trace and understand what went wrong. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing - designing test cases, validating responses, and building reliable API clients in code. 
 - Experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) - writing pipeline stages, triaging failures, and improving reliability. 
 - Strong debugging instinct: given a test failure and a log, you can form and test a hypothesis independently. Clear written communication - test plans, bug reports, and post-mortem write-ups that other engineers can act on without follow-up. 

Good To Have

- Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic cloud environments (GCP/AWS). 
 - Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) - knowing which metrics to pull when a test exhibits unexpected behavior. 
 - Exposure to PKI infrastructure: certificate chains, SCEP/EST enrollment, TLS handshake failure modes. Experience with browser automation frameworks for UI/captive-portal test scenarios. 
 - Familiarity with database testing (PostgreSQL or equivalent) - validating that backend state changes are correctly persisted. 

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

Reporting To: Hospital Management / General Manager

1. Job Purpose

The HIMS Development Lead / Manager will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, integration, maintenance and continuous improvement of the Hospital Information Management System (HIMS). 

The position will work closely with doctors, nurses, hospital administration, laboratory, radiology, pharmacy, medical records, billing, finance, HR and quality teams to develop a secure, scalable, user-friendly and integrated digital hospital ecosystem. 

The role will also ensure that the HIMS supports patient safety, operational efficiency, data security, management reporting and NABH accreditation requirements. 

2. Key Responsibilities

A. HIMS Development & Implementation

- Analyse hospital processes and convert them into digital workflows. 
 - Design, develop and maintain HIMS applications and modules. 
 - Prepare BRD, FRS and SRS for new system requirements. 
 - Develop web/mobile applications, dashboards, alerts and approval workflows. 
 - Conduct system testing, UAT and implementation. 
 - Manage system upgrades, enhancements and change requests. 
 - Ensure system availability, performance and reliability. B. Clinical & Hospital Modules

Develop, integrate and maintain modules covering: 

- Patient Registration / UHID
 - Appointment & OPD Management
 - IPD / Admission & Discharge
 - Emergency / Casualty
 - Doctor Consultation & Clinical Documentation
 - EMR / EHR
 - Nursing Management
 - Operation Theatre / ICU
 - Medical Records
 - Laboratory Information System (LIS)
 - Radiology Information System (RIS)
 - PACS
 - Pharmacy Management
 - Blood Bank
 - Ambulance and other clinical support servicesC. Billing & Administrative Systems

- OPD/IPD Billing and Package Management

 - Insurance / TPA / Corporate Billing
 - Cashless and payment integration
 - Inventory and Stores Management
 - Purchase and Vendor Management
 - Asset and Maintenance Management
 - HRMS, Attendance and Payroll integrationD. System Integration

- Integrate HIMS with LIS, RIS, PACS, Pharmacy, Finance, HRMS and other hospital applications. 
 - Develop and manage APIs and third-party integrations. 
 - Knowledge of HL7, FHIR, DICOM and REST APIs will be preferred. 
 - Support integration with medical devices and diagnostic equipment. 

3. Data Security & IT Governance

- Implement role-based access control and user authentication. 
 - Ensure confidentiality and security of patient information. 
 - Maintain complete audit trails. 
 - Implement backup, disaster recovery and data-recovery mechanisms. 
 - Monitor database performance and data integrity. 
 - Support cybersecurity assessments and vulnerability management. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare data protection and IT requirements. 

4. NABH & Quality Support

The candidate will work with the Quality/NABH team to ensure that HIMS supports accreditation requirements through: 

- Digital clinical and administrative documentation
 - Audit trails and traceability
 - Incident reporting
 - Patient safety alerts
 - Quality dashboards
 - Hospital KPI reporting
 - Statutory and regulatory reports
 - Document control and approval workflows
 - Easy retrieval of patient records
 - Quality indicator monitoring

5. MIS, Analytics & Management Dashboards

Develop dashboards and reports covering: 

- OPD/IPD statistics
 - Bed occupancy and Average Length of Stay
 - ICU and OT utilization
 - Doctor and department performance
 - Laboratory and pharmacy performance
 - Patient waiting time
 - Revenue and collections
 - Insurance/TPA performance
 - Patient feedback
 - Quality indicators
 - Patient safety and hospital KPIs

6. Project & Team Management

- Gather requirements from all hospital departments. 
 - Prepare project plans, timelines and implementation schedules. 
 - Coordinate developers, database administrators, QA/testing and support teams. 
 - Monitor project milestones and deliverables. 
 - Coordinate with external HIMS vendors wherever applicable. 
 - Conduct user training and system demonstrations. 
 - Prepare user manuals, SOPs and technical documentation. 
 - Provide go-live and post-implementation support. 

7. Key Performance Areas (KPA)

- HIMS development and implementation
 - Clinical workflow digitization
 - Hospital system integration
 - Application performance and uptime
 - Data security and privacy
 - User adoption and satisfaction
 - MIS and management reporting
 - NABH / quality compliance support
 - Project delivery and implementation
 - Continuous digital transformation

  Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

- HIMS modules delivered within agreed timelines
 - System uptime and application performance
 - Reduction in manual processes
 - User adoption and satisfaction
 - Number and resolution time of critical system issues
 - Successful integration of hospital applications
 - Data accuracy and integrity
 - UAT success rate
 - Timely generation of management reports
 - Security and backup compliance
 - NABH audit readiness and compliance

8. Qualification & Experience

Educational Qualification

Essential: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science / IT / Computer Applications / Software Engineering / Healthcare Informatics or equivalent. Preferred: 

- MCA / M. Tech / MS - Computer Science / IT
 - Master's in Health Informatics / Healthcare Technology
 - MBA - Healthcare / IT ManagementExperience

- 8-12 years of overall IT/software development experience
 - Minimum 4 years of relevant HIMS/HIS/EMR/EHR or healthcare technology experience preferred. 
 - Experience in implementing IT solutions in a multi-specialty hospital / medical college hospital will be highly preferred. 

9. Technical & Domain Skills

Technical Skills

- Full-stack application development
 - Java / . NET / Python / PHP or equivalent
 - JavaScript / TypeScript
 - React / Angular or equivalent
 - SQL Server / MySQL / PostgreSQL / Oracle
 - REST APIs and system integration
 - Cloud technologies

HIMS / HIS | EMR / EHR | LIS | RIS | PACS | HL7 | FHIR | DICOM | Healthcare APIs | Medical Device Integration

10. Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Excellent understanding of hospital workflows
 - Project and team management
 - Stakeholder management
 - Strong communication and documentation skills
 - Process improvement mindset
 - Ability to interact effectively with doctors, nurses and administrators
 - Strong leadership and decision-making skills

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a healthcare technology professional capable of bridging hospital operations and software development. The candidate should understand clinical, administrative and financial hospital workflows and translate them into an integrated, secure and scalable HIMS platform. 

Experience in developing or implementing HIMS/HIS/EMR/EHR solutions in a medical college hospital or multi-specialty hospital will be an added advantage.

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Architect with strong expertise in Next. js, React. js, and Python to design, architect, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications. 

The ideal candidate should have hands-on development experience, strong system design capabilities, and the ability to lead technical architecture decisions across frontend, backend, databases, cloud infrastructure, and integrations.

Frontend Technologies

• Knowledge of micro-frontend architecture is an advantage. 

Backend Technologies

• Strong hands-on experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Django. 

• Experience designing RESTful APIs, asynchronous services, and microservices. 

• Strong understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, and middleware. 

• Experience with background processing, task queues, and distributed systems. 

Database & Data Layer

• Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server. 

• Knowledge of MongoDB, Redis, or other NoSQL/caching technologies. 

• Strong understanding of database modeling, indexing, and query optimization. 

• Experience with ORMs such as SQLAlchemy. 

Architecture & System Design

• Strong knowledge of High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD). 

• Experience designing scalable, distributed, multi-tenant enterprise applications. 

• Understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean architecture. 

• Experience with API gateways, message queues, caching, and event-driven architecture. 

• Ability to make architectural decisions considering performance, security, cost, and maintainability. 

Cloud & DevOps

• Experience with AWS or Microsoft Azure. 

• Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based deployments. 

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. 

• Understanding of cloud networking, monitoring, logging, and infrastructure scalability. 

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

• Experience integrating Generative AI and LLM-based capabilities into enterprise applications. 

• Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies. 

• Experience with WebSockets, real-time applications, and asynchronous communication. 

• Knowledge of GraphQL and API orchestration. 

• Familiarity with Databricks, data platforms, or analytics-driven applications. 

• Experience working with enterprise SSO, OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID. 

Leadership & Collaboration

• Ability to lead technical teams and mentor senior developers. 

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 

• Experience conducting architecture reviews and technical feasibility assessments. 

• Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture and implementation plans. 

• Strong communication skills for collaborating with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. 

• Experience supporting technical estimations, solution proposals, and delivery planning. 

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

• 6-8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience in full-stack application development. 

• At least 2-3 years of experience in technical architecture, solution design, or technical leadership. 

• Proven experience architecting and delivering production-grade enterprise applications. 

Expected Outcomes

• Deliver scalable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready application architectures. 

• Establish consistent technical standards across frontend and backend development. 

• Improve application performance, reliability, and development efficiency. 

• Provide architectural guidance while remaining actively involved in critical technical implementations.

data.title: Physical Design Manager
data.description:
Company Description Radiant Semiconductors is a VLSI services firm delivering advanced Design Verification, DFT, Physical Design, Physical Verification, Analog Layout, and Analog Circuit Design solutions to leading global clients. The company is recognized for its expertise across the semiconductor lifecycle, supporting complex and high-performance chip development. Radiant Semiconductors is expanding its offerings to include Embedded, Automotive, and Software sectors, enabling integrated product and design (P&D) services across multiple technology domains. This growth provides opportunities for professionals to work on diverse projects in VLSI, Embedded, Automotive, and Software, collaborating with international teams and customers. 
Role Description The Physical Design Manager will lead and oversee end-to-end physical design activities, ensuring high-quality implementation from RTL to GDSII for complex SoCs and ASICs. This full-time, on-site role is based in the Greater Bengaluru Area and involves managing a team of physical design engineers, driving project schedules, and coordinating with RTL, verification, and timing sign-off teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, power optimization, and close collaboration with physical verification teams for sign-off. The manager will also contribute to methodology improvements, review design constraints, resolve design and implementation issues, and communicate project status and risks to stakeholders. Mentoring team members, conducting technical reviews, and maintaining best practices in physical design and sign-off flows are key aspects of this role. 
Qualifications

- Strong expertise in Physical Design, including floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and implementation flows. 
 - Hands-on experience with Timing analysis and closure, including static timing analysis, constraint management, and sign-off methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in Power Analysis, power optimization techniques, and power integrity considerations in complex digital designs. 
 - Knowledge of Physical Verification flows, including DRC, LVS, and sign-off checks, and collaboration with PD and layout teams. 
 - Understanding of RTL Design concepts, interfaces, and constraints to support effective implementation and debug. 
 - Experience with industry-standard EDA tools (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys, or equivalent) for physical design, timing, and verification. 
 - Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams, manage multiple projects, and drive schedules and quality targets. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field. 
 - Prior experience in managing physical design teams or large, complex designs is highly beneficial.

This role requires deep technical expertise in Kubernetes, Networking, and Go (Golang) to develop scalable, secure, and high-performance platform solutions that empower engineering teams.

 - Networking (Expert): Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, Load Balancing, Ingress, CNI, Network Policies, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting distributed networking.

Key Responsibilities

 - Continuously improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and observability through automation and engineering excellence. 

What We're Looking For

- A platform-first mindset with a passion for building scalable, reliable, secure, and automated engineering platforms that enhance developer productivity. 
 - Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable leading technical initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with accountability for technical decisions, architecture, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to solve complex engineering challenges with pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Passion for mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence, and raising the technical bar across the organization. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, drive architecture and design decisions, mentor engineers, and be accountable for the successful delivery of critical platform engineering projects. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to build reusable frameworks, automation, and platform services that improve developer productivity, reliability, and operational excellence. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on cloud-native platform engineering. 
 - Kubernetes (Expert): Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, controllers, CRDs, Operators, networking, storage, security, RBAC, Helm, and production-scale cluster operations. 
 - Networking (Expert): Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, Load Balancing, Ingress, CNI, Network Policies, routing, firewalls, and troubleshooting distributed networking. 
 - Go (Golang): Extensive experience building scalable backend services, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and automation frameworks. 
 - Azure & AKS: Extensive experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including managing and operating hundreds of AKS clusters at scale. 
 - Kubernetes Operators: Proven experience developing and maintaining Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Strong experience with GitHub workflows, CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, and GitOps practices using Argo CD. 
 - Platform Engineering: Experience designing and building scalable, high-performance platform frameworks, internal developer platforms, and reusable engineering services. 
 - Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of architecture and technical decisions, accountability for team deliverables, and experience conducting code reviews and mentoring engineers. 

Good To Have

- Experience with Cloudflare CDN, edge networking, WAF, DNS, and traffic management. 
 - Experience with MongoDB, including high availability, replication, sharding, and performance tuning. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including IAM, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault/Secrets Management, RBAC, network security, and Zero Trust principles. 
 - Hands-on experience with GitOps workflows and deployment automation. 
 - Experience implementing observability solutions using Elastic Stack, Logstash, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar monitoring and logging platforms. 
 - Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio. 
 - Exposure to multi-cluster Kubernetes, disaster recovery, backup and restore strategies, and platform resilience. 
 - Experience with performance optimization, capacity planning, scalability, and cost optimization for cloud-native platforms. 
 - Knowledge of container security, image scanning, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and software supply chain security. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable platform engineering solutions. 
 - Design and build reusable platform frameworks, services, and automation to improve developer experience and operational efficiency. 
 - Develop cloud-native applications, Kubernetes Operators, controllers, and platform services using Go (Golang). 
 - Design, develop, and maintain Kubernetes Operators using Operator SDK or Kubebuilder. 
 - Drive technical decisions and establish engineering best practices across platform teams. 
 - Own the technical roadmap for platform initiatives and be accountable for architecture, code quality, and successful delivery. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Infrastructure, Security, and SRE teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient platform capabilities. 
 - Perform architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews to maintain high engineering standards. 
 - Mentor and coach junior engineers through technical guidance, design discussions, and code reviews. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues involving Kubernetes, networking, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Continuously improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and observability through automation and engineering excellence. 

What We're Looking For

- A platform-first mindset with a passion for building scalable, reliable, secure, and automated engineering platforms that enhance developer productivity. 
 - Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable leading technical initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with accountability for technical decisions, architecture, and delivery outcomes. 
 - Ability to solve complex engineering challenges with pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Passion for mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence, and raising the technical bar across the organization. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

data.description:
DeepIntent is the leading healthcare marketing platform, purpose-built to help marketers plan, activate, and optimize data-driven campaigns with speed and precision. Backed by patented technology and proven outcomes, DeepIntent's platform delivers measurable audience quality and script lift at scale. Learn more at www. deepintent. com. 

What You'll Do

- Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and backend systems, owning the architecture of high-throughput, low-latency services built primarily on Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Drive architecture decisions for distributed systems, including service boundaries, data modelling, storage choices, and scalability, so the platform stays future-proof as volume and complexity grow. 
 - Tackle the most complex architectural challenges in your area, and partner with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers to shape the technical vision and roadmap. 
 - Lead critical cross-team technical initiatives end to end, from design through rollout, aligning engineering work with product and business goals. 
 - Act as the technical lead for your product line, breaking down complex problems into well-defined work, providing clear technical guidance, and unblocking engineers. 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pair programming, raising the technical bar and fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning. 
 - Design and build systems that make effective use of Redis across a range of patterns, such as caching, real-time counters, rate limiting, distributed locking, pub/sub, and streams, alongside other datastores. 
 - Build and evolve event-driven and asynchronous systems using messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka. 
 - Lead the integration of AI into our products and engineering workflows, including LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and tool integrations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Champion AI-assisted software development across the team, setting standards for how engineers use coding agents and AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality. 
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices around API design, code quality, testing, security, and data privacy, with healthcare compliance expectations in mind. 
 - Design observability strategies (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) using tools such as Grafana and Prometheus to proactively identify bottlenecks and ensure production stability. 
 - Lead deep-dive investigations into complex production issues and drive root-cause fixes and blameless postmortems. 
 - Drive knowledge sharing across engineering through technical documentation, design forums, and internal talks. 

Who You Are

- 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems in production. 
 - Deep expertise in Java (17+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data), including a solid understanding of JVM internals, concurrency, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Redis, including its data structures, persistence and clustering models, and how to apply it to problems beyond caching, with a clear understanding of its trade-offs at scale. 
 - Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e. g. , MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aerospike, Cassandra or similar), including query optimisation and schema design. 
 - Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, and with designing resilient, idempotent, event-driven architectures. 
 - Strong grounding in microservices, REST/gRPC API design, and distributed systems fundamentals (consistency, partitioning, fault tolerance). 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), and owning CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of current AI trends and their practical engineering application: LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, agentic systems, RAG and vector databases, MCP, and evaluation of AI system quality and reliability. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of where they help and where human judgment is essential. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical work across multiple teams, influence architectural decisions without direct authority, and mentor senior engineers. 
 - Clear communicator who can explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience in ad tech (programmatic advertising, RTB, DSP/SSP systems) or healthcare data platforms is a plus. 
 - Experience building production LLM features, including guardrails, cost and latency optimisation, and observability for AI workloads, is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with big data processing frameworks such as Spark or Flink is a plus. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects, or experience with technical writing or speaking, are a plus. 

We believe great work starts with great support. That's why DeepIntent offers a competitive, holistic benefits package designed to empower you both professionally and personally. 

Here's what you can expect when you join our team based in the US: Competitive base salary plus performance based bonus or commission, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K match program, flexible PTO policy and paid holidays, remote friendly culture with flexible work options, career development and advanced education support, WFH and internet stipends, plus many more perks and benefits!

data.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram. 

About The Team

We are seeking an exceptional Engineer to build next-generation security analytics and AI-powered capabilities within Netskope's platform. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who excels at solving complex technical problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, large-scale data systems, and cybersecurity. 

As a Sr. Staff Engineer, you will own the architecture and delivery of cloud services that handle large volumes of data and traffic for enterprise customers. You'll set technical direction, raise the engineering bar for the team, and ship. 

What's In It For You

This is your chance to work at the absolute intersection of Artificial Intelligence, large-scale Data Systems, and Cybersecurity. You won't just use existing tools; you will be designing and implementing sophisticated, cutting-edge systems that fundamentally change how enterprises detect and respond to threats. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance backend services in Python on AWS
 - Architect distributed systems with sound tradeoffs across consistency, availability, latency, cost, and operational complexity
 - Provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from discovery and design through delivery and operations
 - Use AI-native development workflows (Claude Code) to accelerate design, implementation, testing, code review, and debugging, and help the team develop effective practices for doing so
 - Partner with product and customers to turn requirements into well-scoped, well-designed features
 - Investigate and resolve production issues, and drive improvements to observability, reliability, and incident response
 - Improve engineering processes, CI/CD, and developer tooling

Required Skills And Experience

- 12+ years of software development experience, including building enterprise-grade backend systems
 - Expert-level Python, with strong experience building production backend services and REST APIs
 - Deep experience with AWS and cloud architecture (e. g. , compute, storage, networking, messaging, IAM, managed data services)
 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals: scalability, fault tolerance, concurrency, data consistency, and event-driven or asynchronous architectures
 - Solid knowledge of databases and data stores, both relational and NoSQL (OLTP and OLAP)
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Demonstrated fluency with AI-native development, including daily, hands-on use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools. You can describe how you decompose work for an AI agent, review and validate its output critically, and maintain quality, security, and maintainability while moving faster. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
 - Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where you might lead a design one week and fix a critical bug or improve CI the next

Nice to have

- Hands-on experience building production LLM agents, including orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, ReAct-style reasoning and tool-use loops, and deep agent patterns (planning, sub-agents, long-running tasks)
 - Experience with observability tooling and SLO-driven operations
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation)
 - Experience with streaming and messaging systems (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS)

Education

- BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Trusted Data Platform
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. 

You will collaborate closely with principal engineers, architects, SREs, and product teams to define technical roadmaps, improve storage efficiency, and optimize access patterns. You will drive performance tuning, data modeling, caching strategies, and cost optimization across AWS storage services like S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier. Additionally, you will contribute to infrastructure automation, security best practices, and monitoring strategies using tools like Terraform, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry. 

In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. 

Qualifications

Strong Backend Development Skills

- 8+ years of experience in backend software development
 - Proficiency in Kotlin or Java for backend development
 - Experience building high-performance, scalable microservices and APIs
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event-driven architectures

Experience With AWS Storage Technologies

- Hands-on experience with AWS S3, DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, FSx, and Glacier
 - Knowledge of AWS IAM, KMS, and data access policies for secure storage solutions
 - Understanding of AWS networking (VPC, PrivateLink, Route 53) for optimizing storage performance

Distributed Systems & Scalability

- Solid understanding of distributed databases, storage consistency models, and caching mechanisms
 - Experience with sharding, partitioning, and load balancing to scale storage-heavy applications
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures using AWS SNS, SQS, Kinesis, or Kafka

Performance Optimization & Cost Efficiency

- Ability to profile and optimize storage performance, indexing strategies, and data retrieval latencies
 - Experience with cost-efficient storage solutions by implementing tiering, lifecycle policies, and data deduplication
 - Knowledge of benchmarking and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

Security & Reliability

- Experience implementing data encryption at rest and in transit using AWS KMS or TLS
 - Understanding of access control mechanisms (IAM roles, STS, fine-grained permissions)
 - Experience ensuring high availability and disaster recovery using AWS backup strategies and multi-region replication

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

- Experience using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK to manage infrastructure
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for backend deployments using GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or Jenkins
 - Experience with containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), and serverless solutions (Lambda, Fargate)

Troubleshooting & Production Support

- Strong debugging skills for investigating storage failures, high-latency issues, and API bottlenecks
 - Experience using observability and tracing tools to monitor storage workloads
 - Ability to triage and resolve production incidents in large-scale backend systems

Collaboration & Engineering Best Practices

- Strong experience in code reviews, unit testing, and API contract enforcement
 - Ability to work cross-functionally with SREs, data engineers, and infrastructure teams
 - Good documentation habits for ensuring architecture decisions and design patterns are well-documented

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh .

Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Responsibilities

- Apply SRE core tenets of measurement (SLI/SLO/SLA), eliminate toil, and reliability modeling
 - Enable and educate development teams on industry best practice design patterns, ways of working and operational knowledge to ensure platform continuity
 - Develop and architect solutions to infrastructure and operational aspects of new products and feature sets
 - Assist with go/no go preplanning, verification/validation, and review of existing and new product/services
 - Proactively analyze data and test the integrity of network/systems to ensure production applications and services are operating optimally
 - Work within development teams to troubleshoot and resolve business affecting issues
 - Escalations, incident response, RCA, and blameless postmortem
 - Participate in on-call rotation

Qualifications

- At least 7+ years of professional experience within a cloud/web/CDN scale infrastructure
 - Expert Linux troubleshooting in production: isolate CPU vs memory vs IO vs network bottlenecks quickly; hands-on with top/htop, vmstat, iostat, sar, pidstat, ss, lsof, dmesg, and journald/systemd. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals + practical debugging: deep understanding of TCP/UDP and routing basics; can prove issues using curl, dig, mtr/traceroute, nc, and tcpdump. 
 - DNS & HTTP(S) clarity: understands resolver vs authoritative, TTL/caching, SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN patterns; knows HTTP 502/503/504 meaning and common LB/proxy failure modes. 
 - TLS/SSL proficiency: understands certificate chain, expiry, SNI mismatch, handshake failures; can validate quickly using openssl s_client and interpret output. 
 - Production mindset: prioritizes mitigation first (rollback/disable/route around), then RCA; writes clear runbooks and automates repeat fixes to reduce toil. 
 - Expert knowledge of Linux systems, network programming and protocols TCP, UDP, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP
 - Experience with BGP and Anycast routing is a plus
 - Experience with DevOps principles and concepts such as Infrastructure as Code (Ansible/Saltstack), CI/CD (Gitlab, Jenkins, Git), monitoring and visualization (Prometheus, Grafana)
 - Experience with big data technologies such as NoSQL/RDBMS, Redis, ElasticSearch, Kafka
 - Experience with containers and container management (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Experience analyzing and building data telemetry, modeling, pipelines, UI visualization
 - Experience in developing software, troubleshooting, and monitoring large scale distributed systems
 - Implement software engineering best practices/standards and software development life cycle
 - Working knowledge and experience of Agile software development methodologies
 - A strong team player who is accountable towards business urgency
 - Ability to stay organized in a multi-tasking environment
 - Self-starter personality

At Thales, we're committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you'll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Your Impact

About the role -- As a Senior Associate, Core Technology, you'll leverage your technical depth and problem-solving skills to build reliable, lightweight, high-performing web applications and platform services. While your strength is back-end development (Python/Django and related frameworks), you're comfortable collaborating across the stack and are conversant with modern front-end ecosystems (React/Angular/Vue). 

You thrive in an agile, sprint-driven environment and bring a strong engineering mindset: clean architecture, test-driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, and scalable system design. You're also excited by the evolution of AI engineering - especially RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLM integrations, and agentic workflows. What You'll Do

 - Sprint ownership & leadership: Independently run sprints for a small team-planning, task breakdown, execution tracking, and clear communication with internal stakeholders and clients. 

Who You Are

WHO YOU ARE
