data.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on Senior Database Reliability Engineer to help design, build, and scale the database platform used across Sezzle's applications. 

This is not a traditional DBA role. This role is for an engineer who can combine deep database knowledge with software engineering, infrastructure engineering, and platform thinking. You will help build the systems, libraries, automation, standards, and guardrails that make database usage across Sezzle reliable, secure, scalable, and easy for developers to adopt correctly. 

As a Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for improving how Sezzle applications connect to, migrate, operate, observe, and scale their databases. You will work across application teams, infrastructure, security, and engineering leadership to define patterns that improve database reliability by design - not just by operational response. 

You should be comfortable owning problems end-to-end: understanding application behavior, reading code, reviewing database access patterns, building shared tooling, improving connection management, designing migration safety checks, analyzing production performance, and helping developers use databases in safer and more scalable ways. 

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We are looking for someone who can ship production-quality engineering work, not just advise from the sidelines. With AI tooling and automation, you should be a force multiplier for database reliability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Sezzle. 

Compensation: 

For this senior development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience. 

What You'll Do: 

- Design, build, and maintain shared database platform components used by Sezzle applications, such as database connection packages, database client libraries, migration tooling, safety checks, query standards, and developer-facing abstractions. 
 - Establish reliable, scalable patterns for how Sezzle services connect to and interact with relational databases across production, staging, and development environments. 
 - Partner with backend engineering teams to improve database usage in application code, including connection lifecycle, transaction handling, retries, timeouts, pooling, query patterns, and migration workflows. 
 - Build automation and internal tooling that makes database operations safer, more repeatable, and less dependent on manual intervention. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards for database access, schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, connection management, and operational readiness. 
 - Architect and improve database infrastructure across AWS RDS/Aurora MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDS Proxy, read replicas, backups, failover, parameter groups, monitoring, and capacity planning. 
 - Lead database reliability initiatives that reduce operational risk, improve performance, and help Sezzle scale safely. 
 - Review application designs and database changes early in the development lifecycle to ensure reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security are built in from the start. 
 - Build guardrails for database migrations, including automated checks, rollback expectations, schema review workflows, migration observability, and production safety controls. 
 - Improve developer self-service for database provisioning, access, schema management, local development, testing, and observability. 
 - Investigate production database issues by combining application telemetry, database metrics, logs, query plans, traces, and cloud infrastructure data. 
 - Identify and fix systemic database problems, not just symptoms - including bad access patterns, unsafe migrations, inefficient queries, connection storms, lock contention, replication lag, and capacity bottlenecks. 
 - Create and maintain high-signal dashboards, alerts, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, and operational readiness checks for database-backed services. 
 - Drive improvements in database backup validation, restore testing, disaster recovery, failover readiness, and business continuity. 
 - Work with security and compliance teams to improve database access controls, auditability, encryption, secrets management, least privilege, and PCI/SOC 2 aligned controls. 
 - Mentor engineers on database design, query performance, safe migrations, operational readiness, and production debugging. 
 - Use automation and AI tooling where appropriate to improve migration review, query analysis, incident investigation, documentation, and developer productivity. 

What We look for: 

- 6+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, database engineering, SRE, or platform engineering experience. 
 - Strong software engineering ability in at least one production programming language such as Go, Python, or TypeScript. 
 - Proven ability to build production-quality internal tools, libraries, frameworks, services, or platform components used by other engineers. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with relational databases, especially MySQL and/or PostgreSQL, in high-availability production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of how application code interacts with databases, including connection pooling, transactions, isolation levels, retries, timeouts, deadlocks, locking, migrations, and query execution. 
 - Experience designing or improving shared database access patterns, internal database packages, ORM wrappers, migration frameworks, or developer-facing database tooling. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS RDS/Aurora, including provisioning, upgrades, replicas, backups, failover, monitoring, parameter tuning, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with database connection management technologies such as RDS Proxy, PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or application-level pooling. 
 - Strong ability to analyze database performance using query plans, indexes, slow query logs, wait events, locks, metrics, and application traces. 
 - Experience designing safe database migration processes for production systems. 
 - Strong understanding of observability for database-backed applications, including metrics, logs, traces, SLOs, alerting, and incident response. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD systems such as Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Helm, or similar tooling. 
 - Ability to influence engineering teams through clear design reviews, documentation, technical standards, and practical implementation. 
 - Ability to operate independently, identify high-impact problems, propose pragmatic solutions, and drive them to completion. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- Experience building platform capabilities for a microservices environment. 
 - Experience with Golang application development and database access patterns. 
 - Experience creating database libraries, SDKs, service templates, migration frameworks, or paved-road developer tooling. 
 - Experience improving database reliability across many services or teams, not just one application. 
 - Experience with fintech, payments, banking, e-commerce, or other high-volume transactional systems. 
 - Experience with compliance-sensitive environments such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or SOX. 
 - Experience with database access governance, audit logging, secrets management, encryption, IAM authentication, and least-privilege access models. 
 - Experience with large-scale operational automation for provisioning, patching, failover testing, backup validation, access management, or schema review. 
 - Experience with distributed systems patterns such as transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, idempotency, queues, eventual consistency, and data consistency tradeoffs. 
 - Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Performance Insights, OpenTelemetry, or New Relic. 
 - Familiarity with Elasticsearch or other supporting data stores. 
 - Familiarity with AI developer tooling such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, and using it to be a more productive engineer. 

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack: 

- Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend: Golang
 - Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control: Git
 - CI/CD: Gitlab
 - Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
 - Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

data.description:
About T-Mobile: 

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America's supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience. 

About TMUS Global Solutions: 

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company's global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking. 

TMUS India Private Limited operates as TMUS Global Solutions. 

T-Mobile is expanding its TfB capabilities and is seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to own quality engineering for Salesforce-based B2B and enterprise solutions. This role designs and builds automated test frameworks, drives test strategy across the delivery lifecycle, and partners with developers, business analysts, and product owners to ensure Salesforce releases are reliable, secure, and defect-free. 

The SDET combines strong software-engineering skills with deep testing expertise to shift quality left, reduce production risk, and build durable automation that scales with the platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and suites for Salesforce applications, covering UI, API, and data-layer testing. 
 - Develop Apex test classes and ensure meaningful code coverage, adherence to bulkification, and validation of governor-limit behavior. 
 - Build and maintain automated regression, functional, and integration test suites using tools such as ACCELQ, Selenium, TOSCA, Copado, or similar Salesforce test-automation platforms. 
 - Define and execute test strategy and test plans for new features, integrations, and platform enhancements, including risk-based test prioritization. 
 - Validate integrations between Salesforce and external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, Platform Events) for functional correctness, data integrity, and error handling. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, performance, and exploratory testing across Salesforce releases and sandboxes. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects; perform root-cause analysis in partnership with development teams; verify fixes. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and safe, frequent deployments. 
 - Collaborate with developers and architects during design reviews to build testability into features from the start. 
 - Monitor test results, coverage metrics, and quality KPIs; report on release readiness and quality risk to stakeholders. 
 - Maintain test-data management strategies and environment/sandbox readiness for testing needs. 
 - Mentor other QA/testing team members on automation practices, tools, and Salesforce-specific testing techniques. 

Minimum Required Qualifications: 

- 3-5 years of experience in software quality engineering / test automation, including experience testing Salesforce applications. 
 - Hands-on experience writing Apex test classes and validating Salesforce configuration, automation, and integrations. 
 - Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks/scripts (e. g. , ACCELQ, Selenium, TOSCA, Copado, or similar tools) using a programming or scripting language such as Java, JavaScript, or Apex. 
 - Strong understanding of basic software design principles and the ability to apply them in automation framework and test suite development. Candidate should be able to build reusable, maintainable, scalable, and customizable automation solutions. 
 - Solid understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing), and platform limits as they relate to testing. 
 - Experience testing REST/SOAP API integrations, including using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and working with source control (Git). 
 - Strong understanding of QA methodologies, including test planning, test-case design, defect management, and risk-based testing. 
 - Ability to analyze requirements and designs to identify test scenarios, edge cases, and quality risks. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly report quality status and risk to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and collaboration across Product, Development, Architecture, and Release Management teams. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, or a testing-focused Salesforce credential. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing tools for Salesforce or integrated systems. 
 - Experience with data-migration validation, master-data quality checks, or synchronization testing involving Salesforce. 
 - Experience in telecommunications, wireless, IoT, enterprise connectivity, quoting, contracting, order management, or related B2B domains. 
 - Experience with observability/monitoring tools for tracking test and release quality trends. 
 - Experience working with distributed onshore and offshore engineering and QA teams.

data.description:
Build our future together

Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health. 

At Regeneron Digital & Technology, we are expanding our AI and Platform Engineering capabilities to support next-generation intelligent systems, machine learning platforms, and cloud-native technologies. We are seeking an AI-MLOps SRE Lead Engineer to drive reliability, scalability, observability, and operational excellence across our AI, ML, and cloud ecosystem. Hyderabad (Hybrid)

 - Design, build, and scale enterprise ML platform infrastructure using technologies such as Dataiku, Amazon SageMaker AI, Databricks, and Google Vertex AI.

 - Design and implement Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, self-healing systems, and platform automation capabilities to improve engineering productivity and operational resilience. 
 - Architect enterprise ChatOps solutions that integrate operational events, AI workflows, observability platforms, and automated remediation capabilities. 
 - Partner with Data Science, AI Engineering, and Platform teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI/ML solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI-native operational technologies and integrate innovative solutions that enhance platform reliability, engineering efficiency, and business value. 
 - Conduct technical debt assessments, identify architectural risks, and provide strategic recommendations to improve enterprise platform maturity. 
 - Serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor, mentoring engineers and influencing reliability engineering, MLOps, and cloud platform strategy across the organization. 

This role requires

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related subject area; Master's degree preferred. 
 - 6-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or related technology fields with enterprise-scale delivery experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience operating across two or more major cloud platforms, including AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Deep expertise with ML platform technologies including Databricks, Amazon SageMaker AI, Dataiku, and Google Vertex AI. 
 - Proven experience implementing end-to-end ML workflows including model training, deployment, experiment tracking, monitoring, and pipeline orchestration. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and modern CI/CD automation practices. 
 - Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages. 
 - Experience building enterprise observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics, and logging platforms. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in anomaly detection, predictive analytics, automated remediation, and AI-assisted operational capabilities. 
 - Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise ChatOps solutions and AI-enabled operational workflows. 
 - Strong ability to assess technical debt, influence technical strategy, and drive platform modernization initiatives. 
 - Experience using AI tools, LLM-powered assistants, and AI Agents to enhance engineering operations and productivity. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms such as EKS, GKE, or AKS preferred. 
 - Familiarity with MLOps technologies including Kubeflow, Feast, MLflow, and model evaluation frameworks such as LangSmith, RAGAS, Evidently AI, or Weights & Biases preferred. 
 - Knowledge of cloud cost optimization, policy-as-code, compliance automation, and multi-cloud governance practices preferred. 

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. data.title: QA Manager - Salesforce & Tosca Tricentris
data.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Test Lead with over 8 years of experience in software quality assurance to spearhead our testing initiatives. In this role, you will define the automation strategy, build robust frameworks, and lead a team of QA engineers. Your primary focus will be optimizing and executing automated regression suites for complex, enterprise-level Salesforce ecosystems using Tricentis Tosca. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business processes and technical execution, ensuring the seamless delivery of high-quality CRM solutions in an Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategy & Framework Design: Define, build, and maintain scalable, model-based automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca optimized for Salesforce. 
 - Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead, mentor, and allocate tasks to a team of QA engineers. Coordinate testing activities across multi-vendor setups and cross-functional Agile teams. 
 - Salesforce End-to-End Validation: Map end-to-end business workflows and validate complex configurations across core Salesforce environments (e. g. , Sales Cloud, Service Cloud).

Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Job Purpose

Looking for a Data QA Engineer to lead data validation and regression testing across capital-markets data pipelines spanning legacy and modern platforms. The role will focus on ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema checks, reconciliation, lineage review, and automation-led regression testing. 

The candidate will build reusable Python/SQL-based validation frameworks, support batch and cloud execution, validate post-trade data flows, identify data anomalies, and partner with engineering and business teams to embed strong data-quality controls. The ideal candidate combines data QA expertise, capital-markets domain understanding, automation-first thinking, and strong ownership of data quality across environments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments. 
 - Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities. 
 - Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems. 
 - Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows. 
 - Perform testing of derivative products and workflows including Options, Swaps, Futures, and Forwards. 
 - Validate business workflows covering bonds, treasuries, corporate debt, and other fixed income instruments
 - Verify trade booking, valuations, cashflows, margin processing, lifecycle events, and settlement workflows across asset classes. 
 - Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance. 
 - Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms. 
 - Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions. 
 - Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows. 
 - Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments. 
 - Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows. 
 - Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations. 
 - Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context. 
 - Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting. 

Key competencies

- 5-7 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles. 
 - Atleast basic domain knowledge of Capital Markets with expertise in Fixed Income products and workflows
 - Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification. 
 - Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets. 
 - Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms. 
 - Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow. 
 - Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios. 
 - Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation. 
 - Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines. 
 - Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform integrations. 
 - Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams to align hardware development with overall product requirements. 2. Embedded Hardware Design & Development

- Lead the design and development of embedded hardware systems for robotics, automation, and other intelligent devices. 
 - Develop circuit schematics, select electronic components, and oversee PCB design and layout for complex embedded systems. 
 - Design and validate analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits. 
 - Work with microcontrollers, processors, power management circuits, sensor interfaces, and peripheral devices. 
 - Evaluate component specifications, cost, availability, reliability, and suitability for product requirements. 3. PCB Design, Prototyping & Manufacturing

- Oversee PCB design and layout using tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad, or equivalent EDA software. 
 - Review schematics, PCB layouts, signal integrity, power integrity, and thermal considerations. 
 - Lead hardware prototyping, soldering, board bring-up, and troubleshooting activities. 
 - Ensure designs follow design-for-manufacturing (DFM), design-for-testability (DFT), and design-for-reliability principles. 
 - Collaborate with manufacturing partners and vendors to ensure smooth transition from prototype to production. 4. Hardware Testing, Validation & Debugging

- Lead hardware testing, verification, validation, and system-level debugging. 
 - Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, spectrum analyzers, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve hardware issues. 
 - Troubleshoot power, signal integrity, communication, and electromagnetic interference (EMI/EMC) issues. 
 - Establish test procedures, validation plans, and reliability assessment methods. 
 - Ensure hardware performance meets functional, safety, and applicable regulatory requirements. 5. Hardware-Firmware & System Integration

- Collaborate with embedded firmware, software, and robotics teams to define hardware specifications and system interfaces. 
 - Integrate microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, communication modules, and other electronic subsystems. 
 - Troubleshoot hardware-firmware integration issues and optimize overall system performance. 
 - Support the integration of embedded hardware with robotics platforms, control systems, and automation solutions. 
 - Work with communication interfaces and protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, and Ethernet. 6. Technical Documentation & Quality Management

- Maintain accurate technical documentation, including schematics, PCB layouts, bills of materials (BOMs), test reports, and design specifications. 
 - Conduct design reviews, risk assessments, and root-cause analysis for hardware failures. 
 - Ensure adherence to engineering standards, internal quality processes, and applicable safety and compliance requirements. 
 - Track component changes, design revisions, and engineering documentation throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in hardware design, development processes, and product reliability. Required Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field. 
 - Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in embedded hardware design and development. 
 - Proven experience in leading or managing a team of hardware engineers. 
 - Demonstrated experience in taking embedded hardware products from concept and prototyping through validation and production. 
 - Strong experience in PCB design, circuit development, hardware debugging, and system integration. Required Technical Skills
 - Circuit Design: Strong knowledge of analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuit design. 
 - PCB Design: Hands-on experience with Altium Designer, KiCad, or equivalent PCB design tools. 
 - Microcontrollers & Processors: Experience with ARM Cortex-M, STM32, PIC, AVR, or similar platforms. 
 - Communication Protocols: Working knowledge of UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, and Ethernet. 
 - Hardware Debugging: Proficiency with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and other hardware diagnostic tools. 
 - Power Electronics: Understanding of power supply design, voltage regulation, battery management, and power distribution. 
 - Hardware Integration: Experience integrating sensors, actuators, communication modules, and embedded controllers. 
 - Debugging Tools: Familiarity with JTAG/SWD debugging and firmware debugging tools. 
 - Version Control: Working knowledge of Git or equivalent version control systems. 
 - Hardware Reliability: Understanding of EMI/EMC, signal integrity, thermal management, and hardware validation practices. Leadership & Managerial Competencies

 - Experience in project planning, resource allocation, and delivery management. 
 - Ability to conduct design reviews and establish engineering best practices. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 - A proactive approach to risk management, continuous improvement, and innovation. Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience in robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems, or intelligent electronic products. 
 - Exposure to sensor integration, motor control, motor drivers, and actuator interfaces. 
 - Experience with high-speed digital design, RF modules, wireless connectivity, or advanced power electronics.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently driving critical design decisions, resolving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and ensuring the successful delivery of reliable embedded hardware solutions.

Job Description

Position Summary

Job Summary

As the Intelligent Packaged Power (IPP) SW/FW Engineering Team Lead, you will lead the IPP software and firmware engineering resources based in Pune. Your scope will include the LVMCC Software Engineering Team and the MVB Firmware Engineering Team. You will combine people leadership, technical direction, and execution leadership to allow secure, reliable, and high-quality embedded firmware and industrial software solutions. You will work in partnership with the designated Scrum Masters. You will collaborate with global teams, including engineering, product management, quality, cybersecurity, test, and operations teams. These collaborations will align priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions for IPP products and platforms. 

You will report to the Global Engineering Director - IPP and will work in hybrid schedule based in Pune, Hinjewadi. 

Your Responsibilities

- Lead the Pune-based IPP software and firmware engineering teams, creating clear priorities, engagement, accountability, and understanding of IPP goals. 
 - Provide daily leadership for the LVMCC Software Engineering Team and MVB Firmware Engineering Team, balancing people leadership with hands-on technical guidance and delivery ownership. 
 - Coach engineers in technical capability, career development, and professional growth while building a culture of inclusion, learning, collaboration, and engineering excellence. 
 - Partner with global engineering leaders and product team members to translate product roadmaps and customer needs into executable software and firmware plans, staffing priorities, and delivery commitments. 
 - Support planning and execution, remove organisational impediments, manage cross-team dependencies, and lead predictable delivery and continuous improvement. 
 - Promote disciplined engineering practices across architecture, requirements, design, coding, peer review, configuration management, verification, validation, release, and lifecycle support. 
 - Champion quality, functional safety, product security, DevOps, automated testing, and CI/CD practices appropriate for industrial software and embedded firmware development. 
 - Coordinate across distributed teams, including hardware, systems, test, quality, cybersecurity, product management, and manufacturing engineering. 
 - Monitor project health, capacity, technical risks, defects, and delivery performance; communicate clear status, decisions, trade-offs, and escalations to stakeholders. 
 - Support hiring, onboarding, resource planning, succession planning, and capability development for the Pune SW/FW organization. 
 - Guide reuse, common architectures, tools, and engineering methods across LVMCC and MVB while respecting product-specific technical and regulatory requirements. 
 - Foster customer-focused innovation and identify opportunities to improve product value, engineering efficiency, maintainability, and speed to market. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Electronic & Communication, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum 7 years of relevant software or firmware engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a team leadership, people leadership, technical leadership, or engineering management role. 
 - Experience leading, coaching, software and/or firmware engineers in a product development environment. 
 - Experience delivering industrial software, embedded firmware, controls, automation, power electronics, motor control, or other complex engineered products. 
 - Working knowledge of modern software and firmware development lifecycles, requirements management, architecture, coding practices, testing, defect management, and release processes. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments with product owners and cross-functional engineering stakeholders. 
 - Legal authorization to work in India. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

- Master's degree in a relevant engineering or technical field. 
 - Experience leading both application software and embedded firmware teams. 
 - Knowledge of low-voltage motor control centers, medium-voltage products, drives, motor control, power distribution, or industrial automation systems. 
 - Experience with Rockwell Automation platforms, IntelliCENTER solutions, FactoryTalk software, Logix-based systems, or connected industrial products. 
 - Experience with embedded C/C++, real-time operating systems, industrial communications, desktop or web application development, and software integration. 
 - Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated build and test environments, source control, static analysis, and engineering metrics. 
 - Knowledge of product cybersecurity, secure development lifecycle practices, functional safety, or relevant industrial standards. 
 - Experience managing external partners, contractors, or globally distributed development teams. 
 - Agile, project management, or engineering leadership certification. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees. 
 - Company volunteer and donation matching programme - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalised wellbeing programmes through our OnTrack programme
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world's most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do. 

The Opportunity

This role shapes the end-to-end design and delivery of resilient cloud-native data platforms and microservices. You'll set technical direction across modernisation of legacy estates while staying close enough to the code to unblock teams and strengthen engineering quality in Java and distributed system design. The focus spans high-performance data pipelines, event-driven integration and production-ready operational standards in a regulated environment. Success means services that are scalable, observable and secure with clear roadmaps that reduce risk and disruption to live operations. You'll influence senior stakeholders by translating business outcomes into pragmatic technical plans and measurable milestones. 

What you'll be doing

- Own solution architecture for high-performance data pipelines and microservices including resilience, scalability, latency, observability and security
 - Define modernisation roadmaps across re-platforming, refactoring and microservices decomposition with minimal disruption to live services
 - Establish engineering standards for API design, event-driven integration, data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD and operational readiness
 - Manage technical debt through clear prioritisation and measurable outcomes
 - Architect, design and build core services using Java (8+), Spring Boot 3, JPA and PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) using event streaming patterns
 - Deliver real-time processing implementations using Apache Flink and/or Apache Beam where appropriate
 - Partner with engineers on code reviews, pair debugging, performance tuning and production incident resolution
 - Own operational excellence on GCP across monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, reliability improvements and cost optimisation

What we're looking for

- Bring substantial software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed systems and data-intensive applications
 - Demonstrate recent hands-on Java engineering expertise using Spring Boot with REST and event-driven services
 - Apply proven system design across microservices patterns, asynchronous messaging, idempotency, consistency models, caching, rate limiting and failure handling
 - Show strong SQL capability including performance tuning and working effectively with ORM frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate
 - Deliver cloud-native solutions on GCP or an equivalent cloud platform with the ability to translate patterns and services
 - Troubleshoot across application, data, infrastructure and performance layers to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence
 - Communicate architecture decisions clearly and connect them to business priorities and operational constraints
 - Coach and mentor engineers across levels to strengthen craftsmanship, accountability and continuous improvement

Building resilient data services

If you want to shape modern cloud-native platforms while staying hands-on with Java engineering this role offers real scope to make a visible difference. You'll set direction for microservices and data pipelines that need to perform under demanding production conditions. The work spans architecture, delivery and operational excellence so improvements show up in reliability, scalability and engineering efficiency. If this aligns with the kind of platform work you want to own we'd welcome your application. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc. , We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. "

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. 

Issued by - HSBC Software Development India

data.title: Software Development Engineer - 3
data.description:
AssetPlus is redefining the future of wealth management. We're a fast-scaling SaaS fintech platform powering mutual fund distributors (MFDs) and financial advisors with tools that modernise how investments are managed. Our mission is to build India's best assisted wealth management platform, helping millions of households achieve their financial goals. 

Engineering at AssetPlus is a growth led, high-velocity team of ~18 engineers organized into three product pods. We ship on a modern, AI-enabled Node. js + TypeScript + MongoDB stack, own our systems in production, and hold a high technical and cultural bar. If you want to solve meaningful problems at scale with real ownership, this is the place. 

The Role

We are looking for a deeply hands-on SDE-3 who owns features end-to-end and raises the quality bar within a pod. You bring strong technical judgment, speed, clarity and simplicity to everything you build. You will be a core builder inside one product pod: designing services, writing production Node. js + TypeScript, shaping MongoDB schemas, debugging across backend, React and Flutter, and keeping the systems you own reliable. You will use AI as a cognitive partner to move faster without lowering the bar. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Systems

- Design and build scalable, resilient services within your pod's domain. 
 - Contribute to system design reviews and argue trade-offs with first-principles reasoning. 
 - Decide what to build vs reuse vs adopt open-source, and explain the call. 
 - Follow and strengthen the architecture patterns the team has agreed on. 

Hands-On Engineering

- Write high-quality Node. js + TypeScript code - readable, tested, production-grade. 
 - Design efficient MongoDB schemas and build complex aggregations. 
 - Debug issues across React, Flutter and Backend, down to the infra and DB layer. 
 - Leverage AI capabilities and develop at a high pace with good taste. 

AI Driven Engineering

- Use AI as a cognitive partner to accelerate coding, debugging, design and decision-making. 
 - Orchestrate models, tools, context and workflows into a productive AI-powered engineering loop. 
 - Continuously adopt new AI capabilities to compound speed and improve system quality. 
 - Bring AI native practices into your pod's day-to-day workflow. 

Reliability & Support

- Monitor the systems you own and catch issues early. 
 - Respond to critical incidents with urgency - including off-hours when it matters. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis, performance improvements and observability. 

Developer Experience & Quality

- Contribute to improving developer workflows, tooling and automation. 
 - Maintain high standards around clarity, testing, security and simplicity. 
 - Advocate for minimal, robust and maintainable engineering. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and review their work closely. 
 - Communicate decisions clearly and confidently. 
 - Be approachable, energetic and easy to build with. 

What we are looking for; 

Must have

- 6-8 years of full stack experience with a backend-heavy core (experience range is indicative - we hire for ownership, not tenure)
 - Strong Node. js + TypeScript in production; you have owned services end-to-end, not just contributed
 - Solid MongoDB - schema design, indexing, complex aggregations
 - Built and operated systems under real load; comfortable being on the hook when they break
 - Strong debugging across backend, frontend and DB layer
 - Pragmatic engineering judgment - simple > clever; sound build vs reuse vs open-source calls
 - Strong communicator - can clearly explain a system you owned and the decisions behind it

Strongly Preferred

- Hands-on AWS - CloudWatch, ECS, Amplify, Lambda, SQS, SES
 - React and/or Flutter exposure - enough to debug across the stack
 - Fintech, wealth-tech or SEBI-regulated product experience
 - Daily use of AI coding tools as a real productivity multiplier, not a novelty
 - Experience mentoring juniors and running meaningful code reviews
 - CI/CD, Docker and GitHub-based workflows in a fast-shipping team

data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

About Gracenote : 

Gracenote is the top provider of entertainment information, creating industry-leading databases of TV, movie, and music metadata for entertainment guides, applications and in-car entertainment. Our technology serves billions of requests daily to hundreds of millions of devices around the world. Our customers include innovators like Apple, Twitter, Google, Spotify, M-GO and Hulu, top consumer electronics and cable companies, and leading automotive manufacturers such as Ford and Toyota, throughout the US and the world. Simply put, data provides you with an opportunity to impact the evolution of the entire entertainment industry. 

Purpose

As a devops engineer, your role is to support the development teams by assisting in automation of deployment processes, monitoring system performance and troubleshooting issues. You will gain hands-on experience in implementing devops tools and practices, contributing to efficiency and reliability of our software delivery. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Deploy, automate, maintain, and troubleshoot DevOps managed shared services
 - Assist in Design, Implement and maintain scalable, reliable infrastructure to support SDLC 
 - Develop and manage robust CI/CD pipelines to streamline software releases and updates
 - Ensure the availability, performance, scalability and security of production systems
 - Contribute to automating system configurations, deployments and monitoring to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention. 
 - Research and implement new DevOps technologies 
 - Work closely with the Global DevOps and dedicated DevOps teams
 - Suggest and implement best practices and architecture improvements

Must Haves

- Proven ability to troubleshoot complex systems issues and implement effective solutions. 
 - Demonstrable DevOps experience 
 - Experience with programming or scripting language such as Python, Bash, Java
 - Experience working in a Linux and in a cloud environment 
 - Proficient in implementing Infrastructure as a code using tools like terraform and cloud formation
 - Experience with Infrastructure as code, containerization such as K8s/Docker, logging, monitoring and alerting, and CI/CD tools 
 - Willingness to learn above mentioned qualifications if some are missing
 - Minimum 3+ years provisioning, operating, and managing AWS environments 
 - Proficient with AWS services
 - Familiarity interacting with AWS APIs 
 - AWS Disaster Recovery design and deployment across regions a plus

Desired Skills / Good To Have

- Experience with multi-tier architectures: load balancers, caching, web servers, application servers, databases, and networking 
 - Experience in automation and testing via scripting & programming (PowerShell, Jenkins, Python, Ruby, Java) 
 - Experience with working with geographically dispersed teams
 - Experience with secrets management tools like Hashicorp Vault
 - Professional certifications such as AWS certified Devops Engineer, Kubernetes administrator etc
 - Demonstrated experience leading devops teams or projects, fostering collaboration. 
 - A personal technical blog
 - A personal (Git) repository of side projects
 - Participation in an open-source community

Qualifications

- B. E / B. Tech / BCA/ MCA in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject. 
 - Strong Computer Science fundamentals. 
 - Comfortable with version control systems such as git. 
 - A thirst for learning new Tech and keeping up with industry advances. 
 - Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing skills. 
 - Comfortable working with technical and non-technical teams. 
 - Strong debugging skills. 
 - Comfortable providing and receiving code review feedback. 
 - Smart+Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
 - A positive attitude, adaptability, enthusiasm, and a growth mindset. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Scope: 

Yotta is building a family of advanced AI platforms-from large language model infrastructure to no-code AI builders and autonomous agent orchestration tools. 

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and automation of Yotta's platform infrastructure. You will design and operate CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native environments, and production monitoring systems that enable engineering and AI teams to ship safely, frequently, and at scale. 

This This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, infrastructure, and operations, with a strong focus on automation, resilience, and cost efficiency. 

Key Responsibilities: 

A. Infrastructure Automation & Cloud Operations

• Design, build, and maintain scalable infrastructure across cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and on-prem environments. 

• Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent. 

• Manage Kubernetes clusters, container orchestration, and node-level optimizations. 

• Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery readiness. 

B. CI/CD & Release Engineering

• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for backend, frontend, and AI workloads. 

• Automate build, test, security scanning, and deployment processes. 

• Implement safe deployment strategies such as blue-green, canary, and rolling releases. 

• Partner with engineering teams to improve release velocity without compromising stability. 

C. Observability, Reliability & Incident Management

• Build and maintain observability stacks for metrics, logs, and traces (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, etc. ). 

• Define SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs for critical services. 

• Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. 

• Proactively identify and resolve reliability and performance bottlenecks. 

D. Security, Compliance & Governance

• Implement security best practices across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments. 

• Manage secrets, access controls, and identity management securely. 

• Support compliance requirements such as SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and India DPDP Act. 

• Collaborate with security and compliance teams on audits and risk mitigation. 

E. Cost Optimization & Platform Efficiency

• Monitor and optimize infrastructure costs across compute, storage, networking, and AI workloads. 

• Implement auto-scaling, resource quotas, and cost-aware scheduling. 

• Provide visibility into infra usage and cost drivers for leadership and product teams. 

F. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement

• Work closely with backend, frontend, AI/ML, and MLOps teams to support production workloads. 

• Create reusable infrastructure templates and DevOps best practices. 

• Mentor junior DevOps or platform engineers through reviews and guidance. 

• Act as a technical advisor on scalability, reliability, and deployment strategies. 

Qualifications Criteria: 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

• 8 plus years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering roles. 

• Proven experience operating production systems with real uptime and SLA commitments. 

• Strong hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container ecosystems. 

• Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure). 

• Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or similar tooling. 

• Experience with Git-based CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD). 

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and tracing stacks. 

• Knowledge of networking, load balancing, and CDN architectures. 

• Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, or equivalent). 

• Hands-on experience managing large-scale distributed systems. 

• Experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or AI infrastructure environments is a major plus. 

Interested candidates can share their updates resume at sadhatrao@yotta. com

Regards, 

YOTTA

data.title: Full Stack Engineer (Go and React)
data.description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. Miratech retains over 1000 full-time professionals and has achieved sustained shareholder value growth exceeding 25% annually over many years. 

Job Description

Join a team building innovative, cloud-native applications that power next-generation conversational AI and enterprise solutions. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will develop scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and modern web applications using Golang and React. You will work with modern cloud technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and contribute to reliable, high-performance solutions that support evolving business needs. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Golang. 
 - Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly web applications using React, and modern frontend development practices. 
 - Integrate frontend applications with backend services, third-party APIs, and enterprise systems to enable seamless data exchange and business workflows. 
 - Develop and enhance cloud-native applications and distributed systems, contributing to reliable, scalable, and efficient application architectures. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and testable code; participate in code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization. 
 - Support CI/CD pipelines, application deployments, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting to maintain application stability and reliability. 
 - Identify and resolve technical issues, optimize application performance, and contribute to continuous improvements across the development lifecycle. 
 - Work closely with product, architecture, security, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, using approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity and code quality. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend applications using React. 
 - 3+ years of experience in Go programming, backend development, REST APIs, and microservices. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure. 
 - Hands-on experience with distributed systems, API integrations, and application design. 
 - Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. 
 - Understanding of application security, performance optimization, debugging, and production support. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Nice To Have

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application architectures. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Kafka. 
 - Exposure to conversational AI, chatbot applications, or AI-powered solutions. 
 - Familiarity with real-time communication, voice integrations, or telephony technologies. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools. 
 - Exposure to third-party AI/ML integrations or generative AI solutions. 

Additional Information

We offer: 

- Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. 
 - Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. 
 - Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work. 
 - Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. 
 - Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. 
 - Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. 
 - Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. 
 - Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Job Title: Frontend Architect / Technical Lead - Digital Experiences & AI

Location: Flexible / Remote, subject to business requirements

Experience: Typically 8-12+ years in software engineering, with substantial hands-on frontend architecture and delivery experience

Engagement: Full-time or contract, depending on availability and budget

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Frontend Architect / Technical Lead to lead the technical design, development and continuous improvement of a portfolio of modern, content-driven digital experiences across various digital platforms. 

The successful candidate will work closely with business and engineering leadership to translate product requirements into scalable, reusable and maintainable frontend solutions. The role combines architecture, hands-on coding, API integration, technical problem-solving and team leadership. 

The candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of an existing Sanity-based platform with limited vendor transition support, establishing independent development and deployment capabilities, and delivering business outcomes in a fast-moving environment. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not an architecture-only position. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Architecture and Engineering

- Design and evolve frontend architecture using React, Next. js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. 
 - Establish reusable components, design patterns, application structures and shared frontend capabilities across multiple brands. 
 - Balance common architecture with channel-specific branding, content presentation and business requirements. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leadership and business stakeholders on architectural decisions rather than imposing solutions unilaterally. 
 - Ensure responsive design, accessibility, SEO, performance, maintainability and security are incorporated into implementation. 2. Sanity CMS and Digital Experience

- Take technical ownership of the existing Sanity-based content platform. 
 - Design and improve Sanity schemas, content models, references, reusable blocks and publishing workflows. 
 - Enable geolocation-aware content and functionality based on visitor location and applicable business rules. 
 - Support consolidation of existing Journey digital properties into a unified website. 
 - Establish practical integration patterns between Sanity and React/Next. js applications. 

3. API and Travel Technology Integrations

- Design frontend integration patterns for white-label booking solutions. 
 - Evaluate and implement the frontend for the AI itinerary builder, subject to the agreed build and ownership model. 
 - Design reusable booking widgets and integration interfaces that minimise dependency on individual suppliers. 
 - Implement secure API communication, error handling, retries, loading states and appropriate monitoring. 
 - Collaborate with backend, supplier and external technology teams to resolve integration issues. 4. AI-Assisted Development

- Use AI coding assistants and development tools to accelerate implementation, debugging, code reviews, documentation and test creation. 
 - Apply sound engineering judgement to AI-generated code, including security, correctness, performance and maintainability reviews. 
 - Identify opportunities to use AI for rapid prototyping and delivery without compromising production quality. 5. Engineering Ownership and Delivery

- Establish company-controlled source-code repositories, build pipelines and deployment processes. 
 - Lead the technical takeover of the existing platform with minimal vendor assistance. 
 - Ensure the application can be independently built, deployed, tested and maintained. 
 - Establish suitable development and test environments and practical release controls. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to senior developers. 
 - Identify risks early, communicate trade-offs and deliver working increments against agreed milestones. Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on expertise in React, Next. js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. 
 - Production experience with Sanity CMS, including schemas, GROQ queries, content modelling and frontend integration. 
 - Strong experience designing frontend architecture for content-driven websites and multi-brand digital platforms. 
 - Practical experience integrating REST APIs and third-party SaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with responsive UI engineering, SEO, accessibility, web performance and browser compatibility. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD, environment management, automated builds and production deployments. 
 - Understanding of authentication, authorisation, secure frontend practices and API security. 
 - Practical testing experience using suitable unit, integration and end-to-end testing tools. 
 - Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted software development tools effectively. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Tailwind CSS and reusable design systems. 
 - Experience with geolocation, personalisation, dynamic content and location-specific experiences. 
 - Experience integrating booking engines, travel APIs, payments or dynamic packaging solutions. 
 - Experience with AI itinerary builders, LLM-powered interfaces or agent-based applications. 
 - Experience with analytics-driven optimisation and SEO for content-heavy websites. 
 - Experience taking over applications from external development vendors. Working Style and Leadership Expectations

- Hands-on, pragmatic and comfortable working with ambiguity. 
 - Collaborative, receptive to feedback and aligned with shared architectural governance. 
 - Able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively and explain technical trade-offs. 
 - Comfortable operating in a lean team with multiple priorities and limited budgets. 
 - Focused on delivering usable functionality quickly, then iterating based on testing and feedback. 
 - Accountable for outcomes, not merely technical recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build intuitive, user-friendly Power Apps canvas apps - screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation-aware data access and performance tuning. 
 - Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes.

 - Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs.

 - Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues. 
 - Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client's environment strategy. 
 - Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities. 
 - Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 6-10 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive - component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation. 
 - Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns.

Preferred / Good to Have

Theom was founded in 2020 by an experienced team with extensive backgrounds at Google, Yahoo, and Cisco. These security practitioners, who had previously created Tetration Analytics-one of the first Zero Trust cloud security platforms-united their expertise to build cutting-edge solutions for protecting and governing enterprise data in the cloud.

The Senior QA Engineer defines test strategy, translates business requirements into test scenarios and cases, and leads functional integration, regression, and automation testing as appropriate. The role also oversees defect management, test data preparation, and release validation to help ensure reliable system performance. Working with a high degree of judgment and independence, the Senior QA Engineer collaborates with stakeholders to clarify requirements, investigate issues, support timely resolution, and strengthen overall quality practices. data.title: Manual QA Tester - Junior QA Engineer
data.description:
Ahmedabad, Gujarat - applications welcome from across Gujarat

  Fully remote currently; hybrid working in Ahmedabad planned

  Engineering graduates and freshers welcome | Typically 0-2 years' experience

Full-time | Four openings

  

Start your software testing career with Script AssistScript Assist is hiring four Manual QA Testers / Junior QA Engineers to help test software connecting clinics, pharmacies and patients across the UK. 

Our platform supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month. Behind each prescription are connected workflows: consultations, prescribing, stock availability, payments, dispensing, delivery updates and repeat requests. Those workflows need to work correctly for the people relying on them. 

We're looking for engineering graduates and junior candidates who notice inconsistencies, enjoy investigating problems and can explain their findings clearly. If you want to build a career in manual testing, software testing and quality assurance, this is an opportunity to work on a live product where careful testing matters. 

What you'll be testing

You'll test connected clinic, pharmacy and patient applications, checking both individual features and complete user journeys. 

Does a saved change appear correctly when the record is reopened? Does an order move through the right stages? Can each user access the right information? Does a new release fix the original problem without breaking a related workflow?

Your job will be to turn questions like these into organised tests, investigate unexpected behaviour and give developers clear evidence they can act on. 

What you'll do

•        Functional testing: Check features, forms, validation rules, user permissions and complete workflows against their requirements. 

•        Test cases and scenarios: Turn requirements into practical tests covering normal use, boundary conditions, invalid inputs and exceptions. 

•        Exploratory testing: Investigate unfamiliar features, try different sequences of actions and identify problems that straightforward checks might miss. 

•        Regression, smoke and sanity testing: Check new builds and confirm that changes have not disrupted existing functionality. 

•        Bug reporting and defect tracking: Record clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence. 

•        Retesting and release checks: Verify fixes, check related behaviour and communicate test results to the product and engineering team. 

Who we're looking for

•        A completed B. E. , B. Tech or equivalent engineering degree, in any engineering discipline. 

•        Strong attention to detail and logical reasoning. 

•        An organised approach to investigating problems and following requirements. 

•        The ability to distinguish what you have observed from what you are assuming. 

•        Clear written and spoken English, especially when explaining a problem. 

•        A current base in Gujarat and the ability to work in Ahmedabad when the role moves to a hybrid arrangement. 

Freshers are welcome. Previous professional manual testing experience is not required. Relevant college projects, internships, testing courses or junior QA experience are useful, but your ability to think carefully and perform in the practical assessment matters. 

You do not need programming or test automation experience to apply. 

  

Why join Script Assist?

You'll work on a live healthcare software platform with connected workflows and real operational complexity. Your findings will help improve the experience of clinic staff, pharmacy teams and patients. 

You'll develop practical experience across test design, exploratory testing, defect investigation, regression testing and release verification. As your product knowledge grows, you'll be able to take ownership of more complex features and user journeys. 

This is an opportunity to build the foundations of a software QA career through hands-on product work. 

Location and working arrangement

The role is fully remote at present. We plan to introduce hybrid working in Ahmedabad, so applicants must be able to attend the Ahmedabad office when that arrangement begins. 

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn and complete the short screening questions. Suitable applicants will receive an online practical assessment covering observation, reasoning and manual testing tasks. The strongest candidates will then be invited to a remote interview.

These security practitioners, who had previously created Tetration Analytics-one of the first Zero Trust cloud security platforms-united their expertise to build cutting-edge solutions for protecting and governing enterprise data in the cloud.
