data.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs. 

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale. 

Role Overview & Key Responsibilities

This is a high-leverage leadership role that spans architecture, execution, and org-building, and will shape the direction of our AI / ML initiatives at Ema. We are seeking an AI / ML technical leader who can take a vision and build it. As a Principal ML Engineer at Ema, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for shaping the machine learning roadmap, architecting large-scale ML systems, driving innovation, and ensuring our mixture of expert models (LLM + SLM + Custom Model) is accurate and performant at scale. You will collaborate across teams (research, product, infra, data, etc. ), mentor senior engineers, and influence strategy and execution at company-wide levels. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical direction of GenAI and agentic ML systems that power enterprise-grade AI agents - spanning reasoning, retrieval, tool use, and integrations across various SaaS products. 
 - Architect, design, and implement scalable production pipelines for model training, fine-tuning, retrieval (RAG), agent orchestration, and evaluation - ensuring robustness, latency efficiency, and continuous learning. 
 - Define and own the multi-year ML roadmap for GenAI infrastructure - including agent frameworks, RAG systems, world-class evaluation loops, and integration with MCP, browser, and vision pipelines. 
 - Identify and integrate cutting-edge ML methods / research (deep learning, large models, recommender systems, LLMs, etc. ) into Ema's products or infrastructure. 
 - Research, prototype, and integrate cutting-edge ML and LLM advancements (reasoning, memory architectures, multi-modal perception, long-context models, autonomous agents) into the platform. 
 - Optimize trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, interpretability, and real-world reliability across the agent lifecycle - from prompt design to orchestration and execution. 
 - Champion engineering excellence - drive observability, reproducibility, versioning, testing, and bias-aware development across ML and agentic systems. 
 - Mentor and elevate senior engineers and researchers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and system-level thinking. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and research teams to align ML innovation with enterprise needs - enabling secure integrations, privacy-aware deployments, and scalable use cases. 
 - Influence data strategy - guide how retrieval indices, embeddings, structured/unstructured corpora, and feedback loops evolve to improve grounding, factuality, and reasoning depth. 
 - Drive system scalability and performance - ensuring ML agents and RAG pipelines can operate across billions of knowledge objects, diverse APIs, and real-time enterprise contexts. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's (or PhD) degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field. 
 - A strong track record (usually 10-12+ years) of applied experience with ML techniques, especially in large-scale settings. 
 - Experience building production ML systems that operate at scale (latency / throughput / cost constraints). 
 - Experience in Knowledge retrieval and Search space. 
 - Exposure in building Agentic Systems and Frameworks. 
 - Proficiency in relevant programming languages (e. g. Python, C++, Java) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc. ). 
 - Strong understanding of the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, serving, monitoring, maintenance. 
 - Experience designing systems for monitoring, diagnostics, logging, model versioning, etc. 
 - Deep knowledge of computational trade-offs: distributed training, inference, optimizations (e. g. quantization, pruning, batching). 
 - Excellent communication skills; ability to present complex systems / trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers; ability to lead technical discussions and influence across orgs. 

Why Join Ema?

- Work at the forefront of agentic AI systems-driving real enterprise transformation. 
 - Own mission-critical platforms that make or break Ema's capabilities. 
 - Join an elite team of engineers, product thinkers, and AI researchers who value deep execution. 
 - Help define the architectural, cultural, and operational DNA of a company set to define a new category. 

Our culture & Values

- High Bar on Quality - We value excellence and expect world-class execution. 
 - Ownership & Accountability - We take full responsibility for our work and outcomes. 
 - Impact-Driven Approach - We set ambitious goals and measure success through real-world impact. 
 - Team Collaboration & Growth - We believe in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and supporting each other. 
 - No Hierarchy, Just Execution - Everyone is an individual contributor, focused on delivering results. 

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. 

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

Principal Engineer - Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms (R3)

About The Role

As a Principal Engineer - Operations, Reliability & AI Platforms, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale production systems, cloud platforms, and AI-powered applications. You will drive reliability, operational excellence, observability, automation, and resiliency across multiple products and platforms while serving as a trusted engineering leader for critical business services. 

This role combines deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, operational ownership, and strategic thinking. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, and Operations teams to establish reliability standards, eliminate operational toil through automation, improve system resilience, and ensure mission-critical services operate securely and efficiently at scale. 

What You'll Be Doing

Technical Leadership & Strategy

- Define and drive the operational engineering strategy for enterprise applications, cloud-native platforms, and AI-enabled systems. 
 - Establish standards for reliability, scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Lead architecture reviews with a focus on supportability, observability, resiliency, disaster recovery, and long-term sustainability. 
 - Provide technical leadership during major incidents, service disruptions, and high-severity production events. 
 - Influence product and engineering roadmaps to proactively address technical debt, operational risks, and reliability improvements. 

Production Operations & Reliability Engineering

- Own reliability outcomes through Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and operational health metrics. 
 - Drive adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and operational excellence practices across teams. 
 - Lead complex root cause investigations involving distributed systems, cloud platforms, integrations, databases, and AI services. 
 - Establish operational readiness reviews, production acceptance criteria, release governance, and supportability standards. 
 - Define and implement resiliency engineering practices including failover validation, disaster recovery testing, capacity planning, and business continuity programs. 
 - Drive continuous improvement through incident trend analysis, reliability metrics, and operational insights. 

AI Platform & Agent Operations

- Provide technical leadership for AI-powered applications, copilots, virtual assistants, chatbots, and agent-based systems operating in production environments. 
 - Establish operational standards for Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, vector databases, MCP ecosystems, and orchestration platforms. 
 - Lead investigations involving AI model failures, retrieval issues, prompt orchestration, tool-calling workflows, agent interactions, and integration failures. 
 - Define monitoring strategies for AI quality, token consumption, latency, throughput, reliability, and operational health. 
 - Drive AI governance, responsible AI practices, security, compliance, and operational risk management. 

Automation & Operational Excellence

- Lead initiatives to eliminate manual operational effort through automation, intelligent workflows, self-healing capabilities, and autonomous remediation. 
 - Design and implement operational automation using scripting, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and AIOps solutions. 
 - Establish enterprise runbooks, playbooks, operational standards, and knowledge management frameworks. 
 - Drive adoption of platform engineering principles to improve reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations teams to improve service quality and customer outcomes. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leaders in reliability engineering, distributed systems, cloud operations, and AI platform support. 
 - Communicate technical risks, operational health, and strategic recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders. 
 - Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve reliability, resilience, supportability, and operational maturity across the organisation. 

How You Will Succeed

- Demonstrate exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and systems-thinking capabilities across complex distributed environments. 
 - Drive measurable improvements in service reliability, availability, performance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Build scalable observability, monitoring, tracing, and automation capabilities that proactively detect and resolve issues. 
 - Operate effectively across application, platform, infrastructure, cloud, and AI technology stacks. 
 - Influence engineering organisations through technical leadership, collaboration, and data-driven decision making. 
 - Balance business priorities, operational risk, engineering investment, and long-term sustainability. 
 - Establish measurable operational KPIs, SLOs, SLIs, and reliability programmes. 
 - Become the escalation point for the most complex technical and operational challenges. 

Experience

What You Should Bring

- 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Production Operations, or related disciplines. 
 - Proven experience operating and supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer – Generative AI
data.description:
About Us

Walnut Folks Group is the parent company of three agencies shaping how brands grow in India: 

- Confluencr - influencer marketing (700+ brands served)

- Intent Farm - performance and marketplace marketing

- Kalakaaar - talent representation

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer - Generative AI who can take a problem from idea to production. 

This isn't a role where you'll simply receive technical specifications and implement tickets. You'll work closely with founders, business teams, and product stakeholders to identify opportunities, shape solutions, build applications, and own them after launch. 

You'll work across our SaaS products, Creator App, and internal AI-powered systems. Depending on the problem, you might build a customer-facing feature, develop an AI-powered workflow, or turn a manual business process into a scalable application. 

We value engineers who combine solid software fundamentals with practical AI expertise, move quickly without compromising reliability, and take responsibility for the outcomes of what they build. 

What You'll Do

1. Own Products End to End

Understand business problems by working directly with founders, marketing teams, operations, finance, and other stakeholders. 

Translate requirements into clear technical plans, define MVPs, and prioritize features based on business impact. 

Build and ship complete features across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and AI integrations. 

Take ownership of applications throughout their lifecycle, from initial prototype to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

2. Build AI-Powered Products

Integrate LLMs and generative AI capabilities into real-world products and business workflows. 

Build AI-powered features using techniques such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows where appropriate. 

Evaluate models, prompts, and architectures to balance quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 

Design workflows that combine AI with business rules, databases, and external APIs. 

Implement appropriate validation, error handling, observability, and human review for AI outputs. 

3. Develop Scalable Full-Stack Applications

Build responsive, user-friendly frontend experiences and reliable backend services. 

Design APIs, data models, and database schemas that support product requirements and future growth. 

Write maintainable, testable code and follow sound engineering practices. 

Integrate third-party services, authentication systems, background jobs, and other infrastructure as needed. 

Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, bugs, and production issues. 

4. Ship, Measure, and Improve

Prototype promising ideas quickly and validate them with actual users. 

Deploy applications and manage releases, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. 

Use user feedback, product usage, and business outcomes to guide improvements. 

Leverage AI coding tools to accelerate development while maintaining code quality, security, and reliability. 

Document key technical decisions and share learnings with the team. 

What We're Looking For

Essential Skills

- 2-4 years of experience building and shipping full-stack software applications. 
 - Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on experience developing frontend and backend applications. 
 - Practical experience integrating LLMs or generative AI into applications, workflows, or developer tooling. 
 - Experience designing and working with REST APIs, databases, and third-party integrations. 
 - Familiarity with deploying applications to production and troubleshooting real-world issues. 
 - Ability to break down ambiguous requirements into practical, well-scoped solutions. 
 - A strong sense of ownership, with a focus on usability, reliability, and business outcomes. 
 - We are particularly interested in candidates who have gone beyond basic chatbot implementations. 
 - Working with LLM APIs and structured model outputs. 
 - Building RAG pipelines, semantic search, or document-processing workflows. 
 - Implementing AI agents, tool calling, or multi-step AI workflows where appropriate. 
 - Evaluating AI output quality and handling hallucinations, failures, and edge cases. 
 - Using AI coding assistants to improve development speed and productivity. 
 - Experience building consumer-facing applications or SaaS products with active users. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automated testing, and application monitoring. 
 - Experience with background processing, queues, caching, or event-driven systems. 
 - Experience in marketing technology, creator platforms, analytics, or workflow automation. 
 - A strong portfolio, GitHub repository, live product, or technical case study demonstrating your work. 
 - You don't need experience with every technique listed. We value practical implementation experience and sound technical judgment over familiarity with buzzwords. 

How You Work Matters

- You can communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - You are comfortable making decisions when requirements are incomplete. 
 - You know when to use AI, when traditional software is more reliable, and when a simpler solution is better. 
 - You can move fast, accept feedback, and iterate without losing sight of code quality. 
 - You take responsibility for what happens after deployment, not just for writing the code. 

Our Technology Environment

We care more about your ability to choose the right tools and build reliable products than about matching every item on a checklist. 

Depending on the product, our engineering environment may involve modern frontend frameworks, backend services, relational or NoSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, LLM APIs, and AI development tools. 

You'll have the opportunity to evaluate technologies, experiment with new approaches, and make informed architectural decisions. 

How We'll Measure Success

In this role, success means: 

- Turning business problems into working solutions that users can actually use. 
 - Shipping useful prototypes and production features with appropriate speed and quality. 
 - Building AI capabilities that deliver measurable improvements in accuracy, productivity, or user experience. 
 - Maintaining reliable applications through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 

Why Work With Us

Flexible Work Culture

We focus on outcomes, not rigid rules. You'll have the autonomy to manage your work, with a culture built on trust and accountability. 

Health & Accident Insurance

Your wellbeing matters to us. We provide comprehensive health and accident coverage to support you when it counts. 

Complimentary Meals

Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are on us-so you can stay focused and energized throughout the day. 

Sports & Outdoor Activities

From cricket matches to badminton games and monthly hikes, we keep things active with at least two sports events every month. 

Upskill with Us

Get access to learning platforms like Udemy and mentorship to continuously build your marketing and growth skillset. 

Performance Gets Rewarded

We recognize and reward great work through regular incentives, quarterly and annual awards, and ongoing appreciation. 

Working Days: Monday to Friday (Onsite) + Saturday Half Day (WFH)

Location: Bommanahalli, Bangalore.

Two Circles | Audience Intelligence Platform

About us

Two Circles is a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best. We help clients understand and influence how fans spend, which events they attend, which channels they respond to and what content they watch. 

Our platforms and services are trusted by 1, 000+ clients globally, including the English Premier League,   Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL and the Board of Control for Cricket India (BCCI). [RB1]    We're 1, 000+ people across 15 offices. 

The role

Join our global squad of software and data engineers building the Audience Intelligence Platform, the leading data management and analytics platform for the sports industry. You'll build the React frontend and . NET services that let teams, leagues and rights holders explore fan data, build audiences and act on insight, increasingly through AI-powered experiences. 

You'll work in an AI-augmented way: using tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to ship faster, and building AI features directly into the product. 

What you'll do

- Design, build and test scalable React/TypeScript applications and . NET APIs (C#, ASP. NET Web API/MVC). 
 - Build AI-powered UI features such as natural-language audience building, conversational analytics, AI-generated insights and summaries, and smart recommendations. 
 - Design interfaces for AI interactions: streaming responses, loading and error states, citations and confidence cues, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Build APIs that expose fan behaviour analytics to the UI and to AI services. 
 - Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, and help the team shape good practice: prompting, code review of AI-generated code, testing and guardrails. 
 - Work closely with product and marketing to turn data into high-value features. 
 - Write clean, tested, maintainable code with accessibility and performance in mind. 

Requirements

- Strong React and TypeScript experience, including component architecture, state management, and performance. 
 - Strong HTML5 (semantic, accessible) and CSS3/SCSS (responsive, themeable). 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot or similar) in day-to-day development, with a clear view of their strengths and limits. 
 - CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps pipelines or GitHub Actions. 
 - Familiarity with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), prompt design, tool/function calling, or MCP. 
 - Experience implementing AI features in a UI: LLM-backed chat or copilots, generative UI, or AI-assisted search and filtering. 
 - Experience testing and evaluating non-deterministic features, and handling latency, cost, privacy and safety. 
 - Clear communication, including explaining blockers and timelines to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred

- Strong C# and experience building APIs in modern . NET (Core/6/8/10); awareness of . NET Framework migration considerations. What matters most

Skills can be learned. Attitude and the ability to learn quickly matter most in this team, especially as AI changes how we build software. 

Benefits

What can we offer you?

We offer a benefits package to suit you and your lifestyle! Out of a core monthly budget, you can choose your own comprehensive benefit package

- 15 standard days of PTO (+1 Birthday, 1 Admin Day, +1 Big Life Event Day, + 1 Wellbeing Day)
 - Medical Insurance (Self +5 Dependents) & Group Term Insurance
 - Performance reviews every 6 months with discretionary salary increases
 - Hybrid work set-up
 - Gym membership contribution/ Sport challenge contribution
 - WFH set-up equipment allowance(Valid upto 1st  six months of joining)
 - Renowned team days often throughout the year
 - Discretionary bonus on company performance
 - Manager, team & individual training-Lunch & Learns, Brunch clubs, Global Huddles
 - Mobile & Internet Reimbursement  Though these are the basics written down, we will principally be recruiting for energy, values and commitment - both to Two Circles and to your career. Even if you feel you don't tick 100% of the boxes but feel you could bring value to the role, we'd still love to hear from you!  Our recruitment process will be honest & thorough, and so will our roles. In return, we can offer honesty, integrity, and the chance to progress in the organisation as quickly as you develop within it. 

Two Circles is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Role Description

We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions. 

This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs. 

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams. 

The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.

Job Description

Job Description - Production Supervisor

XDU/CDU End-of-Line Testing Production Supervisor

Company: Vertiv Location: Chakan Plant, Pune, India Department: Production / Manufacturing Reports To: Production Manager Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient CDU (Coolant Distribution Unit) End-of-Line Testing Supervisor to lead and manage the end-of-line testing operations for our CDU production line. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in liquid cooling systems, chilled water systems, and automated testing equipment, combined with strong supervisory and production management skills. This role is critical to ensuring every CDU leaving the production line meets stringent quality, performance, and safety standards. 

Key Responsibilities Technical & Testing

- Supervise and execute end-of-line testing of Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) used in data centre liquid cooling applications
 - Operate, program, and troubleshoot automated test equipment (auto testers) designed for CDU functional and performance validation
 - Conduct and oversee water pressure testing including hydrostatic testing, leak testing, and pressure decay testing as per established procedures and standards
 - Read, interpret, and validate readings from instrumentation including pressure transducers, temperature sensors (RTDs, thermocouples), flow meters, differential pressure gauges, and other water system instruments
 - Ensure proper functioning and calibration of all test instruments and equipment
 - Validate CDU components and sub-assemblies including butterfly valves, ball valves, control valves, coupling joints (Victaulic/grooved couplings), heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, and piping assemblies
 - Understand and apply knowledge of chilled water system principles - flow dynamics, pressure drops, heat rejection, temperature differentials, and coolant loop operations
 - Diagnose and resolve test failures by analyzing root causes related to hydraulic, mechanical, or electrical sub-systems of the CDU
 - Maintain and update test procedures, checklists, and acceptance criteria documentation

Safety & Compliance

- Enforce and ensure strict adherence to electrical safety protocols during CDU testing (lockout/tagout, grounding, insulation resistance testing, high-voltage precautions)

data.title: Director - SoC Verification
data.description:
Job Title: 

- Director - SoC Verification

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have built a career at the intersection of deep SoC verification expertise and organizational leadership. You have closed coverage on complex multi-protocol designs and know that scaling verification across a services organization requires clear structure, strong leaders, and a strategy that holds when customer scope, timelines, and design complexity move at once. The difference between a verification plan that delivers and one that collapses three months before tapeout is usually visible early, and you are the kind of leader who sees it and acts before it becomes an escalation. You operate at two levels simultaneously. One day you are reviewing a coverage closure strategy for an automotive SoC with safety requirements your team has never seen before. The next you are restructuring team assignments because two customer engagements just expanded scope and you need to rebalance without dropping quality. You build leaders, not just projects. You know how to develop a senior engineer into someone who can own customer signoff, and you know when to step into a room yourself because the technical or relationship stakes require it. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for the System Solutions Group and shape how we deliver complex SoC services to customers who depend on us to get it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow a multi-team SoC verification organization delivering customer-facing services across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing
 - Define and drive SSG verification strategy, including methodology standards, signoff criteria, VIP and tool deployment, and reusable testbench patterns adopted across projects
 - Own organizational planning including headcount, hiring, succession, performance management, and skill development to build scalable verification capability
 - Partner with sales and account teams to scope opportunities, assess technical and resource risk, prioritize work against capacity, and align delivery with customer and business objectives
 - Serve as executive-level technical authority on complex SoC verification challenges, escalations, and convergence across multi-protocol, multi-domain, and advanced-node designs
 - Establish clear accountability across verification managers and technical leads, and drive adoption of Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP based on customer project learnings
 - Build and maintain executive customer relationships that enable long-term engagement growth and position Synopsys as the verification partner of choice for complex SoC programs

The Impact You Will Have

- Your organization will enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, affecting product launches in AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing
 - The verification strategy and standards you define will scale across SSG projects, improving coverage quality, reducing cycle time, and compressing ramp time on new engagements
 - The leaders you develop will strengthen Synopsys capability to win and execute larger, more complex verification service engagements
 - Your capacity planning and executive customer engagement will shape how leading semiconductor companies adopt Synopsys EDA tools, VIP, and verification services
 - What you build will directly influence how SSG scales verification delivery, wins competitive pursuits, and expands into new customer segments and protocol domains
 - The organizational structure and accountability model you establish will become the foundation for how SSG verification grows over the next three to five years

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 20+ years of hands-on SoC, subsystem, or IP verification experience, including significant leadership scope
 - Expert-level knowledge of UVM-based verification, coverage-driven closure, verification planning, and complex multi-domain debug across processor-based SoC architectures
 - Proven experience leading large verification organizations or multi-project teams through planning, delivery, and customer signoff in a services or product development environment
 - Deep working knowledge of protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and AMBA interconnects, and hands-on proficiency with Synopsys VCS, Verdi, and VIP
 - Demonstrated ability to build organizational structures with clear accountability, develop managers and technical leads, and partner with sales and senior customer stakeholders on scoping and escalations
 - Experience with ARM-based SoC architectures, automotive functional safety verification, or emulation flows is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You translate vague customer requests into scoped plans, staffed organizations, and delivery models your teams can execute without losing quality
 - You see both the technical gap and the organizational failure behind a coverage miss or escalation, and you know how to fix both
 - You build leaders, not just projects, and you invest time developing managers and senior engineers into people who can own customer outcomes independently
 - You communicate effectively to engineers debugging a testbench, customer architects reviewing signoff criteria, sales executives scoping a new opportunity, and Synopsys senior leadership reviewing quarterly business performance
 - You make hard calls on resource allocation, project prioritization, and team structure when the right answer is not the easy one, and you explain the tradeoff clearly enough that people understand why
 - You know when to delegate and when to step in yourself, whether that means reviewing a verification plan before it goes to a customer or sitting in an escalation call with an executive stakeholder

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will lead verification within the System Solutions Group (SSG), which delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. You will build and lead the verification organization and collaborate with SSG design and architecture peers, sales, application engineering, IP, and EDA teams to deliver customer engagements and scale Synopsys verification capability. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: USB Lead Engineer
data.description:
USB Lead Engineer - Linux Enablement & AVV (Pre/Post-Silicon) - RISC‐V MPU Platform

Location: Pune / Bangalore, India

Own USB enablement on Linux - driver bring-up, compliance, and AVV from FPGA to first silicon. 

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com. 

About The Role

We're building a next-generation, application-class RISC‐V MPU SoC platform for Linux systems - bringing together multimedia, industrial connectivity, security, and high-speed I/O. 

In the Platform Software team, you will be the technical owner for USB across the stack: boot-to-user-space enablement, kernel/driver integration, and automated validation (AVV) on virtual platforms/FPGA and first silicon. You'll partner closely with architects and hardware teams to de-risk the USB subsystem, drive bring-up readiness and deliver a production-quality SDK experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- USB Linux enablement & integration: enable and maintain USB host/device/dual-role functionality on a 64-bit RISC‐V MPU Linux platform. 
 - Bring up USB controllers (e. g. , xHCI/EHCI for host, UDC for device/gadget), PHY integration, clocks/resets, and interrupts. 
 - Drive kernel/BSP enablement: Device Tree bindings, power management (runtime/PM QoS), suspend/resume, and performance tuning. 
 - Develop/debug USB drivers and related subsystems: USB core interactions, hub behavior, gadget framework, and class drivers as needed. 
 - Enable and validate user-space workflows: enumeration, throughput/latency, storage/networking classes, and reliability over hot-plug scenarios. 
 - Deliver USB-ready SDK releases: integration, regression validation, and developer-facing documentation/debug guides. 
 - AVV & silicon validation (pre/post-silicon): create test plans and automation to validate USB functionality, performance, and compliance on FPGA/emulation and first silicon. 
 - Contribute to shift-left validation using virtual platforms/emulation/FPGA; build reusable USB validation apps/tests to exercise data paths and corner cases. 
 - Debug and root-cause USB issues across HW/FW/kernel using logs, traces, and lab equipment (e. g. , JTAG, logic/protocol analyzers); drive fixes to closure. 
 - Cross-functional ownership: partner with architects, RTL/PHY, board, and platform teams to define requirements, de-risk schedules, and land USB features. 
 - Own USB feature planning: role/port matrix, power & charging considerations, compliance goals, and bring-up milestones. 
 - Provide bring-up and validation feedback that influences USB architecture decisions (controller/PHY selection, debug hooks, observability, testability). 
 - Align with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables, bug triage, and release readiness for USB enablement. 
 - Customer & ecosystem engagement: support early adopters and upstream fixes when appropriate (kernel, Device Tree, test collateral).

data.title: Principal Expert, US Insurance Industry
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We're committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. 

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care-about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. 

Could that be you?

Your Mission

UiPath is building a new way to design and deliver enterprise processes. UiPath cartographer draws on a curated library of industry process knowledge, interviews the business, and produces process maps and design documents. AI coding agents then turn those designs into working, orchestrated solutions, in days rather than months. 

In insurance, "almost right" isn't good enough. The best AI companies in regulated industries have learned the same lesson: quality comes from making a senior practitioner part of the team to building the benchmarks, evaluations and feedback loops around their experience and judgment. 

That's this role. As our Principal Expert for insurance, you will own the quality of everything our AI produces for US insurers. You'll set the bar, build the tests that hold the AI to it, and work in the field with customers and partners to make sure what we ship works in a real carrier. 

This role does not carry a sales quota and is not a product management role. Success is measured by the quality of the insurance solutions we deliver and how confidently customers build on them. 

Why This Role Is Exciting

- Your work sets the standard. What you define as good will be used by insurance customers, partners and AI agents across the platform. 
 - You see the impact. Take a process from discovery to a working solution in days, then keep improving it. 
 - You're building something new. Help decide which lines of business we go after next and how we measure the success of AI-designed processes. 

What You'll Do At UiPath

Own insurance AI quality

- Own the quality of insurance process knowledge, designs and solutions across Property & Casualty and Life & Annuity. 
 - Decide what needs fixing first, review changes before they go to customers, and sign off when a process is ready. 
 - Work with industry experts, partners and reviewers to maintain and improve quality. 

Build the insurance benchmark

- Build a library of real insurance use cases covering claims, FNOL and triage, total loss, endorsements, life claims, medical records, disability claims and new business NIGO. 
 - Define test cases, scoring criteria and expected answers to evaluate every new AI model and product release before it reaches customers. 

Turn expert judgment into evaluations

- Evaluate AI outputs at every stage, from process knowledge and process maps to design documents and working solutions. 
 - Work with applied scientists and engineers to make sure automated AI evaluations match expert judgment, so we can scale quality checks without relying on manual reviews for everything. 

Find failures and make sure they get fixed

- Review actual outputs, identify common failure types across regulation, coverage, workflows, data and terminology, and prioritise them based on customer impact. 
 - Turn recurring failures into reusable test cases and make sure fixes work before they go live. 
 - Share clear updates on quality, key issues and progress with leadership, product teams and customers. 

How You'll Work

You'll work in a small, senior team of automation consultants, engineers and applied scientists, working directly with customers. 

- Work with insurance carriers, MGAs and consulting partners to understand how their claims and underwriting teams operate, and test our designs against real processes. 
 - Join consultants and engineers on customer deployments and use what you learn to improve our benchmarks and evaluations. 
 - Run a regular review cycle, roughly every two weeks, to assess outputs, prioritise fixes and track improvements. 
 - Join customer and partner meetings. 

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in US insurance, ideally starting hands-on in claims and moving into claims operations senior or mid level roles. 
 - Deep P&C or Life & Annuity knowledge across the lifecycle
 - Working knowledge of US claims regulation: unfair claims settlement practices, state acknowledgment and payment deadlines, total-loss and salvage rules, and market conduct exams. 
 - Experience mapping or redesigning claims or policy servicing operations: queues, handoffs, SLAs, exceptions, fraud referral and QA. 
 - The confidence to review complex documents quickly, spot what's plausible but wrong, and explain exactly why. 

Nice To Have

- Life & Annuity or disability expertise: contestability, beneficiary determination, unclaimed property, suitability, and underwriting evidence such as medical records. 
 - Experience evaluating AI or automation output: writing test cases, rubrics or reference answers, or running QA or validation programs. 
 - Experience with insurance AI, claims automation or document intake programs. 
 - Comfort with data and light technical work, such as spreadsheets, data analysis or prompting AI tools. 
 - Experience leading or calibrating a team of reviewers, auditors or claims QA specialists. 
 - Commercial lines, workers' compensation, employee benefits or broker/MGA experience. 

Maybe you don't tick all the boxes above-but still think you'd be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes-and passion can't be learned. 

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Staff Performance Engineer to lead and scale performance engineering practices for our cloud-native SaaS platform. This role is responsible for driving performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency at an organizational level, with a strong focus on serverless and distributed architectures. 

You will define performance engineering strategy, build scalable and AI-driven performance platforms, and influence architectural decisions across teams. The role requires deep expertise in modern cloud environments and a strong focus on embedding performance into the entire software lifecycle, from development to production.

- Define and drive organization-wide performance engineering strategy aligned with business KPIs, customer experience, and cost efficiency

data.description:
About WeRize

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India's largest full stack fintechplatform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd). 

This customer segmentis not served by privatesector banks, Insurersand Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit. While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need properguidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn't work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its 'Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)', a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30, 000 a month from WeRize in commissions. 

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literatefreelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when comparedto upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn't workfor this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-fieldteams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That resultsin very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousandsof freelancers in 5000+ citiesonly through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize. 

To know more about the company, please visit: https: //www. werize. com

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own the complete hybrid mobile stack-spanning React/TypeScript web apps, React Native shells, and native Android code. You will spend roughly 60% of your time on React/React Native and 40% on native Android development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Feature Development & Architecture: Build and maintain features across React (TypeScript), React Native, and native Android. Design robust, secure messaging bridges between web and native components. 
 - Native Development & WebView: Write Kotlin native modules (camera, permissions, storage) and configure/harden WebViews (sessions, security allowlisting, file choosers). 
 - SDK Integrations & Performance: Integrate, wrap, and maintain third-party native SDKs. Optimize load times, app startup, bundle sizes, crash rates, and performance on low-end devices. 
 - CI/CD & Quality: Manage CI/CD pipelines (GitLab/Jenkins, signing, Play Store releases), write tests (Jest/JUnit), review code, and maintain high standards for security and observability. Requirements (Must Have)

- Experience: 3-5 years in frontend/mobile tech, with at least 1 Android app published on the Google Play Store. 
 - React & Web: Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, hooks, state management, and responsive UI performance for low-end devices. 
 - React Native & Bridges: Hands-on experience with react-native-webview, custom native modules, and bidirectional JS-to-native messaging. 
 - Native Android: Solid Kotlin skills, Android SDK, lifecycle management, WebView configurations, Gradle, and debugging tools (Logcat, chrome: //inspect). 
 - SDKs & DevOps: Experience integrating third-party SDKs (handling ProGuard/R8 conflicts) and working with mobile CI/CD pipelines, build variants, and app signing. Good to Have

- Background in fintech (KYC, payments, lending workflows) or familiarity with RBI compliance and Play Store financial app policies. 
 - Expertise in mobile security (certificate pinning, root detection, JS bridge hardening). 
 - Advanced profiling/observability skills (Perfetto, Android Profiler, Crashlytics, Sentry) and automated release tools (Fastlane). 
 - Exposure to React Native New Architecture (TurboModules, JSI) or Jetpack Compose.

data.title: Senior Member Technical Staff - Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

We are looking for a strong Quality Engineering candidate who can flex across MTS-2 and MTS-3 expectations depending on depth of experience, ownership, and technical maturity. This role is ideal for someone who brings deep hands-on automation skills with solid manual testing foundations, and who is excited to work on products spanning mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and large-scale data pipelines. 

This person will work across Nielsen Pulse / Streaming+, EMM / panel applications, and adjacent digital measurement platforms. The role requires end-to-end quality ownership across user journeys, platform integrations, data collection flows, and backend validation in a domain where correctness, scale, and platform diversity matter. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable testing not just UI behavior, but also events, telemetry, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and platform-specific edge cases across Android, iOS, web, and TV environments. They should be able to design robust automation, perform deep debugging, and partner closely with engineering, product, data, and operations teams to ship high-quality releases. 

Qualifications

- Own test strategy, planning, execution, and sign-off for features spanning manual and automation coverage
 - Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing
 - Validate complex end-to-end flows across mobile, TV/CTV, web, backend services, and data pipelines
 - Perform deep validation of data correctness across logs, APIs, databases, batch jobs, event streams, and downstream reports
 - Design test cases for large-volume, high-variability, real-world datasets and platform combinations
 - Investigate production issues, reproduce complex defects, and drive root-cause analysis with engineering teams
 - Validate streaming/data donation flows, permissions, onboarding, telemetry, reward logic, and panel-related workflows
 - Partner with developers, product managers, designers, data engineers, and stakeholders to ensure quality from requirements through release
 - Improve CI/CD quality gates, regression coverage, release confidence, and defect prevention practices
 - Contribute to test planning for new devices, OS upgrades, beta releases, and cross-platform compatibility validation
 - Create and maintain test documentation, test evidence, dashboards, and release-quality communication
 - Mentor junior QA engineers or peers in test design, debugging, automation, and quality best practices

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 6+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering
 - Strong hands-on experience in test automation, with good grounding in manual exploratory and functional testing
 - Experience testing across some combination of Android, iOS, web, CTV/TV, and backend systems
 - Strong understanding of API testing, service validation, and backend workflow testing
 - Experience validating large datasets, event pipelines, reporting outputs, or analytics systems
 - Strong SQL and data validation skills, including comparison of source vs processed outputs
 - Experience debugging issues using logs, network traces, device logs, browser tools, and backend evidence
 - Strong understanding of test design, regression planning, edge-case identification, and defect lifecycle management
 - Experience working in Agile teams with cross-functional collaboration
 - Ability to independently own features, drive clarity in ambiguous situations, and balance speed with quality

Additional Information

- Experience in panel, measurement, attribution, or data donation ecosystems
 - Experience working with CTV platforms such as Android TV, Apple TV/tvOS, Fire TV, Roku, or similar
 - Experience testing OS transitions, device-specific behaviors, and platform permission models
 - Exposure to analytics instrumentation, event schemas, or certification-style validation workflows

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Overview

The Sr. Agentic Process Automation Developer designs, builds, deploys, and supports intelligent agents and process-automation solutions using platforms such as UiPath and Microsoft Copilot Studio. This role translates business needs into secure, scalable technical solutions that improve efficiency, quality, standardization, and user experience. 

Working with business leaders, process owners, transformation teams, technology partners, and support teams, the Sr. Agentic Process Automation Developer leads technical discovery, solution design, development, integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement across multiple automation and AI-enabled initiatives. 

Essential Functions

- Partner with business leaders, process owners, and transformation teams to identify, assess, and prioritize processes that can be automated, streamlined, or augmented through AI and workflow technologies. 
 - Lead technical discovery by developing use cases, process maps, requirements, value assessments, scope documents, solution designs, and operating procedures for approved initiatives. 
 - Design and build scalable process automations, generative-AI capabilities, and custom intelligent agents that integrate with enterprise systems, APIs, connectors, data sources, and multiple delivery channels. 
 - Implement agent goals, decision logic, human oversight, access controls, auditability, sensitivity protections, and other governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 
 - Deploy and manage automations and agents across platforms such as UiPath, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Teams, websites, and mobile applications. 
 - Develop integrations and advanced AI capabilities using appropriate coding languages, model interfaces, Model Context Protocol implementations, prompts, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation, and language models. 
 - Test solutions and document process flows, technical designs, test plans, operating procedures, deployment details, known issues, and support requirements. 
 - Monitor logs, key performance indicators, user feedback, productivity, return on investment, business impact, and solution health to troubleshoot issues and guide improvements. 
 - Coordinate with support, infrastructure, security, data, architecture, and business teams to resolve incidents, manage dependencies, and transition solutions into ongoing operations. 
 - Communicate progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, resource needs, and technical issues to leadership and stakeholders throughout delivery.

 - Manage multiple automation workstreams within an Agile environment while maintaining quality, documentation, and delivery commitments. 
 - Coach less-experienced team members, share reusable patterns and lessons learned, and pursue relevant technical training and certifications. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
 - Four or more years of experience developing software or automations using a modern programming language such as JavaScript, . NET, Python, C#, or Ruby. 
 - Four or more years of experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting process automations using UiPath or comparable automation technology. 
 - Two or more years of experience developing or deploying intelligent process automation, generative-AI, or agentic-AI solutions. 
 - Experience integrating or training AI and machine-learning models and working with language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval-augmented generation. 
 - Experience designing scalable applications, APIs, custom connectors, and integrations across multiple enterprise systems and data sources. 
 - Experience managing automation platform components such as bots, assets, machines, queues, orchestrators, or comparable services. 
 - Knowledge of process mining, task mining, communications mining, document understanding, and automation frameworks such as UiPath REFramework preferred. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Model Context Protocol, or comparable agent and workflow technologies preferred.

Summary

Position Summary

Senior Manager, Applied AI Engineering

Role Overview: As a Senior Manager , Applied AI Engineering , you will set the engineering vision and technical direction for the firm's enterprise solutions-mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver. Leading across teams and product groups, you will stay hands-on in your craft-shaping architecture, design, and code-while driving the standards and reference architectures that engineers build against. Your leadership will be pivotal in delivering tangible value across Deloitte's product and AI investments, aligning technical solutions with business and technology strategy, and advancing Applied AI engineering across the organization. 

You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across software and data engineering, solution architecture, and AI/ML and GenAI, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing -setting vision, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to executives. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Craft and articulate a vision for Applied AI engineering across the firm's enterprise solutions-mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver-in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders across product, engineering, experience, delivery, security, and infrastructure at all organizational levels. 
 - Advocate for, develop, and communicate the integrated Applied AI engineering, architecture, and technology strategy and its implementation roadmap to engineering teams and business stakeholders. Ensure the organization is well-informed about objectives, KPIs, maturity, compliance, and progress. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed-keeping an eye on leverage of existing assets and on the inference, token, and cloud cost of what we build, to maximize outcomes and minimize total cost. 
 - Define, measure, and drive the achievement of KPIs and NFRs spanning system performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability. Establish and evolve Applied AI engineering, architecture, and AI/ML/GenAI reference architectures, standards, and best practices-including spec- and context-driven development, evaluations, AI agent orchestration, and the AI and Agentic SSDLC that carries work from discovery to production to operations with full automation and quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Remain hands-on with design, architecture, and code-contributing to team and product group velocity and staying engaged with engineers across the SSDLC-while reviewing code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology. 
 - As a recognized engineering leader, mentor and develop engineers and emerging engineering leaders, coaching modern Applied AI engineering practices-full-stack and micro-services, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI and agentic systems, data engineering, application-level infrastructure-as-code, and advanced deployment techniques (Blue-Green, Canary, A/B testing) that minimize downtime. Lead by example through thought leadership-showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the organization. 
 - Embrace an iterative and incremental approach to Applied AI product engineering, favoring action and rapid learning over extensive upfront planning. Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, ensuring each iteration delivers value and stays aligned with customer and business goals. 
 - Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical challenges faced by customers and users, aligning technical solutions with business outcomes. Minimize unnecessary technical complexity and avoid overengineering-features and functionality that do not add value-and drive teams toward peak performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution. 
 - Possess deep expertise in modern Applied AI engineering and architecture practices, with a keen ability to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for innovation across the product lifecycle. Continuously enhance the engineering operating model to be lean, adaptable, and responsive-guiding and transforming the organization to embrace lean principles and foster a culture of innovation. 
 - Establish and evolve reference architectures, coding standards, and engineering and quality benchmarks that ensure robust, secure, scalable, and reliable/resilient solutions. Ensure appropriate, responsible technology adoption-developing explainable, scalable, reliable, and secure AI and agentic products-and proactively identify technical risks, developing mitigation strategies through proactive problem-solving and contingency planning. 
 - Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making across the organization. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms, crafting clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs supported by evidence. 
 - Engage stakeholders at all levels-from team members to middle management to executives-building collaborative, constructive relationships and co-creating momentum and value across multiple organizational levels. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 10+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, . NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, REST/SOAP/GraphQL, SSO/MFA, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks. 
 - 7+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise solutions on modern technology stacks (e. g. , API Gateways, Message Brokers, Queuing Services, Workflow Automation & Orchestration, ETL/ELT, Event Streaming, Real-Time Data Processing, Service Mesh) and cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, and micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including leveraging their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability). 
 - 5+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration. 
 - 2+ years of experience in establishing engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards. 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e. g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.
