data.title: Unified Data Platform Manager
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team responsible for our Unified Data Platform, a foundational platform supporting large-scale data processing, analytics, search, and data-driven applications across the company. 

The team owns critical platform capabilities including Hadoop, ETL and data processing platforms, Elasticsearch, Apache Airflow, and Data Lake Studio. 

In this role, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for building, operating, and evolving highly scalable and reliable data infrastructure. You will define technical and organizational priorities, drive platform strategy and execution, and partner with engineering teams across the company to provide efficient, reliable, and easy-to-use data platform capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & People Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software and platform engineers responsible for business-critical data infrastructure. 
 - Define engineering priorities and translate platform strategy into clear, executable roadmaps. 
 - Build a strong engineering culture focused on technical excellence, ownership, reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering talent through coaching, career development, and performance management. 
 - Partner with senior engineers and architects to drive technical direction and long-term platform evolution. 

Platform Ownership & Strategy

- Own the strategy, architecture, roadmap, and execution for the Unified Data Platform, including: Hadoop Platform - large-scale distributed storage and data processing infrastructure. ETL Platform - scalable infrastructure and frameworks for production data pipelines. Apache Airflow - workflow orchestration, scheduling, and operational capabilities. Elasticsearch Platform - large-scale search, indexing, and data-serving infrastructure. Data Lake Studio - developer-facing tools and experiences for data development, discovery, processing, and analytics. 
 - Drive platform standardization and integration to provide a consistent experience across storage, compute, data processing, orchestration, and developer tooling. 
 - Develop self-service platform capabilities that simplify infrastructure complexity and improve engineering productivity. 
 - Drive architectural evolution to support increasing scale, workload diversity, reliability, and business requirements. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify the platform, reduce operational complexity, and improve infrastructure efficiency. 

Reliability & Operational Excellence

- Ensure scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence across mission-critical platforms. 
 - Establish and track platform SLAs/SLOs and engineering metrics around reliability, performance, capacity, adoption, and efficiency. 
 - Drive improvements in observability, automation, capacity management, incident response, and disaster recovery. 
 - Lead technical reviews and post-incident analysis for significant platform issues and drive systemic improvements. 
 - Promote engineering practices that improve platform resilience and reduce operational overhead. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with data engineering, analytics, infrastructure, security, and application teams to understand requirements and establish platform priorities. 
 - Balance investments in platform reliability, technical modernization, and new capabilities. 
 - Drive adoption of common platform capabilities and reduce fragmented or duplicated infrastructure. 
 - Communicate platform strategy, priorities, technical trade-offs, risks, and progress to engineering leadership and stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years software engineering experience, including engineering management or technical leadership experience. 
 - 5+ years experience building and operating large-scale platform, infrastructure, distributed systems, or data infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and production operations. 
 - Experience leading teams responsible for highly available, large-scale production platforms or infrastructure. 
 - Experience defining technical strategy and driving complex, multi-quarter engineering initiatives involving multiple systems and teams. 
 - Strong engineering judgment with the ability to evaluate architecture, technical trade-offs, operational risks, and long-term platform investments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and lead high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering organizations. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading teams responsible for large-scale data platforms, infrastructure platforms, distributed systems, or developer platforms. 
 - Experience with technologies in areas such as distributed storage and compute, data processing, workflow orchestration, search infrastructure, or data engineering platforms. 
 - Experience building internal platforms and self-service infrastructure used by large engineering organizations. 
 - Experience modernizing large-scale infrastructure while maintaining production reliability. 
 - Experience driving improvements in platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, and infrastructure efficiency. 
 - Ability to operate effectively across deep technical discussions, people leadership, organizational planning, and long-term platform strategy. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Firmware
data.description:
What You'll Do

As Firmware Engineering Manager, you will lead a global team responsible for embedded firmware and platform software for Critical Power Solutions technology and product-development programs, including uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, and energy metering. You will own people leadership, technical direction, execution, quality, and lifecycle delivery across real-time operating system (RTOS) and embedded Linux platforms. You will partner with product management, systems, hardware, validation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and global engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable architectures and predictable releases. The role balances hands-on technical leadership with coaching, talent development, resource planning, risk management, and continuous improvement. 

"

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of firmware engineers and technical leads; set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, conduct performance and development discussions, and build succession plans. 
 - Own delivery of embedded firmware for technology development and new product programs across RTOS and embedded Linux platforms while meeting scope, schedule, cost, quality, cybersecurity, and product-performance commitments. 
 - Establish firmware strategy, platform roadmaps, software architecture, requirements, and reuse plans for products including uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, and energy metering. 
 - Translate business and system requirements into executable plans; prioritize the portfolio, allocate resources, manage dependencies, and make transparent trade-off decisions. 
 - Provide technical oversight for board support packages, device drivers, bootloaders, middleware, inter-process communication, networking, diagnostics, and application-layer software. 
 - Guide RTOS design for deterministic behavior, scheduling, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory constraints, safety, and reliability; guide embedded Linux development using Yocto-based distributions, kernel and driver integration, and system services. 
 - Drive disciplined engineering practices including design reviews, code reviews, static analysis, unit and integration testing, continuous integration, configuration management, release governance, and defect prevention. 
 - Monitor program execution using meaningful metrics, identify technical and delivery risks early, remove obstacles, and communicate status and recovery plans to stakeholders. 
 - Partner with systems, hardware, power electronics, validation, cybersecurity, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to deliver robust end-to-end solutions. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable product-development processes, functional-safety expectations, cybersecurity requirements, open-source obligations, and company release procedures. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex field, lab, and production issues; ensure corrective actions are systemic and lessons learned are reused. 
 - Build capability through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, technical communities of practice, knowledge sharing, and targeted learning plans. 
 - Foster an inclusive, accountable, and innovative team culture that encourages constructive challenge, collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage suppliers and engineering partners where applicable, including technical scope, deliverables, reviews, quality, and integration. 
 - Champion process improvement, automation, platform reuse, and engineering productivity across global firmware teams. "

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline; master's degree preferred
 - 9+ years of embedded software or firmware development experience, including substantial experience with embedded Linux and/or RTOS-based products. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineers through direct people management, technical leadership, or program leadership in a global environment. 

Skills

- Strong C and C++ skills, object-oriented design, software architecture, algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and multi-threading. 
 - Practical RTOS expertise, including task scheduling, synchronization, interrupt handling, memory management, timing analysis, debugging, and real-time performance optimization. 
 - Strong embedded Linux expertise, including Yocto Project, Linux kernel concepts, device trees, board support packages, device drivers, bootloaders, system services, and cross-compilation toolchains. 
 - Experience with software lifecycle practices and tools such as Git, Jira, continuous integration, automated testing, static analysis, requirements traceability, and release management. 
 - Working knowledge of embedded cybersecurity, secure boot, cryptography, vulnerability management, and secure development practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to make architecture and delivery trade-offs, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Yocto releases such as Dunfell and Kirkstone, open-source software governance, and upstream contribution. 
 - Familiarity with power conversion, uninterruptible power supplies, energy storage, power distribution, metering, or other high-reliability industrial products. 
 - Familiarity with functional safety, product certification, model-based design, test automation, and Agile product development. 
 - Experience managing external engineering partners, suppliers, budgets, or multi-site resource plans. "

"Embodies Eaton leadership attributes-ethical, passionate, accountable, efficient, transparent, and learning-with demonstrated capability in: 

- People leadership - sets direction and expectations, delegates effectively, coaches for performance, recognizes contributions, and addresses performance issues promptly and fairly. 
 - Talent development - identifies strengths and gaps, creates development opportunities, supports career growth, and builds succession and hiring plans. 
 - Inclusive leadership - creates psychological safety, values diverse perspectives, and builds an environment where people can contribute at their best. 
 - Strategic thinking - connects technology and platform choices to customer needs, product roadmaps, business priorities, and long-term capability. 
 - Execution and accountability - converts strategy into clear plans, uses metrics to manage commitments, removes barriers, and delivers results. 
 - Decision quality - makes timely, fact-based decisions under uncertainty and explains trade-offs, risks, and rationale. 
 - Influence and stakeholder management - aligns global and cross-functional teams, manages conflict constructively, and communicates effectively at all levels. 
 - Change leadership - leads teams through ambiguity, drives adoption of improved practices, and sustains organizational change. 
 - Customer and business acumen - understands customer outcomes, commercial priorities, competitive technologies, and quality expectations. 
 - Innovation leadership - creates space for experimentation, facilitates effective problem solving, and converts promising ideas into scalable solutions. 
 - Learning agility and resilience - adapts quickly, seeks feedback, remains composed under pressure, and helps the team recover from setbacks. 
 - Integrity and judgment - models ethical behavior, protects confidential information, and makes decisions consistent with company values. "

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions.  - Cloud & Deployment: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerisation and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - AI Evaluation & Security: Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt security, guardrails, and production monitoring. 
 - Engineering Practices: Strong knowledge of software architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, Git, code reviews, and production support. Preferred Qualifications

Ideal Candidate Profile

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365, all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors, including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling. com addresses. 

About Monetization Platform

The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries. 

The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle: 

Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue

These systems support a $1B+ sales base, manage entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries. 

As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time. 

Our vision is simple: 

Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code. 

This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team. 

The opportunity

- Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories. 
 - Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems. 
 - We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform. 
 - You will own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust. 
 - This role combines: 
 - Hands-on backend and platform engineering
 - Org-level architectural leadership
 - Technical leadership and mentorship
 - Cross-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data
 - You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence. 
 - This is not an architecture-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level technical decisions. 

What you'll own

- Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows. 
 - Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries. 
 - Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one-off solutions. 
 - Lead multi-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long-term operational ownership. 
 - Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems. 
 - Make high-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed. 
 - Stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation-level decisions. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams. 
 - Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake. 
 - Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence. What success looks like

- Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure. 
 - Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability. 
 - Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one-off implementations. 
 - Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems. 
 - Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership. 
 - Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross-system problems. 
 - Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives. 

What we're looking for

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering. 
 - Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff+ scope. 
 - Deep hands-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience. 
 - Experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements. 
 - Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross-functional, multi-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership. 
 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. 
 - Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments. 
 - Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus. Bonus points

- Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems. 
 - Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams. 
 - Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow-heavy domains, or high-growth product companies. 
 - Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise-grade controls. 
 - A builder-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend / Agent Orchestration
data.description:
Build the Future Workforce

Wand turns AI into labor. It enables humans and AI agents to operate together as a unified, hybrid workforce, with comprehensive management and oversight. And it's already operating at scale inside some of the world's largest organizations. 

Wand built the world's first Agentic Labor Infrastructure enabling governments and global enterprises to create, manage, and scale digital workforces. 

Our mission is to integrate agent ecosystems into the core of work and business, unlocking a generational leap in the global economy. We're building the infrastructure that lets humans and AI agents operate together safely, transparently, and at scale. 

Join Wand in leading the Agentic Shift

Wand is building a high-performing global team who take full ownership of what they build. We lead by example, move fast, make data-aware decisions, and continuously push for more- always with a focus on delivering real value to customers. 

You would be joining a world-class team that combines deep research expertise and real-world product execution, with experience spanning Deepmind, Google, Amazon, Miro, Elise AI, IBM and Accern. 

Position Summary

Every agent on our platform runs because of what this team builds. We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help architect the distributed backend that powers agent orchestration at Wand: workflow execution on Temporal, sandboxed agent code, and the pipelines that keep thousands of agents running without falling over. Zero UI, zero fluff. Just hard distributed systems problems at real scale. 

You'll pair directly with our Tech Lead on the India based team and take the architecture to the next level. We need someone who can turn "design v3 of this system" into a real, working plan, then help the team build it. 

This isn't just about orchestrating a single agent. It's about orchestrating a workforce of agents working together through processes, and building the layer that makes that possible. Orchestration, task execution and tool calling, and sandboxing are largely independent pieces, so depth in any one of them matters more than breadth across all of them. 

Role Responsibilities

- Architect the agent orchestration and workflow execution system on Temporal, including the sandboxing that keeps agent code execution, web access, and file systems locked down and safe. 
 - Build the task management, autonomous execution loops, and tool calling infrastructure that let agents run independently and act in the real world at scale. 
 - Own the distributed data and event pipelines (Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis) that keep the platform observable and resilient. 
 - Turn ambiguous, high stakes problems into concrete technical designs, ship them, and document the architecture so the next engineer doesn't have to guess. 
 - Pair with the team's Tech Lead to raise the bar on architecture and code quality, reviewing designs across the team as it scales. 
 - Work with the Workforce Management team so the execution layer supports what they're building on top, and pitch in on production support, including coverage that overlaps with US afternoons. 

Key Requirements

- Real scalable distributed systems experience: production systems that run across many machines, not one box. 
 - Hands on with Temporal or comparable workflow orchestration systems. 
 - Strong with Kafka, and Kubernetes for container orchestration (especially for the sandboxing components). 
 - Deep backend chops. There's no frontend here, so this needs to run deep. 
 - Experience with distributed streaming and event driven systems (we use Kafka and Redis). What you built with these tools matters more than which specific ones you've used. 
 - A track record of owning architecture end to end, not just contributing to someone else's plan. 
 - Strong in Go and Python. 
 - Clear communicator who can design independently and bring the team along. 
 - Exposure to agentic or LLM based systems, especially tool calling. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience building safe, isolated execution environments (sandboxing). 
 - Background in process automation or RPA (e. g. BPMN, Camunda, UiPath, or similar), even without direct agent experience. We're building orchestration for a workforce of agents, and process automation experience transfers well. 
 - Exposure to distributed data stores such as Cassandra or ClickHouse. Helpful, not required. 
 - Experience building infrastructure other teams can't live without. 
 - On call experience for distributed systems. 
 - Time spent scaling infrastructure inside a fast growing engineering org.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1, 300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide. 

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced, proactive and innovative professional that is keen to join as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer! The mission of Nexthink's SRE team is to strengthen our infrastructure and enhance our ability to deploy, monitor, and scale systems effectively and reliably. They work closely with over 50 Product Engineering teams that develop our products and services, as well as with the Technical Platform Engineering, Security and Architecture teams to understand the reliability requirements, design and implement solutions, and promote them for adoption and usage. 

Join our vibrant team of diverse and experienced engineers where cutting-edge technology meets innovation. Be a part of Nexthink's Digital Employee Experience technological revolution, ensuring our global customers enjoy a seamless user experience. Apply now and become a key player in our dynamic SRE organisation. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will: 

- Implement and manage cloud-native systems (AWS) using best-in-class tools and automation. 
 - Operate and enhance Kubernetes clusters, deployment pipelines, and service meshes to support rapid delivery cycles. 
 - Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure powering our multi-tenant SaaS platform with reliability, security, and scalability in mind. 
 - Define and maintain SLOs, SLAs, and error budgets, and proactively address availability and performance issues. 
 - Develop infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar) for repeatable and auditable provisioning. 
 - Build internal platform tools and automation to support provisioning, monitoring, and operational efficiency. 
 - Monitor infrastructure and applications ensuring high-quality user experiences. 
 - Participate in a shared on-call rotation, responding to incidents, troubleshooting outages, and driving timely resolution and communication. 
 - Act as an Incident Commander during the on-call duty and coordinate cross-team responses effectively to maintain an SLA. 
 - Drive and refine incident response processes, reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex issues independently, minimizing the need for external escalation. 
 - Work closely with software engineers to embed observability, fault tolerance, and reliability principles into service design. 
 - Automate runbooks, health checks, and alerting to support reliable operations with minimal manual intervention. 
 - Support automated testing, canary deployments, and rollback strategies to ensure safe, fast, and reliable releases. 
 - Contribute to security best practices, compliance automation, and cost optimization. 

Qualifications

- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or Platform Engineer with strong knowledge of software development best practices. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with public cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) and supporting SaaS product. 
 - Strong programming or scripting skills (e. g. , Python, Go, Bash. . . ), and experience with infrastructure-as-code (e. g. Terraform). 
 - Proficiency with Kubernetes, container-based deployment (e. g. , Docker) and related ecosystems (e. g. , Helm). 
 - Experience supporting multi-tenant microservices architectures. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines & tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, FluxCD, Crossplane). 
 - Experience with managing monitoring solutions (e. g. Datadog). 
 - Comfortable participating in a rotating on-call schedule, managing critical incidents, and leading post-incident reviews. 
 - At ease with operating and managing production systems, striking the right balance between urgency and methodology. 
 - Strong system-level troubleshooting skills and a proactive mindset toward incident prevention. 
 - Deep understanding of Linux systems, networking, and common troubleshooting practices. 
 - Solid understanding of the network stack (e. g. , TCP/IP, VPN, etc. ), cloud architectures (VPC, subnets, firewalls, load balancers), service mesh (e. g. , Istio) and storage (e. g. , S3, EBS, etc). 
 - Knowledge of zero-downtime deployment strategies, blue/green and canary releases. 
 - Exposure to compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. FedRAMP experience is a big plus. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing practices. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, collaborative mindset, and a strong grasp of agile, iterative development. 
 - Self-driven, highly organised, and capable of independently managing priorities. 
 - Curiosity to learn new things and discover new technologies. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, and team collaboration skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal skills in English. 
 - The prior experience with any of the above-mentioned tools is a bonus, but not a must! We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single requirement. We welcome candidates with different level of background and experience. If you are excited about this role, please apply and our recruiters will assess your application. 

Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace. 

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people's health around the world. Together, we're improving health and improving lives. 

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. 

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer - Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12. 30 PM IST - 9. 30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable. 
 - Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior. 

Technical Oversight

- Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation.

 - Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization. 
 - Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation. 
 - Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness. 
 - Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces. 
 - Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer. 
 - 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. 
 - 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications. 
 - 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools. 
 - 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
 - 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices. 

Certifications

- Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail. 
 - Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills. 
 - Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English. 
 - Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins. 
 - Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 
 - Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams. 
 - Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes. 

About The Role

- The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. The role requires strong Salesforce testing experience and the ability to test complex business processes involving integrations, data migration, and multiple enterprise systems.

data.title: Principal Automation Developer
data.description:
About The Role

TTEC is scaling its Automation & AI portfolio to move beyond manual, ticket-by-ticket process work toward an agentic framework that can right-source work across business units. This role is central to that shift - building the multi-agent systems, integrations, and evaluation rigor needed to deploy AI agents safely and at scale across TTEC's technology and business operations. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement multi-agent workflows using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), including agent orchestration, tool routing, and memory/context management 
 - Build integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose internal systems (Jira, SharePoint, ServiceNow, internal APIs, etc. ) as discoverable tools that agents can call at runtime 
 - Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, task completion rate, and safety - both pre- and post-deployment 
 - Design, build, and optimize conversational and task-based agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, integrating with Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) and enterprise data sources 
 - Apply strong prompt engineering practices - structured prompting, few-shot design, guardrails, and iterative evaluation - to improve agent reliability and reduce hallucination/drift 
 - Architect and deploy agentic solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, IAM) with attention to scalability, cost, and security 
 - Partner with business unit stakeholders to identify manual, repeatable processes suitable for agent-based automation, translating business requirements into technical agent designs

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SMTS Software Quality Engineer to join the HIP Runtime Quality Engineering team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on defect triage, root‐cause analysis, and scalable test automation for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends. 

The role sits at the intersection of runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‐source stack. 

HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform. 

Key Responsibilities

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

- Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines. 
 - Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management. 
 - Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Correlate failures across: 
 - ROCr system runtime
 - HIP runtime
 - Driver / firmware interfaces
 - Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions
 - File high‐quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment. 

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses). 
 - Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for: 
 - HIP Runtime APIs
 - Graph APIs
 - Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
 - Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting. 
 - Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis. 
 - Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with HIP runtime developers to: 
 - Review test gaps for new features and APIs
 - Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths
 - Collaborate with: 
 - Compiler and language runtime teams
 - ROCr system runtime teams
 - Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams
 - Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories. 

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement

- Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 
 - Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements. 
 - Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb). 
 - Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution. 
 - Experience with Linux-based development and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries. 

Debugging & Analysis Skills

- Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution. 
 - Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging. 
 - Experience triaging issues across hardware-software boundaries is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL). 
 - Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers). 
 - Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems. 
 - Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing. 

What Success Looks Like

- Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights. 
 - Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases. 
 - Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers. 
 - Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

Description: 

Senior Database Performance & Benchmark Engineer, the responsible for designing and executing rigorous testing strategies across a complex hybrid environment consisting of large-scale on-premises SQL Server instances and public cloud managed database services. You will act as the bridge between infrastructure engineering, database administration, and application development to ensure our systems are resilient, highly scalable, and optimized for peak

production workloads. 

Your responsibilities

- Hybrid Benchmarking & Load Testing: Design, script, and execute comprehensive load, stress, and endurance tests utilizing synthetic tools (e. g. , HammerDB, OStress, Apache JMeter) and production replay tools (e. g. , WorkloadTools, DEA). 
 - Performance Telemetry & Monitoring: Establish performance baselines and build continuous monitoring dashboards utilizing OS-level metrics (PerfMon/Linux Sysstat) and SQL Server Dynamic Management Views (DMVs). 
 - Cloud Migration & Scaling Validation: Benchmark on-premises workloads and simulate equivalent performance in public cloud environments (such as AWS RDS/EC2, Azure SQL, or GCP Cloud SQL) to accurately size cloud infrastructure and control costs. 
 - Bottleneck Isolation & Optimization: Analyze execution plans, identify plan regressions, and isolate resource contention bottlenecks (CPU, Memory, Disk I/O, TempDB, and network latency). 
 - Concurrency & Lock Management: Diagnose and resolve complex locking, blocking, and deadlock scenarios discovered during high-concurrency simulation cycles. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Performance QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to establish quality gates and provide actionable code/indexing optimization recommendations. 

Your skills and experience

Must-Have: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent with 7+ years of experience in dedicated database administration (DBA), database engineering, or specialized database performance testing experience. 
 - Hybrid Environment Mastery: Proven track record managing or benchmarking both traditional on-premises enterprise hardware and public cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Deep SQL Server Internals: Expert-level knowledge of SQL Server query optimization, execution plan analysis, Query Store, Extended Events (XEvents), and system DMVs and Extensive experience setting up and operating database benchmarking suites such as HammerDB, SQLQueryStress, OStress, or similar automated simulation frameworks. 
 - Solid understanding of underlying storage configurations (SAN, NVMe, Cloud IOPS allocations), virtualization layers, and network latency mechanics in hybrid setups and Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell, T-SQL, or Python to automate test deployments, data generation, and telemetry collection. 
 - Experience with cloud native infrastructure-as-code tools (e. g. , Terraform) to spin up and tear down transient performance testing sandboxes and Experience with production workload masking and synchronization methodologies to generate high-fidelity, non-sensitive testing datasets. 

Nice-To-Have: 

- Relevant certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or historical Microsoft SQL Server certifications.

data.title: Automation Engineer
data.description:
About Anzo Controls Pvt. Ltd. 

Anzo Controls Pvt. Ltd. is a leading Indian manufacturer of advanced industrial automation and robotics solutions. With a strong vision to position India as a global hub for automation technology, we develop indigenous solutions across Robotics, Motion Control, AGVs/AMRs, Servo Drives, Material Handling Systems, SCARA Robots, Delta Robots, Gantry Systems, ASRS, and Smart Factory Automation. 

Driven by our philosophy of "Make in India, Build for India, " we empower manufacturers and OEMs with innovative, reliable, and cost-effective automation solutions. Our multidisciplinary team of 100+ professionals is dedicated to transforming industries through cutting-edge engineering and technology. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated PLC Programmer / Controls & Automation Engineer to join our automation team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, programming, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial automation systems involving PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, robotics, servo drives, and motion control applications. 

The role offers an exciting opportunity to work on advanced automation projects including robotic systems, material handling equipment, AGVs/AMRs, conveyors, and custom machine automation solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement PLC-based automation systems for industrial applications. 
 - Program, test, commission, and troubleshoot PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems. 
 - Configure, tune, and optimize servo drives, VFDs, and motion control systems. 
 - Develop and maintain multi-axis motion control applications involving synchronization, interpolation, and positioning. 
 - Integrate and commission robotic systems such as SCARA, Delta, Gantry, and articulated robots. 
 - Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and software teams for seamless system integration. 
 - Perform machine commissioning, FAT, SAT, and troubleshooting at factory and customer sites. 
 - Develop control logic, machine sequences, safety interlocks, and automation workflows. 
 - Ensure communication between automation devices using industrial protocols such as Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, CAN, and OPC. 
 - Prepare technical documentation including electrical schematics, IO lists, operating manuals, and project reports. 
 - Provide technical support for maintenance, upgrades, and optimization of automation systems. 
 - Participate in R&D and development of innovative automation and robotics solutions. 

Required Skills

- Strong experience in PLC programming and troubleshooting. 
 - Hands-on experience with Siemens, Allen Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, or similar PLC platforms. 
 - Proficiency in HMI and SCADA development. 
 - Good understanding of industrial automation systems and electrical controls. 
 - Experience with servo drives, VFDs, and motion controllers. 
 - Knowledge of robotics integration and automation systems. 
 - Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, CAN, and OPC. 
 - Ability to read and understand electrical drawings and control schematics. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent teamwork and communication abilities. 
 - Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related field. 
 - 1-5 years of experience in PLC programming, controls engineering, or industrial automation.

About 360 Technology

360 Technology delivers digital transformation and technology services from ideation to execution, enabling global clients to outperform the competition. Its expertise spans Cloud, Microservice Transformation, IoT, IT Consulting, Healthcare Solutions, Hyperautomation, Low-Code/No-Code Platforms and RegTech. The company is ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 27001: 2022 and CMMI Level 3 certified. 

About the role

360 Technology is establishing an AI lab in Bengaluru. We are looking for an ambitious, hands-on technology leader who can build enterprise-grade automation solutions using agents and AI, and build things extremely, extremely fast. Speed matters more than anything else. You will turn early ideas into working automation products and own the system architecture end to end. 

What you will do

- Design and build AI agents with tool and function calling, workflow orchestration and RAG over enterprise data (embeddings, vector stores, re-ranking). 

- Connect solutions to business systems through REST APIs, webhooks, databases and event-driven services (queues, Temporal, n8n). Choose simple designs before adding complexity. 

- Own the path to production: CI/CD, containers, cloud deployment, tracing, evaluations, monitoring, retries and recovery. Track task success, latency and cost per run. 

- Protect customer data with access controls, secret management and audit trails. Add human approval for sensitive actions. 

- Set the technical direction, review code and help other builders move faster. Explain technical choices clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

What we are looking for

- Evidence of building and shipping AI-powered products or automation, beyond chatbot demos. Strong coding and system-design ability. 

- Strong Python (FastAPI, async) and/or TypeScript; backend services, SQL and NoSQL databases, Docker, and AWS, GCP or Azure. 

- Hands-on with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, open-source models) and agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI or the OpenAI Agents SDK. Structured outputs, prompt design and model trade-offs. 

- Evaluation and observability habits: eval sets, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression tests. Ability to diagnose failures across models, prompts, data and software. Know when an agent is unnecessary. 

- High ownership, curiosity and a bias for action. Comfortable trying new approaches, learning quickly and changing course based on results. 

- Speed is a core requirement: build, test, show and improve in short cycles. Avoid over-engineering, without skipping essential data protection and release checks. 

- A live product, repository or short demo of something you built. Be ready to explain your contribution, delivery speed, architecture and measured results. 

Location and work mode: Bengaluru, Hybrid. Full-time. 

Experience: Open, roughly 1-2 to 6-7 years. 

Compensation: INR 15-60 LPA (total CTC). 

Skills: Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven services. 

Keywords: AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM, generative AI, enterprise automation, RAG, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, vector database, prompt engineering, LLM evals, tracing, n8n, Temporal, AI lab, CTO, AI architect, Bengaluru.

data.title: Vice President of Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Summary

The Vice President - Software Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and continuous evolution of the MADTECH. AI platform. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to multiple engineering teams responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS products. 

The ideal candidate is an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled applications, data engineering, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. This individual will build high-performing engineering teams, establish engineering excellence, drive innovation, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products while working closely with Product Management, AI/ML, Data Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Strategy & Technology Leadership

- Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the organization's business and product objectives. 
 - Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, coding best practices, and software development governance. 
 - Drive technology modernization and adoption of emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, cloud-native platforms, and automation. 
 - Develop long-term technology roadmaps to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security. 

Software Engineering Leadership

- Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for backend, frontend, platform engineering, integrations, and DevOps. 
 - Ensure successful delivery of high-quality software products within timelines and budget. 
 - Oversee software architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Drive engineering productivity through Agile delivery methodologies and engineering metrics. 

Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Provide technical leadership for scalable microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Guide architectural decisions across cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and integrations. 
 - Ensure platform scalability, performance, availability, reliability, and security. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and technology evaluations. 

Engineering Operations & Delivery Excellence

- Improve engineering processes, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment automation. 
 - Implement DevSecOps best practices. 
 - Monitor engineering KPIs including
 - Velocity
 - Quality
 - Reliability
 - Deployment frequency
 - MTTR
 - Engineering efficiency
 - Ensure operational excellence through observability, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis. 

AI & Data Engineering Enablement

- Collaborate with AI/ML teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into the platform. 
 - Enable scalable data pipelines, APIs, AI agents, RAG architectures, and GenAI applications. 
 - Promote engineering practices that support analytics, automation, and customer intelligence. 

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Collaborate with QA, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Support customer escalations requiring engineering leadership. 

People Leadership

- Recruit, mentor, coach, and retain world-class engineering talent. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. 
 - Develop engineering managers and technical leads. 
 - Drive performance management, succession planning, and career development. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS applications using modern software engineering principles and best practices. 
 - Deep understanding of software architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and multi-tenant platforms. 
 - Proficiency in cloud platforms, with hands-on experience in AWS (mandatory); exposure to Azure and GCP is preferred. Strong knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and modern CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Extensive experience with modern software development technologies and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node. js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and related technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol), TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and LLM integrations. 
 - Experience with data engineering, including SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, reverse ETL, data modeling, data lakes, and large-scale data processing frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, Kafka, webhooks, third-party integrations, and modern integration frameworks. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), automated testing, release management, monitoring, logging, observability, and production support. 
 - Expertise in Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Jira, engineering planning, sprint execution, and continuous delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of software quality engineering, secure coding practices, performance optimization, scalability, reliability engineering, and engineering governance. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree preferred. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 8 years leading large engineering teams. 
 - Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale B2B SaaS products. 
 - Strong hands-on background in software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, and modern application development. 
 - Experience leading engineering organizations of 30+ engineers across multiple functional teams. 
 - Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cloud-native applications, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience working with global customers across the US, UK, Australia, and MENA markets. 
 - Demonstrated success in building high-performing engineering organizations. 
 - Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. 
 - Willing to work from Mysuru or Bengaluru. 

Why MADTECH. AI?

Join us in building the future of AI-powered Marketing Decision Intelligence. 

At MADTECH. AI, we're developing a next-generation B2B SaaS platform that brings together AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation to help organizations make faster, smarter, and data-driven business decisions. 

As the VP - Software Engineering, you will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision of our platform, lead high-performing engineering teams, and influence the architecture of products used by global customers. You'll work on cutting-edge technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence. 

If you're passionate about building scalable SaaS products, mentoring exceptional engineering talent, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-growing AI company, MADTECH. AI offers the opportunity to innovate, lead, and grow with us.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. 

So, what's the role all about?

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for builders who understand the business as well as the code. 

As Technical AI Architect & Builder, you will design and build the AI solutions that SPARK brings to life. You combine real business knowledge with solid software engineering: you understand how sales, service, support, and operations teams actually work, and you know how to take an idea through the full software development lifecycle to a solution people use every day. 

You will work as part of a small team of senior builders, led by the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, with significant ownership of the solutions you deliver. You will partner closely with the Business Analyst and the Project Manager. 

How will you make an impact?

You will design and build the AI solutions at the heart of SPARK, owning them from the first prototype through hardening and handover, working with the Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, the Business Analyst, and the Project Manager. 

Design Solutions that Fit the Business

- Work with the Business Analyst and business teams to understand the process, the users, and the outcome, and shape a solution design that fits how people actually work
 - Translate use cases into solution architectures covering agents, retrieval, integrations, data flows, and user experience
 - Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that is an AI agent, a workflow automation, a prompt-based assistant, or a conventional software fix
 - Estimate effort and flag technical risks early to the Project Manager

Build and Ship

- Build working prototypes and production-grade solutions using LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and RAG pipelines
 - Work with IT to develop integrations, APIs, and services that connect AI solutions to enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Power BI, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
 - Apply prompt engineering and context design that deliver reliable results, and iterate on user feedback
 - Write clean, tested, documented code and keep it in well-organised shared repositories
 - Optimize solution costs

Engineer for Quality and Scale

- Apply the full SDLC to every solution (design, build, test, release, and support), using Git workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines

Job Summary: 

Vortech is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company building enterprise-grade platforms for global partners. We are establishing our Hyderabad engineering hub and looking for a NodeJS Team Lead to be one of its founding members. You will own technical delivery end-to-end, collaborate as a peer with our engineering teams across hubs, and help define what great engineering looks like in Hyderabad. 

You will sit at the intersection of hands-on engineering and team leadership - writing code, guiding juniors, and ensuring what gets shipped is reliable, scalable, and delivers real value to our enterprise clients. 

  

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design and delivery of microservices and backend systems that form the core of Vortech's B2B platform. 
 - Make and defend architectural decisions - data models, API contracts, service boundaries - in collaboration with senior engineers across hubs. 
 - Set and enforce coding standards, PR review practices. 
 - Be the technical point of contact for the Hyderabad hub in cross-team discussions with other hubs. 
 - Contribute hands-on code - this is a lead role, not a manager role. 
 - Guide and mentor junior and mid-level engineers in the Hyderabad team; accelerate their growth through structured feedback and pairing. 
 - Participate in hiring - technical interviews, code assessments, and culture-fit evaluations for the growing Hyderabad team. 
 - Foster a team culture of ownership, peer accountability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Own sprint-level delivery commitments - plan, estimate, identify risks early, and unblock the team. 
 - Champion engineering quality: test coverage, CI/CD discipline, observability, and zero-surprise production deployments. 
 - Track and improve DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) as a measure of team health. 
 - Collaborate with QA to embed quality upstream - not as a handoff, but as a shared responsibility. 
 - Translate technical constraints into business language clearly - proactively, not reactively. 
 - Identify technical debt that impacts product velocity or client experience and build a case for addressing it. 
 -

Required Qualifications: 

MUST HAVE

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or any relevant field. 
 - 6+ years of backend engineering experience with Node. js, deep proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Express. js / NestJS / Fastify, REST APIs, and microservices architecture. 
 - Knowledge of project management methodologies. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively across time zones
 - Ownership mindset - you don't wait to be told what needs doing. 
 - Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) - schema design, query optimisation, indexing. 
 - Deep understanding of the Node. js event loop, asynchronous programming (async/await, Promises), stream management, and memory leak profiling/debugging. 
 - Package managers (npm, yarn, or pnpm), semantic versioning (semver), and dependency lockfile management. 
 - Structured logging libraries (e. g. , Winston, Pino) and APM/tracing tools (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Datadog). 
 - Unit and integration testing frameworks for Node. js (e. g. , Jest, Mocha, Chai, Supertest). 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with event-driven architecture - Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar. 
 - Exposure to frontend technologies (ReactJS) - enough to collaborate meaningfully with full-stack & frontend engineers. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS integration patterns - webhooks, OAuth, multi-tenancy, API gateways. 
 - Experience working in a multi-hub global engineering team. 
 - Understanding of SaaS business metrics - churn, NPS, SLA - and how engineering decisions affect them. 
 - WebSocket workflow
 - Comfortable with exploring new technologies. 
 - Have a strong understanding of software development lifecycles and modern transaction processing environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, AWS/GCP, and distributed caching (Redis).   

What We Offer

- A founding role in Vortech's Hyderabad engineering hub - high visibility, high impact from day one. 
 - Peer-level collaboration with experienced engineering teams across the globe. 
 - Direct mentorship from the Head of Engineering with a clear growth path
 - Competitive compensation benchmarked to Hyderabad senior engineering market rates. 
 - A culture that values engineering craft, business awareness, and user empathy equally.

Manager, Embedded Software Engineering

Role Purpose

This exciting opportunity is created to build and lead a growing embedded software team in Bangalore, shaping its technical capability, ways of working and contribution to global product development. The successful candidate will recruit and develop a team that can scale up rapidly in the medium term, while building strong partnerships across software, electronics, hardware and product teams in Europe, Asia and the US. With a focus on delivery, engineering quality and continuous learning, the successful candidate will help the team make a lasting impact on industrial products. 

Role Responsibilities

- Recruit, onboard and develop the Bangalore embedded software team, building the structure and capabilities to scale up rapidly in the medium term. 
 - Provide functional and disciplinary leadership, set clear priorities and create an environment where engineers can do their best work. 
 - Build effective working relationships with global software, hardware, electronics and product teams across Europe, Asia and the US.

 - Facilitate cross-site technical decisions, planning and prioritisation, and resolve or escalate conflicts when priorities diverge.

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering or a comparable discipline.

 - Strong understanding of hardware-near software development, including drivers, interfaces, integration, debugging and hardware-software root-cause analysis.
