 - Establish effective capacity planning, performance optimization, release safety and operational readiness practices. 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

- Own cloud architecture, provisioning, infrastructure operations and platform resilience. 
 - Manage cloud environments across OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP, with OCI experience preferred. 
 - Oversee Kubernetes, virtual machines, microservices infrastructure, cloud networking and databases. 
 - Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC), policy as code, configuration automation and standardized provisioning. 
 - Own disaster recovery, backup and restoration testing, business continuity and infrastructure cost optimization through FinOps. 3. Security Engineering & Proactive Risk Prevention

- Lead hands-on security engineering across IAM, privileged access, secrets management, API authorization and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Establish continuous vulnerability identification, risk prioritization, remediation SLAs and security verification. 
 - Drive cloud security posture management, security monitoring, threat detection and security incident response. 
 - Own penetration-testing programs and ensure identified vulnerabilities are remediated within defined timelines. 
 - Embed security controls into production operations and software delivery rather than relying solely on periodic audits. 4. DevSecOps & Secure Delivery

- Partner with software Engineering to integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Implement SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, container security and Infrastructure as Code scanning. 
 - Establish security gates, remediation SLAs, exception management and measurable security engineering outcomes. 
 - Enable secure and efficient releases without introducing unnecessary manual bottlenecks. 5. ISMS, Compliance & Customer Assurance

- Lead operational implementation of ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 controls. 
 - Ensure controls are continuously enforced and validated across production systems. 
 - Manage customer security assessments, audit readiness, risk registers and corrective actions. 
 - Build an integrated operating model where security engineering and compliance work together, with technical risk reduction as the priority. 6. Automation & AI-Driven Operations

- Drive AIOps adoption for anomaly detection, event correlation, predictive monitoring and incident response automation. 
 - Reduce manual operational effort through scripting, workflow automation and intelligent monitoring. 
 - Establish production security controls for AI agents, including identity, tool authorization, execution isolation, audit trails and human approval for high-risk actions. 7. Organization Leadership & Transformation

- Lead and develop the existing Cloud Operations, SRE and ISMS organization, including managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Establish clear ownership, operational KPIs, escalation structures and accountability across teams. 
 - Identify capability gaps, recruit critical talent and develop a technically strong leadership pipeline. 
 - Drive operational transformation through automation, engineering discipline, measurable service improvements and continuous learning. 
 - Report production reliability, security exposure, major incidents, remediation progress and infrastructure efficiency to executive leadership. Mandatory Requirements

- 15+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial experience in production operations, SRE, cloud infrastructure or security engineering leadership. 
 - Proven leadership of a customer-facing SaaS product or platform in a live production environment. 
 - Direct accountability for 24×7 application monitoring, customer SLAs, production reliability and major incident management. 
 - Demonstrated experience personally leading critical production incidents and implementing corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Strong technical leadership experience managing managers, senior engineers and multi-disciplinary teams. 
 - Hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, infrastructure automation and disaster recovery. 
 - Practical security engineering experience covering IAM, secrets management, API authorization, vulnerability management and security incident response. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps controls and automated security testing within CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Demonstrated success in improving an existing organization's processes, reliability, security posture and operational performance. Preferred Experience

- Multi-tenant SaaS products in insurance, fintech, financial services or other regulated industries. 
 - OCI architecture and operations. 
 - ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 control implementation in production environments. 
 - AIOps implementation and AI-agent security in production. 
 - Experience scaling engineering organizations and driving operational transformation. First-Year Success Measures

First 90 days

- Establish baseline reliability, incident, security and cloud cost metrics. 
 - Identify operational and security risks, with clear owners and remediation timelines. 
 - Deliver a prioritized 12-month transformation roadmap. Within 12 months

- Demonstrate measurable improvements in production incident frequency, MTTR, vulnerability exposure time and cloud cost efficiency. 
 - Establish automated security gates and tenant-isolation testing. 
 - Complete a successful disaster recovery test. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership, incident prevention, security automation and team effectiveness. Candidate Application Requirements

Please provide specific examples demonstrating: 

- A major production incident you personally led on a customer-facing SaaS platform, including business impact, your role and corrective actions. 
 - A security engineering initiative or security incident you led, including tools used, vulnerabilities addressed and remediation timelines. 
 - Your current leadership structure, including direct reports, managers reporting to you, total team size and budget responsibility. 
 - Whether your production platform was a product sold to customers or a service delivered to a client. Candidates should be prepared to discuss measurable outcomes and their personal accountability for production reliability and security. 

Ideal candidate: A senior production operator who combines strong technical depth, executive leadership, customer-facing SaaS operations ownership, SRE, proactive security engineering and organizational transformation experience.

data.title: Principal Validation Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is a global semiconductor leader shaping the backbone of next‐generation automotive, industrial, cloud, and IoT innovation. With over $9. 3 billion in annual revenue (2024) and a world‐class team of 22, 700+ employees, Renesas operates at scale while retaining the agility to drive category‐defining breakthroughs. The company's footprint spans more than 30 countries, enabling deep customer proximity and a uniquely global innovative engine. As Japan's semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‐world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‐solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‐level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader-paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies. 

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division's (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications. 

Job Description

Renesas is looking for a Principal SoC Validation Engineer, to redefine how SoCs are built and validated-driving first‐time‐right silicon, eliminating customer escapes, and setting a new industry benchmark for validation excellence

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end‐to‐end silicon validation strategy for automotive and Embedded SoCs, from pre‐silicon enablement through post‐silicon production release. 
 - Ensure first‐time‐right silicon, robust validation coverage, and zero customer escapes across all assigned programs. 
 - Lead global validation teams responsible for silicon bring‐up, characterization, and system‐level validation across multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Establish and drive a System Use Case Validation Program, harvesting real customer/OEM and system scenarios and converting them into automated, traceable validation suites. 
 - Influence SoC architecture, design, and program decisions through early validation insights, risk identification, and data‐backed recommendations. 
 - Drive shift‐left validation as a measurable engineering program, increasing reuse across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and silicon to reduce late surprises. 
 - Own escape‐prevention strategy, including robustness testing, fault scenarios, coverage models, and disciplined validation signoff criteria. 
 - Build and scale high‐performing validation organizations, developing strong technical leadership (Staff/Principal pipeline) and execution ownership. 
 - Lead automation, standardization, and infrastructure modernization across validation labs, board farms, and CI systems. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, quality benchmarks, metrics, and dashboards aligned with Renesas standards and automotive expectations. 
 - Identify technical, execution, and program risks early; drive data‐driven mitigation and executive decision‐making. 
 - Provide clear executive‐level reporting on validation status, risks, readiness, and outcomes. 
 - Act as a trusted partner to Design, DV, Test, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, Quality, and BU leadership. 
 - Adoption of industry best practices as a measurable program

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - 15+ years of experience in semiconductor validation, characterization, or silicon engineering, with demonstrated ownership of silicon quality outcomes. 
 - 3+ years in senior technical leadership roles 
 - Strong domain expertise in SoC validation, system‐level use‐case testing, and robustness validation. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex SoC programs from first silicon through production release. 
 - Deep understanding of silicon validation flows, lab environments, and post‐silicon debug ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automation‐first validation frameworks using Python, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience driving cross‐functional execution in a matrixed, global environment. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision‐making skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Experience with ISO 26262 / ASIL‐B development and validation environments. 
 - Exposure to emulation/FPGA‐based shift‐left validation and pre↔post silicon continuity models. 
 - Strong foundation in mixed‐signal and digital silicon validation, including pattern‐based and system‐level methodologies.

data.title: Validation Engineer – Post Silicon Functional Validation, Compute Subsystem (CSS)
data.description:
About The Team

The Compute Subsystem (CSS) team at Arm designs and delivers integrated, validated compute subsystems that serve as reference platforms for Arm-based SoCs. The team collaborates across CPU, interconnect, memory, and IO IP teams to build efficient, high-performance solutions targeting client, infrastructure, and automotive markets. 

The Functional Validation Team ensures that Arm's compute subsystems meet quality, performance, and functionality expectations through comprehensive pre-silicon and post-silicon validation across the product lifecycle. 

Role Overview

As a Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, executing, and improving validation methodologies for Arm's compute subsystems IPs both before and after silicon bring-up. You will work closely with design, verification, emulation and customer enablement teams to ensure robust validation coverage and early detection of complex system-level issues. 

or

As a Validation Engineer in the Compute Sub-System (CSS) team, you will be responsible for validating key subsystem IPs and platform functionality across the pre-silicon and post-silicon lifecycle. You will develop validation solutions, execute comprehensive test plans, debug complex hardware/software issues, and collaborate closely with Architecture, Design, DV, Firmware, and Software teams to ensure high-quality silicon delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute pre-silicon and post-silicon validation plans for Arm's compute subsystems. 
 - Build and enhance test environments, automation frameworks, and validation infrastructure using emulation and silicon platforms. 
 - Perform system-level functional validation, focusing on CPU clusters, coherent interconnects, memory controllers, and peripheral integration. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of hardware, firmware, and software issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams. 
 - Develop diagnostic, stress, and performance workloads to validate system functionality, power, and performance. 
 - Support silicon bring-up and debug activities, including board-level testing and post-silicon lab validation. 
 - Analyse coverage gaps and contribute to improving validation efficiency and quality metrics. 
 - Contribute to automation and continuous integration for validation workflows. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 1-3 years of relevant industry experience in SoC, subsystem, or IP-level functional validation. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM based SoC architecture, AMBA protocols (AXI/ACE/CHI), cache coherency, and CPU subsystems. 
 - Proficiency in C/C++ and scripting languages (Python) for test automation and analysis. 
 - Experience with hardware validation tools (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG debuggers) and pre-silicon simulation/emulation environments. 
 - Solid understanding of pre-silicon verification techniques and post-silicon validation challenges. 
 - Familiarity with C based IP drivers and firmware for system-level bring-up and validation. 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills; ability to triage complex hardware/software interactions. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer with 7+ years of hands-on experience in software testing, with strong expertise in both Test Automation and Functional Testing. 

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience designing and developing scalable automation solutions using technologies such as Selenium, Playwright, Python, TypeScript, and Java. The candidate should be comfortable working in an Agile product development environment and collaborating closely with Development, QA/Test, Product, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle. 

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical skills, quality ownership, analytical thinking, and excellent communication. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks and test suites for web and enterprise applications. 
 - Develop reliable and maintainable automation using Selenium and/or Playwright. 
 - Write automation code using Python, TypeScript, and/or Java. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing as required. 
 - Analyze product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs to identify appropriate test coverage. 
 - Develop comprehensive Test Strategies, Test Plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on functional and technical requirements. 
 - Define the appropriate balance between automated and manual/functional testing based on risk, complexity, and business impact. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, test execution efficiency, reliability, and defect detection. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and work with tools such as GitHub and GitHub Actions. 
 - Investigate automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and distinguish between application defects, environment issues, test-data issues, and automation defects. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate effectively with Developers, Test Engineers, Product Owners/Product Managers, and DevOps Engineers to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Participate in defect triage and communicate quality risks, dependencies, blockers, and release-readiness concerns clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of the team's testing processes, automation architecture, coding standards, and overall quality engineering practices. 
 - Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve engineering productivity while following appropriate code-review, security, and quality practices. 
 - Mentor and support other test engineers by sharing automation and quality engineering best practices. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of professional experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering, including significant hands-on experience in automation. 
 - Strong expertise in Test Automation and automation framework development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills in at least one of the following: 
 - Python 
 - TypeScript 
 - Java 
 - Strong experience in Functional Testing, including requirements analysis, test design, test execution, defect identification, and regression testing. 
 - Experience designing and documenting a comprehensive Test Strategy for a product, application, release, or major feature. 
 - Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams and delivering quality software across multiple sprints/releases. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git and GitHub for source-control and collaborative development. 
 - Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD solutions for automated test execution. 
 - Exposure to GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted software engineering/testing tools. 
 - Ability to analyze automation failures and debug issues across application, automation, API, test-data, and environment layers. 
 - Good understanding of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, risk-based testing, and test coverage. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps teams. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues and quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with API testing and API automation, for example REST APIs. 
 - Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of modern automation patterns such as Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable test components, test-data management, and parallel execution. 
 - Experience with test reporting and automated quality metrics. 
 - Exposure to testing applications deployed using cloud and containerized environments. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, automation-code development, code review, debugging, or test analysis. 
 - Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical guidance on test automation. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality considerations such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and usability testing would be an advantage. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline from a recognised institution. 

What We Are Looking For

The successful candidate should be a hands-on Senior Test Engineer, not someone focused only on test coordination or management. We are looking for someone who: 

- Can write automation code, not just execute automated suites. 
 - Has strong functional testing fundamentals in addition to automation expertise. 
 - Can independently define a test strategy and approach for complex features. 
 - Understands quality throughout the complete software development lifecycle. 
 - Can identify what should be automated and what requires exploratory or functional testing. 
 - Is comfortable reviewing requirements and challenging gaps in acceptance criteria and testability. 
 - Can work closely with developers to identify defects early rather than relying only on end-of-sprint testing. 
 - Can collaborate with Product teams to understand customer/business expectations and with DevOps teams to enable reliable automated testing within CI/CD. 
 - Demonstrates ownership, technical depth, attention to detail, and a quality-first mindset. 
 - Communicates clearly, constructively, and confidently across cross-functional teams. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

 - Engineering leadership across large-scale distributed systems and event-driven architectures. 
 - Proven experience driving reliability, resilience, automation, and SDLC optimization
 - Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead teams, manage delivery, and foster collaboration. 

Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued

- Experience in financial services or regulated environments. 
 - Strong Problem-solving skill and stake holder management. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives. 

Accountabilities

- Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives. 
 - Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.

 - Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity. 
 - Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development. 
 - Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment. 
 - Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does. 
 - Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies. 
 - Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. 
 - Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. 
 - Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

data.title: Lead WLAN Test Engineer
data.description:
Lead WLAN Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Experience: 8-12 years

About the Company

Rohde & Schwarz is a telecommunications company working to ensure a safer and connected world. Its business is organized around Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks. Across these divisions, the company develops solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers facing technology and connectivity challenges. This work places testing, communications, and dependable technical systems at the center of the company's business. Rohde & Schwarz states that it stands for independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners. These commitments reflect an emphasis on sustained customer and partner engagement alongside its work in technology markets. The company's activities span multiple areas where reliable connectivity and technical performance matter, from measurement and communications to infrastructure and networks. The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves. 

About the Role

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802. 11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards. 
 - Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution. 
 - Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior. 
 - Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802. 11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior. 
 - Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution. 
 - Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices. 

Essential Skills & Technologies

- Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802. 11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage. 
 - Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation. 
 - Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution. 
 - Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior. 
 - Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution. 
 - Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing. 

Additional Plus

- Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation. 
 - Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation. 

What You'll Bring

- Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes. 
 - A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization. 
 - Practical strength in Python automation, 802. 11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis. 
 - Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues. 

Why Join Us

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices. 

What We Offer

- A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation. 
 - Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams. 
 - The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz's broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Non-Functional Testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

Collaboration & Growth

We are seeking an experienced Switchboard Design Engineer / Team Lead with strong expertise in low-voltage switchboard design, UL 891 compliance, and North American electrical standards. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing low-voltage switchboards for commercial, industrial, and mission-critical applications, particularly data centers. 

The candidate should possess a thorough understanding of UL 891, NFPA 70 (NEC), applicable NEMA requirements, and North American electrical design practices, along with familiarity with European electrical standards and IEC-based design principles. 

This role combines technical expertise with team leadership. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a team of 4-5 electrical design engineers, oversee engineering deliverables, ensure design quality and regulatory compliance, and collaborate with cross-functional teams and international stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality switchboard solutions.

Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in low-voltage switchboard and electrical power distribution design.

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. 
 - A master's degree or relevant technical certifications will be an advantage. Preferred Experience

- 10-15+ years of overall electrical engineering experience, including substantial experience in low-voltage switchboard design. 
 - Proven hands-on experience with UL 891-compliant switchboard products.

 - Exposure to IEC-based European projects and international electrical standards.

data.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing
data.description:
Job Title: Sr. Manager Manufacturing

Location: Dewasnaka, Indore (MP)

Department: Operations

Reporting to: Director

Job Purpose: 

The Sr Manager - Manufacturing shall be the single point of accountability for all manufacturing

operations across the company's 3 factory units. The role shall own production output, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people performance at every site and ensure that the supply chain from raw material purchase to finished goods despatch runs as one integrated system. 

The person will lead the 3 Factory Operations Heads and the functional leads to drive the scale-up, 

standardisation, automation, cost leadership and a strong safety and compliance culture. 

Job Responsibilities: 

A. Overall Manufacturing Operations Leadership

* Facilitate the finalisation of annual operating plans, production targets, capacity utilisation

objectives, and performance benchmarks for each unit and the functional heads. 

* Translate business plans into unit-wise operational targets, conduct periodic business and

operational reviews to assess achievement of targets, and address performance gaps. 

* Ensure consistency in operating practices and standard operating procedures across units. 

* Identify operational bottlenecks and initiate appropriate corrective actions. 

* Drive operational excellence, process standardisation, cost efficiency, and continuous

improvement across the manufacturing network. 

* Ensure effective coordination between units to balance production requirements, capacity, 

material availability and customer commitments. 

B. Manufacturing Process and Production Management

* Drive the Operations Head of all plants to achieve planned production volumes, specifications

and delivery schedules, optimum productivity, reduction in rejection rates, and appropriate

material consumption. 

* Ensure adherence to approved formulations, process parameters, batch controls and

standard operating procedures, wherever applicable. 

C. Labour Management and Industrial Relations

Mentor the Functional IR Heads in ensuring adequate manpower availability, deployment and

utilisation as well as productivity across manufacturing operations as per shift patterns and

seasonal demand. 

D. Maintenance and Engineering

* Lead the Head of Maintenance in all units to establish preventive, predictive and breakdown

maintenance systems of the entire plant equipment. 

* Evaluate and recommend requisite automation, energy-efficiency initiatives or equipment

updations. 

E. Fire Safety, Occupational Safety, and Emergency Preparedness

* Review the performance of the Safety team on their KPI's to ensure effective implementation

of fire prevention and emergency response systems across units. 

F. Quality Control (QC) and Product Quality

* Lead the Head of QC in establishing and maintaining quality standards for incoming materials, 

in-process production and finished goods in accordance with approved specifications and

sampling procedures. 

* Monitor rejection rates, rework, customer complaints, quality deviations and product

consistency for timely investigation of non-conformities and implementation of corrective

and preventive actions. 

G. Laboratory Management

* Oversee the Laboratory team to ensure reliable and timely testing of raw materials, 

fragrances, binders, bamboo sticks, packaging materials and finished products, as applicable. 

H. Inbound Material Control

* Oversee the GRN function to ensure that all incoming materials are received, verified, 

documented and recorded accurately as per SOP's. 

* Ensure reconciliation of purchase orders, supplier invoices, delivery challans, physical

quantities and accepted quantities. 

I. Purchase and Procurement Management

* Mentor the Purchase dept to ensure timely, cost-effective, and reliable availability of raw

materials, packaging materials, consumables, spare parts month on month. 

* Ensure competitive sourcing, appropriate commercial terms, quality compliance, and

adherence to approved procurement policies. 

J. Dispatch and Finished Goods Movement

* Ensure timely, accurate, and cost-effective movement of finished goods to depots and

distribution points for efficient delivery performance. 

K. Cost Control and Resource Optimisation

* Develop and monitor operational budgets covering manufacturing, labour, maintenance, quality, procurement, safety, and dispatch. 

* Identify cost-saving opportunities, and review operational variances, and establish

accountability for corrective actions. 

L. Reporting Systems

* Ensure compliance with applicable factory, labour, safety, environmental, quality, and other

statutory requirements, in coordination with designated functional owners. 

* Have regular performance reviews on all business KPI's with the Management. 

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

1. Industry and Business orientation

2. Entrepreneurial approach

3. Strategic Leadership

4. Collaborative approach

5. Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving

6. Communication skills. 

7. Negotiation skills and stakeholder management

8. Team leadership and capability development. 

9. Functional expertise

Educational Qualifications & Work Experience

* Post Graduate/ Graduate degree in any discipline

* Certifications Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, EHS, quality systems or operational

excellence will be an advantage. 

* 12 -16 years of experience in a relevant manufacturing set-up. 

* Experience in manufacturing cost optimisation, plant productivity improvement, and

operational transformation. 

About the company -

MDPH is a leading FMCG company in India that owns household Brands like Zed Black, Manthan, DinDin, Coach, Orva & more. 

MDPH provides direct employment to over 4, 000 people, has a range of 1200+ SKUs, a network of over 3, 500 distributors, and has invested in 4 manufacturing plants, 39 distribution centers, and an overseas office in New York. MDPH exports to 40+ countries. 

Zed Black Agarbatti is endorsed by MS Dhoni, Manthan Dhoop is endorsed by Hrithik Roshan, and DinDin Confectionery is endorsed by Doraemon.

- Full Time
 - Ahmedabad/GiftCity
 - Posted 1 hour ago

Website Trading Technologies

Multi-asset platform for capital markets

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation engineer to continuously modernize, strengthen and accelerate our test automation frameworks. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes excellent production-quality Python code, can diagnose complex technical problems, and turns that expertise into reliable, maintainable and fast automation infrastructure. Our automation stack includes a Python-based backend for Clear Flow in house framework and Playwright with TypeScript for frontend end-to-end testing. The successful candidate will lead framework design and evolution, improve test reliability and execution speed, strengthen CI integration, and mentor other engineers. Experience testing financial technology or trading systems is highly desirable. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead continuous framework modernization: Own the technical direction and ongoing improvement of our automation frameworks, libraries, utilities and test architecture. 
 - Write high-quality Python: Develop and review robust, readable, efficient Python code for backend automation, framework services, test utilities and integrations. 
 - Improve performance and scalability: Profile and reduce test execution time; identify bottlenecks in setup, data handling, environment interaction and parallel execution; improve resource use without sacrificing reliability. 
 - Increase test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, improve diagnostics and failure reporting, strengthen logging and debugging support, and make failures easier to reproduce and resolve. 
 - Develop end-to-end automation: Maintain and improve Playwright/TypeScript UI automation and ensure effective integration with Python-based backend testing. 
 - Improve CI/CD integration: Make automated suites easier to run and troubleshoot in CI pipelines; improve test selection, reporting, repeatability and feedback time. 
 - Design for maintainability: Apply sound object-oriented design, modular architecture, reusable abstractions, clear interfaces and appropriate design patterns-avoiding unnecessary complexity. 
 - Work across teams: Partner with software engineers, quality engineers and infrastructure teams to investigate failures, improve testability and prevent defects earlier. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, partnership and practical guidance; establish coding standards and framework-development practices. 
 - Measure impact: Use meaningful metrics such as execution duration, flakiness, failure diagnosis time, framework adoption and regression coverage to prioritize improvements. 
 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

- Experience testing financial technology, electronic trading, capital markets, market data, order management or other complex, high-throughput systems. 
 - Experience with development and maintenance of Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Experience improving large regression suites through parallelization, smarter test selection, test-data management, code coverage, performance profiling and flakiness reduction. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, service integrations, messaging or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with Linux-based test environments, containers and troubleshooting environment-dependent failures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, with appropriate review and validation of generated code. 

What We Bring to the Table

Compensation

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). 
 - Work-Life Support & Resources: 
 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. 
Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. data.description:
Job description: 

Job Description Join Wipro Technologies as a Techno Functional Consultant L1, where you will play a pivotal role in driving technological innovations and delivering impactful solutions in dynamic multi-cloud and hybrid cloud environments. This role is designed for professionals with substantial expertise in AIOPS implementation, leveraging cutting-edge cloud-native architectures and advanced monitoring and automation tools to enhance system performance and reliability. 

As a key contributor within the Technology Services sector and the TTMS - AMS (EA) practice, you will collaborate closely across teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable systems that meet evolving client needs. Your responsibilities will encompass developing strategic solutions integrating Datadog's stack, Kubernetes orchestration, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, while fostering robust incident response and alerting mechanisms. 

This role offers an opportunity to be part of an innovative digital transformation journey at Wipro. You will work within an environment that champions agility, collaboration, and continuous learning, empowering you to advance your career and skillset while contributing to inspiring business growth and client success. 

͏ 
 - 6-9 years of comprehensive hands-on experience working with Datadog's monitoring and analytics suite across diverse multi-cloud and hybrid cloud infrastructures. 
 - Strong foundation in systems engineering principles or software development methodologies, enabling holistic understanding of complex system interactions. 
 - Proven expertise with container orchestration using Kubernetes and practical experience with major public cloud platforms including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Advanced proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Go, Python, and Java to develop automation scripts and customize monitoring solutions. 
 - Deep understanding of monitoring strategies, alert configurations, and incident management procedures to ensure system reliability and quick remediation. 
 - Solid grasp of cloud-native application architectures and microservices design, facilitating efficient deployment and scaling of distributed applications. 
 - Experience designing and managing high-throughput, low-latency systems ensuring optimal performance under demanding conditions, complemented by strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 - Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and leveraging monitoring tools for automated feedback and system health tracking. 
 - Comprehensive knowledge of both Windows and Linux operating systems internals, networking concepts, and system-level troubleshooting. 
 - Experience building and maintaining distributed systems with high availability requirements and disaster recovery strategies. 
 - Expertise in containerization using Docker, advanced Kubernetes features, and integration with service mesh technologies to enhance security and traffic management. 
 - Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi adds valuable advantages; competency in building dashboards, designing monitors, and configuring alert systems enhances operational visibility and proactive issue resolution. 
 - Familiar with automation frameworks and workflow orchestration tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and CircleCI to streamline deployment, rollback, and testing processes efficiently. ͏ At Wipro, we seek individuals who bring not only technical expertise but also a strong set of professional competencies that foster effective teamwork and successful project delivery: 

- Effective Communication: Ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative Working: Embrace teamwork and collective problem-solving to achieve shared goals. 
 - Passion for Results: Demonstrating commitment and dedication to delivering high-quality outcomes. 
 - Client Centricity: Focusing on understanding and fulfilling client requirements to drive satisfaction and value.

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation engineer to continuously modernize, strengthen and accelerate our test automation frameworks. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes excellent production-quality Python code, can diagnose complex technical problems, and turns that expertise into reliable, maintainable and fast automation infrastructure. Our automation stack includes a Python-based backend for Clear Flow in house framework and Playwright with TypeScript for frontend end-to-end testing. The successful candidate will lead framework design and evolution, improve test reliability and execution speed, strengthen CI integration, and mentor other engineers. Experience testing financial technology or trading systems is highly desirable. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead continuous framework modernization: Own the technical direction and ongoing improvement of our automation frameworks, libraries, utilities and test architecture. 
 - Write high-quality Python: Develop and review robust, readable, efficient Python code for backend automation, framework services, test utilities and integrations. 
 - Improve performance and scalability: Profile and reduce test execution time; identify bottlenecks in setup, data handling, environment interaction and parallel execution; improve resource use without sacrificing reliability. 
 - Increase test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, improve diagnostics and failure reporting, strengthen logging and debugging support, and make failures easier to reproduce and resolve. 
 - Develop end-to-end automation: Maintain and improve Playwright/TypeScript UI automation and ensure effective integration with Python-based backend testing. 
 - Improve CI/CD integration: Make automated suites easier to run and troubleshoot in CI pipelines; improve test selection, reporting, repeatability and feedback time. 
 - Design for maintainability: Apply sound object-oriented design, modular architecture, reusable abstractions, clear interfaces and appropriate design patterns-avoiding unnecessary complexity. 
 - Work across teams: Partner with software engineers, quality engineers and infrastructure teams to investigate failures, improve testability and prevent defects earlier. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, partnership and practical guidance; establish coding standards and framework-development practices. 
 - Measure impact: Use meaningful metrics such as execution duration, flakiness, failure diagnosis time, framework adoption and regression coverage to prioritize improvements. 
 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

- Experience testing financial technology, electronic trading, capital markets, market data, order management or other complex, high-throughput systems. 
 - Experience with development and maintenance of Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Experience improving large regression suites through parallelization, smarter test selection, test-data management, code coverage, performance profiling and flakiness reduction. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, service integrations, messaging or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with Linux-based test environments, containers and troubleshooting environment-dependent failures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, with appropriate review and validation of generated code. 

What We Bring To The Table

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.

 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.

 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. data.title: Container Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Container Engineer based in India. 

Join a globally distributed engineering team building and operating a high-performance container platform that powers modern, cloud-native applications at scale. In this role, you will help ensure the reliability, security, observability, and cost efficiency of multi-tenant Kubernetes infrastructure across multiple regions. You will combine software engineering, platform architecture, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to build robust automation and improve operational resilience. Working closely with infrastructure specialists and product engineers, you will make reliable deployment practices easier to adopt and maintain. The position offers the opportunity to influence core platform architecture, solve complex infrastructure challenges, and improve the experience of engineering teams worldwide. It is an excellent fit for an experienced engineer who enjoys autonomy, open-source technologies, and building scalable systems in a fast-moving, asynchronous environment. 

Accountabilities

- Platform reliability and operations: Define and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and error budgets for the container platform. Develop policies that connect reliability targets to platform changes and deployment decisions. 
 - Operational readiness and observability: Lead Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) for new capabilities and significant changes. Establish meaningful uptime metrics and improve visibility through comprehensive metrics, logs, and distributed traces across platform components. 
 - Incident management and continuous improvement: Participate in the team's on-call rotation, respond to platform incidents, and drive issues through resolution and follow-up. Facilitate blameless postmortems, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement lasting improvements that reduce detection and recovery times. 
 - Platform software engineering: Build, maintain, and deploy production-grade automation, controllers, operators, internal tools, and platform APIs. Develop custom solutions when existing tools do not adequately address the underlying technical challenges. 
 - Deployment automation and release management: Design and improve platform CI/CD pipelines, rollout mechanisms, and release processes that enable safe, efficient, and predictable deployments. 
 - Security and operational automation: Implement security automation covering intrusion detection, automated remediation, and patch management. Identify repetitive operational tasks and eliminate toil through reliable automation. 
 - Testing and quality assurance: Develop and maintain automated testing suites and pipelines that validate platform releases before they reach production workloads. 
 - Architecture and ecosystem development: Evaluate and evolve the container technology stack, including orchestration, runtimes, networking, workload isolation, and observability tools. Conduct failure-mode analysis, map dependencies, and design resilient architectures for multi-tenant environments. 
 - Infrastructure efficiency: Improve platform architecture to optimize infrastructure costs while maintaining appropriate standards for security, reliability, and performance across tenants. 
 - Engineering enablement: Help product teams adopt sustainable operational practices, including effective alerting, escalation procedures, runbook coverage, and reduced notification noise. 

Requirements

- Professional experience: At least five years of experience in platform engineering, Kubernetes or container platform operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or production infrastructure, including operating production systems at scale and participating in on-call rotations. 
 - Deep technical expertise: Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas, ideally with experience across two: 
 - Container tooling and ecosystem: In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, containerd, OCI/CRI standards, and the broader Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) ecosystem. Familiarity with technologies such as Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Cilium, eBPF, Gateway API, Karpenter, KEDA, gVisor, or Kata Containers is valuable. 
 - Software engineering: Ability to write production-quality code in Go or a comparable systems programming language, build controllers and operators, and design platform APIs and custom automation solutions. 
 - Operational excellence and SRE: Strong understanding of SLOs, error budgets, operational KPIs, incident response, blameless postmortems, and strategies for reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recover (MTTR). 
 - Multi-tenant infrastructure: Experience with large-scale, multi-tenant systems and an understanding of workload isolation mechanisms, including namespaces, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, resource quotas, virtual clusters, and stronger isolation models such as VM-based runtimes. 
 - Cloud infrastructure: Confident working with AWS environments, including multiple accounts, IAM, and VPC networking. 
 - Infrastructure as code: Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools, preferably Pulumi, with Terraform or AWS CDK also suitable. 
 - Kubernetes proficiency: Practical experience deploying, operating, troubleshooting, and improving Kubernetes-based infrastructure. 
 - Automation mindset: A proactive approach to scripting and automating repetitive work to improve efficiency, reliability, and consistency. 
 - Communication and collaboration: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both infrastructure experts and product engineers, collaborate across disciplines, and work effectively in asynchronous, globally distributed teams. 
 - Adaptability and ownership: Comfort navigating ambiguity, making informed technical trade-offs, working independently, and continuously improving systems as requirements evolve. 
Nice To Have

- Experience building and operating a multi-tenant Kubernetes platform used by internal engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with policy enforcement tools such as Kyverno or OPA/Gatekeeper. 
 - Experience with infrastructure cost attribution and optimization tools such as OpenCost or Kubecost. 
 - Knowledge of managed database platforms or PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, and Grafana. 
 - A strong interest in open-source software and the cloud-native ecosystem. 

Benefits

- Fully remote work: Work from anywhere, with no requirement to attend a central office. 
 - Co-working allowance: Access to a WeWork membership or co-working budget to support a productive working environment. 
 - Employee equity: Participation in an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), allowing team members to share in the company's long-term growth. 
 - Technology allowance: A dedicated budget for equipment and tools, including laptops, monitors, headphones, and other work essentials. 
 - Health insurance: Health insurance coverage fully funded for employees, with 80% coverage for eligible dependents, subject to applicable arrangements. 
 - Annual company off-sites: Join colleagues from around the world for an annual gathering focused on collaboration, connection, and team building. 
 - Flexible working arrangements: An asynchronous work culture that emphasizes trust, autonomy, and flexibility in managing your schedule. 
 - Professional development: An annual learning allowance for courses, books, conferences, and other activities that support career growth. 
 - International collaboration: Work with a globally distributed team spanning dozens of countries and languages. 
 - Open-source innovation: Contribute to modern cloud-native infrastructure and help build tools that support the wider developer community. 

How Jobgether Works

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
