data.title: Production And Quality Manager
data.description:
Primary purpose of the role

The Quality Control Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that both internal processes and external suppliers consistently meet the company's quality standards and regulatory requirements. This role involves managing in-process and final inspections for the full range of Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES) and Rotating Disc Electrode (RDE), as well as leading supplier quality engineering initiatives

Major responsibilities

• Product Quality Assurance: This KRA focuses on the overall quality of the products, ensuring that the defect rates are minimized, and that all quality protocols during the final inspection stage are adhered to before shipment. 

• Process Control and Monitoring: This involves monitoring the manufacturing processes to detect and correct defects at early stages and maintaining process capability at an acceptable level to ensure product consistency. 

• Testing and Validation: Ensuring raw materials and components are tested according to established protocols, as well as keeping all testing and calibration equipment within compliance. 

• Continuous Improvement Initiatives: The QC Manager is responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives like Kaizen and Six Sigma, aimed at reducing waste, rework, and improving overall product quality. 

Key Responsibility Areas

1. Control the In-process and Final Inspection for entire range of OES & RDE with documentation & records of in-process and Final inspection. , ensuring optimum utilization of resources with quality output. Escalate to the HOD if abnormality cannot be recovered. 

2. Monitor and maintain Inward, In process and ICT failure rejection data. 

3. Analysis of in process and ICT failure & coordinate with concern dept. (Service, Production & R&D) for root cause & corrective action. 

4. Ensure the zero-defect product is delivered to the customer. 

5. Support to sales team for demo & Quality inspection by customer or third-party inspection for tender and Export orders. 

6. Maintenance of QMS ISO 9001: 2015 like Internal and external Audit plan vs actual, ISO documentation & records, Calibrations of measuring & monitoring equipment. 

7. Work closely with warehouse team, production team, calibration team, R&D team, Sales team and packing team to compliance the customer requirement. 

8. Actively participate in the ramp-up journey of MPA to enhance the Quality as per company's objective. 

9. Active participation in design team / product reviews & SAP reviews for OES. Support R&D team in resolving product related issues to have smooth & trouble-free operation. 

10. Take responsibility for people management related actions including employee communication, training & discipline for your team. 

11. HEALTH, SAFETY, & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE: Ensure proper compliance with all relevant Health, Safety, Environmental, Regulatory and ISO requirements. 

12. Actively take lead in solving problems on the shop floor through Lean Boot Camp for Problem solving, daily management. 

13. Monitor and communicate shop floor performance and identify required improvements individually on time, if required. 

14. Skill evaluation / enhancement of your team.

data.title: Manufacturing Automation CSA Program Lead
data.description:
Manufacturing Automation CSA Program Lead (GMP)

Your Challenge: 

As we scale our advanced manufacturing capabilities, we need a visionary leader to architect and execute our holistic Automation Quality, Compliance, and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) strategy. The GMP Automation CSA Program Lead will bridge strategic quality oversight, automation governance, and operational excellence. Deep technical expertise in GMP manufacturing automation is mandatory, as is a proven track record of strategic thinking in CSV/CSA execution. You will move compliance from a defensive testing exercise to a streamlined, risk-based enabler of modern manufacturing-orchestrating global automation quality standards, driving data integrity, and establishing modern CSV/CSA paradigms across our state-of-the-art GMP facilities. 

. . . in Our Journey: 

You will serve as the organizational authority on automation compliance and program oversight, setting the tone for how we govern manufacturing execution systems, control systems, and data infrastructure. By applying CSIA Best Practices and FDA CSA guidance to critical OT assets, you will build scalable validation and assurance frameworks that safeguard product quality and patient safety while accelerating technology deployment and operational readiness. 

Position SummaryThe GMP Automation CSA Program Lead provides high-level strategic direction, program governance, and operational oversight for all automated and computerized systems operating in our regulated GMP manufacturing network. This pivotal role defines system lifecycle policies, drives risk-proportionate software assurance frameworks, and maintains full alignment with international regulatory expectations and industrial automation standards. 

Functioning at a directorial level of strategic oversight, you will lead the cross-functional integration of Automation, Quality Assurance, IT/OT Infrastructure, Manufacturing Operations, and Engineering. The position commands solid technical mastery over industrial automation platforms (e. g. , Emerson DeltaV, SCADA, PLCs, OSIsoft/AVEVA PI System) paired with advanced strategic vision in risk-based assurance frameworks (FDA CSA, GAMP 5 2nd Edition) and industrial governance standards (CSIA Best Practices) to maximize system reliability, data integrity, and inspection readiness. 

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic CSA Program Governance & Lifecycle Architecture
 - Define Enterprise Automation CSA Strategy: Formulate and enforce company-wide program roadmaps and computerized software assurance (CSA) frameworks tailored for complex, multi-tiered GMP automation architectures. 
 - Strategic CSV/CSA Vision: Drive the paradigm shift from traditional document-heavy CSV to modern, risk-proportionate FDA CSA principles-aligning compliance effort directly with critical process parameters (CPPs), critical quality attributes (CQAs), and direct patient/product safety impacts. 
 - CSIA Compliance Framework: Direct the integration of CSIA (Control System Integrators Association) Best Practices across system lifecycle management, vendor oversight, project execution, and OT system sustainability. 
 - Capital Project Governance: Serve as the lead compliance strategist for capital expenditure projects, system migrations, expansions, DeltaV upgrades, and enterprise historian deployments. 

System Lifecycle & Technical Documentation Governance
 - GMP Automation Architectural Oversight: Establish standard operating procedures for system architecture specifications, user requirements (URSs), functional specifications (FSs), and data flow maps across all automation levels (Level 0-Level 3). 
 - Defensible Program Portfolios: Drive enterprise traceability models and oversee the lifecycle documentation suite (Validation Plans, Risk Assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ, Traceability Matrices, and Summary Reports) to maintain defensible, audit-ready compliance evidence. 
 - Vendor & Integrator Strategy: Define technical and compliance benchmarks for external system integrators and automation suppliers. Conduct strategic reviews of vendor Quality Management Systems (QMS) to maximize the leveraging of supplier testing and FAT/SAT documentation under CSA guidelines. 

Next-Generation Assurance & Testing Execution Strategy
 - Advanced CSA Testing Methodologies: Lead the design and deployment of objective-driven testing strategies-leveraging continuous integration, automated testing tools, and unscripted testing techniques where appropriate under CSA guidance. 
 - Control Loop & Advanced Automation Verification: Apply deep GMP automation knowledge to provide subject matter expertise on the strategic assurance and quality oversight of complex control logic, batch management (ISA-88), phase logic, permissive matrices, alarm management (ISA-18. 2), and interlock architectures. 
 - Operational Readiness & Handover: Establish governance policies for seamless system transitions from project delivery into site operations, continuous monitoring, and ongoing program ownership. 

Data Integrity, Cybersecurity & Risk Management
 - ALCOA+ Framework Governance: Establish site-wide data integrity strategies for automated systems, ensuring robust design controls for electronic records, electronic signatures (21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11), audit trails, and system access models. 
 - OT Cybersecurity & Resilience: Align automation assurance strategies with industrial cybersecurity frameworks (ISA/IEC 62443, CSIA guidelines) to defend against OT threats, secure time synchronization, enforce backup/disaster recovery protocols, and ensure business continuity. 
 - Lifecycle Data Flow Auditing: Direct comprehensive data integrity and functional risk assessments across interconnected control systems, enterprise historians, and manufacturing execution systems (MES). 

Quality Systems & Inspection Readiness Strategy
 - Change Control & Impact Governance: Serve as the final authority on change control impact assessments for automation platforms, ensuring that hardware, software, configuration, and patch changes undergo risk-proportionate verification without stifling innovation. 
 - Deviation & Root Cause Oversight: Lead high-level investigations, CAPAs, and continuous improvement initiatives stemming from automation events, software exceptions, or data anomalies. 
 - Regulatory Inspection Leadership: Represent the company as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) during regulatory agency inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and client audits, articulate the site's risk-based CSA strategy, and defend automated control paradigms. 

Executive Collaboration & Program Delivery
 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Direct cross-functional alignment between Automation Engineering, Quality Assurance, IT/OT, Manufacturing, and Executive Leadership to ensure operational readiness and compliance coherence. 
 - Resource & Integrator Oversight: Manage external validation partners, managed services, and system integrators - ensuring alignment with program timelines, fiscal budgets, and quality standards. 
 - Operational Modernization: Continually benchmark internal automation practices against evolving regulatory guidance, ISPE GAMP trends, CSIA guidelines, and Industry 4. 0 automation practices. 

Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Chemical, Automation, Biomedical), Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Core Mastery (Must-Have): Solid, hands-on technical expertise in GMP manufacturing automation paired with proven strategic vision in Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) within a regulated environment. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in computer system validation/assurance, automation quality engineering, or automation engineering within a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing environment, with demonstrated experience leading program-level compliance strategies. 
 - Regulatory & Framework Expertise: 
 - Deep, practical working knowledge of FDA Computer Software Assurance (CSA) guidance, ISPE GAMP 5 (2nd Edition), 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11. 
 - Strong working knowledge and experience implementing CSIA (Control System Integrators Association) Best Practices for project management, system development, and program governance. 
 - Technical Automation Mastery: Hands-on and architectural depth with industrial automation technologies, including Emerson DeltaV, SCADA systems, PLCs (Allen-Bradley/Siemens), AVEVA PI / OSIsoft PI Historian, batch execution systems (ISA-88), and industrial networks/interfaces (OPC, Modbus, Ethernet/IP). 
 - Data Integrity & Risk: Proven track record of applying risk-based quality management principles (ICH Q9) and ALCOA+ data integrity standards to automation platforms and infrastructure. 
 - Inspection Defense: Demonstrated success in leading inspection readiness programs and defending computerized automation systems directly to regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, etc. ). 
 - Communication & Strategic Influence: Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and consensus-building skills with the ability to articulate complex automation concepts to both technical SMEs and non-technical executive leadership. 

Preferred Qualifications
 - Active involvement in professional industry bodies (e. g. , ISPE, CSIA, MESA, IEEE, ASQ). 
 - Certified CSIA Lead or experience driving CSIA certification for internal engineering organizations or integrator partners. 
 - Experience integrating Level 2 automation control systems with Level 3/4 enterprise systems (e. g. , MES, Syncade, Werum PAS-X, ERP, LIMS). 
 - Direct leadership experience managing capital automation program budgets, external engineering service providers, and system integrators. 
 - Deep knowledge of OT cybersecurity protocols and convergence architectures (ISA/IEC 62443).

data.title: Material+ - Technical Lead - DevOps & Security
data.description:
About The Role

Srijan, a Material company, is a global digital engineering firm specialising in solving complex technology challenges. We are seeking a Technical Lead DevOps & Security with strong expertise in Azure platform security, identity and access management, API security, cloud networking, observability, and DevOps Design and implement Azure platform security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure networking, and native Azure monitoring and security services. 

- Configure Microsoft Entra ID app registrations, service principals, OAuth 2. 0 scopes, delegated and application permissions, OBO token flows, and consent models. 
 - Implement resource-scoped permissions, including Exchange Application RBAC and resource-specific consent (RSC)-style scoping. 
 - Develop and stage APIM policies, including client-specific policies, correlation-ID propagation, content-safety controls, and token-limit enforcement. 
 - Configure network security groups, firewall and egress rules, private endpoints, private connectivity, and subnet segmentation. 
 - Implement observability and audit logging using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel, OpenTelemetry, and KQL. 
 - Review application source code and agent workflows to determine minimum permissions for MCP servers, tools, and Microsoft Graph resources. 
 - Build shared instrumentation libraries or SDKs that enforce structured event emission, schema compliance, and consistent logging. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices to promote controls through DEV and UAT environments. 
 - Follow a native-first, GA-only approach, prioritising existing Azure security capabilities. 
 - Apply default-deny, least-privilege, and fail-closed principles to prevent unauthorised access. 
 - Design and execute positive and negative security tests to verify permitted operations and block unauthorised access. 
 - Produce audit-ready evidence, including permission exports, allow/deny matrices, tamper tests, and control designs. 
 - Coordinate with client platform, cloud networking, and SecOps teams to implement network segmentation and security dashboards. 
 - Manage control implementation through two-week sprint cycles, ensuring staged promotion and validation. 
 - Collaborate with architecture and governance stakeholders to support ARB, TRC, and security/compliance sign-offs. 
 - Drive continuous hardening of platform controls, ensuring they are operationally effective and verifiable. 

Requirements

- 6 - 10 years of experience in DevOps engineering, cloud security, platform engineering, or security engineering, with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including app registrations, service principals, OAuth 2. 0, and consent management. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure API Management, policy authoring, and security policy enforcement. 
 - Strong understanding of Azure networking (NSGs, firewalls, egress controls, private endpoints, subnet segmentation). 
 - Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Microsoft Sentinel, OpenTelemetry, and KQL. 
 - Ability to analyse source code and derive least-privilege permissions for AI agents, MCP servers, and Microsoft Graph resources. 
 - Experience developing shared instrumentation libraries, structured logging, and telemetry controls. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and controlled promotion across environments. 
 - Practical experience with default-deny access, fail-closed controls, and security bypass validation. 
 - Ability to produce clear technical documentation, control designs, and audit-grade evidence. 
 - Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work in an Agile environment and deliver security controls within defined timelines. 
 - Experience with PlainID, AI agent platforms, LLM gateways, MCP hubs, LangSmith, PostgreSQL, and Azure AI security (Content Safety, Prompt Shields) would be an advantage. 

Working Conditions

- The role follows a native-first, GA-only approach with staged DEV-to-UAT promotion, positive and negative testing, and documented sign-off before client handover. Production changes are managed by the client through its own change-control process.

Role Overview -

The developer will work with C#, ASP. NET Core, ASP. NET Zero, ABP. io, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, C++, Boost, IIS, SignalR, RTSP and WebRTC. The role owns platform components from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and production support. A key responsibility is modernizing existing components from ASP. NET Zero to ABP. io while preserving security, reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability. 

Education : Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electronics engineering, or a related discipline. 

Key Responsibilities

- Backend Development
 - Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, business logic, data-access components and integration modules. 
 - Develop and maintain enterprise applications using C#, ASP. NET Core, ASP. NET Zero, ABP. io and SQL Server. 
 - Contribute to ASP. NET Zero-to-ABP. io modernization and migration activities. 
 - Apply object-oriented design, modular architecture, design patterns, and clean coding practices.

 - Design RabbitMQ-based asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, and distributed processing mechanisms.

 - Integrate video-management and surveillance systems using RTSP-based streams.

 - Monitor system health, availability, performance, reliability, and scalability; maintain logging, auditing, tracing, and alerts.

 - Experience with RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms.

data.title: Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

The Engineering Manager will lead a team building and operating scalable OCI metering services that collect, validate, and aggregate cloud resource usage for downstream pricing, rating, and billing. They will own roadmap delivery over a 2-4 quarter horizon, hire and develop engineers, and guide architecture for high-throughput distributed systems with strong data correctness, fault tolerance, and availability. The role includes overseeing batch and streaming data pipelines using managed distributed processing platforms such as Data Flow. Responsibilities include setting engineering standards and SLOs; driving performance optimization, observability, reconciliation, and recovery; ensuring operational readiness and effective on-call coverage; and overseeing security, automation, and safe deployments and rollbacks. The manager will partner with compute, networking, storage, and commercial platform teams to deliver reliable metering capabilities and support new consumption models. Experience with Java, Python, Spark, and cloud data processing platforms is preferred. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Oversees code and/or system optimization efforts for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements within and across teams to support hyper-scale systems. 
 - Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met. 
 - Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 
 - Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 
 - Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Provides oversight in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 
 - Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Oversees the design and implementation of functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 
 - Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Directs implementation strategies for data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Guides teams to be proactive when diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams leverage expertise to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Oversees operational readiness protocol and ensures teams remain knowledgeable of owned components and systems to support effective troubleshooting and performance. 
 - Oversees and approves schedules for operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Oversees implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, ensuring team strategies incorporate encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets (when applicable) are monitored and met. 
 - Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. 
 - Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align on expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. 
 - Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. 
 - Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues, as well as guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. 
 - Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping teams to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. 
 - Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. 
 - Identifies skill gaps across teams and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge-sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives teams to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. 
 - Guides teams to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. 
 - Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. data.title: Build and Release Methodology Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

We are looking for a Senior Engineer for our Build and Release Methodology Group catering to our pioneering SOCs. As the SOC development becomes more complex requiring packing of more and more IPs and the need for doing more SOCs increase, we need to have a scalable infrastructure to be able to complete SOC development in fastest as well as most efficient way possible. This requires an SOC Build and IP Release infrastructure that caters to and keeps up with these ever-increasing complexities. In this position, you will work first-hand on architecting and developing this methodology. If you have real passion for methodologies and automation solutions, you will fit in great!

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and develop system-level methodologies and tools to build SOCs in an efficient and scalable manner. 
 - Architect and implement core build flows so as to optimize build and make it simpler and efficient. 
 - Improve build, release, and integration tools and procedures. 
 - Identify and develop Checks to enforce the best practices for the Build and Release guidelines. 
 - Develop solutions to enable abstraction and compartmentalization for customer IPs. 
 - Identify difficulties and inefficiencies in the SOC implementation process and propose ideas to solve them. 
 - Support IP teams with Build and Release related issues. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 
 - 2+ years of industry experience as Build and Release Engineer, Build Automation, IP integration and related areas. 
 - Strong coding skills in Perl, Python, Makefile, Shell script, or other industry-standard scripting languages. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills to work with multi-functional teams and collaborate with team members across sites and cultures to build consensus. 
 - Background in RTL (Verilog), Verification (UVM, System Verilog) and C/C++ is a plus - Not must. 
 - Experience in synthesis and physical design is a plus - Not must. 

, , JR2028814

data.title: Engineer II - QA Manual

At Aristocrat, we're dedicated to crafting world-class gaming content and technology that captivates and entertains millions worldwide. As an Engineer II, you will play a key role in maintaining our high standards and ensuring flawless functionality across our products. Your contributions will directly impact the quality and success of our beloved games, making this an exciting and rewarding role!

What You'll Do

- Develop test planning documentation based on requirement specifications, ensuring every element is addressed.

 - Apply your experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and web technologies to detect bugs and find their solutions. 
 - Suggest innovative ideas to improve testing processes, tools, and test cases. 

What We're Looking For

- Over 3 years of extensive experience in manual closed system testing. 
 - Proven experience in testing digital games. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in preparing extensive test planning materials. 
 - Experience working with test management and defect tracking tools like Jira. 
 - Ability to evaluate and confirm both automated and manual test methods.

 - Experience in mentoring and nurturing junior team members. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills to address and resolve technical issues.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

data.description:
This role has been designed as ''Onsite' with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

Job Description: 

At HPE Networking, the Digital Experience & Automation (DEA) team is reimagining how people experience support and services in a digital‐first world -- setting new standards for the future of networking. We enable customers, partners, and employees through AI‐driven tools and modern platforms, transforming support into a unified, efficient, and simple experience that drives measurable value. Our mission is grounded in innovation with purpose: applying automation, AI, and data‐driven insights to simplify journeys, reduce friction, and create meaningful outcomes at every touchpoint. 

DEA's charter is to discover, evaluate, and scale solutions that embed intelligent technology into every interaction-delivering proactive and predictive experiences that shorten resolution times and accelerate task completion. We partner closely with technology providers, engineering, and business teams to deliver seamless omnichannel experiences and enable business transformation through data engineering, process optimization, and automation. Our work is fuelled by a passion for self‐service, intelligent automation, and building digital experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and human‐centric. 

What You'll Do

- Automation of features for web applications and Web APIs 
 - Familiarity with testing and testing life cycle. 
 - Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback 
 - Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases 
 - Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities 
 - Design, develop and execute automation scripts using open-source tools 
 - Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs 
 - Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved 
 - Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet requirements 
 - Monitor debugging process results 
 - Investigate the causes of non-conforming software and train users to implement solutions 
 - Stay up-to-date with new testing tools and test strategies 
 - Knowledge on Docker and containers

Whar You Need to Bring

- Should have 9 to 12 years of experience in testing and Minimum 3+ years in Automation. 
 - Must have experience with automated testing tools like Selenium, SoapUI, Python and must have knowledge on Pycharm 
 - Proven work experience in software development and software quality assurance 
 - Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes 
 - Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases 
 - Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing 
 - Solid knowledge of SQL and scripting 
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process 
 - Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus

Education And Experience Required

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or closely related quantitative discipline. Master's desirable.

Job Title: Principal AI Engineer

We are seeking a Principal AI Engineer to design, build, and scale AI-driven systems across our product platforms. This role is ideal for a deeply technical engineer who leads through hands-on contribution, solves complex problems, and drives the adoption of AI into real-world products.

Leveling Guidance

- Senior AI Engineer: Owns complex components and services; strong execution and technical depth.

Why Join Us?

- Real AI Impact: Build AI systems that ship, scale, and deliver customer value. 
 - Hands-On Leadership: Lead through deep technical contribution. 
 - Modern Stack: Java, AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), SQL/NoSQL, and Generative AI. 
 - Collaboration: Work with strong product, data, and engineering partners. 
 - Core Values: Be part of a company that lives by Shattering Boundaries, Sparking Greatness, and Sharing Success. 

Our Culture

Our mission is to empower people, businesses and communities. A culture created less by what we do and more by who we are. When people ask what our team is about, we point to our core values: champion customer success, bring our best, achieve together, get stuff done, and innovate every day. We're always on the lookout for new, curious and capable people who can help us achieve our goal and we are seeking diversity in the people who join our team. We want to make sure that our company reflects the demographic of our customers, clients, and the communities in which we operate. So if you want to work for a friendly, global, inclusive and innovative company, we'd love to meet you!

Working in a permanent feature team, you'll be developing knowledge of aspects of the associated platform across the disciplines of business, applications, data and infrastructure. You'll also be liaising with principal engineers, architects in the domain and other key stakeholders to understand how the platform works and how it supports business objectives.

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with strong full stack experience in data engineering design and implementation, including being able to exploit programming languages to solve complex problems. You'll also need to be capable of complex requirements analysis capture and validation against and with business and systems requirements, coupled with leadership and people management skills

data.description:
Company Description

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista's award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners. 

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation. 

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do. 

Job Description

Who You'll Work With

You will work with the Platform team who work closest to the hardware and programming chips. 

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer your core responsibility is to deliver new cutting edge product features. A major part of this is writing and owning design/implementation of the code that drives our products. However, the role of a Software Engineer is much bigger than 'simply' writing code. Software engineers work on the whole development process, including: 

- Suggesting and deciding what features to build
 - Driving the design and architecture
 - Pushing, testing, documenting the feature
 - Working alongside customers in the field if needed

Are you right for this role?

This Is An Interesting And Exciting Opportunity To Be a Part Of The Software Development Team That Is Redefining Data Center Switching. For Success At Arista All You Need Is

- Strong industry experience of 5+ years
 - Extensive background in algorithms and strong software architecture skills
 - Fluency in C/C++ programming
 - Hands-on experience with designs and implementations in a strong product-engineering environment. 

Qualifications

- Strong software debugging skills especially in embedded systems. 
 - Experience with software development for the forwarding ASICs, FPGAs, Network Processors etc
 - Experience with hardware abstraction layer
 - Datapath forwarding for ACLs, QoS, Unicast, Multicast, EVPN MPLS, VXLAN, OAM etc
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment
 - Experience working through the complete software development life cycle right from requirements gathering to deliver the fully developed feature. 
 - Experience in Network Systems Software development is a plus

Additional Information

Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. 

We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. 

Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. 

Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

- 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or Analytics Engineering.

data.title: Mobility Technology OBT Functional Testing Specialist
data.description:
About The Role

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Functional Testing Specialist to join the Mobility Technology / Digital Enablement team. The role will focus on manual testing of internal travel applications, particularly Online Booking Tools (OBTs) and integrated travel-technology platforms. 

Primary Objective

Own end-to-end quality assurance for reservation platforms and help ensure reliable operation of corporate travel policy engines, air and hotel booking workflows, GDS/NDC integrations, payment gateways, and downstream systems. 

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. They will combine analytical thinking and attention to detail with effective cross-functional collaboration and a sound understanding of travel-domain processes. Prior travel-industry experience is preferred. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Planning and Design: Create, document, and maintain detailed manual test cases for internal travel applications, with particular emphasis on Online Booking Tools. 
 - Requirements Analysis: Understand travel business processes and translate business and technical requirements into clear, practical, and testable scenarios. 
 - Test Execution: Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, and end-to-end testing across releases and sprint cycles. 
 - Booking-Path Validation: Test complex, multi-tier booking journeys across air, hotel, rail, and car rental, including corporate travel policies, approval workflows, and profile synchronization. 
 - API and Integration Testing: Validate XML/JSON RESTful and SOAP integrations between the OBT and GDS platforms such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Travelport, as well as NDC aggregators and direct supplier connections. 
 - Payment and Downstream-System Validation: Verify corporate, virtual, and ghost-card processing and confirm accurate data transmission to mid-office, back-office, and expense-management systems, including SAP Concur and Chrome River. 
 - Defect Management: Identify, isolate, document, prioritize, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, appropriate severity levels, and supporting evidence. 
 - Retesting and Resolution: Collaborate with development teams to resolve defects and complete retesting to confirm that fixes work as expected. 
 - Delivery Planning: Estimate testing effort, identify risks, and support mitigation planning to enable timely, high-quality releases. 
 - Agile Delivery: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, requirement discussions, development cycles, and retrospectives, providing timely quality-assurance input. 
 - Stakeholder Communication: Keep Product, Technology, and business stakeholders informed about testing progress, risks, blockers, quality concerns, and release readiness. 
 - Data Validation: Query databases to verify backend transaction states, profile-data mapping, and Passenger Name Record (PNR) generation. 
 - AI-Enabled Testing: Use AI tools where appropriate to support test-case creation, test-data preparation, defect analysis, and defect summarization. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Analyse user feedback and improve testing processes, documentation, test coverage, and overall quality-assurance practices. 

Must have

- 6-8+ years of overall software testing experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in manual testing. 
 - 15 years of formal education. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Proactive, curious and continuous-improvement mindset. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Experience with AI, data analytics and digital technologies. 
 - Experience in UAT and working with cross-functional teams. 
 - Excellent attention to detail
 - Ability to simplify complex themes
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Basic understanding of the product development lifecycle. 
 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Trello, Notion, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred. 
 - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Eagerness to learn and take ownership of tasks. 
 - Basic understanding of UI/UX principles. 
 - Familiarity with SQL, analytics tools, or wireframing tools is an added advantage. 

Required Skills: The person in this role will need strong skills and experience in: 

- 6 to 8 years of core software testing experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to online tech platforms B2B and B2C
 - Experience in a cross-border global role, successfully managing multiple complex projects at a global level
 - Outstanding communication skills

Optional/Preferred skills: 

- 3 to 6 years of core software testing experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to travel-tech platforms, corporate travel booking engines, or OTA (Online Travel Agency) ecosystems. 
 - Experience or working knowledge of the travel domain, especially online booking applications and travel business processes. 
 - Understanding of the travel lifecycle, including PNR creation, ticketing, modifications, cancellations, refunds, void windows, and corporate travel policy configurations. 
 - proficiency with API testing tools (e. g. , Postman, SoapUI). Solid hands-on experience using test management software (e. g. , Jira/Zephyr, ALM, Azure DevOps). 
 - Intermediate proficiency in SQL for backend database verification (joins, indexing, basic data manipulation). 
 - Familiarity with web debugging tools (Chrome DevTools) to analyse network traffic, errors, and payloads. 
 - Conceptual understanding or basic exposure to automation testing frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, or RestAssured) to help transition manual workflows to automation. 

Certifications: ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification Preferred Not mandatory

Work Experience: 8-10 Years of end-to-end functional testing of any online B2C/B2B product preferably travel booking systems

data.title: Senior Testing Analyst
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Can Expect

The People Services & Solutions team is responsible for end-to-end ownership of processes and programs that support HR across the global enterprise. Within this organization, a unique opportunity exists for a Senior Testing Analyst to play a critical role in ensuring the quality, stability, and successful delivery of HR technology solutions. This role partners closely with HR Centers of Excellence, Process Solutions, and Technology teams to support testing efforts across key HR functions, including payroll, compensation, talent acquisition, onboarding, learning, and performance management. 

What You Will Do

- Accountability for end-to-end People Team testing execution, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and regression testing for new initiatives, enhancements, and releases
 - Support of a variety of testing efforts across a broad range of HR functional areas including payroll, compensation, talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, learning and development, and core HCM
 - Understanding of end-to-end business processes to ensure test cases meet business requirements and expected outcomes
 - Development of test design and scripts, including scenario coverage, defect management, and ensuring audit-ready documentation and clear sign-off processes
 - Help identify testing risks and recommend mitigation strategies
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track testing defects through resolution, including retesting and validation to confirm defects have been resolved successfully
 - Partnership with People Team Process Solutions, Technology teams, and HR Centers of Excellence to validate testing outcomes
 - Assist with the development and maintenance of testing standards, templates, and documentation. 
 - Participate in project meetings, release planning, and change management activities, as needed
 - Championing of continuous improvement opportunities, including testing automation, process standardization, and improved vendor coordination models

What You Will Bring

- Hands-on experience in system testing, quality assurance, or business analysis within an HR or People Team function in a large, complex organization
 - Experience with HR systems (i. e. Workday or similar) from an HR administrator or technology perspective
 - Knowledge of People Team Operational processes across different areas of HR including but not limited to: payroll, talent acquisition, compensation, performance and talent management, learning and training, etc. 
 - Strong business analysis skills, including experience defining, documenting, and completing test scenarios as well as identifying data issues
 - Proven verbal and written communication skills, with ability to engage across business, technical, and vendor teams
 - Strong attention to detail, and analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and dependencies simultaneously

What will set you apart?

- Experience supporting global HR processes and understanding country-specific requirements and dependencies. 
 - Experience supporting testing activities for Workday implementations, upgrades, or releases, including Workday HCM, Recruiting, Compensation, Payroll, Learning, or Talent modules
 - Familiarity working with system integrations, data validation, and end-to-end process testing across multiple technology platforms. 
 - Exposure to test automation tools and continuous improvement initiatives
 - Ability to develop and maintain testing standards, templates, and reusable testing assets
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways Infrastructure
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99. 99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global SaaS scale. 

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this multi-tenant SaaS platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters. 

What You'll Do

- Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance. 
 - Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions. 
 - Drive 4-9s (99. 99%+) availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale. 
 - Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's SaaS infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally. 
 - Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function. 
 - Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil. 
 - Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit: 

- Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating. 
 - Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The Kong DNA

- Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

 - Hone your existing data engineering skills and advance your career in this critical role
 - We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

Working in a permanent feature team, you'll be developing knowledge of aspects of the associated platform across the disciplines of business, applications, data and infrastructure. You'll also be liaising with principal engineers, architects in the domain and other key stakeholders to understand how the platform works and how it supports business objectives. 

You'll also be: 

- Applying Agile methods to the development of data engineering solutions on the backlog
 - Producing resilient and long-lived solutions and acting flexibly to cope with future needs
 - Delivering intentional architecture and formulating emergent design through innovative ideas, experimentation and prototyping
 - Designing and developing solutions with a focus on the automation of build, test and deployment activities, using executable patterns
 - Leading and line managing a team of 5 Data Engineers aligning to data engineering best practices

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with strong full stack experience in data engineering design and implementation, including being able to exploit programming languages to solve complex problems. You'll also need to be capable of complex requirements analysis capture and validation against and with business and systems requirements, coupled with leadership and people management skills

Additionally, you'll demonstrate: 

- Experience of leading the implementation of best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance
 - Strong proficiency in relational databases, advanced SQL, and robust data modelling, database optimisation, Python pipelines, Airflow orchestration, and dbt transformation
 - Experience designing, building, and operating cloud‐based data solutions (Azure preferred)

 - Sound collaboration skills with the ability to work with business and data teams to produce pragmatic solutions that work for the business

data.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer (SDET) to join NetApp's ONTAP Engineering team, focusing on SAN and block storage solutions. ONTAP is a feature-rich storage platform used in mission-critical environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments. As an Senior Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and developing scalable test frameworks, automation infrastructure, and validation pipelines that ensure high product quality for complex distributed storage systems. You will work across multiple subsystems, understand end-to-end customer workflows, and drive quality at scale. This is an advanced IC role requiring strong technical depth, ownership of features/modules, and the ability to operate with limited supervision while influencing test strategy, automation direction, and cross-team quality outcomes. 

Job Requirements

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and infrastructure using Python and related technologies
 - Own end-to-end validation for SAN/block storage features, including test design, execution, and defect lifecycle management
 - Collaborate with development teams to understand feature design, define validation strategies, and drive testability improvements early in the cycle. 
 - Develop functional, integration, stress, and scale tests for distributed storage systems
 - Drive automation-first testing approaches and improve code/test coverage across components
 - Analyze failures, debug complex issues across software layers, and drive root cause resolution. 
 - Participate in product design discussions and contribute to improving reliability, observability, and diagnosability
 - Lead or significantly contribute to test planning, quality reviews, and release readiness. 
 - Work across cross-functional teams (Dev, QA, Field Support) to understand customer use cases and ensure production readiness. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and influence engineering best practices within the team. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python (mandatory) with experience building automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with system-level testing and debugging of distributed systems
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, multithreading, and system internals
 - Experience in storage technologies, with strong preference for SAN protocols (FC, iSCSI, NVMe-oF)
 - Understanding of file systems, data paths, replication, or high-availability systems
 - Experience in test automation for scale, performance, and stress scenarios
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and modern development workflows. 
 - Strong debugging skills across software and system layers. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 8-12 years of relevant industry experience Proven track record of owning and delivering quality outcomes for complex subsystems
 - Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately to highly complex problems and drive solutions Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep expertise in SAN/block storage domain (ONTAP, SnapMirror, SVM, HA/MetroCluster, etc. )
 - Experience in large-scale system validation and customer scenario testing
 - Exposure to cloud-integrated storage or hybrid cloud architectures
 - Prior experience in SDET roles driving automation strategy at team level

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. 

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment-you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. 

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

At Capital One India, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent - along with our deep experience in machine learning - position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. 

Team Description: 

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. 

What You'll Do: 

- Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One
 - Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. 
 - Make high judgment build-vs-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more
 - Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance - scalability, cost, latency, throughput - of large scale production AI systems
 - Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One
 - Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state-of-the-art in AI
 - Translate enterprise AI goals into actionable team roadmaps with measurable outcomes and regular readouts
 - Operationalize Responsible AI: establish review gates, documentation/evaluation requirements, and rollout/rollback standards for all production AI systems
 - Create strong collaboration interfaces with Research, Data, and Platform teams to accelerate model lifecycle

The Ideal Candidate: 

- You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
 - Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
 - You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential and you actively drive professional development through mentoring and coaching. You are hands-on when necessary and lead by example
 - You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
 - You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss

Preferred Qualifications:

 - 6+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e. g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)

data.title: Sr Staff Engineer, Mobile
data.description:
About The Role And Team

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer in Rider, you will shape the technical architecture and long-term evolution of the systems that power the Rider experience globally. 

Deep mobile architecture expertise will be the anchor for this role, but not its boundary. You will operate across mobile clients, edge capabilities, and backend services, tackling problems spanning application architecture, performance, reliability, server-driven experiences, client-server contracts, and emerging on-device intelligence. 

Your impact will extend well beyond the code you write. You will shape how multiple engineering teams build and ship Rider experiences-establishing durable technical foundations, simplifying complex systems, making high-leverage architectural decisions, and enabling teams to move faster without compromising performance, reliability, or quality. 

What You'll Do

- Define the multi-year technical strategy and architecture for Rider experiences across mobile applications, client platforms, edge capabilities, and supporting backend services. 
 - Set the architectural direction for the Rider application and client platform, enabling multiple teams to independently build and evolve experiences without compromising performance, reliability, or consistency. 
 - Establish engineering standards and technical foundations across architecture, dependency management, build health, application size, startup and runtime performance, observability, testing, and release quality. 
 - Architect server-driven and cross-platform experience frameworks, making deliberate trade-offs between native, web-based, shared, and backend-driven implementations. 
 - Define durable client-server contracts covering API design, schema evolution, backward compatibility, rollout safety, experimentation, offline behavior, and failure recovery. 
 - Shape the architecture for emerging on-device and edge capabilities, determining what should run on the client versus backend systems while balancing latency, privacy, reliability, battery consumption, and cost. 
 - Build frameworks, SDKs, developer tools, and reusable abstractions that make it easier for product teams to deliver high-quality Rider experiences without repeatedly solving underlying platform problems. 
 - Work with Product and Engineering leadership to identify architectural constraints and technical bets that materially expand the set of Rider experiences we can build, and shape investment priorities accordingly. 
 - Lead major architectural migrations and reduce systemic technical debt, improving engineering velocity, reliability, performance, and product quality across the organization. 
 - Navigate ambiguous, cross-organizational technical problems where there is no obvious architectural answer; make clear trade-offs, establish alignment, and drive decisions to durable outcomes. 
 - Stay close to the technology and periodically dive deep into the hardest architectural and technical problems, while multiplying impact through Staff+ engineers and technical leaders across the organization. 

What You'll Need

- Extensive experience building and operating large-scale production applications on Android or iOS, with deep expertise in mobile architecture. 
 - Proven experience driving major mobile-architecture decisions across areas such as modularization, application performance, build systems, dependency management, application size, or release infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated ability to reason and operate across the client-server boundary, including designing APIs, data contracts, rollout mechanisms, and resilient end-to-end experiences. 
 - Track record of building platforms, frameworks, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams-not solely delivering individual product features. 
 - Experience establishing multi-year technical direction and anticipating architectural risks before they constrain product or organizational execution. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from strategy and design through global production adoption. 
 - Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries and align senior engineering, product, and business stakeholders around a technical direction. 
 - Expertise in establishing standards and practices for testing, performance, observability, reliability, and incident management. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Expert-level proficiency in Kotlin/Java or Swift/Objective-C, with the ability to work effectively across the broader technology stack. 
 - Experience with modern client architectures including server-driven experiences, cross-platform frameworks, hybrid applications, dynamic delivery, experimentation, and progressive rollouts. 
 - Experience designing robust client-server protocols and contracts using technologies such as GraphQL, gRPC, Protobuf, or equivalent API frameworks. 
 - Experience with large monorepositories, build systems such as Bazel, and mobile developer-productivity infrastructure. 
 - Experience optimizing applications for constrained devices and networks, particularly in emerging markets. 
 - Experience with on-device machine learning, model deployment and optimization, mobile ML runtimes, or hardware-accelerated inference. 
 - Experience building mobile experiences powered by LLMs or agents, including architectures that distribute intelligence across device and backend systems. 
 - Strategic architecture mindset: the ability to balance near-term delivery with durable investments that improve engineering velocity, reliability, and product quality across an organization. 
 - Experience representing an organization through internal technical forums, external publications, conference talks, or open-source contributions. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you. 

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. 

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. 

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to design, implement, execute, and maintain reliable automated tests for distributed applications and connected-service workflows.
