data.description:
Software Engineer, QE

Title: Software Engineer, QE

Level: L2

Location: Hyderabad, India

Department: Engineering

Company

Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems' portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem. 

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India. Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent, Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin. 

Company Core Values

Job Description

We're looking for a hands-on QE engineer who can think like a tester and build like a developer. You'll own the quality for FastCast features: break down requirements into sharp test scenarios, automate them, and keep them running in CI. AI is core to how we work: you'll use AI tools at every step to generate, write and maintain tests faster than automation alone allows. 

You'll sit with the developers building the product, catch issues early, and help the team ship fast without breaking things. 

Responsibilities

- Understand product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; turn them into clear test cases and scenarios covering happy paths, edge cases and negative flows
 - Write and maintain E2E automation for web (Playwright preferred) and for our React Native mobile apps on iOS and Android, covering sprint stories, smoke and regression suites
 - Run automated suites in CI/CD and triage failures fast: real bug, flaky test or environment issue
 - Try out and adopt AI-powered QE tooling (e. g. Playwright MCP, self-healing locators, visual AI) and share what works with the team
 - Do focused manual and exploratory testing where automation doesn't make sense yet
 - Log clear, reproducible bugs and work with developers to get them fixed
 - Test APIs and validate data with SQL where needed
 - Prepare test data for sprint stories and regression runs
 - Join Agile ceremonies and flag testability and quality risks early
 - Help sign off releases and support production verification
 - Report on test coverage and quality status for each sprintMust-haves

- 2-3 years in QA / QE on web applications
 - Strong at writing test cases and scenarios from requirements; you spot the edge cases others miss
 - Hands-on test automation experience with Playwright, or other automation tools
 - Good programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript (Node. js a plus)
 - Hands-on use of AI coding assistants for testing work, plus the judgment to review, verify and fix what they produce
 - Understanding of test automation patterns like Page Object Model
 - Experience running tests in a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar)
 - API testing experience (Postman or similar)
 - Working knowledge of SQL
 - Comfortable with Git and Agile / Scrum
 - Clear written and verbal communication; can explain a bug so a developer gets it the first timeNice-to-haves

- Experience with Playwright specifically
 - Exposure to BDD (Cucumber or similar)
 - Testing native mobile apps (iOS, Android)
 - Testing AI-powered features: LLM output quality, evals, prompt regressions
 - Basic performance or load testing
 - Experience with log tools (e. g. LogDNA) to debug failures
 - Worked in a team shipping to production weekly or fasterWhy join

- Own quality on a live product used by the entertainment industry
 - Work side by side with the engineers building it, not in a separate QA silo
 - Modern, automation-first stack with real room to grow into an SDET role

data.description:
Job Description

Job Title - Senior Front End Developer - Angular Developer, AWS

Asset Management Technology is seeking a highly motivated individual contributor for the Fidelity Digital Asset Management - technology team in India. This individual will partner very closely with various Fidelity Digital Asset Management Technology teams, in addition to the broader Asset management technology teams to contribute to the Digital Asset Management platform for Tokenization and Crypto Products. The associate would need to have thorough experience in Engineering and Agile practices. 

The Purpose of Your Role

The associate is expected to be a Front-End Engineer with technical knowledge of different areas but not limited to AWS Cloud, Application Development using Angular and Blockchain related technologies. A thorough knowledge of CI/CD processes would be an added advantage. 

The Value You Deliver

- The Fidelity Digital Asset Management Technology team is responsible for Digital Asset Management platform and Crypto Products. 
 - Enforce Engineering practices with all team members globally
 - Contribute to Deliveries and Releases of the Digital Asset Management platform and related components on AWS Cloud
 - Communicate effectively with other AMTech Application teams and adopt of IT Blueprint for application with upstream and downstream dependencies
 - Work alongside large multifunctional teams and promote engineering and Agile practices with experience preferably in the Asset Management domain

The Skills That Are Key To This Role

Behavioral

- Be Collaborative: Work in partnership with the AM Architecture and Engineering teams to design and build end-to-end solutions to enable Digital Asset Management platform on AWS Cloud
 - Be Strategic: Partner with other key team members (and other AM teams) to implement the strategic vision to help execute the multi-year product roadmap and to various organizational initiatives
 - Be Transformative: Encourages or able to cause positive and lasting change, challenges status quo. Fosters an ethical work environment with clear values, priorities and standards
 - Be an Organizational Leader: Puts firm's interest ahead of individual or group's interest, speak their mind respectfully, takes smart risks to advance business, coaches others to their full potential, empowers decision making and owns the outcome
 - Influence Others: In partnership with the delivery and engineering leads in Boston, Ireland, and India, help advance and support product, delivery and technical practices including continuous integration, continuous delivery, and automated testing within your team and across the organization
 - Lead the team: Help the team manage the priorities and provide technical expertise, direction and engineering excellence
 - Inspire Others: Demonstrate a deep passion for software development and asset management domain in general and create an ability to tap into the expertise of the engineering team. Passion to drive innovation at work which contributes to business value through scale and efficiency, business growth and/or investment performance

Technical

- Strong hands-on experience in working on key initiative and green-field Engineering projects
 - Strong understanding of Engineering Practices like Code Review, Branching Patterns, etc
 - Strong Communication skills
 - Mentoring and coaching fellow squad members
 - Required Technical skillset: 
 - AWS Cloud
 - Front End Application Development using Angular, Typescript, HTML5, CSS, Events and Async processing, WebSocket
 - Explore to UI interoperability tool Glue42, Interop. io
 - Authentication frameworks
 - CI/CD Pipelines
 - Testing Tools like Cypress, TestNG
 - Experienced in ALM tools like JIRA, Confluence, Jenkins, Git
The Skills that are Good to Have for this role

- Added hands-on experience with Blockchain, Java/J2EE and/or DB technologies will be an advantage

How Your Work Impacts the Organization

Asset Management Technology (AM Tech) is the business unit that is responsible for delivering innovative, scalable, industry-leading investment tools that enable Fidelity's Investment & Asset Management business to achieve competitive advantage globally. AM Tech is global organization of technologists based in the United States, London, India and Ireland. - BE/MCA

data.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Exp mandatory)
data.description:
Description

Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to play a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team. We are key players in this objective, as they can use Industry Cloud functionality to deliver customer requirements quickly with minimal customization. 

In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team. 

This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce's Lifesciences and Health industry solutions

Responsibilities

- You'll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility. 
 - You will be required to deliver technical work (as a technical architect) on Salesforce's Life Sciences Cloud projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants and Senior Technical Consultants. 
 - You'll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers' needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value. 
 - Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community's overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team. 
 - Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs. 
 - Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap. 
 - Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying. 
 - Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Lifesciences and Health clouds, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health. 
 - Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads. 
 - Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders. 
 - Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion. 

Minimum Requirements

- 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors. 
 - 5+ years of people management experience. 
 - Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills. 
 - Proven experience architecting enterprise-level Salesforce solutions in the life sciences or Veeva product or healthcare industry. 
 - Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements including HIPAA, GxP, PHI, HL7, and FHIR. 
 - Expertise in one or multiple domains of Healthcare Providers, Healthcare Payers, Life Science and Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Public health & Government Healthcare programs, Insurance. 
 - Experience in healthcare domain (Preferred)
 - Integration Architecture (Must have)
 - Platform Security (Must have)
 - Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
 - Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
 - Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
 - Architectural Design Patterns
 - Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
 - Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others) or Veeva CRm experience
 - Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect, System Architect)
 - OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
 - Health Cloud Certification (Good to have).

data.description:
Description

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good - you've come to the right place. 

Organization Overview

Information Technology blazes the trail of enterprise IT. Built on the foundation of our core values - Trust, Ohana, Innovation - we own more than the traditional IT components with a heavy focus on working closely with our business partners for amazing outcomes. Our goal is to deliver technology that is centered around our business and our collective success. We oversee technology strategy supporting HR and Finance systems in Hire to Retire, Source to Pay, Record to Report and Plan to Perform business areas with applications engineering, infrastructure, collaboration, enterprise operations, architecture, and program enablement. 

Role Description

Salesforce seeks a talented, self-directed, technical leader to manage software engineers on the Information Technology Application Engineering and Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end management of tools, systems, and applications that support the Salesforce Finance and HR (Employee Success) systems. You will collaborate with many teams across Information Technology, Finance and Employee Success (HR) to scale and enhance systems for the unparalleled growth of Salesforce. 

Responsibilities

- Hire and retain top engineering talent
 - Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, providing guidance and support to ensure the successful delivery of projects. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, timelines, and resource requirements. 
 - Drive the implementation and adoption of best practices in software engineering, including Agile methodologies and continuous integration/delivery. 
 - Champion the utilization of MuleSoft and Workday integration solutions for Workday Financials or Workday HCM, leveraging its capabilities to streamline business processes and enhance efficiency. 
 - Oversee end-to-end support, operations and enhancements for Workday Financials or Workday HCM and their integrations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products. 
 - Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status updates effectively. 
 - Occasional travel is involved

Experience/Skills Required

- 12+ years of experience in software engineering & operations, with a proven track record of leadership and project delivery in Finance and HR Systems such as Workday / Peoplesoft / Oracle EBS in end to end Hire to Retire cycle or Finance business processes. 
 - Strong understanding of engineering management principles, including team leadership, performance management, and talent development. 
 - Experience managing vendor partners and teams extended with contractors
 - A keen eye for Innovation, Engineering / Operational Excellence, and Test Automation
 - Worked on project delivery in Workday Human Capital Management and/or Financial Transformation
 - Experience in HR domain (Hire to Retire, Talent Foundations, Total Rewards, Global Time & Absence, Payroll) OR in Finance (Record to Report, Source to Pay, Plan to Perform)
 - Experience in multiple Integration technologies like MuleSoft and Workday integrations (Studio, Orchestrations, etc. )
 - Experience managing global team working out of multiple time zones
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent preferred
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience with agile/scrum methodology

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will join a team of highly adaptable engineers responsible for rapidly learning new business domains, understanding complex technology ecosystems, and delivering high-priority business outcomes. Engineers in this organization are expected to engage across multiple domains, become productive quickly, execute prioritized initiatives, and transition seamlessly to new opportunities as business priorities evolve. 

Success in this role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, business curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments with numerous upstream and downstream dependencies. Candidates must be comfortable working across modern cloud-native platforms, enterprise integrations, legacy systems, APIs, and emerging AI-enabled solutions. 

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, microservices, and integration services that enable critical business capabilities. 
 - Establish trusted partnerships with domain engineering teams and deliver solutions that align with existing engineering standards, delivery processes, and operational models. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and improve code quality. 
 - Apply cloud engineering best practices, including security, observability, and cost optimization. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery. 
 - Develop and deploy containerized applications using Kubernetes and OpenShift. 
 - Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code and automation practices. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability capabilities. 
 - Contribute to experimentation and adoption of Generative and Agentic AI capabilities and intelligent automation solutions. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in software development with Java 11+/J2EE in Spring boot, with a focus on cloud technologies. 
 - Experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and Agent Core. 
 - Experience building scalable cloud-native, distributed, and event-driven applications. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture and API design. 
 - Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, with the judgment to validate and own AI-generated output. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns. 
 - Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable. 
 - Rapidly learn new business domains, alliance partner ecosystems, and integrated travel experiences to support evolving business priorities. 
 - Analyze system dependencies, data flows, APIs, and integration patterns to identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities that accelerate delivery. 
 - Collaborate across application, architecture, and business teams to drive cross-functional solutions, ensure operational readiness, and maintain delivery momentum across initiatives. 
 - Lead technical design sessions and architecture discussions. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or Node. js. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in observability via tools like DynaTrace, Datadog, etc. 
 - Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred. 
 - AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification. 
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. 
 - Ability to quickly develop expertise in new business domains, customer journeys, interconnected enterprise systems, and partner ecosystems to drive rapid delivery of business priorities. 
 - Proven analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams. 
 - Experience operating within large-scale enterprise environments, including cloud transformation and legacy modernization initiatives. 
 - Delivers complex engineering solutions from design through implementation with minimal oversight. 
 - Leverage systems thinking to navigate dependencies, solve complex business and technology challenges, and deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. 

For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

Senior AI Quality Assurance Engineer (Immediate Joiners Only)

About the Role

You will own the evaluation process for our AI agent system. The system includes models, prompts, tools, memory, and orchestration logic. You will test all of these parts. You will build the tests that decide if an agent is ready to ship. You will find regressions before customers find them. You will measure agent quality with numbers, not opinions. 

What You Will Do

Own the evaluation process

- Build and maintain evaluation suites for the full agent stack. 
 - Test prompt behavior, tool selection, tool calls, multi-step plans, memory use, error recovery, and task results. 
 - Define quality metrics for each capability. Examples: task success rate, trajectory correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost. 
 - Build and maintain golden datasets, regression suites, and adversarial test sets. Put these datasets under version control. Build evaluation infrastructure

- Build automated evaluation pipelines. Connect them to CI/CD. 
 - Make sure each change to a model, prompt, tool, or the harness must pass evaluation before release. 
 - Use more than one grading method: rule-based checks, exact match, semantic match, human review, and LLM-as-judge. 
 - Calibrate LLM judges against human labels. Monitor the judges for drift. 
 - Add tracing and logs to agent runs. Record each step, each tool call, and each cost. Make failures easy to diagnose. Establish and standardize KPIs and metrics

- Define the KPI set for agent quality. Include accuracy, faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision, context recall, tool-call correctness, hallucination rate, latency, and cost. 
 - Write standard definitions for each metric. Write standard rubrics and report formats. 
 - Make sure teams can compare results across models, prompts, and releases. 
 - Extend evaluation to more than one modality: text, image, audio, and structured documents. Select the correct grading method for each modality. Analyze failures and drive fixes

- Do structured error analysis. Group failures by type. 
 - Find the source of each failure: the model, the harness, or a tool. 
 - Set sample sizes, pass thresholds, and confidence bounds. Agent runs are not deterministic. Plan for variance. 
 - Work with engineers to reproduce failures and to verify fixes. Protect the evaluation results

- Find and prevent test contamination, overfitting to benchmarks, and metric gaming. 
 - Keep a mix of offline evaluations, staged evaluations, and production monitoring. 
 - Make sure evaluation results predict production behavior. Set the quality bar

- Define release criteria for agent changes. Approve or block releases with data. 
 - Write clear documentation for the evaluation methods. 
 - Report results to engineering and to leadership. 

What We Require

- AI and agent evaluation (6 years) or more years of hands-on work in evaluation of LLM systems and agents. 
 - Hands-on skill with RAGAs, Promptfoo, and DeepEval. Skill with Braintrust, LangSmith, W&B Weave, or OpenAI Evals is a plus. 
 - Proof that you can create KPIs and metrics from zero: select the metrics, set the baselines, set the thresholds, and get agreement from stakeholders. 
 - Proof that you can standardize evaluation across teams: shared metric definitions, reusable templates, versioned datasets, and one report format. 
 - Experience with evaluation in more than one modality: text plus image, audio, video, or structured documents. 
 - Knowledge of the agent evaluation problem space: trajectory evaluation, outcome evaluation, tool-use correctness, multi-turn behavior, non-determinism, and prompt sensitivity. 
 - Experience with LLM-as-judge design: rubric design, calibration against human labels, and bias control. 
 - Knowledge of statistics for evaluation: sampling, significance tests, inter-rater agreement, and variance across runs. 
 - Strong Python skills. Experience with test harnesses, data pipelines, or evaluation tools that you built. 
 - Skill with tracing and observability for agent systems. Example: OpenTelemetry-style traces and structured logs of tool calls. 

Core software QA

- Knowledge of QA fundamentals: test plans, test-case design, functional tests, regression tests, integration tests, and defect management. 
 - Hands-on skill with test automation frameworks. Examples: pytest, Playwright, Selenium. 
 - Hands-on skill with API tests. Examples: Postman, REST-assured. 
 - Experience with test suites in CI/CD pipelines. Examples: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI. 
 - Skill with bug tracking and test management tools. Examples: Jira, TestRail, Xray. 
 - Ability to write clear defect reports that engineers can reproduce. 
 - Knowledge of non-functional tests: performance, load, and reliability. 

What Is a Plus

- Experience with red-teaming, safety evaluations, or adversarial tests of AI systems. 
 - Experience with human annotation work: labeling guidelines, calibration sessions, and inter-annotator agreement. 
 - Background in CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, or platform engineering. 
 - Contributions to open-source evaluation tools. Published work on evaluation methods. 

What Success Looks Like

- 90 days: You know the current agent harness. You found the gaps in the current evaluations. A baseline regression suite runs on each change. 
 - 6 months: Evaluation results are trusted release gates. Failure types are tracked and decrease. Engineers come to you before they ship. 
 - 12 months: Other teams use the evaluation platform on their own. Offline results predict production quality. Our quality bar is a competitive advantage. 

Why This Role Matters

Agents fail in ways that normal software does not. They fail silently. They fail at random. They fail on step ten of a long task. Users trust an AI product only when the evaluation is rigorous. You own that rigor.

data.title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead AI Ops Engineer

AI Ops

Overview

Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really "finished. " They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent's reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns. 

Role

- Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
 - Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
 - Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
 - Evaluate whether the agent's reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
 - Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
 - Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
 - Embed governance within the agent's learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

All About You

- Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
 - Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
 - Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
 - Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
 - Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent's post launch health
 - Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
 - Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Architect - GPU Performance
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI - the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities which are hard to seek, which only we can pursue, and which matter to the world. This is our life's work: to amplify human inventiveness and intelligence. 

NVIDIA is now driving innovation at the intersection of visual processing, high performance computing and artificial intelligence. We are looking for passionate, highly motivated, creative engineers to be part of our HW architecture team. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today. 

What You'll Be Doing

- System level performance analysis/ bottleneck analysis of complex, high performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Work on hardware models of different levels of abstraction, including performance models, RTL test benches , emulators and silicon to analyze performance and find performance bottlenecks in the system. 
 - Understand key performance use-cases of the product. Develop workloads and test suits targeting graphics, machine learning, automotive, video, compute vision applications running on these products. 
 - Work closely with the architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption. 
 - Develop required infrastructure including performance models, testbench components, performance analysis and visualization tools. 
 - Drive methodologies for improving turnaround time, finding representative data-sets and enabling performance analysis early in the product development cycle. 

What We Need To See

- BE/BTech, or MS/MTech in relevant area, PhD is a plus, or equivalent experience. 
 - 3+ years of experience with exposure to performance analysis and complex system on chip and/or GPU architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture, graphics pipeline, memory subsystem architecture and Network-on-Chip (NoC)/Interconnect architecture. 
 - Expert hands on competence in programming (C/C++) and scripting (Perl/Python). Exposure to Verilog/System Verilog, SystemC/TLM is a strong plus. 
 - Strong debugging and analysis (including data and statistical analysis) skills, including use for RTL dumps to debug failures. 
 - Hands on experience developing performance simulators, cycle accurate/approximate models for pre-silicon performance analysis is a strong plus. 

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Our team builds and operates core platform services that process large volumes of data across distributed environments. We focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and efficient resource utilization while continuously evolving our architecture to support new capabilities and growing workloads. 

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant architectural ownership and opportunities to influence technical direction across the platform. We value engineers who understand how complex systems behave under load, reason about failure scenarios, and make pragmatic engineering trade-offs. 

What you'll do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable distributed backend systems and high-throughput data processing pipelines.

 - Design and improve event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, and distributed coordination mechanisms. 
 - Solve complex engineering challenges involving consistency, retries, idempotency, deduplication, backpressure, and failure recovery. 
 - Make architectural decisions involving distributed storage, messaging systems, and data processing strategies. 
 - Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks, improving throughput, latency, resource utilization, and infrastructure cost efficiency. 
 - Drive architectural improvements and modernization of existing systems while maintaining production stability. 
 - Own critical services end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production operations. 
 - Lead technical design discussions, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and establish engineering best practices.

Who you are

 - Strong proficiency in Go, or comparable backend programming experience with the ability to become productive in Go.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Position: Sr. Software Engineer - AI Engineer

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision - transforming patients' lives through science. Each of our colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. 

Scope

The EMES Core Platform, Its Components, Interfaces, Data Layer And Tools - Material And Inventory, Order Management, Equipment And Instrument Integration, Sample Management, Patient Scheduling System Integration, Label Printing, Recipe Authoring And Execution, Electronic Batch Records, And Batch Reporting And Analytics - Together With

- AI and GenAI services embedded in manufacturing workflows: assistants, retrieval over controlled documents, anomaly detection and decision support. 
 - Web applications and operator-facing interfaces across shop-floor, quality and supply-chain personas. 
 - Enterprise data models, databases, audit-trail architecture and reporting data flows; cloud migration and adoption of next-generation manufacturing systems. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering

- Design, build and operate production-grade AI services - not prototypes - including retrieval-augmented generation over SOPs, batch records, deviations and equipment documentation, and agentic workflows that act against MES systems under human oversight. 
 - Own the retrieval architecture (chunking, embedding selection, vector storage such as pgvector or OpenSearch, hybrid search, re-ranking, citation fidelity) and LLM application patterns: structured output and tool calling, MCP servers over enterprise systems, orchestration, cost controls and guardrails. 
 - Establish AI evaluation and observability: golden datasets, offline and online evals, regression gates in CI, hallucination and drift detection, tracing and human-in-the-loop review. 
 - Apply classical ML where it is the better tool (anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive quality) and ensure responsible, compliant AI: data classification, IP and PII protection, model and prompt versioning, reproducibility and validation evidence for GxP-relevant use. 

Web Application Development

- Deliver full-stack applications: React with TypeScript front ends, component libraries and design systems, and responsive, accessible (WCAG) interfaces built for gloved, time-pressured shop-floor use as well as office users. 
 - Build backend services in Python (FastAPI) and/or Java (Spring Boot) exposing REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI-first contracts, secured with OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, JWT, SSO and fine-grained RBAC, and write the data access layer with the same rigour as the API (deliberate query design, sound ORM boundaries, pagination, no N+1 access, idempotent writes). 
 - Implement real-time and AI-assisted experiences - WebSockets/SSE for live batch and equipment status, token streaming with inline citations - alongside validation-rich workflows including e-signature interaction patterns. 
 - Own quality and performance end to end: automated tests across the stack (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Playwright), load testing, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) with GitOps delivery of application and database changes together against measured p95 targets. 

System and Data Architecture

- Lead the design of distributed, multi-tenant systems: bounded contexts and Domain-Driven Design, service decomposition, API and event contracts, and evolution strategy. Own the data model end to end - conceptual, logical and physical design, deliberate normalization, and referential integrity, constraints and domain invariants enforced in the database rather than only in application code. 
 - Demonstrate advanced relational expertise: complex SQL, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures (PL/pgSQL, PL/SQL), partitioning, deliberate indexing strategy, and performance diagnosis from execution plans, statistics, lock contention and pool exhaustion. 
 - Apply correct transaction design (isolation levels, concurrency control, idempotency, retry semantics) and migration discipline (Flyway/Liquibase/Alembic, expand-contract zero-downtime rollout, tested rollback), and run databases as production assets on AWS: RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, Multi-AZ, read replicas, pooling, PITR and DR. 
 - Design regulated-grade data integrity - immutable, append-only audit trails (including hash-chained designs), e-signature records, ALCOA+, retention and archival - satisfying GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and GAMP 5 (2nd edition, incl. AI/ML guidance) by design, not documentation alone. 
 - Design event-driven systems with Kafka (partitioning and ordering guarantees, transactional outbox, CQRS and event sourcing, sagas) and enable analytics without burdening the transactional system through change data capture (Debezium) and dimensional models for batch reporting. 
 - Reason rigorously about non-functional requirements - capacity, scalability, SLOs, failure modes, circuit breakers, backpressure, graceful degradation when a site link is down - and define caching, queuing and throttling strategy (Redis, SQS/SNS, idempotency keys). 
 - Architect for hybrid deployment (on-premise and near-line where shop-floor latency demands it, AWS for scale) using Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS) and IaC; instrument for observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); and apply security by design, mitigating the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. 

Collaboration and Leadership

- Partner with Manufacturing, MS&T, Quality, Automation and site IT to translate process needs into system and data design; produce and defend the artifacts of real architecture work (ADRs, design documents, data models, sequence and data-flow diagrams, threat models) and run design reviews; and communicate integration contracts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers, review code and designs, and raise the bar on clean code, TDD/BDD and craftsmanship - including governed AI-assisted development that improves throughput without weakening review rigour or compliance - while driving continuous improvement through Agile/Scrum across global teams. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, with 10-12 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years building and operating web applications and 2+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI capabilities into production (prototypes alone will not qualify). 
 - Expert-level SQL and relational data modeling with deep hands-on PostgreSQL (or Oracle/SQL Server): schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and migrations. 
 - Demonstrable system design capability at the level of a multi-service, multi-tenant platform - bounded contexts, API and event contracts, consistency and failure modes, capacity and scaling - with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS), cloud-native architecture on AWS, infrastructure as code and Kafka-based event streaming. 
 - Strong hands-on Python 3. x with FastAPI and TypeScript with React; Java/Spring Boot experience is a strong advantage. 
 - Practical experience with the LLM application stack: model APIs, embeddings and vector search, RAG, tool calling, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation. Agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph) and MCP server development are an advantage. 
 - Working knowledge of MES/EMES platforms, pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory compliance - ISA-88 and ISA-95, electronic batch records, recipe execution - or demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a regulated domain. 
 - Solid grounding in application and data security (OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, JWT, SSO, RBAC, TLS, secrets management), automated testing, CI/CD and observability tooling. 
 - Clear written communication (design documents, ADRs, API documentation) and strong collaboration across global teams. 

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

All About You

________________________________________

This is a rare opportunity to build from the ground up in a fast growing, high visibility space. Sports on streaming is still early innings, and the problems here are genuinely hard: real time data at scale, intelligent automation, and matching across thousands of global sports entities. You'll have the autonomy to define and drive innovative features. 

If you love building systems that delight customers in real time and want to be a part of shaping the future of live sports experiences, we'd love to talk. 

Key job responsibilities

A Manager III (SDM III) is a hybrid of system designer, people manager, roadmap/customer satisfaction driver, and project manager. - Ambiguity: Leads a team where the business problem or strategy may not yet be defined, with limited guidance

 - Engineering Excellence: Demonstrates technical breadth and depth; solves problems at root cause; builds flexible systems without over engineering
 - People Development: Hires the right mix of SDEs, manages performance, develops and promotes engineers
 - Communication: Writes narratives and strategic docs, fosters constructive dialogue, escalates risks proactively

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

We are seeking an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst (Software Quality Analyst, Test Analyst, Computer System Validation Analyst) to join our life sciences and clinical research team. - Support system validation and qualification activities for software applications

data.title: Copy of Lead, QA
data.description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines. 

Website: https: //ayr. energy

Role Purpose

Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33-400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate

customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality System & Documentation
 - Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points. 
 - Own NCR/CAPA-facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention. 
 - Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT. 
 - Supplier & Customer Interface
 - Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable. 
 - Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly. 
 - Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
 - Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards. 
 - Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes. 
 - Run kaizens to reduce defects (e. g. , oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages. 

Compliance & Standards

- ISO 9001: 2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) - adhere to procedures and participate in audits. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Education: BE/B. Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred). 
 - Experience: 8-15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class. 
 - Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001). 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems. 
 - Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results. 
 - Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes. 
 - QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel. 
 - Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
 - Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
 - Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
 - Calibration compliance and audit scores
 - On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

Why Join Ayr Energy

Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks. 

Work Conditions

- Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas. 
 - Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed. 
 - Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns application development lifecycle, suggesting improvements and following best practices. Develops features, enhancements, and fixes based on design specs, documenting design and code. Leads code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting for complex issues. Designs software aligned with architecture, collaborating on customer solutions. Provides technical guidance and support, driving code quality and security standards. Performs maintenance, testing, and upgrades for application systems. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities: 

- Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes. 
 - Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts. 
 - Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes. 
 - Define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules. 
 - Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements. 
 - Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans. 
 - Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area. 
 - Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback. 
 - Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement. 
 - Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. 
 - Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up-to-date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. 
 - Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. 
 - Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. 
 - Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. 
 - Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. 
 - Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. 
 - Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. 
 - Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: Software Engineer (PLC) -Control System Engineering
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions.  - Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions address both immediate causes and broader systemic risks. 
 - Use incident trends, recurring failure patterns, service metrics, and operational data to prioritize engineering investments and reduce technical and operational risk. 
 - Influence production-readiness criteria and operational acceptance for new solutions, releases, architectural changes, and major configuration updates.

 - Promote knowledge reuse and operational readiness by strengthening technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and support-team capability.

 - Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, log analysis, alerting, performance tuning, and service-health analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of configuration management practices and distributed messaging technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Strong hands-on capability with SQL for production diagnostics, data validation, and issue analysis. 
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, assess technical risk, establish priorities, and create clarity for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience participating in rotational on-call or shift-based support for mission-critical production services. 
 - Proven ability to lead customer or client technical discussions, incident reviews, risk conversations, and solution-alignment sessions. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering, program, operational, and leadership audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in transportation, finance, smart mobility, or another regulated and mission-critical industry.

data.title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
data.description:
Role Summary

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable. 

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix - Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions - ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks. 

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations. 

Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation

- Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments. 
 - Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology. 

Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build

- Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained. 
 - Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership. 

Integration and Data Engineering

- Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms. 
 - Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

Position Purpose

Lead the global USP Manufacturing Science & Technology Center of Excellence responsible for technology transfers, process lifecycle management, manufacturing support, validation support, and technical governance across Sandoz manufacturing sites and external partners. 

- Provide scientific leadership and scalable technical solutions that enable robust manufacturing, uninterrupted supply, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across the global biologics network. 

Your Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to: 

Technical Leadership

- Own technical oversight of upstream manufacturing processes across commercial products. 
 - Serve as SME for fed-batch, intensified fed-batch, and continuous perfusion upstream process control strategies. 
 - Lead resolution of complex technical manufacturing issues and investigations. 

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

- Continuously evaluate emerging upstream processing technologies, digital solutions, advanced analytics, automation platforms, single-use technologies, and manufacturing innovations for applicability across the biologics network.

Process Lifecycle Management

- Lead continued process verification (CPV) programs across commercial products. 
 - Support Annual Product Reviews (APR/PQR) and trend evaluations. 
 - Lead technical risk assessments associated with process changes, deviations, investigations, and technology transfers. 
 - Support change control assessments and implementation of post-approval manufacturing changes.

Technology Transfer

 - Assess technical risks associated with process transfers and scale-up activities. 

Validation Activities

- Support PPQ planning, execution, review and closure. 
 - Support process characterization and validation strategy development. 
 - Provide technical oversight for validation exceptions and deviations. 
 - Support ongoing process validation activities throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with Validation, Quality and Manufacturing organizations to maintain validated state.

Continuous Improvement

- Drive initiatives to improve yield, throughput, process capability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Promote application of advanced analytics, PAT, digital tools, and data-driven process monitoring. 
 - Identify and implement innovative manufacturing solutions. 

People Leadership

- Lead and develop Technical Managers and scientists within the upstream MS&T organization. 
 - Build technical capabilities and ensure succession planning. 
 - Foster a culture of scientific excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Key Performance Indicators

Quality & Compliance

- Critical/Major inspection observations
 - Recurring deviation rate
 - Overdue deviations and CAPAs
 - Upstream processes maintained in validated state

Operational Excellence

- Right First Time (RFT) manufacturing
 - Upstream process yield achievement
 - Upstream process CpK/PpK performance
 - Process robustness indicators

Delivery

- Technology transfers delivered OTIF

 - Technical investigations completed on time

Continuous Improvement

- Yield/productivity improvement realization
 - Successful implementation of process improvements

People

- Employee engagement
 - Talent development and succession readiness
 - Training compliance

Essential Requirements

- PhD in Biotechnology, Bioprocess Engineering, or related field (Preferred) / MSc in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline.

 - Strong expertise in upstream processing and commercial biologics manufacturing
 - Experience in technology transfer and process validation
 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections. 
 - Continuous manufacturing experience
 - Multi-product commercial manufacturing support
 - Advanced process analytics/PAT experience

Why Sandoz?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world's medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare. 

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably. 

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.

We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

 - Champion delivery excellence-every engagement must tie back to measurable value realization and customer adoption. 

Technical Leadership & Standards

Thought Leadership & Cross-Team Enablement

- Stay at the forefront of generative AI, creative automation, and enterprise integration-keeping your teams current and inspired. 
 - Foster internal knowledge sharing-publishing playbooks, reusable modules, and lessons learned that accelerate the entire organization. 
 - Represent your team in customer workshops, internal reviews, and external forums, showcasing the engineering craft and thought leadership of the FDE org. 

What You Bring

- Technical Credibility - 8+ years of software engineering, AI/ML, or technical consulting experience, with recent hands-on development in full-stack, cloud, and GenAI applications. You can dive into code, architecture, or delivery sprints when needed. 
 - People Leadership - More than 3 years in managing people or leading technical teams. Experienced in mentoring, coaching, and developing engineers and architects into highly capable technical and customer-facing talent. 
 - GenAI Mastery - Direct experience with modern AI technologies, including LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Llama, Mistral), diffusion models (Firefly, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E), RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen). 
 - Adobe Platform Fluency - Strong working knowledge of Adobe Firefly APIs, Creative Cloud SDKs, GenStudio for Performance Marketing, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - DevOps & Delivery Excellence - Expertise in cloud deployments (AWS, Azure), CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and enterprise-grade delivery with governance, security, and monitoring.

 - Startup DNA - Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; relentless about finding faster, better, more innovative ways to deliver impact for customers and scale patterns across the org.
