Description

Anaqua is seeking a Senior Java Developer to take ownership of core backend services on RightHub, our distributed, domain-driven Java platform on GCP. In this hands-on senior role, you will own services end-to-end, design domain events and service integrations, and set the technical bar for the engineers around you. This role suits someone with strong distributed-systems instincts and a track record of mentoring. 

You'll Love This Job If You Like To

- Own services end-to-end on a modern Java + Spring Boot platform - design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Design domain events and the integrations between services - event types, processors, idempotency, and eventual-consistency boundaries. 
 - Extend the shared platform libraries - auth, async tasks, common infrastructure - that every service in the company depends on. 
 - Write code that is genuinely tested - strong unit, integration, and contract testing as part of the development loop. 
 - Drive performance and reliability work, including query optimisation, debugging distributed flows, and capacity planning. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through code review, technical design docs, and mentoring mid-level engineers. 
 - Work across a modern stack: Java (latest LTS), Spring Boot 3. x, Spring Cloud GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), PostgreSQL with a domain-event model, and contract-first APIs with OpenAPI. 
 - Work closely with frontend engineers on the Next. js application when shipping features that cross the boundary. 

What You'll Need To Be Successful

- 5+ years of senior-level Java engineering with proven production ownership of services real users depend on. 
 - Strong Spring Boot in production - fluent on transactional boundaries, connection pools, JVM tuning, and how things break under load. 
 - Distributed-systems thinking - async messaging, idempotency, retries, ordering, eventual consistency, and clean bounded contexts. 
 - Comfort with domain-driven design and event-sourcing patterns, designing domain events that capture state transitions. 
 - Contract-first API design with OpenAPI, deep PostgreSQL (schema design, indexing, migrations under load). 
 - Production experience running services on Kubernetes, with hands-on experience on a major public cloud (GCP preferred). 
 - Strong testing discipline and extensive experience converting business requirements to technical requirements. 
 - Track record of mentoring, raising the engineering bar, and excellent written and spoken English. 
 - Spring Cloud GCP/Pub/Sub/Cloud Run, reusable internal libraries, React/Next. js knowledge, or IP/legal-tech/regulated B2B SaaS exposure all an advantage. 

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua's AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U. S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua's solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company's global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U. S. , Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua. com, or on LinkedIn.

We are seeking a highly hands on Automation Test Lead who can architect and scale enterprise grade test automation frameworks across data platforms, APIs, and cloud native systems. 

This role is not about managing testing. It is about owning quality engineering as a discipline. You will design frameworks that teams adopt, enforce standards that prevent bad releases, and build systems that proactively catch failures before they hit production. 

You should be equally comfortable writing Python frameworks, designing data validation strategies, and challenging engineers on weak implementations. Also embrace AI ways of working wherever possible to accelerate automation. 

Core Expectations

- You do not wait for bugs, you design systems that make bugs difficult to exist
 - You build frameworks that multiple teams adopt without friction
 - You challenge architecture, not just test outcomes
 - You reduce false positives, flaky tests, and wasted compute
 - You think in terms of data reliability, contracts, and system behaviour under stress

Key Responsibilities

• Test Automation Architecture & Strategy

Own the design and evolution of a scalable, modular, metadata driven test automation framework supporting: 

- Data pipelines (batch and streaming)
 - APIs and backend services
 - End to end data product validationEnable plug and play components, parallel execution, environment isolation, and deterministic runs. 

• Data Testing Framework Engineering

Build reusable frameworks supporting: 

- SQL based assertions and reconciliation
 - Schema validation and evolution checks

Experience

data.title: Quality Control Manager, Quality/ Food & Safety
data.description:
Company 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers. 

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness. 

We're a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we're just getting started!

Roles & Responsibilities Overview

The Quality Control (QC) Manager at RYZE, Inc is responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of raw materials and finished products manufactured by external partners. This role involves overseeing quality control activities at contract manufacturers, implementing quality programs, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The role will manage daily quality compliance, ensuring timely product release, reviewing non-conforming materials, and assisting in complaint investigations. This role works cross-functionally with various teams, including operations, R&D, and logistics, to maintain the highest standards for product quality, safety, and compliance. 

What You'll Do 🎯

Responsibilities will include: 

Product & Process Quality Control

- Review Certificates of Analysis (COAs) from suppliers and third-party labs for accuracy and compliance with specifications. 
 - Facilitate the testing and release/rejection of Raw Material and Finished Product samples based on established specifications. 
 - Provide onsite quality support during new product launches. 
 - Investigate product quality issues, including consumer complaints, deviations, and non-conformances as it pertains to contract manufacturers. 
 - Lead the material review board and manage disposal of non-conforming, expiring, damaged and returned products at warehouse and 3PLs. 
 - Train and lead a team of virtual QC individuals who support various QC functions. 

Documentation & Compliance

- Maintain accurate QC records in accordance with FDA 21 CFR Part 111/117 requirements for foods and dietary supplements. 
 - Manage and approve finished product specifications and testing protocols. 
 - Ensure proper retention and traceability of QC data for audits and regulatory inspections. 
 - Collaborate with QA to ensure corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) are implemented for identified issues. 

Testing & Laboratory Management

- Coordinate with third-party laboratories for microbiological, chemical, analytical, and stability testing. 
 - Evaluate and approve external labs, ensuring they meet ISO/IEC 17025 standards or equivalent. 
 - Validate new testing methods or procedures when required. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Operations, QA, Regulatory, and R&D teams to ensure smooth product launches and ongoing quality monitoring. 
 - Partner with Quality on supplier quality programs to ensure raw materials and finished product consistentlymeet quality and safety requirements. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identify opportunities to improve QC processes and product quality. 
 - Implement lean or efficiency-focused initiatives to optimize QC operations. 
 - Support training initiatives for cross-functional teams on QC-related topics. 
 - Stay up to date on industry trends and regulatory changes affecting production quality.

data.description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office. 

Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)

The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline's data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms. 

We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.

Why this job's a big deal

As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently. 

You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams. 

This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads. 

In This Role, You Will

- Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
 - Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.

 - Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls. 
 - Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.

 - Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage. 
 - Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities. 
 - Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
 - Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services. 
 - Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices. 
 - Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.

 - Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
 - Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains. 
 - Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads. 
 - Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues. 

Who You Are

- Degree & Experience: B. Tech or B. E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes. 
 - Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities. 
 - Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies. 
 - MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations. 
 - Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems. 
 - Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations. 
 - Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers. 
 - Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems. 
 - Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE. 

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. 

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking. com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

Huron is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to join its product engineering team.  - Architect and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI; REST Assured or similar for APIs; integrate into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. 
 - Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity in PostgreSQL (using DBeaver); build data-driven test suites for parallel and cross-browser execution. 

Defect management, collaboration, and mentorship

- Isolate, document, and track defects in Azure DevOps; lead exploratory testing sessions and root-cause analysis on escaped defects. 
 - Serve as quality engineering lead across Agile delivery teams; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, standups, and retrospectives. 
 - Conduct code reviews and coach developers and team members on shift-left testing practices and quality engineering standards. 

Required Qualifications

Core

- B. E. /B. Tech. in Computer Science, MIS, or related discipline; 4 to 7 years in software quality engineering with the majority in test automation and framework development on a commercial product.

 - CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins); strong Git skills; cross-browser testing with BrowserStack or equivalent; solid SQL skills for database validation. 
 - Deep understanding of QA lifecycle and Agile/Iterative delivery; clear communicator able to produce test strategies and quality summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.

AI and agentic development tools

- Practical daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and review test code; proven ability to craft effective prompts and system instructions. 
 - Solid understanding of AI agents, skills, and tool-calling; familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) - ability to connect AI models to internal tools, APIs, and test infrastructure for multi-step agentic workflows; working knowledge of an LLM API or orchestration framework (Anthropic API, LangChain, or similar) is a strong plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

Associate

 - Participate in test code/script reviews and provide feedback to enhance software quality.

 - Web Technology Basics: Deep understanding of HTML, CSS selectors, XPath, and the DOM structure for locating elements.

 - Proficient in use/adoption of AI tools to deliver testing deliverables with significant productivity gains
 - Advanced proficiency in test case design, test data management and execution. 
 - Thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integration with testing processes. 
 - Overall, the candidate should have good understanding of Insurance & Claims domain, Duck Creek Claims product and strong software testing & automation skills. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and working with cloud-based solutions is a plus. 

Why Chubb?

Employee BenefitsOur company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. data.description:
Role: QA Engineer

Experience: 2 years

Location: Hyderabad

About The Role

We are hiring 2 QA Engineers with about 2 years of experience to join the Openprise QA team. You will

test our data automation platform, which connects to tools like Salesforce, HubSpot and Marketo, and

you will help grow our test automation. 

What you will do

- Test new features, enhancements and bug fixes in each release, first in the test setup and then

in the stage setup. 

- Read the issue, the linked code change (pull request) and the notes from developers, then write

clear test cases. 

- Help build our new end-to-end UI test suite in Playwright from the start: pick the key user flows, 

write the tests, and keep them stable. 

- Write and maintain automated tests for our APIs and screens, mainly in Karate for APIs and

Playwright for the UI. 

- Run the automated test suites, look into failures, and tell real bugs apart from test problems
 - Log bugs in GitHub with clear steps, screenshots or recordings, and the setup you used
 - Move issues through their QA states on time and add a short comment on what you tested and

what you found. 

- Work closely with developers and product managers to understand what each change should

do. 

- Help keep test data clean: create your own test data and remove it when you are done

Must have

- 2 to 3 years of hands-on software testing, covering both manual and automated testing
 - At least 1 year writing automated tests for APIs (Karate, Rest Assured or Postman with scripts)
 - Hands-on UI automation with Playwright (preferred) or Selenium, using JavaScript or TypeScript
 - Good grasp of REST APIs and JSON: you can read a request and response and check the values
 - Basic SQL to check data in a database
 - Basic coding in JavaScript or TypeScript (for Playwright) and Java, enough to write and fix test

code. 

- Experience with Git and GitHub: branches, pull requests and code reviews
 - Clear written English for bug reports and test cases
 - A curious mind: you ask why a test failed and dig until you know

Nice to have

- Hands-on Karate experience (feature files, reusable calls, data-driven tests)
 - Playwright features like page objects, fixtures, trace viewer and running tests in parallel
 - Experience testing SaaS products that connect to CRM or marketing tools such as Salesforce, 

HubSpot or Marketo. 

- Testing data pipelines or large data loads: imports, exports, record counts and data quality

checks. 

- Running tests in CI, for example GitHub Actions or Jenkins
 - Performance testing basics, for example Gatling or JMeter
 - Using AI tools to write or review test cases faster

Tools you will use

Area: Tools

API automation: Karate

UI automation: Playwright (new end-to-end suite), Selenium (existing tests)

Performance: Gatling

Code and issues: GitHub (issues, pull requests, project boards)

Connected apps under test: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Google Drive and others

data.title: Senior Automation Tester
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Role: Senior QA Test Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, India

Department: Eurofins IT Solutions - eQMS

Experience: 5-8+ Years

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies. 

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As Senior Automation Engineer, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals. 

This role reports to a Manager. 

Required Experience and Skills

Experience: 

- Experience between 5 to 8 yrs. 
 - Expertise in Automation Testing of Web based applications
 - Good experience in building and using automation frameworks using technologies: Java/ C#. 
 - Experience in doing in-sprint automation. 
 - Strong Automation background with experience in identifying and reviewing test cases and testing results. 
 - Ability to understand complex requirements and transform those into Test Scenarios, Test cases and Test Scripts. 
 - Proficient in Version Control tool (ex: GIT )
 - Worked on automating the CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Good Knowledge of Manual Testing of Web and Windows-based applications. 
 - Have an excellent understanding of SDLC and STLC lifecycles. 
 - Hands-on work experience in preparing Test Strategy, Test plans and Requirement traceability matrix. 
 - Exposure to different Testing types - Sanity, Functional, Integration, Exploratory and System testing. 
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodology and working experience in an Agile environment. 
 - Proficient in creating Test Reports. 
 - Should know about analyzing the Risks. 
 - Prior experience in testing LIMS would be an added advantage. Specific skills required

- Expertise in Automation Testing using Selenium/Specflow/BDD/Protractor/WebDriver IO. 
 - Hands-on experience in programming languages (C#, Java, Python, JavaScript). 
 - Experienced in Creating VM for Automation and setting up the configuration in the test suite and runners. 
 - Hands-on experience in SQL to write medium complex queries (e. g. Joins/sub-queries etc. ). 
 - Good understanding of JSON, XML, REST and experience in testing web services using POSTMAN, REST Assured, JSON Lint, SOAP UI. 
 - Experience with any defect tracking tool like Jira, TFS/MTM, Bugzilla, etc. 
 - Experience on any test management tools like TFS/MTM, ALM, etcDesirable Experience

- Knowledge of Performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Security testing. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

Req ID: 382656

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN). 

The Storage Engineering team is seeking a Senior / Lead Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise storage platforms, data protection ecosystems, and automation frameworks to lead validation and testing efforts. This role will drive automation strategy, testing frameworks, and large-scale validation to ensure the reliability, performance, and resilience of storage systems, with a primary focus on accelerating patching across the environment. 

In this role, you will: 

- Lead automation frameworks (Python, Playwright/Selenium) for validating storage and data workflows supporting accelerated patching
 - Design and execute validation for: 
 - High-velocity patch distribution and deployment workflows
 - Storage performance during patching (IOPS, throughput, latency)
 - API and distributed system integration for patch orchestration
 - Define and execute validation strategies across: 
 - PowerMax / PowerFlex (high-performance block storage)
 - NetApp FAS (multi-protocol access for distributed repositories)
 - StorageGRID (S3 object storage for artifacts, staging, and distribution)
 - Cohesity (backup, recovery, and cyber resilience)
 - Validate data protection, replication, and disaster recovery for storage systems supporting accelerated patching
 - Build reusable automation frameworks and integrate into CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation
 - Use Terraform (IaC) to provision and validate storage environments optimized for rapid patching
 - Drive testing for: 
 - Data integrity and consistency of patch artifacts
 - High-volume data movement across environments and endpoints
 - Lead deep troubleshooting and root cause analysis across storage and patch deployment workflows

Platform Focus Areas

- Cohesity: Backup/restore, cyber recovery, and protection of repositories and configurations
 - PowerMax / PowerFlex: Low-latency, high-throughput storage to support rapid patch deployment
 - NetApp FAS: Shared access (NFS/SMB/iSCSI/FC) for staging, repositories, and lifecycle management
 - StorageGRID: S3 object storage for artifact storage, ingestion, and large-scale distribution

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
 - 5+ years in storage, automation, or infrastructure engineering
 - Strong Python and automation experience
 - Knowledge of block, file, object storage, and data protection

Minimum Qualifications

- 5+ years with enterprise storage platforms (Cohesity, PowerMax/PowerFlex, NetApp, StorageGRID)
 - Experience leading automation and validation for distributed infrastructure systems and patch deployment processes
 - Expertise in: 
 - High-volume data delivery and validation
 - Backup/restore, replication, and DR at scale
 - Data integrity and large artifact handling
 - Terraform (IaC) and CI/CD integration
 - Advanced troubleshooting across storage, compute, and distributed systems
Desired Qualifications

- Direct experience supporting accelerated patching initiatives or large-scale update delivery environments
 - Multi-cloud storage architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 - Kubernetes/CSI storage integrations
 - Performance benchmarking for high-throughput systems
 - Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk)

Job Expectations

- Act as SME for storage and data infrastructure with a focus on accelerating patching across storage systems
 - Lead cross-functional initiatives across Storage, DevOps, and Platform Engineering teams
 - Deliver scalable, production-grade automation for validation and patch delivery workflows
 - Drive improvements in system performance, scalability, resiliency, and patch deployment velocity

data.title: CTOi CIB Cloud lead
data.description:
Some careers have more impact than others. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world's most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our Chief Technology Office team in the role of CTOi CIB Cloud lead. 

The Opportunity

Head of Corporate and Institutional Banking Cloud is accountable for the strategy, governance, engineering standards, adoption and operational management of cloud services across all Corporate and Institutional Banking functions globally. 

The role holder will lead the development of a consistent, resilient and cost-effective cloud capability across Corporate and Institutional Banking, working in close partnership with the central Chief Technology Office Cloud team to support platform build, adoption and standardization. The role will provide senior leadership across FinOps, infrastructure management, risk and controls, regulatory requirements, cloud architecture, solution design and engineering practices. 

What You Will Do

- Define the target state for cloud adoption, platforms, operating models and engineering capability, aligned with wider Chief Technology Office, Corporate and Institutional Banking and Group technology strategies. 
 - Provide senior leadership across cloud engineering, architecture, infrastructure and governance communities, setting measurable objectives and developing skills, succession and delivery capability. 
 - Establish governance for budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, chargeback or show back, optimization and variance management. Drive transparent reporting, value assessments and cost-conscious engineering without compromising resilience, security or regulatory obligations. 
 - Ensure cloud platforms and workloads meet required standards for availability, capacity, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational support across their full lifecycle. 
 - Own the cloud risk and control agenda, ensuring effective assessments, evidence, testing, issue remediation, dependency mapping, recovery planning, scenario testing and tolerance compliance. 
 - Act as a credible senior technology representative in regulatory reviews, audits and assurance activities, explaining cloud arrangements clearly and ensuring findings, commitments and obligations are addressed within agreed timescales. 
 - Serve as the primary cloud face-off for Corporate and Institutional Banking business and technology leaders, Chief Operating Office team by translating business needs into secure, scalable and practical solutions while clearly communicating costs, risks, trade-offs, performance and priorities. 
 - Oversee solutions from initial demand through implementation and operational adoption, ensuring alignment with approved architectures, security requirements, data protection, identity, resilience, monitoring, recovery and regulatory expectations. 
 - Define and embed reusable cloud patterns, guardrails and practices covering infrastructure as code, automation, CI/CD, observability, security, resilience and self-service. Partner with the central Chief Technology Office Cloud team to shape platforms, roadmaps, service catalogues and adoption plans. 
 - Lead cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, application migration, data platform and engineering productivity initiatives, ensuring dependencies, risks, costs, operational impacts and benefits are managed through to sustainable adoption and measurable outcomes. 
 - Working alongside Chief Technology Office central team to set enterprise cloud architecture direction, govern solution design and establish technology standards. 

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- Leadership experience across cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering or technology transformation in a large, regulated organization. 
 - Extensive expertise in public and hybrid cloud, including networking, compute, storage, databases, identity, security, monitoring and automation. 
 - Proven ability to set enterprise cloud architecture direction, govern solution design and establish technology standards. 
 - Experience in Google Cloud Platform is required 
 - Strong engineering expertise across Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration and delivery, observability and platform engineering. 
 - Experience building or operating FinOps capabilities covering cost governance, optimization, forecasting and accountability. 
 - Strong understanding of technology risk, control frameworks, operational resilience, audit requirements and regulatory expectations, including representing 
 - technology in formal reviews and assurance engagements. 
 - Experience partnering with central cloud platform teams to build, adopt, govern and standardize enterprise cloud services. 
 - Proven success leading geographically distributed direct and virtual teams to deliver major cloud migration or modernization programmes.

And we're on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model. 

Our team builds high-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state-of-the-art subscription management platform. 

Overview of the Role

We are looking for a Technical Lead - Backend Engineering who thrives in fast-paced environments and believes in getting things done. You will drive initiatives that scale our core systems, balance existing business logic with new innovations, and ensure high reliability and performance across mission-critical components. 

This role requires taking ownership of complex problems, collaborating effectively with peers, and comfortably engaging in both technical and customer-facing discussions. If you're ready to solve challenges at scale and directly impact the revenue engines of our partners, this is the opportunity for you. 

What You'll Work On

Execute with precision: Own technical execution for backend and frontend modules and lead delivery across the team. 

Scale smartly: Enhance and evolve existing backend systems with scalable architecture patterns and thoughtful refactoring-not rewrites for the sake of it. 

Drive backend excellence: Architect high-performance services using Java and Spring Boot, built for scale and uptime. 

Enable observability: Work closely with DevOps to ensure production readiness with robust monitoring and alerting practices on AWS. 

Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with technical peers, product managers, and occasionally with customer-facing teams to ensure alignment of business and tech priorities. 

Mentor and lead: Grow backend engineering capabilities by providing clear guidance, thoughtful code reviews, and proactive problem-solving. 

What We're Looking For

Technical Expertise

7+ years of backend experience, with recent hands-on development in Java and Spring Boot. 

Proven experience building and scaling systems to handle high throughput, low latency, and event-driven architecture. 

Solid understanding of AWS infrastructure components: EC2, S3, RDS, SQS, VPC, and more. 

Familiarity with DevOps best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and performance tuning. 

Leadership & Execution

Ability to own end-to-end delivery of backend and frontend features with high accountability. 

Pragmatic decision-maker who focuses on value and execution over over-engineering. 

Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and managing technical debt effectively. 

Collaboration & Communication

Strong communication skills to influence technical decisions and align with business objectives. 

Comfortable in customer-facing discussions, when needed, to represent technical perspectives. 

Proven ability to collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams in remote/hybrid setups. 

Bonus Points

Prior experience in subscription billing, e-commerce, or high-scale fintech systems. 

Exposure to high-scale event-driven systems

Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog. 

Why Join Chargebee's Engineering Team?

Build features for a platform that processes billions of dollars in revenue annually. 

Work on real challenges of scale, resiliency, and complexity, with ownership from day one. 

Thrive in a hybrid work environment with flexibility and autonomy. 

Recharge with an uncapped leave policy, because sustainable pace matters. 

Benefits

Want to know what it means to work for a company that genuinely cares about you? Check out just a few of the benefits we give our employees: 

We are Globally Local

With a diverse team across four continents, and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood. 

We value Curiosity

We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it's that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, and then figure out answers to them. 

Customer! Customer! Customer!

Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers' growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It's a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun. 

Ready to build the future of recurring revenue at scale?

Join the Chargebee tribe.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Navi

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale. 

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold - building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience. 

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India's fastest-growing UPI platforms. 

What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey. 

Why Explore a Career at Navi?

Where Ownership Creates Real Impact

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day. 

Where Careers Accelerate

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you'll find the space to grow quickly here. 

Where Great Talent Builds Together

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey. 

About the Team

Navi's Engineering team builds the backbone of our financial products-spanning lending, upi & payments, insurance, investments, and debt management. We operate as cross-functional teams that work closely with Product, Data, and Business functions to deliver reliable, high-performance systems at scale. Our engineers focus on solving real-world challenges through scalable architecture, automation, and long-term thinking, along with providing quality feedback ensuring every Navi product is built to serve millions efficiently and seamlessly. 

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager at Navi, you'll lead a team of engineers to design, build, and maintain scalable systems to serve customer and business needs. You'll ensure high-quality delivery, drive operational excellence, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to actively co-own technical and business roadmaps and drive business outcomes. You'll also mentor and grow engineers and help shape the technical direction of the team. 

What You'll Own

- Lead and mentor a team of ~10 engineers, fostering a collaborative, growth-oriented, and high-performance environment, which includes developing role-specific growth plans and effectively calibrating and differentiating performance across all team members. 
 - Set clear goals and expectations for individuals and the team, continuously track performance and coach for improvement. 
 - Collaborate with business, product, and HR stakeholders to align engineering initiatives with company goals, including the ability to push back with logic on priorities and handle conflicts constructively. 
 - Provide strong technical direction and hands-on support to ensure delivery of scalable and robust solutions. Champion production excellence with a strong focus on observability, monitoring, and debuggability of systems. 
 - Drive execution of technical deliverables with a focus on quality, timely delivery, and long-term impact, while ensuring execution predictability. 
 - Support hiring efforts through workforce planning, interviewing, and evaluation with a strong focus on building a diverse and skilled team. 
 - Set the vision for your team and reinforce a business impact-oriented culture, driving a focus on long-term initiatives. 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Strong technical expertise in designing and delivering scalable, reliable, and observable backend systems, including the ability to deeply understand systems to challenge design choices and identify failure points, dependencies, and scalability issues. 
 - Experience driving end-to-end project delivery including planning, estimation, risk mitigation, and execution tracking. 
 - Solid understanding of SDLC best practices (code reviews, testing, CI/CD, on-call processes) and driving operational excellence through metrics . 

Soft Skills & Traits

- Demonstrated ownership and accountability for team outcomes and delivery. 
 - A strong mindset for Product Thinking and Business Ownership, thinking beyond execution to understand customer and business problems, and linking technical decisions to measurable business outcomes. 
 - Strong people management skills and stakeholder communication. 
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize competing demands based on business impact, and make trade-offs pragmatically between business value and technical needs. 
 - A continuous improvement and highly solution-oriented mindset, prioritizing achieving business outcomes and constantly looking to elevate team efficiency and engineering quality. 

The Navi OS

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values. 

- Start with the Customer
 - Master the Details
 - Act with Urgency
 - Own the Outcome
 - Build for a Decade - Not a Day
 - Win as OneWe hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation. 

To read more about the Navi OS, visit navi. com/our-values

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable. 

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being. 

Whether it's the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable. 

If you'd like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi. com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you, Navi could be the place for you.

Key Competencies

- Strong technical leadership without formal people management responsibility

- Ability to work independently and drive complex problems to resolution

- Excellent communication skills in global, cross-functional environments

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

data.title: Lead Engineer - Systems Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

GA GECC Lead Protection and Control (CCS) Engineer will execute Conventional Control System (CCS) engineering activities considering the quality/Cost/time for the project assigned. This role involves the execution of project design activities in line with the Engineering Process. Monitoring and controlling of project design budget, implementing design change process, supervising, and coordinating all engineering activities required to execute the project, whether done in house or by suppliers/subcontractors, and ensuring the compliance to project technical specification in line with defined scope. The successful candidate will be responsible for the performance of CCS engineering activities of the project. The successful candidate will coordinate with cross functional teams, customers, and suppliers to ensure timely and efficient design delivery

Job Description

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead Technical Projects: Drive technical project activities, lead customer kick-off meetings, and ensure successful project execution from design to commissioning. 
 - Customer and Project Management: Participate in project risk reviews, manage project budgets in term of man-days allocated to the engineering tasks, and provide regular progress updates. 
 - Design and Documentation: Analyse customer specifications, write project technical documentation, and validate technical solutions with customers. 
 - Technical Oversight: Specify software and IEDs, manage technical execution planning, and ensure adherence to GE Vernova safety standards. 
 - Issue Resolution: Address technical deviations, manage fault reports, and support site engineers remotely or on-site. 
 - Testing and Commissioning: Lead Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, and coordinate with commissioning teams for major site milestones. 
 - Training and Support: Provide project-specific training to customers, support tendering and commercial teams, and ensure customer satisfaction through professional project execution. 

Essential Qualifications

- Educational Background: B. E or Btech in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. 
 - Experience: Over 8 years of protection and electrical design engineering-related experience. 
 - Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of protection functions, electrical scheme, and cubicle design. 
 - Design Expertise: Proficient in designing and configuring protection relays and network studies. 
 - GE Substation Automation Solutions: Preferred candidates will have proven knowledge in this area. 
 - Travel: Ability to travel globally. 

Desired Characteristics

- Automation and protection Systems: In-depth knowledge of automation electrical scheme, detailed design of electrical protection relays (LV, MV & HV), and network studies. 
 - Interpersonal and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong interpersonal, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 
 - Independent and Flexible: Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment with a flexible approach to working hours. 
 - Communication and Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to cooperate across departments. 

Why Join Us?

At GE Vernova - Grid Automation, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of energy. We offer a collaborative environment where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a tangible impact. Join us and be part of a team that is driving innovation and excellence in control systems. 

Apply today and help us lead the way in renewable energy solutions!

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Purpose of the Role

Responsible for Process Equipment & Offline Equipment Maintenance

A Maintenance Electrical Engineer oversees the maintenance, repair, and optimization of electrical systems and equipment to ensure their efficient and reliable operation. This role entails close collaboration with cross-functional teams to integrate electrical systems into the overall manufacturing processes while ensuring adherence to safety regulations and industry standards. 

Key Responsibility Areas

Technical /Functional

- Install and commission electrical systems: Supervise the installation and commissioning of electrical systems to ensure their dependable operation. 
 - Troubleshoot and repair electrical faults: Diagnose and resolve electrical faults, implementing corrective actions to ensure MTTR , MTBF and quality targets are met. 
 - Ensure compliance with codes and standards: Ensure that electrical systems adhere to electrical codes, safety regulations, and industry standards. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work with engineering and production teams to integrate electrical systems into overall manufacturing processes. 
 - Optimize system performance: Continuously enhance electrical control systems to boost machine and equipment performance. 
 - Maintain documentation: Maintain and update documentation and schematics for electrical systems in case of modifications
 - Supervise and train team members: Offer guidance and training to technicians and prepare SPLs to help reduce MTTR. Ensure safety protocols are adhered to during all the activities. 

Knowledge Generic

Mandatory Desired: 8 to 12 years in Lithium-ion cell manufacturing industry, Warehouse , Bottling plant industries

Prerequires

- In-depth knowledge & Experience in PLC ( SIEMENS, Rockwell), HMI, SERVO, VFD, Robot (Fanuc, ABB or Kuka), VISON System (Keyence and Cognex) Programming & Troubleshooting. 
 - Deep knowledge of Industrial communication Protocols like Profinet, Ethernet, Profibus, Ether cat
 - In-depth knowledge in vision applications (Pattern identification, OCR Detection, Filter implementation on Raw image)
 - In-depth Knowledge in Conveyors, Stacker cranes , AGV, Vision system, precision Dozing, Robotics (Articulated), Fluid Pumping, injectors. 

TPM

- Clear Understanding of TPM Concepts. 

IT Skills

- Hands on experience in MES/SAP systems. 
 - Computer Proficiency (MS Excel, Power point). 
 - Good presentation skills. 

Job Context Specific

- Stay updated with industry advancements: Keep up to date with emerging technologies and trends in electrical engineering and manufacturing. 
 - PM & PDM: Ensure PM, PDM schedules are consistently met while ensuring the effectiveness of PMs. Yearly PM task review & optimization (PM Scrubbing) for ensuring effective use of manpower. 
 - Cost: Budget preparation for maintenance and ensuring it is being met. 
 - Spares: Spare ordering and maintaining inventory levels within agreed limits. 
 - BBQ: Ensuring Backup, Bypass, Quick changeover (BBQ) are maintained in ready for use condition for Constraint machines. 

Constraint identification: Identify the constraints at agreed time intervals and take actions to ensure issues are fixed with root cause identification, by identifying and implementing continuous improvements ideas

Knowledge Specific

Mandatory Desired: 8 to 12 years in Lithium-ion cell manufacturing industry, Warehouse , Bottling plant industries

Suitable / Optional: Similar process industry with 8 to 12 years of experience in in Conveyors, Stacker cranes , AGV, Vision system, precision Dozing, Robotics (Articulated), Fluid Pumping, injectors.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About The Job

We are looking for an experienced and driven Engineering Manager to lead our high-performance software development teams. In this role, you are expected to solve client's business problem by delivering software solution or services. 

As an Engineering Manager, you will not only oversee the technical roadmap but also mentor leads, senior developers, manage client stakeholders, and drive operational excellence. If you have a background in hands-on development and a passion for building scalable teams in a service-oriented environment, we want to hear from you

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Delivery & Project Management 
 - End-to-End Delivery: Own the delivery of software projects from conception to deployment, ensuring adherence to timelines, scope, and quality standards (SLA/KPIs). 
 - Agile Leadership: Champion Agile/Scrum methodologies; facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to ensure team velocity and efficiency. 
 - Architecture & Quality: Collaborate with Architects to make high-level design choices and technical standards. Oversee code reviews, CI/CD pipeline implementation, and technical debt management. 
 - Risk Management: Proactively identify technical risks and project bottlenecks, creating mitigation plans to avoid client escalations 
 - Client & Stakeholder Management 
 - Client Partnership: Act as the primary technical point of contact for global clients (US). Translate business requirements into technical specifications. 
 - Reporting: Provide crisp status reports, metrics (velocity, defect density, etc. ), and financial health updates (billing/utilization) to senior management and clients. 
 - Growth: Identify opportunities for account mining and technical value additions to expand the scope of work 
 - People & Team Management 
 - Talent Development: Manage a team of 10-20 engineers (Developers, QAs, Leads). Conduct performance appraisals, 1: 1s, and career pathing. 
 - Hiring & Retention: Assist in recruitment efforts for the team and implement strategies to retain top talent. 
 - Mentorship: Foster a culture of continuous learning, guiding the team on new technologies and best practices

Requirements

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Experience: 
 - 10 to 15 years years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in a dedicated technical project lead / management role for an IT services company. 
 - Proven track record of managing and delivering projects for US/North American clients. 
 - Experience managing projects that involve AI/ML, Data Engineering, Cloud-native applications, Workflow automation, or Digital Transformation. 
 - Technical Skills: 
 - Any programming and database skills is must. Preferably hands-on 
 - Familiarity with modern software development life cycles (SDLC) and DevOps practices. 
 - In-depth knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies. 
 - PMP, PRINCE2, or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification is must. 
Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)

- Experience in a scaling, AI-first or product engineering focused company. 
 - Advanced certifications (e. g. , SAFe Agilist, AWS/Azure/GCP Project Management or Technical certification). 
 - Experience with advanced tools for project management, collaboration, and reporting (e. g. , Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project). 

Benefits

Why Join Us?

- Be at the forefront of AI-driven digital engineering and work with cutting-edge technologies. 
 - Collaborate directly with ambitious, high-growth US tech companies. 
 - Receive competitive compensation and benefits, with significant opportunities for professional growth and development. 
 - Be part of a dynamic, high-performance, and technically-focused culture

data.title: Sr. Application Architect
data.description:
Description

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. 

We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team. 

You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built. 

In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager. 

Key job responsibilities

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about: 

- Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
 - Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
 - Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
 - Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
 - Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
 - Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
 - Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
 - Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
 - Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
 - 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
 - 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
 - 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
 - Travel up to 30% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
 - Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
 - Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node. js, C#, or C
 - Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
 - Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
 - Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field. Professional certification in CBTC or similar systems is a plus. 
 - At least 5-7 years of experience in CBTC systems, train control, or related railway signaling systems.

 - Knowledge of railway operations, signaling, and communications standards. 
 - Strong leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Experience with project management methodologies (e. g. , Agile, Waterfall) and tools (e. g. , Microsoft Project, Jira). 
 - Problem-solving and critical thinking abilities. 
 - Ability to of working effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines. 
 - Strong team-player with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

This role is based in Pune, where you'll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come. 

We're Siemens. A collection of over 312, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. Company Description Power Plant is a power generation facility focused on delivering reliable, efficient, and safe energy to industrial and domestic consumers. The organization emphasizes high operational standards and adherence to industry regulations, with a strong commitment to preventive maintenance and continuous improvement. Teams work with advanced turbine technologies and digital control systems to optimize performance and minimize downtime. The work environment supports collaboration among engineering, operations, and maintenance personnel, offering opportunities to work on complex technical challenges and large-scale infrastructure projects. 
Role Description The Turbine DCS Engineer is responsible for the operation, monitoring, and optimization of turbine Distributed Control Systems (DCS) at the power plant. This full-time, on-site role in Hyderabad involves configuring control logic, tuning process parameters, and ensuring reliable integration of turbine and auxiliary systems. Day-to-day tasks include diagnosing and resolving control system issues, coordinating with operations and maintenance teams during startups, shutdowns, and planned outages, and implementing modifications to improve performance, safety, and compliance. The engineer will prepare technical documentation, support root-cause analyses, participate in safety and reliability reviews, and collaborate with vendors or contractors as needed for system upgrades and maintenance.

data.title: CAT Modeling (for one of Lloyd’s largest syndicates)
data.description:
Company Description

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence - WNS' core differentiator - with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption. 

Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66, 000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact. 

Job Description

The Role

An exciting opportunity for a Catastrophe Risk Analyst to join a leading Exposure Management team at one of Lloyd's largest syndicates. The successful candidate will be delivering cutting edge analytics to stakeholders across the business for the D&F Property class, which has seen significant growth over the last 12 months. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate looking to have a material impact at a top Lloyds' syndicate and global (re)insurer. 

As an analyst, you will have a real ability to meaningfully influence the risk selection process. The successful candidate will look to work collaboratively with various internal stakeholders to ensure timely modelling analytics to support risk pricing and wider Catastrophe Management goals. 

Skill mix: Account Modeling + Data Cleansing

CAT Modelers/ Sr. CAT Modelers: 

Responsibilities: 

- Confident and timely delivery of analytics and the ability to explain how these analytics can help drive risk selection. 
 - Use RMS and various other tools to deliver market leading analysis both on individual account and portfolio basis. 
 - Work closely with the Natural Catastrophe Management team, across different regions, to ensure close communication across the team, consistent application of view of risk and contribute to cross-region analytics. 
 - Create a narrative based on the modelling data and other sources to effectively provide a valuable summary of a certain risk and give advice to Underwriters on the strengths and weaknesses of both the data and the model's ability to provide meaningful results. This includes communicating the concept of uncertainty. 
 - Communicate risk metrics to key stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate with the Analytics and Reporting team to ensure timely delivery of data required for internal and external reporting. 

Skills and Experience: 

- Experience in a Cat Modelling role - RMS experience is highly desirable and D&F Property class experience is advantageous. 
 - Highly numerate and logical - strong mathematical/statistical knowledge is advantageous. 
 - Excellent business communication skills - ability to influence, negotiate, and listen. 
 - Ability to manipulate large data sets with strong Excel and SQL skills. 
 - Experience using Microsoft Power BI for analytics is desirable. 
 - Intermediate/Advanced Experience with MS SQL is a strong advantage. Ability to build/design and manipulate queries to improve process. 
 - Familiarity with another programming language such as VBA, . NET, R, Python is an advantage. 

Asst. Manager - CAT Modeling

Responsibilities: 

- Lead and manage catastrophe modeling projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of client and business requirements. 
 - Review, validate, and approve exposure data, data scrubbing activities, quality checks, and model-ready datasets. 
 - Manage and mentor a team of catastrophe modeling analysts, providing technical guidance, training, and performance coaching. 
 - Oversee workload planning, resource allocation, and project prioritization to meet business objectives and service-level expectations. 
 - Drive data quality initiatives by identifying process gaps, implementing controls, and ensuring adherence to quality standards. 
 - Perform complex account, portfolio, and reinsurance analysis using catastrophe modeling platforms and internal tools. 
 - Collaborate with onshore stakeholders, underwriters, brokers, actuaries, and client teams to resolve data and modeling-related queries. 
 - Monitor project risks, track deliverables, and proactively communicate status, issues, and mitigation plans to management. 
 - Develop and enhance standard operating procedures, best practices, and process improvement initiatives. 
 - Review catastrophe model outputs, perform reasonability checks, and provide analytical insights to support business decisions. 
 - Ensure compliance with organizational policies, audit requirements, and data governance standards. 
 - Support transition activities, process documentation, knowledge management, and capability-building initiatives within the team. 

Skills and Experience: 

- 10+ years of experience in Catastrophe Modeling, exposure management, and insurance analytics. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with catastrophe modeling platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk, or equivalent industry-standard tools. 
 - Proven expertise in exposure data review, data cleansing, financial validation, geo-coding, and portfolio quality assurance. 
 - Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing performance, and developing junior analysts. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders, and competing priorities. 
 - Excellent understanding of insurance and reinsurance concepts, policy structures, CAT modeling methodologies, and financial terms. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query, and data analysis techniques. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with global stakeholders and senior leadership. 
 - Experience driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational excellence programs. 
 - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality. 
 - Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and client-facing skills. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics/ Applied Mathematics/ Statistics/ Operations Research/ Actuarial Science

data.description:
