data.title: Staff AI Engineer
data.description:
Staff AI Engineer

Hyderabad/Pune/Bangalore (hybrid)

Experience Level- 6+ years

(Candidates Preferred with Product Background with Tier 1 Educational Background)

Our Company: 

What You'll Do: Shape the Way the World Understands Data

Teradata is building the next generation of AI-native analytics, enabling customers to deploy production-grade Generative AI systems directly where enterprise data lives. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to play a key role in designing and building the LLM, agent and ModelOps capabilities of Teradata's cloud and SaaS platform, taking them from prototype to secure, observable, multi-tenant production services. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of LLMs, agentic systems and cloud-native engineering, and wants to work on core platform capabilities, not just application demos. 

You will: 

- Own the architecture and technical direction of Teradata's agentic AI platform, delivered as a secure, multi-tenant, cloud-native SaaS service. 
 - Design and build agent runtimes and harnesses: tool calling, planning, memory, context management, multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Design, build and secure MCP servers and clients, and other agent and tool protocols, that expose Teradata capabilities to agents through governed, well-documented APIs. 
 - Integrate and serve LLMs, both hosted APIs and self-hosted open-weight models: model gateway, routing, caching, fallbacks, token budgets, latency and cost control. 
 - Build ModelOps / LLMOps pipelines: model, prompt and agent registries and versioning, CI/CD with evaluation gates, canary releases and rollback, and quality and drift monitoring. 
 - Build evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM and agent systems: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, regression suites, and quality, safety, latency and cost metrics. 
 - Implement AI guardrails and responsible-AI controls: prompt-injection defense, PII handling, permissions, policy enforcement and audit trails for regulated industries. 
 - Run AI services as SaaS on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud: tenant isolation, authentication and authorization, quotas, usage metering, SLOs, and production and on-call readiness. 
 - Drive scalability, performance, reliability and cost efficiency of AI workloads, using Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - Where use cases call for it, apply RAG, vector search and semantic retrieval patterns, including Teradata's vector store. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and influence cross-team architectural decisions; identify risks early and drive solutions. 
 - Collaborate with product, research and platform teams to turn customer use cases into scalable features, and benchmark against cloud and open-source alternatives. 

Who You'll Work With: Join Forces with the Best

You'll collaborate with a world-class team of AI architects, ML engineers and domain experts across India and Silicon Valley, working together to build the next generation of enterprise AI systems. 

You'll also work cross-functionally with: 

- Product managers and UX designers to craft agentic workflows that are intuitive and impactful. 
 - Domain specialists to ensure solutions fit real business problems in regulated industries. 
 - Cloud, SaaS and infrastructure teams responsible for deploying, evaluating and scaling AI workloads. This is a rare opportunity to shape foundational AI capabilities within a global, data-driven company. This is a deeply collaborative environment where technical innovation meets real-world application, where your ideas are not only heard but implemented to shape the next generation of data interaction. 

Minimum Requirements

- BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems, and 2+ years building LLM-based applications or platforms in production. 
 - Strong cloud engineering on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud: Kubernetes and containers, infrastructure-as-code (for example Terraform), and CI/CD. 
 - Experience building and operating SaaS services: multi-tenancy, API design, authentication and authorization (OAuth/OIDC), observability, SLOs and reliability engineering. 
 - Hands-on LLM experience: prompt and context engineering, function and tool calling, structured outputs, and working with both commercial and open-weight models. 
 - Experience designing agentic systems: planning, memory, orchestration and custom agent harnesses, plus familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent. 
 - Experience with ModelOps / LLMOps: deploying, versioning, evaluating and monitoring models, prompts and agents in production. 
 - Working knowledge of methods for evaluating LLM and agent quality, safety, latency and cost. 
 - Proficiency in Python (and/or Java or Go), with experience shipping production-grade systems. 
 - Experience with large-scale data and performance-sensitive distributed systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with LLM inference and serving optimization (for example vLLM or Triton, quantization, GPU scheduling). 
 - Experience with fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight models (for example LoRA, preference optimization, distillation). 
 - Experience implementing AI guardrails, red-teaming and security controls for agents, such as prompt-injection defense. 
 - Familiarity with agent-to-agent protocols and tracing standards such as A2A and OpenTelemetry for GenAI. 
 - Experience with analytics platforms, data warehouses and SQL-based workloads. 
 - m impact.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

For a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, this environment provides hands-on ownership of business-critical production systems, complex database and infrastructure troubleshooting, patching and deployment automation, and continuous improvement of service reliability. 

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer will support the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational lifecycle of Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS) infrastructure and services. The role requires deep expertise in Oracle RAC, Exadata, OCI, database/infrastructure upgrades and patching, incident response, automation, capacity management, and production troubleshooting, including the ability to troubleshoot across the Exadata and OS layers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, operate, and continuously improve highly reliable and scalable infrastructure supporting Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS). 
 - Administer and optimize high-availability Oracle database environments using Oracle RAC and ASM, with responsibility for service health, performance, capacity, and operational reliability. 
 - Execute end-to-end Exadata lifecycle management, including infrastructure upgrades, storage expansion, quarterly patching/QFSDP activities, and related maintenance across Exadata generations. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across Exadata hardware, database, network, and OS layers, including incident response, root cause analysis, and post-mortem activities. 
 - Use Exadata capabilities and database performance techniques, including SQL tuning, Smart Scans, Storage Indexes, and Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), to improve performance and resource efficiency. 
 - Develop and maintain automation using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible for infrastructure provisioning, database operations, monitoring, remediation, and recurring maintenance. 
 - Partner with software development and cross-functional teams to assess infrastructure changes, capacity requirements, deployments, reliability risks, and operational impact. 
 - Participate in on-call operations, health/performance reporting, technical analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned to service reliability and SLOs. 

Responsibilities

Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory

- Strong hands-on experience with Oracle RAC and ASM in production environments. 
 - Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Oracle databases on Exadata physical infrastructure. 
 - Proven experience with Exadata infrastructure upgrades and patching, including end-to-end lifecycle activities across multiple Exadata generations. 
 - Practical experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI); exact OCI services to be confirmed. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot issues across the Exadata and operating-system layers. 
 - Experience with production incident response, technical troubleshooting, RCA, post-mortems, and on-call support. 
 - Experience with capacity, health, and performance management for database/infrastructure services. 
 - Experience developing operational automation using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible. 
 - Experience with Oracle database performance tuning, including SQL tuning and Exadata-engineered features such as Smart Scans, Storage Indexes, and HCC. 
 - Experience supporting highly available database/infrastructure environments and working with software/development teams. 

Good-to-Have

- Direct experience supporting Autonomous Database Serverless (ADBS). 
 - Experience across the stated Oracle database versions: 9i, 10g, 11gR1/R2, 12c, 18c, and 19c. 
 - Experience with Exadata Cloud Service (ExaCS). 
 - Experience using CellCLI, DCLI, and Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) Cloud Control. 
 - Experience troubleshooting and monitoring Exadata storage cells, compute nodes, and InfiniBand/RDMA networking. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices and tooling beyond the scripting/automation requirements. 

Experience prototyping or onboarding new infrastructure, applications, or operational tooling.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. About Team

The Health & Wellness Engineering team at Walmart is on a mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and convenient for millions of customers across the US. Our systems process millions of prescriptions annually and connect patients, pharmacists, prescribers, and payers in real time. The team operates at the intersection of technology and healthcare, building platforms that have a direct, measurable impact on patient outcomes and community health. 

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and patient-facing applications that power Walmart's pharmacy and health platforms

data.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI

At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape AnalyticsTM platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world's largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale. 

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation. 
 - Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust. 
 - Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use. 
 - Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama. cpp, and ONNX Runtime; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense. 
 - Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments. 
 - Own the full delivery path: CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing. 
 - Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve. 
 - Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation. 
 - Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation. 

Who You'll Work With

You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure. 
 - Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning). 
 - Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference. 
 - Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above. 
 - Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling. 
 - Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes. 
 - Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform). 
 - Full-stack engineering experience: comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration. 
 - Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads. 
 - You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed. 
 - You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them. 

What You Bring

- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale. 
 - Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating. 
 - Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus. 

Bonus Points

- Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines. 
 - Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama. cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment. 
 - Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents). 
 - Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust. 
 - Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Advanced Specialist - Incoming Quality
data.description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive (Incoming Quality). 

We are seeking an experienced Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive (Incoming Quality) to join our Quality team. The role is responsible for ensuring supplier part quality, managing incoming inspections, supporting production quality requirements, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in quality inspection, supplier quality management, measurement systems, and problem-solving methodologies within a manufacturing environment. 

Key Responsibilities

Incoming Quality Management

- Execute incoming material inspections as per defined sampling plans and quality standards. 
 - Ensure supplier parts meet quality requirements before release to production. 
 - Develop and maintain part inspection standards and related documentation. 
 - Monitor incoming quality performance and drive improvement actions. 

Supplier Quality Management

- Investigate supplier-related quality issues and implement containment actions. 
 - Conduct joint inspections and quality reviews with suppliers. 
 - Review supplier corrective action plans and 8D reports. 
 - Raise supplier quality defects in the system and ensure timely closure. 

Production Line Support

- Address line quality concerns related to supplier parts. 
 - Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support production teams to minimize quality-related disruptions. 

Team & Shift Operations

- Manage and guide a team of 5-6 inspectors, including supplier representatives. 
 - Ensure smooth execution of incoming quality activities across shifts. 
 - Drive inspection strengthening and quality improvement initiatives. 

Quality Systems & Reporting

- Maintain inspection records, rejection reports, dashboards, and PPM data. 
 - Support customer, system, and internal audits. 
 - Manage rejection, segregation, material disposition, and supplier returns. 
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure uninterrupted material flow. 

Calibration & Testing

- Manage calibration of measuring instruments as per schedule. 
 - Ensure raw material testing activities are completed as planned. 
 - Maintain compliance with quality standards and procedures. 

Required Technical Skills

- Hands-on experience with measuring instruments such as: 
 - Vernier Caliper
 - Micrometer
 - Height Gauge
 - CMM
 - VMM
 - Vision Measurement Systems
 - Strong knowledge of engineering drawings and GD&T. 
 - Understanding of: 
 - MSA (Measurement System Analysis)
 - SPC (Statistical Process Control)
 - 7 QC Tools
 - Root Cause Analysis and Problem-Solving Techniques
 - Good presentation, reporting, and documentation skills. 
Behavioral Competencies

- Integrity
 - Customer Focus
 - Accountability
 - Execution Excellence
 - Collaboration
 - Trust Building
 - Effective Communication
 - Stakeholder Management

Personal Attributes

- Ethical and professional approach
 - Open-minded and adaptable
 - Strong observational and analytical skills
 - Tactful in handling stakeholders and suppliers
 - Versatile and proactive
 - Innovative problem solver

Qualifications

- BE / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Automotive, or related Engineering discipline. 

Experience

- 6-9 years of experience in Incoming Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Automotive Quality functions. 

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals. 

In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team's success. We are committed to develop people's skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill. 

More lives saved - more life lived!

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
We're Hiring: Senior Manager - Quality (BESS Manufacturing)

Company: Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited

Location: Ambawadi, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Experience: 15-20 Years

Department: R&D - Factory

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited

Kintech GreenUrja Private Limited operates in the renewable energy and energy storage sector, 

focusing on Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and customized energy storage solutions

for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. We are committed to

delivering reliable, safe, high-quality, and sustainable energy solutions. 

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and results-oriented Senior Manager - Quality to lead

Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) activities for BESS manufacturing at our

facility in Ambawadi, Ahmedabad. 

The ideal candidate will have 15-20 years of experience in quality management, preferably in

BESS, lithium-ion battery systems, battery pack manufacturing, electrical equipment, power

electronics, or electromechanical manufacturing. 

The candidate will be responsible for implementing robust quality management systems, 

ensuring product reliability and safety, managing inspections and testing, resolving quality

issues, and driving continuous improvement across the manufacturing lifecycle of Battery

Energy Storage Systems. 

Key Responsibilities

• BESS Product Quality: Lead quality assurance and quality control for BESS

manufacturing, including battery modules and packs, enclosures, electrical panels, 

wiring, and system integration, as applicable. 

• Quality Management System: Develop, implement, and maintain quality management

systems aligned with ISO 9001 and applicable customer, industry, and regulatory

requirements. 

• Incoming Material Inspection: Ensure quality verification of battery cells, battery

modules, BMS components, PCS/inverters, electrical components, cables, connectors, 

cooling systems, and other critical materials. 

• In-Process Quality Control: Establish inspection checkpoints throughout assembly, 

wiring, electrical integration, and manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with

drawings, specifications, and work instructions. 

• Final Inspection & Testing: Oversee final product inspections and coordinate

functional, electrical, and performance testing in accordance with approved specifications

and applicable standards. 

• Battery Safety & Reliability: Ensure appropriate quality controls for battery handling, 

assembly, electrical insulation, protection systems, thermal management, and other

safety-critical features. 

• BMS & Electrical Integration Quality: Coordinate quality verification of Battery

Management Systems (BMS), protection mechanisms, communication interfaces, and

integration with power conversion and auxiliary systems, as applicable. 

• Supplier Quality Management: Evaluate supplier quality performance, conduct

supplier audits, resolve material non-conformities, and implement corrective actions with

Procurement and Supply Chain teams. 

• Root Cause Analysis & CAPA: Investigate product failures, manufacturing defects, and

recurring quality issues using root cause analysis, 8D, and corrective and preventive

action methodologies. 

• Customer Complaints & Field Issues: Lead investigation and resolution of customer

complaints, product failures, warranty claims, and field quality issues in coordination

with Engineering and Service teams. 

• Quality Documentation & Traceability: Maintain inspection reports, test records, nonconformance reports, product traceability records, control plans, and quality

documentation for manufactured BESS units. 

• Audit Management: Plan and coordinate internal, external, supplier, and customer

audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings. 

• New Product Introduction (NPI): Work closely with R&D and Design Engineering

teams to establish quality plans, validate manufacturing processes, and address designrelated quality risks before production release. 

• Continuous Improvement: Implement quality improvement initiatives using FMEA, 8D

problem-solving, SPC, Six Sigma, and other applicable quality tools. 

• Rejection & Rework Reduction: Monitor defects, rejection rates, first-pass yield, and

rework costs while implementing measures to improve product quality and

manufacturing efficiency. 

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians, 

ensuring effective execution of inspection, testing, and quality improvement activities. 

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with Production, R&D, Design

Engineering, Procurement, Stores, and Maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and

improve product reliability. 

• Management Reporting: Report quality KPIs, product reliability trends, audit findings, 

customer complaints, and corrective action status to senior management. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Industrial, or

Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

• A postgraduate qualification or relevant quality-management certification will be an

added advantage. 

• 15-20 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control, preferably in

battery manufacturing, BESS, electrical equipment, power electronics, or

electromechanical manufacturing. 

• Proven experience managing factory-level quality operations and leading a team of

quality professionals. 

• Strong understanding of incoming material inspection, in-process quality control, final

inspection, and product testing. 

• Hands-on experience with quality management systems, supplier quality, audits, root

cause analysis, CAPA, and non-conformance management. 

• Knowledge of electrical testing, product reliability, manufacturing process validation, and

product traceability. 

• Experience handling customer complaints, supplier quality issues, and manufacturing

defects. 

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, decision-making, and leadership

skills. 

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be preferred: 

• Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) manufacturing and system integration. 

• Lithium-ion battery pack, module, or battery system manufacturing. 

• Battery Management Systems (BMS) and battery protection systems. 

• Power Conversion Systems (PCS), inverters, UPS, and power electronics. 

• Electrical panels, switchgear, transformers, and power equipment. 

• Renewable energy equipment and solar power systems. 

• Electromechanical assembly and industrial equipment manufacturing. 

Key Skills

Quality Assurance | Quality Control | BESS Manufacturing | Battery Quality | ISO 9001 |

Electrical Testing | Supplier Quality | Root Cause Analysis | CAPA | 8D Problem Solving | FMEA

| SPC | Product Reliability | Quality Audits | Manufacturing Process Validation | Team Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Reduction in product defects, rejection rates, rework, and warranty claims. 

• Improvement in first-pass yield and manufacturing quality. 

• Compliance with product specifications, approved testing procedures, and applicable

standards. 

• Timely closure of corrective and preventive actions. 

• Improvement in supplier quality and incoming material acceptance. 

• Successful completion of internal, external, and customer audits. 

• Improved product reliability and traceability. 

• Timely resolution of customer complaints and field quality issues. 

How to Apply

Interested candidates with 15-20 years of relevant experience in BESS, battery manufacturing, 

electrical equipment, or power electronics quality management are invited to apply through

LinkedIn with their updated resume

data.title: Engineering Excellence Manager
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Description

Job Description

Engineering Excellence Manager

Industrial Automation and Control

As Engineering Excellence Manager, you will raise the quality, consistency and repeatability of the industrial automation and control solutions we engineer for our customers. You will lead the engineering standards, design practices, trusted content and quality gates that our project teams work to, and you will hold the organisation accountable for applying them across process, discrete and hybrid engagements. Your remit covers engineering governance, design assurance, continuous improvement and technical competency development, so that every project starts from content rather than a blank page. 

You will have the Engineering Standards and Trusted Content, Design Assurance and Quality, Engineering Continuous Improvement, and Technical Competency and Training functions reporting to you. You will build a engineering chain, assuring the development of technical resources, and preparing the structure to support new delivery strategies as our automation and digital transformation portfolio grows. You will be responsible for resource development, with Engineering Domain Expertise Management. 

You will report to the Director of Engineering Delivery and have a hybrid schedule working in Pune, India. 

Your Responsibilities

Under your leadership, the following functions will have the following responsibilities -

Technical Competency and Training

- Lead a team of Technical Leads and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across automation domains, providing direction, coaching, performance development, and succession planning to provide a strong and sustainable technical organisation. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability for domain expertise, ensuring that SMEs maintain deep technical knowledge aligned with current and latest technologies. 
 - Provide leadership and oversight to the Technical Lead and SME community, ensuring technical decision-making, knowledge sharing, and understanding of engineering practices across projects, industries, and regions. 
 - Be a final escalation point for complex technical challenges and cross-domain engineering decisions that require expert judgement and resolution. 

Engineering Standards and Trusted Content

This department will be responsible for governing the usage of Trusted Content and standard templates in project execution, and will be the focal point for resolving all critical engineering problems. It will define, publish and version-control the engineering standards, design templates and reusable control libraries built on Logix controllers, FactoryTalk software and Rockwell Automation reference architectures, so that engineers across the region design from the same proven baseline. 

Design Assurance and Quality

This department will maintain engineering quality control by using our Global Quality Management System in the design and delivery of our projects and services. It will operate design reviews and quality gates across the full lifecycle, from functional design specification through factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing and handover, and will confirm that deliverables meet the applicable functional safety, cybersecurity and industry standards including IEC 61511, IEC 62443, ISA-88 and ISA-95. 

Engineering Continuous Improvement

This department will help use Lean, Six Sigma, Agile and other quality methodologies within the engineering community. It will ensure that productivity projects are identified and executed through the year for measurable results, reducing engineering effort per deliverable without conceding quality. It will also introduce tooling that raises productivity, including configuration-driven code generation, automated testing, emulation and disciplined version control, and will own the lessons-learned process so that an issue surfaced on one project becomes standard practice on the next. 

Technical Competency and Training

This function is responsible for managing the competency needs of the engineering organisation and for the programmes that feed it. It will maintain a competency framework covering process, discrete, hybrid, safety and information solutions disciplines with clear proficiency levels, run technical training, certification and mentoring from graduate trainee through to technical lead, and work with engineering managers to close skill gaps against the forward order book. 

Technical Authority and Customer Engagement

You will act as the senior technical authority for PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, motion and safety applications, reviewing complex or high-risk designs covering network topology, controller sizing, redundancy strategy, functional safety and industrial cybersecurity before they reach the customer. You will guide the adoption of Rockwell Automation platforms in delivery engagements, including Studio 5000, FactoryTalk View, FactoryTalk Optix, PlantPAx and Emulate3D, support proposal engineering with technical solution reviews and estimating norms, and represent engineering quality in customer design reviews, audits and escalations. 

All the above roles will work with the relevant global teams to make this happen. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

- You will have a bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Control Systems or Mechatronics Engineering. 
 - You will have 15 or more years in industrial automation engineering, including experience leading engineering teams, technical governance or an engineering excellence function. 
 - You will be Six Sigma certified. 
 - You will understand process and discrete automation and the relevant control systems, with hands-on design and commissioning background across PLC, HMI, SCADA and drive systems. 
 - You will have overseen engineering standards, design reviews or quality systems in a project delivery environment. 
 - You will display, communication, partner management. 
 - You will have experience building technical teams while promoting a culture of collaboration, innovation, and learning. 
 - Expertise in managing diverse technical expert teams across multiple industries, technologies, and geographical regions. 

What You Will Be Measured On

- Provide a quarterly engineering excellence update to leadership. 
 - Fulfilment of important talent development plans across the engineering population. 
 - Manage turnover of necessary technical talent no higher than the turnover of the location. 
 - Lead engineering quality management and reduce rework hours and defects found at site acceptance testing. 
 - Conduct the monthly engineering governance meetings, including the design review board, the trusted content and standards review, and engineering quality reporting. 
 - Grow the reuse of control modules and templates across industry segments and report adoption. 
 - Support employee engagement, retention, and career development outcomes within the Technical Lead and SME organisation. 
 - Maintain a pipeline of technical talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and career progression of Technical Leads and SMEs. 
 - Improve technical competency maturity across the organisation through measurable growth in certifications, domain expertise, and technical capability development. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
 - Company volunteer and donation matching programme - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalised wellbeing programs through our OnTrack programme
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Senior QA Test Engineer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

External Job Ad

Sr. Devops Engineer

About The Team

The DevOps team supports Applied Systems' product development teams and user base across the US, UK, Canada and India. We own the build, source control, release and deployment tooling that engineers rely on every day, and we build and maintain the development and test environments used to deliver our insurance software products. We work closely with development, QA, cloud and infrastructure teams in an Agile way of working, and we are increasingly using AI to automate and improve how we build, deploy and operate our platforms. 

About The Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you deliver great work while expanding your knowledge and deepening your technical skills. The team can rely on you to complete assigned work by drawing on past experience and getting input when needed. Your work is high quality, and you collaborate with the team to deliver what is needed. 

What Success Looks Like

- DevOps platform capabilities (build, source control, deployment, monitoring and test environments) are set up and maintained to meet defined specifications. 
 - Work is completed within expected timelines with limited guidance, and status is communicated to support the team. 
 - Troubleshooting support is delivered and questions are answered using documentation and monitoring tools, with others engaged on high-complexity issues when needed. 
 - Internal teams understand existing DevOps services and how to get support for complex requests or new services. 
 - Reliable delivery contributes to automation, quality and operational consistency. 

What you'll do Development, debugging, quality and security

- Complete a variety of development, testing and debugging tasks. 
 - Build, maintain and support CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure for product teams, including helping teams migrate pipelines to modern platforms. 
 - Create and manage deployment projects, steps, variables and lifecycles, and maintain deployment manifests for promotion from development to staging and production. 
 - Install, configure, upgrade and troubleshoot development and test environments, including application servers and SQL Server databases. 
 - Configure monitoring and logging for product teams. 
 - Manage existing infrastructure to maintain security and ensure quality by considering functional and non-functional requirements. 

Automation, system administration and continuous improvement

- Identify ways to work more efficiently and share ideas for continuous improvement. 
 - Automate repetitive tasks by writing code or using tools. 
 - Use AI tools and assistants to accelerate automation, such as generating and reviewing scripts and pipeline code, analyzing logs and alerts, and reducing manual operational work. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply AI across build, deployment, monitoring and support workflows, and share what works with the team. 
 - Manage source control repositories, branching and access in line with company best practices. 
 - Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), with support from the team, to prevent recurrences. 

Documentation and knowledge

- Contribute to documentation on standard processes and existing DevOps platform capabilities. 
 - Share ideas for improving documentation for the team and other stakeholders. 

Prioritization and communication

- Deliver high-quality work within established timelines by prioritizing and getting support on complex issues or blockers. 
 - Communicate trade-offs and decisions to keep work aligned with standards. 
 - Act as a point of contact for development teams on build, deployment and environment issues, and communicate deployments, outages and status updates. 
 - Take an active part in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with development, operations and infrastructure teams. 

Perform other duties as assigned. Exhibit behaviors that exemplify Applied Systems' Values in Action. 

Required Qualifacations

- 8+ years of experience in DevOps engineering or a related area. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. 
 - Working knowledge of software engineering principles and practices. 
 - Experience interpreting technical documentation to complete setup, testing and security steps. 
 - Experience writing code to automate repetitive tasks (for example PowerShell, Bash or Python). 
 - Practical experience with monitoring tools, including using them to track application performance. 
 - Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and related tools or frameworks for public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. 
 - Practical experience with debugging and issue resolution. 
 - Experience using AI tools or coding assistants to automate tasks and improve productivity. 

PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONs

- Hands-on experience with CI/CD and source control tools such as GitLab, TeamCity or Azure DevOps Server. 
 - Experience with Octopus Deploy, ArgoCD or a similar release and deployment tool. 
 - Experience administering Windows Server, IIS and SQL Server in development or test environments. 
 - Experience with Datadog or a similar observability platform. 
 - Experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, Crossplane, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) or GitOps-style deployment workflows. 
 - Experience building AI-driven automation, such as AI agents, LLM-based tooling or AIOps for alerting and incident triage. 
 - Experience working in Agile teams across multiple regions and time zones. 

When You Join Team Applied, You Can Expect: 

A culture that values who you are and recognizes that you aren't just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day. 

We flex our time together, collaborating remotely and in-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them. 

Learn more about the people behind our products at -

Your Security Matters: 

Our candidates' personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At Applied, we proactively protect your personal information and only communicate with candidates via a secure@appliedsystems. com email or through our official career's portal. 

EEO Statement

Applied Systems is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diversity and Inclusion is a business imperative and is a part of building our brand and reputation. data.title: Advisory Senior Manager - Development & QA Lead
data.description:
Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you're starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you'll love from top to bottom - we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join the Technology practice, in our Hyderabad office. We are seeking someone who thrives in a growing environment and provides clients and internal partners with exceptional service. The Sr. Manager - IT Software Development Testing Lead directs the quality assurance function for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. This position owns the testing function across the software development life cycle, designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing in collaboration with development teams, and leads a team of software test engineers. 

Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the Testing Lead brings a software development background to quality engineering: writing and reviewing testing code, building automated regression testing, integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, and building report testing meeting acceptability thresholds. The role also serves as the quality escalation point for release readiness decisions and reports quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

What It Means To Work For EisnerAmper

- You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
 - You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
 - You will join a culture that has received multiple top "Places to Work" awards
 - We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
 - We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
 - Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
 - Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts
What Work You Will Be Responsible For

Test Strategy and Quality Leadership

- Owns the overall test strategy for assigned applications and engagements, covering unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams. 
 - Serves as the quality decision point for release readiness, presenting risk assessments and recommendations to technology and engagement leadership. 
 - Estimates testing effort and resources, prioritizes the test backlog, and confirms that testing tasks are delivered on schedule. 
 - Evaluates and recommends testing tools, frameworks, and platform investments, including build-versus-buy analysis and proof-of-concept work. 

Automated Test Development

- Designs, codes, reviews, and maintains automated test frameworks and reusable libraries in C# / . NET for UI, API, database, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Builds data-driven and behavior-driven automated suites, including test data management, environment configuration, and reporting. 
 - Integrates automated regression and smoke suites into Azure DevOps pipelines with gated builds, quality gates, and automated result publication. 
 - Monitors automation health - flaky test rates, execution time, and coverage - and refactors suites to keep results trustworthy and fast. 
 - Sets automation targets by release and reports progress against manual-to-automated conversion goals. 

Unit Testing and Shift-Left Quality

- Advises developers on unit test design, test doubles, and mocking strategy, and participates in code review with a focus on testability and coverage. 
 - Defines code coverage thresholds and static analysis rules with development leadership, and monitors adherence through build reporting. 
 - Writes unit and integration tests directly when supporting shared components, remediation work, or teams building new test capability. 
 - Promotes early defect detection through requirements review, design review, and acceptance criteria refinement before development begins. 

Test Case Design and Execution

- Analyzes requirements and design specifications to produce comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts with expected results and traceability to acceptance criteria. 
 - Applies risk-based, boundary, negative, and equivalence-partitioning techniques to focus coverage where defect probability and business impact are highest. 
 - Reviews and approves test cases authored by team members, providing written feedback on coverage gaps, clarity, and reusability. 
 - Directs system, functional, regression, and end-to-end business scenario testing for new applications and enhancements. 
 - Maintains and manages manual test scripts, automated suites, and test databases under version control. 
 - Coordinates user acceptance testing with business stakeholders, including scenario preparation, facilitation, and results documentation. 

Defect Management and Metrics

- Verifies and traces evidence of reproduction for reported faults, and validates fixes along with impact analysis for related functionality. 
 - Manages the defect life cycle through triage, prioritization, assignment, and closure, and escalates aging or high-severity items. 
 - Tracks and reports quality metrics such as defect density, escape rate, open defect counts, coverage, and cycle time, and uses trends to guide process improvement. 
 - Leads root cause analysis on production escapes and translates findings into concrete process or automation changes. 

Collaboration and Communication

- Serves as liaison among analysts, developers, architects, and business domain owners to clarify requirements and produce effective test scripts. 
 - Keeps development teams, project management, and internal customers informed of testing progress, risks, and significant issues. 
 - Produces well-written internal and external documentation, and conducts workshops or training on areas of knowledge as needed. 
 - Assists and advises internal customers on technical issues, resolving assigned incidents in a timely manner and retaining ownership until closure. 
 - Builds and maintains trusted relationships with a diverse group of clients, team members, managers, and subject matter contacts. 

Team Leadership And Firm Responsibilities

- Leads, coaches, and develops software test engineers, including work assignment, code and test case review, on-the-job training, and performance feedback. 
 - Participates in hiring, onboarding, and skills development planning for the testing team, including automation upskilling. 
 - Works with supervisors to identify and understand engagement scope, manages day-to-day activities of completing work, and assists with oversight of overall quality control of client deliverables. 
 - Monitors workload to meet billable hour expectations and performs timely reviews of work products prior to submission to a supervisor. 
 - Maintains the required CPE for firm and licensing requirements. 
 - Complies with professional and firm requirements (e. g. , employee handbook requirements, time entry procedures). 

Other Duties

- Provides courteous and prompt service to all internal and external parties. Prioritizes and addresses requests and assignments in a professional and cooperative manner. 
 - Identifies opportunities and recommends methods to improve service, work processes, and financial performance (e. g. , procedure optimization). Assists in the implementation of quality improvement initiatives. 
 - Assists co-workers in the completion of tasks and assignments to support continuity of service. Actively supports teamwork throughout the organization. 
 - Performs other services as assigned. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Systems and Decision Sciences is required. Coursework in data structures, algorithms, and software design is expected. 
 - ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Manager or Test Analyst) is preferred. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer, or comparable Microsoft credential is preferred. 
 - Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile credential is preferred. 
 - 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality engineering and test automation across the full system development life cycle is required. 
 - 6+ years of experience leading, building, and developing test teams, including work assignment, review, and performance feedback, is required. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, coding, and maintaining automated test suites - UI, API, and data layer is required. 
 - 6+ years of software development experience within the Microsoft stack, including C#, . NET / . NET Core, ASP. NET, and SQL Server / T-SQL, is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience writing and reviewing unit tests is required. 
 - Demonstrated experience authoring test plans, test cases, and test scripts from requirements and design specifications, including boundary, negative, and risk-based case design with traceability back to acceptance criteria, is required. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including gated builds and release quality gates, is required. 
 - Experience with agile delivery, system development life cycle governance, and tools such as Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans), JIRA, Confluence, Zephyr, Xray, or TestRail is preferred. 
 - Experience with performance and load testing (JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing), accessibility testing, or application security testing concepts is preferred. 
 - Experience in professional services, accounting, tax, or another regulated environment - including testing of financial calculations and data migrations - is preferred. 
 - Languages: C#, . NET / . NET Core, T-SQL, PowerShell, and JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Microsoft platform: Azure DevOps, Azure (App Service, Functions, SQL), SQL Server, Power BI, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365. 
 - Source control and branching strategy in Git, including pull request review and code review participation. 
 - Working knowledge of API design (REST, JSON, XML), relational data modeling, and query optimization sufficient to validate results independently. 
 - Working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, or other agile methodologies, including estimation and sprint planning. 
 - Depth of knowledge in quality assurance and quality control processes, defect life cycle management, and release governance. 
 - Ability to translate technical quality data into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and continuously changing environment while holding the team to consistent standards. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with attention to detail and accuracy. 
 - Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and appropriately with a diverse group of individuals. 
 - Demonstrates a positive attitude, proactive nature, and a high degree of professionalism, and maintains the highest level of confidentiality. 
 - Ability to work independently and within a team, and to coach others toward the same standard. 
 - Computer literacy at an intermediate or advanced level with the Microsoft Office suite of products (specifically Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint). 

We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste & religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status. 

About Our Technology Team

The EisnerAmper Technology Testing team owns quality assurance for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the team designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing alongside development teams, and provides release readiness recommendations and quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

By instilling a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and trust across the department, we're committed to building our people into tomorrow's industry leaders. At all levels, employees are encouraged to take on new responsibilities and challenges in order to grow both as individuals and a team. 

Our core values of trust, integrity and accountability allow us to act as strategic innovators. Because when we build trust with each other, we can bring new ideas to the table and execute them without fear of failure. 

About EisnerAmper

EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5, 000 employees including 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow. 

Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients. 

About EisnerAmper India

EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. ("EA India") is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC ("EA Group"), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of EisnerAmper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP. 

EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad. data.title: Application Platform Architect
data.description:
As an Application Platform Architect at Zeta Global, you will be a visionary leader responsible for designing the foundational architecture that supports all of our applications and services. You will focus on building a scalable, reliable, and secure platform that empowers engineering teams to build and deploy applications with speed and efficiency. This role involves defining standards, selecting technologies, and guiding the development of core platform components such as microservices frameworks, APIs, and shared libraries-including those that enable AI agents and agentic workflows. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform Strategy: Define the technical vision and roadmap for the Zeta application platform, ensuring it meets the long-term needs of the business and engineering teams. 
 - Architectural Design: Design and lead the implementation of core platform services, including reusable microservices, APIs, and shared components that serve all applications. 
 - AI Platform Integration: Architect and build the underlying platform services and APIs that enable the seamless integration of AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and agentic workflows. Design a robust and scalable infrastructure to support these advanced capabilities. 
 - Scalability & Reliability: Ensure the platform's architecture can handle increasing scale and complexity, with a focus on high availability, performance, and fault tolerance. 
 - Developer Enablement: Create tools, frameworks, and best practices that improve the developer experience, accelerate development velocity, and ensure consistency across all applications. 
 - Technology Evaluation: Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and architectural patterns to keep the platform at the forefront of innovation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to embed security, monitoring, and operational best practices into the platform's design and development lifecycle. 
 - Documentation & Governance: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, guidelines, and governance standards for the platform's architecture and usage. Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a lead architect or principal engineer role. 
 - Extensive experience designing and building large-scale, distributed application platforms. 
 - Deep expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems. 
 - Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Scala, or Python. 
 - Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native services. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible). 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar, and a proven track record of architecting platforms to support them. 
 - Experience with service meshes (Istio, Linkerd) and API gateways. 
 - Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM) systems. 
 - Experience with security architecture, including threat modeling and secure-by-design principles. 
 - A track record of contributing to open-source projects or speaking at industry conferences.   

Company Profile: 

Zeta Global is a data-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi-Cola, the Company combines the industry's 3rd largest proprietary data set (2. 4B+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth. 

Zeta Global is a leading AI-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes. 

Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by ZetaTM, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer's workspace, surfaces platform generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes. 

Learn more about Zeta: https: //zetaglobal. com/press-news/
