data.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. 

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality technology solutions through activities that include software development, test automation, quality engineering, platform modernization, and implementation of data, security, and regulatory standards. 

Pay And Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 - Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 - Pension / Retirement benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being
 - DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee)

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The SDET family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. This may include new development, maintenance, automation, enhancement, and modernization of software products used internally and externally across DTCC platforms. 

As an Associate, Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help drive quality engineering practices across strategic initiatives and enterprise delivery streams. In this role, you will contribute to functional and automated testing, support shift-left quality practices, maintain end-to-end traceability, and help validate complex workflows spanning user interfaces, APIs, databases, regulatory reporting flows, file-based ingestion, and cross-system integrations. The role is expected to support secure, compliant, and scalable delivery by partnering closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms. This scope includes regulatory and reporting validation, schema and file-format transformations, traceability across testing tools, UI/API/backend coordination, and testing across database, integration, regression, and automation workflows. 

Your Primary Responsibilities

- Apply software development and testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to validate business, functional, and regulatory requirements across multiple enterprise applications and platforms. 
 - Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests across the delivery lifecycle, including functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and automation-assisted testing. 
 - Maintain traceability from user stories and acceptance criteria through test scenarios, test cases, automation assets, evidence, and defect tracking using tools such as JIRA and ALM/AQM. 
 - Partner with Software Engineers and Product Owners during refinement, story grooming, and scenario walkthroughs to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities early, and improve testability before code completion. 
 - Validate API, UI, and database behavior as required, including support for backend and data-level verification across enterprise systems where project scope requires it. 
 - Perform validation activities such as file ingestion, schema validation, field mapping, field transformation, XML/CSV processing, report verification, ACK/NACK handling, error validation, and simulator-driven testing. 
 - Support regulatory and control-focused testing needs, including validation of transaction/reporting accuracy, reporting timeliness, privacy and data masking, entitlements, auditability, portal access, and downstream impacts to related systems or reporting channels. 
 - Contribute to automation frameworks and continuous testing by integrating automated checks with CI/CD pipelines and supporting smoke, sanity, and regression execution as part of release readiness. 
 - Use enterprise testing and engineering tools effectively, including JIRA, ALM, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Splunk, database-driven validation platforms, simulator tools, and automation frameworks. 
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams on requirement analysis, UI/API integration, issue triage, dependency management, troubleshooting, and solution validation across shared and distributed teams. 
 - Create and maintain system, test, and execution documentation including test plans, scenario coverage, execution evidence, defect summaries, and test status reporting. 
 - Align risk and control processes into day-to-day responsibilities to monitor and mitigate risk, escalate issues appropriately, and support secure, compliant software delivery. 

Qualifications

- Minimum of 4 years of related experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation
 - Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience
 - Experience in functional testing, automation testing, and defect lifecycle management in Agile delivery environments
 - Hands-on experience with test design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision table testing, pairwise testing, and exploratory testing
 - Experience working with JIRA and ALM for requirements traceability, test management, and issue tracking
 - Experience with one or more programming/scripting languages such as Java or Python
 - Familiarity with API testing and automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, Karate, or Rest Assured
 - Familiarity with Git / Bitbucket and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins
 - Familiarity with AI Prompt Engineering and AI Agents
 - Experience validating file-based and data-intensive workflows involving XML, CSV, schema validations, field mappings, and database verification is preferred
 - Exposure to financial services, regulatory/reporting processes, onboarding flows, portal-based applications, or data-platform testing is preferred

Talents Needed For Success

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 - Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate requirements into effective test coverage
 - Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum teams, and partner platforms
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills, including ability to document findings and present testing status clearly
 - Curiosity and ownership mindset with a strong quality-first orientation
 - Ability to balance manual validation with automation opportunities and continuously improve testing efficiency
 - Comfort working in fast-paced, iterative delivery environments with changing priorities
 - Awareness of privacy, security, risk, and regulatory expectations in enterprise software delivery
 - Willingness to learn domain-specific concepts across regulatory reporting, operational workflows, and UI/API integration models

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. data.title: Manager - Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
data.description:
Manager - Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)

Department: Customer Support / Forward Deployed Engineering

Experience: 6-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Timing: 6 PM - 03 AM (US Business Hours)

Location: On-site, Gurgaon, Haryana

About Spyne

Spyne is rebuilding the $12B+ automotive software stack from the ground up, giving dealers the AI-powered tools they need to sell more cars, faster. Founded by ex-Amazon, Cox, and OYO operators, Spyne has grown 30x in under three years and now serves 1, 500+ dealerships across the US. 

The company entered the market through Studio AI, a visual merchandising platform powered by 80+ proprietary AI models that transforms raw car photos into studio-quality images, 360-degree spins, and videos in minutes. Deeply integrated with 60+ dealer tools, from DMS and CRM platforms to major automotive marketplaces, Studio AI has become the trusted foundation inside dealer workflows nationwide. 

Now, Spyne is breaking into a much larger opportunity with Vini AI, a conversational Voice AI agent that handles inbound and outbound calls, books test drives, follows up on leads, and manages service appointments 24/7 without human intervention. Vini bookings have grown 7x in six months, and dealers who add Vini on top of Studio see ACV expansions of 4-7x. 

Together, the two products are converging into a full-stack Retail AI platform covering inventory management, digital retail, and customer relationship management. 

Backed by Accel, Vertex Ventures, and Storm Ventures, Spyne is targeting $50M ARR by the end of 2026 and positioning itself to become the category-defining AI platform for the modern dealership. 

The Role

Spyne builds AI for US car dealerships: we get their cars online faster and answer their sales and service calls. Our support team no longer just logs tickets. Our forward deployed engineers fix most dealer issues themselves, in production. 

You lead that team and set how it works. You take the hardest issues yourself, and you decide which recurring problems become product, so they stop coming back. 

What you'll do

- Fix the hardest escalations: dealer system integrations, agent behaviour, data gaps, and the handoffs between sales, service and F&I. Close the loop with the dealer and the CSM. 
 - Run the queue: a car not listed or a lead lost outranks a cosmetic bug. Keep response times, and run P0 and P1 incidents and on-call across India and US hours. 
 - Make fixes safe and fast: rules for access, review and rollback, plus runbooks and AI tooling for triage and diagnosis. 
 - Own the team's product work: every FDE spends 20% of their time on a product initiative. You decide which recurring problems they take on, and coach them from spec to shipped, measured impact. 
 - Build the team: hire 5 to 10 FDEs, review their code, and keep the queue covered as FDEs move into PM roles. 

How we'll judge it

- SLAs met, and time to fix P0 and P1 issues
 - Issues closed without core Engineering
 - Repeat issues eliminated each quarter
 - FDE product initiatives shipped, and FDEs moved into PM roles

You'll do well here if you have

- 6 to 10 years of software engineering, 4+ of them shipping production code, and you still write it. 
 - 2+ years leading engineers, as a manager or tech lead. 
 - Been accountable for customer issues in production: response times, incidents, and being on call when something breaks at night. 
 - Comfort debugging production systems you didn't write, under customer pressure. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. You'll be on calls with US dealers. 

Nice to have

- Experience leading a customer-facing engineering team (FDE, solutions engineering, support engineering). 
 - Exposure to US auto retail, DMS/CRM integrations (CDK, Reynolds, Dealertrack, VinSolutions), or voice and chat agents.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (HW, SW, Systems) to validate modem performance in pre-silicon and post-silicon phases. 
 - Develop and maintain performance models and dashboards for modem subsystems.

 - Experience with pre-silicon validation platforms (TLM, RUMI, Emulation).

 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills in complex HW/SW environments.

Job Description

Title: Engineering Team Leader - Mechanical-Husky (India) Guindy, Chennai

Id: 21203

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Engineering Team Leader, Platform Mechanical

Lead and develop a mechanical engineering team made up of junior, senior, and specialist level designers in the development of new Husky products and solutions with a focus on innovation, quality, risk mitigation and customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability

- Lead, manage and develop the team, which includes but is not limited to coaching, mentoring and cross-training. 
 - Oversee the design, development, and release of engineering for new Husky machine platforms as well as critical service and customer support requests. 
 - Ensure the team is effective in delivering new products that meet the requirements defined by the businesses as essential for success - aligned with product definition and the Husky Operating model. 
 - Planning and scheduling design activities to ensure committed completion dates are met as per business needs. 
 - Enforcement of Product Development Process, Design Documents and Risk Mitigation as well as applicable directives and standards our machines must comply with. 
 - Participate in, and lead as needed, technical discussions, design reviews, and executive updates to ensure the implementation of high-quality solutions with stakeholder transparency. 
 - Influence and establish engineering standards through solid design decisions, processes and tools. 
 - Participate in process creation, product architecture decisions, technology roadmap creation and continuous improvement initiatives
 - Encourage team members to think, organize and lead while providing them with developmental and career growth opportunities. 
 - Lead effective cross-disciplinary collaboration between various stakeholders and teams. 
 - Facilitating collaboration between other departments (Supply chain, Service, Operations)
 - Interviewing and hiring new team members. 

Critcal Capabilities And Qualifications

- Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, interpersonal and presentation)
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team. 
 - Strong decision-making and judgment. 
 - System level thinking at both a product and enterprise level. 
 - Excellent knowledge of the mechanical design discipline
 - Demonstrates high degree of flexibility and embraces changing priorities. 
 - Knowledge of Husky products, tools, standards, processes and technology is an asset. 

Education

- Bachelor or Master's of engineering degree from accredited university

Experience

- 10+ years relevant engineering experience. 
 - Proven leadership experience. 
 - Previous engineering experience in heavy machinery or injection molding industry is an asset. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Lead Data Engineer
data.description:
- Joining Arup

Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. 

We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to help shape, build and operate scalable data solutions on the Databricks platform. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, mentor engineers and deliver robust, secure and high-performing data pipelines, Lakehouse solutions and analytics-ready data products. 

You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, product owners and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical, reliable and scalable data services. You will bring strong technical judgement, a passion for engineering excellence and the ability to promote best practice across data engineering, governance and platform operations. 

The Opportunity

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective - in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning - to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve. 

- Lead, mentor and support a team of data engineers, setting technical direction and encouraging engineering best practice. 
 - Design, build and operate scalable data pipelines and Lakehouse solutions using Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake and cloud-native services. 
 - Define standards for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, deployment, observability and monitoring. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn business and technical requirements into high-quality data solutions. 
 - Champion reusable frameworks, automation, medallion architecture patterns and modern data engineering practices. 
 - Embed data quality, security, governance and compliance controls across pipelines and data products. 
 - Review solution designs, code and deployment approaches to maintain consistency, resilience and operational reliability. 
 - Optimise Databricks workloads for performance, scalability and cost efficiency. 
 - Support Agile delivery, sprint planning, estimation, continuous improvement and technical roadmap development. 

Did you know: Our Digital Technology team are proud prior winners of the IT Team of the Year Award at the Chartered Institute of IT's UK IT Industry Awards. 

Is this role right for you?

- Strong production experience in Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake. 
 - Experience designing scalable data pipelines, Lakehouse solutions and cloud-native data services. 
 - Knowledge of Unity Catalog, data governance, security and access control patterns. 
 - Confidence leading, mentoring and developing data engineers. 
 - A passion for engineering excellence, automation, reliability and continuous improvement. 

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member's success, so we can grow together. 

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive - through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do. 

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup's legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts. 

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you're pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence. 

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion - we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at Careers - Your Life at Arup . 

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you. 

Our Application Process

To understand what to expect next, please visit our Careers page Our aim is to make this process as streamlined and easy as possible for our applicants. 

Please note that all applicants must apply directly via the job portal and applications sent via email will not be considered. If this role is not quite what you are looking for, but you are interested in other opportunities for a future with purpose, please sign up to our Talent Community where you will be kept up to date with roles suitable for you to shape a better world. 

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process. 

An environment that will give you freedom to design with a purpose, focus on your skills to deliver quality work to our clients, opportunity to learn and share knowledge openly. You will have the opportunity to utilise your technical expertise to improve the lives of the most vulnerable in the communities in which we live and work through Arup's community engagement programme. 

You'll have access to lots of learning opportunities and ongoing training through Arup university and other learning programmes.

Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and scale enterprise applications that bring data science, analytics, optimization, and AI/ML solutions into production. 

As part of the Data Science team, this role will work closely with data scientists and business stakeholders to transform analytical models, algorithms, and data-driven solutions into secure, reliable, intuitive applications that can be used across the enterprise. 

The ideal candidate has strong full-stack engineering experience and deep hands-on experience building and deploying applications on Microsoft Azure. Experience with GCP is also valuable. Familiarity with AI/ML systems is preferred, but this is primarily an application engineering role. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Science Application Development

- Design and build enterprise applications that operationalize data science, analytics, optimization, and AI/ML solutions. 
 - Partner closely with data scientists to integrate predictive models, optimization models, analytics workflows, and other computational services into production applications. 
 - Translate data science prototypes and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, production-ready solutions. 
 - Build intuitive user experiences that enable business users to interact with data, models, scenarios, recommendations, and analytical outputs. 
 - Develop reusable application components and architectural patterns that accelerate deployment of future data science solutions. 

Full Stack Engineering

- Build modern, high-performance frontend applications using React, Angular, TypeScript, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python, Java, Node. js, C#, or similar technologies. 
 - Design APIs and service layers that connect applications with data platforms, databases, analytical models, and AI/ML services. 
 - Optimize performance across frontend, backend, API, and database layers. 
 - Apply strong software engineering practices including modular architecture, testing, version control, code review, and maintainable design. 

Azure Cloud Application Engineering

- Design, build, deploy, and operate enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Work with relevant Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps/AKS, Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Storage, and API Management. 
 - Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID and enterprise identity patterns. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. 
 - Develop containerized applications using Docker and, where appropriate, Kubernetes. 
 - Design applications for availability, scalability, security, observability, and operational support. 
 - Experience building applications on GCP is a plus; AWS experience is also valuable. 

Data & AI Integration

- Integrate applications with enterprise data platforms, databases, APIs, and analytical services. 
 - Collaborate with Data Scientist to productionize machine learning and optimization models. 
 - Build application workflows that allow users to consume predictions, recommendations, simulations, and scenario-analysis results. 
 - Integrate Generative AI and AI services where appropriate to improve user experience and business processes. 
 - Experience working with modern data and AI platforms such as Databricks is a plus. 

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional software engineering or full-stack application development experience with undergraduate degree or 3+ years of experience with master degree. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and building enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong frontend development experience with React, Angular, TypeScript, or similar modern frameworks. 
 - Strong backend development experience with Python, Java, Node. js, C#, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience designing REST APIs, service-oriented architectures, and application integrations. 
 - Experience building secure applications using authentication and authorization frameworks, preferably Microsoft Entra ID. 
 - Strong understanding of application architecture, scalability, security, reliability, and performance. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as Azure SQL, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience designing and deploying cloud-native applications. 
 - Strong communication skills and experience working with technical and business stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing applications that expose or operationalize data science, machine learning, optimization, forecasting, simulation, or advanced analytics solutions. 
 - Experience integrating applications with Databricks or similar modern data platforms. 
 - Experience with Azure services for AI, data, integration, or application hosting. 
 - Experience with GCP application development. 
 - Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application architectures. 
 - Experience working closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to move analytical prototypes into production. 
 - Experience building internal enterprise applications for decision support, planning, forecasting, or operational analytics. 

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution. 

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs. accommodations@sandisk. com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

Over 50, 000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress. With double-digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver scalable outcomes than Extreme.

What you will do (Job Specific Details on the nature of the job and responsibilities). 

Excellent QA Experience In Most Of The Following Areas

- Experience in testing cloud-based applications.

 - Experience and understanding of Kubernetes, Docker and Clustering solutions. 
 - Experience in creating end-to-end test strategy and test planning.

 - Experience in testing Enterprise Wireless and Wired networks. 
 - Experience in security concepts and protocols such as AAA framework, 802. 1X, Captive portal, VPN, Firewalls, SSL etc. 
 - UI test automation experience using selenium or playwright. 
 - Knowledge of Virtualization and Hypervisor (ESX, Hyper-V). 
 - Experience using network testing tools like Wireshark, Ethereal or Jmeter. 
 - Proficiency in Linux/Unix OS. 
 - Experience or exposure to AI, Machine Learning and related tools. 
 - Good Analytical and Communication Skills

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 
 - 5-8 years of Experience in Network Management/Orchestration domain
 - Good debugging skills in a Microservices oriented architecture based product
 - A detailed understanding of cloud technologies , containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
 - Hands on experience with Performance Testing - Experience with Performance Testing & Monitoring using tools such as Jmeter, Locust etc. , 
 - Expert in API Testing: API Contract Testing using Mocks, API Automation etc. , . Knowledge on relevant widely used Tools for the same.

 - Applied experience with version control systems such as Git, Github
 - Comfortable with SQL/NoSQL/In-memory databases such as PostgreSQL/Redis/Ignite 
 - Knowledge on monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus

Soft Skills

- Ability and willingness to work independently. Good verbal and written communication skills. Curiosity and mindset to challenge the status quo
 - Ability to identify and automate repeated day to day activities
 - Ability to clearly articulate and report the risks and mitigations to management

Working closely with Product Management, Development, CloudOps, and Customer Support teams, you will ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and reliable solutions by validating real-world customer workflows, deployment scenarios, integrations, and upgrade paths.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Infotainment Test Engineer with strong Python programming skills to join our Automotive Software Engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for validating next-generation automotive infotainment systems, designing automated test frameworks, executing functional and integration testing, and ensuring high-quality software delivery for automotive products. 

What You Will Do

What Makes You Eligible

What We Offer

 - Collaborative and dynamic work environment
 - Access to cutting-edge technologies and tools
 - Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance through BeBrilliant

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. data.description:
The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we're taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we're elevating the standards for an entire industry - and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. 

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

Kidde Global Solutions is seeking an experienced Digital Portfolio QA Manager to lead quality assurance for mobile, web, cloud, desktop software, API, and connected digital applications. The role will build and guide a strong QA team, strengthen automation and testing practices, adopt practical AI methods in day-to-day QA work, and ensure reliable, secure, and scalable digital experiences across IoT, intrusion, video, and access-control product ecosystems

Role Overview

The Digital Portfolio QA Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the QA approach across web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected product platforms. This includes planning test coverage, improving automation, using AI to make testing faster and smarter, managing release readiness, and driving measurable quality outcomes for applications and tools used to configure, commission, monitor, and manage hardware devices. 

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities

The role is accountable for team leadership, QA planning, automation, AI adoption in testing, and release confidence across mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital applications. Key responsibilities include: 

- QA strategy and ownership: Define and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital application releases in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives. 
 - Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of QA engineers responsible for mobile and web-based digital applications, promoting accountability, engineering discipline, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - AI adoption in QA: Use practical AI methods to improve testing, including AI-assisted test case creation, test data generation, automation support, defect analysis, risk identification, and quality reporting. 
 - Testing and automation methods: Lead manual, automated, regression, integration, API, mobile, web, desktop, and end-to-end testing using scalable frameworks, reusable test assets, CI/CD integration, and clear effectiveness metrics. 
 - Digital application quality: Ensure functional, usability, compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, integration, and regression quality across Android, iOS, responsive web applications, portals, APIs, desktop tools, and cloud-connected workflows. 
 - IoT and security-domain alignment: Apply a fair understanding of IoT application behavior, device-to-cloud interactions, mobile app connectivity, user workflows, and system integrations; experience in intrusion, video, access control, security panels or connected security ecosystems is highly appreciated. 
 - Release governance and metrics: Establish release-readiness criteria, quality dashboards, defect governance, traceability, risk-based testing, and executive-level reporting to provide transparent quality signals and data-driven release recommendations. 
 - Continuous improvement: Improve test productivity, automation value, defect detection, regression cycle time, release predictability, and customer quality through better processes, metrics, and AI-enabled testing improvements. 
 - Cross-functional influence: Partner closely with product management, engineering, architecture, DevOps, customer support, and program teams to align quality priorities, resolve risks, improve product reliability, and deliver customer-ready digital products. 

Education

BE, B. Tech. , ME, or M. Tech. in Electronics, Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline. 

Experience And Technical Qualifications

Minimum 12+ years of experience in software quality engineering, digital application testing, test automation, or QA leadership roles, including substantial experience managing QA teams for product-based mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, or connected application platforms. 

- Managerial QA leadership: Proven experience leading QA teams, defining team goals, managing delivery commitments, reviewing quality metrics, coaching engineers, and influencing engineering and product stakeholders in a product development environment. 
 - Mobile, web, and desktop application QA: Strong experience testing Android, iOS, responsive web applications, portals, desktop software used to configure and manage hardware devices, APIs, user workflows, cross-browser behavior, device compatibility, integration flows, and cloud-connected digital services. 
 - AI and automation outcomes: Demonstrated track record of using AI in QA processes to achieve measurable outcomes such as increased automation coverage, faster regression execution, improved defect prediction, reduced manual effort, better test design quality, and stronger release confidence. 
 - Automation and toolchain expertise: Hands-on background with modern automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Robot Framework, PyTest, Postman, API automation, JIRA, X-Ray or equivalent test management platforms. 
 - Preferred domain experience: Fair understanding of IoT applications, device connectivity, cloud integrations, mobile-to-device interactions, and connected product behavior; prior exposure to intrusion, video surveillance, access control, security monitoring, or smart building/security domains is highly appreciated. 

Leadership and Managerial Competencies

- People leadership and ownership: Builds and leads high-performing QA teams with clear ownership, accountability, mentoring, performance orientation, and commitment to product quality outcomes. 
 - Strategic execution: Converts product priorities into practical QA plans, balances hands-on technical judgment with managerial decision-making, removes execution barriers, and escalates risks with clarity. 
 - Stakeholder communication: Communicates quality status, automation progress, AI adoption impact, release risks, and improvement plans effectively to engineering leaders, product owners, program teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaboration and delivery: Collaborates effectively across teams and maintains accountability for timely, high-quality delivery. 
 - Continuous learning: Demonstrates curiosity, creativity, and a sustained commitment to continuous learning, engineering excellence, and professional growth. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong managerial maturity, digital QA depth, automation leadership, and a proven ability to convert AI adoption into tangible quality, productivity, and release-readiness outcomes for product-based digital applications. 

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

data.description:
Job Description

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you're starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you'll love from top to bottom - we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. 

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join the Technology practice, in our Hyderabad office. We are seeking someone who thrives in a growing environment and provides clients and internal partners with exceptional service. The Sr. Manager - IT Software Development Testing Lead directs the quality assurance function for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. This position owns the testing function across the software development life cycle, designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing in collaboration with development teams, and leads a team of software test engineers. 

Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the Testing Lead brings a software development background to quality engineering: writing and reviewing testing code, building automated regression testing, integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, and building report testing meeting acceptability thresholds. The role also serves as the quality escalation point for release readiness decisions and reports quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership. 

What it means to work for EisnerAmper: 

- You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
 - You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
 - You will join a culture that has received multiple top "Places to Work" awards
 - We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
 - We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
 - Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
 - Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts
What work you will be responsible for: 

Test Strategy and Quality Leadership

- Owns the overall test strategy for assigned applications and engagements, covering unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams. 
 - Serves as the quality decision point for release readiness, presenting risk assessments and recommendations to technology and engagement leadership. 
 - Estimates testing effort and resources, prioritizes the test backlog, and confirms that testing tasks are delivered on schedule. 
 - Evaluates and recommends testing tools, frameworks, and platform investments, including build-versus-buy analysis and proof-of-concept work. 

Automated Test Development

- Designs, codes, reviews, and maintains automated test frameworks and reusable libraries in C# / . NET for UI, API, database, and end-to-end scenarios. 
 - Builds data-driven and behavior-driven automated suites, including test data management, environment configuration, and reporting. 
 - Integrates automated regression and smoke suites into Azure DevOps pipelines with gated builds, quality gates, and automated result publication. 
 - Monitors automation health - flaky test rates, execution time, and coverage - and refactors suites to keep results trustworthy and fast. 
 - Sets automation targets by release and reports progress against manual-to-automated conversion goals. 

Unit Testing and Shift-Left Quality

- Advises developers on unit test design, test doubles, and mocking strategy, and participates in code review with a focus on testability and coverage. 
 - Defines code coverage thresholds and static analysis rules with development leadership, and monitors adherence through build reporting. 
 - Writes unit and integration tests directly when supporting shared components, remediation work, or teams building new test capability. 
 - Promotes early defect detection through requirements review, design review, and acceptance criteria refinement before development begins. 

Test Case Design and Execution

- Analyzes requirements and design specifications to produce comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts with expected results and traceability to acceptance criteria. 
 - Applies risk-based, boundary, negative, and equivalence-partitioning techniques to focus coverage where defect probability and business impact are highest. 
 - Reviews and approves test cases authored by team members, providing written feedback on coverage gaps, clarity, and reusability. 
 - Directs system, functional, regression, and end-to-end business scenario testing for new applications and enhancements.

data.title: Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer
data.description:
Experience: 10+years

Work Mode: Hybrid/ 24/7 shift

Work Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Pune, Kochi

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer to pioneer the next generation of intent-based, self-healing network infrastructures. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence. You will not just write scripts; you will architect autonomous AI Agents capable of diagnosing infrastructure faults, correlating real-time telemetry, and safely executing deterministic changes across a global multi-vendor environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Advanced Ansible Engineering: Architect scalable, production-grade network configuration playbooks, custom roles, and execution environments using Ansible Automation Platform / AWX. Develop custom Python plugins/modules to extend Ansible functionality where native vendor support is limited. 
 - Multi-Vendor API Integration: Write highly concurrent Python middleware to interface natively with the REST APIs and SDKs of our core infrastructure stack (Cisco Nexus/ACI, Meraki Dashboard, Versa Director, and Zscaler). 
 - AI Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using Generative AI frameworks (e. g. , LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain) to automate complex network troubleshooting, validation, and root-cause analysis (RCA). 
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP): Build and maintain custom MCP clients and servers to securely expose internal networking tools, documentation (RAG), and script suites as executable "tools" for LLMs. 
 - Event-Driven Remediation: Build closed-loop automation systems using Event-Driven Ansible (EDA) or asynchronous message queues (Celery/Redis/Kafka) to ingest real-time syslogs and trigger proactive self-healing workflows. 
 - Guardrails & Safety Architecture: Implement strict software boundaries and input validation schemas (e. g. , Pydantic) ensuring LLM-generated variables are deterministically parsed, with mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates before configuration changes impact production. Required Technical Skill Set

- Automation & Programming: Advanced Ansible AAP, Python (Object-Oriented, Asyncio, FastAPI), robust try/except exception handling, Ansible Core, AWX/Tower, and Jinja2 templating. 
 - AI & GenAI Ecosystems: Deep practical experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or CrewAI; strict JSON/Function Calling; Model Context Protocol (MCP); Semantic Routing; and vector databases (Milvus, Chroma) for network RAG pipelines. 
 - Enterprise Networking & Security: Solid understanding of L2/L3 routing (BGP, OSPF, VXLAN EVPN), SD-WAN architectures, and Secure Service Edge (SSE) frameworks. 
 - Target Vendor Stack (Highly Desirable): Hands-on API experience with Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Meraki SDK, Versa Analytics, and pyZscaler. 
 - DevOps & Observability: Git/GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), and log streaming architectures (ELK Stack, Kafka, or Splunk). Experience & Qualifications

- Total Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise Network Engineering, DevOps, or Systems Automation. 
 - Automation Focus: 3+ years of dedicated experience building infrastructure automation or developer toolchains. 
 - AI Exposure: 1+ years of hands-on application development involving LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or local Ollama engines). 
 - Certifications (a plus): Cisco/Red Hat/Ansible

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Sr. Engineer - Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement. 

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab. 
 - Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements. 
 - Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems. 
 - Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions. 
 - Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures. 
 - Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions. 
 - Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions. 
 - Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams. 
 - Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities. 
 - Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure. 
 - Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required. 
 - Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities. 
 - Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 

Key Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.

 - Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.

 - Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures.

 - Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices. 
 - Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.

data.title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

13

We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as Director of Engineering, Data Platforms for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls. 

This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders. 

You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle-from acquisition through distribution-to create a trusted single source of truth. 

This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems. 

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery

- Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform. 
 - Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns. 
 - Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets. 
 - Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support. 
 - Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services. 
 - Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms. 

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement

- Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner. 
 - Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case. 
 - Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform. 
 - Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction. 
 - Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering. 

Data Mastering Platform Integration

- Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform. 
 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows. 
 - Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform. 
 - Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows. 
 - Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data. 
 - Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management. 

Team Leadership and Delivery Management

- Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering. 
 - Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability. 
 - Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members. 
 - Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership. 
 - Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms. 

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards

- Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations. 
 - Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access. 
 - Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness. 
 - Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate. 
 - Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant. 

Required Qualifications

Leadership and Delivery Experience

- 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model. 
 - Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment. 
 - Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows. 
 - Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture. 
 - Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services. 
 - Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts. 
 - Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines. 
 - Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering. 
 - Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring. 
 - Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards. 

Collaboration and Execution

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams. 
 - Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans. 
 - Comfortable operating in a role that blends technical leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery oversight. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains or asset types. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging or metadata management environments, including integrations involving operational and business metadata platforms. 
 - Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, or golden record workflows in financial services environments. 
 - Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets. 
 - Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data. 
 - Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, and auditability requirements are important. 
 - Databricks certifications, AWS certifications (such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus. AWS certification paths remain relevant for modern cloud-native data engineering roles.

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Designation: Head - Design & Engineering

Preferred Industry: EOT Cranes / Material Handling / Heavy Engineering / Industrial Equipment

Reporting To: Founder / CEO

About the Role

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in crane design, structural and mechanical calculations, engineering validation, and team leadership. The candidate will be responsible for developing standardized and scalable engineering processes, improving design quality, optimizing costs, and ensuring timely engineering deliverables while maintaining safety, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards. 

We are looking for a leader who can build a strong engineering team, establish systematic design processes, and reduce dependency on individual expertise. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Design & Engineering Leadership

Lead the complete design and engineering of EOT cranes and customized lifting systems. 

Oversee structural design, mechanical calculations, component selection, and technical validation. 

Ensure compliance with applicable IS standards, FEM standards, and customer-specific requirements. 

Review and approve General Arrangement (GA) drawings, detailed engineering drawings, and manufacturing documentation. 

2. Product Standardization & Engineering Systems

Develop standardized, modular, and configurable crane designs while accommodating customer-specific requirements. 

Establish engineering workflows covering customer requirements, GA drawings, detailed design, BOM preparation, and manufacturing release. 

Develop engineering libraries, design templates, calculation sheets, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 

Implement structured design processes to reduce engineering lead time and dependency on individual team members. 

3. CAD Design & Technical Documentation

Lead the implementation and effective utilization of SolidWorks and 3D design tools. 

Ensure accuracy and timely release of engineering drawings, technical calculations, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). 

Maintain engineering documentation, revision control, and design records. 

Improve collaboration between design and manufacturing teams through effective 3D modelling and drawing practices. 

4. Design for Manufacturing & Cost Optimization

Drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM), value engineering, and cost optimization initiatives. 

Optimize material utilization, component selection, fabrication methods, and assembly processes. 

Identify opportunities to improve product performance, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturability without compromising safety or reliability. 

Work closely with Production, Purchase, Projects, and Quality teams to improve engineering efficiency. 

5. Design Quality & Continuous Improvement

Conduct design reviews, technical risk assessments, and root-cause analysis of engineering issues. 

Reduce design errors, manufacturing rework, and site modifications. 

Establish first-time-right engineering practices and quality checkpoints. 

Drive continuous improvement in design accuracy, engineering productivity, and delivery performance. 

6. Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination

Build, lead, mentor, and develop a competent design and engineering team. 

Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and technical review mechanisms. 

Collaborate with Sales, Production, Purchase, Projects, Quality, Installation, and Service teams. 

Support technical discussions with customers and resolve complex engineering issues. 

Develop a knowledge-sharing culture to strengthen team capability and reduce key-person dependency. 

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong expertise in EOT crane and material-handling equipment design. 

Knowledge of structural and mechanical engineering calculations. 

Working knowledge of applicable IS standards, FEM standards, and customer specifications. 

Proficiency in SolidWorks, 3D modelling, and AutoCAD. 

Strong understanding of GA drawings, detailed engineering, BOM preparation, and manufacturing drawings. 

Experience in Design for Manufacturing (DFM), value engineering, and cost optimization. 

Strong technical problem-solving, design validation, and root-cause analysis skills. 

Proven experience in engineering team leadership and process development. 

Excellent coordination, decision-making, and communication skills. 

Candidate Profile

B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering. 

10-15+ years of relevant experience in EOT cranes, material handling, heavy engineering, or industrial equipment. 

Demonstrated experience leading crane design and engineering teams. 

Strong understanding of end-to-end crane design, from customer requirements to manufacturing release. 

Experience in establishing engineering standards, design libraries, SOPs, and standardized product platforms. 

Ability to balance technical accuracy, safety, manufacturing feasibility, cost, and delivery timelines

data.title: Technical Team Lead – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
data.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 

The Position

We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning. 

In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad. 

Description Of The Area
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare. 

In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e. g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.

Team Management

- Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment
 - Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work
 - Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.

- Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it

- Enable technical decision-making and design of robust, resilient, and highly available systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent frameworks, RAG/GraphRAG pipelines, state machines, classical ML, and enterprise data ecosystems
 - Establish robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal foundation models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, and vector, graph and relational databases
 - Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of RDT and Business functions, strictly following architectural patterns, standards, and data strategies established across the functions
 - Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt, ensuring optimal cloud resource and model inference cost-efficiency
 - Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise standards for code, systems development, identity management, and authentication mechanisms across the team

Agentic SDLC & Code Quality: 

- Ensure the team effectively leverages agentic Software Development Lifecycle workflows and tools daily (e. g. , Claude Code, autonomous agents) to safely accelerate development and automated testing cycles
 - Act as the technical standards keeper; perform or enable effective, rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code to maintain strict enterprise software engineering standards

Compliance & Regulatory Alignment: 

- Oversee compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments, ensuring engineering deliverables are audit-ready and aligned with GxP compliance and Computerized System Validation (CSV)/Software Assurance (CSA) standards
 - Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) to preserve validated infrastructure states

Qualifications & Experience

- Education: Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Science, or a related field
 - Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in team leadership and people leadership in an agile product delivery environment, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams
 - Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience working in AI software development teams, with at least 5 years as a hands-on engineer or architect designing cloud-native solutions
 - Regulated Domain Experience: Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical healthcare preferred) delivering validated applications
 - Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior
 - Possesses deep active listening and mentoring/coaching skills
 - Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity
 - Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Brings an enterprise mindset that can break down silos, focusing on delivery through collaboration across organizational boundaries

Technical Skills

- AI & Orchestration Frameworks: Deep practical expertise in multi-agent system design, state machine logic, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
 - Classical Machine Learning: strong hands-on background in building applications driven by classical (pre-generative) Machine Learning and MLOps
 - Core Programming: Production-grade mastery in advanced Python for backend/AI workloads and TypeScript for modern frontend interfaces and generative AI and classical ML UX/UI. Strong foundational understanding of modern full-stack development environments
 - Data & Cloud Platforms: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise data platforms like Snowflake, vector databases (e. g. , AWS OpenSearch), and graph databases (e. g. , AWS Neptune)
 - Cloud Engineering & DevOps: High proficiency overseeing AWS cloud architecture (including serverless workloads, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, etc. ), managing fully automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
 - AI Observability: Experience defining monitoring, logging, and telemetry strategies to track model drift, API/MCP health, resource utilization, and anomaly identification

Additional Qualifications

- Excels in communicating in English highly effectively and clearly, at the level of: C1+

 - Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures
 - Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker, detail-oriented and highly organized

Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).

A healthier future drives us to innovate.
