data.title: Senior Principal - GCP Platform Architect
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal GCP Platform Architect owns the technical design of the Google Cloud platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the Google Cloud and Edge services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. 
 - Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. 
 - Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. 
 - Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. 
 - Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. 
 - Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. 
 - Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. 
 - Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). 
 - Architecture certifications desirable (e. g. , TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. 
 - Strong experience as a Google Cloud Architect. Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments. 
 - Experience deploying, configuring and managing services in Google Cloud Platform including AI Services
 - Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. 
 - Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. 
 - Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. 
 - Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

Skills/Background

- Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. 
 - Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. 
 - Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. 
 - Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. 
 - Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. 
 - Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, Design Assurance, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Google Cloud Platform Architecture, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Reference Architectures, Security Compliance, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance.

 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. 
 - Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 

Leadership behaviors and ways of working

- Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. 
 - Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. 
 - Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. 
 - Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. 
 - Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Scripting, Serverless Computing, Software Frameworks, Software Testing, System Monitors, Test Automation, UI Automation Testing, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Manager, Cloud Security Engineer
data.description:
About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we're on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one. 

Get to Know the Security Services Team

We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end-to-end ownership, our Cloud Security Engineering team designs hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, writes Terraform baselines, and fixes failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption. 

What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. If you enjoy solving tough security problems and want to be part of a team that is scrappy enough to move fast but seasoned enough to get it right, you will be in good company here. 

The Opportunity

Workstreet is seeking a Manager, Cloud Security Engineering to lead a team of Cloud Security Engineers who design, build, and operate cloud security controls for our clients across AWS, Azure, and GCP. This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who has built hardened cloud environments themselves and now wants to multiply that impact through a team. 

You will own the quality, capacity, and consistency of Cloud Security Engineering delivery: hiring and developing engineers, staffing and overseeing client engagements, setting engineering standards, and serving as the escalation point for technical and relationship issues. You will stay close enough to the work to review architecture, unblock engineers, and step into client conversations when it matters, while working alongside the GRC delivery teams to deliver outcomes that hold up in front of auditors and adversaries alike. 

You will work with client engineering leads and executives during U. S. Eastern Time business hours, and you will be accountable for ensuring that every client environment achieves drift-resistant, code-defined security rather than documentation-only compliance. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and develop the team: manage, coach, and grow Cloud Security Engineers through clear expectations, regular feedback, performance reviews, and defined career paths. 
 - Hire and onboard: build the interview process, recruit and select engineers, and onboard them so they take direct ownership of client work quickly. 
 - Own delivery across the client portfolio: plan capacity, assign engineers to engagements, track milestones and quality, and make sure multiple concurrent engagements stay on schedule without sacrificing technical rigor. 
 - Serve as the escalation point: handle technical and relationship escalations calmly, and lead conversations with client engineering leads and executives on scope, risk, and remediation priorities. 
 - Set engineering standards: define and maintain reusable Terraform and CloudFormation baselines, landing zone patterns, IAM and logging modules, and code review practices that make client environments drift-resistant. 
 - Guide cloud architecture decisions: review designs for AWS multi-account structures, Azure Hub-Spoke and Landing Zone architectures, least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, and encryption using services such as AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault. 
 - Direct native security tooling: set the approach for deploying and tuning AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, Microsoft Sentinel, and Defender for Cloud, including logging pipelines for SIEM ingestion. 
 - Embed security in delivery pipelines: establish guardrails and automated remediation workflows, including SAST, DAST, and secret scanning in GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 
 - Translate frameworks into functional controls: ensure technical controls satisfy SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP requirements in practice, not only on a compliance map, and that evidence supports audit readiness. 
 - Oversee incident response: set the escalation path for cloud security incidents and ensure rapid containment, diagnostics, and post-incident improvements. 
 - Collaborate across Security Services and GRC: coordinate with GRC delivery teams, and provide technical input on scoping, statements of work, and new client opportunities. 
 - Continuously improve the practice: track delivery health, remediation cycle times, and module reuse, and invest in tooling and automation that removes repetitive work for the team. 
 - Stay hands-on where it counts: step into architecture reviews, complex remediations, and client workshops to unblock engineers and maintain technical credibility. 

Who You Are

- Technical leader of cloud security engineers: experienced people manager who has hired, coached, and retained engineers, and who sets a high bar for work quality while backing the team under pressure. 
 - Multi-cloud security expert: deep, hands-on background securing AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, including IAM strategy (RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, federated identity via Okta or Entra ID), network zoning, encryption, and logging. 
 - Infrastructure as Code authority: fluent in Terraform, with working knowledge of CloudFormation, Python, or Bash, and able to review module design, versioning, state management, and provider security controls. 
 - GRC infrastructure strategist: maps technical cloud configurations to SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA requirements, and distinguishes compliance mappings from functional technical controls. 
 - Delivery operator: thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, balancing multiple client portfolios and competing priorities while keeping the team focused on rapid, well-governed remediation. 
 - Trusted client advisor: partners with US-based technology founders, DevOps leads, and executive teams, handles escalations with calm professionalism, and leads architectural workshops. 
 - Elite communicator: delivers precise written and verbal English communication that translates complex cloud risks into clear business decisions for both engineers and executives. 

What Will Help You Succeed

- Validated cloud security credentials: active certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CISM, or CISA. 
 - Experience building or scaling a security engineering team: in a consulting, MSSP, or hyper-growth technology environment, including capacity planning and resourcing across client engagements. 
 - Federal and regulated environment experience: hands-on history building CMMC-compliant enclaves or FedRAMP security architectures, including NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171 control implementation. 
 - FIPS 140 encryption implementation: practical experience configuring and enforcing FIPS 140 standards across cloud services. 
 - Container and DevSecOps engineering: experience securing microservice architectures, Docker, and Kubernetes, including runtime security controls and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Zero Trust deployment models: direct experience with identity-centric security policies, network micro-segmentation, and context-aware access. 
 - Monitoring and detection tooling: advanced use of logging platforms, SIEM, vulnerability management engines, and threat hunting feeds. 

What We Offer

- Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities. 
 - Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role. 
 - Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities. 
 - Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement. 
 - Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team. 

What You'll Need To Thrive

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams. 
 - A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration. 
 - Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8: 00 AM-5: 00 PM U. S. Eastern Time (ET) to effectively collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners while ensuring timely communication and support. 
 - Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed. 

Hiring and Selection Process

- Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with camera on (non-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding. 
 - Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law. 
 - Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet's operating principles. 
 - Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step. 

Workstreet Is An Equal Opportunity Employer

As an equal opportunity employer, Workstreet is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Workstreet will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

data.title: Software Engineering Team Lead – C++ / ADAS Resimulation
data.description:
Help shape the future of mobility. 

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv's passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error. 

Software Engineering Team Lead - C++ / ADAS Resimulation

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineering Team Lead to lead a team developing C++-based resimulation solutions, applications and automation for large-scale ADAS analysis. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining software development, team leadership and delivery ownership. The Team Lead will actively design, develop, debug, test and optimize C++ software alongside the team, while guiding engineers, driving execution and ensuring software quality. 

Key Responsibilities

- Actively design, develop, debug, test and optimize production-quality C++ software for ADAS resimulation and analysis. 
 - Lead and technically guide a team of software engineers while continuing to contribute directly to development. 
 - Own technical execution and delivery of resimulation features, applications and releases. 
 - Drive software design, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis and performance optimization. 
 - Develop scalable Linux-based applications and automation for HPC and/or cloud environments. 
 - Drive engineering best practices for clean code, modularity, maintainability, testability and performance. 
 - Support resimulation-based analysis of ADAS perception, sensor processing and control algorithms on large-scale datasets. 
 - Mentor engineers, improve technical competency and resolve complex technical issues. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, ADAS developers, validation and platform teams. 
 - Drive continuous improvement, automation and engineering productivity. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Robotics or related discipline. 
 - 10-12 years of overall Software Engineering experience. 
 - Minimum 8 years of hands-on C++ software development experience, with strong knowledge of modern C++. 
 - Strong experience developing large-scale, production-quality C++ applications or frameworks. 
 - Strong Linux application development, debugging and performance optimization experience. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading and software architecture. 
 - Experience technically leading software engineers while remaining hands-on with development. 
 - Experience with software development lifecycle, testing, CI/CD and software quality practices. 
 - Experience with HPC, cloud, parallel or distributed computing environments. 
 - Strong problem-solving, technical communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in ADAS, Automated Driving, automotive software or resimulation. 
 - Experience with camera, radar or LiDAR data and large automotive datasets. 
 - Familiarity with embedded systems and automotive software development. 

Why join us?

You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs. 

You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents. 

You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.

Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development); 

Life and accident insurance; 

Sodexo cards for food and beverages

Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events;

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on-advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies. 

Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

data.title: Senior Manager – Systems & V&V
data.description:
Job Description Summary

The Senior Manager - Systems & Verification Engineering will lead Systems and Verification & Validation organisation supporting CVUS digital products across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. The role owns system integration, system-level verification, test strategy and automation capability for the Digital portfolio, including the CVUS Digital Viewer. As a functional leader, this person will build and develop a high-performing team, strengthen technical capability and improve product quality and release predictability through automation-first verification practices. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

The Senior Manager - Systems & Verification Engineering will lead Systems and Verification & Validation organization supporting CVUS digital products across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. The role owns system integration, system-level verification, test strategy and automation capability for the Digital portfolio, including the CVUS Digital Viewer. As a functional leader, this person will build and develop a high-performing team, strengthen technical capability and improve product quality and release predictability through automation-first verification practices. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead and develop the CVUS Digital Systems and V&V organization in Bengaluru. 
 - 
 - Own system requirements, interfaces, workflows, integration strategy, system behavior and verification approach. 
 - Develop and execute system V&V strategies for on-premises, cloud and hybrid digital products. 
 - Define and evolve scalable test automation frameworks, tools and infrastructure for continuous, regression and release testing. 
 - Increase automation across API, integration, workflow, system, performance and end-to-end product testing. 
 - Ensure requirements traceability from customer and system needs through verification evidence and release readiness. 
 - Own system-level verification planning, execution, defect management, risk-based testing and quality assessment. 
 - Partner with Software Engineering, Architecture, Product Management and Clinical teams to build testability and quality into product design. 
 - Establish metrics for automation coverage, test effectiveness, defect leakage, regression health and release readiness. 
 - Partner with Quality, Regulatory and Cybersecurity teams to ensure verification evidence supports design controls, risk management and regulatory expectations. 
 - Build, hire, coach and retain strong Systems and V&V talent; own workforce planning, performance management, competency development and succession. 
 - Collaborate with global CVUS teams and communicate system quality, verification status, risks and release readiness to engineering leadership. 

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline. 

Required Qualifications

- 15+ years of progressive experience in software-intensive product development, systems engineering, verification and validation or related disciplines. 
 - 5+ years of functional engineering leadership experience, including people management, talent development, performance management and organizational capability building. 
 - Proven experience leading Systems Engineering and/or V&V teams for complex digital products. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining test automation strategies and implementing scalable automation frameworks. 
 - Strong experience in system requirements, interfaces, integration, verification planning, traceability, defect management and release-readiness assessment. 
 - Experience testing complex products across on-premises, cloud and/or hybrid environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle, system architecture, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD and automated testing. 
 - Proven ability to build teams, develop technical talent and drive execution in a global matrix organization. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills. 

Desired Qualifications

- Experience with medical-device, healthcare or other regulated digital products. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including DICOM, HL7 and FHIR. 
 - Experience with Azure, AWS or GCP and cloud-based system verification. 
 - Experience integrating automated verification into CI/CD and DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, design controls and risk-based verification. 
 - Experience modernizing manual V&V organizations towards an automation-first verification model. 
 - Demonstrated success improving product quality and release predictability using engineering metrics, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 

Common Engineering Expectations

- Cloud-native and hybrid cloud/on-premises product development using AWS services. 
 - Containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production observability. 
 - Secure engineering, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management and DevSecOps. 
 - Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery. 
 - Automated unit, integration, API, system, performance and reliability testing. 
 - Strong design, coding, debugging, root-cause analysis and technical documentation practices. 
 - Integration challenges of third party and second party SaaS solutions. 
 - Working with AI-DLC and software development acceleration. 

Healthcare And Medical Device Context

- Experience in regulated healthcare or medical-device development is required for the Verification Lead and strongly preferred for senior architecture, automation and program roles. 
 - Strong knowledge on SDLC, PRD process, Risks, FMEAs. 
 - Awareness of patient-data privacy, cybersecurity and secure handling of clinical information. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7 and FHIR. 
 - Experience with real-time clinical data, device connectivity, patient monitoring or high-availability clinical applications is advantageous. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. 

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership - always with unyielding integrity. 

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. 

#EveryRoleIsVital

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – QA
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - QA will help shape and evolve the organisation's quality engineering platform, enabling teams to build, test, deploy and operate software faster, more securely, and more reliably. The QA role will set the testing and quality standards helping to build test automation that can be adopted across platform and application teams. They will also mentor the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the test automation as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality strategy and architecture

- Define the platform quality engineering strategy, test pyramid and quality gates for all cloud platform products. 
 - Set standards for testing infrastructure-as-code: static analysis, policy-as-code, unit, integration and end-to-end tests for Terraform modules. 
 - Design ephemeral test environments that provision, validate and tear down platform stacks on every change. 

Continuous verification and automation

- Build shift-left quality into CI/CD: automated gates for security, compliance, cost and drift before merge and release. 
 - Establish contract and compatibility testing so module and API changes never break consuming business teams. 
 - Lead resilience and chaos testing for platforms. 
 - Drive performance and scale testing for self-service provisioning paths. 

GxP and computerised system assurance

- Modernise qualification from document-heavy validation to risk-based, automated Assurance. 
 - Generate qualification evidence (IQ/OQ traceability, test results, approvals) directly from pipelines. 
 - Partner with Quality, GRC and the CISO office to keep evidence audit-ready for GxP, SOX and data integrity requirements. 

Images, supply chain and security quality

- Own test frameworks for VM, OS, database and container image bakeries: CIS benchmarks, vulnerability thresholds, SBOM and signing checks. 
 - Integrate CNAPP and code scanning findings (e. g. Wiz, GitHub Advanced Security) into release gates with clear SLAs. 

AI and agentic platform quality

- Define evaluation frameworks for platform AI agents: accuracy, safety & guardrail 
 - Test agent-generated artifacts for correctness, policy compliance and blast radius before execution. 

Engineering leadership

- Set quality metrics and SLOs, report them to platform and security leadership, and drive corrective actions. 
 - Mentor engineers across platform teams; grow a quality-engineering community of practice. 
 - Evaluate and select tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software or platform engineering, with 3+ years leading quality or test engineering for tenant platforms at enterprise scale. 
 - Deep hands-on Terraform experience 
 - Strong policy-as-code skills around OPA/Rego 
 - Production experience on Azure and GCP; working knowledge of Kubernetes and GitOps 
 - Built CI/CD quality gates in GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar. 
 - Proficient in at least one of Python, Go or TypeScript for test frameworks and tooling. 
 - Experience in a regulated industry (life sciences, pharma, finance or healthcare), including GxP or equivalent validation. 
 - Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-based or agentic systems 
 - Familiarity with software supply chain standards: SLSA, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), Sigstore/cosign. 
 - Chaos engineering tools such as Azure Chaos Studio, LitmusChaos or Gremlin. 
 - Experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, Azure Arc or hybrid estates. 
 - Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, ISTQB Advanced or CKA. 

Leadership behaviors and ways of working

- Quality as an engineering discipline: builds automation and paved roads, not manual sign-off queues. 
 - Risk-based judgement: scales testing rigour to patient, product and data-integrity impact. 
 - Influence without authority: aligns platform, security, Quality and GRC stakeholders on shared standards. 
 - Hands-on credibility: writes and reviews code, and can debug a failing pipeline alongside the team. 
 - Clear communicator: turns quality data into decisions for senior leadership and auditors alike. 

#AGTech

Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Scripting, Serverless Computing, Software Frameworks, Software Testing, System Monitors, Test Automation, UI Test Automation, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Test Automation
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer to define automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and build engineering capability through reusable assets, coaching, and technical communities of practice. 

What You'll Bring

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 10 years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Mandatory: Systems-oriented Quality Engineer with a strong understanding of how products, services, and components interconnect; able to see the broader product architecture and decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on Automation Architect with advanced C# and . NET skills and a strong understanding of software design principles, dependency injection, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and extensible architecture. 
 - Mandatory: Hands-on experience architecting and developing REST API automation frameworks using RestSharp. 
 - Mandatory: Strong hands-on experience with NUnit or Selenium or playwright for test automation. 
 - Mandatory: Working knowledge of GraphQL (GQL) and experience validating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Mandatory: Solid understanding of test data management principles, strategies, and reusable data provisioning approaches. 
 - Mandatory: Strong awareness of Kubernetes and containerized test environments. 
 - Good understanding of communication protocols, particularly SIP, and hands-on exposure to SIPp for protocol-level testing. 
 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates. 
 - Proven ability to improve framework reliability, diagnose flaky tests, optimize execution, and drive adoption across multiple teams. 
 - Strong technical leadership, stakeholder communication, mentoring, and architecture decision-making skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Allure reporting is preferred. 
 - Experience with Postman is good to have. 
 - Experience with Azure, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, message brokers, observability platforms, and cloud-native test environments. 
 - Experience validating healthcare platforms, HL7/FHIR integrations, connected devices, or regulated software products. 
 - Knowledge of security, accessibility, performance, reliability, and resilience testing within a unified automation strategy. 
 - Relevant Microsoft, cloud, architecture, or testing certification is advantageous. 
 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC. 
 - Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, and container security tooling. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - Experience leading a team of automation testers toward a common goal. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

Overall Experience: 4-7+ Years

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Automation QA Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, Salesforce application testing, API testing, and quality assurance best practices. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions for Salesforce applications and integrations. 

The candidate should possess strong knowledge of Salesforce business processes, automation frameworks, regression testing, API validation, and CI/CD integration. The role will work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Salesforce Administrators, and QA teams to ensure successful delivery of high-quality Salesforce solutions. 

Day To Day Job Duties

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for Salesforce applications. 
 - Create reusable automation frameworks and test components to improve test efficiency and coverage. 
 - Execute automated functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Validate Salesforce functionality including standard and custom objects, Lightning components, Flows, validation rules, approval processes, profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules. 
 - Automate testing of Salesforce integrations and APIs using REST and SOAP services. 
 - Perform API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Develop automation solutions using Selenium, Playwright, Copado Robotic Testing, or similar tools. 
 - Create and maintain test data, automation utilities, and reusable testing assets. 
 - Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing. 
 - Analyze test failures, identify root causes, and collaborate with development teams to resolve defects. 
 - Prepare and maintain test plans, test strategies, automation scripts, test cases, and execution reports. 
 - Track and manage defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. 
 - Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and defect triage sessions. 
 - Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, release validation, and post-deployment verification activities. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation coverage and testing efficiency. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4-7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Automation Testing. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience testing Salesforce applications. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce platform concepts, including Objects, Relationships, Lightning Experience, Salesforce Flows, Validation Rules, Profiles, Permission Sets, and Security Models. 
 - Hands-on experience with automation testing tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or Copado Robotic Testing. 
 - Experience with test automation scripting using Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar programming languages. 
 - Experience with API testing and Salesforce integration validation. 
 - Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing methodologies. 
 - Experience working with Agile/Scrum delivery models. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. 

Core Technical Skills

- Automation Testing: Selenium, Playwright, Copado Robotic Testing
 - Salesforce Testing: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud
 - UI Testing: Salesforce Lightning Experience, Lightning Web Components (LWC)
 - Salesforce Configuration Validation: Objects, Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes
 - API Testing: REST, SOAP, Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI
 - Programming: Java, JavaScript, Python
 - Test Management: Test Plans, Test Cases, Automation Frameworks, Defect Management
 - DevOps & CI/CD: Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Continuous Testing
 - Tools: Jira, Azure DevOps, Git
 - Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, SDLC
 - Reporting: Test Execution, Defect Tracking, Quality Metrics

Nice to Have

- Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce Platform certification. 
 - Experience with Copado DevOps and Salesforce release management. 
 - Experience testing Salesforce integrations with external enterprise applications. 
 - Familiarity with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks such as Cucumber. 
 - Experience working with Salesforce APIs, middleware, and integration platforms. 
 - Exposure to performance, security, or accessibility testing. 
 - Experience with cloud-based testing platforms and test automation accelerators.

About Us

Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable healthcare management partner to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US-based healthcare company. 

With nine years of experience, we have developed and delivered end-to-end services in medical billing, A/R management, and other essential healthcare functions. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented professionals to join our team and contribute to our ongoing success. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Analyst with a strong background in International Voice Process Auditing. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years of experience in international calling, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience in call auditing. 

The role will be responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and improving the performance of customer service representatives in an international voice support environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring compliance with quality standards, enhancing customer satisfaction, and providing insights for continuous process improvement. 

Responsibilities

- Conduct daily audits of inbound and outbound international voice calls to evaluate agent performance against predefined quality parameters

 - Provide constructive feedback and coaching to agents based on audit findings
 - Collaborate with Team Leaders and Operations Managers to implement performance improvement plans
 - Ensure compliance with client-specific guidelines and internal quality assurance frameworks
 - Identify recurring quality gaps and recommend appropriate corrective actions
 - Identify critical errors and compliance issues and escalate them appropriately
 - Conduct quality calibration sessions with Operations and Training teams
 - Assist in developing training materials, SOPs, and quality benchmarks
 - Analyze quality trends and identify opportunities for continuous process improvement
 - Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports, performance summaries, and insights for leadership review
 - Support the implementation and continuous improvement of quality assurance processes and standards

Required Skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Strong listening, analytical, and attention-to-detail skills
 - Hands-on experience with call monitoring and quality scorecards
 - Good knowledge of MS Excel and reporting
 - Ability to provide effective feedback and coaching
 - Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills
 - Ability to work independently and consistently meet audit targets
 - Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and call monitoring systems
 - Ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally and provide constructive feedback
 - Experience with customer satisfaction metrics such as CSAT, NPS, FCR, and other relevant KPIs is a plus

Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's degree is required
 - Minimum 3 years of experience in International Calling
 - Minimum 2 years of experience in Call Auditing / Quality Assurance
 - Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, tools, and call monitoring systems
 - Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Healthcare, BPO, International Voice Process, or Customer Service
 - Knowledge of RCA, CAPA, calibration, and quality improvement methodologies
 - Experience working with international clients or US-based processes is preferred

Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion

Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We actively promote diversity across all aspects of our organization, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, and age. 

We strive to foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are embraced and everyone has equal opportunities to grow, contribute, and succeed. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary, including EPF and applicable statutory benefits
 - Health insurance
 - Four-day workweek (Monday-Thursday)
 - Opportunities for career growth and professional development
 - Additional benefits, including food and cab drop

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

For any queries, please feel free to reach out to us at recruitment@hupcfl. com. 

Note: Candidates must be available to take calls between 4: 45 PM and 3: 45 AM IST, Monday through Thursday.

About you and this role: 

As a Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Solution Specialist based in Mumbai your position is crucial for supporting Finance as we continue to expand and innovate the automation of financial work processes, leveraging both artificial intelligence and citizen development tools. 

In this role, you'll work closely with finance functional owners to lead the design, development, and testing of complex RPA solutions, ensuring they align with enterprise best practices. One of your key responsibilities will be supporting, maintaining, and optimizing the existing RPA portfolio within Finance, which means you'll play a vital part in ensuring stability, driving continuous improvement, and maintaining strong governance standards. 

Collaboration is at the heart of this position; you'll partner with business operations and business analysts to develop, streamline, and enhance workflow processes. Your initiatives will cover solution design, project coordination, testing, and issue resolution, all aimed at improving operational efficiency.

 - Design and deliver end‐to‐end automation solutions using UiPath and other approved enterprise technologies, ensuring solutions meet business needs and adhere to established development and governance standards.

data.description:
Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history:   www. spreetail. com.     

The Software Engineer II for Ads builds the data, analytics, and product experiences that help Merchants and Brands understand how advertising is performing and decide where to invest next. This role will strengthen the Ads experience across the customer-facing Brand Experience platform and the internal Merchant Station platform by turning complex advertising data and business logic into clear, actionable insights. 

Ads, together with DART and margin calculators, is a critical input into day-to-day Merchant decisions. The current Ads experience is one of the lowest-used areas in Brand Experience because it does not yet provide essential data, including keyword-level detail, or a compelling explanation of performance. This engineer will help overhaul that experience, support rapid proofs of concept, and build scalable capabilities that contribute to Merchandising's goal of generating $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support. 

What Success Looks Like

-     Delivers a significantly improved Ads experience in Brand Experience and Merchant Station, increasing engagement with a page that currently has the lowest usage on the platform

-     Provides Merchants and Brands with accurate, decision-ready advertising data, including keyword-level performance insights

-     Enables Merchants to audit advertising spend, explain the impact of Project Astra, and present a clear story about Spreetail's advertising strategy and results

-     Builds actionable recommendations that help Brands understand when and where additional advertising investment can create value

-     Runs focused proofs of concept quickly, incorporates feedback, and scales successful approaches into reliable product capabilities

-     Contributes to Merchandising's goal of securing $1 million in additional programmatic Brand support across Ads, Promotions, and Pricing Support

-     Improves the reliability, clarity, and usability of advertising data across both internal and Brand-facing workflows

Key Responsibilities

-     Design, build, test, and maintain full-stack features for Ads across Brand Experience and Merchant Station

-     Develop data services and visualizations that show advertising performance, spend, impact, and opportunities for action

-     Translate advertising strategy, Project Astra outputs, and complex business rules into clear product experiences for Merchants and Brands

-     Create keyword-level and other detailed views needed to diagnose performance and support investment decisions

-     Integrate advertising data into existing Merch Tech workflows while maintaining accuracy, freshness, and consistency

-     Partner with Merchants, Product, Design, Data, and engineering teammates to clarify user needs and prioritize the highest-value capabilities

This role combines deep expertise in foundation models, healthcare data standards, and serverless cloud architecture to create scalable, secure, and compliant AI solutions for healthcare organizations. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

AI/ML Engineering

- Design and implement production foundation model applications using prompt engineering techniques including structured output design, few-shot learning, function-calling patterns, and hallucination mitigation strategies
 - Build and optimize vector search solutions using OpenSearch Serverless with k-NN, including HNSW/IVF parameter tuning, hybrid retrieval (lexical + semantic), and multi-stage ranking pipelines (BM25 + dense + re-ranking)
 - Develop and deploy Amazon Bedrock solutions leveraging Claude family models, Titan Embeddings v2, and Guardrails for PHI/PII detection while optimizing for provisioned vs on-demand throughput
 - Implement classical ML pipelines including clustering algorithms (HDBSCAN, k-means), confidence score calibration (Platt scaling, isotonic regression), and model evaluation frameworks

Healthcare Data & Standards

- Design and implement systems that work with FHIR R4 resources, HL7 v2 message structures, and USCDI data elements

Backend & Infrastructure

Experience in large-scale mining operations would be highly advantageous.

data.title: Quality Consultant – Build a GxP QMS from Scratch (AI / SaaS)
data.description:
*** This is not a typical QA role. There is no QMS for you to maintain. You will build one. ***

Most QA roles ask you to follow, update and audit a quality system someone else designed. This one asks you to design, write, launch and own the Quality Management System of a regulated software business, from the ground up. And the QMS you build will run on a product we're building ourselves. If you've ever looked at a QMS and thought "I would have built this differently", this is your chance to do it. 

About us

Technopath Consulting is a niche UK consultancy specialising in process automation and AI. We help organisations rethink how work gets done, so that it's automated where it should be, intelligent where it helps and controlled where it matters. We're now building that expertise into our own products for regulated industries: 

- Route9: an application for computerised system validation and for document management, including review and approval. 
 - RoshamAI: our AI platform. 

Our offshore development centre, Rete BPO Services Pvt. Ltd. (RBS) in India, is home to our development and test team. This role is employed by RBS and works directly with Technopath's Director. 

What you'll build

- The QMS architecture: quality manual, quality policy and the full SOP set, covering document control, training, quality risk management, SDLC and CSV, change control, supplier management, deviations and CAPA, access and security, backup and recovery, data protection, release management, periodic review, internal audit, complaints and management review. Plus the forms, templates, registers and training matrix that make the SOPs work in practice. 
 - A QMS that runs on Route9: our own document review, approval and training workflows will run in Route9. You'll define how controlled documents, e-signatures, training and quality records must behave, and you'll see those requirements become the product. 
 - Quality inside an agile, cloud-native SDLC: risk-based CSV aligned with GAMP 5 (2nd edition) for SaaS products on Google Cloud with CI/CD pipelines. You'll define what a validated release looks like: validation plan, URS, specifications, risk assessments, traceability, IQ/OQ/PQ and release records. 
 - AI governance: how AI is assessed, evaluated, controlled and monitored when it's used in GxP work, both in our products and in our own processes, taking into account emerging expectations such as EU GMP Annex 22 and the EU AI Act. 
 - Supplier and partner assurance: qualifying our cloud providers and other critical suppliers. 
 - Audit readiness: an internal audit programme, management review and quality KPIs. You'll be our quality voice when customers audit us. 
 - Shaping Route9 from the inside: as our in-house quality and validation expert, you'll help make sure Route9 does what validation and quality teams really need. You won't be starting alone. We use AI heavily, including for first drafts. What we need from you is the judgement and experience to turn drafts into a working system that people actually follow and that passes audit. 

What you bring

- You have built a QMS from scratch at least once: at a start-up, a new site, a spin-off or a software vendor. This is essential; please tell us about it in your application. 
 - 6+ years in pharma, biotech, medical devices or GxP software quality. 
 - Strong working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ICH Q9 and data integrity (ALCOA+). 
 - Experience with computerised system validation, ideally of SaaS or cloud systems. 
 - You write clear, practical SOPs that people can follow, not documents that only auditors read. 
 - You've hosted or led audits (customer, supplier or regulatory). 
 - You're comfortable with AI tools and curious about how AI should be governed in regulated work. 
 - Excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to have

- Experience in a software vendor or SaaS quality role
 - Hands-on use of an eQMS or electronic document management system
 - ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO/IEC 27001 or ISO/IEC 42001 exposure
 - Lead auditor certification

This role is probably not for you if. . . most of your experience is executing test scripts or maintaining a QMS someone else designed. We value that experience, but this role is about building. 

What we offer

- Real ownership: your name on the Quality Manual
 - Influence on a product built for quality and validation professionals
 - Direct work with the Director, with no layers of management
 - Fully remote, anywhere in India
 - Full-time employment with RBS, or a long-term full-time freelance contract

To apply, send your CV with a short note (no more than one page) about a QMS you built from scratch: its scope, how many SOPs, how long it took to go live, and how its first audit went.

data.description:
Description

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line. 

Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it. 

What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience. 

You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates. 

Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities. 

Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion. 

Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them. 

Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership. 

Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises. 

Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases. 

A day in the life

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1: 1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

About The Team

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. You start your day with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, then a 1: 1. You unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review, and when North America comes online you take a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

Job Description - IP Digital Design Manager

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a team of IP digital design engineers while driving the successful execution of complex IP development programs. The role requires close collaboration with Architecture, Verification, Physical Design, DFT, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, and SoC Integration teams to ensure delivery of high-quality IPs that meet performance, power, area, quality, and schedule objectives. 

This position offers the opportunity to influence product roadmaps, establish engineering best practices, and contribute to the development of industry-leading semiconductor solutions.

Technology Background

Experience
