data.title: Head – Mechanical Engineering (Defence & Aerospace)
data.description:
Experience: 10+ Years

Location: Gurugram  

Department: Engineering / R&D  

Reporting To: CEO / Head of R&D

  

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Head - Mechanical Engineering to lead mechanical design, structural development, packaging, integration and qualification of complex systems for defence and aerospace programmes. 

The candidate will lead the mechanical engineering team, own key design decisions, coordinate manufacturing and outsourced engineering vendors, and take mechanical systems from concept through detailed design, prototype, qualification and production. 

Projects include Tethered aerostat and radar platforms, Underwater Communication Systems, AUV systems, UAV/avionics platforms and surveillance systems. 

Previous hands-on experience in defence, aerospace or military-grade engineering programmes is mandatory. 

  

Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Team Management

  

●        Lead and mentor mechanical design, structural and manufacturing engineers across multiple projects. 

●          Define system mechanical architecture, structural concepts, packaging philosophy and interface requirements. 

●          Allocate engineering activities and ensure project milestones, technical reviews and deliverables are achieved. 

●        Conduct concept, PDR/CDR, manufacturing and test-readiness reviews. 

●        Coordinate closely with electronics, RF, firmware, systems and manufacturing teams. 

●        Identify mechanical risks and drive technical decisions and corrective actions. 

  

Mechanical Design & Analysis

  

●        Lead/review 3D modelling, detailed drawings, GD&T, tolerance stack-up and engineering calculations. 

●          Design/review structural frames, payload enclosures, LRUs, equipment racks, brackets, housings, mounts and mechanisms. 

●        Perform/review structural, static, dynamic, vibration, shock and thermal analyses. 

●        Apply FEA for structural integrity, deformation, modal response, fatigue and optimisation. 

●          Ensure appropriate material selection considering strength, weight, corrosion, environment and manufacturability. 

●          Design ruggedised solutions suitable for airborne, naval, underwater and field-deployed environments. 

●          Ensure mechanical designs consider thermal management, ingress protection, sealing, vibration isolation and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Vendor Management

  

●          Coordinate with external vendors for machining, sheet-metal fabrication, composites, welding, casting, surface treatment and specialised manufacturing. 

●        Prepare technical drawings, manufacturing specifications, SOWs and acceptance criteria. 

●        Evaluate and review vendor designs, manufacturing processes, tooling and first-article components. 

●        Monitor vendor quality, timelines, manufacturing tolerances and delivery. 

●        Lead DFM/DFA activities and optimise designs for production, cost and repeatability. 

●        Support development of fixtures, jigs, assembly tooling and production documentation. 

  

Qualification & Reliability

  

●        Lead structural, environmental, vibration, shock, temperature and mechanical qualification activities. 

●          Experience with applicable defence/aerospace standards such as MIL-STD-810, JSS 55555, RTCA DO-160 or equivalent environmental requirements. 

●        Prepare/review qualification plans, test procedures, compliance matrices and test reports. 

●          Coordinate with certification, inspection and customer quality teams during qualification and acceptance. 

●        Conduct design FMEA, failure analysis and corrective-action activities. 

  

System Integration & Field Trials

  

●          Lead mechanical integration of electronics, sensors, antennas, payloads, power systems and other subsystems. 

●        Ensure interface compliance between mechanical, electrical and system-level assemblies. 

●        Support prototype assembly, system integration, field trials and qualification testing. 

●        Resolve mechanical issues identified during trials and customer acceptance. 

●        Maintain drawings, BOMs, interface documents, design calculations and configuration records. 

  

Mandatory Qualification & Experience

●        B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent discipline. M. Tech preferred. 

●          10+ years of mechanical product/system development experience, preferably in defence or aerospace. 

●        Minimum 3 years leading a mechanical engineering/design team. 

●        Prior experience working on defence/aerospace projects is mandatory. 

●        Strong hands-on mechanical design and engineering analysis capability. 

●        Expertise in 3D CAD and engineering drawings using SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX or equivalent. 

●          Strong understanding of GD&T, tolerance analysis, materials, manufacturing processes and assembly design. 

●        Experience with structural/thermal FEA using ANSYS, Abaqus, Nastran or equivalent tools. 

●        Experience taking products from concept through prototype, qualification and production. 

●          Prior involvement in environmental/structural qualification or certification of defence/aerospace equipment. 

●        Experience coordinating outsourced design and manufacturing vendors. 

Technical Knowledge

Candidate should have strong knowledge of: 

  

●        Structural design and load calculations. 

●        Static, dynamic, modal, vibration and shock analysis. 

●        Fatigue and structural reliability. 

●        Thermal management and heat-transfer fundamentals. 

●        Sheet metal, CNC machining, welding, composites, casting and additive manufacturing. 

●        Material selection including aluminium alloys, steels, composites and engineering polymers. 

●        Corrosion protection, coatings and surface-treatment processes. 

●        Environmental sealing, IP-rated enclosure design and ruggedisation. 

●        Lightweight design and structural optimisation. 

●        Mechanical packaging of electronics and avionics equipment. 

  

Preferred Experience

●        Experience with DRDO, HAL, BEL, DPSUs, Indian Armed Forces or defence OEMs. 

●          Mechanical development of UAVs, aerostats, radar systems, underwater platforms, surveillance systems or similar equipment. 

●        Experience with airborne structures, payload mounting systems and ruggedised equipment. 

●        Exposure to underwater pressure housings, watertight enclosures and corrosion-resistant design. 

●        Experience with composite structures and lightweight aerospace design. 

●        Knowledge of configuration management, defence documentation and production quality processes. 

  

Leadership Competencies

●        Strong engineering judgement and design-review capability. 

●        Ability to lead and grow a multidisciplinary mechanical team. 

●        Strong analytical and structured problem-solving ability. 

●        Effective vendor management and manufacturing coordination. 

●        Ability to manage multiple programmes and aggressive development schedules. 

●        Strong communication with engineering teams, customers and external partners. 

●        Willingness to travel for manufacturing reviews, integration and field trials. 

  

Critical Selection Criteria: Defence/aerospace project experience, strong mechanical design and analysis capability, team leadership, vendor management and prior qualification/testing experience are mandatory.

data.title: Head of Quality Control
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHead of Quality Control (QC)Company: DGZ Holdings

Business Units: Flavours of Calicut | Crizpo | DGZ Food Manufacturing LLP

Department: Quality Control / Quality Assurance

Experience: Minimum 10 Years

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Kerala, India

Reporting To: Management

1. Job SummaryWe are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Head of Quality Control to lead and oversee quality control and quality assurance operations across our food manufacturing units. The ideal candidate should have at least 10 years of experience in the food processing or FMCG industry, with strong expertise in food safety, quality management systems, regulatory compliance, product quality, and process improvement. 

The candidate will be responsible for establishing and maintaining quality standards across the entire production process, ensuring that all products meet applicable food safety regulations, company specifications, and customer expectations. 

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Quality Control & Assurance

- Lead and manage all Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) activities across manufacturing and packaging operations. 
 - Establish, implement, and monitor quality standards for raw materials, ingredients, work-in-progress, finished products, and packaging materials. 
 - Ensure consistent product quality, taste, texture, appearance, freshness, and shelf life across all product categories. 
 - Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality specifications, inspection checklists, and quality control plans. 
 - Monitor quality at every stage of production, from raw material procurement to finished product dispatch. 
 - Establish appropriate sampling, testing, inspection, and product release procedures. B. Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, and other relevant statutory requirements. 
 - Implement and maintain food safety management systems, including HACCP-based controls, GMP, and GHP. 
 - Lead internal quality audits, hygiene inspections, and compliance assessments. 
 - Coordinate with external auditors, regulatory authorities, certification bodies, and testing laboratories as required. 
 - Ensure proper documentation, traceability, batch records, and quality-related statutory records are maintained. 
 - Monitor sanitation, personal hygiene, pest control, storage conditions, and overall manufacturing hygiene. C. Raw Material & Supplier Quality

- Establish quality specifications and acceptance criteria for raw materials, ingredients, and packaging materials. 
 - Work closely with Procurement and suppliers to ensure the quality and consistency of incoming materials. 
 - Develop supplier evaluation, approval, and performance monitoring processes. 
 - Investigate raw material quality issues and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers. 
 - Ensure appropriate inspection and testing of incoming materials before approval for production. D. Production & Process Quality

- Work closely with Production, New Product Development (NPD), Procurement, Packaging, and Warehouse teams to maintain consistent product quality. 
 - Monitor critical process parameters and establish suitable controls to minimize product defects and variations. 
 - Identify quality deviations during production and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for recurring quality issues and implement effective solutions. 
 - Establish in-process inspection procedures and ensure adherence to approved formulations, processing methods, and product specifications. 
 - Support process improvement initiatives to reduce rejection rates, wastage, rework, and customer complaints. E. Product Testing & Shelf-Life Management

- Oversee product sampling, sensory evaluation, laboratory testing, and third-party testing where required. 
 - Coordinate microbiological, chemical, physical, and other relevant tests based on product risk and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish and monitor shelf-life validation procedures for new and existing products. 
 - Ensure appropriate packaging integrity, storage conditions, and product stability. 
 - Review test results and approve products for release in accordance with established quality standards and procedures. F. Customer Complaints & Corrective Actions

- Lead the investigation of customer complaints related to product quality, food safety, packaging, contamination, or shelf life. 
 - Identify root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Maintain a complaint analysis system to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities. 
 - Coordinate with Customer Support, Production, and other relevant teams to resolve quality-related concerns. 
 - Establish procedures for product withdrawal, recall, and incident management where necessary. G. Team Leadership & Training

- Lead, mentor, and develop the QC/QA team across manufacturing operations. 
 - Define team responsibilities, performance expectations, and quality-related KPIs. 
 - Conduct training sessions on food safety, hygiene, quality standards, documentation, and inspection procedures. 
 - Build a strong quality culture by promoting accountability and adherence to established processes. 
 - Ensure adequate staffing, training, and resources for effective quality operations. H. Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain accurate records of inspections, testing, non-conformities, audits, corrective actions, and product approvals. 
 - Prepare periodic quality performance reports for management. 
 - Track quality KPIs, including rejection rates, customer complaints, non-conformities, audit findings, and CAPA closure. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve product consistency, process efficiency, food safety, and operational performance. 
 - Support new product launches, formulation trials, packaging changes, and process validation in coordination with the NPD team. 3. Educational Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related discipline. 
 - Additional qualifications in Food Safety, Quality Management, HACCP, or related fields will be an advantage. 
 - Relevant certifications in ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, or Internal/Lead Auditing will be preferred. 4. Experience & Technical Requirements
 - Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Quality Control and/or Quality Assurance within food manufacturing, food processing, or FMCG. 
 - Demonstrated experience in managing quality operations at a manufacturing facility, preferably with multiple product categories. 
 - Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, food safety practices, HACCP principles, GMP, GHP, and quality management systems. 
 - Experience in handling internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, product testing, and quality documentation. 
 - Practical experience in root cause analysis, CAPA, risk assessment, and non-conformance management. 
 - Experience in supplier quality management, shelf-life studies, product validation, and customer complaint investigations. 
 - Previous experience leading and managing a QC/QA team is essential. 5. Key Skills & Competencies
 - Strong leadership and team management skills. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. 
 - High attention to detail and a systematic approach to quality management. 
 - Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Ability to identify potential quality risks and implement preventive measures. 
 - Strong documentation, reporting, and audit management capabilities. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced food manufacturing environment. 
 - High standards of integrity, accountability, and commitment to food safety. 
 - Ability to drive continuous improvement and establish a quality-focused work culture. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters: 

- Compliance with applicable food safety and regulatory requirements. 
 - Reduction in product rejection, rework, and quality-related wastage. 
 - Reduction in customer complaints and recurring product defects. 
 - Timely completion and closure of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Successful completion of internal and external quality audits. 
 - Consistency of product quality across batches and production units. 
 - Effectiveness of supplier quality monitoring. 
 - Timely completion of product testing and shelf-life validation. 
 - Effectiveness of QC/QA team training and performance. 
 - Accuracy and completeness of quality documentation and traceability records. 7. Ideal Candidate ProfileThe ideal candidate will be a hands-on quality professional who combines strong technical knowledge with practical manufacturing experience and leadership capability. They should be comfortable working closely with Production, NPD, Procurement, Packaging, and Warehouse teams while maintaining independent judgment on quality and food safety matters. 

The candidate must be proactive in identifying risks, resolving quality issues, strengthening food safety systems, and ensuring that quality standards are consistently maintained across all products and manufacturing operations. 

8. Application ProcessInterested candidates may submit their updated CV along with details of their relevant experience, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period. 

Email: hr@flavoursofcalicut. com

data.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world's most ambitious changemakers define the future. 

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. 

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of "shared innovation, seamless execution, " underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. 

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

This position sits within an agile data engineering team, owning the quality of end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through medallion-layer transformation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to BI/reporting consumption. The role suits someone who thinks like a data architect and builds/tests like an engineer, equally comfortable with pipeline design and hands-on SQL, PySpark, and automated data quality frameworks. 

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

The engineer independently owns the data testing strategy for their workstream, including a reusable SQL validation library usable for both manual and automated checks, and constructively challenges design or process decisions that risk data integrity or delivery quality. Works closely with Data Engineers, the QA Manager, Product/Project Managers, and business stakeholders. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Requirement, Project and Business Understanding (20%)

- Develop deep expertise in the data domain and business context source systems, transformation logic, medallion layers, and downstream BI consumption. 
 - Build a thorough understanding of the pipeline lifecycle (ingestion → staging → transformation → curated/BI layer). 
 - Review source-to-target mappings and transformation logic before test design begins. 
 - Support the team on data QA methodologies and processes, with guidance from QA leadership. Test Planning, Design, Execution, and Defect Management (35%)

- Own the data testing strategy across full, incremental, delta, and historical loads, including insert/update/delete/cancel and effective-dated transactions. 
 - Design and execute ETL/ELT validation, reconciliation, schema, null/completeness, and transformation test cases across the medallion architecture. 
 - Validate pipelines end-to-end source through Databricks/ADF/Spark to final BI output, confirming numbers, aggregations, and business logic tie out. 
 - Define and enforce data quality rules and build reusable checks; investigate anomalies and drive root-cause analysis with Data Engineers. 
 - Manage the defect lifecycle and prepare test evidence, quality dashboards, and RCA reporting for release sign-off.   SQL Script & Automation Engineering (20%)

- Build and maintain a structured, version-controlled Databricks/SQL validation queries usable standalone for manual checks and pluggable into automated regression/CI without rework. 
 - Own inline maintenance of the library: refactor as schemas evolve, retire obsolete checks, keep naming and parameterization consistent, and document each script's purpose, inputs, expected output, and edge cases so it stays usable by the wider team. 
 - Set up and maintain automated data testing frameworks (e. g. , Datagaps, PySpark-based checks) that consume the library for scheduled/CI-triggered runs. 
 - Work with Data Engineers to wire validation into CI/CD, ensuring failures surface with actionable, traceable output.   Collaboration (15%)

- Provide input into the test strategy mix (manual/automated/framework-driven) in partnership with QA leadership and data engineering. 
 - Constructively challenge decisions that risk data quality or testability and propose practical alternatives. 
 - Participate fully in agile ceremonies; raise risks and quality concerns early and clearly. 
 - Partner with the business to understand the wider data system and act as a quality partner for delivery.   Leadership (10%)

- Own data testing deliverables, including the health of the automation/SQL library, for the workstream. 
 - Lead or contribute to QA initiatives that raise the bar on data testing practice across the team. 
 - Mentor junior testers on ETL/data testing techniques, SQL standards, and automation tooling

ABOUT YOU

- Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with the ability to trace a data point end-to-end into its BI report representation. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with Azure SQL/Databricks/Apache Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data validation and transformation testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, linked services), Azure Storage (partitioning, Parquet/Delta), and third-party API integrations (e. g. , Salesforce, etc. )
 - Advanced SQL for backend validation and reconciliation across SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Databricks, with emphasis on writing maintainable, reusable, parameterized scripts. 
 - Working knowledge of Python for test scripting and validation automation. 
 - Practical exposure to ETL/data quality tools, Datagaps DataOps Suite (good to have), or equivalent (DQX, QuerySurge, Informatica, Talend, DataStage, SSIS). 
 - Ability to define and apply data quality rules systematically (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness).

Change the world. Love your job. 

Texas Instruments is seeking an Analog Design Manager. You may also evaluate final results of research and development projects to assure accomplishment of technical objectives. In addition, job functions include preparing and presenting reports outlining the outcome of technical projects and making recommendations for actions necessary to achieve desired results. As an Analog Design Manager, you may also select, develop, and evaluate personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function. 

We are looking for an experienced Design Manager to lead our Wide VIN Bucks design team focused on high-performance DC-DC buck regulators for industrial and automotive applications. 

The team owns the charter for all buck converters with input voltages above 60V and consists of 15 engineers. This role requires a strong technical leader who can drive execution across multiple parallel projects while mentoring and guiding a young, high-potential team.

Requirements

- Strong experience in analog/power management IC design with deep expertise in switching regulators and buck converters 
 - Proven track record of leading high-performing design teams and delivering complex products to market

Job Description

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment. 

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale. 

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm. 

J. S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

 - Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability. 
 - Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks. Collaboration, Reuse & Scale

- Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.

 - Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model. 
 - Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions. 
 - · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty. 

Qualifications

data.title: Director of Software Engineering
data.description:
About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner. 

With 6, 200+ active customers worldwide and a market-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45+ years of industry expertise with modern AI-driven execution - helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact. 

CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company. 

This role is part of our Graphic Communications business unit, which serves the global print and packaging industry with ERP and production software designed for commercial printers, packaging manufacturers, promotional and transactional print providers, sign and display manufacturers, and in-plant print operations. Our solutions help customers manage complex production environments, improve operational visibility, and deliver high-quality products efficiently and profitably. 

CAI India

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust. 

About the Role

CAI Software is seeking a Director of Engineering to join our Graphic Communications team in Bangalore, India. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with 20+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise products, ideally within the ERP or MIS domain. You'll stay technically engaged in architecture, design, and code-level decisions while providing strategic direction, mentoring engineering talent, and driving product modernization through AI-native development practices - equally comfortable in a design review, a customer conversation, or a hands-on coding session. 

What You'll Do

- Own and evolve the technical architecture for enterprise product lines, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with modern engineering practices
 - Stay actively engaged in the codebase, reviewing, prototyping, and contributing directly where needed rather than directing from a distance
 - Lead initiatives to modernize legacy enterprise, ERP, and MIS systems using AI-native development approaches such as AI-assisted coding, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation of legacy processes
 - Build engineering capability across the team through structured mentoring, technical coaching, and career development of senior and mid-level engineers
 - Define, track, and report on engineering KPIs (velocity, quality, release cadence, technical debt, adoption metrics) to drive continuous improvement and data-informed decisions
 - Partner directly with customers and stakeholders to understand real-world usage, pain points, and priorities, translating them into product and technical roadmaps
 - Manage, grow, and retain a high-performing engineering organization, fostering a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous learning
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management, QA, DevOps, and executive stakeholders to align engineering execution with business strategy

What We're Looking For

- 20+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise product development, with demonstrated depth in architecture, design, development, and delivery
 - Prior experience in ERP or MIS environments strongly preferred
 - Proven experience with a modern enterprise technology stack, including Java and . NET on the backend, React on the frontend, and PostgreSQL and/or Microsoft SQL Server
 - Demonstrated ability to operate across the full engineering lifecycle, from architecture and design through hands-on coding, code review, and production support
 - Strong track record of coaching and mentoring engineers at multiple levels of seniority
 - Experience defining and driving engineering KPIs and using data to guide technical and organizational decisions
 - Demonstrated customer-first orientation, comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders to shape technical and product direction
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance technical depth with business pragmatism
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices, such as AI coding assistants, agentic development workflows, or AI-native SDLC, is a plus
 - Direct experience modernizing legacy enterprise products using AI - for example, re-architecting monolithic ERP/MIS systems, introducing intelligent automation, or embedding AI capabilities into existing product lines - is a plus
 - Familiarity with modern DevOps/CI-CD practices and release engineering at scale is a plus

Why Join CAI

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6, 200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like - and we are building the team to lead that work. 

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers - and how we work: 

- Built to Fit - Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
 - Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays. 
 - Built to Deliver - AI turns action and insights into measurable performance. 
 - Built to Scale - Sustains and scales performance without disruption.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
data.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Our integrations sync sales, payments, payroll and supplier data from Toast into accounting platforms accurately and on time, so owners can close their books with confidence. 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer (P3) to build full stack features for Toast's Accounting Integrations team in Chennai. The team sits in the Suppliers & Accounting division and connects Toast to the accounting software our customers run their books on. This is a high-growth moment for the team. We're extending our integrations to support Toast's expansion into Retail, and partnering across lines of business with the Fintech team to power in-house bookkeeping through Toast Books. You'll work with Java, Kotlin, React and AWS, and use AI tools every day to ship faster and better. 

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

- Independently design and implement well-defined features across the full stack, from backend sync services to the merchant-facing setup and mapping UI, with minimal day-to-day guidance. 
 - Build and maintain backend services in Java and Kotlin that sync financial data (sales, payments, payouts, invoices, journal entries) from Toast to external accounting platforms. 
 - Build and consume RESTful APIs, and integrate with third-party accounting APIs and internal Toast systems, handling auth, rate limits, retries and idempotency. 
 - Develop frontend features in React with TypeScript, focusing on usability and performance for restaurant and retail operators. 
 - Deploy and run services on AWS, and use observability tools to monitor sync health and data accuracy. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Cursor, Devin) daily for coding, testing, debugging and documentation, and share what works with the team. 
 - Help explore and ship AI-powered capabilities in the product, such as smarter account mapping or automated reconciliation suggestions. 
 - Collaborate with Product, UX, QA and partner teams, including Fintech for Toast Books, to turn requirements into working software. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, testable code aligned with Toast engineering standards, and take an active part in code reviews. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues in owned areas, contribute to root-cause analysis, and support the team during critical phases and on-call. 
 - Deliver on commitments with predictable cycle time, and communicate progress, risks and dependencies early. 
 - Own components or features end-to-end within established architectural patterns, while growing toward larger system ownership. 

What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline
 - 6 to 9 years of experience in software or full stack development. 
 - Strong backend experience in Java, with hands-on Kotlin experience or a clear willingness to become productive in it quickly. 
 - Strong frontend experience with React (or Angular) and TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with a cloud platform, preferably AWS (e. g. , ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB).

 - Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design and query tuning. 
 - Familiarity with Gradle or Maven, Git and modern branching workflows. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to code quality and data correctness. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including with distributed teams across time zones. 
 - This is a hybrid role with 2 days per week in the Chennai office. 

What Will Help You Standout (Nice To Have)

- Experience integrating with accounting platforms such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, Sage Intacct, NetSuite or Restaurant365. 
 - Understanding of accounting concepts: chart of accounts, journal entries, general ledger, reconciliation. 
 - Experience building with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG) or agentic workflows in production. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, SQS/SNS) and resilient data sync patterns. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Background in fintech, payments, retail or POS domains. 
 - Experience in a large-scale SaaS or product engineering environment. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture. 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

data.title: Principal Compiler Engineer
data.description:
Location : Hyderabad

Experience Level : 8+Years

Skill Set : NPU - Compiler Role

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Compiler / Software Architect to join our NPU Hardware Architecture team and play a key role in the hardware-software co-design of next-generation AI inference accelerators. 

This is a unique role at the intersection of NPU hardware architecture, AI compilers, performance modeling, and software development. The position will work directly with hardware architects to define, evaluate, and prototype the software stack required to program current and future NPU architectures. 

Our NPU architecture is closely coupled with the compiler stack. Efficient utilization of the accelerator requires deep understanding of the hardware compute architecture, memory hierarchy, dataflow, scheduling, quantization, instruction set and execution model. The successful candidate will use this understanding to develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts, evaluate architectural proposals against real AI workloads, and influence the design of future NPU hardware. 

You will work closely with hardware architects, micro-architects, compiler engineers and AI software teams to answer a fundamental question: 

How should the NPU hardware and software be co-designed to deliver the best performance, power efficiency, programmability and scalability for real-world AI workloads?

What You Will Be Responsible For

Compiler & Software Architecture for NPU

- Develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts for current and next-generation NPU architectures. 
 - Define software abstractions and compiler flows that efficiently expose NPU hardware capabilities to AI workloads. 
 - Develop and evaluate compiler concepts including graph lowering, intermediate representations, operator mapping, scheduling, tiling, fusion, memory planning and code generation. 
 - Translate NPU architectural concepts into executable software models and demonstrate their feasibility using representative AI workloads. 
 - Develop lightweight compiler/runtime infrastructure to validate new hardware features before production software implementation. 
 - Analyze existing compiler limitations and identify architectural changes required to improve programmability and accelerator utilization. Hardware-Software Co-Design

- Work as an integral member of the hardware architecture team to co-design NPU hardware and software. 
 - Analyze how proposed hardware features can be effectively exposed through the compiler and software stack. 
 - Provide software-driven feedback on compute architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, dataflow, scheduling, instruction set and accelerator programmability. 
 - Identify hardware features that provide meaningful benefits to real AI workloads and challenge features that add hardware complexity without sufficient software value. 
 - Define compiler requirements and software abstractions for new NPU capabilities. 
 - Participate in architecture and micro-architecture reviews and influence hardware decisions from a software and workload perspective. 
 - Evaluate architectural trade-offs considering performance, power, area, compiler complexity and software scalability. 

AI Workload & Performance Analysis

- Analyze representative AI models and workloads to identify compute, memory, bandwidth, scheduling and data-movement bottlenecks. 
 - Build software-based performance models and workload prototypes to evaluate architectural concepts. 
 - Develop experiments to quantify the impact of proposed hardware features on model performance and accelerator utilization. 
 - Investigate issues such as quantization, sparsity, operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, data reuse, memory bandwidth and scheduling efficiency. 
 - Correlate software/model-level performance with architectural and micro-architectural behavior. 
 - Use workload analysis to guide both current-generation optimizations and next-generation NPU architecture. Architecture Prototyping

- Rapidly prototype software solutions for architectural concepts that may be months or years away from production silicon. 
 - Develop functional models, compiler prototypes, simulators, emulators, reference implementations or runtime abstractions as needed to validate architectural ideas. 
 - Demonstrate end-to-end execution of representative AI workloads on proposed NPU architectures. 
 - Build proof-of-concepts that allow hardware architects to make informed architectural decisions before RTL implementation. 
 - Help establish software models and interfaces that can later evolve into production compiler components. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Work closely with NPU hardware architects, micro-architects, RTL designers and the production compiler/software organization. 
 - Bridge the communication gap between hardware and software teams and translate requirements in both directions. 
 - Participate in architecture definition from early concept through implementation and silicon bring-up. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction for compiler-driven hardware/software co-design. 
 - Influence the roadmap of future NPU architectures through workload and software-driven insights. 

Necessary Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 

8+ years of experience in compiler development, systems software, computer architecture, AI accelerators, or a closely related area. 

Strong understanding of compiler architecture and compiler optimization techniques. 

Strong C++ programming skills and proficiency in Python. 

Strong understanding of computer architecture and familiarity with accelerator architectures, memory hierarchies and data movement. 

Experience analyzing AI/ML workloads and understanding performance bottlenecks. 

Ability to work across hardware and software boundaries and communicate effectively with hardware architects. 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate architectural ideas. 

Good to have

- Experience developing compilers or software stacks for NPUs, GPUs, DSPs, TPUs or other AI accelerators. 
 - Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TOSA, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR or similar compiler infrastructure. 
 - Experience with accelerator-specific scheduling, tiling, memory management or code generation. 
 - Understanding of NPU architecture concepts such as dataflow, tensor engines, systolic/array-based compute, local SRAMs, DMA/data movement and accelerator instruction sets.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - C++
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team responsible for one of X-Rite's strategically important desktop software products. This product plays a critical role in our customers' workflows and has a large installed base worldwide. 

The role combines maintenance and enhancement of an established Windows desktop application built primarily in C++. The successful candidate will contribute to new development, issue resolution, technical debt reduction, and ongoing modernization efforts while ensuring the stability and reliability expected by our customers. 

This position is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys working with complex software systems, understands the challenges of maintaining and evolving long-lived commercial products, and can balance short-term business needs with long-term technical improvements. 

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Application Support, and engineering teams across multiple geographies to deliver high-quality software solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality C++ with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Working extensively with Qt libraries, and multi-threaded programming to build robust and efficient applications
 - Configuring, building, and troubleshooting applications using CMake build systems and Visual Studio IDE. 
 - Identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex issues using debugging tools and performance profilers. 
 - Collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment using tools such as JIRA and similar tracking systems. 
 - Analyzing customer and business requirements and translating them into clear technical designs and formal software specifications
 - Conducting code reviews, providing technical feedback, and mentoring junior developers to improve overall code quality
 - Communicating technical concepts clearly through documentation, design discussions, and presentations
 - Continuously learning and adapting to new technologies, tools, and technology stacks as project needs evolve
 - Develop and expand automated unit and integration test coverage. 
 - Contribute to long-term roadmap activities aimed at improving the sustainability of the product platform. 

Required Qualifications & Professional Knowledge

- 4 - 8+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - Strong proficiency in modern C++ and object-oriented software design. 
 - Experience maintaining and evolving long-lived commercial software products. 
 - Experience working with large and complex codebases in production environments. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, multithreading, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience debugging complex software issues across multiple layers of an application. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Visual Studio, CMake, and Windows application development. 
 - Familiarity with source control systems, automated builds, testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking tools. 
 - Experience participating in Agile software development processes (Scrum and/or Kanban). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work effectively within globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience maintaining and extending mature or legacy software products. 
 - Experience modernizing existing software systems while maintaining backward compatibility. 
 - Experience with dependency management solutions such as vcpkg, Conan, or NuGet. 
 - Experience with automated testing frameworks and software quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience working in geographically distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Experience in Windows desktop application development. 

Nice to Have

- Experience working with hardware-connected desktop applications. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership mindset and accountability for delivering reliable, high-quality software. 
 - Pragmatic approach to balancing feature delivery, product stability, and technical improvement. 
 - Ability to understand and work effectively within existing software architectures before introducing changes. 
 - Curiosity and enthusiasm for improving long-standing systems through incremental modernization. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
 - Collaborative and effective communicator in cross-functional and globally distributed teams. 
 - Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across multiple time zones. 
 - Appreciation for the business value and customer impact of mature software products with large installed customer bases. 
 - Ability to balance short-term delivery priorities with long-term platform sustainability

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 
 - The opportunity to work on business-critical data platforms that support decision-making across the company. 
 - Be part of building products that address real-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value. 
 - Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America. 
 - A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. data.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology-enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization. 

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645, 000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1, 900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers. 

We're looking for an experienced Team Lead in Software Development to manage and support our teams developing and enhancing our DEX capabilities, trusted by large enterprise customers. In this role, you'll be essential to maintain a steady delivery cadence for the team, working with the different stakeholders (Product Management, Customer Support, Security, SRE) to ensure a clear prioritized Sprint backlog, and minimizing disruptions. You will translate high-level vision into working services. You will communicate status clearly to all stakeholders, surfacing risks and impediments as they arise, and identifying ways forward - and escalating to leadership as needed. You will also coach and mentor your team members, guiding them in their personal and technical improvement, providing appropriate and timely feedback. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Lead a cross-functional engineering team which focuses on maintaining and enhancing end-to-end services for our DEX solution deployed in Azure
 - Align the team's product roadmap in collaboration with Product Management

 - Work with the Product Owner/Product Manager to finalize the Sprint Backlog for each Sprint, by prioritizing the different workloads - Product (Feature) roadmap; Customer requests and Sustain cases; Security vulnerabilities; Technical Debt; ad-hoc work requests
 - Be the single point of contact for all stakeholders (Product Management, Customer Support, Security team, SRE, other engineering teams, etc) to prevent disruptions to the team members
 - Own all parts of the service lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing, tracking and operations
 - Continuously improve the product delivery process
 - Deliver software meeting highest quality in terms of usability, stability, performance and security 
 - Be responsible for the quality the product the team delivers, as well as their overall effectiveness
 - Utilize proven technical best practices to inspire and guide the team, ensure that their solutions can be used by other teams in an easy and flexible manner 
 - Ensure the personal and professional development of the team members to help them reach their full potential
 - Provide guidance in regards to technical, process, or method-related questions to the team, and enable and foster a culture of open feedback and communication

Requirements

- A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject
 - 10+ years of software development experience on Product Development (on C# . Net & SQL - experience in Azure is a plus), with at least 2 years as Team Lead / Team Manager for an Agile team
 - Experience contributing to cross-team initiatives, coordinating with other team leads and team members (both remote and in-person)
 - Comfortable with working in high-demand set-up and ability to prioritize execution, hands-on mentality
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
 - Experience partnering with product and user experience teams
 - Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top-10 vulnerabilities & remediation, and Threat Modeling 
 - Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
 - Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
 - A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines. 
 - A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
 - Technical background is a plus - experience in Docker, Kafka, DataBricks, ADO pipelines or Azure services (like AKS, Redis, Keyvault, EventHub, ServiceBus, SQL MI etc) 
 - Domain knowledge in end-user computing and/or DEX is a plus
 - Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages are a plus

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

The Product Structuring, Requirements & Interfaces Structure Leader is a strategic role focused on leading the transformation of Configuration Management and Systems Engineering practices for product structures. The role is accountable for standardization, requirements rationalization, interface definition, and plant system structuring across the product lifecycle. 

This leader will functionally guide a team of senior and lead Configuration Management professionals and will be responsible for setting the strategic direction for engineering standards, requirements management in PLM, plant system structure consistency, and MBE alignment. The role requires deep systems engineering knowledge, strong leadership capability, and the ability to coach teams and drive cross-functional execution across complex technical domains. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Configuration Management and Standardization Strategy
 - Lead the Configuration Management standardization strategy for product structures across the organization. 
 - Define and drive the future-state operating model for how engineering standards, requirements, and interfaces are structured and governed. 
 - Ensure consistency and scalability of configuration practices across product lines and lifecycle stages. 
 - Systems Engineering Transformation Leadership
 - Lead the Systems Engineering transformation of product structures in alignment with Systems Engineering 2030 principles. 
 - Establish and mature the system structuring logic that connects product definition, requirements, interfaces, and plant-level execution. 
 - Drive systems thinking behaviors within the Configuration Management community and across partner functions.

 - Lead the alignment of plant system structures with product structures and engineering standards.

 - Drive clear rules and practices for maintaining structural integrity across digital environments. 
 - Standards Management, Verification, and Audit
 - Develop and maintain the process for standards management, verification, quality measurement, and audit.

 - Act as a strategic resource for current system assessment, product structure rationalization, and requirements simplification.

Job Description

The Lead Software Engineer oversees the QA team and manages the end-to-end testing lifecycle including defect management and reporting. They are responsible for ensuring efficient testing processes, driving process improvements and providing leadership to QA personnel. 

As the Lead Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of software products through comprehensive testing methodologies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand product requirements, design test cases, and execute test plans to identify defects and ensure the highest level of product quality. Your expertise in manual & automation testing and test case development will be instrumental in delivering robust and user-friendly software solutions. 

Responsibilities

- Assign testing activities across the QA team. 
 - Provide directions to QA engineers and help to remove blockers. 
 - Ensure critical testing, regression, integration and UAT-support activities are adequately covered. Co-ordinate QA activities with development team, product owners and other stakeholders. 
 - Monitor progress and act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders regarding defect status and testing updates. 
 - Mentor and develop team members. 
 - Evaluate and integrate new tools and methodologies to enhance testing outcomes. 

Additional Responsibilities

Test Planning and Strategy: 

- Collaborate with product managers and development teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test plans. 
 - Design test strategies, including scope, approach, resources, and schedule estimation, to ensure thorough test coverage. 
 - Identify and prioritize test cases based on risk analysis and business impact. 

Test Case Development

- Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases and test scenarios based on functional specifications and user stories. 
 - Define test data and environment setup requirements for effective test execution. 
 - Maintain test case repositories and ensure documentation accuracy and completeness. 

Manual Testing

- Execute manual test cases to validate software functionality, performance, usability, and compatibility across different platforms and environments. 
 - Identify, isolate, document, and track software defects using bug tracking tools (Jira) and collaborate with development teams to resolve issues. 
 - Perform ad-hoc testing as needed to uncover unexpected behaviors and usability issues. 

Regression Testing

- Conduct regression testing to ensure the stability of software releases and verify that new features and enhancements do not adversely impact existing functionalities. 
 - Automate repetitive manual test cases where applicable to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. 

Quality Assurance

- Participate in peer reviews of test cases, test plans, and other testing artifacts to ensure quality standards are met. 
 - Continuously monitor and evaluate testing processes and methodologies to identify areas for improvement and optimization. 
 - Automated testing suites development
 - Develop and document scalable automated testing suites 
 - Convert manual tests to automated tests
 - Develop, document, run, and report on automatic tests

Required

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. 
 - Minimum 8 years of experience working with software testing methodologies, best practices, test automation, using tools like Cucumber, REST-assured, Selenium, Postman etc. 

Skills

- Minimum 8 years of experience testing and understanding complex engineering applications. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross-functional teams. 
 - Able to perform cross-browser/load/performance testing automatically. 
 - Experience writing Automated Tests using Selenium or any other kind of testing framework. 
 - Must be fluent in the English language, with a strong attention to detail. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex applications. 

Desired Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring and coordinating the activities of a software QA/testing team. 
 - Agile methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. 
 - XRay Test Management. 
 - Selenium. 
 - C# Programming. 

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics

- Gives and receives constructive feedback
 - Ensures that regular consistent communication takes place within area of responsibility
 - Ensures that important information from management is shared with employees and others as appropriate
 - Self-motivated, confident and passionate
 - Strong organizational and documentation skills
 - Provides vision and inspiration to peers and subordinates
 - Able to make decisions in conflicting situations
 - Should be comfortable with ambiguity
 - Able to manage a wide variety of discrete functions and services
 - Able to set priorities in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment

About Us

Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries. 

Overview

ABOUT THE TEAM

Since year 2003, Oceaneering's India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering's robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling & logistics. 

Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design & Animation, and more. 

In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety & Environment (HSE). 

Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy. 

At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in "Solving the Unsolvable" by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

Meet the Team

Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission-critical networks prior to Go-Live. We help Tier-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence. 

Your Impact

As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next-generation Service Provider Networks

- Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C-level and senior engineering leadership. 
 - Solution Validation & Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing of next-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS-XR 64-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness. 
 - Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full-scale, high-fidelity customer simulations in world-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment. 
 - Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity. 
 - Defect Advocacy & Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution. 
 - Pre-Sales & Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR). 
 - Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence. 

Decision Making & Scope of Impact

- Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements. 
 - Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go-Live success, network availability, multi-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier-1 accounts. 
 - Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards. 

Role-Specific Responsibilities

- Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies. 
 - Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR). 
 - Performance & Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence. 
 - Automation & Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines. 
 - Advanced Troubleshooting & RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions. 
 - Knowledge Transfer & Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education & Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10-15+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery. 
 - Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems. 
 - Consulting & Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior-level decision makers. 
 - Certifications: Expert-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing & Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired. 
 - Software & Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML). 
 - Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure environments. 

Preferred Technical Qualifications

Strong architectural understanding and hands-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas: 

- Service Provider Core & Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport & RON): 
 - Cisco SP Platforms
 - Operating Systems
 - Core Routing Protocols
 - Segment Routing & Traffic Engineering
 - Multi-Service VPNs & EVPN
 - SP Network Timing & 5G Sync
 - Routed Optical Networking (RON)
 - SP Resiliency & Security
 - SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability & Tooling:

Leadership & Autonomy

- Self-Direction & Initiative: Operates with high autonomy, determining methods and validation frameworks on strategic, high-visibility customer projects. 
 - Strategic Advisor: Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leadership and customers, translating strategic technology goals into actionable validation programs. 
 - Team Leadership: Champions innovation, leading internal initiatives to advance SVS testing capabilities, tooling, and delivery best practices. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
