Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience in designing, developing, and supporting scalable enterprise applications. The role involves building cloud-native solutions, developing modern web applications, and working across the full software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in . NET, Microservices, Azure/AWS, React/Angular, and modern engineering practices. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications. 
 - Build backend services using C#, . NET, and Microservices. 
 - Develop front-end solutions using React/Angular, JavaScript, HTML, and SCSS. 
 - Implement cloud-native solutions on Azure or AWS. 
 - Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Apply SOLID principles and design patterns to deliver high-quality software. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and mentor junior engineers. 
 - Support application performance, reliability, and production issues. 
 - Contribute to test automation using Playwright/Selenium.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI technologies.

 - Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, and distributed systems architecture. 

What's in it For You?

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

data.description:
Full-time

- Mangaluru, India
 - Senior leadership
 - Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

About Vinyl Equity

We're building the next generation of capital-markets infrastructure, starting with a modern, digital-native transfer agent designed for today's public companies. Our platform replaces slow, manual processes with secure, automated workflows - delivering the first API-driven, real-time infrastructure for public companies. 

Backed by Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Jump, MUFG, and Infinity Ventures, our team includes veterans from NYSE, Equiniti, Computershare, and AngelList. Our Engineering team is headquartered in Mangaluru. 

About The Role

As one of three engineering leaders reporting directly to the CTO, you will help shape the technical foundations and engineering capabilities that enable Vinyl to scale. You will own the shared technical layer that enables our application teams to build, deploy and operate securely at scale. This is one of Vinyl's first senior leadership hires, and you will sit on the engineering leadership team. 

You will lead this layer through its functional managers and technical leads, with direct reports across Cloud Infrastructure, Security & IT, Data Products, Evaluation Engineering and Platform Services, along with a Senior GRC Business Analyst shared across the platform organization. 

You'll inherit established teams in some of these functions and build others from the ground up, hiring and growing the organization as Vinyl scales. Vinyl stays intentionally lean, so you'll remain hands-on in the areas you're building while setting direction, driving outcomes and shaping how the platform organization evolves. 

This is an in-office position in Mangaluru, India. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own Cloud Infrastructure, setting standards for AWS provisioning, cost, reliability, observability, disaster recovery and business continuity. 
 - Own Security & IT, setting security standards across access, secrets, vendor access, audit readiness and security operations. 
 - Own Data Products, hiring and leading its technical leadership, and building the data and applied AI capabilities supporting analytics, regulatory requirements and shareholder intelligence. 
 - Own Evaluation Engineering, establishing evaluation, QA and production-readiness standards across application and platform engineering, including AI-assisted and automated work. 
 - Hire and lead the team responsible for Platform Services, covering AuthN/AuthZ, the common API and communication stack, digital signatures, and the frontend platform. Establish the architecture, standards, and operating practices that enable application teams to build and ship efficiently and securely.

What Success Looks Like

- Cloud Infrastructure: Reliable, scalable and cost-efficient infrastructure with strong observability and operational resilience.

 - Data Products: Trusted data capabilities that support analytics, regulatory requirements and applied AI use cases. 
 - Evaluation Engineering: Consistent quality and production-readiness standards across application and platform engineering. 
 - Platform Services: Shared capabilities that reduce complexity and enable application teams to build and ship faster. 

In your first 6 months: 

- Leaders in place, or hiring underway, for every function, including Data Products and Platform Services. 
 - Baselines for each measure below agreed with the CTO. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: uptime and production incidents tracked against the agreed baseline. 
 - Security & IT: open audit findings tracked and closing, with access reviews and secrets management in place. 
 - Data Products: data quality measured on every regulatory report. 
 - Evaluation Engineering: evaluation coverage measured on application and platform releases. 

In your first 12 months: 

- Each measure above reaches its agreed 12-month target. 
 - Application teams ship faster, with time saved tracked and reported quarterly. 

You are accountable to the CTO for the reliability, security and quality of the platform. 

Across the platform, you establish clear ownership, strong technical standards and scalable practices that enable the application layer to move faster without compromising reliability, security or quality. 

Role Requirements

- 18+ years in engineering, including at least 5 years leading managers or function leaders across infrastructure, security, data or quality engineering. Candidates with 15+ years will be considered where the scope has been exceptional. 
 - Strong technical depth in infrastructure, data platform, security engineering or related domains, with a hands-on foundation. You should be comfortable contributing individually while setting direction, hiring talent and growing teams. 
 - Direct, end-to-end ownership of a production data platform, with sufficient infrastructure and security depth to lead those functions through their technical leaders. 
 - Prior experience working in a small, resource-constrained company or lean team, where you've operated with greater individual ownership than a similar role at a larger company would require. 
 - Comfortable operating in a regulated, high-integrity financial-services environment where infrastructure, data, or security mistakes are genuinely costly. 
 - Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 

Nice to Haves

- Transfer agency / registrar / SEC 17Ad / DTC / DTCC experience. 
 - Experience building security engineering or data platform capabilities from the ground up. 
 - AI-assisted engineering experience. 
 - Experience at a company of a broadly similar size (well under 100 people). 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation based on experience
 - Equity participation
 - Comprehensive health insurance (self + family), wellness and meal benefits
 - A high-ownership opportunity to shape the technical foundations of a modern capital-markets platform and influence how engineering scales across the organization. 
 - Modern, AI-first engineering environment - Claude is a first-class tool here, not an afterthought

This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Your Role At Baxter

The role of Verification & Validation Engineer II is to independently Verify and Validating the device with minimal / no supervision. In addition to providing technical support and service in these areas, the incumbent may also perform the following functions: requisitioning, defining, initiating, specifying, documenting and training. 

This position is based out of Bangalore and reporting to the V&V Manager for PSS/GSS unit of HST. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Author, Execute, perform, summarize, report out verification & validation test activities of components to a full system device: Which includes but not limited to: 
 - Test Plans, Test Procedures, User and Functional Requirements testing, 
 - Installation/Operational/Performance Qualification Protocols, 
 - Support compliance/ closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before completing Design Outputs/ Program Deliverables. 
 - Support the qualification of lab area, productivity improvement efforts, including testing, building fixtures, calibration and data collection. 
 - Diagnose, isolate and investigate problem reports. Drive product improvements and/or bug fixes. 
 - Works with external test houses (such as EMI (Electromagnetic Interference), EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility) tests for electrical boards and full device) to define the test scope, author the test plans, test procedures, execute & consolidate the reports. 
 - Ensure good documentation and Good Manufacturing practices are followed in the Verification and Validation Process
 - Participate in continuous improvement activities by supporting the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives
 - Participate in Verification and Validation development process improvement and test automation. 
 - Maintains awareness of current regulatory trends and their impact on the Verification and validation status of equipment and processes. 
 - Support the SMEs on Regulatory responses and Audits, as needed
 - Adheres to Baxter Quality Management system & supports the quality audits. 
 - Presents the findings / objective evidence and able to present with rationale with applicability / exclusions
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective / Preventive action as needed. 

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bio-Medical, Industrial Engineering or related field
 - 3 to 7 years of experience in Verification and validation testing of Software, hardware and System. 
 - Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in electro-mechanical, electrical, or software testing
 - An understanding of test methods and processes as well as the methods used to verify product in the realms of; software, mechanical, electrical, functional and environmental testing environments. 
 - Experience in - writing system, subsystem-level and module level verification and validation plans, procedures, Test Execution and Test report generation
 - Understanding of hardware and software product design methodologies and test practices. 
 - Familiarity with reliability theory and analysis as it pertains to test quantities derived from reliability. 
 - Experience in medical device or similar product development, design verification/validation, system integration (involving software & hardware), risk management, reliability engineering, process validation and Quality systems

data.title: Mathematics Quality Assurance Lead (QAL)
data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Mathematics Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across mathematics AI training projects. You will review AI-generated math content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for mathematical accuracy, logical reasoning, calculation correctness, proof validity, notation quality, clarity, formatting, instruction-following, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong mathematics expertise, strong English communication skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote technical teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your mathematics quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that math training data is accurate, logically sound, clearly explained, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check mathematics items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Mathematical review: Evaluate AI-generated math explanations, proofs, derivations, calculations, word-problem solutions, diagrams/descriptions, and step-by-step reasoning for correctness and clarity. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, quality expectations, and math-specific review standards. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around reasoning validity, notation, assumptions, solution methods, proof structure, formatting, and rubric interpretation. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain mathematics project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, calibration tasks, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and mathematics-specific review requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply mathematics guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Error-pattern analysis: Identify recurring issues such as skipped reasoning steps, invalid simplifications, wrong formulas, notation inconsistencies, arithmetic mistakes, or answers that are correct but poorly justified. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for mathematics AI training projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics Education, or a closely related quantitative field. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear mathematical feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in mathematics, teaching, tutoring, research, quantitative analysis, technical writing, curriculum development, problem creation, assessment design, or math-content review. 
 - Strong understanding of core mathematics topics such as algebra, geometry, trigonometry, calculus, linear algebra, discrete mathematics, probability, statistics, number theory, combinatorics, differential equations, and mathematical proofs. 
 - Ability to evaluate math content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as incorrect assumptions, flawed reasoning, invalid proofs, calculation errors, notation problems, missing steps, hallucinated facts, or incomplete explanations. 
 - Comfortable reviewing both conceptual explanations and step-by-step solutions, including whether each step logically follows from the previous one. 
 - Familiarity with mathematical tools or workflows such as LaTeX, Python, MATLAB, R, WolframAlpha/Mathematica, GeoGebra, Desmos, spreadsheet modeling, or symbolic computation tools is preferred. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, educators, technical writers, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, calibration tasks, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, mathematical content QA, or rubric-based LLM evaluation is a strong plus. 
 - Native fluency in Punjabi

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Revolutionize Enterprise ERP Systems as an AI Engineer

Are you a forward-thinking AI practitioner driven to push the boundaries of Generative AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation within enterprise systems? Trimble is seeking a high-caliber AI Engineer to join our Construction Management Solutions (CMS) team in Chennai. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will work hands-on across our premier ERP product suite, architecting and embedding state-of-the-art AI capabilities utilizing Azure OpenAI, modern foundation models, and vector search frameworks to shape the next generation of construction technology. 

About Us

Dedicated to the world's tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www. trimble. com

About Our Division: Construction Management Solutions (CMS)

As an industry leader in construction software and ERP solutions, Trimble CMS empowers contractors worldwide. We connect the office, team, and field by seamlessly integrating core business functions like construction accounting and project controls with jobsite execution. Powered by modern cloud architectures and partnerships, we help global organizations prototype, validate, and scale AI-powered solutions to enterprise grade. 

What Makes This Role Great

We embrace a talent-led culture where success is defined by technical ingenuity and creative exploration. In this role, you will not simply consume standard APIs-you will architect, prototype, and scale groundbreaking Generative AI capabilities that have never been built before in construction ERP. Working out of our Chennai engineering hub alongside some of the sharpest minds in software development, data science, and product design, you will possess end-to-end technical autonomy to take AI features from initial zero-shot experimentation all the way to global production releases. 

Key Exciting Responsibilities

- AI Architecture & End-to-End Delivery: Design, develop, and deploy production-ready AI solutions across our ERP platform ecosystem, managing the full development lifecycle from exploratory prototyping to enterprise-scale deployment. 
 - LLM Engineering & Framework Integration: Build robust Generative AI workflows utilizing LangChain, Azure OpenAI, and foundational LLMs, integrating vector search databases to ground AI outputs in proprietary enterprise data. 
 - Advanced Prompt & Context Engineering: Engineer complex multi-step prompts and optimize zero-shot and few-shot techniques to power personalized recommendations, intelligent document processing, and natural language workflows. 
 - Model Evaluation & Hyperparameter Tuning: Rigorously evaluate LLM performance, fine-tune model parameters, optimize latency and token economics, and establish interpretability standards for reliable web application integrations. 
 - Cross-Functional Product Roadmap Influence: Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and integration engineers to identify high-value customer problems and translate them into AI-driven product capabilities. 
 - Continuous Technology Exploration: Stay ahead of the curve across rapidly emerging AI/ML breakthroughs, agentic frameworks, and new model iterations, evaluating their application within enterprise construction workflows. 

Essential Skills & Experience

- Professional Experience: 6+ years of dedicated professional experience in Machine Learning and AI engineering, with a proven track record of architecting, deploying, and maintaining production-grade AI solutions.

data.title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
data.description:
Req ID: 393047

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. 

We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). 

Job Description

About this role: 

Wells Fargo is seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead technical research, design, coding, implementation, and execution for Research and Systems Engineering (RSE). This role is ideal for a senior engineer who can move from strategy and architecture into working code, technical prototypes, test environments, and proof-of-concept solutions. The Principal Engineer will evaluate emerging technologies by building and testing them, determine how they can operate within Wells Fargo's available platforms, architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, and engineering constraints, and provide expert recommendations grounded in direct technical evidence. 

In this role, you'll be expected to personally develop prototypes, write and review code, design technical solutions, configure and integrate technologies, execute tests, troubleshoot issues, and document findings. You'll work closely with architects, platform owners, security and risk partners, and engineering teams to understand what is currently available within Wells Fargo, identify gaps or limitations, and determine whether a technology can be adopted, adapted, integrated, or should not move forward. Success requires strong engineering depth, curiosity, disciplined experimentation, sound technical judgment, and the ability to convert proof-of-concept results into practical implementation guidance. 

In this role, you will: 

- Lead hands-on design, coding, configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation for RSE research and proof-of-concept initiatives. 
 - Build working prototypes and reference implementations that validate technical feasibility, integration requirements, performance, security, resiliency, operability, and enterprise applicability. 
 - Write production-quality or near-production-quality code, automation, APIs, scripts, infrastructure definitions, test harnesses, and integration components needed to evaluate new technologies. 
 - Design and execute structured proofs of concept with defined technical questions, success criteria, assumptions, test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and measurable results. 
 - Install, configure, and test emerging technologies in approved environments using the platforms, tools, services, access models, and infrastructure available within Wells Fargo. 
 - Evaluate how proposed technologies align with Wells Fargo architecture, engineering standards, security controls, risk requirements, network patterns, identity and access models, data requirements, observability capabilities, and support processes. 
 - Identify technical gaps, constraints, integration challenges, required exceptions, operational impacts, and dependencies that may affect enterprise adoption. 
 - Provide expert, evidence-based recommendations on whether a technology should be adopted, adapted, integrated with existing capabilities, further tested, or not pursued. 
 - Translate proof-of-concept outcomes into implementable designs, reference patterns, reusable code, technical decision records, test evidence, runbooks, and engineering guidance. 
 - Partner with architects to validate target-state designs and ensure proposed patterns can be implemented within existing enterprise capabilities and constraints. 
 - Work directly with engineering teams to demonstrate solutions, resolve implementation issues, review code and designs, and guide the transition from experimental work to supported delivery. 
 - Guide platforms toward standard implementation models by developing reusable components, common APIs, automation patterns, integration approaches, and reference configurations. 
 - Perform technical comparisons of products, frameworks, platforms, and architectural approaches using repeatable evaluation criteria and hands-on testing. 
 - Conduct performance, scalability, reliability, failure, security, interoperability, and operational-readiness testing appropriate to the technology being evaluated. 
 - Prototype and evaluate capabilities across RSE focus areas, including artificial intelligence, accelerated computing, GPU infrastructure, integration services, automation, operating systems, image lifecycle, OpenShift, platform engineering, and modernization technologies. 
 - Lead technical execution across the full experimentation lifecycle, from research and environment setup through design, build, test, findings, recommendation, and transition. 
 - Create clear white papers, opinion papers, executive briefs, architecture diagrams, code examples, test results, and technical recommendations based on hands-on findings. 
 - Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews, technical workshops, demonstrations, and practical implementation guidance. 
 - Anticipate technical obstacles, lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, and make informed tradeoffs across feasibility, business value, risk, cost, delivery speed, and long-term sustainability. 
 - Stay current on emerging engineering technologies and continuously test their relevance against Wells Fargo's current and future enterprise ecosystem. 

Required Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education. 
 - 7+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience. 
 - 7+ years of hands-on software development, systems engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or architecture implementation experience. 
 - 5+ years designing, coding, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting complex enterprise applications, platforms, infrastructure services, or distributed systems. 
 - 5+ years creating technical prototypes, proofs of concept, reference implementations, automation, or reusable engineering components. 
 - Experience evaluating new technologies within enterprise architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, operational, and support constraints. 
 - Experience developing in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent languages. 
 - Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, APIs, infrastructure automation, observability, and technical documentation. 
 - In-depth knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies, including cloud, virtualization, containers, operating systems, networking, storage, security, automation, or distributed systems. 

Desired Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated ability to independently take an emerging technology from initial research through environment setup, coding, integration, testing, evaluation, and documented recommendation. 
 - Experience building proof-of-concept solutions using Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud or hybrid infrastructure, artificial intelligence platforms, GPU or accelerated computing, automation frameworks, operating systems, or platform services. 
 - Experience with RESTful APIs, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, CI/CD, containers, image pipelines, policy automation, telemetry, and platform integration patterns. 
 - Experience designing test plans and executing functional, integration, performance, scalability, reliability, failure, security, and operational-readiness testing. 
 - Ability to assess technical feasibility and enterprise fit using direct evidence rather than vendor claims or conceptual analysis alone. 
 - Experience producing reusable code, reference designs, technical decision records, implementation guidance, runbooks, white papers, and executive recommendations. 
 - Ability to explain constraints and tradeoffs clearly to architects, engineers, product partners, risk stakeholders, platform owners, and senior leaders. 
 - Strong code review, design review, debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Strong mentoring and technical leadership skills, including pairing with engineers and leading practical workshops or demonstrations. 
 - A hands-on research and engineering mindset with a focus on practical experimentation, disciplined execution, enterprise compatibility, and measurable technical outcomes. 

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D. 

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client's needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata. com, @nttdatafed. com and @talent. nttdataservices. com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https: //us. nttdata. com/en/contact-us. 

NTT DATA endeavors to make https: //us. nttdata. com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https: //us. nttdata. com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. For Pay Transparency information, please click here.

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality. 

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market. 

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us. 

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come. 

Reports To

Senior Software Engineering Manager

What You Will Be Doing

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer for our Fleet Operations (FleetOps) team. In this role, you help shape, build, and sustain our fleet management platform. This platform manages depot charging, vehicle management, trip planning, and charge optimization for commercial EV fleets. You will work on reliable microservices that support our product roadmap. This role requires practical experience in software development. This includes feature design, coding, unit testing, automated verification, and deployment

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

You participate in feature development and team initiatives. 

You deliver tasks from planning through production release. 

You help build backend services across the FleetOps platform. Examples include depot management, vehicle management, and charge schedule services. 

You collaborate with team members and cross-functional partners, such as Product, Support, and Quality teams, to clarify requirements and resolve technical issues. 

You with AI assistance build clean, tested code that directly supports business goals, such as depot charging schedules and vehicle reliability. 

You take ownership of assigned features through the development lifecycle. This includes development, automated testing, deployment, and monitoring. 

You write unit and integration tests for your code changes. 

You use AI test tools to validate changes before you deploy them to production. 

You participate in code reviews, write clear documentation, and uphold team engineering standards. 

Requirements

- 3+ years of professional experience in backend software development. 
 - Hands-on experience with JVM languages, such as Java or Kotlin. 
 - Working experience with the Spring Boot framework and relational databases. 
 - Basic experience with, or exposure to, message streaming tools (such as Apache Kafka) and container tools (such as Docker and Kubernetes). 
 - Working experience with at least one cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related STEM field. 
 - strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, to improve personal productivity while maintaining code quality. 
 - Active interest in multi-agent workflows and automated development practices. Personal/Leadership Attributes
 - Communicate technical choices clearly with facts and data.

 - Show curiosity, learn new frameworks quickly, and experiment with modern AI developer tools. 
 - Adapt to changing requirements and welcome feedback from peers and leaders

Bangalore, India

You will be responsible for building, testing, and debugging emulation models while developing innovative tools and environments to improve verification efficiency. Your contributions will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver high-quality silicon solutions, ensuring precision and reliability in cutting-edge chip designs. Business Group As part of Intel Corporation, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to advancing the design and validation of system-on-chip (SoC) and intellectual property (IP) products. The group focuses on enabling efficient emulation environments, fostering collaboration across design, validation, and software teams, and supporting Intel's broader goal of delivering world-class silicon technologies. Key Responsibilities - Build emulation models from RTL designs using synthesis, partitioning, and routing tools. - Develop, integrate, test, and debug hardware and software collateral in simulation and emulation models. - Create and optimize hybrid emulation environments and develop directed tests to support verification. - Interface with verification teams to enhance presilicon verification methodologies and test suites for emulation efficiency. - Develop automation aids, flows, and scripts to streamline emulation utilization. - Debug failing RTL tests and improve usability on emulation platforms. - Collaborate across teams for SoC/IP bring-up, root-cause analysis, and emulator environment issues.

Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication or related field with 6-12 yrs of experience Experience in Emulation Model Builds and Debug Experience in ZeBu or Veloce or Palladium Emulation Platforms Experience in RTL code debug [Verilog preferred] Experience in Reset and Boot debugs at SoC level designs Programming skills: Python, C/C++, Perspec, Verilog Good multi-tasking skills Team-player, great communication skills Preferred Qualifications - Familiarity with Synopsys tools and emulation platforms like Zebu or HAPS. - Knowledge of Intel CPU architecture or x86 architecture. - Exposure to system-level emulation-based verification and virtual platforms. - Strong collaboration, problem-solving, and communication skills. We encourage you to bring your expertise and passion to a role where you will make a meaningful impact on the future of technology. data.title: Head of Industrials Innovation
data.description:
Interested in a career that matters?

Interested in a career that matters?

Are you passionate about turning biotechnology and scientific innovation into solutions that create measurable value for customers and industry?

As Head of Industrials Innovation, MEIA, you will lead our regional innovation agenda for industrial biosolutions. You will work at the intersection of science, industrial processes, customer needs and commercial opportunity, leading a team of scientists to identify new applications, accelerate technology adoption and turn promising technical concepts into validated, scalable commercial opportunities. 

The Role & Your Impact

You will shape and drive the Industrials innovation pipeline across MEIA, connecting scientific capabilities with customer challenges and growth opportunities across BioEnergy, Grain and Sugar Processing, Oils and Fats, and other industrial segments. 

Your key responsibilities will be to: 

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of scientists, setting clear priorities, coaching talent and strengthening scientific, customer and commercial capabilities. 
 - Build a strong innovation culture that encourages curiosity, collaboration, ownership and disciplined execution. 
 - Lead the regional Industrials innovation pipeline, identifying, assessing and prioritizing new applications and growth opportunities. 
 - Accelerate new technologies from concept to commercial scale, spanning application development, customer validation and value demonstration. 
 - Connect technical performance with customer value, translating scientific outcomes into process improvements, economic impact and compelling commercial opportunities. 
 - Strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing across customers, R&D, Technical Services, Marketing, Sales and global teams, while building reusable capabilities that advance innovation across MEIA. 

What You'll Need to Be Successful

To succeed in this role, you will bring: 

- A Master's degree or PhD in biotechnology, microbiology, biochemical or chemical engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Around 10+ years of relevant experience in industrial biotechnology or process industries. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing technical or scientific teams. 
 - The ability to combine people leadership, technical depth and commercial thinking. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional innovation or technology programs. 
 - Strong customer orientation and stakeholder management skills. 

Above all, you are a leader who brings out the best in people while connecting science, customer needs and business opportunities to create scalable growth. 

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage: 

- Biofuels or biogas
 - Sugar or grain processing
 - Oils and fats
 - Biomass processing
 - Related industrial biotechnology applications. 

What We Offer

This is an opportunity to lead a regional scientific team and shape how industrial biosolutions move from promising ideas to customer-validated opportunities. You will collaborate across technical, commercial and global teams while building capabilities and knowledge that strengthen innovation across MEIA. 

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity's biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It's how we've gotten so far. And it's how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. 

Opportunities for everyone

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying. 

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status. 

Explore Other Openings

If this position isn't the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You're welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis. com/Career

data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Kannada Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Kannada AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Kannada content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Kannada and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Kannada quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Kannada training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Kannada items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Kannada wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, regional variation, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Kannada project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Kannada-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Kannada language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Kannada-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics
 - Native or near-native Kannada proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Kannada writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Kannada grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Kannada content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus.

You're Our Person If. . .

Preferred Certifications

Unleash Your Potential

At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. Projects will include mobile and web applications that integrate data from drones, sensors, LiDAR, AI, and rugged field equipment.  - Experience building systems that operate in offline or low-connectivity environments.

- Experience working with LiDAR, GIS systems, sensors, or real-time data capture technologies.

What To Expect

This role blends architecture, hands-on development, and real-world problem solving. You will work closely with both technical teams and field personnel, requiring adaptability and a willingness to operate in evolving and sometimes ambiguous environments. 

Expect To

- Collaborate across business, operations, and engineering teams

Physical Requirements And Environment

Ceres provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants with sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. The physical requirements listed below reflect the essential functions of this role. If you need accommodation to perform these functions, please inform us during the application process.

At Ceres India, you won't just have a job, you'll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters. 

We Offer

data.description:
About Company

InfoStride is a certified firm serving various federal, state, local, and county departments, primarily in IT consulting and services. A Texas-headquartered technology solutions company with offices in Mohali and Noida, India, and an international presence in Canada and Dubai. An AWS Consulting Partner and CMMI Level 5 Certified organization, InfoStride specializes in IT services, healthcare technology, data engineering, software development, and digital transformation. Led by CEO Ms. Ritu Mangla, the company delivers innovative, scalable technology solutions to global clients, emphasising quality, collaboration, and technological excellence. 

PFB the JD for the Java Developer role: 

Experience: 4 to 8 years

Timings: 10: 30 am to 07: 30 pm

Location: Mohali (Sec-83)

Industry - Financial Services

Role overview

We're looking for a Java Developer with strong backend skills and experience building calculation-heavy, finance-related applications. 

Key responsibilities

- Design, build and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. Break requirements into modules, write the code end to end, and keep it maintainable as features grow. 
 - Build secure, well-structured REST APIs with proper request validation, error handling, status codes and versioning. Document APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI so other teams can use them easily. 
 - Write clean, readable and testable code that follows SOLID principles and team coding standards. Refactor older code when needed and keep technical debt under control. 
 - Implement business logic for multi-step calculations such as rates, slabs, percentages, fees, rebates and penalties. Make sure every result is accurate, repeatable and easy to trace. 
 - Implement double-entry postings, map each transaction to the correct finance/account codes, and handle reversals, refunds and adjustments without breaking ledger balances. 
 - Write and optimise complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and reports. Design tables and indexes that keep data consistent and queries fast as volume grows. 
 - Write unit and integration tests for all business logic, with extra focus on calculation edge cases and boundary values. Keep test coverage high so changes can be released with confidence. 
 - Investigate and fix production issues, including calculation or data mismatches. Do root-cause analysis and put permanent fixes in place, not just workarounds. 
 - Take part in code reviews, sprint planning and technical discussions. Work closely with QA, business analysts and finance teams to clarify rules and confirm expected results. 

Required skills and experience

- 4-8 years of hands-on Java development (Java 11 or later; Java 17 preferred), with at least 2 years on enterprise or transaction-heavy applications. 
 - Strong command of OOP concepts, Collections, Generics, Multithreading and concurrency utilities, Exception Handling, Streams and Lambdas. Able to explain why one approach is better than another, not just use it. 
 - Solid experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate and Spring Security. Understands dependency injection, bean lifecycle, profiles and configuration management. 
 - Has built and consumed RESTful services, including authentication (JWT/OAuth2), validation, pagination and global exception handling. Has integrated with third-party APIs such as payment gateways or banks. 
 - Strong SQL on PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL - complex joins, subqueries, window functions, indexing, stored procedures and query tuning using execution plans. 
 - Clear understanding of ACID, isolation levels, optimistic and pessimistic locking, and idempotency. Knows how to prevent duplicate entries and race conditions in multi-user systems. 
 - Uses BigDecimal correctly for money, with defined scale and rounding modes. Knows why double/float must not be used for financial values. 
 - Understands ledgers, journal entries, debits and credits, chart of accounts and finance code structures. Can translate a finance rule into correct and testable code. 
 - Writes unit tests with JUnit 5 and Mockito, and integration tests for APIs and database layers. Comfortable with test-driven thinking for logic-heavy code. 
 - Comfortable with Git branching, Maven or Gradle, Jenkins or other CI/CD tools, and basic Linux commands for deployment and log checks. 
 - B. Tech / BE / MCA in Computer Science, IT or a related field. Good to have

- Experience splitting applications into microservices, with service-to-service communication, API gateways and service discovery. 
 - Hands-on work with Kafka or RabbitMQ for async processing, event-driven flows and reliable retries. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes and deployment on cloud platforms, with Azure preferred (AWS or GCP also fine). 
 - Using Redis to speed up frequently read data and reduce database load. 
 - Generating documents and reports with iText, Apache PDFBox or JasperReports. 
 - Basic React knowledge, enough to work smoothly with the front-end team and debug integration issues.

data.title: Assamese Team Lead
data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as an Assamese Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Assamese AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Assamese content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Assamese and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Assamese quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Assamese training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Assamese items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Assamese wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Assamese project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Assamese-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Assamese language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Assamese-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Assamese, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Assamese proficiency with strong reading and writing skills.

For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines. 

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging.

data.title: Technical Head – Sampling & Development
data.description:
About Evolv

Evolv Clothing is a Chennai-based apparel manufacturing powerhouse with over 50 years of deep expertise in precision garment manufacturing for leading European and American brands. Recognized for quality, consistency, and product excellence, Evolv specializes in value-added apparel manufacturing, blending craftsmanship with innovation and technology. 

With advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong global partnerships, and a commitment to sustainable and compliant production, Evolv is strengthening its position as a preferred apparel manufacturing partner for UK, European, and global fashion brands. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior Technical Head to lead the Sampling and Development function. The role requires strong technical expertise and a thorough understanding of the products we manufacture, along with the leadership to deliver sampling and development programs that meet customer expectations, quality standards, and delivery timelines. 

The Technical Head will own technical evaluation, product feasibility, and sampling execution end to end. Working closely with customers and internal teams, the role resolves technical challenges, makes sure product requirements are clearly understood before sampling begins, and builds the technical capability of the garment technician team. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Review & Product Feasibility

·    Analyse customer tech packs, sketches, specifications, measurement charts, construction details, and workmanship requirements to fully understand each product. 

·    Assess product feasibility against garment construction, fabric and trim behaviour, wash-finish requirements, and technical risks. 

·    Identify technical gaps early and recommend practical construction or process solutions before sampling begins. 

·    Provide technical inputs for costing, including construction methods, SMV, and fabric consumption. 

·    Translate customer requests into technical garment development solutions, ensuring design feasibility and product functionality. 

·    Coordinate closely with design teams on fabric selection, trim compatibility, garment detailing, and construction techniques. 

·    Understand the characteristics of different fabric categories and determine suitable trims, construction techniques, and finishing methods for each garment. 

·    Evaluate fabric suitability and identify appropriate garment construction approaches based on design requirements and end-use. 

·    Explore and develop new avenues in garment development across design, technical, and construction aspects, considering fabric characteristics, trim selection, and garment feasibility. 

Sampling & Development Delivery

·    Lead the sample room and development team so that all samples are completed and submitted within agreed timelines. 

·    Plan sample room capacity, workload, and priorities across customers and seasons. 

·    Conduct fit sessions, review fit comments, and drive pattern and construction corrections. 

·    Review and sign off every sample against customer specifications and quality standards before submission. 

·    Track sample status, approvals, comments, and revisions, and reduce the number of sample rounds per style. 

·    Drive seasonal garment development in collaboration with design teams, aligning product concepts with collection requirements. 

·    Lead sampling and technical development activities to translate garment concepts into production-ready samples. 

·    Prepare and develop garment lines for seasonal collections in coordination with the Technical Head, Sampling, and Development teams. 

Customer Liaison & Technical Ownership

·    Act as the senior technical point of contact for customers on construction, specifications, feasibility, and development concerns. 

·    Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams. 

·    Take full ownership of technical issues and coordinate merchandising, pattern, sampling, production, and quality teams to resolve them within customer timelines. 

·    Escalate risks to sample quality or delivery proactively and ensure closure with all stakeholders

Sampling-to-Production Handover

·    Lead pre-production (PP) meetings and ensure complete technical handover from sampling to bulk production. 

·    Be present on the production floor to support the line on technical issues during bulk, so that issues solved in sampling do not recur in production. 

Team Leadership & Capability Development

·    Guide, coach, and train garment technicians to upgrade their technical skills and problem-solving capability. 

·    Identify skill gaps across the technical and sampling teams and run structured, hands-on training. 

·    Set technical standards and SOPs for sampling, tech pack interpretation, and measurement checks. 

·    Set KRAs for the team, review performance, and build accountability for quality and timelines. 

Key Performance Indicators

·    On-time sample submission rate

·    Right-first-time sample approval rate and average sample rounds per style

·    Technical issues carried from sampling into bulk production

·    Measurable skill improvement across the garment technician team

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

·    10-15 years in garment technical, sampling, or product development roles within export apparel manufacturing for UK, European, or US brands. 

·    Must have led a technical or sampling team including garment technicians

·    Hands-on experience with product categories Women's, Kid's and Men's Woven Wears, including tech packs, fit sessions, and sample development. 

·    Proven experience handling customer technical discussions and feasibility issues directly. 

Technical & Functional Skills

·    Expert knowledge of garment construction, specifications, measurements, workmanship, and fabric and trim behaviour. 

·    Strong understanding of patterns, fit, sewing operations, washes/finishes, and testing requirements. 

·    Ability to evaluate SMV, construction methods, and consumption for costing inputs. 

·    Strong troubleshooting and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple development programs at once.

data.title: Principal Hardware DFT Lead
data.description:
We are looking for a Principal HW DFT Engineer who will architect, implement, and validate NXP's Automotive grade products. You will be responsible for advanced test strategies and implementation, verification and validation of pre/post tapeout of DFT features, overall test coverage improvements, and work closely with RTL and physical team on DFT timing constraints and closures. 

Main Job Tasks And Responsibilities

- Architecture & Strategy: Define and implement advanced DFT strategies, including Scan Architecture, JTAG, Memory BIST (MBIST), and Logic BIST (LBIST)
 - Implementation & Verification: Lead the integration of digital subsystems, perform scan insertion, and generate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns while ensuring high fault coverage. 
 - Silicon Support: Drive post-silicon validation and debug activities to root cause failures and improve manufacturing test efficiency. 
 - Collaboration: Coordinate with physical design and test engineering teams to ensure timing closure and that test patterns are operational immediately upon silicon arrival. 

Minimum Required Qualifications

- Education: B. S. /M. S. Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degrees)
 - Experience: Typically requires 10+ years of industry experience in SoC DFT implementation, verification, static timing closure, test coverage analysis and improvement, and silicon bring-up on ATE
 - Tool Expertise: Proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools from Mentor Graphics/Siemens (Tessent), Cadence, or Synopsys
 - Technical Skills: 
 - DFT - Scan insertion and architecture, ATPG: Proficiency in generating test vectors to detect manufacturing faults like stuck-at, transition, and advanced faults, Built-In Self-Test (BIST): Integration of Memory BIST (MBIST) for embedded SRAM/ROM and Logic BIST (LBIST) for autonomous logic testing, Boundary Scan & JTAG, Test Compression: Implementing techniques to reduce test data volume and application time, which is critical for large System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. 
 - Hardware Design & Implementation - HDL Proficiency: Strong command of Verilog or SystemVerilog for modifying RTL to insert test logic and writing test wrappers. Timing & Constraints: Knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) and creating DFT-specific timing constraints (SDC files) to ensure test logic does not degrade functional performance. 
 - Verification & Debug - Simulation: Conducting gate-level simulations (GLS) and verifying DFT logic for correctness before fabrication. Post-Silicon Debug: Analyzing silicon data from Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to diagnose failures and improve manufacturing yield. 
 - Software & Tool Proficiency - EDA Tool Suites: Mastery of industry-standard tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Mentor Graphics Tessent, and Cadence Modus. Scripting & Automation: Expertise in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate test insertion flows, run simulations, and parse coverage reports.

 - 8+ years of experience in Systems Integration, Validation, or Test Development 
 - Experience with embedded systems validation and firmware testing 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++ 
 - Strong debugging skills across hardware and firmware

Company Overview

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world's communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications. 

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world's most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner. 

MaxLinear began by developing the world's first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn't achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we've developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we've expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel's Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers' needs. 

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore. 

We have approximately 1, 200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph. D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

- Architect, design, and implement DFT strategies for complex, high-performance SoCs and AI accelerators. 
 - Take complete ownership of tool flows, scripting, and debug constraints for assigned DFT domains. 
 - Collaborate closely with RTL design, synthesis, and post-silicon validation teams to ensure seamlessly integrated test structures. 
 - For Senior/Lead roles: Mentor junior engineers, drive DFT architecture definition, and lead chip-level test closure. 

Required Technical Expertise (Any one or multiple techniques)

We are looking for solid, fundamental mastery in any one or a combination of the following techniques and flows: 

- Scan & ATPG: Classic Scan insertion, Compression methodologies, and complex ATPG (Stuck-at, Transition, At-Speed, Cell-Aware). 
 - Memory BIST (MBIST): Industry-standard MBIST insertion, repair algorithms, and integration. 
 - Logic BIST (LBIST): In-system test architectures, especially crucial for automotive or high-reliability chips. 
 - Boundary Scan (BSCAN): Classic IEEE 1149. 1 JTAG architecture, implementation, and board-level test support. 
 - IJTAG: Deep understanding of IEEE 1687 infrastructure, instrument integration, and pattern retargeting. The Plus Factors (Highly Valued)

- Hands-on experience with SSN (Streaming Scan Network). 
 - Direct experience handling AI / Machine Learning Chip architectures. 
 - Advanced multi-die/chiplet test standard experience. Core Candidate Requirements

- Deep Architecture Understanding: You must possess a strong, bottom-up conceptual understanding of the techniques you have worked on. You should be able to explain the underlying logic, tool command behavior, and structural debug choices deeply. 
 - Exceptional Logical & Communication Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities with the ability to articulate complex technical challenges and solutions clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Tool Flow Proficiency: Mastery over major industry-standard toolchains (Synopsys TestMax/DFTMAX/TetraMAX, Siemens Tessent suite, or Cadence Modus). 
 - Genuine Passion: We are looking for engineers who are genuinely fascinated by the VLSI test domain and want to master it for the long term. Why Apply?

- Work on cutting-edge, complex silicon architectures. 
 - Collaborative environment prioritizing technical excellence over bureaucratic process. 
 - Direct path to becoming an industry-recognized DFT expert in India. 

How to Apply: 

Genuine and passionate candidates only. If you match the location requirement (Bangalore) and are ready to tackle deep technical challenges, please submit your updated resume highlighting your specific domain expertise (e. g. , Scan/ATPG, MBIST, JTAG, SSN) and your current notice period status. 

Email - prabhu. p@acldigital. com

Job Title: Supplier Quality Engineer

Location: CCPL Engineering, Navi Mumbai

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on quality engineering in medical devices, pharma, aerospace or automotive industry

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to own product quality across our orthopedic surgical instrument manufacturing business. In this role, you will drive first-pass yield up and customer rejects down. You will lead root cause investigations, close the gap between our inspection results and our customers' incoming inspection, and work closely with our manufacturing partners to raise the quality of the parts we receive from them. 

Please find more information about the company here: https: //ccplengg. com/

Key Responsibilities: 

·            Candidates should possess skills in Supplier Evaluation and Supplier Quality to assess and qualify manufacturing partners. 

·            Supplier quality: Own incoming inspection of partner shipments; qualify and audit machining and finishing partners, run first article inspections, verify material certifications (ASTM F899, A564) and manage supplier corrective actions. 

·            Partner process control: Get control plans, PFMEA, in-process checks and SPC in place at partner sites for critical features, so defects are caught at the source. 

·            Reduce rejects and improve yield: Track first-pass yield, scrap, rework and customer rejects by part and supplier; lead projects that measurably bring them down. 

·            Root cause and CAPA: Lead structured investigations (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa) into nonconformances and customer complaints; own corrective actions through to verified effectiveness. 

·            Drawing and GD&T review: Review customer drawings per ASME Y14. 5 before production; flag unspecified dimensions, ambiguous datums and malformed callouts with the customer up front. 

·            Quality system: Keep our processes and records aligned with ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR (21 CFR 820) expectations as a registered contract manufacturer - NCR/MRB, device history records, document control and audit readiness. 

·            Customer communication: Act as the technical quality contact for international customers - investigation reports, SCAR responses and clear written updates. 

  

Required Qualifications: 

·            B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field. 

·            At least 5 years of hands-on quality engineering experience in medical device, pharmaceutical equipment or aerospace manufacturing. 

·            Strong command of GD&T (ASME Y14. 5) and reading complex engineering drawings. 

·            Proven record of quality projects that increased throughput or reduced rejects, with numbers to show for it. 

·            Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal. 

·            Ability to work on multiple projects across different industries. 

Preferred Skills: 

·            Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or a Lean manufacturing certification. 

·            Experience working within a customer's quality system as a supplier or contract manufacturer. 

·            Experience with orthopedic instruments or implants, and stainless steel (420, 17-4 PH, 465) or titanium parts. 

·            Supplier quality engineering experience, driving improvement at external manufacturers. 

Perks & Benefits: 

·            A high-impact role with direct ownership of quality outcomes for Global medical device customers. 

·            The chance to shape CCPL's supplier quality program and how we work with our manufacturing partners. 

·            Work in a collaborative, close-knit team with direct access to leadership. 

·            Competitive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks, with strong potential for career and salary growth. 

Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday - 10: 00 - 18: 00

Ability to commute/relocate: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Production Engineering/Industrial Engineering or related field

Experience: 5+ years in quality engineering - medical device, pharma, aerospace or automotive manufacturing

Language: English (required)

Work Location: In person, with periodic visits to supplier sites

In your cover letter, describe one quality improvement project you led and the results it delivered.
