data.title: Principal Scientist Neutral Atom QPU
data.description:
About QPiAI India Pvt. Ltd. 

QPIAI India Pvt. Ltd. is a next-generation technology company focused on Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Computing, and advanced IT innovation. At QPIAI, we believe that great ideas grow in the right environment. Our culture is built on flexibility, collaboration, and continuous learning, supported by a strong commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance. We provide a workplace that encourages creativity, fosters professional growth, and empowers people to take ownership of impactful projects. 

We are proud to be a company where innovation meets opportunity-where passionate professionals come together to solve complex challenges and shape the future of technology. If you are driven by curiosity, inspired by cutting-edge technologies, and eager to contribute to a global tech journey, QPIAI is the place to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact. 

About the Role: 

A Neutral Atom Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) Designer is a specialized research scientist or hardware engineer responsible for designing, building, and optimizing quantum hardware that uses individual neutral atoms (often rubidium, cesium, or ytterbium) as qubits. They work at the intersection of atomic physics, quantum optics, and engineering to create scalable, error-corrected quantum systems. This is a leadership role, where you will be directly reporting to the CEO and strategize the data centre strategy with neutral atom QPUs integrated to Superconducting QPUs and classical compute

Core Responsibilities: 

- Team building and infra setup: To build a team of neutral atom QPU designers and build infrastructure for neutral atom QPU
 - Cross-functional interaction: To lead interaction with the Superconducting QPU design team to enable integration of the neutral atom Quantum computing system with the superconducting QPU in a data centre environment
 - Hardware Design & Implementation: Designing, prototyping, and testing experimental setups for trapping, cooling, and manipulating neutral atoms using laser beams (optical tweezers) and vacuum apparatuses. 
 - Qubit Control: Developing high-fidelity control techniques, such as Rydberg excitation, to enable quantum gates and entanglement between atom qubits. 
 - System Architecture: Developing "error-tailored" architectures to improve the scalability of neutral atom processors, aiming to scale from hundreds to thousands of physical qubits. 
 - Error Modeling: Conducting experiments to understand, characterize, and mitigate noise and errors (e. g. , atom loss, laser noise) in neutral-atom physical operations. [
 - Translating Theory to Practice: Translating theoretical concepts in quantum computing, such as surface codes, into practical, physical experimental setups. 

Required Skills and Qualifications: 

- Education: PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Atomic/Molecular/Optical (AMO) Physics, or a related field. 
 - Technical Experience: Hands-on experience building neutral atom experiments, including experience with ultra-high vacuum (UHV) systems, lasers, and optics. 
 - Programming: Strong capabilities in Python for hardware control, simulation, and data analysis (e. g. , NumPy, SciPy). 
 - Scientific Contribution: A track record of peer-reviewed publications or contributions to the field of quantum technology. 

Context within Industry: 

- Goal: To move neutral atom computing from scientific prototypes to commercial-grade, fault-tolerant quantum computers. 
 - Collaboration: Working closely with quantum algorithm teams to improve gate fidelity and with software teams to optimize hardware-level instructions (pulse sequences).

data.title: QA Lead /SDET Lead
data.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. 

TTEC Digital seeks a QA/SDET Lead to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Automation-first quality engineering for a platform combining voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI
 - We emphasize AUTOMATION - we do not do manual QA here
 - Weekly code deploys are the heartbeat: when a QA branch is ready, regressions run fast, results report fast, and the train doesn't wait
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, fail fast, move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- Quality strategy across the 1-week cadence as surface area grows 
 - The cross-service contract suite gating production
 - Future (phase 2) QA hires
 - Sets the automation patterns by shipping them; raises the QA engineers around you
 - Automation coverage for your squads' services
 - Fast-turnaround regression suites gating weekly deploys
 - Rapid detection and reporting
 - Quality signal in minutes, not days
 - Load/stress coverage for your services' latency budgets 
 - Your committed timelines

Who you are: 

- Keeps the respect of senior engineers through technical credibility; comfortable telling a tech lead their branch isn't ready - and delivering that fast, with data
 - Show-me mentality on committed timelines: quality visible in every Friday demo, never the bottleneck
 - Chaos/failure-injection mindset - kill a service, drop the bus, flap the network; prove the platform degrades gracefully. Self-starter with grit and a show-me mentality
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love new technology, adapt fast when the stack changes under you, and use AI tools daily to multiply velocity - including AI-assisted test generation
 - A team player who likes winning, and a partner to dev, not a gate: when something breaks, you help the dev team isolate it fast. 

What You Will Bring: 

- The QA/SDET Lead role builds upon our Senior QA/SDET profile by adding team leadership responsibilities. This is a player-coach position where the individual leads the quality engineering function while remaining hands-on with framework design, automation architecture, and the team's most complex technical challenges. 8+ years QA/SDET; you have built a test-automation foundation from scratch for a fast-shipping product - you'll build ours before scaled module QA exists. 
 - Master issue-isolator and root-cause debugger - you narrow a failure to the service, the commit, the event; dev teams love your bug reports because they're half the debugging done. 
 - Fast regression discipline - parallelized suites, smart test selection, results in minutes; quality at weekly-deploy speed without becoming the bottleneck. 
 - Comfortable in high-load testing environments - load, stress, and soak testing of high-throughput, low-latency systems; you know how to find the knee of the curve. 
 - Experience testing event-driven systems, WebSocket flows, and browser extensions - ordering, race conditions, real-time state. 
 - CI-native mindset - tests wired into trunk-based CI/CD; flake management as a first-class discipline (a flaky suite is a broken suite). 
 - Contract/API testing between services; synthetic data and traffic generation (simulated calls, event streams, audio) for repeatable real-time testing. 
 - Testing AI outputs - eval-style assertions for non-deterministic LLM/ML features - a strong plus.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Job Description - Senior / Lead Machine Learning Engineer (AI/ML)

Company: Saradysol Tech Ventures Private Limited

Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior / Lead Machine Learning Engineer who combines strong AI/ML expertise with excellent communication, technical leadership, mentoring skills, and end-to-end ownership. 

You will translate business problems into practical AI solutions, design architecture, develop production-ready systems, and guide engineers throughout delivery. The ideal candidate can work independently, make informed decisions, explain complex concepts clearly, and take responsibility for results. 

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Ownership and Delivery

- Own AI/ML initiatives from requirement gathering and feasibility assessment through development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Translate business objectives into clear technical requirements, delivery plans, and measurable success criteria. 
 - Take responsibility for solution quality, technical decisions, timelines, and production performance. 
 - Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, and drive their resolution. 
 - Communicate progress transparently and escalate issues early with proposed solutions. 2. Machine Learning and Generative AI Development

- Design, develop, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning solutions. 
 - Apply appropriate techniques for data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and performance evaluation. 
 - Build applications using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and agent workflows where appropriate. 
 - Select suitable approaches based on business needs, data availability, accuracy, latency, cost, and maintainability. 
 - Establish evaluation baselines, prevent data leakage, and document assumptions and model limitations. 
 - Assess emerging AI technologies and apply them where they offer practical value. 3. Production Engineering and MLOps

- Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-tested Python code. 
 - Build APIs and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications. 
 - Implement reproducible pipelines, experiment tracking, model versioning, automated testing, and CI/CD. 
 - Deploy and operate solutions using cloud services, Docker, and appropriate MLOps tools. 
 - Monitor model quality, data drift, reliability, inference latency, and operating costs. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and implement sustainable improvements. 
 - Apply appropriate security, privacy, access-control, and responsible AI practices. 4. Communication and Stakeholder Collaboration

- Explain complex AI/ML concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Lead requirement discussions and ask questions that clarify business needs and expectations. 
 - Present architecture proposals, evaluation results, technical recommendations, and delivery updates professionally. 
 - Communicate trade-offs, risks, uncertainty, and limitations openly. 
 - Write clear technical documentation, architecture explanations, and decision records. 
 - Collaborate effectively with software engineers, data engineers, DevOps teams, product teams, customers, and management. 5. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Teaching

- Provide hands-on technical direction through architecture discussions, code reviews, and problem-solving sessions. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers with practical guidance and constructive feedback. 
 - Explain both how to implement solutions and why specific approaches are appropriate. 
 - Conduct technical training, knowledge-sharing sessions, and architecture walkthroughs. 
 - Establish coding standards, engineering practices, and production-readiness expectations. 
 - Lead through expertise, evidence, and collaboration, including without formal people-management responsibility. 

Required Technical Skills

- Programming: Strong Python, SQL, debugging, data structures, and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model selection, statistical foundations, and evaluation. 
 - Deep Learning: Hands-on experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
 - Generative AI: LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt design, and output evaluation.

 - Data Pipelines: Data preprocessing, validation, feature pipelines, and reproducible workflows. 
 - MLOps: Experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, and monitoring using MLflow or equivalent. 
 - Deployment: REST APIs, FastAPI or equivalent, Docker, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD. 
 - Cloud: Hands-on experience with at least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - System Design: Scalable architecture, observability, reliability, security, and performance optimization. 

Essential Professional Qualities

- Excellent communication: Speaks and writes clearly, listens actively, and explains complex topics simply. 
 - Strong ownership: Drives work to completion and follows through without constant follow-up. 
 - Technical leadership: Guides engineers, makes sound decisions, and leads by example. 
 - Teaching mindset: Explains concepts patiently and helps others develop independent problem-solving skills. 
 - Structured problem-solving: Investigates root causes and evaluates alternatives using evidence. 
 - Proactive approach: Anticipates challenges and acts before they affect delivery. 
 - Accountability: Honors commitments and communicates early when priorities or timelines change. 
 - Business understanding: Connects technical decisions to measurable business outcomes. 
 - Professional maturity: Accepts feedback and handles disagreements respectfully. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Evidence of mentoring engineers, leading technical initiatives, or conducting technical training. 
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. 

Preferred Experience

 - Distributed data processing, large-scale ML systems, or Kubernetes.

Why Join Us?

About the role: 

We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use. It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job. 

Job Location: Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Noida

What you will be doing: 

• Delivering from the backlog. Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production. 

• Building across the stack. Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary. 

• Working with structured and unstructured data. Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean. 

• Integrating with enterprise platforms. Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results. 

• Applying AI where it earns its place. Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer. 

• Proving the work. Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase. 

• Shaping what gets built. You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them. 

Skills and experience

Commercial experience: 8+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level. 

Core languages: Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C# as a secondary language is welcome. 

Back end: Modern Node. js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production. 

Front end: React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand. 

Data: Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem. 

Data formats: Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change. 

Cloud: Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring. 

AI engineering: Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers. 

Engineering practice: Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain. 

Highly regarded

• Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform

• Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce

• Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware

data.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a senior full-stack developer to help modernize OT365, a mature brand operations platform used to control branding and the distribution of print and promotional items. The successful candidate will build new, maintainable platform capabilities while carefully analyzing and preserving the business-critical workflows embedded in the existing application. This is not a greenfield project in the conventional sense. The work combines modern product development with legacy-system analysis, incremental migration, customer-specific workflow discovery, and integration with production and fulfillment systems. The developer must be comfortable working where requirements are partly documented and partly expressed through existing code, database logic, configuration, and operational practice. 

About OT365: 

OT365 supports customer-specific product catalogs, permissions, personalization, proofing, ordering, approvals, inventory, production, fulfillment, and reporting. The platform has also been extended to support reusable event-resource scheduling, personalized data-merge products, timed multi-touch Easy Touch campaigns, analytics, and CRM-connected workflows. 

Building on our MoneyGram project experience, an emerging product vision would extend OT365 to coordinated retail and multi-location brand rollouts. Potential capabilities include location-specific requirements, production and distribution of rollout materials, delivery and installation scheduling, installation-status and exception tracking, and photographic proof of completion. The detailed workflows are not yet defined and will require structured product and technical discovery. 

The modernization program will establish a modern React user experience, a service-oriented . NET backend, reusable analytics, and defined integration boundaries, with Linux as the target operating system. PostgreSQL is the expected target database, but discovery must validate its feasibility, cost, performance, operational implications, and migration risk. The existing SQL Server database, Pageflex, and selected legacy components will remain important during discovery and may coexist with modernized capabilities during transition. 

Primary Responsibilities

·          Design, build, test, document, and support modern OT365 capabilities using . NET, C#, React, JavaScript or TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and the existing SQL Server platform. 

·          Develop RESTful APIs using a controller-service-model architecture with clear separation of business logic, data access, and transport concerns. 

·          Implement PostgreSQL data access using Npgsql and well-structured ADO. NET, with clear separation between data access and business logic rather than relying on Entity Framework or Dapper. 

·          Analyze the existing SQL Server schema, queries, stored procedures, data behavior, and integrations to support discovery, controlled coexistence, migration planning, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback. 

·          Analyze existing ASP. NET, C#, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL, stored procedure, Pageflex, and configuration-based behavior to determine the true business requirement. 

·          Translate legacy and customer-specific workflows into reusable platform capabilities, configuration, rules, and extension points. 

·          Build responsive customer-facing and administrative experiences in React. 

·          Support catalogs, user and group permissions, variable-data personalization, proofing, pricing, approvals, ordering, inventory, campaigns, events, production, fulfillment, and analytics. 

·          Participate in discovery and technical design for emerging retail and multi-location rollout capabilities without prematurely converting incomplete product ideas into fixed implementation commitments. 

·          Integrate with systems such as EPMS, Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft identity services, shipping carriers, tax services, and other customer or production platforms. 

·          Create automated unit, integration, and regression tests for new behavior and migration-critical workflows. 

·          Use Cursor AI as an integral development tool, creating and following project plans, rules, skills, and other repository guidance while independently validating generated code and technical decisions. 

·          Develop, deploy, diagnose, and support the application in a Linux-based runtime environment. 

·          Participate in Jira-based Agile delivery, including backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, daily coordination, code reviews, defect investigation, deployment, and production stabilization. 

·          Document technical decisions, service contracts, data flows, operational procedures, and discovered legacy behavior. 

·          Communicate risks and uncertainties early, propose options, and take ownership of work through verification and production readiness. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

·          Strong professional experience developing production applications with C# and modern . NET. 

·          Strong React experience, including component design, state management, API integration, forms, validation, and responsive user interfaces. 

·          Strong PostgreSQL skills, including relational design, complex queries, transactions, indexing, performance analysis, concurrency, and operational troubleshooting. 

·          Strong SQL Server skills sufficient to analyze and migrate a mature production schema, stored procedures, queries, data behavior, and integrations. 

·          Practical experience with Npgsql and ADO. NET, or the ability to work effectively within an ADO. NET-based data-access standard. 

·          Experience migrating production data and application behavior between database platforms, preferably from SQL Server to PostgreSQL. 

·          Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with third-party systems. 

·          Experience modernizing, decomposing, or incrementally replacing a mature legacy application. 

·          Working knowledge of authentication, authorization, role-based access, secure coding, logging, auditing, and error handling. 

·          Experience with Git-based development, pull requests, code review, CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined release practices. 

·          Demonstrated experience using Cursor AI for production software development, including creating and adhering to Cursor plans, rules, skills, and project-specific instructions. 

·          Experience working with Jira and delivering software through an Agile development process. 

·          Ability to diagnose behavior across the browser, API, application services, database, scheduled processes, and external integrations. 

Professional Qualifications: 

·          Demonstrated ownership: follows work from requirement through implementation, verification, documentation, and production support. 

·          Strong analytical and reverse-engineering ability; does not require perfectly documented requirements before making progress. 

·          Clear written and verbal English communication with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 

·          Able to work effectively with a distributed U. S. and India team and maintain reliable scheduled overlap. 

·          Comfortable asking precise questions, documenting assumptions, and distinguishing confirmed behavior from inference. 

·          Customer-oriented judgment and respect for the operational consequences of changes to a production platform. 

Preferred Experience: 

·          ASP. NET Framework 4. 8, JavaScript, jQuery, or migration from older Microsoft web stacks. 

·          Familiarity with Linux command-line tools, application configuration, process and service management, logs, networking, permissions, scripting, deployment, and troubleshooting. 

·          Pageflex, variable-data publishing, document composition, PDF or bitmap proof generation, or another rendering engine. 

·          Print, promotional products, marketing operations, web-to-print, inventory, production, or fulfillment workflows. 

·          CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot. 

·          Dashboards, reporting, analytics, exports, or integration with business-intelligence tools. 

·          Multi-tenant or highly configurable B2B SaaS applications with customer-specific rules and permissions. 

·          Retail rollout, field service, installation coordination, location management, photographic verification, proof-of-completion, or exception and rework workflows. 

·          SQL Server-to-PostgreSQL migration, including data-type mapping, sequence and identity behavior, stored-procedure replacement, validation, reconciliation, coexistence, cutover, and rollback. 

·          Azure or comparable cloud infrastructure, observability, automated deployment, and application security. 

What Success Looks Like

·          Produces maintainable, tested code that conforms to the agreed architecture and coding standards. 

·          Learns the existing platform without blindly reproducing every legacy implementation choice. 

·          Preserves critical customer workflows while helping move the platform toward reusable, configurable capabilities. 

·          Reduces uncertainty by documenting discovered behavior, decisions, dependencies, and risks. 

·          Works independently on well-defined outcomes while collaborating closely on architecture and ambiguous requirements. 

·          Earns trust through predictable delivery, honest status reporting, thoughtful problem-solving, and production ownership.

data.title: Applied ML engineer, Evals & data (5+ Years, 60L)
data.description:
This role is for one of our partner companies, YC backed

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Applied ML Engineer to own the quality and evaluation systems behind an AI video agent. 

You'll be responsible for answering a difficult question: how do we know the agent is actually getting better?

You'll turn subjective agent behavior into measurable signals and build the datasets, evals, graders, and feedback loops needed to continuously improve production performance. 

This is an applied ML role for someone who has shipped LLM or agentic systems to real users and understands what happens after the initial prototype works. 

You'll work directly with the founders and product team. 

What you'll own

- Agent quality and evaluation: Define measurable standards for useful, reliable agent behavior across the video editing workflow. 
 - Evaluation systems: Build offline and online evals, model-based graders, human review systems, and automated quality checks. 
 - Production datasets: Turn user interactions, telemetry, failures, and human feedback into reliable datasets for model and product iteration. 
 - Multimodal evaluation: Measure retrieval and agent performance across video, audio, images, and graphics while working within real-time constraints. 
 - Regression testing: Build release gates and regression suites that prevent quality degradation as models, prompts, tools, and workflows change. 
 - Model selection: Evaluate and select models based on production performance across quality, latency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Agent learning loops: Build systems to evaluate and improve next-action prediction, creator memory, brand alignment, pacing, and technical output quality. 

You'll be a great fit if

- Have shipped an LLM agent or agentic product to real users and owned its production quality. 
 - Have built evals for LLM or agent behavior, translating subjective quality requirements into metrics, graders, and test suites. 
 - Have created datasets from production usage, including telemetry, human feedback, failures, or user behavior. 
 - Know how to evaluate models across quality, latency, reliability, and cost rather than optimizing for benchmark performance alone. 
 - Have worked on problems where outputs are inherently subjective, such as preference, style, creative quality, ranking, or personalization. 
 - Are comfortable working across applied research and product engineering, turning uncertain findings into systems that ship. 
 - Are strong in Python or TypeScript and can build production-quality systems that support rapid model iteration. 

Why this role is interesting

Video agents create an unusually difficult ML evaluation problem. 

There often isn't a single objectively correct output. A good result depends on context, creator intent, brand, pacing, visual quality, and what the user is trying to accomplish. 

You'll build the systems that measure those behaviors, identify where the agent fails, and systematically improve its performance. 

If you've built production agent systems and enjoy turning messy model behavior into measurable engineering problems, we'd love to hear from you.

TECHNICAL ARCHITECT

Azure Healthcare Platform & Integration | Hands-on builder-architect | US Based Healthcare Platform

EXPERIENCE

8-10 years total

LOCATION

Hyderabad | Primarily WFO

ROLE TYPE

Full-time | Hands-on technical lead

The role in one sentence

PERSONALLY LEAD the technical evolution of the client's modernized backend and ensure that backend services, integrations, FHIR, Databricks, identity, security, and external platforms evolve as one coherent architecture. 

This is not an ivory-tower architecture position.   

About the RoleThe client is building a modern, Azure-first healthcare platform. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Architect with 8-10 years of total technology experience who can architect, build, integrate, troubleshoot, and continuously evolve this ecosystem. 

The Architecture You Will UnifyOperational & Clinical: Healthie for care workflows; Azure Health Data Services / FHIR as the canonical clinical backbone; Redox for hospital interoperability. 

Backend & Integration: Azure API Management, Service Bus/eventing, Functions, Logic Apps, backend services, APIs, webhooks, integration contracts, retries, reconciliation and observability. 

Data & Intelligence: ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion Architecture, Unity Catalog, governed analytics and AI consumption. 

Engagement & Enterprise: HubSpot, Intercom, patient communications, downstream reporting, identity/EMPI, consent, governance and security controls. 

What You Will Own and Lead·  Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the modernized backend and continuously evolve it as it scales. 

·  Define clear system boundaries and source-of-truth rules so FHIR, Healthie, Databricks, engagement systems and hospital integrations do not become competing data silos. 

·  Architect integration patterns across APIs, webhooks, Service Bus/events, batch, CDC and FHIR transactions; make practical sync-versus-async decisions. 

·  Define reusable patterns for idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, replay, reconciliation, schema evolution, versioning, correlation IDs and observability.

data.title: Systems Engineer
data.description:
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow - in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a Systems Engineer in Pune/Bangalore, you will join ACI's Monitoring & Tools team and help operate and evolve the monitoring, observability and operational automation capabilities that support the world's payments ecosystem. You will work across established platforms such as Zabbix while helping expand our use of Grafana Cloud, modern telemetry and AI-assisted operations. 
Purpose of the Systems Engineer Role
Implements, configures and contributes to the design of moderately complex monitoring, observability and systems-management solutions for internal customers. Administers and improves platforms used to collect, visualize, alert on and respond to infrastructure and application telemetry. Performs analysis of existing monitoring capabilities, identifies coverage and operational gaps, and recommends appropriate solutions based on reliability, supportability, security and cost. 
Works with engineering, application, infrastructure and operations teams to integrate telemetry sources, improve actionable alerting, support production incidents and increase automation. Contributes to the continued development of ACI's observability strategy across Grafana Cloud, Zabbix and related operational platforms. 
A Typical Day at ACI for a Systems Engineer
- Engineer, configure and administer monitoring and observability solutions for application and infrastructure environments. 

- Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, data-source integrations and telemetry pipelines using Grafana Cloud and related technologies. 

- Support the collection and analysis of metrics, logs and traces using technologies such as Prometheus, Loki and OpenTelemetry/Alloy. 

- Administer and improve existing Zabbix environments, including templates, proxies, triggers, alert tuning, integrations and platform maintenance. 

- Work with service and application owners to understand monitoring requirements and select the appropriate capability for each use case. 

- Investigate monitoring gaps, alert noise and telemetry-quality issues, and implement sustainable corrective actions. 

- Support production incidents by gathering evidence, assessing customer and business impact, following approved runbooks and escalation paths, and documenting actions and outcomes. 

- Develop scripts and automation that reduce repetitive administration, improve onboarding and support reliable platform operations. 

- Integrate monitoring and observability platforms with incident-management, event-management and automation tooling. 

- Use approved AI capabilities to assist with troubleshooting, dashboard development, analysis, documentation and automation, while protecting sensitive operational data and validating generated outputs. 

- Monitor platform consumption and contribute to cost-effective use of managed observability services. 

- Work with internal teams and external vendors to resolve moderately complex technical and service issues. 

- Anticipate and raise project, operational and technical risks to the appropriate stakeholders and participate in their resolution. 

- Perform other duties as assigned. 

- Understand and adhere to all corporate policies, including the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. 

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Needed to Succeed
- Experience administering and troubleshooting monitoring, observability or production-support environments. 

- Hands-on experience with Grafana Cloud, Grafana OSS or a comparable enterprise observability platform, including dashboards, alerting, users, data sources and integrations. 

- Experience working with one or more observability signals: metrics, logs or traces. 

- Practical knowledge of Prometheus, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Alloy or comparable telemetry technologies. 

- Experience with Zabbix or another infrastructure-monitoring platform, including configuration, tuning, maintenance and troubleshooting. 

- Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, preferably Red Hat or a related distribution. 

- Working knowledge of Windows Server administration and troubleshooting. 

- Scripting or automation experience using Python, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language. 

- Experience supporting production environments and applying sound judgement during incidents, including escalation, evidence gathering, risk assessment and documentation. 

- Ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate service requirements into monitoring and observability solutions. 

- Demonstrated interest in learning emerging technologies and improving existing operational practices. 

- Practical experience using approved AI tools to support engineering, analysis, troubleshooting or automation, with appropriate attention to data security and output validation. 

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience
- Grafana Cloud administration in a multi-team or multi-stack environment. 

- Experience with Grafana Cloud cost, usage, access or stack governance. 

- PagerDuty or another enterprise incident-response and on-call platform. 

- SolarWinds, Dynatrace, Datadog, Elastic Observability or New Relic. 

- OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation and telemetry-routing patterns. 

- Integration of monitoring tools with Jira, ServiceNow, Ignio or comparable workflow and automation platforms. 

- Infrastructure automation using Ansible or similar technologies. 

- Exposure to AWS, Azure, Kubernetes or hybrid infrastructure. 

- Jira and Confluence. 

- Password Manager Pro (PAM360). 

- Comforte or Protegrity. 

- Experience working in payments, financial services or another regulated production environment. 

Core Capabilities
- Ensure Accountability - holding self and others accountable to meet commitments. 

- Drive Results - consistently achieving outcomes even under tough circumstances. 

- Customer Focus - building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions. 

- Cultivate Innovation - creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. 

- Collaborates - building partnerships and working collaboratively with others. 

- Courage - stepping up to address difficult issues and saying what needs to be said.

data.title: Senior System Engineer
data.description:
VergeCloud is looking for a hands-on System Engineer to work on the core of our CDN and edge infrastructure platform. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building high-performance, low-latency, secure systems close to the network, operating system, and runtime layer. 

You will contribute directly to VergeCloud's CDN core, including request processing, caching, reverse proxying, traffic routing, TLS handling, DNS integration, observability, WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection capabilities. 

The ideal candidate should be comfortable writing production-grade Rust code and working with distributed infrastructure that handles high-volume internet traffic across edge locations. 

Key responsibilities include: 

- Develop and maintain CDN core services using Rust. 

- Build high-performance caching, proxying, routing, and traffic management components. 

- Work on HTTP, HTTPS, TLS, TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, and edge networking systems. 

- Improve CDN performance, reliability, scalability, and resource efficiency. 

- Contribute to WAF, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and DDoS protection features. 

- Debug production issues across CDN edge nodes, origin connectivity, cache behavior, DNS, TLS, and network paths. 

- Work closely with SRE, security, and platform teams to build reliable edge infrastructure. 

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or backend engineering. 

- Strong production-level programming experience in Rust or C. 

- Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, processes, memory, filesystems, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. 

- Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS/SSL, and DNS. 

- Experience building high-performance, concurrent, asynchronous, or event-driven systems. 

- Understanding of caching, reverse proxying, load balancing, request routing, and traffic management. 

- Experience debugging complex production issues across application, network, operating system, and infrastructure layers. 

- Good understanding of distributed systems, high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable service design. 

- Experience with logs, metrics, tracing, monitoring, and production observability. 

Preferred skills: 

- Experience with CDN, edge computing, WAF, API gateway, reverse proxy, load balancer, or DDoS protection platforms. 

- Familiarity with Tokio or other async Rust runtimes. 

- Knowledge of NGINX, Envoy, HAProxy, Varnish, OpenResty, or similar technologies. 

- Knowledge of BGP, Anycast, traffic engineering, and global routing. 

- Experience with eBPF, XDP, DPDK, or kernel-level networking. 

- Familiarity with Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis, object storage, and large-scale log pipelines. 

- Understanding of OWASP CRS, ModSecurity concepts, bot mitigation, rate limiting, and API security. 

- Exposure to WebAssembly, V8, or edge function runtimes. 

Benefits

- Opportunity to work on the core technology of a deep-tech edge cloud platform. 

- Build CDN, DNS, WAF, DDoS protection, video delivery, and edge computing infrastructure from India for global customers. 

- High ownership role with direct impact on platform architecture, performance, reliability, and security. 

- Work on challenging systems engineering problems involving Rust, Linux, networking, distributed systems, and high-scale traffic. 

- Collaborate with a strong technical team across platform engineering, SRE, security, and product. 

- Exposure to production-scale internet infrastructure, edge networking, caching, traffic routing, and security systems. 

- Opportunity to grow into senior engineering, platform architecture, or infrastructure leadership roles. 

- Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise. 

- On-site collaboration in Bangalore with a fast-moving engineering team.

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineering Architect with extensive expertise in large-scale data processing, enterprise pipeline design, and business intelligence architecture within the retail domain. 

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end design and execution of our enterprise data platform, processing high-volume retail transactions, customer interactions, and inventory feeds. - Domain Alignment: Leverage deep retail domain expertise (e. g. , POS data, inventory management, customer 360, supply chain, store operations, and promotional effectiveness) to design logical data models that reflect business realities. 
 - Insight Delivery: Collaborate with business analysts and decision-makers to transform complex datasets into actionable operational and executive insights. 4. Technical Leadership & Governance

- Standards & Best Practices: Establish technical standards for data modeling, ETL/ELT development, code reviews, CI/CD deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Data Quality & Governance: Implement data lineage, metadata management, and automated data validation rules to guarantee data integrity across downstream reports.

The International Technology team enables Walmart's stores and eCommerce operations across the world, with platforms used in most markets where Walmart has a presence outside the US. Our Customer Engagement group focuses on building platforms responsible for acquiring new customers and re-engaging existing ones. We own the foundational systems that drive the end-to-end shopping experience - spanning account identity & authentication, customer profiles, payments, and post order experience.

Job Description

A central focus of this role is building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that bring the Database Tools service into AI-agent workflows, making its capabilities available to AI agents and helping shape how developers work with Oracle Database. You'll also contribute to the Document Generator Pre-built Function and the Oracle Database, Oracle ORDS, and Oracle APEX stack on Oracle Cloud. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do Every Day

- Build native cloud services in an Agile environment using the latest cloud technologies, such as Terraform
 - Instrument services and automate solution deployment worldwide with a DevOps mindset
 - Use Codex and other agentic development tools extensively in day-to-day engineering work, including code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation; review and validate their output
 - Coordinate with project stakeholders such as Support and Operations to provide a high level of expertise and service availability
 - Respond to production platform service escalations; lead incident recovery and root-cause analysis
 - Participate in code reviews and provide feedback to the team with continuous improvement in mind
 - Produce the documentation needed to make the platform easy to operate
 - Contribute to the design, development, and operation of MCP servers and related integrations as the team's work evolves

Preferred Skills

6+ years of professional experience in back-end engineering

- BS or MS degree in computer science or equivalent software development experience
 - Experience working on commercial products that handle large volumes of data in highly available distributed systems
 - Experience developing scripts to automate software deployments and installations
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and microservice architectures
 - Familiarity with version control tools such as Git and Bitbucket
 - Familiarity with monitoring tools, such as alarms and Grafana dashboards
 - Strong programming skills with Java and SQL
 - Curiosity and a willingness to learn and continually improve the solution
 - Exposure to Agile development methodologies
 - Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), MCP server development, or integrating services with AI agents is a plus

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer — CDN Infrastructure
data.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Senior SRE with 5+ years of experience to help operate and evolve

the infrastructure behind our CDN - from the baremetal edge nodes serving traffic, to

the Kubernetes-based control plane, to the observability and data pipelines that tell us

what's actually happening on the network. You'll work across the full stack: provisioning

and configuration management, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and the logging/monitoring systems

that let us catch problems before customers do. 

This is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role for someone who's comfortable

moving between low-level networking debugging and higher-level platform/infra

automation, and who can drive decisions with less oversight. 

What You'll Do
Operate and maintain our fleet of self-managed baremetal edge servers, using

SaltStack (or Ansible) for configuration management and automation

Manage and improve our managed Kubernetes cluster, deploying and maintaining

services via Helm

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) for infrastructure and service

deployments

Own and extend observability tooling - Prometheus, Grafana, Alert manager, and

distributed tracing with Grafana Tempo

Maintain and query ClickHouse at scale - millions of rows ingested daily, with a

focus on schema design and low-latency query tuning

Manage cloud service configuration as code using Terraform

Diagnose and resolve issues across the stack - from DNS resolution and

BGP/routing anomalies to TCP/IP-level performance regressions and applicationWhat

You'll Need

Requirements

What You'll Need

5+ years of experience in an SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure/platform engineering
role

Deep understanding of networking fundamentals - DNS, TCP/IP, and CDN concepts

(caching, routing, anycast, edge delivery) - you should be comfortable reading a

packet capture or debugging a DNS resolution chain

Solid experience operating Linux systems in production, including self-managed

baremetal infrastructure

Hands-on experience with configuration management tools - SaltStack or Ansible

Experience with Kubernetes in production, including deploying and managing

services via Helm

Experience building CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions

Working knowledge of Terraform or similar IaC tools

Practical experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager for monitoring and

alerting; familiarity with distributed tracing (Grafana Tempo or similar)

Ability to write code in Go or Python for automation, tooling, or internal services

Strong debugging skills across layers - from kernel/network to application to

infrastructure automation

Good communication skills and comfort working in a small, high-ownership team

Nice to Have

Experience with BGP / anycast routing in a production CDN or network operator

context

Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar/analytical database at scale

Experience with Kafka/Redpanda or similar streaming systems for log/data pipelines

Prior experience at a CDN, ISP, hosting provider, or similar network-heavy operator

Experience with GitOps workflows (ArgoCD or similar)

data.title: Lead Instrumentation Engineer
data.description:
Lead Instrumentation Engineer - Propulsion Testing

Location: Navi Mumbai, India (On-site)

Team: Propulsion Testing / AIT (Assembly, Integration & Test)

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience. 

About Manastu

Manastu Space is a Space Safety and Logistics company focused on making space safe, sustainable, and accessible. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as space debris mitigation and green propulsion, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem. 

Our work sits at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking. 

Website: https: //www. manastuspace. com

LinkedIn: https: //www. linkedin. com/company/manastu-space/

Email: careers@manastuspace. com

Role Objective

Own the sensing, data acquisition, valve actuation and measurement backbone of the propulsion test facility end to end and build and lead the instrumentation team that runs it. The goal is a facility where every new rig is instrumented against a frozen requirement, every channel produces clean, calibrated and traceable data on every firing, test campaigns run round the clock without instrumentation delays, and the facility keeps pace with Manastu's growth through clear standards and a costed upgrade roadmap. 

Role Overview

Every firing, every pressure spike, every millisecond of thermal data that proves our thrusters work starts with the instrumentation. As the Lead Instrumentation Engineer in Propulsion Testing, you'll head our instrumentation team and own the sensing, data acquisition, actuation and measurement backbone of our propulsion test facility, building it up alongside the AIT team and standing at the console when the thrusters fire. 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the heart of our test operations. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with ISRO veterans who've spent careers building and firing propulsion systems, a rare chance to learn flight-grade test discipline directly from the people who wrote the playbook. Test windows don't always fall in business hours: hot-fire and qualification campaigns often run late, and you'll be there through them, making sure every channel captures clean, reliable data when it counts. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team leadership: Lead and build the instrumentation team, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and technicians, allocating work across test campaigns, and growing the group as the facility scales. 
 - Shift cover: Organise round-the-clock (24-hour) test cover with a working shift roster, and train technicians to run set-ups unsupervised. 
 - Requirement analysis: Translate test objectives into a frozen instrumentation requirement for every new rig (measurement list, ranges, accuracy, sample rates, channel count and layout) before the rig is built. 
 - Facility integration: Coordinate closely with the AIT team and Space propulsion experts to establish and integrate the test facility, defining instrumentation layouts, wiring diagrams and channel lists for hot-fire, cold-flow and qualification campaigns. 
 - DAQ architecture: Design, build and commission the instrumentation and data acquisition (DAQ) architecture for the propulsion test facility, from sensor selection through signal path to recorded data. 
 - Sensors and calibration: Select, install and calibrate sensors including pressure transducers, thermocouples, load cells, flow meters, strain gauges and accelerometers for propulsion and structural test articles. 
 - Valve actuation: Own the design of valve actuation for test rigs (currently handled by the avionics department): valve driver circuits, position and feedback sensing, and measurement and verification of actuation timing and valve state. 
 - Automation and control: Own the automation layer for valves and actuators: specify sequences, interlocks and safe-state behaviour, and evaluate PLC, SCADA and NI-based platforms rather than defaulting to NI alone. 
 - DAQ / LabVIEW software: Write the requirements and algorithms for DAQ and control software, direct the LabVIEW engineer through the build, and accept the software against a written acceptance test. 
 - Cabling and grounding: Design and implement power and signal cable layouts and instrument grounding schemes that control noise without compromising measurement accuracy, and issue them as facility standards. 
 - Signal conditioning and troubleshooting: Configure signal conditioning, verify calibration, and troubleshoot sensors, wiring, signal paths and control loops, often under live test conditions. 
 - Live test operations: Set up, operate and monitor instrumentation during live propulsion test campaigns, including night and off-hours shifts, and own abort criteria and test holds for instrumentation reasons. 
 - Facility upkeep: Operate and maintain the test facility and its equipment (power supplies, test and measuring instruments, and automation/feedback-based systems), keeping everything calibrated, safe and campaign-ready. 
 - Quick set-ups: Stand up quick instrumentation set-ups to meet urgent development-test requirements without cutting corners on safety or data quality. 
 - Safety and standards: Ensure every test configuration meets safety standards, which is critical when working with high-test peroxide propellants and high-pressure systems, and work to ECSS-aligned and AS9100 practices. 
 - Documentation and traceability: Own instrumentation documentation (control narratives, functional specs, channel lists, calibration records and post-test data validation reports) to a standard that holds up in an anomaly investigation or an AS9100 audit. Maintain a live baseline of active channels, calibration due dates, noise floors and spares. 
 - Procurement and spares: Generate equipment and instrument specifications based on test needs, drive procurement, and maintain essential spares through lean inventory management. 
 - Roadmap: Forecast future facility requirements, publish a costed upgrade roadmap, and adopt emerging technology to keep our test capability current and competitive. Experience & Background

Academic qualifications

- BE / B. Tech / M. Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics or Electrical Engineering. Experience and expertise

- Minimum 3 years of industrial experience in the above disciplines, handling a range of power supplies, testing instruments and measuring instruments; calibration of instruments; and automation involving feedback-based operations. 
 - Operation and maintenance of test facilities built around the above equipment and instruments. 
 - Setting up instrumentation facilities to industry standards and safety/environmental protocols, including writing measurement requirements and selecting the right range and accuracy of instruments for the test conditions. 
 - Specialisation in power and signal cable layout design and implementation, and in instrument grounding to control noise levels without affecting measurement accuracy during data acquisition. 
 - Hands-on configuration of NI DAQ hardware and LabVIEW-based systems; exposure to PLC and SCADA control platforms. 
 - Design of valve driver / actuation circuits and position or feedback sensing, including verifying actuation timing. 
 - Developing system-operation and facility-maintenance documentation, with calibration traceability. 
 - Ability to develop quick instrumentation test set-ups to meet urgent development-test requirements. 
 - Organising teams to meet round-the-clock (24-hour) testing requirements as and when required. 
 - Generating equipment / instrument specifications based on needs, driving procurement, and maintaining essential spares through lean inventory management. 
 - Forecasting future requirements and adopting changing technology to keep facilities up to date. 
 - Excellent communication skills, including concept presentation and demonstration, and guiding technicians to deliver seamless service. Bonus points for

- Experience instrumenting propulsion, engine or structural test rigs; harness fabrication and EMI/EMC awareness; exposure to aerospace quality standards (AS9100, ECSS); or hands-on time supporting hot-fire or qualification test campaigns. Ideal Candidate Profile

- Has written channel lists and chosen ranges personally, not just been handed them, and can state the range, accuracy and uncertainty of every instrument they have used. 
 - Has selected parts and drawn circuits themselves and can explain the trade-off behind each choice rather than naming a catalogue part. 
 - Backs grounding and shielding decisions with before/after noise numbers and a grounding scheme they drew. 
 - Has configured DAQ and control software personally, written specs and acceptance tests, and can argue for a control platform choice (NI, PLC or SCADA). 
 - Has sat the console on live firings and has called a hold when data quality or safety demanded it. 
 - Writes requirements instead of waiting for them and can get a design or spec changed when the rig cannot support the measurement. 
 - Builds people: has trained technicians to run set-ups unsupervised and has organised cover for 24-hour test windows. 
 - Raises problems early, even when it costs schedule, never signs off data they are not sure of, and leaves drawings and records behind. What we offer

- Learn directly from Space propulsion veterans: flight-proven expertise you can't get from a textbook
 - Sit at the console for live thruster firings and own the data that decides whether hardware flies
 - Work on flight-proven, DRDO- and ISRO-validated green propulsion technology
 - Build and lead the instrumentation team from the ground up and shape how testing is done at Manastu
 - Competitive compensation
 - Comprehensive health insurance
 - High ownership and visibility, with direct access to leadership
 - Support for learning, conferences, and research exposure
 - Subsidized lunch plan

data.title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

For a single team delivering components of distributed systems. Translates goals into a 1-2 quarter execution plan, sets coding, testing, and scalability practices, and provides hands-on oversight of performance tuning and load/perf testing. Guides the team in building fault-tolerant, in-service-upgradable components (redundancy, replication, failover) and in applying resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts). Ensures robust observability (tests, alarms, dashboards, telemetry) and operational readiness via reviewed runbooks and standard procedures. Manages delivery of scoped features and correctness testing (including fault-injection/brownouts), and directs implementation of data replication/synchronization to maintain integrity and availability. Leads team incident response and root-cause efforts, enforces no-customer-downtime practices, and drives use of automation/IaC for troubleshooting. Oversees team security implementation (encryption, access controls), tracks remediation plans, verifies compliance documentation, and coaches adherence to change-management plans for safe patching, updates, and rollbacks.

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools.

data.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently. 

The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms. 

We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions. 

Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems. 
 - Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery. 
 - Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load. 
 - Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery. 
 - Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes. 
 - Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices. 
 - Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements. 
 - Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management. 
 - Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives. 
 - Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting. 
 - Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers. 
 - Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies. 
 - Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

 - Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups. 
 - Experience with NETCONF, Junos XML APIs, gRPC, OpenConfig, and model-driven network automation. 
 - Experience tuning containerized networking workloads, including cgroups, socket buffers, veth, and SR-IOV. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code, automated lifecycle orchestration, and rolling upgrades for stateful services. 
 - Understanding of Clos fabrics, overlay/underlay integration, ECMP behavior, and backbone transit.

Our company culture, which values collaboration and mutual trust, creates the ideal framework for boldly trying new things and questioning the status quo. Our technologies inspire people to develop and produce things that are currently unimaginable. Whether lasers, machine tools, EUV or electronics - TRUMPF is building technological worlds for future generations. Are you ready for new challenges?

Job Title: Quality Engineer

Job Function: Quality Assurance & Quality Control

To ensure that products and processes meet customer requirements, company standards, and regulatory requirements through effective quality planning, inspection, auditing, problem-solving, and continuous improvement activities. 

Maintain and improve product and process quality throughout the manufacturing lifecycle. 

- Drive quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects, rework, and customer complaints. 
 - Ensure compliance with internal quality standards and customer specifications. 
 - Develop and implement quality control plans & inspection procedures
 - Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of part kits and components. 
 - Analyze quality issues and lead root cause analysis using quality tools such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and FMEA. 
 - Monitor quality performance indicators and prepare periodic quality reports. 
 - Manage non-conformance reports (NCRs) and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Participate in internal, supplier, and customer quality audits. 
 - Ensure compliance with Standards and other applicable quality management system requirements. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Industrial Engineering, and Purchase departments to resolve quality issues. 
 - Support new product introduction activities through quality planning and validation. 
 - Drive continuous improvement projects to enhance product quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Develop and maintain supplier quality performance through regular supplier assessments, quality reviews, and improvement initiatives. 
 - Support supplier development activities to improve process capability, product quality, delivery performance, and adherence to TRUMPF quality requirements. 
 - Conduct supplier audits and drive corrective actions for recurring quality issues. 
 - Work closely with Purchase and suppliers during new part development, qualification, and process validation. 
 - Monitor supplier quality KPIs and initiate improvement actions where required. 

Skills

- Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and TRUMPF Quality standards. 
 - Experience with quality tools such as FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, APQP, 8D, and Root Cause Analysis. 
 - Knowledge of Assembly processes, inspection techniques, and measurement instruments. 
 - Proficiency in SAP and MS Office applications. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Knowledge of customer complaint handling and supplier quality management. 
 - Understanding of GD&T and engineering drawings. 
 - Knowledge and experience in Supplier Quality Management and Supplier Development. 
 - Ability to assess supplier processes, identify quality risks, and drive supplier improvement plans. 
 - Knowledge of supplier audits, process capability, PPAP/APQP, and supplier corrective action processes.

data.title: Senior Quality Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

If you're a Quality Engineer based in India, who is highly motivated and experienced in quality control, you might be seeing an opportunity that others aren't. This role plays a critical role in ensuring the quality of all products by overseeing inspections, implementing quality systems, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. The position reports to Quality Manager. 

Here, you have the freedom to use your expertise to improve something vital to all of our lives - food. With structured career development, a role with us can take your career to the next level. 

Join us and make an impact to be proud of - for food, people and the planet. 

What You Will Do

- Inspection & Quality Control: 
 - Lead in-house inspections and ensure adherence to relevant standards (ISO, EN). 
 - Analyze inspection data and interpret NDT results (PT, RT, DP). 
 - Make informed decisions regarding deviations from procedures or specifications. 
 - Manage and collaborate with external inspectors during audits and FATs. 
 - Conduct training for fabrication personnel on quality procedures and standards. 
 - Monitor critical-to-quality (CTQ) parameters
 - Quality Systems & Improvement: 
 - Implement and maintain quality management systems (QMS) including SOPs and TPM principles. 
 - Develop and manage quality KPIs and KAIs to measure and improve performance. 
 - Identify and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for quality issues. 
 - Participate in global change management processes (TI resolution, IRs, etc. ). 
 - Lead WCM pillar or improvement teams for continuous improvement. 
 - Maintain calibration . Conduct Measurement System Analysis) and GR&R studies. 
 - Participate in HRA and legislations and statutory requirements like PED, CE etc. 
 - Conduct supplier audits (PDQI) and ensure their adherence to quality standards. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Work closely with Production, Planning, Logistics, IE, and Supplier Management teams to resolve quality issues. 
 - Support new product development, raw material qualification, and process validation activities
 - Technical Expertise: 
 - Possess a minimum of 7-8 years of experience in Quality Control. 
 - Demonstrate a strong understanding of fabrication processes, equipment functions, and pressure vessel codes. 
 - Possess in-depth knowledge of drawing interpretation and technical documentation -Familiarity with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing)
 - Exhibit a comprehensive knowledge of ISO standards (9000, 3834-2, 22000) & EN standards
 - Familiarity with measurement tools. 
Profile Description

We believe you have

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics , industrial engineering or a related Engineering field. 
 - 7-8 years of experience in quality control / Quality systems improvement or similar technical role. 
 - Experience in Food industry is preferred. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. 
 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 
 - Proficiency in quality reporting formats and documentation. 
 - Ability to provide quality-related training programs. 
 - Team spirit, autonomous, pragmatic, rigorous, determined, tenacious, curious. 

We Offer

We Offer You

- A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
 - A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
 - An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
 - Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https: //jobs. tetrapak. com/. 

This job posting expires on 31/10/2026. 

If you have any questions about your application, please contact Dipali Moray. 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide. 

Dipali Moray
