data.title: Dev Ops Engineer (Web, Python, CI/CD, cloud environments) - Hybrid
data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

About The Team

You'll be joining a growing, distributed team within FactSet's Developer Enablement & Automation organization. The team focuses on the workflows, tooling, and shared infrastructure that power FactSet's engineering communities - helping engineers ship software with confidence. 

Job Description

FactSet's ecosystem spans a wide range of teams and technologies. This role focuses on integrating and supporting a centralized CI/CD pipeline platform that brings consistency and governance to how software is built, tested, and deployed - without slowing teams down. 

The work is less about building from scratch and more about making the right pieces fit together on a scale. Good engineering judgment is as important as technical skill: the platform needs to be consistent where it matters and flexible enough to support the teams that rely on it. 

What You'll Do

- Build a centralized CI/CD platform to support a diverse portfolio of applications with varying build tools, test frameworks, and deployment targets
 - Identify and implement extension points that accommodate existing build requirements
 - Define and enforce standardized quality gates (linting, testing, security checks) while preserving team flexibility
 - Collaborate directly with application teams to surface requirements and ensure the pipeline fits their needs
 - Support deployments across an internal PaaS platform, Kubernetes/ArgoCD, and AWS
 - Help shape the long-term vision of the platform and what good engineering workflows look like at FactSet

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years with solid experience as a software engineer with a strong focus on CI/CD, developer tooling, or platform engineering at a comparable seniority level
 - Experience working with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Travis CI and an understanding of how to design pipelines that scale across many teams and applications
 - Deep familiarity with the software packaging lifecycle ecosystem - you understand how these applications are built, tested, and what good looks like across different build toolchains
 - Familiarity with containerized deployments and cloud environments (Kubernetes, AWS, or similar)
 - An instinct for where standardization helps and where it hurts - you know the difference between a guardrail and a roadblock
 - Familiarity with Linux - you should be able to navigate the Linux file system via a CLI and understand Linux operating system concepts like package managers. 

Additional/Desired Skill

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach - you'll need to engage with application teams, understand their constraints, and build solutions that earn adoption rather than demanding it 
 - A genuine passion for developer experience and enabling engineering teams to move faster with more confidence
 - Experience with modern CI/CD vendors and pipeline-as-code approaches
 - Familiarity with internal developer platforms or PaaS-style deployment environments
 - Experience driving tooling adoption across a large engineering organization
 - Broader experience with developer enablement concerns such as shared libraries, scaffolding, or local development environment standardization
 - Familiarity with Python, Bash and Typescript
 - Familiarity with the Harness Developer Platform

Must be fluent in English

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8, 200 global clients, including over 200, 000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees' Choice Award winner. Learn more at www. factset. com and follow us on X and LinkedIn. 

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

data.title: AI & Data / Cloud & Gen AI (Japan Market Focus) - Sr Manager
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Artificial Intelligence & Engineering

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. 

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses. 

Senior Manager - AI & Data, Cloud & Generative AI (Japan Market Focus)

Position Summary

Level: Senior Manager

As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for overall technical delivery as part of large-scale software solutions at enterprise level. You will lead functional and technical teams on the project located across shores guiding and mentoring junior team members and collaborating to understand the functional requirements. You will respond to new sales or proposals and support end-to-end delivery of the project along with estimations and planning. 

You will be responsible for managing the design, development, and deployment of large-scale system implementations at an enterprise level. You will be responsible for independently managing the team and guiding team members at different levels through their career path, work through technical leads across shores to manage implementation of the functional requirements and implement them on platforms like Guidewire and Majesco. You will own the end-to-end delivery of the project from estimations, planning, and execution. You would also be responsible for managing the status and end to end delivery of the final product. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead client delivery, AI governance orchestration, and go-to-market activities across AI & Data, Cloud, and Generative AI engagements, with a specific focus on Japan-market and clients. This role combines hands-on delivery and architectural leadership with business development and advisory responsibility - requiring fluency in Japanese, prior exposure working in Japan, and the ability to bridge CAIO/CIO-level strategic agendas on Advice & Implementation of Data Modernization on cloud along with Scaled AI adoption. 

What You'll Do

AI-Driven Modernization & Delivery

- Deliver on AI-driven modernization and build enterprise data utilization foundations through cloud lift-and-transform initiatives. 
 - Provide design, architecture, and delivery expertise on Snowflake and/or Databricks platforms as part of modernization engagements. 
 - Drive engineering teams to accelerate and scale prototyping, moving PoCs into production-grade delivery. 
 - Champion upfront investment in AI PoCs to build organizational momentum for broader enterprise implementation. 
 - Showcase engineering SME and conduct hands-on workshops across App Modernization, Data Engineering, AI/ML Platform Design, AI Use Case Prioritization, Legacy Exits, Quality Engineering, and DevSecOps. 

AI Governance & Enterprise Strategy

- Partner with cross-Op groups to advise on AI governance and Trusted & Secure AI assessments, shaping the broader technology roadmap. 
 - Maintain strong command on AI & data governance, secure AI adoption practices, and data platform modernization principles. 
 - Align technology modernization initiatives with business priorities, scaling AI adoption across the Group/enterprise. 

Use Case Identification & Business Enablement

- Lead AI use case identification, requirements definition, and implementation across both business and corporate functions. 
 - Orchestrate workshop supports connecting the CAIO/CIO agenda with feasible, prioritized use cases. 
 - Lead workshops on AI-based Business Process Reengineering (BPR), Physical AI business opportunities

Tech Sales Leadership & Client Advisory

- Drive and promote Deloitte's AI implementation capabilities directly to clients 
 - Lead and enable technology-led sales pursuits, RFP responses, and solutioning for AI & Data / Cloud / GenAI opportunities 
 - Bring forth perspectives on Global Delivery Pods, Forward deployment Engineers (FDE Pods ), Staff Augmentation methodologies to shape delivery archetypes 
 - Act as a trusted technical/business advisor in client discussions, bridging technical teams and Japanese business stakeholders with cultural and linguistic fluency

Capability & Practice Building

- Contribute to the firm's AI & Data / GenAI offering development, including industry use cases, accelerators, and reusable IP. 
 - Mentor and upskill delivery teams, particularly around AI/Cloud/GenAI delivery and Japan market readiness. 
 - Represent the practice in internal and external forums, alliance partner sessions, and thought leadership initiatives. 

Required Qualifications

- 12-15+ years of experience in technology consulting, with at least 4-5 years focused on AI/ML, Data platforms, Cloud, and/or Generative AI. 
 - Demonstrated experience working on client engagements in Japan or with Japanese clients (onshore, offshore, or hybrid delivery models). 
 - Business-level or native fluency in Japanese (JLPT N2 or above strongly preferred) and professional fluency in English. 
 - Hands-on design/architecture and delivery expertise on Snowflake and/or Databricks. 
 - Proven experience establishing or operating within an AI Center of Excellence, including AI governance frameworks and enterprise AI roadmaps. 
 - Strong knowledge of AI & data governance, secure/trusted AI adoption assessments, and data platform modernization on cloud 
 - Demonstrated experience leading technology-led sales pursuits, proposal development, and client pitches. 
 - Experience with Global Delivery Pod, FDE Pod, or Staff Augmentation delivery models and contract structuring. 
 - Measurable growth/uplift in sales team win rates for Japan Market on tech-led (AI & Data, GenAI) pursuits through enablement and reusable assets. 
 - PoC-to-production conversion rate demonstrating sustained AI implementation momentum. 
 - Strong internal reputation as the bridge between CAIO/CIO strategic agendas and feasible delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture patterns: agentic AI, RAG/GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, MCP-based integrations, LLM governance frameworks. 
 - Strong executive communication skills - able to build and deliver C-suite (CAIO/CIO)-ready narratives connecting strategy to feasible use cases. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior expatriate assignment or extended engagement based in Japan. 
 - Experience in Physical AI strategy, including GTM, capability acquisition, and manufacturing/procurement strategy. 
 - Experience in financial services, manufacturing, or other Japan-heavy industry verticals. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) or AI/ML specializations. 
 - Experience designing human-agent mixed business processes or leading AI-based BPR workshops. 

Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future.

Staff Engineer for a group of engineers with responsibility for Linux and VMWare initiator stack behavior as well as Fibre Channel and NIC drivers on Pure storage array.

This includes software development/fixes for Linux initiator stack, debugging initiator problems, and creating compatibility documents for Purity. For VMWare, focus is on debugging issues with VMWare as an initiator, and creating compatibility documentation.

This includes responsibility for related code, utilities, enhancements supporting RAS, as well as debugging failures found internally and in the field.

- Experience developing test automation

data.title: Senior Workato Integration Engineer
data.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Senior Workato Integration Engineer

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide. 

Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. 

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Workato Integration Engineer to join our IT / Enterprise Applications team. This role is responsible for designing, building, and scaling enterprise integrations across Five9's business application ecosystem using Workato, while establishing the integration standards and best practices that support the company's continued growth. 

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5 years of integration experience, a Workato certification, deep technical expertise across modern integration patterns and security practices, and the ability to lead technical discussions with both architects and business stakeholders. 

The position is based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires working hours that overlap with the US Pacific time zone, where our Technology teams are primarily based. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade integrations and automations using Workato across Five9's business application ecosystem. 
 - Define and maintain integration standards, reusable patterns, and design guidelines so integrations remain scalable and maintainable as systems evolve. 
 - Standardize error handling across recipes, including retry logic, dead letter queues, compensating transactions, alerting, and logging. 
 - Optimize Workato recipes for performance and cost, minimizing unnecessary API consumption and job usage. 
 - Support and maintain integrations between UKG Pro, Deel, Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, Replicon, and other business applications, partnering with Business Technology teams as needed. 
 - Design and implement secure authentication patterns (OAuth 2. 0, JWT, SAML, API keys, certificates) and manage secrets in accordance with least privilege principles. 
 - Design an enterprise integration architecture and lead technical discussions with architects and business stakeholders. 
 - Troubleshoot complex, cross-system production issues and drive them to resolution. 
 - Improve the quality and consistency of integration and data documentation, leveraging AI tools such as Copilot where appropriate. 
 - Evaluate and incorporate Workato's AI capabilities, including MCP, Workato Genies, and Agent Studio, into Five9's automation strategy where appropriate. 
 - Mentor other integration engineers and help grow the team's technical capabilities. 
 - Stay current with Workato platform updates, integration best practices, and emerging AI-driven automation capabilities. 

Key Requirements: 

- Minimum of 5 years of hands-on integration experience. 
 - Workato certification required (e. g. , Workato Automation Pro or higher). 
 - Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, including HTTP methods, authentication, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, and JSON payloads. 
 - Experience designing reusable, versioned APIs and integrations that remain maintainable as systems evolve. 
 - Strong understanding of authentication and security practices, including OAuth 2. 0, JWT, API keys, Basic Auth, SAML, certificates, secret management, encryption, and least privilege access. 
 - Proficiency working with JSON and XML, including parsing, transformation, and mapping of complex payloads. 
 - Experience with data transformation, including mapping, filtering, aggregation, cleansing, deduplication, and schema conversion. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL, including querying databases, troubleshooting, and relational data models. 
 - Experience implementing robust error handling, including retry logic, dead letter queues, compensating transactions, alerts, logging, and graceful failure handling. 
 - Understanding of event-driven architecture, including webhooks, event streams, asynchronous processing, and message-based integrations. 
 - Familiarity with common integration patterns, including request/response, publish/subscribe, polling, batch processing, ETL, orchestration, and choreography. 
 - Experience with, or strong interest in, business applications such as Salesforce, NetSuite, GCP, UKG, Deel, Ramp, Jira, Freshservice, and Coupa is a big plus. 
 - Familiarity with Workato's emerging AI capabilities, including MCP, Workato Genies, and Agent Studio, is a big plus. 
 - Experience with version control and CI/CD practices for integration development is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling for integration health and performance is a plus. 
 - Awareness of data privacy and compliance considerations (e. g. , GDPR, SOC 2) as they relate to integrations is a plus. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and mentor other engineers. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively across a distributed, global team. 

Why You'll Love This Role: 

- You will play a key role in shaping how Five9's core business systems connect and scale through modern integration and automation technology. 
 - You will work at the forefront of Workato's evolving AI capabilities, including agentic automation and enterprise AI use cases. 
 - You will collaborate with cross functional teams across the enterprise while helping define the integration standards that power the company's growth. 
 - If you enjoy solving complex, cross-system problems and building resilient, scalable integrations, this role offers strong technical depth and growth opportunities. 

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9. com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law. 

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https: //www. five9. com/pt-pt/legal. 

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

data.title: Manager-FDI-FINANCE TECH
data.description:
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

Manager - FDI

EY - GDS - Consulting - Finance

As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc. ), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY's global finance data intelligence service offering. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting. 
 - Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics. 
 - Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives. 
 - Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks. 
 - Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives. 
 - Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools. 
 - Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables. 
 - Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance. 
 - Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration. 
 - Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation. 
 - Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures. 
 - Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives. 
 - Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects. 
 - Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. 
 - Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required. 
 - Skills and Attributes for Success
 - Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles. 
 - Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels. 
 - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly. 
 - Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments. 
 - Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 
 - Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

- CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master's degree in Finance or related field. 
 - 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain. 
 - Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL. 

Ideally, You'll Also Have

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms. 
 - Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives. 
 - Project management certification or experience. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills. 

What We Look For

- A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning. 
 - A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world's top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer: 

- Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues. 
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career. 
 - Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. 

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. 

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 - Guide the team on documentation and data management best practices. 

4. Documentation & Deliverables

data.description:
Position Title: Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME)

Location: Satyavedu

ob Description

The Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Fabrication (Projects & ME) is responsible for the process planning, industrialization, robotic automation, and technical validation of chassis and frame fabrication lines. Sitting at the core of structural manufacturing engineering, this role leads the development of advanced joining processes (MIG, TIG, Resistance, Laser, and Friction Stir Welding), robotic programming (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), WPS/PQR specifications, and metallurgical validation. The incumbent oversees the complete project lifecycle-from DFMEA/PFMEA design reviews and fixture/gauge procurement to Cpk/Ppk trials, PPAP approval, ergonomic line balancing (MOST), and SBP strategic capacity planning-ensuring high weld quality, safety compliance, and zero-defect mass production. 

Key Responsibilities

- Process Planning & Weld Engineering: Formulate Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, WPS/PQR standards, and torch/parameter sequences across manual and robotic joining lines (MIG/TIG/Spot/Laser). 
 - Robotic Automation & Line Setup: Program and commission robotic welding cells (ABB, Fanuc, Yaskawa), integrate automated seam tracking, design ergonomic layouts, and optimize cycle times using MOST. 
 - Tooling, Jigs & Fixture Development: Conceptualize, procure, and prove out welding jigs, locators, Poka-Yoke clamping mechanisms, gauges, and Special Purpose Machines (SPMs) with vendors. 
 - Metallurgical Validation & Quality Control: Perform mechanical testing (tensile, bend, macro/micro, hardness) and NDT inspections to guarantee weld penetration, structural integrity, and IATF 16949 / ISO 3834 compliance. 
 - NPD, APQP & Industrialization: Lead cross-functional trials for New Product Development (NPD), execute ECN updates, drive APQP/PPAP sign-offs, and prove line capability (Cpk/Ppk) for mass production readiness. 
 - Operational Excellence & Cost Optimization: Drive VA/VE projects, scrap reduction, setup time optimization (SMED), OEE improvements, and long-term Strategic Business Plan (SBP) budget/capacity projections. 

Desired Skills & Experience

- Education: B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Metallurgy, Automotive, or Mechatronics Engineering. Experience Requirements by Band: 

- Senior Engineer: 3-6 years of hands-on experience independently managing fabrication process setups, NPD trials, and improvement projects. 
 - Deputy Manager: 9-12+ years of leadership experience driving SBP long-term roadmaps, mentoring engineering teams, upgrading plant technology, and projecting multi-year capital budgets.

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Job Description

Renesas is looking for a Principal Engineer, Validation. to redefine how automotive‐grade silicon quality is built-driving first‐time‐right silicon, eliminating customer escapes, and setting a new industry benchmark for validation excellence

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own the end‐to‐end silicon validation strategy for automotive and HPC SoCs, from pre‐silicon enablement through post‐silicon production release. 
 - Ensure first‐time‐right silicon, robust validation coverage, and zero customer escapes across all assigned programs. 
 - Lead global validation teams responsible for silicon bring‐up, characterization, and system‐level validation across multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Establish and drive a System Use Case Validation Program, harvesting real customer/OEM and system scenarios and converting them into automated, traceable validation suites. 
 - Influence SoC architecture, design, and program decisions through early validation insights, risk identification, and data‐backed recommendations. 
 - Drive shift‐left validation as a measurable engineering program, increasing reuse across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and silicon to reduce late surprises. 
 - Own escape‐prevention strategy, including robustness testing, fault scenarios, coverage models, and disciplined validation signoff criteria. 
 - Build and scale high‐performing validation organizations, developing strong technical leadership (Staff/Principal pipeline) and execution ownership. 
 - Lead automation, standardization, and infrastructure modernization across validation labs, board farms, and CI systems. 
 - Establish validation methodologies, quality benchmarks, metrics, and dashboards aligned with Renesas standards and automotive expectations. 
 - Identify technical, execution, and program risks early; drive data‐driven mitigation and executive decision‐making. 
 - Provide clear executive‐level reporting on validation status, risks, readiness, and outcomes. 
 - Act as a trusted partner to Design, DV, Test, Firmware, Software, Product Engineering, Quality, and BU leadership. 
 - Adoption of industry best practices as a measurable program

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- B. E. /B. Tech or M. E. /M. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience. 
 - 16+ years of experience in semiconductor validation, characterization, or silicon engineering, with demonstrated ownership of silicon quality outcomes. 
 - Strong domain expertise in automotive SoC validation, system‐level use‐case testing, and robustness validation. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex SoC programs from first silicon through production release. 
 - Deep understanding of silicon validation flows, lab environments, and post‐silicon debug ecosystems. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automation‐first validation frameworks using Python, C++, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong experience driving cross‐functional execution in a matrixed, global environment. 
 - Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision‐making skills. 
 - Experience with AI frameworks for SoC Validation efficiency and quality gain- eg validation specific AI agents, Cody AI for content development etc. Preferred

- Experience with ISO 26262 / ASIL‐D development and validation environments. 
 - Exposure to emulation/FPGA‐based shift‐left validation and pre↔post silicon continuity models.

data.title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
data.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16, 800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. 

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. 

We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on. 

You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Design

- Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed. 
 - Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications. 
 - Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply. 
 - Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack. 
 - Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability. 
 - Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers. 
 - Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews. 

Implementation

- Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations. 
 - Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches. 
 - Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards. 
 - Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs. 

Agentic AI for Observability

- Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval. 
 - Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP. 
 - Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems. 
 - Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load. 

Collaboration

- Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring. 
 - Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what "healthy" and "available" mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams. 

Continuous Improvement

- Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly. 
 - Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response. 
 - Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape. 

Qualifications

Required

- 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments. 
 - Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk. 
 - Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e. g. , VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters. 
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them. 
 - Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization. 
 - Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie. 
 - Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools. 
 - Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability. 
 - Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers. 
 - Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening. 
 - Strong scripting skills (e. g. , Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage). 
 - Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting). 
 - Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments. 
 - Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

The company provides comprehensive services for electrical and automation panels, DG sets, UPS systems, transformers, and annual maintenance contracts, including supply, installation, testing, and commissioning across India and globally for both private and government projects. With a strong focus on renewable energy, SYNCHRO ELECTRICALS aims to deliver innovative and sustainable supply and service solutions that support the transition to clean energy. Guided by excellence, integrity, and collaboration, the company strives to be a market leader in industrial electrical solutions through advanced engineering, responsive customer service, and tailored offerings that address evolving client needs. 
Role Description The Production Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Rajkot, responsible for overseeing daily production operations for electrical distribution and automation panels. This role involves planning and scheduling production activities, allocating resources, and ensuring that products meet quality, safety, and regulatory standards. The Production Manager will supervise production teams, monitor workflow, resolve operational issues, and coordinate with design, engineering, procurement, and quality departments to achieve delivery timelines. The role also includes optimizing processes, maintaining production documentation, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and ensuring adherence to company policies and industry best practices. The Production Manager will contribute to efficiency, cost control, and consistent performance in line with the organization's mission and project commitments. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong production management and operations skills, including production planning, workflow optimization, and resource allocation. 
 - Candidates should possess technical skills related to electrical systems, such as familiarity with electrical panels, industrial automation, and relevant standards or codes. 
 - Candidates should possess quality and safety management skills, including experience with inspection processes, documentation, and adherence to safety regulations. 
 - Candidates should possess leadership and people management skills, including team supervision, performance monitoring, and coaching in a manufacturing environment. 
 - Candidates should possess communication and coordination skills, enabling effective collaboration with engineering, procurement, sales, and project management teams. 
 - A degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in manufacturing or electrical panel production.

data.title: ServiceNow Demand Management Architect (Remote
data.description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Demand Architect to bridge business demand with enterprise technology architecture. In this role, you will evaluate incoming demand for technical feasibility, define scalable solution approaches, and provide architectural direction that aligns with the organization's ServiceNow platform strategy. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Solution Architects, Developers, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are technically sound, reusable, and aligned with long-term platform objectives. 

The ideal candidate combines strong ServiceNow platform expertise with enterprise architecture knowledge, enabling informed technical decisions, governance, and strategic planning across the demand lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Review Business Analyst (BA) analysis to assess technical feasibility before effort estimation. 

- Define solution options and recommend the optimal approach by evaluating build vs. configure vs. integrate vs. buy scenarios. 

- Identify cross-functional dependencies, architectural impacts, and integration requirements early in the demand lifecycle. 

- Represent the technical solution during architecture and platform governance reviews, presenting recommendations and technical rationale. 

- Challenge business demands that duplicate existing capabilities or conflict with the ServiceNow platform strategy and enterprise architecture. 

- Maintain visibility of the overall ServiceNow solution landscape, including existing capabilities, planned initiatives, and retiring solutions. 

- Produce high-quality solution design briefs for large, strategic, and complex initiatives. 

- Translate business requirements into clear technical direction for development teams, ensuring a smooth transition from analysis to implementation. 

- Provide architectural guidance and support to developers throughout the implementation lifecycle. 

- Coach Business Analysts on ServiceNow capabilities, platform limitations, and technical concepts to improve requirement quality. 

- Contribute to demand assessment methodologies, including complexity tiering and solution governance frameworks. 

- Partner with Portfolio Managers by providing insights into technical debt, architectural risks, platform health, and modernization opportunities. 

- Develop and maintain reusable architecture patterns, reference solutions, design standards, and governance documentation. 

- Ensure all proposed solutions align with ServiceNow best practices, security standards, scalability, and long-term maintainability. 

Why Join Us?

- Play a strategic role in shaping the organization's ServiceNow platform roadmap and architecture. 

- Influence enterprise-wide technology decisions and digital transformation initiatives. 

- Work closely with senior business stakeholders, architects, and technology leaders. 

- Drive innovation by promoting reusable solutions, architectural consistency, and platform optimization. 

- Gain exposure to complex enterprise programs spanning multiple ServiceNow products and integrations. 

- Be part of a collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning, technical excellence, and professional growth. 

Qualifications & Requirements: 

- 10+ years of overall IT experience with significant experience in ServiceNow architecture, solution design, or enterprise architecture. 

- Strong understanding of the ServiceNow platform, including architecture, governance, integrations, and best practices. 

- Experience evaluating business demand and translating functional requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

- Expertise in solution architecture, application integration, and enterprise design principles. 

- Strong knowledge of ServiceNow implementation methodologies and platform governance. 

- Experience creating architecture documents, solution design briefs, technical roadmaps, and decision records. 

- Ability to identify technical risks, dependencies, architectural impacts, and optimization opportunities. 

- Experience collaborating with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Development teams, Enterprise Architects, and senior business stakeholders. 

- Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. 

- Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or SAFe delivery environments. 

Certifications: 

- ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) - Mandatory

- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - Preferred

- ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) - Preferred

- TOGAF 9/10 Certified

- IASA CITA-F (IT Architecture Foundation) / CITA-P (Professional)

- ITIL 4 Foundation

- AWS or Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional level)

Good-to-Have Skills: 

- Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, FSM, IRM/GRC, App Engine). 

- Knowledge of CSDM, CMDB, Data Foundation, IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, and enterprise integration patterns. 

- Exposure to Now Assist and AI-driven capabilities within the ServiceNow platform. 

- Experience defining enterprise architecture standards, reusable solution patterns, and governance frameworks. 

- Knowledge of cloud architecture, microservices, APIs, event-driven integrations, and enterprise integration platforms. 

- Experience contributing to platform modernization initiatives, technical debt reduction, and strategic technology roadmaps.

data.description:
Life at EvoluteIQ

We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building an industry leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business. To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self-driven, and collaborative. 

People who not only want to be a part of a fast-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and caring-about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day. 

Could that be you?

We are looking for an experienced Java Technical Lead to build clean, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready applications. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience taking Python applications into production, enforcing engineering best practices. 

What you'll do at EvoluteIQ: 

- Own end-to-end technical design for web and enterprise applications, including browser/client, DNS, TLS/HTTPS, reverse proxy/load balancer, API/middle tier, messaging, cache, databases, and deployment infrastructure. 
 - Lead hands-on Java development and engineering using Java, JVM, Spring/Spring Boot and modern API/microservice patterns; review critical code and solve complex technical problems. 
 - Design for performance, scalability, high availability, resilience, security, observability, maintainability, backup/recovery, and capacity requirements. 
 - Prepare HLDs; drive and review team LLDs, API contracts, data models, sequence flows, integration designs, and deployment designs. 
 - Validate WBS, estimates, dependencies, assumptions, technical risks, and implementation plans; work closely with Project Management through delivery. 
 - Partner with Product Management to refine requirements, identify edge cases/NFRs, assess feasibility, and translate product intent into implementable solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers, enforce engineering standards, perform design/code reviews, and lead root-cause analysis for production and performance issues. 

What will you bring to the team

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 2-4+ years as a Technical Lead/Lead Engineer. 
 - Architecture/design patterns, distributed systems, troubleshooting across application/database/network/infrastructure layers, and strong analytical problem solving
 - Strong Java and JVM fundamentals: collections, concurrency, multithreading, memory management, garbage collection, profiling, exception handling, and performance tuning. 
 - Spring / Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, dependency injection, persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - RDBMS expertise: MySQL/PostgreSQL/Oracle/SQL Server; data modelling, SQL tuning, indexing, transactions, locking, isolation, connection pooling, HA and scalability. 
 - Working knowledge of NoSQL/cache/search technologies such as Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or Cassandra; messaging such as Kafka/ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ. 
 - HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, DNS, TCP/IP basics, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, API security, certificates, NGINX/reverse proxies, load balancing and clustering. 
 - Linux, Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, CI/CD, cloud deployment concepts and production observability/logging/monitoring. 

What We Offer

- Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next-gen hyper-automation platform. 
 - Work with a cross-disciplinary team in a fast-growing, innovation-driven environment. Competitive compensation and growth opportunities. 
 - A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. 

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

data.description:
Description

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?

Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team. 

We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5× growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading. 

As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99. 9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems. 

Key job responsibilities

- Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
 - Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
 - Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
 - Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
 - Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

A day in the life

- Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
 - Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
 - Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

About The Team

The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services. 

Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster. 

We are a global team with presence across India and North America. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
 - 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Job Title: Electrical Quality Engineer for Solar Projects

Job Description

As an Electrical Quality Engineer for Solar Projects, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of our solar power installations. You will be responsible for overseeing all electrical aspects of our solar projects from design through construction and commissioning. Working closely with project managers, engineers, and installation teams, you will uphold the highest standards of electrical engineering practices to optimize system performance and longevity. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain quality assurance procedures to ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal quality benchmarks throughout all stages of project development. 
 - Design Review: Review electrical designs and specifications for solar power systems to identify potential issues, optimize performance, and ensure adherence to project requirements and local electrical codes. 
 - Supplier and Material Evaluation: Evaluate electrical components, equipment, and materials supplied by vendors to ensure they meet specified standards and performance criteria. 
 - Installation Oversight: Provide technical guidance and oversight during the installation and commissioning of solar power systems, ensuring that all electrical work is executed safely, accurately, and according to design specifications. 
 - Testing and Inspection: Conduct electrical tests and inspections during various project stages to verify system functionality, identify defects or deficiencies, and ensure compliance with safety and performance standards. 
 - Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution: Identify and troubleshoot electrical issues or discrepancies that arise during project execution, proposing effective solutions to maintain project timelines and quality standards. 
 - Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of project activities, including inspection reports, test results, and compliance documentation. Prepare regular progress reports and communicate findings to project stakeholders as needed. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Participate in lessons learned sessions and contribute to process improvements to enhance the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of future solar projects. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. 
 - Previous experience in solar energy or renewable energy projects preferred. 
 - Proficiency in electrical design software and familiarity with relevant industry standards and codes (e. g. , NEC, IEEE). 
 - Strong understanding of electrical systems, components, and equipment used in solar power generation. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Effective communication and teamwork abilities, with the capacity to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Certifications such as NABCEP PV Installation Professional or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) desirable. 
 - Commitment to safety, quality, and environmental sustainability principles.

data.title: Director, Engineering - Marketplace & Dev Ecosystem
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Engineering - Marketplace & Dev Ecosystem based in India. 

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity for an experienced technology leader to shape the future of a large-scale marketplace and developer ecosystem within a global, remote-first SaaS environment. You will define the engineering vision for public APIs, third-party integrations, developer tools, monetization infrastructure, and the app marketplace. The role combines strategic planning, architectural leadership, and people management to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable platform capabilities. You will lead multiple engineering teams, mentor managers and senior technical contributors, and establish a culture of accountability and technical excellence. Working closely with Product and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help expand partner capabilities, improve the developer experience, and unlock new revenue opportunities. Your work will directly influence how external developers and businesses build, integrate, and grow on a platform serving a global customer base. 

Accountabilities

- Engineering Leadership and Team Development
 - Mentor and coach Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Tech Leads, fostering technical excellence, accountability, and ownership. 
 - Lead performance reviews, define clear career development paths, and support the growth of engineering talent across the marketplace organization. 
 - Build and develop resilient teams capable of operating high-traffic public APIs and reliable financial transaction systems. 
 - Strategic Planning and Execution
 - Translate business objectives into scalable engineering roadmaps for the marketplace and developer ecosystem. 
 - Improve processes for managing hundreds of integrations and thousands of developer applications throughout their lifecycle. 
 - Establish effective agile delivery practices while maintaining rigorous security, governance, and reliability standards. 
 - Architecture and Technical Oversight
 - Oversee public API architecture, including versioning strategies, backward compatibility, scalability, and high availability. 
 - Guide the development of monetization infrastructure, including automated payouts and usage-based billing systems. 
 - Maintain high engineering standards across SDKs, sandbox environments, native integrations, and developer-facing tools. 
 - Drive architectural decisions that support platform extensibility, operational resilience, and long-term growth. 
 - Business Strategy and Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner with Product Managers and other business stakeholders to define the strategy for the app marketplace and partner program. 
 - Design extensible integration architectures that support major third-party platforms, including Google, Meta, and Slack, as well as custom solutions. 
 - Align technical investments with business priorities, developer needs, platform adoption, and revenue growth. 
Requirements

- Experience: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership or management roles overseeing multiple teams or other managers. 
 - Technical expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Node. js and Vue. js, or comparable modern front-end frameworks such as React or Angular. 
 - Developer ecosystem experience: Demonstrated success building or managing public APIs, developer platforms, app marketplaces, or complex third-party integration ecosystems. 
 - SaaS background: Experience in a high-growth Software-as-a-Service environment is highly desirable. 
 - Architecture and systems design: Strong judgment in API versioning, backward compatibility, system security, scalability, and high-availability architecture. 
 - Leadership capabilities: Proven ability to mentor engineering leaders, develop high-performing teams, manage complex delivery portfolios, and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. 
 - Strategic execution: Ability to translate business needs into technical roadmaps and balance rapid delivery with quality, security, and governance. 
 - Collaboration: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business functions. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 

Benefits

- Remote work: India-based remote position within a globally distributed organization. 
 - Leadership impact: Opportunity to shape the engineering strategy for a large marketplace and developer ecosystem. 
 - Technical scale: Work on complex systems involving public APIs, distributed services, integrations, developer tooling, and monetization infrastructure. 
 - Professional development: Opportunities to mentor engineering leaders, influence architectural direction, and help build high-performing teams.

data.title: Senior Privacy Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Privacy Engineer based in India. 

As a Senior Privacy Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing technology that protects users' privacy across digital products and services. You will lead complex engineering projects, build innovative privacy solutions, and help strengthen protections against online tracking and emerging threats. Working within a distributed, remote-first engineering team, you will take ownership of major technical components from initial planning through implementation and ongoing improvement. You will collaborate across teams to ensure new features and product developments uphold strong privacy standards. The role offers opportunities to contribute to privacy-focused search technologies, AI-powered experiences, and advanced tracking protection systems. You will also participate in privacy reviews, support engineering best practices, and mentor colleagues as the team grows. 

Accountabilities

- Lead high-impact, complex engineering projects from initial proposal and technical planning through implementation, deployment, and post-project evaluation. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain privacy-preserving systems and features that protect users across search technologies, AI experiences, browsers, and related digital services. 
 - Build and improve systems that enhance search indexes and AI capabilities while maintaining robust user privacy protections. 
 - Develop and extend crawler-based technologies to identify, analyze, and address emerging online tracking methods and privacy threats. 
 - Implement, maintain, and optimize privacy features, including web tracking prevention and email protection capabilities. 
 - Write pragmatic, efficient, maintainable, and testable code using technologies such as Go, Node. js, Python, and, where appropriate, Perl. 
 - Take ownership of critical privacy technology components, ensuring their reliability, security, scalability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Participate in privacy reviews, technical audits, and product assessments to ensure engineering decisions and new developments align with established privacy principles. 
 - Navigate ambiguous technical challenges, identify practical solutions, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to deliver effective outcomes. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, project progress, and privacy considerations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Mentor fellow engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the professional development and long-term growth of the privacy engineering team. 

Requirements

- Significant professional experience in software engineering, with demonstrated expertise in developing and maintaining privacy-focused technologies or solutions. 
 - Strong technical understanding of online privacy threats, tracking mechanisms, and the technologies and approaches used to mitigate them. 
 - Practical experience building privacy solutions in an engineering role, such as tracker blocking, differential privacy, or comparable privacy-enhancing technologies. 
 - Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Go, Node. js, Python, or Perl. 
 - Proven ability to lead complex, high-impact technical projects from concept and planning through delivery, maintenance, and retrospective analysis. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to work through ambiguous requirements, evaluate trade-offs, propose innovative approaches, and execute solutions effectively. 
 - Experience designing reliable, performant, maintainable, and well-tested software systems. 
 - The ability to collaborate effectively across functions, involve stakeholders when needed, and communicate technical concepts and decisions to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise. 
 - A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, and initiative, with the ability to manage projects independently while contributing to shared team objectives. 
 - Interest in mentoring engineers, sharing expertise, and supporting the development of colleagues. 
 - Willingness to work remotely with an international team, participate in video meetings with cameras enabled, and travel approximately twice a year for company-wide gatherings and team retreats. 
 - Ability to commit to a full-time workload averaging 40 hours per week, with flexibility to coordinate across time zones and no fixed core working hours. 
 - Willingness to complete a background check as a condition of employment. 

Benefits

- Annual compensation: €157, 350 for Europe and the rest of the world, including India, according to the stated global compensation structure. 
 - Equity compensation: Stock options offered in addition to annual salary. 
 - Transparent compensation framework: Compensation is standardized by professional level rather than individual location or functional area. 
 - Remote-first work environment: Work remotely from India as part of a globally distributed team. 
 - Flexible working arrangements: No fixed core hours, offering flexibility in organizing your work around team commitments and project priorities. 
 - Wellbeing and family support: Access to support provisions that include paid parental leave. 
 - Home office support: Assistance with office setup and coworking allowances. 
 - Professional growth: Opportunities to lead complex projects, expand technical expertise, and take ownership of significant privacy engineering initiatives. 
 - Mentorship opportunities: Scope to guide other engineers and contribute to the development of the broader engineering team. 
 - Mission-driven work: The opportunity to build technology that advances online privacy and helps protect users from tracking and other digital privacy risks.

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client's goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what's right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success - they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab's growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations - it's a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region . 

Our team is seeking a Software Development & Engineering Manager with a passion for the retirement industry and a strong history of leading development teams. Our mission is to build, maintain, and modernize our robust set of solutions. 

What you have

Required Qulaifications

- 3-5 years of experience as a manger leading engineering teams 
 - 10+ years of hands on experience in software development building enterprise software using Microsoft technology stack: . Net framework, . Net Core - C#. 
 - 5+ years' experience as a Technical Lead 
 - 3+ years experience in UI Development using the Angular framework with CSS, JavaScript, HTML5, and TypeScript. 
 - Demonstrated experience in designing, creating, testing, and consuming APIs using micro-services architecture patterns with a focus on availability, security, and performance 
 - Knowledge of authorization frameworks (e. g. , OAuth 2, SAML, JWT) 
 - Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment experience using modern tools (Bamboo, BitBucket/Git, Jenkins, or others) 
 - Experience developing RESTful Web APIs in Microsoft . NET or related technologies 
 - Minimum B. S. in Computer Science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Domain Driven Design methodology 
 - Experience with State Management (NgRx) and RxJs 
 - Advanced knowledge of Splunk 
 - Experience working in the Retirement or Financial Services industries 
 - Excellent oral and written communication skills

What's in it for you
