data.title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Test Engineering - Networking Background Required based in India. 

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity for an experienced quality professional to lead end-to-end testing and quality strategy for a complex network security operating system. You will oversee quality assurance across major releases, patches, and hotfixes, ensuring that critical firewall products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and customer trust. Working across engineering, product management, release engineering, DevOps, and support, you will embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will drive automation strategy, strengthen CI/CD integration, and improve test infrastructure across hardware, virtual, and cloud environments. The role combines deep networking expertise with strategic planning, technical decision-making, and people leadership. You will also mentor QA managers and senior engineers while building a high-performing team focused on continuous improvement and predictable, high-quality releases. 

Accountabilities

- Quality Strategy and Release Management
 - Define and continuously improve the quality assurance strategy for network security software across major releases, patches, and hotfixes. 
 - Establish quality gates, entry and exit criteria, and measurable release readiness standards. 
 - Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to identify defects and security risks early in the development lifecycle. 
 - Lead quality reviews and make release go/no-go recommendations based on testing results, risk assessments, and product readiness. 
 - Networking and Security Test Leadership
 - Provide technical leadership across firewall capabilities, including stateful firewalling, NAT, IPSec and SSL VPNs, routing, and high availability. 
 - Oversee testing of security services such as intrusion prevention, DPI-SSL, gateway antivirus, application control, and web filtering. 
 - Review product requirements, design documents, and architecture proposals to identify quality, security, and reliability risks. 
 - Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional behavior, end-to-end customer workflows, throughput, performance, scalability, and stress testing. 
 - Ensure robust validation of failover scenarios, upgrades and downgrades, configuration migrations, and long-duration system stability. 
 - Champion negative testing and security-focused scenarios to validate resilience against misuse, abuse cases, and potential threats. 
 - Automation and Test Infrastructure
 - Define the long-term automation roadmap across UI, API, CLI, and end-to-end testing, with measurable coverage and effectiveness goals. 
 - Partner with automation leaders to develop scalable, reliable test frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Improve automated test suite stability by reducing flaky tests and strengthening the reliability and usefulness of test results. 
 - Oversee test environment strategy across physical hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments. 
 - Collaborate with infrastructure teams on test environment availability, capacity planning, and operational reliability. 
 - Quality Metrics and Continuous Improvement
 - Track key quality indicators, including defect leakage, production escape rates, regression effectiveness, automation return on investment, and test flakiness. 
 - Lead regular release readiness reviews and communicate quality risks, trends, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
 - Conduct root cause analyses for production defects and customer-impacting incidents, addressing systemic quality gaps. 
 - Translate customer and field feedback into preventive testing improvements and stronger engineering practices. 
 - People Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration
 - Build, mentor, and retain a strong QA leadership team comprising managers, technical leads, and senior engineers. 
 - Establish clear performance expectations, career development pathways, and technical growth plans. 
 - Influence engineering and product leadership to prioritize quality, reliability, security, and customer outcomes. 
 - Represent the QA function in leadership discussions, cross-functional reviews, and customer escalations. 
Requirements

- Professional experience: 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2 years in an engineering management or leadership role. 
 - Networking expertise: Strong hands-on understanding of networking and security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN technologies, high availability, authentication mechanisms, and intrusion prevention or deep packet inspection concepts. 
 - Domain experience: Proven experience testing firewall products, network security solutions, or comparable complex system software. A strong networking background is essential for this position. 
 - Quality ownership: Demonstrated ability to lead quality assurance for complex software releases, establish testing strategies, and manage release readiness and risk. 
 - People management: Experience leading, developing, and scaling QA teams, including collaboration across locations and time zones. 
 - Automation and CI/CD: Strong knowledge of test automation strategy, automated regression testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and quality engineering practices. 
 - Technical judgment: Ability to assess architecture and design decisions, identify security and reliability risks, and develop comprehensive test coverage for complex systems. 
 - Communication and influence: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical teams and influence senior decision-makers. 
 - Preferred platform experience: Previous experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall operating systems is an advantage. 
 - Additional preferred qualifications: Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as FIPS, Common Criteria, or SOC 2; experience testing hybrid hardware, virtual, and cloud environments; and experience handling customer escalations and field issue root cause analysis. 
 - Location and work arrangements: The role is based in Pune, India. Candidates should confirm any relocation expectations and applicable working arrangements during the hiring process. 

Benefits

- Location flexibility: The role is advertised with remote-work tagging, although the listed location is Pune, India; the precise remote or hybrid arrangement should be confirmed. 
 - Leadership opportunity: Shape quality strategy for critical network security software and influence release decisions at scale. 
 - Technical impact: Work on complex firewall technologies, security services, automation frameworks, and large-scale test infrastructure. 
 - Professional growth: Mentor engineering leaders, strengthen technical leadership capabilities, and influence cross-functional engineering practices. 
 - Continuous improvement: Drive measurable advances in automation coverage, testing effectiveness, release predictability, and customer reliability. 
 - Collaborative environment: Partner with engineering, product, DevOps, release management, and support teams. 
 - Compensation and employee benefits: Salary range, healthcare coverage, paid leave, bonuses, and other specific benefits were not provided in the available job description and should be confirmed with the hiring team. 
 - Equal opportunity: The employer states a commitment to fair employment practices and an inclusive workplace.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

data.description:
Description

Have you ever wondered how that Amazon box with the smile arrives so quickly, where it came from, and how much it cost Amazon to deliver? The WW Amazon Logistics, Business Analytics team manages the delivery of tens of millions of products every week to Amazon's customers, achieving on-time delivery in a cost-effective manner. 

We are seeking an enthusiastic, customer-obsessed Research Science Manager(RSM) with strong analytical skills to join our team. This role is crucial in optimizing Amazon's vast delivery network and will have significant impact on the customer experience, particularly in the final phase of delivery. 

As a Research Science Manager, You Will

- Address business challenges through building compelling cases and using data to influence change across the organization
 - Develop input and assumptions based on preexisting models to estimate costs and savings opportunities associated with varying levels of network growth and operations
 - Create metrics to measure business performance, identify root causes and trends, and prescribe action plans
 - Manage multiple high-impact projects simultaneously
 - Work with technology teams and product managers to develop new tools and systems supporting business growth
 - Communicate with and support various internal stakeholders and external audiences
 - Implement scheduling solutions, improve metrics, and develop scalable processes and tools

Looking For Minds With

Extensive experience in operations research and data-driven decision making

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Robust program management and research science skills

Ability to work with a team and make independent decisions in ambiguous environments

Customer-obsessed mindset with a focus on improving the Amazon delivery experience

This role offers the autonomy to think strategically and make data-driven decisions from day one. Join us in shaping the future of e-commerce delivery and addressing the core challenges in our world-class operations space!

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

- Advanced Modeling and Algorithm Development: 

Design and implement sophisticated machine learning models for logistics optimization

Develop complex time series forecasting algorithms for demand prediction and resource allocation

- AI and Machine Learning Integration: 

Architect and deploy AI-powered systems to enhance decision-making in logistics operations

Implement deep learning techniques for image recognition in package sorting and handling

Develop reinforcement learning algorithms for adaptive scheduling and resource management

- Big Data Analytics and Processing: 

Design and implement distributed computing solutions for processing massive logistics datasets

Utilize cloud computing platforms (e. g. , AWS) for scalable data processing and analysis

- AI-Driven Workflow Optimization: 

Design and implement AI agents for autonomous decision-making in logistics processes

Create machine learning models for customer behavior analysis and personalized delivery options

- Software Development and System Architecture: 

Write efficient, scalable code in languages such as Python, Java, or C++

Develop and maintain complex software systems for logistics optimization

Stay at the forefront of AI and ML research

Publish research findings in top-tier conferences and journals

About The Team

We are Amazon's Last Mile Science and Analytics team, dedicated to improving e-commerce delivery. We work to optimize our vast network, forecast demand using machine learning, and enhance route efficiency. Our efforts focus on developing innovative delivery methods, applying AI to solve complex problems, and conducting geospatial analysis. We create simulations to refine processes and plan capacity effectively. Operating globally, we strive to develop adaptable solutions for diverse markets. We aim to advance logistics science, continually improving speed, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, in support of Amazon's mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company. 

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
 - PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or Master's degree and 10+ years of industry or academic research experience
 - Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl
 - Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

Preferred Qualifications

- PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
 - Knowledge of deep learning, machine learning and statistics
 - 4+ years of scripting, programming, or security code review in a common language, such as Python, Java or C++ experience
 - Knowledge of mathematical/statistical/physics fundamentals
 - Experience in successful technology product work from ideation through launch
 - Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
 - Experience in science or engineering team management
 - Experience leading and managing a team (external or internal as required)
 - Experience shaping business strategy for technical products or services for large enterprises or partners
 - Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
 - 5+ years of data science, business analytics, business intelligence, or similar experience in big data environments experience
 - Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. 
 - Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc. 
 - PhD or equivalent research experience, or PhD and 12+ years of applied research experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. data.title: Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
data.description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) - a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. 

About The Team

The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America. 

About The Role

As a Senior Principal Cloud Platform Engineer you'll keep our AI inferencing platform reliable, fast, and scalable. Your focus is uptime, latency, and resource utilization on the inference endpoints customers depend on. The work spans monitoring, deployment, capacity planning, and incident response, and includes a shared on-call rotation covering 24/7 coverage. 

Responsibilities

- Owning the availability, latency, and efficiency of the production inferencing service, including change management, emergency response, and standing up AI infrastructure in new regions
 - Building and maintaining monitoring, alerting, and dashboards in Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog covering service health, model latency and throughput, and RDU utilization
 - Leading incident response, running blameless post-mortems, and automating the toil those incidents expose
 - Finding and fixing performance bottlenecks, and designing auto-scaling policies that handle variable inference load without overspending
 - Managing cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code in Terraform and Ansible, and building the CI/CD pipelines that deploy new model versions and service updates

Required Qualifications

- B. S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 3+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role supporting a large-scale, customer-facing service in a public cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
 - Strong programming and scripting skills in Python, Go, or Java
 - Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
 - Deep understanding of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or the ELK Stack
 - Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD
 - Strong Linux system administration fundamentals

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a hybrid environment spanning cloud and on-premise data center infrastructure
 - Experience supporting ML or AI inferencing services in production
 - Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing and optimizing workloads for NVIDIA GPUs, for purposes of mapping to RDUs
 - Knowledge of model serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, or Ray
 - Experience managing and tuning databases (SQL or NoSQL) and caching systems such as Redis or Memcached

Base Salary Range: 

Base Pay Range

₹8, 900, 000-₹10, 800, 000 INR

Submission Guidelines

Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. 

EEO Policy

SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions

SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

🚀 About Joveo

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work. 

We are hiring a director to shape this capability and build the organisation that delivers it. 

🌟 About the role

Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on. 

You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop. 

For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost. 

🧠 What you'll do

- Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service. 
 - Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand. 
 - Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible. 
 - Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs. 
 - Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions. 
 - Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability. 

🎯 What we're looking for

- You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field. 
 - You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you. 
 - You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost.

data.title: AI/ML Engineering Lead
data.description:
Job Title: AI/ML Engineering Lead Company: Toro Technology Center India

Who Are We?

The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career. 

What Will You Do?

In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: 

AI/ML Engineer, EIT

- Design, develop, test, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, and other business use cases. 
 - Validate, optimize, and continuously improve models through feature engineering, experimentation, performance analysis, tuning, and evaluation to support production readiness and business outcomes. 
 - Build Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including conversational assistants, ML models, intelligent search, and multi-step intelligent workflows. 
 - Develop and optimize models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and AI architecture based on accuracy, quality, latency, cost, security, explainability, scalability, and business value. 
 - Design scalable, secure, and maintainable AI services, APIs, data and feature pipelines, and enterprise application integrations using strong software engineering practices, including source control, code review, automated testing, and technical documentation. 
 - Implement MLOps and GenAIOps practices, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated deployment, rollback, and lifecycle management. 
 - Establish production monitoring and evaluation to track model performance, data and prediction drift, groundedness, bias, data quality, reliability, safety, usage, cost, and operational health, with appropriate alerting and retraining or remediation workflows. 
 - Implement Responsible AI, security, and governance controls, including risk assessments, human-in-the-loop oversight, access controls, data protection, traceability, and safeguards against hallucination, prompt injection, and data leakage. 
 - Troubleshoot production AI solutions, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve reliability, scalability, performance, and operational supportability. 
 - Translate business opportunities into well-defined AI problem statements, success measures, solution designs, and delivery plans, collaborating with Business, Data Science and Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal, Compliance, and Governance teams to deliver production-ready solutions aligned with enterprise standards. 

What Do You Need?

To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative or technical discipline. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, AI Engineering, and/or advanced analytics. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, evaluation, optimization, and production monitoring. 
 - Experience building Generative AI or agentic AI applications using technologies and patterns such as RAG, vector search, embeddings, tool calling, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks. 
 - Proficiency in one or more programming and analytical technologies such as Python, R, Spark, Scala, and SQL. 
 - Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques, including neural networks, XGBoost, support vector machines, gradient boosting, random forests, and related algorithms. 
 - Experience working with both structured and unstructured data, including feature engineering, information retrieval, dimensionality reduction, and feature extraction. 
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline. 
 - Experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical techniques, and data visualization. 
 - Advanced proficiency with Python/R, Spark, SQL, MLOps, GenAIOps, and agentic AI workflows. 
 - Experience designing and operating production Generative AI solutions utilizing RAG, embeddings, vector and semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks. 
 - Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agents SDK, Databricks, or comparable AI/ML platforms. 
 - Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Azure DevOps, or comparable enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience with MLflow or comparable experiment tracking and model registry capabilities, containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, privacy, data governance, model risk management, security, and Responsible AI controls. 
 - Experience operating production AI/ML solutions with model observability, service-level monitoring, cost controls, incident management, usage telemetry, and continuous performance improvement.

Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior System Software Engineer - HW/SW Co-Design
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24, 000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's PossibleTM. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X). 

Senior System Software Engineer

We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join our HW/SW Co-Design team. In this role, you will take ownership of individual IP blocks from a software perspective -- defining, reviewing, and implementing the functionality and the hardware/software interfaces of those blocks in close collaboration with the HW engineer writing the RTL. 

You will work alongside a Principal System Software Architect who sets the broader system-level direction, while you dive deep into the details of specific IP blocks. Your focus is narrower but no less critical: ensuring that each block is well-designed for software consumption, efficiently programmable, debuggable, and consistent with the overall system architecture. 

This is applied engineering, not abstract design work. You will spend 4-6 weeks at a time embedded with a hardware engineer counterpart, iterating together on register maps, data flow, interrupt behavior, configuration schemes, and DMA interfaces -- writing real code against virtual platform models to validate decisions before silicon exists. 

Key Responsibilities

- IP Block Software Ownership: Own the software perspective for assigned IP blocks end-to-end -- from initial definition through implementation review and pre-silicon validation. 
 - HW/SW Interface Definition: Work directly with HW engineers to co-define register maps, control/status interfaces, interrupt schemes, and data path configurations that are efficient and straightforward to program. 
 - Virtual Platform Implementation: Work with the SystemC modeling team to deliver firmware or driver prototypes against virtual platforms to validate IP block designs and catch usability or performance issues early. 
 - Design Review Participation: Review RTL specifications and micro-architecture documents, providing actionable feedback from a software integration perspective before RTL is committed. 
 - Driver & Firmware Prototyping: Develop early driver code and firmware prototypes that exercise IP block functionality, proving out programming models and identifying gaps. 
 - Debuggability Assessment: Evaluate and influence the debug and observability features of each IP block, ensuring software has adequate visibility during bringup and in the field. 
 - Documentation & Handoff: Produce clear programming guides, register descriptions, and usage examples that downstream software teams can use to build production drivers and SDKs. 
 - Cross-Block Integration: Collaborate with peers owning adjacent IP blocks to ensure consistent interfaces, shared conventions, and smooth data flow between blocks. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in embedded software, firmware development, or SoC platform software
 - Proficiency in C/C++ with hands-on experience writing device drivers, HALs, or register-level firmware
 - Strong understanding of hardware/software interfaces: register maps, memory-mapped I/O, interrupt handling, DMA, and bus protocols (AXI/AHB/APB)
 - Ability to read and interpret RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) or hardware specification documents
 - Experience collaborating directly with hardware design engineers during IP or SoC development
 - Familiarity with SystemC (TLM 2. 0) or willingness to develop proficiency quickly for virtual platform work
 - Attention to detail -- able to identify subtle interface issues, race conditions, or ambiguities in hardware specifications
 - Strong interpersonal skills -- able to work side-by-side with HW engineers for extended periods, negotiate trade-offs constructively, and build trust

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with AMBA protocols
 - Experience with SystemC modeling or virtual platform development (e. g. , Synopsys Virtualizer, QEMU, or custom TLM platforms)
 - Familiarity with FPGA prototyping or pre-silicon software bring-up workflows
 - Experience with Zephyr RTOS and/or Embedded Linux kernel driver development
 - Knowledge of RISC-V or Arm architecture, including interrupt controllers, memory protection, and debug infrastructure
 - Experience with signal processing, data converter, or mixed-signal IP blocks
 - Familiarity with hardware emulation environments (Palladium, Veloce, etc. )
 - Background in design verification or functional coverage from a software stimulus perspective
 - Experience with Verilog/SystemVerilog for co-simulation or design comprehension

What Sets This Role Apart

This is not a downstream software role where you receive a finished data sheet and write a driver. You are part of the design process from the start -- shaping the hardware you will eventually program. When the register map doesn't make sense for software, you have the authority and responsibility to push back and propose alternatives. 

Expect to spend weeks at a time working intensively with a single HW engineer on a specific IP block -- whiteboarding interfaces, debating trade-offs, writing prototype code, and iterating until the design is right. This requires patience, attention to detail, and the ability to compromise effectively when hardware constraints conflict with software ideals. 

You will stay with your IP blocks through the full lifecycle: initial concept, specification review, virtual platform validation, silicon bringup, and production driver handoff. If you want deep ownership of the hardware/software boundary at the block level and enjoy the craftsmanship of getting interfaces right, this role is for you.

About Platform Services

Platform Services as a group provides common infrastructure, managed services, and product development and release services to support Bloomberg's application development. The group has about a thousand team members spread across all of Bloomberg's global offices focused on Application and Middleware Frameworks, Database Solutions, Connectivity, Security, Cloud Native Compute and Storage Services. Our mission is to provide Bloomberg developers with a standard, scalable, managed and compliant platform experience. 

About The Teams

DataLayer Platform

DataLayer is the high-performance library used to build reactive transformations of data in the Bloomberg Terminal. From simple sorting and filtering, to complex multi-level aggregations and the Excel-like expression evaluation engine, Datalayer is the engine that powers almost every grid or table of data in the Bloomberg Terminal. 

The newly created DataLayer Platform team in Pune will take ownership of embedding the DataLayer into Bloomberg runtimes, providing seamless integration with the Bloomberg Terminal and backend services. This will require the team to work closely with other DataLayer teams as well as multiple infrastructure teams to ensure that DataLayer works as efficiently and performant as possible in those runtimes. 

We'll Trust You To

- Have an eye for detail and an interest in working on the complex challenges of large-scale distributed systems.

data.title: Software Engineering Manager- Build and Release Engineering
data.description:
This role has been designed as ''Onsite' with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. 

Job Description

Software Engineering Manager - Build and Release Engineering

We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for build, release engineering, source code administration, and sandbox tooling supporting large-scale systems, including the release pipeline for HPE Networking's JUNOS and EVO platforms. This is a working manager role: you will set direction and manage a high-performing team while staying directly engaged in the engineering work. The role combines technical depth with people leadership, requiring the ability to build and mentor high-performing engineers while driving strategic DevSecOps initiatives across the organization. 

As a leader, you will define and execute the roadmap for CI/CD infrastructure, source code administration, and developer sandbox environments; partner with cross-functional engineering, release, and product managers; and establish best practices that enable scalable, reliable, high-velocity development workflows, all while remaining close enough to the code and systems to guide technical decisions credibly and unblock your team when needed. 

What You Will Do

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team responsible for build, release engineering, source code administration, and sandbox tooling for large-scale systems, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement, while staying directly engaged in the codebase and infrastructure. 
 - Personally contribute to architecture, design reviews, and complex debugging for CI/CD platforms, source control systems, and sandbox infrastructure, not just direct the work from a distance. 
 - Own the architecture, scalability, and reliability of enterprise-wide CI/CD, source code management, and sandbox platforms, staying technically deep enough to make and defend design decisions. 
 - Define and drive the CI/CD, source code administration, and automation strategy for JUNOS and EVO platform delivery, aligning with broader engineering and business objectives. 
 - Oversee the development of robust automation frameworks for build, test, release, source code administration, and infrastructure orchestration, contributing code and scripts directly where it accelerates delivery. 
 - Establish and enforce best practices for version control, branching strategies, artifact management, and release governance across large, distributed codebases. 
 - Drive DevSecOps practices across the build and release pipeline, including generation and management of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX). 
 - Drive adoption of AI/ML-driven automation and observability to improve pipeline efficiency, detect issues early, and reduce cycle time. 
 - Ensure production CI/CD, SCM, and sandbox systems meet high standards for availability, performance, scalability, and security; act as a technical escalation point during critical incidents. 
 - Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts across CI/CD, SCM, and sandbox infrastructure, often diagnosing issues directly alongside the team. 
 - Influence and guide organizational DevSecOps maturity, setting standards and driving consistency across teams. 

What You Need To Bring

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15 -20 years of experience in build/release engineering, source code administration, or infrastructure engineering for large-scale systems, with increasing leadership responsibility and a track record of staying technically engaged. 
 - 5+ years of experience managing or leading high-performing engineering teams while continuing to write code, review designs, or troubleshoot production systems directly. 
 - Proven experience architecting and operating large-scale CI/CD, source code management( Gerrit, SVN, Gitlab, Github) and sandbox systems in complex, multi-repository environments. 
 - Deep expertise in CI/CD tools and frameworks (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) at enterprise scale. 
 - Experience generating and managing SBOM and VEX reports, and integrating supply chain security and vulnerability management into build and release pipelines. 
 - Strong proficiency in programming/scripting (Python, Bash, Go, or similar), with the ability to personally build and debug automation, not just review it. 
 - Strong Linux systems expertise and operational troubleshooting skills for C/C++/Rust-based build systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence technical direction, backed by credible, direct engineering experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience migrating large-scale build, release, or source code systems across geographies. 
 - Experience applying AI/ML techniques for intelligent automation, observability, or anomaly detection. 
 - Expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and executive-level presentation skills. 

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

data.title: Chief Technology Officer
data.description:
If you are looking for a job, this is not for you

CTO Founding role  (Salary + Equity)

About Simora

Simora. ai is the contextual layer for AI video. AI models can generate a video, but they don't understand a brand, its audience, the language people actually speak or what works in their market. Simora adds that context, for enterprises, we go further. We build custom studios and AI workflows around how their teams actually create content, so large organisations can produce videos at scale in their own format, brand and process. Over 1000+ brands, agencies and enterprises use Simora today. 

Simora's next stage is building our own models. You will lead how we train and fine-tune open-source video, voice and image models on our own data, and how we run them in production at a cost that works. 

If you are looking for a job, this is not for you. This is for people who are looking to start their own startup, or who want to mine the gold rush of AI with the right ideas and execution. 

The role

We are looking for a CTO to join as a founding member and own all of Simora's technology. You will set the technical direction, build and lead the engineering team, and make the calls on architecture, infrastructure, AI models and cost. You will work closely with the founders on what we build next. 

This is a building role, not a supervising one. You will write code every day, alongside the team you lead. 

You are the right person if you

- Have built a complete product end to end, from first architecture to paying users at scale, and stayed accountable for it in production
 - Live in the code. Even as CTO, you write, review and ship code yourself
 - Are the person everyone turns to when things go wrong. When a system breaks, you figure out what happened and fix it, fast
 - Have trained or fine-tuned open-source AI models yourself, from preparing the data to evaluating results and running the model in a real product
 - Are hands-on with the AI/ML stack: PyTorch, Hugging Face, diffusion and generative models, fine-tuning methods like LoRA, and GPU training and inference infrastructure
 - Can judge when to train our own model, when to fine-tune an open one and when to simply use an API, and what each will cost
 - Are best at figuring things out, even in parts of the system or problems you have never seen before
 - Have led engineers, hired well and set the standard for how a team builds
 - Understand AI models and media pipelines well enough to decide what to build, what to buy and what it will cost
 - Think in terms of business outcomes, not just technology: speed, reliability and cost per user matter equally to you
 - Plan clearly, move fast and are comfortable with the uncertainty of an early-stage company
 - Know your systems better than anyone else. Use any AI tool you like, but you understand everything that goes to production

This role is not for you if

- You are looking for a job. This is for people who want to start their own startup, or who want to mine the gold rush of AI
 - You have only used AI through APIs and have never trained or fine-tuned a model yourself
 - You see the CTO role as managing and reviewing, not coding
 - You have only managed teams and no longer build things yourself
 - You have never owned a product's technology end to end
 - You need a large team and established processes to be effective

What you get

- Co-founder level equity
 - Salary
 - Full ownership of Simora's technology and a real say in the direction of the company
 - Direct partnership with the founders as one of them

How we will move ahead: 

This is not a usual hiring process. We are looking for someone to build Simora with us, so we want to get to know each other properly before either of us commits. 

1. We meet. Online or in person, whichever works for you. We will show you what we are building, where we are taking it and the vision behind it. You will see the product, the numbers and the problems as they are. 

2. We see if the vibe matches. If you like what you see and we feel the same about you, we move to the next step. If not, we part ways with respect, no hard feelings on either side. 

3. We work together for three months. You join us full time at our office in Bengaluru, on a fixed salary. This is not a part-time or side arrangement. It is the best way for both of us to see how we think, build and handle hard days together. 

4. We offer co-founder level equity. If things go well in these three months and we know we are right for each other, we will offer you the equity structure right away, along with your salary. 

We would rather take three months to build the right partnership than rush into one that doesn't last.

data.title: SDWAN/L3 Test Engineering Technical Leader | L2/L3 security | Network automation | IPSEC and cloud security(11-15 Years)
data.description:
Meet the Team

Cisco SDWAN focuses on simplifying and securing enterprise WANs, enabling seamless cloud connectivity, automating network operations and ensuring optimal application performance through advanced SD-WAN solutions. 

Your Impact

- Define and drive test strategy and validation architecture for software features on Cisco SDWAN Secure Router Platforms. 
 - Establish end-to-end test strategies covering functional, system, scale, performance, resiliency, security and migration. 
 - Lead customer demos and technical presentations to showcase product capabilities and articulate solution value. 
 - Design and evolve scalable test frameworks, automation platforms, and validation pipelines for enterprise-grade networking. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leaders, product management, hardware, and TAC teams to define quality goals, test scope, and execution strategies. 
 - Mentor team members to enhance technical depth, architectural thinking, and quality leadership. 
 - Represent the test organization in cross-functional forums to influence release decisions, risk assessment, and quality metrics. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in CS or Equivalent or related degree with 11+ years in Layer 2/Layer 3 or SD-WAN product testing. 
 - Strong testing experience in NAT, Firewall, QoS, BFD, NetFlow, and GRE /IPsec . 
 - Hands-on expertise in IP and IPv6, ARP, DNS, DHCP, AAA, RADIUS, SNMP, EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP. 
 - Experience with HA and redundancy protocols, PKI, certificate management, and Layer 2/Layer 3 security. 
 - Good understanding of SD-WAN architecture and operations, including PNP, ZTP, and Day 0 or Day N workflows. 
 - Strong Linux fundamentals with hands-on virtualization experience in KVM or ESXi. 
 - Hands-on use of troubleshooting tools such as Ixia, Spirent, and Wireshark. 
 - 8+ years of experience in Network automation experience using Python and REST APIs. 
 - Proficiency with Git for code and configuration version control. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and end-to-end solution validation skills. 
 - Clear verbal and written communication skills for complex technical topics. 
 - Strong collaboration across engineering teams and mentoring skills. 
 - Performance Debugging: Perform deep-dive analysis into performance bottlenecks at the kernel and hardware-abstraction layers including control plane and dataplane. 
 - Modern Test Practices: Utilize modern Test workflows, including AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex) and integrated development environments like VSCode, to accelerate the development lifecycle and improve code quality. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Cisco Viptela or Meraki, VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet, or Prisma SD-WAN. 
 - Familiarity with SD-WAN integration across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
 - Experience with CI or CD pipelines and network automation. 
 - Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments. 
 - Exposure to AI-driven automation for network management and optimization. 
 - CCIE, CCNP or equivalent certifications. 

#sdwanhiring

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Description

Maersk is achieving an unprecedented transformation in the growth of our business, rethinking the way we engage with customers and partners, and how the world's trade flows across our global network. You will play a vital part in our success, helping ensure that our customers, partners and internal users are provided with the right tools and a seamless experience utilizing a wide variety of technologies across the business. 

Work Experience: 14+ years of experience Software Engineering, Product Development, Engineering excellence at scale, technical mentoring

Key Skills: As a key member of the technical leadership team, you will serve as a liaison to the larger Fulfilled by Maersk Engineering community. The ideal candidate is one who has successfully led the solutioning, design and development of complex Integration Engineering solution at scale; is passionate about technology and knows how to get results; is driven to create and build; is operationally credible; possess a relentless focus on the customer; and can effectively build, inspire and lead teams. 

Who You Are

- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale, high-performance integration solutions in hybrid (on-prem + cloud) environments. 
 - Strong background in E-commerce, API design, and microservices-based architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and containerized workloads. 
 - Adept at translating business objectives into technical strategies and measurable outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication skills - able to simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences. 
 - Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving ability, and bias for action. 
 - Recognized as a technical thought leader with credibility across engineering and business teams. 
 - Hands-on experience in modernization from legacy to Microservices. 
 - Ability to fully understand business goals and metrics, turn data into insights, and translate requirements into actionable analysis
 - Able to present and communicate technical concepts in a clear and concise manner
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, supported by excellent written and oral communication
 - Exhibit a strong work ethic and technical thought-leadership

People Leadership

- Inspiring and approachable as a leader; Ability to motivate and inspire team to overcome challenges and focus on problem-solving
 - Create an environment where people can realize their full potential
 - Be humble and lead with open, candid relationships
 - Proven expertise in building, mentoring and achieving high performing teams
 - Passionate about engaging and developing talent; attract, develop, engage and retain talented individuals with a compelling, unifying vision that steers and motivates

Additional Competencies

- Natural bar-raiser: curious and passionate, with a desire to continuously learn more, which you use to understand basic business operations and the organizational levers that drive profitable growth
 - Bias to action, being familiar with methods and approaches needed to get things done in a collaborative, lean and fast-moving environment
 - Respond effectively to complex and ambiguous problems and situations
 - Lead mostly with questions rather than opinions, thriving on the opportunity to own, innovate, create, and constantly re-evaluate
 - Comfortable making recommendations across competing and equally critical business needs
 - Simplify, clearly and succinctly convey complex information and ideas to individuals at all levels of the organization

data.title: Deputy General Manager_Oracle SOA & FMW
data.description:
Who we are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability. 

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal. 

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Middleware professional to provide senior subject-matter expertise and end-to-end operational ownership across Oracle Middleware, Enterprise Integration and Enterprise Content Management services. 

Based at SP Infocity, Pune, this role will support the reliable operation, resilience and continual improvement of Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB), Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC) platforms underpinning critical Telecom BSS, OSS and enterprise applications. 

You will lead production support, major incident recovery, service transitions and platform stabilisation while advancing observability, automation, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and AI-driven operational optimisation. This is primarily an Application and Middleware Operations and Service Management role rather than an application development position. 

Candidates should bring 12+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for Oracle Fusion Middleware production environments, together with technical leadership and service-governance experience. 

What you will do

Middleware and integration operations

- Own the operational health, availability, performance, resilience and supportability of Oracle SOA Suite, OSB, WebLogic and WCC platforms 
 - Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex middleware, integration, service orchestration and content-management incidents 
 - Govern critical integration flows, messaging frameworks, service orchestration processes and enterprise content services 
 - Maintain service-level commitments across middleware and integration platforms 
 - Lead capacity planning, performance optimisation and technology lifecycle activities

Incident, problem and service management

- Lead P1/P2 major-incident recovery and coordinate troubleshooting across application, infrastructure, database and network teams 
 - Lead root-cause analysis, corrective actions and known-error management to reduce recurring disruption 
 - Maintain SLA and KPI performance across Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request and operational-risk processes 
 - Establish proactive support practices focused on resilience and reduced service downtime 
 - Conduct post-incident reviews and translate findings into continual-improvement actions

Service transition and operational readiness

- Lead due diligence, knowledge acquisition, service transition and operational takeover 
 - Coordinate shadowing, reverse-shadowing and knowledge-transfer activities 
 - Establish operational-readiness requirements covering documentation, monitoring, runbooks, access management, escalation procedures, capacity planning, security controls and disaster recovery 
 - Own early-life support and stabilisation of transitioned services

Platform governance and administration

- Monitor and maintain the operational reliability of interfaces, APIs, web services, message flows and enterprise integrations 
 - Manage Oracle WebLogic domains, clusters, managed servers and application deployments 
 - Support Oracle SOA composites, BPEL processes, Mediators, Adapters and OSB services 
 - Administer and support WCC repositories, content workflows, storage utilisation and service availability 
 - Perform environment validation, deployment verification and patch-coordination activities 
 - Identify performance degradation, integration failures and bottlenecks and coordinate appropriate remediation 
 - Maintain middleware compliance with applicable security and audit requirements

Automation, observability and continual improvement

- Automate health checks, deployment verification, service validation, housekeeping and operational reporting using Shell Scripting, WLST, SQL and relevant automation technologies 
 - Develop proactive monitoring, dashboards and alerting using enterprise observability platforms 
 - Apply operational insights and AI-driven approaches to improve efficiency and reliability 
 - Use service trends to reduce Mean Time To Restore (MTTR), repeat incidents and manual operational effort 
 - Improve alert thresholds, event correlation and proactive issue detection

Stakeholder and technical leadership

- Partner with Business, Enterprise Architecture, Service Management, Infrastructure, Database, Security, Application and Vendor teams 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring to L2/L3 support engineers 
 - Support knowledge management, cross-skilling and succession planning 
 - Facilitate operational reviews, governance forums and service-improvement initiatives 
 - Maintain clear stakeholder communication during outages, service changes and transition activities

Who you are

You bring 12+ years of experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations, with substantial hands-on experience supporting Oracle middleware in highly available, mission-critical production environments. 

Essential technical knowledge

- Oracle SOA Suite administration and production support
 - Oracle Service Bus (OSB)
 - Oracle WebLogic Server administration
 - Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC)
 - Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)
 - BPEL, Mediators and Adapters
 - SOAP and REST services
 - API and message-based integration
 - Middleware performance tuning
 - High Availability and Disaster Recovery
 - Unix/Linux administration and Shell Scripting
 - Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
 - WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST)
 - Middleware and application log analysis
 - Interface troubleshooting and monitoring
 - Oracle Database fundamentals
 - SRE practices and AI-driven operational optimisation

Service and operational expertise

You have demonstrable experience in major incident and problem management, service recovery, service transition, operational readiness, ITIL-aligned service management, observability, automation and operational improvement. You can apply independent judgement to complex production issues while coordinating effectively across technical and business stakeholders. 

Knowledge of managed-service governance, vendor management, audit and compliance readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity and availability management, and operational risk management is also relevant. 

Desirable exposure

Experience with one or more of the following would complement the core requirements: 

- Oracle API Gateway and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
 - Oracle Identity Management, Oracle Access Manager and Oracle Internet Directory

data.title: Senior Software Developer – Cloud Platform Engineering (OCI / Kubernetes / Java)
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native software solutions within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

In this IC3 individual contributor role, you will work on the Data Plane and Control Plane components of Oracle's IoT platform, combining hands-on software engineering with cloud infrastructure automation, container orchestration, and production troubleshooting. 

You will collaborate with engineering, QA, and DevOps teams to improve platform reliability, optimize performance, automate deployments, and deliver high-quality software solutions. 

The ideal candidate brings strong Java development experience, hands-on expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure automation capabilities, and practical experience operating software in cloud environments. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Platform Development: Design, develop, and enhance software components supporting the Data Plane and Control Plane of Oracle's OCI IoT platform. 
 - Containerization and Orchestration: Develop, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, availability, and operational stability. 
 - Infrastructure Automation: Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and maintenance using Terraform or Ansible to improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency. 
 - Software Engineering and API Development: Develop and optimize Java-based software components and APIs, applying software design principles, concurrency concepts, secure coding practices, and appropriate testing strategies. 
 - Production Reliability and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve application, infrastructure, networking, and integration issues while improving observability, system performance, and service availability. 
 - Security and Operational Excellence: Implement cloud security best practices, support vulnerability remediation, and contribute to maintenance, patching, monitoring, and reliability improvements. 
 - Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: Partner with development, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders to deliver software enhancements, conduct code reviews, resolve defects, and improve engineering standards. 
 - Technical Ownership and Continuous Improvement: Independently manage assigned engineering deliverables, contribute to architecture-aligned design decisions, mentor colleagues where appropriate, and identify opportunities to improve development and operational processes. 

Qualifications & SkillsMandatory

AreaEssential Requirements

Education BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

Experience 5+ years of software industry experience, including 3+ years in a senior developer or technical leadership capacity. 

Programming Experience in Java and Python, including Java software design principles, concurrency, debugging, and development best practices. 

Containers Strong hands-on expertise with Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment and troubleshooting. 

Infrastructure as Code Practical experience automating infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible. 

Cloud platforms Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, or Azure. 

Software engineering Ability to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and optimize scalable software components and APIs. 

Production troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve software and infrastructure issues in production environments. 

Cloud networking Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including cloud configuration and troubleshooting. 

Cloud security Knowledge of cloud security and secure software development practices. 

Collaboration Ability to work independently, collaborate across engineering teams, communicate effectively, and adapt to new technologies. 

Good-to-Have

- Prior experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Experience developing and deploying CI/CD pipelines across multi-cluster, multi-region, or multi-architecture environments. 
 - Experience in the Internet of Things (IoT) domain. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native platform engineering involving Data Plane and Control Plane components. 

Important classification note: The original JD explicitly lists IoT experience and complex CI/CD environments as preferred. OCI-specific experience is not mandatory because AWS or Azure experience is also accepted. Data Plane/Control Plane experience is treated as an advantage rather than a screening requirement because the JD describes it as work to be performed, not an explicit prior-experience prerequisite. 

Self-Assessment Questions

- Do I have at least five years of software industry experience, including three years of senior development or technical leadership responsibility?
 - Have I worked hands-on with Java and Python, including developing, debugging, and optimizing software components?
 - Am I confident deploying and troubleshooting Docker-based applications in Kubernetes environments?
 - Have I automated infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible and worked with OCI, AWS, or Azure?
 - Can I independently investigate production issues involving applications, APIs, networking, security, or cloud infrastructure and collaborate effectively to resolve them?

Qualifications

Career Level - IC3

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
