data.title: SAP ABAP/ BTP Developer
data.description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better. 

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14, 000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers. 

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

What We Bring To The Table: 

The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits you'd expect from a global leader (401k, health insurance, paid time off, etc. ) we also offer: 

- Competitive compensation
 - Career growth opportunities
 - Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices
 - We prioritize our communities and the planet we share. We are proud to be awarded as a Diversity Inc. Top 50 company for Diversity and have multiple Sustainability awards (ranking #22 in the World and #1 in Food Products)
 - Wellbeing programs including Physical, Mental and Financial wellness
 - Tuition assistance

Position Overview

The Senior SAP ABAP Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality SAP solutions across on-premise and SAP BTP ABAP environments. The role focuses on building scalable, efficient, and maintainable applications, leveraging advanced ABAP techniques and modern programming models. 

As a technical lead, the developer collaborates closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust technical designs. They drive solution architecture, enforce development standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure performance optimization and clean-core principles are followed across implementations. 

The role also involves developing advanced extensions and integrations using SAP BTP, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), and cloud-native approaches. Additionally, the Senior ABAP Developer mentors junior team members, promotes best practices, and contributes to continuous innovation within the SAP landscape. 

Shift Timings: 01PM - 09: 30PM IST

Description

Key responsibilities

- First level contact for the Business Analysts for any inquiries re: application or technical support and potential technical solutions. 
 - Analyzes business requirements and functional specifications to determine effective technical solutions to support the business across multiple entities (divisions, functions, countries)
 - Provide technical solutions and governance for SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP solutions, ensuring compliance with architecture standards, development guidelines, and best practices. 
 - Designs complex solutions across multiple functions, business units, technical tools and/or systems. 
 - Designs, codes, tests, and implements new application programs and/or modifies existing programs. 
 - Considers trade-offs between performance, scalability, reliability, availability, maintainability, manageability and business requirements. 
 - Provides post implementation application support and regular system maintenance and support which will periodically require evening, weekend, and on-call support. 
 - Support new project initiatives as a Senior Developer, designing and building SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP objects to meet business and technical requirements. 
 - Act as a senior technical authority, providing hands‐on guidance, problem resolution, and design support for complex development and integration scenarios. 
 - May function as Team and/or Project lead responsible for completion of project phase. 
 - Recommend and promote platform and industry best practices, including cloud‐ready development approaches and clean core principles\

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Description

Level of Education and Discipline

Bachelors or Maters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Certification and/or Licenses

SAP Backend Developer - ABAP Cloud

SAP Backend Developer - Cloud Application Programming Model

Any SAP Development Cloud related certification

Experience - Functional/industry/commercial Knowledge, Business Acumen

- 5-8 years of experience working in the SAP ecosystem (required)
 - 5+ years of hands‐on experience in SAP BTP ABAP development (required)
 - Proven experience delivering and governing SAP ABAP solutions in large, complex enterprise environments
 - Strong hands‐on expertise in: 
 - SAP S/4HANA ABAP development
 - SAP BTP ABAP Environment
 - SAP Business Application Studio (BAS)
 - RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP)
 - Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM)
 - SAP Build
 - SAP BTP Workflow
 - Demonstrated understanding of modern programming paradigms and cloud‐based extension models

Strong business and functional acumen, enabling translation of enterprise requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions

Interpersonal Skills - leadership, interactions, communication, influence

Ability to develop effective working relationships. Demonstrated organizational, verbal, and written communication skills. Acts as a mentor within team and across GBS and proactively shares knowledge. Interacts with peers to manager. Interacts with peers to director (presents to and interacts with function heads and steering committees) Performs role in a professional manner with the ability to develop effective working relationships. 

Other Skills And HPO Competencies

Proven leadership and project management skills. Ability to work on complex integration of one or more functional or technical areas. Seeks constant improvement opportunities and appropriately challenges technical solutions to improve performance and reduce Total Cost of Ownership. 

The Role Demonstrates High Performance Organization (HPO) Competencies, Including: 

- Values all People: Encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing, and trust
 - Strategic Thinking: Balances BAU stability with project innovation and long‐term platform goals
 - Influence: Drives adherence to standards and best practices
 - Personal & Team Leadership: Takes ownership and supports team capability growth
 - Attracting & Developing Talent: Actively enables skill development through coaching and hands‐on collaboration
 - Innovation: Applies modern development models and tools where appropriate
 - Business Savvy & Acumen: Understands enterprise priorities, risk, and operational impact

The role requires a deep understanding of clean core and extensibility, best practices, strong analytical and design skills, and experience in large, regulated enterprise environments. Success depends on balancing strategic governance with hands‐on technical contribution, along with strong documentation and technical review capabilities. 

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our "Power of People" principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

 - Mentor junior members, participate in interviews, and contribute to building high-performance teams.

 - Strong oral and written communication skills.

 - 12+ years of experience and must be hands-on with coding

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Designation: Senior Manager - Industrial Engineering

Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat

About The Role

The Sr. Manager - Industrial Engineering owns the Industrial Engineering function across all Group Bayport plants and processes - printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. This is a senior, cross-plant leadership role: standardising IE method and measurement (SAM/MOST, line balancing, layout re-designing, SMED) across previously fragmented, undocumented practice, and directly supervising the Stitching IE and Plant Area IE teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plant-Wide IE Leadership
 - 
 - Lead plant-level Industrial Engineering strategy across all factory floors - printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. 
 - Act as direct supervisor for the IE - setting priorities, reviewing output, and developing the team. 
 - Standardise IE methodology, templates and reporting formats so results are comparable across areas and roll up cleanly to Management. 
 - Methods, Layout & Line Balancing
 - 
 - Own workstation layout design, line ergonomics and tooling standardisation across all plant areas. 
 - Direct line-balancing exercises against Takt Time on printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. 
 - Review and approve area-level SMED / quick-changeover initiatives before roll-out. 
 - Time & Motion Standards
 - 
 - Own delivery of the Departmental SAM (Standard Allowed Minutes) Catalog, in partnership with MDM team for BOM set-up. 
 - Validate area process times against field time-study data before they are published as standard. 
 - Sign off the time-study methodology and sample sizes with each Plant Area IE before field work begins. 
 - Visual Management
 - 
 - Implement hourly production tracking boards - with BPM Team. 
 - Introduce Poka-Yoke / mistake-proofing where scrap or quality leakage is systemic rather than one-off. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership
 - 
 - Partner with MDM Team for BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size/labour/machine). 
 - Partner with the Manager, Global Capacity to feed validated IE process-time data into the Capacity vs Demand model and the monthly Capacity Governance Review. 
 - Partner with the Manager, Automation & Business Analyst on layout and line-balancing implications of newly commissioned machines, and on post-commissioning variance audits. 
 - Support the Ops Excellence Head on the phased CIP / LDM / VSM roll-out. 
Qualifications & Experience

- 
 - B. E. / B. Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering; a Master's degree or equivalent Lean/Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is preferred. 
 - 10-15 years of progressive Industrial Engineering experience in an apparel manufacturing environment, including at least 8 years in a managerial role leading multiple engineers or areas. 
 - Demonstrated, hands-on expertise in BOM/SAM/MOST/MTM time-study methods, line balancing, workstation layout design and Takt Time setting. 
 - Experience standing up or running a structured time-study or work-study programme, including supervising junior engineers/interns collecting field data. 
 - Prior exposure to apparel, soft-furnishing, furniture or comparable multi-SKU manufacturing is preferred, across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. 
 - Working proficiency in Excel and, ideally, Power BI, for data-driven decisions. 
Skills & Competencies

- 
 - Senior stakeholder management - comfortable presenting to and being evaluated. 
 - People leadership across multiple, physically dispersed teams and areas. 
 - Analytical rigor balanced with pragmatic, shop-floor-first problem solving. 
 - Structured change management - able to introduce new standards without disrupting live production. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication for cross-functional coordination with MDM, Global Capacity and Automation. 
Key Performance Indicators

- 
 - BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size / labour / machine calculation) - SKU wise
 - Departmental SAM Catalog - % of process elements documented and signed off, against plan. 
 - Line efficiency / OEE improvement on lines where IE has intervened. 
 - On-time delivery of hourly production tracking board roll-out.

data.title: FBS - Product Owner IV- Data Delivery
data.description:
Takes a fully independent lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog. Anticipates and prioritizes needs, oversees development stages and executes multiple value streams, agent channels and lines of business. Acts as a primary liaison and evaluates product progress. Collaborates and leads multiple cross functional teams on feature delivery. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks with little to no support with a high volume of work and increased complexity. Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to to regularly contribute and manage execution. Heavily influences the business owner's requirements, the Product Manager's program vision and roadmap while introducing new and useful tools and practices to drive continuous improvement. Provides overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance and provides back up to Product Manager, as needed. 

Requirements

Exp- 7 to 9 Years

Skill- Product owner exp in Data Architecture, Expertise in Data Delivery, Data Governance, Data Models, Data Profiling

Must have- P&C / Commercial Insurance experience

Location- Pune & Hyderabad

- Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value
 - Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. 
 - Leads discussions on off-train dependencies across various value streams. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. 
 - Utilizes advanced business knowledge, based on prior experience within business function, and communication skills to anticipate problems and address them accordingly. 
 - Works cross functionally in a self-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Leads processes and procedure changes identified by teams by working with external business partners
 - Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. 
 - Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared expectations. 
 - Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. 
 - Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. 
 - Contributes strategic input into the prioritization of the program backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. 
 - Drives the mitigation of program risks. Leads PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution. 
 - Leads in Inspect & Adapt (I&A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. 
 - A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery
 - Regularly works to refine the program backlog in the value stream, collaborating with business owners and stakeholders to refine feature acceptance criteria, to ready features as candidates for the ART(s) to deliver in the next program increment. 
 - Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies
 - Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, sharing extensive knowledge in order to make sound decisions. 
 - Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution
 - Partners with a diverse group of stakeholders and interfaces with senior leaders in the organization to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. 
 - Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. 
 - Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. 
 - Continuously keeps the end-user needs in mind based on higher level of business acumen to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories
 - Independently represents business owners' interest and prioritize user stories based on business value while maximizing agile team's capacity. Provides mentorship and guidance to PO II and III. Performs other duties as assigned

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package: 

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
 - Comprehensive benefits package
 - Career development and training opportunities
 - Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
 - Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
 - Private Health Insurance
 - Pension Plan
 - Paid Time Off
 - Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.

data.description:
Company Description ADWIK INTELLIMECH PVT LTD delivers material handling and intralogistics solutions designed to improve productivity and reduce product travel time for industrial and business clients worldwide. The company provides end-to-end services, including in-house design, manufacturing, system integration, deployment, and support. ADWIK specializes in engineered systems that enable automation across every stage of material handling. Its product portfolio includes belt and modular conveyors, roller conveyors, storage systems (FIFO/LIFO, warehouse), chain and slat chain conveyors, turntables, sorters, lifters, stackers, and related automation equipment. 
Role Description The Team Leader - Design is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai, responsible for leading the design team in developing material handling and intralogistics solutions. This role involves managing end-to-end product design activities, including requirements gathering, concept development, detailed design, and design reviews to ensure technical accuracy, safety, and manufacturability. The Team Leader will coordinate closely with project management, manufacturing, and installation teams to align designs with project timelines and client specifications. Day-to-day tasks include assigning and monitoring design work, mentoring team members, ensuring adherence to standards and best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement of design processes and tools. 
Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong Team Leadership and Team Management skills to guide, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary design team. 
 - Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with clients, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional project teams. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Project Management skills to plan design activities, manage timelines, and support successful project delivery. 
 - Candidates should possess Product Design skills relevant to mechanical systems, material handling equipment, and automation solutions. 
 - Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline is preferred, with experience in industrial automation or material handling design. 
 - Proficiency in CAD tools (e. g. , AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar) and familiarity with design standards, safety regulations, and manufacturing processes. 
 - Ability to analyze technical requirements, propose innovative solutions, and work independently in a fast-paced, production-oriented environment. 
 - Prior experience in leading design teams or projects in intralogistics, conveyors, or warehouse automation will be an advantage.

Join An Engineering company, a rapidly scaling technology startup, as an SDE 4 / EM in Bangalore, India. You will lead and develop a dedicated team of engineers, creating impactful solutions in the consumer healthcare sector. - Be part of a passionate team that values innovation and creativity. 
 - Enjoy opportunities for personal and professional growth in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Build high-impact solutions that can positively affect healthcare outcomes. 
 - Receive valuable equity options as part of your compensation package. 
 - Contribute to a dynamic company culture that encourages entrepreneurial spirit.

data.title: Senior Software Developer – Cloud Platform Engineering (OCI / Kubernetes / Java)
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native software solutions within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

In this IC3 individual contributor role, you will work on the Data Plane and Control Plane components of Oracle's IoT platform, combining hands-on software engineering with cloud infrastructure automation, container orchestration, and production troubleshooting. 

You will collaborate with engineering, QA, and DevOps teams to improve platform reliability, optimize performance, automate deployments, and deliver high-quality software solutions. 

The ideal candidate brings strong Java development experience, hands-on expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure automation capabilities, and practical experience operating software in cloud environments. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Platform Development: Design, develop, and enhance software components supporting the Data Plane and Control Plane of Oracle's OCI IoT platform. 
 - Containerization and Orchestration: Develop, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, availability, and operational stability. 
 - Infrastructure Automation: Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and maintenance using Terraform or Ansible to improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency. 
 - Software Engineering and API Development: Develop and optimize Java-based software components and APIs, applying software design principles, concurrency concepts, secure coding practices, and appropriate testing strategies. 
 - Production Reliability and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve application, infrastructure, networking, and integration issues while improving observability, system performance, and service availability. 
 - Security and Operational Excellence: Implement cloud security best practices, support vulnerability remediation, and contribute to maintenance, patching, monitoring, and reliability improvements. 
 - Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: Partner with development, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders to deliver software enhancements, conduct code reviews, resolve defects, and improve engineering standards. 
 - Technical Ownership and Continuous Improvement: Independently manage assigned engineering deliverables, contribute to architecture-aligned design decisions, mentor colleagues where appropriate, and identify opportunities to improve development and operational processes. 

Qualifications & SkillsMandatory

AreaEssential Requirements

Education BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

Experience 5+ years of software industry experience, including 3+ years in a senior developer or technical leadership capacity. 

Programming Experience in Java and Python, including Java software design principles, concurrency, debugging, and development best practices. 

Containers Strong hands-on expertise with Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment and troubleshooting. 

Infrastructure as Code Practical experience automating infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible. 

Cloud platforms Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, or Azure. 

Software engineering Ability to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and optimize scalable software components and APIs. 

Production troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve software and infrastructure issues in production environments. 

Cloud networking Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including cloud configuration and troubleshooting. 

Cloud security Knowledge of cloud security and secure software development practices. 

Collaboration Ability to work independently, collaborate across engineering teams, communicate effectively, and adapt to new technologies. 

Good-to-Have

- Prior experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Experience developing and deploying CI/CD pipelines across multi-cluster, multi-region, or multi-architecture environments. 
 - Experience in the Internet of Things (IoT) domain. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native platform engineering involving Data Plane and Control Plane components. 

Important classification note: The original JD explicitly lists IoT experience and complex CI/CD environments as preferred. OCI-specific experience is not mandatory because AWS or Azure experience is also accepted. Data Plane/Control Plane experience is treated as an advantage rather than a screening requirement because the JD describes it as work to be performed, not an explicit prior-experience prerequisite. 

Self-Assessment Questions

- Do I have at least five years of software industry experience, including three years of senior development or technical leadership responsibility?
 - Have I worked hands-on with Java and Python, including developing, debugging, and optimizing software components?
 - Am I confident deploying and troubleshooting Docker-based applications in Kubernetes environments?
 - Have I automated infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible and worked with OCI, AWS, or Azure?
 - Can I independently investigate production issues involving applications, APIs, networking, security, or cloud infrastructure and collaborate effectively to resolve them?

Qualifications

Career Level - IC3

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.title: SOC/Subsystem Principal Verification Engineer
data.description:
About the Company

Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. Cadence customers are the world's most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health. 

The Cadence Advantage

- The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact. 
 - Cadence's employee-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees. 
 - The unique "One Cadence - One Team" culture promotes collaboration within and across teams to ensure customer success. 
 - Multiple avenues of learning and development available for employees to explore as per their specific requirement and interests. 
 - You get to work with a diverse team of passionate, dedicated, and talented individuals who go above and beyond for our customers, our communities, and each other-every day. 

Location: Hyderabad

About the Role

A SOC/Subsystem Lead Verification Engineer is responsible for owning the verification strategy, planning, execution, and closure for a complex SoC block or subsystem. The role combines strong hands-on verification depth with technical leadership, cross-functional coordination, and delivery accountability. 

Responsibilities

- Lead verification of SoC or subsystem-level designs from architecture review through verification closure, ensuring functional correctness, coverage closure, and high-quality tapeout readiness. 
 - Drive methodology, team execution, debug, and alignment with design, architecture, firmware, emulation, and system teams. 
 - Define subsystem or SoC-level verification strategy, architecture, and execution plan. 
 - Review specifications, architecture documents, and micro-architecture for testability and verification completeness. 
 - Create and own verification plans, feature mapping, coverage models, and closure criteria. 
 - Lead development of UVM/SystemVerilog-based verification environments, reusable testbenches, checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and assertions. 
 - Drive test planning for protocol, performance, power, reset, interrupt, security, coherency, and error scenarios. 
 - Own regression strategy, triage, debug, and bug tracking to closure. 
 - Lead coverage closure across code coverage, functional coverage, assertions, and scenario coverage. 
 - Coordinate with design, DFT, firmware, architecture, emulation, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and review verification code, test plans, and debug approaches. 
 - Identify verification gaps, schedule risks, and quality risks early and drive mitigation. 
 - Support formal verification, emulation, prototyping, and low-power verification where applicable. 
 - Drive signoff readiness and contribute to tapeout reviews. 

Qualifications

- 10-20years of experience in ASIC/SoC verification. 
 - Strong experience in subsystem or SoC-level verification ownership. 
 - Proven track record of leading verification closure for complex designs. 
 - Strong debugging skills across RTL, testbench, protocol, and system-level issues. 
 - Experience handling technically complex, cross-functional programs with schedule accountability. 

Required Skills

- Strong hands-on expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM. 
 - Solid understanding of verification methodologies, constrained-random testing, assertions, and coverage-driven verification. 
 - Experience with SoC fabrics and standard protocols such as AXI, AHB, APB, NoC, PCIe, USB, Ethernet, DDR, CXL, CHI, ACE, or similar, depending on domain. 
 - Experience in subsystem integration verification including resets, clocks, interrupts, boot flows, power states, and register validation. 
 - Working knowledge of SVA, formal verification concepts, CDC/RDC, and lint flows. 
 - Familiarity with emulation or FPGA prototyping is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python, Perl, Shell, or Tcl for automation and regression analysis. 
 - Experience with coverage and debug tools from major EDA vendors. 
 - Understanding of low-power verification using UPF/CPF is preferred. 
 - Exposure to firmware-hardware interaction and performance validation is a plus. 

Preferred Skills

- Lead a small to mid-sized verification team or act as technical lead for a larger program. 
 - Break down high-level milestones into execution plans and track delivery. 
 - Drive technical reviews and decision-making. 
 - Mentor engineers on methodology, coding quality, and debug efficiency. 
 - Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and closure metrics clearly to stakeholders. 

Pay range and compensation package

Location: Hyderabad

data.title: Senior Software Developer – Cloud Platform Engineering (OCI / Kubernetes / Java)
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Software Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native software solutions within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 

In this IC3 individual contributor role, you will work on the Data Plane and Control Plane components of Oracle's IoT platform, combining hands-on software engineering with cloud infrastructure automation, container orchestration, and production troubleshooting. 

You will collaborate with engineering, QA, and DevOps teams to improve platform reliability, optimize performance, automate deployments, and deliver high-quality software solutions. 

The ideal candidate brings strong Java development experience, hands-on expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure automation capabilities, and practical experience operating software in cloud environments. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Platform Development: Design, develop, and enhance software components supporting the Data Plane and Control Plane of Oracle's OCI IoT platform. 
 - Containerization and Orchestration: Develop, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring scalability, availability, and operational stability. 
 - Infrastructure Automation: Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and maintenance using Terraform or Ansible to improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency. 
 - Software Engineering and API Development: Develop and optimize Java-based software components and APIs, applying software design principles, concurrency concepts, secure coding practices, and appropriate testing strategies. 
 - Production Reliability and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve application, infrastructure, networking, and integration issues while improving observability, system performance, and service availability. 
 - Security and Operational Excellence: Implement cloud security best practices, support vulnerability remediation, and contribute to maintenance, patching, monitoring, and reliability improvements. 
 - Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: Partner with development, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders to deliver software enhancements, conduct code reviews, resolve defects, and improve engineering standards. 
 - Technical Ownership and Continuous Improvement: Independently manage assigned engineering deliverables, contribute to architecture-aligned design decisions, mentor colleagues where appropriate, and identify opportunities to improve development and operational processes. 

Qualifications & SkillsMandatory

AreaEssential Requirements

Education BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

Experience 5+ years of software industry experience, including 3+ years in a senior developer or technical leadership capacity. 

Programming Experience in Java and Python, including Java software design principles, concurrency, debugging, and development best practices. 

Containers Strong hands-on expertise with Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment and troubleshooting. 

Infrastructure as Code Practical experience automating infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible. 

Cloud platforms Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: OCI, AWS, or Azure. 

Software engineering Ability to design, develop, test, troubleshoot, and optimize scalable software components and APIs. 

Production troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve software and infrastructure issues in production environments. 

Cloud networking Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including cloud configuration and troubleshooting. 

Cloud security Knowledge of cloud security and secure software development practices. 

Collaboration Ability to work independently, collaborate across engineering teams, communicate effectively, and adapt to new technologies. 

Good-to-Have

- Prior experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Experience developing and deploying CI/CD pipelines across multi-cluster, multi-region, or multi-architecture environments. 
 - Experience in the Internet of Things (IoT) domain. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native platform engineering involving Data Plane and Control Plane components. 

Important classification note: The original JD explicitly lists IoT experience and complex CI/CD environments as preferred. OCI-specific experience is not mandatory because AWS or Azure experience is also accepted. Data Plane/Control Plane experience is treated as an advantage rather than a screening requirement because the JD describes it as work to be performed, not an explicit prior-experience prerequisite. 

Self-Assessment Questions

- Do I have at least five years of software industry experience, including three years of senior development or technical leadership responsibility?
 - Have I worked hands-on with Java and Python, including developing, debugging, and optimizing software components?
 - Am I confident deploying and troubleshooting Docker-based applications in Kubernetes environments?
 - Have I automated infrastructure using Terraform or Ansible and worked with OCI, AWS, or Azure?
 - Can I independently investigate production issues involving applications, APIs, networking, security, or cloud infrastructure and collaborate effectively to resolve them?

data.title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III
data.description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and limited guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non -functional requirements. Defines and executes tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools. 

Exp- 5 To 7 Years Relevant Experience

Tech Skill-

- Guidewire PolicyCenter
 - Java, REST API
 - Insurance Domain Knowledge

Requirements

Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. Supports implementation activities, troubleshooting user/system environmental issues, and training as required. Effectively supports business in building a Lean Business Case and breaking epics into features. Identifies and raises issues and risks with functional design. Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Executes Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; co nfigures packaged software. Provides input into the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members. Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions. Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. Demonstrates ability to read and write simple code. Modifies code in an existing file. Executes basic data creation tools and reads automation test results. Demonstrates understanding of the fundamentals of automation tools and framework. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. Identifies complex errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes standard testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools. Provides guidance to others as needed. Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution. Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. Mentors junior team members in test planning and execution techniques. Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. Assists with resolution of environmental issues. Supports application development, implementation, and user training ac tivities, as required. Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency. May provide limited guidance to junior team members, when needed. Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. Implements innovative ideas within area of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and elicits contributions from group members. Plans and conducts CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. Performs other functions as assigned.

data.title: Senior Technical Consultant
data.description:
Description

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good - you've come to the right place. 

Salesforce Technical Consultants deliver solutions that transform our customers' businesses and their customers' experiences. This role involves working with teams to discover, design, code and deploy Salesforce Platform solutions. 75% of this role involves programming, using Apex (Salesforce's Java-like language), JavaScript, and other development languages and tools. 

The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated thought leader in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of enterprise desktop, cloud, and/or mobile solutions, including enterprise integrations leveraging middleware tools and platforms. Developers deliver technical solutions to meet the customer's business and technical requirements. Developers lead the evaluation of options and subsequent presentation and education of the customer/partner. They will also identify and proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through to complete resolution. 

YOUR IMPACT: Responsibilities

- Programming solutions in Salesforce's Apex programming language, JavaScript, Lightning Web Component Framework and JS Frameworks with API integrations to cloud and back-office systems
 - Developing, optimizing and deploying Salesforce applications
 - Demonstrating key Salesforce capabilities and features
 - Learn and use Salesforce's Services team best practices
 - Help clients consistently meet/exceed goals and metrics
 - Contribute to customer success through front and back-end solution development and release management
 - Deliver high customer satisfaction (CSAT)
 - Continued professional growth and development
 - Travel to client site (average of 50%), but may be higher or lower based on the client engagement
 - Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limit compliance
 - Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize daily development velocity, document custom code, and maintain strict platform security standards

Minimum Qualifications

- BA/BS degree or foreign equivalent
 - 6+ years of relevant experience
 - Strong problem solving skills
 - Experience using technical skills to solve real-world business problems
 - Strong programming skills with JavaScript and one object-oriented language (eg Java, C#, Python)
 - Data modeling (objects, fields and relationships; able to model 1: M and M: M relationships)
 - Salesforce certifications and Platform development experience are a plus
 - Customer engagement/facilitation skills
 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
 - Ability to work independently and be a self-starter
 - Specializes in gathering and analyzing information and designing comprehensive solutions that are flexible and adaptable to clients' needs
 - Cutting edge innovator who continually studies new technologies and functionality, and is involved in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies
 - Strong potential to continue to grow in career to higher levels of Services or other positions at Salesforce

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong presentation skills. Able to effectively present and defend point of view to a variety of audiences
 - Prior Salesforce development experience (Apex programming language and Lightning Web Components) highly desired, but not required
 - Other highly desired, but not required, technical experience includes: JS Frameworks, SQL, APIs, Testing Tools, DevOps. 
 - Highly beneficial to have any Salesforce product certifications prior to joining. It is expected that you will gain the following certifications as part of the role requirement and on-boarding process in the first 3 months: 
 - Salesforce Certified Administrator
 - Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
 - Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
 - Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
Attributes

- Leader, who can communicate the value of Cloud features
 - Results-driven, tenacious, drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment
 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to change
 - Positive attitude; ability to motivate others

data.title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III
data.description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and limited guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non -functional requirements. Defines and executes tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools. 

Exp- 5 To 7 Years Relevant Experience

Tech Skill-

- Guidewire PolicyCenter
 - Java, REST API
 - Insurance Domain Knowledge

Requirements

Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. Supports implementation activities, troubleshooting user/system environmental issues, and training as required. Effectively supports business in building a Lean Business Case and breaking epics into features. Identifies and raises issues and risks with functional design. Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Executes Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; co nfigures packaged software. Provides input into the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members. Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions. Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. Demonstrates ability to read and write simple code. Modifies code in an existing file. Executes basic data creation tools and reads automation test results. Demonstrates understanding of the fundamentals of automation tools and framework. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. Identifies complex errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes standard testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools. Provides guidance to others as needed. Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution. Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. Mentors junior team members in test planning and execution techniques. Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. Assists with resolution of environmental issues. Supports application development, implementation, and user training ac tivities, as required. Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency. May provide limited guidance to junior team members, when needed. Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. Implements innovative ideas within area of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and elicits contributions from group members. Plans and conducts CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. Performs other functions as assigned.

data.title: Senior Platform Automation Engineer
data.description:
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will design, build, automate, and operate enterprise-grade Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms. You will work closely with development and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native platform capabilities. 

This role requires a strong engineering mindset, hands-on development experience, and expertise in platform automation, API integration, CI/CD, and GitOps practices. 

- Design, build, administer, and upgrade Kubernetes and OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) clusters. 
 - Develop platform capabilities using automation, scripting, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies. 
 - Build integrations between platform services and enterprise systems through APIs and automation frameworks. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD and GitOps solutions using tools such as GitHub, Argo CD, and Tekton. 
 - Develop and maintain platform components using Go, Python, or equivalent programming languages. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to build scalable and resilient cloud-native solutions. 
 - Implement platform observability, monitoring, and troubleshooting practices. 
 - Contribute to platform architecture, security, reliability, and operational excellence initiatives. 
 - Support microservices-based workloads and distributed systems running on container platforms. 
 - 6-10 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Strong experience administering Kubernetes and OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), including cluster deployment, upgrades, lifecycle management, and automation. 
 - Proficiency in software development with strong object-oriented programming concepts. 
 - Hands-on development experience in Go, Python, or a similar programming language. 
 - Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tools such as GitHub, Argo CD, and Tekton. 
 - Experience designing and integrating APIs with an API-first engineering approach. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing platform solutions as an individual contributor. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices architectures, and cloud-native design principles. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following: 

- Kubernetes Operators and Custom Controllers
 - Service Mesh technologies such as Istio
 - Observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Dynatrace, or similar tools
 - Storage technologies such as Ceph and OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF)
 - Secrets management solutions such as HashiCorp Vault
 - Hybrid cloud and private cloud environments
 - Platform security, governance, and compliance best practices

data.title: Advanced Project Engr - APC
data.description:
Job Description

The Project Engineer I/Project Engineer II/Advance Proj. engr (APC/Optimization)will support the lead to implement Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects and assist in onsite user training as necessary. The candidate should have a very strong career interest in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer work. 

Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The role will have a broad set of responsibilities encompassing the following: 

- Execute Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer projects including assessment, kick-off, pre-test, plant test, design, modeling, configuration, installation, commissioning, and post-audit. 
 - Implement RMPCT Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer/Control Performance Monitor technologies as Lead Consultant/Engineer 
 - Perform/Participate in Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer studies, proof of concepts/trial evaluation and provide user training. 
 - Review the economic targets for the Advanced Process Controllers, suggest and incorporate necessary changes, to provide the right direction to the controllers. This may be required to incorporate the new economic indicators, if any, and make the controller to constantly work towards the current economic objectives. 
 - Identify, advise, and incorporate modifications to the controller configuration, in terms of proposing addition of new variables/ constraints, deletion of the redundant variables, wherever found necessary. 
 - Identify faulty regulatory control loops in the system (DCS level) and carryout tuning of existing regulatory controller at Distributed control systems. 
 - Lead cross function teams such as the Customer Support and R&D to resolve Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer issues. 
 - Support Sales and Marketing to grow Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer licenses and services business. 
 - Support and train junior personnel

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

- Has a at least 8+ years of experience in refining/petrochemical, MMM industry. 
 - Has a background in Chemical Engineering principles and operations. 
 - Knowledge of regulatory control and advanced control. 
 - Understands optimization principles. Experience in implementing global optimization programs is advantages. 
 - Good communication and writing skills. 
 - Knowledge of Advanced Process Control/Plant wide Optimizer, DCS and real-time database technologies. 
 - Good team player. Strong ability to maintain good working relationship with customers. 

WE VALUE

- Demonstrated project experience implementing commercial off-the-shelf software for APC such as DMC3/DMC Plus, SMOC, PACE, ROMeo. 
 - Experience in deploying APC or maintenance management strategies in an operating company. 
 - Candidates having experience in plant operations. 
 - Experience in plant startup & commissioning 
 - Configuration experience working on control systems, DCS / PLC / Safety Systems. 
 - Advanced post graduate degree in a technical discipline. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.
