data.title: Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer - Cloud & Integration
data.description:
About Us

PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. 

PHINIA is an independent, market-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGETM. With over 12, 500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. 

At PHINIA, we provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality - developed and manufactured responsibly - that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards. 

Our Culture

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously. 

Career Opportunities

We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow. 

Job Purpose

PHINIA is seeking a Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer with a cloud and integration focus to build and maintain the data pipelines and applications that ingest IoT/manufacturing data, process it, and surface it in dashboards and apps for plant stakeholders. This role owns the portfolio of cloud side applications and integrations that turn raw machine data into usable information - from streaming ingestion through to the dashboards that plant managers use daily. The engineer works under the technical direction of a Bucharest based architecture lead and coordinates with a local delivery coordinator in Bangalore. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain end‐to‐end IoT and manufacturing data pipelines - from plant‐floor data sources (sensors, PLCs, OPC‐UA gateways) through cloud ingestion (Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Kafka, MQTT) to storage and visualization. 
 - Develop and maintain production‐facing applications: OEE dashboards, downtime trackers, quality reporting tools, and operator‐facing UIs using React/Angular frontends and . NET/Node. js/Python backends. 
 - Build secure, event‐driven integrations between shopfloor solutions and MES, ERP (SAP), PLM, SCADA/PLC, historians, and IoT platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MQTT/AMQP, OPC‐UA, and middleware. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure‐as‐code, and environment promotion across dev/test/production for shopfloor applications. 
 - Implement and maintain real‐time streaming architectures handling high‐throughput manufacturing data with proper handling of backpressure, out‐of‐order events, schema evolution, and failure recovery. 
 - Write and optimize non‐trivial SQL queries against production databases for data mining, reporting, and integration validation; design data models for time‐series and manufacturing datasets. 
 - Implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), SLOs/SLIs, and proactive alerting using Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor; ensure high availability during production shifts. 
 - Troubleshoot integration failures end‐to‐end: capture raw payloads, compare against schema, identify encoding issues, trace through network layers, and resolve root cause across JSON, XML, and SOAP integrations. 
 - Develop and maintain real‐time dashboards, machine connectors, and monitoring tools; integrate time‐series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for actionable insights (OEE, scrap, downtime, anomaly trends). 
 - Ensure all solutions meet PHINIA's standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, data integrity, and operational performance. 
 - Apply automation‐first engineering: test automation, containerization, repeatable builds, and standardized templates/components for reuse across global sites. 
 - Explore and implement edge AI/computer‐vision capabilities (e. g. , defect detection) and cloud/edge patterns (Azure IoT, Functions, Event Hub, Kafka) where value is demonstrated. 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, data‐flow diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field
 - 4-7 years of experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or software engineering for manufacturing/industrial environments
 - Hands‐on experience with Azure cloud services (IoT Hub, Functions, Event Hub, App Service) or equivalent cloud platform
 - Experience with real‐time streaming technologies (Kafka, MQTT, NiFi, Azure Event Hub) including handling of backpressure, deduplication, and late‐arriving data
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Node. js, C#/. NET, or Java; modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular) for dashboard development
 - SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production and analytics databases; comfort with time‐series data modeling
 - Big data awareness: familiarity with data lake architectures, batch and streaming ingestion patterns, and time‐series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, ADX)
 - Fluency reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads across integration boundaries
 - Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, graph traversal, complexity analysis)
 - CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent); containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor)
 - Understanding of IT/OT security principles (ISA/IEC 62443, Zero Trust) and manufacturing network basics
 - Integration experience with MES/SCADA/PLC/ERP/PLM using REST APIs, OPC‐UA, MQTT/AMQP
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‐900, AZ‐204) - preferred
 - Docker/Kubernetes certifications - preferred

What We Offer

We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well-being resources, family-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value. 

We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed. 

What We Believe

- Product Leadership - Innovation that brings value to our customers 
 - Humility - Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively 
 - Inclusivity - Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional 
 - Net-Zero - Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse 
 - Integrity - Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right 
 - Accountability - Taking ownership of our actions and driving results

SAFETY

You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!

We also believe employee health and safety is everyone's responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative. 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. 

VISA SPONSORSHIP

PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based. 

NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS & VENDORS

Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received. 

GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT

Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms. 

Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review. 

Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms. 

Career Scam Disclaimer: 

PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA's website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities. 

Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. Join us on this shared journey to a brighter tomorrow. For more information about PHINIA, please visit www. phinia. com.

data.title: MDR Team Lead
data.description:
Summary

Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: "Is my data safe?"

At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We've built the industry's first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort. 

At Varonis, we move fast. We're an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we're solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world's data safe. 

Position Overview: 

Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It's a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents. 

We are seeking an experienced MDR Team Lead who will oversee a team of MDR Security Analysts. This oversight includes training and developing the knowledge and skills needed to execute the MDR mission, ensuring adherence to all operating policies and procedures, ensuring the delivery of the MDR service within all SLAs, and serving as a point of technical and operational escalation for MDR analysts. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis' Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. MDR Team Leads are the lynchpin of MDR operations, ensuring the team is working 24x7 to monitor, triage, investigate, and escalate incidents where data is at risk and to ensure we meet operational SLAs. 

Responsibilities: 

Technical and operational escalation point for investigations, incidents, and other elements of the MDR service. 

- Validate findings and coordinate investigative efforts with customers and internal teams. 
 - Ensure all investigative findings are documented and communicated appropriately by the team, including tracking in CRM. 
 - Lead or attend customer calls and represent the MDR service when required. 

Team Management: 

- Lead the recruitment and onboarding of new team members. 
 - Continuously train the team so they are equipped with the required skills and knowledge to effectively execute the MDR service. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews and quarterly SWOT analyses to drive team growth and development. 
 - Develop strong work relationships within the MDR Team as well as with other departments ex. Product Support, Product Management, Engineering. 

Service Management: 

- Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis' threat detection systems, playbooks, runbooks, and the MDR Team operations. 
 - Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all aspects of the MDR service. 
 - Oversee and execute programs, projects, operational tasks, and responsibilities related to the MDR service. 

Requirements: 

- Proven success in leading and managing within a team-oriented environment. 
 - 4+ years of experience working in cybersecurity operations in a global cybersecurity company
 - 2+ years of experience leading a team. 
 - Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cybersecurity operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response. 
 - Proven ability to deliver security operations service while meeting SLA and other operational requirements. 
 - Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM). 
 - Proven ability to creatively problem-solve when handling complex issues. 
 - Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 
 - Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (direct reports, colleagues, and customers). 
 - Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously. 
 - This role may require working either a morning shift (6: 30 AM-3: 30 PM IST) or an afternoon shift (2: 00 PM-11: 00 PM IST). 

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!

data.title: Tech Lead (Flutter, Python, AWS)
data.description:
We're looking for a seasoned, hands-on Tech Lead to lead the development of a customer-facing mobile application, working closely with customer/stakeholders and cross-functional engineering teams. 

You'll own technical architecture, guide product and engineering decisions, and lead a team of 2-5 engineers to deliver a production-ready application. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between high-level system design, hands-on development, product discussions, and stakeholder management. 

We're looking for an engineer who combines strong mobile and backend expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic development practices. 

What You'll Do

1. Technical Leadership & Software Architecture

- Own end-to-end technical architecture, making pragmatic decisions around scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Translate business requirements into technical designs, system integrations, and implementation plans. 
 - Establish engineering standards, conduct code reviews, and drive best practices across the development lifecycle. 
 - Identify technical risks early and make informed trade-offs between delivery timelines and long-term maintainability. 

2. Mobile Application Development

- Lead the development of high-quality mobile applications using Flutter, with a strong understanding of native Android and iOS development. 
 - Design mobile application architecture, state management, navigation, API integration, offline capabilities, and error handling. 
 - Understand platform-specific requirements, performance optimization, app lifecycle management, permissions, and deployment processes. 
 - Ensure reliable integration between mobile applications, backend services, and third-party systems. 

3. Backend Engineering & AWS

- Design, develop, and maintain production-grade backend services using Python, FastAPI, and AWS Lambda. 
 - Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker, Amazon ECS, and AWS Fargate. 
 - Design robust APIs, asynchronous workflows, integrations, and data models. 
 - Apply best practices for authentication, authorization, observability, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring. 
 - Make sound architectural decisions around serverless versus containerized workloads, reliability, scalability, and cloud costs. 

4. Product Thinking & Customer Collaboration

- Work directly with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, clarify requirements, and translate them into actionable engineering plans. 
 - Participate in product discovery, solution design, feature prioritization, and technical feasibility discussions. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and delivery progress clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Proactively manage expectations, resolve ambiguities, and ensure alignment between customer needs and engineering execution. 

5. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Lead and mentor a team of 2-5 engineers, providing technical direction, code reviews, and hands-on guidance. 
 - Break down requirements into milestones, delegate work effectively, and maintain delivery quality and predictability. 
 - Collaborate with other engineering teams on APIs, integrations, shared services, and architectural dependencies. 
 - Coordinate across teams to resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and ensure smooth end-to-end delivery. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

6. AI, LLMs & Agentic Development

- Leverage AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and code review. 
 - Design and implement LLM-powered features, integrating commercial or open-source language models into applications. 
 - Understand practical patterns for tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-step agent workflows. 
 - Apply appropriate evaluation, security, observability, and human-in-the-loop safeguards to AI-powered features. 
 - Identify opportunities to use AI to improve both the product experience and engineering productivity. 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a Tech Lead or equivalent technical/product leadership role. 
 - Proven experience leading a team of engineers and delivering production software. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Flutter and mobile application development, backed by a solid understanding of native Android and iOS development. 
 - Strong backend engineering experience with Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and AWS. 
 - Practical experience deploying and operating production workloads on AWS ECS and Fargate. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, API design, distributed systems fundamentals, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Demonstrated experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders, including requirements gathering, solution design, and delivery management. 
 - Experience collaborating with multiple engineering teams and managing technical dependencies. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into applications and using AI-assisted or agentic development tools in real engineering workflows. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly. 

Good to Have

- Experience taking a mobile product from initial design through production launch and subsequent iterations. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and production observability. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, event-driven systems, queues, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Experience with mobile app security, performance profiling, crash analytics, and release management. 
 - Experience designing AI agents that interact with APIs, external tools, or business workflows. 
 - Experience working in a customer-facing engineering, consulting, or product development environment. 

What Success Looks Like

- A well-architected, production-ready mobile application delivered in alignment with customer expectations. 
 - A team that executes effectively with clear technical direction, strong engineering practices, and minimal avoidable rework. 
 - Product and architecture decisions that balance business needs, engineering quality, delivery timelines, and operational costs. 
 - Effective collaboration across customer stakeholders and internal engineering teams. 
 - Meaningful use of AI and agentic development to improve engineering velocity without compromising quality. 

Who Would Thrive in This Role?

Someone who is hands-on enough to solve difficult engineering problems, experienced enough to make sound architectural decisions, and has led customer conversations to drive delivery.

data.title: Lead Developer - ServiceNow IRM
data.description:
Experience: 8 -12 Years

Role: Lead Developer - ServiceNow IRM

Key Skills

ServiceNow IRM | Risk Management | GRC | Flow Designer | Business Rules | Script Includes | REST APIs | IntegrationHub | Performance Analytics | Case Management | Operational Risk | Risk & Controls | AFC | Agile | ServiceNow Development

Role Purpose

The Lead Developer - ServiceNow IRM will lead the technical design, development, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) solutions supporting Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) and Operational Risk & Controls capabilities. 

This is a senior, hands-on development role requiring deep practical expertise across the ServiceNow IRM product suite, including risk, control, issue, action, assessment, evidence, case, and workflow management capabilities. 

The role holder will enhance existing IRM workflows, design and implement new workflows, manage development environments, challenge third-party requirements and designs, and provide technical leadership to the wider development team. 

Key Responsibilities

ServiceNow IRM Development

- Lead the design, configuration, and development of solutions using ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management. 
 - Remain hands-on across configuration, scripting, workflow design, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build and enhance IRM capabilities covering: 
 - Risk identification and assessment 
 - Control definition, ownership, and testing 
 - Issues, findings, and remediation actions 
 - Operational events 
 - Evidence collection and attestation 
 - Policy and compliance workflows 
 - Case management 
 - Risk and control reporting 
 - Configure and extend IRM data models, records, forms, relationships, user experiences, assessment methodologies, indicators, scoring models, and control evaluation logic. 
 - Design workflows using Flow Designer, decision logic, approvals, tasks, notifications, escalations, and service-level controls. 
 - Develop dashboards, reports, and management information for AFC and Operational Risk & Controls stakeholders. 
 - Support integrations between ServiceNow IRM and upstream/downstream systems using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and appropriate integration patterns. 
 - Diagnose and resolve defects, data issues, performance problems, and production incidents affecting IRM workflows. 
Workflow and Case Management

- Maintain and enhance existing AFC and Operational Risk & Controls workflows, ensuring changes are introduced safely and with appropriate regression coverage. 
 - Design new case types and workflow patterns to support investigations, assessments, reviews, escalations, remediation, and closure. 
 - Ensure workflows provide clear ownership, status management, auditability, evidence capture, and end-to-end traceability. 
 - Design effective routing, prioritisation, service-level tracking, exception handling, and escalation mechanisms. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate manual processes through ServiceNow IRM. 

Technical Leadership

- Lead the ServiceNow IRM development team within an Agile delivery environment, while remaining directly involved in delivery. 
 - Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching, and support to developers and configuration specialists. 
 - Establish and maintain development, configuration, design, and documentation standards. 
 - Conduct code, configuration, and solution design reviews, ensuring work is appropriately estimated, documented, tested, and deployed. 
 - Guide team members through complex IRM configuration and workflow challenges. 
 - Promote the reuse of standard IRM capabilities, minimise unnecessary customisation, and actively manage technical debt. 
 - Build internal capability and reduce dependency on individual developers or third-party suppliers. 

Requirements and Design Assurance

- Work with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to translate business, regulatory, and control requirements into robust ServiceNow IRM designs. 
 - Review and challenge requirements that are incomplete, inconsistent, operationally unclear, or misaligned with IRM capabilities. 
 - Assess whether requirements should be met through standard configuration, extension, integration, or process change. 
 - Review and challenge third-party requirements, designs, and technical deliverables. 
 - Identify design defects, gaps, unnecessary complexity, unsupported customisation, and technical debt. 
 - Ensure designs use standard ServiceNow IRM functionality appropriately rather than recreating capabilities through bespoke development. 
 - Provide clear recommendations where the platform has constraints or where requirements conflict with good IRM design practices. 
 - Ensure designs address security, data quality, auditability, performance, resilience, and supportability. 

Platform and Environment Management

- Configure, maintain, and support ServiceNow IRM development, test, and production environments. 
 - Manage scoped applications, configuration, update sets, source control, release packages, and deployment activities. 
 - Maintain appropriate environment controls, access restrictions, and segregation of duties. 
 - Support IRM platform upgrades, store application updates, patches, regression testing, and release impact assessments. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, deployment instructions, and support procedures. 
 - Ensure environment stability and consistency across the development lifecycle, including production validation and post-implementation assurance. 

Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Engagement

- Lead development activity through backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Support Product Owners in shaping and prioritising the IRM product backlog and converting requirements into development-ready stories. 
 - Produce reliable estimates, identify technical dependencies and risks, and coordinate development, testing, defect resolution, and deployment. 
 - Work closely with AFC, Operational Risk & Controls, Compliance, Technology, and Operations stakeholders. 
 - Explain ServiceNow IRM capabilities, configuration options, product limitations, and design trade-offs in clear business language. 
 - Demonstrate new capabilities, prototypes, and workflow enhancements, while managing stakeholder expectations transparently. 

Governance, Risk and Controls

- Ensure ServiceNow IRM solutions meet requirements for security, privacy, resilience, and auditability. 
 - Embed appropriate access controls, workflow approvals, evidence capture, record traceability, and audit trails. 
 - Ensure risk, control, issue, and action records remain complete, accurate, and supportable. 
 - Support governance over configuration changes and production deployments. 
 - Support internal audit, assurance, and regulatory evidence requests relating to IRM workflows. 
 - Ensure production issues and control weaknesses are remediated promptly and sustainably. 

Requirements

Required Experience and Capabilities

- Significant hands-on experience designing and developing ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) solutions. 
 - Strong knowledge of ServiceNow IRM architecture, data structures, and workflow capabilities. 
 - Practical experience across multiple IRM areas, such as: 
 - Risk Management 
 - Policy and Compliance Management 
 - Audit Management 
 - Operational Risk Management 
 - Regulatory Change Management 
 - Business Continuity Management 
 - Third-Party Risk Management 
 - Experience configuring risk and control frameworks, assessments, indicators, issues, findings, and remediation actions. 
 - Experience designing case management and workflow solutions within ServiceNow IRM. 
 - Strong technical knowledge of: 
 - Flow Designer 
 - Business Rules 
 - Script Includes 
 - Client Scripts 
 - UI Policies and Actions 
 - Access Control Lists (ACLs) 
 - ServiceNow tables and data models 
 - Notifications and approvals 
 - Reporting and Performance Analytics 
 - REST APIs 
 - IntegrationHub 
 - Experience enhancing and supporting live, business-critical IRM workflows and designing new workflows based on business, regulatory, and control requirements. 
 - Strong understanding of environment management, release management, and controlled deployment practices. 
 - Experience reviewing and challenging third-party requirements, designs, and development outputs. 
 - Experience leading developers and providing technical coaching and oversight within Agile delivery teams.

Demonstrates understanding of the fundamentals of automation tools and framework. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes standard testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools. Provides guidance to others as needed. Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution. Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. Mentors junior team members in test planning and execution techniques. Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. Assists with resolution of environmental issues. Supports application development, implementation, and user training ac tivities, as required. Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency. May provide limited guidance to junior team members, when needed. Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. Implements innovative ideas within area of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and elicits contributions from group members. Plans and conducts CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. Performs other functions as assigned.

data.title: Perceived Quality Lead Engineer
data.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80, 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. 

Could you be the full-time Perceived Quality Lead Engineer in Bangaore we're looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in managing digital mock-ups and mechanical architecture to a cutting-edge field. You'll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and forward-thinking teammates. 

You'll play a key role in shaping the future of rail transport by ensuring the seamless integration of mechanical designs and maintaining high standards of quality. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with teams across the business (such as SBS designers, industrial teams, and DTC stakeholders), lead collaborative design workshops, and ensure compliance with métier rules, and much more. 

You'll specifically take care of managing digital mock-ups, producing related KPIs, and leading train mechanical architecture derivations into installation specifications, but also managing perceived quality and producing color and finishing specifications. 

We'll look to you for: 

- Managing digital mock-ups and producing related KPIs (completion, maturity, conformity to métier rules) 
 - Overseeing perceived quality and producing color and finishing specifications 
 - Managing dimensional requirements for train architecture (identification, quantification, priority definition, historic dashboard) 
 - Organizing day-to-day collaborative work with SBS designers and development stakeholders (including industrial teams and DTC) 
 - Leading train mechanical architecture derivation into installation specifications (interface definition, volume allocation, tolerances) 
 - Producing decision books and consolidating needed inputs 
 - Structuring, sequencing, and leading collaborative design workshops 
 - Preparing data for decision-making within train level and SBS governance 
 - Producing related KPIs and providing continuous visibility on mechanical development maturity and adherence to carry-over targets 
 - Communicating progress and raising issues to relevant development governances

All About You

We value passion and attitude over experience. That's why we don't expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we've listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: 

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field 
 - Experience or understanding of digital mock-up management and KPI production 
 - Knowledge of train architecture, dimensional requirements, and mechanical development processes 
 - Familiarity with collaborative design workshops and cross-functional teamwork 
 - A certification in mechanical design or a related area 
 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

Things you'll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey - the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You'll also: 

- Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines 
 - Work with new security standards for rail signalling 
 - Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues 
 - Contribute to innovative projects 
 - Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment 
 - Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries 
 - Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning 
 - Progress towards senior leadership or specialized technical roles 
 - Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don't need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you'll be proud. If you're up for the challenge, we'd love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we're an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

data.title: Senior Manager – Transparency Operations.
data.description:
Summary

Location: Hyderabad, India

Lead Global Transparency Solutions

Join Novartis and help shape the future of healthcare transparency. As a Lead in the Global Transparency Team (Ethics, Risk & Compliance), you'll drive global reporting compliance for regulations such as EFPIA, NPAG, US Sunshine, and local transparency requirements. 

You'll lead a portfolio of strategic initiatives, driving system enhancements, regulatory change adoption, and data landscape transformations to ensure accurate, compliant, and efficient reporting worldwide. 

This is a unique opportunity to combine compliance expertise, technology, and transformation leadership-translating complex regulations into scalable global solutions while leading a high-performing team in an agile environment. 

Make an impact where ethics, technology, and global compliance come together. 

About The Role

The role has several responsibilities, including but limited to: 

- Regulatory Interpretation & Implementation
 - Interpret global transparency regulations (EFPIA, US Sunshine, and local laws) from a system and data perspective. 
 - Translate regulatory changes, amendments, and industry codes (e. g. , LDC, Control Room) into clear system and reporting requirements. 
 - Governance
 - Governance Documentation Management : Ensure all governance-related task position documents and Transparency Guidelines are reviewed bi-annually, kept up to date, and formally approved in collaboration with the respective Pillar Associate Director and GPO. 
 - Knowledge Hub & Training Enablement : Maintain and regularly update Novartis Hub and training materials, ensuring accessibility, accuracy, and appropriate sign-offs from the Pillar Associate Director and GPO
 - Global Systems & Data Landscape Enablement
 - Drive integration of regulatory requirements into global transparency platforms and solutions. 
 - Lead system enhancements ensuring scalability, standardization, and alignment with enterprise architecture. 
 - Project & Portfolio Management
 - Manage a portfolio of regulatory and system transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment with ERC priorities. 
 - Define delivery roadmaps, prioritization, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects. 
 - Acquisitions
 - Lead the design and deployment of end-to-end transparency reporting processes for newly acquired entities, ensuring alignment with global standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Define the operating model, roles, and ownership (Global, Country, Acquired Entity PoCs) for data collection, validation, and reporting. 
 - Establish transition frameworks to onboard acquired entities into Novartis Transparency systems and governance structures. 
 - Continuous Improvement & Risk Management
 - Drive initiatives to simplify, harmonize, and standardize transparency reporting processes. 
 - Embed regulatory intelligence and forward-looking insights into planning and governance forums.

data.title: Lab Director
data.description:
Cancer is most treatable when found early, and in India it rarely is. BigGen Labs exists to change that, and to bring the same genomic precision to every stage of clinical care. 

BigGen Labs is a multidimensional genomics diagnostics company building an advanced molecular laboratory in New Delhi. We bring genomic science into everyday clinical decisions, accurately, affordably and at scale, and we are building across six areas: 

- Early cancer detection: blood-based tests that find cancer while curative options remain open. Our lead programme, HelioLiverTM, combines cell-free DNA methylation analysis with established serum protein markers to support hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) surveillance in at-risk adults. 
 - Precision oncology: molecular profiling that helps oncologists match the right therapy to the right patient and monitor response over time. 
 - Clinical and population genetics: whole exome sequencing and genetic testing for inherited disease, built on genomic data generated in India, for India. 
 - Reproductive genetics: non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) to screen for chromosomal conditions, offered in full compliance with the PC&PNDT Act. 
 - Infectious disease molecular diagnostics: real-time PCR and NGS-based testing for faster, more targeted treatment decisions. 
 - Smart genomics: NGS, real-time PCR, immunochemistry and bioinformatics working as one validated sample-to-report workflow, under quality systems designed to ISO 15189 requirements from day one. We are investing in India-specific clinical validation with leading hospitals and research centres, because evidence generated elsewhere must be proven here. We partner with oncologists, hepatologists, gastroenterologists, obstetricians, geneticists, microbiologists, hospital networks and research institutions who share one belief: precision diagnostics should be accessible, not exceptional. 

BigGen Labs does not conduct or communicate foetal sex determination in any form. 

Role description

The Lab Director will establish and lead BigGen Labs' molecular diagnostics laboratory across its oncology, genetics, reproductive and infectious disease testing menu. This is a full-time, on-site role in New Delhi. 

- Lead laboratory commissioning, workflow design and equipment qualification for NGS, real-time PCR and immunochemistry platforms
 - Oversee implementation and validation of HelioLiverTM and new assays across oncology, clinical and reproductive genetics, and infectious disease
 - Build and maintain quality systems aligned with ISO 15189, and lead the laboratory to NABL accreditation
 - Ensure the laboratory's prenatal testing meets PC&PNDT Act registration, documentation and record-keeping requirements
 - Establish quality control, review and authorise laboratory reports, and own report-release controls
 - Recruit, train and certify a multidisciplinary laboratory team; set competency and authorisation standards
 - Manage equipment, reagent inventory, cold chain and vendor performance
 - Partner with clinicians, bioinformatics and research collaborators on validation studies and new test development
 - Contribute to strategic planning, capacity expansion and continuous improvementQualifications

- PhD or MD in Molecular Biology, Molecular Medicine, Pathology or a related discipline, with registration with the relevant professional bodies where applicable
 - 12-15 years of experience in molecular diagnostics
 - Demonstrated leadership in an NABL-accredited medical laboratory; an NABL/ISO 15189 assessor or auditor credential is preferred
 - Strong expertise in interpreting complex molecular, genetic and pathology results
 - Advanced laboratory skills across NGS, real-time PCR and molecular microbiology
 - Working knowledge of PC&PNDT Act compliance for prenatal genetic testing
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams, implement SOPs and drive process improvement
 - Excellent analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to work with clinicians, hospital networks and diagnostic partners

Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

The role is responsible for ensuring strict cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices) compliance and overseeing end-to-end injectable manufacturing operations for the assigned production line. The role involves supervising aseptic manufacturing activities, ensuring adherence to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices) across General, Control, and Aseptic areas. The position is accountable for equipment and line validation status, change control, deviation management, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) implementation. The role also leads SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) lifecycle management, production planning versus actual performance monitoring, and regulatory readiness. Additionally, the role requires maintaining accurate online documentation systems and aligning operations with USFDA (United States Food and Drug Administration) and ICH (International Council for Harmonisation) requirements. 

Essential Functions

- Ensure and monitor all GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and GDP (Good Documentation Practices) activities, including cleaning and sanitization, across General, Control, and Aseptic areas
 - Supervise overall injectable manufacturing operations during assigned shifts, ensuring aseptic compliance
 - Ensure all equipment and manufacturing lines are validated and calibrated as per approved schedules
 - Generate and track general purchase indents for departmental consumables and production items
 - Handle Change Control, Deviations, Investigations, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) in coordination with QA
 - Prepare, review, revise, control, and implement SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for sterile manufacturing operations
 - Prepare production plan vs actual reports on daily and monthly basis based on material availability
 - Ensure strict adherence to aseptic techniques and sterilization processes during injectable manufacturing
 - Monitor CPPs (Critical Process Parameters) and CQAs (Critical Quality Attributes) during batch execution
 - Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with USFDA and ICH guidelines 
 - Responsible for preparation & review of the all-master documents of production

data.title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member IV - Guidewire
data.description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Provides guidance, mentorship and training to a direct reporting staff of Agile Dev team members. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are architecturally sound, high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and little to no guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Define and execute tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad and deep level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools. 

Work Mode- Hybrid

Tech skill -

- Guidewire policy center 10 development and GOSU language
 - PolicyCenter Product Model, PolicyCenter Data model, PolicyCenter integration in GOSU and PCF, Web Service, Batch and Plugin
 - Java, J2EE, Hibernate; Spring, Spring JPA, SpringBoot

Requirements

Experience- 4 to 6 years

- Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. 
 - Performs detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. Identifies and raises issues and risks with functional design. 
 - Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Executes Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. 
 - Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; con figures packaged software. 
 - Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions. 
 - Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. 
 - Delivers working code each sprint. Demonstrates ability to read and write simple code. 
 - Modifies code in an existing file. Executes basic data creation tools and reads automation test results. 
 - Demonstrates understanding fundamentals of automation tools and framework. 
 - Agile Dev Team Member II with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. 
 - Identifies common errors that occur in standard application testing. 
 - Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. 
 - Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system
 - Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. 
 - Utilizes basic testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools
 - Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution. 
 - Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation with some guidance
 - Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. 
 - Assists with resolution of environmental issues. Supports application development, implementation, and user training activities, as required
 - Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency with limited guidance from a senior team member. 
 - Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. 
 - Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos
 - Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. 
 - Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. 
 - Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions
 - Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. 
 - Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. 
 - Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. 
 - Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. 
 - Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP). Plans and conducts CoP sessions. 
 - Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
data.description:
About The Role

What if your engineering skills could directly shape the platforms and systems behind the AI revolution? We're looking for Senior Software Engineers in Bangalore to design, build, and scale the infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide. 

This is high-impact, technically challenging work - the kind that keeps great engineers engaged. You'll tackle real architectural problems, write code that matters, and collaborate with some of the sharpest minds in AI research and engineering. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you're an experienced engineer who thrives on autonomy, writes clean and scalable code, and wants to work at the frontier of technology - we want to hear from you. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 20-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain production-grade software systems that support AI training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines
 - Write clean, well-tested, and performant code in Python, TypeScript, or other modern languages
 - Build and optimize APIs, data pipelines, and backend services that operate reliably at scale
 - Architect solutions that balance speed of delivery with long-term maintainability
 - Troubleshoot complex technical issues across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure
 - Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional teams - including ML engineers, researchers, and product managers
 - Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices across the team
 - Work independently on well-scoped projects with meaningful ownership and autonomy

Who You Are

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
 - Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language - Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or similar
 - Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and system design principles
 - Experience building and deploying backend services, APIs, or data-intensive applications
 - Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerized environments
 - Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD workflows, and modern development tooling
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills - you can navigate ambiguity and find root causes efficiently
 - Excellent written communication skills - you can document decisions, explain tradeoffs, and collaborate effectively in an async-first environment
 - Self-directed and reliable - you manage your own time and deliver consistently without close supervision

Nice to Have

- Experience with ML/AI infrastructure - training pipelines, model serving, data annotation platforms, or evaluation frameworks
 - Familiarity with large-scale data processing tools (Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar)
 - Background in distributed systems, microservices architecture, or event-driven design
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) or Kubernetes
 - Contributions to open-source projects or a public portfolio of technical work
 - Previous experience in a remote-first or async-heavy engineering culture

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure alongside world-class research labs and engineering teams
 - Fully remote and flexible - set your own schedule and work from anywhere
 - Tackle genuinely hard technical problems with real-world impact at scale
 - High autonomy and ownership - no micromanagement, just meaningful engineering work
 - Collaborate with a global community of top-tier engineers and researchers
 - Potential for ongoing work, expanded scope, and long-term contract extension as projects grow

The position is responsible for in-process and final product quality analyses and inspection in compliance with established specifications, standards, and regulatory requirements.
