The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build Desktop Intercept - the native Windows driver and app that acts as a virtual mic/speaker, replaces audio in real time, and (Phase 1 Phase C) reads the DOM and drives Computer Use
 - This is the hardest engineering on the platform and the deepest moat. Everything you build feeds a high-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency distributed platform - voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI combined - so you think in latency budgets, throughput, and efficiency, not just features
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- Windows native driver (WASAPI, virtual audio devices, kernel-adjacent hooks)
 - real-time bidirectional audio routing
 - The user-space app (audio router, DOM scraper, MCP server)
 - The desktop-to-cloud path onto the event bus (NATS-class, WebSocket) under a sub-300ms budget
 - AV co-existence and mass-deployment
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- Self-starter, hacker, grit
 - You consider yourself exceptional at the systems level and can show it
 - You love new technology, adapt fast when it changes, demonstrate ideas with working code, and use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - Team player who makes and hits committed timelines
 - Loves solving the problems nobody else can - and winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 8+ years systems / native development; shipped a Windows desktop agent at real scale (>10k seats) with audio. 
 - Strong C/C++ - mandatory. Strong Go for the service side - mandatory. 
 - Comfortable building and interacting with drivers - virtual audio devices, virtual microphones/speakers, WASAPI / Core Audio, kernel-adjacent hooks. 
 - Real-time audio pipelines under a sub-300ms budget - buffering, resampling, drift, glitch-free capture/playback. 
 - Understands high-efficiency systems end-to-end - event-driven architecture, pub/sub, WebSocket streaming, and what state, race conditions, and locking mean at the native layer (lock-free audio buffers, real-time threads, priority inversion). 
 - macOS / Linux native experience is a huge +++++ - cross-platform desktop is where this goes next. 
 - Browser / DOM internals and process injection a strong plus (Phase C). 
 - Enterprise mass-deployment craft - MSI/installer engineering, silent deploys, fleet upgrades across 10k+ locked-down seats. 
 - Driver/code signing and AV/EDR co-existence - WHQL, EV certs, and staying invisible to CrowdStrike-class agents without tripping them. 
 - Crash-dump and telemetry discipline - WinDbg/minidumps, symbolized crash reporting from the field; you debug machines you'll never touch. 
 - Security posture - least-privilege service design; this app hears customer audio and reads screens, so it must be provably tight. 
 - A master debugger at the systems level - kernel logs, crash dumps, audio glitches, AV interference; you see it. 
 - SIP / RTP a strong plus. Mid-tier or better hands-on AI-in-product experience a plus (the desktop app hosts an MCP server and drives Computer Use).

data.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI (CAD/EDA)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of a decade building CAD infrastructure that has to hold up under real silicon development pressure, not just proof-of-concept demos or similar domains. You know that the difference between a flow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around is usually in the details no one else thought about. Lately, you have been watching the explosion of agentic AI and LLM orchestration, and instead of seeing hype, you see exactly how autonomous agents could transform the way IP gets designed, verified, and managed across its lifecycle. 

You are someone who can sit with IP designers who need faster turnaround on design and verification and walk out with a multi-agent workflow spec that actually solves their problem. You do not wait for the AI platform team to tell you what is possible. You prototype, you integrate, you prove the concept, and then you scale it. You have strong opinions about what makes infrastructure scalable, and you are not afraid to push back when a proposed solution will not survive the challenges of a scalable production use. 

At Synopsys, you will work at the center of Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) IP development in the AI Center of Excellence team, architecting AI Infrastructure, building Agents from scratch, leveraging when possible and customizing to the team needs. The problems are hard, the scale is real, and what you build will reshape how thousands of engineers work. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Architect and define the next generation of AI-powered CAD infrastructure for Silicon IP development, building and integrating autonomous agents into core design and verification workflows
 - Build Agentic frameworks and Agents to improve Engineering productivity of the organization
 - Deploy and operationalize Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform directly into the SLM IP development loop, building orchestration layers that connect LLMs, agents, and EDA toolchains across design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing
 - Design multi-agent workflows that automate IP design tasks, verification loops, and lifecycle analytics, turning manual bottlenecks into autonomous, scalable processes
 - Partner with IP design teams, CAD engineers, and global AI platform teams to align architecture with real engineering needs and deployment constraints
 - Build and maintain the infrastructure layer that connects silicon design phases with AI-driven automation, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the full IP lifecycle
 - Prototype, test, and validate new AI-CAD integrations in live development environments, iterating based on feedback from design teams and measurable workflow improvements
 - Drive technical strategy and roadmap for AI-augmented CAD systems within SLM, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete engineering solutions
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering best practices

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable IP design and verification teams to move faster by automating repetitive, high-friction tasks through intelligent agent-driven workflows
 - Reduce time-to-market for SLM IP by building scalable CAD infrastructure that adapts to design complexity without linear increases in manual effort
 - Set the technical foundation for how Synopsys integrates agentic AI into silicon development, influencing architecture decisions across the broader EDA organization
 - Improve design quality and lifecycle visibility by embedding AI-driven analytics and telemetry into the core IP development flow
 - Accelerate adoption of Synopsys' Agentic AI platform by proving its value in one of the most demanding, high-stakes engineering environments in the company
 - Shape the future of CAD infrastructure at Synopsys, defining patterns and practices that will scale across multiple IP families and product lines
 - Directly influence how thousands of engineers experience their daily workflows, making complex silicon development more efficient, predictable, and autonomous

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph. D. in Computer Science, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying advanced CAD flows and infrastructure in silicon design environments
 - Proven experience implementing Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent platforms, LLM orchestrations, or autonomous software agent systems in production settings
 - Mastery of Python and C++ for building production-grade infrastructure, plus strong proficiency in EDA scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Shell
 - Track record of building agents and orchestration layers that interact with design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing flows
 - Technical understanding of silicon design phases, particularly IP development, verification, and lifecycle management workflows, is a plus
 - Experience with Silicon Lifecycle Management concepts such as in-chip sensing, telemetry, and analytics is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room full of IP designers talking about verification bottlenecks and walk out with a clear architecture for an agent-driven solution that actually fits their workflow
 - You prototype fast and iterate based on real feedback, not theoretical requirements, and you know the difference between a demo that impresses and a system that ships
 - You have a point of view on what makes CAD infrastructure scalable and maintainable, and you are comfortable defending that view with technical depth and real-world examples
 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially when integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into established silicon development environments where stability and correctness are non-negotiable
 - You think in systems, understanding how changes in one part of the CAD flow ripple through design, verification, and downstream lifecycle analytics
 - You do not need perfect documentation or fully baked requirements to get started, you ask the right questions, align stakeholders, and find a path forward

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of the Silicon Lifecycle Management IP Development team in Bangalore, working at the intersection of advanced IP design and AI-driven automation. This team is responsible for building the infrastructure and workflows that power SLM IP development across Synopsys, and you will be the principal engineer defining how agentic AI gets integrated into that foundation. You will collaborate closely with IP designers, CAD engineers, and Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform teams, bridging technical domains and driving alignment across a distributed, highly technical organization. This is a Principal Individual Contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibilities across multiple globally distributed engineering teams. This role may evolve into leading a small team of AI infrastructure engineers as adoption scales. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
The Group You'll Be A Part Of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. 

The Impact You'll Make

As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs. 

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___. 

What You'll Do

- Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of the company's complex semiconductor capital equipment and systems. 
 - Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products. Involvement may begin at any step from pilot plant to full-scale manufacturing. 
 - May conceive and plan projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches in the processing or development of new processes. 
 - Supports customer technology managers in the planning, data collection, analysis, and reporting of customer demos to defend existing process applications. Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges. 
 - Utilize internal simulation & AI/ML based tools to drive process development strategies in optimizing the etch processes. 
 - Analyze data and provide insights to improve process performance, yield and efficiency. Utilize JMP and other tools to generate process sensitivities and trade-offs
 - Work closely with concept & feasibility teams to drive and adopt new process innovations and technology roadmaps. Great presentation skills to clearly articulate demo status, complex etch strategies. 
 - Works with customer to demonstrate and introduce new technologies at customer sites through demos, on site evaluations, and new tool qualifications. Drives the adoption of new technology at the customer site. 
 - Acts as single point of contact accountable for process, hardware, software, etc. related requests from customer and work with cross-functional teams within BU. Contributes to product development and release activities. 

Minimum Qualifications

Who We're Looking For

- Minimum Qualifications: 
 - Ph. D. in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics with 5+ years or M. S. with 8+ years or B. S. with 10+ years of relevant work experience. 
 - Managerial & Leadership responsibilities
 - Lead a team of Junior & Senior process engineers to enable successful penetration & defense of key etch applications directly impacting Lam revenue
 - Responsible for managing multiple customer accounts in driving Lam Etch Tool Strategy, enabling successful tool evaluations at the customer site & driving new business opportunities. 
 - Acts as a hands-on technical manager & leader for colleagues with less experience, coach them, and ensure successful engagement of the team in driving Lam Etch objectives. 
 - Responsible for creating & presenting technical review material for key technical projects on frequent basis for high level TRMs at customer site. 
 - Will be subject matter expert & key technologist with etch experience in process development in advanced technology nodes, will be responsible in coming up with solutions & implementing learnings from global scientific community in new approaches for some of grand etch challenges. 
 - Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results as needed to enable successful tool demo and business wins/defenses. 
 - Update on regular basis demo progress & customer penetration & defense status to executives and higher management both at customer and internal. 
 - Customer Relation- Professionally represent the company to the customer. Utilize knowledge of company's product lines and services to keep existing/ potential customers informed when new/ additional needs are identified. 
 - Other Job Responsibilities-Comfortable with travelling 2-3 Months of the time during initial training. 

Preferred Qualifications

- In depth understanding of Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP). 
 - Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques. 
 - Experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques. 
 - Interest in advanced technology and an on-going desire to learn. 
 - In-depth understanding and working knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE); experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc. )
 - Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and ability to react to shifting priorities to meet business needs and deadlines. 
 - Excellent people skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively and efficiently with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, internal and external partners. 
 - Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment
 - Handling development projects and supporting semiconductor customers

Job Description - QA Documentation Engineer

Company: Esteril Process Solutions

Department: Quality Assurance / Validation

Experience: Minimum 2 Years

Qualification: B. E. /B. Tech in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, or B. Sc. in a relevant discipline

Job Summary

Estriel Process Solutions is looking for a skilled QA Documentation Engineer with experience in preparing, reviewing, and executing technical quality and validation documentation for process equipment and systems. The candidate must be capable of independently developing Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Design Qualification (DQ), Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) documents in accordance with customer requirements, engineering specifications, and applicable quality standards. 

Key Responsibilities

* Independently develop, review, and maintain FDS, DQ, IQ, OQ, and FAT documents. 

* Prepare technical documentation based on user requirements, process descriptions, equipment specifications, and engineering drawings. 

* Develop validation protocols, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and test result documentation. 

* Prepare equipment qualification documents, including design verification, installation checks, operational testing, and functional verification, as applicable. 

* Develop FAT protocols and reports, including functional checks, safety interlocks, alarm verification, and equipment performance tests, as applicable. 

* Coordinate with engineering, automation, production, QA/QC, and project teams to collect technical inputs and finalize documentation. 

* Review technical drawings, P&IDs, equipment specifications, and control system descriptions for documentation purposes. 

* Ensure traceability between customer requirements, design specifications, test cases, and acceptance criteria. 

* Prepare and maintain SOPs, inspection reports, test reports, document registers, and revision history. 

* Coordinate document reviews and approvals with internal teams and customers. 

* Support FAT activities, customer inspections, documentation reviews, and audits. 

* Ensure documentation complies with applicable standards, project specifications, and customer requirements. 

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in QA documentation, equipment qualification, validation documentation, or technical documentation. 

* B. E. /B. Tech in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, or B. Sc. in a relevant discipline. 

* Practical experience in independently preparing FDS, DQ, IQ, OQ, and FAT documents. 

* Ability to understand engineering drawings, P&IDs, equipment specifications, and process requirements. 

* Knowledge of qualification protocols, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and traceability matrices. 

* Good proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and technical report preparation. 

* Strong written communication, analytical skills, and attention to detail. 

Preferred Experience

* Experience in process equipment, industrial automation, skid-mounted systems, or process solutions. 

* Familiarity with GMP, risk assessment, where applicable to the project. 

* Experience coordinating with engineering teams and customers for document review, approval, and FAT execution. 

* Knowledge of PLC/SCADA documentation and functional testing, where applicable. 

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently preparing high-quality technical and qualification documents from project requirements, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring documentation readiness for customer review, FAT, and equipment qualification activities. 

Candidates with hands-on experience in developing FDS, DQ, IQ, OQ, and FAT documentation are encouraged to apply.

data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Material Sourcing / Production Manager - Linen (India)

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Fiber Inventory & Quality Control

- Oversee linen fiber inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for spinning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock. 
 - Inspect and verify that only quality fiber-meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards-is released into the spinning process. 
 - Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming fiber before production begins, preventing downstream defects. 
 - Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw linen. 

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management

- Own fiber OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to spinning mills and flagging potential delays. 
 - Prolinenly manage production schedules to ensure fiber is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners. 
 - Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines. 
 - Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Coordinate with planners and production team to align fiber availability with production demand and spinning schedules. 
 - Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs. 
 - Provide input on fiber purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history. 
 - Escalate production blockers (e. g. , fiber shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals. 

Spinning & Production Support

- Partner with spinning mills to ensure fiber lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations. 
 - Monitor fiber consumption during spinning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations. 
 - Work upstream with suppliers to align fiber bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother mill integration. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of fiber lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field. 
 - Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with linen or other luxury fibers. 
 - Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess fiber quality and enforce standards before spinning. 
 - Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance. 
 - Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor fiber usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow. 
 - Collaboration: Experience working with spinning mills, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly. 

Preferred: 

- Experience with linen fiber grading, testing, or lot management. 
 - Knowledge of spinning mill operations and fiber-to-yarn conversion. 
 - Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools. 
 - Understanding of sustainable fiber sourcing and production practices. 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

Job Details
 - Location: Hyderabad, India (100% Work from Office)
 - Experience Required: 12-15 Years
 - Job Type: Full-Time / Permanent
 - Client Context: US-Based Fortune 200 Energy & Utilities Enterprise
 - Travel Requirement: Active US Business Visa (B1/B2) required for potential immediate travel deploymentAbout Us: The Prodigy DNA

At Prodigy Systems and Services, we are an AI-Native, extensive-engineering-focused enterprise that believes software engineering is an elite craft. For over 14 years, we have maintained a deeply trusted, bulletproof foothold with our primary US Fortune 200 client. Today, we have a powerhouse family of 70 elite engineers actively scaling and supporting their infrastructure. 

We are a tight-knit family of professionals built on a core pillar of deep mutual respect. Our strengths are anchored in Customer First, Integrity, Transparency, and Innovation. We are working hungry, driven to make a true difference in society and the world through hyper-velocity technological progress. 

When you join Prodigy, you will experience: 

- Warm, brilliant colleagues who push you to be your best engineering self. 
 - A humble management team that is fiercely committed to doing the right thing. 
 - An environment of radical documentation: We live by a strict operational doctrine: "Over-communication is a mandatory requirement. " We heavily utilize Microsoft Teams, Emails, and written technical specs. If it is not in writing, it never happened. Role Description & Intent

We are looking for a powerhouse, battle-tested Senior Consultant / Principal Engineer (IC) who can single-handedly pull the engineering weight of an entire team. This is a high-throttle street-the work is highly demanding, intensely fast-paced, yet deeply rewarding. 

This is strictly a production-code-producing role. You will not be limited to high-level whiteboard architecture; you must actively write, optimize, compile, and ship the code you design. You will be responsible for tearing down a legacy enterprise stack and rebuilding it from scratch using state-of-the-art Generative AI acceleration. 

Core Responsibilities & Technical Expectations
 - Production Code Execution: Massively produce clean, scalable, production-grade code leveraging Microsoft . NET Core (C#) and advanced SQL Server engineering. 
 - AI-Autonomous Engineering: Operate as an AI-augmented developer. You must natively orchestrate autonomous AI software agents (like Devin) and advanced tools (ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf) within sandboxed environments to multiply development speed. 
 - Spec-Driven Development (SDD): Write software exclusively against rigorous, unambiguous technical specifications. Code is only written once the spec is perfect. 
 - Architectural Rigor: Strictly apply SOLID principles and decoupled design patterns to ensure the new stack is easily maintainable. 
 - High-Scale Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain systems built to handle 0. 5 Million+ active customers and scale smoothly through 5 Million+ transactions daily with bulletproof stability. 
 - Hybrid Infrastructure Management: Engineer code optimized to run seamlessly within a primary On-Premises Data Center while managing low-latency replication and automated failover pipelines to AWS Disaster Recovery (DR). 
 - Observability & Instrumentation: Build world-class distributed log instrumentation and tracing setups to ensure zero blind spots across the On-Prem/AWS boundary. 
 - Cost-Sensitive Engineering: Demonstrate a relentless focus on minimizing cloud operational spend, compute overhead, and execution costs per transaction. Core Skills & Competencies
 - Primary Stack: Microsoft . NET C#, . NET Core, Advanced SQL Server (Query optimization, locking, indexing structures). 
 - AI Engineering: Cognition Devin orchestration, ChatGPT prompt engineering, Cursor, Windsurf. 
 - Methodologies: Spec-Driven Development (SDD), SOLID Principles, Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Infrastructure: Hybrid Data Centers, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, RDS, DR automation). 
 - Observability: Advanced Distributed Logging, Telemetry, and APM Instrumentation. 
 - Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the Texas Energy & Utilities sector (ERCOT, smart grids, or deregulated market clearing) is a massive plus. Rigorous 4-Round Interview Evaluation Process
 - Round 1: Elite Core Engineering & Architecture Deep-Dive
 - Focus: Severe testing of . NET/C# memory allocations, asynchronous programming models, multi-threading, and SQL Server transactional plan internals. 
 - Round 2: The AI-Augmented Hyper-Velocity Coding Challenge
 - Focus: A live, 60-minute, hands-on programming test. Candidates must leverage Generative AI tools (Devin/Cursor paradigms) to modernize a complex legacy code block into fully instrumented, spec-driven code. 
 - Round 3: Scale, Hybrid Infra & Cost-Sensitive Systems Design
 - Focus: Whiteboard scenario cracking. Designing for 5M daily transactions, maintaining sync across On-Prem and AWS DR, and proving compute-cost efficiency. 
 - Round 4: High-Throttle Executive & Cultural Fit
 - Focus: Evaluation of written and verbal communication fluency, mental stamina under high pressure.

data.description:
At Aristocrat, we're on a mission to bring happiness to life through the power of play. We believe our innovative and inclusive culture drives our success. We're committed to making a positive impact in the gaming industry. As a Technical Lead - AI Specialist / Automation Engineer, you'll have the chance to develop the future of our AI-based tools and platforms. You will make a significant impact within our engineering, creative, and quality assurance teams. This is an outstanding opportunity for someone passionate about using modern technologies to improve our workflows and deliver world-class gaming experiences. Join our ambitious team and help us continue to raise the standard in responsible gameplay and sustainability!

What You'll Do

- Cross-Functional AI Tooling: Partner with Dev, Creative, and QA leads to identify operational bottlenecks and engineer tailored AI solutions. 
 - Build and prioritize custom graphics tools to capture and multiply both static and animated art assets. These tools ensure they closely match our studio's outstanding art style. 
 - Architecture & Development: Build, test, and deploy internal AI applications, custom web portals, and Slack/Teams bots using modern LLM APIs. 
 - Workflow Automation: Build end-to-end automated pipelines connecting software systems like Jira, GitHub, and CMS using orchestration frameworks. 
 - Prompt Engineering & Fine-Tuning: Develop, evaluate, and optimize complex system prompts and workflows for high-quality outputs. 
 - Evaluation & Maintenance: Monitor tool performance, manage API cost optimization, mitigate model hallucination, and ensure strict data privacy and security compliance. 

Domain-Specific Impact Areas

- For Dev & Math Teams: Automate tasks such as summarizing technical documentation, generating boilerplate code, and AI-assisted code reviews. Develop specialized AI tools to assist with complex math tooling and game balancing. 
 - For Creative Teams: Build asset-generation pipelines, automated game rules generation, and tools to generate themes that help Artists/Animators scale content securely. 
 - For QA Teams: Build agents that parse acceptance criteria to generate comprehensive test cases, automate synthetic test data generation, generate submission documents, and categorize bug reports. 

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 5+ years in software engineering, with at least 1. 5+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade AI/LLM applications. 
 - Specialized Expertise: Strong experience with art and animation pipelines is highly favorable. 
 - Programming: Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node. js. 
 - AI Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks, and Vector Databases. 
 - Integrations: Proven track record of working with REST APIs, webhooks, and SDKs for various platforms like GitHub, Jira, Figma, Adobe, Slack, and Teams. 

Soft Skills & Approach

- Product Approach: Ability to interview internal users, translate their difficulties into technical requirements, and build intuitive UX/UI. 
 - Ambiguity Champion: Comfortable working in a rapidly shifting AI landscape, evaluating new frameworks, and picking the right tool for the job. 

Qualification

- Education: Computer Science Education (B. Tech/BE/MCA). 

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. 

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. 

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. 

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows. 

Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation-not experimentation without operational accountability. 

Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator

We are seeking a Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node. js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software. 

Core Responsibilities

- Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule. 
 - Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications. 
 - App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node. js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS). 
 - Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs. 
 - Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance. 
 - Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces. 

Technical Profile

- Core Data Engineering Foundations: 
 - Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms. 
 - Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting). 
 - Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts. 
 - Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge: 
 - Practical experience with Node. js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO). 
 - AI & Agentic Engineering: 
 - Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain. 
 - Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms. 
 - Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e. g. , Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code. 
 - Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure: 
 - Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 

Qualifications

- Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth). 
 - Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation. 
 - Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node. js/APIs). 
 - Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Principal ASIC/SoC Verification Engineer to join our dynamic and fast‐paced engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the functional correctness, robustness, and overall quality of our cutting‐edge semiconductor and SoC designs. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, this opportunity is an excellent fit. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Verification Planning and Execution
 - Develop and execute comprehensive SoC/IP‐level verification plans aligned with design specifications and project goals. 
 - Drive verification closure through functional, code, and assertion coverage, ensuring high‐quality deliverables. 
 - Apply industry‐standard ASIC/SoC verification techniques including test planning, testbench creation, constrained‐random and directed stimulus, assertions, and coverage‐driven verification. 
 - Perform SoC integration verification, validating interactions across subsystems, interfaces, and power/performance domains. 
 - Testbench & Environment Development
 - Architect, develop, and enhance SystemVerilog UVM/OVM‐based testbenches for IP and SoC‐level verification. 
 - Build and integrate reusable Verification IP (VIP) and scalable verification components. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams and third‐party VIP providers to ensure seamless integration and compliance. 
 - Develop checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and coverage models to support robust verification. 
 - Methodology, Flows & Best Practices
 - Demonstrate strong understanding of ASIC/SoC design and verification methodologies, including constraint‐random verification and object‐oriented programming principles. 
 - Contribute to verification methodology improvements, automation, and flow optimization. 
 - Ensure adherence to best practices in UVM architecture, reuse, and maintainability
 - Advanced Verification Skills
 - Perform Gate‐Level Simulation (GLS) including SDF annotation, timing verification, and debug of post‐synthesis/post‐layout issues. 
 - Execute power‐aware verification using UPF/CPF, validating power modes, isolation, retention, and sequencing. 
 - Debug complex SoC‐level issues involving multiple clock domains, resets, and power states. 
 - Apply formal verification techniques where appropriate to complement simulation‐based verification. 
 - Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog (UVM/OVM) and scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Tcl, C/C++, and Verilog PLI. 
 - Familiarity with standard protocols and interfaces (e. g. , I2C, SPI, UART, AXI/AHB/APB). 
 - Experience with simulation, debug, and coverage tools from major EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens). 
 - Knowledge of CI/regression automation, version control, and workflow tools is a plus

data.title: Senior Engineer - GTM Tech
data.description:
About Team

The IT SaaS Engineering Team is the backbone of MongoDB's go-to-market operations. We build and run the Salesforce platform - with the automation, security, and governance that Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, and Compliance rely on daily to manage customer relationships and drive business growth. 

Role Overview

Join us as a Senior Salesforce Engineer and take ownership of the CPQ and CLM systems that power MongoDB's quote-to-contract lifecycle. You'll design and build scalable pricing, quoting, and contract automation solutions end-to-end - from first design conversation to production support - working alongside senior engineers and stakeholders across Sales, Deal Desk, and Legal. This is a role for an engineer who enjoys solving hard technical problems, cares deeply about accuracy and compliance in revenue-critical systems, and wants to bring modern, AI-augmented development practices into how enterprise Q2C solutions get built. 

What you'll do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable CPQ configuration (product rules, price rules, bundles, discounting logic) and CLM workflows (clause libraries, approval chains, e-signature integration)
 - Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance stakeholders to translate quote-to-cash requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions
 - Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle - design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
 - Collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, well-governed CPQ/CLM solutions in an Agile environment
 - Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
 - Identify opportunities to simplify pricing logic, reduce legacy quote template debt, and strengthen the overall Q2C operating model
 - Troubleshoot complex pricing, approval, or contract-generation issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
 - Stay current on CPQ/CLM platform capabilities and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes, Claude Code, Cursor) to improve productivity, code quality, and documentation - with sound judgment on security, privacy, and responsible AI usage. 

Responsibilities

- Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality CPQ/CLM solutions aligned with business and compliance needs
 - Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across CPQ, CLM, and related integrations (ERP/billing)
 - Investigate pricing, contract, and integration issues, working closely with development, operations, Deal Desk, and Legal teams to resolve them
 - Communicate clearly with stakeholders on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution trade-offs
 - Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery
 - Research new CPQ/CLM platform capabilities and engineering approaches to improve the Q2C ecosystem
 - Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
 - Contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
 - 9+ years of experience in Salesforce development and enterprise application engineering, with 3+ years specifically in CPQ and/or CLM implementation
 - Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (product/price rules, quote templates, approval processes) and a CLM platform (Malbek, DocuSign CLM, Conga, or similar)
 - Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and platform customization
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, declarative automation, integration patterns, and scalable solution design
 - Experience integrating CPQ/CLM with ERP/billing systems (NetSuite preferred)
 - Experience with CI/CD, deployment processes, code refactoring, and performance optimization
 - Salesforce Platform Developer II (PD2) certification strongly preferred; Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification a plus; JavaScript Developer, Advanced Administrator, Application Architect, or System Architect certifications also valued
 - Working knowledge of AI-powered and agentic development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes) and the ability to use them effectively to improve productivity and delivery

Success Measures

- In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB's Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders
 - In 6 months, you will: Successfully deliver one or more critical Salesforce initiatives and establish yourself as a trusted technical contributor within the Sales Apps team
 - In 12 months, you will: Become a go-to engineer for key Salesforce solutions, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the scalability, quality, and long-term evolution of the CRM platform

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

data.title: Integration Engineer
data.description:
As an Integration and Automation Engineer in the Technology Architecture team at Basware IT, you'll build and run the integration fabric that connects our enterprise systems - directly impacting how reliably data and processes flow across finance, operations, and customer-facing platforms. You'll design, build, and support integrations on Azure Integration Services, standing up the APIs, event-driven interfaces, and automations other teams depend on, while helping shape this into a dedicated Integration and Automation practice as it grows. You're hands-on by nature: comfortable owning a build end-to-end - writing the code, securing it, load-testing it, and troubleshooting it in production - and picking up new tools fast, including AI-assisted development, without needing everything taught. 

- Integration development - design and build integrations on Azure Integration Services - Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Event Grid/Event Hubs - that are reliable, maintainable, and reusable. 
 - API management - build and manage APIs end-to-end through Azure API Management, including policies, versioning, throttling, and lifecycle, exposing them securely to internal and external consumers. 
 - Security & authentication - implement OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, JWT validation, and Managed Identities across integrations and APIs, and manage secrets and certificates through Azure Key Vault. 
 - Event-driven & asynchronous processing - design pub/sub and queue-based patterns using Service Bus topics/subscriptions and Event Grid/Event Hubs for decoupled, scalable system-to-system communication. 
 - Data handling & transformation - map and transform data between JSON, XML, and flat-file formats, handle schema evolution, and build validation and quality checks into pipelines rather than bolting them on afterward. 
 - Resilient API & integration design - build in retry policies, circuit breakers, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and graceful degradation so integrations fail safely and recover on their own wherever possible. 
 - Reliability & observability - monitor integrations in production using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics; troubleshoot failures and drive fixes that improve stability over time. 
 - CI/CD & source control - build and maintain deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (ARM/Bicep) and work disciplined Git workflows so releases are repeatable and low-risk. 
 - AI-assisted development - use tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude as part of your everyday workflow - for design, coding, testing, and documentation - while owning the quality of everything you ship. 
 - Collaboration - work closely with Enterprise Data, Solution Architecture, and AI Enablement so integrations are built with the wider platform in mind, not in isolation. 

, 

Must-have Skills & Experience

- Hands-on, production-grade experience building integrations on Azure Integration Services - Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and API Management. 
 - Practical experience building and securing APIs end to end, including OAuth2/OpenID Connect, JWT, API keys, and Managed Identities. 
 - Working knowledge of event-driven architecture - Event Grid and/or Event Hubs, pub/sub and queue-based messaging patterns. 
 - Strong grasp of data handling and transformation - JSON, XML, schema mapping, and building validation and error handling into the pipeline itself. 
 - Experience designing resilient, error-resistant APIs and integrations - retry logic, circuit breakers, idempotency, and dead-letter/exception handling - not just the happy path. 
 - Solid programming fundamentals (C#/. NET, Python, or JavaScript) applied to Azure Functions and custom integration logic. 
 - A demonstrated ability to learn new tools quickly, particularly AI-assisted development tools - our toolchain evolves fast, and curiosity matters as much as current skills. Hands-on experience with Claude and/or Azure AI tooling in a real development workflow is a strong plus. 
 - Strong written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multicultural, globally distributed teams. 
 - Comfort operating independently in a small, growing team, with the flexibility to take on ambiguous problems. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Power Automate. 
 - SQL Server / T-SQL for data debugging, stored procedures, and integration troubleshooting. 
 - Exposure to Azure Data Factory or Databricks for data ingestion pipelines. 
 - Microsoft certification such as AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate) or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with Finance Technology and SaaS business
 - Prior experience in an enterprise environment with multiple integrated systems. 

How We Think About AI

We value curiosity and a proactive willingness to explore AI-driven technologies, and we provide room to experiment and learn - AI capability is something we build, not just buy.

data.title: Quant Developer - Low Latency C++
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub-working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You'll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science.

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets.

data.title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
data.description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform. 

Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands. 

Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities

- Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand. 
 - Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput. 
 - Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity. 
 - Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff. 
 - Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness. 
 - Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients. 
 - Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens. 
 - Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks. 
 - Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review. 
 - Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams. 
 - Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
 - 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
 - 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
 - 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
 - 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
 - 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
 - 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
 - Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
 - 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications

- CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
 - CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
 - CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

- Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules. 
 - Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record. 
 - Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance. 
 - Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms. 
 - Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones. 
 - Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established. 
 - Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data. 

Working Arrangements

- Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements. 
 - Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely. 
 - Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams. 

Travel

- Up to 10% travel may be required. 

Benefits

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.

You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
 - 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
 - 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
