data.description:
Job Description

About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. 

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. 

The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain - from distribution center operations and warehouse management to transportation and delivery for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party vendors to deliver scalable microservices that keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end - designing systems, integrating with WMS and TMS platforms, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day. 

Role Overview

The Staff Software Engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade, scalable microservices applications supporting Logistics and Warehouse Management Systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on development expertise, and close collaboration with cross-functional business and technology teams, including third-party vendors such as Manhattan Associates. 

Impact of the Role

- Provide technical leadership for the Logistics domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of scalable, enterprise-grade microservices. 
 - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution. 
 - Lead integrations across Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, Slotting, and Labor Management systems and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve Logistics operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 
 - Drive Agile delivery and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. 
 - Guide teams, drive execution, and deliver measurable business value. 

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

- Java, JavaEE, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC/WebFlux
 - Microservices and RESTful APIs
 - Kafka, MQ, TCP/IP, and file systems
 - JPA and SLF4J logging
 - DB2, SQL Server, and Oracle
 - Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
 - Git and Sonar
 - AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana
 - Manhattan WMOS
 - Transportation Management Systems
 - Manhattan Slotting
 - Labor Management systems
 - Jira
 - AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership for the Logistics domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of scalable, enterprise-grade microservices. 
 - Drive hands-on development of Java and Spring Boot services, RESTful APIs, and event-driven integrations using Kafka. 
 - Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality. 
 - Lead deployments and CI/CD automation on containerized platforms, including automated testing and release readiness. 
 - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution. 
 - Lead integrations across Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, Slotting, and Labor Management systems and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders and third-party vendors such as Manhattan Associates to translate logistics requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve Logistics operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 
 - Drive Agile delivery - sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking - and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years as a Java Lead. 
 - Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale microservices applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment. 
 - Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking. 
 - Strong knowledge of logistics, warehouse management, and Distribution Center operations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating with Manhattan WMOS, Transportation Management Systems, Manhattan Slotting, and Labor Management systems. 
 - Experience leading third-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services. 
 - Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to revenue and operational goals. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Java, JavaEE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC/WebFlux, Microservices, and Kafka. 
 - Proficiency with RESTful web services, JPA, SLF4J logging, and application configuration management. 
 - Strong relational database skills across DB2, SQL Server, and Oracle. 
 - Experience with containerized platforms such as Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. 
 - Working knowledge of secure coding standards, Git repository and branching strategies, and code quality tools such as Sonar. 
 - Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana, including alert and notification setup. 
 - Proficiency with Enterprise Integration Systems architecture using Kafka, MQ, TCP/IP, file systems, etc. 
 - Strong AI-first mindset. 
 - Experience using AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, and documentation. 
 - Ability to design AI-agent-led solutions for use cases such as issue triage, exception monitoring, report generation, knowledge retrieval, regression testing support, and operational analytics. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, and validation of AI-generated outputs. 
 - Demonstrated situational leadership - guiding teams, driving execution, and delivering measurable business value. 
 - Ability to facilitate productive discussions across diverse stakeholder groups and drive alignment. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

- Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. 
 - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact. 
 - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. 
 - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

data.title: Senior Configuration and Delivery Manager
data.description:
Job Description

Configuration and Delivery Manager would be responsible for configuration control, release coordination, deployment governance, and delivery readiness across current and upcoming WSP Digital Products. The role would ensure that product configuration, environment readiness, version control, release packages, deployment approvals, and production releases are managed through controlled, traceable, auditable, and repeatable processes across development, test, staging, and production environments. 

Responsibilities

Configuration Management

Define and maintain configuration management standards across applications, environments, release packages, and deployment artefacts. 

Maintain traceability for product versions, configuration items, environment variables, dependencies, release baselines, and deployment records. 

Coordinate configuration changes across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and environment layers. 

Ensure configuration decisions are documented, controlled, and auditable. 

Release & Deployment Management

Plan, coordinate, schedule, and govern product releases across current and upcoming digital products. 

Maintain release calendars, deployment schedules, release notes, release scope, deployment checklist, and rollback plans. 

Coordinate release readiness reviews, QA sign-offs, DevOps readiness, CAB inputs, and production deployment approvals. 

Track release risks, deployment issues, defects, rollback outcomes, and post-release validation status. 

Environment & Delivery Readiness

Coordinate environment readiness across Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production, and support environments. 

Ensure environment consistency, access readiness, dependency readiness, and deployment sequencing before release execution. 

Support environment refresh, configuration updates, smoke-test coordination, and deployment troubleshooting. 

Work with DevOps and engineering teams to improve repeatability and reliability of deployment practices. 

Compliance, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Maintain release evidence, approval records, deployment logs, release decisions, and audit-ready documentation. 

Track release metrics including deployment frequency, failed deployments, rollback frequency, defect leakage, and release predictability. 

Identify recurring release and configuration issues and drive preventive improvements with engineering, QA, DevOps, and support teams. 

Contribute to release SOPs, configuration playbooks, governance checklists, and operational documentation. 

Required Technical Skills

Configuration Management | Advanced - software baselines, version control, configuration item traceability, environment configuration, and audit records

Release Management | Advanced - release planning, deployment coordination, CAB inputs, release readiness, rollback planning, and sign-offs

DevOps / CI-CD Awareness | Proficient - Azure DevOps, GitHub, branching, tagging, pipelines, deployment controls, and release artefacts

Environment Governance | Proficient - Dev, QA, UAT, staging, production readiness, environment refresh, and deployment sequencing

ITIL / Change Governance | Proficient - change, release, configuration, risk-based approvals, governance documentation, and auditability

Stakeholder Coordination | Advanced - coordination across engineering, QA, DevOps, business, support, and leadership teams

Required Experience

Minimum 8 years of professional experience in configuration management, release management, DevOps coordination, IT operations, or software delivery governance. 

Experience managing enterprise release cycles across multiple environments and product teams. 

Experience with configuration baselines, release packages, deployment records, change controls, and audit-ready documentation. 

Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, branching strategies, build/release pipelines, and deployment governance. 

Experience coordinating CAB approvals, release readiness, rollback planning, deployment validation, and post-release verification. 

Preferred (Not Required)

Experience supporting SaaS, cloud-hosted, or integration-heavy enterprise digital products. 

Exposure to ITIL Change, Release, and Configuration Management practices. 

Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Confluence, or similar tools. 

Exposure to product transition, MVP stabilization, or multi-vendor delivery models. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 
 - ITIL Foundation, DevOps, Agile, or Release Management certification is preferred but not mandatory.

 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration.

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

data.title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
data.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview

TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70, 000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. You will partner with Automation Developers, Network Engineers, Security, Global Systems, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to build a scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable automation ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

What You Will Own

Platform Engineering & Operations

- Own the architecture, deployment, operation, and lifecycle of network automation applications and supporting services. 
 - Design and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, Argo, and Terraform. 
 - Own the Nautobot platform stack, including Python/Django, Celery, uWSGI/NGINX, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements. 

DevOps & Software Delivery

- Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows. 
 - Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices. 
 - Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments. 

Cloud, Security & Risk

- Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support. 
 - Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation. 
 - Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements. 

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team. 
 - Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

- 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering. 
 - Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Git, GitLab administration, runners, and CI/CD pipeline design. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience including IAM, EKS, EC2, VPCs, S3, security controls, monitoring, and cloud networking. 
 - Hands-on Experience operating distributed application platforms using Kubernetes, Celery, Redis, and containers. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security scanning across the software lifecycle. 
 - Experience supporting highly available production applications with demanding operational requirements. 
 - Ability to lead architecture decisions, solve complex platform problems, and guide engineers through implementation. 

Preferred Experience

- Nautobot, NetBox, or comparable network source-of-truth platforms. 
 - Network automation and orchestration, including Ansible. 
 - Python and Django applications; PostgreSQL or MongoDB. 
 - GitLab Runner architecture and management; Argo-based deployment workflows. 
 - Enterprise platforms operating in regulated environments. 

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first 12 months, you will: 
 - Lead the transition of the Nautobot AWS/Kubernetes platform from vendor-managed operations to a TNS-owned and operated service, including architecture, deployment, upgrades, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management. 
 - Standardize GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release management. 
 - Provide clear technical leadership for platform engineering and automation infrastructure. 
 - Lead the AWS architecture and migration approach for applications, services, and infrastructure moving from on-premises and legacy environments. 

For this role in the United States, we anticipate paying $125, 000k - $155, 000K. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package. 

If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!

TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

data.title: Head of Enterprise Technology
data.description:
Location: Indore or Hyderabad, India

Reports to: Office of the CEO

About YASH Technologies

YASH Technologies is a customer-centric, transformational global IT solutions and services partner with a proven track record delivering exceptional outcomes for Fortune 1000 enterprises across multiple industries. For nearly 30 years, YASH has grown through strong client relationships, deep technical capability, and a values-driven culture shaped by founder leadership. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are focused on building the technology and infrastructure needed to scale with more clarity and discipline. 

About the Role

YASH is looking for a Head of Enterprise Technology to join the Office of the CEO and help reimagine how we transform technology to enable our business. This role has multiple mandates: (1) Understand the core YASH business and build trust with global leadership, (2) Work in a phased approach to build and transform the enterprise technology function, and (3) Re-imagine enterprise technology for the world of AI. We are looking for someone who can work collaboratively in a matrixed organization and lead through empathy and influence. This is a hybrid role with an expectation of three days per week onsite and travel as needed (~10%). 

What You'll Do

Partner with the Business

- Understand the core business, provide solutions that transform business processes, and showcase internal solutions to YASH customers. 
 - Deliver the Enterprise Technology vision and operating model, anchored to YASH's business strategy while serving as a technology thought leader to the CEO. 
 - Turn unclear problems into clear processes, owners, and measures, and keep those processes light enough to be used. 
 - Keep core systems reliable while moving the function forward in practical, incremental steps that the business can absorb. 

Establish and Collaborate On Enterprise Technology

- Set and establish baseline and innovative standards for architecture, security, data, integration, and service management. 
 - Establish and run a product led operating model using innovative and agentic ways of working. 
 - Govern and manage the global application portfolio. 
 - Manage Enterprise Technology spend and make build vs. buy decisions. 
 - Lead a core team in a matrix model, manage vendors and sourcing, and attract people who want to be business enablers, not order takers, and work in a "fail fast and learn" model. 

Establish and Manage Security, Data, Infrastructure, and Service Management

- Work collaboratively to transform, manage, and govern enterprise data to drive real time business decisions. 
 - Establish and manage enterprise wide role-based access, security, and manage regulatory compliance. 
 - Establish global service management, service levels, and operations so application support and management is predictable, measured, and trusted, without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 - Be accountable for keeping YASH infrastructure reliable, secure, cost effective, and incrementally improving. 

Lead with Empathy and Roll Up Your Sleeves

- Be ok not directly owning all functions on day 1, building credibility and trust, and working collaboratively to create positive outcomes. 
 - Read people well, build real relationships, and understand what each leader and team needs before proposing a solution. 
 - Bring ideas and outside perspective, question "how we have always done it, " and make the case with evidence and empathy. 
 - Be comfortable building a prototype, configuring a workflow, analyzing a cost model, or writing the standard yourself. Use delegation to multiply your impact, not to avoid the work. 

What You'll Need (Required)

- 12+ years of experience in global enterprise technology, product management, and IT service management. 
 - History of standing up or materially rebuilding an enterprise technology function, ideally in a founder-led, PE-backed, or rapidly scaling organization. 
 - Experience delivering through partners, outsourced providers, or internal service organizations, with clear service levels and accountability. 
 - Technical credibility from architecture, design, hands on delivery, to product management. 
 - Strong business judgment and high EQ with the ability to advise, constructively challenge, and influence senior leaders. 
 - Practical experience applying AI in an enterprise from business processes to engineering, development, and support. 
 - Comfort operating in an entrepreneurial, fast paced environment with exposure to senior leadership. 
 - Experience owning and shaping a technology budget and P&L. 
 - Working knowledge of security, access control, data privacy, and a record of working to make them real in enterprises. 
 - Track record of working across multiple geographies and experience in professional services. 

Compensation & Benefits

YASH Technologies offers a competitive and comprehensive Cost to Company (CTC) package, commensurate with the candidate's experience, expertise, and the strategic importance of the role. 

The compensation structure includes fixed pay and a performance-linked variable incentive, with the opportunity to earn up to 120% of the eligible incentive amount, subject to individual and organisational performance. 

In addition, YASH offers a comprehensive benefits programme, including medical insurance for employees and their families, parental medical insurance, group personal accident coverage, performance-based rewards and recognition, and other employee benefits as per company policy. 

For the right candidate, compensation will not be a constraint. The final package will be determined based on the candidate's experience, capabilities, and overall fit for the role. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

YASH Technologies provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religious practices and observances, national origin, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran, or disability.

data.title: Staff Engineer - Backend
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Staff Engineer (Backend)

We're looking for a Staff Engineer (Backend) to join our engineering organization. In this role, you will drive the architecture, scalability, and reliability of critical backend systems across multiple teams. You will operate at a strategic level, influencing technical direction, solving highly complex problems, and enabling teams to build robust, high-performing systems. 

Success in this role means defining long-term technical vision, improving engineering excellence across the organization, and mentoring senior engineers while driving large-scale impact. This position is critical to scaling our platform and supporting Quince's mission of delivering exceptional quality at incredible value. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own and evolve multiple critical applications/services, ensuring long-term scalability, reliability, and maintainability
 - Lead the design and architecture of complex, large-scale distributed systems, frameworks, and platforms across teams
 - Define and drive the roadmap for engineering and operational excellence at an organizational level
 - Conduct deep performance analysis and lead system-wide optimizations to ensure high scalability and efficiency
 - Drive technical planning, system design reviews, and estimation for large, cross-team initiatives
 - Collaborate with product, data, and infrastructure stakeholders to define ambiguous requirements and translate them into scalable system designs
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior and mid-level engineers across teams
 - Establish and enforce best practices for coding standards, system design, observability, and reliability
 - Review and guide critical architectural and code decisions across multiple teams
 - Stay ahead of emerging technologies and introduce new architectural patterns to improve system capabilities
 - Raise the engineering bar by actively contributing to hiring, team building, and technical culture

Qualifications: 

- Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and advanced system design
 - 8+ years of experience working on backend and distributed systems
 - Deep expertise in Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL/NoSQL databases
 - Proven experience designing and scaling highly reliable, large-scale distributed systems across multiple services/teams
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, multithreading, and high-performance system design
 - Deep knowledge of system architecture, design principles, and trade-off analysis at scale
 - Experience driving organization-wide technical initiatives and architectural decisions
 - Strong focus on code quality, latency optimization, observability, and system reliability
 - Ability to operate effectively in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments with significant ownership
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams
 - Proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture

Preferred: 

- Experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS preferred)
 - Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven systems, and distributed system patterns
 - Experience leading large-scale system migrations or platform transformations
 - Familiarity with observability tools, monitoring systems, and SRE practices
 - Experience in high-growth startups or scaling consumer internet platforms
 - Passion for building platforms that enable teams to move faster with high reliability

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

What We Are Looking For

Technical Excellence

 - Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production environments.

 - Strong expertise troubleshooting Kubernetes networking, storage, scheduling, scaling, and workload lifecycle challenges.

data.title: Field Engineer III
data.description:
About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer III with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc. 

- Responsible to lead the team of discipline engineers for construction supervision and management of the respective discipline works at project site. 
 - Assign/distribute works/work areas to the discipline engineers and ensure that the process of review of the 'Issued for Construction' drawings and seeking clarification based on the established procedure is followed. 
 - Necessary inputs are provided to the Planning Engineer/Team at project site for developing the construction schedule for the respective discipline. 
 - The engineers understand the requirements specified in the contract agreement of the contractors for respective discipline. 
 - The engineers collaborate with the contractors for development of the detailed construction schedule/review the construction schedule, resource status submitted by contractors. 
 - Stage wise inspections are carried out, of works performed by the contractor based on the approved quality plan and necessary documentation for the inspections performed are maintained. 
 - The engineers Review JHAs, method statements and lifting plan (if applicable). 
 - Approval of Quality Plan and Inspection Test Plan of the contractors. 
 - Lead site walk rounds for the respective discipline and participate in quality audits. 
 - Supervise for safety to maintain a safe workplace. Ensure that the team of engineers carry out inspections of activities performed by the contractors to confirm compliance to Field HSE Specification. Highlight deficiencies to contractor through formal communication. 

Additional Responsibilities

- Maintain status of front availability and monitor work progress as compared to the approved schedule and highlight deficiencies to the contractor through formal contractual communications. 
 - Monitor contractor's compliance to various requirements indicated under the contract agreement. Highlight non-conformities to the contractor through formal communication and follow up for compliance. 
 - Lead review meetings with Contractors. 
 - Review and certify the interim and final measurement records submitted by the contractors. 
 - Coordinate with the Contractors for submission of 'As Built' mark ups and review of the same. 

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes: 

- Knowledge of quality control, safe ways of working, resource requirement, sequence of activities, and supervision of construction activities for the respective discipline. Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc. ) for the respective discipline. Knowledge of statutory requirements, general contract requirements and interpretation of contract clauses. 
 - Graduate Engineers with minimum 15 years of experience with minimum 3 years of experience of working as Lead Engineer/Area Manager/Superintendent in Oil & Gas Sector and Chemicals. 
 - Graduate in Engineering in respective discipline. 
 - Knowledge of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline. 
 - Proficient in MS Office. 
 - Leadership skills, Team Player. 
 - Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity. 

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. 

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. 

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.description:
Role Purpose

This is an exciting role in the expanding Security Architecture team at LSEG. The Architecture team reports into the Group CISO. 

This role is to join the team as a Senior Security Specialist - with a view to strengthening and building out our assurance processes as we move from a traditional on-prem operation, into the virtual, software defined and cloud paradigm. 

Security Architecture Review team is responsible for reviewing the security posture of new systems alongside the Principal Security Architects; Managing firewall team and supporting Firewall rule changes in both BAU and strategic initiatives

Successful candidate will be part of Security Architecture Review team to define the role's goals, processes and deliverable, support our strategy to Shift Left and enable the business to achieve its goals in agility and innovation. 

Role Responsibilities

- Undertake security Architecture reviews and work with architecture teams to ensure security is built into active development project's design
 - Proven ability to assess and approve firewall rule changes in line with security architecture, secure design patterns and compliance standards. 
 - Undertake reviewing rule sets in platforms like standard, Next generation and virtualization firewalls, be able to design and operate firewall change control processes with audit traceability. 
 - Experience designing secure connectivity patterns that align with architectural principles, standards and policies. 
 - Validate that firewall rules align with approved network segmentation models and security zoning policies. 
 - Drawing on technical experience and knowledge to assure that technical implementations match approved architectures
 - Attend the Security Architecture Design Forum as needed
 - Experience line managing a small team and leading from the front
 - Operates metrics and monitoring to report the effectiveness and efficiency of the Security Architecture function.

 - Evangelise Security Architecture as an enabler as opposed to a blocking point

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required; a Master's degree is a plus
 - Line Management experience
 - Understanding of the latest security principles, techniques and protocols
 - Problem solving skills, critical thinking, ability to work under pressure and self-starter

 - Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, NIST / CSC, CIS etc. 
 - Proven ability to influence; Good verbal and written communication skills, with strengths in communicating security concepts to non-security minded technical audiences
 - Fast learner - Willing to expand skillset and rapidly understand new technologies

Beneficial Skills. Experience And Certifications

 - Previous experience in finance industry / financial markets infrastructure and / or technology sector

 - Experience designing secure connectivity patterns that align with architectural principles, standards and policies. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native firewall services (e. g. , Azure Firewall, AWS Network Firewall). 
 - Understanding of how firewall rules support or violate architectural principles and approved patterns (e. g. , least privilege, zero trust). 
 - Experience using firewall management and review tools (e. g. , Tufin, FireMon, AlgoSec).

Team Leadership

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a global delivery center, captive, or shared services environment. 
 - Prior experience supporting US CPA firms, consulting firms, or Big 4 / large professional services organizations.

Skills & Competencies

data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

- Job Summary

The Design Manager is assigned to a project as a key member of the design team, he is responsible for the proper and timely execution within his discipline of the design and requisitioning in accordance with the control estimate and specific requirements of the project. He is also responsible for ensuring that the Group's technical policies, are followed, considering any special contractual requirements. Ensure the timely completion of design and engineering deliverables. Manage the activity as assigned by Group Lead / DM. 

- Lead the design and engineering of HVAC systems across all assigned projects. Ensure effective interdisciplinary coordination and actively participate in client meetings. 
 - Maintain comprehensive project documentation including meeting notes, hold lists, comment logs, and assumption lists. 
 - Foster strong client relationships and ensure the use of Jacobs' project management tools and systems. Ensure all HVAC designs meet client requirements, applicable building codes, and energy efficiency standards. 
 - Review and validate complete HVAC design packages, including heat load calculations, area classification, pressure zoning, AHU zoning, and HVAC Room Book summaries. Evaluate reheating capacities and conduct technical assessments for equipment selection such as chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, pumps, dehumidifiers, and ventilation systems, to ensure optimal performance and cost-effective solutions. 
 - Documentation & Specification Development Review and verify BMS logic diagrams, P&ID, and AF&ID sheets. Prepare tender documents, bills of quantities (BOQ), technical specifications, approved make lists, and general terms and conditions in accordance with local regulations, building codes, and energy efficiency standards. 
 - Requires specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise; serves as an expert within own function and discipline. 
 - Interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. 
 - Solves complex problems; takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions; identifies applications of functional knowledge and existing methodologies to complex problems. 
 - Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations. 
 - Leads functional teams or projects and serves as a best practice/quality resource. 
 - Progression to this level is typically restricted based on business requirement. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders and manage timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful project delivery. 
 - Conduct design reviews and value engineering assessments. Recommend improvements to existing systems for enhanced performance and efficiency. 
 - Stay updated with the latest HVAC technologies and sustainability practices. Integrate smart building solutions and energy modelling into designs. 
 - Demonstrate excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Prepare audit documentation. 

People and Team

- Contributes to a culture of excellence in quality work and successful projects
 - Build appropriate relationships with relevant project stakeholders
 - Works towards achieving "best for project" outcomes
 - Provide feedback and coaching to junior team members
 - Supports internal learning and development / knowledge sharing in area of expertise within Jacobs. 
 - Supervise and mentor junior HVAC engineers and designers. Facilitate training and development programs. 
 - Develop working relationships across various disciplines
 - Strong communications skills. 
 - Strong negotiation skills. 

Here's what you'll need

Qualification- B. Tech in Mechanical (Full Time)

Experience- 18+ years of experience

- Strong experience on design of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility / Speciality Chemical in terms of HVAC design. 
 - Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility architectural layout and process sequence. 
 - Selection of HVAC Equipment / Items. 
 - Sound experience of Hazardous Area Classification. 
 - Design and selection of LAFs, fume hoods, and biosafety cabinets. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: Staff Engineer, Software
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 

DESCRIPTION: 

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries. 

Lead AI/ML, chemometric, and LLM capabilities for bioprocessing and industrial software, turning process data into reliable models and secure decision-support tools. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead architecture and delivery of AI/ML, LLM, and data products for bioprocessing and industrial applications. 
 - Partner with software, process, automation, and scientific teams to define valuable use cases and measurable outcomes. 
 - Own data science workflows from acquisition and analysis through feature engineering, validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Build ML models for multivariate and time-series data, including anomaly detection, forecasting, soft sensing, and optimization. 
 - Apply chemometric methods such as PCA and PLS to process and analytical data for PAT and process insight. 
 - Develop data pipelines, APIs, and integrations for equipment, instruments, historians, automation, and enterprise systems. 
 - Build LLM applications using RAG, semantic search, and approved knowledge sources; evaluate retrieval and answer quality. 
 - Productionize AI/ML and LLM solutions with reproducible experiments, versioning, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Ensure solutions address security, privacy, data integrity, validation, explainability, and responsible AI. 
 - Set engineering direction, review designs, mentor engineers, and communicate model behavior and limitations to stakeholders. 

Required Experience

- 9-14 years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI/ML, data science, industrial analytics, or process automation. 
 - Strong Python and software engineering skills; experience with C#/. NET or Java is valuable. 
 - Applied data science and ML experience, including statistical analysis and supervised or unsupervised methods. 
 - Experience with multivariate and time-series data, model validation, performance metrics, and uncertainty. 
 - Experience with data pipelines and SQL or NoSQL databases; time-series or historian data is desirable. 
 - Working knowledge of MLOps, including reproducible experiments, model versioning, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Hands-on chemometrics experience, including PCA, PLS, calibration, and model validation. 
 - Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, semantic retrieval, vector search, and RAG. 
 - Experience building LLM applications and evaluating grounding, retrieval relevance, and response quality. 
 - Knowledge of secure LLM design, data privacy, safeguards, and human review. 
 - Experience integrating software with industrial or laboratory systems. 
 - Understanding of process control, instrumentation, sensors, and process data acquisition. 
 - Experience productizing software or analytics and leading or mentoring multidisciplinary teams. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Spectral or process analytical data experience (such as NIR or Raman), PAT, or bioprocessing experience. 
 - Familiarity with OPC UA, PLC, SCADA, or MES integration. 
 - Knowledge of GxP, validation, data integrity, cybersecurity, and responsible AI.

Position Title Team Manager, RCM Medical Coding

Reports To Wendy Rogers, Manager, Medical Coding

Role Type - People Manager

Job Summary

The Team Manager, RCM Coding (Supervisor, Medical Coding & Auditing)** serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in multi-specialty medical coding, documentation compliance, and quality assurance. In this role, you will direct and empower an internal coding team, streamlining day-to-day workflows, auditing performance, and driving continuous process improvement. You will also oversee the accuracy and quality of our global coding vendor partners, ensuring our BOOST clients receive high-caliber coding support that optimizes practice success. 

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Quality Assurance Management

Direct and manage the internal department's day-to-day coding and auditing processes. 

Establish quality assurance workflows, establish guidelines, and delegate work across internal and global teams to optimize operational efficiency. 

Oversee coding and billing compliance monitoring for gGastro/gMed and EMA/PM BOOST clients. 

Subject Matter Expertise & Query Support

Serve as the primary coding SME for ModMed India COE coders and the broader BOOST team. 

Resolve complex coding queries, documentation clarifications, and billing items to ensure accurate claim generation. 

Vendor Oversight & Denial Mitigation

Partner with the Manager of Medical Coding and Auditing to conduct recurring quality calls with global coding vendors. 

Analyze coding denial trends, drive root-cause analysis, lead knowledge transfer sessions, and conduct regular trainings for internal and vendor teams. 

Process Innovation & Documentation

Proactively design, create, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Quick Reference Guides (QRGs), and client-specific instruction sets for gMed and EMA/PM platforms. 

Develop client-facing communications and workflow guides to elevate client understanding of coding best practices. 

People Management, Compliance & Team Development

Partner with the People Team (Talent Acquisition and Business Partners) to recruit, interview, onboard, and train top talent. 

Conduct regular 1: 1 performance meetings (weekly/biweekly) and execute annual and mid-year performance reviews. 

Mentor staff to maximize potential, efficiency, and professional growth. 

Participate in BOOST committee calls to assess coding requirements and resolve compliance items. 

Key Attributes & Organizational Scope

Leadership Competencies (Priority Focus)

Team Leadership: Builds high-performing, engaged teams through empathetic leadership, continuous coaching, and strategic talent development. 

Results Driven: Consistently achieves high-quality outcomes, overcomes obstacles, and inspires others to excel. 

Customer Focus: Establishes strong relationships internally and externally, delivering client-centric solutions that create true customer delight. 

Business Savvy: Applies technical and industry coding expertise to elevate team efficiency and positively impact overall business health. 

Communication & Analysis Complexities

Global Scope: Communicates cross-functionally across multiple business units, countries (US & India), and globally across the enterprise. 

Disseminates critical operational updates internally and externally. 

Problem Solving & Decision Making: Solves complex coding scenarios, resolves team workflow roadblocks, and establishes guidelines for client success. 

Acts as the final authority on operational coding procedures and day-to-day task delegation. 

Innovation: Continuously modernizes workflows, develops training presentations, and builds comprehensive knowledge-transfer materials to boost accuracy

Job Qualifications & Requirements

Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent practical experience. 

Required Certification: Active certification in at least one of the following: 

Certified Professional Coder

Certified Outpatient Coder

Certified Coding Specialist - Physician

Experience & Skills: 

Demonstrated background in multi-specialty medical coding and documentation auditing. 

Proven leadership capability or team management experience. 

Strong expertise with physician billing workflows and electronic health record (EHR) systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

Active **Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA)** certification in addition to CPC, COC, or CCS-P. 

Direct experience working with EMA/PM or gGastro/gMed platforms. Previous experience managing global vendor performance and remote team dynamics.

The person in this position oversees quality assurance processes for organic and natural produce, from sourcing and handling through storage, packaging, and distribution. The role involves setting up testing protocols, maintaining detailed quality documentation and records, and coordinating with farmers, procurement, and logistics teams to resolve quality issues promptly. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Requisition ID: 77773

About Skyworks

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Skyworks offers the industry's broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance. 

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 3 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure

data.title: Project Journey Resident Engineer
data.description:
Description

As the Resident Engineer - Automatic Transmission Launch & Localization, you will represent Product Development onsite at a new manufacturing facility producing automatic transmissions. 

You will provide technical leadership throughout equipment commissioning, pre-production builds, production validation, launch, ramp-up, and ongoing production. You will also lead regional Product Development activities associated with localization of components and assemblies. 

The Position Combines Two Closely Related Areas Of Accountability

- Resident engineering leadership for the transmission manufacturing operation. 
 - Regional Product Development leadership for component localization and implementation. 

You will work closely with regional and global transmission engineering teams to ensure localized products, manufacturing changes, supplier proposals, validation activities, and production approvals meet applicable engineering, functional, durability, quality, and manufacturing requirements. 

The role reports to the Product Development General Manager for Underbody Systems in Chennai, with a matrix reporting relationship to the Global Rear-Wheel-Drive Transmission Manager. 

Responsibilities

Serve as the onsite Product Development technical representative

- Act as the primary Product Development interface between the transmission plant and regional and global engineering organizations. 
 - Represent Product Development in decisions related to product engineering, manufacturing feasibility, quality, production readiness, and launch. 
 - Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, design requirements, validation results, and product acceptance criteria. 
 - Connect plant concerns with the appropriate Product Development, Design and Release, systems engineering, manufacturing, quality, supplier, and vehicle engineering owners. 
 - Establish productive working relationships with plant leadership, engineers, manufacturing personnel, suppliers, and regional and global Product Development teams. 

Support plant launch and production readiness

- Provide onsite engineering support during installation, commissioning, pre-production builds, production validation, launch, ramp-up, and ongoing production. 
 - Support applicable prototype, development, validation, tooling-trial, pre-production, and production builds. 
 - Coordinate engineering disposition of build concerns and ensure unresolved risks have defined owners, containment actions, and closure plans. 
 - Support transmission and component approval for regional vehicle builds and vehicle assembly plants. 
 - Lead or support Product Development reviews for Production Validation, part approval, production sign-off, and Ok-to-Ship decisions. 
 - Identify emerging product and manufacturing concerns early and escalate issues requiring regional or global engineering support. 
 - Capture launch lessons learned and support the transition to stable production. 

Lead technical problem solving

- Lead Product Development response to transmission and component concerns identified at the plant. 
 - Determine whether concerns originate from product design, supplier quality, manufacturing processes, assembly execution, specifications, or interactions among these areas. 
 - Lead structured root-cause analysis using appropriate problem-solving methods and coordinate interim and permanent corrective actions. 
 - Review end-of-line test results, process audit data, component measurements, transmission build history, teardown findings, and other engineering evidence when assessing product acceptability. 
 - Support investigation of plant concerns, vehicle assembly plant concerns, field/warranty returns, and transmission teardowns. 
 - Ensure significant technical issues are documented, tracked, escalated, and driven to verified closure. 

Manage engineering changes and plant concerns

- Initiate, review, approve or reject, track, and close engineering concerns within delegated authority. 
 - Coordinate implementation of engineering changes at the transmission plant and affected regional vehicle assembly plants. 
 - Ensure manufacturing teams understand each change's technical rationale, affected components, implementation timing, validation requirements, and production risks. 
 - Review supplier requests for engineering approval and coordinate Design and Release and systems engineering input. 
 - Review Manufacturing Risk Assessments within established engineering governance and delegated authority. 
 - Coordinate temporary engineering deviations with appropriate regional and global engineering owners. 
 - Monitor component availability, supplier readiness, implementation timing, production run-out plans, and trial results. 
 - Maintain a current record of open engineering concerns, changes, decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and closure evidence. 

Lead regional product localization

- Serve as the regional Product Development focal point for localization and manufacturing implementation. 
 - Coordinate localization with global transmission systems, component engineering, Design and Release, validation, manufacturing, purchasing, supplier, and program teams. 
 - Ensure localized components maintain approved design intent and satisfy applicable functional, durability, quality, engineering, and manufacturing requirements. 
 - Develop and execute localization-specific component and transmission validation plans, obtaining global engineering approval where required. 
 - Coordinate pre-production and Production Validation testing, analyze results, identify gaps, and drive closure. 
 - Lead regional execution of Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Part Submission Warrant (PSW), Production Validation, and Ok-to-Ship activities as applicable. 
 - Support supplier technical reviews, site assessments, readiness reviews, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), control-plan reviews, and production trials. 
 - Coordinate local vehicle-integration support, prototype requirements, transmission sign-off, and regional vehicle-program interfaces. 
 - Ensure sourcing, supplier, tooling, timing, cost, and local-content decisions do not compromise product requirements. 
 - Maintain alignment with global Design and Release ownership, engineering specifications, engineering changes, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), and Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R) requirements. 

Drive regional and global engineering alignment

- Provide clear, concise status updates to regional Product Development and global transmission leadership. 
 - Communicate significant product risks, launch concerns, quality trends, approval gaps, decisions required, and support needs. 
 - Participate in relevant regional and global product, design, manufacturing, supplier, launch, and quality reviews. 
 - Collaborate across regions and time zones to obtain timely technical decisions. 
 - Ensure locally made decisions are properly documented and comply with applicable global engineering governance. 
 - Share lessons learned and effective practices with other resident engineers and Product Development teams. 
 - Escalate unresolved safety, regulatory, durability, quality, supplier, production, or customer risks through established leadership channels. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. 
 - 10+ years of relevant engineering experience in one or more areas such as Product Development, Design and Release, systems engineering, powertrain engineering, transmission engineering, manufacturing engineering, vehicle plant engineering, launch, or product quality. 
 - Demonstrated experience resolving complex technical problems in manufacturing, product launch, or product-development environments. 
 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, product requirements, validation results, test data, and manufacturing data. 
 - Experience with engineering change control, product concern management, production approvals, or supplier deviation processes. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to engineering specialists and senior leaders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority technical issues while maintaining disciplined ownership and action tracking. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with manufacturing employees, engineering specialists, suppliers, cross-functional teams, and leadership. 
 - Ability to work onsite at the transmission manufacturing facility and support launch or production activities outside normal business hours when necessary. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with regional and global teams across time zones. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with or comparable longitudinal automatic transmissions, including transmission systems, mechanical components, controls, calibration, manufacturing, or validation. 
 - Experience launching a new powertrain manufacturing operation, automatic transmission line, or major localized automotive product. 
 - Experience with APQP, PPAP/PSW, DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, production validation, and engineering change management. 
 - Experience working directly with automotive component suppliers during product localization or manufacturing launch. 
 - Experience using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why analysis, Ishikawa/fishbone analysis, or equivalent methods.

 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 15+ year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.description:
Job Description

The Principal Engineer will lead the design and technical development of BMS, GRMS, HAS and SCADA systems within a consultancy setup. The role focuses on producing high-quality designs, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with project standards. This position requires strong design depth, solid communication skills, and the ability to guide teams across multiple project stages. 

Responsibilities

- Lead concept, schematic, and detailed design for BMS, GRMS, HAS and SCADA systems. 
 - Prepare design reports, control philosophies, layouts, schematics, points lists, and equipment schedules. 
 - Coordinate with architects, MEP consultants, and client representatives to ensure smooth design integration. 
 - Review vendor submissions, design proposals, and equipment selections to ensure compliance with specifications. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentoring to design engineers and CAD/BIM teams. 
 - Conduct design reviews, compliance checks, and value engineering exercises. 
 - Support tender documentation, BOQs, and technical specifications. 
 - Participate in client meetings, workshops, and technical presentations. 
 - Ensure designs follow relevant codes, standards, and project requirements. 
 - Assist the site team during design clarifications, RFIs, and commissioning stages when needed. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or related discipline; Master's degree preferred. 
 - At least 10 years of experience in BMS, GRMS, HAS and SCADA design within a consultancy or design-focused role. 
 - Strong understanding of HVAC controls, energy management, room automation, and integration protocols. 
 - Proficiency with major BMS platforms and industry-standard design tools. 
 - Sound knowledge of international codes and standards (ASHRAE, IEC, ISO, etc. ). 
 - Strong documentation and technical writing skills. 
 - Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams in a consultancy environment. 
 - Ability to manage multiple design packages and meet deadlines. 
 - Certifications such as CET, PMP, or LEED are an advantage. 

Key Skills

- BMS/GRMS/HAS/SCADA system design
 - Control philosophies and sequence development
 - System integration and interface design
 - Technical documentation and specifications
 - Tender support and design review
 - Multidisciplinary coordination
 - Client handling and presentation
 - Team mentoring.

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.
