At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

- Maximize collaboration.

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: 

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

data.title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
data.description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB's customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows. 

The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB's top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes. 

This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services. 

You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
 - Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
 - Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
 - Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
 - Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
 - Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
 - Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
 - Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
 - Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
 - Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
 - Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
 - Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

Responsibilities

Technical Delivery

- Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms. 

Marketing Technology Engineering

- Own and enhance capabilities across: 
 - Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
 - Marketing enrichment and data normalization
 - Campaign and campaign member management
 - Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
 - Territory planning and account assignment
 - Activity and engagement management
 - Outreach and business development workflows
 - Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
 - Annual planning and operational planning processes
Integration and System Design

- Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms. 

Data Quality and Governance

- Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data. 

Engineering Excellence

- Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns. 

Platform Optimization

- Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture. 

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
 - Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
 - Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
 - Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
 - Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
 - Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
 - Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
 - Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures

In 3 Months

Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB's marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment. 

In 6 Months

Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations. 

In 12 Months

Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy. 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Job Description

OnSemi is seeking a Senior MTS Analog design Engineer, NEW PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT, Power Management, to join our growing team in Bengaluru, India. This group is responsible for development of Power management products including SiC drivers, MOS/IGBT drivers, LED drivers, smart Switches and efuses for consumer, industrial and automotive applications. In this role, you will focus on the following

- Mentor a diverse team of experienced and junior Analog IC design engineers 
 - Lead an Analog IC design team with product ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing
 - Make assignments for team members, providing design guidance as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project
 - Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the design phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives

 - Define IP test plan and execution working along with product and test engineer.

 - Interface and lead discussions with the customer and/or ONsemi field sales/field applications teams to understand customer designs, problems and support as required
 - Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating personnel to ensure efficient operation of the organization and growth of the individuals into leader
 - Lead, motivate, provide technical mentorship to the team 
 - Collaborate with overseas design and systems teams on technical aspects, IP development, sharing of know-how

Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power the next generation of infrastructure - combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production-ready solutions.

Role: Senior Technical Engineer - LabVantage Master Data

The Senior Technical Engineer will be leading designing, building, and automating analytical test methods and associated data and specifications within LabVantage LIMS, and for developing or coordinating the development of instrument drivers and integrations that enable direct data capture into LIMS from laboratory instruments.

Governance, Validation & Documentation

 - Improved data flow between LabVantage and analytical instruments in secured environment
 - Compliance with global lab data governance and validation standards. 
 - Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data.

 - Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables
 - Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments.

Job Description - Quality Manager

Ingenious Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and results-driven **Quality Manager** to lead quality assurance and quality control operations across its steel fabrication and OEM manufacturing processes. The role involves establishing and implementing quality standards, managing inspection teams, ensuring compliance with customer specifications, and driving continuous improvement to deliver high-quality fabricated steel components and assemblies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage all quality assurance and quality control activities across incoming materials, in-process manufacturing, and final product inspection. 
 - Develop, implement, and monitor quality procedures, inspection plans, and control processes to ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards. 
 - Supervise, train, and guide the quality inspection team to maintain consistent inspection practices and performance. 
 - Review and interpret **mechanical drawings, technical specifications, tolerances, and quality requirements** to ensure product conformity. 
 - Oversee dimensional inspections, weld quality inspections, material verification, and final acceptance of fabricated components and assemblies. 
 - Ensure proper maintenance of inspection reports, test certificates, material traceability records, non-conformance reports, and quality documentation. 
 - Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence. 
 - Coordinate with design, production, planning, procurement, and dispatch teams to resolve quality concerns and ensure timely delivery of conforming products. 
 - Manage customer quality complaints, coordinate inspections and audits, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.

data.description:
About The Role

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to own the hardest technical problems in our product and see them through from first sketch to stable production. You will set technical direction, design systems that scale, and raise the engineering bar through your own work and the people around you. This is a hands-on leadership role: you write code, review designs, and ship. 

What will you do?

You will own outcomes, not just tasks. Expect to spend your time on the following. 

- Own projects end to end. Take an ambiguous problem, shape the requirements, design the solution, break down the work, deliver it to production, and stay accountable for how it runs afterwards. 
 - Lead system design. Author and review architecture for services, data pipelines and integrations, with clear trade-offs on scale, latency, cost, consistency and reliability. 
 - Write and review critical code. Build the hardest components yourself, and set standards for code quality, testing and maintainability through code and design reviews. 
 - Own deployment and operations. Design CI/CD, infrastructure and release strategies. Drive observability, on-call readiness, incident response and post-incident learning. 
 - Solve hard problems. Debug production issues across the stack, and find root causes in performance, concurrency, data and scaling problems. 
 - Mentor and multiply. Coach senior and junior engineers, grow future tech leads, and make the whole team faster and more confident. 
 - Partner across functions. Work with product, design, data and business teams to turn goals into technical plans, and to say no or reshape scope when needed. 
 - Shape technical strategy. Guide build-versus-buy decisions, manage tech debt, evaluate new technologies, and contribute to the engineering roadmap. 
 - Raise the bar. Help define engineering practices, hiring standards and culture, and take part in interviewing. 

What are we looking for?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Core engineering

- 10+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping and running production systems. 
 - Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and complexity, operating systems, networking, databases and concurrency. 
 - Fluency in at least one major backend language (for example Python, Go, Java, or Node. js/ TypeScript) and the ability to pick up others quickly. 
 - Deep knowledge of relational and NoSQL data stores: schema design, indexing, transactions, query tuning and replication. 

System design and problem solving

- Proven ability to design distributed systems that are scalable, fault tolerant and cost aware, and to explain the trade-offs clearly. 
 - Experience with APIs, event-driven and asynchronous architectures, queues, caching and service-to-service communication. 
 - A structured approach to ambiguous problems: break them down, test assumptions, decide with incomplete data, and measure results. 
 - Strong debugging instincts, including performance profiling and production troubleshooting. 

Delivery and operations

- Have led at least two significant projects from inception to production, including planning, milestones, risk management and launch. 
 - Hands-on experience with deployment: CI/CD pipelines, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), a major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), and infrastructure as code. 
 - Practical experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs and incident management. 
 - Habit of writing tests and automation, and of leaving systems more reliable than you found them. 

Leadership and communication

- Experience leading engineers without formal authority, through influence, mentoring and clear technical writing. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication: design docs, RFCs and concise updates to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ownership mindset, sound judgment on priorities, and comfort working in a fast-moving environment. 

Nice to have

- Experience in fintech, lending or another regulated, data-heavy domain. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production: model serving, evaluation, retrieval, and cost and latency management. 
 - Deep experience with data engineering: streaming, batch pipelines, warehouses or search systems. 
 - Security and compliance awareness: authentication, encryption, audit trails, secure SDLC. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, high-throughput systems or zero downtime migrations. 
 - Open-source contributions, conference talks, or technical writing. 
 - Experience scaling an engineering team or helping set up hiring and onboarding practices.

data.title: Staff/ Sr Staff - Analog Mixed-Signal Verification
data.description:
Role Overview

The role involves end-to-end mixed-signal verification of high-current IVR designs, including developing behavioral models, performing analog-digital co-simulation, and verifying digital control loops and key power-performance metrics. The candidate will be responsible for creating testbenches, running PVT and Monte Carlo regressions, debugging transistor- and behavioral-level issues, and developing automation to improve verification efficiency. The role also requires close collaboration with analog, digital, and system teams and support for post-silicon validation. 

What You'll Do

- Develop and execute mixed-signal verification plans for high-current IVR designs. 
 - Build and maintain analog behavioral models (Verilog-A / SystemVerilog real-number modeling) for power stages, integrated inductors, PDN, and analog blocks. 
 - Perform analog-digital co-simulation using industry-standard tools (Cadence Xcelium + Spectre, Synopsys VCS + FineSim / CustomSim, or AMS Designer). 
 - Verify digital control loops
 - Create testbenches for key performance metrics: transient response (load steps), loop stability, efficiency, ripple, over-current / over-voltage protection, and startup/shutdown sequences. 
 - Run regressions across PVT corners, Monte-Carlo analysis, and corner-case scenarios. 
 - Debug mixed-signal issues at both transistor-level and behavioral level. 
 - Collaborate closely with analog designers, digital designers, and system engineers to close verification coverage. 
 - Develop automated verification scripts and improve verification methodology for faster turnaround. 
 - Support post-silicon validation by correlating simulation results with lab measurements. What We're Looking For

- 8 to 15 years of hands-on experience in mixed-signal verification of power management ICs OR analog/mixed-signal SoCs. 
 - Strong proficiency in mixed-signal simulation flows: 
 - Real Number Modeling (RNM) and Verilog-A behavioral modeling
 - Analog-digital co-simulation (AMS, VCS + Spectre, Xcelium)
 - Solid understanding of power converter topologies (buck, multi-phase, 3-level buck, switched-capacitor converters). 
 - Good knowledge of digital control concepts for power converters (PID controllers, DPWM, digital feedback loops). 
 - Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for system-level modeling and testbench reference generation. 
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM for digital/mixed-signal testbenches. 
 - Familiarity with Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, or Synopsys CustomSim for analog simulation. 
 - Understanding of analog non-idealities (quantization effects, loop delay, sensor offsets, PDN resonances, inductor non-linearities). 
 - BSEE / MSEE with 8+ years relevant experience. Nice to Have

- Experience verifying high-frequency IVRs, PoL regulators, or high-current power delivery systems. 
 - Experience with SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Simulink for system-level power electronics validation. 
 - Familiarity with digital PID controller verification and fixed-point arithmetic effects. 
 - Exposure to advanced packaging and on-die inductor modeling. 
 - Scripting skills in Python, Perl, or Tcl for automation. About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in BangaloreMove Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 8-10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.

data.title: BDR Manager
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Most BDR manager jobs are a dead end if you care about marketing. You book meetings, you hit a number, you repeat. 

This one is not that. This team sits inside Demand Generation, not Sales. You own the humans and the plays that turn demand into pipeline, and you work shoulder to shoulder with performance marketing, SEO, and lifecycle on the same funnel. If your goal is to grow into demand gen or growth marketing, this is the fastest seat in the building to do it from. We are specifically hiring someone who wants that path, not someone who wants to manage a dialer forever. 

You run Sprinto's BDR function end to end: the entire inbound engine, and the net-new intent plays we are building from scratch. You own the number across SMB and mid-market, the team that hits it, and the systems (sequences, routing, reporting, AI) that make it repeatable. 

This is a growth role by design. The intent funnel, the AI automation, the campaign-level conversion work, and the reporting are all demand gen muscles. As you prove them, the path opens toward owning a channel (lifecycle, paid, or intent/ABM) or a broader demand gen mandate. 

We will invest in that deliberately: exposure to campaign planning, budget thinking, and the full funnel, not just the BDR slice. If you show up curious about why a campaign converts and not only how many dials it took, you will move fast here. 

Where you'll leave your mark

- Hitting the number. Carry and hit the demo and pipeline number across both the SMB and the mid-market motion. 
 - Make the inbound engine efficient. Move the engine from volume to conversion. Lift conversion rates campaign by campaign and hold the gains, not just for a spike month. 
 - Build a net-new demos engine. Stand up an intent-based funnel that produces demos predictably, turn at least one intent signal into a repeatable documented playbook, and diversify pipeline beyond the top-priority campaigns so growth isn't riding on a couple of plays. 
 - Raise outreach quality. Improve response rates and the quality of the pitch on live calls, not just activity volume. 
 - Put AI to work inside the team. Automate the manual ops (lead assignment, reporting) end to end, build real-time reporting leadership can trust, and extend coverage with AI so inbound doesn't go dark on weekends. 
 - Build the talent engine. Turn the BDR team into a farm system for Associate AEs. The goal: a repeatable pipeline that brings BDRs in and graduates them into AAEs inside 12 months

What You'll Own Day To Day

- Build and lead the team. Recruit, ramp, and train BDRs across inbound and outbound. Run recurring 1: 1s, live call reviews, and feedback that changes what happens on the next call
 - Run the operating rhythm. Weekly reviews against pipeline, activity, qualification, and conversion targets. Scorecards over vibes
 - Forecast honestly. Own pipeline predictability on both volume and value, so leadership can actually plan on your number
 - Own the playbook. SOPs, sequences, scripts, email pitches, and qualification criteria. Build them, keep them sharp, kill what stops working
 - Watch ramp and productivity. Time to productivity for new hires, activity levels, meeting quality, and opportunity conversion. Know where every rep is and why
 - Build the culture. Accountability, recognition, honest feedback, and a career path people can actually see. This is also what feeds the AAE bench
 - Work across functions. With content marketing on webinars, messaging, campaign follow-up, and events. With AEs and Sales on target accounts, outbound execution, and handoff quality. With RevOps on the tooling and the tech stack

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- 3-5+ years in BDR/SDR, with at least 1-2 years managing or leading a team (or a strong senior IC ready to step up) 
 - You have carried and hit a pipeline number, and you can explain exactly how you did it 
 - You think in funnels and conversion rates, not just activity counts 
 - You are genuinely curious about marketing: campaigns, positioning, channels, the whole funnel 
 - You are AI-forward: you have already used AI to make outreach or ops faster, or you are itching to 
 - You write well. Punchy, plain, no fluff. We care about this a lot 
 - Comfortable in HubSpot and modern outbound/sequencing tooling

Nice to have

- Experience selling compliance, security, or developer/infra tooling 
 - Built an outbound motion or intent play from scratch before 
 - Comfort with data: light SQL, spreadsheets, or a BI tool

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

You don't just solve problems; you anticipate the needs of a global healthcare platform years in advance. You will think big to define the standards for reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and security that allow our doctors to provide world-class care without interruption. This is a high-impact technical leadership role where you will innovate boldly, then make things happen, acting as a vital bridge between engineering, product, and business goals. By aligning passion with purpose, you will build a resilient infrastructure that serves as the backbone for modern medicine and consistently creates customer delight. 

Primary Responsibilities

Core Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

- Architectural Strategy & Technical Governance: Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for our global AWS cloud ecosystem. Design high-performance, fault-tolerant, and cost-optimized multi-region topologies capable of scaling elastically to meet massive transaction volumes while enforcing rigorous cloud hygiene (Save time). 
 - Systemic Observability Ecosystems: Institutionalize "Observability as a Culture" across the enterprise. Architect unified, global telemetry standards using Datadog and OpenTelemetry, transforming raw logs, metrics, and distributed traces into actionable, predictive insights that elevate system reliability across all product engineering groups. 
 - Developer Platform Evolution & CI/CD Engineering: Revolutionize the corporate CI/CD philosophy and internal developer platform (IDP) strategy. Engineer systemic, highly automated pipeline improvements using tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, ACK, CUE, and others to eliminate developer friction, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate the release velocity of hundreds of engineers. 
 - Enterprise Kubernetes Stewardship: Serve as the ultimate authority on container orchestration, microservices deployment, and service mesh architectures. Drive high-level initiatives to maximize Kubernetes cluster efficiency, auto-scaling dynamics, secure multi-tenancy, and immutable deployment patterns across the entire organization. 
 - Proactive Infrastructure Security & Compliance: Partner closely with SecOps to architect a zero-trust infrastructure fortress. Embed automated security guardrails and compliance controls into core Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines, ensuring seamless, continuous adherence to strict healthcare regulatory standards, including HIPAA and SOC 2 (Do good). 
 - Enterprise Triage & Resilience Engineering: Act as the premier technical escalation authority for critical, cross-system infrastructure failures. Spearhead complex, multi-layered root-cause analysis, lead deep-dive post-mortems, and champion engineering patterns that turn production incidents into systemic resilience upgrades. 

Technical Leadership & Culture Multiplication

- Engineering Force Multiplier: Act as a strategic force multiplier across the engineering ecosystem. Direct high-impact cross-functional initiatives, define and publish enterprise-wide best practices, influence organizational technology roadmaps, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of technical excellence (Have fun. Do good. ). 

Role Requirements & Qualifications Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with an IT focus. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles. 
 - Engineering Tenure: 13-15+ years of distinguished experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Architecture, or DevOps Platform Engineering, with a definitive track record of scaling high-concurrency, enterprise cloud environments. 
 - AWS Architectural Authority: Deep, authoritative mastery of the AWS ecosystem (including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, and advanced networking features) with proven experience executing massive scalability strategies and sophisticated cloud spend optimization structures. 
 - Advanced Platform Stack: Professional-grade expertise architecting and managing production-scale Kubernetes environments, comprehensive Datadog telemetry architectures, and modular Infrastructure-as-Code platforms utilizing Terraform or Terragrunt at scale. 
 - Strategic Engineering & Tooling: Expert-level software engineering capability in Python, Go, or Bash to construct intelligent automation engines, internal CLI tools, and infrastructure platforms that systematically eliminate operational toil. 
 - Executive-Level Influence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, low-level technical trade-offs into clear strategic visions for executive leadership while remaining capable of conducting a rigorous, line-by-line code and architecture review. 
 - Mission Dedication: A strong desire to apply elite technical expertise toward modernizing healthcare infrastructure, protecting patient data integrity, and solving complex societal-scale challenges. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's in Engineering or MCA. 
 - Industry Credentials: Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, or relevant advanced Specialty certifications (Security, Advanced Networking). 
 - Distributed Systems Expertise: Direct experience managing high-throughput, event-driven streaming architectures (e. g. , Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis) or high-scale data warehouse solutions (e. g. , Amazon Redshift, Snowflake). 
 - Community & Thought Leadership: A history of contributing to foundational open-source cloud-native projects, authoring technical white papers, or speaking at premier industry tech conferences (e. g. , AWS re: Invent, KubeCon). - Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment workflows, and cloud operational frameworks. 
- Lead cloud governance, security, compliance automation, and operational excellence initiatives.

Required Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering. 
- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Strong experience leading architecture, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives.

Technical Expertise

- Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent technologies). 
- Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, platform automation, and DevOps practices. 
- Experience with Containerization Technologies, Kubernetes Orchestration, and Cloud Platform Operations. 
- Strong understanding of Cloud Networking, Security, Compliance, Reliability Engineering, and Governance. 
- Experience implementing automated configuration management and secure cloud deployment frameworks. 
- Experience developing pipeline-driven infrastructure delivery and enterprise cloud automation solutions. 
- Strong understanding of scalability, performance optimization, operational resilience, and security best practices. 
- Experience evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools. 

AI & Emerging Technologies
- Proven experience evaluating and integrating AI/ML capabilities into cloud platforms and engineering operations. 
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI-driven automation concepts. 
- Experience leveraging AI-powered cloud services from AWS, Azure, OpenAI, or equivalent providers. 
- Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve cloud operations, infrastructure management, compliance automation, and engineering productivity. 
- Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices within enterprise environments. 
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate delivery, automation, and platform reliability. 
- Ability to drive technical strategy and architectural decisions related to AI adoption within cloud engineering organizations. 

Professional Skills
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Strong strategic and architectural thinking with a business-outcome mindset. 
- Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority. 
- Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent. 
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of continuous compliance and automated audit evidence generation.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Automation, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Security with the ability to architect and scale AI-enabled cloud platforms, driving innovation while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and business value. data.title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Influence la qualité de son propre travail et du travail des collègues de son équipe. Exécute les tâches opérationnelles/techniques standard généralement soumises à des instructions et à des routines professionnelles. Une certaine latitude est accordée pour réorganiser l'ordre des tâches en fonction de l'évolution des situations professionnelles. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Élargir la connaissance de sa propre discipline technique pour exécuter la politique/stratégie. Peut inclure des rôles de soutien dans des domaines de connaissances techniques spécialisés. Poursuivre son acquisition de connaissances et de compétences de haut niveau. 
 - Compréhension de base des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Bonne compréhension de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Peut disposer d'une certaine autonomie pour prendre des décisions dans un cadre défini. Résout des problèmes dans des situations qui exigent une bonne connaissance technique et un bon discernement et ce, selon les procédures établies. Consulte les membres les plus expérimentés de l'équipe pour les problèmes extérieurs aux instructions et/ou aux paramètres définis. 
 - Un poste de ce niveau nécessite de bonnes relations interpersonnelles et peut être nécessaire pour diriger une équipe junior. Pour les rôles en relation avec le client, développe des relations solides avec le client et sert d'interface entre le client et GE Vernova. Explique les informations techniques à ses collègues. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience de base de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Existing Automation : 

The current invoice processing solution is automated using Power Automate Desktop, Power Automate Cloud Flows, and an AI Document Processing Model. 

Existing Process Flow

- Vendors send invoices through email. 
 - The bot monitors the mailbox and downloads invoice attachments. 
 - Invoices are received from 11 different vendors, each having different invoice formats/templates. 
 - An AI model extracts key invoice details such as: Vendor details, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Purchase Order (PO) Number, Invoice Amount, Line Item Information
 - Extracted data is stored in a SharePoint List for tracking. 
 - The bot reads the extracted data from SharePoint. 
 - Using UI automation, the bot logs into the AX Windows application. 
 - Invoice details are entered into AX and the invoice creation/posting process is completed. 
 - Processing status is updated for monitoring and reporting. 

Business Requirement for D365

The Business Wants To Eliminate The Dependency On: 

- AX Windows application
 - Power Automate Desktop UI automation
 - SharePoint-based intermediate processing and move to a D365 Invoice Capture based solution. 

D365 Task : 

- Vendor invoices are received through configured intake channels such as Email. 
 - D365 Invoice Capture automatically imports and processes incoming invoices. 
 - AI-powered extraction captures invoice header and line-item details. 
 - Extracted data is validated within D365 Invoice Capture. 
 - Purchase Order matching and business rule validations are performed directly in D365. 
 - Validated invoices are automatically created as Vendor Invoices in D365 Finance. 
 - Invoice approval, processing, and posting are managed within D365 without any UI automation. 
 - Users can track and monitor invoice status directly from D365 Finance. 

D365 Skills Required : 

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance

D365 Invoice Capture Setup & Configuration

D365 Finance Integration

Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes du domaine fonctionnel ou de l'organisation et des méthodes de travail affectées. Influe sur la qualité, l'efficacité et l'efficience de sa propre équipe. Contribue significativement à l'élaboration des priorités. Se fonde sur des pratiques et des politiques professionnelles façonnées par le rôle. Le rôle dispose d'une autonomie modérée, nécessitant un haut niveau de discernement opérationnel. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Oversee day-to-day departmental operations, ensuring consistent design practices, adherence to global processes, and delivery of technical solutions that meet project and tender objectives. 
 - Be the owner of all aspects of Control & Protection system deployment, system Configuration, and validation, as well as all usual integration challenges of the control & protection system
 - Understanding of advanced modelling and simulation of HVDC Control & Protection systems, including: 
 - Electromagnetic transient studies (PSCAD, EMTP-RV)
 - Control and protection system modelling (MATLAB/Simulink)
 - Network conversion, modelling, tuning, and verification (PSSE, PSCAD, RSCAD)
 - Full plant/system modelling with end-to-end validation across multiple platforms
 - Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering talent to build a high-performing, resilient organisation. 
 - Identify and implement improvements in engineering tools, processes, systems, and technical solutions to enhance customer value and operational efficiency. 
 - Provide guidance and leadership to specialists, supervisors, and staff while fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. 
 - Demonstrate technical excellence, professionalism, and a strong commitment to safety in all activities. 
 - Execute and provide guidance for the analysis / evaluation of assigned projects that meet business standards, practices and procedures and the product / program requirements. Build strategic partnerships to advance departmental and organisational goals. 
 - Make informed decisions regarding work processes, operational plans, schedules, and priorities to achieve departmental objectives. 
 - Manage engineering resources, workloads, schedules, and project milestones. 
 - Define project work breakdown structures (WBS), required resources, and skill sets to ensure timely delivery. 
 - Uphold and promote Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) principles across teams. 

Required Qualifications

- Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC Control &Protection System Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience in power system and control System Engineering, and Engineering Team Management
 - Exceptional sense of urgency and ability to identify and manage team organizational risks. 
 - Proven skills in managing and leading team with strong technical background. 
 - Experience of multi-discipline system integration projects. 
 - Experienced in leading large teams - Technical & Operational. 
 - Proactively serves on cross functional leadership teams; Makes decisions independently; Pulls in experts when needed. 
 - Electromagnetic transient studies (PSCAD, EMTP-RV)
 - Control and protection system modelling (MATLAB/Simulink)

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Job Title : : Automation Engineer - Salesforce CRM

Role Summary

We are looking for a Salesforce CRM Automation Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable test automation solutions for Salesforce CRM applications. The role will focus on increasing regression coverage, reducing manual testing effort, improving automation reliability, and enabling continuous testing within Client's Agile/DevOps delivery pipelines. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain robust automation for Salesforce CRM. 
 - Automate critical CRM business scenarios including account and contact management, customer/broker interactions, lead/opportunity workflows, activities, and other applicable CRM processes. 
 - Develop automation coverage for Salesforce Lightning UI, business workflows, validations, role-based scenarios, integrations, and APIs. 
 - Analyze existing manual regression suites and identify high-value automation candidates based on business criticality, risk, repeatability, and regression frequency. 
 - Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable Salesforce automation components, libraries, utilities, and test suites. 
 - Enhance existing automation frameworks to improve stability, maintainability, reusability, and execution efficiency. 
 - Implement and maintain Selenium-based Salesforce UI automation or other approved automation technology used by the program. 
 - Automate UI, functional, regression, integration, and API/service-level testing across Salesforce CRM workflows. 
 - Validate integrations between Salesforce CRM and upstream/downstream applications through appropriate API, service, database, and end-to-end automation. 
 - Develop reliable automation for dynamic Salesforce UI components, reusable workflows, data-driven scenarios, and role/profile-based functionality. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster feedback. 
 - Analyze automation failures and differentiate between application defects, automation-script issues, environment problems, integration failures, and test-data issues. 
 - Manage automation test data and dependencies while adhering to applicable masked/synthetic-data requirements. 
 - Maintain automation coding standards, reusable libraries, documentation, execution evidence, and reporting. 
 - Collaborate closely with Salesforce functional SMEs, developers, business analysts, functional testers, and Test Leads to ensure automation covers business-critical CRM regression scenarios. 
 - Participate in automation code reviews and continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, framework stability, and maintainability. 
 - Evaluate approved AI/GenAI-assisted testing accelerators through controlled PoCs where applicable. 
 - Ensure AI-generated tests, automation code, and artifacts receive appropriate human review and validation before adoption. 

Must-Have Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Salesforce CRM testing and test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce CRM business processes and workflows. 
 - Hands-on experience automating Salesforce Lightning UI applications. 
 - Strong experience with Selenium-based UI automation. 
 - Experience handling dynamic Salesforce UI elements, synchronization, reusable components, and complex business workflows. 
 - Strong experience in API/service test automation and integration validation. 
 - Experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise automation frameworks. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills appropriate to the automation framework, such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or equivalent, depending on the program technology stack. 
 - Experience developing reusable automation components, utilities, and data-driven tests. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites with CI/CD and continuous-testing pipelines. 
 - Good understanding of Git/source control, branching, pull requests, and code-review practices. 
 - Experience with test-data management and reusable test component design. 
 - Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and automation failure-triage skills. 
 - Experience working within Agile/DevOps delivery models. 

Good-to-Have

- AI/GenAI-assisted test generation and maintenance
 - SQL/database validation
 - Experience optimizing large enterprise regression suites

 - 10-12 years of relevant experience in the design and delivery of highway and rail bridges, stations, and associated civil and utility structures. 
 - Extensive experience leading design teams and managing multidiscipline infrastructure projects is highly desirable. Minimum 3 years of working experience on Design & Build Projects in USA. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead and oversee the delivery of complex structural design projects for highways, railways, and associated civil or utility works, ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to design teams, reviewing and approving work to ensure quality, constructability, and safety. 
 - Manage all stages of the design process, from concept development and optioneering through detailed engineering to construction support and project close-out. 
 - Take primary responsibility for project planning, resource allocation, scheduling, and delivery against programme timelines, budgets, and health & safety objectives.

Required Specific Competencies:

 - Advanced knowledge of US (AASHTO/ACI) design standards LRFD, DMRB, British and Euro codes along with other international standards and various DOT standards, as well as delivery processes in the ANA (Atlantic North America) region. 
 - Proven track record in the design and delivery of major prestressed and steel composite bridges, including complex and non-standard structures. 
 - Expertise in conceptualizing, designing, and coordinating multidisciplinary infrastructure projects using advanced digital engineering tools and methodologies.

 - Strong project management skills, including resource planning, risk management, and financial oversight. 
 - Excellent communication, negotiation, and client management skills, with the ability to present complex technical information to diverse audiences.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Workspace Search Quality
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software engineering with Information Retrieval (IR), Natural Language Processing (NLP) or Machine Learning (ML). 
 - Experience with launching user-facing, large-scale, production quality systems. 
 - Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing large-scale, high-performance, distributed search or quality systems in production environments. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience with embedding-based retrieval, vector search, query understanding or Large Language Models (LLMs) applied to search/recommendation systems. 
 - Experience mamaging system latency improvements (e. g. , progressive loading, perfecting techniques, or bypassing post-retrieval latency overhead) and scalability enhancements. 
 - Background in defining metrics, analyzing user-perception surveys, and running complex search experiments. 
 - Good understanding of agentic architectures, tool-calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounding layers. 
 - Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability todrive technical alignment with cross-functional stakeholders and navigate competing priorities. 

About The Job

Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

We are building Intuitive, and effective searching and finding experiences by enabling search journeys that bridge across Google Workspace products (e. g. , Gmail, Chat, Drive, etc. ). We have an ambitious roadmap for making Workspace Search excellent, including the usage of advanced Machine Learning (ML) technologies, significant user-facing changes, revamping our evaluation framework and more. 

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products- Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design and implementation of end-to-end search solutions, from understanding natural language queries to developing and deploying machine learning models that significantly improve search quality. 
 - Drive innovation by exploring and integrating machine learning techniques, algorithms, and architectures to enhance search relevance and user experience. 
 - Own the technical goal and roadmap for critical areas of Workspace Search, collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and deliver on a strategic roadmap. 
 - Establish and refine evaluation frameworks and metrics to measure and track progress against key performance-indicators. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Endpoint Agent - Senior Software Engineer

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated-combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Endpoint Software Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents. You will work alongside senior engineers to deliver new capabilities, improve platform reliability, and solve complex device management challenges across multiple operating systems. 

This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, and endpoint security. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, and device management. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Participate in root-cause analysis and resolution of agent-related problems. 
 - Work with Product and Support teams to understand customer enhancement requests and contribute to implementation plans. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, and security. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management and security frameworks. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve supportability. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and sprint planning. 
 - Collaborate with cloud, platform, QA, and support teams. 
 - Continuously learn and expand expertise in system software and endpoint technologies. 

What You Bring

- 5+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, or platform services. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET 
 - Deep understanding of at least one operating system platform (Windows, macOS or Linux) 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals including - Processes, Threads, Filesystems, Networking, Security fundamentals 
 - Good understanding of operating system security features and device management concepts. 
 - Familiarity with one or more MDM ecosystems - Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, Linux management tools

Nice to have

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, or endpoint security products. 
 - Proficiency in one of C, C++, Rust, Go, F# 
 - Knowledge of scripting technologies such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, or AppleScript. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Endpoint Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features from design through production support. 
 - Solves complex customer and platform challenges. 
 - Improves reliability, security, and performance of endpoint agents. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, and Engineering teams. 
 - Learns continuously and stays current with evolving operating system and device management technologies. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

data.title: Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer – Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)
data.description:
Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer - Residential Gateways (prplOS & Wireless)Role

Overview

We are looking for a Lead Embedded Firmware Developer with 12+ years of experience to drive the architectural direction, optimization, and scaling of our next-generation Residential Gateway products. Our software architecture leverages prplOS, making our platform inherently SoC-independent across diverse silicon, including Broadcom and MaxLinear SoCs. 

In this role, you will serve as the technical authority for our embedded firmware and wireless stack. You will own the Linux wireless architecture, scaling our platform to support cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 capabilities, while ensuring carrier-grade stability through deep system-level profiling and optimization using tools like perf and Valgrind. Additionally, you will champion automation by using Python scripting to build robust testing and unit testing framework methodologies that ensure code quality across the entire lifecyle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of resilient, hardware-agnostic gateway firmware, mentoring engineering teams and establishing embedded development best practices. 
 - Test Automation & Scripting: Architect and implement automated testing and unit testing frameworks using Python to validate system components, APIs, and overall firmware reliability. 
 - Performance Profiling & Optimization: Use perf, Valgrind (Memcheck, Massif, Helgrind), and kernel utilities to profile OS memory and CPU management, eliminate memory leaks, resolve race conditions, and minimize CPU bottlenecks. 
 - Wireless Stack & Driver Integration: Design, configure, and optimize Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7 features using hostapd, wpa_supplicant, and iw sub-systems. 
 - Firmware Development: Architect, develop, and maintain high-performance firmware in C and C++ across various gateway hardware platforms. 
 - SoC Abstraction: Leverage prpl APIs to maintain hardware-agnostic implementations across multiple carrier-grade SoCs. 
 - Inter-process Communication (IPC): Develop and maintain scalable services utilizing ubus and/or iMTP to ensure reliable internal bus communication. 
 - Network Stack Management: Design and troubleshoot robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 network stacks to ensure optimal routing, bridging, and packet forwarding. 
 - Service Management & Provisioning: Implement and maintain device management and service models, including TR-181 data models and USP (User Services Platform / TR-369). 
 - Containerization & Lifecycle Management: Configure and manage containerized microservices and virtual execution environments using Docker and prpl LCM (Lifecycle Management). 
 - Version Control: Manage source code, branching strategies, and firmware release pipelines using Git. 

Must-Have Requirements

- Experience: 10+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience in the telecom, networking, or residential gateway industries. 
 - Languages: High proficiency in C and modern C++ programming within resource-constrained embedded systems. 
 - Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Embedded Linux development within OpenWrt or prplOS ecosystems. 
 - Device Management: Deep, production-level expertise with broadband management standards, explicitly TR-181 data models and USP (TR-369). 
 - Containerization: Demonstrated experience deploying, isolating, and configuring containerized microservices using Docker and lifecycle tools like prpl LCM. 
 - Advanced Linux Wireless: Deep knowledge of the Linux Wireless stack, including hostapd, wpa_supplicant, iw, and Linux wireless drivers. 
 - Networking Protocols: Deep understanding of Layer 2/3 networking and core routing/bridging concepts. 
 - Profiling & Debugging: Hands-on experience with Linux profiling and debugging tools, specifically perf and Valgrind. 
 - Version Control: Strong expertise managing source code and branching strategies via Git. 

Good-to-Have Requirements

- Next-Gen Wi-Fi: Experience implementing, configuring, or debugging next-generation wireless features like Wi-Fi 6E and Wi-Fi 7. 
 - Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python for creating automated test scripts, hardware validation, or test execution. 
 - Testing Frameworks: Experience building or maintaining unit testing frameworks (e. g. , CUnit, Unity, PyTest) in an embedded context. 
 - IPC Frameworks: Deep familiarity with OpenWrt ubus and message bus architectures like iMTP. 
 - Hardware Abstraction: Hands-on experience developing abstraction layers on Broadcom or MaxLinear residential gateway SoCs. 

Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Regular

Location: 

Bangalore, India, Hyderabad, India
