data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we're looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team. 

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor. 

Learn more at: https: //www. armor. com

Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our infrastructure team with expertise across Cloud Deployments, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Office 365, Zerto, Rubrik, VMware, and NSX-T. This hands-on, automation-heavy role focuses on system reliability, scalability, and proactive problem prevention. You will be responsible for building and maintaining resilient infrastructure, automating repetitive tasks, monitoring, and improving

performance, and driving incident reduction strategies across hybrid cloud environments. 

This role operates in a hybrid structure with on-site presence four days a week, specifically Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, based in Pune, India. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)

- 
 - Own the design and roadmap for hybrid identity (Entra ID and on-prem AD), including conditional access and secure authentication standards. 
 - Design, deploy, and administer VMware vSphere and NSX-T environments, including capacity planning and secure network topologies. 
 - Define and own the DR strategy for Zerto and Rubrik, ensuring RTO/RPO and compliance requirements are met. 
 - Plan and lead workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure. 
 - Define SLIs/SLOs and design monitoring, alerting, and incident response workflows for production services. 
 - Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules; set IaC standards for the team. 
 - Develop automation frameworks in Python/PowerShell, including self-healing and proactive detection. 
 - Design and maintain CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent). 
 - Own the automated vulnerability patch management program. 
 - Optimize Office 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune) for security and performance. 
 - Lead response and resolution for high-impact incidents; act as on-call escalation point. 
 - Conduct blameless postmortems and drive remediation to closure. 
 - Mentor SRE team members and review scripts, Terraform, and change plans. 
 - Represent infrastructure in security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO). 

Required Skills

- 6-10 years in SRE on Windows-based production environments, including ownership of platform reliability. 
 - Deep expertise in VMware (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, NSX-T), including capacity planning and architecture design. 
 - Expert-level Microsoft Entra ID and on-prem Active Directory: hybrid identity design, conditional access strategy, identity protection, and troubleshooting at scale. 
 - Strong programming/scripting in Python and PowerShell, with the ability to build reusable automation frameworks and self-healing mechanisms. Infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, including module design and DRY principles. 
 - CI/CD and GitOps experience (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent). 
 - Designing and implementing observability: defining SLIs/SLOs and building dashboards and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK. 
 - DR design and ownership with Zerto and Rubrik, including RTO/RPO planning, DR testing, and compliance. 
 - Strong networking knowledge: virtual network topology design, firewalls, load balancing, and DNS. 

Preferred Skills

- Production experience with AWS or Azure, including Secure Landing Zone design. 
 - Experience planning and executing workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure. 
 - Kubernetes and Linux/Unix production experience. 
 - Ansible or similar configuration management tools. 
 - Experience owning vulnerability and patch management programs at scale. 
 - Experience supporting security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO). 
 - Relevant certifications (VCP, AZ-104/AZ-305, SC-300, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or equivalent). 
 - Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical initiatives. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills in complex hybrid environments. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting designs to stakeholders. 

WHY ARMOR

Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role - we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story. 

ARMOR CORE VALUES

- Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges. 
 - Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency + honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances. 
 - Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection. 
 - Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes. 
 - Follow-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.

data.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

- providing the best services for homebuyers
 - led by advantaged underwriting in insurance
 - to protect the whole home

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service ("SaaS") space, we've built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies. 

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED. 

Job Title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, AI

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with the Information Technology team. 

Help us build world class infrastructure in public cloud, mainly GCP and AWS. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer with a strong focus on AI-enabled platforms and automation to design, build, and operate highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure. 

As a Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating highly scalable, secure, and intelligent cloud infrastructure, while maintaining and improving the reliability and performance of our company's technology stack. 

You will work closely with development teams to design scalable and highly reliable software systems, play a critical role in optimizing CI/CD pipelines using AI insights, and leverage automation to improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across cloud environments. 

Your role will involve identifying and resolving complex issues before they impact customers, implementing automation to streamline our operations, and advocating for best practices in reliability, scalability, and maintainability. As a senior member of the team, you will mentor junior engineers, drive technical initiatives, and collaborate across departments to achieve our reliability goals. 

What You Will Do As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Build infrastructure/systems that balance operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization. 
 - Improve the observability of our systems to anticipate and address issues before they become critical, leveraging strategies like infrastructure as code, system operational and health metrics, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Contribute to DevOps roadmaps, helping balance priorities like modernizing past infrastructure, supporting new projects and deployments, and improving/hardening systems where it is needed most. 
 - Integrate AI-powered tools into DevOps workflows for predictive monitoring, anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, and auto-remediation. 
 - Leverage AI/ML insights to optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and infrastructure performance and cost. 
 - Build and maintain self-healing systems using AI-based observability platforms. 
 - Support our initiatives for modernizing/centralizing our cloud footprint in partnership with business, analytics, software, InfoSec, and data science teams. 
 - Design and enforce SDLC, InfoSec, and compliance requirements. 
 - Assist with root cause analysis/remediation for system incidents. 
 - Provide support to the engineering team in basic database operations (SQL Server, MySQL) in running SQL scripts, creating database objects, and troubleshooting performance and connection issues. 
 - Manage, patch, and monitor MySQL and SQL Server databases running in AWS and GCP. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for build, test, and deployment workflows. 
 - Manage repository structure, branch protection, and access controls across the GitHub Organization. 
 - Automate release processes and deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Configure and manage Cloudflare services: DNS, CDN caching rules, Page Rules/Rulesets, Load Balancing, Workers, WAF, and Zero Trust (Access/Tunnel). 
 - Provide 24x7x365 monitoring, incident response, and on-call support as part of the DevOps team. 
 - Perform other IT related duties or projects, as assigned. 

What You Will Bring As A Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software or Systems Engineering preferred, or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Expertise with cloud-based systems and containerized infrastructure (Linux/OS fundamentals, Kubernetes, database systems, cloud networking). 
 - Deep expertise with GCP required, with significant expertise across two or more (GCP and AWS) preferred. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms and integrating AI-powered DevOps tools. 
 - Experience working with and supporting database infrastructure, mainly MySQL and SQL Server databases, in AWS and GCP. 
 - Familiarity with LLM-based systems, vector databases, or AI APIs. 
 - Expertise building common web/internet platform components (e. g. proxies, caches, load balancers, firewalls, app/web server tiers, DB systems). 
 - Unix scripting experience required, and a willingness to learn/support technologies you may not presently know. 
 - Conceptual and practical knowledge of modern DevOps techniques, such as CI/CD, IaC, configuration management, and secrets/vault management. 
 - Expertise in troubleshooting that spans systems, network, and applications in a distributed/microservice environment. 
 - Hands-on experience with Cloudflare. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. 
 - Experience managing GitHub Organizations, repo permissions, and branch protection policies. 
 - Candidates that have worked in IT for a United States based publicly owned company preferred. 
 - Excellent written and communication skills in the English language. 
 - Proven experience working with US based business teams. 
 - Ability to work within core US business hours / time zone expectations - Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap. 
 - Working Hours: 8 Hours (Excluding breaks) 4 Core US Hours Overlap (7: 30pm- 11: 30pm IST) 4 flexible hours (IST) 
 - Workspace: A quiet, dedicated space to work, and a reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps. 

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: ₹24, 75, 000 - ₹34, 65, 000 INR Annually

- Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location. 

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. 

- Our benefits include medical insurance, accident insurance and retiral benefits
 - Our wellness programs include 12 company-paid holidays, 2 flexible holidays, privilege/earned leave, casual/sick leave, paid maternity and paternity leaves, and weekly wellness events. 

What's next?

Submit your application below and our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

Porch is committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. 

Porch is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

data.description:
About This Role

Front End Engineering Manager, Software Engineering - AWT

Your team

BlackRock's Aladdin Wealth Tech (AWT) organization develops technology serving financial advisors and investors. The organization brings together products including Advisor Center, Aladdin Risk for Wealth, and the Separately Managed Account business, working alongside marketing and sales teams to improve the experience of technology products and deepen relationships with financial advisors. 

Your role and impact

As an Engineering Manager in Mumbai, you will combine hands-on software engineering with technical and people leadership. You will lead engineers delivering front-end and full-stack capabilities, contribute to product roadmap milestones, and provide technical direction across design, development, testing, troubleshooting, and ongoing enhancement of enterprise systems. 

The role requires strong engineering judgment, creative problem solving, and the ability to balance technical delivery with leadership, communication, and decision-making. You will help the team build new capabilities, enhance existing systems, strengthen engineering practices, and continue developing technical expertise. 

Your Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: 

- Lead and mentor a team of software engineers delivering front-end and full-stack capabilities, fostering strong engineering practices, learning, and growth. 
 - Partner with product, design, and quality assurance stakeholders to plan the roadmap, manage delivery, and align engineering priorities with product milestones.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

What happens when AI agents can rewrite millions of lines of code orders of magnitude faster than humans can review them? That question drives the Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in Microsoft's CoreAI division. We build AI agents that transform some of the world's largest codebases, including Windows and Azure. Generating code is becoming the easy part; knowing whether to trust it is the real challenge. 

We combine AI agents with static analysis, testing, and formal verification to make large-scale software transformation practical and trustworthy, and we design tools that spend scarce human attention where it matters most. The team began in Microsoft Research and moved to CoreAI in 2025, and we continue to collaborate closely with Microsoft Research, so research depth meets production stakes every day. 

Here are the main problems we are currently working on: 

Migration at scale: We work on migrating hundreds of millions of lines of code, across Windows, Azure, Office, and other products, to work with new versions of dependent packages, new compilers and new platforms. Examples include increasing language-standards conformance of code, remediating CodeQL and other static analysis findings, and retargeting services from x86 to ARM. 

Language modernization: We move legacy C/C++ (and C#) codebases to Rust, with validation gates at every step. Differential testing against the original, held-out tests, and specification extraction with formal verification (such as Verus proofs) mean each migration is backed by evidence, not optimism. 

Specification-driven development: We help brownfield codebases adopt specification-driven development by inferring formal specifications for existing code. The specifications are grounded using execution traces and then used to generate concurrency and fault-tolerance tests, find subtle bugs, and ultimately create a validation guardrail for future AI-driven code changes. We are working with formal tools such as TLA+, F*, Lean and Verus in this work. 

You will be onsite at least three days a week and learn and grow through working with talented colleagues. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of agentic tools and infrastructure for one or more of our problem areas (such as migration at scale, language modernization, or specification-driven development). 
 - Set technical direction for a problem area end to end, from architecture to production adoption. 
 - Architect systems that let a small expert team drive transformations across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Define the validation strategies and quality bars that make agent-produced changes trustworthy at scale. 
 - Lead cross-organizational efforts with partner teams, such as Windows, Azure, compiler, and security teams, and with the research community. 
 - Turn ambiguous, fast-moving problems into roadmaps while staying flexible as models improve. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the engineering bar across the team. 
 - Represent the team externally through talks, papers, and our blog. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related areas and 10+ years of experience. Or a Master's degree with 8+ years of experience. Or a PhD in computer science or related areas with 5+ years of experience. 
 - Experience coding in languages such as C, C++, C#, or Rust. 
 - Experience building developer tools using LLM-based agents. 
 - Experience with compilers and program analysis. 
 - Excellent technical design, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, customer obsession, and a passion for shipping high-quality products. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Rust and C/C++ interop and memory safety. 
 - Experience testing at scale, such as differential testing, property-based testing, or fuzzing. 
 - Experience with formal methods such as TLA+, model checking, F*, Lean, Verus, Dafny, or similar. 
 - Experience working with very large codebases and build systems. 
 - Interest or experience in human-AI interaction and developer experience design. 
 - Experience leading research-to-production transitions. 
 - Track record of leading technical efforts across teams or organizations. 
 - Publications or open-source contributions are a plus. 

Why join us

- Work on the hardest problems in agentic software engineering, at real scale. 
 - Join a small team with outsized leverage, where a handful of experts steer changes across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Blend research and engineering: ideas here ship to tools used by Windows, Azure, and other large teams. 
 - Build on, and contribute back to, the research community around TLA+, F*, Lean, Verus, etc.

Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23, 000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. 

Job Description

Job Summary**

Get To Know Us: 

SS&C GIDS provides information processing and computer software services and products. The Company's operating segments include financial markets, customer management, professional services, and output solutions. SS&C GIDS serves the alternative investments, asset and wealth management, banking and lending, insurance, and real estate industries. 

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Software Engineer to lead the development of full-stack solutions. This role involves guiding a team, architecting robust systems, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software in a fast-paced environment. 

What You Will Get to Do: 

As a Senior Developer, you'll play a key role in contributing to delivery within a collaborative scrum team, providing technical guidance while supporting high-quality outcomes. 

- Contribute to the design and delivery of features, including coding, optimisation, automation, and ensuring alignment with architectural and performance standards 
 - Collaborate with the team to plan, estimate, and deliver work through backlog grooming, sprint execution, and releases to production 
 - Support uplift in development practices, CI/CD automation, and AI capabilities across the team 
 - Foster a positive, collaborative environment to deliver robust, scalable, and pragmatic solutions 
 - Champion strong engineering practices, contribute to managing technical debt, and support the team's technical direction 
 - Take shared responsibility for production health, including deployments, monitoring, and ongoing support of delivered features 
 - Work with the team to identify and resolve technical risks, escalating blockers appropriately 
 - Contribute to mentoring and knowledge sharing to build overall team capability

What You Will Bring: 

- Relevant tertiary qualification/degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) 
 - Software engineering experience of 8+ years as a full stack developer 
 - We use a broad range of tools, languages, and frameworks. We do not expect you to know them all, but experience or exposure to some of the following will help you succeed in this role: 
 - Strong proficiency in frontend development using React and/or Angular with JavaScript/TypeScript 
 - Solid backend development experience with Java (Spring Boot) and/or Node. js, with exposure to RESTful services and Web API design/implementation 
 - Proficient in testing and quality engineering practices, including unit testing, and TDD/BDD approaches 
 - Secure coding practices 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 
 - Understanding of cloud platforms (e. g. AWS, Private Cloud) and modern deployment practices

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Digital Media Company
data.description:
In-Office | Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Location: Basvangudi, Bengaluru

Reports to: CTO

Type: Full-time

Experience: 5 to 8 years

Katapult is a recruitment consultancy that helps brands and agencies hire exceptional talent. This role is with our client company. 

Company: A Leading Digital Media Company

We're an integrated digital-first media and marketing company, specialising in organic media, meme marketing, influencer partnerships, and content-led brand solutions. Operating at the intersection of culture, creators, and communities, we help leading consumer and digital-native brands drive awareness, engagement, and cultural relevance across social platforms. Through a vertically integrated ecosystem of proprietary meme networks, creator collectives, and owned media brands, we deliver scalable, content-first distribution models that combine strategy, storytelling, and organic reach to engineer attention at scale. 

The Role

You will build the products behind our new age content creation platforms and the tech-led businesses we launch next. This is a builder's job. We want someone who can take a feature from idea to production across web, mobile and backend, solve hard problems personally, and raise the bar for the engineers around them. 

What You Will Do

Year one

- Help scale our 2 live social media platforms: users, engagement, reliability, performance and monetisation. 
 - Build and ship core features end to end across backend, web and mobile. 
 - Contribute to launching 1 to 2 new tech-led lines of business from zero. 
 - Use AI and LLM-powered features in our products and internal workflows: content, recommendations, creator and brand matching, analytics and automation. 

Ongoing

- Design and build scalable APIs, services and data pipelines using Python, MongoDB and ClickHouse. 
 - Build fast, polished web experiences with React, Next. js and TypeScript. 
 - Build and ship cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Flutter. 
 - Own the quality of what you ship: architecture, security, performance, cloud costs and uptime. 
 - Stay hands-on with debugging, code reviews and design reviews, and mentor junior engineers. 
 - Use AI tools to move faster and help the team do the same. 
 - Work closely with product, design, content, creator and sales teams across all business verticals. 
 - Help build an engineering culture that is fast, curious and AI-native. 

Experience

What We Are Looking For

- 5 to 8 years in software development, with a strong record of shipping and maintaining production products. 
 - Has built and scaled consumer-facing products, ideally in social media, creator platforms, media, content or high-traffic consumer apps. 
 - Has worked in a fast-growing team and taken ownership of features or systems from start to finish. 

Technical depth

- Strong in Python and TypeScript. 
 - Hands-on with React and Next. js for web. 
 - Experience building mobile apps with React Native and Flutter. 
 - Solid working knowledge of MongoDB, including data modelling and performance tuning. 
 - Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases for high-volume event and analytics data. 
 - Comfortable with cloud-native architectures, APIs and modern stacks. 
 - Practical AI experience: has shipped AI/ML or LLM-powered features and uses AI to speed up engineering. 
 - Experience with scale: high traffic, video and media pipelines, data infrastructure and cost-efficient cloud operations. 

How you work

- A problem solver who gets things done and takes ownership. 
 - Comfortable with ambiguity, speed and shifting priorities in a high-growth company. 
 - Understands social media and internet culture, and cares about what makes content and communities work. 
 - Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to product, design and business teams. 
 - Thrives in a young, ambitious team and brings energy to it. 

Why This Role

- You will work on real scale: a large creator network, owned media properties and two live platforms with a growing user base. 
 - You will build from the ground up, with new businesses to launch alongside the core platforms. 
 - You will work directly with a senior tech leadership team in a company that moves quickly and rewards ownership. 
 - You will grow fast, with room to step into lead and architect roles as the engineering team expands.

data.description:
Location: All EXL Location

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Kafka Tester with strong experience in quality assurance, event-driven systems, and API/message streaming validation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Kafka, JSON, Postman, MongoDB, Oracle, and QA tools such as X-Ray, Jira, and Confluence. This role involves planning, executing, and maintaining comprehensive test strategies to ensure high-quality deliverables across distributed systems and microservices integrations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Participate fully in the software quality assurance process, following organizational procedures and ensuring all software components meet company and client standards. 
 - Review, analyze, and validate software and project documentation for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to standards. 
 - Conduct code inspections, walkthroughs, design reviews, and test readiness reviews to ensure proper implementation and release readiness. 
 - Plan, design, execute, and summarize reliability, functional, integration, and validation test cases for Kafka-based and related systems. 
 - Develop and execute detailed test plans, test scenarios, and test cases, specifically targeting Kafka message streams, JSON payloads, schemas, and transformations. 
 - Interface closely with development teams to discuss test results, raise defects, track resolutions, and provide improvement recommendations. 
 - Assist in internal and external audits, reviews, and compliance activities related to QA processes. 
 - Ensure robust quality control and corporate governance practices throughout project lifecycle. 
 - Provide quality support and guidance to cross-functional teams; contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and tools. 
 - Lead and mentor QA activities within assigned projects/programs. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Strong experience in Test Case Development, Software Testing, Controls Testing, and Quality Assurance. 
 - Proficient in Kafka testing including validation of producers/consumers, topics, partitions, offsets, and message flow. 
 - Strong understanding of JSON message structures, schema validation, and data integrity testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with MongoDB and Oracle for data validation. 
 - Working knowledge of Postman, Git, and related tooling for API and repository management. 
 - Strong experience with Agile methodologies and active participation in Agile ceremonies (scrum, standups, retrospectives, etc. ). 
 - Proficiency with X-Ray, Jira, and Confluence for test management and documentation. 
 - Solid analytical thinking, problem-solving, and usability testing abilities. 
 - Good understanding of Corporate Governance and Quality Support frameworks.

data.description:
Job Description

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution. 

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. 

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. 

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. 

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space - from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. 

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36, 000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17. 4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https: //www. honeywellaerospace. com

Responsibilities

- Good understanding in avionics concepts, domain and processes with an expertise in the field of Verification & Validation of avionics embedded software. 
 - Very good knowledge on C, C++, Python, Embedded programming, Model based Testing. 
 - Experienced in driving common test architecture/environment/strategies, tools, processes. 
 - Expertise in using debuggers, simulators & good knowledge on structural coverage tools like VectorCover, LDRA, TCA, CodeTest and TRACE 32 etc. 
 - Proficient with deep knowledge and understanding of DO 178 B / C and supplements. 
 - Passion to explore opportunities and solutions in test methodologies and test design automation. 
 - Experienced in managing stakeholders within and outside organization demonstrate ability to identify and propose technical improvements using engineering expertise. 
 - Capable of ideating/driving VPD ideas and RDE reduction initiatives. 
 - Knowledge in Communication Navigation Surveillance products. 
 - Experience in Flight Management, Global Navigation technologies will be added advantage. 
 - Experience in Change Impact Analysis (RA, DRAT), Tool Qual, TRR, RFS, Cert Docs, SOI#3 Audits will be considered as plus. 

Skills/Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Engineering (ECE/CS/EEE)

- 5+ years' experience in software development/systems/software verification with minimum 2 years' experience in software verification & validation. 
 - Strong technical skills with emphasis in the areas of software development and verification processes, TSO certification and DO-178B/C design assurance guidelines. 
 - Strong understanding of software verification methods and tools currently in use as well as in industry standards and direction. 
 - Strong technical leadership skills and stake holder management. 
 - The candidate should be highly motivated and have the ability to influence technical decisions. 
 - The candidate shall have effective communication skills. 
 - Mindset to contribute to technical initiatives for continuous growth. 
 - Good understanding of Aero Flight Management products and product line business. 
 - Passion to explore opportunities and solutions. 

Honeywell Aerospace never requests or accepts money from candidates at any stage of the hiring process. Any demand for payment in exchange for employment opportunities is fraudulent and should be reported immediately to local law enforcement authorities

data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
data.description:
Job Description Summary

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d'optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l'identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d'études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. 

Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation. 

Job Description

Rôles et responsabilités

- Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes. 
 - Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. 
 - Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine. 
 - Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions. 
 - Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 

Qualifications De Base

- 
 - Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent). 
 - Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction). 

Caractéristiques souhaitées

- Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées. Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années. Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
data.description:
Description

At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions. 

The Role

As a Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). 

LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification. 

What You Will Do

Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems

- Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions. 
 - Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities. 
 - Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements. 
 - Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues. 
 - Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally. 

Partner with the Business

- Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions. 
 - Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change. 

Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation

- Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies. 
 - Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance. 
 - Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes. 
 - Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization. 

Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations

data.title: Lead Engineer - Controls & Protection
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft. 

Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung. Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird. Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen. 
 - Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen. 
 - Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten. Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt. 
 - Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung. Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen. Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind. Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen. 
 - Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann. Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung). 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.description:
Company

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in. 

Qualcomm has been at the forefront of driving the revolution in the mobile gaming space by providing state of the art powerful GPUs as part of the Snapdragon program. Snapdragon Elite Gaming delivers the full suite of desktop-level features, including volumetric rendering for hyper-realistic visuals. Qualcomm® AdrenoTM GPU is the powerhouse engine behind high-performance graphics and rich user experiences with low power consumption. Our AdrenoTM GPU is designed to quickly render complex geometries for next-level visuals in games and apps-with super-fast responsiveness and superior mobile connectivity for truly immersive experiences. As part of GPU performance and architecture team, the candidate will be working on the latest and greatest in GPU architecture and Computer Graphics. The role revolves around working on analyzing the most popular games and benchmarks which use highly advanced rendering techniques, evaluating their performance on Qualcomm GPUs, define new optimizations/algorithms/configurations for the Adreno GPUs and modeling them to define next generation of AdrenoTM GPU

Responsibilities

- Conduct system level performance analysis and bottleneck analysis for intricate, high-performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Utilize hardware models at various levels of abstraction, including performance models, RTL test benches, emulators, and silicon, to scrutinize and identify performance bottlenecks in the system. 
 - Comprehend key performance use-cases of the product and formulate workloads and test suits focusing on graphics, machine learning, automotive, video, and computer vision applications. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption. 
 - Develop necessary infrastructure, including performance models, testbench components, and performance analysis and visualization tools. 
 - Lead efforts to enhance turnaround time, identify representative data-sets, and facilitate early performance analysis in the product development cycle. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's (BE/BTech) or Master's (MS/MTech) degree in a relevant field; PhD is a plus, or equivalent experience. 
 - Knowledge of Graphics APIs e. g. OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX, Metal
 - A minimum of 12 years of experience in Computer Graphics or a related field with exposure to performance analysis and complex System-on-Chip (SoC) and/or GPU architectures. 
 - Profound understanding of System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture, graphics pipeline, memory subsystem architecture, and Network-on-Chip (NoC)/Interconnect architecture. 
 - Expertise in programming languages (C/C++) and scripting languages (Perl/Python). Exposure to Verilog/System Verilog, SystemC/TLM is highly advantageous. 
 - Strong debugging and analysis skills, including data and statistical analysis, and proficiency in using RTL dumps to debug failures. 
 - Hands-on experience in developing performance simulators and cycle accurate/approximate models for pre-silicon performance analysis is a significant advantage. 

Keywords: 3D graphics; benchmark analysis; gpu; performance modeling; compute architecture, Complier, OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX

Minimum Qualifications

OR

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CPU/SoC Validation Engineer with strong knowledge of ARM Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC) architecture and hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, system-level debugging. The engineer will own validation of interrupt-controller functionality across CPU, firmware, power-management, and OS interactions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for ARM GICv3/GICv4 and CPU interrupt subsystems. 
 - Validate GIC components including: Distributor (GICD)Redistributor (GICR)CPU interface and system registersInterrupt Translation Service (ITS)SGI, PPI, SPI and LPI interrupt flows
 - Validate interrupt routing, prioritization, masking, preemption, affinity, acknowledgement and EOI behavior. 
 - Develop stress scenarios covering: Concurrent interrupt generationHigh interrupt ratesMulti-core interrupt routingSGI broadcast and targeted SGIsInterrupt migration and CPU hotplugInterrupt handling during CPU idle and low-power transitions
 - Validate GIC behavior across CPU power collapse, suspend/resume, reset and DVFS transitions. 
 - Debug complex issues involving lost interrupts, unexpected routing, interrupt latency, stuck interrupts and incorrect GIC state. 
 - Analyze key GIC registers such as GICD, GICR, ICC system registers, ICH virtualization registers and ITS state. 
 - Validate interactions between the GIC and OS/kernel, firmware, hypervisor and power-management software. 
 - Work closely with CPU architecture, firmware, kernel, power-management, design and verification teams to root-cause silicon issues. 
 - Use hardware/software debugging techniques including register dumps, trace, kernel logs, crash dumps and waveform/trace correlation. 
 - Develop automation and stress workloads for interrupt validation and regression testing. 
 - Track validation coverage, defects, risks and closure status through engineering tracking systems. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of ARMv8/ARMv9 architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM GICv3/GICv4 architecture. 
 - Good knowledge of: SGI / PPI / SPI / LPIInterrupt affinity and routingPriority masking and preemptionGroup 0 / Group 1 interruptsSecure and Non-secure interrupt handlingGIC Distributor and RedistributorCPU interface registersITS and MSI-based interruptsVirtual interrupts / vGIC concepts
 - Understanding of CPU power states, clock/power collapse, reset sequences and low-power entry/exit. 
 - Programming/scripting experience with C/C++, Python and shell scripting. 
 - Experience with JTAG/debuggers and SoC debug methodologies is desirable. 

Preferred Experience

- 7 to 16 years of experience in CPU/SoC post-silicon validation or silicon bring-up experience. 
 - Validation of ARM-based multicore SoCs. 
 - Knowledge of virtualization, hypervisors and virtual interrupt handling. 
 - Experience debugging interactions among GIC, CPU low-power states, DVFS and firmware. 
 - Ability to convert architectural requirements into validation scenarios, stress tests and measurable coverage.

Job Description

- Collaborates with Software Engineering teams to support the development, and implementation of features that enhance system resilience, scalability, and performance, ensuring systems can handle varying loads and recover effectively from unexpected disruptions.

data.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise. 

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP. com. 

Senior FullStack Engineer

WPP Open

- Engineering
 - Gurugram

About the job: 

WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. The role is backend-heavy, and you also build the React interfaces for the features you deliver. Our interviews are practical and hands-on. 

Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first. 
 - Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook. 
 - Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care. 
 - Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them. 
 - Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes. 
 - Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server. 
 - Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions. 
 - Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly. 

Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node. js or Python. 
 - 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. 
 - Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions. 
 - Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node. js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth. 
 - React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the

features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services. 

- APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline. 
 - Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons. 
 - Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks. 
 - Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined

as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload. 

- Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and

own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests. 

- Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews

when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production. 

- Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2. 0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline. 
 - Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that

changes do not break the people who depend on your service. 

- Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE. md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents.

data.description:
Job Description- Pre-sales Lead

Overview: Sellability is on an aggressive, market-redefining growth trajectory, with development mandates spanning residential, commercial and mixed-use projects. We're a merit-driven, entrepreneurial team - the kind of place where ambitious, hard-working people get real ownership early, not after they've proven themselves for years. 

At Sellability, you don't just build a job, you build a legacy: fast-tracked career growth, structured mentorship, exposure to marquee developers, and a direct hand in redefining how real estate is sold and marketed in India. Our projects demand year-round market activation and sustained brand salience. As we serve an AOP of INR 5000 Cr+ and growing, Marketing carries a real mandate: project branding, launch and sustenance support, and constant innovation. 

About the role: 

Every sale starts in pre-sales. As Team Lead, you'll run the team that turns enquiries into site visits. That means making sure every lead is called quickly, qualified properly and handed to the closing team ready to convert. You set the pace, coach the callers and own the numbers at the top of the funnel. 

What you will own: 

- Team performance: Lead and coach a team of pre-sales executives against daily and weekly targets for calls, connects, qualified leads and site visits. 
 - Lead management: Make sure every lead, whether from digital, channel partners, events or walk-ins, is contacted within the agreed response time and followed up until it closes out, with the CRM kept accurate. 
 - Funnel conversion: Track the funnel from lead to connect, qualified lead, visit scheduled and visit done. Spot where leads drop off and fix it. 
 - Quality: Build and refresh pitch scripts and objection handling for each project. Run regular call audits and give feedback. 
 - Working with sales: Coordinate with closing managers and site heads on visit scheduling, and feed their visit outcomes back into how the team qualifies leads. 
 - Working with marketing: Share lead-quality insights by source and campaign so spend goes where leads actually convert. 
 - Reporting: Send daily and weekly reports on team performance and funnel health to the cluster head. 
 - Building the team: Hire, onboard and train new pre-sales team members. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 4-6 years in real estate pre-sales or tele-sales, including at least 1-2 years leading a team. 
 - A strong grip on funnel metrics, and comfort working in a CRM and Excel every day. 
 - A coach's mindset: you make callers better, not just busier. 
 - Fluency in English, Hindi and Marathi. 
 - Knowledge of Pune's residential market is a strong plus. 
 - A graduate degree in any discipline. 

Location: Baner, Pune

Note: Its a 6-day WFO role

Why Sellability

- Growth without limits - Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large-scale launches. 
 - Performance with rewards - A merit-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy. 
 - Collaborative culture - Work directly with founder-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute. 
 - Purpose & impact - Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

AI

 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple functions. 

You'll Thrive If You. . . 

- Enjoy enabling engineers to do their best work and grow their careers. 
 - Can successfully navigate ambiguity and drive clarity across teams and stakeholders. 
 - Have experience supporting large-scale, customer-facing products in fast-paced environments. 
 - Are passionate about building inclusive, collaborative engineering cultures. 

What You Can Expect From Us

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

Benefits in India

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- 10-12 years in data engineering/technical delivery roles, with strong recent hands-on experience delivering Azure Databricks-based solutions. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Databricks: Lakehouse/Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows, and cluster/compute optimization. 
 - Strong grounding in modern data estate patterns - data lake and data warehouse architecture (medallion architecture, dimensional modeling). 
 - Experience leading or being a key technical contributor on data migration projects - legacy on-prem or cloud platforms to Azure Databricks. 
 - Solid experience across the broader Azure data ecosystem: Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL. 
 - Strong SQL, data modeling, and performance tuning skills; strong hands-on Spark/PySpark expertise. 
 - Working knowledge of data governance and security practices - Unity Catalog, role-based access, data lineage. 
 - Proven experience leading a delivery team - technical mentoring, code/design reviews, and hands-on problem-solving under project timelines. 
 - Comfortable working directly with project/program managers and client technical teams during delivery. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience specifically on Azure Databricks. 
 - Databricks certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD and DevOps practices for data platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). 
 - Exposure to AI/ML integration on Databricks (MLflow, Databricks Model Serving) or broader GenAI/agentic data use cases.

data.title: Sr. Staff Engineer - C++
data.description:
Senior Staff Engineer - C++

Let's be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth-powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set. 

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We're a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be CertifiedTM by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www. circana. com. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking Senior Staff Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale. 

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. 
 - Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). 
 - Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. 
 - Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). 
 - Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). 
 - In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. 
 - Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
 - Vector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e. g. , HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. 
 - Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. 
 - Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications: 

- Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
 - Modern C++ Expertise: 8+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. 
 - HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. 
 - Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. 
 - Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std: : atomic). 
 - Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e. g. , vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). 
 - Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc. )

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e. g. , ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). 
 - Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. 
 - Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. 
 - Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. 
 - Functional domain awareness - CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

- Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
 - Challenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. 
 - Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. 

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily. 

Circana Behaviors: 

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: 

- Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. 
 - Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. 
 - Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. 
 - Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. 
 - Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. 
 - Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. 
 - Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.
