data.description:
Business Function

Group Technology enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble, and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Technology, we manage most the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Finacle Customization: Design, develop, configure, and maintain Finacle customizations, user hooks, scripts, batch programs, menus, and interfaces in line with approved solution designs and coding standards. 
 - Core Banking Integration: Build and support secure integrations between Finacle and surrounding channels/platforms using APIs, messaging, file-based interfaces, and scheduled/batch processing; ensure reconciliation, error handling, idempotency, and auditability. 
 - Finacle Domain Delivery: Translate banking requirements into technical solutions across relevant product areas such as CASA/Term Deposits, Loans, payments, customer/account services, Wealth Management Services (WMS), and Core Banking integrations. 
 - Finacle Data & Scripting: Develop and optimize Oracle SQL/PLSQL and Unix/Shell scripts used for Finacle enquiries, reports, batch processing, operational utilities, and production diagnostics. 
 - Finacle Release & Environment Support: Support impact assessment, deployment packaging, configuration, regression validation, release implementation, and post-release verification across Finacle environments. 
 - Diagnose functional and technical issues across online and batch flows, analyze logs and database behavior, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes in partnership with operations and product teams
 - Microservices Development: Design, develop, and maintain microservices using Java 17+ (with Java 21 LTS) and Spring Boot 3. 3. x including Spring Cloud 2023. x for microservices patterns. End-to-end integration experience of microservices with frontend systems using RESTful APIs and event-driven architecture
 - Database Management: Develop and maintain databases using MySQL 8. x and Redis 7. x for caching and session management, optimizing for performance, reliability, and implementing database migrations using Liquibase or Flyway
 - API Development: Create and document RESTful APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger specifications for seamless integration with frontend applications and third-party services. Experience with API Gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway or Kong) , GraphQL is a plus
 - Feature Release: Collaborate with product teams and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and implement new features following Domain Driven Design (DDD) principles, ensuring timely and successful releases
 - Bug Fixing: Troubleshoot and resolve bugs in a timely manner using Test Driven Development (TDD) approach, maintaining high standards of code quality and performance through comprehensive unit and integration testing
 - Application Updates: Regularly update applications implementing new features, addressing bugs, enhancing system performance, and following secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10 compliance) with production-quality code
 - Upgrade Management: Manage upgrades of Spring Boot, backend databases, and cloud platform dependencies ensuring compatibility, improved performance, and maintaining zero-trust security architecture
 - Production Support: Work with operations team to monitor and troubleshoot production issues using observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack/Splunk, Jaeger/Zipkin), participate in on-call rotations and conduct post-mortem analysis
 - Deployment Automation: Deploy microservices using CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), containerize applications with Docker, and orchestrate with Kubernetes (deployments, services, ingress, ConfigMaps)
 - Performance Monitoring: Utilize monitoring tools (Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to analyze system performance, implement distributed tracing, and conduct performance testing using JMeter or Gatling based on metrics and feedback
 - Hands on experience on Finacle version 10. x/11. x

Requirements

- Degree in Computing / Computer Science / Engineering preferred BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related subject with strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and system design
 - Should be able to apply Agentic AI approaches towards SDLC phases with AI first mindset
 - 4 to 10 years of years of experience in backend development, including hands-on Finacle customization/integration using Java, SQL and Unix/Shell scripting
 - Hands-on experience in Finacle application development, customization, implementation, upgrade, or production support within a Core Banking environment. 
 - Working knowledge of Finacle architecture and common customization/integration constructs, including user hooks, scripts, batch jobs, interfaces, application configuration, and deployment artefacts. 
 - Banking domain knowledge in at least one area such as CASA/Term Deposits, Loans, payments, customer/account services, or Core Banking integrations. 
 - Experience troubleshooting Finacle online and batch issues through application logs, database analysis, interface monitoring, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Exposure to Finacle deployments on OpenShift/Kubernetes and integration with Spring Boot microservices is preferred. 
 - Proficient in Java 17+ features (records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads) with deep understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, and performance tuning
 - Experience with messaging and event streaming platforms (Apache Kafka 3. x, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS) and event-driven architecture patterns
 - Knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation)
 - Experience with MySQL 8. x or similar relational databases. NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB) knowledge is a plus
 - Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Pivotal/VMware Tanzu)
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, design principles, and Domain Driven Design (DDD)
 - Proficient in unit testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ), integration testing (Testcontainers, Spring Boot Test), and Test Driven Development (TDD)
 - Experience with OAuth 2. 0/OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT token handling, and API security best practices
 - Familiarity with production support, observability tools, troubleshooting, and incident management
 - Strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration abilities, and continuous learning mindset
 - Proficiency in Finacle-related development skills such as Java, Oracle SQL/PLSQL 
 - Unix/Shell scripting, and ADA/Finacle scripting, as applicable to the implementation

data.title: Senior HR Technology Analyst — Automation & AI (m/f/d)
data.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

You will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology - deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions. You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation - using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI. 

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions. 

This role is based in Gurugram or Bangalore (India), with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required. 

About The Role

- Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle - conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions. 
 - Help build, deploy and maintain Claude-based applications and AI-powered internal tools, working with our cloud and technology teams to ensure appropriate authentication (RBAC/ABAC), governance and HRIS-aligned access controls including MCPs, APIs and custom connectors that securely connect AI applications with the wider HR Tech landscape. 
 - Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance. 
 - Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration. 
 - Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology - turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value. 

About You

- 6+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR & Workday domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is a must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred. 
 - Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape. 
 - Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus. 
 - Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems. 
 - Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to build service desks, portals, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services. 
 - Fluency in English. Mandatory Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e. g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus. 
 - Comfort working across European, APAC and US time zones, with a primary collaboration focus on a Berlin-based team. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

- Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
 - Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
 - Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
 - Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1: 1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
 - Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
 - Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. 

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. 

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

data.title: Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Principal HW DFT Engineer who will architect, implement, and validate in-vehicle networking devices as part of NXP's Automotive grade products. You will be responsible for advanced test strategies and implementation, verification and validation of pre/post tapeout of DFT features, overall test coverage improvements, and work closely with RTL and physical team on DFT timing constraints and closures. 

Main Job Tasks And Responsibilities

- Architecture & Strategy: Define and implement advanced DFT strategies, including Scan Architecture, JTAG, Memory BIST (MBIST), and Logic BIST (LBIST)
 - Implementation & Verification: Lead the integration of digital subsystems, perform scan insertion, and generate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns while ensuring high fault coverage. 
 - Silicon Support: Drive post-silicon validation and debug activities to root cause failures and improve manufacturing test efficiency. 
 - Collaboration: Coordinate with physical design and test engineering teams to ensure timing closure and that test patterns are operational immediately upon silicon arrival. 

Minimum Required Qualifications

- Education: B. S. /M. S. Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degrees)
 - Experience: Typically requires 10+ years of industry experience in SoC DFT implementation, verification, static timing closure, test coverage analysis and improvement, and silicon bring-up on ATE
 - Tool Expertise: Proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools from Mentor Graphics/Siemens (Tessent), Cadence, or Synopsys
 - Technical Skills: 
 - DFT - Scan insertion and architecture, ATPG: Proficiency in generating test vectors to detect manufacturing faults like stuck-at, transition, and advanced faults, Built-In Self-Test (BIST): Integration of Memory BIST (MBIST) for embedded SRAM/ROM and Logic BIST (LBIST) for autonomous logic testing, Boundary Scan & JTAG, Test Compression: Implementing techniques to reduce test data volume and application time, which is critical for large System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. 
 - Hardware Design & Implementation - HDL Proficiency: Strong command of Verilog or SystemVerilog for modifying RTL to insert test logic and writing test wrappers. Timing & Constraints: Knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) and creating DFT-specific timing constraints (SDC files) to ensure test logic does not degrade functional performance. 
 - Verification & Debug - Simulation: Conducting gate-level simulations (GLS) and verifying DFT logic for correctness before fabrication. Post-Silicon Debug: Analyzing silicon data from Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to diagnose failures and improve manufacturing yield. 
 - Software & Tool Proficiency - EDA Tool Suites: Mastery of industry-standard tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Mentor Graphics Tessent, and Cadence Modus. Scripting & Automation: Expertise in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate test insertion flows, run simulations, and parse coverage reports.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
data.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to take ownership of reliability, performance, and operational excellence across our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms. You'll lead the response to complex, high-severity incidents, raise the bar on automation and observability, and mentor other engineers as the team scales. 

This is a Rotational Shift role and an onsite position located at Bangalore, India. You will be required to work from the office on a full-time basis. We are only considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. 

Position Details

About The Role

- Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex, high-severity incidents across AWS/GCP infrastructure and EKS/GKE clusters, often serving as incident commander for major incidents. 
 - Design and build Python-based automation frameworks and tooling that eliminate manual toil and improve reliability at scale, not just one-off scripts. 
 - Architect and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, establishing reusable, secure, and scalable patterns across AWS/GCP environments. 
 - Drive observability strategy - design Grafana dashboards and alert frameworks that surface the right signals to the right teams at the right time. 
 - Use SQL and CloudWatch Logs Insights to perform deep root-cause analysis on complex, cross-service incidents. 
 - Own end-to-end ITSM processes - Incident Management and Problem Management - including root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and long-term remediation plans. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level SREs, reviewing their troubleshooting approach, automation, and incident handling. 
 - Partner with engineering, product, and leadership teams to communicate incident impact, risk, and remediation plans clearly and confidently. 
 - Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones. 
 - Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks. 
 - Participate in and provide senior-level escalation support for on-call rotations. 

About You

- You should have 5-8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with a proven track record of owning the reliability and performance of production-critical systems. 
 - You should possess deep hands-on expertise across AWS services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, networking, and related cloud infrastructure technologies. 
 - You should have demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex EKS and GKE environments, including cluster failures, networking issues, autoscaling challenges, performance bottlenecks, and platform upgrades. 
 - You should be highly proficient in Python for developing automation frameworks, operational tooling, and scalable engineering solutions, as well as Terraform for designing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code patterns at scale. 
 - You should have strong experience with ITSM practices, including hands-on ownership of Incident and Problem Management processes, complemented by advanced skills in SQL and AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights for root-cause analysis and operational investigations. 
 - You should be experienced in designing Grafana dashboards and alerting strategies that provide meaningful observability across multiple teams, services, and environments. 
 - You should communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor other engineers, contribute to reliability strategy, and demonstrate ownership, accountability, and composure during high-severity incidents. 
 - You should hold an AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) and a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent Kubernetes certification, along with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Your opportunity

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion every client's goal with passion and integrity. Our people are at the heart of our success - empowered to grow, take bold ideas forward and make a lasting difference for clients and our communities. As we expand into India, we're carrying forward that same spirit of trust, opportunity and belonging that defines the Schwab experience. Joining us means being part of a Fortune 500 company where your ideas can shape the future of investing while you shape your own career. 

Schwab's offices in Hyderabad are a strategic growth engine for the firm - helping us deliver innovation, scale and efficiency across our business. Here, technology and talent come together to build enterprise-grade solutions that support millions of clients every day. It's more than operations - it's a place to create, test, and deliver modern solutions in a fast-paced agile environment. This is a unique opportunity to help build something from the ground up while backed by the strength and stability of a Fortune 500 company. If you're energized by entrepreneurship and excited about shaping culture, talent, and technology in a brand-new environment, this is where you'll make your mark. 

What you have

Overview Of The Role

As a People Leader within the Analytical Data Platform Engineering (ADPE) organization, you will lead and grow two complementary engineering teams within Schwab Data India: the Data Tools team, which builds and maintains full-stack automation tools and applications that streamline data engineering workflows for Schwab's hundreds of ETL developers; and the Control-M team, which designs, develops and supports mainframe and distributed batch scheduling across an enterprise environment that demands highly secure and reliable batch processing. You will be accountable for the people leadership, technical direction, delivery, and operational excellence of both disciplines - partnering closely with Business stakeholders, Data Engineering teams, Production Control, and the U. S. -based Data Tools and Control-M teams. 

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership & Team Development

- Lead, coach and grow two engineering teams - Data Tools (Python/Angular full-stack developers) and Control-M (batch scheduling developers) - providing technical guidance and career development support to each.

 - Foster a collaborative, inclusive, high-performance environment aligned with Schwab's values and OneSchwab/OneGCC culture.

Technical Leadership & Delivery

- Guide the design, development, and delivery of full-stack web applications (Python and Angular/React) that automate and streamline data engineering workflows. 
 - Oversee the design, development, and support of Control-M mainframe and distributed batch scheduling solutions across multiple applications, ensuring highly secure and reliable batch processing. 
 - Participate in and drive architecture discussions and technical solution design across both the application and scheduling stacks. 
 - Ensure engineering excellence through code reviews, unit testing, coding standards, and clear technical documentation, design specs, and solution diagrams. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of sprint and project commitments across both teams, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with Schwab Data standards. 
 - Champion automation everywhere - both in application development and in Control-M batch operations - and drive continuous process improvement.

Operational Excellence

 - Ensure adherence to Schwab's privacy, security, and regulatory standards across all deliverables, applications, and batch schedules. 
 - Drive retrospectives, service reviews, and process automation that produce measurable quality and efficiency gains. 
 - Support CI/CD pipeline maintenance, deployment processes, and environment management.

Preferred Experience

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Builds and maintains partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. data.title: Director, Software Engineer
data.description:
Level: Director

Location: Gurgaon, India

Reports to: VP of Engineering (or designated Japan Technology leader)

About The Role

We are building a new AI-native, product-led engineering organization at Prudential Japan and are looking for Engineering Directors who want to help shape the future of both technology and the insurance business. 

This role is responsible for building and leading high-performing engineering teams that deliver modern digital products, platforms, and business capabilities aligned to Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation initiative. Engineering Directors will lead teams of Full-Stack Engineers, Front-End Engineers, AI Engineers, and other engineering specialists to modernize legacy systems, redesign business workflows, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and business growth. 

This is not a traditional delivery management role. We are looking for hands-on technology leaders who combine engineering excellence, product thinking, AI adoption, and people leadership to help transform Prudential into a more product-driven, data-driven, and insurtech-style organization. 

Key Responsibilities

Japan Technology Transformation & Business Growth

- Lead engineering teams that help accelerate Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation initiative
 - Partner with business, product, design, and technology leaders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy complexity, and improve how the business operates
 - Drive adoption of AI-enabled products and workflows that improve customer experiences, employee productivity, distribution effectiveness, and operational efficiency
 - Contribute directly to business growth by delivering technology capabilities that enable new products, improve customer engagement, accelerate distribution, and reduce operational friction
 - Help establish a modern product engineering culture that moves Prudential toward a more insurtech-style operating model

Product & Engineering Delivery

- Lead one or more product-aligned engineering teams delivering business-critical capabilities, platforms, and customer journeys
 - Provide technical leadership across the product domain, helping teams make sound architecture, design, and engineering decisions. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Design, Architecture, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions
 - Drive delivery of high-quality products and services using modern engineering practices
 - Ensure teams focus on business outcomes, customer value, and operational excellence rather than project milestones alone
 - Support the transition from siloed applications to modern product and workflow-based platforms
 - Foster adoption of reusable services, APIs, shared capabilities, and platform thinking across engineering teams

AI-First Engineering

- Build teams that leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, documentation, and operations
 - Help engineers identify opportunities to embed AI into products, customer journeys, and business workflows
 - Drive practical adoption of AI technologies that improve delivery speed, product quality, productivity, and business outcomes
 - Foster an AI-native mindset where teams challenge existing processes and rethink how technology and work get done
 - Encourage experimentation and continuous learning around AI technologies while maintaining appropriate controls and governance

People Leadership & Talent Development

- Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams of Full-Stack Engineers, Front-End Engineers, AI Engineers, and other engineering specialists
 - Create an environment where engineers can grow their technical expertise, product mindset, and business understanding
 - Develop future technical leaders and engineering managers
 - Foster a culture aligned to Product Engineering's tenets: 
 - AI-First, Human-Led
 - Outcomes Over Projects
 - Standardize Before Customize
 - Builders Own the Outcome
 - Secure by Design
 - Raise the Bar Every Day
 - Promote continuous learning, experimentation, coaching, and engineering excellence

Engineering Excellence

- Establish and reinforce modern software engineering practices
 - Drive adoption of reusable components, APIs, shared platforms, and engineering standards
 - Promote secure-by-design and compliance-by-design development practices
 - Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, maintainable, and supportable in production
 - Balance speed, quality, risk, and long-term sustainability

Delivery & Vendor Leadership

- Lead hybrid engineering teams consisting of internal engineers and strategic vendor partners
 - Ensure vendors operate as integrated members of the product team and deliver against shared outcomes
 - Improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery predictability
 - Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, vendor effectiveness, and engineering practices

Stakeholder Collaboration

- Build strong partnerships across Product Engineering, Product Management, Design, Architecture, Security, Data & AI, and Platform Engineering teams
 - Communicate effectively with business and technology stakeholders across Japan and global teams
 - Manage competing priorities and drive informed trade-off decisions
 - Help bridge business strategy and technology execution

Examples of Key Success Metrics

- Delivery of business outcomes and product roadmap commitments
 - Improvement in customer experience, operational efficiency, and business workflow outcomes
 - Adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices
 - Engineering productivity and delivery lead time
 - Product quality, reliability, and system performance
 - Reduction in technical debt and operational risk
 - Reuse of shared services, APIs, and engineering standards
 - Team engagement, retention, and capability growth
 - Vendor productivity, quality, and effectiveness

Experience

Qualifications and Experience

- Experience leading software engineering teams in an enterprise technology environment
 - Proven track record delivering modern digital products, platforms, or customer-facing solutions
 - Experience working within Agile product delivery models
 - Experience managing distributed teams and collaborating across global organizations
 - Experience working with third-party vendors and hybrid delivery models preferred
 - Experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated industries preferred but not required

Technical Background

- Strong software engineering foundation with experience in one or more modern technology stacks
 - Experience with cloud-native technologies, APIs, microservices, and modern application architectures
 - Experience making architecture, platform, and technical design decisions for complex enterprise systems
 - Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and software engineering best practices
 - Understanding of AI-assisted software development and emerging AI technologies
 - Experience building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise systems
 - Ability to balance immediate business needs with long-term technology strategy and sustainability. 

Capabilities

- Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills
 - Product and outcome-oriented mindset
 - Ability to connect engineering decisions to business outcomes and customer value
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
 - Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-changing, and transformation-oriented environments
 - Passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and engineering excellence

Culture and Leadership Expectations

- Act as One Prudential by collaborating across teams, geographies, and domains
 - Drive Change by challenging legacy ways of working and embracing modern engineering and AI-enabled practices
 - Be Highly Accountable for team outcomes, engineering quality, and customer impact
 - Engage with Candor through open communication and transparent decision-making
 - Demonstrate core values: Worthy of Trust, Customer Focused, Respect for Each Other, and Winning with Integrity

Mission

This role builds the teams, products, and culture that help drive Prudential Japan's Technology Transformation and business growth. Engineering Directors are expected to challenge legacy thinking, embrace AI-native ways of working, and deliver innovative solutions that transform customer experiences, accelerate business growth, and shape the future of technology at Prudential Japan. 

You'll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters; where every day, your work transforms our experiences to make lives better. As you put your skills to use, we'll help you make an even bigger impact with learning experiences that can grow your technical and leadership capabilities. You'll be surprised by what this rock-solid organization has in store for you.

data.title: Product Lifecycle Manager
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This position reports to: 

Global BL Quality & Lifecycle Manager

__

Your Role And Responsibilities

As new industries turn to electrification, it is more vital than ever that we can support ABB's customers with their new challenges and ensure that our Low Voltage System Drives products meet emerging requirements. That is why we are establishing a new role of Product Lifecycle Manager in our Quality & Lifecycle organization. 

In this role, you will ensure that learnings from field performance and reliability testing reach all needed stakeholders for example in product management, R&D and sales. You will also analyze the effects of planned changes or new products on the existing technical offering and customer installed base. The target is to fully leverage accumulated product performance data to support business growth. 

This role is contributing to ABB's Low Voltage System Drives business line in Motion High Power division. You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from division's Product Management, Product Engineering, R&D and Service. 

This is a global role but location is set to be one of these: Finland (Helsinki), China (Beijing), Germany (Mannheim), USA (New Berlin, WI) or India (Bangalore). The work model for the role is: hybrid, 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Initial phase: Developing a new process, related documentation (reports, dashboards) and meeting practices to support efficient product lifecycle decision making and a learning organization
 - Overseeing the process and ensuring execution of related tasks with stakeholders
 - Coordinating and conducting change impact analysis of additions, enhancements or simplifications of the existing product portfolio
 - Facilitating continuous improvements along with the execution of lifecycle changes
 - Managing global projects, involving stakeholders from various functions and local units

Qualifications For The Role

- 10+ years of experience on product engineering, product management, portfolio management, R&D or similar area. 
 - 5+ years experience in leading people with or without line manager authority
 - M. Sc. or B. Sc. degree in electrical /electronics engineering, mechanical engineering or equivalent
 - Experience on process development is a benefit
 - Experience on frequency converters is an asset
 - You enjoy taking on new challenges and working with people across different functions, perspectives, and backgrounds to move ideas forward. 
 - Readiness for international travel, estimated 15% of work time

More About Us
ABB High Power division is the market leader in high-power, high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial process and large infrastructure applications, and a leading supplier of power conversion equipment for renewable energy and other applications. The division offers global support to help customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications. 

If you have questions, please contact Global Business Line Quality & Lifecycle Manager, Johanna Honkanen, at one of these times (according to Finland's time): Oct 29 between 1-3pm, or Nov 2 between 8. 30-9. 30am. 

Interested in joining the crew? Please apply for the position by Nov 8, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application. #ABBCareers #Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https: //www. abb. com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Job Description

Provana is looking for a rare engineering leader. Someone who doesn't just manage software teams, but actively reshapes how software is built. 

As our AI Native Software Engineering Manager, you will be the company's foremost practitioner of agentic AI software development practices compressing entire development cycles and turning ideas into production in days rather than months owning the full engineering lifecycle from idea to production across both internal enterprise transformation and externally-facing product lines. 

You will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers embedded across Provana's business units and product divisions. You will be equally at home architecting a multi-agent workflow that automates legal document processing and pairing with an engineer on a complex PostgreSQL schema migration. Hands-on coding is not optional it is core to how you lead. 

This role sits at the intersection of organizational transformation and product innovation. You will compress the distance between what AI can do and what Provana ships at speed and at scale. 

What You Will Own

INTERNAL ENTERPRISE TRANSFORMATION (Org-Wide) : 

- Lead engineering for AI-driven transformation across Finance, Legal, HR, IT, and Accounts replacing manual workflows with rule bases and/or intelligent, agentic systems that deliver measurable efficiency and productivity gains.

 - Extend Provana's Speech AI and Conversational AI capabilities designing and shipping production-grade voice and language products for contact center, compliance monitoring, and customer interaction domains. 
 - Collaborate with product and domain teams to ship AI features that directly improve client outcomes: reduced denial rates, faster cycle times, improved compliance coverage, and lower cost-to-serve. 

Team Leadership & Engineering Excellence

- Manage, mentor, and grow a team of forward-deployed engineers across product and internal domains defining career paths, conducting code reviews, and setting quality standards. 
 - Act as the primary technical thought leader on AI-native development practices: agentic software development, swarm architectures, context engineering, and spec-driven workflows. 
 - Partner with executive and product leadership to translate business priorities into engineered solutions with clear ROI, defined success metrics, and delivery timelines.

 - Fluency in spec-driven development structured PRDs, versioned specs as source of truth, and context engineering discipline. 
 - Generative AI integration experience: RAG systems, structured generation, agent memory, multi-step reasoning, and output validation. 
 - Proficiency with the BMAD method or equivalent multi-agent orchestration frameworks for structured software delivery. 
 - Strong communication skills ability to write clear technical specifications, architectural decision records, and executive-level summaries. 
 - Strong Azure platform skills including Azure OpenAI, AKS, Azure Functions, and Azure SQL / Cosmos DB. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive engineering culture across cross-functional teams. 

Technical Stack

AI & Agentic : 

- Claude Code - OpenAI Codex - Cursor - BMAD Method - Spec-Driven Dev - Agentic Swarms - RAG - MCP Servers - Context Engineering. 

Cloud (Azure)

- Azure OpenAI - Azure AKS - Azure Functions - Azure DevOps - Azure AI Studio - CI/CD Pipelines - Docker / Kubernetes. 

Data & Backend

Domains

data.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Embedded & Edge AI
data.description:
Description

Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world's most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics AstraTM AI-Native embedded compute, VerosTM wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We're making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play. 

Overview

Synaptics is looking for talented Sr. Staff Software Engineer to join our dynamic and growing organization. You will be responsible for the software development for Synaptics Astra® SL Series of Embedded processors. The Astra® SL Series is a family of highly integrated AI-native Linux SoCs optimized for multi-modal Consumer and Industrial IoT workloads with high-performance hardware accelerators for edge-based inferencing, security, graphics, vision and audio. These processors incorporate multiple high-performance compute engines including a quad-core Arm64 CPU subsystem, multi-TOPS NPU, GPU for AI-acceleration and 3D Graphics, along with multimedia accelerators for Image Signal Processing, 4K video encode and decode, backed by industry-grade security certifications. This position reports to the Director, Software Engineering. 

Responsibilities & Competencies

Job Duties

- Develop device drivers for GPU/Display/Camera as well as the Media/Camera/Graphics framework for our Astra processor series 
 - Development of bare metal drivers for pre and post silicon bring up 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship on various Software lifecycle components including requirements analysis, design, implementation, qualification, and production release 
 - Participate in design reviews, documentation, and process improvements to ensure quality and efficiency 
 - This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of a large team around the world working to create revolutionary products

Competencies

- Solid understanding of software system architecture 
 - Excellent skills in C/C++ programming 
 - Excellent knowledge of Linux system programming and kernel drivers
 - Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment to complete projects on time with minimal guidance
 - Well organized with strong attention to detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
 - Positive attitude and work ethic; unafraid to ask questions and explore new ideas 
 - Resourceful and able to solve complex problems through adaptation of existing technology and investigation of new technology with a solid understanding of product architecture
 - Analytical and able to make informed decisions based on experience 
 - Sets clear expectations and objectives, and brings parties together to drive key initiatives
 - Ability to work within a diverse team and mentor developing team members 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 - Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across engineering teams

Qualifications (Requirements)

- Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in CSE/ECE or related field or equivalent 
 - 12+ years of relevant industry experience 
 - 8+ years of experience working with embedded firmware/hardware 
 - Expertise with systems analysis, profiling, and low-level debugging with ability to interpret and isolate root causes 
 - Experience in trusted software development in Secure OS/TEE 
 - Strong development experience with device drivers, including Display, GPU, Audio, and Camera drivers 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of display, graphics, multimedia, including Display, GPU, MIPI, Audio, and Camera ISP subsystems 
 - Experience with Linux Display, Graphics, Video, and Audio subsystems, including OpenGL, Framebuffer driver, DRM/KMS, V4L2, and ALSA 
 - Proven proficiency with Linux graphics stack (Wayland, EGL, X11, Qt5 / Qt6 and QML) 
 - Experience developing and integrating Media framework (Gstreamer/OpenMax) 
 - No travel required

Belief in Diversity

Synaptics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, or genetic information. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: STAFF QA SW ENGINEER
data.description:
Over 50, 000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress. With double-digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver scalable outcomes than Extreme. 

Inclusion is one of our core values and in our DNA. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that embraces our differences and creates an atmosphere where all our employees thrive because of their differences, not in spite of them. 

Become part of Something big with Extreme! As a global networking leader, learn why there's no better time to join the Extreme team. 

Job Description

What you will do (Job Specific Details on the nature of the job and responsibilities). 

Qualifications And Requirements

- Requires a BS or MS in EE/CS and 8 to 14 years of hands-on experience in functional, system test and automation
 - Excellent technical knowledge on Data Center Network - IP Fabric, VxLAN EVPN, Network Virtualization Framework
 - Excellent technical knowledge on Network Security, and Routing Protocols (OSPF, ISIS BGP, Multicast)
 - Excellent knowledge and hands-on experience in test plan development and validating scalable data center network and network security solutions
 - Experience in planning and building large scaled system test topologies with detailed knowledge of test automation tools and software test tools (Spirent, IXIA) and virtualization platforms such as VMware (vCenter, NSX), OpenStack and Linux OS variants such as Ubuntu, CentOS, KVM
 - Hands-on experience in developing test automation suites using Python
 - Experience in performance, scale and convergence testing and analyzing performance related issues and improving the performance and convergence at system level
 - Ability to develop and publish solution validation document and test reports
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization: Product Management, Technical Marketing, Field Sales, Documentation and Development Team
 - Highly motivated and self-driven. Able to collaborate cross functionally to meet challenging goals. 

Skillset Required

- Excellent knowledge and work experience in most of the following areas: 
 - IEEE 802. 1 (Bridging, VLAN, STP, MAC security, LLDP, AVB)
 - L2/L3 Features (TCP/IP, VRRP, IGMP, IPv4, IPv6, ICMP, ICMPv6, ARP), Basic understanding of IS-IS
 - Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud or Azure is a plus. 
 - Exposure to Docker Containerization, Clustering solutions is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Traffic Generators (Ixia/Spirent) and Network debugging tools (Wireshark, ping, traceroute etc. )

data.title: Propulsion Systems Engineer, Engine Test & Acceptance
data.description:
About Astrobase Space Technologies

Astrobase Space Technologies is an early-stage Bengaluru company building a two-stage orbital launch vehicle. Our engine is a LOX-methane full-flow staged-combustion engine. The Astrobase Propulsion team is looking for experienced and passionate professionals who can own the vehicle's stage fluid and propulsion systems from design to flight. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write engine and component test plans and procedures: proof and leak checks, functional and valve-timing checks, water and LN2 flow tests, and hot-fire runs. 
 - Set test objectives, test matrices, redlines and abort criteria with the cycle and controls engineers; chair test readiness reviews. 
 - Define the test-article configuration, stand interfaces and instrumentation list (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, high-speed channels); verify calibration and channel checkout before each run. 
 - Interface with system specialists and bring engine to test stand; conduct and own test process. 
 - Review data against pre-test predictions after every run; issue quick-look and final test reports. 
 - Lead anomaly investigations to root cause and verified corrective action; disposition test-related nonconformances at MRB. 
 - Assess every engineering change for its effect on completed test and acceptance evidence, and decide what must be repeated. 
 - Write the engine acceptance test specification; maintain as-tested against as-built records and compile the acceptance data package and certificate of conformity for each flight engine. 

DESIRED QUALIFICATION

- B. E. /B. Tech/M. E. /M. Tech in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. 
 - Min. 5+ years in liquid rocket engine or propulsion component testing. 
 - Has written and run test procedures on a cryogenic stand (LOX, LN2, LCH4 or LH2). 
 - Has led an anomaly investigation through to a closed corrective action. 
 - Instrumentation and DAQ: transducer selection, calibration traceability, sample rates and filtering. 
 - Python or MATLAB for test-data reduction. 

Preferred Qualification

- Has accepted and delivered flight propulsion hardware under AS9100D, including AS9102 first-article inspection. 
 - Oxygen-service cleaning and compatibility (ASTM G93, IEST-STD-CC1246, NASA-STD-6001). 
 - Pressure-system safety on test stands (ASME B31. 3, NASA-STD-8719. 17). 
 - Liquid rocket engine qualification and acceptance practice (SMC-S-016; Aerospace TR-RS-2023-00026). 
 - Turbopump-fed or staged-combustion engine test experience. 
 - Stand sequencing and automated redline logic.

Citi's Markets Technology group is seeking an experienced Senior Python and Data Engineer in Pune to join the engineering organization in developing high-throughput Regulatory & Market Manipulation Controls. In this hands-on technical role, you will code, architect, and optimize scalable Python backend services and data pipelines that process massive volumes of financial market data - including trade lifecycles, orders, executions, and risk analytics. Bridging software engineering with capital markets domain expertise, you will serve as a strategic partner to risk managers, trading desks heads and compliance teams, delivering automated control frameworks and leveraging modern innovations - including Generative AI - to enhance operational resilience and ensure regulatory compliance across Citi's global markets footprint. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the hands-on design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency Python backend services and SQL pipelines to ingest and process massive volumes of financial market data. 
 - Translate complex regulatory mandates and market surveillance policies into robust, deterministic control algorithms and automated surveillance engines. 
 - Partner directly with trading desks, risk managers, and compliance stakeholders to model end-to-end trade lifecycles, order workflows, and multi-asset risk analytics. 
 - Conduct application profiling, database tuning, and SQL query optimization to eliminate bottlenecks, minimize latency, and maximize throughput. 
 - Implement Generative AI-assisted solutions and modern automation patterns to eliminate manual operational activities and streamline control testing workflows. 
 - Act as the technical authority for the engineering team, guiding architectural decisions, system design reviews, and modern CI/CD practices using GitHub and Jira. 
 - Champion engineering best practices, conduct rigorous peer code reviews, enforce testing standards, and mentor engineers across the team. 
 - Ensure technical deliverables strictly adhere to Citi engineering policies, enterprise security standards, and global regulatory compliance requirements. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep hands-on expertise building backend applications and data-intensive pipelines in Python. 
 - Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational database design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and database performance profiling. 
 - Strong domain knowledge in Investment Banking and Capital Markets, including comprehensive understanding of trade and transaction lifecycles, order management, execution workflows, and market risk analytics. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership capabilities, including conducting architectural reviews, mentoring engineers, and setting engineering standards. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the skill to resolve complex, ambiguous technical issues and translate business requirements into robust technical specifications. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills, with the ability to partner effectively with both technical teams and non-technical business leaders. 

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

- Prior experience building regulatory reporting or market surveillance platforms (e. g. , MiFID II, CAT, Dodd-Frank, MAR, Best Execution).

 - Exposure to distributed computing or data streaming technologies (e. g. , Apache Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Solace, MQ). 
 - Experience applying Generative AI APIs, prompt engineering, or LLM-driven tooling to automate workflows and extract structured insights from unstructured datasets.

data.title: Head of PBU - Vantage AI
data.description:
About Us

Head of Product Business Unit, Anchanto Vantage AI

Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 10 to 30 people, growing with each bet

About Anchanto

Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company. 

THE UNIT

Anchanto Vantage AI is the data, intelligence and economics business of Anchanto, and the Product Business Unit that builds our new products. Every customer runs their operation on our software, so we hold the most complete operational and financial data they have: orders, inventory, fulfilment events, carrier performance, marketplace performance, settlements and cost to serve, correlated in one place. Vantage AI is built on that asset. It owns the central data layer across every Anchanto product and the products that monetize it: data access for enterprise data and AI teams through MCP, connectors and streaming; operational, business and market insights; Anchanto Settle and Anchanto E-commerce Economics, the financial operations and economics products for e-commerce, starting with marketplace settlement reconciliation and extending to cost to serve, channel contribution and the financial health of the operation; and agentic decisioning for e-commerce and supply chain, where the system sees the stock out, the SLA breach or the margin leak before the customer does and acts or recommends the action. 

A Product Business Unit (PBU) at Anchanto is Product Management and Engineering for one business, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. This unit is different from the other PBUs in one respect: it takes bets. It builds more than one new product, runs each through stage gates, and either spins it out as its own PBU or closes it on evidence. The first bet in build is Anchanto Settle and E-commerce Economics; the data foundation and the agentic products follow. 

THE ROLE

You build a product business from the data Anchanto already holds. You set where each product goes, build it with your own product and engineering team, take it to the first paying customers with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns. This is not a pure product management role and it is not a data platform role: you lead the engineers who build the data layer and the products on it, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is also not a role that protects its bets. You propose them, you fund them against a gate, and you close the ones that fail. 

WHAT YOU OWN: STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, BETS AND RESULTS

- Product strategy. For each product in the unit you know the market, the buyer and the competitors better than anyone in the company, set the strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, and give the CROs your input on pricing, packaging and the entitlement model (included, paid module, download and page level) before anything is built. 
 - The portfolio of bets. You propose which products the unit builds, in what order, with what envelope and against what gate. Each bet moves through the same gates: problem validated with named design partners; first paying customer; ten paying customers; gross margin at scale; then spin out as its own PBU or close. You take the close decision yourself and put it in writing with the evidence. 
 - The data foundation. The central data lake and pipelines from every Anchanto product, the warehouse model, shard discipline, access and entitlement, and the MCP, connector and streaming layer that gives enterprise customers their data back. Nothing above it works without it, so it is built first and kept to an internal SLA for every other unit that consumes it. 
 - Roadmap, decisions and execution. One backlog per bet; what gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security guardrails; release decisions; and whether a product can meet a scope and a date. Customer priorities and asks on live products come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer. 
 - The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering from the first line of code. Two pizza teams per bet, forward deployed engineers with design partners, built on Anchanto Grid and the Vantage data layer rather than on new plumbing. A bet does not get its own infrastructure. 
 - Results and people. The unit's P&L and the spend envelope of each bet; reliability and customer satisfaction for live products; unit structure, hiring, promotions and the final interview of every person joining the unit. Your people are not a bench for other units; a transfer out of the unit is your decision. 

CUSTOMERS, DESIGN PARTNERS AND THE REVENUE TEAMS

This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how each product is sold; the revenue teams own the customer connect and close every deal. A 0 to 1 unit needs discovery, so the rule here is wider than in the other units: you run design partner and discovery conversations with enterprise data teams, finance teams and operations leaders, with the account owner in the room and informed before and after, and you bring the revenue teams the product story, the demos and the answers. You never price, negotiate or close alone, and you never go around the account owner to reach a customer. 

How You Manage Your People

- Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining. Everyone in the unit is full time on the unit; nobody works on Vantage on the side of another job. 
 - Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters. 
 - You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it. 
 - Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. People are confirmed and promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation. 
 - The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review. 
 - You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly, and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep. 

OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS

An escalation on a live product of the unit is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. For the data layer, an outage or a data quality failure felt by another unit's customer is your escalation too. 

How You Are Measured

You own outcomes, not activities. Products without customers cannot be judged on retention and margin yet, so the outputs below are built for a unit that takes bets. You run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance. 

- Gate progress

Each bet against the gate committed in the quarterly plan: design partners signed, first paying customer, ten paying customers, gross margin at scale; bets closed on evidence count as progress, bets kept alive without evidence do not. 

- Time to revenue and ARR per bet

Months from start to first paying customer; ARR, net revenue retention and churn per product once live; deals unblocked or lost on product capability. 

- Data foundation

Products connected to the central data layer, data freshness and quality, enterprise customers on MCP, connector or streaming access, internal SLA met for the other units. 

- Time to market

Weeks from bet approved to a product early adopters can use; weeks from first build to first paying customer; early adopters signed and live with the revenue and account management teams each quarter; planned versus actual on the quarterly plan with variances explained in writing. 

- Reliability and customer satisfaction

Availability, incidents and time to resolve, data quality incidents, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT on live products. 

- AI leverage and AI first approach

Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, and whether every product is designed AI first and agentic rather than as a dashboard. 

- Team EPS and health

Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room. 

PLANNING AND CADENCE

You write the product plan for the unit as a portfolio: which bets, the thesis and the buyer of each, the envelope, the gate and the date it is reviewed. The annual plan each October is a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios. Four weeks before each quarter you write a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly gate review per bet, and a review of the two or three CEO goals for the unit. 

Skills And Prior Experience

Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted. 

- At least fifteen years of industry experience, and at least one product taken personally from zero to paying customers in B2B SaaS, fintech or commerce technology, with accountability for its results. 
 - Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify. 
 - Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school. 
 - Data and AI products. Has built or run a product whose value is data, analytics or AI driven decisions, and can sit with an enterprise data team and a finance team in the same week and be credible with both. 
 - Domain. E-commerce, marketplaces, logistics or supply chain, or the finance and operations functions they serve. 
 - Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome; has closed a product or a project of their own on evidence; has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. 

Career paths we are open to. Nobody arrives with product, technology, data and business skills at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each. 

- Technology or data leader with product skills. CTO, Director of Engineering, Head of Data or equivalent who has built, released and commercialized data or AI systems, and has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs. 
 - Product leader with technology depth. Head of Product for a data, analytics, fintech or commerce product in B2B SaaS, who has led or closely directed engineering and has shipped and commercialized what they defined. 
 - Operations or finance practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer, brand or marketplace. Has run e-commerce finance, settlements, supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale and has specified, bought or built the data and systems behind it well enough to direct a product team. 
 - Consultant or transformation leader. Head of a data, analytics, supply chain or commerce practice who has delivered data platforms, decisioning systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side. 

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a data platform lead with a product manager reporting in, a BI or reporting manager, an innovation lab head who demonstrates but does not sell, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates. 

Benefits Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 
 - Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 
 - International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 
 - Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 
 - Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 
 - Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 
 - Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

Amex GBT is a place where colleagues find inspiration in travel as a force for good and - through their work - can make an impact on our industry. We're here to help our colleagues achieve success and offer an inclusive and collaborative culture where your voice is valued. 

This role focuses on designing and maintaining enterprise Java services within distributed architectures. You'll work across the full development lifecycle-from API design and Spring Boot development to deployment automation and production support-while collaborating with cross-functional teams in AWS and Linux environments. 

What You'll Do

- Build, develop, and maintain Java-based services/APIs (REST/SOAP) and SOA/web services in a distributed, multi-tier architecture, managing XML and JSON data exchanges. 
 - Develop and maintain Spring Boot applications with containerized deployments on Docker, Tomcat, and OpenShift using strong Unix/Linux operational skills. 
 - Support and implement integrations using Kafka and various queuing or messaging approaches. 
 - Work with relational databases (Postgres, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases, including XML data handling, schema design, and query optimization. 
 - Participate in or lead Java migration/upgrade efforts (JDK 8/11 → JDK 17), ensuring compatibility, performance, and security. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation (Maven builds, GitHub workflows, Jenkins jobs, artifact publishing to Nexus). 
 - Integrate with communication platforms including SMS providers (Syniverse/Twilio), email delivery platforms (SparkPost), and security integrations (Proofpoint/DMARC). 
 - Collaborate with multi-functional teams to develop clear user documentation and communicate status, risks, and build decisions. 
 - Fix and support applications across multiple runtime environments and deployment platforms. 
 - Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and architecture standards. 

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of extensive hands-on Java development experience, including JDK 11 and/or JDK 17 (beyond Java 8), with strong object-oriented design and coding skills. 
 - Experience building and integrating APIs and services using REST, SOAP/Web Services, SOA, XML, and JSON data formats. 
 - Advanced XML transformation experience with XSLT programming skills. 
 - 4+ years of experience in Node. js development experience with working knowledge of JavaScript and related technologies. 
 - Knowledge of distributed systems concepts including multi-tier architecture, algorithms, and messaging/queuing patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling (Maven, GitHub, Jenkins, Nexus or equivalent) along with applied Unix/Linux command knowledge for production troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with application servers (Apache Tomcat) and containerization platforms (Docker and OpenShift). 
 - Demonstrated ability to work across multiple databases including relational (Postgres, SQL Server) and NoSQL solutions. 
 - Experience integrating with SMS and email communication platforms, including delivery callbacks, templates, compliance, and security protocols. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with ability to document technical decisions and manage cross-functional projects. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience on JDK migration projects (JDK 8/11 → JDK 17) including compatibility, dependency upgrades, testing, and performance tuning. 
 - Production-level expertise with Kafka (streams, consumer groups, retries/DLQ patterns, schema evolution) and hands-on experience with SMS/email platform integrations (Syniverse, Twilio, SparkPost, Proofpoint/DMARC). 
 - Cloud depth in AWS (networking, IAM, monitoring/logging, scaling, cost awareness) and production OpenShift operations, plus HTML email template design and SMTP workflow expertise.

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to age, sex, gender (and characteristics related to sex and gender), pregnancy (and related medical conditions), race, color, citizenship, religion, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by law. 

Click Here for Additional Disclosures in Accordance with the LA County Fair Chance Ordinance.

Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the hiring process. For details regarding how we protect your data, please consult the Amex GBT Recruitment Privacy Statement.
