data.description:
About Gartner IT: 

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. 

About this role: 

Director, Quality Assurance will directly manage QA team and will provide leadership in the development of test strategies, design, build, review, execution, and automation of test cases. 

What you will do: 

The responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following: 

- Develop and implement a comprehensive, long-term Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering strategy that aligns with the company's goals and growth plans. 
 - Establish and enforce QA best practices, processes, and standards across teams, covering functional, non-functional, performance, and security testing. 
 - Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to assess the effectiveness of QA initiatives, providing actionable insights and reports to senior leadership. 
 - Lead the integration of AI/ML technologies into testing frameworks to optimize outcomes, enhance efficiency, and increase test coverage. 
 - Champion a culture of innovation, encouraging the exploration of new AI/ML techniques and methodologies within the QE teams. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing, cross-functional team of QA engineers, automation specialists

What You Will Need

Strong IT professional with 11-16 years of experience in software testing (websites and/or mobile applications). The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative critical thinking skills along with high on ownership and accountability. 

Must have: 

- 11-16 years of experience in QA, including a minimum of 4 years in a management position. 
 - Hands on exposure to AI driven testing. Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their application in quality engineering, familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms, and experience with data analysis and quality management systems. 
 - Hands on experience in Nightwatch, Playwright, JUnit, TestNG, JMeter, Cucumber, Appium, Postman, and Report Portal
 - Experience implementing and enforcing standards for manual and automated testing. 
 - Experience leading automation scripting and experience in developing/maintaining Test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience in estimation, prioritization, and planning/coordination of QA activities in a Scrum environment
 - Experience leading project teams as well as coaching and developing direct reports and partnering with managers of other teams or domain areas. 

Who You Are

- Graduate/Postgraduate in BE/B tech, ME/MTech or MCA are preferred. 
 - Excellent communication and prioritization skills. 
 - Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast-paced AGILE-SCRUM environment. 
 - Owns success - Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions. 
 - Ardent desire to improve upon their skills in software development, frameworks, and technologies. 

Don't meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles. 

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. 

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. 

Since our founding in 1979, we've grown to 20, 000 associates globally who support over 13, 000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That's why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. 

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities - opportunities that may not even exist right now - for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. 

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. 

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. 

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. 

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you'll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients' AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You'll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. 

It's an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that's reshaping the way we operate. If you're passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that's guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. 

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. 

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive - working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. 

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us. 

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

data.title: Tech Lead
data.description:
Job Description - Technical Lead

Company: MAKO IT

Experience: 3-6 Years

Location: Chennai - Work from Office

Shift: 2: 00 PM - 11: 00 PM IST

Employment Type: Full-Time

Career Path: Technical Lead → Senior Technical Lead → Solution Architect

About The Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Technical Lead to join our SaaS Integration & Solutions team. 

The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in API integrations, backend development, and solution design, along with the ability to lead projects and develop a high-performing engineering team. 

This position offers a clear growth opportunity toward a Solution Architect role, where the individual will progressively take responsibility for designing scalable integration solutions, making architectural decisions, and driving technical excellence. 

A key expectation is to build and develop a team of engineers, including fresh graduates, through structured training, mentorship, technical guidance, and hands-on project exposure. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Integration Development
 - Design, develop, and maintain integrations between enterprise SaaS applications. 
 - Work extensively with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication protocols, and data synchronization. 
 - Develop backend services and custom integration solutions using Python and/or Node. js. 
 - Lead technical discovery, requirement analysis, estimation, development, testing, and deployment. 
 - Troubleshoot complex integration issues and provide sustainable technical solutions. 
 - Maintain high coding standards, conduct code reviews, and implement engineering best practices. 
 - Develop reusable integration components, connectors, and frameworks. 
 - Solution Architecture & Technical Growth
 - Gradually take ownership of end-to-end integration solution architecture. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical designs. 
 - Prepare solution architecture documents, API specifications, integration workflows, and technical diagrams. 
 - Evaluate alternative integration approaches based on scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Identify opportunities to standardize and automate integration development. 
 - Collaborate with senior leadership on architectural decisions and technical improvements. 
 - Develop the technical and business understanding required to progress into a Solution Architect role. 
 - Team Building & Fresher Development
 - Build and develop a capable team of integration engineers. 
 - Actively participate in technical interviews, fresher hiring, and candidate evaluations. 
 - Design structured onboarding and technical training programs for fresh graduates. 
 - Mentor junior engineers in Python, APIs, integration concepts, coding standards, and debugging. 
 - Create practical assignments, learning milestones, and technical assessments. 
 - Gradually transition trained freshers into independent project contributors. 
 - Conduct regular technical reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and performance feedback discussions. 
 - Identify future technical leaders within the team and support their professional growth. 
 - Build a team culture focused on ownership, continuous learning, and technical excellence. 
 - Project Delivery & Ownership
 - Independently manage multiple integration projects from initiation to successful delivery. 
 - Prepare accurate technical estimates, implementation plans, and delivery timelines. 
 - Allocate technical tasks based on team capabilities and project priorities. 
 - Monitor project execution, identify risks, and resolve technical dependencies. 
 - Ensure quality deliverables, appropriate documentation, and timely project closure. 
 - Take complete ownership of technical escalations and issue resolution. 
 - Establish repeatable delivery practices to improve consistency and productivity. 
 - Customer Communication & Solution Consulting
 - Participate in technical discovery sessions and discussions with international customers. 
 - Understand customer business processes and recommend suitable integration solutions. 
 - Conduct solution walkthroughs, technical demonstrations, and implementation discussions. 
 - Communicate technical dependencies, challenges, and project progress proactively. 
 - Collaborate with implementation managers, project managers, and customer success teams. 
 - Build customer confidence through technical expertise, accountability, and effective communication. 

Required Technical Skills

Must-Have

- 5-8 years of software development experience with strong exposure to enterprise SaaS integrations. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or Node. js. 
 - Excellent knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth 2. 0, and authentication mechanisms. 
 - Experience with third-party system integrations, data mapping, and synchronization. 
 - Strong understanding of backend architecture, databases, and integration design patterns. 
 - Experience independently designing and delivering technical solutions. 
 - Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills. 
 - Experience guiding junior engineers or mentoring developers. 
 - Good English communication skills and confidence in customer-facing technical discussions. 
 - Ability to manage multiple parallel technical projects. 

Good-to-Have

- Experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, Make, or similar iPaaS platforms. 
 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, or ServiceNow. 
 - Knowledge of AWS/Azure, Docker, and CI/CD. 
 - Experience developing reusable connectors, SDKs, and integration frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and workflow automation. 
 - Experience designing training programs or mentoring fresh graduates. 
 - Exposure to SaaS implementation, professional services, or customer onboarding projects. 

Leadership Expectations

- Strong hands-on technical contributor with a leadership mindset. 
 - Willingness and ability to recruit, train, and develop freshers. 
 - Ability to build a self-sufficient integration engineering team. 
 - Strong ownership of customer commitments and technical delivery. 
 - Proactive approach to solving problems and improving processes. 
 - Interest in learning system architecture and growing into a Solution Architect position. 
 - Ability to balance coding, mentoring, customer communication, and project responsibilities. 

Growth Opportunities

This role provides a structured progression toward Solution Architect responsibilities. 

Initial Phase - Technical Leadership

- Own integration development and technical project delivery. 
 - Establish development standards and reusable integration practices. 
 - Mentor freshers and develop their technical capabilities. 

Growth Phase - Team & Solution Ownership

- Build a capable team that can independently execute integration projects. 
 - Lead increasingly complex solution designs. 
 - Improve technical estimation, scalability, and integration architecture. 

Future Phase - Solution Architect

- Own end-to-end technical architecture across integration projects. 
 - Define reusable solution patterns, technical standards, and frameworks. 
 - Guide multiple engineering teams on architecture and technical decisions. 
 - Collaborate with business and delivery leadership on complex customer solutions. 

Required Skills

Solution Design Python REST API SaaS Integrations Customer-Facing API Integration Technical Lead Technical Project Delivery

Lead Software Engineer

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. - Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization.

 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 6 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
 - Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, . NET preferred, or similar)

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Member Records
data.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to shape the systems that give Hinge Health care-team members a clear, actionable view of the people they support. Member Records is the care-team-facing context layer within CareHub: it brings together member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indications, device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions so care teams can spend less time navigating fragmented systems and more time delivering personalized care. 

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and adjacent engineering teams. You will turn complex healthcare workflows into reliable, intuitive experiences and lead work from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support. 

This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area end to end, influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team, and raise the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of the systems and engineers around you. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-service Member Records initiatives-from discovery through production-bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Set and advance a multi-quarter technical direction for Member Records in partnership with engineering and product leadership. 
 - Establish durable technical patterns for APIs, domain models, integrations, testing, observability, and secure handling of member data. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through high-quality design and code reviews, pairing, mentoring, hiring participation, and coaching other engineers toward greater technical ownership. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership by defining meaningful health metrics, improving incident response, and addressing root causes rather than symptoms. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree
 - 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software. 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development. 
 - 3+years backend experience with Node. js, service development, API design, and integration patterns. 
 - 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making

Preferred Qualifications

- Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS
 - Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization, 
 - Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices. 
 - Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners. 
 - A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2, 900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth. com. 

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth. com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. Turn production failures into eval cases so quality compounds.

Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

data.title: QAQC (Civil/Mech)

Monitor and control all QA/QC activities at site through stage-wise inspection of construction works. Identify, maintain, and control quality records, checklists, test reports, and as-built documentation. Prepare and maintain the master list of testing and measuring equipment; ensure periodic calibration. Organize and participate in internal, external, and customer audits; coordinate with department heads for closure of observations. Control non-conformance reports (NCRs), implement corrective and preventive actions, and monitor closure. Coordinate with site construction manager on all quality-related issues and conduct regular Management Review Meetings. Chair and coordinate weekly QA/QC meetings with subcontractors QC personnel. Conduct training programs and toolbox talks for subcontractors and labour on quality requirements as per QMS. Coordinate and monitor quality inspections for subcontractors, vendors, and receipt inspections at site. Coordinate and witness Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and third-party inspections as required. Ensure compliance of site activities with applicable codes, standards, contract specifications, and drawings. Review customer specifications and provide technical guidance and training to site QC inspectors. Coordinate approval of QC technical submittals, method statements, and inspection requests with the client/consultant. Ensure timely compilation and completion of QA/QC documentation for final as-built and handover dossiers. Interpret and apply relevant codes and standards in Civil and Mechanical disciplines. Ensure all QA/QC documents at site are current, controlled, and properly distributed to concerned parties.

data.title: Lead Engineer (Quality) – DTC Platform Engineering
data.description:

You will be part of the DTC Platform Engineering organisation responsible for delivering the shared platforms, engineering services, and foundations that enable product teams to build, test, deploy, and operate software securely and reliably at scale.  - Establish and maintain scalable automation frameworks for Web, Mobile, API, Integration, and End-to-End testing.

 - Define quality metrics, automation KPIs, release-readiness criteria, and engineering quality dashboards.

 - Experience validating experimentation platforms, feature flags, and A/B testing programs is a plus.

data.title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for SonicOS, the core operating system powering SonicWall's next-generation firewall products. This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define quality strategy, drive automation and test infrastructure investments, and partner closely with Product Management, Development, Release Engineering, DevOps, and Support teams to ensure every release meets high standards of reliability, security, and customer trust. 

You will be responsible not just for test execution, but for shaping how quality is built into the product lifecycle - from early design reviews and threat modelling to release readiness and post-release learning. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Release Ownership

- Define and continuously improve the QA strategy for SonicOS across major releases, patches, and hotfixes
 - Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and clear release readiness standards
 - Drive risk-based testing and shift-left practices to catch issues early
 - Own go/no-go decisions for releases from a quality standpointFirewall Domain & Technical Leadership

- Provide strong technical leadership across firewall features such as: 
 - Stateful firewall, NAT, VPN (IPSec/SSL), routing, HA
 - Security services like IPS, DPI-SSL, Gateway AV, App Control, Web Filtering
 - Review PRDs, design documents, and architecture proposals with a quality & security mindset
 - Define comprehensive test strategies covering: 
 - Functional correctness and complex E2E customer workflows
 - Performance, scale, and stress (throughput, sessions, DPI impact)
 - HA failover, upgrades/downgrades, config migrations, and long-run stability
 - Champion security and negative testing to validate abuse cases and threat scenariosAutomation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure

- Define the long-term automation vision (UI, API, CLI, E2E) and measurable coverage goals
 - Partner with automation leads to build scalable, reliable frameworks integrated into CI/CD
 - Drive stability and reliability of automated test suites (reduce flakiness, improve signal)
 - Own strategy for testbeds spanning hardware appliances, virtual firewalls, and cloud deployments
 - Work with infra teams to ensure availability, capacity planning, and reliability of test environmentsExecution Excellence & Metrics

- Own and track key quality metrics: defect leakage, escape rate, regression effectiveness, automation ROI, flakiness trends
 - Lead regular release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders
 - Drive deep root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps
 - Convert learnings from field issues into preventive quality improvementsPeople Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

- Build, mentor, and retain a strong leadership bench of QA managers, leads, and senior engineers
 - Set clear expectations, career paths, and technical growth plans for the QA organization
 - Influence engineering leadership and PMs to prioritize quality, reliability, and customer impact
 - Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, and cross-functional reviewsRequired Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of total technical experience, including at least 2+ years in a management or leadership role
 - Strong background in testing firewall / network security products or similar system software
 - Deep understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, NAT, VPN, HA, IPS/DPI concepts, authentication mechanisms)
 - Experience owning quality for complex, large-scale system software releases
 - Proven leadership experience managing and scaling QA teams across geographies
 - Strong exposure to automation strategy and CI/CD-driven quality practices
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholdersGood to Have

- Prior experience with SonicOS or comparable firewall OS platforms
 - Exposure to security compliance programs (FIPS, Common Criteria, SOC2)
 - Experience testing in hybrid environments (hardware + virtual + cloud)
 - Experience handling customer escalations and field issue RCAWhat Success Looks Like

- Predictable, high-quality SonicOS releases with reduced Sev1/Sev2 customer issues
 - Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness
 - Faster feedback cycles for Dev and PM through shift-left and CI/CD integration
 - Strong QA leadership bench and high team engagement
 - Improved customer trust and reduced critical escalations

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.     

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries. 

Applicant Privacy Notice

It is part of F-TECH Utility Services Private Limited, a technology-driven fintech company focused on digital lending and financial services. Through a seamless digital platform, the organization provides fast, convenient, and technology-enabled lending solutions supported by strong credit assessment and customer service. Data-driven decision-making underpins its commitment to transparent, efficient, and customer-centric financial solutions. The Team Leader Overdue Recovery role is based on-site at Wave Silver Tower, 10th Floor, Noida Sector-18. 
Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role located in Noida for a Team Leader Overdue Recovery at Royal Money. The role involves leading and supervising a team responsible for recovery of overdue accounts, ensuring timely follow-up with customers through calls and other communication channels. The team leader will monitor portfolio performance, analyze repayment trends, and implement recovery strategies in line with company policies and regulatory guidelines. Responsibilities include setting daily and weekly targets, coaching team members, resolving escalated customer issues, and maintaining accurate records of interactions and settlements. The role also requires coordinating with internal stakeholders such as operations, credit, and compliance to improve processes and enhance customer experience while achieving recovery goals. 
Qualifications

- Strong leadership and team management skills, including the ability to set targets, provide feedback, and motivate recovery agents. 
 - Experience in collections, overdue recovery, or related credit control functions within financial services or NBFC/fintech environments. 
 - Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle difficult conversations and resolve customer disputes professionally. 
 - Good analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency in using spreadsheets or recovery/CRM systems to track performance and metrics. 
 - Sound understanding of lending processes, basic credit concepts, and regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to collections. 
 - Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to balance recovery objectives and fair, transparent treatment of customers. 
 - Ability to work on-site in Noida, manage time effectively, and adapt to a fast-paced, target-driven environment. 
 - Minimum of a bachelor's degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in a similar supervisory role is preferred.

data.title: Principal AI/ML Architect
data.description:
About Egen: 

Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. 

We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team. 

About the opportunity: 

As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same. 

You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance. 

You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program. 

What you will do: 

- Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements. 
 - Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI. 
 - Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved. 
 - Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls. 
 - Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle. 
 - Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh. 
 - Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning. 
 - Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence. 
 - Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution. 

Your technical toolkit: 

Languages and software engineering

Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership. 

Models and AI ecosystem

Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation. 

Agentic AI engineering

Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design. 

Retrieval and search

Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. 

Cloud infrastructure and AI systems

End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management. 

Frameworks

Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate. 

MLOps and LLMOps

CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response. 

Data and ML foundations

Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes. 

Basic qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 
 - 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale. 
 - Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios. 
 - A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems. 
 - Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions. 
 - Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products. 
 - Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models. 
 - Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector. 
 - Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification. 
 - Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams. 
 - Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations. 
 - Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

data.title: DevOps Engineer IV (Infrastructure)
data.description:
Lead DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

What this Job Entails

This is a hands-on lead role owning the cloud infrastructure and DevOps function for Astreya's product portfolio. The person in this seat is accountable for how our products get built, deployed, secured and run - in our own environments and inside customer environments. 

Google Cloud is the primary platform; Azure is secondary. This is not a role that sets direction and hands the work to someone else: the expectation is that this person writes the Terraform, debugs the cluster, runs the deployment, and then mentors the engineers who will do it next time. They act as the subject matter expert for infrastructure across product, engineering and delivery teams, and as the technical owner in customer conversations about deployment, security and hosting models. 

Scope

- Owns the infrastructure and deployment layer end to end, from CI pipeline to production runtime, across multiple products on independent release cadences
 - Resolves complex problems where the diagnosis requires in-depth evaluation of many interacting variables - networking, identity, cluster behaviour, managed service limits, cost
 - Exercises independent judgment in selecting platform services, patterns and tooling, and is expected to defend those choices technically and commercially
 - Operates as a player-coach: a small team reports to this role, and the role remains individually productive

Your Roles and Responsibilities

Cloud infrastructure (primary)

- Design, build and operate our GCP footprint: GKE, Artifact Registry, Cloud SQL (Postgres), Cloud Storage, Memorystore (Redis), Vertex AI, Cloud Monitoring/Logging, Cloud DNS
 - Own network and perimeter design: VPC architecture, Private Service Connect, Cloud NAT, Cloud Armor, private connectivity to customer systems
 - Own secrets, keys and identity: Secret Manager, Workload Identity, IAM design and least-privilege service accounts, KMS, certificate lifecycle
 - Run R&D on platform services we haven't used yet - evaluate the GCP service, identify the Azure and AWS equivalents, and produce a recommendation with a working proof of concept, not a slide
 - Manage cloud cost: attribution by product and environment, budget alerts, rightsizing, commitment planning

Deployment into environments (a core reason this role exists)

- Make deploying our products into a new environment a repeatable, documented, low-drama exercise - both customer-VPC and Astreya-hosted models
 - Own the deployment artefacts: Helm charts, namespace and pod topology, environment configuration, migration and rollback paths
 - Work directly with customer infrastructure and security teams during onboarding - answer their architecture and security questions, adapt to their constraints, and get us to production
 - Produce and maintain the evidence infrastructure security reviews and audits ask for: architecture diagrams, data flow, access controls, encryption posture, audit logging, retention

DevOps and platform engineering

- Own CI/CD across products: build pipelines, artefact promotion, environment strategy, source control branching strategies across multiple release cadences
 - Write automation and internal tooling for provisioning and operating infrastructure - infrastructure as code (Terraform) as the default, scripts and services where it isn't
 - Build the observability layer: metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards and SLOs that let us find problems before customers do
 - Improve scalability, reliability, capacity and performance of the platform, including the infrastructure serving AI/LLM workloads
 - Harden the platform: image scanning, dependency and vulnerability management, network policy, secrets hygiene, patching

Leadership and process

- Lead and mentor DevOps and infrastructure engineers; set standards and review their work
 - Work with product owners and engineering leads to understand requirements, surface infrastructure bottlenecks early, and propose resolutions
 - Own incident response for platform issues and produce root cause analyses for outages that are honest about cause and specific about prevention
 - Design and implement improvements to existing support processes and tooling; introduce innovations and follow through on execution, not just proposal
 - Document decisions, runbooks and resolution history so the next person doesn't rediscover them
 - Other duties as required. This list is not a comprehensive inventory of all responsibilities assigned to this position

Required Qualifications/Skills

- Bachelor's degree (B. S/B. A) from a four-year college or university and 8+ years' related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 - Deep, hands-on Google Cloud experience - has designed and run production workloads on GCP, not just passed a certification
 - Strong Kubernetes experience in production: GKE preferred, including networking, ingress, autoscaling, resource management and debugging failures under load
 - Infrastructure as code at a professional standard - Terraform, module design, state management, review discipline
 - Strong scripting and coding ability (Python, Go, Bash or equivalent) and enough software development experience to work inside application repositories, not just around them
 - Practical cloud networking and security depth: VPC design, private connectivity, IAM, secrets management, TLS
 - CI/CD ownership across multiple products and release trains, with source control branching strategies
 - Monitoring, alerting and incident management experience, including writing the RCA afterwards
 - Experience with open-source tooling in large distributed systems
 - Good communication skills - can hold a technical conversation with a customer's security team and a working conversation with a developer on the same day
 - Ability to pick up unfamiliar technology quickly and carry several threads at once

Preferred Qualifications

- Working Azure knowledge (AKS, Key Vault, Entra ID, VNet) and the ability to translate a GCP design onto it; AWS exposure a bonus
 - Experience deploying a product into customer-controlled cloud environments as a vendor
 - Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production - Vertex AI, model endpoints, GPU scheduling, inference cost control
 - Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001 or comparable audits from the infrastructure side
 - Experience integrating with enterprise ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) and the connectivity that requires
 - Prior experience as a first or early infrastructure hire on a product team
 - Relevant certification (Google Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA)

Physical Demand & Work Environment

- Must have the ability to perform office-related tasks which may include prolonged sitting or standing
 - Must have the ability to move from place to place within an office environment
 - Must be able to use a computer
 - Must have the ability to communicate effectively
 - Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers

- Plan, coordinate, and manage customer visits and client audits, ensuring readiness of facilities, documentation, inspection activities, and relevant departments, while facilitating timely closure of observations and audit findings.

- Identify process or product deviations, raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and halt non-compliant processes immediately.

Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. data.description:
PeopleSoft Developer

About The Role

#JLLTechAmbitions

JLL, an international real estate management company, is looking for PeopleSoft Developers to join our JLL Technology Engineering organization. You will work on mission-critical financial systems, combining hands-on PeopleSoft development with analysis of business needs, root-cause work on production issues, and delivery of enhancements through the full change lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, changing environment, enjoys solving business problems through creative thinking, and brings a "Get it done" attitude with a "Think ahead" mentality. You should be comfortable working independently and with a distributed team, and able to lead by example. 

Responsibilities

- Develop and enhance: design, code, and unit test customizations and enhancements to JLL's PeopleSoft Financials modules using PeopleCode, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, SQR, and SQL. 
 - Resolve production issues: analyze incidents and batch failures, determine root cause, deliver fixes, and move solutions through the change lifecycle. Document recurring failures as SOPs and known-error articles. 
 - Translate requirements: work with finance users and functional analysts to turn business needs into functional and technical specifications, and articulate requirements in enough detail for thorough testing. 
 - Build and support integrations: develop and maintain interfaces with upstream and downstream systems using Integration Broker, file layouts, and Component Interfaces, and monitor interface and batch process flows. 
 - Reporting: build and maintain BI Publisher reports, PS Queries, and SQRs for finance, audit, and operational needs. 
 - Upgrades and infrastructure: take part in PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) and PeopleTools upgrades, including keep/drop analysis, compare-report review, and retrofit of customizations, and support PeopleSoft environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). 
 - Testing and quality: prepare test cases, run unit and system integration testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and track defects to closure. 
 - Improve and optimize: identify performance improvements and automation opportunities, evaluate user interface enhancements, and drive change that reduces manual effort. 
 - Document and enable: maintain technical documentation, training material, and job aids, and consult with the business on correct use and interpretation of PeopleSoft functionality. 
 - Collaborate and mentor: participate in global and regional enhancement and implementation projects, and share knowledge with and guide junior team members. 

Experience & Education

- At least 5 years of IT experience, with 8+ years of hands-on PeopleSoft development preferred. A computer science or related engineering degree is preferred. 
 - Proven experience supporting and enhancing PeopleSoft Financials (FSCM 9. 2) in a production environment. 
 - Experience with PeopleSoft upgrades (PUM image and PeopleTools), including object compare and retrofit. 
 - Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to resolve issues under SLA pressure. 
 - Experience with API testing and familiarity with HTTP, REST, and JSON protocols. 
 - Reliable, self-motivated, and self-disciplined, able to plan and run multiple tasks at once. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication, and strong analytical and organizational skills. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

- PeopleSoft development (required): PeopleCode, Application Designer, Application Engine, Application Packages, Component Interfaces, File Layouts, Data Mover, Approval Workflow Engine (AWE), and PS Query, on PeopleTools 8. 5x and later. 
 - Reporting (required): BI/XML Publisher and SQR. 
 - Integrations (required): PeopleSoft Integration Broker, plus experience with file-based and web-service interfaces. 
 - Database (required): Strong Oracle SQL; ability to write, tune, and troubleshoot SQL scripts. 
 - Financial modules: hands-on experience in several of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Billing, Contracts, Purchasing/Requisitions, Asset Management, Project Costing, and Travel & Expenses. Exposure to a multi-currency, multi-book instance is a plus, including document sequencing, VAT, sales and use tax processing, payment predictor, and bank interfaces. 
 - SDLC and tooling: full software development lifecycle (analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment), Agile delivery, and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow and Jira. 
 - Basic knowledge of financial accounting. 

Preferred (Nice To Have)

- PeopleSoft Fluid user interface development. 
 - Experience with PeopleSoft on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or a cloud migration. 
 - PeopleSoft Test Framework or other test automation tools. 
 - UNIX shell scripting and job scheduling tools (for example Autosys). 
 - PeopleSoft security administration (user profiles, roles, workflow setup). 
 - Integration experience with external platforms such as Workday or ServiceNow. 
 - Oracle PeopleSoft or Oracle Cloud certifications.

Lead Verification & Validation Engineer will be responsible for the delivery of the of HVDC Controls & Protection Verification and Validation team's activities on time / as per Project Scheduled through proper coordination between Project and department.  - Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.

-

data.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2, 800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. 

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. 

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. 

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. 

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. 

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. 

Role Details

📍 Job location: Bangalore (On-site)

🕒 Contract type: Permanent

🗓 Target start date: January 2027

⏰ Working hours: Full-time (40h/week), aligned with the GMT timezone (starting at 1: 00 PM IST)

💵 Compensation: INR 10, 00, 000 - 22, 00, 000 per year

📋 What You'll Architect

As a Business Acceptance Analyst / Digital Solution Validation, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making. 

This role is both analytical and consultative, ideal for someone who can bridge business requirements and delivered digital solutions while ensuring production readiness. We are looking for professionals who can connect business needs with technology delivery, ensuring that solutions meet expectations before moving into production. Professionals who think like architects and act like builders. 

You will support a global team responsible for the processes, tools, and data governance associated with customer installed-base management, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and digital delivery teams. 

Responsibilities

 - Excellent documentation and communication skills. 
 - Experience with requirements traceability and acceptance management processes. 
 - Experience supporting production-readiness assessments and go-live decisions.

Nice to Have

 - Experience in consulting or client-facing projects.

⭐ What Makes You Successful

- You focus on outcomes rather than activity.

 - You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and finding practical solutions. 
 - You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.

🎁 What We Offer at Keyrus India

 - Competitive fixed salary with EPF & statutory benefits

💰 How Our Salary Ranges Work

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role - not different job titles.

About The Role

 - Develop and oversee process validation protocols, capability studies and production qualification activities to demonstrate sustained compliance and performance.

Experience

data.title: Full-Stack Tech Lead – AI Best Practices - Remote
data.description:
Company Description

McFadyen Digital is the leading advisor and implementer of eCommerce Marketplace solutions. During 15 years of implementing marketplaces, we've built dozens of platforms that cumulatively generate billions of dollars of gross merchandise value (GMV). We're honored to have supported 10% of the Fortune 500 with their digital marketplace initiatives. Over 250 global brands like ABB, AB InBev, ACCO, Albertsons, American Red Cross, American Eagle Outfitters, US Army, US Agriculture Dept, (and many more) have entrusted their digital transformations to McFadyen. We operate global offices across the US, Brazil, and India. McFadyen Digital has been a trusted employer for 35 years and believes that people are the most important part of our company. We're proud of our Great Place to Work certification. 

Learn more about us at our website: www. mcfadyen. com

About AI Best Practices (AIBP)

AI Best Practices (ai-best-practices. com) is a knowledge platform and toolset that helps enterprises benchmark and improve how they apply AI across their value chains. It pairs a content-rich Wiki - covering use cases, AI tools, ROI frameworks, and industry categorization - with Librarian, an AI-driven backend that curates, scores, and surfaces that content. The platform serves C-suite and VP-level decision-makers evaluating AI maturity, tooling, and vendor fit across industries. 

AIBP is a product line built and operated by McFadyen Digital. This role owns the full-stack engineering of the AIBP web application portfolio (Wiki, Librarian, and the surrounding product surface) end-to-end - including how work is planned, ticketed, sequenced, and released. 

Job Description

Do you want to own architecture, delivery, and release for a fast-moving AI-native product line - not just write code for one? Can you turn a rough roadmap into a sequence of self-contained, agent-ready Linear tickets without anyone needing to ask a follow-up question? Have you made Claude Code and Claude. ai your daily driver for coding, planning, and ticket-writing, and built your own skills, hooks, or MCP integrations on top of them? Can you judge in seconds when AI-generated code needs a second look - especially around auth, access control, or anything destructive? Do you thrive in fast, ambiguous, unscoped delivery rather than traditional phased client work? If you answered yes, then we want to talk to you!

We need a full-stack tech lead to own fast-moving AI-native products end-to-end - and to be the person who turns roadmap into shipped software through well-run Linear tickets, realistic timelines, and clean releases. We build with AI as a first-class part of the workflow: Claude (Claude Code and Claude. ai) is our daily driver for coding, ticket drafting, planning, and status reporting, alongside agentic coding tools, custom skills/hooks/MCP servers, and spec-driven plan/execute/verify loops. You'll work the same way - full-time, hands-on daily, owning architecture, planning, and delivery, and mentoring/reviewing other engineers. 

Responsibilities

Top 5 responsibilities

- Own architecture and technical direction across the AIBP web application portfolio - data model, auth/access control, API design, and deployment. 
 - Ship full-stack features end-to-end - UI, backend logic, schema/migrations, and cloud deploy. 
 - Plan and run the team's work in Linear as the single source of truth - break initiatives into tickets, sequence them against timelines, and keep status, priority, and dependencies accurate at all times. 
 - Build and own delivery timelines and project plans, setting realistic estimates for a fast pace and flagging delays and blockers early with a clear cause and recovery plan. 
 - Own the release process end-to-end - decide what ships, verify migration/deploy readiness, write release notes, and hold the rollback plan. 

Additional Responsibilities

- Write and review tickets so they're self-contained and agent-ready - clear scope, acceptance criteria, and file/test pointers - whether executed by a person or an agentic coding tool. 
 - Use Claude (Claude Code and Claude. ai) as the default way of writing code, drafting/refining tickets, planning work, and producing status reports. 
 - Review PRs, mentor other engineers, and set technical and ticket-quality standards. 
 - Judge when AI output needs verification - especially auth, access control, and destructive data operations. 
 - Keep tests (unit/integration/E2E) and CI/CD gating healthy as things move fast. 
 - Report status concisely to stakeholders - what shipped, what's at risk, and what's needed to unblock it. 
 - Linear & ticket quality: keep Linear accurate as the single source of truth (not a wiki or chat thread); maintain ticket hygiene - status, labels, priority, linked dependencies, sub-issue structure - continuously, not just before a status meeting. 
 - Timeline & project planning: keep milestones, dependencies, and sequencing visibly current as scope shifts; surface risk and slippage the moment they're known, with a cause and recovery plan attached. 
 - Release ownership: gate every release through CI/CD and required checks, confirm migration safety, and ensure release notes and a rollback plan exist for every release; run post-release monitoring and any hotfix path. 

Qualifications

Top 5 qualifications

- 8-12 years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a lead/ownership capacity. 
 - Strong TypeScript/React expertise with a modern full-stack framework such as Next. js (deep App Router experience a plus). 
 - 2+ years of daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools, with Claude (Claude Code and/or Claude. ai) as a true daily driver - not occasional autocomplete. 
 - Relational database design and ORM experience (Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, or similar), with sound judgment on migration safety and cascade behavior. 
 - Fluency with Linear (or an equivalent issue tracker) as a planning and delivery tool, not just a task list. 

Additional Qualifications

- REST API design experience: auth boundaries, rate limiting, CSRF protection. 
 - Solid experience on at least one major cloud/edge platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare) and the judgment to apply it elsewhere. 
 - CI/CD literacy: gating, required checks, migration safety.

data.title: AI Principle Architect
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

AI Principle Architect

Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage. 

We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale. 
 - Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks). 
 - Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e. g. , LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context. 
 - Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond. 
 - Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e. g. , Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention. 
 - Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e. g. , Neo4j, AWS Neptune). 
 - Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models. 
 - Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency. 
 - Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards. 
 - Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness. 
 - Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program. 
 - Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point. 

All About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail. 
 - Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency. 
 - Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. 
 - A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry. 
 - The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms. 
 - Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks. 
 - Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs. 
 - Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

As a Principal Software Engineering Manager in W+D Silicon and Fundamentals Team you will set technical and execution direction along with building and growing a high performing team in the areas of AI, silicon and software. We remain laser-focused on establishing Fundamentals as a delighter for the Copilot+ PC brand. If you love the pursuit of excellence and are inspired by the challenge of driving innovations that impact how the world lives, works and plays, then we invite you to an exciting opportunity to innovate, influence, transform, inspire and grow within the W+D Silicon and Fundamentals Team. 

This role carries end‐to‐end ownership across people, technology, and delivery, with an explicit mandate to drive AI‐forward engineering practices at scale to improve productivity, quality, and developer effectiveness. 

Responsibilities

This role focuses on leading teams that design, build, validate and operate scalable software solutions in the areas of AI, silicon and software with laser-focus on establishing great Fundamentals. As a Principal Software Engineering Manager, focuses on people leadership, technical direction, and delivery outcomes across teams. 

In This Role, You Are Expected To

- Lead, coach, and support a team of Software Engineers by providing clear expectations, regular feedback, and career guidance through one-on-one connections, mentoring, and performance discussions. 
 - Set and align technical direction and execution plans by partnering with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer needs and business priorities into engineering plans. 
 - Support operational excellence and delivery consistency by reinforcing engineering fundamentals, planning practices, and coordinated response to incidents and live-site issues. 
 - Leverage customer feedback, telemetry, and product usage data to identify improvement opportunities, prioritize investments, and guide teams toward long-term Windows Fundamentals enhancements. 
 - Establish and reinforce engineering practices for design reviews, code reviews, testing, and continuous integration to support secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions. 
 - Provide technical guidance and escalation support by working with engineers on complex diagnostics using debugging tools, performance analysis, and code-level investigation, and representing the team in cross-organization discussions. 
 - Foster a customer-focused and inclusive team environment where engineers understand customer impact, collaborate across teams, and take shared ownership of outcomes that matter to customers. 

AI‐Forward Engineering

- Champion AI‐assisted and agentic engineering workflows across the org; set standards and expectations so teams use AI to move faster without compromising security or quality. 
 - Establish guardrails and best practices for responsible use of AI tools-ensuring correctness, security, privacy, and compliance. 
 - Encourage teams to use AI to: 
 - Accelerate root‐cause analysis and debugging
 - Improve test coverage and validation
 - Reduce toil through automation and repeatable workflows
 - Partner with AI‐forward initiatives across Windows to scale learnings, patterns, and reusable assets. 
Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical field AND 12+ years in AI/ML software or systems engineering
 - 4+ years of people management experience, including hiring and developing engineering teams
 - Act as the primary bridge between model development teams, software API engineers, and Microsoft ecosystem stakeholders to define feature acceptance thresholds and validation gating. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of internal tools that automate the measurement of accuracy degradation (e. g. , drift in quantized INT4/INT8 models) and API-level performance overheads. 
 - Align engineering metrics with the Windows AI Foundry, DirectML, and ONNX Runtime specifications to ensure flawless execution providers. 
 - Establish regression tracking systems to evaluate how model updates alter API response latencies, memory footprint, and user-experience quality across Windows PC form factors. 
 - Strong technical background in systems, platform, on-device AI experiences with the ability to guide architecture and technical decisions. 
 - Strong familiarity with the Windows ML architecture, DirectML, and implementing Execution Providers (EPs) within ONNX Runtime
 - Proven track record of working side-by-side with model training/fine-tuning teams and application-layer software engineers
 - Familiarity with Windows architecture, OS fundamentals, and On Device AI concepts. 
 - Familiarity with scripting or automation to support operational efficiency and repeatable processes.
