data.title: Solution Architect — Full-Stack & Mobile Application Architecture
data.description:
Solution Architect - Full-Stack & Mobile Application Architecture

Surat / Ahmedabad

Hybrid / On-site

7+ years in software engineering (Java/. NET mandatory), with 2+ years in a dedicated Solution Architect role -including ownership of SADs, TDDs, design reviews, and architectural governance

About Project Tree

At Project Tree, we bridge the gap between complex business challenges and elegant technical solutions. As a premier IT service provider in Gujarat, we specialize in building scalable, future-ready applications. We are looking for a high-caliber Solution Architect to join our leadership team and define the technical foundations of our global enterprise projects. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a Solution Architect who can bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution. This is a hands-on role - you will design end-to-end application architectures across web and mobile, write and review code alongside delivery teams, and mentor developers as they grow. You will not just draw diagrams; you will roll up your sleeves and prove your designs work. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

- Application Architecture: Design and own application architecture for full-stack and mobile solutions spanning frontend, backend, APIs, databases, mobile apps, and integrations. 
 - Requirements Translation: Translate business and functional requirements into technical designs, including component diagrams, data models, sequence flows, and technology selection rationale. 
 - Standards & Governance: Define and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and coding best practices across project teams. 
 - Technology Evaluation: Assess and introduce modern technologies, frameworks, and tools where they add genuine value - not novelty. 
 - Data Modeling: Define data models and make informed decisions between relational and NoSQL approaches based on use cases. 
 - Data Lifecycle & Retention: Establish strategies for data storage, archival, and retention aligned with business and compliance needs. 
 - Data Consistency Patterns: Apply appropriate consistency models such as eventual consistency and CQRS where required. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Technical Delivery: Lead and participate in hands-on delivery - prototyping, building reference implementations, conducting code reviews, and resolving complex technical blockers. 
 - Planning & Estimation: Contribute to estimation, technical risk assessment, and solution proposals during project planning. 
 - Documentation: Document architectures clearly enough that teams can build from them independently. 
 - Architecture Artifacts: Create and maintain ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), C4 model diagrams, and API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger). 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Mentoring: Mentor and coach mid-level and junior developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and stakeholders to evaluate trade-offs and recommend pragmatic solutions. 

Observability & Monitoring

- Logging, monitoring, tracing (OpenTelemetry, ELK, CloudWatch)
 - Alerting & incident response design

KPIs & Success Metrics

- System Scalability & Performance: Ensuring applications can handle projected load with sub-second latency. 
 - Technical Debt Reduction: Measurable decrease in legacy issues and code complexity over time. 
 - Architectural Alignment: Zero major deviations from the approved design during the development lifecycle. 
 - Time-to-Market Efficiency: Improving delivery speed through reusable components and standardized frameworks. 
 - Performance Tuning Effectiveness: Implementation and impact of performance tuning strategies, including caching and database optimization. 
 - Load Testing & Benchmarking: Regular execution of load testing and benchmarking to validate system performance against defined thresholds. 
 - Profiling & Optimization Practices: Effective use of profiling tools and techniques to identify bottlenecks and improve system efficiency. 

Experience (Non-Negotiable)

Technical Skills & Qualifications

- 7+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience, of which a mandatory 2+ years must have been in a dedicated Solution Architect role - with a proven track record of: 
 - Authoring Solution Architecture Documents (SADs) and Technical Design Documents (TDDs)
 - Providing technical direction to delivery teams and leading design reviews
 - Planning architecture and delivery roadmaps across full project lifecycles
 - Enforcing adherence to best practices, standards, and governance frameworks
 - Candidates who cannot evidence the above with real examples from prior roles will not be progressed. 

Backend

- Server-Side Technologies: Strong proficiency in Java or . NET (mandatory), with working knowledge of Node. js as an advantage. 
 - Object-Oriented Programming: Solid command of OOP principles (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction) with demonstrable application in enterprise-grade backend systems. This is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have. 

Frontend

- UI Frameworks: Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Next. js. 

Mobile

- Mobile Architecture: Experience in architecting mobile application solutions. Flutter experience is desirable. 

Solution Architect

- API Design: Solid experience designing RESTful and event-driven APIs. Knowledge of GraphQL APIs. 

Cloud

- AWS: Practical experience with AWS and its managed services for application workloads - compute, storage, messaging, and serverless. 

DevOps & Infrastructure

- CI/CD & Containers: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code concepts. 

Delivery & Ways of Working

- Agile Methodology: Experience working in SAFe Agile or WaterAgile (hybrid waterfall/agile) delivery environments. 

Education

- Degree: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or information technology. 

Nice to Have

- Exposure to domain-driven design, microservices patterns, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with integration middleware or API management platforms. 
 - AWS Solutions Architect certification, TOGAF, or equivalent. 
 - Prior consulting or multi-client delivery experience. 

Soft Skills

- AI-Augmented Delivery: Ability to leverage AI tools and LLMs within project execution - for design, development, review, documentation, and problem-solving - to accelerate delivery and improve quality. 
 - AI Enablement & Team Leadership: Capable of guiding and upskilling project teams in the effective use of the organization's approved AI tooling, establishing best practices, and ensuring the team consistently extracts maximum value from these tools. 
 - Strategic Communication: Excellence in articulating complex technical visions to stakeholders, clients, and engineering teams. 

What We Offer

- Career Evolution: We offer a merit-based trajectory from Architect → Senior Architect → Lead Architect, culminating in Principal Architect/CTO. Your journey is defined by transitioning from technical execution to Strategic Architectural Governance. 
 - Project Tree Life: We believe in celebrating our wins together! Enjoy a vibrant culture with frequent team lunches, dinners, annual trips, and our signature Cricket tournaments. 
 - The Advantage: Technical autonomy to shape the company's tech direction, premium hardware at our Iconic Shyamal (Ahmedabad) office, and competitive salary benchmarks. 

How To Apply

If this feels like the right role for you, click on the Apply button to submit your Resume and Architectural Portfolio/GitHub and complete the application form. 

To learn more about our vision and the impactful work we do, feel free to explore our website at https: //projecttree. in

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian India

Atlassian's mission "to unleash the potential of every team" is the guiding light behind what we do. Our products, including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, help teams everywhere work better together, from NASA to Cochlear. 

Our office is in Bengaluru, but eligible candidates can work remotely across India: from home, from an office, or somewhere in between. We call this TEAM Anywhere. 

Your future team: KubePlat Team

The KubePlat group in Core Engineering owns Atlassian's entire Kubernetes ecosystem. Every Atlassian cloud product, including Jira, Confluence, Loom and Rovo, runs on the clusters, platform services and deployment systems we build and operate. Our mission is to provide Atlassian a secure, reliable, cost-efficient and globally distributed compute platform, as the foundation for building great products. 

What We Own

- Kubernetes infrastructure: hundreds of production clusters (EKS and GKE) across AWS, GCP and regulated cloud environments. 
 - Fleet management: automated, cloud-agnostic lifecycle management for clusters and platform components, with safe progressive rollouts. 
 - Kubernetes Platform-as-a-Service: an opinionated, multi-tenant platform for running Atlassian's microservices. 
 - Cloud resource management: self-serve, Kubernetes-driven provisioning of the cloud resources that services depend on. 
 - Secure sandboxed compute: strongly isolated environments for running untrusted code and AI-agent workloads. 
 - Software delivery: artifact management, deployment orchestration and automated verification for thousands of deployments every day. 
 - AI/ML infrastructure: the GPU compute, high-bandwidth networking and parallel filesystem ecosystem on Kubernetes that powers model training and AI inference behind Atlassian's AI features. 

We are in the middle of a major transformation: moving to a multi-cloud, cell-based architecture, meeting FedRAMP and data-residency requirements, and building a reliable, cloud-native foundation for AI training and inference at scale. 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical direction for Atlassian's Kubernetes, compute and AI/ML infrastructure platform. You will lead engineers across several teams on our hardest problems, and take large, cross-team initiatives from design to launch. 

What You'll Do

- Define the architecture and multi-year roadmap for a multi-cloud, cell-based Kubernetes fleet that scales to thousands of clusters. 
 - Design Kubernetes-native control planes (controllers, operators, CRDs and policy) that give engineers self-serve compute, networking and cloud resources. 
 - Raise platform reliability and security: reduce blast radius, build safe progressive rollouts, define SLOs, isolate workloads and support compliance (for example FedRAMP). 
 - Lead compute efficiency through autoscaling, bin packing, capacity planning and cost optimisation. 
 - Build the AI/ML infrastructure ecosystem on Kubernetes: GPU compute at scale, high-bandwidth, low-latency networking, and high-performance parallel filesystems for training and inference. 
 - Influence engineering and product leaders globally, set architectural standards, and mentor senior engineers. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years building and operating large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-as-a-service systems. 
 - Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise from running it in production at scale: internals, networking, multi-tenancy, and building operators and CRDs. 
 - Strong experience with AWS and/or GCP (EKS/GKE) and distributed systems design. 
 - Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java or similar. 
 - Platform engineering experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps/CD (for example Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD) and observability. 
 - A track record of leading technical direction across teams, with excellent communication and mentoring skills. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Kubernetes fleet management, cell-based architectures, sandboxing (gVisor, Firecracker) or regulated environments. 
 - Experience providing AI/ML infrastructure: GPU clusters, high-bandwidth networking (for example RDMA, InfiniBand, AWS EFA, GPUDirect) or parallel filesystems (for example Lustre, Amazon FSx for Lustre, GCP Parallelstore). 
 - Contributions to CNCF open-source projects.

Process Overview*

Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) strives to provide the company with transparent, proactive insights into process and control effectiveness that are used for managing risk, policy adherence, and driving operational excellence. EIT tests processes and controls throughout the year on behalf of Frontline Units (FLUs), Control Functions (CFs), and Global Risk Management to enable them to manage their processes and controls more effectively. EIT also participates in regular reviews, examinations, and routines with regulators, as well as Corporate Audit. 

Job Description*

TEST DEVELOPMENT AND TEST AUTOMATION (TD) IC

The Test Development and automation role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive test procedures to evaluate control effectiveness, and looking for test automation feasibility and execution. 

The role requires collaboration with stakeholders to translate business, regulatory, and process requirements into structured, repeatable test scripts, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of testing outcomes, as well as checking for usable automated workflows . The role operates within a structured framework, ensuring all development activities are executed, tracked, and governed through a centralized system of record, including milestone tracking, documentation, and status reporting.

 - Adhere to defined SLAs, timelines, and quality benchmarks
 - Monitor automation performance, investigate failures, and maintain documentation, evidence, and change history
 - Contribute to continuous improvement and testing transformation initiatives

Education*

Graduate / Postgraduate in

- Business / Commerce / Banking
 - Finance / Risk / Operations
 - Technology or related disciplines

Experience Range*

4-6 years

Foundational skills*

- Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet defined SLAs
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop integrated solutions
 - Strong data-analysis capability using Excel and query tools to profile, reconcile, and validate test populations
 - Ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive test requirements and scenarios
 - Strong understanding of test design, test lifecycle management, automation feasibility, and control validation

Desired Skills

12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM (IST); As per business requirement (flexibility to support global stakeholders)

GIFT/HYD City

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco AI Software & Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios. 

Your Impact

Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join

our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure

cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the

organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code

delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment-enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime. 
 - Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions. 
 - Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks. 
 - Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity. 
 - Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability. 
 - Participate in on-call rotation. 
 - Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization-promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 8 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 5 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. 
 - Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker 
 - Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Solid scripting and automation skills (e. g. , Python, Bash, Go). 

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar. 
 - Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations. 
 - Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview*

Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) strives to provide the company with transparent, proactive insights into process and control effectiveness that are used for managing risk, policy adherence, and driving operational excellence. EIT tests processes and controls throughout the year on behalf of Frontline Units (FLUs), Control Functions (CFs), and Global Risk Management to enable them to manage their processes and controls more effectively. EIT also participates in regular reviews, examinations, and routines with regulators, as well as Corporate Audit. 

Job Description*

TEST DEVELOPMENT (TD) IC

The Test Development role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive test procedures to evaluate control effectiveness. 

The role requires collaboration with stakeholders to translate business, regulatory, and process requirements into structured, repeatable test scripts, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency of testing outcomes. The role operates within a structured Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC) framework, ensuring all development activities are executed, tracked, and governed through a centralized system of record, including milestone tracking, documentation, and status reporting. 

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and hands-on experience in test development, test execution, and QA/QC practices. 

Responsibilities*

- Design and develop test procedures and scripts aligned to EIT standards. 
 - Translate business and control requirements into structured, repeatable test scenarios. 
 - Execute activities across the end-to-end Test Development Life Cycle (TDLC). 
 - Ensure all development activities are accurately tracked in the system of record, with timely status updates and progression. 
 - Prepare and maintain attestation evidence and deliverables, ensuring alignment to defined acceptance criteria prior to closure. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders across Test Execution, QA, and Risk teams to ensure seamless workflow progression. 
 - Identify, document, and escalate defects, control gaps, and process issues. 
 - Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing standards, and quality benchmarks. 
 - Adhere to defined SLAs, timelines, and quality benchmarks. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement and testing transformation initiatives. 

Requirements*

Education*

- Graduate / Postgraduate in

Business / Commerce / Banking. 

Finance / Risk / Operations. 

Technology or related disciplines. 

- Certifications If Any: NA. 

Experience Range*

- 04 Years to 06 Years of total experience. 

Foundational Skills*

- Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and consistently meet defined SLAs. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to develop integrated solutions. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office tools, with strong expertise in Excel (data analysis, pivot tables, lookups). 
 - Ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive test requirements and scenarios. 
 - Strong understanding of test lifecycle management and test design principles. 
 - Ability to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency in testing outputs. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills. 
 - Understanding of structured test lifecycle frameworks (e. g. , TDLC or equivalent). 
 - Minimum 2+ years of experience in testing, risk management, process improvement, compliance, or front-line control roles demonstrating strong analytical capability. 
 - Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Test Development, Test Execution, or Quality Assurance (QA/QC) or related functions. 

Desired Skills*

- Working knowledge of data warehousing and data mining concepts, with basic understanding of SAS/SQL query languages.

Client: Fortune 500 company, recently opened their branch in Hyderabad, Telangana

Role: Director/Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Delivery

Duration: Full time (direct hire)

About Client

- Global AI & Innovation team to build next-generation AI platforms, autonomous agents, and real-time intelligence solutions that transform how a global enterprise operates and serves its customers. 

Position Summary

- It s is seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Manager, AI Engineering & Delivery to lead the Hyderabad GCC AI delivery organization and serve as a critical execution partner to the Global AI & Innovation leadership team. 
 - This role will own the design, delivery, operationalization, and support of enterprise AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions across the prioritized global pipeline. 
 - The successful candidate will manage a multidisciplinary team of AI/ML Engineers, Agent Developers, Data Scientists, MLOps resources, contractors, and delivery partners. 
 - The role will act as the single point of contact for the onshore AI team and business stakeholders, translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions, lead Responsible AI training and awareness, and serve as the first-level escalation point for AI/ML and Agentic AI issues. 
 - This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep knowledge of business operations, strong stakeholder management, and the technical depth to design and deploy secure, reusable, production-grade AI capabilities that integrate into business workflows and create measurable value. 

Key Responsibilities

Global AI/ML & Agentic Solution Delivery: 

- Lead end-to-end delivery of AI, ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI initiatives across the prioritized global portfolio, from discovery and design through production deployment, adoption, and value realization. 
 - Create delivery plans, estimates, milestones, resource models, technical dependencies, risk controls, and release readiness criteria. 
 - Ensure solutions are scalable, reusable, maintainable, observable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and engineering standards. 
 - Establish reusable implementation patterns, accelerators, components, APIs, and reference architectures to improve speed and quality across the portfolio. 
 - Maintain transparent portfolio reporting on scope, schedule, quality, risks, dependencies, budget, adoption, and business outcomes. 

AI Architecture & Hands-on Technical Leadership

- Own solution architecture and technical design for AI/ML applications, AI microservices, RAG solutions, intelligent assistants, and single- and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Guide model, algorithm, platform, orchestration, data, integration, and deployment decisions based on business requirements and operational constraints. 
 - Conduct architecture and code reviews; establish engineering standards for testing, evaluation, observability, resiliency, security, and supportability. 
 - Remain hands-on in design, prototyping, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production deployment of critical solutions. 
 - Design APIs and integrations that embed AI capabilities into operational processes, enterprise applications, and business workflows. 

GCC Team Leadership & Delivery Management

- Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary GCC team of AI/ML Engineers, Agent Developers, Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers, contractors, and partner resources. 
 - Allocate work across the portfolio, balance capacity and demand, remove delivery blockers, and maintain accountability for quality and outcomes. 
 - Define role expectations, engineering practices, onboarding plans, technical learning paths, and knowledge-sharing mechanisms. 
 - Manage contractors and vendors against defined deliverables, acceptance criteria, security requirements, and performance expectations. 
 - Partner with onshore leadership to evolve the global AI operating model and create effective follow-the-sun delivery and support practices. 

Business Partnership & Operational Knowledge

- Serve as the primary GCC AI point of contact for the onshore team, technology leaders, and business stakeholders. 
 - Develop detailed knowledge of It s business operations, workflows, data, controls, customer needs, and regional differences. 
 - Facilitate discovery workshops and translate operational pain points into well-defined AI use cases, solution options, and delivery roadmaps. 
 - Partner with business owners to define success measures, adoption plans, process changes, controls, and quantified value outcomes. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executives, business leaders, product owners, engineers, and control functions. 

AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Operationalize It s AI governance requirements throughout the solution lifecycle, including intake, design, risk assessment, approval, testing, deployment, monitoring, and retirement. 
 - Ensure security-by-design and privacy-by-design for sensitive financial, customer, employee, and operational data. 
 - Implement safeguards for prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination and inaccuracy, unauthorized access, model misuse, bias, explainability, and regulatory or compliance risk. 
 - Maintain solution documentation, decision records, model cards, evaluation evidence, approvals, risk treatments, and audit ready artifacts. 
 - Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, Data Governance, and Internal Audit as required. 

Global AI Training, Adoption & Awareness

- Own and drive continuous AI learning, enablement, and Responsible AI awareness across global It s teams. 
 - Develop and deliver executive briefings, business enablement sessions, technical workshops, developer training, and role based learning paths. 
 - Create practical guidance that helps employees use AI safely, responsibly, and effectively within approved policies and tools. 
 - Build a network of AI champions and reusable training assets to scale adoption across regions and functions. 
 - Track participation, adoption, proficiency, policy awareness, and feedback to continuously improve enablement programs. 

AI Operations, Support & Escalation

- Serve as the first-level escalation point for delivery, production, model, agent, data, integration, governance, and adoption issues related to AI/ML and Agentic AI. 
 - Lead structured triage, root-cause analysis, stakeholder communication, remediation, and preventive action for critical incidents. 
 - Establish operational readiness standards, service ownership, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, support handoffs, and incident response procedures. 
 - Monitor model and agent quality, latency, reliability, cost, drift, safety, and business performance after deployment. 
 - Escalate material risks and decisions promptly with clear impact, options, recommendations, owners, and resolution plans. 

Strategy Execution & Value Realization

- Reporting directly to Global Head, AI & Innovation to translate the Global AI Strategy into an executable roadmap and delivery portfolio. 
 - Support portfolio prioritization, investment planning, governance forums, executive reviews, vendor evaluations, and strategic partnerships. 
 - Identify opportunities to reuse platforms, data products, models, agents, and integration patterns across functions and regions. 
 - Define and report measurable outcomes, including business value, adoption, risk reduction, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical adoption paths aligned with business need, enterprise readiness, and risk tolerance. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, data science, AI/ML engineering, enterprise architecture, or digital solution delivery. 
 - 5+ years leading multidisciplinary AI/ML, data science, or advanced engineering teams, including contractors and delivery partners. 
 - Demonstrated success designing, deploying, and supporting production-grade enterprise AI/ML or Generative AI solutions. 
 - Experience operating as a technical and delivery leader across geographically distributed onshore and offshore teams. 
 - Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, risk management, and delivery governance skills. 
 - Ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem solving and detailed operational understanding. 

Required Technical Skills & Experience

AI, Generative AI & Agentic Engineering: 

- LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use, function calling, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, model evaluation, grounding, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI and/or Amazon Bedrock and with relevant model providers and enterprise AI services. 
 - Experience with frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or comparable orchestration frameworks. 

Data Science & Algorithm Selection

- Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, feature engineering, predictive modeling, optimization, and model evaluation. 
 - Ability to select algorithms based on business objective, target variable, data volume and quality, latency, interpretability, risk, cost, and deployment constraints. 
 - Practical experience with regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, clustering, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, NLP, recommendation methods, neural networks, and optimization techniques. 
 - Ability to compare candidate models using appropriate evaluation metrics, validation strategies, explainability methods, and business acceptance criteria. 

Software Engineering & Integration

- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL; strong understanding of APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, object-oriented design, automated testing, version control, and secure coding. 
 - Experience with REST services, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub or Azure DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevSecOps practices. 

Data Engineering & Knowledge Platforms

- Experience with batch and real-time data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, streaming, operational data, document processing, metadata, and data quality. 
 - Experience with Snowflake cortex, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Informatica Claire, Apache Spark, Kafka or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience designing vector search and knowledge retrieval using Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, or comparable vector database technologies. 

Cloud, MLOps & Observability

- Strong experience designing and operating solutions across Azure and AWS. 
 - Experience with model and agent deployment, registries, experiment tracking, automated testing, monitoring, drift detection, telemetry, performance tuning, autoscaling, cost optimization, secrets management, and production support. 
 - Familiarity with MLflow and relevant cloud-native AI/ML services. 

AI Security, Governance & Responsible AI

- Knowledge of secure AI design, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, DLP, privacy, retention, auditability, model risk, bias and fairness, explainability, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience implementing controls for prompt injection, insecure tool use, sensitive-data exposure, hallucination, unsafe outputs, unauthorized actions, model misuse, and third-party AI risk. 

Business & Domain Experience

- Strong knowledge of business operations at a detailed process level is essential. Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: 
 - Secure logistics and cash management
 - Financial services, banking, payments, or regulated operations
 - Route, branch, vault, fleet, or field-service operations
 - Customer service, sales, pricing, revenue, and retention analytics
 - Forecasting, workforce productivity, fraud, risk, and operational optimization
 - Global shared services, GCC delivery, or large-scale enterprise transformation

Leadership Competencies

- Enterprise thinking with disciplined execution
 - Customer- and business-outcome orientation
 - Strong ownership, urgency, and accountability
 - Ability to influence without direct authority
 - Clarity in decision-making and escalation
 - Talent development and inclusive team leadership
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and managing multiple priorities
 - High standards for security, quality, ethics, and operational excellence

Success Measures

- Outcome Area Measures of Success
 - Portfolio delivery On-time, high-quality delivery of prioritized AI/ML and Agentic AI initiatives, with risks and dependencies actively managed. 
 - Business value Measurable operational, customer, revenue, productivity, risk, or cost outcomes from deployed solutions. 
 - Production excellence Reliable, secure, observable, scalable, and cost-effective AI services with effective operational support. 
 - Reusable capability Growth in reusable architectures, components, platforms, models, agents, data products, and engineering standards. 
 - Governance & risk Consistent compliance with AI governance, security, privacy, legal, and Responsible AI requirements. 
 - Talent & capacity Strong team performance, skills growth, retention, succession readiness, and effective partner utilization. 
 - Adoption & awareness Increased AI adoption, proficiency, training participation, and Responsible AI awareness across global teams. 
 - Stakeholder confidence High trust and satisfaction among onshore leadership, business stakeholders, technology teams, and control functions. 

Why This Role Matters

- This role is central to the successful execution of It s Global AI Strategy. It combines GCC delivery leadership, enterprise architecture, hands-on engineering, business partnership, governance, Responsible AI, training, and operational accountability. The successful candidate will be a trusted extension of the onshore AI & Innovation team and will help turn It s AI vision into secure, scalable, reusable, and measurable business outcomes across the global enterprise. 

Best Regards,

data.title: Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Ciklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer to join our team full-time in India. 

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4, 000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. 

About The Role

As a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release. 

You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable. 

This is a high-visibility role where we establish the production-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent-a-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI engineers, platform engineers, and the evaluation team, embedding quality from the design stage rather than inspecting for it at the end. 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent-developer experience as the SDK evolves 
 - Build automated tests for long-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior 
 - Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion 
 - Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations 
 - AI-Specific & Non-Deterministic Testing 
 - Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression 
 - Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies 
 - Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization 
 - Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable 
 - Performance, Reliability & NFR Verification 
 - Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release 
 - Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs 
 - Process, Evidence & Collaboration 
 - Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests 
 - Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off 
 - Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts 
 - Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable 
 - Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy

Requirements

- 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases 
 - Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples) 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus 
 - Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates 
 - Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality 
 - A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast 
 - Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders 
 - Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites

JOB DESCRIPTION: 

At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. 

We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. 

You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. 

Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Lead and mentor a group of bioinformatics and software test engineers. 
 - Establish software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively measure software and bioinformatics product quality. Implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Single point of contact while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation

Minimum Qualifications (must have): 

- Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 06 years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 06+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Strong leadership abilities and extensive experience managing the activities of software quality engineering and assurance teams. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-site teams preferred. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership. 
 - Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

data.title: Manager, Data Engineering
data.description:
Manages the activities of a team of data analysts and newer data engineers responsible for developing software code that formats, tags, processes, stores and serves data. Manages the development of data pipelines to ensure that they are scalable, repeatable, and secure and can serve multiple groups at Vanguard. 

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

The Manager, Data Engineering is responsible for leading a team of data engineers to design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role focuses on enabling high-performance data workflows, ensuring seamless data integration and driving automation to enhance data accessibility. 

Responsibilites

- Hire, mentor and manage a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous learning in data engineering best practices. 
 - Design, develop and maintain scalable ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines to efficiently process and integrate structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. 
 - Build and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant data architectures, ensuring efficient data storage, retrieval and processing across cloud and on-premises environments. 
 - Oversee the design, implementation and performance tuning of relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring data consistency, security and accessibility. 
 - Automate data ingestion, transformation and validation processes to enhance data pipeline efficiency and reduce manual intervention. 
 - Develop cloud-based data solutions using platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, leveraging technologies such as Spark, Hadoop and Kafka for large-scale data processing. 
 - Work closely with data scientists, analysts and business intelligence teams to understand data requirements and develop scalable solutions for analytics and reporting. 
 - Proactively monitor data pipelines and systems for performance issues, troubleshoot failures and implement preventive measures for system reliability. 
 - Partner with business and IT leaders to align data engineering initiatives with company goals, ensuring seamless integration of data-driven solutions across departments. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop high-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development. 
 - Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence. 
 - Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Lead product-oriented teams with end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. 
 - Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance. 
 - Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled tools and capabilities to improve personal and team productivity, automate and streamline day-to-day workflows, and accelerate responsible AI adoption across the team by identifying practical use cases, encouraging experimentation, and embedding effective AI practices into how the team works. 
 - Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards. 
 - Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices. 
 - Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership. 
 - Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business-outcome ownership. 
 - Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity. 
 - The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value. This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics. The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing data engineering teams and large-scale data infrastructure. 
 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science, IT, or a related field or Diploma in Data Science/Data Engineering. 
 - Strong expertise in ETL development, data warehousing and real-time data processing frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Spark, Kafka and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). 
 - Proficiency in database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, Big Query) and distributed computing frameworks. 
 - Proven experience leading teams in a product-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira. 
 - Experience leading data-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms. 
 - Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change. 
 - Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes. 
 - Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries. 
 - Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-enabled technology initiatives. 
 - Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred. 
 - Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives. 

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered. 

Our mission

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success. 

Our commitment to you

data.title: Principal Software Architect - Next Gen Informatics
data.description:
Job Requirements

Job Description

Principal Software Architect is responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end architecture of high performant, scalable, resilient next-generation laboratory informatics software platform, including instrument connectivity, laboratory workflows, quality control (QC), result management, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong software engineering and architectural expertise with demonstrated experience in AI-native software development - requiring the ability to transform conventional engineering workflows into AI-enabled development practices using coding agents, automated code analysis, agentic workflows, AI-assisted testing, and continuous verification while maintaining architectural integrity, security, and product quality. 

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise and Solution Architecture

Own the end-to-end software architecture, including system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, deployment topology, and technology choices. 

Define modular, extensible architectures supporting multiple instrument vendors, laboratory sites, product configurations, and deployment environments. 

Establish architectural principles, design patterns, interface contracts, coding standards, and reference architectures. 

Make informed build-versus-buy and architectural trade-off decisions considering reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and total cost of ownership. 

Identify architectural risks, structural technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and opportunities for platform simplification. 

Guide architecture evolution and modernization of legacy systems without compromising existing customer workflows or data integrity. 

AI-Native Software Architecture and Engineering

Define the technical strategy for integrating AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, and maintenance. 

Design AI-enabled engineering workflows using coding agents, agentic development environments, codebase intelligence, and automated verification. 

Establish architectural context, repository-level instructions, machine-readable specifications, and guardrails that enable AI agents to work safely within complex software systems. 

Evaluate AI agent architectures, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and code graph technologies where appropriate. 

Establish repeatable evaluations for AI-generated code, including correctness, architectural conformance, test effectiveness, security, maintainability, and regression risk. 

Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity without compromising software quality or release integrity. 

Instrument Connectivity and Interoperability Architecture

Define a reusable connectivity architecture for integrating diagnostic instruments from multiple vendors. 

Establish abstractions for protocol adapters, device drivers, message parsing, normalization, acknowledgements, retry, buffering, and recovery. 

Guide implementation of TCP/IP and serial communication, vendor-specific protocols, and relevant standards such as CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2. 

Defining canonical data models and interface contracts for instrument messages, results, QC data, device status, and configuration. 

Design for intermittent connectivity, duplicate or malformed messages, out-of-order events, service restarts, and safe recovery. 

Establish simulator-based testing and conformance strategies that reduce the cost and complexity of onboarding new instruments. 

Laboratory Domain and Data Architecture

Translate laboratory workflows and domain requirements into explicit, testable architectural models. 

Define architectures for QC management, Levey-Jennings charts, Westgard rules, result review, QC closeout, alerting, and audit trails. 

Establish data models and persistence strategies for historical results, QC observations, configuration versions, rule changes, and operator actions. 

Ensure deterministic processing, traceability, historical reproducibility, and appropriate handling of concurrent updates. 

Key Technical Skills And Experience

Software Engineering

15+ years in software engineering, including significant experience in software architecture and technical leadership

Strong proficiency in C#, . NET / . NET Core, object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and software design patterns. 

Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant high-performance scalable applications. 

Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or comparable frontend frameworks. 

Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, automated testing, CI/CD, debugging, security, and production issue resolution. 

Domain Experience - Mandatory

Deep expertise in laboratory middleware systems, instrument drivers, message translation. 

Clinical laboratory workflows, QC processes, result review, and instrument integration. 

Laboratory instrument communication standards, including ASTM, CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2. 

Healthcare IT, LIS, laboratory middleware, diagnostic software, or IVD product development. 

Applicable healthcare software lifecycle, quality-management, risk-management, and cybersecurity standards. 

AI-Native Development - Mandatory

Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools in real software delivery projects. 

Ability to design and implement AI-enabled engineering workflows spanning requirements analysis, codebase exploration, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and documentation. 

Practical experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent agentic development environments. 

Experience creating and maintaining repository-level AI instructions, reusable agent workflows, project context, and engineering guardrails. 

Understanding of agent tool use, context windows, structured outputs, model limitations, and techniques for grounding AI-generated changes in actual code and specifications. 

Experience integrating AI agents with source control, work items, build pipelines, test frameworks, and other engineering tools. 

Ability to establish automated verification & human review mechanisms for AI-generated code. 

Demonstrated understanding of AI failure modes, including hallucinated APIs, incorrect assumptions, insecure code, incomplete test coverage, and unintended architectural changes. 

Practical knowledge of secure AI usage, confidential-data protection, access controls, auditability, and software licensing considerations. 

Experience building custom coding agents, agentic workflows, or multi-agent engineering systems. 

Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and codebase indexing. 

Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool integrations, or equivalent mechanisms for exposing engineering systems to AI agents. 

Experience with code graphs, dependency analysis, semantic code search, and repository-scale reasoning. 

Qualifications And Experience

Engineering degree in Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 

15+ years of professional experience in SW product development

Sound knowledge of SDLC and agile practices. 

Other Attributes

Excellent spoken & written communication skills

Detail oriented with strong problem solving and analytical skills

Team player with a proactive approach

Self-starter, quick learner, and passionate problem resolver

Benefits

Qualifications and experience

Engineering degree in Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 

15+ years of professional experience in SW product development

Sound knowledge of SDLC and agile practices. 

Other Attributes

Excellent spoken & written communication skills

Detail oriented with strong problem solving and analytical skills

Team player with a proactive approach

Self-starter, quick learner, and passionate problem resolver
