Opportunity Overview

As DevOps and Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you'll be part of the action - working closely with application teams to automate / optimize infrastructure, and solve issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment. You'll play a vital role in ensuring that our systems are reliable, scalable, and high-performing. 

You would design, implement, and manage robust observability solutions across our cloud infrastructure and applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, AWS Cloud Monitoring, Datadog. You should be comfortable working with metrics, logs, and traces, and be able to correlate telemetry data to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve issues. 

What You'll Do

- Automate deployments and Implement release governance. 
 - Site Reliability Engineering: Maintain SLAs, SLIs/SLOs. 
 - Implement observability dashboards & metrics. 
 - Monitor production systems. 
 - Enforce security best practices- support audit and compliance activities. 
 - Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Develop automation scripts and self-healing mechanisms to reduce manual intervention. 
 - Required Skills: AWS, Lambda ECS, CloudWatch, API Gateway, Okta, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Jenkins. 
 - SRE Observability Monitoring, Alerting, Incident Management. Manage incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and service restoration. 
 - Create and maintain runbooks, and knowledge articles. Participate in incident/ infra issue resolution. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps
 - Strong foundation in programming language (Java), scripting (Python / Bash / LUA) and AWS Cloud. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field (equivalent practical experience). 

Required Qualifications

Must-Haves

- Knowledge of SLIs/SLOs and performance benchmarking
 - Deep expertise in AWS (ECS, Lambda, CloudFormation/Terraform, IAM, networking, security controls)
 - Solid understanding of telemetry data types: metrics, logs, and traces
 - Ownership mindset - you've owned SRE-level reliability (SLOs/SLIs, incident management, runbooks, post-mortems)
 - Expertise in observability stacks (Datadog, CloudWatch, ELK/Kibana, or equivalent)
 - Ability to proactively identify and resolve platform issues, ensuring high availability, minimal downtime, and a streamlined integration experience for users. 
 - Strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, operations, architecture) to ensure platform reliability. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, or similar) with working knowledge of compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST)

data.title: Deputy Manager - Quality (Data Center)
data.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager - Quality (ADLEC) will play a pivotal role in controlling and supervising quality assurance processes, working closely with process owners to enhance efficiency and product quality. This role is integral to the company's commitment to delivering high-quality electrical and digital systems, and the successful candidate will have a direct impact on the company's reputation and customer satisfaction. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build effective quality processes within the organization and work with all process owners to remove bottlenecks. 
 - Understand test methods and the operation of testing equipment. 
 - Conduct product and process audits and plan daily inspection activities to thoroughly inspect final products and components. 
 - Ensure effective quality-checking activities to prevent errors in subsequent processes. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis for product quality issues and present findings to senior management. 
 - Conduct stage-wise verification to check compliance with stated requirements and analyze stage-wise rejection to control CONQ and first-hand rejections. 
 - Provide quick and effective solutions to quality issues. 
 - Manage field returns and recommend corrective actions. 
 - Ensure timely analysis and resolution of customer complaints. 
 - Carry out calibration activities and ensure all instruments are calibrated on time. 
 - Track quality measures and achieve targets for first-hand rejections, cost of non-quality, customer returns index, instrument calibration, and other relevant measures. 
 - Conduct monthly SGIA audits and work toward achieving productivity targets. 
 - Support Production and other teams on a daily basis to ensure product quality. 
 - Train, develop, and coach team members, keeping them updated on the latest developments in the QA field. 
 - Handle customers during product inspections, compliance follow-ups, and factory assessments/evaluations. 
 - Prepare Manufacturing Control Plans. 
 - Demonstrate good communication skills and coordinate/collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Maintain good knowledge of electrical switchgear/switchboards and applicable IS/IEC standards. 

Qualifications

Functional Competencies

Understanding of product standards

Knowledge of manufacturing processes

Awareness of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, TQM, etc. 

Planning and organizing skills

Product qualification, PPAP, and PFMEA tools

Qualifications, Role-specific Knowledge And Experience

Diploma/BE/B. Tech, preferably in Electrical Engineering. 

7+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry. 

At least 2-3 years of experience in process, product, and quality system audits. 

Quality certifications such as ISO, TQM, Six Sigma, etc. 

ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 Internal Auditor certification would be an added advantage. 

Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), ERP systems, and technical tools such as SPC, SOC, and other quality tools. 

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Job Title

Test Integration Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are an experienced testing and integration professional who enjoys leading complex system validation activities and working directly with customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams, this is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering Vanderlande's advanced automation solutions. 

Your Role

As a Test Integration Engineer I, you will provide functional leadership for testing activities across the project lifecycle. You will own the overall testing strategy, coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead customer test workshops, and ensure the system is ready for successful acceptance. 

You will work closely with Project Leaders, Engineering teams, customers, and other stakeholders to ensure that testing activities are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with project requirements. 

What You Will Do / Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Project Ownership

- Own and drive the testing strategy across the project lifecycle. 
 - Define and manage test approaches, test plans, test readiness criteria, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Ensure testing activities are aligned with project requirements, system specifications, and customer expectations. 
 - Lead operational scenario validation to ensure the system performs effectively under realistic operating conditions. 
 - Approve test readiness and ensure required prerequisites are in place before testing activities commence. 
 - Lead and coordinate FAT, IHT, SFT, SAT, and other system acceptance activities as applicable. 
 - Monitor overall testing progress and provide clear reporting to project leadership. 

Customer & Stakeholder Management

- Lead customer test workshops and facilitate technical discussions related to system testing and acceptance. 
 - Act as the key testing interface between the customer and internal engineering teams. 
 - Present test results, issues, risks, and mitigation plans to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Manage expectations and ensure alignment between customer requirements and testing outcomes. 
 - Participate in engineering discussions, design reviews, and system-level technical meetings.

 - Drive system integration activities and ensure interfaces between disciplines are properly validated. 
 - Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues. 
 - Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team. 
 - Support and mentor junior engineers and promote consistent testing practices. 

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

 - Drive defect investigations and ensure critical issues are followed through to resolution. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, methodologies, and system validation. 
 - Promote standardisation and reuse of test procedures and best practices across projects. 
 - Ensure complete and accurate test documentation and project handover deliverables. 

What You Bring

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, E&TC, or Computer Engineering.

 - Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

 - Strong ownership, leadership, and mentoring capabilities. 
 - Willingness to travel extensively and support customer projects based on business requirements.

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. data.title: Test Process & Test Cell Development Manager
data.description:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. 

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. 

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust. '

Role Overview

The Test Cell Development/ Test Process Development Manager is responsible for leading the design, optimization, and deployment of wafer probe (wafer sort) and final test processes for NPI projects and release it for high-volume OSAT environment. This role ensures robust Test Cell released with cost efficiency, and seamless integration of test cells into production lines, supporting both NPI (New Product Introduction) and mass manufacturing. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Cell Development: 

- Design and develop test cell configuration, docking/undocking handlers and probers, including hardware change kits for NPI programs & production ramp-ups. 
 - Assist with test floor tool setup, ensure smooth transition from NPI to production by buying off new hardware and clarifying constraints 
 - Handler and Prober change Kits development and setup and manage teams
 - Architect and deploy automated test cells for wafer sort and final test. 
 - Familiar with all the testers (Advantest (93K), Teradyne Ultra Flex/J750, Eagle ETS, Nextest, Advantest), Handler/Probers Good Knowledge working on Handler (Hon Precision, Delta Matrix), probers (TEL, Accretes) and identifying the Handler & Prober for the NPI devices, sockets for the devices, burn-in equipment's and process. 
 - Ensure scalability, repeatability, and robustness of test cell designs. 
 - Integrate test cells with OSAT production lines, balancing throughput, cost, and reliability. 
 - Oversee qualification and release of new test platforms and equipment. 
 - Continuous Improvement - Suggest DOE/project actions to improve uptime & yield
 - Collaboration & Coordination - Engage with NPI, planning, engineering, spare-stock teams
 - Hands-on troubleshooting skills for handlers, probers, sockets, probe cards, and load boards. 

Handler & Prober Change Kit Management

- Assist in managing handler docking, qualification of multiple change kits, and maintaining documentation for hardware swaps during ramp-up and product transitions. 
 - Localize the Change Kits. 

Continuous Improvement & Projects

- Identify recurring machine faults or inefficiencies and propose improvement projects or DOE initiatives in collaboration with Engineering and NPI teams 
 - Assist in roll-out of hardware improvements, process standardization, and updates to checklists. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead cross-functional teams of test engineers, technicians, and operators. 
 - Train staff on wafer probe and final test methodologies, equipment, and best practices. 
 - Act as the primary liaison between OSAT customers and internal teams for test-equipment's related issues. 

Test Process Development

- Define and optimize wafer probe and final test processes for semiconductor devices. 
 - Collaborate with design, product, and test engineering teams to ensure test coverage, yield, and throughput. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean/Six Sigma practices. 
 - Monitor KPIs such as yield, defect detection rate, cycle time, and equipment utilization. 
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards (JEDEC, ISO, IPC). 
 - Support customer audits and technical reviews. 

Essential Attributes

Technical skills: 

- Hands-on experience with wafer probe (probers, probe cards) and final test ATE platforms (e. g. , Teradyne, Advantest, Cohu, SPEA). 
 - Strong knowledge of, functional test, parametric test, and Load Board & probe card technologies. 
 - Proficient with data analysis tools (e. g. , Python, R, JMP, Minitab) and MES/Test data systems. 

Process Skills

- Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred), project management experience. 

Soft Skills

- Strong leadership, cross-functional collaboration, customer-facing communication, and problem-solving. 
 - Ability to manage multiple test Cell development projects simultaneously. 
 - Skilled in Lean/Six Sigma for process optimization. 
 - Strong documentation and reporting skills. 
 - Leadership and team management. 
 - Customer communication and stakeholder management. 
 - Analytical and problem-solving mindset. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field; Master's preferred. 

Desired Experience Level

- Minimum 8-12 years in semiconductor test engineering within OSAT, IDM, or ATE vendor environments; at least 4 years in a leadership role.

data.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology-enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization. 

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645, 000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1, 900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which makes IT administrators' day-to-day life easier. Our vision is to become THE unified endpoint management solution for our customers. 

We are looking for a team lead with experience working across servers and clients with knowledge of Ruby On Rails, C++, JavaScript and more. You will lead the work to bring capabilities from our Observability platform into our DEX platform. This will involve making technical decisions about the best way we can integrate to provide our users with the best customer experience whilst ensuring that we can converge our 2 platforms into a single unified, scalable, maintainable platform. 

Our observability platform consists of an agent (C++, QT, Electron, JavaScript), a UI (React, Vue, Angular) and a backend (Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS EC2). Our DEX platform consists of an agent (C++), a UI (React) and a backend (C# . Net Core 8 running on Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, EventHub, Kafka, Databricks). 

You will own the delivery of the roadmap, working closely with our existing observability team that is US-based to deliver the integration whilst also supporting the maintenance of the existing platform. 

- Own delivery roadmap and technical direction for integrating the acquired product into our platform and delivery of new features. 
 - Drive architectural decisions that meet product requirements whilst considering key non-functional requirements such as scalability, security and maintainability - taking an approach that aligns with our north star of converging to a single unified platform. 
 - Align stakeholders (Product, Security, Operations) and manage risks, dependencies and scope.

 - Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
 - Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
 - A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines. 
 - A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day

data.title: Senior Staff Engineer —  Agent Ready Platform, PDX
data.description:
Overview

ARP assesses if Intuit internal platforms are "agentic-ready" for end-to-end AI agent development. Its Eval engine normalizes top use cases, spawns agents in virtualized environments, executes plans, auto-files issue for friction (e. g. , missing docs/APIs), and re-runs checks on CI/CD deploys to prevent regressions. This role belongs to the Core Platform Framework team, which builds the Eval platform and requires research-minded engineers focused on agent orchestration and LLM tooling, distinct from the Operations/Adoption team. 

Responsibilities

The selected responsibilities for the Senior Staff Engineer role encompass leading and driving key architecture initiatives for the Eval platform: 

- Core Platform Architecture: Owning and evolving the virtualization/harness layer, the agent plan-then-execute engine, and the friction detection and auto-ticketing pipeline. 
 - Model Orchestration & Cost Efficiency: Transitioning from single static models to dynamic, step-level orchestration that routes tasks to cost-effective models (including open-source options and Claude) while monitoring cost and performance per step. 
 - Telemetry & Auditability: Designing scalable logging, cost, and telemetry systems to ensure full auditability and cost accountability for agent runs. 
 - Use-Case Normalization: Setting technical standards to normalize agent-readable use cases across differently-documented capability platforms. 
 - Cross-Team & Strategic Collaboration: Partnering with capability, operations, and adjacent platform teams on friction reporting, PRD-to-action pipelines, RAG-backed architecture context, and OPA policy validation. 
 - Roadmap Leadership & Governance: Guiding the roadmap from foundational tooling (plugins, RBAC, alerting) to automation (auto-fix agents, continuous re-runs) and governance visibility. 
 - Mentorship & Technical Standards: Mentoring engineers and elevating engineering standards through design reviews, architecture documentation, and hands-on contributions. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, focused on large-scale distributed systems or developer platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent systems (orchestration loops, tool use, plan-and-execute patterns). 
 - Strong systems programming background (Python, Java) with virtualization, sandboxing, or IaC experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, and React. 
 - Applied AI and prompt design skills for reliable, cost-aware LLM behavior. 
 - Proven Staff+ capability setting cross-team technical direction. 
 - Comfort navigating ambiguity in a research-driven, next-gen engineering environment. 

Preferred

- Building or contributing to LLM or agent evaluation/benchmarking frameworks. 
 - Policy-as-code , RAG pipelines, or vector databases for enterprise agent grounding. 
 - Cost/token optimization and multi-model routing. 
 - Intuit experience or internal developer tools (CI/CD, Jira automation, developer portals). 

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Description

The Retail Business Services (RBS) Technology team's mission is to transform the Amazon's e-commerce business through technology, delivering order of magnitude higher speed, scale and impact. This Principal Engineer role leads a strong charter to accelerate business functions currently done manually, by envisioning and developing ML/GenAI-driven Agentic core platforms, thus enabling self-service building of agents to perform cognitive tasks autonomously. 

Providing a delightful experience to Amazon's e-commerce customers and selling partners requires thousands of various types of tasks performed by business teams that operate at the interface of the company as well at the heart of it. These teams work with vendors to source products to increase selection and choice for the customers, audit the app/website experience to ensure trustworthy information is provided to customers to enable confident purchases, learn from customer feedback on product reviews and returns, and ensure the inventory is placed at the right location for fast delivery of orders, just to name a few activities. Manual activities reduces speed of operations, introduce undesirable variations and limit scale. Hence there is a need to automate these, while overcoming the challenges of 1) task-by-task automation being inefficient, 2) human cognitive work automation requires equivalent or better intelligent systems, 3) a vast variety of business use cases, and 4) ability to integrate with the existing ecosystem of 100s of tools. 

The Principal Engineer owns the charter of defining and building these scalable platforms for automation, leveraging the state-of-the-art technologies such as GenAI and Agentic infrastructure. The role will understand the express and latent needs of the space, by working with business and product teams. Further, the role will define the core services and platforms that will enable rapid automation through leverage of ML/GenAI. These platforms will enable self-service, low-code/no-code automation by deskilling automation development. The Principal Engineer sets the right quality bar for resilience, latency, maintainability, accuracy (precision/recall), usability, security/privacy and efficiency, for the team to adhere to. The ideal candidate is one who thrives on understanding the complexity of software systems, and brings a nuanced understanding of different aspects of automation technologies spanning machine learning and big data processing. Working with the rest of the team, peers and stakeholders, they will lead the technology decisions to empower thousands of task automation, from simple few steps, to complex ones involving several tool integrations and conditional steps. The enormous challenge requires creative thinking and passion to use technology to make customers' and internal teams' lives better. 

The Principal Engineer in this role collaborates with the team to grow/mentor talent, review work constructively and create a supportive learning environment. They never lose sight of the customer needs, and tackle ambiguous technical and product challenges to continually find ways to serve them better. They build mechanisms to expand and maintain coverage of the platforms to multiple geographies in which Amazon operates, multi-lingual needs, multitude of product types, and hundreds of teams. 

The role will embody the Amazon leadership principles of thinking big while diving deep, learning and inventing to move fast, and build trustful relationships to leverage resources and technologies available, delivering to customer needs and delighting them. 

Key job responsibilities

- Technical leadership on our most demanding, cross-functional projects
 - Setting the technology vision in alignment with business needs
 - Architecting and designing key parts of the core platforms and services
 - Working with the team, partners and stakeholders to make optimal technical decisions
 - Review the work of, inspire and mentor other engineers
 - Build consensus and harmonize on decisions with long-term implications
 - Partner with other senior roles (managers, business leaders) to optimize at company/group level
 - Set a high technical bar and lead by example
 - Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. 

About The Team

Amazon's mission is to be the Earth's most customer-centric company. The Stores business within Amazon connects 100s of millions of customers with millions of sellers, to conveniently fulfill their shopping needs. The Retail Business Services Technology team turbocharges the pursuit of this mission by putting technology at the heart of these interactions. The team builds core platforms that leverage Machine Learning, to automatically discover customer and seller impacting frictions and eliminate them systematically. The RBS Tech team thrives on innovation, collaboration and talent growth. 

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of IT industry experience
 - BS or higher degree
 - Experience designing, building and maintaining software systems of large scale and complexity
 - Hands on experience with big data processing/storage, object-oriented design, usage of GenAI
 - Experience in working with multiple cross functional, cross geography teams
 - Experience of leading and mentoring senior engineers
 - Proven track record of delivering high-quality software

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building web-scale systems and products
 - Good understanding of Machine Learning, Neural Networks, Image/Video processing

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Senior Supplier Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies-like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion-have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. 

We're a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. 

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful-because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. 

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. 

Job Description

Primary Function: 

At Intuitive, our mission is to advance minimally invasive care through innovation. As a Supplier Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring suppliers can consistently deliver high-quality, innovative products that meet Intuitive's stringent quality, delivery, capacity, and cost requirements. 

The Supplier Engineer serves as the technical interface between suppliers and internal cross-functional teams, including Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations. This role is responsible for supplier qualification, process validation, new product introduction (NPI), supplier performance improvement, and ongoing supplier development. 

Roles And Responsibilities

Supplier Development & Qualification

- Assess, qualify, and develop suppliers to meet Intuitive's technical, quality, regulatory, and business requirements. 
 - Lead supplier manufacturing readiness activities for new products and process changes. 
 - Evaluate supplier processes, capacity, quality systems, and technical capabilities. 
 - Support supplier selection and sourcing activities through technical assessments and on-site audits. 

New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Partner with Design Engineering and suppliers to support Design for Manufacturability (DFM) initiatives. 
 - Drive supplier readiness for product launches and scale-up activities. 
 - Ensure supplier qualification deliverables are completed on schedule, including: 
 - Process Flow Diagrams
 - pFMEA
 - Control Plans
 - Process Capability Studies
 - First Article Inspection (FAI)
 - Measurement System Analysis (MSA)
 - PPQP/PPAP submissions
 - Facilitate successful transfer from development to production. 
Supplier Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Monitor supplier performance against quality, delivery, cost, and capacity metrics. 
 - Lead supplier corrective action activities utilizing structured problem-solving methodologies. 
 - Drive root cause investigations and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support supplier audits and quality system assessments. 
 - Promote continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects, improve process capability, and increase operational efficiency. 

Technical Manufacturing Support

- Provide expertise in various manufacturing processes. SME in either Metals or Electronics is a plus. 
 - Review engineering drawings and specifications, including GD&T requirements. 
 - Identify manufacturing risks and implement mitigation strategies. 

Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Manage supplier-related project plans, timelines, and risk mitigation activities. 
 - Coordinate with engineering, sourcing, quality, and operations teams to achieve project objectives. 
 - Present supplier performance, project status, and risk assessments to stakeholders. 

Qualifications

Skills/Job Requirements: 

Education

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field. 

Experience

5+ years of experience in one or more of the following: 

- Supplier Engineering
 - Manufacturing Engineering
 - Supplier Quality Engineering
 - Process Engineering
 - New Product Introduction

Technical Competencies

- Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and supplier development. 
 - Experience with APQP, PPAP, PPQP, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and capability studies. 
 - Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T. 
 - Experience conducting supplier audits and technical assessments. 
 - Structured problem-solving skills (5 Whys, Fishbone, CAPA, SCAR). 
 - Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in medical device, aerospace, robotics, or regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Exposure to global supply chains and international supplier management. 
 - Project management experience with concurrent programs and multiple suppliers. 
 - Familiarity with machining, castings, and complex electromechanical assemblies. 

Travel

- Ability to travel to suppliers (domestic and international) as needed: minimum 30%

Key Success Metrics

- On-time supplier qualification and NPI launches. 
 - Supplier quality performance and defect reduction. 
 - Supplier delivery and capacity readiness. 
 - Successful completion of PPQP/PPAP activities. 
 - Supplier risk reduction and business continuity improvements. 
 - Achievement of cost, quality, and operational improvement goals. 

Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. 

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. 

U. S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

- 743. 13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U. S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. 

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U. S. Government on your behalf (note: the government's licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan ("TCP") (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). 

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee's start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate's experience, knowledge and skills. 

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

Candidate's Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.

data.description:
Job Overview

Role Summary

The System Integration Test Engineer is responsible for executing system integration testing (SIT) across applications, devices, APIs, and data systems to ensure overall product quality and reliability. This role focuses on validating end-to-end workflows, performing functional and performance testing, and leveraging modern tools, automation, AI techniques, and database validation to support high-quality releases. 

A Day In The Life

Key Responsibilities

System Integration Testing

- Execute end-to-end SIT scenarios across multiple systems, including APIs, backend services, and user interfaces
 - Validate data flow, integration points, and system interactions
 - Identify, log, and track defects, integration issues, and inconsistencies
 - Support test planning, test case creation, and test execution

Automation & Modern Testing Tools

- Develop and execute automation scripts for regression and integration testing
 - Work with tools such as: 
 - Selenium / Cypress (UI testing)
 - Postman / REST Assured (API testing)
 - Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines
Performance & Load Testing (Basic)

- Assist in executing load and performance tests using tools such as: 
 - JMeter / k6
 - Analyze test results and identify basic performance bottlenecks
AI-Assisted Testing (Emerging Skills)

- Use AI-powered testing tools for: 
 - Test case generation
 - Defect prediction
 - Analysis of test results
 - Support implementation of intelligent automation practices
Database & Data Validation

- Validate data integrity across systems using: 
 - SQL queries

Defect Management & Troubleshooting

- Log and manage defects using tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps

 - Collaborate with development teams to resolve issues

Collaboration & Agile Participation

 - Sprint planning

 - Retrospectives
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams
What will help you thrive in this role?

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
 - 2+ years of experience in: 
 - Software testing / QA
 - System Integration Testing (preferred)
Technical Skills

Testing Tools

- API Testing: Postman, REST Assured

Performance Testing (Basic)

- JMeter, k6 (preferred)

Programming / Scripting

- Basic knowledge of: 
 - Python / Java / JavaScript
Database Skills

- Strong SQL fundamentals
 - Experience querying and validating data

AI Tools (Preferred)

- Exposure to AI-based testing tools or frameworks is a plus
 - Familiarity with automation optimization using AI

Other Skills

- Understanding of SDLC and STLC processes
 - Basic knowledge of API architecture and microservices
 - Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) is a plus

Key Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Attention to detail and quality focus
 - Good communication and collaboration skills
 - Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly
 - Proactive mindset toward automation and innovation

Preferred Experience

- Exposure to integration testing across multiple systems
 - Knowledge of basic performance testing concepts
 - Experience working with Agile teams

Success Metrics

- Test coverage and execution completeness
 - Defect detection effectiveness
 - Contribution to automation and efficiency improvements
 - Accuracy of data and integration validation

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. 

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. 

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

data.title: Engineering Manager-DTT
data.description:
The Opportunity

As Engineering Manager -DTT (Traction Transformer) at GEC India, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization delivering tender, order, product, and technology engineering services to global traction transformer factories and business units. You will translate business priorities into a clear engineering strategy, build scalable competencies and capacity, and establish robust governance for safe, compliant, high-quality, and on-time execution. Working closely with HUB engineering leaders, factories, product management, project management, supply chain, quality, and customers, you will drive standardization, digitalization, innovation, and continuous improvement while developing a strong leadership pipeline and an engaged, high-performing team. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Define and execute the GEC India engineering strategy and capability roadmap for traction transformers in alignment with Business Unit, Global Product Group, HUB, and factory priorities. 
 - Lead engineering delivery for tenders, customer orders, design modifications, product development, value engineering, and lifecycle support, ensuring committed quality, cost, and schedule targets are achieved. 
 - Establish effective governance for project allocation, design reviews, technical risk management, escalation, change control, documentation, and engineering release processes. 
 - Ensure traction transformer designs meet contractual requirements, applicable railway and transformer standards, customer specifications, internal design rules, and safety and regulatory expectations. 
 - Own capacity and workforce planning, competency mapping, succession planning, recruitment, onboarding, and technical development for electrical, mechanical, and related engineering disciplines. 
 - Develop team and technical experts, set clear objectives, coach performance, and foster an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage resource utilization, productivity, external engineering spending, and cost recovery while balancing demand across factories, HUBs, and projects. 
 - Define and monitor KPIs for on-time delivery, first-time-right quality, engineering hours, productivity, utilization, cost performance, customer satisfaction, and competency development; implement corrective actions where required. 
 - Drive design standardization, modularization, reuse, digital engineering, automation, and deployment of common tools and processes across the traction transformer engineering network. 
 - Partner with factories and cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues, support root-cause analysis, capture lessons learned, and improve product quality, manufacturability, reliability, and total cost. 
 - Build trusted relationships with global stakeholders and customers, communicate priorities and risks transparently, and represent GEC India in technical and operational reviews. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, information-security requirements, and engineering guidelines. 
 - Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for colleagues and the business. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering; a master's degree or formal qualification in engineering or business management is preferred. 
 - Typically, >14 years of progressive transformer engineering experience, including substantial experience in traction transformers and at least 5 years in people or functional leadership. 
 - Strong knowledge of traction transformer design, including electrical and mechanical design interfaces, dielectric and thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, losses, noise, insulation systems, cooling, materials, and manufacturing constraints. 
 - Demonstrated experience in tender engineering, order execution, design reviews, technical risk management, customer interfaces, and delivery of multiple projects in a global matrix organization. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable IEC, EN, railway, quality, and safety standards; familiarity with customer-specific and regional requirements is an advantage. 
 - Experience with engineering tools, product lifecycle management, design automation, digital workflows, and structured problem-solving methods such as Lean or Six Sigma are desirable. 
 - Proven ability to build and scale engineering teams, manage budgets and capacity, develop talent, lead change, and collaborate effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones. 
 - Strong commercial awareness, decision-making, stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. 
 - Fluent spoken and written English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

data.description:
KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets. 

Summary Section

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Process Engineer to lead and execute Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) and Detailed Engineering (DE) for new and revamp projects in petrochemical facilities. The candidate will have strong experience in both open-art and licensed process units such as olefins (steam cracking), aromatics (BTX), polymer units including LDPE, HDPE, polypropylene (PP), and butene/butene derivatives, along with hydrogen management systems, utilities, and tankage. The role involves close coordination with multidisciplinary teams, technology licensors, and EPC contractors to ensure technical integrity, compliance with project specifications, adherence to schedules, and timely delivery of high-quality engineering deliverables. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead and coordinate FEED and Detailed Engineering activities for open‐art units as well as licensed units. 
 - Liaise with technology licensors, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of project scope and technical specifications. 
 - Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, HMBs, and material selection diagrams. 
 - Support HAZID/HAZOP, SIL, and other risk assessments throughout the engineering phases. 
 - Prepare and review engineering deliverables including data sheets, technical specifications, design calculations, and layout drawings. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client specifications (e. g. , API, ASME, NFPA). 
 - Provide input for cost estimation, procurement strategies, and long-lead item identification. 
 - Monitor engineering progress against project milestones and intervene as necessary to resolve issues. 
 - Participate in design reviews, model reviews (3D), and constructability assessments. 
 - Provide technical support during procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. Qualifications including Required Education, Experience, & Skills: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in chemical engineering or equivalent. 
 - 15-20 years of relevant experience, with at least 5-8 years in petrochemical units. 
 - Proven track record in FEED and DE phases for large-scale petrochemical projects. 
 - Familiarity with leading licensors and their design packages. 
 - Strong knowledge of process simulation tools (e. g. , Aspen HYSYS, Aspen Plus). 
 - Effective communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills. 
 - Willingness to travel or relocate as per project requirements. 

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience in software development. 
 - 3 years of experience building developer tools (e. g. , compilers, automated releases, code design and testing, test automation frameworks). 
 - 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role. 
 - 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization. 

About the jobLike Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

Google One (G1) is Google's membership for personal cloud storage and Google's cutting-edge AI features. G1 is one of Google's fastest growing subscriptions, with over 150 million subscribers. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact team, shaping the future of our subscriber experiences, premium features and business growth initiatives. 

Responsibilities

- Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. 
 - Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching. 
 - Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap within the scope of the multiple teams. Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs. 
 - Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems. 
 - Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e. g. , style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

NTR (Network Traffic Redirector) is Mobileum's flagship in-path roaming traffic steering solution, deployed across 600+ operator networks worldwide and engineered for five-nines availability. data.title: ServiceNow Architect
data.description:
Join Verdantas - A Top #ENR 73 Firm, 

We at Verdantas, looking for a ServiceNow Architect to lead platform architecture, enterprise integrations, and governance, delivering scalable and high-performing ServiceNow solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

- 
 - Own the end-to-end solution architecture across ServiceNow product lines (ITSM, ITOM, ITBM/SPM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, as applicable). 
 - Define platform standards, design patterns, data models, and governance to ensure scalability, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Translate business requirements into robust technical designs and make build-vs-configure decisions that protect long-term platform health. 
Enterprise Integrations

- 
 - Architect and oversee integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems (ERP, CMDB sources, HRIS, identity/SSO, monitoring, and third-party APIs). 
 - Design integration solutions using Integration Hub, REST/SOAP web services, MID Servers, event-driven patterns, and data-import strategies. 
 - Establish integration governance, error-handling, reconciliation, and security standards; ensure reliable, auditable data flows across the enterprise. 
 - Lead CMDB/CSDM design and data integrity strategy across integrated sources. 
Team Leadership

- 
 - Lead and mentor a team of ServiceNow developers, admins, and consultants; set technical direction and uphold quality through design and code reviews. 
 - Own delivery quality across the SDLC - estimation, sprint planning, technical standards, and release management. 
 - Coach team members, grow platform capability, and manage technical dependencies across cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Partner with product owners, business leaders, and vendors to align the platform roadmap with organizational priorities. 
Governance & Strategy

- 
 - Chair the ServiceNow technical governance/CAB function; manage upgrades, technical debt, and instance strategy. 
 - Advise leadership on platform strategy, licensing implications, and emerging ServiceNow capabilities (including AI/Now Assist where relevant). 
Education & Experience

- 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or IT or degree in a relevant field
 - 10+ years in enterprise IT, with 5+ years architecting and delivering ServiceNow solutions at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex enterprise integrations with ServiceNow (Integration Hub, REST/SOAP, MID Server, web services, event/messaging patterns). 
 - Proven experience leading technical teams and owning delivery quality across multiple concurrent workstreams. 
 - Deep expertise in the ServiceNow platform: scripting (JavaScript, Glide), Flow Designer, Service Portal, ACLs/security, CMDB/CSDM, and performance optimization. 
 - Strong grasp of ITSM/ITIL processes and enterprise architecture principles. 
 - Excellent stakeholder communication - able to influence both engineers and executives. 
Certifications

- 
 - ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) strongly preferred (or Certified Master Architect). 
 - Certified System Administrator (CSA) required. 
 - One or more Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) credentials (e. g. , ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM). 
 - Integration Hub / relevant micro-certifications a plus. 
Preferred

- 
 - Exposure to Agile delivery, DevOps for ServiceNow (CI/CD, automated testing/ATF), and multi-instance/global deployments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and enterprise identity (SSO/SAML/OAuth). 
Location and Work Set-up

- 
 - Pune, Maharashtra, India
 - Work Mode: In Office

data.title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Engineering Leadership & Delivery

- Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services. 
 - Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments. 
 - Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them. 
 - Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team. 
 - Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization. 
 - Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities. 

Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

- Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. 
 - Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities. 
 - Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team. 
 - Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions. 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health. 

People Leadership & Team Development

- Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development. 
 - Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
 - Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation. 
 - Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities. 
 - Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment. 
 - Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team. 
 - Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors. 

AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation

- Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows. 
 - Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality. 
 - Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls. 
 - Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities. 
 - Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives. 

Operational Excellence & Production Ownership

- Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations. 
 - Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices. 
 - Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked. 
 - Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability. 
 - Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes. 
 - Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics. 

Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution

- Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities. 
 - Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership. 
 - Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team. 
 - Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk. 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery. 
 - Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development. 
 - Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms. 
 - Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications. 
 - Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities. 
 - Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles. 
 - Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance. 
 - Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows. 
 - Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions. 
 - Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities. 

AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE: 

- Experience leading engineering teams supporting Billing, Payments, Collections, or Commerce platforms. 
 - Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or in an architecture-focused role, bringing additional depth in technical design and engineering decision-making. 
 - Experience leading large-scale modernization, platform migration, or technical transformation initiatives. 
 - Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams or multiple engineering workstreams. 
 - Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted software development, or emerging agentic AI technologies. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling

 - Best Life Perk - we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
 - Premium Calm App - enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
 - Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don't just build technology-we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. 

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn't just the right thing to do-it's a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness. com.

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Description

Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire PV stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who We Are

We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As PV has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystalize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who understands and sets a high bar for all phases of the software development life-cycle, while hiring, coaching, developing and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. Your ability to foster a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices.

 - Contribute to the vision, goals, and technical strategy in alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. 
 - Mentor engineers, provide leadership on complex technical issues, design trade-offs, and feature and schedule prioritization. 
 - Innovate on behalf of customer

About The Team

- We are a team who value diversity, respect, and inclusiveness. We love mentoring and helping each other grow. 
 - Our technology choices and designs are driven from the engineers, not handed down from above. 
 - We have a lot of say for what goes into our product. We get to pitch our ideas up the chain, not the other way around.

Preferred Qualifications

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer Manager
data.description:
Role Summary

We're looking for an experienced SRE Manager to lead our Site Reliability Engineering team and own reliability strategy across our Cloud and Kubernetes platforms. You'll combine deep technical credibility with strong people leadership - setting direction, growing the team, and acting as the senior escalation point during the most critical incidents - while partnering closely with engineering and business leadership. 

This is a Rotational Shift role and an onsite position located at Bangalore, India. You will be required to work from the office on a full-time basis. We are only considering candidates who are within a commutable distance of our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. 

Position Details

About The Role

- Lead and grow a team of SREs, setting technical direction and reliability strategy across AWS, GCP infrastructure and EKS platforms, and GKE platforms. 
 - Own the organization's Incident and Problem Management processes, ensuring major incidents are handled efficiently, with timely executive communication and thorough post-incident reviews. 
 - Drive the team's automation strategy, championing Python-based tooling and frameworks that reduce manual toil and improve reliability at scale. 
 - Set standards for Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, ensuring secure, scalable, and consistent provisioning practices across teams. 
 - Define the organization's observability strategy, ensuring Grafana dashboards, alerting, and SQL/CloudWatch-based analysis practices scale effectively. 
 - Act as a senior escalation point and incident commander for the most critical, high-severity incidents, providing calm, decisive leadership under pressure. 
 - Partner with senior leadership, product, and engineering stakeholders to communicate risk, reliability posture, and remediation roadmaps clearly and confidently. 
 - Own hiring, mentoring, performance management, and career development for the SRE team. 
 - Design and build self-healing automation and runbooks that detect known failure patterns and trigger remediation automatically, reducing manual intervention and recovery time for recurring incidents. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring across multiple regions to ensure consistent visibility into system health, latency, and failover readiness across all deployment zones. 
 - Proactively identify potential failure points and performance bottlenecks before they impact production and reduce operational workload by automating recurring manual tasks. 
 - Drive ITSM process maturity across the organization, partnering with other teams to embed Incident and Problem Management best practices. 
 - Manage on-call structure, escalation paths, staffing, and operational readiness for the team. 
 - Report on reliability metrics, incident trends, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership. 

About You

- You should have 8-12 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or related disciplines, including significant experience leading and managing technical teams. 
 - You should have deep hands-on expertise with AWS infrastructure and the technical credibility to guide architecture, operational, and reliability decisions across complex cloud environments. 
 - You should have successfully led teams through complex EKS and GKE operational challenges, demonstrating strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in large-scale distributed systems. 
 - You should possess advanced proficiency in Python for automation and Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, with the ability to mentor engineers, review technical designs, and establish engineering best practices. 
 - You should have extensive experience owning and improving Incident and Problem Management processes, along with a strong understanding of observability tools and practices, including Grafana, SQL, CloudWatch Logs Insights, and alerting strategies. 
 - You should be an exceptional communicator who can clearly articulate technical risks, incident impacts, and reliability strategies to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders while building strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams. 
 - You should have a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing technical teams, creating an environment focused on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and long-term reliability. 
 - You should hold an AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent) and a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent Kubernetes certification, and you demonstrate strong leadership qualities through strategic thinking, incident leadership, people development, and stakeholder trust.

We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

BE/B. Tech. or equivalent technical qualification

Strong hands-on experience deploying, administering, automating, and troubleshooting OpenText xECM , and related components; cloud deployment experience is strongly preferred.

 - GitLab CI/CD: practical knowledge of pipeline configuration, reusable templates and shared libraries, automated build and testing, security checks, artifact management, approvals, deployment, rollback, and release management. 
 - Automation and infrastructure as code: experience with Terraform, Helm, Ansible, scripting, APIs, and automation of provisioning and operational workflows. 
 - Kubernetes and container orchestration: strong hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. Skills should include pods, deployments, services, ingress, ConfigMaps, secrets, namespaces, persistent storage, resource limits, autoscaling, rolling updates, health probes, RBAC, network policies, logging, monitoring, upgrades, and root-cause troubleshooting. Exposure to managed Kubernetes services such as GKE, EKS, or AKS is preferred. 
 - OpenText solutions: deployment, administration, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting experience with TeamSite, LiveSite, Exstream, OTMM, xECM, Documentum, or related platforms. 
 - Platform engineering: working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, web and application servers, databases, and secure application operations. 
 - Service reliability: experience with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management in Agile or Scrum delivery environments. 
 - Ability to lead a small technical team, review technical deliverables, mentor engineers, and provide clear technical direction. 
 - Strong problem-solving, ownership, and customer-service mindset, with disciplined attention to reliability and quality. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams. 
 - Continuous-learning mindset and willingness to evaluate and adopt new AI, automation, cloud, and SRE practices. 

One last thing

- Programming or scripting experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Shell, or PowerShell. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server. 
 - Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, LDAP, object-oriented programming, and application integration patterns.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer based in India.

Beyond hands-on development, you will contribute to architectural decisions, mentor fellow developers, and help shape the technical roadmap. This fully remote opportunity offers significant ownership, modern development tools, and a collaborative environment where engineering excellence and measurable impact are valued. 

Accountabilities

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will take ownership of the architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement of scalable e-commerce software solutions. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Planning, architecting, and developing Shopify applications, plugins, and API integrations. 
 - Building full-stack solutions using React, Next. js, Node. js, Express, and TypeScript. 
 - Integrating third-party systems, including ERP, payment, CRM, and logistics platforms, through REST and GraphQL APIs. 
 - Ensuring application performance, code quality, security, maintainability, and scalability.
