About Envestnet

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by over 25 years of experience and approximately $7. 0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs. 

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www. envestnet. com. 

The Team You'll Join

On the Tamarac development team, we build one of the industry's most advanced portfolio management and trading platforms for RIAs. We tackle complex engineering challenges every day from large scale data ingestion and analytics to deep system integrations, high performance trading algorithms, and a robust full stack web experience used by thousands of advisors. 

As we continue to scale the platform-supporting 50+ million trades annually-we're modernizing our architecture to meet growing demand while delivering innovative, advisor focused features. Our engineers collaborate across disciplines to build AI powered insights, enhance cross platform capabilities, and design resilient, cloud native systems. 

This is a rare opportunity to join us in shaping the technical roadmap of a leading trading platform-driving how we scale, evolve, and deliver capabilities that elevate both the advisor and client experience, with real world impact from day one. 

How You'll Contribute

Responsible for building scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements. 

- Designs, develops, and maintains complex features or system components. 
 - Leads technical design for small-to-medium features or services. 
 - Identifies root causes of issues and implement robust, scalable fixes. 
 - Optimizes code for performance, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Mentors junior engineers (P1-P2) and provide technical guidance. 
 - Drives improvements in coding standards, testing practices, and CI/CD processes. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to refine requirements and clarify technical constraints. 
 - Troubleshoots production issues and lead resolution efforts. 
 - Balances multiple priorities across projects with minimal supervision. 
 - Implements and improves basic observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) for owned services. 
 - Supports production troubleshooting in collaboration with DevOps/SRE teams. 
 - Partners with DevOps/SRE to improve system reliability, deployment automation, and observability. 
 - Designs and maintains CI/CD pipelines for owned services, improving deployment speed and safety. 
 - Implements infrastructure-aware design decisions (scalability, failover, resiliency, cost). 
 - Leverages agentic coding tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to increase personal productivity across development, testing, and code review phases of the SDLC. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- Candidates should demonstrate the relevant experience, skills, and capabilities needed to successfully perform in the role. Relevant experience may be gained through current responsibilities, prior roles, project work, leadership opportunities, or other comparable experiences. 
 - Strong proficiency in . NET, C#, RESTful APIs, and relational/NoSQL database design. 
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and Redis. 
 - Experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudWatch. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, observability practices, agile/Scrum delivery, test-driven development, and code quality standards. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot and resolve production issues independently and lead resolution efforts within owned services. 
 - Experience mentoring P1-P2 engineers and contributing to team technical standards. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML systems, LLM-based applications, or data pipeline work preferred. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field required; master's degree preferred. 
 - Software engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of complex features or system components in production environments. 

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future. 

The opportunity is now!

Our Investment in You

At Envestnet, our total rewards philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and grow exceptional talent. We offer competitive, market-aligned compensation complemented with performance-linked incentives and rewards programs that recognize and reward impact. 

In addition, we provide a comprehensive suite of benefits - subject to Envestnet's plan eligibility rules - that support your overall well-being, including medical insurance for you and your family, annual health check-ups, free online doctor consultations and telemedicine services, subsidized health club memberships, and an employee assistance program. Our investment in you means supporting you professionally, financially, and personally at every stage of your journey with us. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

Envestnet is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of religion, race, color, caste, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, medical condition, nationality, ethnic origin, marital status, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. This commitment is in accordance with the Constitution of India and applicable labor and employment laws. All employment decisions are made solely based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. 

We strive to provide an inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at [email protected]. Please include your full name, the title of the role you are applying for, and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

Recruitment Fraud

At Envestnet, safeguarding the trust and safety of job seekers is a top priority. We are aware that scammers may impersonate Envestnet recruiters or create fake job opportunities to deceive candidates. Review the information on our recruitment fraud awareness page to help you recognize and avoid recruitment fraud.

data.description:
Job Description: Senior Backend Java Developer

Job Title: Senior Backend Java Developer

Experience: 5+ Years

Location: Mohali, India

Work Mode: Work from Office (Full-time, On-site)

Shift time is -7: 30 am to 3: 30 pm. 

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Java Developer with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Apache Kafka, MySQL, Docker, and Kubernetes. 

The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing backend services, designing scalable REST APIs, and managing integrations with internal and external systems. The role also involves taking ownership of existing microservices, troubleshooting production issues, maintaining Kubernetes deployments, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Take ownership of 2-3 assigned microservices, including application controllers, BSS controllers, notification services, schedulers, and exporters. 
 - Understand, document, maintain, and improve existing business logic across microservices. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance REST APIs. 
 - Implement Kafka producers and consumers for push and email notification pipelines. 
 - Integrate applications with external systems, including BSS, ASM, ATG, FCM/Firebase, email systems, and Vault. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established coding standards. 
 - Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback. 
 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests. 
 - Maintain Helm charts and Kubernetes deployment configurations. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and support L3/L4 escalations for owned services. 
 - Contribute to technical documentation, test strategies, deployment procedures, and architecture reviews. 
 - Mentor junior developers and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies. Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of professional backend software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot for microservices development. 
 - Strong experience with Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topics, and consumer groups. 
 - Solid knowledge of MySQL, complex queries, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including pods, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and resource management. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, including OpenAPI and Swagger documentation. 
 - Understanding of JWT, OAuth2, and token-based authentication and authorization. 
 - Experience integrating Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications. 
 - Proficiency in Git and feature-branch workflows. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD. 
 - Hands-on experience with Helm charts. 
 - Good understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies. Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, or Spring Scheduler. 
 - Familiarity with HashiCorp Vault for secrets and certificate management. 
 - Knowledge of Strimzi Operator and Kafka on Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with Micrometer, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Familiarity with distributed tracing tools such as Jaeger or Zipkin. 
 - Knowledge of the Telecom domain, particularly BSS/OSS provisioning workflows and account management. 
 - Experience with ELK Stack, Loki, or APM tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, or Datadog. 
 - Familiarity with Istio or Envoy service mesh technologies. 
 - Experience with JUnit 5, Mockito, and Testcontainers. 
 - CKAD certification is an added advantage. Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership, accountability, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. 
 - Comfortable working with geographically distributed teams across different cultures and time zones. 
 - Delivery-oriented mindset with the ability to meet strict deadlines. 
 - Willingness to learn, document, and take ownership of existing systems. Work Location and Reporting

This position is based in Mohali, India, and requires full-time, on-site presence on all working days. This is not a work-from-home position.

At Vertiv, we don't just hire talent-we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what's possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next-gen technology-and we need bold, high-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.

The P3 Digital Automation and AI Specialist is a senior-level subject matter expert within the Optimization Team, responsible for developing and delivering AI solutions, scaling automation initiatives, and uplifting team capabilities across the organization. This role combines hands-on AI development experience (including tools like Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other LLM platforms) with software development skills and practical RPA expertise in business contexts such as finance, procurement, and sales. 

As a people-oriented leader and experienced subject matter expert, the Specialist drives AI adoption by building and deploying solutions, training colleagues on AI tools and methodologies, and coaching team members to develop their own expertise. The role also involves product and project management, ensuring initiatives move from concept to delivery with clear ownership and accountability. 

The role demands a results-driven mindset, strong training skills, and the ability to bring personal expertise to uplift others. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives on getting things done, enjoys teaching and mentoring, and can bridge the gap between technical AI capabilities and real-world business outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Development & Delivery

- Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions leveraging platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other LLM/generative AI tools 
 - Apply software development skills to build custom integrations, APIs, and AI-powered applications that solve business challenges 
 - Leverage RPA experience to automate processes in business-critical areas such as finance, procurement, and sales 
 - Own the full lifecycle of AI projects, from requirements gathering and prototyping through deployment and iteration

Training & Knowledge Sharing

- Develop and deliver training programs on AI tools for teams across the organization 
 - Conduct hands-on workshops, lunch-and-learns, and structured training sessions to build AI literacy and practical skills 
 - Create reusable training materials, guides, and documentation to support ongoing learning and adoption 
 - Promote AI capabilities and use cases to drive awareness and enthusiasm for AI adoption across business functions

Team Coaching & Mentorship

- Coach and mentor team members at all levels, sharing personal expertise to accelerate their growth and technical capabilities 
 - Foster a people-oriented team culture focused on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support 
 - Help scale AI and automation solutions by enabling others to build, maintain, and extend solutions independently 
 - Lead guild sessions and community-of-practice meetings to share best practices, emerging AI trends, and lessons learned across teams

Scaling & Continuous Improvement

- Scale successful AI and automation solutions across business units, ensuring broad adoption and measurable impact 
 - Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and pilot programs to validate new AI technologies and identify high-value use cases 
 - Drive a results-oriented culture focused on getting things done, continuous improvement, and delivering tangible business value through AI and automation

Qualifications & Requirements

Education & Experience

- 5-8+ years of experience in AI solution development, automation, and digital transformation, with hands-on experience using AI/LLM platforms (e. g. , Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT). Demonstrated software development skills and practical RPA experience in business contexts such as finance, procurement, or sales. Product or project management experience preferred. 
 - Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred in IT, Computer Science, Data Science, or related discipline. 

Technical Skills

- Proficiency in AI/LLM tools (Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar), software development (Python, JavaScript, or comparable languages), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI), RPA development, API design, and project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or SAFe). 

Core Competencies & Soft Skills

- People-oriented mindset, strong training and facilitation skills, results-driven attitude, coaching and mentoring ability, cross-functional collaboration, clear communication, and a passion for teaching others and driving AI adoption. 

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv's Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

data.title: Sr. SDET
data.description:
About Us

Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry's first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end-to-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics-all delivered with enterprise-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential. 

Senior SDET - AI-Driven Quality Engineering

Full-Time

- Engineering
 - Quality
 - AI & Automation

Location : Bangalore / Hyderabad

We are looking for a Senior SDET who brings together deep automation expertise and a forward-looking AI-first mindset to redefine how quality is built into our products. You will lead the charge in adopting AI-powered testing tools, intelligent defect analysis, and autonomous test generation - while remaining the quality champion your team relies on. 

- Job Roles and Responsibilities
 - Champion an AI-first testing culture - proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML-powered tools into test design, execution, maintenance, and defect analysis. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test authoring, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort in test script maintenance. 
 - Apply AI-driven visual testing and self-healing automation techniques to reduce flakiness and keep test suites resilient across rapid UI changes. 
 - Leverage large language models (LLMs) and AI assistants to generate test cases from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria - then validate, refine, and own the output. 
 - Implement AI-augmented log and anomaly analysis to proactively identify patterns that precede failures in production or staging environments. 
 - Quickly gain a deep understanding of the solution domain; analyze customer-reported defects and implement automation strategies - powered by AI where applicable - to prevent recurrence. 
 - Be the first customer to the product and its documentation; provide feedback from the customer's perspective and act as the quality champion for the team. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, developers, UX/UI designers, developers and SDETs to understand functionality, identify test scenarios, and ensure comprehensive coverage. 
 - Review all backend and engineering stories assigned, assess impact, and define test coverage with an AI-assisted risk-based approach. 
 - Perform functional, integration, end-to-end, performance and regression testing across all release phases, augmented by AI-driven test selection and prioritization. 
 - Set up, maintain, and evolve test automation frameworks across Web, Desktop, and Mobile - incorporating AI capabilities for smarter execution and maintenance. 
 - Write and maintain automation code for front-end & back-end testing; apply AI tools to assist in debugging, refactoring, and coverage gap analysis. 
 - Build automation for customer use-case scenarios and customer reported defects; use AI-generated scenario suggestions to expand coverage beyond manual thinking. 
 - Contribute actively to API/integration testing, UI automation, TDD, ATDD, and code quality tooling - using AI to boost throughput at every layer. 
 - Diagnose and resolve CI/CD pipeline issues; apply AI-based observability tools to detect and predict build instability. 
 - Perform database querying and log analysis for root cause investigation; use AI-assisted analysis where available to speed up triage. 
 - Share knowledge with the team through workshops and learning sessions focused on AI tools, testing innovation, and SDET skill development. 
 - Continuously evaluate and introduce new AI-powered testing tools and methodologies; advocate for adoption across the team. 
 - Contribute to initiatives that improve team processes, tooling, and product quality - with a bias toward intelligent automation over manual toil. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of test strategies, automation processes, and AI tooling decisions to ensure knowledge is accessible and transferable. 
 - Candidates who bring hands-on experience with RAG-based conversational AI and have tested conversational bots with automated frameworks that validate multi-turn flows across intent recognition, context retention, response accuracy, and end-to-end workflow validations will be a compelling fit for this role. 
 - Job Requirements
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5-7 years of experience in SDET or quality engineering roles, with demonstrable exposure to AI-assisted testing or tooling. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and modern software testing methodologies. 
 - Proficiency in Java, Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; ability to write, review, and debug automation code at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with Playwright/Selenium for UI and API testing. 
 - Practical experience with one or more AI-powered testing tools - such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, similar. 
 - Familiarity with using LLMs or AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc. ) to accelerate test authoring, code review, or defect analysis. 
 - Experience with self-healing test frameworks or AI-driven test maintenance strategies is a strong plus. 
 - Understanding TDD, BDD, and ATDD techniques & integrating it into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Working knowledge of database querying and log/anomaly analysis, including AI-assisted observability platforms. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and the ability to triage, stabilize, and improve build and deployment workflows. 
 - Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated test output - validating, refining, and taking ownership rather than accepting it at face value. 
 - Knows when to ask for help, communicates clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders, and documents AI tool decisions transparently. 
 - Problem-solving mindset with the ability to debug complex issues in both handwritten and AI-generated automation code. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Collaborative team player who leads by example in driving a culture of quality, innovation, and continuous improvement. 

All unsolicited resumes submitted to any @automationanywhere. com email address, whether submitted by an individual or by an agency, will not be eligible for an agency fee.

data.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun - where everyone can succeed. 

Join us to transform the way the world works. 

Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 

Hiring Team Description: 

LinkedIn Learning Solutions Engineering India is a ground-up, AI-first org building scalable systems and consumer-grade experiences that connect skills, learning, career growth, and internal mobility across LinkedIn Learning and the enterprise Career Hub. Engineers own end-to-end delivery across web, mobile, backend, data, and AI - designing architectures for skills intelligence, skill-gap detection, personalized recommendations, workforce transformation, and internal mobility-while shaping engineering standards, culture, and hiring in a greenfield environment with LinkedIn's scale. 

LinkedIn Learning is entering a significant new phase of growth and innovation. What started as a learning platform has evolved into a much broader vision: helping organizations understand, develop, and transform workforce capabilities at scale. Our new Learning Solutions Engineering charter is going to be built ground-up from India exclusively and is building AI-powered experiences that connect skills, learning, career growth, and internal mobility. 

The Learning Solutions Engineering team is being built to drive this next chapter. This is a rare opportunity to join a business that already serves millions of professionals globally while helping shape the future of AI-powered workforce transformation. 

About the Role: 

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the design and delivery of AI-native systems that solve real product and business problems. You'll set technical direction for how we apply LLMs and agentic systems at scale , from prototyping to production-grade, evaluated, and observable systems. 

What You'll Do

- Design and build agentic workflows that orchestrate multi-step reasoning, tool use, and decision-making across complex tasks
 - Architect and scale Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines - including chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval strategy - for accuracy and latency at production scale
 - Own prompt engineering practices: design, iterate, and systematize prompts across use cases, balancing reliability, cost, and latency
 - Build robust evaluation frameworks (offline and online) to measure model/agent quality, catch regressions, and guide iteration
 - Partner closely with product, data science, and infra teams to translate ambiguous problems into scoped AI-powered solutions
 - Drive technical decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, and build-vs-buy for AI infrastructure
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers; raise the technical bar for applied AI practices org-wide
 - Stay current with the fast-moving LLM/agent ecosystem and pragmatically bring relevant advances into the roadmap

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

- BS Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline or related practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years hands-on building applied AI/LLM-based systems in production

Nice to Have

- Experience with fine-tuning or custom model training
 - Familiarity with LLM observability/tracing tools . 
 - Experience in a high-scale consumer or enterprise product environment
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping agentic workflows (multi-step tool-calling, planning, orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, custom agent loops, etc. )
 - Strong grasp of RAG system design - retrieval quality, embedding strategies, vector DBs, hybrid search
 - Deep experience with prompt engineering methodologies and prompt/version management at scale
 - Proven track record building evaluation systems for LLM outputs (automated evals, human-in-the-loop review, regression suites, LLM-as-judge techniques)
 - Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, APIs, and production-grade software engineering
 - Excellent communication skills; able to explain AI system trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Suggested Skills: 

- LLM
 - Backend Development
 - Distributed Systems

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer, VP
data.description:
Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer

- In this key role, you'll improve, drive, and embed non-functional and operational characteristics such as availability, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, security, incident response, and capacity planning of our products and services
 - You'll enjoy significant stakeholder interaction, working in collaboration with engineers to ensure a principled approach to deliver change in a safe and secure way
 - This is a chance to join an inclusive team with a collaborative ethos and a commitment to innovation and professional development
 - We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

As our Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work closely with our feature team and other colleagues to meet defined service level objectives and continually improve systems and environments. You'll define error budgets that support finding the right balance between risk and reliability. 

You'll also provide structure and help to our release process, suggesting and making improvements where possible. You'll scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, evolving them by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity. We'll also look to you to coach and provide guidance to colleagues and the wider team, leading where required. 

In Addition To This, You'll

- Proactively contribute new ideas and innovations to meet short term and longer-term goals
 - Continually balance and manage any potential risks
 - Be accountable for the day-to-day health of both production and non-production environments and respond to any incidents as required
 - Provide technical expertise and input to establish the risk tolerance of products and services
 - Communicate incident status updates clearly and frequently to other teams, customers and stakeholders

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with strong knowledge of reliability systems thinking and experience of software engineering. You'll need experience of using a data driven and scientific approach to fact finding. We'll also look for financial services knowledge, and the ability to identify wider business impact, risk and opportunity, and make connections across key outputs and processes

We're Also Looking For

- Strong SRE and production support expertise, including SLI/SLOs, incident/problem management, ITIL, resilience and operational reliability with 12+ years of experience
 - Strong technical experience across AWS, Java/Spring Boot, Microservices, React, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, automation and AIOps. 
 - Proven technical leadership and mentoring, with strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills.

 - Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation for automated test suites, RPA workflows, and technical procedures. 

Who Are We Looking For

Qualifications & Requirements

- Technical Proficiency: Solid experience in test automation using Selenium WebDriver with Java. 
 - Framework Knowledge: Proven track record in building frameworks from scratch using Maven and the Page Object Model (POM). 
 - RPA Experience: Practical experience or strong willingness to lead the implementation of UiPath. 
 - General Skills: Familiarity with version control systems (e. g. , Git), build tools, and CI/CD concepts. 
 - Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to automation strategy. 

Language: Fluent in English (German language skills are a plus). 

Perks & Benefits

- The opportunity to shape our automation strategy from the ground up. 
 - Work with a modern tech stack and influence the future of our RPA deployment. 
 - A collaborative environment that values continuous learning and professional development. 

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Join our global team of 18, 000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs. worldline. com

data.description:
About The Role

Freight Tiger is looking for an Integration Lead to own end-to-end customer integration delivery between the Freight Tiger platform and customer ERP, SAP and Third party systems. The role combines technical integration expertise, solution design, customer engagement and delivery ownership. The person will work with customer IT/SAP teams, Integration Solution Engineers, Product, Engineering and DevOps to take integrations from requirements to production. This can be a strong IC or a team-lead role, depending on experience. The person should be comfortable designing solutions, guiding engineers, managing delivery and resolving production issues.

Customer & Solution Ownership

- Own customer integration requirements and act as the primary technical integration contact. 
 - Lead requirement and solution-design discussions with customer IT/SAP teams. 
 - Understand business flows and translate them into practical integration solutions. 
 - Define integration architecture, interfaces, data mappings and dependencies. 
 - Identify risks, effort and technical constraints early. 

Integration Delivery

- Drive integrations end-to-end: Design → Development → SIT/UAT → Go-Live → Hypercare. 
 - Guide Integration Solution Engineers and review their technical implementation. 
 - Work hands-on with Dell Boomi or other similar integration platform, APIs and data transformations when required. 
 - Ensure appropriate security, error handling, retry and reconciliation mechanisms. 
 - Coordinate with Engineering, Product, DevOps and external implementation partners. 

Delivery & Production

- Own delivery plans, milestones, dependencies and customer commitments. 
 - Proactively identify and resolve delivery blockers and risks. 
 - Support customer go-lives and production troubleshooting. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of integration issues. 
 - Maintain key integration documentation and reusable implementation patterns.

- Mentor and provide technical direction to Integration Solution Engineers. 
 - Contribute to integration standards, reusable patterns and improved delivery practices. 
 - People management experience is an added advantage. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 5 to 10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, API integration or technical delivery.

 - Practical experience with SAP ECC/S4HANA integrations, preferably IDoc, RFC/JCo or OData.

 - Synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven integration

 - Basic distributed systems and microservices concepts

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer to work on Qualys' next-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys' next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open source technologies, and work on challenging and business-impacting projects. 

Responsibilities

As a data platform engineer you will be responsible for the team running data stored with millions of transactions per second, scaling 100s of terrabytes of data. Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys. 

You will be reviewing the application architecture and identify the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting edge technologies and do POC and then responsible for rolling out in production. Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open source community if any enhancement needed to fit in Qualys ecosystem. 

You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate, burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero or least amount of downtime. 

You will be responsible for delivering resilient client SDKs to the applications to communicate with the data source you are responsible for. 

You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current scaling, availability and cost effective alternative solutions. 

Co-develop with a strong sense of ownership Qualys' big-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first-rate experience to our customers. 

Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys' business objectives. 

Produce high quality software following good architecture and design principles that you and your team will find easy to work with in the future. 

A day in the life. . . 

- Apply advanced concepts, theories and principles to create multi-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations 
 - Contribute to development of new data platform principles and concepts 
 - Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys 
 - Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys 
 - Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams 
 - Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams

Who You Are. . . 

- A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies. 
 - A teacher. You're able to mentor your peers and help our team grow. 
 - A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding. 
 - A pragmatist. Your goal is to create useful products, not build technology for technology's sake. 
 - An empath. You understand what the customer needs and use that perspective to create the best user experience. 

How We Work. . . 

- With others. We have remote pairing tools where engineers often work together, as well as virtual collaboration tools for building out architecture solutions. 
 - With transparency. We encourage open dialog and discourse. We don't encourage silos. 
 - With agility. We don't believe in following a process for process's sake. We ship frequently and focus on delivering incremental value. 
 - With open minds. We are committed to building a diverse team of people with unique perspectives. This encourages a healthy and inclusive environment that builds a more sustainable, successful company. 
 - With pride. We value our people most of all. We invest in ourselves by applying our own strengths and interests to company needs. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience . 
 - 6+ years hands-on experience with developing SaaS based software products and solutions for service-oriented deployments in public (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, etc. ) or private clouds. 
 - Prior experience with RDBMS systems and NoSQL databases. 
 - Proven expertise in data-driven critical thinking problem-solving 
 - Ability to debug systems of software and people 
 - Demonstrated ability to write high-quality, production-ready code (readable, well-tested, with well-designed APIs) 
 - Demonstrated passion for innovation with an ability to work within agile software development methodologies 
 - Experience with infrastructure orchestration and automation tools (Terraform) 
 - Hands-on experience using CI/CD pipelines 
 - Data platform design / build utilizing Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Ceph, Flink, Spark or similar technologies 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills. 
 - Java programming skills including object-oriented design, prototyping, development, testing, profiling, etc. 
 - Knowledge of JVM concepts like garbage collection, heap, stack, profiling, class loading, etc. 
 - Strong in data structures and algorithms. 
 - Ability to clearly articulate and communicate technical concepts within and across teams. 
 - Knowledge of the below is a plus

 - Experience with applying data encryption and data security standards.

data.title: Leadership - System Engineering

We are looking for an experienced systems engineering leader to head our Systems Engineering function for UAV/UAS platform development. In this senior leadership role, you will build and lead a high-performing team of systems engineers, owning end-to-end system architecture, requirements management, and verification & validation across our unmanned aerial platforms - including hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing systems. You will be the technical authority bridging mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload sub-disciplines, ensuring the platform is engineered as a coherent, certifiable, and mission-ready system, while partnering closely with program management, manufacturing, quality, and customers to deliver robust, field-proven products.

- Establish, lead, and continuously mature the Systems Engineering function - defining processes, tools, and governance for requirements management, system architecture, interface control, and verification & validation (V&V) across the UAV product portfolio. 2

 - Lead make-vs-buy and vendor technical evaluations for critical subsystems (propulsion, avionics, payload, navigation) and manage technical relationships with external partners and consultants.

data.title: Senior Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
data.description:
Role Summary

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you'll provide deep reliability and operational expertise for business-critical cloud services. You'll help set the reliability strategy (for example, defining SLOs and error budgets), design the observability and automation that keep services balanced, and lead improvements that reduce operational risk and customer impact. This role suits people who enjoy solving complex production problems and raising the standard for engineering excellence-regardless of whether your background is SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering with strong operations experience. 

On-call: You'll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. As a senior specialist, you'll help improve how we run on-call by reducing noisy alerts, automating repetitive tasks, and strengthening operational readiness so incidents become less frequent and easier to resolve. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly and continuously improve the on-call experience. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own reliability outcomes for critical user journeys and cloud components by defining SLIs/SLOs, setting error budgets, and using data to prioritise resilience work. 
 - Design observability standards (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting) using tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly. 
 - Lead major incident response as incident commander when needed, drive blameless post-incident reviews, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and measured. 
 - Improve platform resilience and scalability through reliability architecture reviews, capacity and performance engineering, and proactive risk assessments. 
 - Reduce toil by automating repetitive operational work (for example with Terraform, CI/CD, and scripting), and track improvements through clear operational metrics. 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Security, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, compliance obligations, and customer impact. 
 - Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and change procedures, and raise standards through reviews, templates, and shared practices. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers, helping teams adopt SRE ways of working and strengthening operational ownership. 

What You'll Bring

- Significant experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) supporting production services and making reliability improvements that stick. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of reliability practices such as SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident actions, and operational readiness. 
 - Strong AWS knowledge and hands-on experience operating cloud services (for example: EKS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and CloudWatch/CloudWatch Insights). 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (for example, Terraform) and with CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitLab CI/CD). 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, including production operations on managed platforms such as Amazon EKS. 
 - Ability to script to automate and solve (for example, Python and/or JavaScript), with an engineering approach to testing, review, and maintainability. 
 - Experience building actionable monitoring and alerting that balances sensitivity and noise (for example, Datadog and CloudWatch). 
 - Confidence presenting, staying calm during incidents, and influencing teams through data, clear writing, and pragmatic recommendations. 

Good to have Skills: 

Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, networking, security, policy, and multi-tenant considerations). 

Experience with performance testing, load testing, and capacity modelling for cloud-native services. 

Software engineering experience in Python and/or JavaScript beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews). 

Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric develop, alert tuning, incident analytics). 

We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India '25

Career Stage: 

Senior Associate

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information: 

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

data.title: Staff DFT Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are hiring a Staff DFT Engineer to lead DFT strategy, architecture, and implementation for complex, high-performance SoCs. You will define methodologies, and drive DFT from RTL to silicon bring-up, ensuring optimal quality, cost, and time-to-market. 

What You'll Do

- Define DFT architecture and test strategy for SoCs, including scan, compression, MBIST, LBIST, and IO test. 
 - Lead ATPG pattern generation, optimization, and diagnosis flows across multiple fault models. 
 - Architect and oversee MBIST, BISR, and memory repair solutions for large memory arrays. 
 - Design and implement advanced test access mechanisms using JTAG, Boundary Scan (BSCAN), and IJTAG (IEEE 1687). 
 - Drive DFT timing closure, power-aware DFT, and hierarchical/multi-core test strategies. 
 - Own pre-silicon DFT verification (ATPG simulation, GLS) and coverage closure. 
 - Lead silicon bring-up, ATE test program development, post-silicon validation, debug, and yield improvement. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate DFT into the overall design flow and resolve complex issues. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers; contribute to methodology development and tool evaluation. 
 - Optimize test time, data volume, and manufacturing test costs. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's/master's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering. 
 - 8+ years of strong hands-on experience in DFT for complex SoC/ASIC projects. 
 - Expert-level knowledge of ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, IJTAG, BSCAN, scan compression, and related areas. 
 - Proven track record in silicon bring-up, ATE support, and post-silicon debug. 
 - Deep understanding of full ASIC flow (RTL to Silicon) and DFT impact on PPA. 
 - Proficiency with leading EDA tools (Synopsys TetraMAX/DFTMAX, Siemens/Tessent SSN, TestKompress etc. ). 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills. 

Good To Have

- Knowledge of advanced topics like 2. 5D/3D packaging test, analog/mixed-signal DFT. 

Job Location

Hybrid/ On-site - Bangalore / Remote - India

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk. 

READY TO JOIN?

This position partners with cross-functional teams to develop validation strategies, guide testing and data migration/transformation activities, support system lifecycle changes, drive process improvements, support supplier/3rd Party vendors oversight validation activities, and ensure solutions meet business, quality, cybersecurity, and GxP requirements and keep the system audit-ready. 

Work Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)

Shift Timing - 3: 00 PM - 12: 00 AM

How You'll Create Impact

- Leads multiple concurrent high-complexity software validation projects, enhancements, and changes which align to defined procedures
 - Leads gap and risk analysis of IT system changes to ensure appropriate testing levels/strategies are identified as per CSV/CSA principles across projects and platforms. 
 - Works with project teams to develop, review, and approve comprehensive risk-based validation lifecycle documentation, including Validation Plans, Risk Assessments, Requirements, Traceability Matrices, IQ/OQ/UAT Test cases, Validation Summary Reports, and Change Control documentation aligned with CSV, CSA, GAMP 5, and regulatory expectations
 - Guides testing to ensure the quality of software meets the approved intended use prior to production release
 - Define risk-based verification strategies, advising project teams on functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, infrastructure, and automated testing approaches based on system complexity, intended use, and regulatory risk. 
 - Develop validation strategy for data migration/transformation activities by defining migration verification methodologies, reconciliation processes, sampling strategies, traceability requirements, data integrity controls, and acceptance criteria to ensure complete and accurate migration of regulated data
 - Provides change management support for regulated applications by performing change impact assessments, reviewing change requests, defining regression testing requirements, and evaluating implementation risks
 - Develop and deliver structured training and mentoring programs on Computer Software Assurance (CSA), Computer System Validation (CSV), validation lifecycle processes, ALM, and risk-based testing methodologies to improve process consistency
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating existing validation processes, identifying operational inefficiencies, recommending standardized methodologies, and implementing best practices that improve compliance, consistency, quality, and delivery efficiency
 - Acts as a cross-functional resource by partnering with Business, Quality, and Technical teams and ensures compliance with regulatory and corporate policies and standards. 
 - Provide validation guidance for cloud-based, SaaS, and hybrid-hosted applications. 
 - Meet defined deadlines for assigned tasks and scheduled deliverables
 - Support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits by providing Computer System Validation expertise and required validation evidence, and inspection-ready documentation. 
 - Provides mentoring and coaching to junior team members
 - Apply concepts of appropriate standard methodologies and best practices
 - Leads the adoption of validation practices for AI-enabled systems by developing risk-based validation approaches

Preferred Validation Experience

- Partner with Information Security and Infrastructure teams to assess cybersecurity-related system changes and determine validation impact, testing requirements, and compliance considerations. 
 - Provide validation guidance for assessment of supplier controls, infrastructure qualification reliance, and shared responsibility considerations

What Makes You Stand Out

- Experience with Medical Device or Pharmaceutical industries desired. 
 - Advanced knowledge of applicable global regulations and industry guidance, including 21 CFR Part 11, 21 CFR Part 820, GAMP 5 (2nd Edition), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), Data Integrity (ALCOA+), and risk-based validation methodologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to interpret regulatory expectations and translate them into practical validation strategies for enterprise software implementations and system changes. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, system integrations, APIs, interfaces, data flows, middleware, cloud technologies, authentication mechanisms, and database concepts sufficient to assess validation impact and testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile, V-model, Waterfall, Hybrid SDLC methodologies. 
 - Highly motivated self-starter with strong attention to detail and proven ability to prioritize and scope work. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Flexibility to handle demands of a rapidly growing and changing workplace. 
 - General wide breadth of knowledge of the different Microsoft Office applications. 
 - Advanced experience with test management tools (ALM)
 - Working knowledge of validation considerations for AI-enabled software solutions. 
 - Ability to assess validation implications of emerging technologies while ensuring continued compliance with regulatory expectations. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, Engineering, Science, or related field. 
 - A minimum of 10plus years in an FDA/ISO regulated industry working on Computerized System Validation (CSV) activities. 
 - Demonstrated experience supporting GxP regulated computerized systems. 
 - Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA). 
 - Experience leading validation activities for enterprise software implementations, upgrades, migrations, and integrations. 

Travel Expectations

Up to 15%

data.description:
Position Title: DevSecOps Engineer, IE&O

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 45078

Role Overview

The DevSecOps Engineer is a senior hands-on engineering role within the Enterprise Infrastructure Platform Engineering team. The role designs, implements, secures, and operates resilient cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevSecOps platforms, with a strong focus on automation, developer enablement, governance, reliability, and measurable delivery outcomes. 

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and also Google Cloud, the engineer partners with platform architects, security, application, data, and AI teams to embed security, quality, observability, and change controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. The role also advances responsible use of generative and agentic AI in infrastructure-as-code and engineering workflows, supported by appropriate guardrails, human oversight, and FinOps discipline. 

Success in this role means: secure-by-design platforms, reliable automated delivery, faster developer flow, auditable change, and reduced operational toil. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Reliability: Design, implement, and monitor secure, fault-tolerant, highly available cloud infrastructure and DevSecOps platform services. 

CI/CD & Release Engineering: Establish and continuously improve build, test, release, and deployment frameworks that support scalable delivery, traceability, auditability, and repeatability. 

DevSecOps Adoption: Drive adoption of DevSecOps and cloud platform capabilities across application, data, and AI engineering teams through reusable patterns, enablement, and technical guidance. 

Security by Design: Embed SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, secrets management, policy enforcement, and security quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. 

Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain modular, tested, and governed infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and related tooling. 

GitOps & Kubernetes: Implement GitOps-based delivery and lifecycle management for container platforms using technologies such as Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, Argo CD, Flux CD, Helm, Docker, and Podman. 

Toolchain Availability: Engineer and operate reliable services supporting source control, artifact management, containerization, continuous integration, release management, change management, and developer workflows. 

Automated Governance: Integrate automated change-management controls, approvals, evidence capture, policy-as-code, and promotion controls across development-to-production pipelines. 

Observability & Self-Healing: Integrate metrics, logs, traces, event analytics, and automated remediation to improve service health, troubleshooting, performance, and resilience. 

Performance & Operations: Lead technical analysis, optimization, incident response, problem resolution, upgrade planning, operational readiness, and lifecycle management for DevOps infrastructure. 

Cross-Functional Architecture: Translate development, security, operations, reliability, and compliance requirements into implementable platform designs and engineering standards. 

AI-Assisted Engineering: Apply generative and agentic AI to accelerate infrastructure engineering and automation while maintaining human oversight, security guardrails, governance, and cost accountability. 

Documentation & Enablement: Produce clear technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, runbooks, and reusable implementation guidance; coach teams on engineering best practices. 

Automation Culture: Identify repetitive manual processes and replace them with secure, supportable, observable automation. 

Required Skills And Experience

Core Experience

10+ years of relevant experience in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, task automation, or GitOps. 

Hands-on engineering experience designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and automation frameworks. 

Strong programming and scripting capability using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, Java, C#, C++, or comparable languages. 

Proven operational discipline across incident response, problem management, performance analysis, upgrade execution, high availability, and technical documentation. 

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across architecture, security, infrastructure, application, data, and AI teams. 

Technical Capabilities Required

Capability Area

Expected Experience

Cloud Platforms

Microsoft Azure (Must); Google Cloud Platform (Nice to have). 

Source Control & CI/CD

GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent enterprise platforms. 

Infrastructure as Code & Configuration

Terraform, Terratest, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt, or equivalent tools. 

Containers & Orchestration

Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, kubectl, Helm, Docker, Podman, or comparable technologies. 

GitOps & Continuous Delivery

Argo CD, Flux CD, or equivalent GitOps tooling. 

Application & Supply-Chain Security

SonarQube, Snyk, Akido, Chaingaurd, SAST, DAST, IAST, software composition analysis, dependency scanning, secrets scanning, and quality gates. 

Artifact & Package Management

JFrog Artifactory or equivalent artifact repositories. 

Observability

Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or equivalent monitoring, logging, and analytics platforms. 

ITSM & Work Management

ServiceNow, Jira, automated change integration, and auditable delivery workflows. Handson Experience of integrating DevOps tools chain and ServiceNow and Jira Integration

Testing & Service Virtualization

Selenium, Tosca, automated functional/performance/security testing, and service virtualization tools. 

Linux & Networking

Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine, RHEL; TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, SMTP, FTP, and cloud networking fundamentals. 

AI-Enabled Engineering

GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding and engineering assistants, used within defined governance and security controls. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 

Relevant public cloud certification in Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is required. 

DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, or CNCF certification is preferred. 

Experience with Agile and DevOps delivery methods and with planning, estimation, and delivery in a fast-paced enterprise environment. 

Demonstrated learning agility with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies responsibly. 

Preferred Attributes

- Systems thinker who balances developer experience, security, reliability, governance, and cost. 
 - Self-starter who can operate with appropriate autonomy while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment. 
 - Pragmatic engineer who favors standards, reusable products, automation, and measurable outcomes over one-off solutions. 
 - Curious and adaptable, with a commitment to continuous learning and responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices. 

Key Outcomes

- Secure delivery: Security and compliance controls are consistently embedded and evidenced within delivery pipelines. 
 - Reliable platforms: DevSecOps services meet defined availability, performance, recovery, and support expectations. 
 - Faster flow: Standardized automation reduces manual effort and enables repeatable, lower-risk releases.

Summary: 

As a Veeva CRM Tester, a typical day involves designing and executing testing for implementations, integrations, and releases in a regulated life sciences environment. The role owns test preparation, execution, defect investigation, validation evidence, and delivery of high-quality results. This position focuses on ensuring quality, compliance, traceability, and release readiness across Veeva CRM programs while collaborating with cross-functional teams, supporting testing best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement in testing processes and automation. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, cases, data, and traceability. 
 - Execute functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, data migration, and UAT testing. 
 - Validate Veeva CRM commercial processes, Salesforce configurations, integrations, and offline scenarios. 
 - Record clear evidence, identify and report defects, perform retesting, and support root-cause analysis. 
 - Maintain GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, security, and audit-ready documentation. 
 - Coordinate with business, development, validation, and support teams to resolve issues. 
 - Report progress, risks, blockers, and test results to the Test Lead. 
 - Support junior testers, peer reviews, automation, regression optimization, and reusable assets. 
 - Own test execution activities with a strong focus on accuracy, risk awareness, and quality outcomes. 
 - Support defect analysis, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Ensure on-time completion of assigned testing, validation evidence, timely identification and communication of issues, and effective retesting activities. 
 - Deliver strong coverage, traceability, defect quality, reduced escaped defects, and improved regression efficiency. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

- Must Have Skills: Hands-on Veeva CRM testing experience in a life sciences environment. 
 - Secondary skills include Veeva CRM, Salesforce, ISTQB, or Agile certification. 
 - Experience testing Veeva CRM in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or life sciences environments. 
 - Good knowledge of accounts, calls, consent, Approved Email, CLM, events, samples, territories, and mobile/offline functionality. 
 - Experience in test analysis, design, execution, defect management, traceability, data validation, integration testing, and UAT support. 
 - Ability to write clear test cases, query data, validate interfaces, analyze defects, and produce audit-ready evidence. 
 - Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, Zephyr, or equivalent tools. 
 - Exposure to Selenium, Cucumber, Tosca, or similar automation tools. 
 - Understanding of Agile delivery, GxP, CSV, ALCOA+, data integrity, and validation controls. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills. 
 - Strong learning agility, stakeholder collaboration, and effective communication skills. 
 - Experience with Veeva Commercial Cloud, CLM, Approved Email, Align, MyInsights, or iOS offline testing is preferred. 
 - Exposure to API, database, automation, performance, accessibility, and security testing is preferred. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have 2-4 years of software testing or quality engineering experience, including at least 1 years of hands-on Veeva CRM testing. 
 - Bachelor s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience. 
 - This is based at our Accenture Office

So, what's the role all about?

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions that ensure the delivery of high-quality software products. You will work closely with developers, QA engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders to build robust automation frameworks, define and execute test strategies, and embed quality best practices throughout the software development lifecycle. This role requires strong expertise in Java, API test automation, and backend quality engineering, with experience using Playwright and related automation technologies. You will play a key role in improving product quality, reliability, and release confidence. 

How will you make an impact?

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. 
 - Build, enhance, and maintain automation frameworks using Java, Playwright, and related testing technologies.

data.title: Technical Lead - OpenBlue CUPO Systems Specialist
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Johnson Controls is shaping a future that is more productive, secure, and sustainable by applying cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and Design Thinking to intelligent buildings. 

In this role, you will help deliver OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions that support reliable, efficient central utilities for critical environments such as universities, hospitals, airports, office towers, and data centers. 

Role Overview

- Based in Pune, this position leads the engineering, integration, commissioning, and optimization of OpenBlue CUP solutions for district energy and chiller plants globally. You will serve as the technical lead for project execution, aligning delivery with customer objectives, schedules, and performance goals while helping drive energy savings, reduced water use, and lower carbon impact. 
 - Key Responsibilities
 - Lead the engineering and project execution of OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions from design through closeout. 
 - Analyze site and operational data to build accurate energy models using CUPO software and identify optimization opportunities. 
 - Prepare drawings, scopes of work, and recommissioning requirements for sensors, meters, and controls needed to make a plant CUP-ready. 
 - Oversee system design, programming, installation coordination, commissioning, performance validation, and project closeout activities. 
 - Create and execute integration test plans with controls service contractors to verify bidirectional data and command flow between CPO and the plant automation system. 
 - Oversee point mapping and local plant automation programming to support smooth transitions between operating modes. 
 - Validate system functionality, analyze command dispatch results, and resolve issues throughout commissioning and startup. 
 - Collaborate with customers, plant operators, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance outcomes. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentor engineering team members, and train operators and end users on OpenBlue CUP solutions. 
 - Maintain strong ethics, quality, safety, and compliance with Johnson Controls policies and applicable regulations. 
 - How You Will Do It
 - Own project outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping delivery aligned to scope, schedule, and customer expectations. 
 - Stay close to the work by reviewing plant data, point maps, and field results to identify practical optimization actions and remove obstacles quickly. 
 - Improve every day through structured test plans, candid troubleshooting, and continuous refinement of engineering standards and methods. 
 - Win as one team by working closely with controls contractors, project managers, operators, and other engineering disciplines. 
 - Lead regular progress meetings, document decisions clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of risks, changes, and commissioning status. 
 - Use Microsoft Project or similar tools to support planning, coordination, and milestone tracking. 
 - Translate technical findings into clear training and support so plant teams can confidently operate the CUP solution. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in building automation controls engineering, programming, and commissioning.

data.title: Lead Robotics Engineer
data.description:
Company Description MultiplexEV is an agritech organization focused on building electric tractors, and construction equipments from the ground up. The company leverages advanced technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), to power smart farming solutions. These innovations support farm health monitoring and precision agriculture, helping farmers make data-driven decisions and improve productivity. MultiplexEV operates at the intersection of electric vehicles and agriculture, offering a dynamic environment for professionals interested in sustainable, tech-driven farming. 

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership

- Define the system architecture for perception, planning, controls and hardware interfaces
 - Make build-vs-buy and technology-stack decisions (ROS 2, simulation tools, compute platforms)
 - Set engineering standards for code quality, testing, safety and documentation
 - Review designs and code; be the final technical escalation point

Hands-on engineering

- Develop and optimise core modules in motion planning, controls, localisation or manipulation
 - Lead sensor integration and calibration (LiDAR, cameras, IMU, encoders, force/torque)
 - Build simulation and hardware-in-the-loop test pipelines to cut field debugging time
 - Diagnose complex failures across software, electronics and mechanics

Team and delivery

- Hire, mentor and grow a team of robotics engineers
 - Plan roadmaps and sprints with product, hardware and operations teams
 - Own delivery from prototype to production and field deployment
 - Drive compliance with relevant safety standards: ISO 3691-4 (indoor AMRs), ISO 18497 (agricultural machines), ISO 17757 (construction and mining machines) and ISO 13849 (safety-related control systems)

Required qualifications

- B. Tech/B. E. , M. S. or Ph. D. in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science or a related field
 - 6-8 years building robotic systems, with at least one product shipped to real users or customers
 - 2+ years leading engineers, formally or as tech lead
 - Strong C++ (modern C++14/17) and Python, with deep experience in ROS 2, Linux and real-time systems
 - Hands-on autonomous navigation for wheeled or tracked vehicles: localisation, path planning and path following for skid-steer and Ackermann platforms
 - Multi-sensor fusion across LiDAR, radar, cameras, IMU, wheel odometry and RTK-GNSS
 - Robust localisation where GNSS is weak or missing: warehouses, vineyard rows under canopy, underground or open-pit mines
 - Navigation on uneven terrain: traversability mapping, slope handling, and obstacle and person detection in cluttered outdoor scenes
 - Experience with ROS 2 navigation stacks (Nav2, Autoware or similar) and simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
 - Track record of debugging integrated hardware-software systems in the field

Preferred qualifications

- Converting existing machines to autonomy: drive-by-wire integration and vehicle buses such as CAN, J1939 or ISOBUS
 - Ruggedising sensors and compute against dust, mud, rain, vibration and heat (enclosures, sensor cleaning, IP ratings)
 - Vineyard or orchard row-following, or autonomy for haul and earth-moving machines at construction and mining sites
 - Fleet management, teleoperation fallback and connectivity over 4G/5G or private LTE
 - Perception and ML for outdoor autonomy, with edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson or similar
 - Running field-test programmes at real customer sites
