data.description:
At U. S. Bancorp India, we're on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U. S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One. 

Job Description

Job Description: Senior Software Engineering Manager - MMC (India)

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead engineering delivery for the Money Movement Capability (MMC) application in India. This leader will play a critical role in building and scaling U. S. Bank's India engineering presence for MMC by managing a high-performing team of software developers and quality engineers, strengthening engineering practices, and partnering closely with U. S. -based leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 

This is a managerial leadership role for a technically strong engineering leader who can operate with broad direction, focus on the bigger picture, and drive execution across multiple domains. The ideal candidate combines deep technical experience with people leadership, architectural judgment, delivery rigor, and a strong understanding of payments systems. This role requires business knowledge in the Payments domain, including Zelle, RTP, and FedNow, along with the ability to build software products that are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned to business strategy. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & India Organization Build-Out
 - Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers and QEs in India supporting the MMC application
 - Help establish and scale the India engineering organization, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and creating a strong engineering culture for U. S. Bank
 - Drive career development, technical mentoring, performance management, and succession planning across the team
 - Create an accountable, inclusive, and high-performing environment focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement
 - Engineering Delivery & Execution
 - Manage under broad direction and objectives, with a focus on business outcomes, delivery quality, and operational stability
 - Drive execution of the product roadmap on time and within budget while ensuring security, compliance, and reliability of core systems
 - Guide teams toward strong coding practices, solid software design decisions, and high-quality delivery with minimal disruption to production
 - Set expectations across the organization and ensure dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints are identified and addressed early
 - Promote urgency, prioritization, and thoughtful trade-off decisions aligned to organizational strategy
 - Technical Leadership & Architecture
 - Provide high-level architectural guidance and help teams align solution design to business requirements, enterprise standards, and regulatory needs
 - Ensure technical designs are clear, well thought out, and account for dependencies, failure states, maintainability, testability, scalability, and ease of support
 - Develop and maintain high-level and detailed architecture designs for complex technology solutions across multiple platforms, frameworks, and languages
 - Lead architectural review sessions and technical design discussions across the organization
 - Simplify product and technical design where possible to improve speed, resilience, and supportability
 - Cross-Team Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership
 - Partner with business leaders, product managers, architects, and engineering teams in an agile environment to gather requirements and drive execution
 - Participate in roadmap discussions and provide feedback to product and business teams based on engineering strategy, technical constraints, and delivery considerations
 - Understand adjacent teams' business domains and influence cross-team decisions to deliver business value efficiently
 - Communicate technical decisions, architecture strategies, and delivery risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Quality, Operations & Incident Leadership
 - Drive a culture of quality, timely code reviews, release readiness, and engineering discipline across the organization
 - Coach teams on systematic debugging, problem diagnosis, and effective use of tools for troubleshooting
 - Lead incident response as needed and establish processes and tooling that improve issue detection, root-cause analysis, and repeat-issue prevention
 - Ensure teams proactively handle risk, change, and ambiguity, escalating concerns early with practical solution options

Technical Scope

The Senior Software Engineering Manager is expected to bring strong hands-on technical credibility and experience building modern distributed systems. This role will guide teams delivering software products and APIs in a payments ecosystem with high expectations for availability, performance, resiliency, and compliance. 

Expected technical experience includes: 

- Experience building highly maintainable, extensible, and testable distributed systems
 - Experience in microservices and API development using Java and Spring Boot
 - Experience designing low-latency, high-throughput applications built for scalability and reliability
 - Experience implementing user interfaces against REST APIs
 - Experience with Kafka, event-driven patterns, and open-source technologies used in modern application development
 - Experience with containerization and platform tooling such as Kubernetes, Rancher, Istio, Apigee, Jenkins/CloudBees, and GitLab
 - Familiarity with source control management best practices, DevOps principles, and agile software delivery lifecycle practices
 - Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and driving resolution in production environments

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
 - 10 to 12 years of relevant technical experience
 - 5 or more years of leading a software engineering team
 - Proven experience leading software engineers and offshore teams to deliver complex products with multiple stakeholders
 - Strong understanding of software development processes, architecture, and engineering tools in enterprise environments
 - Comprehensive knowledge of how business strategy aligns with technical and engineering strategy
 - Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills
 - Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, product owners, scrum masters, business partners, vendors, and customers

Preferred Qualifications

- Business domain knowledge in Payments, especially ACH, Wires, Zelle, RTP, and FedNow
 - Experience in Business Banking, Payment Services, Financial Services, or other regulated industries
 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems architecture, microservices architecture, API management, and integration platforms
 - Experience overseeing integration of new systems and technologies into existing environments
 - Experience balancing technical debt, feature delivery, and operational reliability at scale
 - Certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, Cloud, or Azure are a plus

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks beyond a single team and considers impacts across multiple domains
 - Has a complete understanding of the team's domain, key features, affected users, impacted flows, and business purpose
 - Takes initiative to clarify ambiguity, identify risk early, and guide teams toward sound decisions
 - Fosters a culture of strong design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountable delivery
 - Brings a mix of technical acumen, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and talent-building capability
 - Can represent the India team effectively while partnering across global stakeholders and enterprise functions

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants. 

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants. 

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Enterprise Investment Technology team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer and will partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to enhance and evolve the development of Investment Cloud / iRisk. You will develop and modernize cloud-native investment and risk platforms through scalable engineering, data processing, and AWS-based solutions to delight our customers! In addition to applied experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do. 

What You Can Expect

- Build applications ensuring that the code follows latest coding practices and industry standards, using modern design patterns and architectural principles; actively code against the roadmap
 - Develop high-quality, well-documented and efficient code adhering to all applicable Prudential standards
 - Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
 - Write unit, integration tests and functional automation, researching problems discovered by quality assurance or product support, developing solutions to address the problems
 - Bring an applied understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others, and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
 - Work on complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors
 - Use programming languages including but not limited to Java, AWS, Fargate, Postgres, Redshift, EventBridge, Python, or JavaScript and React, Springboot, and Node. js frameworks

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or experience in related fields
 - 5-7 years of experience in: Java, AWS, Fargate, Postgres, Redshift, EventBridge
 - Ability to leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts and perspectives to the benefit of the organization
 - Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
 - Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
 - Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
 - Applied experience with several of the following: 
 - Programming Languages: Python, Java or Java Script; working in distributed systems, object oriented programming, design patterns and design methodology; JAVA services using Spring CLI, Maven, Microservice, multi-threading, Concurrency and parallel processing
 - Frameworks: React, Springboot, Node. js, such as Full / MEAN / MERN stack
 - Data Store: NoSQL or Relational Data structures; MongoDB BPM tools
 - Data Streaming: SQS, Kinesis
 - Application Programming Interfaces (API): Consumption & Development; implementing service oriented architecture (SOA) patterns; Web service technologies such as APIs, REST, JSON, SOAP, XML, JDBC, MySQL
 - Unit, interface and end user testing concepts and tooling (functional & non-functional)
 - Automated testing
 - Accessibility awareness
 - Software security skills including secure coding, web application security and DevSecOps; Solid grasp of security concepts (authentication, authorization, encryption, digital signature, JWT), SSL, web service proxies, firewall, SAML 2. 0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2. 0)
 - DevOps Tools & Practices: Branching techniques and usage of GitHub, Bitbucket or Subversion; DevOps, Jenkins
 - Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Monitoring and logging techniques
 - AWS Core Services: AWS Services such as CloudWatch, Code-Deploy

What will set you apart?

- AWS Development
 - Architecture Patterns
 - Design Thinking
 - Financial/Insurance industry knowledge is a plus
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Job Title: Testing-Insurance Automation-Senior

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY-Consulting-Insurance-Automation-Testing- Senior

The opportunity

As a Business Tester, you will be accountable & responsible to Prepare test strategy, test plan, test scenario, test scripts based on the project requirements. Execute functional and regression test cases. Report the defects in tracking tool and ensure its closure through STLC process. Involve in review meetings and walk through meetings. Candidate should have knowledge / experience in Guidewire - Policy-Claims-BillingCenter / Insurance domain. Having experience in Agile methodology is a must. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Deft knowledge on Agile Scrum
 - Strong hands-on experience in Guidewire - PolicyCenter with Rating, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter and GW Portal Products
 - Strong knowledge in GW Integrations points. 
 - Very Strong Knowledge in P&C Insurance Domain with multiple LOBs. 
 - Candidates must have experience in Automation and/or AI testing. 
 - Experience in SQL basics
 - Understanding the entire modules and their functionality by verifying the Functional Specification and Style guide issued by the client. 
 - Responsible for writing and executing the Test Cases for Functional Testing. 
 - Maintaining the Bug Reports and delivery Note details. 
 - Involved in Peer-Review of the test cases, Sanity Testing, Smoke Testing, Regression Testing, System Testing and User Acceptance Testing. 
 - Should be a Team player and has experience in Stakeholders management
 - Involved in review meetings and walk through meetings. 
 - Attend status calls as needed to report on testing progress

To qualify for the role, you must have

- BE/BTech/MCA/M. Sc. 
 - 5 -8 years of UAT/Business testing experience in in Guidewire - Policy-Claims-Billing centre / Insurance domain with Agile methodology. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Should have excellent communication skills & should be able to articulate concisely & clearly
 - Should be ready to do an individual contributor and lead role as well. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. 

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Technical Co-Founder / Founding Engineer
data.description:
Company Description XIMPEX provides expert export management services tailored to the specific needs of each client, helping organizations expand their global reach. The company focuses on enabling international growth while minimizing operational and regulatory risks. By offering structured, data-driven export solutions, XIMPEX supports businesses in navigating complex international markets. The team is dedicated to building long-term partnerships and delivering measurable results for global success. 
Role Description The Technical Co-Founder / Founding Engineer will lead the design, development, and scaling of XIMPEX's core technology platform, with a focus on tools that streamline export management and international operations. This full-time remote role involves building and maintaining backend and frontend systems, integrating third-party data sources, and ensuring robust performance, security, and reliability. The person in this role will define technical architecture, choose and implement technology stacks, and create prototypes and MVPs based on customer feedback and market research. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing clean, testable code, reviewing contributions, managing cloud infrastructure, and collaborating closely with business and product stakeholders on feature prioritization and roadmap planning. As a founding team member, this role also contributes to product strategy, supports fundraising and customer demos, and helps establish engineering best practices and culture. 
Qualifications

- Strong analytical skills for solving complex technical problems, designing system architecture, and interpreting product and market data. 
 - Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate in a remote environment. 
 - Understanding of sales processes and customer engagement dynamics to support demos, technical discussions with prospects, and solution customization. 
 - Foundational marketing awareness, particularly in positioning technical capabilities, supporting product messaging, and providing input on go-to-market strategies. 
 - Solid research skills to evaluate technologies, study export management domain requirements, and incorporate user and market insights into product development. 
 - Proven experience as a full-stack or backend engineer (startup or early-stage experience preferred), with ownership of production systems. 
 - Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks (e. g. , JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar; common web frameworks; RESTful APIs). 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, GCP, or Azure), databases, and basic DevOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, security best practices). 
 - Ability to work autonomously, make pragmatic decisions under uncertainty, and thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage environment. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; prior exposure to logistics, trade, or export domains is a plus.

data.description:

 - Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support. 
 - Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps. 
 - Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection. 
 - Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards. 
 - Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities. 
 - Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development.

data.description:
Job Description

Title: Test Automation Engineer- Husky (India) Guindy, Chennai-Immediate joiners only

Id: 20973

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
What makes us Qlik?

A Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly. 

Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in. 

The Senior Automation QA Engineer Role

Qlik is seeking a highly skilled Senior Automation QA Engineer to design and develop automated testing solutions for our Salesforce and NetSuite platforms. 

This role combines strong QA automation engineering with hands-on AI agent development using Playwright. The engineer will use AI agents and modern automation techniques to accelerate testing, improve coverage and reliability, and provide faster quality feedback throughout the software development lifecycle. 

The role also requires a responsible approach to AI development, considering appropriate ethical, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight principles. 

What makes this role interesting?

The software testing landscape is rapidly evolving, and the biggest challenge we are tackling right now is balancing deployment speed with flawless reliability. You will be at the forefront of solving this by replacing manual bottlenecks with intelligent, AI-driven automation. 

Here Is Why You Will Love What You Do

- Pioneering AI in QA: You get to build and deploy advanced AI agents using Playwright, completely transforming how test creation, execution, and regression testing are handled. 
 - Accelerating development cycles: By seamlessly integrating your automated tests directly into CI/CD pipelines, you will give developers the immediate, reliable feedback they need to build faster. 
 - Elevating the testing framework: Instead of maintaining legacy code, you will design and develop highly reusable automation frameworks and utilities from the ground up, freeing yourself from repetitive maintenance. 
 - Championing ethical AI: You won't just blindly trust AI outputs; you will be the human-in-the-loop. You will apply vital oversight, evaluating AI-generated results to ensure our testing practices remain secure, fair, and highly accurate. 

Here's How You'll Be Making An Impact

Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely we deliver software. By joining us, you aren't just finding bugs-you are engineering a smarter, more efficient way to build products. 

- Driving strategic quality: You will partner closely with developers, product owners, and key stakeholders to identify risks early, shifting quality left and shaping the overall testing strategy. 
 - Transforming defect detection: Your sophisticated, AI-enhanced test scenarios will catch critical issues before they reach production, ensuring rock-solid reliability across our Salesforce and NetSuite environments. 
 - Streamlining QA processes: Your clear, actionable insights from test failures and meticulous tracking metrics will continuously elevate our entire software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentoring through innovation: By introducing AI-assisted testing practices and clear documentation, you will naturally elevate the technical capabilities of the wider team and establish new industry-leading standards. 

We're Looking For a Teammate With

- 5+ years of hands-on QA automation experience. 
 - Strong programming and automation experience with Playwright and Python; experience with Selenium or similar frameworks is beneficial. 
 - Proven experience building AI agents using Playwright for software testing or QA automation. 
 - Good understanding of AI models, LLMs, and AI agent development, including how agents use tools and interact with applications. 
 - Experience with AI/agent technologies such as OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of Salesforce (Apex, Lightning) and NetSuite (SuiteScript, workflows, or saved searches). 
 - Experience developing end-to-end automation across complex enterprise applications and integrations. 
 - Strong understanding of QA fundamentals, including test planning, test design, regression testing, defect management, and Agile/Scrum. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD, Jira, and test management tools such as Zephyr. 
 - Understanding of prompt engineering and effective use of LLMs in software engineering. 
 - Awareness of responsible AI practices, including ethical use, privacy, security, fairness, and human oversight. 
 - Performance, load, or security testing experience is desirable. 
 - Salesforce or NetSuite certifications are desirable. 

The location for this role is: 

Bangalore, India

Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!

More About Qlik And Who We Are

Find out more about 'Life at Qlik' on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page. 

What else do we offer?

- Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs. 
 - Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness. 
 - Flexible, diverse, and international work environment. 

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra "change the world" day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs

If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to accessibilityta@qlik. com. Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik's Recruitment Privacy Notice. Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests. 

Qlik is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means.

data.title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Leads a platform group; develops strategies and plans that standardize runtimes, APIs, and SDKs across several teams. Accountable for group results and governance adherence; makes operational decisions ensuring compatibility, security, and performance. Sponsors cross-group innovation in resilience, capacity modeling, and interoperability. Communicates with executive leadership on platform health, risk, and adoption. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Define platform strategy for a group, aligning runtimes, SDKs, and integration frameworks to interoperable, multi-tenant standards. 
 - Govern cross-group compatibility and security controls with SRE/security partners; approve high-risk migrations and deprecations. 
 - Own group-wide resilience and capacity objectives; institutionalize rollout, canary, and rollback patterns across services. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Defines key elements for leads and/or teams to design multiple software solutions and identify and analyze requirements to ensure alignment with business and organizational goals. 
 - Applies broad understanding of other areas within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads design and specification reviews to drive improvements across multiple projects/programs. 
 - Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct leads and/or teams for conducting debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues. 
 - Directs leads and/or teams to implement software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. 
 - Drives the optimization of design and development practices to improve performance across products and domains, ensuring adherence to organizational goals in execution of business priorities. 
 - Directs teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Directs teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Directs teams to design and develop software, systems, and services. 
 - Coaches managers to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct teams in conducting periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within and outside the organization to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus. 
 - Directs teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Defines processes and approaches to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders within and outside of organization, including executive leadership, to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - Directs teams to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues. 
 - Leads teams and sets direction to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences multiple teams to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Directs the implementation of training for customer issue and/or defect handling processes. 
 - Leads the investigation and troubleshooting of complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions. 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with teams and leadership to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, evolving/dynamic industry best practices and processes, and coding standards. 
 - Ensures clarity on key elements and objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria to impact development processes in the organization. 
 - Implements complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities that affect the organization. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Defines key elements for teams to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Ensures teams are aware of and adhere to service contract, terms, and conditions. 
 - Directs teams to proactively evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives. 

Problem Solving: 

- Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level. Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments. 

Performance and Development: 

- Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives. Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.description:
Overview

As the world's most global bank, Citi gives you the tools to be a trailblazer. We're not just building technology; we're building the future of banking. With thousands of employees located around the globe, we are an international team encompassing a broad range of teams, roles, and cultures, and we invite you to come and join us!

Citi's technology team supports business operations in 100+ countries, across multiple lines of business spanning both Institutional and retail businesses. 

The group works to optimize the IT environment by standardizing production platforms, reducing complexity, and introducing innovative solutions that provide new business capabilities, reduce total cost of ownership, and create a competitive advantage for Citi. 

We want to regularly engage with talented individuals who are passionate about producing clean, testable code as part of a high performing team. We have found this to be way more important than experience in the financial sector. 

We welcome applications from any industry and should you wish to apply your application will be reviewed for a multitude of Developer positions at varying levels. 

What We Do / The Team

- Citi FX has a physical presence in 83 countries with 1, 400 dedicated staff giving us the largest FX presence of any bank globally. Foreign Exchange has been one of the defining businesses of Citi for much of its 200 year existence. 
 - Citi has the largest FX presence of any bank globally and we proudly put this down to delivering unrivalled service and insight to our clients. Increasing investment in technology has seen us roll out award winning applications. Technology is a central pillar for our plans to sustain and grow our FX business.

The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities. 

Responsibilities: 

- Design, develop, and maintain modern, scalable, and responsive user interfaces using Angular and Micro-Frontend (MFE) architectures. 
 - Handle the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) for advanced document extraction, validation, and processing. 
 - Lead and mentor a scrum team of developers, guiding them through the agile development process and playing the role of a lead. 
 - Oversee the design, development, and deployment of Java/Spring Boot-based microservices and collaborate across full-stack capabilities. 
 - Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, model development, and establish and implement new or revised applications systems and programs to meet specific business needs or user areas. 
 - Monitor and control all phases of development process and analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation as well as provide user and operational support on applications to business users. 
 - Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgement. 
 - Recommend and develop security measures in post implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality. 
 - Consult with users/clients and other technology groups on issues, recommend advanced programming solutions, and install and assist customer exposure systems. 
 - Ensure essential procedures are followed and help define operating standards and processes
 - Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts
 - Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision. 
 - Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy. 
 - Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members. 
 - Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency. 

Recommended Qualifications: 

- 5-8 years of relevant experience
 - Strong, hands-on experience with modern Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx/State Management) and building modular applications using Micro-Frontend (MFE) architectures. 
 - Solid knowledge and understanding of how AI integration works, particularly with LLMs for document processing and data extraction. Expert-level technical knowledge in Java, Spring Boot, and building microservices-based architectures. 
 - Proven experience in team leadership and handling a scrum team. Experience acting as a Software development lead. 
 - Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications
 - Experience in managing and implementing successful projects
 - Working knowledge of consulting/project management techniques/methods
 - Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

data.title: Senior Java Lead Engineer
data.description:
Business / Organization Overview

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Java Technical Lead (C12) to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms. 

Role Summary

As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards. 
 - Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance). 

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery

- Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs. 
 - Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using Apache Kafka and IBM MQ / JMS. 
 - Architect and tune high-volume data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL document stores (MongoDB). 
 - Drive containerization and deployment strategies targeting modern enterprise cloud platforms (ECS / Red Hat OpenShift). 

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

- Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce unit/integration test coverage standards, and eliminate technical debt. 
 - Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks. 

Agile & DevOps Collaboration

- Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments. 
 - Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity. 

Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies

- Core Java & Frameworks: Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning. 
 - Spring Ecosystem: Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). 
 - API & Integration: Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns. 
 - Messaging & Event Streaming: Strong hands-on implementation experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (IBM MQ / JMS). 
 - Database Engineering: Relational: Oracle DB (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: MongoDB (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning). 
 - Design Patterns & Clean Code: Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns. 

Secondary Skills & Familiarity (Highly Desirable)

- Containerization & Platforms: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as ECS / Red Hat OpenShift. 
 - Frontend / Full-Stack Exposure: Familiarity with modern frontend development using Angular, React JS. 
 - Business Process Management: Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM. 
 - Application Servers & Middleware: Understanding of legacy or hybrid runtime environments including IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS / Liberty). 
 - CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk). 

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

- Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a proven track record of resolving complex distributed systems challenges. 
 - Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business partners. 
 - Ownership & Drive: Demonstrated ability to independently lead engineering initiatives from ideation to production rollout. 
 - Collaboration: High team spirit and emotional intelligence to work across globally distributed engineering teams.

data.title: Senior Delivery Lead - Modernisation
data.description:
Position Overview: 

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Applications Development Group Manager / SVP of Technology to lead the evolution of the Global Concentration Engine (GCE), a business-critical, SOX-critical platform for global liquidity management. 

The GCE provides our clients with the ability to manage their liquidity globally on an end-of-day and intra-day basis. It is a cornerstone of our Treasury and Trade Solutions, enabling integrated cash management, real-time analytics, and cross-border cash mobilization. 

This is a senior management, 'player-coach' position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team, coupled with a large component (>50%) of individual, hands-on contribution. The ideal candidate will be a forerunner in driving the adoption of Artificial Intelligence within the GCE platform, a hands-on coder, and a strategic leader who can establish and implement new application systems in coordination with the Technology Team. 

The candidate will have a proven track record of building and supporting high-performing global technology solutions, driving innovation, and delivering industry-defining products. This role requires a strategic thinker with exceptional leadership, communication, and deep hands-on technical skills, capable of setting product vision, personally coding on large-scale projects, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- AI Leadership & Strategy for GCE: Champion the strategic adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), including Generative AI, within the Global Concentration Engine to enhance its analytical and predictive capabilities, creating significant business impact and competitive advantage. Define and drive the AI roadmap for GCE, from conceptualization through to production, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise goals for liquidity management. Act as the organization's thought leader on the application of AI in Treasury and Trade Solutions, staying at the forefront of industry trends and mentoring teams to build their AI capabilities. 
 - Hands-on Technical Leadership & Delivery: Lead by example as a senior individual contributor, dedicating a significant portion of time (>50%) to hands-on development, including coding, designing, and architecting key components for the modernization and enhancement of the GCE platform. Oversee the full product development lifecycle for GCE, from ideation to deployment and ongoing maintenance, setting the bar for code quality, system performance, and engineering discipline. Drive the adoption of modern technologies and best practices (e. g. , DevSecOps, Cloud, Microservices) through direct implementation and team mentorship within the context of the GCE application. 
 - Team & Organizational Leadership: Lead and inspire a global technology organization, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence. Mentor and develop high-performing engineering teams, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment. Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, effectively communicating technical concepts and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Qualifications: 

- Overa decade of experience in technology roles, with a proven track record of success in leadership positions. 
 - Demonstrated experience as a 'player-coach', with a substantial and recent hands-on contribution to coding, architecture, and system design in a complex, transactional environment. 
 - Proven track record of championing and delivering AI/ML-driven projects from concept to production, with a deep understanding of its practical applications (including Generative AI) in a complex enterprise environment. 
 - Solid, expert-level hands-on experience with Open Source technologies, including Java/Springboot, Kafka, and containerization platforms (OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Deep understanding of modern software architecture principles, development methodologies (Agile, SAFe), and engineering best practices. 
 - Experience building and scaling high-availability, business-critical SaaS platforms. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with experience leading and collaborating with global technology teams. 
 - Experience in a large financial conglomerate is highly preferred, with specific experience in Treasury, Trade, or Liquidity Management Solutions being a significant advantage. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience required. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred. Executive education from top-tier institutions is a plus.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Business / Organization Overview

We are looking for a high-caliber Senior Java Technical Lead / Architect (C13) to spearhead the architecture, engineering strategy, and technical delivery of enterprise-scale distributed platforms. In this strategic technical leadership position, you will govern large-scale engineering initiatives, drive cloud-native modernization, set foundational architecture patterns, and mentor multiple agile engineering squads across globally distributed teams. 

Role Summary

At the C13 grade, you will operate as a subject matter expert and technical authority combining deep architectural mastery with strategic delivery oversight. You will lead end-to-end design, technology evaluation, security governance, and multi-system integration across distributed microservices, high-throughput event streaming, enterprise databases, and container platforms. You will partner with Directors, Enterprise Architects, Product Managers, and Business Leaders to ensure technology roadmaps align with business transformation objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Architecture & System Design

- Own end-to-end technical architecture, system decomposition, and integration strategy for complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems. 
 - Define architectural blueprints, domain models, and technical design standards for high-throughput, low-latency, and highly available microservices. 
 - Lead technology evaluation, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and modernization roadmaps (e. g. , legacy monolith/WebSphere decomposition to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures). 
 - Formally represent the application in Enterprise Architecture Governance, Security Reviews, and Technology Risk committees. 

Technical Governance & Engineering Leadership

- Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight across multiple development teams and technical leads (C11/C12). 
 - Enforce rigorous engineering standards, Clean Code practices, comprehensive automated testing (TDD/BDD), and robust CI/CD DevOps pipelines. 
 - Establish standards for non-functional requirements (NFRs) including system resilience, fault tolerance, high availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), low latency, and horizontal scalability. 
 - Drive modernization of messaging pipelines, event stream topologies, and polyglot persistence layers. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Partner closely with Product Owners, Program Managers, and Executive Stakeholders to translate multi-year business strategies into actionable, phased technical roadmaps. 
 - Manage architectural risks, technical debt remediation, and capacity planning. 
 - Act as the senior escalation authority for critical production incidents, driving root cause analysis (RCA) and long-term architectural stability solutions. 

Mentorship & Talent Development

- Foster an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture emphasizing continuous learning, innovation, and technical rigor. 
 - Mentor and develop senior engineers and technical leads, building leadership pipelines and engineering talent across the organization. 

Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
 - 15+ years of overall software engineering experience in enterprise-grade applications, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical lead, software architect or engineering leadership capacity. 
 - Proven track record of architecting, delivering, and supporting high-throughput, mission-critical systems in financial services, banking, or large enterprise domains. 

Primary Skills & Technical Mastery

- Core Java & Advanced JVM Engineering: Deep mastery of Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), high-concurrency programming, multithreading, memory management, garbage collection tuning (ZGC/G1), and low-latency optimization. 
 - Spring Ecosystem & Microservices Architecture: Extensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch) and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). 
 - Event-Driven Architecture & Distributed Messaging: 
 - Expert-level design and production operations with Apache Kafka (cluster architecture, partitions, consumer groups, Kafka Streams/Connect, schema registry, idempotent producers). 
 - Enterprise messaging and integration via IBM MQ / JMS and transaction management across distributed systems (Saga pattern, two-phase commit alternatives). 
 - API Strategy & Integration Patterns: Advanced RESTful API design, OpenAPI standards, API Gateways, gRPC, OAuth2/OIDC, and mutual TLS (mTLS). 
 - Polyglot Database Architecture: 
 - Relational: Oracle (advanced PL/SQL, partitioning, index optimization, query execution plan analysis, Active Data Guard). 
 - NoSQL / Document: MongoDB (sharding, replica sets, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning at scale). 
 - Resilience & Fault Tolerance Patterns: Proven experience implementing Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j), Rate Limiting, Bulkheads, and Distributed Tracing (OpenTelemetry/Jaeger). 

Secondary Skills & Modernization Competencies

- Containerization & Cloud Native Platforms: Architectural expertise in container platforms, specifically Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes and AWS ECS, including Pod autoscaling, ingress controllers, and Helm chart lifecycle management. 
 - Legacy Modernization & Middleware: Experience migrating workloads from legacy application servers (IBM WebSphere WAS/ND) and workflow orchestrators (IBM BAW / BPM) to modern microservices and cloud runtimes. 
 - Frontend Architecture Exposure: Solid understanding of modern SPA architecture, frontend integration, and frameworks like Angular (TypeScript, state management).

data.title: IAM Automation Engineer / ServiceNow Automation Engineer
data.description:
Experience: 3-4 Years

Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)

Role Overview

We are looking for an IAM Automation Engineer / ServiceNow Automation Engineer with 3-4 years of experience to design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for Identity and Access Management processes using ServiceNow. The candidate will work closely with IAM, security, application, and infrastructure teams to automate manual processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance IAM service delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain ServiceNow automation and workflows for IAM processes. 
 - Build and maintain automation using ServiceNow Flow Designer, Workflows, Business Rules, Script Includes, and Catalog Items. 
 - Automate IAM processes such as user provisioning/de-provisioning, access requests and approvals, role/group assignment, JML processes, and access revocation. 
 - Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and IAM platforms/applications using REST/SOAP APIs. 
 - Analyze manual IAM processes and identify opportunities for automation. 
 - Troubleshoot and enhance existing ServiceNow workflows and integrations. 
 - Develop reusable automation components to improve scalability and reduce manual effort. 
 - Work with IAM teams to understand requirements and convert them into technical automation solutions. 
 - Perform testing, debugging, deployment, and post-production support for ServiceNow automations. 
 - Monitor automation failures and troubleshoot issues within defined SLAs. 
 - Maintain technical documentation for workflows, integrations, and automation processes. 
 - Follow ServiceNow development best practices, security standards, and change-management processes. 

Required Skills

- 3-4 years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow automation/development. 
 - Strong experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer and Workflow. 
 - Good understanding of ServiceNow ITSM and Service Catalog. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow scripting and JavaScript. 
 - Experience developing Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Catalog Items. 
 - Good understanding of REST APIs and system integrations. 
 - Experience automating IAM-related processes is highly preferred. 
 - Understanding of IAM concepts such as provisioning, de-provisioning, RBAC, JML, access requests, and approvals. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID. 
 - Experience integrating ServiceNow with IAM platforms. 
 - Knowledge of Active Directory / LDAP. 
 - Knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, and MFA. 
 - Experience with PowerShell or Python scripting. 
 - Experience with ServiceNow REST APIs and IntegrationHub. 
 - ServiceNow certifications such as CSA or CAD. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on ServiceNow automation experience and understands IAM processes well enough to automate identity and access workflows. The role is primarily focused on automation and development rather than routine IAM ticket operations. 

Primary Skills

ServiceNow Automation | Flow Designer | ServiceNow Workflow | JavaScript | REST APIs | IAM | JML | Provisioning | Access Management

data.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a senior engineer in execution systems with a strong focus on Ignition based industrial applications designing and implementing robust solutions that optimize manufacturing operations and supply chain visibility while working in a hybrid day shift model and collaborating with global stakeholders to drive measurable improvements in efficiency quality and sustainability across enterprise production environments. 

Responsibilities

- Design robust execution system solutions using Ignition to support reliable data acquisition visualization and control across complex manufacturing environments while ensuring maintainability and scalability for future growth and integration needs. 
 - Develop high quality Ignition based applications that collect real time production data from diverse shop floor assets and transform it into actionable insights that improve throughput reduce downtime and support continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Configure integration between Ignition projects and upstream planning or downstream reporting systems to provide end to end traceability and accurate information flows that support informed operational and supply chain decisions. 
 - Collaborate closely with operations teams and subject matter experts to analyze manufacturing workflows identify process bottlenecks and translate business requirements into clear technical specifications for Ignition solutions. 
 - Implement standardized templates reusable components and configuration practices within Ignition that promote consistency reduce engineering effort and accelerate deployment across multiple plants and product lines. 
 - Optimize Ignition project performance by refining gateway configuration scripting logic and database interactions to ensure fast response times stable runtime behavior and secure access for users at different responsibility levels. 
 - Create comprehensive documentation for Ignition architectures configuration standards operating procedures and troubleshooting guides to support reliable system operations and effective knowledge transfer across engineering and operations teams. 
 - Provide hands on support during system deployment cutover and hypercare periods by monitoring key indicators resolving incidents and fine tuning Ignition configurations to ensure stable production execution. 
 - Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to implement secure network connections access controls and backup strategies for Ignition gateways and related components that protect critical operational data and system availability. 
 - Drive incremental enhancements to execution systems by analyzing production metrics feedback from end users and new digital initiatives then implementing targeted Ignition changes that deliver measurable value to manufacturing performance. 
 - Collaborate with data and analytics teams to expose clean standardized operational data from Ignition for reporting dashboards and predictive models that strengthen enterprise decision making and supply chain resilience. 
 - Support hybrid working practices by using remote access tools collaboration platforms and structured communication routines to deliver timely engineering outcomes while aligning with distributed teams across time zones. 
 - Ensure that all Ignition deliverables and configuration changes comply with internal quality standards regulatory expectations and validation requirements relevant to the manufacturing domain. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in designing configuring and maintaining Ignition based industrial applications including experience with tags scripting visualization components and gateway administration. 
 - Apply solid knowledge of execution systems such as manufacturing execution use cases work order tracking machine monitoring and production data collection in order to design solutions that fit real shop floor needs. 
 - Leverage practical exposure to manufacturing processes and supply chain operations to interpret requirements accurately and propose Ignition implementations that enhance flow reliability and material traceability. 
 - Utilize experience of eight to twelve years in industrial automation or execution systems engineering to handle complex cross functional projects with minimal supervision while maintaining high technical quality. 
 - Employ strong skills in relational databases query design and data modelling to ensure that Ignition solutions store and retrieve operational data in a consistent reliable and performant manner. 
 - Communicate clearly with stakeholders from technical and nontechnical backgrounds by explaining Ignition capabilities constraints and design options in terms that support sound business and engineering decisions. 
 - Adopt disciplined practices for version control testing documentation and incident management so that Ignition changes can be deployed safely during day shift operations without unplanned production impact.
