data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

Keep GSK's standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section. 

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK's Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment. 

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner's backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Reliability: achieve 99. 9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred. 
 - Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards. 
 - Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team's time. 
 - AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails. 
 - Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline. 
 - Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting. 
 - Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours. 
 - Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect's reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 - Area of Specialisation
 - Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
 - Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts. undefined
 - Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
 - Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
 - Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert). 
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

Skills

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Company Description

Guardant Health is a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant® is transforming patient care and accelerating new cancer therapies by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and treatment selection for patients with advanced cancer. For more information, visit guardanthealth. com and follow the company on LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and Facebook. 

About The Role

Are you passionate about transforming healthcare through data-driven innovation? The Enterprise Data Platform team is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, evolution, and scaling of our AWS-based enterprise data platform that powers analytics, operational intelligence, AI-enabled solutions, and business-critical decision-making. This role is ideal for a technical leader who combines strong data engineering expertise with architectural vision, product thinking, and a passion for solving business problems through data. As a player-coach, you will contribute to architecture, technical design, and key implementations while mentoring engineers and shaping the future of our data platform. You will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business stakeholders to build scalable data products and platform capabilities that transform data into actionable insights, intelligent automation, and measurable business outcomes. Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Strategy

- Architect and evolve scalable, secure, and AI-ready data platforms across ingestion, storage, transformation, analytics, and data product layers. 
 - Define technical vision, architecture standards, and engineering best practices that balance business needs, scalability, governance, and innovation. Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Analytics, Operations, and business teams to define and execute the architectural vision for a modern data platform, influencing long-term technical direction while balancing current priorities with future growth. 
 - Lead the evolution of our AWS-centric data platform by continuously evaluating modern data architecture patterns, cloud-native services, and emerging AI technologies to ensure the platform scales efficiently with growing business needs and data volumes. 
 - Assess build-versus-buy opportunities and make pragmatic technology decisions that balance business value, scalability, maintainability, operational complexity, and cost. 
 - Champion modern data architecture patterns including data products, data contracts, observability, self-service capabilities, metadata-driven architectures, and AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Data Products & Business Impact

- 
 - Lead the design and delivery of data products that generate measurable business value through analytics, automation, AI/ML, and operational insights. 
 - Partner with stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities and translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Apply a product mindset to data solutions, ensuring investments align with business priorities and user needs. 
 - Define success metrics and drive adoption, reliability, and business outcomes for data products. 

Engineering Leadership

- Lead the design and evolution of scalable data platforms and engineering practices that enable reliable delivery of data products across analytics, AI/ML, and operational use cases.

 - Establish engineering standards for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data platforms across batch, streaming, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads. 
 - Contribute to architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and critical implementations. 
 - Promote engineering excellence through automation, testing, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as Code, and operational best practices. 

Team & Culture

- Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers. 
 - Coach engineers in system design, architectural thinking, engineering craftsmanship, and operational excellence. 
 - Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical curiosity.

Governance & Reliability

Minimum Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 2+ years of experience leading and growing engineering teams. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling enterprise data platforms and data products. 
 - Demonstrated experience delivering measurable business value through data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, automation, or a combination of these capabilities. 
 - Strong expertise in data architecture, data modelling, distributed data processing, and modern data platform technologies.

Key Responsibilities

 - Enable seamless integration across channels and partners through well-defined RESTful APIs and event-driven communication patterns. 
 - Apply event-driven architecture principles using Kafka and related streaming technologies to support asynchronous processing and real-time data flows.

 - Establish modern DevOps and CI/CD practices using tools such as Jenkins/CloudBees and GitLab, ensuring automated testing, deployment, and release management. 
 - Enforce best practices in source control, code quality, and agile delivery, driving consistency, speed, and reliability across engineering teams. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues, ensuring rapid recovery, root cause analysis, and continuous system improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience designing and delivering modern, distributed software systems. 
 - 5+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams, including globally distributed/offshore teams. 
 - Proven expertise building and scaling platform-based solutions with measurable business impact. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams in delivering complex, multi-stakeholder products in fast-paced, enterprise environments. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering practices, architecture patterns, and enterprise development tools. 
 - Ability to translate business strategy into technology and engineering outcomes, driving alignment across product, risk, and engineering. 
 - Strong analytical, planning, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, scrum teams, business stakeholders, and external partners. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong domain expertise in customer acquisition, credit underwriting, and Open Banking ecosystems. 
 - Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries, with an understanding of risk, compliance, and security requirements. 
 - Advanced knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, API platforms, and event-driven integration patterns. 
 - Experience leading modernization initiatives, including integrating new platforms with legacy systems in enterprise environments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance feature delivery, technical debt, and operational reliability at scale. 
 - Experience with cloud-native platforms and engineering ecosystems (Azure, containers, CI/CD, API management). 
 - Relevant certifications in Java, Spring, Microservices, or Cloud technologies are a plus. 

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a leader who: 

- Thinks and operates at a platform and ecosystem level, considering impacts across domains, customer journeys, and partner integrations. 
 - Demonstrates deep understanding of end-to-end acquisition and underwriting flows, including users, systems, and business outcomes.

 - Builds a culture of strong engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, coding standards, quality engineering, and accountability. 
 - Combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and disciplined execution to deliver consistent results. 
 - Effectively represents and scales global engineering teams, especially across India and U. S. -based stakeholders. 

If there's anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

This is an U. S. Bancorp India posting. U. S. Bancorp India is a part of the U. S. Bank family.

data.description:
WirelessCar's Journey

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands-like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover-innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

As a Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience, you will help shape and evolve the architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle - from business needs and early design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution. You will work closely with our development teams and other architects to turn business needs into secure, scalable and sustainable technical solutions. 

Our environment is primarily built around AWS, but also Azure, using modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to technology while helping teams make good architectural decisions. You won't be working in isolation. Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort, and an important part of your role will be creating alignment and helping teams make sound technical decisions. 

Your Impact: 

- Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services. 
 - Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 - Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs. 
 - Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost.

 - Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software. 
 - Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects. 

What We're Looking For

- You are a technically experienced and pragmatic person who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details. 
 - You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping a team reach a good solution. 
 - You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation. 

We believe you bring: 

- Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure.

 - Experience designing distributed systems and working with areas such as APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures.

 - Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures. 
 - Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements. 
 - Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed development teams.

 - Relevant AWS, Azure or other cloud certifications. 

To join our journey

WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

data.title: Principal Architect
data.description:
Principal AI Architect - Generative AI & Enterprise Delivery

India (Hybrid) | Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time | Hands-on Architecture & Senior Engineering

About Us

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20, 000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6, 000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance. 

The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM's 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT-a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world's leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025-Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale. 

About the Role

Straive is seeking a hands-on Principal AI Architect & Senior Developer to serve as the technical authority for our enterprise Generative AI delivery practice. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end architectural design, backend engineering, and production deployment of enterprise Generative AI platforms, multi-agent systems, document intelligence pipelines, and real-time streaming LLM applications. 

This is an intensely hands-on role requiring expert backend proficiency in Python and SQL alongside deep expertise in Generative AI architectures. You will move beyond simple API orchestration to fine-tune open-weight models, build custom agentic workflows, engineer advanced multimodal RAG pipelines, write high-concurrency streaming backend microservices (FastAPI/AsyncIO), enforce AI security/PII guardrails, and optimize LLM unit economics (inference cost, latency, accuracy) for production deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

• Hands-on Gen AI Architecture & System Design: Architect scalable enterprise Gen AI solutions-including multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph or AutoGen or CrewAI), advanced RAG retrieval pipelines, real-time streaming interfaces (SSE, WebSockets), prompt security, guardrails, and automated evaluation suites. 

• High-Concurrency Backend Engineering & SQL: Write clean, async, high-performance Python backend code (FastAPI or AsyncIO or PyDantic) and write complex, optimized SQL queries to build robust microservices, caching layers (Redis), queueing systems (RabbitMQ/Celery), and vector search integrations. 

• Open-Weight Fine-Tuning & AI Economics: Own open-weight model fine-tuning (Llama or Mistral or Qwen or Phi) using LoRA, QLoRA, and full tuning. Drive inference optimization via quantization (AWQ, GPTQ), model distillation, prompt caching, and high-throughput GPU serving (vLLM/Triton). 

• Agentic Workflows & Tool Integration (MCP): Architect autonomous multi-agent workflows, planner-worker execution patterns, and custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connecting LLMs securely to enterprise databases, APIs, and legacy systems of record. 

• Multimodal RAG & Document Intelligence: Build complex document intelligence and multimodal ingestion pipelines to parse, OCR, chunk, and embed structured/unstructured documents (PDFs, tables, images) using Textract, Unstructured, and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). 

• LLMOps, Telemetry, Guardrails & Governance: Establish end-to-end LLMOps infrastructure-automated CI/CD eval gates (Ragas, TruLens), hallucination detection, telemetry/tracing (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Arize), and AI safety controls (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, PII redaction). 

• Technical Leadership, RFPs & Client Advisory: Lead and mentor 30+ AI engineers and developers through architecture reviews and hands-on code reviews. Partner with client CTOs, CDOs, and commercial teams on RFPs, technical proposals, discovery workshops, and effort estimations. 

Required Experience and Qualifications

• 12+ years of professional software engineering experience across system design, distributed backend development, and AI/ML, with a minimum of 4+ years dedicated to hands-on Generative AI and LLM application architecture. 

• Expert-level hands-on proficiency in Python (FastAPI or AsyncIO or PyDantic or Celery) and SQL (PostgreSQL/pgvector, MySQL, complex joins, CTEs, query optimization) for building production microservices. 

• Proven track record architecting and shipping production Gen AI systems using multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph or AutoGen or CrewAI or LangChain) and advanced RAG architectures (hybrid semantic + BM25 retrieval/re-ranking models). 

• Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight LLMs/SLMs (Llama/Mistral/Qwen/Phi), dataset curation, LoRA/QLoRA execution, and serving models under production load using vLLM, Triton, or Ollama. 

• Strong practical depth with Vector Databases (OpenSearch Vector Search/ Qdrant/ Milvus/ FAISS/ Pinecone) and document parsing/multimodal pipelines (AWS Textract, OCR, Vision-Language Models). 

• Demonstrated ability to optimize LLM inference cost and latency via quantization (AWQ/GPTQ, GGUF), prompt engineering/caching, model routing, and batching. 

• Hands-on expertise in LLMOps telemetry and AI security: evaluation frameworks (Ragas/TruLens), tracing (LangSmith/OpenTelemetry), prompt injection protection, PII masking, and guardrails (NeMo Guardrails/Llama Guard). 

• Solid command of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), streaming APIs (SSE, WebSockets), GPU serving, and cloud AI platforms across either AWS (Bedrock/SageMaker), Azure (Azure OpenAI), or GCP (Vertex AI). 

Preferred Experience & Education

• Hands-on exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Claude Skills, and agentic tool-use protocols. 

• Working command of enterprise AI risk and compliance frameworks. 

• Familiarity with enterprise data platforms (Databricks MLflow/Snowflake) or classical ML (XGBoost, scikit-learn). 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field from Tier 1/Tier 2 colleges)

Recognition & Achievements

• We have been recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest's North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM's PeMa Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025. 

• In Nov 2023, Straive acquired Gramener, an award-winning, design-led data science company, enhancing our data, analytics, and AI capabilities. In June 2025, we acquired SG Analytics, a leading provider of AI-powered insights and contextual analytics services. 

For more information, please visit our Website: https: //www. straive. com/

Equal Opportunity Employer

Straive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

data.title: Lead Full Stack Data Engineer
data.description:
The Lead Full Stack Data Engineer owns Data products across the full lifecycle: from data ingestion and transformation through to semantic modelling, reporting, documentation, and user adoption. Working closely with commercial, operations, finance, and clinical stakeholders, the role translates complex and often ambiguous business requirements into clear, reliable, and scalable Analytics solutions built on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. 

This position requires strong technical capability across data engineering and Analytics, a structured analytical mindset, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

About Role

- Design, build, and support end-to-end data products from ingestion through to reporting and analytics. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and actionable insights. 
 - Own delivery throughout the full lifecycle, including discovery, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Ensure data quality, integrity, reliability, and governance across all data solutions. 

Data Engineering & Platform Development

- Develop and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric. 
 - Build and manage Lakehouse and Data Warehouse solutions using modern architectural patterns. 
 - Implement scalable Bronze, Silver, and Gold data architectures to support reusable and maintainable data products. 
 - Define and enforce ETL/ELT standards, performance optimization practices, and engineering best practices. 
 - Build AI-ready datasets by ensuring data is clean, governed, well-modelled, and well-documented. 
 - Drive CI/CD adoption using GitHub, including branching strategies, automated testing, and deployment pipelines. 

Analytics & Reporting

- Design dimensional data models and star schemas optimized for analytics workloads. 
 - Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, datasets, reports, dashboards, and applications. 
 - Develop intuitive, high-performing reporting solutions using DAX and modern visualization techniques. 
 - Implement security controls including Row-Level Security (RLS) and object-level security. 
 - Continuously optimize reporting and semantic models for scalability and performance. 

Data Governance & Quality

- Apply data quality checks, validation frameworks, monitoring, and issue resolution processes. 
 - Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain clear documentation covering ownership, lineage, refresh schedules, business definitions, and known limitations. 
 - Contribute reusable frameworks, templates, standards, and best practices across the Analytics function. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Data Engineers. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching conversations, and development planning. 
 - Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Governance, and Engineering teams to align on standards and delivery approaches. 
 - Participate in peer reviews of SQL, Python, DAX, data models, and reporting solutions. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

About You

- Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end-to-end Data solutions. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL/Python for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including: 
 - Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2)
 - Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse
 - Power BI datasets, reports, and apps
 - Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization. 
 - Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts. 
 - Experience implementing BI security models (e. g. RLS). 
 - Familiarity with Git-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets. 
 - Experience working with enterprise source systems (e. g. ERP, CRM, finance systems). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. 
 - Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, collaborative environment. 
 - Comfortable working in regulated or compliance-driven environments. 

Education/ Qualifications

- Bachelor/Masters in a relevant field (e. g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience working across the full Data stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

data.description:
Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director - Asset Servicing Technology - Data and Digital Propositions Lead in CIB Tech - Securities Services & Digital Assets Technology department. 

About The Opportunity

Asset Servicing (Corporate Actions processing) is entering an important phase of technology-led transformation. This role offers the opportunity to shape how data, digital capability, automation and Artificial Intelligence improve both client and operational experience across the Asset Servicing business. 

As the Data and Digital Propositions Lead, you'll define and deliver propositions that make it easier for clients and colleagues to access, exchange and act on accurate corporate action data and insides. You'll help reduce manual activity across operations and technology, improve transparency and reporting, strengthen operational resilience, and create scalable digital capabilities that support future growth. 

Working across Asset Servicing, Technology, Operations, Product, Data, Risk and Control teams, you'll turn business challenges into practical, measurable solutions. The role will suit an experienced technology transformation leader who can connect strategic ambition with delivery discipline and who understands that good data is not merely a reporting asset; it's the fuel for better decisions and better experiences. 

In This Role, You Will

- Own the data and digital proposition technology strategy and exicuition for Asset Servicing (Corporate Actions processing), aligning priorities to client needs, business objectives, operational resilience and sustainable growth. 
 - Identify, shape and deliver technology-led business transformation opportunities across Asset Servicing, including process redesign, workflow automation, data remediation, digital servicing and client experience improvement. 
 - Develop and maintain a prioritised roadmap for data and digital capabilities, such as enhanced client reporting, data exchange, application programming interface connectivity, workflow digitisation and self-service propositions. 
 - Lead the identification, assessment and implementation of Artificial Intelligence use cases for Asset Servicing (Corporate Actions processing), including but not limited to unstructured data processing, data quality improvement across clients and internal teams, operational support, exception management, workflow optimisation and client servicing. 
 - Establish a disciplined approach to Artificial Intelligence delivery, covering use-case selection, data readiness, business case development, responsible use, governance, implementation, adoption and benefits realisation. 
 - Partner with business, product, operations, architecture, engineering, data, risk and control teams to deliver secure and scalable solutions across the Asset Servicing ecosystem. 
 - Define and track measurable outcomes, including improved client satisfaction, faster access to information, reduced manual processing, better data quality, increased straight-through processing, improved control effectiveness and lower operational risk. 
 - Champion a culture of continuous improvement, using client and operational insight to identify new opportunities and move propositions from concept through to production adoption. 

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- Preferable to have demonstrable experience in the Custody domain, preferably across Asset Servicing and/or Corporate Actions, with a good to have understanding of custody operations, settlement, reconciliations, books and records, client servicing, data management and operational resilience. 
 - Experience applying specification-driven development practices to improve delivery quality, traceability and control effectiveness, ensuring that AI solutions are developed against agreed acceptance criteria, testable requirements, measurable business outcomes aligned with the guardrails & consistency of the solution. 
 - Strong and hands-on experience in data strategy, data-led proposition development and applying data to improve client outcomes, operational performance and decision-making. 
 - Proven (hands-on) experience leading digital experience, digital servicing or proposition design initiatives within financial services or another complex, regulated environment. 
 - Demonstrable track record of delivering technology-led business transformation from strategy and discovery through to implementation, adoption and measurable benefits. 
 - Mandatory experience using and implementing Artificial Intelligence projects specifically within Asset Servicing or closely related Securities Services activities, with a sound understanding of production delivery, data requirements, governance and responsible Artificial Intelligence. 
 - Strong understanding (and hands-on experience) of modern technology and digital delivery tech stack, including APIs, data platforms, workflow automation, integration, cloud-enabled services and data visualisation. 
 - Ability to translate complex business and operational needs into clear propositions, investment cases, delivery roadmaps and success measures. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across business, technology, operations, product, risk, compliance and regional teams. 
 - A strategic, commercially minded and collaborative approach, with sound judgement and a strong focus on client experience, operational resilience, control effectiveness and sustainable growth.

We are seeking a Principal Data Engineer to design and build a next-generation proprietary data platform from the ground up at a global leading trading firm. You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A. 

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets. 

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows. 

What You'll Do

- Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery. 
 - Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets. 
 - Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data. 
 - Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources. 
 - Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products. 
 - Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks. 
 - Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.

 - Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets 
 - Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams. 
 - Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions. 

What We're Looking For

- Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business. 
 - Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems. 
 - Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources. 
 - Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation. 
 - Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams. 
 - Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation. 

Desirable Experience

- Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.

We are seeking an experienced Associate Director, IAM Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Observability & Automation to lead reliability engineering, operational architecture, observability, service automation, and platform resiliency initiatives across the enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) ecosystem. 

This role is responsible for improving the availability, performance, scalability, recoverability, and operational readiness of critical IAM platforms, including Privileged Access Management (PAM), Active Directory, PKI, Secrets Management, Authentication Services, Cloud Identity Platforms, and Identity Security services. 

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in IAM operations, site reliability engineering, observability, scripting, and test automation to drive proactive monitoring, service health management, operational automation, and continuous improvement across the IAM landscape. 

The Associate Director will work closely with Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams to ensure IAM services are designed, instrumented, tested, and operated for maximum reliability and resilience.

data.title: Staff Quality Engineer — Qira AI Platform
data.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers. 

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world's largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo's continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY). 

This transformation together with Lenovo's world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www. lenovo. com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub. 

About The Role

As a Staff AI Quality Engineer for the Qira AI Platform, you will lead the technical test strategy and architectural validation for Lenovo's cross-device agentic AI ecosystem. You will serve as the technical authority on evaluating non-deterministic systems, designing automated quality platforms that operate across personal computing form factors (PCs, tablets, and smartphones). You will drive non-functional quality standards-ensuring that privacy, security, accessibility, internationalization, and device thermals/battery efficiency are safeguarded-while acting as a crucial release partner alongside Product Management and PMO leads. 

What Will You Do

- Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness. 
 - Agentic AI Quality Frameworks: Design automated evaluation methodologies to validate multi-step agent reasoning, tool-calling graphs, autonomous error recovery, and transactional rollback mechanisms; establish statistical release gates for non-deterministic model behaviors. 
 - Hardware Runtime Resource Profiling: Formulate automated performance and endurance soak suites to benchmark on-device SLM execution against cloud fallback paths, monitoring thermal throttling, memory leaks, and battery draw across hardware device tiers. 
 - Non-Functional Quality Standards: Lead automated verification across non-functional pillars: red-teaming indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities, securing inter-process data barriers, standardizing automated accessibility (screen-reader verbosity, dynamic token streaming), and validating semantic fidelity across international locales. 
 - CI/CD Quality Pipelines Gating: Drive the technical implementation of shift-left gating in continuous integration pipelines, establishing automated failure analytics, regression detection, and flakiness isolation frameworks. 
 - Cross-Functional Peer Leadership: Serve as a core technical gatekeeper alongside Product Management and PMO; establish release acceptance criteria, lead data-informed risk assessments during schedule compressions, and influence platform design for enhanced testability. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field. 
 - 8+ years of progressive software quality engineering, test architecture, and automation experience covering multi-device hardware ecosystems (Windows and Android). 
 - 3+ years of experience leading quality strategy and automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic AI workflows, or conversational platforms. 
 - Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons. 
 - Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation. 
 - Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on expertise implementing and tuning non-deterministic evaluation platforms (e. g. , RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, TruLens) in production pipelines. 
 - Direct experience testing local NPU runtimes and quantized models (INT4/INT8 vs. FP16) on client silicon (Qualcomm, Intel, AMD). 
 - Background designing automated testing for multimodal inputs (synchronized voice injection, screen-capture parsing, synthetic system events). 
 - Demonstrated ability to resolve complex release-gating disputes with Product Management and PMO using objective risk metrics and clear mitigation trade-offs. 

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

This role is for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with sound technical judgement. Someone who can move comfortably across different layers of the system, understand the underlying business problem, and make pragmatic technology decisions that stand the test of time. 

If you're excited by learning how the business works, challenging assumptions, simplifying complexity, and building high-quality systems end-to-end, we'd love to talk to you.

More importantly. . .

 - Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term maintainability. 
 - Understand trade-offs and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Requisition ID: 77662

Description

The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB's IC Verification Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on chip-level verification. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed & complex front-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US. 

As the Verification manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving chip top level verification. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad. 

In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company. 

We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast-paced dynamic team environment. 

Responsibilities

The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US leading IC design. 

Responsibilities Will Include, But Not Be Limited To

- Recruiting & Staffing: 
 - 
 - Jointly drive staffing & recruiting with HR to ensure a world-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs. 
 - Technical Leadership: 
 - Act as the IC Verification & Technical Leader for a team focused on the verification of RFICs that are integrated into our complex front-end modules
 - Experience managing large technical teams
 - A track record of growing successful design teams
 - Ability to set & articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those 
 - Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug-tracking and reporting
 - Communication: 
 - Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1: 1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US. 
 - Travel to US will be required from time to time
Required Experience And Skills

- The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status & schedule progress to senior management. 
 - Technical requirements: 
 - Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools
 - Deep and broad expertise in functional AMS verification of RFICs including RF/Analog/Digital content
 - Develop and maintain verification plans, strategies and methodology
 - Perform functional, behavioral and regression verification
 - Collaborate with RF designers and chip leads for successful tapeout and release of products to guarantee first-pass success
 - Automate verification flows and reporting infrastructure
 - Strong debug and root-cause analysis skills
 - Circuit Analysis: 
 - Understanding of analog blocks including low bit count data converters (ADC & DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge-pumps, Temp sensor, LDO, ESD, e-fuse and other supporting cells. 
 - Knowledge of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning & RF LNA design. 
 - Digital Design including SPI & MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines. 
 - Semiconductor device and process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe. 
Minimum Requirements

- BSEE; MS preferred
 - 10+ years of IC Design/Verification experience
 - 6+ years of Technical Leadership and Management experience

Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities. 

Lead, DevOps

Job Description

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced DevOps erve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, assessing DevOps maturity, identifying capability gaps, recommending improvement opportunities, and guiding teams through the implementation and adoption of approved standards, practices, and enterprise capabilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own and advance a designated DevOps capability domain, defining its implementation patterns, adoption strategy, technical direction, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Serve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, providing technical leadership, standards guidance, architecture direction, and capability adoption support. 
 - Lead DevOps excellence evaluations by establishing maturity baselines, assessing current-state capabilities, defining and tracking key performance indicators, performing gap analyses, measuring progress against target-state objectives, and recommending improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead DevOps capability adoption across product teams by assessing current-state maturity, identifying capability gaps, establishing implementation backlogs, defining roadmaps, and driving adoption of enterprise DevOps standards. 
 - Perform application, platform, and team readiness assessments to identify technical, operational, process, skills, and capability gaps. Conduct gap assessments against enterprise cloud requirements, engineering standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and DevOps standards, and define remediation plans to address identified deficiencies. 
 - Lead the planning and execution of DevOps transformation and implementation initiatives, including roadmap development, backlog establishment, work prioritization, effort estimation, resource planning, budget forecasting, and day-to-day delivery coordination. 
 - Assign, lead, and support DevOps Engineers embedded within product teams to accelerate capability adoption, standards implementation, platform modernization, and delivery improvements. 
 - Ensure all engagements include structured coaching, mentoring, knowledge transfer, documentation, and capability enablement activities that increase team self-sufficiency and reduce long-term dependency on embedded DevOps support. 
 - Establish clear engagement objectives, success criteria, transition plans, and exit criteria that enable operational ownership to be successfully transferred to product teams once capabilities have been adopted. 
 - Provide low-level solution architecture and low-level cloud architecture guidance, ensuring applications, platforms, delivery pipelines, and operational practices remain aligned with enterprise standards, architecture principles, and strategic technology direction. 
 - Design, review, and contribute Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application deployment specifications, automation scripts, and reusable implementations that improve scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead and promote observability and monitoring practices that improve visibility into application and platform health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Integrate security controls and tooling into development pipelines and partner with engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Apply and promote DevOps good practices, industry standards, enterprise architecture principles, and approved engineering patterns across product teams and platforms. 
 - Define and promote standard implementation patterns, ensuring teams leverage approved enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever practical and appropriate. 
 - Track delivery milestones, capability adoption progress, implementation outcomes, and team objectives, proactively identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required. 
 - Perform code reviews, architecture reviews, standards compliance reviews, and change-control assessments to identify quality, security, reliability, and compliance gaps. 
 - Promote awareness and adoption of enterprise platforms, shared services, engineering capabilities, and reusable solutions available across the organization. 
 - Create opportunities for experimentation, proof-of-concepts, pilot implementations, and innovation initiatives that improve engineering effectiveness, accelerate adoption, and support the evolution of DevOps capabilities. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, automation practices, cloud capabilities, observability approaches, and AI-driven engineering techniques, recommending solutions that improve the repeatability, reliability, security, and efficiency of software delivery. 
 - Demonstrate initiative, maintain a continuous learning mindset, and support the ongoing evolution of the assigned DevOps capability domain. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in IT operations, DevOps, platform engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one designated DevOps capability domain, such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, observability and monitoring, deployment automation, platform engineering, or DevSecOps. 
 - Strong technical background in DevOps practices, including cybersecurity and secure software delivery. 
 - Experience with low-level solution architecture, Infrastructure as Code, low-level cloud architecture, and observability and monitoring. 
 - Expert knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD). 
 - Demonstrated understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Agile development and Scrum methodologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps good practices and relevant industry standards. 
 - Excellent project-management, problem-solving, and analytical skills. 
 - Strong communication, presentation, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills, including written and verbal communication. 
 - Strong English-language skills and comfort communicating in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and teach technical concepts to engineers and product teams. 
 - Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive projects and capability outcomes to completion. 
 - Capability-ownership mindset with accountability for technical quality, adoption, standards, and continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with team and people leadership. 
 - Experience assessing candidates for technical positions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to quickly develop a working understanding of new technologies. 
 - Fast learner with a strong willingness to acquire and apply new skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to accept feedback and take action. 

Preferred Qualification

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, or a comparable cloud certification, is a plus

Working under the Automation Lead, this role builds high-quality SOAR playbooks, integrations, scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and orchestration pipelines to reduce manual workloads and support the Autonomic Security Operations (ASO) model.

Automation Engineering & Development

 - Build scalable, reusable automation components, scripts, and integrations. 
 - Implement high-quality scripting using Python, PowerShell, and REST APIs. 
 - Ensure appropriate version control, QA, testing, and documentation of automation artefacts. 
 - Maintain reliability of automations by monitoring performance, exceptions, and system behaviour. 

Platform Integration & Tooling Engineering

- Integrate SOAR with SIEM, EDR, TIP, cloud-native security tools, and case management systems. 
 - Engineer automation pipelines to support Microsoft and Google security ecosystems. 
 - Develop API integrations, webhooks, and event-driven automation triggers. 
 - Support data transformation, enrichment, and telemetry orchestration requirements. 

AI / ML Automation Enablement

- Contribute to embedding AI/ML-driven enrichment and correlation logic into automated workflows. 
 - Support operationalisation of ML models for anomaly detection and decision support. 
 - Collaborate with data and detection teams to refine and enhance AI-enabled automation. 

Workflow Engineering & Process Automation

- Translate SOPs, response runbooks, and detection workflows into automated processes. 
 - Identify automation opportunities to eliminate manual tasks across SecOps functions. 
 - Ensure automated processes remain consistent, auditable, and compliant with Operational Security standards. 

Operational Collaboration & Support

- Work with Detection Engineering, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and Threat Intelligence teams to automate use cases. 
 - Participate in post-incident reviews and embed improvements into automation workflows. 
 - Assist with tool evaluations, optimisation initiatives, and integration efforts led by the Automation Lead. 

Continuous Improvement

- Contribute to a backlog of automation enhancements and new capabilities. 
 - Optimise accuracy, resilience, and efficiency across automation workflows. 
 - Ensure alignment with GCAT SOC10x principles, including 10X Technology, Process, Speed, and Visibility.

Technical Expertise

 - Proficiency in Python and/or PowerShell for automation development. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and event-driven automation. 
 - Experience integrating SIEM, EDR, TIP, and cloud-native security tools. 

Process & Operational Knowledge

- Understanding of workflows across SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and Detection Engineering. 
 - Ability to convert operational requirements and SOPs into engineered automation. 
 - Familiarity with playbooks, runbooks, and security process governance. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Strong communication and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work in an engineering-led, automation-first culture. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional technical teams in security operations. 

Certifications (Preferred)

- SOAR platform certifications. 
 - GIAC (GMON, GCTI, GCIH, GCDA). 
 - Python or scripting certifications. 
 - Azure or GCP cloud certifications. 

Key Attributes

- Engineering-first mindset with strong attention to detail.

 - Structured, methodical, and reliable approach to delivery.

data.title: Software Development Manager, PV Sports and Linear Tech / Live Events Publishing
data.description:
Description

Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers. 

We are a team of builders - from new graduates to seasoned architects - who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on. 

Who Are We

The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact. 

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices. 

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline

Define and communicate your team's roadmap and technical strategy to management, principal stakeholders, and partner teams, aligning priorities with customer needs

Facilitate systems design, architecture, and scaling discussions, making sound trade-offs across reliability, latency, and maintainability for the live sports catalog

Partner with product management and peer engineering managers to scope work, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality software that improves the live sports viewing experience worldwide

Champion operational excellence by establishing metrics, monitoring practices, and automation that keep your team's services healthy and your customers well-served

A day in the life

You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders. 

About The Team

The Prime Video Sports Publishing (LEP) team is the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device. 

We are a team that values inclusiveness, respect, and mentorship. Our technology choices and designs are driven by engineers, not handed down from above. We have a strong voice in shaping the product, pitching ideas up the chain rather than the other way around. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

data.description:
Trexquant is a growing systematic fund at the forefront of quantitative finance, with a team of world-class researchers and engineers. As we continue to expand our trading operations, we are investing heavily in building the next generation of our quantitative research & trading platform. 

Our Infrastructure Engineers are embedded within the following teams{{: }}

- C++ Trading Engineer
 As a member of the Engineering team, you will focus on developing high-performance trading systems, designing and optimizing short-term trading signals in a high-frequency environment with strict latency and efficiency requirements. You will also support independent trading activities by building robust C++ systems, collaborating with researchers and technologists, and delivering solutions that have a direct and measurable impact on trading performance
 - C++ Simulation Engineer
 As a C++ Simulator Engineer, you will work closely with quantitative researchers and traders to design, develop, and optimize high-performance systems for algorithmic trading. Your responsibilities will include building and maintaining the core infrastructure for trading simulations
 - Data Infrastructure Engineer
As a member of the Data team, you will focus on financial and market data development, building scalable, distributed pipelines for systematic web scraping and ingestion of diverse data sources, with strict latency and reliability requirements. You will also work on developing exchange connectivity solutions by creating high-performance C++ handlers to capture, process, and integrate real-time market data feedsWhen you apply for an Infrastructure role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Engineering team.   During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best team that closely aligns with your skills and preference. 

Responsibilities{{: }}

- Full lifecycle development of low-latency/high-throughput research and trading systems using C++ & Python
 - Build and optimize data processing pipelines to ensure reliable access to large, high-quality datasets
 - Assist in developing tools for back testing, model training, and strategy evaluation
 - Collaborate with researchers and traders to deliver technical solutions that improve research productivity and trading performance
 - Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to maintain high-quality standards
 - Stay abreast of emerging technologies, tools, and best practices, bringing innovative ideas to continuously improve our systems

Requirements

- Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or a related STEM discipline
 - Minimum 2 years of experience in C++ software development within demanding, real-time environments
 - Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17/20), including advanced features such as template metaprogramming
 - Demonstrated experience in building high-throughput, low-latency systems

- Experience working with matrix computation and optimization (Blaze, OpenBLAS, LAPACK)

 - Experience profiling and tuning production Linux systems for high throughput
 - Experience working with time-series processing or event driven systems
 - Experience working across C++ and Python boundaries, such as with bindings (pybind11, C API), embedded Python, hybrid pipelines and orchestration
 - A background in finance is preferred but not required

Benefits

- Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
 - Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in the decision-making process for research direction, and have the opportunity to lead on new ideas
 - Comprehensive benefits including healthcare and insurance

Job Role Description

Are you passionate about architecting enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines that empower embedded software teams to deliver with speed, quality, and confidence? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives. 

As our new Senior Software Integration Engineer, you'll be designing and maintaining automated build, test, and deployment workflows for embedded software products that accelerate DevOps adoption across Grundfos engineering teams. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging. 

What you will be doing

As a key part of the Embedded Software Integration & DevOps team, you'll create impact by driving engineering transformation by building scalable CI/CD infrastructure and automation frameworks that elevate software delivery across multiple product platforms. 

Your main responsibilities include: 

- Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines for embedded C/C++ software products, including automated build, test, validation, and deployment workflows
 - Define and enforce pipeline standards, quality gates, and governance practices while building reusable templates and shared automation frameworks across product teams
 - Integrate static code analysis, security scanning, unit testing, and compliance checks into delivery pipelines, implementing DevSecOps and software supply chain security practices
 - Drive DevOps adoption across engineering teams by mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and leading automation initiatives organization-wide
 - Develop Python-based solutions for build orchestration, deployment automation, and API integrations with DevOps and SCM platforms
 - Manage cross-compilation toolchains, artifact repositories, and firmware build/packaging/deployment processes while troubleshooting complex build and dependency issues

What makes you a great fit

Above all, you're a seasoned integration engineer with deep CI/CD expertise, a DevOps-first mindset, and the ability to drive standardization and automation across multiple embedded software teams. We'd also imagine that you are/have: 

- 9+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Build Engineering, DevOps, or CI/CD Automation with proven experience designing pipelines from scratch
 - Strong experience supporting Embedded C software development environments including cross-compilation, toolchain management, and firmware deployment
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and implementing DevSecOps practices including software supply chain security
 - Demonstrated ability to lead automation initiatives across multiple teams with excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

It's a plus if you also: 

- Familiarity with tools such as Black Duck, SonarQube, Coverity, or Fortify, and experience in regulated industries with cybersecurity requirements for embedded products
 - Track record of driving engineering transformation initiatives at scale

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations. 

Join Grundfos, apply today!
