data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Applications Architect
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Software Engineer - Applications Architect

Principal Engineer - Applications Architect

Worker Type Level Location Number of Positions

Employee L5 Pune 1

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment-network services, predominantly Java based. 
 - Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross-cutting issues. 
 - Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction. 
 - Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness. 
 - Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams. 
 - Communicate architecture trade-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams. 

Essential Skills

- Extensive software architecture and hands-on Java development experience in large-scale systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture especially Kafka, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production-readiness practices. 
 - Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams. 
 - Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing multi-region resiliency architectures, including active-active and active-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions. 
 - Champions operability and maintainability as first-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception. 
 - Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization. 
 - Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation. 
 - Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.description:
Lead Full-Stack Engineer

Location: Pune, India

Model of Work: Hybrid

Working Hours: 12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM IST, a nine-hour workday that provides overlap with US Central Time stakeholders. 

About Quorum Software

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1, 800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware. com

Be a part of our legacy

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies. 

Who We Are Looking For

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation. 

The Opportunity

Quorum is seeking a Lead Full-Stack Engineer to own the technical design, development, and long-term success of a portfolio of AI-native platforms and operational solutions within Cloud Operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who enjoys building products, establishing practical engineering standards, and owning production outcomes. You will serve as the primary technical lead and code owner while partnering with Cloud Operations, engineering peers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders. 

The initial focus is QPOP, the Quorum Platform Operations Portal, an Azure-native internal platform that brings service management, change management, estate visibility, customer relationships, and operational workflows into a unified experience. As the portfolio grows, the role will also deliver governed AI agents, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 

What You Will Own

- Application architecture and code quality across the assigned portfolio, including module boundaries, integrations, data models, testing standards, and production readiness. 
 - Engineering standards for code review, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates, documentation, observability, security, and an AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI SDLC). 
 - Technical delivery from design through production support, working with partner teams rather than operating as a standalone contributor. 
 - Repository governance, including code ownership, reusable development patterns, AI-development guidance, prompt and agent assets, evaluation criteria, and review controls. 

What You Will Do

- Deliver full-stack application modules from design through build, integration, verification, release, and ongoing support. 
 - Build workflow integrations with enterprise platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, PagerDuty, Microsoft Fabric, and related internal systems. 
 - Design reliable integration patterns using idempotency, webhooks, retries, reconciliation, failure recovery, and traceable audit records. 
 - Implement enterprise authentication and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0, Microsoft Entra ID, and role-based access control. 
 - Build metadata-driven forms, service catalogs, request workflows, and rules-driven user experiences. 
 - Design and develop governed AI agents, MCP servers, assistants, and agentic workflows that take approved actions through well-defined tools, permission checks, human approval points, and complete audit trails. 
 - Embed AI-assisted engineering into the SDLC, including planning, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, security validation, and controlled promotion, while ensuring engineers remain accountable for every change. 
 - Deliver applications and infrastructure through GitHub Actions, OIDC, Bicep, and controlled promotion across development, non-production, and production environments. 
 - Create automated unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests that provide confidence in releases. 
 - Participate in the appropriate production support and on-call rotation, with shared operational ownership across the team. 
 - Document architecture, operational procedures, key decisions, and support requirements as part of normal delivery. 
 - And other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience delivering production full-stack applications using modern React, Next. js, TypeScript, and server-side APIs. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and long-term ownership of a production codebase, including architecture decisions, engineering standards, code review, and mentoring. 
 - Experience delivering production software through an AI-enabled SDLC using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Ability to explain how AI-generated code, prompts, agent behavior, and tool integrations were reviewed, tested, evaluated, corrected, secured, and governed before production release. 
 - Experience building enterprise integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous messaging, retries, reconciliation, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong SQL data modeling experience, including schema migrations, entity resolution, and traceable audit records. 
 - Experience implementing enterprise identity and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0 and role-based access control. 
 - Proficiency with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code using GitHub Actions and Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies. 
 - Strong automated testing experience across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Production troubleshooting and observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, health checks, dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across international teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Claude Code experience, including planning modes, subagents, repository guidance, hooks, skills, automated evaluations, or headless CI execution. 
 - Experience building and operating LLM assistants or AI agents with tool use, streaming responses, conversation state, evaluations, observability, safety controls, and orchestration of actions against real systems. 
 - Experience designing or consuming MCP servers and working with Anthropic APIs, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model gateways, or equivalent AI platforms. 
 - Experience building metadata-driven forms, low-code platforms, service catalogs, or rules-driven user interfaces. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps work-item APIs and service hooks. 
 - Experience with Fastify, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, and Azure Key Vault. 
 - Experience with durable orchestration using Azure Durable Task Scheduler, Temporal, or an equivalent platform. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Graph, Okta APIs, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI REST APIs, or Cloudflare Zero Trust. 
 - Experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. 

Success In The First 90 Days

- Become productive in the application architecture, codebase, delivery pipeline, and operational model. 
 - Deliver a semi-production application into production for use by its intended audiences, with defined acceptance criteria, appropriate controls, operational documentation, monitoring, and a support model. 
 - Implement or improve module-level RBAC, health endpoints, automated testing, and observability where applicable. 
 - Build effective working relationships with Cloud Operations, architecture, platform, security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Participate in technical planning, production-readiness reviews, and the applicable support model. 

Technology Environment

The current environment includes Next. js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Bicep, GitHub Actions with OIDC, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Service Bus, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Prisma, Fastify, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Anthropic Claude enterprise APIs, Cloudflare Zero Trust, and Vitest. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed. 

Additional Details

- Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position. 

Quorum Diversity Statement: At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique. 

Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. 

Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department

Recruitment Scam Alert: Quorum Software does not charge fees, request payments, conduct interviews via messaging apps, or request the installation of software at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate recruitment activities are conducted exclusively through our official careers website (www. quorumsoftware. com/careers) and email addresses ending in @quorumsoftware. com. Any communication that does not originate from these official channels should be considered unauthorized and may be reported to [email protected]

data.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. 

Position Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Development Team Manager to lead our Active Integration R&D team in Pune. Your mission is to build and manage a high-performing team of engineers-including UI/UX & AI experts, Cloud Lead Developers, and Teamcenter specialists-to deliver the next generation of Siemens Xcelerator solutions. 

The Active Integration platform features smart and ready to use gateways for SAP Business Suite, Oracle EBS, Opcenter, Product Cost Management and other Enterprise Applications. 

As the Software Engineering Manager, you will lead a highly multi-functional, agile team comprising both local and external/contractor developers. In this role, you will act as a key bridge, collaborating closely with Product Management and the Software Operations team to orchestrate seamless software delivery. You will cultivate a collaborative culture that balances operational excellence with rapid innovation, ensuring our engineering efforts align directly with business and product objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Personnel Management & Leadership: Partner closely with the Software Engineering Manager to supervise, hire, train, appraise, reward, motivate, and discipline engineering staff, including recommending termination when necessary. 
 - Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Act as the technical lead and mentor for junior engineers, offering high-level technical expertise, problem resolution, and leadership to the development group. 
 - System Design & Architecture: Create, document, and implement robust software designs, which includes spearheading the significant re-architecting of critical internal systems. 
 - Drive the adoption of AI-based development approaches within the team, ensuring AI is used as a core competency to accelerate engineering productivity. 
 - Functional Quality Assurance: Be responsible for and ensure the overall functional quality of all released software products, focusing on high-quality, on-time delivery that exceeds customer expectations. 
 - Product Direction & Innovation: Influence the technical roadmap for a specific product area and actively promote innovation by introducing new technologies and advanced knowledge to the team and product. 
 - Complex Programming & Analysis: Perform in-depth, highly complex software systems programming and analysis, working independently with complete latitude for judgment on advanced projects. 
 - Customer Collaboration & Advisory: Regularly collaborate with customers regarding future product upgrades, using a broad knowledge of internal operating systems, application implications, and customer environments. 
 - Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the development process, driving permanent corrective actions and operational efficiency. 
 - Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent. 
 - Experience: 
 - 15+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management, leading R&D teams, or directing technical organizations. 
 - 8+ years of Hands-on experience in C++/Full Stack/Cloud/AI Technologies
 - Demonstrated professional experience with Teamcenter is required. 
 - Proven experience scaling enterprise-level software ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale digital transformation environments. 
 - Enterprise Data & Migration Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on or leadership experience architecting and delivering large-scale data migration initiatives, enterprise data integration pipelines, and modern data lake / data warehouse architectures across heterogeneous systems (e. g. , migrating legacy ERP/PLM data stores to cloud data platforms). 
 - Demonstrated success managing and orchestrating multi-functional, cross-cultural teams across international time zones (e. g. , Europe and India). 
 - AI, Data Lakes & Analytics Mastery: 
 - Strong conceptual and practical understanding of AI/ML ecosystems (LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and AI tooling). 
 - Deep proficiency in enterprise data management, including structuring and querying data lakes, managing massive data migration projects, and establishing reliable ETL/ELT pipelines. 
 - Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerization/orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) crucial for modern AIG infrastructure. 
 - Extensive experience with complex system integrations (Siemens Active Integration, SAP, PLM/ERP systems, event-driven architectures, and API gateways). 
 - Mastery of Agile methodologies, software lifecycle (SLC) governance, quality assurance, and fostering developer productivity through modern AI-assisted coding tools. 
 - Exceptional communication skills; ability to align executive leadership, product management, and hands-on engineering teams around a unified AI-first vision. 
Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that's as ambitious as it is authentic. Let's transform the future of fitness-together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

Lead the service transformation teams

Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans. 

Turn architecture into shipped services

Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered. 

Establish the base service tier

Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application - and the AI agents and partners building on top of them - can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably. 

Protect compatibility and business continuity

Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved. 

Modernize the application foundations

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over. 

Raise the bar for engineering quality

Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops - layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience - that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly. 

Drive AI-native ways of working

Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates - not manual inspection - prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Hire and grow strong engineers

Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through. 

Partner across the program

Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed. 

What This Is Not

This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes - while your engineers own the code. 

This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications. 

This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events. 

What You Bring

Proven engineering leadership

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health. 

Service transformation depth

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments - and delivering those migrations to production. 

Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency

Enough hands-on depth - in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems - to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room. 

Migration safety instincts

You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs. 

Quality and operational discipline

You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built - and you hold that bar for your teams. 

People development

You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care. 

Cross-functional execution

You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute. 

An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering

You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning - and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective. 

Bonus Points

Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades. 

Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies. 

Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well. 

Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers. 

Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks). 

Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering. 

What Success Looks Like

The base service tier becomes real

Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired - reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered. 

Convergence advances without destabilizing the business

Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use. 

The platform compounds

data.title: Team Leader - Data Analytics
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly capable Team Leader - Data Analytics (P4) to lead and manage the Data Analytics function within the UK&I Transport & Infrastructure PMO GCC. 

The role is responsible for delivering high-quality, scalable, and data-driven analytics solutions across data engineering, visualisation, reporting, automation, and advanced analytics, enabling effective decision-making across project controls, programme performance, portfolio governance, and strategic leadership reporting. 

This is a dual leadership role requiring both strong technical expertise and effective people leadership. The successful candidate will lead a team of data analytics professionals, drive reporting standardisation, champion digital innovation, and work closely with Head -T&I PMO, PMO Leads and UK stakeholders to continuously streamline, optimise, and enhance reporting and insights across projects.

 - Foster a strong "one-team" culture across GCC and UK / onshore stakeholders, promoting collaboration, accountability, and shared success.

 - Define and implement a standardised reporting solutions across projects and portfolios which are scalable, efficient, and aligned to PMO governance standards. 
 - Work in consultation with PMO Leads in GCC and UK stakeholders to align project reporting requirements to the appropriate maturity level. 
 - Standardise key dashboards, templates, KPIs, and reporting approaches to support consistency across the portfolio. 
 - Drive adoption of common data models and structured reporting approaches across teams.

 - Power Automate for workflow and process automation 
 - Power Apps for digital forms, data capture, and process enablement 
 - Identify repetitive manual processes and convert them into efficient automated solutions. 
 - Design integrated workflows connecting project data, approvals, alerts, and reporting outputs. 
 - Promote a digital-first approach to reporting, governance, and information management. 
 - Propose and implement practical automation solutions that improve efficiency, control, and user experience. 
 - Technical Analytics, Data Engineering & Advanced Insights

 - Promote use of advanced Excel, Power Query, DAX, SQL, Python, and modern data engineering practices where appropriate. 
 - Explore opportunities to apply advanced analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and automation to improve efficiency and insight generation. 
 - Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable, business-relevant insights for PMO, project, and leadership stakeholders. 
 - PMO, Project Controls & Business Integration
 - Work closely with PMO Leads, Project Controls teams, Commercial teams, and Delivery stakeholders to align analytics outputs with business and project needs. 
 - Ensure reporting supports visibility across Cost, Schedule, Risk, Commercial performance, Resource and delivery metrics 
 - Integrate analytics outputs with project controls and PMO processes to strengthen governance and decision-making. 
 - Support alignment of reporting with project and portfolio performance frameworks. 
 - Enable joined-up reporting across PMO, controls, commercial, and operational functions. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration
 - Act as the primary analytics SPOC for collaboration between GCC and UK stakeholders on reporting and analytics requirements. 
 - Partner with PMO leadership, Project Directors, Project Managers, and functional leads to understand evolving reporting needs. 
 - Present insights through governance forums, showcases, leadership reviews, and stakeholder meetings. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, Finance, Risk, Commercial, and Project Controls to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Build trusted relationships and position the GCC analytics team as a value-adding strategic partner. 
 - Strategy, Innovation & Continuous Improvement
 - Drive the analytics capability roadmap for the PMO GCC, aligned to business needs and digital strategy. 
 - Continuously review current ways of working and identify opportunities to streamline, optimise, and improve reporting and analytics delivery. 
 - Stay up to date with the latest developments in analytics, Power Platform, automation, AI, and emerging technology, and translate relevant advancements into practical solutions for projects and PMO teams. 
 - Introduce new tools, methods, and innovations to improve reporting maturity and operational efficiency. 
 - Support knowledge management and reusable solution development across the analytics function. 
 - Define and track service performance metrics, team KPIs, and adoption measures. 
 - Capability Building & Training
 - Build a sustainable and continuously improving analytics capability within GCC. 
 - Develop structured training and development plans such as Power Platform, PMO reporting standards and KPI design etc. 
 - Promote data literacy and dashboard adoption across PMO and project teams. 

Ensure the analytics team remains technically current and aligned to evolving business and technology requirements. 

Essential

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Information Systems, or related discipline. 
 - 8-12 years of experience in Data Analytics / BI / PMO Reporting / Project Controls Analytics / Management Information roles. 
 - Proven team management experience leading and managing Data Analytics professionals, including workload allocation, mentoring, performance management, structured upskilling, and delivery governance. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Power Platform, SQL and other reporting and automation solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, automation, or advanced analytics use cases. 
 - Strong experience designing and delivering reporting solutions in PMO / project controls / infrastructure / engineering environments.

 - Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and influencing skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions. 

Desirable

 - Familiarity with Primavera P6, cost/commercial datasets, and project delivery reporting systems. 
 - Exposure to ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise systems. 
 - Experience with cloud or modern data platforms, such as Azure, AWS, Databricks, ADF, or equivalent. 
 - Exposure to additional BI / analytics tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 
 - Understanding of AI / ML / GenAI applications for analytics, automation, or reporting use cases. 
 - Relevant professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / Scrum, or equivalent. 

Tools & Technology

 - Power Apps - digital forms and process enablement 
 - Advanced Excel - Power Query, Pivot Tables, advanced analytics support

data.title: FS RC-FSRM - CSTC-MORTGAGE QUALITY CONTROL-QUALITY ASSURANCE-MANAGER
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)

Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview

As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post-underwriting and post-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks. 

Core Responsibilities

- Perform pre-funding and post-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
 - Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
 - Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
 - Validate collateral-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
 - Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e. g. , Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
 - Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
 - Reconcile underwriting decisions by re-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
 - Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
 - Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
 - Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
 - Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading

Domain Skills Required

- Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc. ) and underwriting frameworks
 - Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre-funding and post-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
 - Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
 - Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
 - Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
 - Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management-ready findings

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- MBA/CA or equivalent with 7-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
 - Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage. 
 - Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations. 

Good-to-have: 

- Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage-specific certifications
 - Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
 - Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Design Engineering Manager Piping support the Discipline Manager on achieving Jacob's project and engineering process and procedure. This dynamic position provides leadership, champions inclusion and diversity, drives global delivery, supports a culture of innovation applies a disciplined deployment and ensures Management responsibilities including performance appraisals, pay reviews, training and development. Manages professional employees and/or supervisors or manages multi-discipline teams of support employees accounting for a large/significant span of control. Has accountability for the performance and results of a team within own area of specialty. Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges and problem solving guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance from senior manager. Provides technical guidance to employees, colleagues and/or customers. Drives design consistency across projects by standardizing templates, specifications, and workflows. Promotes continuous improvement in design efficiency, digital tools, and engineering practices. 

The Piping Design Manager will lead and manage piping design activities for life sciences projects-including pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities, biotechnology plants, sterile/aseptic production suites, R&D laboratories, utility systems, and cleanroom environments. This role ensures that all piping design deliverables meet project requirements, regulatory standards, GMP compliance, and client expectations while driving innovation, efficiency, and quality. Ensure design deliverables meet quality and safety standards, regulatory expectations, and project specifications. Act as the primary point of contact for piping design matters with clients, PMCs, and EPC/EPCM partners. Participate in design workshops, HAZOPs, risk assessments, and constructability studies and provide technical support during construction, commissioning, and start‐up. 

Here's what you'll need

- 17-20 Years of Experience and Degree in full time BE/Btech - Chemical/Mechanical
 - Strong experience on design of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility / Speciality Chemical in terms of Piping design. 
 - Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical / Life Science /Biotech facility inter discipline requirements. 
 - Location- Navi Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Chennai (Candidate will be considered for Pharma & Lifescience only)

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer - VP
data.description:
Join us as a Full Stack Engineer - VP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as a Full Stack Engineer - VP, you should have experience with: 

- Extensive hands-on experience in Java (JDK 17+), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and building highly scalable, secure backend systems for financial and enterprise applications. 
 - Strong expertise in RESTful API design and development, microservices architecture, and service-to-service integrations in high-volume transactional environments. 
 - Strong experience in workflow orchestration and workflow management platforms, including designing and implementing long-running business processes, stateful workflows, and automation frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms, including Apache Kafka and asynchronous processing patterns. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise integration frameworks such as Apache Camel (or equivalent), implementing routing, mediation, transformation, orchestration, and API integration patterns across distributed systems. 
 - Solid understanding of end-to-end full-stack development, including frontend-backend integration and asynchronous communication patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern UI technologies including React, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, and frontend testing frameworks such as Jest or Jasmine. 
 - Experience working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases, with strong focus on data integrity and performance. 
 - Strong knowledge of security standards and practices including OAuth2, JWT, authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure coding guidelines. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, build tools (Maven, Gradle), and secure deployments. 
 - Proficiency with version control systems (Git) and enterprise development workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, system resiliency, fault tolerance, observability, and production support in mission-critical environments. 
 - Experience leading technical design discussions, conducting code reviews, and mentoring engineers in large delivery teams. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and integrating solutions on Hyperledger Besu or other enterprise blockchain platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of blockchain network architecture, node operations, transaction lifecycle, consensus mechanisms, and enterprise DLT deployments. 
 - Practical experience developing, integrating, testing, and supporting Smart Contracts and blockchain-enabled business workflows. 
 - Experience integrating enterprise applications with blockchain networks through APIs, events, message-driven architectures, and middleware platforms. 
 - Strong experience working in regulated environments with strict compliance, audit, and governance requirements. 
 - Deep understanding of system resiliency, fault tolerance, high availability, and performance optimization. 
 - Solid knowledge of design patterns, object-oriented principles, and enterprise architecture best practices. 
 - Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, integration testing, and contract testing. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and large-scale delivery models. 
 - Ability to collaborate closely with product owners, architects, QA, security, and DevOps teams. 
 - Strong communication skills for explaining complex technical solutions to business and senior stakeholders. 
 - Banking domain knowledge such as Payments & Transfer, Treasury, Settlement, Reconciliation, Regulatory and Compliance Controls. 
 - Experience building Digital Asset, Blockchain, Tokenization, Custody, Settlement, or Enterprise DLT platforms. 
 - Good understanding of workflow-driven architectures, orchestration patterns, event-driven systems, and distributed transaction processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architectures, and interoperability across complex banking ecosystems. 
 - Experience integrating on-chain and off-chain applications across enterprise platforms and blockchain networks. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Hyperledger Besu
 - Ethereum and EVM-Based Blockchain Platforms
 - Smart Contract Development and Integration
 - Tokenization Concepts and Platforms
 - Digital Asset Custody Concepts
 - Distributed Ledger Technologies (DLT)
 - Blockchain Architecture and Design
 - Consensus Mechanisms
 - Wallet and Key Management Concepts
 - Blockchain Security and Auditing Concepts
 - Enterprise Blockchain Integration Patterns
 - Web3 Fundamentals and Ecosystem Awareness

Artificial Intelligence & Developer Productivity

- AI-Assisted Software Development
 - Unit Test Generation
 - Code Review Automation
 - MCP (Model Context Protocol) Awareness
 - AI-enabled SDLC and Engineering Productivity Practices

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives. 

Accountabilities

- Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives. 
 - Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget. 
 - Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity. 
 - Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development. 
 - Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. 

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . 
 - If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department's future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . 
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions. . 
 - Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment. 
 - Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does. 
 - Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies. 
 - Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. 
 - Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. 
 - Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

data.title: Specialist Software Engineer, Full Stack — Decision Intelligence
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - Decision Intelligence

About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today. 

The opportunity

Amgen's AI & Data Science team is building decision-intelligence products that help teams make faster, more defensible decisions under uncertainty. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Decision Intelligence to join the Forecasting & Decision Intelligence team, within the AI & Data organization. This role will develop cutting edge scenario-planning capabilities, while creating reusable foundations for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI-assisted decision products across the enterprise. 

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer who can own meaningful product experiences end-to-end. You will build the interfaces people use to configure, launch, monitor, compare, and understand complex scenarios, as well as the APIs, data integrations, and execution services that make those experiences trustworthy. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, deploy, and operate end-to-end decision-support products across frontend, backend, data, and workflow layers. 
 - Create intuitive planner experiences for configuring scenarios, managing assumptions, launching and monitoring, comparing outcomes, and understanding uncertainty and trade-offs. 
 - Build responsive, accessible React/TypeScript user interfaces and reusable frontend components for scenario setup, results visualization, and decision workflows. 
 - Design and implement production APIs, backend services, data integrations, and execution workflows for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI-assisted decision products. 
 - Work closely with product managers, planners, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into simple, valuable releases. 
 - Lead substantial workstreams independently, provide thoughtful code reviews, and mentor developing engineers. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of professional software-engineering experience, including ownership of complex production applications or major end-to-end capabilities. 
 - Strong full-stack engineering experience, including modern frontend development with React and TypeScript and backend API development with Python or another modern server-side language. 
 - Experience designing usable, data-rich web applications in partnership with product, design, and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience with relational SQL and data-intensive applications, including integration with warehouse, lakehouse, or operational data systems. 
 - Experience with asynchronous processing, queues, workflow engines, or resilient patterns for long-running workloads. 
 - Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated commitment to code quality, accessibility, observability, documentation, and operational ownership. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with FastAPI, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, modular frontend architectures, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience building interactive visualizations and comparison workflows for analytical, operational, financial, or planning users. 
 - Experience embedding statistical models, optimization engines, simulation, or machine-learning capabilities into production applications. 
 - Experience with API and data-contract versioning, enterprise identity and access management, and secure integrations. 
 - Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, healthcare, finance, or another complex operational domain. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted product experiences and appropriate grounding, evaluation, and human-review controls.

We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

IoT Software Developer

Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies. 

If you want to build software where industrial IoT, edge computing, and cloud technologies converge, the Device Engineering Team is where it happens. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Implement software components and features based on provided designs, specifications, and guidance. 
 - Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable, and secure code within the assigned scope. 
 - Apply agreed coding standards, patterns, and best practices in daily development work. 
 - Make basic technical decisions within assigned tasks, escalating questions or uncertainties when needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate assigned requirements and tasks into working software. 
 - Complete development work in alignment with sprint goals and delivery commitments. 
 - Contribute to task breakdowns and effort estimates for assigned work. 
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, or implementation issues to the team. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable code and contribute to unit and integration tests. 
 - Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback and learning from peers. 
 - Ensure individual contributions meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) criteria. 
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality practices. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects and issues in development and production environments. 
 - Support corrective (bug fixes) and evolutive (enhancements) maintenance of existing solutions. 

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate effectively with other developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads. 
 - Seek feedback and guidance to continuously improve technical skills. 
 - Actively learn the systems, tools, and technologies used by the team. 
 - Contribute positively to team culture and shared ownership of outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 - Proficiency in C# and the . NET platform
 - Working knowledge of Python or other scripting languages
 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
 - Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Assets

- Hands-on experience with IoT, industrial automation, edge computing, or device lifecycle management
 - Experience with Azure IoTHub, DPS, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, or Azure Data Explorer
 - Experience supporting Windows based machines
 - Familiarity with OTA software and firmware update mechanisms
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity and data privacy controls for IoT environments

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3. 5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world's largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. 

Vultr Cares

- Medical Insurance stipend paid annually 
 - 9 Company-Paid Holidays 
 - Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
 - Professional Development Reimbursement 
 - Internet reimbursement 
 - Fitness membership reimbursement
 - Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Dev Engineer to serve as the technical owner connecting our engineering alerting to Vultr's new Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai, India, and to build the consolidated single-pane dashboard GIOC will operate from. The ideal candidate looks at five disconnected monitoring consoles and a dozen siloed alert feeds, winces, and then methodically builds the one dashboard that replaces all of them. This is a highly visible, focused role, requiring deep familiarity with Vultr's current architecture, monitoring stack, and operational workflows. This is your opportunity to build the operational backbone GIOC runs on from day one. 

Role Overview

The Senior Software Engineer - Tooling & Automation will own the development of automation, integrations, and unified monitoring capabilities for Vultr's GIOC in Chennai. The role will connect multiple monitoring, SIEM, infrastructure, and provider platforms into a single operational view, while automating alert routing, ticketing, paging, escalation, and SLA tracking. The engineer will work closely with Systems, Network, Security, and GIOC teams to improve observability, reduce manual intervention, and enable reliable 24×7 global infrastructure operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze every engineering alert stream across Systems, Network, and Security-including Icinga, Grafana, and SIEM platforms-to determine the optimal integration strategy via webhooks, APIs, or native connectors. 
 - Develop a robust notification layer that funnels high-priority events into GIOC's operational toolkit, ensuring critical context remains intact for rapid L1 response. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts to align automated routing logic with established escalation and resolution protocols. 
 - Engineer seamless on-call notification workflows that drive strict adherence to acknowledgment SLAs without requiring manual intervention. 
 - Architect a comprehensive single-pane dashboard that aggregates monitoring across global providers like Equinix and Airtel, eliminating inefficient tool-switching. 
 - Define the initial scope for visualization projects alongside leadership to meet aggressive technical and operational milestones. 
 - Maintain continuous infrastructure visibility by managing side-by-side operations of legacy and modern tools during the GIOC transition phase. 
 - Integrate health and performance metrics-such as escalation precision and aging-into reporting modules for executive-level status updates. 
 - Produce detailed documentation for all routing systems and dashboards to ensure long-term maintainability by global operations teams. 

Qualifications

- 5-8 years of experience in Platform Engineering or similar domains, with significant expertise in NMS platforms, Grafana, and major SIEM environments. 
 - Profound understanding of Vultr's existing monitoring ecosystem, infrastructure stack, and standard operational procedures across multiple technical pillars. 
 - Proven track record of building complex integrations using Python and RESTful APIs over the last three years. 
 - Extensive experience crafting or customizing sophisticated dashboards via Kibana, Power BI, or similar visualization toolsets. 
 - Deep knowledge of ITSM workflows-specifically Jira and Mattermost-and the technical mapping of event severity to incident metadata. 
 - Preference for candidates with experience in 24x7 global NOC/SOC environments and multi-provider datacenter logistics. 

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted. 

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U. S. privacy rules and India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures. 

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
