data.title: Lead SDET
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Own quality outcomes, not activities - the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint, " it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it. "
 - Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there - the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention
 - Own bug leakage rate - target under 2-3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through
 - Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite - preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does
 - Shape automation coverage at the right layer - E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it - not just chasing a coverage percentage
 - Stay 50-60% hands-on - writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code
 - Build AI-native quality infrastructure - systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions
 - Deliver engineering-wide quality impact - at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar
 - Partner and present - sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation - this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (: 40-50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring)
 - Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal - you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works
 - AI-native, not AI-assisted - you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves - validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems
 - A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator - with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow
 - Fluent in the modern stack - Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them
 - Comfortable influencing without authority - defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Job Description

Gracenote, the content data division of Nielsen, powers innovative entertainment experiences for leading media companies worldwide. Our advanced entertainment metadata and connected IDs enable seamless content navigation and discovery, helping consumers connect to the content they love and explore new favorites. With a global presence, Gracenote delivers both global and localized video, audio, automotive, and sports content solutions across the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Some of the biggest names who trust Gracenote are Jio, Amazon, NBC, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Samsung, Sony, and more. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Director of Engineering to lead our high-impact engineering organization at Gracenote. In this role, you will be responsible for defining technical strategy, building scalable architectures, driving platform modernization, and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (including Engineering Managers and technical leads). 

You will lead the evolution of next-generation metadata processing pipelines-integrating modern data platforms, automated web crawling, content curation, real-time metadata serving, and AI/Machine Learning solutions. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, and Global Business leadership to ensure our technology directly powers market-leading media solutions. 

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technical Vision

- Define Engineering Strategy: Drive long-term technical vision and architectural direction for Gracenote's core metadata, ingestion, and serving platforms. 
 - Platform Modernization: Lead initiatives to platformize metadata processing pipelines, transitioning legacy flows into modern, intelligent, high-performance distributed architectures. 
 - AI & Data Science Integration: Partner with Data Science and AI teams to integrate machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and GenAI capabilities into core operational processes, content ingestion, and data enrichment pipelines. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Excellence

- Scale High-Performing Teams: Lead, mentor, and build an engineering organization of Engineering Managers, Architects, and Software Engineers. 
 - Culture & Retention: Foster an inclusive culture based on Nielsen values-promoting innovation, continuous learning, technical rigor, and high associate retention. 
 - Talent Management: Oversee succession planning, performance management, career growth frameworks, and talent pipelines (including university relations and new joiner programs). 

Business & Stakeholder Alignment

- Product & Strategy Collaboration: Partner directly with Product Management, Data Science, and cross-functional executives to align engineering deliverables with key business metrics and strategic revenue drivers. 
 - Global Execution: Coordinate across local and global stakeholders to ensure seamless integration, high productivity, and successful delivery of high-visibility projects. 

Operational & Technical Execution

- System Scale & Reliability: Ensure overall system health by defining Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)-focusing on high availability, fault tolerance, low latency, recoverability, and scalability across global delivery APIs. 
 - Process Improvement & Automation: Drive agile methodologies and apply an automation-first mindset to software delivery, CI/CD, testing automation, and operational monitoring. 
 - Engineering Governance: Establish robust quality assurance standards, operational cadences, and continuous process optimization across the Product Development Lifecycle. 

Qualifications

Basic / Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

Experience

- 13+ years of total software development and engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing scalable, high-performance systems. 
 - 5+ years of direct management experience, including managing managers, technical leads, and multi-disciplinary global engineering teams. 

System Architecture & Tech Stack

- Deep expertise in object-oriented and functional programming languages (e. g. , Golang, Java, Python, Scala). 
 - Proven experience designing highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems and microservices. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern data architectures: real-time streaming architectures (e. g. , Kafka), batch data processing (e. g. , Spark, Flink), and RESTful/GraphQL API serving. 
 - Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Cassandra), caching layers (Redis, Memcached), and search engines (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch). 
 - Solid expertise in cloud-native deployment environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud ecosystems. 

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM)

Mortgage Quality Control (QC) Analyst - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview

As part of the Mortgage Quality Control (QC) team, the Analyst will perform independent post-underwriting and post-funding reviews of US residential mortgage loans to evaluate the accuracy of underwriting decisions, adherence to internal credit policies, and compliance with investor and regulatory requirements. The role involves detailed examination of approved and funded loan files to identify underwriting deficiencies, documentation gaps, and control weaknesses, while providing actionable insights to enhance mortgage credit quality, operational processes, and overall risk management frameworks. 

Core Responsibilities

- Perform pre-funding and post-funding Quality Control (QC) reviews of residential mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and policy compliance
 - Independently validate key underwriting calculations, including FOIR/DTI, LTV/CLTV, income calculations, and borrower eligibility criteria
 - Review borrower documentation such as income proofs, employment verification, bank statements, tax returns, and credit bureau reports to assess consistency and accuracy
 - Validate collateral-related documents including property appraisals, title reports, insurance, and legal documentation for compliance with lending guidelines
 - Assess adherence to investor and regulatory requirements (e. g. , Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA guidelines) and internal credit policies
 - Identify, document, and classify QC findings (defects) based on severity levels; perform root cause analysis and highlight control gaps
 - Reconcile underwriting decisions by re-performing key credit assessments and highlighting discrepancies in credit approval decisions
 - Track and report defect trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across reviewed files to support continuous improvement initiatives
 - Prepare QC reporting outputs including detailed review summaries, dashboards, and management reports for stakeholders
 - Collaborate with underwriting, operations, credit policy, and compliance teams to discuss findings and support remediation actions
 - Participate in calibration exercises and quality assurance processes to ensure consistency in QC review standards and defect grading

Domain Skills Required

- Strong understanding of US residential mortgage products (conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, etc. ) and underwriting frameworks
 - Experience in mortgage QC/QA including pre-funding and post-closing reviews, defect identification, and compliance validation
 - Knowledge of underwriting guidelines such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and agency lending standards
 - Familiarity with QC methodologies including defect grading, sampling, re-performance of underwriting, and root cause analysis
 - Ability to analyze borrower financials (income, assets, liabilities) and validate underwriting calculations
 - Experience in preparing structured QC reports, trend analysis, and management-ready findings

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- MBA/CA or equivalent with 7-10 years of experience in mortgage QC, underwriting, or retail credit roles. 
 - Strong analytical skills with experience in loan file review and underwriting validation
 - Advanced Excel skills; exposure to reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL and Basic Knowledge in AI is an added advantage. 
 - Strong communication skills with ability to clearly articulate QC findings and recommendations. 

Good-to-have: 

- Certifications such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or mortgage-specific certifications
 - Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and underwriting platforms
 - Exposure to regulatory audits, QC audits, or internal control testing environments

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

data.title: Storage Systems Architect
data.description:
Location - Bangalore / Pune / Kolkata / Indore

Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Storage Systems Architect to design and build storage software for AI workloads: NVMe and NVMe-oF data paths, flash tiering for KV cache and vector data, and GPU-to-storage paths. You will work with SSD vendors, AI platform companies and customer engineering teams, lead development, and contribute to presales. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect storage data paths for AI training and inference: NVMe, NVMe-oF (RDMA/TCP) and GPUDirect Storage. 
 - Design and build flash tiering for inference: KV cache offload and vector indexes (DiskANN-class) on SSD. 
 - Benchmark and characterize storage: latency, tail latency, IOPS and bandwidth using fio, SPDK perf and AI storage workloads. 
 - Lead C/C++ development in the Linux storage stack or in user space (SPDK). 
 - Evaluate new storage technology (Gen5/Gen6 SSDs, FDP/ZNS, CXL memory) and turn it into PoCs and customer offerings. 
 - Contribute to presales: solution design, technical proposals and customer architecture discussions. 
 - Mentor engineers and lead design reviews.   

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer engineering or computer science, Electronics, Electrical, (or equivalent experience). Experience

- 10 to 16 years in storage product engineering. 
 - Hands-on design or coding. Must-Have Technical Skills

- Storage product development (block, file or object), not only storage administration. 
 - Linux I/O stack (blk-mq, NVMe driver, io_uring) or SPDK. 
 - NVMe and NVMe-oF. 
 - C/C++ systems programming and performance analysis (perf, eBPF). 
 - Data protection fundamentals: replication, snapshots, RAID/erasure coding. Good-to-Have Technical Skills

- GPUDirect Storage, RDMA (RoCE/InfiniBand). 
 - KV cache offload frameworks (LMCache, NVIDIA Dynamo KVBM) and vLLM. 
 - Vector databases and ANN indexes (Milvus, DiskANN). 
 - Parallel or distributed file systems (Lustre, WEKA, DAOS, Ceph). 
 - SSD internals: FTL, FDP, ZNS. 
 - CXL memory tiering; Python.

Job Summary

Senior Architect role for a global enterprise responsible for designing scalable microservices solutions on cloud platforms using Java Springboot and Angular while guiding agile scrum practices and modern DevOps automation. The position focuses on creating resilient hybrid model applications that enhance customer experience optimize engineering productivity and align with business strategy. 

Responsibilities

- Design and architect scalable microservices based applications that enable reliable business services and improve overall system resilience for enterprise customers. 
 - Define robust application and integration architecture using Java Springboot and core Java so that complex business workflows are implemented with high performance and maintainability. 
 - Architect front end solutions using Angular frameworks to deliver intuitive and accessible user experiences that support diverse customer journeys and digital channels. 
 - Plan and implement cloud native solutions on AWS that leverage managed services to achieve secure deployments optimized cost structures and high availability across environments. 
 - Guide DevOps practices on AWS by promoting infrastructure automation continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that reduce deployment risk and cycle times. 
 - Collaborate with product owners and cross functional squads in a scrum environment to translate business requirements into technical designs that are clear feasible and value driven. 
 - Review solution designs and code for microservices and cloud components to ensure alignment with architectural standards security guidelines and long term scalability objectives. 
 - Create and maintain architecture blueprints reference implementations and design patterns that help engineering teams adopt consistent approaches across multiple product lines. 
 - Coordinate with hybrid work model teams across locations to ensure architecture decisions are communicated clearly risks are addressed early and delivery milestones are met on time.

 - Engage with stakeholders to explain architectural options and tradeoffs so that technology decisions are aligned with business priorities and regulatory considerations. 
 - Promote modern engineering practices such as test automation secure coding and observability for microservices based systems to enhance operational excellence and customer trust. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate between twelve and fifteen years of progressive experience in application architecture with a strong focus on distributed systems and enterprise scale platforms. 
 - Possess advanced hands on expertise in Java core Java and Springboot frameworks including designing and implementing complex Springboot microservices in production environments. 
 - Show practical experience in building and operating microservices architectures including service discovery fault tolerance configuration management and API design using industry standards. 
 - Have substantial exposure to AWS services such as compute storage networking and security features with a proven record of deploying and operating cloud native workloads. 
 - Bring solid knowledge of AWS DevOps tooling and practices including pipeline automation configuration management and environment standardization that supports frequent deployments. 
 - Exhibit strong proficiency in Angular for front end development with the ability to design modular components and responsive interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend microservices.

Are you passionate about transforming how millions of customers interact with their Amazon orders? Join us in revolutionizing order history search with advanced semantic search technologies that deliver lightning-fast results across all Amazon surfaces. We're building high-throughput systems that handle massive scale while ensuring every customer can seamlessly access their order history. 

As a Software Development Engineer III, you'll work at the intersection of modern search technologies and distributed systems, collaborating closely with applied scientists to design scalable semantic search experiences. This role offers the unique opportunity to lead technical initiatives that directly impact the daily lives of Amazon customers worldwide, while mentoring engineers and driving innovation in one of Amazon's most visible customer-facing platforms. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and build large-scale distributed systems that power order history search capabilities, ensuring minimal latency and exceptional performance for customers worldwide
 - Lead technical initiatives spanning the full software lifecycle from design through deployment, making architectural decisions that balance current constraints with future extensibility
 - Mentor and coach engineers on your team, conducting thorough code reviews and establishing best practices that elevate the team's technical standards
 - Collaborate with applied scientists, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate product vision into technical strategy, creating work-backwards plans and three-year roadmaps
 - Own team architecture and operational excellence, ensuring systems have proper monitoring, telemetry, runbooks, and retrospective processes while proactively addressing root causes of persistent problems

A day in the life

You'll begin by meeting with your team to identify blockers and guide engineers through ambiguous technical challenges. You'll engage with product managers to translate their vision into technical roadmaps and work-backwards documents, then collaborate with engineering leaders to prioritize initiatives. Throughout the day, you'll work hands-on with engineers across multiple programs, reviewing designs and code to ensure quality. You'll coordinate with Quality Assurance teams to establish robust testing strategies, ensuring features meet high standards before reaching customers.

The Recipient Experience team creates transparent and flexible delivery experiences that customers love. We own highly visible destinations including Your Orders, Progress Tracker, Order Details, and Product Owner Page, along with customer notifications that millions interact with daily. 

Our mission focuses on modernizing customer controls and enhancing order history search capabilities in innovative ways. We're building the future of how customers interact with their Amazon purchases, creating experiences that empower and delight. Our culture emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning as we tackle complex technical challenges at massive scale.

 - 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

This role is ideal for a well-rounded software developer who brings strong traditional software engineering fundamentals along with experience or interest in developing and integrating AI-enabled capabilities. 

The Senior Software Engineer will work as part of an Agile development team to build scalable, secure, and reliable applications while leveraging modern development practices, cloud technologies, automation, and emerging artificial intelligence tools and frameworks. The Lead Software Engineer will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to delivery predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety critical environment. The candidate will work on software that directly supports air traffic operations, applying AI tools to accelerate development, improve quality, and enhance system reliability. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of a team, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining source code within an Agile environment. 
 - Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, product owners, and other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into working software. 
 - Work within Agile/Scrum development environments and participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions. 
 - Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and services. 
 - Develop software using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, C#, or similar technologies. 
 - Develop automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality and reliability. 
 - Utilize modern DevOps and CI/CD practices to automate software builds, testing, deployment, and monitoring. 
 - Troubleshoot complex software issues and continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security. 
 - Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and performance

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline with relevant professional software development experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. 
 - 4+ years of relevant experience or a Master's Degree and 2+ years of relevant experience
 - Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to effectively collaborate with team members and present reports and status. 
 - Professional experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#. 
 - Experience with object-oriented programming, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and source control tools such as Git. 
 - Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, or distributed applications. 
 - Experience with modern software development methodologies and the SDLC.

Business, Plant, and Cross-Functional Leadership

Talent and Organizational Development

data.description:
The Principal GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI systems that combine LLM-powered GenAI and ADK-based agentic workflows on Google Cloud Platform. This role also requires leading and developing data pipelines for necessary data layer for AI/ML. This role sets architecture standards, leads multi-team delivery, and governs safety, reliability, and cost at enterprise scale-accelerating product teams to achieve monetization of AI based products through reusable patterns, platforms, and guardrails. 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Architecture

- Define reference architectures for GenAI apps, RAG systems, and agent ecosystems (single/multi-agent) on GCP using ADK. 
 - Leverage capabilities of Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform in the Agentic AI Product development. 
 - Establish domain and platform standards: model selection, RAG/generation patterns, memory architectures, security baselines, observability, and LLMOps. 
 - Lead portfolio-wide technical decisions (build/buy, vendor selection, SLAs, quotas) with a focus on reliability, safety, and cost control. 
 - Define the data pipeline development for lakehouse, delta lake or feature engineering. 

Solution Design & Delivery

- Architect and lead implementation of production-grade GenAI solutions (Vertex AI models, Grounding, Pipelines, Evaluation) and agentic services (planning, tools, memory, HIL). 
 - Design multi-tenant and hub-and-spoke patterns with Okta/IAP/Apigee for secure API exposure and tenant isolation. 
 - Drive end-to-end delivery across teams: data ingestion (Dataflow/Composer), indexing (BigQuery vectors/Vertex Vector Search), services (Cloud Run/Workflows), events (Pub/Sub). 
 - Data Pipeline both near real time and batch. 

Platformization & Reuse

- Build and maintain prompt libraries, tool catalogs, agent templates, and evaluation harnesses for organization-wide reuse. 
 - Standardize LLMOps: CI/CD for prompts/models/agents, model registry, traceability, rollback, canaries, cost/performance scorecards. 
 - Enable a marketplace of agents/services with productized APIs, documentation, chargeback, and KPIs. 

Responsible AI, Security & Compliance

- Implement multi-layer guardrails: policy prompts, filters, memory governance, tool whitelisting, audit logs; ensure regulator-ready posture. 
 - Codify privacy, PII handling, data residency, and per-tenant isolation using VPC-SC, Secret Manager, IAM, and Apigee policies. 

Leadership & Enablement

- Mentor senior engineers and team leads; run architecture reviews, design clinics, and red-team exercises. 
 - Drive continuous evaluation programs and publish org scorecards for quality, safety, and cost. 
 - Partner with Product, Security, and SRE to align roadmaps, SLOs, and operational playbooks. 

Required Technical Competencies

- Dataflow and Apache Beam for data pipeline development. 
 - Strong on using SQL for data analysis. 
 - LLM & GenAI: Model selection (Gemini & Model Garden), prompt engineering, RAG/grounding, multimodal pipelines, fine-tuning/adapter methods. 
 - Agentic AI (ADK): Agent loops, planners, tool/function design, memory (episodic/semantic/long-term), HIL, policy enforcement. 
 - Data & Retrieval: BigQuery (including vector functions), Vertex Vector Search, Document AI, Dataplex for lineage and governance. 
 - Orchestration & Services: Cloud Run, Workflows, Pub/Sub, Dataflow/Composer; HA/DR, backpressure, circuit breakers. 
 - LLMOps/MLOps: Vertex AI Pipelines, registry, CI/CD, trace correlation, cost/performance monitoring. 
 - Security & Compliance: IAM, Secret Manager, VPC-SC, private service connect, DLP, Okta/IAP, Apigee API policies. 
 - Observability & Cost: Central telemetry, user feedback loops, drift/outlier detection, quota/capacity planning. 

Qualifications

- 12-15+ years in software/data/ML engineering; 1+ years hands-on with LLMs/GenAI and agentic systems. 
 - Proven delivery of enterprise-scale GenAI/agent platforms on GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Workflows). 
 - Demonstrated impact in platformization, governance, and multi-team technical leadership. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript (or equivalent) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/GCP Deployment Manager). 
 - Experience in security-by-design, privacy, and compliance audits. 
 - Proven delivery in building data pipeline using distributed computing frameworks such as Dataflow, Spark.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Lead Release Engineer (Production Engineering)
data.description:

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical Lead Release Engineer with a strong engineering foundation to lead the end-to-end release lifecycle of our storage products. You will serve as the bridge between Development, QA, and Product Management - ensuring that complex storage stacks are delivered with high quality and predictable cadences. 

Unlike traditional project-based release management, this role demands deep hands-on expertise across CI/CD orchestration, codeline management, system-level triaging, fleet operations, and the engineering rigor required for data-critical products. You will own the health of our release pipelines, lead triage war rooms, drive automation initiatives, and participate in on-call rotations to keep CI and test-orchestration infrastructure running reliably. You will also build developer-facing tooling, manage HW test fleet operations, and maintain high-quality integration workflows across our code lines. 

What You'll Do

- Release Orchestration: Own the end-to-end release process for storage software and firmware, from development to GA (General Availability). 
 - CI/CD Leadership: Design and build optimized pipelines and tools to scale code management and merge operations. Work closely with systems such as Jenkins, test frameworks, Premerge, Orchestrator, and related developer productivity tooling to keep the codeline healthy and actionable. 
 - Technical Triaging: Act as the primary technical point of contact during the "war room" phases of a release. You must be able to understand bug reports, analyze logs, and work with engineers to prioritize fixes based on product impact. 
 - Quality Governance: Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects with engineering teams and TPMs to improve CI and release quality, developer experience, and overall reliability. Partner with product and infrastructure teams to find issues earlier in the pipeline, improve signal quality, and reduce manual toil in triage and merge operations. 
 - SDLC Optimization: Continuously improve the SDLC by identifying bottlenecks in the build-test-deploy loop and implementing automated gates. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Communicate release status, risks, and trade-offs to executive leadership, ensuring transparency across the organization. 
 - Fleet Management: Improve the health, automation, and operational efficiency of HW test fleets that support CI and merge workflows. 
 - Operation support: Participate in on-call duty rotations for CI and test-orchestration infrastructure; lead incident triage and mitigation, bring order to chaos, and ensure thorough follow-through on root-cause fixes. 
 - Automation: Build easy-to-use tools that help developers diagnose failures in test and infrastructure systems. Own and improve automation, workflows, and quality gates around git collaboration and code integration across FA and FB codelines. 

What You Bring

- Engineering Background: 8+ years in software engineering or DevOps, with at least 3-5 years specifically in a Release Management or Lead Capacity. 
 - CI/CD Mastery: Expert knowledge of orchestration tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible). 
 - Systems Thinking: Deep understanding of the full SDLC, including branching strategies (Gitflow/Trunk-based development) and versioning. 
 - Scripting/Automation: Proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automating release tasks and data analysis. 
 - Branching/Codeline management: Strong git and codeline intuition, with an appreciation for merge quality, guardrails, and release-safe integration workflows.

data.title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

Date Posted

21-Oct-2026

Closing Date

05-Nov-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.description:
NVIDIA's GeForce NOW, the next-generation gaming service powered by NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud, transforms a Mac, PC, or mobile device into a high-performance gaming machine. GeForce NOW keeps games up-to-date automatically, enabling users worldwide to instantly stream the latest games in high-definition resolution with minimal latency and the smoothest gameplay. Just click and play! Visit us at https: //www. nvidia. com/en-us/geforce-now. We are now extending this industry defining technology to a new range of applications including virtual and augmented reality, artificial intelligence and remote controlled robotics. 

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a team of skilled and motivated engineers who develop a high performance, low latency streaming stack that delivers unprecedented video quality at lowest latency that makes gaming from the cloud the preferred gaming platform for millions. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Design and develop new video streaming functionalities delivering new interactive experiences
 - Innovate, design and develop features to improve image quality, performance, reliability, security and maintainability
 - Analyze GPU/ CPU performance for the video pipeline, isolate bottlenecks and implement solutions in collaboration with GPU hardware and software teams to deliver top performance
 - Develop tools to measure video quality experienced by users, refine to enable evaluation of quality improvements with high confidence
 - Leverage features and toolsets in latest video compression technologies to deliver high quality streaming solutions tailored for different interactive graphics applications
 - Develop quality-evaluation and analysis capabilities that use metrics along with encoder statistics to detect regressions, evaluate new video features, and guide codec and pipeline tuning. 
 - Apply machine learning and AI models to develop specialized video processing and adaptive streaming algorithms to minimize perceptible artifacts while delivering the lowest latency under different network conditions. 

What We Need To See

- 5+ years of experience with Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related area. 
 - Proficiency in C, C++, Python
 - Strong understanding of real-time GPU-accelerated video pipeline performance, including encoder behavior, color spaces, video scaling, transport efficiency, buffering, pacing, bitrate adaptation, frame handling, and latency-sensitive optimizations in distributed or cloud-based systems. 
 - Familiarity with API frameworks such as Vulkan, CUDA, OpenGL and DX
 - Solid understanding of toolsets in different video codecs like H. 264, HEVC, and AV1, including tuning codec configurations to meet application requirements and trade-offs. 
 - Experience debugging and improving reliability and stability in complex streaming systems, including issues related to degraded network conditions, packet loss recovery, telemetry, tracing, field validation, and long-running session behavior. 
 - Proficiency in telemetry, statistical data analysis, and performance monitoring to measure and optimize video quality, latency, and system performance in cloud infrastructures. 
 - Experience in using and integrating AI models into real-time video pipelines
 - Experience with objective video quality assessment using metrics such as VMAF, CAMBI, PSNR, and SSIM/MS-SSIM, and the ability to correlate those metrics with perceptual video quality across different content types and artifacts. 
 - Strong understanding of different layers of software stack including OS internals, user-mode and kernel-mode drivers, strong system software performance analysis, testing and debugging skills

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience in optimizing video pipelines on multiple GPU families such as Intel integrated and AMD GPUs
 - Experience writing or analyzing graphics rendering applications or advanced AI based graphics generation such as DLSS, RTX, FSR

Required Qualifications

 - Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations. 
 - Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance. 
 - Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements. 
 - Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies. 
 - Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities.

About Us

Meesho is India's e-commerce marketplace, on a mission to democratise internet commerce. 

Our multi-sided technology platform connects four key stakeholders - consumers, sellers, logistics partners, and content creators - to power inclusive growth at scale. 

We enable individuals and small businesses to sell online with ease, offering access to a wide customer base, integrated logistics, payment solutions, and platform support. 

For customers, Meesho offers a broad and affordable selection, tailored for diverse needs across Bharat. We also empower creators to build commerce-driven content that drives discovery and engagement. 

Our logistics operations are powered by Valmo, Meesho's asset-light logistics platform that works entirely through partner-led infrastructure to ensure cost-efficient and scalable deliveries. 

Follow Meesho

LinkedIn Instagram YouTube Facebook Twitter Website

Benefits & perks

Health & Insurance

Medical Insurance: Base cover of ₹6 lakhs for employees and their families, including coverage for LGBTIQ+ and live-in partners, with day-1 coverage for pre-existing conditions. 

Accident & Life Insurance: Personal accident insurance up to 3x CTC and term life insurance up to 2x CTC. 

Wellbeing Support: Free doctor consultations, telehealth services, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

Leave & Time Off

Parental & Childcare Support: Gender-neutral parental leave, including 30 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers, 30 days for secondary caregivers, adoption assistance (up to ₹1 lakh), and pet adoption leave. 

Wellness & Special Leaves: Company-wide "Reset & Recharge" leaves (approx. 11 days), infinite wellness leaves (up to 365 days), and bereavement/paid time off (around 20 days/year). 

Financial Benefits & Equity

Stock Options (ESOPs): Direct ownership via MeeSOPs with employee-friendly vesting schedules and periodic buyback opportunities. 

Retirement & Planning: Provident Fund (PF), Gratuity, National Pension System (NPS) contribution options, and flexible benefit plan (FBP) tax benefits. 

Perks & Aids: Salary advance program (up to 3 months CTC), car lease policy, gym/wellness benefits, and relocation support. 

Work Culture & Learning

Work Arrangement: Remote-first and flexible work policies, with certain roles operating on hybrid or office models. 

Development & Training: Access to learning platforms, courses, and continuous development initiatives via MYAcademy and specialized programs. 

Why explore a career with us

The Key Reasons to Join Meesho

- Accelerated Career Growth & "Extreme Ownership"

Meesho operates on a culture of high autonomy. Teams utilize a "problem-first" approach rather than a feature-first approach. Employees are encouraged to take extreme ownership of projects early in their careers, giving them opportunities to ship ideas quickly and see their direct impact on millions of users. 

- Immense Impact (Building for the Next Billion)

Unlike platforms targeting Tier 1 demographics, Meesho is dedicated to democratizing internet commerce for Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. To foster deep user empathy, the company implements unique rituals like "Listen or Die" (LOD)-mandating that team members gather direct user insights before beginning any project-and sponsors user-safari trips into smaller towns to study consumer habits firsthand. 

- Top-Tier Compensation & Financial Perks

Meesho rates highly for its Compensation & Total Rewards (4. 1/5 stars on Glassdoor). The company offers: 

Competitive base cash salaries. 

Direct equity ownership with employee-friendly vesting schedules and frequent ESOP buybacks. 

Substantial lifestyle perks, such as gym benefits, car lease policies, and salary advance programs. 

- People-First Benefits & Well-Being

Through its MeeCare Program, Meesho focuses on holistic wellness. Notable initiatives include comprehensive health insurance, mental health support, flexible leave policies, and a distinct 9-day post-festive "rest and recharge" shutdown to prevent burnout after major sales campaigns. 

Interview process

Overview of Interview Rounds

- Application & Resume Screening: 
 - Candidates apply via official job portals, campus drives, or recruiter networks. 
 - AI-backed review tools on platforms like Lever may analyze resume metrics, experience, and baseline competencies. 
 - Online Assessment (OA): 
 - Typically lasts 90 to 105 minutes and features 3 to 5 coding and debugging questions (ranging from arrays and greedy approaches to graph/tree and dynamic programming problems) alongside computer science MCQs on OS, DBMS, and Networks. 
 - Technical Interviews (1-2 Rounds): 
 - Round 1 (DSA / Problem-Solving): Focuses on core data structures, algorithms, and logical problem-solving (such as greedy algorithms, array manipulations, or DFS/trees). 
 - Round 2 (Machine Coding / Low-Level Design): A practical coding or LLD session (e. g. , implementing a carpooling system or ticket booking system in 60-75 minutes) to test code structure, scalability, and clean design under constraints. 
 - Hiring Manager / System Design Round: 
 - In-depth discussion on past projects, internships, concurrency, multi-threading, and CS fundamentals like CAP theorem. 
 - Evaluates system architecture and trade-offs. 
 - HR / Cultural Fit Round: 
 - Focuses on alignment with Meesho's core values, such as "extreme ownership, " a "user-first" mindset, and structured communication.

Amazon OpenSearch is a fully managed and Serverless service that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch clusters for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, and more. The Amazon OpenSearch Core Foundation team owns the foundational indexing and search systems powering both OpenSearch Managed Service and Serverless offerings. data.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer - AI
data.description:
Are you passionate about building AI-driven software that transforms how professionals work? Join a dynamic and highly skilled team at Thomson Reuters, where we invest deeply in AI technologies and explore emerging fields with the backing of a global leader. As a Senior Software Engineer - AI, you will play a key role in developing intelligent systems that power the next generation of expert solutions across legal, tax, risk, and compliance domains. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - AI II, you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of product managers, UX designers, and engineers to design, build, and deliver AI-powered solutions. 

- Architect and implement advanced AI systems, including multi-component pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom AI agents with multi-step reasoning. 
 - Integrate AI models into production software through robust APIs and scalable data pipelines. 
 - Adapt AI models and techniques to specialized domains, tailoring solutions for expert systems in areas such as legal, tax, and compliance. 
 - Evaluate and prototype cutting-edge AI techniques to solve business challenges. 
 - Conduct proof-of-concept projects for new AI-driven features. 
 - Stay current with AI research and emerging technologies. 
 - Break down functional requirements into scalable technical specifications. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and facilitate technical discussions 
 - Contribute to MLOps and LLMOps practices, both in design and implementation. 
 - Act as a thought leader, sharing expertise in company-wide forums and representing the organization in emerging technology areas. 
 - Implement comprehensive testing frameworks and monitoring systems for AI model performance 
 - Ensure compliance with ethical AI principles and security standards. 
 - Conduct systems analysis and recommend operational improvements. 
 - Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, designers and product teams to translate AI capabilities into real-world applications. 
 - Optimize AI system performance considering factors like latency and resource usage. 
 - Support application feature enhancements through AI capabilities. 

About You

You are a fit for the position of Senior Software Engineer- AI if your background includes: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience. 
 - 7+ years of experience in software engineering; at least 2 years focused on AI/ML. 
 - Proficiency in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks (e. g. , PyTorch, TensorFlow). 
 - Strong understanding of machine learning principles, evaluation, and system design. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps and the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-powered software applications. 
 - Experience integrating AI models into production systems using APIs and data pipelines. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Strong communication skills and experience working in cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience with AI-driven systems, agent-based architectures, or AI APIs from providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. 
 - Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or search-based AI. 
 - Domain knowledge in legal, tax, or accounting. 
 - A portfolio of projects demonstrating creativity and skill building solutions with LLMs. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Alexa AI (AURORA)
data.description:
Description

Interested in building Amazon Alexa, Machine Learning, and Generative Artificial Intelligence? We're building products and services that power state of the art for Amazon customers. Come join us!

The Alexa AI org is looking for a Principal Engineer to join Aurora (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) - Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization. Aurora is a science and engineering organization that advances research while delivering robust, scalable runtime solutions. We revolutionize conversational AI through three core pillars: architecting mission-critical AI runtime systems, advancing science solutions that connect key conversational capabilities, and transforming how builders create at scale. 

This role sits at the intersection of latest AI research and large-scale production systems, where you will architect and deliver Pragmatic AI capabilities - AI that is not just technically impressive, but reliably useful, trustworthy, and accessible to real customers in their everyday lives. 

What makes this role unique

You will be building AI experiences that work across the full spectrum of human interaction - multi-modal (speech, text, image, video), multi-lingual (global locales with distinct linguistic and cultural requirements), and multi-model (orchestrating and routing across frontier and specialized AI models to optimize for accuracy, latency, and cost). Your systems will serve customers across a diverse range of endpoints and form factors, from voice-first devices to screen-based and mobile experiences. 

AURORA influences the full Alexa+ agent execution path - from reasoning to evaluation to runtime - enabling you to operate in a structure designed to simplify interactions between components and the people who build them, accelerate feature development, and raise the bar on both operations and innovation velocity. 

Infrastructure & Systems Complexity

- Design and own the architecture for AI capability routing and orchestration at massive scale, including intelligent query classification, model selection, and fallback strategies across heterogeneous AI back-ends
 - Drive latency optimization across globally distributed inference pipelines, including model serving infrastructure, caching strategies, and real-time performance monitoring to meet strict customer-facing SLAs
 - Build evaluation and quality assurance infrastructure - including offline test sets, live traffic sampling, model and prompt release gating, and automated regression frameworks - to maintain high accuracy and reliability as models and locales evolve
 - Architect systems that support rapid iteration and safe deployment of new AI capabilities across global regions, with robust rollback, experimentation, and observability tooling
 - Lead the design of core AI runtime platforms that power conversational experiences end-to-end, including speech processing, intent orchestration, and unconstrained interaction models that move beyond rigid turn-taking structures

Technology Vision

- Define the long-term technical strategy for how Alexa+ delivers high-quality, low-latency AI experiences to a global customer base, including the evolution of model integration patterns as the AI landscape rapidly changes
 - Shape AURORA's platform vision to empower internal and external engineers and scientists worldwide with modular, reusable platforms that accelerate innovation - while delivering accurate, responsive, and reliable conversational experiences to millions of end-users through operational excellence at scale
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for responsible AI deployment - ensuring accuracy, safety, and fairness are first-class properties of every capability shipped
 - Influence the broader Alexa AI platform roadmap by identifying capability gaps, proposing architectural investments, and partnering with applied science, product, and platform teams to close them
 - Drive science-to-production integration for specialized conversational AI capabilities, including reasoning, classification, and language understanding models

What we're looking for

- Deep expertise in distributed systems, ML inference infrastructure, or large-scale AI platform engineering
 - Demonstrated ability to define technical direction in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces with significant customer and business impact
 - Experience driving cross-functional alignment across science, engineering, and product organizations - particularly in environments where unified ownership across research, runtime, and evaluation accelerates delivery
 - A track record of delivering production AI systems that serve diverse, global customer populations
 - Passion for building AI that is genuinely useful and trustworthy for real people

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

- Lead the org's technical direction, making critical decisions on architecture, infrastructure, and systems design for optimal performance, scalability, resilience and access patterns. 
 - Drive innovation in architectures with GenAI models
 - Design and implement scalable solutions to org's technical initiatives
 - Architect and build large-scale, distributed systems that integrate complex datasets and support different access patterns. 
 - Mentor and inspire a team of skilled engineers and scientists, fostering technical and professional growth
 - Collaborate across Amazon to align technical vision and priorities, influencing decisions at senior levels. 
 - Define best practices for system architecture and engineering processes, maintaining high standards for software quality and operational excellence
 - Lead engineering efforts that directly enhance customer experiences and business outcomes through Alexa+ and GenAI powered services. 

About The Team

The AURORA (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) org is part of Alexa AI VP and Devices and Services SVP organization. AURORA is Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization - a science and engineering organization that advances research while delivering robust, scalable runtime solutions. Our vision is to revolutionize conversational AI through three core pillars: architecting mission-critical AI runtime systems, advancing science solutions that connect key conversational capabilities, and transforming how builders create at scale. We are the horizontal Science and Engineering team that empowers Domains and Horizontal CX owners with transformative solutions that enable rapid, efficient scaling. AURORA represents a sophisticated global organization that spans multiple international locations including the US (Boston, Seattle), Canada, Poland, and India. The team's core mission is to deliver Pragmatic AI capabilities - AI that is not just technically impressive, but reliably useful, trustworthy, and accessible to real customers in their everyday lives - by developing and maintaining AI runtime systems and services that enhance the performance of core LLM models across various endpoints, modalities, and locales. 

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
 - Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes. 
 - Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing, building & operating large scale, highly available, secure cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience with AI software systems including Agents. 
 - 15+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - 10+ years of highly scalable systems experience

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to manage, optimize, and scale our cloud infrastructure supporting high-traffic digital news platforms, APIs, internal applications, and video delivery systems. 

The role involves managing AWS infrastructure, improving production reliability, automating operational tasks, strengthening security, troubleshooting performance issues, and optimizing cloud costs. The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of infrastructure and working closely with development teams. 

Key Responsibilities

• AWS Infrastructure Management: Manage and optimize EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, CloudFront, Application Load Balancers, Route 53, VPC, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, and related AWS services. 

• Production Operations: Monitor infrastructure health, troubleshoot application and server issues, investigate outages, and improve system availability and recovery. 

• Linux & Web Servers: Administer Ubuntu/Linux environments, Apache, Nginx, PHP-FPM, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, and server-level performance configurations. 

• CI/CD & Automation: Build and maintain deployment pipelines, automate repetitive operational tasks, and improve release reliability using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools. 

• Infrastructure as Code: Work with Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent tools to make infrastructure deployments consistent and repeatable. 

• Cloud Security: Implement least-privilege IAM, security group policies, WAF rules, secure origin access, certificate management, logging, and vulnerability mitigation. 

• Performance & Scalability: Troubleshoot traffic spikes, database and application bottlenecks, CDN behavior, caching issues, and network-related performance problems. 

• Cost Optimization: Analyze AWS usage and billing, identify unnecessary expenditure, optimize compute and database resources, evaluate commitment plans, and implement cost-saving measures. 

• Monitoring & Incident Response: Set up actionable alerts, dashboards, centralized logs, health checks, and incident documentation using CloudWatch and other relevant tools. 

• Collaboration: Work with developers to improve application deployments, environment management, secrets handling, reliability, and production readiness. 

Required Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and production workloads. 

• Good understanding of Linux administration, shell scripting, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancing, and networking. 

• Experience with EC2, S3, CloudFront, ALB, Route 53, VPC, IAM, RDS, and CloudWatch. 

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. 

• Proficiency in Bash or Python scripting for automation and troubleshooting. 

• Practical knowledge of Terraform, CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code tools. 

• Experience troubleshooting production incidents, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes. 

• Understanding of cloud security, backups, disaster recovery, and high availability. 

• Ability to independently investigate issues, document solutions, and take ownership of assigned systems. 

Good to Have

• Docker and containerization; Kubernetes experience is a plus, but not mandatory. 

• Experience with AWS WAF, DDoS mitigation, CDN optimization, and high-traffic web applications. 

• Experience optimizing AWS costs and analyzing billing reports. 

• Knowledge of Redis/Valkey, MySQL/Aurora, PostgreSQL, and database connectivity issues. 

• Experience with media streaming, video delivery, caching, or large-scale content platforms. 

What We Expect

A practical engineer who can independently manage infrastructure, solve production problems, automate routine work, and continuously improve reliability, security, and cost efficiency. We value troubleshooting ability and real-world AWS experience over certifications alone.
