data.title: Applied Science Manager ,  Catalog Quality
data.description:
Description

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines. 

As an Applied Science Manager on the team, you will lead a team of scientists to define and execute a transformative vision for holistic catalog quality measurement, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. Your team will own the science solutions for foundational quality detection frameworks, metadata validation and correction technologies, state-of-the-art algorithms to identify and resolve catalog anomalies (violative content, duplicative/low value content, misattributed tracks, incorrect metadata), and/or agentic AI solutions that help internal teams quickly surface and fix quality issues to ensure customers receive accurate, complete catalog experiences. 

Key job responsibilities

You independently manage a team of scientists. You identify the needs of your team and effectively grow, hire, and promote scientists to maintain a high-performing team. 

You have a broad understanding of scientific techniques, several of which may fall out of your specific job function. 

You define the strategic vision for your team. You establish a roadmap and successfully deliver scientific solutions that innovate on catalog quality detection, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. 

You define clear goals for your team and effectively prioritize, balancing short-term quality improvements and long-term innovation in catalog intelligence. 

You establish clear and effective metrics and scientific process to enforce consistent, high-quality artifact delivery and measurable catalog quality improvements. 

You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks. You know when to escalate. 

You communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. You author strategic documentation for your team. You communicate issues and options with leaders in such a way that facilitates understanding and that leads to a decision. 

You work successfully with customers, leaders, and engineering teams. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues. 

About The Team

We are a team of scientists and MLEs focused on music catalog quality and metadata intelligence. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and data quality systems with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, content operations teams, and other scientists with expertise in music metadata, content classification, and building scalable modeling and software solutions that keep the Amazon Music catalog accurate, complete, and trustworthy. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
 - Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics
 - 6+ years of applied research experience
 - Knowledge of machine learning approaches and algorithms
 - 3+ years of programming in Java, C++, Python or related language experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
 - Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - 5+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
 - PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Lead Verification & Validation Engineer will be responsible for the delivery of the of HVDC Controls & Protection Verification and Validation team's activities on time / as per Project Scheduled through proper coordination between Project and department. The role involves technical leadership on the various work packages within the department ensuring that they meet the requirements, and the relevant processes are followed. 

Job Description

Main duties and responsibilities will include. 

- 
 - Prepare and maintain Validation & Verification team's activity plans as per the Project scheduled. 
 - Design and create FST and FAT test cases against design requirements. 
 - Properly manage Validation team shift plan. 
 - Leading the FAT with client. 
 - Gap analysis between standard / design requirement and customer technical requirements further leading to defining of test requirement. 
 - Understand the key milestones in the project plan, ensure that the plan correctly provisions for the required testing activities. 
 - Clearly communicate details of failures to the respective engineering functions. 
 - Knowledge of control system requirements for the RTDS LAB setup including AC DC interface requirement, Plant Emulator Interface requirement and RSCAD Power system network conversion, modelling and verification. 
 - Problem solving skills to support test issues especially lab setup and debugging skills. 
 - Strong sense of urgency and ability to identify and manage technical risks. 
 - Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and Product care teams to develop existing and new products and tools. 
 - Knowledge of Dynamic performance studies using both offline and online simulation tools (PSCAD/RSCAD). 
 - Assist Validation Engineers to carry out execution of tests and provide clear reporting of results. 
 - Review/analyze the test results thereby reporting the status. 
 - Provide support to Commissioning Engineers during Dynamic commissioning at Site. 
 - Support continual improvement, raising the effectiveness and efficiency of the team through the introduction of tools, methods and process improvements and coordinating with the Continuous Improvement leaders
 - Support a standard product methodology mindset, seek opportunities to re-use solutions, improve quality and reliability whilst reducing the delivery timeline and associated costs. 
Qualifications / Essential Requirements

- 
 - Engineering degree with 12+ years of experience or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business. 
 - Experience in the position of Verification Engineer in High Voltage field, preferably experience as a Control & Protection design Engineer. Good knowledge of overall 400kV substation, HVDC system (LCC/VSC/SVC) including control and protection system is essential. 
 - Knowledge and experience of developing and working with RSCAD models is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of Overall HVDC System Operational behavior. 
 - Strong communication skills with a fluency in English language. 
 - Must be flexible with working hours and willing to travel to support projects globally.

Desired Requirements

- 
 - Experience on MATCAD, PSCAD, PSS/E and MATLAB SIMULINK, EMTP-RV, Dig silent etc. will add advantage. 
 - Knowledge of Fault Recorder (TFR) systems. 
Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Release & Platform Engineering
data.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

About This Role

Release Engineering is OutSystems' is a Platform Engineering function. The group owns the platform's build and deployment orchestration, empowering product and development teams to focus on delivering business value. 

North Star: to empower teams to focus on delivering business value, by creating a zero-touch, secure, reliable, and cutting-edge technology platform capable of orchestrating full build and production deployment processes. 

The group is organized into small, autonomous squads. Release Engineers work across the full software delivery lifecycle - from CI/CD and containerization to cloud infrastructure and release governance - and act as a trusted point of support for engineering teams across the company via the group's dedicated support channels. 

This is a hybrid role: part software engineer, part cloud/infrastructure engineer, and part release governance owner. Expectations scale with seniority - from being autonomous in your own work, to leveraging your knowledge to help the team hit its goals, to guiding others and balancing technical, business, and operational needs. 

Key Responsibilities

- CI/CD ownership: Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows) that power build, test, and deployment automation across OutSystems services. 
 - Container & image management: Maintain and secure the Docker base-image catalogue (ingestion, versioning, deprecation, scanning) and manage AMI/machine-image pipelines (Packer, EC2 Image Builder) for build and CI infrastructure. 
 - Cloud infrastructure: Manage and provision cloud resources across AWS (ECR, EC2, IAM/OIDC) and Azure (ACR, Azure DevOps), using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform via Spacelift). 
 - Versioning & packaging: Own semantic versioning and package management practices (GitVersion, SemVer, NuGet feeds) to keep releases consistent and traceable. 
 - Release governance: Operate release governance processes, including RFC/CAB change management, deployment gating, and rollback procedures for production changes. 
 - Operational support: Staff the Release Engineering support rotation, triaging and resolving developer requests and incidents raised through dedicated support channels. 
 - Monitoring & metrics: Build and maintain observability into pipelines and deployments using tools such as Grafana, Power BI, and Kibana. 
 - Security & compliance: Uphold security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and FedRAMP controls, vulnerability scanning via Wiz/Snyk) across the release pipeline. 
 - Leadership & enablement: As seniority grows, guide other engineers, mentor teams adopting CI platform/release best practices, and represent Release Engineering's roadmap to stakeholders across the company. 

Skills You Need to Succeed

Skills below are ranked by how central they are to day-to-day Release Engineering work. Must-haves are used constantly and span nearly every squad; good-to-haves add significant value but are more specialized or team-specific and can often be developed on the job. 

Must Haves

- CI/CD pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions - designing, debugging, and maintaining build/release workflows. 
 - OCI Lifecycle: Development and management of the full life cycle of OCI artifacts. 
 - Cloud platform fundamentals: AWS (ECR, IAM/OIDC, EC2, RDS) and Azure (ACR, Azure Machines and DBs, Azure DevOps) core services. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Image Building: Proficiency in Terraform, CloudFormation for cloud provisioning and experience with Packer and EC2 Image Builder are must-have skills. 
 - Ownership under pressure: A strong sense of urgency, customer focus, and reliability as a support point for other engineering teams. 

Good To Haves

- Git workflows & semantic versioning: Branching strategies, tagging, GitVersion/SemVer discipline, and NuGet/npm feed mechanics. 
 - Observability & monitoring: Hands-on experience designing, building, and managing end-to-end monitoring and alerting systems to gain operational insights across pipelines and platform components (e. g. , using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Power BI, or Kibana). 
 - Security & vulnerability scanning: Working knowledge of security practices, vulnerability scanning, and compliance standards such as SOC 2 and FedRAMP. 
 - Release & change governance: RFC/CAB processes and staged (ring-based) promotion models for production changes. 
 - GitOps & Kubernetes: Flux-based GitOps repositories and Helm release troubleshooting across multiple environment rings. 
 - Cross-team mentoring & leadership: Experience mentoring other engineers or representing a team's roadmap to stakeholders

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform. 

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact. 

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration. 

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1, 700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees. 

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries- such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA-who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact. 

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports. 

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems. 

What do we have to offer you?

- A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don't just react to AI innovation-we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse.

Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there.

At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries-they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together. 

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to influence not only the architecture and scalability of our platform services, but also how engineering teams leverage AI-assisted development, automation, and quality engineering practices to deliver reliable software faster. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native platform capabilities that power Kaseya products. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building reliable, secure, and maintainable SaaS applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about software architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, engineering excellence, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, scalability, and release confidence. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement scalable backend services, APIs, and distributed applications using Java and modern cloud technologies. 
 - Build and maintain highly available SaaS platform capabilities and microservices architectures. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, API, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, observability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to technical decision-making. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues, production incidents, and service degradations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues using logs, metrics, traces, database analysis, and code-level debugging. 
 - Improve platform reliability, scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD pipelines that automate build, testing, deployment, security scanning, and release processes. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Security, Architecture, Platform, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in code reviews, architecture reviews, sprint planning, and technical mentoring activities. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, debugging, documentation, and codebase analysis. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted testing techniques to improve test generation, coverage, and engineering productivity. 
 - Help establish engineering best practices around AI-generated code validation, automation, and responsible AI-assisted development. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience building SaaS applications, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or cloud-native services. 
 - 8+ years of experience developing backend services using Java. 
 - Strong proficiency with Java and modern backend development frameworks such as Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. 
 - Experience building and maintaining scalable APIs, distributed systems, and microservices-based architectures. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as JUnit, TestNG, REST Assured, Selenium, Playwright, or similar testing frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of software design, object-oriented programming, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control. 
 - Experience developing automated coverage for API, integration, regression, and distributed-system testing. 
 - Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. 
 - Experience working with AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or other relational database technologies. 
 - Experience with cloud-native, microservices-based, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, quality engineering tooling, or validation platforms. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized development or testing environments.

data.title: Member of Technical Staff- Quality Engineer
data.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3. 7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem. 

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us. 

THE ROLE

We are hiring a senior quality engineer to own System Testing for Pure's FlashArray products. You will validate stability, resiliency, and performance under sustained, production‐like workloads, far beyond basic functional testing. 

You will design and run multi‐week, customer‐like scenarios that combine workloads, failovers, upgrades, and fault injections, and use the insights to influence architecture, design, and release decisions. 

This is a hands‐on, high‐impact role at the intersection of architecture, systems, and large‐scale testing-acting as a key quality gate before releases reach Pure's customers. 

What You'll Do

- Own System Testing strategy for releases Define System Testing strategy and test plans for major features and releases, focusing on stability, longevity, and end‐to‐end behavior, not just feature correctness. 
 - Design realistic, high‐value scenarios Build scenarios that mirror Pure customer environments: mixed workloads (block, file, object), long‐running IO, failovers, NDUs, hardware events, and background operations (replication, snapshots, quotas, etc. ), combining automation with targeted "tortures". 
 - Drive execution and triage on System Testing beds Own System Testing environments (arrays, initiators, OSes, accessories); keep them healthy, representative, and well‐instrumented. Monitor runs, triage failures quickly, separate infra issues from product bugs, and file high‐quality defects with clear workload, scale, logs, and impact-driving them to closure with Dev, PM, and Release teams. 
 - Be a key voice in release readiness Act as a primary quality gate for Release Candidates: define System Testing entry/exit criteria, sign‐off requirements, and soak expectations (for example, 24-48h+ without critical events). Summarize findings, risks, and recommendations and provide data‐driven input on go/no‐go decisions. 
 - Lead technically and mentor others Coach mid‐level and junior QE engineers (System Testing and system test) on test design, debugging, triage, and long‐running validation best practices. Refine System Testing processes, playbooks, and governance in partnership with engineering managers and technical leaders. 
 - Advance automation, tooling, and observability Partner with automation teams to extend System Testing workflows (workload drivers, torture suites, health checks, dashboards). Improve observability for System Testing: metrics, alerting, and automated log/triage helpers that make issues obvious and actionable. 

What You Bring

- 10+ years in software QA / system test / performance / reliability engineering, with significant experience in system‐level or longevity testing of complex distributed or storage systems. 
 - Strong understanding of storage concepts (block, file, snapshots, replication, HA/failover, NDUs) and their behavior under sustained load and fault conditions. 
 - Proven ability to design and execute long‐running scenarios that surface race conditions, memory leaks, scaling issues, and resiliency gaps. 
 - Strong debugging skills across host, network, storage system, logs, and metrics. 
 - Hands‐on experience with Linux and at least one of VMware, Windows, or Kubernetes. 
 - Solid experience with test automation (Python, shell), CI pipelines, and result dashboards. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross‐functional collaboration with Development, System Test, Release, and Support. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting complex findings and risk assessments to senior engineers and leaders. 
 - Directory services and identity: AD, LDAP, Kerberos, ID mapping - and how per-tenant auth domains explode the test matrix. 
 - Linux systems skills: shell, networking (VLANs, sub-interfaces, routing, ip, tc), service debugging, log and core analysis at scale

Nice‐to‐have

- Background in enterprise storage. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, capacity / longevity modeling, or customer‐data‐driven test design. 
 - Exposure to AI‐assisted test design or triage and interest in using new tools to improve coverage and efficiency. 
 - Experience working with different hypervisors, backup applications, databases, video streaming or healthcare applications/workloads is a plus
 - Prior multi-tenancy / RBAC / virtual-array isolation work in storage or cloud. 
 - Replication and DR: async/ADR, sync-rep, ActiveCluster or metro-cluster, split-brain and resync validation. 
 - QoS and quotatest background. 

What You Can Expect From Us

- Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers. 
 - Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in TechnologyTM, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay AreaTM, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
 - Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good. 

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http: //benefits. everpuredata. com/ for more information. 

Accommodations And Accessibility

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage. com if you're invited to an interview. 

Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team

We're forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn't just accepted but embraced. That's why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership. 

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire. 

Join us and bring your best. 

Bring your bold. 

Pure and simple.

data.title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere's AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments. 

The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable

What You'll Achieve

- Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework. 
 - Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments. 
 - Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations. 
 - Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting. 
 - Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure. 
 - Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting. 
 - Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence. 
 - Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D. 
 - Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
 - 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
 - Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration. 
 - Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills. 
 - Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting. 
 - Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes. 
 - Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions. 
 - Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power. 
 - Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results. 
 - Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus. 
 - Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up. 
 - Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits. 
 - Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail. 
 - Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures. 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

Date Posted

21-Oct-2026

Closing Date

05-Nov-2026

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.title: Software QA Engineer - Physics AI
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge SimcenterTM portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing. 

We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities. 

In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results. 

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software. 

Key Responsibilities

- Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results. 
 - Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities. 
 - Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate. 
 - Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution. 
 - Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities. 
 - Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment. 

Qualifications

- 4-6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation. 
 - 1-3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products. 
 - Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results. 
 - Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable. 
 - Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications. 
 - Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data. 
 - Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing. 
 - Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks. 
 - Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing. 
 - Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies. 

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30, 000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

This role is responsible for defining and specifying the activities, processes, and standards required to fulfill quality requirements for manufactured materials, components, and products within a global pharmaceutical environment. It leads and manages validation quality assurance activities to ensure manufacturing processes and equipment meet defined regulatory and internal standards. The role ensures efficient and effective workflows, procedures, policies, and validation programs are in place and adhered to across manufacturing operations. It manages in-process product quality in coordination with vendors and contract manufacturers. The position facilitates communication with customers and vendors to resolve quality-related issues in a timely and compliant manner. The role leads a team of quality professionals and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, errors, and rework across manufacturing operations. - Define and specify quality activities, processes, and standards for validation programs in compliance with regulatory requirements

 - Ensure efficient workflow, procedures, policies, and validation inspection programs are implemented and maintained across manufacturing operations
 - Manage in-process product quality and validation outcomes in coordination with vendors and contract manufacturers
 - Communicate with customers and vendors to investigate and resolve quality and validation-related issues in a timely manner
 - Report and troubleshoot manufacturing process deviations and defects identified during validation studies and finished goods inspection

Education

Experience

Chat.

other conversational/Generative AI platforms.

REST-assured or equivalent.

management and release readiness experience.

Good-to-Have

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Castrol is one of the world's leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company's commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol. 

Job Description

About the Team: 

The Manager - Engineering (Electrical & Instrumentation) reports to the Senior Manager - Engineering & Projects and provides functional leadership for plant instrumentation, automation, control systems and associated electrical systems. 

You will be accountable for PLC/SCADA reliability, filling-line controls, field instrumentation, calibration, interlocks, control panels and automation projects, while ensuring essential electrical power reliability and statutory compliance. 

You will work across Production, HSSE, Quality, IT/OT, Procurement, contractors and the Mechanical Engineering Manager to deliver safe, reliable and cost-effective operations. 

Key Tasks: 

Own reliability and lifecycle performance of PLCs, SCADA, HMIs, filling-line controls, industrial networks, safety interlocks and control panels. 

- Lead maintenance and troubleshooting of sensors, encoders, photoelectric and proximity devices, load cells, weighing systems, flow meters, transmitters, control valves, actuators, printers, labelers and vision interfaces. 
 - Plan preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance to improve asset availability, MTBF and MTTR. 
 - Ensure calibration, functional testing and traceability of instruments, weighing systems, alarms, trips and protective devices. 
 - Maintain controlled PLC/SCADA programs, backups, access controls, software revisions, I/O lists, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm/interlock lists, loop drawings and network architecture. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and defect elimination for recurring filling-line, PLC, instrumentation and control-system failures. 
 - Deliver E&I scope for CAPEX and minor projects from concept, specification and technical bid evaluation through FAT/SAT, commissioning, performance verification and handover. 
 - Drive automation, digitization, data acquisition, predictive maintenance and process-control improvements with measurable business value. 
 - Manage critical spares, obsolescence risks, AMCs, vendors, contractors and assigned expenditure within approved budgets. 
 - Coach engineers and technicians in PLC diagnostics, calibration, filling-line controls, safe isolation and structured troubleshooting. 
 - Ensure essential electrical systems including HT/LT distribution, MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, earthing and protection remain safe, reliable and compliant. 

Responsible for HSSE in Engineering (both people and equipment) activities and compliance to Castrol HSSE standards. 

The person with be responsible as Contractor Assurance Manager (CAM) to manage the contractors at site for HSSE & Legal requirements for contract. 

The person will be responsible for Castrol Engineering Standards specifically Integrity Management Standards application for Engineering activities at site. 

Experience Required: 

Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent recognized engineering qualification. 

- Preferably 8-10 years of instrumentation, automation, maintenance and project experience in manufacturing or process industries, including team and contractor responsibility. 
 - Strong knowledge of PLC programming, diagnostics, I/O systems, SCADA, HMI, industrial communication networks, control loops, alarms, trips and interlocks. 
 - Hands-on experience with filling-line automation, sensors, encoders, load cells, weighing/filling systems, control valves, actuators, printers and labellers. 
 - Knowledge of Allen-Bradley PLC and SCADA platforms is an added advantage. 
 - Experience in calibration, loop checking, FAT/SAT, commissioning, functional testing, performance testing and as-built documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of MCC/PCC, motors, VFDs, UPS, DG interfaces, protection, earthing and electrical drawings. 
 - Understanding of OT lifecycle controls including backups, access control, change management, recovery planning and cybersecurity coordination. 
 - Good project management, contractor management, communication, planning and commercial-judgement skills; proficiency in MS Project and MS Office is desirable. 

Privacy

The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy. response@castrol. com. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e. g. , accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc. ).

data.title: SDE II - DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Auriga is looking for a DevOps / SRE Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and operational health of our production infrastructure. He will manage infrastructure end-to-end through code, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, respond to production incidents as part of an on-call rotation, and partner with engineering teams to embed reliability into every stage of our software delivery lifecycle. This is a hands-on ownership role - not a support or ticket-queue position. 

Key Responsibilities

On-Call & Incident Management

- Participate/ lead production incident triage, mitigation, and resolution. 
 - Define and track SLIs / SLOs and manage error budgets for critical services. 
 - Author blameless postmortems with root cause analysis and corrective action plans for all significant incidents. 
 - Build and maintain runbooks and incident response playbooks. 

Infrastructure as Code & Infra Management

- Own the full infrastructure lifecycle using Terraform exclusively - no manual console provisioning in production. 
 - Design modular Terraform modules for cloud resources: compute, networking, storage, IAM, DNS, databases. 
 - Manage environment parity (dev / staging / prod), drift detection, and immutable infrastructure principles. 
 - Use Ansible or equivalent for configuration management, patch management, and compliance at scale. 
 - Plan and execute capacity planning, scaling, and cost optimization initiatives. 

Kubernetes & Containers

- Provision, configure, upgrade, and maintain production Kubernetes clusters (EKS / GKE / AKS). 
 - Manage Helm charts, ArgoCD / FluxCD GitOps workflows, RBAC, network policies, and secrets management. 
 - Troubleshoot pod failures, resource constraints, scheduling issues, and node-level problems. 

CI/CD & Release Engineering

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins) with quality gates and automated rollback. 
 - Implement progressive delivery: blue-green, canary deployments, and feature flags. 
 - Conduct production readiness reviews before new service go-lives. 

Observability & Monitoring

- Implement and manage full-stack observability: metrics (Prometheus + Grafana), logs (Loki), traces (OpenTelemetry / Jaeger). 
 - Build SLO-driven alerting and dashboards covering the four golden signals; route via PagerDuty / OpsGenie. 

Linux, Networking & Security

- Administer production Linux systems (Ubuntu / RHEL / CentOS): performance tuning, hardening, troubleshooting. 
 - Manage VPCs, subnets, security groups, VPNs, load balancers, Nginx / HAProxy, CDNs, and SSL/TLS certificates. 
 - Manage secrets with Vault / AWS Secrets Manager; integrate security scanning into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps). 

Database & Application Operations

- Manage operational health, backups, replication, and failover for MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Memcached. 
 - Support deployments for both monolithic and microservices architectures; validate DR procedures regularly. 

Requirements

- 3-5 years of hands-on production DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering experience. 
 - Proven on-call experience: incident ownership, RCA, and postmortem authorship in a real production environment. 
 - Strong Terraform proficiency: writing and maintaining modules, managing state, and working in team IaC workflow. 
 - Solid Linux administration skills at the OS level (not just application-layer). 
 - Kubernetes production experience: cluster admin, workload management, debugging, RBAC, network policies. 
 - CI/CD pipeline ownership experience (built pipelines from scratch, not just run them). 
 - Hands-on Prometheus + Grafana: alert rule design and dashboard creation. 
 - Python and/or Bash scripting for production automation. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS (primary), GCP, or Azure - able to architect and troubleshoot independently. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, VPCs, load balancers, firewalls. 

Preferred Qualifications

- CKA / CKAD, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification. 
 - GitOps experience with ArgoCD or FluxCD in production. 
 - Service mesh experience: Istio or Linkerd. 
 - Message queue / streaming experience: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS / SNS. 
 - Chaos engineering or DR game day experience. 
 - HashiCorp Vault or cloud-native secrets management experience. 
 - Exposure to FinOps, cost visibility tooling, and cloud cost optimisation. 

Preferred Technical Skill Set

- Cloud: AWS (primary) | GCP / Azure
 - IaC & Config: Terraform, Ansible
 - Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD / FluxCD
 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, PagerDuty / OpsGenie

data.title: Agentic AI Architect — Backend Platforms and Voice Agents
data.description:
Role Overview

We are hiring a hands-on architect to design the backend foundations and the shared agent platform

that every team builds products on. You will own architecture across products and client deployments

- service boundaries, data flows, agent execution, real-time voice infrastructure and operational

reliability - and consolidate the systems different teams use today into one platform that is faster and

safer to build on. You will set the engineering practices the whole company follows, and partner with

senior AI engineers on solution delivery and with inference engineers on model-serving interfaces. 

Key Responsibilities

Backend and distributed systems

- Design service boundaries, APIs, data models, databases, caching and event-driven integrations

that scale to [thousands] of concurrent agent sessions. 

- Make consistency, partitioning and replication trade-offs explicit, and design for partial failure

with timeouts, backpressure, circuit breakers and graceful degradation. 

- Scale real-time voice infrastructure: session routing, media servers, and horizontal scaling of

WebSocket, SIP and WebRTC connections. 

- Set reliability targets (SLOs), latency and cost budgets, and plan capacity across cloud and on-

premises deployments. 

- Manage all infrastructure as code with GitOps workflows, so every environment is reproducible, 

reviewed and auditable. 

- Track model, speech and infrastructure cost per team, product and client, and set up chargeback

so owners see and control their spend. 

Agent platform

- Build a shared agent platform: agent runtime, tool registry, enterprise connectors, memory and

retrieval services, and a model gateway with routing, fallbacks, rate limits and caching. 

- Architect durable agent execution with persisted state, checkpoints, retries, idempotency, 

timeouts, compensation for failed actions and human approval points. 

- Enforce tenant isolation, authentication, authorisation, tool permissions and audit trails at the

platform level, so every product inherits them. 

- Make the platform self-serve: SDKs, templates and documentation that let a team launch a new

voice or chat agent in days, not weeks. 

- Run an internal developer portal (such as Backstage) as the single place to find services, 

connectors, templates, owners and docs. 

- Provide shared evaluation, tracing and monitoring services that every agent uses by default. 
 - Build a data platform for call and agent analytics: transcripts, outcomes, tool usage and latency, 

feeding product insights, evals and client reporting. 

Consolidation And Company-wide Practices

- Audit existing agent and voice stacks, and consolidate duplicate pipelines, connectors and

prompt setups onto the platform with migration plans that keep live clients running. 

- Define reference architectures and golden paths for common use cases, such as voice agents, 

chat agents and document workflows. 

- Set engineering standards: architecture decision records, design reviews, API guidelines, testing

and eval requirements, release controls and incident management. 

- Maintain a tech radar of approved, trial and retired tools, and lead build-versus-buy decisions

for agent frameworks, model providers, speech vendors and infrastructure. 

Security, governance and resilience

- Design systems to meet security and compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and India's

DPDP Act, and support audits with evidence from the platform. 

- Set AI governance policy: red-teaming of agents before launch, model risk reviews, prompt-

injection defences and rules for which data each model may see. 

- Define disaster recovery targets (RPO and RTO), run regular recovery drills and use chaos testing

to prove agents and voice sessions survive failures. 

Technical leadership

- Translate business workflows into technical designs, build reference implementations and

review critical code. 

- Guide engineering teams through architectural decisions, and mentor senior engineers to make

sound design choices on their own. 

- Manage a team of [N] engineers: set goals, run one-on-ones and performance reviews, and

support their career growth. 

- Act as solution architect in pre-sales: scope client requirements, design proposed solutions, 

estimate effort and present the architecture to client technical teams. 

- Align product, infrastructure, inference and delivery teams around one implementable

architecture, and represent it to enterprise clients. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

- Strong backend and distributed-systems experience, including ownership of production

architecture and its evolution under growing scale. 

- Hands-on Python expertise and deep knowledge of APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, queues, 

caching, concurrency and consistency trade-offs. 

- Practical experience delivering LLM agents with tool integrations, stateful orchestration, 

retrieval and failure handling. 

- Understanding of real-time, low-latency systems such as voice or streaming, including

backpressure and connection scaling. 

- Experience building internal platforms or shared services adopted by multiple teams. 
 - A track record of leading system consolidations or architectural migrations without disrupting

production. 

- Ability to design for partial failures, long-running tasks and secure multi-tenant execution, 

supported by automated tests, tracing and deployment practices. 

- Ability to write clear design documents, explain trade-offs and align product, infrastructure and

delivery teams. 

- Experience managing engineers, and working directly with clients in pre-sales or solution design. 
 - A relevant technical degree or equivalent experience. 

Preferred Experience

data.title: Sr. Tech Lead, Prod Dev (RAN, AI-Assisted RCA, Design & Development)
data.description:
Parallel Wireless is transforming its Feature-Validation & Stability organization into a single Prod-Dev team - in the AI era there is no longer a separate "development" vs "validation" team. We are building a group of strong System Engineers who own a problem end to end: understand the complete product behavior, find the actual root cause, and contribute directly to the fix - accelerated by Claude / AI-assisted engineering. 

This is a pro-development, system-level problem-solving role. You will take a field or test issue and drive it the whole way: 

Issue → Reproduction → Cross-layer analysis → RCA → Code investigation → Fix → Validation

You will not stop at "which component failed. " You will name the root cause, prove it, and fix it. 

What You Will Do

- Deep, cross-layer RCA on field and lab issues that span multiple modules, correlating evidence across the full stack: 

→ UE logs

- PHY logs
 - DU / MAC / SCH logs
 - CU / L3 logs
 - Core logs
 - Platform logs
 - RRH logs
 - System logs
 - field issues across EMS / system monitoring. 
 - Reproduce field/customer issues in the lab on production-like (Friendly-Operator) setups. 
 - Investigate code and deliver bug fixes - own the fix through to validation, not just the analysis note. 
 - Field-issue investigation with direct customer / field involvement; feed learnings back into design, regression and stability. 
 - Feature development driven by design/framework gaps and customer-driven requirements. 
 - Use AI tools (Claude / AI-assisted engineering) to accelerate code understanding, log analysis, debugging, correlation and RCA - especially on multi-module problems. 
 - Identify scenarios, improve monitoring/validation coverage, and raise the quality bar before issues reach the field. 

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

- Strong software engineering in C / C++ (and Python for tooling/automation) with the ability to read and fix production RAN stack code. 
 - Solid wireless/telecom system understanding across 2G / 4G LTE / 5G NSA / SA - RRC, S1AP/NGAP, X2/Xn, PDCP/RLC/MAC scheduling, PHY/FAPI, GTP-U, and the core/platform interfaces. 
 - Proven debugging & RCA skills: coredumps/gdb, log/PCAP analysis, memory/crash triage, KPI/counter reasoning. 
 - A system mindset - comfortable reasoning across UE ↔ RAN ↔ Core ↔ Platform ↔ EMS rather than a single layer. 
 - Willingness and aptitude to work with AI tools as a daily engineering accelerator. 
 - Ownership attitude: drives Issue → Fix → Validation to closure. 
 - Good to have
 - O-RAN / disaggregated CU-DU, fronthaul (split 7. 2), PTP/timing, IPsec/transport exposure. 
 - Experience with EMS / OSS, Kibana/KPI monitoring, PM counters. 
 - Prior field / customer-facing deployment or NPI experience. 
 - Scrum / Agile delivery experience

Addional details

What Success Looks Like

You turn an opaque field escape into a named, proven root cause and a merged fix. 

Your RCA is accurate - the cause you name is the one the fix confirms (evidence-cited, instrumented, graded). 

You reduce field escapes and the RCA load on the core development team. 

You grow into a complete-product System Engineer who can design, reproduce, debug and fix across any layer. 

Why join

You will work at the center of PW's Prod-Dev transformation - a "Friendly customer in the lab" operating model - using cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering to solve real, multi-layer telecom problems end to end, with direct customer impact and genuine system ownership. 

Academic Qualification

Relevant Degree in Bachelor of Engineering in computer science, Electronics , Information Technology or relevant field from reputed college/ University

 - Monitor reporting timelines and ensure all deliverables are submitted within agreed deadlines. 
 - Support vessel reporting activities across multiple management offices and client portfolios. 
Financial Reporting & Analysis

- Review vessel operating results and perform variance analysis against budget and prior periods. 
 - Analyze vessel expenditures, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations. 
 - Review cash flow forecasts and funding requirements. 
 - Monitor outstanding receivables, payables, and owner account balances. 
 - Provide management insights and recommendations based on vessel financial performance. 
Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary contact for Vessel Managers, Fleet Managers, Owners, and Regional Finance Teams. 
 - Respond to client queries relating to vessel management accounts and financial reports. 
 - Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Treasury, Vessel Accounting, Procurement, and Technical Management teams for issue resolution. 
 - Present financial reporting outcomes and analysis during stakeholder meetings when required. 
Process Improvement & Controls

- Identify opportunities for process standardization and automation. 
 - Strengthen internal controls to improve reporting accuracy and efficiency. 
 - Lead implementation of new reporting requirements and system enhancements. 
 - Develop and maintain SOPs, reporting templates, and knowledge management documentation. 
 - Ensure adherence to company policies, audit requirements, and compliance standards. 
Quality Assurance

- Perform final review of key vessel reports before submission. 
 - Monitor reporting quality through regular audits and KPI tracking. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce reporting errors and improve turnaround times. 
Qualifications: 
Mandatory requirements

- Degree in Accounting, Finance, Banking and/or Commerce. 
 - Minimum 5 years working experience in a related field. 
 - Have experience in managing others. 
 - Experience managing reporting for multiple vessel portfolios and stakeholders. 
 - undefined

- Strong understanding of vessel management accounting principles. 
 - Knowledge of vessel operating expenses (OPEX), CAPEX, dry-docking, and owner reporting. 
 - Experience with SAP and vessel management systems. 
 - Advanced MS Excel and financial analysis capabilities. 
 - Strong reporting and presentation skills. 
Competency Requirement: 

- Excellent leadership and people management skills. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
 - Analytical mindset with attention to detail. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines. 
 - Continuous improvement orientation.

data.title: Field Debt Manager
data.description:
About Navi

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale. 

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, 

Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold - building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience. 

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India's fastest-growing UPI platforms. 

About the Team

The Debt Management team is responsible for ensuring timely and efficient recovery of outstanding dues from customers. Their role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing collection strategies across various channels to minimize delinquencies and improve cash flow. The team focuses on balancing customer experience with recovery effectiveness by using data-driven insights, segmentation, and targeted action plans. 

What You'll Own

- Managing a team of ground Field Executives for effective & efficient recovery of overdue amounts from default customers through planned visits to customer addresses
 - Ensure proper planning for effective recovery through strong execution; guide and motivate the field team to reach monthly targets
 - Overview of day-to-day agent activities including regular performance monitoring, in-person visits for high-value accounts, and regular & timely follow-ups with customers
 - Guide executives to increase contactability with customers and execute advanced loss prevention activities wherever applicable (i. e. skip tracing, foreclosures, etc. )
 - Maintain fair collection practices in adherence with the code of conduct & legal guidelines and ensure that the team follows the same
 - Ensure agents regularly attend all meetings, AHMs, and training sessions as required
 - Highlight accounts requiring legal action and follow the process on the same
 - Ensure that the team adheres to SOPs related to collection, such as timely updation of feedback for assigned accounts, conducting in-depth review and audit of collection cases, alongside reviewing and presenting a synthesis of high-value accounts on a weekly basis
 - Run daily team stand-up/ huddle, ensure attendance and App adoption by the agent
 - Ensure that you and the team are up to date on all relevant circulars and all products/services offered. 

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Strong communication and influencing skills. 
 - Should have a geographical understanding of the specified area. 
 - 2 - 5 years of people management experience in sales, operations, customer experience, or collections role. 
 - Should have a working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets
 - Should have high professional ethics and integrity
 - Qualification: Any Graduate

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious, and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable. 

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being. 

Whether it's the sports turf, gym, focus zone, or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable. 

If you'd like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi. com/careers/life-at-navi. 

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale, and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you, 

Navi could be the place for you!

Development

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. scale. You'll write code that ships inside customer networks, runs 24/7 without human intervention, and

needs to be correct the first time.

pipelines, and tunneling infrastructure

Framework cell tests that spin up virtual sensors on AWS/Azure/VMware and validate end-to-end

behaviour

orchestration, Ansible-based sensor provisioning, and production incidents traced through

CloudWatch Logs Insights

- Contribute to sensor upgrade and deployment automation (Ansible, Debian packaging, 

manifest-driven rollouts)

- Work across the full stack - from BPF maps pinned on a sensor's kernel to ECS services in AWS

serving REST APIs to the portal

environments

root cause in code

We are developing an AWS-based Master Data Management (MDM) hub to consolidate, cleanse, standardize, and manage customer data from multiple CRM systems. 

The solution will establish trusted golden customer records, support AI-assisted customer matching, orchestrate data processing and exception workflows, and integrate with Oracle Fusion. It will also include a web-based user interface that enables business users to review and manually resolve MDM exceptions.

The AWS MDM Technical Lead will lead a cross-functional Agile engineering team comprising data engineers, full-stack developers, and DevOps engineers.
