data.title: I&E Design Engineering Lead
data.description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world's current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies. 

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world's growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all. 

About the position

Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a I&E Design Engineering Lead (LNG) to join the Facilities Design Engineering team. Reporting to the Facilities Design Engineering Manager, this role will be based in Chevron's office in Bengaluru. 

Supervises a team that designs, selects, tests, installs, monitors, modifies, and maintains safe and reliable process automation systems and electrical infrastructure ?for new and existing facilities. The team utilizes process automation systems (PAS) including process control systems (PCS), safety instrumented systems (SIS)/instrumented protective systems (IPS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems and associated applications. Optimize process automation system integrity, reliability, safety, and efficiency. In addition, the team supports site MOC work packages and project design assurance for the Instrumentation & Control (I&C) as well as Electrical engineering disciplines. 

Manages group and employee work to align with corporate/department objectives. Direct reports are typically technical individual contributors from I&C and Electrical disciplines. 

Key responsibilities

- Supervise, coach, mentor, and develop I&E Design Engineers providing leadership and guidance on standard tools and processes such as Engineering Work Orders, Management of Change, Chevrons Turnaround process and Root Cause Analysis techniques. 
 - Sets clear expectations and support creation and management of individuals' performance and development plans
 - Partner with customers and stakeholders to prioritize the team's workload. Ensure the team is appropriately resourced to meet the customer's needs and business plan commitments
 - Responsible for the timeliness and quality of team deliverables including Engineering Work Orders as well as technical and constructability reviews
 - Collaborate with other Designs Engineering Team Leads to manage Designs Engineering department organizational capabilities and competencies
 - Promote a continual improvement mindset while removing barriers and seeking simple, fit-for-purpose solutions
 - Provide leadership in sharing information and resources across the business units
 - Utilize Chevron and Industry Engineering Standards for Safety in Designs
 - Leverage expertise and knowledge of electrical power systems and codes, instrumentation and control design, safety instrumented systems, process control systems, field instrument selection and sizing, equipment procurement, field construction and repair practices, process safety information, management of change work process and process control and monitoring to coach and develop team. 
 - Support department recruiting and hiring efforts. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Minimum of 10-15 years relevant experience performing I&E Engineering in an Oil & Gas operating environment
 - Demonstrated supervisory experience will be highly regarded
 - Bachelor's degree in instrumentation or electrical engineering (B. E. /B. Tech. ) from a deemed/recognized (AICTE) university

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of refinery and LNG process technologies will be highly regarded
 - Knowledge of Australian electrical legislation and codes

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way. 

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace. 

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work. 

Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration. 

Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron's values and business priorities. 

Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. 

Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise. 

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8: 00 AM to 5: 00 PM or 1: 30 PM to 10: 30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

 - UI (Web/Mobile)

Test Strategy & Implementation

 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

This role requires a strong focus on test automation, integration testing, and data validation, alongside leadership to define best practices and ensure system reliability across the estate. The ideal candidate will also bring an understanding of cloud-native testing principles and security testing requirements at a high level. 

You will work as a hands-on contributor within CBS, leading by example, building automation frameworks, and driving testing across all six platforms and the workflows that connect them. 

What You Will Do: 

Test Automation Framework Development

Design, Develop, And Maintain Robust Test Automation Frameworks For: 

- UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright - covering ServiceNow, Salesforce, and NetSuite front ends
 - API Testing: Postman, REST Assured - covering Boomi integration endpoints and platform APIs
 - Data Validation: Python scripting with SQL integration - covering cross-platform data flows between Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, OpenAir, and Anaplan
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins or Azure DevOps to ensure seamless testing during deployments across the CBS estate. 
 - Maintain clean, reusable, and well-documented test scripts for consistent results across all platforms. 

Metrics: 

- Achieve 70-80% test automation coverage for critical CBS workflows within 12 months. 
 - Ensure automation stability with <5% failure rates across regression runs. 

Functional, Integration, and Regression Testing

- Conduct functional testing to validate workflows, integrations, and system updates across CBS platforms. 
 - Perform end-to-end integration testing across ServiceNow (ITSM), Salesforce and NetSuite (CRM/ERP), Boomi (integration layer), OpenAir, and Anaplan. 
 - Automate data validation testing to ensure consistency and accuracy across systems, using SQL and Python scripts - with particular attention to Boomi-mediated data flows as integration scripting is rewritten for ongoing platform compliance. 

Metrics: 

- Maintain <10% defect leakage post-production, improving to <5% as automation matures. 

Performance and Load Testing

- Use tools like JMeter or Locust to conduct performance testing to measure response times and system scalability across CBS platforms. 
 - Establish performance benchmarks for critical workflows and collaborate with the Data and Integrations lead and platform owners to address bottlenecks. 

Metrics: 

- Ensure systems meet defined performance SLAs under expected and peak load conditions. 

Cloud-Native Testing and Monitoring (High Level)

CI/CD and Continuous Improvement

- Enhance CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated test execution, reporting, and validation processes across CBS platforms. 
 - Identify and introduce 1-2 new tools or methodologies annually to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. 
 - Collaborate with CBS platform owners, the service delivery manager, and the data and integrations lead to align QA processes with project timelines and delivery goals. 

Metrics:

 - UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright

The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This role requires you to operate in 1. 30 pm to 10. 30 pm.

- Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles. 
 - Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms. 
 - Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions. 
 - Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases. 
 - Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms. 
 - Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms. 
 - Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites. 
 - Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns. 
 - Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university. 
 - Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition. 
 - Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation. 
 - Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting. 
 - Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture. 
 - System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization. 
 - Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
 - GCP certification
 - Background in Mathematics or Statistics

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

Design Manager

Surendranagar, Gujarat

About Us

Del Pd Pumps & Gears as Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE: IR), has emerged as the leading & dominant rotary positive displacement gear pump manufacturer of Indian subcontinents offering widest range of most compact, reliable, efficient & elegant rotary gear, twin gear & triplet win gear pump for all viscous and semi-viscous liquid applications. Company started it's business in year 1980 as a small proprietary venture to design, develop, manufacture & market these pumps starting with small, low cost, general purpose gear pumps as a standard product readily available though network of dealers. The company followed brick & mortar economy with consistence commitment to produce quality embedded product. Company also addressed the typical pumping problem peculiar while handling viscous liquid and also offered free guidance in selective, installing & using such pumps to ensure constant growth of the company and expand into OE & Project business. 

Job Summary

Design Manager is responsible for leading the design and development of gear pumps and related components, ensuring products meet performance, quality, cost, and manufacturability requirements. The role bridges design, manufacturing (CNC/VMC), quality, and customer requirements to deliver robust and competitive products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Product Design & Development
 - Lead design and development of external/internal gear pumps, variants, and custom solutions. 
 - Prepare and approve design calculations, 3D models, 2D drawings, GD&T, and BOMs. 
 - Ensure designs meet hydraulic performance, pressure, efficiency, noise, and durability targets. 
 - Drive standardization and modular design to reduce cost and lead time. 
 - Engineering Analysis & Validation
 - Perform and review hydraulic, mechanical, and thermal calculations. 
 - Review tolerances, fits, surface finishes critical for pump performance and leakage control. 
 - Support prototype development, testing, validation, and design iterations. 
 - Analyze field failures and implement design solutions. 
 - Design for Manufacturing (DFM/DFA)
 - Ensure designs are optimized for in‐house CNC/VMC machining, assembly, and testing. 
 - Collaborate with Production to finalize machining processes, fixtures, and tooling needs. 
 - Support cycle time reduction and manufacturability improvements through design changes. 
 - Manage ECNs/ECRs and configuration control. 
 - Cross‐Functional Coordination
 - Work closely with Production, Quality, Materials, and Maintenance teams. 
 - Support PPAP/APQP, control plans, and quality documentation. 
 - Provide technical support during audits, customer reviews, and cost‐reduction initiatives. 
 - Interface with customers for technical discussions, approvals, and custom requirements. 
 - Team Leadership & Development
 - Lead and mentor Design Engineers and Draftsmen. 
 - Allocate tasks, review designs, and ensure adherence to timelines. 
 - Establish design standards, checklists, and best practices. 
 - Conduct technical training and skill development within the team. 
 - Documentation, Compliance & IP
 - Ensure accurate and controlled engineering documentation. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable standards (ISO, customer specs). 
 - Maintain design history files and revision control. 
 - Support IP protection and design confidentiality. 

Key Skills & Competencies

- Strong knowledge of gear pump design and hydraulics. 
 - Expertise in GD&T, tolerancing, materials, heat treatment, surface finishes.

Now home to 1, 000+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data & Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech & Analytics. 

Our Values define us. They are - Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day. 

They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day. 

Overview Of The Role

Flutter Functions' AI & Automation team is looking for an expert AI Engineering Lead to build and lead a unit of 2-3 AI developers. You will be responsible for the technical vision and execution of Flutter's enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms , using internal data to enhance productivity and decision-making across our global sports betting and gaming operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining AI engineering, architecture, people leadership and cross-functional teamwork . You will shape engineering standards, make key architectural decisions, mentor your team, and help deliver production-grade AI systems serving over 20 million customers across 20+ regulated markets. 

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Set the technical direction for our enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms, making architectural decisions across LLM inference, agentic frameworks, context engineering, guardrails and system design . 
 - Own the selection, deployment and optimisation of LLM inference systems including AWS Bedrock and LiteLLM , with a focus on model routing, cost, latency and operational excellence. 
 - Design production-grade context pipelines, RAG systems and prompt architectures , establishing patterns, standards and evaluation practices for the team. 
 - Guide architectural decisions around token economics, context limits, latency budgets and capability-to-cost trade-offs . 
 - Establish robust guardrails, security and Responsible AI practices , addressing prompt injection, data leakage, authentication, access control and sensitive data handling across regulated markets. 
 - Make informed technology choices across agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands and ADK , and establish scalable orchestration and tool-use patterns. 
 - Own problems end-to-end, from LLM integration and backend services through to user-facing interfaces, APIs and integrations using AWS services, MCP and modern engineering standards . 

People Leadership

- Build, lead and mentor a pod of 2-3 AI developers , supporting their technical and career growth. 
 - Establish engineering standards through code reviews, architectural guidance and continuous technical development . 
 - Lead the team through production incidents, complex technical challenges and post-mortems, driving systemic improvements. 
 - Develop a culture of learning, experimentation, psychological safety and continuous improvement , while encouraging the team to challenge assumptions and take calculated technical risks. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and prioritise high-impact work. 
 - Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into Flutter's existing infrastructure. 
 - Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, present architectural decisions to leadership, and influence technical direction across teams. 

TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED

Core Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI or a related STEM field , with 8-12 years of software development experience, including 2-3+ years focused on AI/ML or agentic systems development. 
 - Experience leading or mentoring technical teams , with the ability to establish technical direction and drive delivery through others. 
 - Advanced Python and backend engineering skills, including production experience with FastAPI, Flask and async patterns . 
 - Hands-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM or similar LLM inference platforms , including model routing, API design, cost optimisation and production deployment. 
 - Strong experience in context engineering, RAG and prompt architecture , and ability to evaluate trade-offs and design production-grade solutions. 
 - Deep experience with 2-3+ agentic frameworks , such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK or CrewAI , including orchestration, tool use and multi-agent patterns. 
 - Experience designing and implementing guardrails, content filtering and Responsible AI practices in production environments. 
 - Strong AI security fundamentals , including prompt injection, data exfiltration, model misuse, OAuth, JWT and least-privilege design. 
 - Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenCode , and ability to validate AI-generated code and guide others in their use. 
 - Expert knowledge of software engineering fundamentals , including SDLC, Git, API design, system architecture and collaborative engineering. 
 - Exceptional communication and influencing skills - ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and build consensus without relying on formal authority. 

Highly Desirable Skills

- Full-stack experience across React, TypeScript, backend services and AI integration . 
 - Hands-on experience designing and operating production RAG systems and vector databases , including Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch or Weaviate. 
 - Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its implementation in AI agent systems. 
 - Contributions to AI/ML or agentic open-source frameworks such as LangChain or CrewAI. 
 - Experience in gaming, sports betting, financial services or other heavily regulated environments . 
 - A track record of growing engineers, building high-performing teams or leading technical initiatives that delivered material business impact. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and thought leadership in AI, with an appetite for emerging technologies and the ability to form and defend informed technology choices. 

Benefits We Offer

- Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling. 
 - Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs. 
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents. 
 - Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year. 
 - Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness. 
 - Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals. 
 - Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance. 
 - Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance. 
 - Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares. 
 - Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections. 
 - Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards. 

WHY CHOOSE US

Flutter is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential. 

We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India. 

If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences, and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - DB builds and runs Database Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.

data.description:

We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. 

We are proud to have the best of both worlds - a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. 

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world. 

Role Overview : 

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will work closely with platform and product leaders to design and deliver solutions for complex infrastructure problems. You will drive the development of highly scalable, reliable, and efficient platform services while providing technical direction across teams working with Java, AWS, Kafka, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Argo CD, and gRPC. 

What You Will Do : 

- Architect and build Coupang's next-generation AI Inference Gateway platform that serves mission-critical machine learning and generative AI workloads at scale. 
 - Design and develop high-performance request routing, model endpoint abstraction, traffic shaping, load balancing, failover, caching, and policy enforcement mechanisms for inference services. 
 - Drive the technical vision and roadmap for scalable, secure, and reliable AI inference infrastructure across cloud and on-prem environments. 
 - Develop critical infrastructure components in Go, Java, or Python with a strong focus on performance, resiliency, and operational excellence. 
 - Design multi-tenant platform capabilities including authentication, authorization, quota management, cost attribution, rate limiting, and governance controls. 
 - Partner closely with ML Platform, Model Serving, Data, and Product Engineering teams to enable seamless deployment and operation of AI workloads. 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews, raise engineering standards, and mentor senior engineers across multiple teams. 
 - Optimize system performance, latency, throughput, and infrastructure efficiency for large-scale inference workloads. 
 - Define observability standards through metrics, tracing, logging, and SLO-based operations for business-critical AI services. 
 - Investigate complex production issues, drive root-cause analysis, and implement long-term architectural solutions. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leaders across Coupang to establish common platform standards and unlock AI innovation across the organization. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems in production. 
 - Strong hands-on programming expertise in one or more of Go, Java, or Python. 
 - Proven track record of building highly available, mission-critical platform or infrastructure services. 
 - Experience designing API platforms, service gateways, service mesh, or large-scale networking infrastructure. 
 - Deep understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems design, and cloud-native technologies. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads in production environments. 
 - Experience operating services on AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Strong understanding of observability, reliability engineering, capacity planning, and production operations. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience building AI/ML inference platforms, LLM gateways, model serving infrastructure, or GPU-accelerated workloads. 
 - Deep expertise in Kubernetes ecosystem technologies such as Gateway API, Ingress Controllers, Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd, Envoy), and platform networking. 
 - Experience with inference serving frameworks such as vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of high-performance networking, gRPC, HTTP/2, streaming protocols, API gateways, and service proxy architectures. 
 - Experience designing large-scale traffic management systems including routing, retries, circuit breaking, rate limiting, and request prioritization. 
 - Experience optimizing latency, throughput, and resource utilization for CPU and GPU workloads. 
 - Familiarity with GenAI and LLM ecosystems including model deployment, prompt routing, RAG systems, model observability, and AI governance. 
 - Experience with distributed data systems such as Kafka, Cassandra, Redis, MongoDB, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, synchronization, asynchronous programming, and non-blocking I/O. 

Type of work model : 

Hybrid /Onsite / Remote working

- Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work. 

Details to consider : 

Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc. ) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. 

Privacy Notice

- Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https: //privacy. coupang. com/en/land/jobs/

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: Cloud FullStack, you will develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components. You will utilize expertise in multiple layers of application development to deliver efficient and secure cloud-based solutions. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Design, develop, test, and deploy backend services using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Build and maintain Microservices-based applications. 
 - Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services. 
 - Optimize application performance, scalability, and security. 
 - Work with relational and NoSQL databases to store and manage data. 
 - Collaborate with frontend developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines and support DevOps practices. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. 
 - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.

Master's Degree

Java Backend Developer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, React and database technologies, with a passion for building robust enterprise applications. 

Required Skills

- Strong proficiency in Java 8/11/17+. and React
 - Experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA. 
 - Strong knowledge of Microservices Architecture. 
 - Experience developing RESTful APIs. 
 - Knowledge of Hibernate/JPA. 
 - Experience with SQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle. 
 - Familiarity with Git, Maven, Gradle. 
 - Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization. 
 - Experience with messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ. 
 - Knowledge of JWT, OAuth2, and application security. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Cloud Security Knowledge: Exposure to implementing cloud security measures, including network security and access control, to ensure the integrity of cloud-based applications. 
 - Advanced DevOps Tools: Experience working with advanced DevOps tools and methodologies to optimize the development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications. 
 - Multi-Cloud Environments: Exposure to designing, building, and maintaining multi-cloud environments, focusing on uptime, scalability, and automation.

data.title: Principal ASIC Verification Engineer - DDR/LPDDR
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You understand that verification is not about writing tests, it is about building an environment where the right bugs cannot hide, and you have the scars from finding those bugs at 2am to prove it. 

Leading a team does not mean delegating tasks, it means knowing when to step in, when to let someone struggle productively, and when to rewrite the testbench architecture because the current one will not scale. You have worked with RTL designers who swear their code is clean and architects who change the spec on Thursday, and you have learned to build verification strategies that survive both. 

Memory protocols like DDR or LPDDR do not intimidate you. Serial interfaces, complex checkers, SystemVerilog assertions that actually mean something, these are tools you reach for without thinking. You care about functional coverage because it tells you what you have not tested yet, not because it is a metric someone asked for. At Synopsys, you will work on DesignWare IP that powers real products, with a team that takes verification as seriously as you do. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of verification engineers through full IP verification cycles, from test plan definition through coverage closure and signoff
 - Build and evolve SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments for DesignWare synthesizable IP cores, ensuring they scale across multiple product generations
 - Define test plans that cover corner cases, protocol compliance, and system-level interactions, then review and guide implementation across the team
 - Write and debug complex testbenches, checkers, and assertions for serial interface protocols and memory controllers, including DDR and LPDDR where applicable
 - Extract, analyze, and drive functional coverage and code coverage metrics to closure, identifying gaps and adjusting strategy in real time
 - Collaborate directly with RTL designers, digital architects, and circuit teams to align verification scope with design intent and catch issues early
 - Manage regression infrastructure and work with the infra team to keep verification cycles efficient and reliable

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver verification signoff on IP cores that ship in millions of devices, ensuring they work correctly the first time in silicon
 - Raise the bar for verification quality across the DesignWare team by mentoring engineers and evolving testbench architecture and methodology
 - Catch critical bugs before tapeout that would otherwise cost months of schedule and customer trust
 - Influence IP architecture decisions by surfacing verification insights early, when design changes are still cheap
 - Help shape how the team adopts AI-assisted verification flows, improving efficiency without sacrificing rigor
 - Contribute to Synopsys' leadership in IP by ensuring that what we deliver is not just feature-complete but robustly verified
 - Build verification environments and strategies that other teams will reuse and learn from, multiplying your impact across the organization

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering with 8+ years of hands-on verification experience
 - Proven track record leading verification teams through IP project delivery, including planning, execution, and signoff
 - Strong experience developing SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches from scratch and evolving them as designs grow
 - Deep expertise writing test plans, implementing checkers, and building assertions that catch real bugs
 - Proficiency extracting and interpreting functional coverage and code coverage, and using those metrics to drive verification closure
 - Experience verifying serial interface protocols and working through IP design and verification processes, knowledge of DDR or LPDDR protocols is a strong plus
 - Demonstrated ability to own end-to-end verification deliverables, including metric closure and formal review signoff, experience with AI-assisted verification tools is a plus

Who You Are

- You can explain a coverage hole to an architect in two sentences and walk out with a plan to close it
 - You debug by hypothesis, not by adding print statements until something makes sense
 - When a testbench is too slow or too brittle, you refactor it instead of working around it
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that makes the code pass
 - You work across time zones and teams without losing context or creating confusion downstream
 - You know when to push back on a design decision and when to adjust the verification plan to match reality

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join Synopsys' DesignWare IP Verification R&D team in Bangalore, working with a global group of experienced verification engineers who are responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of IP cores that power semiconductors across the industry. This team collaborates closely with RTL designers, architects, and infrastructure engineers to deliver robust, production-ready IP. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Cloud Native builds and runs automation scripts and tools (IaC / Terraform) to streamline provisioning, configuration, and management of Cloud PaaS and Serverless Services, and sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Educational Background

data.title: Sr Quality Engineer
data.description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. 

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. 

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

- Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins. 
 - Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices. 
 - Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers. 
 - Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production. 
 - Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems - including reconciliation checks - to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions. 
 - Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions. 
 - Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit. 
 - Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability. 
 - Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team - identifying dependencies and escalating risks early. 
 - Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes. 
 - Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery. 
 - Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

- 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages. 
 - Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows - including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools - with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated. 
 - Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman. 
 - Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers and product managers, prioritize independently, and communicate quality risks with supporting evidence; prior experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and/or FinTech/Payments domains, or with ERP systems and their integrations, is strongly preferred. 

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. 

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2, 500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2, 000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22, 000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

About The Team

Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally - as well as its flagship site, www. fanatics. com. 

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world-including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA). 

At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do: 

- Build Championship Teams
 - Obsessed with Fans
 - Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
 - Determined and Relentless Mindset

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. 

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced RPA Specialist - Blue Prism with 5+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Blue Prism architecture, process automation, exception handling, application integration, debugging, and production support, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable automation solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- RPA Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy automation solutions using Blue Prism, following established development standards and best practices. 
 - Process Assessment: Analyze business processes, identify automation opportunities, and evaluate feasibility, complexity, and expected business benefits. 
 - Solution Design: Prepare Process Definition Documents (PDDs), Solution Design Documents (SDDs), process maps, and technical specifications. 
 - Blue Prism Development: Build and maintain reusable Business Objects, Process Objects, Work Queues, Credentials, Schedules, and Control Room configurations. 
 - Exception Handling: Implement robust exception-handling frameworks, logging, recovery mechanisms, and retry strategies to ensure reliable bot execution. 
 - Application Integration: Integrate Blue Prism with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, web applications, Excel, email, and file systems. 
 - Testing and Deployment: Perform unit testing, support system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), and manage production deployments. 
 - Production Support: Monitor bot performance, troubleshoot failures, conduct root-cause analysis, and resolve production incidents within agreed SLAs. 
 - Automation Optimization: Enhance existing automations to improve execution performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business analysts, process owners, IT and infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders. 
 - Governance and Documentation: Follow security standards, access controls, coding conventions, version control, release management, and RPA governance guidelines. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to expand automation coverage, standardize business processes, and improve operational efficiency. 

Required Technical Skills

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on RPA development experience, with strong practical expertise in Blue Prism.

data.title: Technical Manager
data.description:
Position Overview

The Technical Manager will lead technical and engineering activities for Kaprel India, ensuring accurate and timely project technical submittals, compliance with project specifications, effective coordination with contractors and consultants, and practical technical support through procurement, production and installation. The role will oversee the technical team, support product development and standardization, and act as a central technical resource for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia. 

Responsibilities

1. Technical Submittals and Project Approvals

·                Prepare, review and coordinate complete technical submittal packages for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, in line with project-specific requirements and approval procedures. 

·                Compile material submittals, compliance statements, technical data sheets, product specifications, test reports, certificates, method statements and supporting engineering documents as required. 

·                Manage material and finish sample submissions, approval tracking, consultant comments, resubmissions and closure of technical queries. 

·                Coordinate with main contractors, consultants, clients, project teams and Kaprel management to obtain approvals and finalize project-specific materials, system details and designs. 

·                Maintain an up-to-date submittal register, document revision history and approvals record; proactively flag submission risks affecting procurement or site schedules. 

2. Technical Leadership and Engineering Management

·                Lead and coordinate the technical and design team, assign work priorities, review deliverables and monitor workload, quality and submission deadlines. 

·                Oversee the development and checking of shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation details, material take-offs and bills of materials to support accurate procurement and manufacturing. 

·                Conduct technical evaluations and design assessments for compliance with applicable standards, approved specifications, contractual scope and customer requirements. 

·                Establish consistent engineering checklists, drawing review procedures, revision controls and handover requirements between departments. 

·                Identify gaps or discrepancies in tender documents, drawings and specifications; raise technical clarifications and coordinate timely resolution before fabrication. 

3. Procurement, Production and Site Coordination

·                Prepare and maintain procurement schedules and long-lead material requirements in coordination with project programmes and approved technical submittals. 

·                Liaise with Procurement, Stores and Production teams to ensure the correct materials and specifications are available when required, and highlight risks early. 

·                Provide technical support to manufacturing and installation teams, resolving design interfaces, fabrication constraints and site-specific technical problems. 

·                Investigate installation and product performance issues, establish root causes and implement practical corrective measures to prevent recurrence. 

·                Coordinate technical responses and support to customers and project teams on system specifications, installation details and product performance. 

4. Product Engineering, Quality and Improvement

·                Drive value engineering initiatives to improve manufacturability, installation efficiency, product reliability and cost effectiveness without compromising approved performance. 

·                Support new product and system development, component selection, prototyping, testing, certification and performance improvement initiatives. 

·                Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders on suitable alternatives for aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, seals, gaskets and related components. 

·                Maintain controlled records of technical specifications, approved system details, certificates, testing reports and product documentation for use across Kaprel locations. 

·                Analyze recurring technical errors, nonconformities and rework costs; recommend design standardization and preventive improvements. 

5. Reporting and Accountability

·                Provide regular updates to the General Manager on technical submission status, departmental workload, approval delays, unresolved technical risks and improvement initiatives. 

·                Coordinate closely with regional Kaprel teams so requirements and approved technical documentation are consistent, while respecting differences in local project specifications and standards. 

·                Escalate deviations involving unapproved system changes, project cost impact, contractual scope or technical performance before implementation. 

Qualifications and Experience

·                Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline. 

·                Minimum 6 years of relevant construction or subcontracting experience, preferably in the glazing, architectural aluminium, partition or door systems industry. 

·                Prior experience managing technical work and coordinating with main contractors, consultants and clients. 

·                Good knowledge of project specifications, technical documentation, material approvals and subcontract scope management. 

·                Ability to interpret engineering drawings and coordinate fabrication, procurement and installation requirements; proficiency with AutoCAD and relevant technical tools is advantageous. 

·                Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and team management skills; comfortable coordinating technical deliverables across multiple locations. 

For those interested, pls send your CV to recruitment@kaprel. com with subject line: Application_Technical Manager_India

Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

- AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up. 
 - Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap. 

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

- Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm. 
 - Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months. 

Technical Strategy & Authority

- Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration. 
 - Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies. 

Customer & Business Impact

- Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value. 
 - Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed. 

You're Our Builder Lead If. . . 

- You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent. 
 - You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments. 
 - You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value. 
 - You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects. 
 - You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails. 
 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines. 
 - Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist). 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

 - Knowledge of Gearset-triggered automated executions and release validation.

 - Familiarity with static-analysis processes and automated regression reporting. 5. Test Data Management

 - Understanding of data relationship integrity and environment-independent test execution. Mandatory Requirements

 - Knowledge of API testing and CI/CD integration. 
 - Must be available to work from the Bengaluru or Mumbai office for 10 days per month.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
FlexTrade Systems is a global leader in high-performance multi-asset execution management and order management systems for equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, futures, and options. A pioneer in the field, FlexTrade is internationally recognized for introducing FlexTRADER®, the world's first broker-neutral, execution management trading system, which allows clients to completely control and customize their execution workflows through a comprehensive ability to search/access liquidity while maintaining the confidentiality of their trading strategies. 

At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to an ever-changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to every interaction, and we continue to improve, grow together, and collaborate as one team. All of these, while having Fun, truly make FlexTrade a wonderful place to work. 

About you: 

We are seeking a highly motivated, technically curious engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges in a fast‐paced trading environment. As part of the FX Development & Client Services team, you will architect high‐performance FX trading components, build low‐latency integrations with leading global market participants, and work directly with traders and technologists to shape next‐generation FX workflows. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys breaking down complexity into well‐defined technical solutions and wants to continuously grow as financial products and markets evolve. 

Responsibilities

As a member of the FlexFX Development & Client Services team, you will: 

- Design, implement, and maintain advanced FX trading components with a strong emphasis on performance, scalability, and reliability.

 - Individually test each component you build-designing comprehensive automated tests that cover edge cases, failure scenarios, performance‐critical boundaries, and real‐world resiliency requirements. 
 - Produce clear technical designs, architecture documents, and workflow specifications. 
 - Continuously learn and adapt to new products, markets, and trading technologies as financial systems evolve. Job requirements

- Minimum of 7+ years of professional software development experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
 - Proficiency in modern C++ or similar high‐performance languages. 
 - Experience working on large‐scale, low‐latency, and/or distributed systems, with teams spread all across global regions. 
 - Strong problem‐solving and debugging skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into clear, actionable tasks. 
 - Familiarity with testing methodologies and frameworks such as GTest. 
 - Excellent communication skills for working across technical and business teams. 
 - A positive attitude and fast‐learning mindset, with openness to learning new products, markets, and financial systems as they evolve. 
 - Strong discipline in designing thorough component‐level tests and validating all edge conditions

Nice to have

- Knowledge of trading systems and FIX protocol. 
 - Experience with Order Management Systems (OMS) or Execution Management Systems (EMS). 
 - Exposure to real‐time, high‐throughput, or low‐latency financial applications. 
 - Familiarity with Golang and REST/WebSocket APIs

Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve. 

Who You Are

As a Staff Engineer L6, you lead development across Inovalon products and platforms with a focus on solving resiliency, scale, and security challenges at a higher level of technical sophistication. You serve as a functional lead and subject matter expert, helping guide engineering execution across teams while raising discipline, productivity, and technical quality. In this role, you partner with business stakeholders, architecture leads, and engineers to deliver scalable data solutions, strengthen platform reliability, and drive a collaborative, data-driven engineering culture. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable healthcare data pipelines and data access patterns that support Inovalon products and platforms.
