 - Provide strong technical leadership by raising the technical bar, fostering a data and results driven culture, and building trust and collaboration across teams. 
 - Influence and coach junior engineers within and outside your team, communicate effectively across disciplines, and support on call responsibilities for critical issue resolution. 

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of industrial experience with cloud and serverless technologies. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience required. 
 - Hands on experience with AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, test orchestration, infrastructure as code, and observability tooling. 
 - Experience implementing fully automated pipelines with multi stage validation. 
 - Familiarity with SQL Server, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL, especially test data creation, schema validation, and data quality automation. 
 - Proven ability to drive test automation maturity, reduce manual testing, eliminate flakiness, and improve reliability through automation, monitoring, proactive stability improvements, and automated alerting. 
 - Proficiency in test automation for microservices, containerized environments, and orchestrated systems including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by evaluating emerging tools and frameworks, expanding expertise across cloud, data, and automation domains, and applying new learning to improve engineering outcomes. 
 - Demonstrate leadership by setting technical direction, aligning teams on goals and timelines, coaching engineers, and influencing high quality execution across functions and teams. 
 - Demonstrate adaptability by responding effectively to changing technologies, priorities, and operational demands while maintaining focus on delivery, resiliency, and quality. 
 - Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying innovative ways to solve scale, security, reliability, and automation challenges across products and platforms. 
 - Demonstrate analytical skills by performing root cause analysis, assessing data and system issues, and using evidence to improve performance, quality, and operational stability. 
 - Nice to have: Experience with service meshes and asynchronous or event streaming systems such as Kafka, SQS, and SNS; advanced performance testing and benchmarking experience with k6, JMeter, or Gatling; security automation experience including vulnerability scanning, static analysis, and secrets validation; experience leading organization wide automation transformations, platform migrations, or quality initiatives. 

Our Shared Commitments

- Maintain compliance with Inovalon's policies, procedures and mission statement; 
 - Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon's Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
 - Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer. 

Work Environment

- This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law. 

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e. g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don't meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth. 

Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.

data.title: Senior Solution Architect (AI / LLM solutions)
data.description:
Job description: 

  

About the Team

We are expanding our AI Engineering organization at ZF and are hiring Senior Solution Architects. 

Our team builds enterprise-grade AI platforms and solutions across Agentic AI, Generative AI for the software development lifecycle, systems engineering, automated testing, MLOps, computer vision, and engineering data intelligence. 

Our work includes developing AI agents for requirements engineering, code development, test generation, and traceability. We also address complex automotive engineering challenges, including virtual sensors, lateral and longitudinal control, perception engineering, object detection and tracking, digital twins, condition monitoring, and intelligent validation. 

  

What you can look forward to as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)

- End-to-end ownership: You'll own the technical architecture of enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, from framing the business problem through to secure, observable and cost-efficient production systems. 
 - Real-world impact: You'll turn LLM capabilities into reliable, auditable solutions that hold up against complex enterprise data, strict security and compliance requirements, tight latency and cost budgets, and unpredictable model behavior. This role goes well beyond proof of concept. 
 - Architecture leadership: You'll set the reference architecture, platform patterns and guardrails that multiple engineering teams build on. 
 - Strategic decisions: You'll lead decisions on what to build versus buy, which models to use, and whether to customize models through fine-tuning, weighing quality, cost, scalability and vendor independence. 
 - Cutting-edge technology: You'll design multi-agent systems on leading frameworks and cloud platforms, such as LangGraph, AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Visibility and influence: You'll be the trusted technical authority for business leaders, security teams and enterprise architecture boards.   

Your Profile as Solution Architect: AI/ML (m/f/d)

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, AI or a related field. 
 - 10+ years in software, data or ML engineering, including at least 3 years as a solution or lead architect. 
 - Production GenAI delivery: You have delivered at least 2-3 LLM / Generative AI solutions into production, not only proofs of concept, and owned the architecture and non-functional requirements end to end. 
 - Agentic AI: You have built hands-on agentic systems hands-on, with tool use, state management and human-in-the-loop controls. You've used code-first frameworks such as LangGraph / LangChain or managed platforms such as AWS Bedrock Agents or Azure AI Foundry Agent Service. 
 - LLM and model expertise: You have a strong grasp of LLM fundamentals (transformers, embeddings, context windows). You have hands-on experience customising models through fine-tuning (e. g. , LoRA / QLoRA) and evaluating them, and you can choose sensibly between prompting, RAG and training. 
 - Engineering and cloud: You are an expert in Python and API engineering (FastAPI, async, event-driven design). You have strong architecture experience on at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure or GCP), including networking, identity and security. 
 - RAG, quality and security: You have practical experience with vector databases, hybrid search and retrieval evaluation. You've implemented LLM evaluation, tracing and observability in production, and you're well-grounded in AI security (prompt-injection defence, data protection).

data.title: DISTINGUISHED, SOFTWARE ENGINEER - WFS
data.description:
About The Team

Walmart's Marketplace is the backbone of a thriving ecosystem connecting millions of third-party sellers to hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. You will be build applications that provide accurate and contextual intelligence and recommendations to sellers on Walmart Marketplace and Omni platforms. 

Role Overview

Distinguished Engineer is one of the most coveted technical IC titles at Walmart - and this role lives up to it. As a Distinguished Engineer on the Marketplace team within Growth Tech, you will be developing services that helps millions of sellers to leverage Walmart Fulfilment Services. You will write code, design systems, review architectures, and solve the problems that are complex. Your world-class expertise in distributed systems, API design, and platform engineering will be paired with a Al-forward mindset. 

This is a high-impact role sitting at the intersection of scale, commerce, and platform engineering. You will own the technical vision and execution for a portfolio of mission-critical, cross-cutting services that enables Seller through Seller Center UI and APIs. You will be the technical standard-setter across all of it. 

What You'll Own Technically

The Walmart Fulfilment Services team is essential to the Marketplace ecosystem, responsible for designing and scaling the global platform that supports the complete seller fulfilment within Walmart marketplace journey. The team develops robust global workflows, and complex multi-platform integrations connecting cloud microservices, seller portals, and AI-driven analytics. You will own Architecture, design, development and delivery of Seller journey, addressing distributed systems challenges, optimize APIs, and establish architectural standards to enable international marketplace growth. 

What You'll Do

Architecture & System Design

Lead end-to-end technical design for complex initiatives involving from API contracts, UI interfaces and data models to distributed system topologies and cross-cutting concerns. 

Drive platform standardization by defining and documenting reference architectures, design patterns, and implementation guardrails that teams adopt

Evaluate and select technologies, frameworks, and cloud-native patterns with a clear-eyed understanding of trade-offs at Walmart's operational scale

Author and review RFCs and architecture decision records (ADRs) that become the technical canon for the platform

Hands-On Engineering

Write production-grade code and not prototypes or proof-of-concepts, test and deploy them to production

Solve complex problems considering performance, reliability and scalability

Prototype new solutions rapidly using Al-augmented development workflows and then drive them to production quality

Conduct deep-dive code reviews that raise the technical bar of the team. 

Own the full software development lifecycle for your initiatives involving design, development, testing, deployment, observability

Complex Problem Solving

Solve the hardest and complex problems and enable the team while doing so

Lead technical investigations for P0/P1 incidents affecting platform services; own the root cause analysis and define permanent fixes

Challenge technical assumptions early in the design process before they become expensive production mistakes

Navigate ambiguity with confidence by breaking down underspecified problems into structured technical approaches and drive alignment across stakeholders

Platform Reliability & Operational Excellence

Design for resilience from first principles. Define and own the platform's non-functional requirements

Instrument systems to be deeply observable and use the signals to drive continuous improvement

Build runbooks and operational playbooks that enable the broader team to operate the services confidently

Al & Innovation

This role is Al-forward by design and needs someone who actively shapes how it is used and pushes the frontier of what Al-augmented engineering looks like at scale. 

Day-to-Day Al Fluency

Proficient with GitHub Copilot, Wibey, and LLM-based tooling as active, daily parts of your development workflow

Use Al to compress every phase of the engineering loop: schema design validation, code generation and review, test coverage acceleration, documentation, drafting, incident root-cause analysis, and API design feedback

Identify where Al can replace toil, then build the automation yourself

Al-Native Platform Thinking

Architect and build Al-native capabilities like intelligent API health monitoring, Al-assisted seller onboarding flows, smart alerting and anomaly detection

Evaluate and integrate Al/ML capabilities into services where they create measurable seller value

Stay current on the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring high-signal, opinionated recommendations to the team

Al Advocacy & Enablement

Model Al-augmented engineering practices for the team through live demos, pairing sessions, and written guides

Work with engineering leadership to identify and prioritize investments where Al creates the most leverage across teams

Contribute to the broader Walmart engineering community's understanding of how to build and operate Al-augmented systems responsibly

What You'll Bring

Distinguished Engineers at Walmart lead through technical gravity. Your impact multiplies across teams. 

Raise the floor - your code reviews, design feedback, and written standards lift the quality of every engineer in the team

When a team is stuck on a systems design challenge or a production crisis, you are the person who helps unblock

Your architectural decisions today shape the technical capabilities and codebase for the future

Grow technical depth across the org through tech talks, design reviews, RFCs, and hands-on pairing, you are a force multiplier for technical growth across Growth Tech

Bridge platform and product translate complex technical constraints into clear trade-offs that inform product decisions; translate product ambitions into technically sound, phased engineering strategies

Pioneer Al adoption - model what Al-augmented engineering looks like at the Distinguished level and create the patterns, playbooks, and tooling that the broader team follows

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Benefits

At Schwab India, you're empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration - so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

data.title: Manager, Manufacturing Process Operations
data.description:
Job Purpose

JOB DESCRIPTION

Lead Peptide Upstream Manufacturing, particularly Solid Phase Peptide Synthesis (SPPS), along with manufacturing QMS activities to ensure safe, compliant and timely execution in line with cGMP, quality, EHS and business/project requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Peptide Upstream Manufacturing: Lead SPPS operations covering resin charging/swelling, Fmoc deprotection, amino acid coupling, washing, cleavage and filtration. Ensure execution as per approved BMR/BPR, SOPs, process parameters, quality requirements and production schedules; monitor yields, solvent/material consumption and equipment utilization. 
 - QMS Management: Own manufacturing-related deviations, CAPA, change controls, incident investigations, RCA and risk assessments. Review/approve SOPs, BMR/BPR, protocols, forms, checklists and logbooks, ensuring GDP, Data Integrity and timely QMS closure. Maintain readiness for customer, regulatory and internal audits. 
 - Project & Equipment Readiness: Provide manufacturing inputs for URS, equipment/facility design and process requirements. Coordinate equipment procurement, FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning and qualification, including DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ as applicable, and ensure equipment readiness for engineering and GMP batches. 
 - Technology Transfer & Scale-Up: Coordinate with R&D/Process Development for technology transfer, manufacturing feasibility and scale-up. Support engineering, demonstration, validation and commercial batches; identify scale-up risks, implement mitigation and transfer process knowledge to shop-floor teams. 
 - Team Management: Lead, allocate and monitor the Upstream Manufacturing & QMS team. Ensure training and qualification in SPPS, GMP, QMS, troubleshooting and documentation, while driving Safety, Quality, Compliance, Productivity and Accountability. 
 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with R&D, QA, QC, Engineering, Projects, Warehouse, Supply Chain, EHS, Validation and Procurement to ensure timely availability of raw materials, equipment, documents, utilities and manpower. 
 - EHS & Compliance: Ensure safe handling of solvents, reagents, amino acids, resins and process materials. Participate in process risk assessments, HAZOP and safety reviews, and ensure timely closure of safety observations and corrective actions. 

Qualifications

Qualification B. Pharm / M. Pharm / B. Sc. / M. Sc. / B. Tech / M. Tech in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field

Experience Preferably 12-15 years in Peptide/Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, with relevant experience in manufacturing operations and QMS.

data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients' needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Python & C++ Senior Software Engineer - Data Access (FIP)

FactSet is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Access team - the single, powerful entry point to the FactSet Intelligence Platform (FIP). This is where every interaction begins: AI agents & tools, internal analytics, and client-facing APIs all connect through one unified endpoint and receive responses in a consistent, structured envelope enriched with provenance, source attribution, and entitlement transparency. Operating at the very front of FactSet's data ecosystem, you'll define this client-facing interface and orchestrate the systems behind it, delivering data with exceptional speed, security, reliability, and precision. 

The platform handles immense volumes of low-latency requests, so strong engineering discipline is essential - you'll apply best practices in distributed systems, scalability, and performance to build infrastructure that is both resilient and efficient. It's a unique opportunity to shape a critical layer of FactSet's architecture, one that directly shapes the client's experience and enables the next generation of intelligent applications. If you're passionate about building high-performance systems, simplifying complex data interactions, and making a measurable impact at scale, we'd love to hear from you. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy the Data Access interface that defines how clients access data. 
 - Implement query patterns and APIs that balance flexibility, performance, and security. 
 - Enforce entitlements to ensure clients access only authorized data products. 
 - Leverage metrics and KPIs to optimize query execution, incorporating caching and performance strategies to meet client SLAs. 
 - Build observability into the layer - end-to-end request tracing, provenance, and source attribution surfaced in responses. 
 - Own Data Access products and features, driving bug fixes, performance enhancements, and scalability improvements. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to continuously improve development processes. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical design reviews and architecture decisions for the Data Access layer. 
 - Participate in a regional on-call rotation to support production system

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or related field. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on API development, query systems, or data infrastructure. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience building production-grade, client-facing systems. 
 - Solid understanding of OOP principles and software design patterns. 
 - Experience with API design and building orchestration layers across multiple backend systems. 
 - Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively, with experience leading technical initiatives. 
 - Passion for designing and implementing efficient, scalable, and maintainable software. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with multithreaded programming, low latency, and high-availability systems. 
 - Knowledge of query engine architecture, parsers, compilers and interpreters. 
 - Experience implementing caching strategies (Redis, Memcached) for query results and metadata. 
 - Experience with service-oriented architecture and microservices design. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems and handling failures gracefully across service boundaries. 
 - Experience working with large-scale data systems and balancing latency, throughput, and cost. 
 - Background with rate limiting, throttling, and client quota management.

Bring-Up and Characterization Engineer

Multiple roles across different levels

Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and data centre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. We are looking for a Characterisation and Bring-Up engineer to work with Architecture, Silicon Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Operations (device manufacture) and Product teams to help create and execute the bring-up and characterisation of our cutting-edge silicon devices and system platforms. Graphcore design and develop leading edge silicon processors and high-power high-speed blade systems at the forefront of AI technology. As such you will need to develop a detailed understanding of our silicon and platform products. Your role will be to create and execute bring-up and characterisation plans of our silicon devices in systems to show that they will operate correctly over all conditions in the final product. You will concentrate on automated and manual testing of systems in the lab and datacentre. The results will be integrated with data from other teams to provide the complete characterisation solution for the product. For example, a large amount of device testing can be performed by the production test team using high-speed production test equipment.

- Understand the architecture and design of silicon devices and systems, and clearly document the requirements for characterisation
 - Creation of product specific characterisation plans
 - Liasing with engineering teams to understand what are tests are available for characterisation purposes and driving change where appropriate
 - Create and maintain an automated system for running characterisation testing, capturing the results to a central database and performing data analysis
 - Execution of manual characterisation tests where automation is not appropriate
 - Report regularly on progress and issues during the characterisation
 - Produce characterisation reports containing platform test results and feeding them up into the overall product characterisation report

Essential Skills

- A proven track record of delivering technical output, perhaps as an individual contributor, manager, or project manager
 - Solid experience and understanding of silicon digital device design characterization
 - Knowledge of silicon process technology and how that impacts device performance at transistor and system level
 - Knowledge of high-performance processor and system-on-chip systems

As a Team Lead, Support Engineering at FloQast, you will lead a specialized team dedicated to delivering exceptional technical support for FloQast customers across the Accounting Workflow Automation Platform.  8-12+ years of experience in automation, RPA, software development, or enterprise application

- Core DNA

 - Agentic Implementation. You build, debug and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and long-running business logic. 
 - Legacy-to-Modern Bridge. You treat 20-year-old systems as puzzles for AI-driven modernization, not as someone else's problem. 
 - Evidence Over Confidence. You don't ship an agent because the demo went well. You ship it because you can show what it does on the edge cases - and you know your own error rate rather than claiming there isn't one. 
 - What You Own

Your agent. Design, build, debug, deploy, and keep running. Including the unglamorous parts: retries, state recovery, timeouts, what happens when the model is down. 

The evidence it works. Before you refactor an undocumented module, you capture what it currently does - characterization tests, real inputs, real outputs. After, you show the behaviour matches. Your Builder 3 sets the standard; meeting it is your job, not theirs. 

Your blast radius. You know exactly what your agent is permitted to touch, and you build so a wrong answer costs a review comment rather than a bad ledger entry. 

- Your Elective Specialty (lean into one)
 - The Agentic Architect (Systems) - you don't just build APIs, you build tool-calling interfaces and state management for agentic graphs that survive long-running business processes. 
 - The UX/Interaction Builder (Product) - the chatbox is just the beginning. You build generative UIs and browser-use agents that navigate existing portals to get work done. 
 - The Data & Context Engineer (Data) - master of the RAG pipeline. Vector stores, chunking strategy, and knowledge graphs that teach the AI how a Purchase Order relates to a GL entry. 
 - The Reliability & Eval Engineer (QA) - you move the team from prompt vibes to prompt engineering. DSPy for programmatic optimization, red-teaming agents to pressure-test financial logic. 
 - The Infra & Agent-Ops Builder (DevOps) - you build the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the thoughts of the AI. 
 - The Domain Logic Translator (Business) - you take 50 pages of accounting regulation and turn it into structured system prompts and agentic constraints. 

What You'll Actually Do

- Build execution agents. Move beyond RAG into action - agents that navigate an ERP schema, find a data discrepancy and propose the fix. 
 - Automate the untestable. Wrap legacy business logic in modern tests and documentation using AI, starting with the modules everyone else has avoided. 
 - Prove parity. Capture what the old code does before you replace it, and show the new path matches - on the boring cases and the fiscal-calendar, multi-currency, partial-shipment ones. 
 - Prompt engineering and evals. Use frameworks like DSPy to move from vibes-based prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions. 
 - Rapid prototyping. Turn a "what if" into a working AI-driven feature in days, not months. 
 - Fix your own agents in production. Read the traces, find why it went sideways, make it not happen again. 

What Good Looks Like

(Illustrative - real targets agreed with the hiring manager. )

- 30 days: Shipped your first agentic workflow into a real environment, however small. 
 - 90 days: Owning a legacy module end to end - parity evidence, tests, deployment - with minimal supervision. 
 - 6 months: Other Builders are reusing patterns you built. You're the person people ask about one thing in particular. 

The Stack

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, agentic coding tools, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, pgvector/Qdrant, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Playwright, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry, eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent). And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. 

Who You Are

- You've shipped one. You have built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM workflow that real people used for real work - not a weekend demo. You know how it failed, because it did. 
 - The early adopter. You were using GPT-3 before it was cool and had a local model running the week it leaked. More time on r/LocalLLaMA, GitHub Trending and AI Twitter than on LinkedIn. 
 - Agent-first thinker. You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions. 
 - The manual-task hater. You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you do it twice, you've already started drafting the automation. 
 - Technically fearless. A 500-table undocumented legacy schema isn't complexity, it's a puzzle about to get solved. You aren't intimidated by spaghetti code - you're the one who brings the sauce. 
 - Rigor over hype. You love the new models and you still ask for the numbers. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data. 

Why Join Us

- The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. Automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain and you've mastered the hardest problem in software. 
 - Agentic autonomy. We don't do tickets. We do missions. You'll have real freedom over the models, frameworks and agent architectures you think will win. 
 - No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee - a "Does It Work?" policy. 
 - The Builder Tribe. You won't be the only AI person in the room. You'll be part of a small squad of people equally obsessed with moving faster, where your automation hacks are your biggest contribution rather than a hidden side project.

Lead the development of innovative software products and AI-powered solutions that transform business operations and deliver exceptional digital experiences. In this role, you will define technical direction, guide architecture decisions, and lead projects from early discovery through production delivery. You will help establish an AI-native engineering culture, leveraging advanced coding tools, intelligent agents, and scalable cloud technologies. Working closely with senior engineering and product leaders, you will translate complex business challenges into practical, high-impact solutions. You will also mentor engineers, strengthen development standards, and ensure that technical decisions balance quality, cost, risk, and speed. This opportunity is suited to a hands-on technical leader who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is passionate about turning ambitious AI strategies into reliable products. 

Accountabilities

As Lead Software Engineer, you will own technical execution for a team or product while helping shape the broader engineering strategy. You will combine architectural leadership, hands-on development, cross-functional collaboration, and team mentorship to deliver measurable business outcomes. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Lead AI Initiatives End to End: Define and maintain the architecture roadmap for your team or product, transforming ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans and production-ready software. 
 - Shape AI Architecture: Partner with senior engineering leaders to develop and implement approaches involving AWS Bedrock, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic architectures, evaluation pipelines, and production safeguards. 
 - Establish AI-Native Development Practices: Design and implement agentic coding workflows using tools such as Claude Code, including reusable skills, engineering standards, and review processes that ensure AI-generated code meets production requirements. 
 - Drive Technical Decisions: Evaluate architectural options, make informed trade-offs, retire outdated designs, and establish scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with product and business priorities. 
 - Mentor and Develop Engineers: Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, pairing, code reviews, constructive feedback, and reusable technical guidelines. 
 - Connect Engineering with Business Needs: Collaborate with teams across departments to understand operational challenges and identify opportunities where AI agents and automation can reduce manual work and improve efficiency. 
 - Manage Cost, Risk, and Delivery: Communicate technical trade-offs and risks in terms of timelines, costs, and business impact, helping stakeholders make informed decisions. 
 - Lead Design and Code Reviews: Guide system design, review implementation quality, and evaluate build-versus-buy decisions to support effective technical execution. 
 - Translate Strategy into Results: Work closely with AI, product operations, and product leadership to prioritize initiatives, stay connected to end users, and keep engineering efforts focused on measurable outcomes. 
 - Support Product Innovation: Contribute to software platforms and AI-enabled tools that support complex brand experiences, event operations, guest registration, hospitality, and asset management. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with strong technical judgment, a track record of delivering products end to end, and the leadership skills to guide teams through complex engineering challenges. They should be comfortable applying AI technologies in production environments and making decisions that balance innovation with reliability. Key qualifications include: 

- Extensive hands-on software engineering experience, including ownership of products or major initiatives from concept through deployment.

data.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer(Test Automation Engineer (Salesforce Using Cypress)
data.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One - our cloud-first, AI-powered platform - CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve. 

We're at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences. 

Our Enterprise Platform team aspires to be a leader by applying technology to power business strategies. We connect concepts with solutions to create value and efficiencies for our employees and customers. Our success is driven by our skilled and diverse team who are passionate about excellence, innovation, and agility. 

As the Senior Salesforce Test Automation Engineer, you will lead the expansion of automated quality engineering across our Salesforce ecosystem, with primary ownership for establishing Cypress. io as a scalable, maintainable, and trusted enterprise test automation capability. You will combine hands-on automation engineering with technical leadership, partnering with developers, administrators, product owners, business analysts, release engineering, and quality engineers to improve release confidence, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a Cypress. io automation framework for Salesforce applications, Experience Cloud, integrated web applications, and critical end-to-end business processes. 
 - Define automation architecture, coding standards, repository structure, reusable commands, fixtures, test-data patterns, environment configuration, tagging, and reporting conventions that support maintainability and scale. 
 - Develop and maintain reliable automated suites for smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, API, and selected component-testing scenarios, balancing UI coverage with faster API-based setup and validation where appropriate. 
 - Create a pragmatic automation roadmap that prioritizes high-risk, high-volume, and business-critical Salesforce journeys and converts the existing regression inventory into a sustainable Cypress test portfolio. 
 - Design resilient approaches for Salesforce-specific automation challenges, including dynamic Lightning DOM behavior, asynchronous processing, authentication, role-based access, complex data dependencies, integrations, and multi-environment execution. 
 - Integrate Cypress execution into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows, including pull-request validation, scheduled regression runs, pre-release quality gates, test result publishing, screenshots, videos, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish test observability and quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rate, execution time, flaky-test rate, defect escape trends, failure causes, and manual effort avoided; use insights to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Build secure, repeatable test-data and credential-management practices across Salesforce sandboxes and connected systems, partnering with platform, security, and DevOps teams to protect sensitive information. 
 - Perform hands-on exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and release-readiness testing when automation is not yet available or when human judgment provides better coverage. 
 - Partner with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and administrators to make requirements testable and to strengthen acceptance criteria, negative scenarios, risk analysis, and definition-of-done standards. 
 - Troubleshoot failed tests and application defects, distinguish product issues from automation issues, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution. 
 - Review automation code, mentor quality engineers and developers, provide technical guidance, and promote engineering practices that treat automated tests as production-quality software. 
 - Evaluate Cypress. io capabilities, plugins, Cypress Cloud features, and AI-assisted test authoring; recommend adoption based on security, maintainability, cost, measurable value, and enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to QA governance, release management, Agile ceremonies, test planning, risk reviews, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, including 3+ years testing Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience building and maintaining Cypress. io automation using JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong understanding of selectors, custom commands, fixtures, network interception, retries, asynchronous behavior, and test isolation. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing an automation framework or materially scaling an existing framework across teams, applications, or release trains. 
 - Strong Salesforce testing experience across Lightning Experience and one or more of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ/commerce, custom Apex and Lightning Web Components, integrations, or platform automation. 
 - Experience with API testing, including REST and GraphQL patterns, authentication, request/response validation, data setup, and combining API and UI tests. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket and pipeline technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with test management, defect lifecycle, and work-management tools such as Jira, Xray, Confluence, or equivalent. 
 - Experience developing quality strategies, risk-based test plans, automation backlogs, traceability, release-readiness assessments, and meaningful quality reporting in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Experience diagnosing flaky tests, improving suite performance, handling parallel execution, and maintaining reliable automation across multiple environments and data states. 

Skills: 

- Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate failures across the UI, Salesforce platform, APIs, integrations, test data, and automation framework. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, version control, code review, debugging, documentation, and maintainable test-code practices. 
 - Ability to translate business processes and technical architecture into clear, risk-based automated test coverage. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through influence, mentorship, collaboration, and ownership of cross-team outcomes. 
 - Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance immediate release needs with long-term automation health. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or relevant Salesforce Consultant certification. 
 - Cypress certification, recognized test automation certification, or equivalent evidence of deep Cypress expertise. 
 - Experience with Cypress Cloud capabilities such as recorded runs, test replay, analytics, flaky-test insights, parallelization, and enterprise reporting. 
 - Experience with Okta or SSO-enabled test authentication and secure automated credential management. 
 - Familiarity with accessibility testing, performance testing, AI-assisted test generation, and complementary tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Selenium, Playwright, or Jest. 
 - Experience modernizing or migrating an automation portfolio from a commercial or legacy testing platform to Cypress. io. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- Cypress. io is established as a governed, secure, and reusable automation capability for Salesforce delivery. 
 - Critical business journeys have reliable automated coverage and provide fast, actionable feedback before releases. 
 - CI/CD pipelines consistently execute the right tests at the right stage, with clear evidence for failures and release decisions. 
 - Flaky tests, duplicated effort, and manual regression time decline as framework quality, test data, and team adoption improve. 
 - Developers and quality engineers contribute to a shared automation codebase using consistent standards and effective code reviews. 
 - Quality metrics clearly communicate risk, progress, and business value to engineering and leadership stakeholders. 

Why Join Us?

- Shape the test automation strategy for a business-critical Salesforce platform and influence quality engineering practices across teams. 
 - Lead a high-visibility Cypress. io implementation with opportunities to modernize delivery, improve engineering velocity, and reduce release risk. 
 - Work with a collaborative, forward-thinking team investing in Salesforce, AI-enabled engineering, and enterprise platform transformation. 
 - Access ongoing professional development, technical learning, and Salesforce certification opportunities. 
 - Competitive compensation and benefits. 

Location: 

- Remote - India

Interested or know someone who would be a great fit? Please share the profile with ranjith. allam@cyientsemi. com

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

data.title: Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory
data.description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We're building a future that helps people live better lives longer - and we're looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it. 

Here, you'll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security. 

a Purpose Driven Company - 150 Years

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you'll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1. 334 trillion in assets, we're a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager. 

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you'll find high-performance culture that's flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable - always focused on delivering for our customers. It's the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive. 

Whether you're just starting out or ready to take your next step, we'll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career. 

What You Will Do

The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, serves as a trusted partner within the First Line Information Technology Operational Risk (ITOR) group and is accountable for issue validation testing, risk and controls advisory, governance, and reporting across Global Technology and Operations (GTO). The role leads multiple concurrent validation and control reviews to assess whether remediation addresses root causes, controls are designed and operating effectively, and risk outcomes are sustainable. The individual partners with business and technology leaders identify emerging risks, shape risk strategies and remediation priorities, and strengthen risk and control inventories. The role assists with risk and control governance forums, develops meaningful metrics and executive reporting, communicates risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalates matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. The role also coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities, supports the Privacy team as needed, and provides leadership, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure work is completed in accordance with department and industry standards. 

What You Can Expect

The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, leads the planning and execution of issue validation and control testing to confirm remediation addresses root causes and delivers sustainable outcomes. The role, as a risk advisor, partners with business and technology leaders to identify and assess emerging risks, shape risk strategies, clarify risk acceptance decisions, and align remediation priorities with enterprise standards and business objectives. The role strengthens the control environment by advising on control design, evaluating design and operating effectiveness, maintaining accurate risk and control inventories, identifying thematic gaps and trends, and driving clear ownership, monitoring, and timely remediation. The role also supports effective governance by facilitating risk and control forums, establishing meaningful metrics and reporting, communicating risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalating matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. It coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities across Global Technology and Operations, and supports the Privacy team with privacy-related risk assessments, incident response, data mapping, and privacy-by-design activities. 

- Lead issue validation and testing engagements to confirm that root causes are addressed and remediation is sustainable. 
 - Plan and schedule validation reviews for open issues, prioritizing work based on risk, target closure dates, and validation readiness. 
 - Coordinate validation activities with issue owners, control design functions, First Line management, and Audit to confirm scope, evidence requirements, dependencies, and review timelines. 
 - Assess remediation evidence and control implementation to determine whether corrective actions address root causes and operate as intended. 
 - Track validation progress, resolve evidence gaps, and escalate delays or risks that could affect timely issue closure. 
 - Partner with business and technology leaders to assess technology, cyber, data, resilience, and third-party risks; shape risk strategies; and align risk acceptance and remediation decisions with enterprise standards and business objectives. 
 - Lead risk assessments, maintain accurate process, risk, control, and issue inventories, and analyze trends and control gaps to strengthen control design, monitoring, remediation, governance, and reporting. 
 - Coordinate responses to risk events and emerging issues with business, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and control partners; provide executive reporting and escalation; facilitate root-cause and after-action reviews; and track corrective actions through sustainable resolution. 
 - Remain current on industry developments in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, information security, third-party risk management, and resilience. 
 - Lead and execute engagements that meet the department's methodologies and quality standards. 
 - Invest in professional development, educate others on key risks and controls, and support staff development, recruiting, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Leverage data analytics and develop review programs to support risk assessments, review design, and testing of key GTO risks. 
 - Guide the team on continuous monitoring, year-over-year review coverage, aggregation of key issues for senior leadership, and stakeholder governance meetings. 
 - Support the Privacy team, as needed, with incident response and escalation, awareness activities, Privacy Impact Assessments, data mapping, and privacy-by-design engagement with Technology Product Owners. 
 - Lead and support regulatory gap assessments and responses, SOC/SOX activities, and client assessments in partnership with Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders. 

What You Will Bring

- 8+ years of relevant experience gained through a combination of information security/technology, risk and/or audit related roles, including leading complex engagements and managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Specifically, experience in cloud operations, cyber security operations, vulnerability management or other IT operation-based specialist roles. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in the intricacies associated with a global company and its information technology/cyber security risk profile, including expanding regulatory requirements
 - Strong knowledge of emerging topics and current analytical methods and techniques used to monitor and manage relevant risks. 
 - Track record of supervising, coaching, and developing talent; experience with work planning, staffing, and reviewing team deliverables for quality and consistency. Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience communicating complex topics to senior management and driving alignment on issues, ownership, and remediation. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to leverage data, metrics, and analytics to inform scoping, testing strategy, and thematic insights. 
 - Executive level communication skills, both oral and written, and the ability to partner effectively with multiple business groups, corporate areas, and second and third lines teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree related to technology, risk management, finance, or other quantitative fields of study

What will set you apart?

- Experience in leveraging and/or performing data analysis in support of internal auditing. 
 - Advanced degrees in information technology or cyber security are preferred: An MBA, CIA, CISA, CISSP and/or designations/certifications (e. g. , AI, AWS Cloud Practitioner) that demonstrate proficiency in information technology, information security, and/or cyber security related risks and controls is a plus. 
 - PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer – Java
data.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Java Principal Software Engineer with extensive experience in modern

Java, Spring Boot, microservices, cloud architecture, and database design. 

The candidate will actively contribute to technical design, coding, code reviews, troubleshooting, and feature implementation while providing technical guidance and mentorship to developers. 

The Principal Software Engineer will work closely with the Solution/Technical Architect to translate architectural designs into practical implementations, align development decisions with architectural standards, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and performant. 

The ideal candidate should have strong engineering fundamentals, practical experience with AI-assisted development tools, and a humble, collaborative attitude with a genuine willingness to learn. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, and implementation of backend features using modern Java, Spring Boot, and microservices. 
 - Collaborate with the Solution/Technical Architect to understand architectural decisions, translate designs into implementation plans, and provide technical feedback on feasibility, complexity, and trade-offs. 
 - Ensure implementation aligns with agreed architecture, design principles, security standards, and engineering best practices. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, and design gaps, and work with the Architect to resolve them. 
 - Design maintainable, scalable solutions using appropriate design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean coding practices. 
 - Develop and review REST APIs following established standards for resource naming, HTTP methods, status codes, request validation, error handling, versioning, and pagination. 
 - Design, implement, and troubleshoot scheduled and background jobs, including job execution, scheduling, failure handling, and recovery. 
 - Collaborate with developers on technical implementation, code reviews, problem-solving, and features Delivery. 
 - Design and review database schemas, relationships, indexes, SQL queries, transactions, and database migration strategies. 
 - Understand cloud architecture, including API gateways, load balancers, networking, compute services, managed databases, security, and monitoring. 
 - Implement application security measures, including authentication, authorization, JWT validation, and secure service-to-service communication. 
 - Apply performance optimization techniques, including caching, rate limiting, database query optimization, and efficient resource utilization. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, test creation, and documentation while maintaining code quality and security. 
 - Troubleshoot complex applications, database, networking, performance, and production issues. 
 - Guide and mentor developers, establish coding standards, and ensure maintainable, reliable, secure, and scalable solutions. 
 - Coordinate technical dependencies, manage delivery risks, and collaborate with QA, DevOps, and other Teams. 

Required Skills

- Modern Java: Strong knowledge of Java 17+, collections, HashMap internals, generics, concurrency, multithreading, synchronization, JVM fundamentals, object-oriented programming, and SOLID principles. 
 - Data Structures and Algorithms: Understanding of fundamental data structures and algorithms, including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, hash maps, trees, sorting, and searching. Familiarity with time and space complexity (Big O notation), algorithmic efficiency, and selecting appropriate approaches to solve practical engineering problems. 
 - Spring Boot: Strong understanding of dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, REST APIs, exception handling, and Spring Security. 
 - REST API Standards: Understanding of REST principles, resource-oriented design, HTTP methods and status codes, request validation, consistent error responses, API versioning, pagination, filtering, and backward compatibility. 
 - Design Patterns and Clean Code: Practical knowledge of commonly used design patterns such as Factory, Strategy, Builder, Observer, and Singleton, with the ability to select appropriate patterns without unnecessary complexity. Strong understanding of SOLID principles, separation of concerns, and maintainable code design. 
 - Microservices: Experience designing and troubleshooting distributed applications, service communication, resilience, and data consistency. 
 - Cloud Architecture: Good understanding of cloud components, networking, API gateways, load balancing, security, deployment, and monitoring. Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Database Design: Ability to design relational database schemas, write and optimize SQL queries, understand indexing and transactions and manage schema changes. 
 - Networking and Security: Working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP, TLS, JWT, and secure API communication. 
 - Performance and Scalability: Understanding of caching strategies, cache invalidation, rate limiting, throttling, database optimization, and application performance tuning. 
 - Messaging Systems: Working knowledge of messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or similar technologies, including asynchronous communication and message processing. 
 - Job Scheduling: Working knowledge of Quartz Scheduler or similar scheduling frameworks, including cron expressions, job and trigger configuration, execution lifecycle, misfire handling, failure recovery, and preventing duplicate or overlapping job execution where required. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Practical experience with AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms. Ability to write effective prompts, provide relevant codebase context, use AI for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and test creation, and critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Technical Leadership and Architecture Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with the Solution/Technical Architect, understand and implement architectural decisions, discuss technical tradeoffs, raise design concerns, and provide feedback based on implementation experience. Ability to mentor developers and conduct effective code reviews

Good to Have

- Experience with database synchronization, data reconciliation, and maintaining data consistency across systems. 
 - Familiarity with database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase. 
 - Practical experience with caching technologies such as Redis or equivalent solutions

data.title: AWS DevOps Architect
data.description:
Job Type: Full-Time

Duration: Long Term

Work Preference: Onsite

Experience: 10+ Years

Work Location: Pune, Gondia, MH

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Architect to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices. 

The ideal candidate combines strong AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define enterprise AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures. 
 - Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments. 
 - Architect CI/CD pipelines for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure. 
 - Establish Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation. 
 - Design containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR. 
 - Define deployment strategies including Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback. 
 - Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments. 
 - Implement DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement. 
 - Design AWS networking patterns involving VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity. 
 - Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards. 
 - Implement observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Design IAM and security models following least-privilege and Zero Trust principles. 
 - Implement secrets and encryption management using AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS. 
 - Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity. 
 - Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators. 
 - Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS. 
 - Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging. 
 - Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams. 
 - Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership. 

Required Experience

- 10+ years of overall IT experience with 5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience. 
 - 3+ years in a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including: 
 - EC2, S3, IAM, VPC
 - Lambda
 - ECS/EKS
 - ECR
 - API Gateway
 - Route 53
 - ALB/NLB
 - CloudWatch and CloudTrail
 - Secrets Manager and KMS
 - EventBridge, SNS and SQS
 - Step Functions
 - Strong expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Experience with AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation. 
 - Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes/EKS. 
 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild. 
 - Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell. 
 - Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity. 
 - Experience implementing enterprise DevSecOps and security automation. 
 - Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion. Integration Modernization Experience - Preferred

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving: 

- Amazon API Gateway for API management and exposure. 
 - AWS Lambda for serverless processing and integration. 
 - Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS for event-driven integration. 
 - AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration. 
 - AWS Transfer Family for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration. 
 - AWS B2B Data Interchange for EDI transformation and processing. 
 - Amazon S3 for enterprise file and message storage. 
 - AWS Batch for large-scale batch processing. 
 - Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration. 
 - Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems. DevSecOps Responsibilities

The architect should establish automated controls for: 

- SAST/DAST and dependency scanning
 - Container image scanning
 - Infrastructure vulnerability scanning
 - Terraform/IaC security validation
 - Secrets detection
 - IAM and policy validation
 - Automated compliance checks
 - Artifact and container security
 - Audit logging and traceability

Role Expectations

The AWS DevOps Architect will own the end-to-end DevOps and cloud automation architecture, ensuring that AWS workloads can be provisioned, built, tested, secured, deployed, monitored, scaled, recovered, and operated through standardized and highly automated processes. 

This is an architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role, not simply a CI/CD administration position.

data.title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
data.description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. 

Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production. 

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s). 

We will count on you to: 

- Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
 - Identify and work to eliminate blockers
 - Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
 - e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
 - You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
 - You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
 - You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
 - You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
 - Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
 - Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
 - Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
 - Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
 - Plan product releases
 - You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
 - Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
 - Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
 - You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
 - You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
 - In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation

What you need to have: 

- Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline. 
 - 12+ years of total experience
 - Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
 - You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
 - A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
 - Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
 - Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
 - Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
 - You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices 
 - Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
 - Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent

What makes you stand out: 

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
 - Good troubleshooting and technical skills
 - Able to work independently

Why join our team: 

- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. 
 - We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
 - Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. 

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95, 000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh. com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one "anchor day" per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

Lead the design, build, automation, and support of Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms.

Experience designing and supporting large-scale production platforms in AWS, including Aurora, RDS, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3. 

Strong DevOps and automation experience using Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar technologies.

Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and platform modernization initiatives. 

AWS, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or related cloud certifications. 

Experience Driving Automation, Self-service Platforms, And AI-assisted Operational Capabilities.
