data.title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
data.description:
Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Engineer - Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity. 

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree. 

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1-4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation. 

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation. 

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications. 

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times. 

• Run demos, application trials and customer training. 

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running. 

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation. 

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team. 

Must Have

• Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation. 

• 1-4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering. 

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge. 

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills. 

• Willingness to travel to customer sites. 

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus. 

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus. 

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming. 

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment. 

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity. 

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership. 

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles. 

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics. 

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications. 

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. , headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. 

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna. co. in and recruitment1@luna. co. in with the subject "FAE - Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi). 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Job Description

What You Will Do

- Lead the development of next-generation routing and switching hardware platforms, taking complete ownership from concept and design through validation, production release, and product sustaining. 
 - Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) programs as a technical lead, coordinating cross-functional and geographically distributed teams to deliver high-performance, quality-driven, and cost-effective products. 
 - Define hardware design specifications, implement designs, and drive PCB development, including schematic reviews, layout validation, Gerber generation, and Bill of Materials (BoM) release. 
 - Lead high-speed board bring-up, system-level debugging, fault analysis, Design Verification Testing (DVT), and new component qualification using advanced laboratory test and measurement equipment. 
 - Drive hardware design and validation involving CPU and memory architectures, including DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, SPI, XGMII, XFI, and XAUI interfaces. 
 - Collaborate with PCB layout, signal integrity, power, mechanical, thermal, CPLD/FPGA, firmware/BIOS, software, testing, manufacturing, and sustaining teams to resolve complex system-level challenges. 
 - Design and verify CPLD/FPGA logic and support hardware integration, functionality, and platform validation. 
 - Review and approve schematics, BoMs, PCB placement and routing, laboratory results, compliance test reports, and product technical documentation. 
 - Own technical documentation, including product specifications, hardware design specifications, design review records, DVT plans, compliance test plans, diagnostic test plans, and hardware test reports (HTRs). 
 - Ensure compliance with EMI/EMC, safety, environmental, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA) requirements, as applicable. 
 - Work closely with external vendors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, resolve issues, and support product quality and cost objectives. 
 - Provide ongoing product sustaining support, identify design improvements, and stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and hardware engineering best practices. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Telecommunication, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized university; an M. E. /M. Tech. is preferred. 
 - Proven experience delivering complex, high-end hardware products from concept to volume production, with a strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle. 
 - Strong expertise in high-speed board design, hardware bring-up, debugging, system integration, and advanced laboratory testing and measurement techniques. 
 - In-depth knowledge of CPU and memory architectures, with hands-on experience in DDR4/DDR5, PCIe, SPI, XGMII, XFI, and XAUI interfaces. 
 - Comprehensive understanding of system-level design considerations, including software, PCB design, signal integrity, power conversion, thermal management, mechanical design, DFM, DFA, and cost optimization. 
 - Experience leading NPI programs and influencing design decisions to achieve performance, quality, reliability, and cost targets. 
 - Working knowledge of CPLD/FPGA design and verification, along with hardware integration and validation. 
 - Knowledge of EMI/EMC, safety, and environmental regulatory compliance requirements for telecommunications systems. 
 - Strong technical documentation, design review, problem-solving, and fault-analysis skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, external suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
 - Strong leadership, interpersonal communication, negotiation, and supplier-management skills. 
 - A proactive, self-motivated, and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to organize work, take ownership, and lead by example. 
 - Adaptability to changing business priorities, ambiguous challenges, and assignments beyond immediate areas of expertise, while following established processes, checklists, reporting structures, and company practices. 
 - Awareness of current industry trends, emerging technologies, innovations, and hardware engineering best practices.

Corporate Overview

Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online  marketplaces that match searchers and "research and compare" consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation's largest media networks. 

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven  matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.   They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results. 

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience. 

We believe in: 

- The direct measurability of digital media. 
 - Performance marketing. (We pioneered it. )
 - The advantages of technology. We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world's biggest channel. 

  

Quality Engineer - Backend Automation  

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
Experience: 4-7 Years |  

About the Role

We are seeking hands-on Quality Engineers to support the modernization of Quest, a high-volume event and workflow-processing platform. This role focuses on backend quality engineering, including API, event-driven, database, integration, performance, and migration testing to ensure reliability and correctness throughout the Quest v2 migration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute test strategies for backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and database interactions. 
 - Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate Kafka-based event processing, retries, ordering, duplicate handling, replay, and idempotency scenarios. 
 - Perform migration validation between Quest v1 and Quest v2, including reconciliation and data consistency checks. 
 - Develop SQL-based data validation, integration, regression, performance, and resilience tests. 
 - Investigate defects using logs, metrics, traces, databases, and event streams. 
 - Support production deployments, release validation, and incident investigations. Required Skills

- 4-7 years of Quality Engineering, SDET, or software testing experience. 
 - Strong Java programming and test automation skills. 
 - Hands-on experience with REST API testing, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Strong SQL and database validation experience (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, etc. ). 
 - Experience testing backend services, integrations, and distributed systems. 
 - Good understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, Git, and Linux/Unix environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Preferred Skills

- Experience with Kafka, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures. 
 - Knowledge of Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing.

data.title: Principal R&D Engineer (3DIC)
data.description:
You Are

You have 15+ years of experience and are already drawn to hard technical problems: algorithms, data structures, and software that has to be correct, fast, and maintainable. You may not yet have shipped a full EDA product, but you write solid C/C++, you debug with discipline, and you want to learn how production design tools actually get built. 

You are curious about how chips are designed and packaged - and you want to grow into that domain by working on real software, not only on theory. At Synopsys, you will contribute to package substrate design automation within 3DIC Compiler, helping enable advanced multi-die systems for AI, high-performance computing, and heterogeneous integration. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Implement and extend package substrate design automation capabilities within the 3DIC Compiler platform. 
 - Write production C/C++ code for features such as HDI substrate auto-routing, design rule checking, power delivery network analysis, and design for manufacturability. 
 - Build, test, and debug software that runs on large, real-world packaging designs, including multi-die chiplets and heterogeneous integration. 
 - Work with senior engineers, product teams, and customers to understand design bottlenecks and turn them into well-scoped software changes. 
 - Participate in design and code reviews; learn how architecture decisions are made across the 3DIC product. 
 - Grow your skills in algorithms, performance, and software quality under the mentorship of experienced R&D engineers. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Contribute features that help customers design next-generation advanced packaging for AI, high-performance computing, and other complex systems. 
 - Help reduce design cycle time for teams working on HDI substrates, chiplets, and multi-die architectures. 
 - Own well-defined pieces of auto-routing, power delivery, checking, and manufacturability software - and see them used by leading semiconductor companies. 
 - Build a foundation in a strategic Synopsys product line at the center of the industry shift toward chiplet-based systems. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of relevant software or R&D experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ skills and a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity. 
 - Ability to write, debug, and test production-quality code; coursework, internships, or projects that show this clearly. 
 - Interest in physical design, EDA, semiconductors, or advanced packaging - prior domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. 
 - Coursework or project experience in at least one related area is helpful: graph algorithms, computational geometry, CAD/EDA tools, VLSI/physical design, or large-scale C++ software. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to learn from design reviews and feedback. 

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the advanced packaging design automation team for 3DIC Compiler. The team focuses on package substrate design and the industry shift toward chiplet architectures and heterogeneous integration. You will be mentored by senior and distinguished engineers, contribute to a strategic Synopsys growth area, and see a clear path to greater ownership as you grow.

Job Description

Senior Application Development Lead

SCM Technical & Integration

Location Pune, India Employment Type Full-Time

Role Summary

We are seeking a senior-level Application Development Lead to join our Supply Chain Management (SCM) technology team in India. This role combines hands-on development, solution design, application support, integration delivery, and people leadership. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a team of three developers while remaining actively involved in the design, development, review, deployment, and support of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), APIs, and related SCM solutions. 

The ideal candidate has strong experience across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C), along with advanced Oracle PL/SQL, Oracle APIs, OIC integrations, REST/SOAP services, reporting, DevOps, and production support capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

 - Prepare and review technical solution documents, design specifications, interface mappings, deployment plans, test evidence, support documentation, and operational runbooks. 
 - Design, develop, and customize Oracle EBS concurrent programs using PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and Oracle APIs. 
 - Build and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, including orchestrations, scheduled integrations, file-based interfaces, error handling, monitoring, and reprocessing.

 - Advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, performance tuning, and debugging. 
 - Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including adapters, connections, mappings, orchestrations, schedules, fault handling, monitoring, and integration troubleshooting. 
 - Strong API-development experience using REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, error handling, versioning, and API documentation. 
 - Experience with Oracle APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, SQL*Loader, and data migration/conversion techniques. 
 - Experience with Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, and Discoverer or equivalent reporting technologies. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release-management processes. 
 - Ability to develop high-quality technical designs and conduct structured code and design reviews. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining process flows, system integration diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and technical architecture visuals using Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or comparable diagramming tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, production-support, and root-cause-analysis skills. 

Leadership & Professional Skills

- Prior experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a small technical team. 
 - Ability to balance team leadership responsibilities with hands-on technical delivery. 
 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage priorities, deadlines, risks, and dependencies. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience collaborating across global, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Ability to work effectively within Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid delivery models. 
 - Commitment to documentation, knowledge transfer, operational stability, and continuous improvement. 

Tools & Technologies

Category Technologies

Core Applications Oracle E-Business Suite, SCM, P2P, O2C

Development Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, SQL Developer, Oracle APIs, SQL*Loader

Integration & APIs Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, authentication and API documentation tools

Reporting Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, Discoverer

DevOps & Deployment CI/CD pipelines, source control, WinSCP, SBM, Dimensions CM or comparable tools

Monitoring & Analytics Power BI, DAX, Snowflake, Grafana, Splunk, AppDynamics or similar tools

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle EBS, API, cloud, or DevOps certifications are preferred. 
 - Experience working in an IT consulting, shared-services, or global enterprise delivery organization. 
 - Experience supporting supply chain integrations with third-party platforms, suppliers, logistics providers, or enterprise applications.

Success Measures

- Consistent, high-quality delivery by the lead and the three-person development team.

 - Improved code quality, review discipline, deployment readiness, and production stability.

In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Job Description

Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day -from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving?

As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you'll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You'll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. 

If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day.

Technical Implementation

- Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design).

 - Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. 
 - Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. 

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. 
 - Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. 
 - Provide reliable estimates for owned work. 
 - Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. 
 - Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. 

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

 - Participate in meaningful code reviews. 
 - Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. 
 - Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. 

Incident & Operational Support

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects and production issues. 
 - Contribute to root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
 - Ensure adequate logging and observability in implemented components. 

Collaboration & Mentorship

- Collaborate closely with Tech Leads, Architects, Product Owners, QA, and Platform teams. 
 - Support and mentor junior and mid-level developers. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement within the team. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field. 
 - 5+ years professional experience in software development. 
 - Experience with programming languages like C#, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or others relevant to Azure development. 
 - Experience using Microsoft . NET, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks. 
 - Experience working with web services / APIs (e. g. , REST). 
 - Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, particularly those offered on Azure. 
 - Proficiency in using various Azure services like Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, etc. 
 - Understanding and knowledge of cloud security best practices. 
 - Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. 
 - Familiarity with source code version control, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines and other DevSecOps practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile development practices. 
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. 
 - Fluency in English (spoken and written). 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
 - Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. 

Assets

- Experience using AI assisted coding tools (e. g. GitHub Copilot) responsibly, with full accountability for code quality, security, and compliance. 
 - Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. 
 - Hands‐on experience designing and operating event‐driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. 
 - Experience with React, Next. js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. 
 - Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Azure Developer Associate, Azure Cosmos DB Developer Specialty). 

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. data.title: Electrical Technical Lead Engineer
data.description:
The group you'll be a part of

WETS Deposition group at Lam India Global Hardware Technology (LIGHT) is hiring a Electrical Lead Engineer for its product development engineering and product ownership team. 

Job Summary

As an Electrical Lead Engineer, owns and lead controls, instrumentation and electrical subsystem design for WETS modules. Act as a technical owner for medium - complex electrical subsystems across product lifecycle with reliability and cost goals. Drives safety, diagnostics, reliability, and performance of systems

Job Responsibilities

- Own and influence PDR process deliverables, technical deliverables, obtain design review approvals and achieve project milestones
 - Validates design using prototype or simulation and design verification testing (including test stand development). Safety policy & procedure adherence is mandatory
 - Define cut-in strategy for sub-system changes in collaboration with NPI engineers. 
 - Proficient in concept design and development of medium-high complex electrical/electronic circuits. 
 - Uses various Engineering/Quality/Analysis tools/processes to arrive at design decisions. 
 - Ability to perform critical review & approval of medium - high complex designs/circuits. 
 - Performs Problem Solving & Decision Making to enhance engineering processes. Perform 8D (Why-Why, etc. )
 - Ability to finalize/influence detailed design requirements of complex circuit / sub-systems with CFT (ME, safety, system engineering, thermal, etc). 
 - Hands‐on involvement in module electrical bring‐up, IO validation, and root‐cause debugging during integration and testing. 
 - Work closely with firmware and software teams to define signal interfaces, IO behaviour, and control assumptions

Who We're Looking For

- Education: B. E. / B. Tech / M. E. / M. Tech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering
 - Experience: Bachelors in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with 5-8 years or Masters in Electrical Engineering between 3-5 years

Core Competencies

- Proficient in system level understanding of Electro-Mechanical Sub-systems (Semi-conductor/Automotive/Aerospace), Power Distribution/Control systems and/or Industrial Automation. 
 - Strong competency in communication protocols - RS485, EtherCAT and Ethernet TCP/IP. 
 - Strong experience in mixed circuit design(analog+digital) with strong experience in circuit analysis & simulation, with good hands-on experience in lab testing & validation
 - Good experience in motion control systems - handling drives like Yaskawa/Beckhoff
 - Define and design instrumentation architecture - Temperature, pressure, flow, proximity, position and safety sensors and expert level skill in sensor interfacing and actuators

Desirable Competencies

- Experience in Semiconductor Wafer Fab Equipment (WFE) domain. 
 - Experience in capital equipment or similar (for e. g. , Semiconductor, Process industries, medical instrumentation, Automotive, Aerospace, etc. ) industry in a sub-system / module design project. 
 - Good to have worked on control & simulation tools preferably MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent. 
 - Good to have PCBA design skills with CID certification
 - Basic understanding of pneumatic and hydraulic control systems is added advantage

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. 

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. 

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. 'Virtual Flex' you'll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

data.title: AI Product Engineer
data.description:
Role Summary

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others. 

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving. 

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance

- Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar. 
 - Detect drift early: identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead. 
 - Track portfolio health through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders. 

Technical Assurance

- Assess solution architecture and engineering practice for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability. 
 - Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence. 
 - Review operational risk: hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live. 

Best-Practice Translation & Enablement

- Identify what works in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions. 
 - Spread learning across teams by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery. 
 - Help teams solve operational problems as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio. 

Stakeholder & Team Leadership

- Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads to align roadmap, technical feasibility and delivery priorities, and to surface cross-solution dependencies and shared-platform needs. 
 - Guide and mentor the solution delivery leads and architects across the portfolio; set expectations on delivery discipline and engineering quality, and give feedback on their performance. 
 - Escalate clearly: raise risks and decisions with options and recommendations to program governance and senior leadership. 

Qualifications

Must have

- BE/B. Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MBA / PG is a plus. 
 - 12+ years in IT services, product engineering or platform delivery, with a progression through developer, architect and delivery roles; has led or overseen more than one solution or team at a time. 
 - Strong technical grounding, enough to challenge architecture, code quality and engineering practice credibly: APIs and microservices, data pipelines, CI/CD, containers, observability and security. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler's cloud and AI services and how they integrate with enterprise systems. 
 - Working knowledge of GenAI / Agentic AI solutions in production: LLM integration, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, LLMOps. 
 - Experience running review and governance mechanisms (design reviews, stage gates, release-readiness checks) across several concurrent programs. 
 - Proven ability to codify and transfer best practices across teams, such as playbooks, standards and reference architectures. 

Good to have

- Experience in a product-company or product-engineering environment, working with product managers on roadmaps and releases. 
 - Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, model-evaluation tooling and agent interoperability standards (e. g. MCP). 
 - Hyperscaler AI certification(s) and/or PMP / Scrum / SAFe certification. 
 - Exposure to responsible-AI, data privacy and compliance requirements for enterprise AI. 

Expected Impact

- Solutions across the IAIS portfolio are built as per roadmap, with early detection of drift and fewer late surprises. 
 - Consistent engineering quality and release readiness across solutions, rather than strong in some and weak in others. 
 - Best practices and lessons learned travel quickly between solutions, reducing rework and raising team capability. 
 - Delivery teams resolve operational and technical problems faster because proven fixes and experts are readily available. 
 - Stakeholders have a single, credible, KPI-driven view of portfolio delivery health. 

Skills

Solution Portfolio Review, Roadmap Conformance Tracking, Technical Assurance, GenAI / Agentic AI Architecture Understanding, Hyperscaler / Cloud Integration, Best-Practice Codification, Delivery Governance, Technical Problem Solving, Coaching & Mentoring, Product-Engineering Partnership, Risk/Issue Management, KPI & Metrics Reporting, Stakeholder Management

data.title: PCBA Test Fixture Engineer
data.description:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components. 

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd. ) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence. Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. 

The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust. '

Role Overview

You will oversee end-to-end engineering of PCBA-based testing and automation systems - including ICT (In-Circuit Test), FVT (Functional Validation Test) fixtures, robotic integration, and automated equipment design - within high-volume manufacturing. Your expertise will span hardware design, automation systems, process engineering, and equipment deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Fixture & PCBA Design

- Design ICT/FVT test fixtures, including PCBA-based interface boards, load boards, and DUT connectors. 
 - Develop high-precision fixture layouts for electrical testing, pogo-pin sockets, and contact validation. 
 - Ensure SI/PI integrity for high-speed signals (e. g. digital I/O, RF, power rails), using controlled impedance designs and board stack-up practices. 
 - Support PCB schematic capture, layout review, and DFM/DFA compliance. 

Validation & Debug

- Drive hardware bring-up, fault diagnosis, and test debug during NPI/test-floor integration. 
 - Interface with failure analysis, yield engineering, and validation teams to optimize fixture performance and uptime. 
 - Handle process documentation, SOPs, validation metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Collaboration & Leadership

- Partner with cross-functional teams: process engineering, product/test engineering, SMT/assembly, and quality. 
 - Lead design reviews, project timelines, and handoffs for ICT/FVT and automation milestones. 
 - Mentor junior engineers, oversee vendor qualification for probe/fixture suppliers and robotic integrators. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering. 
 - 5-10+ years in PCBA test fixture design, automation tooling, robotic system deployment, or equipment engineering in electronics manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience with ICT, FVT, flying-probe, functional testers, or test handler systems. 
 - Strong background in PLC programming (Siemens, Allen‐Bradley, Omron), HMI design, and robot motion/control integration. 
 - Practical skills in SI/PI simulation and PCB layout tools (Cadence Allegro/SiWave, Mentor Xpedition, PADS). 
 - Solid understanding of DFM/DFA, SMT/ICT/FVT process environments, statistical process control, and quality systems (Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA). 
 - Hands-on debugging, validation, and automation deployment experience in manufacturing test floors. 
 - 6+ years of hands‐on experience with LabVIEW development and NI hardware platforms (e. g. cRIO, PXI, DAQms)

Preferred & Soft Skills

- Expertise in designing fixtures and robotic test integrators for high-speed PCBA testing. 
 - Experience with IIoT data analytics, predictive maintenance, and digital twin simulation workflows. 
 - Effective communicator with strong documentation and cross-functional leadership. 
 - Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing and automated test environments.

 - Ingestion Pipelines: Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms. 
 - Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management
 - Engineering Standards & Roadmaps: Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads. 
 - Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints. 
 - Delivery & Global Team Management: Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput. 
 - Validation & Iterative Review: Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs. 
 - Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
 - Innovating
 - Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization. 
 - Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions. 
 - Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices
 - Performance Monitoring and Improvement: 
 - Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions. 
 - Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency. 
 - Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements. 
 - Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization. 
 - Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments. 
 - Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
 - Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
 - Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
 - Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
 - Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
 - Delivering on the AGILE KPI's and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes
What We're Looking For. . . 

You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

Non-Functional Testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

Incident & Operational Support

Collaboration & Growth

 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)

Why Husky?

data.title: Senior Salesforce Tester
data.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company's patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www. azurity. com. 

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization. 

About The Role

Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self-driven, hands-on team member who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 

The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives. 

The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Strategy

- Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications. 
 - Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies. 
 - Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities. 

Functional & Regression Testing

- Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities. 
 - Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance-related business processes. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations. 
 - Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes. 
 - Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments. 

Integration & Data Testing

- Test integrations with third-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions. 
 - Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman. 
 - Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes. 
 - Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems. 
 - Support testing of end-to-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications. 

Compliance & Security Testing

- Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions. 
 - Perform role-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification. 
 - Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements. 
 - Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems. 

Performance & Automation Testing

- Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites. 
 - Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads. 
 - Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance. 
 - Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities. 

Defect Tracking & Collaboration

- Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X-Ray, or similar test management tools. 
 - Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities. 

Continuous Improvement & Best Practices

- Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices. 
 - Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes. 
 - Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 7+ years of experience in Salesforce testing, preferably within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries. 
 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud. 
 - Strong knowledge of manual and automated testing frameworks for Salesforce applications. 
 - Experience testing Salesforce integrations with pharmaceutical platforms such as IQVIA, Veeva, SAP, Sales Enablement tools, Snowflake, and MDM solutions. 
 - Proficiency in Salesforce Administration, Flows, Apex test classes, and Lightning Web Component (LWC) testing. 
 - Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP), Postman, and Data Cloud validation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release management practices. 
 - Understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements. 
 - Experience using JIRA, X-Ray, or similar test management and defect-tracking tools. 
 - Basic Python knowledge to support test automation and data validation activities. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a global offshore-onshore delivery model. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release pipelines. 
 - Experience validating Snowflake, MDM, SAP, Veeva, IQVIA, MedPro, or other pharmaceutical data integrations. 
 - Basic Python skills for test utilities, data validation, or automation support. 
 - Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery, risk-based testing, and software quality practices in a regulated environment. 
 - Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial operations and HCP/HCO engagement processes. 
 - Experience with Data Cloud, AI-enabled Salesforce capabilities, and advanced automation frameworks. 

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

data.title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently. 

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally. 

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.

Skill: Senior Architect- AI

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results. 

At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models. 

Responsibilities

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership

- Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams. 
 - Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes. 
 - Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns. 
 - Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end-to-end architecture. 
 - Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse. 
 - Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain-modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability-so solutions remain robust and maintainable. 
 - Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale. 

Delivery and Consulting Excellence

- Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies. 
 - Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact. 
 - Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives. 
 - Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client's best interest. 
 - Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity. 
 - Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery. 
 - Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones. 
 - Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback. 
 - Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language. 
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required. 
 - Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting. 

Mentorship and Team Development

- Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams. 
 - Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified. 
 - Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects. 
 - Growth and Innovation
 - Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them. 
 - Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value. 
 - Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions. 
 - Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction. 
 - Build and evolve reusable assets-such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates-that become standard paths for delivery teams. 
 - Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way. 
 - Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. 

Requirements

- 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain. 
 - 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts. 
 - Deep expertise across most of the following: 
 - Agents & Orchestration - leveraging Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar frameworks to design intelligent workflows; applying tool/function calling, planner and agent-based patterns, and workflow automation engines. 
 - Search & Retrieval - implementing solutions with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, or Milvus; applying hybrid search methods, re-ranking strategies, and selecting embedding models for accuracy and performance. 
 - Evaluation, Quality & LLM Operations - establishing offline and online evaluation approaches; using golden datasets, hallucination and groundedness validation, toxicity and safety testing; building telemetry and feedback loops; managing monitoring, deployment pipelines, and ongoing optimization of large language models. 
 - Responsible AI, Security & Privacy - incorporating practices such as threat modeling, privacy reviews, data minimization, safety guardrails, policy enforcement, auditability, and model risk management in line with GDPR and organizational standards. 
 - AI Platforms & Data Foundations - applying hands-on experience with Azure AI services, Databricks, Azure OpenAI, and related modern data platforms. 
 - Cloud Engineering - designing with APIs, containers, microservices, and DevOps pipelines to deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions. 
 - Data Integration & Governance - developing and managing data pipelines; applying quality controls, metadata practices, and master data management approaches. 
 - Analytics & Visualization - delivering insights with Power BI and other visualization tools. 
 - Proficiency with modern development tools (e. g. , GitHub, Copilot, Cursor). 
 - Knowledge of analytics and data science tools, frameworks, and advanced techniques. 
 - Relevant Azure or Databricks certifications in AI, Data, or Architecture. 
 - Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs. 
 - Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and solid delivery practices. 
 - Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones. 
 - Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale. 
 - Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services. 
 - Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and dependency handling. 
 - Experience in consulting or professional services. 
 - Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data, security, networking, and integration. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication. 
 - Demonstrated interest in learning new cloud technologies and turning that learning into practical improvements for teams. 
 - Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex cloud solutions across teams.

Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. 

Job Title

Advisor, Solutions Architecture

About Your Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Architect to join our dynamic team at Fiserv. As a Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing and implementing scalable, secure, and innovative payment processing solutions for our clients. Your expertise will contribute to the success of our organization by providing technical guidance, overseeing the development of robust payment systems, and ensuring seamless integration with client applications. 

What You'll Do

- Solution Design: Collaborate with clients, business stakeholders, and development teams to define and design end-to-end payment processing solutions that meet business requirements, industry standards, and security regulations. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership and expertise throughout the entire project lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, development, testing, implementation, and support. Drive architectural decisions and ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and secure. 
 - System Integration: Evaluate existing systems and develop integration strategies to ensure seamless communication and data exchange between payment processing systems and client applications, such as e-commerce platforms, mobile apps, and point-of-sale (POS) systems. 
 - API Development: Design and document APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) to facilitate secure and efficient communication between various payment systems and client applications. Collaborate with development teams to ensure proper implementation and adherence to industry standards. 
 - Security and Compliance: Ensure that payment processing solutions adhere to industry security standards (such as PCI DSS) and comply with relevant regulations. Identify potential security risks, recommend, and implement appropriate controls and safeguards. 
 - Technical Consultation: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing technical guidance, best practices, and recommendations related to payment processing technologies, trends, and emerging industry standards. 
 - Documentation and Training: Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, design specifications, user guides, and training materials. Conduct training sessions for internal teams and clients as necessary. 
 - Collaboration and Teamwork: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, quality assurance engineers, and operations teams, to ensure successful delivery of payment processing solutions. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members. 

Experience You'll Need To Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - Proven experience as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, or similar role in the payment industry or related domains. 
 - Deep understanding of payment processing technologies, including payment gateways, card networks, tokenization, encryption, fraud prevention, and risk management. 
 - Strong knowledge of payment industry standards, such as PCI DSS, EMV, ISO 8583, and other relevant regulations. 
 - Proficiency in API design and integration using RESTful APIs and messaging protocols (e. g. , SOAP, JSON, XML). 
 - Experience with cloud-based solutions, microservices architecture, and containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Familiarity with software development methodologies (e. g. , Agile, Scrum) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, automation, infrastructure as code). 
 - Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess complex business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 
 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

- Knowledge of emerging payment technologies, such as mobile payments, digital wallets, and blockchain-based solutions

Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please

- Apply using your legal name
 - Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 

Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. 

Warning About Fake Job Posts

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
