data.description:
Job Title

Controls Project Engineer I

Job Description

Controls Project Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, and delivering advanced automation solutions for material handling environments, this could be the ideal opportunity for you. 

Your Role

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, integration, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems. You will work with Siemens PLC technologies, SCADA, HMI, drives, and safety systems to deliver reliable and high-quality control solutions. 

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary and international project teams, support customer-facing activities, provide technical guidance to junior engineers, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of Vanderlande's controls solutions. 

What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities

Controls Software Development & Engineering

- Design, develop, and test LLC software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems using Siemens TIA Portal. 
 - Develop functional PLC software based on customer requirements, project specifications, and standard controls architecture. 
 - Program and configure Siemens PLC systems using Ladder Logic, FBD, STL, and SCL. 
 - Configure and integrate PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, and safety systems. 
 - Apply reusable software modules, library structures, and standardized controls solutions. 
 - Develop and maintain technical documentation including functional specifications, interface documents, and engineering deliverables. 

Testing, Integration & Commissioning

- Perform engineering, simulation, emulation, FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities. 
 - Troubleshoot software, communication, PLC, HMI, and controls-related issues during testing and commissioning. 
 - Perform system integration activities with SCADA, Equipment Management, Mechanical, Electrical, and Safety disciplines. 
 - Use Siemens diagnostic tools such as Proneta and online diagnostics for troubleshooting and system validation. 
 - Support backup, version management, and software configuration activities. 
 - Prepare test plans, commissioning documentation, and reports to support successful project delivery. 
 - Support successful project handover and completion of Service Take Over (STO) deliverables. 

Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

- Identify project risks, technical issues, and dependencies and recommend appropriate mitigation actions. 
 - Support customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions when required. 
 - Mentor junior Controls Engineers and provide technical guidance during engineering, testing, and commissioning activities. 
 - Ensure compliance with engineering standards, development processes, and quality guidelines. 
 - Contribute to software standardization and continuous improvement of products, tools, and engineering processes. 
 - Report technical progress, deviations, risks, and issues to the Project Lead Engineer and Group Leader. 
 - Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams across global locations. 

What You Bring

- 7+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation and PLC-based control systems. 
 - Proven experience in engineering, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automated material handling or industrial automation systems. 
 - Experience working on international projects and site commissioning activities is preferred. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal for PLC development, troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning. 
 - Good understanding of SCADA systems and system integration. 
 - Experience with HMI development, screen configuration, alarms, diagnostics, and operator interfaces. 
 - Strong knowledge of
 - Ladder Logic
 - Function Block Diagram (FBD)
 - Statement List (STL)
 - Structured Control Language (SCL)
 - Hands-on experience with
 - PROFINET
 - PROFIBUS
 - AS-i
 - Familiarity with Siemens engineering and diagnostic tools including Proneta, online diagnostics, backup, and version management. 
 - Working knowledge of Siemens PLC concepts including data blocks, indirect addressing, reusable software modules, and library structures. 
 - Basic to intermediate experience with Safety PLC programming, testing, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience with Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View is an added advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Good communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams. 
 - Willingness to travel internationally for commissioning and customer support, approximately 50-70%. 
About Vanderlande

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey-from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors. 

At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other. 

Website www. vanderlande. com

What We Offer

Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice

- Competitive Salary Package
 - 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
 - 22 paid leave days
 - 8 sick/casual leave days
 - Applicable government holidays
 - Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance
 - Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs
 - Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
 - Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
 - Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering teams and international customers
 - Exposure to advanced automation and material handling technologies
How We Work

We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. 

In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say. 

Ready to apply?

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume. 

Diversity & Inclusion

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

data.title: Senior Staff - IT Quality Assurance
data.description:
Overview

Connecting clients to markets - and talent to opportunity. 

With 5, 400+ employees and over 80, 000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets - focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors. 

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth. 

Corporate Functions Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies. 

Responsibilities

Position Purpose : 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our NeXus Core backend team. You will own and improve automated testing for distributed services supporting accounts, balances, trades and positions. Working closely with engineers, product and DevOps, you will build reliable component, integration, end-to-end and performance coverage, identify quality risks early, and help the team deliver correct, resilient services. This is a coding-focused role with technical ownership, code review and mentoring responsibilities. 

Primary Responsibilities Include

- Own the backend test strategy, prioritising by business risk and choosing appropriate component, integration and end-to-end coverage. 
 - Extend shared TypeScript automation frameworks and reusable helpers; build maintainable suites, deterministic test data and isolated component environments. 
 - Validate gRPC contracts and behaviour, including authentication, authorisation, errors, deadlines, streaming and backward compatibility. 
 - Test Kafka-driven ingestion and processing, including eventual consistency, duplicate or out-of-order events, retries, recovery and reconciliation with database state. 
 - Develop and maintain k6 performance suites; investigate latency, throughput, error rates and resource behaviour using Datadog. 
 - Integrate functional and performance tests into Azure DevOps pipelines; diagnose failures, improve feedback and reduce flaky tests. 
 - Maintain TestRail traceability and automated reporting; communicate meaningful coverage gaps, defects and release risks. 
 - Work with engineers and product on acceptance criteria and testability; drive defect investigation through resolution. 
 - Review automation pull requests, mentor QA engineers and lead practical improvements to shared tooling and testing practices. 

Qualifications

To Land this role

- 5+ years of QA automation experience, with a strong backend/API focus and demonstrated independent ownership of automation frameworks or substantial test suites. 
 - Strong hands-on TypeScript / JavaScript skills: writing reusable test code, reviewing changes and debugging asynchronous behaviour. Experience with Mocha / Chai or comparable frameworks. 
 - Practical experience testing gRPC / Protocol Buffers, including client setup, metadata, status codes and service contracts; a solid understanding of REST API testing. 
 - Experience designing component and integration tests using controlled fixtures, mocks or service simulation, alongside end-to-end coverage. 
 - Experience testing Kafka or comparable event-driven systems, with an understanding of asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency. 
 - Strong SQL skills for validating persisted data and investigating discrepancies; experience with PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database. 
 - Hands-on performance testing experience using k6 or a comparable tool, including workload design, interpreting results and investigating regressions. 
 - Experience running tests in Docker-based environments and integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines; confident use of Git and pull-request workflows. 
 - Ability to diagnose failures across tests, service logs, APIs, messaging and databases, distinguishing product defects from environment or test issues. 
 - Clear communication of quality risks and release confidence, effective collaboration across teams, and experience reviewing test code or mentoring other QA engineers. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with our specific tooling: Azure DevOps, Docker Compose, WireMock, TestRail, Allure and Datadog. 
 - Familiarity with Java / Spring Boot code, Kubernetes deployments, health/readiness checks and service recovery scenarios. 
 - Experience validating schema evolution, API compatibility and authentication/authorisation across distributed services. 
 - Domain knowledge in financial services, trading systems or regulated environments, particularly account, balance, trade or position data. 

Working Environment

4 days from office

data.description:

More than 23, 000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. 

Job Description

As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has more than 27, 000 employees across 35 countries. Approximately 20, 000 financial services and healthcare organizations-from some of the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms-rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology. 

Why You Will Love It Here!

- Flexibility: Remote/Hybrid Work Model and Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans 
 - Your Future: Provident Fund 
 - Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, and Paid Holidays 
 - Your Wellbeing: Mediclaim, Term Life Insurance, Accidental Coverage, Employee Assistance Program, and Parental Leave 
 - Diversity & Inclusion: A workplace committed to welcoming, celebrating, and thriving on diversity 
 - Training: Hands-on, team-customized learning opportunities, including SS&C University 
 - Extra Perks: Diwali voucher and monthly remunerated Rewards and Recognition program

The Role: 

We are looking for a deeply technical, hands-on Blue Prism specialist who can work across automation development, production operations, solution architecture, platform engineering, and technical problem-solving. 

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a delivery-management, project-management, or people-management position. The successful candidate will be expected to personally design, build, troubleshoot, deploy, support, and improve enterprise-grade Blue Prism solutions. 

This role is suited to engineers who enjoy working directly with technology, solving complex production issues, understanding systems end to end, and expanding their skills across multiple technologies as the automation landscape evolves. 

What You Will Get To Do: 

- Design, build, test, deploy, and support complex enterprise automation solutions using Blue Prism 
 - Own automation solutions across their complete lifecycle, including discovery, feasibility assessment, design, development, release, production support, optimization, and retirement 
 - Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable Blue Prism processes and business objects 
 - Work extensively with Process Studio, Object Studio, Control Room, Work Queues, Schedules, Credentials, Environment Variables, Releases, and Runtime Resources 
 - Design robust exception-handling, recovery, retry, logging, alerting, and operational-support frameworks 
 - Troubleshoot complex automation failures across Blue Prism, applications, databases, APIs, virtual machines, credentials, and infrastructure components 
 - Perform root-cause analysis for recurring production issues and implement permanent technical fixes 
 - Monitor live automations, analyse operational performance, and improve stability, resilience, recoverability, and throughput 
 - Design automation architecture for new and existing processes, including component design, integration patterns, deployment models, and support models 
 - Review and refactor poorly designed, unstable, or difficult-to-maintain automation solutions 
 - Integrate Blue Prism with web applications, Windows applications, Java applications, mainframe systems, Citrix environments, APIs, databases, file systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook, and enterprise platforms 
 - Build and consume REST and SOAP services and work with XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, tokens, and secure credentials 
 - Work closely with infrastructure, architecture, information security, database, application-support, and business teams to resolve technical dependencies 
 - Support Blue Prism environment upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, patching, capacity planning, and platform improvements 
 - Participate in technical design reviews and challenge solutions that are not scalable, secure, supportable, or operationally resilient 
 - Create clear technical documentation, including solution designs, operational runbooks, deployment instructions, support procedures, and troubleshooting guides 
 - Conduct technical code reviews and enforce Blue Prism engineering standards and reusable design patterns 
 - Support release, change, incident, and problem-management activities for production automations 
 - Contribute to automation engineering standards, platform governance, reusable frameworks, and Centre of Excellence practices 
 - Evaluate and learn additional technologies that complement Blue Prism and improve automation capability 
 - Work hands-on with adjacent technologies such as APIs, SQL, scripting, cloud services, monitoring, and platform tooling 
 - Take full technical ownership of assigned solutions without relying on separate development, support, or architecture teams to solve core engineering problems 
 - Continuously expand technical capability by learning and applying multiple technologies based on business and platform needs

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years of overall technology experience, with substantial hands-on experience developing enterprise automations using Blue Prism 
 - At least 5 years of recent, continuous, hands-on Blue Prism development experience 
 - Strong practical expertise in Blue Prism Process Studio and Object Studio 
 - Deep understanding of Blue Prism application modelling, spying techniques, dynamic attributes, wait stages, collections, work queues, environment variables, credentials, schedules, sessions, and runtime resources 
 - Demonstrated experience building complex Blue Prism solutions rather than only maintaining, monitoring, or coordinating automation projects 
 - Strong experience supporting Blue Prism automations in production environments 
 - Proven ability to diagnose failures involving Blue Prism, target applications, virtual machines, databases, APIs, access permissions, credentials, certificates, and infrastructure 
 - Strong understanding of exception handling, retry design, recovery stages, logging, auditability, transaction management, and operational resilience 
 - Experience designing reusable Blue Prism components, frameworks, templates, and utility objects 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise automation architecture and the technical dependencies required to run Blue Prism at scale 
 - Experience integrating Blue Prism with REST APIs, SOAP services, XML, JSON, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications 
 - Good working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write queries, analyse data, troubleshoot database-related issues, and support integrations 
 - Experience with at least one programming or scripting technology such as C#, . NET, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or VBA 
 - Ability to read and troubleshoot code, scripts, API payloads, logs, configuration files, and database queries 
 - Experience automating browser-based, desktop, Java, Citrix, virtual desktop, and legacy applications 
 - Understanding of Blue Prism infrastructure, including application servers, interactive clients, runtime resources, databases, virtual machines, connectivity, and environment configuration 
 - Experience with production monitoring, incident management, problem management, change management, and release management 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release controls, security controls, and enterprise development standards 
 - Ability to independently convert business requirements into technically sound automation designs 
 - Ability to assess automation feasibility, identify technical risks, estimate complexity, and recommend practical solutions 
 - Strong debugging, analytical, and root-cause-analysis skills 
 - High level of ownership and willingness to remain hands-on throughout the solution lifecycle 
 - Willingness and ability to learn multiple technologies beyond Blue Prism 
 - Ability to adapt to new tools, platforms, programming languages, integration methods, and automation technologies based on business needs 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining technical issues and design decisions 
 - Ability to work effectively with globally distributed technical and business teams

This Role May Not Be Suitable for You If: 

- Your recent experience has primarily been in project management, delivery management, team management, or stakeholder coordination 
 - You have worked mainly as a Blue Prism Control Room operator or production-monitoring analyst 
 - You have limited recent hands-on experience building Blue Prism processes and business objects 
 - You prefer to hand off architecture, development, deployment, or production troubleshooting to separate teams 
 - You are looking only for a narrowly defined Blue Prism development role and are not interested in learning additional technologies 
 - You are not comfortable personally investigating and resolving complex technical and production issues 
 - Your experience is primarily with other RPA platforms and you have only limited exposure to Blue Prism

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Blue Prism Developer, Professional Developer, Technical Architect, or equivalent certification 
 - Experience working in large-scale, regulated enterprise environments 
 - Experience with Blue Prism platform upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery, infrastructure design, or environment administration 
 - Experience with Blue Prism Hub, Interact, Capture, or Process Intelligence 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services 
 - Exposure to CI/CD concepts, automated deployments, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices 
 - Experience working with financial services, healthcare, insurance, banking, or other regulated industries

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, enabling us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking, decisions, and conversations. 

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.

Job Opportunity: Automation Engineer

Location : PAN India Site

Company : SFC Environmental Technologies Limited

SFC is an environmental technology company providing advanced solutions in wastewater treatment, wastewater recycle & reuse, and solid waste treatment. Since 2005, we have been enabling municipalities and industries to build and operate plants that are simple, flexible, and cost effective throughout their lifecycle. 

We are the market leader in India in sequencing batch reactor (SBR) technology through our flagship C-Tech process, holding 80%+ share and delivering reliable treatment at scale. With technologies spanning C-Tech, Fiber Disc Filters, Submerged Ultrafiltration, MBR, MABR, and CCRO, we are helping drive the transition to reuse and circular water management. 

Our footprint covers India, Austria, Germany, and Czechia, supported by in-house R&D, manufacturing, and automation capabilities. Together with our subsidiary Hindustan Waste Treatment, we are also advancing integrated solid waste management solutions that generate renewable energy and reduce landfill impact. 

At SFC, we believe in People → Planet → Profit. Our culture is built on freedom, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning - empowering our teams to innovate and grow across roles, functions, and geographies. 

Role Definition: 

The Automation Engineer (PLC Programmer) will develop and implement PLC-SCADA-HMI programs, support onsite commissioning, troubleshoot automation issues, and ensure reliable plant operation across project sites in India. The role requires strong programming skills, coordination with cross-functional teams, and adherence to safety, quality, and project standards. 

Experience

- 2-5 years of relevant experience in industrial automation, PLC-SCADA programming, and plant commissioning. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Diploma / B. E. in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

- Develop PLC-SCADA-HMI programs as per control philosophy using platforms such as TIA Portal, Simatic Manager, Studio 5000, GX Works, WinCC, FTView, and Iconics, ensuring robust logic design, interlocks, and functional sequencing.

data.title: Search Software Engineer
data.description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a seasoned, hands-on . NET developer with strong systems design and architecture experience to join our search engineering team. This role will work on the backend services and search APIs powering our critical applications, and will be trained on our search platform technologies. 

This is a full-time position and reports directly to the VP, Data Architecture. 

Preferred Location

Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule. 

Essential Functions

Backend & API Engineering (. NET)

- Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable RESTful APIs using . NET Core (C#) to support both internal systems and client-facing applications
 - Architect and implement authentication, authorization, and entitlements/access control systems to protect API endpoints and user data
 - Contribute to system design discussions, producing scalable, fault-tolerant architectures for distributed systems and applying event-driven patterns where appropriate
 - Collaborate with data engineering teams to design and optimize data ingestion and enrichment pipelines that feed search indexes
 - Incorporate AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, etc. ) into daily workflows; review and validate AI-generated code before merging
 - Ensure code quality through unit, integration, and performance testing; participate in code reviews and uphold engineering standards

Search Platform Engineering

- Contribute to our scalable search infrastructure built on Apache Solr and/or OpenSearch, including schema design, indexing pipelines, and query parsing
 - Apply or develop knowledge of search relevance concepts: tokenization, stemming, custom analyzers, boosting rules, and query-time vs. index-time tuning
 - Support search cluster operations, replication, and high-availability in production environments
 - Help diagnose and resolve search performance issues, including slow queries, indexing bottlenecks, and relevance degradation

Cloud & Infrastructure

- Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Cognito, etc. )
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK) to support reliable, repeatable deployments

Education Requirement

Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience. 

Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills

- 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
 - Strong proficiency in . NET Core (C#), including asynchronous patterns and dependency-injection frameworks
 - Proven experience designing and developing secure, scalable RESTful APIs for internal and client-facing systems
 - Experience with authentication, entitlements, and access control systems
 - Solid experience with AWS services and strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps/CI/CD pipelines
 - Must have worked with AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot, Codex, etc. )

Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills

data.description:
Job Description

Change the world. Love your job. 

About Team

ASM Auto Group develops safety-compliant automotive MCUs for EV, HEV, traction inverters, onboard chargers, BMS, and body and chassis control. We are at a pivotal moment in automotive technology, and this role offers a chance to work on cutting-edge MCUs with real-world impact. If you want to solve complex technical challenges in fast-growing segments, we encourage you to apply. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced AVV technical leader with 5+ years of pre-silicon and post-silicon functional validation experience to own subsystem-level validation strategy for automotive MCUs. You will define functional validation methodology, lead complex root-cause investigations, drive functional bring-up on silicon, and make evidence-based silicon readiness recommendations. You will work as a technical peer with Architecture, Design, RTL Verification, and Firmware teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own functional validation strategy and sign-off for complex subsystems (e. g. , Ethernet MAC, functional safety, clock/reset/power, multicore interactions)
 - Define requirements-to-test traceability, functional coverage closure criteria, and sign-off readiness
 - Architect reusable validation frameworks spanning emulation platforms and silicon test environments
 - Lead first-silicon functional bring-up and silicon functional test execution
 - Lead complex root-cause analysis across firmware, RTL, emulation models, and silicon
 - Validate cross-peripheral interactions with DMA, interrupts, clock switching, and low-power transitions
 - Lead fault-injection campaigns and functional safety validation evidence (ISO 26262)
 - Define pre-silicon to post-silicon correlation and test reuse strategy
 - Architect and maintain automation and CI/CD-integrated regression infrastructure
 - Define and own performance and benchmarking strategy, including throughput, latency, and timing-margin target. 
 - Lead resolution of customer-reported issues through reproduction and root-cause analysis
 - Define fix or workaround recommendations for customers and drive them to closure
 - Lead validation reviews and provide sign-off recommendations
 - Mentor engineers and drive continuous improvement in methodology and tooling

Qualifications

Minimum requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, ECE, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 5+ years of engineering experience working with silicon design and/or validation
 - Experience with digital/embedded design on emulation/FPGA platforms/RTL simulation

Preferred Qualifications

- Work experience with ARM architecture
 - Advanced embedded C and firmware architecture knowledge
 - MCU/SoC architecture understanding (multicore, coherency, boot, power domains)
 - Expert-level peripheral validation, including complex interactions and error recovery
 - Emulation platform experience (QuickTurn, Palladium, ZeBu) and test infrastructure design
 - RTL and waveform debugging for SoC-level issues
 - Deep understanding of ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, and CAN FD / LIN / Ethernet
 - Functional safety subsystem validation and safety-case evidence
 - Complex DMA and bus (arbitration, ordering, timeout) validation
 - SystemVerilog and advanced RTL debugging

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
The opportunity

The EMR Architect is a core architect of Experity's vision to become the indispensable operating system for on-demand healthcare. 

By diagnosing the legacy WPF monolith and mapping a domain-by-domain path to the modern web stack, this role transforms a rigid, single-threaded system into modular, workflow-aligned services that clinicians can move through faster and clinics can build on. This position ensures Experity's core clinical record isn't just stable-it becomes the foundation the rest of the platform can modernize around. 

We're modernizing a legacy Windows/WPF-based EMR into a new web stack. This is a hands-on architecture role-you'll spend real time in the existing codebase, not just reviewing it from above, debugging multi-threaded WPF code paths and tracing real-time data flows to build an accurate picture of what's actually broken. 

You'll own the architecture story for this migration end to end: diagnosing what's wrong with the current system, communicating that visually to engineers and leadership, and mapping a domain-driven path from monolith to modular web app aligned to real clinical workflows. 

This role demands someone who can go deep on legacy Windows internals one day and present a migration roadmap to executives the next-thriving on ambiguity, incomplete documentation, and a codebase that predates most of the team. 

Business impact

- Reduces patient-record risk and clinician downtime by replacing a fragile, single-threaded WPF core with a stable, modular architecture that can scale with clinic volume. 
 - Speeds care delivery by decomposing the EMR into workflow-aligned domains (vitals, exam, charting), cutting the friction clinicians hit moving between tasks in a shared screen and shared thread. 
 - Improves engineering velocity and lowers migration risk by producing a domain-by-domain roadmap that lets teams modernize incrementally instead of a high-risk, all-at-once rewrite. 

What you will own

Architecture diagnosis

- A visual architecture diagnosis (diagrams, not docs) mapping the current WPF/. NET system's failure points, including thread contention and real-time data flow issues. 

Domain boundary mapping

- A domain boundary map splitting the EMR into workflow-aligned pieces (e. g. , vitals intake, full exam, charting) instead of one monolithic screen and thread. 

Migration roadmap

- A domain-by-domain migration roadmap sequencing the move from legacy WPF to the modern web stack, with near-term stabilization fixes called out separately from the long-term rebuild. 

Architecture communication

- A set of before/after architecture diagrams usable at both engineer and executive review, showing tradeoffs at each migration stage. 

What you'll do

- Diagnose and visually communicate problems in the current WPF/. NET architecture (diagrams, not just docs). 
 - Debug and reason about Windows/WPF applications, including multi-threaded and real-time data (WebSockets, live push) code paths. 
 - Balance near-term performance and sustainability fixes with a long-term web-stack migration plan. 
 - Analyze the codebase to identify domain boundaries, and propose splitting the EMR into pieces aligned to workflow personas (e. g. , nurse taking vitals vs. PA doing a full exam). 
 - Produce a go-forward roadmap for migrating the legacy EMR domain-by-domain to the new stack. 

What we're looking for

Experience

- Bachelor's degree in one of the STEM fields or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with Windows/WPF application development and debugging. 
 - Hands-on C# multi-threaded debugging experience (race conditions, UI freezes, thread contention). 
 - Strong visual communication skills-can explain complex architecture and tradeoffs through diagrams at any audience level (engineer to exec). 
 - Experience with domain modeling and breaking down monolithic systems into bounded domains. 
 - Solid . NET fundamentals, including async/await and efficient sync-to-async call patterns. 
 - Experience with WebSockets or real-time data push architectures. 

Nice to have

- Prior experience on an EMR, healthcare, or other high-reliability enterprise application. 
 - Experience leading or contributing to a legacy-to-web-stack migration. 
 - Solid, hands-on experience with TypeScript, Next. js, and modern web architecture. 
 - Experience designing for concurrent request handling from UI through to DB in large-scale systems. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Role Description

The Identity Governance Administration Automation Engineer is responsible for administering, automating, and continuously improving the enterprise's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environment, with a focus on Saviynt. This role ensures that access certification, provisioning, and entitlement management processes are secure, auditable, and efficient across the enterprise and its Operating Companies (OpCos). 

This role acts as both a platform administrator and an automation engineer, building and maintaining workflows that connect Saviynt to enterprise identity sources, target applications, and downstream systems. The engineer partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Audit teams to ensure identity lifecycle events - joiner, mover, leaver, and access certification - are governed, automated, and evidenced consistently across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 

The role is hands‐on and execution‐focused while embracing the Ralliant Business System (RBS) by embedding operational discipline, staff training, and continuous improvement into tools, workflows, and standard work so endpoint management is scalable, measurable, and repeatable. The role operates in service to the enterprise and operating companies, ensuring standardized identity governance practices while adapting to regional and business-specific needs.

APL READINESS

NICE-TO-HAVE

There is never just only one route, we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please click below to apply or get in touch with Aditya Gurijala, Recruitment Consultant or you may send an email to aditya. gurijala@simcorp. com to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. data.description:
Job Summary: 

We're looking for a Senior Staff Platform Engineer to join our Developer Productivity & Platforms group. This role blends traffic engineering (API gateway, CDN, service-to-service routing) with core responsibilities, including automation, observability, reliability engineering, CI/CD workflows, and internal tooling that accelerates developer efficiency. 

You'll own critical systems responsible for managing API traffic - both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service communication) - across a global, multi-cloud environment. You'll architect resilient routing systems, edge integrations with CDNs, and observability hooks that ensure everything you build is secure, debuggable, and automated. 

This is a hands-on role with high visibility and impact. You'll work across platform, SRE, and developer experience teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, observable, and developer-friendly - from traffic routing to deployments to production operations. 

One of your key responsibilities will also be to design and build a unified traffic abstraction layer - a foundational platform that maps backend services deployed across various compute environments to their respective configurations on CDNs (e. g. , Akamai, Fastly). This framework will centralize control over routing, metadata inventory, configuration tracking, and automated failover across CDNs. This capability does not currently exist and will be built from the ground up. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Own the technical vision and long-term evolution of the API Gateway and traffic platform supporting both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service) traffic, operating at scale across a multi-cloud environment. 
 - Architect and drive a unified traffic abstraction layer that decouples backend services from CDN-specific implementations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare), enabling centralized policy control, metadata-driven routing, automated multi-CDN failover, and future extensibility. 
 - Set architectural standards and design patterns for ingress, traffic routing, and API management, influencing multiple teams and ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and reliability across the organization. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team initiatives spanning networking, platform, SRE, security, and observability teams to deliver resilient, cloud-agnostic ingress solutions that account for varying network topologies, latency characteristics, and failure modes. 
 - Design and govern CI/CD and GitOps workflows for critical traffic infrastructure, defining best practices for safe deployments, progressive rollouts, automated validation, and rollback strategies across environments. 
 - Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes, establishing reusable modules, golden paths, and guardrails that enable teams to deploy and operate traffic components safely and independently. 
 - Build and evolve foundational tooling and services (primarily in Go or Python) that improve visibility, control, scalability, and operational efficiency of API traffic systems at scale. 
 - Define observability strategy and standards for ingress and internal traffic systems, including metrics, logs, tracing, and SLOs; partner closely with observability and SRE teams to ensure systems are diagnosable and production-ready by default. 
 - Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, reviewing high-impact designs, unblocking teams, and raising the overall quality bar for platform engineering and distributed systems practices. 
 - Anticipate future needs and risks, proactively identifying scaling limits, security gaps, and reliability concerns, and driving strategic investments before they become production issues. 

Skills and Attributes to Success: 

- Expert-level programming capability in Go or Python, with a track record of designing and delivering production-grade platforms, internal tooling, and services that operate reliably at scale; able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and velocity. 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with API Gateway platforms in large-scale production environments, including ownership of architecture, rollout strategies, failure handling, and long-term evolution of ingress and traffic management systems. 
 - Strong understanding of CDN architectures and integrations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare or similar), including cache strategies, request routing, edge security, failover mechanisms, and best practices for high-availability API delivery across regions and providers. 
 - Advanced proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, leveraging Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm to design reusable modules, define platform standards, and enable self-service while maintaining strong operational and security guardrails. 
 - Deep knowledge of networking and distributed systems fundamentals, including TLS termination, L4/L7 routing, traffic shaping, rate limiting, retries, circuit breaking, and failure isolation, with the ability to reason about system behavior under load and partial failure. 
 - Proven ability to design systems with observability, automation, and resiliency as first-class concerns, defining metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, and automated remediation strategies in partnership with SRE and observability teams. 
 - Strong architectural judgment and systems thinking, able to navigate ambiguity, evaluate multiple solution paths, and influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews and technical leadership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical multiplier, mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and helping teams ship safer, faster, and more reliable systems. 

Preferred Education & Experience: 

- B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university. 
 - 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery. 

About Us

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

data.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Are you a customer-obsessed, AI-curious problem-solver who thrives in an inclusive, collaborative global team? Join Engineering Operations (EngOps), the organization driving operational excellence across the Microsoft Cloud to strengthen quality, reliability, security, and customer trust. 

Our mission is to prevent issues before they happen by turning operational signals into action through AI-powered automation, enabling measurable customer impact at cloud scale. Our culture of empowerment, inclusion, and growth mindset defines how we work. 

Within EngOps ACES, the Agent Fleet Operations (AFO) team is looking for an AI-first software engineer to join the Cloud Operational Demand Engineering (CØDE) organization and help advance our mission of driving operational demand to zero. We're seeking a hands-on engineer with a DevOps background - CI/CD and release engineering, safe deployment, observability, and always-on production operations - who pairs that discipline with AI engineering skills and a learn-it-all mindset. 

You are passionate about applying AI to solve real customer problems and energized by the challenge of eliminating operational toil. 

In this role, you will build and ship production AI solutions that reduce operational demand and improve customer outcomes. You will contribute to the technical execution that turns unresolved cases into autonomously resolved, customer-delighting outcomes - and help build the release, observability, and reliability practices that let a fleet of agents run safely in the customer path. 

Role summary

As an individual contributor, you will be hands-on building and improving the agentic patterns that reduce operational demand and improve customer satisfaction. This is a DevOps and production-operations engineering role applied to autonomous AI: you own the delivery, quality, and production health of the components you build, not just their design. This role suits an engineer who has built and shipped production-scale AI systems - and ideally the CI/CD, safe-deployment, and reliability practices around them - and who wants to go deep on agentic resolution while collaborating closely across the team. 

Team charter

Build, operationalize, and scale AI-native support experiences for Broad Commercial customers by transforming supportability knowledge into reusable, versioned, testable, and measurable assets that power product experiences, support engineers, and autonomous agents. The team reduces support demand, engineering toil, and time-to-resolution through AI-driven resolution capabilities that continuously learn from customer signals, unresolved cases, and operational insights. 

AFO operates a fleet of autonomous agents that resolve customer support cases with human oversight. This is a production DevOps discipline, not a set of prototypes: agents run continuously in the customer path and released, observed, and improved with the same rigor as any always-on service. You and your team will build and run this system across several planes of a single AIOps suite: 

- Fleet execution and live safety: operating the agents that execute individual cases end to end - evidence acquisition, diagnosis, reasoning, response composition, and safe escalation - alongside the live-safety services that continuously watch sentiment, risk, and unsafe or irreversible actions and can pause autonomy or transfer a case to a human. 
 - Evaluation and repair: running the evaluation systems that judge per-turn and completed-case quality, and the repair pipelines that turn failures into durable fixes - documentation, diagnostics, prompt/routing/policy changes, reusable skills, or product work items routed to the right engineering team. 
 - A control and learning plane: owning the lifecycle state machine that moves every change from observed → detected → diagnosed → repair candidate → independently evaluated → approved → shadowed → canaried → released → production-verified, with explicit expand, pause, revise, 

Responsibilities

- Build agentic resolution capabilities for AFO
 - Build and improve agentic patterns that raise autonomous resolution rate, accuracy, and customer satisfaction, contributing to the team's technical execution. 
 - Deliver engineering for Agentic AI solutions
 - Deliver end-to-end features across autonomous AI systems, including orchestration, reasoning, retrieval, action execution, and human escalation workflows. Take capabilities from prototype through production across support surfaces while partnering effectively across dependent engineering teams. 
 - Contribute to technical direction and engineering standards
 - Help shape the technical foundation for agent development by implementing architectures, design patterns, evaluation frameworks, and reusable platform capabilities. 
 - Apply and help improve standards for prompts, tool interfaces, testing, versioning, code quality, CI/CD, and safe deployment practices (shadow, canary, progressive rollout, automated rollback) so agent behavior remains reliable, observable, and scalable. 
 - Build evals that improve customer confidence that our agents are trustworthy in understanding customer sentiment and intent and in validating agentic actions. 
 - Contribute to production health and reliability
 - Help run the service with a DevOps/SRE operating model. Support availability, latency, cost per resolution, SLOs and error budgets, regression detection, incident response, and the on-call rotation for a fleet of agents acting autonomously in the customer path. Build the observability needed to explain why an agent did what it did, and drive durable fixes rather than repeated mitigations. 
 - Build and maintain evaluation systems
 - Contribute to the evaluation framework that determines whether agents are safe and effective in production. Build and maintain golden datasets, rubrics, judge agents, frozen anchors, and offline/online evaluation pipelines. Use evaluation signals to gate releases and continuously improve quality through production feedback loops. 
 - Contribute to measurable business impact
 - Help move key business outcomes, including support demand reduction, autonomous resolution rate, resolution quality, time-to-resolution, engineer productivity, and customer satisfaction. Ensure the capabilities you build are measurable and directed toward the highest-impact opportunities. 
 - Turn Customer Signals into Engineering Insight
 - Build mechanisms that convert unresolved cases, customer feedback, and dissatisfaction signals into actionable engineering insights. Help ensure recurring failure patterns improve future agent capabilities and route product fixes back to the appropriate engineering teams.

data.title: SAP ABAP Development Lead
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

IS Manager

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own how SAP ABAP is built across our ERP landscape: the development standard, the quality gates, the AI-assisted development practice, and who works on what. Each day, you will spend at least half your time writing production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA, taking on the hardest objects and the first build of every new pattern. You will also showcase your expertise by leading a central team of three developers, growing to six, who serve projects across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales. You will help us choose between agentic AI development platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, and then make the chosen platform part of how the team builds every day. 

This role will be Reporting to the VP of IT and the Head of Core Business Applications (ERP), you will be the team's hands-on technical lead, not an additional management layer. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. 

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the SAP BTP architecture and development team; the integration team; and SAP Basis. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC and S/4HANA every week, and closing team commitments on the promised date, chasing what is blocked rather than waiting. 
 - Owning the ABAP development standard: coding guidelines, naming, enhancement rules, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, applied the same way across the team. 
 - Leading AI-driven development: testing agentic AI platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, hands-on with our own code; recommending one; and making it a daily practice, with rules for use, review of generated code, and automated quality and compliance checks. 
 - Allocating and growing the team: deciding who works on what across competing demand, removing single points of knowledge, coaching developers, and setting practical clean core rules for S/4HANA. 

Our team dynamics

You will join a small, hands-on expert team where everyone builds, and everyone supports. AI is expected here, not merely tolerated. Done means in use by the business, not just transported, and an honest "I don't know yet" is welcome. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- You have 12+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with deep, current ABAP experience in ECC, and you still write code and can show recent work. 
 - You have heavy, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, ideally with agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct, or with SAP Joule for developers. If not, you have a strong drive to adopt them and can show what you built or automated with AI on your own initiative. 
 - You have a demonstrated track record of finishing concrete production outcomes with numbers, including work that was stuck before you picked it up. 
 - You are highly skilled in SAP S/4HANA development, including CDS, RAP, and ABAP Cloud, with a practical view of clean core from real implementations. 
 - You have established skills in defining and enforcing development standards that others followed, including rules for AI-generated code, and in leading developers technically. 
 - You are passionate about getting things done through people you don't manage, and about keeping quality and security controls intact while moving fast. 
 - You are at ease communicating in English, verbally and in writing. 

What's in it for you?

You will work hands-on with the newest agentic AI tools for SAP development and decide how a whole team uses them. You will shape the team's standards and tooling from the start, keep building rather than just reviewing, and see your decisions applied across the ERP landscape as we move to S/4HANA. 

More About Us (Mandatory)

At ABB, we're pioneers in digital industries and power grids, driving sustainable transformation across industries. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We foster a culture of diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+, abilities, and generations-creating an environment where every voice matters. 

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www. abb. com. 

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

data.title: SAP ABAP Development Lead
data.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner-and every person here makes that happen. You'll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. 

This Position reports to: 

IS Manager

Your Role And Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own how SAP ABAP is built across our ERP landscape: the development standard, the quality gates, the AI-assisted development practice, and who works on what. Each day, you will spend at least half your time writing production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA, taking on the hardest objects and the first build of every new pattern. You will also showcase your expertise by leading a central team of three developers, growing to six, who serve projects across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales. You will help us choose between agentic AI development platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, and then make the chosen platform part of how the team builds every day. 

This role will be Reporting to the VP of IT and the Head of Core Business Applications (ERP), you will be the team's hands-on technical lead, not an additional management layer. 

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. 

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the SAP BTP architecture and development team; the integration team; and SAP Basis. 

You will be mainly accountable for: 

- Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC and S/4HANA every week, and closing team commitments on the promised date, chasing what is blocked rather than waiting. 
 - Owning the ABAP development standard: coding guidelines, naming, enhancement rules, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, applied the same way across the team. 
 - Leading AI-driven development: testing agentic AI platforms for SAP, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct, hands-on with our own code; recommending one; and making it a daily practice, with rules for use, review of generated code, and automated quality and compliance checks. 
 - Allocating and growing the team: deciding who works on what across competing demand, removing single points of knowledge, coaching developers, and setting practical clean core rules for S/4HANA. 

Our team dynamics

You will join a small, hands-on expert team where everyone builds, and everyone supports. AI is expected here, not merely tolerated. Done means in use by the business, not just transported, and an honest "I don't know yet" is welcome. 

Qualifications for the role: 

- You have 12+ years of hands-on SAP development experience, with deep, current ABAP experience in ECC, and you still write code and can show recent work. 
 - You have heavy, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, ideally with agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct, or with SAP Joule for developers. If not, you have a strong drive to adopt them and can show what you built or automated with AI on your own initiative. 
 - You have a demonstrated track record of finishing concrete production outcomes with numbers, including work that was stuck before you picked it up. 
 - You are highly skilled in SAP S/4HANA development, including CDS, RAP, and ABAP Cloud, with a practical view of clean core from real implementations. 
 - You have established skills in defining and enforcing development standards that others followed, including rules for AI-generated code, and in leading developers technically. 
 - You are passionate about getting things done through people you don't manage, and about keeping quality and security controls intact while moving fast. 
 - You are at ease communicating in English, verbally and in writing. 

What's in it for you?

You will work hands-on with the newest agentic AI tools for SAP development and decide how a whole team uses them. You will shape the team's standards and tooling from the start, keep building rather than just reviewing, and see your decisions applied across the ERP landscape as we move to S/4HANA.

data.title: IT Quality Assurance Analyst, Senior
data.description:
Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer's and partner's needs and solve their challenges. 

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. 

You'll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about-locally and globally. 

Come make an impact every day at Zebra. 

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst with strong Salesforce (SFDC) domain expertise to lead quality assurance strategy and test automation across Sales, Service, and integrated enterprise platforms. This role requires hands‐on experience with modern test automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca or Playwright, applied thoughtfully to Salesforce‐centric and web‐based applications. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and IT teams to ensure high‐quality, scalable, and reliable Salesforce solutions by leveraging automation, API testing, AI‐assisted development techniques, and CI/CD pipelines in an Agile environment

Salesforce‐Focused Quality Assurance Strategy

- Lead QA efforts for Salesforce (SFDC) platforms including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and integrated enterprise systems. 
 - Define and execute end‐to‐end test strategies covering Salesforce configurations, customizations, workflows, validations, and integrations. 
 - Apply risk‐based, business‐process‐driven testing aligned to CRM, sales operations, marketing, and customer service use cases. 

Test Automation (Tosca or Playwright)

- Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca or Playwright for Salesforce and web applications. 
 - Use Tosca (model‐based automation, Vision AI, API testing) to support enterprise‐scale regression and integration testing where applicable. 
 - Use Playwright to implement robust, code‐based UI automation, focusing on speed, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Leverage AI‐assisted / "vibe coding" approaches using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to accelerate development and iteration of Playwright automation scripts, while ensuring code quality, readability, and long‐term maintainability. 
 - Apply the right automation approach for the use case, balancing low‐code and code‐based strategies. 

API, Integration & End‐to‐End Testing

- Validate Salesforce integrations using API testing (REST/SOAP), middleware, and downstream enterprise systems. 
 - Ensure end‐to‐end test coverage across Salesforce, web applications, and integrated platforms. 

CI/CD, Release Quality & Agile Collaboration

- Integrate Tosca or Playwright automation into CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Flosum, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). 
 - Enable unattended and parallel execution with clear, actionable reporting and dashboards. 
 - Establish and enforce quality gates for Salesforce and web application releases. 
 - Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives with a quality‐first mindset. 

Test Data, Defect Management & Stakeholder Communication

- Drive Salesforce‐specific test data strategies, including reusable and dynamic test data. 
 - Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk assessments. 
 - Communicate quality insights and release readiness clearly to business and technical stakeholders. 

Enablement & Best Practices

- Coach teams on Salesforce QA best practices, automation standards, and scalable test design. 
 - Promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across test assets and frameworks. 
 - Required
 - Bachelor's degree (4 years) in Computer Science or a related field (preferred). 
 - 4+ years of hands‐on QA experience, with strong focus on Salesforce (SFDC) platforms. 
 - Proven experience testing Salesforce business processes (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CRM workflows). 
 - Hands‐on experience with Tricentis Tosca or Playwright for test automation. 
 - Strong understanding of automation framework design, test stability, and maintainability. 
 - Experience with API and integration testing. 
 - Solid knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Agile/Scrum practices. 
 - Experience with JIRA and test management tools such as ALM Quality Center or qTest. 
 - Excellent analytical, communication, and cross‐functional collaboration skills. 
Preferred

- Salesforce certifications or formal Salesforce training (Admin, Platform App Builder, or equivalent). 
 - Experience testing Salesforce integrations with ERP, e‐commerce, or middleware platforms. 
 - Tosca certifications (AS2, AE2, TDS1/TDS2). 
 - Experience optimizing Playwright test suites for performance and parallel execution. 
 - Knowledge of AI‐assisted / "vibe coding" techniques using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor for developing and accelerating Playwright automation scripts. 
 - Knowledge of Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service domains. 

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. 

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra. com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. 

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

data.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

This is a senior technical lead role that pairs deep platform engineering expertise with the thought leadership needed to bring AI into production operations. The person owns the build, hardening, patching, and lifecycle of the operating system and platform estate, and serves as the top escalation point for complex incidents - while simultaneously identifying where AI and automation can replace manual toil, reduce incident volume, and shorten recovery times. Success depends as much on change leadership as on engineering: shaping standards, winning stakeholder buy-in, and guiding 1st line operations through new AI-enabled ways of working without disrupting service levels. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform engineering depth - packaging and hardening approved OS builds, management agent stacks, patch currency, and configuration standards across the estate
 - AI-driven operations innovation - identifying, piloting, and scaling AI/automation use cases for incident triage, root cause analysis, runbook execution, and predictive monitoring
 - Thought leadership and evangelism - articulating an AI-for-operations vision, authoring white papers and R&D positions, staying ahead of emerging tooling
 - Change management and adoption - driving organizational uptake of new practices, coaching 1st line teams, managing risk and resistance while protecting SLAs
 - Incident, problem, and change discipline - major incident leadership, RCA, and rigorous change control in a regulated production environment
 - Service improvement measurement - instrumenting and evidencing reductions in incident volume and MTTR from process redesign and automation
 - Solution design and implementation planning - translating requirements into physical builds, costed designs, and multi-workstream delivery plans
 - Automation and infrastructure-as-code fluency - scripting, configuration management, and pipeline-driven platform delivery
 - Standards, compliance, and documentation - run books, technical policies, and AI governance/guardrails to document-control standards
 - Cross-functional influence - partnering with architecture, security, development, vendors, and the business to land change. 

Required Qualifications

- Provides a high level of technical and subject matter expertise in one or more technologies and serves as a point of escalation for technical issues related to specialty. 
 - Produces, delivers, and maintains appropriate documentation for systems in accordance document control standards and procedures. 
 - Provide input to records, quality systems and management reports as required
 - Contributes to the definition and implementation of improved operability on new and current systems. 
 - Uses innovative methods including the redesign of process and providing technical solutions to reduce the volume and mean time to recover incidents in assigned business unit. 
 - Identifies risks & issues and takes ownership to deliver appropriate resolutions. 
 - Provides technical expertise for root cause analysis and problem management. 
 - Provides detailed implementation/project plans across multiple, complex work streams according to agreed standards and ensures project processes and timelines are understood and followed. 
 - Works and cooperates with internal and external groups when required in order to fully support environments and maintain service. 
 - Adheres to change management procedures in defining, planning and implementing change in such a way that ensures appropriate coordination with other teams, minimizes service disruption, and ensures adherence to Service Level Agreements. 
 - Improves change management processes and procedures to ensure the most efficient processing of change within appropriate service risk constraints. 
 - Provides specialist support during complex and/or major incidents. 
 - May be asked to lead recovery efforts during major incidents within business unit. 
 - Deputize for the team manager as required. 
 - Contributes to or author technical documentation such complex changes instructions. 
 - Reviews, and updates as appropriate, operations procedures, standards, and technical policies. 
 - May be asked to assist with production of white papers on technical R&D projects
 - Collaborates with business, third party vendors, developers, application support and technical operations groups to determine appropriate hardware/software needed and to resolve any issues impacting the application processes. 
 - Stays abreast of recent developments in related technical community, including new technology and business news that may impact vendors' ability to provide service. 
 - Responsible to seek out all information and to fully understand all aspects of each device's technology configuration and uses all approved engineering tools available to implement conforming change. 
 - Leads the analysis and design of complex solutions and requirements definition, including translating technical and business requirements into physical installations, costing design elements, and obtaining agreement to proposed solutions. 
 - Reviews and coordinates the implementation of proposed modifications, and changes to the production environment. 
 - Provides direction into standards and procedures for monitoring, capacity planning, tuning, maintenance, performance optimization, backups and recovery; ensures infrastructure will meet capacity requirements to deliver projects on time. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Provides direction for: proactive health and performance monitoring of databases, indexes and logs, and troubleshooting of reported issues. 
 - Reviews implemented scripts, stored procedures, and reports generated by automated database maintenance scripts. 
 - Participates in the technical design process as it relates to database implementations, reviews technical documents, and communicates any risks or issues using the appropriate escalation procedures. 
 - Provides directions to Technical Recovery plans (Database Standby and Replication, Backup and Recovery). 
 - Platform Engineer: 
 - Packages company approved hardened versions of targeted operating systems. 
 - Ensures stack of agents for management systems are properly installed and connected. 
 - Maintains patch levels in accordance with change management and security standards. 
 - Storage Engineer: 
 - Provides leadership for storage-related projects, including switch installations, disk consolidations, disk assignments, replication, and more. 
 - Works closely with architecture teams to set, communicate, and maintain storage standards. 
 - Network Engineer: 
 - Reviews the network infrastructure documentation/ run book for standards adherence. 
 - Complies with all routing and rules sets, sequences, defaults, and standards. 
 - Documents and maintains all applicable configuration standards. 
 - Assures all NIC and port speeds are appropriately locked down. 
 - Application Engineer: 
 - Fully familiarizes self with all aspects of the developed code. 
 - Recognizes design problems and errors and takes corrective action from a design perspective on the object code Environment. Interfaces with development teams on system design enhancements and the elimination of intermittent hardware/software problems. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.
