data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Why UKG

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That's what we do. 

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you'll get flexibility that's real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters-and so do you. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to join the engineering team for the Ready product. This role is focused on leading the technical direction, architecture, and engineering strategy for a modern, scalable, resilient, and intelligent enterprise SaaS product. 

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a key role in defining the technology stack, shaping the technical roadmap, driving architectural decisions, and leading complex engineering initiatives across multiple teams. You will be expected to bring deep technical expertise, enterprise-scale thinking, and a strong understanding of performance, reliability, observability, and operational excellence. 

This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can guide engineering teams through complex design decisions, lead technical discussions, troubleshoot critical technical issues, and influence the long-term evolution of the Ready product. The ideal candidate will have strong proficiency in Java, database technologies, cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI-assisted software engineering practices. 

We are looking for an engineer who combines strategic technical vision with practical execution, mentors senior engineers, raises engineering standards, and helps build a product platform that is scalable, secure, observable, performant, and ready for the future. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Define and drive the architectural vision for the Ready product, ensuring scalability, resiliency, performance, maintainability, and long-term extensibility. 
 - Lead the evaluation, selection, and evolution of the core technology stack, including application frameworks, cloud-native services, database technologies, observability tools, messaging systems, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities. 
 - Define and influence the technical roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership, product management, architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex product and platform initiatives. 
 - Provide technical direction across multiple teams and ensure alignment with enterprise engineering standards, security expectations, and operational goals. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices to continuously improve product capabilities, developer productivity, and system reliability. 

Software Engineering & Platform Development

- Design and build highly scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native services using Java and related enterprise technologies. 
 - Lead the development of distributed systems, APIs, backend services, event-driven workflows, and data-intensive applications. 
 - Drive modernization initiatives that improve system performance, scalability, maintainability, and engineering velocity. 
 - Establish and promote engineering best practices around code quality, testing, automation, design patterns, performance optimization, and maintainable architecture. 
 - Lead complex cross-functional engineering initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders. 
 - Ensure the Ready product is built with an enterprise-level mindset, including strong consideration for scalability, compliance, security, availability, customer experience, and operational readiness. 

Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence

- Drive platform-wide improvements in observability, monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health management. 
 - Define and implement observability standards using platforms and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or similar technologies. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, system failures, and reliability concerns. 
 - Partner with engineering, operations, and SRE teams to define service-level objectives, operational metrics, error budgets, incident response practices, and reliability improvement plans. 
 - Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions result in long-term improvements to architecture, automation, resiliency, and monitoring. 
 - Champion proactive engineering practices that improve product stability, reduce operational risk, and enhance customer trust. 

Performance Engineering & Scalability

- Drive performance tuning across application services, database layers, APIs, integration points, and distributed system components. 
 - Identify and resolve scalability challenges in high-volume, enterprise-grade SaaS environments. 
 - Lead capacity planning, load testing, profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and performance benchmarking efforts. 
 - Ensure that technical designs account for throughput, latency, concurrency, data growth, resiliency, and cost efficiency. 
 - Partner with teams to establish measurable performance goals and continuously improve system responsiveness and efficiency. 

AI-First Engineering & Agents

- Bring strong insight into AI trends, AI-assisted engineering, intelligent automation, and agent-based capabilities. 
 - Drive adoption of AI tools and practices to improve software design, development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI and agents within the engineering lifecycle and product ecosystem to improve productivity, quality, and customer value. 
 - Guide teams on responsible AI usage, including security, privacy, governance, explainability, and reliability considerations. 
 - Evaluate AI-enabled platforms, developer tools, observability assistants, coding agents, and automation frameworks that can improve engineering outcomes at scale. 

Database & Data Architecture

- Provide technical leadership in database design, data modeling, query optimization, transaction management, and scalable data access patterns. 
 - Work with relational and non-relational database technologies to support enterprise-grade application requirements. 
 - Guide teams in designing reliable, performant, and maintainable database solutions that support high-volume data processing and business-critical workflows. 
 - Lead troubleshooting of complex database performance issues, including indexing, locking, query plans, connection management, data partitioning, and schema evolution. 
 - Ensure data architecture decisions align with security, compliance, scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability goals. 

Security, Compliance & Enterprise Readiness

- Champion secure software design and development practices across the Ready product. 
 - Ensure systems are designed with strong consideration for authentication, authorization, data protection, encryption, auditability, and secure integration patterns. 
 - Promote enterprise readiness through resilient architecture, operational maturity, compliance awareness, and high-quality engineering standards. 
 - Partner with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure technical solutions align with organizational governance and risk management expectations. 

Technical Mentorship & Influence

- Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and development teams on architecture, design, engineering practices, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making. 
 - Lead technical discussions with clarity, influence, and strong engineering judgment. 
 - Build consensus across teams on complex architecture and design decisions. 
 - Raise engineering standards through design reviews, technical coaching, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 16+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building enterprise-scale software products. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java, including modern Java frameworks, backend service development, concurrency, performance tuning, and scalable application design. 
 - Deep experience with database technologies, including relational databases, SQL optimization, schema design, transaction management, indexing strategies, and performance troubleshooting. 
 - Proven experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native enterprise applications. 
 - Strong understanding of observability platforms, monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and production diagnostics. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, capacity planning, caching, query optimization, and system tuning. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architecture, operational readiness, resiliency, availability, security, and scalability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions, define technical roadmaps, and influence engineering direction across multiple teams. 
 - Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, database, and integration layers. 
 - Strong understanding of AI-assisted software engineering practices, AI tools, and emerging agent-based development or automation models. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, mentoring, and technical leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working on large-scale enterprise SaaS products serving global customers. 
 - Experience defining or evolving a product-level technology stack and long-term technical roadmap. 
 - Expertise with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging platforms, distributed caching, and asynchronous processing patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar platforms. 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale architecture evolution initiatives. 
 - Strong knowledge of secure software development, compliance-aware design, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Experience with AI coding assistants, engineering agents, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled operational tooling. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor senior technical talent and establish engineering standards across teams. 
 - Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical problem solving and delivery execution. 

Key Attributes

- Strategic technical thinker with strong execution discipline. 
 - Hands-on engineering leader who can guide architecture while also diving deep into technical issues. 
 - Strong enterprise mindset with focus on reliability, performance, observability, scalability, and security. 
 - Clear communicator who can lead technical discussions and influence decisions across teams. 
 - Passionate about engineering excellence, innovation, AI-first development, and continuous improvement. 
 - Comfortable working in complex environments with multiple stakeholders, systems, and priorities

Company Overview

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry - because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg. com. 

UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Department Overview

The Core Platforms & Services team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud-based Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions' Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS & GCP to build at scale. 

Job Description

The ideal candidate analyzes, develops, designs, and maintains software for the organization's platform infrastructure, performing system integration to ensure high throughput, security, and absolute reliability. In this role, you will focus on building robust Kubernetes platforms across multi-cloud systems and driving their entire Lifecycle Management (LCM), including self-hosted and managed cluster environments. You are expected to act as a key engineering partner for application teams, understanding their specific Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure requirements, integrating those needs back into our core platforms, and maintaining effective monitoring stacks to ensure full platform visibility. By defining clear SLAs, tracking SLOs, and relentlessly automating infrastructure provisioning, LCM operations, and platform enhancements using modern tools, you will scale these environments efficiently. You will own the end-to-end delivery of these systems, from testing structures and maintaining user documentation to ensuring mission-critical reliability. 

Responsibilities Will Include

- Provision, manage, and drive the full Lifecycle Management (LCM) of Kubernetes clusters across multi-cloud environments, spanning both cloud-managed clusters and self-hosted cluster deployments. 
 - Network, cloud, and security design and implementation of core services used by our Public Safety cloud solutions. 
 - Support cloud platform operations and sovereign operations including issue troubleshooting and resolution. 
 - Define and meet scalability, availability, security, and performance goals. 
 - Rapidly build and evolve major features in collaboration with product management. 
 - Utilize Helm charts extensively to deploy, update, and manage core application manifest components across clusters. 
 - Write robust automation scripts using Python and Bash to eliminate operational friction and automate infrastructure tasks. 
 - Build, maintain, and optimize secure CI/CD pipelines for application and configuration delivery. 
 - Research and experiment with key technologies, architectures, and standards to keep the platform modern and efficient. 
 - Integrate fundamental Agentic AI concepts into the operational landscape to explore intelligent infrastructure monitoring and automation. 
 - Leverage AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate day-to-day scripting, manifest authorship, and pipeline building. 
 - Attend daily stand-up meetings, collaborate with peers, prioritize features, and work with a sense of urgency to deliver value to customers. 
 - Assist in reviews and audits conducted at various points in the software life cycle. 

Basic Requirements

Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent with 5+ years of combined experience in Network Engineering, Security, or Cloud/DevOps Engineering. 
 - Experience with web infrastructure and distributed systems; strong knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes, including cloud service provider managed clusters (EKS/AKS/GKE) and self-hosted cluster environments. 
 - Deep familiarity with Helm for packaging, configuration, and manifest deployment. 
 - Fundamental/Expert level knowledge of Python and Bash, with the ability to build reliable operational automation scripts. 
 - Foundational understanding of Agentic AI concepts (basic component orchestration, LLM tool use primitives, and architecture structures). 
 - High proficiency in utilizing AI coding assistance tools (GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cursor, or Claude) to enhance coding speed and accuracy. 
 - Hands-on experience with version control and platform management via GitHub or Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience in configuring modern CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Previous experience dealing with L3/L4 networking components like load balancers and firewalls. 
 - Experience implementing and configuring cloud monitoring tools. 
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving, growing, and agile environment. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex topics to non-technical audiences. 

Primary Skills (Must-Have)

- Cloud Administration, CLI, Identity & Access Management (AWS/Azure/GCP)
 - Knowledge on Containerization
 - Kubernetes Cluster Lifecycle Management (AKS/EKS/GKE & Self-hosted environments)
 - CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub / Azure DevOps)
 - Scripting & Automation (Bash - Mandatory, python - Fundamentals/Mid Level)
 - Helm Charts & Manifest Deployment
 - Identity & Access Management (IAM / Active Directory)
 - Infrastructure Monitoring Tools
 - Networking & Firewall Fundamentals (L3/L4, NGINX, DNS)
 - Linux Administration
 - AI Productivity Tools (Copilot, Windsurf, Cursor, Claude)
 - Foundational Agentic AI Concepts

Nice To Have Skills

- Advanced Python Development: Deep expertise building robust automation frameworks or backend software integrations.

None

None

Experienced

Yes

data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tech Lead
data.description:
Summary

Join Guidewire's Product Development & Operations (PDO) organization as a cornerstone of our Site Reliability Engineering team. We are the architects of stability for the Guidewire Cloud Platform, ensuring the world's leading P&C insurers can depend on our mission-critical applications. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tech Lead you aren't just maintaining systems; you are defining the technical vision for how we operate at scale, automating the complex, and leading a high-performing "pod" of engineers to deliver a resilient, self-healing cloud ecosystem. 

The Role

This is a dual-accountability leadership role. You will act as a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (P5)-providing deep technical expertise and cross-team architectural influence-and as a Tech Lead, where you will serve as the technical engine for your pod. You will bridge the gap between long-term reliability strategy and the daily execution of your team, ensuring that our applications are not only stable but also evolving through elite software engineering practices. 

Job Description

What You'll Do

- Technical Leadership: Serve as the primary technical authority for your SRE pod. You will own the technical design for pod deliverables, oversee production deployments, and act as the final point of escalation for complex technical impediments. 
 - Architectural Influence: Design and implement systemic improvements to our AWS and Kubernetes-based environments. You won't just fix incidents; you will lead the creation of frameworks that prevent them across the entire organization. 
 - Drive Engineering Excellence: Protect the pod's sprint goals by breaking down high-level requirements into actionable technical tasks. Lead by example through hands-on coding (AI, Python, Go, or Java), rigorous code reviews, and the promotion of "Clean Code" and testing standards. Triage and assign work. 
 - Toil Elimination & Automation: Champion the transition from manual operations to "Operations as Code. " You will lead the development of automated runbooks, self-healing systems, and advanced CI/CD pipelines (Terraform, GitOps) to reduce operational friction. 
 - Mentorship & Growth: Actively coach and mentor P1-P5 engineers. You are responsible for raising the "technical bar" of the team, fostering a culture of curiosity, and ensuring the professional growth of your peers through constructive feedback. 
 - Incident Management & Post-mortems: Lead the response to high-severity incidents. You will facilitate blameless post-mortems that go beyond "human error" to identify deep architectural weaknesses, ensuring Guidewire learns and hardens its systems after every event. 
 - AI & Innovation: Proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML and data-driven insights into our observability stack (Datadog/Resolve) to move from reactive monitoring to predictive reliability. 
 - Production Stewardship & On-Call Excellence: Participate in and provide technical oversight for a 24x7 on-call rotation. As a P5 Tech Lead, you will act as a high-level escalation point for complex production incidents, ensuring rapid restoration of service while driving the "blameless" culture and post-incident analysis required to eliminate recurring issues. 

What You'll Bring

- Deep Technical Mastery: 10+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or Software Engineering, with at least 3+ years in a Staff-level, Technical Lead, Manager or Sr. Manager capacity. 
 - Cloud Native Expert: Expert-level command of AWS ecosystem and Kubernetes (EKS) orchestration. You should have a proven track record of managing large-scale, distributed cloud environments. 
 - Automation Specialist: Advanced proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible/Puppet) within a GitOps framework. 
 - Software Engineering Acumen: Strong software engineering foundation with the ability to write production-grade code in languages like Python, Go, or Java or with tools such as Claude Code, CodeEx or CoPilot. 
 - Observability Visionary: Deep experience building comprehensive monitoring, SLIs/SLOs, and tracing strategies using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or Splunk. 
 - Leadership Mindset: Proven ability to manage "up and out"-communicating technical risks to stakeholders and collaborating with Product and Engineering managers to align reliability goals with feature delivery. 
 - Operational Discipline: Experience managing on-call rotations and a "safety-first" mindset. You understand that reliability is the most important feature of any product. 

Your Impact

- In your first 90 days: You will take full ownership of your pod's technical roadmap, identifying "low-hanging fruit" for automation and establishing yourself as the go-to technical resource for your team. 
 - In your first 6 months: You will have successfully led a major cross-pod initiative-such as a significant application migration/upgrade, a new observability standard, or a breakthrough in deployment velocity-measurable by a decrease in MTTR and an increase in system uptime. 
 - Long term: You will shape the future of SRE at Guidewire, influencing our global cloud strategy and building a legacy of engineering excellence that enables our customers to transform the insurance industry. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. 

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. 

For more information, please visit www. guidewire. com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC. 

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position. 

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability. org. uk, our disability partner, or schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

data.title: SDET - Automation Testing
data.description:
Primary Technologies

- Test Automation: Playwright, Selenium WebDriver
 - Languages: TypeScript, Python, or C# (. NET)
 - API Testing: REST beyond basics: request chaining, payload validation, authentication
 - Data: Strong SQL for application databases, data validation, and test data setup
 - AI in QA: Hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar); prompt engineering
 - Test Management: Azure Test Plans
 - BDD (Optional): Cucumber, Gherkin, structured step definitions
 - CI/CD (Good to Have): Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Basic working knowledge is enough. 
 - ETL (Good to Have): Basic understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines
 - Databricks (Good to Have): Basic understanding of Databricks or similar data platforms

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior SDET who combines strong automation engineering with hands-on experience applying AI in a QA context. In this role, you own the quality of features and workstreams assigned to you, build reusable automation the team can rely on, and bring AI-assisted approaches into your day-to-day work. 

This is a senior individual contributor role. You take a technical direction and work through it independently, delivering working solutions with minimal hand-holding. You know when to ask clarifying questions and when to move. 

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to understand what quality means for your area, define the right testing approach, and deliver measurable coverage improvements using a mix of automation and AI-assisted approaches. 

If you enjoy solving hard technical problems, delivering quality that people can trust, and building your AI in QA skills through real work, this role is for you. 

What You'll Do

Quality for Your Features and Workstreams

- Own the quality of features or workstreams assigned to you, from planning through release readiness
 - Define the testing approach for your area, including what needs testing, at what depth, and using which methods
 - Partner with developers and product managers on requirement reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning to catch issues early
 - Track quality signals for your area (defects, coverage gaps, escaped issues) and act on them

Automation Framework Contribution

- Build and maintain scalable automation that covers the scenarios that matter for your area
 - Design reusable automation framework components (helpers, utilities, page objects, shared services) that are scalable and reliable enough for the team to depend on
 - Contribute to and evolve the team's automation framework, following established patterns and shaping new ones where needed
 - Write clean, production-quality automation across UI and API layers using Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools
 - Keep the automation suite healthy. Fix flakes, improve reliability, and remove tests that no longer earn their place. 

AI Implementation in QA

- Implement AI-assisted approaches within your area's QA workflow. Intelligent test generation, self-healing locators, automated step definitions, and AI-powered reporting. 
 - Work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar) to build utilities the team actually uses
 - Apply practical understanding of how large language models work (context windows, prompt structure, response handling) to build reliable integrations
 - Evaluate AI tools critically. Adopt what genuinely improves quality outcomes. 

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

- Participate actively in code and design reviews. Give substantive feedback. 
 - Document your work well enough that others can build on it
 - Support and pair with less experienced SDETs when needed

Reporting and Execution

- Produce test reports and quality summaries that stakeholders trust and act on
 - Support execution strategy improvements where they help. Parallelism, environment configuration, flakiness reduction. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration if and when needed. This is not a heavy focus for us, so working knowledge is enough. 

What You Will Bring

Quality Engineering Foundation (Must Have)

- Proven track record of owning quality for features or workstreams. Not just executing test cases handed to you. 
 - Strong grasp of test strategy, risk-based coverage, and the tradeoffs between manual, automated, and exploratory testing
 - Experience partnering closely with developers and product managers
 - Comfortable making judgment calls on quality risk and communicating them clearly

Automation (Must Have)

- Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and/or Selenium WebDriver
 - Proficiency in TypeScript, Python, or C# (. NET). C# experience is a plus given our existing codebase. 
 - BDD experience (Cucumber, Gherkin, and structured step definitions) is desirable. Familiarity with any major BDD framework is acceptable. 
 - API testing proficiency alongside UI automation
 - Solid understanding of Page Object Model, component-driven design, and reusable test architecture

AI In QA (Hands-On Experience Required)

- You have built or integrated something using LLM APIs in a QA or automation context. Not just used AI as a productivity tool. 
 - Comfortable with prompt engineering. Structuring prompts for test generation, defect summarization, or coverage analysis. 
 - Working understanding of how large language models function, enough to design production-ready integrations that handle real-world conditions

Data And Backend Skills (Must Have)

- Strong SQL skills for querying application databases, validating data across layers, and setting up test data
 - Comfortable working with API testing beyond basic REST calls. Chaining requests, validating payloads, and handling authentication. 

Communication and Ownership

- Clear communicator. You explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and give real feedback in reviews. 
 - Reliable at delivery time. You step up when a release is at risk. 
 - Independent operator. You take direction and return with solutions. 

Engineering Ecosystem (Good to Have)

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps). Good to have, not a hard requirement. We are not heavily invested in CI/CD, so basic working knowledge is enough. 
 - Familiarity with any test management tool (Azure Test Plans or equivalent)
 - Basic understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines
 - Basic understanding of Databricks or similar data platforms

Qualifications

- B. E. / B. Tech / M. Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline
 - 5+ years of QA and test engineering experience with strong hands-on framework development
 - Demonstrable experience implementing AI solutions in a testing or software engineering context. Experimental projects count if you can show what you built and what it delivered. 

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- Has taken ownership of features or workstreams and is delivering quality that stakeholders trust
 - Has contributed reusable automation framework components that other engineers are using
 - Has shipped at least one AI-assisted utility that is helping the team work smarter
 - Is making technical decisions within their area independently and with confidence
 - Is a visible, reliable contributor across QA and engineering conversations

data.description:
About the Role: 

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead Software Development: Take the lead in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements. 
 - Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives. 
 - Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members. 
 - Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process. 
 - Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency. 
 - Application Design: Lead the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards. 
 - Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications. 
 - Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects. 
 - Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development. 
 - Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications. 
 - Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries. 

Skills: 

- Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues. 
 - Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality. 
 - Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++. 
 - Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action. 
 - Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together. 
 - Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality. 
 - Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes. 
 - Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers. 
 - Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and an understanding of database design principles. 
 - APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other. 
 - Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking. 
 - Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. 
 - Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding. 
 - Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency. 

Competencies: 

- Analytical Skills
 - Inclusive Collaboration
 - Drive to Perform
 - Accountability
 - Functional Expertise
 - Operational Expertise

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we're getting to know you-not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

data.title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
data.description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast - and Brings You With It. 

At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn't a slogan - it's how we work. For over 140 years, we've improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions - but how we operate as a company. 

When you join Fuller, you're joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You'll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that's actively expanding - a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. 

If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it - Fuller is where that happens. 

About The Role

For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations: 

engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers. 

As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms - it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts. 

You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle - from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support. 

Your Responsibilities: 

- Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities. 
 - Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies. 
 - Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals. 
 - Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions. 
 - Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability. 
 - Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians. 
 - Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification. 
 - Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform. 
 - Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications. 
 - Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required. 

You bring

- Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes. 
 - Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation. 
 - Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage. 
 - Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis. 
 - Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
 - Willingness to travel (50-70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training. 

As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. 

Application and contact

Please apply by clicking "apply" on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible. 

No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please. 

Build a better world

Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success. 

For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https: //www. fuller-technologies. com/

Role Description

Client Job Title: DFT practice head

UST Job Title: Architect II - VLSI

Who We Are

At UST, we help the world's best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30, 000 employees in over 25 countries, we build for boundless impact-touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at . 

The Opportunity

UST is looking for an experienced DFT Practice Head to lead and grow its Design for Test (DFT) practice. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in DFT methodologies, proven leadership experience, customer-facing capabilities, and a track record of delivering complex SoC/ASIC programs for global semiconductor customers. 

Key Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and drive the overall DFT practice strategy, roadmap, and growth. 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery of DFT projects across multiple customer engagements. 
 - Build, mentor, and manage high-performing DFT engineering teams. 
 - Drive competency development, technical training, and capability-building initiatives. 
 - Engage with customers to understand requirements and provide effective DFT solutions. 
 - Oversee project planning, execution, quality, schedules, resource utilization, and risk management. 
 - Support pre-sales, solution architecture, effort estimation, and proposal preparation.

 - Drive hiring, resource planning, utilization, and career development for the DFT practice. 
 - Manage customer relationships, regular reviews, issue resolution, and overall customer satisfaction. 
 - Drive innovation and evaluate new DFT technologies, methodologies, and EDA tools. 

Required Skills

- Strong expertise in DFT architecture and implementation for complex SoCs/ASICs. 
 - Hands-on experience with Scan Insertion, Scan Compression, MBIST, LBIST, Boundary Scan/JTAG (IEEE 1149. x), ATPG, and Diagnosis. 
 - Strong understanding of RTL Design, Synthesis, STA, and Physical Design flows. 
 - Experience with low-power DFT, test compression, and hierarchical DFT methodologies. 
 - Experience with industry-standard DFT/EDA tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Cadence Modus, and Siemens Tessent.

data.title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
data.description:
Data Engineering Manager

Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role - you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you. 

Who You Are

- A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation - you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard. 
 - You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development - not just code reviews and architectural diagrams. 
 - Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms. 
 - Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design - grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper. 
 - Deep proficiency in SQL and Python - you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself. 
 - Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools. 
 - Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments. 
 - Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices - with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies. 
 - Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code - you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team. 
 - Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs. 

What You'll Do

- Spend a significant portion of your time writing code - building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions. 
 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions. 
 - Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks - selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end. 
 - Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models. 
 - Own critical and complex implementation work - the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team. 
 - Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards. 
 - Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability - not just approval stamps. 
 - Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components. 
 - Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation - by building the reference implementations yourself. 
 - Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration. 
 - Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level. 
 - Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos. 

Preferred Qualifications

- A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew - architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager. 
 - Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself. 
 - Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests. 
 - Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation. 
 - Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination. 

About Riveron

At Riveron, we partner with clients-from global multinationals to high-growth private entities-to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. Job Purpose

The Product Improvement Lead is responsible for leading product design improvement activities arising from feedback on field performance, ease of manufacturing, assembly & testing and ease of installation & retrieval of the product. data.title: Senior QA Engineer with C# / .NET - Contractor in USD
Master Data Quality Manager
data.description:
Company Description DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide. 

Role Description

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation. The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained. 

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose. 

Key responsibilities

1. Data quality monitoring

- Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data. 
 - Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards. 
 - Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions. 
 - Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records. 
 - Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes. 
 - Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement. 

2. Data Cleansing and Remediation

- Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets. 
 - Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies. 
 - Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information. 
 - Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures. 
 - Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status. 
 - Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner. 

3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding

- Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data. 
 - Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment. 
 - Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data. 
 - Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements. 
 - Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions. 
 - Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information. 

4. Data governance and standardization

- Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data. 
 - Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained. 
 - Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality. 
 - Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures. 
 - Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams. 
 - Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation. 

5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support

- Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information. 
 - Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues. 
 - Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records. 
 - Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices. 

6. Reporting and continuous improvement

- Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress. 
 - Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action. 
 - Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes. 
 - Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation. 

Qualifications

- Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline. 
 - Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment. 
 - Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented. 
 - Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records. 
 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically. 
 - Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues. 
 - Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. 
 - Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions. 
 - A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products. 
 - Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases. 
 - Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms. 
 - Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting. 
 - Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes. 
 - Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

Job Description

This is a senior technical lead role that pairs deep platform engineering expertise with the thought leadership needed to bring AI into production operations. The person owns the build, hardening, patching, and lifecycle of the operating system and platform estate, and serves as the top escalation point for complex incidents - while simultaneously identifying where AI and automation can replace manual toil, reduce incident volume, and shorten recovery times. Success depends as much on change leadership as on engineering: shaping standards, winning stakeholder buy-in, and guiding 1st line operations through new AI-enabled ways of working without disrupting service levels. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform engineering depth - packaging and hardening approved OS builds, management agent stacks, patch currency, and configuration standards across the estate
 - AI-driven operations innovation - identifying, piloting, and scaling AI/automation use cases for incident triage, root cause analysis, runbook execution, and predictive monitoring
 - Thought leadership and evangelism - articulating an AI-for-operations vision, authoring white papers and R&D positions, staying ahead of emerging tooling
 - Change management and adoption - driving organizational uptake of new practices, coaching 1st line teams, managing risk and resistance while protecting SLAs
 - Incident, problem, and change discipline - major incident leadership, RCA, and rigorous change control in a regulated production environment
 - Service improvement measurement - instrumenting and evidencing reductions in incident volume and MTTR from process redesign and automation
 - Solution design and implementation planning - translating requirements into physical builds, costed designs, and multi-workstream delivery plans
 - Automation and infrastructure-as-code fluency - scripting, configuration management, and pipeline-driven platform delivery
 - Standards, compliance, and documentation - run books, technical policies, and AI governance/guardrails to document-control standards
 - Cross-functional influence - partnering with architecture, security, development, vendors, and the business to land change. 

Required Qualifications

- Provides a high level of technical and subject matter expertise in one or more technologies and serves as a point of escalation for technical issues related to specialty. 
 - Produces, delivers, and maintains appropriate documentation for systems in accordance document control standards and procedures. 
 - Provide input to records, quality systems and management reports as required
 - Contributes to the definition and implementation of improved operability on new and current systems.

 - Reviews and coordinates the implementation of proposed modifications, and changes to the production environment. 
 - Provides direction into standards and procedures for monitoring, capacity planning, tuning, maintenance, performance optimization, backups and recovery; ensures infrastructure will meet capacity requirements to deliver projects on time. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Provides direction for: proactive health and performance monitoring of databases, indexes and logs, and troubleshooting of reported issues. 
 - Reviews implemented scripts, stored procedures, and reports generated by automated database maintenance scripts. 
 - Participates in the technical design process as it relates to database implementations, reviews technical documents, and communicates any risks or issues using the appropriate escalation procedures. 
 - Provides directions to Technical Recovery plans (Database Standby and Replication, Backup and Recovery). 
 - Platform Engineer:

 - Ensures stack of agents for management systems are properly installed and connected.

 - Storage Engineer: 
 - Provides leadership for storage-related projects, including switch installations, disk consolidations, disk assignments, replication, and more.

What's in it For You?

data.title: SOAR Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

Information Security Engineer Role

Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Python and security automation to join our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be adept at developing and implementing automated security solutions to protect our systems and data, as well as reviewing, validating, and hardening code and workflows produced by AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic systems. This role requires a proactive individual who can work independently and collaboratively to enhance our security posture in an environment where both humans and AI agents write and operate code. In addition, proficiency and experience using a SOAR for automation and security incident response is required. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain security automation scripts and tools using Python to a high standard of reliability and efficiency, including reviewing and hardening code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Integrate security tools and solutions, including developing and managing APIs, to automate security processes and workflows. 

Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential threats. 

Monitor security systems and respond to incidents with automated solutions, implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Tines, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect) to streamline response activities. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement security controls, and write clear technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for tools and processes. 

Govern enterprise use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including tenant restrictions, access scoping, and compliance/audit logging. 

Design and enforce security controls for agentic AI systems, including tool-permission boundaries, prompt injection defenses, and agent identity/access governance. 

Utilise Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for threat detection and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to analyse security data. 

Implement CI/CD pipeline automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) to ensure secure code deployment and infrastructure provisioning. 

Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field. 

Proven experience as a Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on Python and security automation. 

Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing automation scripts and tools, as well as reviewing and validating code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners. 

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes). 

Experience with API development and integration, including RESTful APIs. 

Proficiency in implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect). 

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint security. 

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication, including writing technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience securing AI/LLM-based agentic systems, including prompt injection defense, tool-permission boundaries, and agent identity governance. 

Experience governing enterprise AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), including compliance/audit logging, tenant restrictions, and CI/CD supply-chain hardening against AI-related risks. 

Desirable

Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) for querying and analysing security data. 

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or GIAC. 

Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). 

Understanding of network protocols and security architecture. 

Familiarity with the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e. g. , tool misuse, agentic supply-chain risk, unexpected code execution, human-agent trust exploitation). 

Experience with AI red-teaming and evaluation methodologies for agentic and LLM-based systems. 

Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and other agent-tool integration risks. 

Skills

AI Security, Python, Cloud Security, IDS/IPS, LLMs, Vulnerability Assessment, SOAR, Container Security, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

data.title: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation
data.description:
Company: Upstox

Location: Bengaluru

Work arrangement: 5 days in the office

Function: Insurance - B2B Sales (SDR / Lead Generation team)

About Upstox

At Upstox, we're building the future of investing - simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast - we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place. 

The Role: Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager - B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you'll own the top of this funnel - building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month. 

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you'll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you. 

What You'll Own

Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management

- Lead management framework: Design and own the end-to-end framework - sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads. 
 - Ideal customer profile: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data. 
 - Outreach playbooks: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events. 
 - Renewal-cycle planning: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates. 

Target Account List Building

- Target list: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership. 
 - Research & data tools: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data. 
 - Data hygiene & prioritisation: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert. 

Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team

- Qualified pipeline: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month. 
 - Monthly targets: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals. 
 - Feedback loop: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly. 

Team Leadership & Motivation

- Hiring & training: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e. g. , Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life). 
 - Targets & reviews: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards. 
 - Coaching & culture: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture. 

Individual Contribution

- Personal target: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - CXO outreach: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team. 
 - Lead from the front: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate. 

Tools, Reporting & Analytics

- Lead management stack: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team. 
 - Dashboards & MIS: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement. 
 - Data-led allocation: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaboration: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering. 

How Success Is Measured

- Qualified leads delivered: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target. 
 - Meetings held: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker. 
 - Funnel conversion: Lead → meeting → proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel. 
 - Team productivity: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week. 
 - Self-outreach target: The Manager's personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set. 
 - Data quality: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records.
