data.title: Manager Account Analytics
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive. 

How You'll Make An Impact

The Manager, Account Analytics Development is a hands-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team - today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you. 

We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists. 

What You'll Build

Interpretation. Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business-relevant interpretation - what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization. 

Client knowledge. A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilon's relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki. 

Media investment planning. Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning - putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

Architecture and Systems Design

- Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning. 
 - Design evaluation before you design the solution. Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop. 
 - Establish the engineering standards - source control, testing, documentation, deployment - that let a three-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later. 

Hands-On Delivery

- Write production code. 
 - Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded. 
 - Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them. 

Team Leadership

- Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level. 
 - Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review. 
 - Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to. 
 - Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team. 

Business Partnership

- Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage - and where they do not. 
 - Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non-technical partners. 
 - Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client-facing workflows and have to keep working. 
 - Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights

Qualifications

- 8+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects. 
 - Strong Python and advanced SQL. You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM-based systems in production - agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs - not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone. 
 - Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as "interpret this analysis" and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did. 
 - A considered point of view on evaluating non-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it. 
 - Working familiarity with marketing measurement - attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance - sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output. 
 - Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. 

Additional Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Preferred Technical Experience

- Agentic development environments - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar - used as a daily working tool rather than tried once. 
 - Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms. 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice. 
 - Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow. 
 - Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms. 
 - Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background. 
 - Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints. 

How You Work

- You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to. 
 - You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it. 
 - You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands. 

Additional Information

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. 

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9, 000 employees around the world. 

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. 

- People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other. 
 - Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals. 
 - Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement. 
 - Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches. 
 - Flexibility: We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively. 

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers. 

- Act with integrity
 - Work together to win together
 - Innovate with purpose
 - Respect all voices
 - Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose. 

Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

The Experience

The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution - acting as both a Strategist, shaping the long-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an Orchestrator, coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.

 - Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.

 - Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution - ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects. 
 - Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints. 
 - Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts. 
 - Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI-first design principles.

 - Own end-to-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness. 
 - Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost-efficiency, security posture). 
 - Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.

 - Strong grasp of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.

Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

data.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. 

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. 

ROLE

Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and validation of advanced 3D NAND products. Establish whether silicon meets design intent and datasheet requirements, correlate simulation with measurements, and resolve issues that could affect product qualification, reliability, yield, or SSD/system integration. 

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop end-to-end expertise across advanced NAND products, spanning circuit design concepts, mixed-signal simulations, first-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, product qualification, and manufacturing readiness. Engineers gain broad exposure to analog, mixed-signal, digital, firmware, memory-array, and system-level behavior while working closely with design, verification, firmware, product, and system teams. 

Responsibilities

- Own validation strategies, coverage, and test plans for assigned NAND circuits and functions; define expected behavior, operating corners, and pass/fail criteria from product specifications and design intent. 
 - Lead first-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and simulation-to-silicon correlation across voltage, temperature, process, timing, and workload conditions. 
 - Characterize and debug NAND subsystems including reference and bias generation circuits, bandgap references, oscillators, voltage regulators, charge pumps, sensing and page-buffer paths, high-voltage program/erase circuitry, memory-core drivers, control and timing logic, interface circuitry, trim and calibration functions, and firmware-controlled mixed-signal features. 
 - Investigate silicon failures with Design, Verification, Firmware, Test, Reliability, Product Engineering, and SSD/System teams. Form evidence-based hypotheses, design targeted experiments, identify root causes, and drive issues to verified closure through hardware, firmware, test-flow, trim, or workaround solutions. 
 - Convert silicon observations into engineering insight and product decisions by explaining deviations from expected behavior, assessing risk, recommending next actions, reviewing validation evidence, mentoring engineers, and improving reusable validation and debug methodologies. 
 - Proven ability to leverage AI‐assisted (vibe) coding techniques to improve efficiency or automate design and analysis methodologies
 - Leverage AI tools to automate the tools and workflowApplying Artificial Intelligence in workflows to improve build efficiency

Required Qualifications

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field, with experience appropriate to the approved Senior Staff/Principal level. 
 - Strong analog and mixed-signal fundamentals with substantial experience in at least one of the following: 
 - Mixed-signal verification
 - Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design
 - Post-silicon validation and characterization
 - Memory validation
 - Experience with mixed-signal simulation environments, including full-chip, block-level, pre-layout, or post-layout simulations. 
 - Familiarity with Verilog/System-Verilog-based simulation and debug environments. 
 - Ability to derive tests from specifications, assess coverage, debug complex circuit behavior, and explain differences between expected and observed results. 
 - Experience with validation, characterization, data analysis, scripting, or automation using tools such as Python. 
 - Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- NAND Flash, SSD, DRAM, or other memory technology experience, including program/read/erase operations, sensing architectures, bias generation, charge pumps, timing/control circuits, reliability characterization, or system-level integration. 
 - Experience with System-Verilog, Verilog-AMS, real-number modeling, SPICE, assertions, functional coverage, or simulation-to-silicon correlation methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, probe stations, source measurement units (SMUs), semiconductor parameter analyzers, automated test equipment (ATE), or similar silicon characterization platforms.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform and Infrastructure
data.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected OperationsTM Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Platform & Infrastructure organization, which is responsible for building foundational systems that drive software products. Examples include areas such as Reporting/Automations/Enterprise capabilities to support our rapidly growing footprint of customers and foundational infrastructure capabilities such as container orchestration/data storage/real-time data ingestion/GraphQL execution to power Samsara engineering. 

As a Staff Engineer at Samsara, you will help us spearhead the technical direction for the organization, be a technical leader that brings fresh ideas and expertise to guide the team's technical design and architecture and enable increasingly complex features and customer use cases. You will work on specific projects critical to Samsara's needs alongside other highly-skilled Samsara engineers and push Samsara's technical capabilities forward.   

This role is hybrid - 3 days per week in the office. Office address: PRESTIGE TECH PARK, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103, India

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 - You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. 
 - You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. 
 - You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win-together. In this role, you will:   

- Drive technology choices, implementing services, and/or establishing architectural patterns that have a broad and lasting impact on Samsara's platform
 - Identify opportunities and initiate strategic conversations to influence the direction of platform technology and engineering culture
 - Architect, design, and develop software that enables Samsara to operate at scale
 - Lead teams in delivering products and capabilities that contribute to Samsara's products and revenue
 - Deliver impact by solving the hardest technical problems and enabling products to reach the market quickly and successfully with high quality
 - Keep a platform-first approach while collaborating with our infrastructure and product teams to build products, tools, and solutions. 
 - Act as a multiplier for the team, elevating the impact and output of every team member
 - Contribute to Samsara's engineering brand by representing Samsara in external-facing forums
 - Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new officesMinimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience
 - 12+ years of experience in software design, development, and algorithm-related solutions with at least 4 of those years in an architect or leadership role
 - Stellar programming/coding fundamentals
 - 4+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems
 - 4+ years of experience leading cross-organization projects
 - Expertise working with web services at a massive scale deployed on Cloud providers such as AWS, GCP or AzureAn ideal candidate also: 

- Has 15+ years of relevant industry experience in software development
 - Enjoys leading and mentoring engineers to think about systems - their life cycles, edge cases, and failure modes
 - Enjoys fostering collaboration among engineers with different focuses (frontend, mobile, firmware, vision, ML)
 - Is an expert in writing high-quality, performant, and maintainable code in a modern programming language
 - Production experience working with Javascript and/or client-side code
 - Expertise working on large-scale enterprise software applications
 - Demonstrated ability to ship production-quality software in a dynamic environment
 - Expert-level knowledge of at-scale stream-processing decision engines

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 

Flexible Working  

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. 

Accommodations  

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara. com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. 

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. 

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara. com, @us-greenhouse-mail. io or @mail3. guide. co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here.

data.title: Elixir Developer
data.description:
About Jetbro
Jetbro is a technology consulting and systems integration firm that builds reliable, scalable digital systems for organizations where technology is central to operations. We work across custom product development, enterprise applications, and infrastructure-led digital transformation for clients ranging from Fortune 500 companies to high-growth startups across India, Australia, and Canada. 

Our philosophy is simple: build systems that work quietly, predictably, and under pressure. We value clarity over complexity and reliability over noise. 
About the Role
We are looking for an Elixir Developer to join our team building backend services for scalable, production-grade applications. This is not a role where you simply execute PRDs. Instead, you will be a business-minded engineer who deeply understands the product use cases, business objectives, and strategic implications of technical decisions. 

You will design and extend backend services using the Ash Framework, working across resources, actions, and data layers to ship features fast without sacrificing correctness. Our backend is Elixir/Phoenix with Ash as the core application framework, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on Fly. io. You will spend most of your time inside Ash's resource-oriented patterns rather than hand-rolling boilerplate. 

This is a framework-deep role with a business-first mindset. You will actively collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and leadership to understand the why behind features, ask clarifying questions, and contribute to strategic technical decisions. You will use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as everyday tools, and you'll also work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) to build AI-powered features, not just use AI to write code. We expect you to be proficient with them, not just familiar. 
Key Responsibilities
Business & Product Collaboration: 

- Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases, market context, and business objectives before diving into technical implementation

- Ask critical questions about business impact, trade-offs, and long-term implications of technical decisions

- Communicate technical constraints, risks, and opportunities in business-friendly language to non-technical stakeholders

- Contribute to architectural and strategic decisions by providing context on how technical choices affect business outcomes 
 Technical Design & Development: 

- Design and build Ash resources, actions, calculations, and policies for core product features with a deep understanding of their business purpose

- Write clean, testable Elixir code following OTP and Phoenix conventions

- Build interactive, real-time UI where needed using Phoenix LiveView

- Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and query performance with business scalability in mind

- Build and extend APIs (GraphQL/REST via AshGraphql/AshJsonApi or Phoenix controllers) that serve real production traffic 
 AI & Advanced Features: 

- Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) and vector databases into product features (semantic search, embeddings, retrieval-based workflows)

- Use AI coding assistants effectively to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality

- Understand the business implications of AI-powered features and their impact on user experience and product strategy 
 Operations & Ownership: 

- Instrument features with product analytics (PostHog) to track usage and inform iteration

- Maintain Docker-based dev containers for a consistent, reproducible local development setup

- Deploy, monitor, and scale services on Fly. io

- Own features end-to-end: from understanding requirements and business context to deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement

- Participate in production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning with an eye toward business impact 
 Team & Process: 

- Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, product managers, and project leads in a cross-functional environment

- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions with a focus on business value

- Champion clear thinking and ownership mindset within the engineering team 
 What You'll Work On

- Resource-driven backend architecture using Ash (resources, actions, relationships, policies, calculations, aggregates)

- Workflow logic, versioning, and multi-step business processes modeled declaratively in Ash

- Real-time, interactive features built with Phoenix LiveView

- Vector DB-backed features such as semantic search, embeddings storage, and retrieval-augmented workflows

- Background jobs and async processing (Oban or similar)

- Database design, query optimization, and migrations in PostgreSQL

- Integration with third-party services and internal microservices

- Local development standardized via Docker and dev containers

- Deployment, release management, and scaling on Fly. io

- Production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning 
 Tech Stack

- Languages: Elixir

- Frameworks: Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Ash Framework (AshPostgres, AshGraphql/AshJsonApi, Ash Authentication as applicable)

- Databases: PostgreSQL, Vector DB (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)

- AI/LLM: Claude, Gemini (API-level integration), Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

- Analytics: PostHog

- Infrastructure: Fly. io, Docker, Dev Containers, CI/CD pipelines

- Other: Oban/background jobs, GraphQL/REST APIs, Git

Requirements

Who is this Role for?
This role is a great fit if you: 

Technical Foundation: 

- Have hands-on experience with Elixir, and specifically the Ash Framework (not just Phoenix alone)

- Understand Ash's resource/action/policy model well enough to extend it, not just follow existing patterns

- Have built real-time or interactive features with Phoenix LiveView

- Have worked with vector databases and understand embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval patterns

- Have integrated LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) into production features, not just used them as coding tools

- Are comfortable using product analytics tools like PostHog to inform engineering decisions\

- Are comfortable working in Docker-based dev container environments

- Have experience deploying and operating applications on Fly. io (or similar platforms)

- Actively use AI coding assistants and understand their strengths and limits

- Care about writing code that other people can read and maintain 
 Business & Collaboration Mindset: 

- Genuinely enjoy understanding the business context behind features, not just executing specifications

- Are comfortable asking "why" and challenging assumptions to ensure decisions align with business goals

- Have experience collaborating with product, business, and non-technical stakeholders

- Can translate between technical and business language effectively

- Enjoy working on systems that serve real users at real scale and care about user impact

- Demonstrate ownership mindset: you think about long-term implications, not just shipping code

- Learn fast and don't need to be told twice

- Are curious about how your work affects the broader business and product strategy 
 What we care more about than your resume

- Real Ash Framework experience > general Elixir/Phoenix experience alone

- Business acumen and product thinking > years of experience

- Communication and collaboration skills > individual technical prowess

- AI-fluency (both as a coding tool and as a feature you build) > years of experience

- Clear thinking and strategic mindset > buzzwords

- Ownership mindset and business impact focus > following instructions

- Side projects, experiments, GitHub repos, or well-documented failures are a big plus 
 Bonus

- Experience with AshAdmin, AshStateMachine, or AshPaperTrail

- Experience building RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipelines

- Exposure to observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, or similar)

- Experience in product-driven or cross-functional engineering environments

- Familiarity with Specification-Driven Development (SDD) or similar methodologies

Benefits

Growth at Jetbro
If you do well, this role can grow into: 

- Senior Backend Engineer

- Platform / Infrastructure Engineer

- System Architect (longer term) 
 We invest heavily in people who invest in learning.

data.title: Sr. AI Specialist
data.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. 

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. 

We are seeking a Senior AI Transformation Lead to drive the adoption and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our software engineering organization. This role will lead the transformation of how our teams design, develop, test, deploy, and operate a cloud-based oncology SaaS platform deployed on AWS and used by cancer patients, clinicians, and healthcare providers worldwide. 

The successful candidate will partner with Engineering, Product, Quality Assurance, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Leadership teams to implement AI-enabled software development practices, improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance software quality, and establish AI governance in a regulated medical device environment. 

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role requiring deep understanding of modern software engineering, AI technologies, developer productivity, quality engineering, and organizational change management. 

The product is Siemens Healthineers ́s cloud-based software solution for patient relationships and care navigation management. It's designed to connect cancer patients with their clinics online throughout the entire cancer journey. The product used by 35 000+ active cancer patients and healthcare professionals from leading oncology centers in North America and Europe. The candidate in this role will provide strong product development leadership to a team of software engineers and test engineers, working in an agile/scrum environment. 

Job Description

Position Duties: 

- Define and execute the AI transformation roadmap for the software engineering organization. 
 - Define KPIs and success metrics to measure AI adoption and business impact. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools and workflows across engineering teams. 
 - Enable developers to leverage AI for coding, code reviews, documentation, debugging, refactoring, architecture design, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Integrate AI capabilities into the development lifecycle for Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Angular, and mobile application development. 
 - Lead adoption of AI-powered testing and quality engineering practices. 
 - Drive AI-assisted test generation, regression analysis, defect prediction, and release risk assessment. 
 - Drive AI adoption across CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, incident management, and operational workflows. 
 - Implement AI-assisted root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and operational intelligence. 
 - Evaluate and implement AI platforms, frameworks, and tooling. 
 - Partner with Architects and Engineering teams to define scalable AI integration patterns. 
 - Support development of internal AI assistants and engineering productivity solutions

Qualifications Required

BE, MSc, MCA, Computer Science or related discipline. 

Number of year's related experience 8-12 years

Required

Special Knowledge / Skills: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3 years driving AI, engineering productivity, developer experience, or technology transformation initiatives. 
 - Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI-assisted software development tools. 
 - Hands-on experience with software technologies such as Java, Kotlin, Python, Spring Boot, Angular, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience working with AWS cloud environments and modern DevOps practices. 
 - Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, vector databases, RAG architectures, MCP, AI agents, and prompt engineering. 

Nice To Have

- Experience leading AI transformation initiatives in large software engineering organizations. 
 - Experience developing healthcare products conforming quality system regulations. 
 - Experience in healthcare domain and medical interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7
 - Certifications from AWS or Azure

Who we are: We are a team of more than 72, 000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

data.title: Software Development Engineer - BackEnd (Staff - Level 4) , IND
data.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.     

  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

  

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

About our Team
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You will Do

  

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
 - Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
 - Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
 - Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
 - Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
 - Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
 - Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
 - Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
 - Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
 - Stay hands-on with coding and system design
 - Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
 - Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements  

What We're Looking For

Technical

  

- 8-12 years of backend engineering experience
 - Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
 - Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
 - Strong coding and problem-solving abilityBeyond the technical bar: 

  

- A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks - initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
 - Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
 - Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
 - Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help  

Nice to Have

  

- Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
 - Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
 - Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
 - Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments  

    

  Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview - click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.   

  

Discover more about working at Agoda
 - Agoda Careers  https: //careersatagoda. com
 - Facebook  https: //www. facebook. com/agodacareers/
 - LinkedIn  https: //www. linkedin. com/company/agoda
 - YouTube  https: //www. youtube. com/agodalife  

Equal Opportunity Employer  

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics. 

We  will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy. 

Disclaimer

We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency's representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

Bangalore

We are seeking a Digital Design professional with deep expertise in high-performance controller and bridge design, micro-architecture, RTL implementation, and IP integration. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in the development of cutting-edge connectivity solutions. 

SoC Design Director

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

We provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, We enable organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. ' Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALinkTM semiconductor-based technologies with the company's COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company's custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. 

Job Title: SoC Design Director

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated SoC Design Manager to lead a team of engineers responsible for the design and development of next-generation System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in digital design, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record of delivering complex SoC projects from architecture through silicon.

 - Experience of working with DFT, PD, DV teams to solve critical technical challenges of cross-domain nature
 - Experience of working on PCIE, UCIE, UALink, Ethernet products is highly desirable.

data.description:
Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

AI Agent Orchestration Engineer

About Us

Majesco isn't just riding the AI wave - we're leading it for the P&C, L&AH, and Pension & Retirement markets. Born in the cloud and built with an AI-native vision, we've reimagined the insurance and pension core as an intelligent platform that enables insurers and pension & retirement providers to move faster, see farther, and operate smarter. 

As leaders in intelligent SaaS solutions, we've embedded AI and Agentic AI throughout our product portfolio of core, underwriting, loss control, distribution, digital solutions, and pension & retirement administration. Our solutions help customers reimagine their businesses with real-time insights, optimized operations, and enhanced outcomes. 

At Majesco, you'll collaborate with experienced leaders and global teams building and scaling AI-native solutions that solve complex, real-world challenges. If you're looking for a place where your expertise is trusted, your judgment is valued, and your work helps define what's next for intelligent insurance and retirement technology, Majesco is where that work happens. 

Job Summary

We are looking for an AI Agent Orchestration Engineer to design, build, and scale reliable graph-based AI agents and tools. The role combines strong Python engineering with LangChain and LangGraph expertise, deep understanding of Majesco AI Core architecture, robust tool development, and disciplined prompt engineering. 

You will work across typed state management, schema validation, graph orchestration, agent and tool registries, API integrations, persistence, and human-in-the-loop workflows. You will help transform complex business requirements into production-ready, observable, and governable agentic experiences. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement typed agent state, schemas, data contracts, and validation using Python and Pydantic. 
 - Build LangChain and LangGraph workflows with conditional branching, parallel task execution, retries, sub-agents, checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop approvals. 
 - Develop and extend Majesco AI Core integrations using GraphExecutor, ExecutorFactory, ToolResolver, Agent Registry, Tool Registry, and MajescoCheckpointer. 
 - Design and implement reusable asynchronous tools, including API integrations, authentication, request/response handling, error recovery, registration, and database metadata. 
 - Create reliable graph-agent execution patterns that support modularity, testability, observability, and operational resilience. 
 - Design, test, version, document, and govern system, routing, tool-use, validation, and response prompts. 
 - Partner with product, engineering, QA, and domain teams to translate business needs into scalable AI-agent capabilities. 
 - Investigate production issues, improve failure handling and execution quality, and contribute to engineering standards for agentic systems. 

Essential Attributes & Capabilities

- Strong Python development skills, including asynchronous programming, type-safe design, testing, and maintainable software practices. 
 - Strong understanding of stateful workflows, schemas, validation, error handling, retries, and distributed task execution. 
 - Ability to reason about complex agent workflows and convert them into clear, modular, and observable graph designs. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a quality-first and "do it right the first time" mindset. 
 - Self-driven, highly motivated, outcome-focused, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams and work within agile software development cycles. 
 - Strong interest in automation, reusable components, engineering productivity, and continuous improvement. 
 - Sound judgment when designing guardrails, validation logic, human approvals, and fallback behavior for AI systems. 

Technical Expertise

- Python, asynchronous programming, type hints, Pydantic models, schema design, and validation. 
 - LangChain and LangGraph, including state graphs, nodes, edges, conditional routing, parallel execution, retries, sub-agents, checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop workflows. 
 - Majesco AI Core architecture and components, including GraphExecutor, ExecutorFactory, ToolResolver, Agent Registry, Tool Registry, and MajescoCheckpointer. 
 - Asynchronous tool development, API integration, authentication and authorization, structured inputs and outputs, error handling, logging, and resilience patterns. 
 - Tool and agent registration, database metadata, configuration management, and integration with enterprise services. 
 - Prompt engineering across system, routing, tool-use, validation, and response prompts, including prompt testing, versioning, evaluation, and governance. 
 - Unit, integration, and workflow testing for graph-based agent systems. 
 - Git-based development, code reviews, debugging, documentation, and agile delivery practices. 

Preferred Qualification & Experience

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Professional experience building Python-based backend services, workflow systems, AI applications, or agentic solutions. 
 - Hands-on experience developing production-grade applications with LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable orchestration frameworks. 
 - Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications, including structured outputs, tool calling, prompt evaluation, and guardrails. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, OAuth or token-based authentication, asynchronous service integrations, and relational or document databases. 
 - Experience with observability, automated testing, CI/CD, and troubleshooting distributed or stateful workflows. 
 - Exposure to insurance, financial services, SaaS platforms, or enterprise product development is desirable.

 - Mentor and coach engineers on best practices for building scalable, resilient integrations, fostering a culture of technical excellence. 
 - Champion Agile practices within the team, driving iterative delivery and continuous improvement. 

What You Bring: 

- 7+ years of proven experience designing and building enterprise-scale SaaS platforms, with solid exposure to distributed backend systems. 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in Java, RESTful APIs, and OLTP databases. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture, microservices, and industry best practices for operating at large scale. 
 - Passionate about AI-powered automation and curious about how agentic approaches can transform enterprise workflows. 
 - Experience building, supporting, and optimizing production systems, with a proven track record of identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks. 
 - Proficiency in enterprise-scale monitoring and observability using modern tooling. 
 - Ability to balance pragmatism with vision, delivering incremental value today while laying the foundation for future scale. 
 - Demonstrated success in fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, accountability, and customer focus. 
 - Strong ability to identify gaps in requirements, evaluate alternatives, and guide your team through ambiguity. 
 - Thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments and can rally teams around complex technical missions. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills, with comfort engaging cross-functional stakeholders at all levels. 

Added Advantage: 

- Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI-native products. 
 - Prior experience building a CRM or integrating with enterprise CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot. 

What makes us who we are: 

- We are Globally Local: With a diverse team across four continents and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood. 
 - We value Curiosity: We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it's that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, figure out answers to them, and foster a continuous learning environment. 
 - Customer! Customer! Customer!: Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers' growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It's a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.     

  

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

  

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

  

About our Team
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You will Do

  

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
 - Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
 - Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
 - Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
 - Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
 - Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
 - Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes

 - Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
 - Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements

Technical

 - Strong coding and problem-solving abilityBeyond the technical bar: 

  

- A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks - initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told

 - Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
 - Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

- Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
 - Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

 - Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines

data.title: QA/QC ENGINEER LECTRONICS
data.description:
ABOUT US: 

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India's first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing. 

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don't just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you'll be fuelling the future of space exploration. 

JOB SUMMARY: 

We are looking for a passionate QA/QC Engineer - Electronics to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware. 

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Quality Assurance Leadership: Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices. 
 - Design Phase Integration: Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design. 
 - Reliability & Circuit Analysis: Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities. 
 - AIT & Environmental Compliance: Review and validate environmental qualification test results-including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing-and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP). 
 - Audit & Configuration Control: Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control. 
 - Non-Conformance Management: Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing. 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR?

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems. 
 - Standards & Compliance: Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles. 
 - Technical Expertise: Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills. 
 - Methodologies: Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks. 
 - Core Competencies: Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes. 
 - Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices. 
 - Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads. 
 - Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt). 

WHY JOIN US?

- Pioneering Impact: Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit. 
 - End-to-End Exposure: Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness. 
 - Innovation Culture: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment. 
 - Career Growth: Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world's largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo's automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700, 000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust. 

Simplicity at Scale. 

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you'd like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we'd like to talk to you. 

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Senior Engineering Manager join our growing global team at Sectigo. 

The Senior Engineering Manager will build and drive integration engineering capability from our India GCC. This team owns our engineering-led approach to third-party and platform integrations, starting with our ServiceNow implementation and a new pilot integrating PSA (Professional Services Automation) marketplace platforms into our core platform. This leader is genuinely AI-native by integrating AI tools daily in how we code, test, document, and make decisions. 

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: 

- Define team structure and hiring plan for a new Integration Engineering org in Chennai. 
 - Own a blended workforce model: manage specialized consultants and a contracting team, with a contract-to-hire approach as the default and direct hiring for key roles where warranted. 
 - Recruit, onboard, and develop engineers; set the technical bar and team culture from day one. Own integration engineering delivery
 - Take ownership of the ServiceNow workstream already underway, including a candid retrospective on what hasn't worked so far. 
 - Stand up the engineering model for the Pax8/ConnectWise marketplace/PSA integration pilot, in partnership with specialized consultants and the core platform team. 
 - Build this into a repeatable capability as the integration portfolio grows beyond these two initiatives. Define the operating model with core platform engineering
 - Partner directly with the core platform engineering leadership to define architecture and integration patterns, required APIs/workflows, source-code access boundaries, development standards, and the technical point-of-contact model between teams. 
 - Push for a model where the core platform team focuses on the platform and exposes clean APIs/capabilities, while your team builds and owns integrations on top not one where core teams build every integration themselves. Lead as an AI-native engineering manager
 - Use AI tools yourself, day to day for design exploration, code review, testing, documentation, and even parts of people/project management and set that as the visible norm for the team, not an optional add-on. 
 - Build documentation, API contracts, and integration patterns that are discoverable and usable by AI agents, not just humans. 
 - Create an engineering environment where AI increasingly assists with implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and knowledge transfer this is a core operating principle for the org from day one, not a future aspiration. 
 - Actively evaluate and introduce new AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows as they emerge, rather than waiting for direction from above. Operate as a proactive, senior engineering leader
 - Work through ambiguity: propose structure, process, and scope rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. 
 - Partner closely with Product for visibility and alignment, while keeping engineering ownership and decision-making inside engineering. 
 - Provide regular updates, risks, and recommendations to senior (US-based) engineering leadership, including workforce and contract-to-hire decisions. 
 - Maintain meaningful overlap with US working hours for real-time collaboration with distributed stakeholders, architects, and product partners. 
 - Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: 

- This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week. 
 - This individual may manage a team and will be reporting directly to our General Manager, Chennai Center of Excellence. 
 - The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 55, 00, 000 LPA and INR 75, 00, 000 LPA. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends. 

Qualifications

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or Engineering; platform or vendor certifications (e. g. , ServiceNow, cloud platform, or API-management certifications) is strongly recommended. Experience: 

- Minimum 8+ years in software, systems, or integration engineering, including experience directly managing engineers (as an EM, or as a senior/staff engineer with clear, demonstrable people leadership experience) is required. 
 - Track record of building or scaling a team from the ground up ideally in a GCC, global captive, or new-site environment, not just growing an existing, well-defined team. 
 - Hands-on design and administration of API/integration platforms ServiceNow, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Azure Integration Services, or comparable including workflow, connector, and access design is required. 
 - Familiarity with the PSA (Professional Services Automation) ecosystem tools like ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, or similar and how MSPs/partners consume vendor integrations through them. 
 - Integration design fundamentals: API contract design, data mapping and transformation, authentication patterns, and designing clean ownership boundaries and handoffs between systems and teams. 
 - AI-native, hands-on daily, practical use of AI tools in your own workflow (AI coding assistants, agentic dev tools, AI for documentation/testing), with the disposition to keep learning as the tooling changes, in line with our AI-DLC direction. 
 - ITSM/ticketing and collaboration tooling ServiceNow (or an equivalent ITSM tool) and the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) for engineering workflow, tracking, and documentation. 
 - Experience operating in environments with formal change management, compliance requirements, and high security standards (e. g. , SOC 2, ISO 27001) directly relevant given Sectigo's security/PKI domain. 
 - Genuine comfort with ambiguity able to create structure, process, and scope where none exists yet, without needing constant top-down direction. 
 - Ability to establish priorities and work independently with minimal supervision across time zones, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (e. g. , available into the evening IST for standups, architecture reviews, and leadership syncs). 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across time zones, functions, and seniority levels. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: 

- An established practice of using an AI assistant inside your engineering workflow change review, log analysis, documentation drafting. 
 - Relational databases and reporting/BI tools; directory services and access management (Active Directory or equivalent); general network and security concepts relevant to integration architecture. 
 - PKI and certificate management particularly relevant given Sectigo's core business. 
 - Prior experience setting up or leading a team inside a Global Capability Center (GCC) in India. 
 - Experience with contract-to-hire staffing models specifically in the India market. 
 - Broader background in cybersecurity or certificate/identity infrastructure. 

Additional Information

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate. 

Our "One Sectigo" culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo: 

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage. 

Global team. Global reach. Global impact.

data.title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
data.description:
Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)

About The Role

What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress-test AI-powered applications and infrastructure - identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do. 

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale. 

- Organization: Alignerr
 - Type: Hourly Contract
 - Location: Remote
 - Commitment: 10-40 hours/week

What You'll Do

- Conduct penetration tests against AI-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
 - Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
 - Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry-standard tools and methodologies
 - Simulate real-world attack scenarios - from reconnaissance through exploitation and post-exploitation
 - Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
 - Evaluate AI-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
 - Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
 - Work independently on task-based engagements on your own schedule

Who You Are

- Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK)
 - Proficient with industry-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
 - Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
 - Able to think like an attacker - creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
 - Strong written communication skills - you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
 - Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
 - Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments

Nice to Have

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
 - Experience with AI/ML security testing - adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red-teaming
 - Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
 - Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
 - Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
 - Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
 - Experience conducting security assessments in compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc. )

Why Join Us

- Work on cutting-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
 - Fully remote and flexible - work when and where it suits you
 - Freelance autonomy with access to high-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
 - Be at the forefront of AI security - a rapidly growing field with massive demand
 - Sharpen your skills against novel AI-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
 - Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
 - Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
